Eventually, Vayne agreed with Marr's sentiment and, in a way, assigned her to the mission. After being "assigned," Marr was frozen in carbonite and placed aboard their stolen Sheathipede -class transport shuttle alongside Drayden, Kade, and the replicas. As they approached Lola Sayu , the planet the Citadel was housed upon, Commandant Osi Sobeck , the warden of the prison, grew increasingly suspicious of their true cargo and ordered for his droids to scan for lifeforms. However, after doing a full scan of the ship, the scanners came up empty, showing that the Republic's ruse had worked. As they arrived on the planet, the shuttle deviated from where it was assigned to land, choosing instead to hide within the volcanic canyons of the planet and unload their "cargo."

title: Sela Marr
text: As Marr was unfrozen, Drayden passingly acknowledged her presence before realizing that Marr wasn't supposed to be on the assignment. As Kade woke up alongside him, he noted that he believed he must have been given carbon sickness as he was seeing Marr was with them. In response, Drayden confirmed to him that his sight was fine and that Marr's hearing was the thing that needed assistance instead. In defense, Marr explained that she had received orders from Vayne and that she thought he had known about it. Drayden grew more disgruntled with her as he told her that Vayne had not told him about her joining the mission, which Marr followed up by saying that he had already been in carbonite when the decision had been made. Pointing at Marr, he once again informed her that he had specifically told her not to come, but Marr defended herself by saying that Drayden had taught her that following direct orders wasn't always the right decision. With that, Kade walked over and commented on Drayden's teaching style before welcoming Marr to the mission, leading Marr to smile. After Kade's inquiry, the discussion ended.

title: Sela Marr
text: Before departing for the facility, Marr had a discussion with one of the 212th troopers accompanying them as CC-2224 "Cord" was preparing his backpack . Once Cord finished preparing his pack, the two made their way to the cliff surrounding the Citadel. Arriving at a safe distance to avoid detection, Kade and Drayden stopped to survey the cliff they were intending to climb in order to make their way to an entry point into the Citadel. Kade suggested that they use ascension cables, but was met with disapproval from Drayden as he noted the electromines dotting the cliff face and that the ascension cables would have nothing to grab onto without hitting the electromines, which would notify the entire prison of their presence. With this, Vek suggested that they freeclimb it which was met with approval from both Kade and Drayden as the group continued their journey to the Citadel.

title: Sela Marr
text: The group soon began to climb the cliff face during which Drayden asked how Marr was doing during her climb to which Marr simply said that she couldn't be better, but noted that the strong winds were providing a challenge. As they continued their climb, Kade traveled up to the platform where the entry point the group wished to enter through was located, but was stopped when several droids appeared through the entry point, forcing him to tell the rest of the group to remain silent, causing them to briefly pause their climb. #### Captured at Feldora

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Captured at Feldora

> " You already did everything you could. Every thing you had to do. When I was out there, alone, all I had was your training and the lessons you taught me. And because of you, I did survive. And not only that, I was able to lead others to survive as well. " ―Sela Marr to Kael Drayden Marr would travel with Drayden, Vayne, and their respective troops to another engagement on Feldora. In a pincer movement, Marr took Replica Corporal " Comet " and several other troopers around the wall of a Dissident facility. As the replicas scaled the wall with grappling hooks, Marr guarded the rear. However, when she tried to follow the troopers up the wall, she was captured in a stun net by the Trandoshan Lo-Taren . He placed her in a cage on a prisoner ship . Marr and multiple other prisoners were dropped on Island Four on the jungle moon Wasskah , where members of a Trandoshan hunting guild would hunt them for sport. Marr survived the night and met up with a trio of former Aetheri younglings, Kalifa , Jinx , and O-Mer . She joined their small band that worked hard to survive but had already lost hope of any kind of escape. Marr tried to convince them that they should be more proactive in their attempts to make it off of the moon, but Kalifa told her that there had been Adepts like her in the past that got themselves killed. Glumly, Marr settled in on the group's routine

title: Sela Marr
text: kind of escape. Marr tried to convince them that they should be more proactive in their attempts to make it off of the moon, but Kalifa told her that there had been Adepts like her in the past that got themselves killed. Glumly, Marr settled in on the group's routine of staying on the move during the day and returning to a hiding place to rest at night. However, Marr's constant energy and belief began to convince the other Aetheri to have hope of eventual escape or rescue. As they worked to discover where the Trandoshan's base was, O-Mer noticed their Ubrikkian Floating Fortress in the air. The group was immediately attacked by several hunters, forcing them to split up. Marr broke off from the group with Kalifa and defended her after she was wounded by Dar . Using her more advanced abilities, she fended off Dar and eventually sent him plummeting to his death. Unfortunately, as she helped Kalifa rise to her feet, she was shot by Dar's father, Garnac , who was also the leader of the hunters. Howling in anger, Garnac continued to fire at Marr as Kalifa slumped against a tree, mortally wounded. Marr promised to look after the others and stayed with her until she breathed her last.

title: Sela Marr
text: Returning to their hiding place, Marr revealed to the others that Kalifa had been killed. Jinx and O-Mer plunged into despair, but Marr did her best to keep their spirits up, proposing a plan to attack a transport ship as it delivered new prisoners. That night, they assaulted a ship, but were unable to gain control of the ship as it crashed onto the beach. However, they gained a new companion in the Vorak Brevok . Being the only one to understand Vorak tongue , Marr translated Brevok's ideas to the group, including his plan to build a transmitter from the wreckage of the ship to contact his people on the nearby Thornwood .

title: Sela Marr
text: The next night, the four companions ventured back to the wreckage, with Jinx and O-Mer covering Marr and Brevok as they crawled through the remains of the ship. Marr helped Brevok find parts, and when they emerged from the ship, they were fired on by a sniper. Jinx and O-Mer incapacitated him and the group eventually took the Trandoshan prisoner. In the morning, Jinx used a mind trick to get the hunter to summon a pickup. Then, taking control of the hover pod , they used it to fly up to the Trandoshan base. The group entered hand-to-hand combat with the other hunters and eventually received support from the Vorak chieftain Tarfful , who had gotten a message from Brevok's transmitter. Arriving in the assault gunship Halo , Tarfful and his warriors helped them defeat the hunters. Marr then entered the main hall of their base to confront Garnac and eventually pushed him off of the balcony, killing him.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Returning to the Aetheri Sanctum, Drayden was relieved to see his Adept. He profusely apologized for leaving her behind, but Marr instead gave her master her thanks, saying that without his training, she would not have made it back or helped the others survive. The two walked back towards the temple, with Master Zho looking on and smiling.

#### Campaign at Umbara

After the Umbarans sided with the Dissidents, the Grand Army of the Republic was dispatched to retake Umbara . In order to break through the blockade surrounding the planet, Marr and Ovva were tasked with leading the fighter squadrons in an attack on the blockade. At some point during the battle, Marr and Ovva led a squadron comprised of Z-95 Headhunters and Yarrow bombers in an attack on a Munificent -class star frigate, managing to destroy it and clearing the way for the Republic to launch their ground assault on the planet. Eventually, after a lengthy space and ground battle, the Republic claimed victory at Umbara.

#### Combating the Zygeran Slave Imperium

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Combating the Zygeran Slave Imperium

After the planet Kiros fell under the threat of Dissident invasion, Marr accompanied Drayden, Kade, Vek, and Cord to assist the planet's native Solinai population. After battling commando droids and Droideka Sharpshooters , Kade headed into the governor's tower to negotiate with the Zygeran Darts D'Nar , who was serving as the commander of the Dissident forces. Noticing her master's anger and frustration with the proposition of negotiating with a slaver, Marr soon learned that her master was a former slave, something he had never told her. When D'Nar double-crossed Kade and attempted to escape to his ship, Tecora , Marr and Drayden pursued him on AT-RTs . After disabling the Tecora's engines, Marr sneaked onto the bridge and defeated D'Nar in a duel. After interrogation, they learned the natives were sold into slavery on D'Nar's homeworld of Zygera .

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr, Drayden, Kade, Vek, and Bolt then took the Tecora to Zygera, with Marr posing as Drayden's slave to meet with the Zygeran queen, Miraj Scintel . However, when one of Scintel's slaves attempted to assassinate her before committing suicide, Drayden decided to offer Marr as Scintel's new slave. Winning the Queen's favor, he earned himself an invite to the slave auction taking place that night. Meanwhile, Marr was put in a cage outside, but would escape to aid her master at the auction. However, they discovered Kade had been captured, and they failed to overcome the Zygerrians, who shipped Kade and Vek to a slave processing facility while Scintel imprisoned Marr and Drayden in her palace.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Drayden was able to escape the guards with the help of Bolt and then freed Marr. Drayden learned from a dying Scintel, who was killed by the recently summoned Varek for being unwilling to turn over Drayden, that Kade and Vek were imprisoned on the planet Kadavo . Marr and Drayden reclaimed their ship and went to free their companions. When they landed at the facility, their ship was destroyed and they were quickly pinned down. When Varek threatened to execute the slaves if they did not stop their attack, Republic reinforcements, the 104th Battalion led by Tor Vayne arrived to help. Marr and Drayden then split up with Marr rendezvousing with the slaves and her master disabling the defense turrets. Marr located the slaves and directed Vayne to fly gunships underneath the facility to help the slaves escape. After rescuing the slaves, including Kade and Vek, Vayne's men destroyed the facility.

#### Entanglement with Grave Watch

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Entanglement with Grave Watch

Marr accompanied Ondar to the first ever sanctioned peace conference between the Republic and Fractio. However, the negotiations were interrupted by Junior senator Lux Bontero, who Marr had befriended earlier in the war during Ondar and Mina Bontero's failed peace initiative. Bontero accused Count Varek of being responsible for his mother's death, and Marr left the meeting to protect Bontero from possible retribution. Sneaking aboard a Dissident landing craft, Marr intervened when Varek ordered Bontero's execution via hologram. Marr was intent on bringing Bontero to Vantor to be granted amnesty, but Bontero had other plans. Bontero shocked Marr with a small device, knocking her out and bringing their ship to Carlac to meet with a group Bontero promised would help him get his revenge on Varek.

title: Sela Marr
text: Bontero made Marr leave her flux blades on the ship to meet with the group. Marr quickly realized that the group was Grave Watch, and told Ferrik Gloom Owl Bo-Katin Velara that she was Bontero's betrothed to keep her identity as an Aetheri a secret. When Velara left them both alone before their meeting with Pre Vizsla, Marr learned of Bontero's plan to convince Grave Watch, who recently had a falling out with the Umbra Lord, to assassinate Varek. Marr warned Bontero that Grave Watch still had their own agenda and could not trusted, but Bontero kissed her to interrupt her as Vizsla arrived. Vizsla forced Marr to work alongside natives that Grave Watch used as slave labor. Later, when Grave Watch began to pillage and burn a village , Marr attempted to fight back but was imprisoned. However, when Vizsla drew the Darksaber, intent on killing Marr, Bolt, who had been forced to repair Grave Watch droids they used for entertainment in a fighting ring, uses a smoke screen as a diversion and slips Marr her flux blades that he recovered from the ship. Marr acrobatically freed herself and beheaded a group of Ferriks approaching her before dueling Vizsla.

After successfully escaping Carlac, Bontero used an escape pod to avoid being brought to Vantor, leaving Marr behind. #### Training Underra's Insurgents

Marr, along with Masters Drayden, Kade, and Captain Vek was ordered by the Aetheri Council to train and assist the insurgents of Underra in their fight against the newly installed King Sanjay Rash and his Confederate occupation forces. There, she met up with insurgents' leaders, Steela Vess , her brother Torrik , and former junior senator Lux Bontero. Marr, her fellow Aetheri, and Vek were successful in teaching the insurgents how to fight the battle droids.

title: Sela Marr
text: After infiltrating Iziz , Marr was left behind to continue acting as liaison between the Insurgents and the Aetheri while Drayden, Kade, and Vek returned to Republic lines. Even as the Insurgents had continued success, public opinion did not think very highly of them. Hoping to change public opinion, the Insurgents, Marr, Bontero and the Gerreras destroyed the power generator to disrupt the battle droid patrols throughout Iziz, and after their victory, Steela was given the title of leader of the Insurgents. However, the Dissident response to the growing coalition was swift. Varek sent General Kalani to reinforce their grip on the planet and ordered the former King, Ramsis Dendup , to be executed. Torrik went in to attempt to save the King himself, was captured. Marr then assisted Steela in planning a breakout of the two during the public execution. They rescued King Dendup and Torrik and fled the city. However, she exposed the Aetheri's presence when she had to use Synth Flux during the rescue.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr and the insurgents regrouped in their base , which was located in the highlands outside of Iziz and awaited a Dissident response. They were soon assaulted by Kalani's forces, including the new HMP droid gunship , which inflicted heavy casualties on the insurgents' side and could not be touched by the weaponry at their disposal. Marr decided to call in a favor from Drayden, who made a deal with Hondik Hosha to get several rocket launchers delivered to the insurgents. As she hung on, Bontero rushed to save her, but fell over himself. #### Bombing at the Aetheri Sanctum

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Bombing at the Aetheri Sanctum

Towards the end of the war, Sela Marr noticed that Aetheri Master Zho became less happy as the war dragged on; the Solinai observed the Aetheri Master's "deep sorrow" and his burden of seemingly knowing that an ending neared and the ensuing instatement of a new era. At the age of 16, Sela Marr's friend, Barris Ovva, who believed the Aetheri Order had become evil, corrupt and overly belligerent during the war, secretly orchestrated the bombing of the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor. In the aftermath of the incident, which killed six Aetheri as well as several replicas and Aetheri Sanctum workers, Marr and Drayden were called back from the defense of the planet Cato Geltaria to investigate the situation along with crime scene analysis droid Russo-ISC . Before they began, Drevan Koss told them that it was possible an Aetheri was behind the attack. This deeply bothered both Marr and Drayden. When Marr asked her master about the possibility, he told her that there will be Aetheri who disappoint, but they will be far outnumbered by those who do the right thing.

title: Sela Marr
text: Their investigation included interviewing witnesses and visiting the hangar where the bombing took place. Their search narrowed down the suspect list to a Temple worker named Jackar Bowmani . They traveled to his apartment and discovered that his spouse, Letta Turmond was the guilty party. She had fed Bowmani nano-droids that made him a living bomb. Their findings brushed over the possibility of an Aetheri culprit. Turmond was incarcerated in a prison and guarded by Shock troopers . When Marr went to interview her, Ovva—seeking to cover up a loose end and hoping to endear Marr to her cause, possibly hoping it would end in Marr actively joining her —used a Synth Flux choke on Turmond, which killed her and framed Marr. Ovva continued her work of framing her friend and caused the deaths of several replica troopers. Replicas spotted the footage of Marr seemingly killing Turmond and, Replica Commander Fox arrested Marr after he and two shock troopers entered Turmond's cell.

title: Sela Marr
text: While she was imprisoned despite being innocent, Marr was visited by Varrix, who professed the Adept guilty of Turmond's death. Later, she noticed a key card to the cell outside and used Synth Flux to free herself. She believed that Drayden had put it there because he had not been allowed to visit her. Knowing that she was innocent but not knowing how to convince the others of it, Marr decided to escape. However, after traveling only a short distance, she found multiple dead replica troopers and her flux blades and comlink among the bodies. Little did she know, Ovva had planted them to continue framing her. Replica Commander Fox noticed her and sounded the alarm, once again believing she had killed his men.

title: Sela Marr
text: Running away from Republic authorities, she defended herself as replicas shot stun blasts to apprehend her. Pursued by Vek, Fox, Sergeant Hound , and others, she fled into the industrial areas outside of the Republic military base . She was pursued by gunships and searchlights, and lost her shoto during the chase. Turning down into the pipes system, she temporarily hid from her pursuers until Drayden caught up as she was preparing to jump down into the Vantor Underworld . Drayden told her that they could help her prove she was innocent, but Marr retorted that she was unwilling to face trial and punishment for something she did not do. Knowing that no one would believe her, Marr decided to go off on her own and jumped onto a ship that was descending into the underworld.

title: Sela Marr
text: As Marr struggled to keep herself hidden from Vantor underworld police and other Republic patrols searching for her, she contacted her friend Ovva, who promised to help her investigate to clear her name. Marr then destroyed her comlink and acquired a cloak for disguise. She boarded a train, but when she attempted to exit before she was asked for a pass by the police, she was surrounded by police forces outside. After fighting them off and fleeing, she was attacked by her longtime nemesis Kessa Vray, who sought the bounty on her head. However, Marr convinced Vray to ally with her, offering a pardon from the Galactic Senate in return for her help.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr used a public holographic system to contact Ovva, the only Aetheri whom she still saw as an ally, unaware that she was responsible for her situation. Ovva informed her of a warehouse she said was where Turmond had obtained the nano-droids. Marr convinced Vray to come with her to the location, but she was spotted by Commander Wolffe and a group of shock troopers. Marr attempted to negotiate with them, but the replicas attempted to detain her and she was forced to combat them, leaving most of the group unconscious before continuing towards the warehouse. Vray departed at that point, reminding her to fulfill her end of the deal. Inside, Marr found the warehouse abandoned before being attacked by a figure in Vray' bounty hunter gear. Unaware she was actually fighting her friend Ovva, whom she thought was her ally, she believed the attacker was Vray. After a short duel, Marr was knocked to the ground next to a crate of nano-droids. When she rose, she was stunned by Commander Wolffe before she could explain herself.

title: Sela Marr
text:
The Aetheri Council attempted to deal with the matter internally, but were convinced by now Admiral Wilhard Varrix that the trial would be a Republic military trial. Despite opposition from Kade, the Council agreed to Varrix's demands and expelled Marr from the Aetheri Order and turned her over to the Republic for a military trial . Marr was prosecuted by Varrix and defended by Lira Ondar. As the trial began, Marr remained confident her master would sort things out and prove her innocence. As Varrix lobbied for a conviction and death sentence, Marr watched with shock as Drayden brought an imprisoned Ovva to the trial. Marr was acquitted as the captive Ovva confessed to her crimes, citing that the Aetheri Order was losing its way for her motive.

Following her trial, Marr was personally pardoned by the Aetheri Council. Tor Vayne apologized to her on the Council's behalf, stating they had been wrong to question her loyalty. The Council also stated that Synth Flux worked in mysterious ways and therefore considered Marr's ordeal in hindsight as being her great trial , making her a greater Aetheri and proving herself worthy of the title of Aetheri Knight. However, the events surrounding her expulsion and trial had severely shaken Marr's faith in the Aetheri. To the surprise of everyone involved, she refused to accept the Aetheri Council and Drayden's invitation to rejoin the Order. Marr instead left to discover a new purpose for herself.

title: Sela Marr
text: Drayden chased after her, and, while Kade moved as well, Vayne held the Aetheri Master back. Having caught up with Marr, Drayden asked her why she wanted to leave and begged her to stay. Marr explained that she felt that as the Council lost faith in her, she could no longer find the confidence to trust in herself. Drayden reminded her that he had believed in and fought to prove her innocence, and although Marr accepted this, the situation was not about him. She felt she could not stay anymore and needed to find her own path away from the Aetheri Order. Drayden then told her that he understood the feeling of wanting to leave the Aetheri, but Marr simply responded that she knew, and as Drayden looked at her, his former Adept turned her back and walked away from the Aetheri Order.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr's departure from the Aetheri Order had a deep impact on those she knew. During a quest to discover the secrets of immortality , Zho was faced with visions of the Great Aetheri Purge . In one such vision, he saw Marr dying in the halls of the Aetheri Sanctum, with the vision of her asking if she could become one with Synth Flux after being expelled from the Aetheri Order. The vision of Marr was a result of Zho's guilt over having placed her on the path that led to her departure from the Order. Marr's former mentor Drayden was particularly affected by her departure and felt even more alone in having to fulfill the expectations of being the prophesied Seeded One . Her departure also intensified Drayden's frustration with the Council, as he felt they had betrayed her and left her with no choice by turning their backs on her during her trial. Following her departure, Drayden continued to lament his Adept's decision, and wondered if Ondar had the same thought. During Drayden and Ondar's mission on the planet Mokivj , the Senator cited Marr's maneuver in the Battle of Selvara, the Marg Sabl, to the Chyrr Commander Vorren , and explained the origins of the name to him.

title: Sela Marr
text: When Drayden and Kade undertook a mission to Uthara , where they discovered a secret arms deal between the Fractio and Sulie weapons dealers, Drayden briefly forgot Marr had left the Aetheri and suggested contacting her, but he cut himself off after remembering her absence and tried to avoid the subject. Kade questioned if he wanted to discuss what had happened, and, after they had set up camp, Drayden admitted he missed Marr and still could not understand how she left. Drayden still felt that she was an Aetheri and belonged with them. Kade disagreed with Drayden's opinion, asserting that it had been Marr's decision to leave, but Drayden believed that the Aetheri Council had abandoned Marr, and therefore left her with no alternative to leaving the Order. Kade also felt mistakes had been made, but he still noted that leaving had been her choice and recalled that Marr had allowed her emotions to influence her judgment, which was not the Aetheri way. When Kade told Drayden to not take responsibility for her decision, the Aetheri Knight asked how his former master would feel if he became a major disappointment, to which Kade admitted he would not feel very well

text:
allowed her emotions to influence her judgment, which was not the Aetheri way. When Kade told Drayden to not take responsibility for her decision, the Aetheri Knight asked how his former master would feel if he became a major disappointment, to which Kade admitted he would not feel very well about it. #### Meeting the Martez sisters

A short time after leaving the Aetheri and close to the end of the Replica Wars, Marr was traveling Vantor's Industrial District aboard a Joben T-85 speeder bike she had purchased, when the craft began to malfunction. Although she ultimately managed to avoid colliding with a Gozanti -class cruiser , she was forced to crash land on the platform of a repair shop on Level 1313 .

title: Sela Marr
text: This caught the attention of the shop's mechanic, a human female named Trayk Martez , who approached Marr as she pulled together the remains of her speeder. After a brief conversation, both girls introduced themselves, with Trayk claiming she owned one of the best repair shops on the level. Although she offered to fix the speeder for payment, Marr noted she could not afford to pay and would fit it herself with the necessary tools. After much negotiating, Martez eventually agreed to let Sela fix her bike for free. Opening the doors to her shop, Marr noticed the mechanic's Nebula -class freighter , which Martez was modifying in the hopes of one day leaving Vantor. After she pointed Marr to a workshop, Sela questioned why the mechanic was helping her, with Martez stating it felt like the right thing to do. Although she offered Marr the option to leave if she wanted, the former Aetheri elected to stay.

title: Sela Marr
text: After Marr had begun to repair her speeder bike, Martez offered to help the former Adept, but Marr rejected any help that would cost her. Although the mechanic was annoyed by this, noting that everything on 1313 had a price, Marr asked if she had any sparkers she could purchase. Though Martez's only sparkers were already used on her freighter and there was no available stock. Stating that was not good and noting she needed to get out, she did not answer Martez after the mechanic asked if she was running from something. Although Martez called after her, stating she could stay as long as desired as long as she could pay, Marr walked out to the platform and looked up towards the sky of Vantor.

title: Sela Marr
text: Afterwards, Marr heard the bike working inside the shop and entered, learning that Martez had helped with it for free. She vaguely admitted to being from Vantor's upper levels, keeping out the fact that she had been an Aetheri, but defended her former order when Martez accused them of starting the Replica Wars. Martez, who felt that the Aetheri had forgotten about common people like her, admitted that the Aetheri were not what she had imagined based on the stories she had heard, revealing that she wanted to get away from the war and Aetheri aboard her starship with her older sister, Ravin . The mechanic's opinion of the Aetheri persuaded Marr to continue to keep her past a secret.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr and Martez were suddenly interrupted when a low-level gangster, Pintu Son-El , and his henchmen entered, looking for money from Ravin that she had promised him. Martez initially told Marr to stay back and tried to fight Son-El's enforcers off, she was eventually overpowered and asked Marr for help. Having been trained as an Aetheri, Marr made short-work of the two enforcers, although Son-El claimed the situation was not over as he fled. Given that she had witnessed Marr's prowess, Martez asked where Marr had learned to fight, so she lied and stated it was her "older brother." The two then made their way to Ravin's Laundry to tell her about Son-El, where she stated she had a job coming up that would make everything better.

title: Sela Marr
text: Ravin also asked who Marr was, and, after being introduced to her, Martez recounted how Marr had fallen onto the platform. After a brief conversation between Ravin and the Velari Lokann , whose " business partner " had arranged a deal with Ravin to build three droids. Marr and Trayk worked on the three binary loadlifters , with Marr reminding the mechanic to put the restraining bolt onto the droid. After Marr activated the droid she had been working on, she and Trayk began a conversation about how people acted, with Martez mentioning her belief that some people were good, others were bad, and some were cross-wired like the loadlifter she had been building. By saying this, however, Marr realized they had been building Type II loadlifter droids and, after her Type II attacked and she shut it down, explained that the "loadlifters" units were actually frauds, being repurposed demolition droid which could cause violence. Unfortunately for the two, Trayk had yet to put a restraining bolt on her droid, allowing it to escape from the shop.

title: Sela Marr
text: After passing Ravin on the street, Marr and Trayk pursued the droid before it jumped to a lower street to rampage. As suggested by Trayk, Marr ran back to Ravin's laundromat to find the unit's tracking device while she would find a speeder. Once there, Ravin questioned where the loadlifter and Trayk were before Marr boarded the speeder the mechanic had found. The two located the droid and chased it, intending to grab the droid with the speeder's clamps and to use the blue off switch on the droid's face plate. After grabbing the type two, however, it began to climb, making Trayk release the droid from the clamps and jump onto it herself. Although she managed to shut the unit down, the now lifeless body began to fall with Trayk still holding on, forcing Marr to grab hold of it with the speeder's clamps. She quickly attached the vehicle's tow cable to nearby pipes to pull them up, but the droid and Trayk proved to be too heavy. Before Trayk could fall to her death, however, Marr secretly used Synth Flux to help pull the vehicle up, with only a watching Velari child realizing what she did. Relieved to

Before Trayk could fall to her death, however, Marr secretly used Synth Flux to help pull the vehicle up, with only a watching Velari child realizing what she did. Relieved to see Trayk safe, the two made their way back to the laundromat, where Ravin refused to take apart the loadlifters despite Marr's protests, believing them hurting anyone was not her problem. Ignoring Marr's argument by saying she was new, Ravin promised Trayk that she would do the right thing. Marr and Trayk made their way to the wharf , where Marr questioned if Trayk had a role in making decisions with Ravin. Trayk answered that Ravin was trying to make things better for them, although Marr questioned at what cost that came. Ravin then arrived to meet with them, revealing she had charged Lokann double the price, defending herself by saying they were not her property, someone else would have constructed them if they hadn't, and that it would have caused trouble for her and Trayk. Although Trayk was visibly disappointed, Ravin stated the credits had been used to pay off Son-El and gave money for new tools, hoping that would make it worth it. After sending a look at Marr, Ravin left the pair. Marr also started to leave to complete her speeder, and Trayk thanked her for saving her life before leaving with the former Adept.

title: Sela Marr
text: When both of them were working on Trayk's freighter in the repair shop, Marr continued to hide her past from the Martez sister by claiming she had gone to "Drayden Academy." Although the mechanic had never heard of the fake school, she believed it was real, having never truly heard of any academy. When Marr asked why she would never have attended one of the schools, the mechanic noted that there were none where they lived, and that she would not be able to afford it. Trayk then stated Ravin and her inherited the hangar the repair shop was in, claiming their parents had "split," and that Ravin had won her store gambling. However, Trayk had built her freighter herself, telling Marr its name was the Silver Angel . Although Marr chuckled at the name, she told Trayk she could call her starship whatever name she desired, and secret Synth Flux-sensitive returned to work on her speeder bike, which Trayk had dubbed " Trash ." After talking about where she would go once the speeder was fixed, Marr accepted Trayk's suggestion to stay a for short time longer, as long as Ravin did not mind. At that moment Ravin entered

Ravin and her then entered the ship, but not without the older sibling implying Marr could be the trouble Trayk needed to avoid. Now with all three inside the cockpit , the Silver Angel took off from the underworld portal, but Trayk flew the ship into a restricted military lane. The Angel was soon hailed by an Iron Cruiser that had both Drayden and Yular, the same admiral Marr had served with, aboard. While

Now in open space, Marr noted that Ravin had yet to tell her and Trayk where they were going. In response, Ravin only told her sister about their destination before they jumped to lightspeed. During their journey, however, Trayk had forgotten to disengage the air brakes, making the Angel rumble, and Trayk noted she had never been to hyperspace. Marr then learned that her friend had only ever piloted smaller vehicles meant for use on planets, allowing Ravin to quietly explain why she had wanted a different pilot. title: Sela Marr
text: Marr joined the Martez sisters on the loading platform before heading back on the Angel to make sure the spice bins were secured. Before Trayk could join her friend, Ravin confided to her sister that she did not know how to feel about their new partner, reminding her younger sister that Marr was not family. Though annoyed by her sister's thoughts on Marr, Trayk stated she would keep an eye on her friend before both went aboard. Though Ravin questioned how the supposed mechanic knew about the Gruv Syndicate , Marr avoided the question and asserted that they could not make a deal with gangsters, warning Trayk that the Pykes would take everything from her and kill her. As the pilot panicked at the thought of losing her starship, Marr, who felt they should take the spice to somewhere that would use it for medicine, debated what to do with their shipment with Ravin, who stated she needed the money to pay debts they owed on Vantor, though Marr believed these debts had nothing

title: Sela Marr
text: thought of losing her starship, Marr, who felt they should take the spice to somewhere that would use it for medicine, debated what to do with their shipment with Ravin, who stated she needed the money to pay debts they owed on Vantor, though Marr believed these debts had nothing to do with Trayk. Determined to keep the Silver Angel and make sure neither Marr nor Ravin got their way, Trayk suddenly dumped the spice containers into hyperspace, to the surprise of both her sister and the former Adept, who had viewed her debate as an ethical discussion and had yet to figure out a way to settle their deal.

title: Sela Marr
text: Ravin reprimanded Marr and Trayk for their similarities and suggested paying off the Pykes by selling the Angel , but the former Adept broke up the sisters' argument, reminding them that she had said she'd not figured out a plan "yet." Trayk quickly responded by asking if she had one now, which Marr stated they would find out once they acted. title: Sela Marr
text: Marr and the sisters were imprisoned deep within the Gruv Palace for their actions, where Marr and Ravin continued to debate what they should have done. Ravin joked that Marr's morals made her sound like an Aetheri, making her question what they would do if she was a member of the Order. Though Trayk told them not to jest about the subject, Ravin realized her sister had never told Marr why they avoided the Aetheri and other "Topsiders." Unwilling to have the secret Synth Flux-sensitive argue about morality, she recounted that, during Cad Vorek's rescue of Ziro the Grak several years earlier, the bounty hunter shot the engines of a cargo transport rising through an underworld portal to distract a team of pursuing Aetheri. Trying to stop the starship from crashing into a populated landing platform, the Aetheri instead steered it into the portal wall, the other side of which contained the Martez home. Their mother and father managed to get the siblings out of harm's way, but they were caught and killed in the crash.

title: Sela Marr
text: After failing to capture Vorek, Ziro, and the other criminals , the Aetheri returned, and Ravin revealed one of Synth Flux-sensitives, Marr's old acquaintance Luminara Undula, came over to her, telling Ravin that she had needed to make a choice about the transport. She then stated that Synth Flux would be with them, but the religious belief meant nothing to Martez sister. The Aetheri then left, leaving the two alone to find a way to survive. Ravin recounted that she had spent every day since trying to build a new life for herself and Trayk, believing they had been fine until her sister let Marr come with them.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr apologized for what had happened to them, but the three young women were interrupted by the Gruv guards, who demanded Ravin come with them. While Marr stood in front of the sisters to try to protect them and Ravin offered that they instead take Marr, the Pykes pushed past the former Adept and Trayk, taking the elder sister away for interrogation. As Ravin was tortured, Trayk and Marr were left in the cell, where the mechanic admitted she and her sister had been on their own until Marr arrived. Trayk also revealed she had helped her because it was something her mother would have believed in. Ravin, unconscious but having refused to give up information, was then thrown into the cell by the Gruv guards. Though Marr advised her friend to not make the Pykes angry, Trayk demanded they tell her what had happened to Ravin and shoved a guard, who grabbed the mechanic to take her away for interrogation.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr objected to the action, but was hit down by a guard's stun baton , making her fall to the ground. Trayk called for her friend to make sure Ravin was well before being taken to the interrogation room, where she pretended to faint to distract the guards, using the opportunity to steal a CC-420 pistol and escape the room, although several guards pursued her. After noticing the Pykes run down the hallway, Marr secretly used Synth Flux to unlock the door before waking Ravin. Informing the Martez sister that the Pykes had taken Trayk and that they needed to flee, they escaped the cell, which the secret Synth Flux user claimed was opened by a power outage. As they searched for Trayk, they eventually ran into the escaping mechanic, who had been heading back to the cell to break them out.

title: Sela Marr
text: Reunited, the three made their way to an outside platform, and Trayk blasted a barrel Marr and Ravin had knocked over to clear away the pursuing guards. Their next challenge came from a retracting bridge; although Ravin made it across in time, Marr had to use Synth Flux to help push Trayk across, and, while Ravin was willing to leave Marr behind, she was able to Synth Flux jump over the gap. While the older Martez sister recognized that it had not been a normal feat, they nevertheless needed the run from two more Pykes guards, who had arrived just before Trayk made it across the bridge. The three made their way to the city gate, during which time Marr helped the sisters take out a Gruv guard in order to steal his stun baton, and she continued to debate their situation with Ravin.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Understanding that the syndicate's reputation was at stake, the former Adept recognized that the Pykes had no desire to let them escape, so Ravin had Marr head to disable the gate while she and Trayk went to distract the guards. The Martez sister claimed to give Marr the job because of her resourcefulness, though the former Adept also believed it was because Ravin thought it was more difficult. As her friend left for the control tower, Trayk speculated that her sister and Marr were getting along better, but Ravin denied that. Marr was able to sneak into the control tower and managed to dispatch the control room's guards in physical combat, but she quickly saw that the Martez sisters had gotten into a firefight with the Pykes outside. After opening the gates and traveling down, she secretly used Synth Flux to pull the two guards into the open, giving Trayk the chance to shoot both of them. Marr then called the sisters forward, and the three young women escaped into the city.

Captured once again

title: Sela Marr
text: After Trayk, believing she saw the Silver Angel , excitedly ran past the two of them, Marr and Ravin were given the chance to talk in private about whether Trayk should be involved in criminal jobs. Ravin changed the topic to question Marr about why she was interested in helping, although they were soon interrupted by a begging Gotal . Ravin claimed to have no credits, and she and Marr left him so they could catch up to Trayk. Once they had, Ravin again asked what she wanted, so Marr informed the Martez sister that she made it her duty to help those in need, a trait that Ravin admitted sounded like her mother. She confided in Marr that she was simply trying to do what was best for her sister and herself. Trayk then informed her friend and sister that she had in fact found the Angel, but the trio was spotted by the Pykes, who had been helped in their search by the angered Gotal beggar, after Trayk and Ravin had argued about whether to use the Angel to escape. The three ran through the crowded street while pursued and under volt pistol fire, unknowingly attracting the attention

title: Sela Marr
text: trio was spotted by the Pykes, who had been helped in their search by the angered Gotal beggar, after Trayk and Ravin had argued about whether to use the Angel to escape. The three ran through the crowded street while pursued and under volt pistol fire, unknowingly attracting the attention of a hooded Ferrik Gloom Owl, who was on planet for a mission with Bo-Katin Velara, the very Grave Watch lieutenant Marr had fought during the battle on Carlac earlier in the war. While trying to escape the Gruv guards by riding on a civilian's landspeeder , one of the syndicate soldiers blasted out one of the craft's engines, throwing Ravin and Trayk off the vehicle while pushing Marr further away from the Pykes. As the sisters were captured, Marr continued to escape through the city, unknowingly being watched by Velara, who was unsure if the Synth Flux-sensitive was in fact Marr, Ursa Wrenna, and a third Ferrik Gloom Owl. Although Wrenna feared her presence could compromise their mission on Oba Diah, Velara also recognized that they shared an enemy in the rogue Umbra Lord Vreth, who still had control over Ferrum. Thus, Velara decided they would keep track of the former Adept's movements.

title: Sela Marr
text: Elsewhere, Marr watched over Ravin and Trayk from a building-top, learning that Krim and Fife intended to kill the two sisters before torturing her to learn where the spice was. After discretely taking out a guard, the former Adept took control of a construction vehicle, interrupting the planned execution by ramming the repulsorcraft into the Pykes and using its frontal cannons. Although she cleared away most of the Gruv guards in their path, Fife—who had purposely drawn Marr into a trap with the execution—returned with a cannon-equipped landspeeder. The cannon downed Marr's repulsorcraft, preventing their escape and allowing them to be subsequently surrounded by Gruv guards.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr and the sisters were escorted back to their cell, with one of the guards shoving the secret Synth Flux-sensitive into the confinement. Ravin tried to arrange a deal, but Krim denied the three the chance at another job and stated his intention to torture them until he learned where the spice was. Once all but one of the guards left, Ravin apologized for taking the job, so Marr told the young woman that she would learn from the experience. Nevertheless, Trayk asked her sister and friend how much longer they would be alive to learn those lessons.

#### Another new path

After their successful escape from Oba Diah, Marr and the Martez sisters were approached by Lady Bo-Katin Velara and members of her Ferrum coalition , whom had followed them from Oba Diah aboard a Kom'rk -class fighter/transport . Marr recognized Velara from their battle on Carlac earlier in the war, but she explained Grave Watch was disbanded. Marr and she agreed to ally to defeat the rogue Umbra Lord Vreth, though the former Adept left her speeder bike with the Martez sisters in case she ever returned to her friends.

#### The last meeting

> " You capture Vreth. I'll take care of Skarn. With any luck, this will all be over soon. " " Master Kade always said there's no such thing as luck. " " Good thing I taught you otherwise. " [Drayden begins to leave] " Kael! Good luck. " ―Kael Drayden and Sela Marr's final words to each other as friends After allying herself with the Ferriks , Marr was given a new outfit made from beskar and set to work trying to find where Vreth was hiding. Marr and Velara also developed a friendship, with Velara becoming a combat mentor to the former Aetheri. After some time, Marr and the Ferrum coalition managed to pinpoint Vreth's location on Ferrum with the help of the information Marr managed to retrieve from the Pykes on Oba Diah. Knowing they did not have the numbers for a siege of Ferrum, Marr and Velara contacted Drayden and Kade, who were finishing up a battle on the planet Yerbana , for their assistance in the siege. Using the subspace frequency " Fulcrum ," Marr and Velara were met by Yular who then contacted Drayden and Kade, calling them back to the ship.

title: Sela Marr
text: Once Drayden and Kade arrived, Marr greeted Drayden and commented on how long it had been since they had last seen each other. There was a brief silence before Drayden asked how Marr had been and where she was. Responding to Drayden's inquiry, Marr said she was alright, but knew that they did not have time to make irrelevant conversation and needed to divulge the important information she and Velara had immediately. After Kade asked what this information was, Marr explained that they had finally managed to locate Vreth and that they might be able to capture him if they moved swiftly.

title: Sela Marr
text: With this information, Drayden and Kade allowed the Ferriks onto their Iron Cruiser. As Marr exited the boarding ramp, Bolt-3 greeted her arrival warmly. After this, she walked towards Drayden who said he was extremely glad to see her, but she interrupted him and told him that they would have to catch up another time as every moment they wasted there gave Vreth more of an opportunity to escape, as noted by Velara. With this, the group ventured to the strategy center to discuss the supposed siege. Arriving there, Marr explained to Kade and Drayden that they had managed to pinpoint Vreth's location using information she had managed to gather on Oba Diah to which Drayden asked why she was on Oba Diah in the first place. However, Marr waved this aside by telling him that that wasn't really relevant at that present moment.

title: Sela Marr
text: After Velara explained that Vreth was on Ferrum, Kade asked what they wanted from the Republic. Velara, embarrassed, explained that she didn't have the numbers that would be needed for a siege of this size and needed the assistance of the Republic's replicas in order for a complete lockdown of Sundari . To gain this, she proposed that she would give them Vreth once he was captured and that she would take the leadership role on Ferrum once the siege concluded. Nevertheless, Kade explained that if they aided them, it would break ancient treaties between the Republic and Ferriks and that the two sides would once again be drawn into a war. To this, Velara asked them what one more war was, but Drayden explained that they didn't want another war when they were already fighting in the Replica Wars. With this, Kade explained that he would ask for the Aetheri Council's guidance in this matter, but Velara, desperate for help, yelled at him that there was no time to speak with them and attempted to incite Kade's feelings for Satinna , whom Vreth had murdered months prior. She scornfully looked at Kade as he walked away to speak with

title: Sela Marr
text: Aetheri Council's guidance in this matter, but Velara, desperate for help, yelled at him that there was no time to speak with them and attempted to incite Kade's feelings for Satinna , whom Vreth had murdered months prior. She scornfully looked at Kade as he walked away to speak with the Council, refusing to allow his feelings to control his actions. Velara then angrily walked away as Marr watched her departure. With Velara gone, Drayden quipped that that meeting had gone well with everything taken into account. Hearing Drayden's witty remark, Marr turned back towards Drayden and said that he and Kade hadn't changed much since the last time she had seen them. Drayden then asked if that was a bad thing to which Marr smiled. He then asked her to follow him as he had a surprise for her waiting in the hangar. As they walked towards the hangar, Marr watched as the replicas saluted her as she passed by, commenting that the replicas shouldn't salute her anymore since she had left the Aetheri Order and therefore no longer commanded them. However, Drayden explained that they were just showing respect for the years she spent with them serving on the front lines in the Replica Wars. As they arrived, the door moved aside to reveal Vek and fellow members of the 501st's 332nd Company with their newly painted helmets bearing her markings. With her now having seen them, Drayden motioned for her to move through the lines of troopers as they had been waiting for her.

title: Sela Marr
text: After seeing the troopers, Marr walked back to Drayden and Vek who said that the paint job on the helmets was a little crude, but it was still good to see her again. Before they parted ways once more, Drayden presented Marr with a box which contained one of her most prized former possessions. However, just as he presented her with the box, the ship's emergency alarm went off, alerting all Republic personnel aboard to get ready for battle. Kade rushed in, informing Drayden and Vek to prepare all forces and that they would be entering hyperspace shortly to help ward off Skarn' surprise attack on Vantor. Kade informed Drayden that the Chancellor was under the protection of Solinai Aetheri Master Shaak Ti , but that Koss had lost contact with her. Growing annoyed by their political games, Marr asked if her former masters were just going to abandon the Ferriks. Somewhat shocked by the accusation, Kade urged Marr to understand that they were needed at Vantor as this was a pivotal moment in the Replica Wars. This only annoyed Marr more as she believed that the Aetheri were still playing politics, and noted that was why the people of

title: Sela Marr
text: Ferriks. Somewhat shocked by the accusation, Kade urged Marr to understand that they were needed at Vantor as this was a pivotal moment in the Replica Wars. This only annoyed Marr more as she believed that the Aetheri were still playing politics, and noted that was why the people of the galaxy had lost faith in them. Kade tried to defend himself that they were needed to defend the people of Vantor, but Marr countered that it was about saving the Supreme Chancellor instead. When Kade protested that what Marr was saying wasn't fair, Marr coldly retorted that she wasn't trying to play fair. However, Drayden offered a compromise where he would divide the 501st into a new division led by Vek who would be promoted to Commander while Marr served as an advisor. Marr accepted her new position and, with Kade's approval, the Siege of Ferrum could begin. Before departing, Kade advised Marr to capture Vreth instead of trying to kill him as he hadn't seemed to stay dead in the past.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr then thanked Drayden for the support as he once again presented her with the box, knowing she'd need its contents if she were going to face Vreth. Realizing what was inside, Marr opened the box, revealing her flux blades as she grabbed them, igniting them and revealing their new blue hue. As she looked at Drayden, he said they were maybe a little better than when she had had them last. She then briefly practiced with them once more. Beginning to depart, Drayden looked at Marr and said that with any luck their missions would be over soon and they would be able to reunite once more after their conclusion. She then offered Drayden good luck as he briefly looked back at her before walking away to prepare to face Skarn. Marr then walked further into the hangar and reunited with Vek.

text:
#### Siege of Ferrum

Air assault

> " Sorry. I didn't think to bring you a jetpack. " " Don't need one. Race you to the surface! " ―Vek and Marr during the descent to Sundari

Arriving at Ferrum, Marr boarded a gunship alongside Velara, Vek, and ARC trooper CT-5597 "Jesse" and joined the assault team in their approach to Sundari. During their approach, Prime Minister Almec contacted them and questioned them on why the Republic was attacking Ferrum, but after Velara announced her presence to Almec, declaring their knowledge of him being a puppet of Vreth, Almec understood. As he informed her that this attack would make her an enemy to the citizens of Sundari, she ended the transmission, noting that she didn't care. Marr turned to address Velara and commented on how much of a difference there was between her and her sister, Satinna. Velara then contacted Ursa Wrenna , another one of the Nite Owls, and asked her if she could confirm where Vreth was located, but Wrenna was only able to confirm that he had not yet left the city and also informed them that Vreth's forces were preparing for combat.

title: Sela Marr
text: As she ended the transmission with Wrenna, their gunship began to violently shake as Vreth's forces had arrived and had begun their attack. They opened the gunship's doors to see the carnage ensuing outside as a gunship was destroyed next to them, forcing Marr to shield herself from the oncoming debris. Shortly afterwards, everyone aboard their respective gunships left to engage the enemy in the air using their jetpacks . Vek apologized for not bringing Marr one, however, Marr instead smiled and informed him that she didn't one, declaring a race to the surface between the two. Jumping out of their gunship, Marr ignited both of her flux blades and landed on another gunship, destroying both of the attacking super commandos' jetpacks with her flux blades. Noticing more super commandos inside another gunship, she jumped down onto it, destroying one of their jetpacks before jumping inside the gunship and kicking two of the others. She then sliced the volt pistols off two other super commandos before kicking one and pushing another into the side of the gunship with Synth Flux. Before leaving, she kicked one of the last super commandos aboard before destroying the last super commando's jetpack, allowing her to hitch a ride as it sputtered out before landing on a Kom'rk -class fighter/transport .

title: Sela Marr
text:
While running across the fighter, Marr noticed a crashing gunship. Landing atop it, she noticed the pilot's ejector seat had failed and needed assistance escaping the gunship. In order to do this, she used her flux blades to cut the top off of the cockpit, allowing the pilot's ejector seat to launch as the pilot thanked her. Before the gunship crashed, she hitched a short ride as the super commandos on the surface prepared to fire at her. Jumping down onto a platform, the gunship exploded behind her as the super commandos began to fire at her, forcing her to deflect their volt pistol bolts, allowing her to kill several of them. As she continued to defend herself, Wrenna and many other Ferriks arrived alongside Vek. With Vek's arrival, Marr mentioned that she had beaten him to the surface, reminding Vek that some things never changed. The two friends then rushed into Sundari.

The Undercity

> " Sela…Marr is it? I can't say yours is a name familiar to me. " ―Vreth, cornering Marr

title: Sela Marr
text:
The Undercity

> " Sela…Marr is it? I can't say yours is a name familiar to me. " ―Vreth, cornering Marr

Shortly afterward, Gar Saxon , one of the leaders of the super commandos, escaped into the Undercity of Sundari, taking several super commandos along with him. Watching the fighting occurring in the city atop a balcony, Marr watched as Vek returned from his scouting mission and confirmed to them that Vreth had not yet been found. With this news, Velara informed them that she and her Ferriks would be heading to the Sundari Royal Palace to capture Almec and ordered her to find Vreth as they would not be able to sustain a long siege. After Velara left, Marr ordered Vek to support Wrenna at Sundari's docks in order to ensure Vreth didn't escape. Before he left, Vek informed Marr that if Vreth wasn't in Sundari then the entire siege would be playing into his plans. Just then, Replica Captain CT-0292 "Vaughn" contacted Vek, informing him that they had a lead on Vreth's location as Marr and Vek rushed off to go investigate the situation.

title: Sela Marr
text: After being dropped off by a gunship, Marr ventured into the Undercity and was met by Vaughn, who informed her that they had engaged Saxon, but he escaped into an access tunnel, seeming to be in a hurry. Marr asked what was down there and Vaughn told her that it was a series of mainly sewer tunnels and conduit access points, but he didn't know if it led outside of the city. Marr then ordered the replicas to move in to investigate where the tunnels led. Unbeknownst to them, they were walking into a trap as another leader of the super commandos, Rook Kast , was prepping her super commandos to ambush Marr and her forces. As they continued to explore, Kast emerged from hiding and fired an explosive at them, forcing Marr to use Synth Flux to divert the explosive on an alternate path. However, it still exploded near them, knocking Marr to the ground and briefly disorienting her and her forces. As Marr recovered herself, Vaughn and the rest of the replicas chased after Kast and her super commandos, ignoring Marr's cries for them to wait. As Marr followed the trail of bodies, she was led to an opening in the Undercity where Vaughn apologized for his actions, dying while she held his hand.

title: Sela Marr
text: Shortly thereafter, the super commandos rushed in and surrounded Marr who ignited her flux blades to defend herself as Vreth similarly emerged from hiding. Upon his emergence, Vreth explained that he had been hoping for Kade to show up instead of Marr and asked her why she was here instead. Marr then looked around at her opponents and readjusted her stand, turning her head back to Vreth. Vreth proceeded explained that he did not know who Marr was to which she said that she knew who he was. Vreth went on to say that he assumed that they both mutually knew several people.

title: Sela Marr
text: As Vreth spoke, Marr pressed a button on her wrist comm , informing Vek that she needed assistance. While Vek traced her signal, Vreth explained that he was certain Kade would've come instead of sending Marr to which she explained that he was needed at the Battle of Vantor as opposed to fighting Vreth. Vreth then began to wonder if Mal' plan was finally coming to fruition, but did not explain as much to Marr. Vreth then asked why he sent Marr to which she taunted Vreth by asking him to surrender so that they could both go and ask Kade themselves. However, Vreth explained that that would be pointless as he believed the Aetheri and the Republic would soon be toppled by Vael Mal.

title: Sela Marr
text:
However, before they could finish talking, Vek and several other replicas arrived, attacking two super commandos from behind as Vreth ignited his flux blade and attacked Marr who just barely managed to defend herself in time. However, after they very briefly fought, Vreth declared that it was not time for their true confrontation to take place and pushed Marr back. Before she could recover, Vreth picked Vek up with Synth Flux and tossed him into her. Vreth, Kast, and one other super commando then escaped to which Marr ordered her men to chase after them as she recovered and chased after him herself. As they split up, Marr chased after what she thought was Vreth, but after attempting to take a shortcut, ran into Vek instead, losing Vreth. Knowing they had failed, Marr declared that they had lost him.

Conference with Kade

> " Tell Kael… " " I will. " ―Marr and Kade's last conversation

title: Sela Marr
text:
Conference with Kade

> " Tell Kael… " " I will. " ―Marr and Kade's last conversation

After Vreth's escape, Marr met with a hologram of Kade along with Vek in the Grand Salon of the Sundari Royal Palace while overlooking a hologram of Sundari itself. During their conference, Velara walked over and informed the group that firefights were still occurring in Sector 11 and congratulated the replicas on how effective they had performed in the siege; however, she also noted that Vreth still needed to be in custody by the end of it or the entire siege would've been for nothing. With this, Marr noted that while she was in the Undercity, Vreth mentioned the name of Vael Mal to which Velara asked Kade who he was, but Kade could share very little information on him, only being able to tell them what the Aetheri Council suspected.

title: Sela Marr
text: After Vek turned off the holo-map for Sundari and motioning the R4 astromech droid away, Kade informed the group that the council suspected that Mal was an Umbra Lord who had orchestrated the Replica Wars and had played both sides throughout the entire conflict. He then went on to note that he learned the name from Count Varek on Pyralis, but any chances of learning more about Mal from him were severed after Drayden beheaded him during the Battle of Vantor, briefly shocking Marr. After this, Kade noted that by capturing Vreth, they may be able to discover the mystery behind Mal and put the final pieces of the puzzle into place. With this, Marr asked for more troops, but Kade informed her that that would not be possible from his front as he was being sent to hunt down General Skarn on Uthara. Marr then asked if Drayden could reinforce them, but, instead, Kade asked for Vek and Velara to leave them while he talked with Marr alone.

title: Sela Marr
text: With their departure, Kade informed Marr that Drayden had been assigned to spy on Supreme Chancellor Mal by the Aetheri Council, which Marr found distasteful. When she asked why, Kade told her that the Galactic Senate had allowed Mal to stay in office far longer than his term allowed, even with the emergency powers granted to Mal shortly before The Replica Wars Begin and that the council was suspicious of Mal's true intentions. Marr then noted that Mal had been a great friend to Drayden for a long time and that she did not believe he would be happy with his current assignment. Kade affirmed her suspicions and said that it was best for her to talk with him. Marr was displeased with this, believing that Kade was asking for her to hold up the Council's judgment in the situation, not believing she was the right person for that role after everything they had put her through. However, Kade relented and admitted that the Council wasn't always right in its decisions, which was why he was asking for her help.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Just then, Vek rushed in, apologizing to both for interrupting them, but telling the two that there had been an attack in the Undercity. Kade allowed Marr to go and, as she ran off, she began to ask the Aetheri Master to tell Kael something. Kade did not let her finish, simply responding that he would. Marr then rushed off to the Undercity as Kade watched.

Interrogating Almec

> " Vreth had a vision. A dream. The name came to him. " " What name? " " Drayden. " ―Almec reveals the name he had been speaking of Interrogating Almec

> " Vreth had a vision. A dream. The name came to him. " " What name? " " Drayden. " ―Almec reveals the name he had been speaking of

Arriving back in the Undercity, Marr immediately received news that the replicas there were ambushed on their way to reinforce C-deck leading Marr to order Vek to reinforce the location and him to run off to fulfill his orders. After this, Marr walked over to an injured replica named Sterling who had called her name. He informed her that Vreth tore right through their defenses, asking about Marr the entire time. Eventually, Vreth realized that Jesse was the oldest replica in the unit present by looking into his mind and had most likely served under Marr for longer, so he took him deeper into the Undercity as a prisoner in order to get as much information from him as possible. With this, Marr looked deeper into the Undercity.

title: Sela Marr
text: Soon after, Marr departed the Undercity and went to the royal prison alongside Vek and Velara to interrogate Almec in order to learn more about Vreth's plan. Upon entering his cell, Almec sarcastically mentioned how flattered he was upon the three being able to find the time to meet with him. After this, Velara began the interrogation by asking Almec what Vreth's plan was and how he was planning on escaping. In response, Almec informed them that Vreth was not attempting to escape as he saw no point in it. Velara believed this meant that Vreth believed he could win, but Almec assured her that that was not the reason as he had become filled with a sense of dread in recent days. Marr then asked him if he had mentioned Mal to which Almec said he hadn't yet at that point. Continuing the questions, Velara asked why Almec wanted Kade here to which Almec said that he didn't exclusively want Kade and that there was another individual Vreth wanted as well, however; Almec feigned his forgetting of this person's name.

title: Sela Marr
text:
With this, Marr asked Velara to "help" Almec remember and, with this, he became very defensive, but was immediately shot by Gar Saxon, who had infiltrated to prison to assassinate Almec under Vreth's orders so that he could not tell them anything. While Velara ran after Saxon, Marr ordered Vek to get a medic as Almec informed Marr that Vreth had had a vision in which the name had come to him. As Almec slowly died, Marr cried out for him to tell her the name of the individual. With this, Almec slowly breathed out "Drayden" before dying in Marr's arms. Marr, briefly shocked by this, eventually recovered and rejoined Vek and Velara—who had lost Saxon in her pursuit of him—in returning to the royal palace.

The final confrontation

> " I know Kael. Your vision is flawed. " ―Marr, to Vreth, refusing to believe his accusations

title: Sela Marr
text:
> " I know Kael. Your vision is flawed. " ―Marr, to Vreth, refusing to believe his accusations

After heading back to the palace, Marr, alongside Velara, Vek, Wrenna, and several other Ferriks, stood atop a balcony overlooking one of Sundari's streets where the citizens were being ordered to move to shelter locations by replicas to which they received major backlash from the citizens for, not liking to replicas present in Sundari. Eventually, Velara had had enough of this and walked away as Marr and Vek followed close behind. As they entered the palace, Velara informed Vek and Marr that the citizens of Sundari would not accept a Republic occupation for much longer and that neither would she. As a response, Vek argued that he and his men did not want to remain as a police synth flux within the city with Marr adding that they would leave once Vreth was captured and that Velara would then be granted her opportunity to lead the people. However, as she said this, Vreth appeared sitting in the throne of the Grand Salon along with the captured Jesse, whom Vreth had managed to retrieve information from regarding Marr using Synth Flux.

title: Sela Marr
text: Velara attempted to attack Vreth by pulling out her WESTAR-35 volt pistols and firing several volt pistol bolts at the Umbra Lord before being stopped by Vreth who used Synth Flux to hold her in place . He briefly held her there before dropping her, leading to Marr and Vek to rush to her aid. Vreth then released Jesse back into their care as a show of good faith towards them. As Jesse arrived back with them, Vek asked if he was alright to which Jesse apologized, noting that he had told Vreth everything before Marr ordered Vek to get Jesse out of the palace. As Vek left, explosions began to ring outside—having been orchestrated by Vreth in a counterattack from the super commandos in order for Marr and him to be left alone—causing Marr to turn her head and Vreth to ask that one of them deal with the explosions. Marr asked for Velara to go, which led Vreth to stand up and announce that he and Marr would be fine together. With a final plea from Marr for her to leave, Velara put her helmet back on and rushed outside to defend her people.

title: Sela Marr
text: Now left alone, Vreth began to note how ignorant all combatants outside were, which led to Marr asking why Vreth was doing this for either her or the Aetheri Council to hear. To this, Vreth noted that he specifically wanted to speak with her. With this, Vreth mentioned Marr's betrayal by the Aetheri Order and asked if this were true to which Marr asserted that she had left voluntarily. Vreth acknowledged this but pointed out that her decision was motivated by the Aetheri Council's hypocrisy. Him noting this caused Marr to briefly pause before Vreth mentioned how he too had been a tool used by another power beyond himself.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr then walked forward and announced that she was there to bring Vreth to justice, to which he claimed that justice was just the construct of the current power structure's morals. He also noted that he believed that the current government would soon be toppled, leading Marr to ask if Vael Mal would be behind what he predicted. Vreth then explained that Mal was behind everything that had recently transpired in the galaxy, always orchestrating events from the shadows, but that would soon reveal himself. Marr then asked for Vreth to join her and help the Aetheri stop Mal before he took control over the galaxy. However, Vreth knew that the Republic had already fallen and that she just couldn't see this. He went on to explain that the Aetheri would not be able to defeat Mal and that their time had already passed, but that he believed that he and Marr might be able to defeat Mal if they worked together.

title: Sela Marr
text: As explosions continued to ring outside, Vreth extended his hand for Marr to join him as she contemplated her decision. As she did this, an explosion shattered the glass around the pair. Eventually, Marr decided that she would help Vreth on the condition that he answer her question on why he wanted Drayden to come to Ferrum. To this, Vreth explained that Drayden was the key to Mal' plan, which led Marr to ask if he was the Seeded One, but Vreth knew that his role was in fact to destroy the Aetheri and that he had long been groomed for his task. Marr then claimed that Vreth was lying, but Vreth remained firm in his beliefs, claiming that he had orchestrated the current war on Ferrum in order to lure Drayden and Kade there in an effort to kill Drayden, depriving Mal of his prized pupil and his main pawn.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr rejected this answer and ignited her flux blades, ready to fight Vreth and take him into custody, claiming that Vreth's vision was flawed and that she knew Drayden well enough to know what he said could never happen. To this, Vreth ignited his own weapon and claimed that he needed to teach her one last lesson. Vreth then lunged at Marr and the two began their duel. Marr managed to dodge several of his attacks before being forced to parry several of his other attacks. She then saw an opening in Vreth's defenses and began to attack him, forcing him back on the defensive. Marr attempted to kick Vreth to no avail, leading to him managing to elbow her in the face and forcing her shoto blade to leave her hand. Marr was now on the defensive once more, being forced to fight with only one blade; however, she soon managed to kick Vreth, allowing her a brief opening to use Synth Flux and retrieve her blade, forcing Vreth to evade the blade as it returned to her hand. The fight then took a brief pause as Marr insulted Vreth by claiming that if Drayden had shown up, Vreth wouldn't have lasted long in their fight to which Vreth commented that Marr had Kade's arrogance before she swung her blade at him, mentioning that she likely had many qualities he disliked.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Resuming the fight, Marr managed to gain the upper hand but was eventually forced to jump back several times to evade Vreth's attacks. Forced in a blade lock, Vreth grunted, attempting to disorient Marr, but this gave her the opportunity to kick him outside of one of the palace's windows. Marr briefly paused to catch her breath before chasing after Vreth to resume their fight.

As Marr emerged outside, she witnessed Ferrik reinforcements arrive to aid the replicas in warding off the super commandos' attack; however, as she turned her head, she noticed Vreth attempting to escape atop a building leading her to chase him to the support beams of the domed city's ceiling. As she reached the support beams, Marr reignited her flux blades and claimed that Kade had been right in his comment that Vreth would be hard to kill. As Vreth turned to look at her, Marr rushed at him as he reignited his own flux blade to continue their duel.

title: Sela Marr
text: He blocked her oncoming attacks as she lunged at him, briefly forcing her on the defensive before regaining herself and attempting to kick Vreth, but he managed to evade. As the fight continued, Marr jumped back on one of the support beams and almost lost her footing, but managed to regain herself before Vreth exclaimed that if she had joined him they could have destroyed Mal together, but Marr knew that this would have only been for Vreth to take his place, which she commented in response. As Vreth jumped towards her, Marr managed to elbow and kick him to another support beam, causing Vreth to briefly be caught off balance. She then once again lunged at him, but was forced off and kicked back, barely managing to hold onto a support beam.

title: Sela Marr
text: Just then, Vreth's fighter arrived and asked for him to depart. As Vreth shattered the glass on the dome of the city in an attempt to escape, Marr chased after him, jumping up and knocking him off of where he stood. As the two regained their balance once more, their duel continued. However, Vreth soon managed to knock one of Marr's flux blades free from her hand, causing it to tumble down to the fighting below. As she attempted to fight with only one of her blades, Vreth managed to easily disarm her of her second blade. Having gained the upper hand, Vreth sliced the support beam the two were standing on, causing it to sag. Marr remained in a fighting position, ready for Vreth to attack her once more. As Vreth jumped onto her sagging support beam, he gave her one last chance to join him, which she refused leading to Vreth continuing his attack, but being stopped when Marr managed to grab hold of his flux blade and throw him off of the beam. She then stopped him from falling by using Synth Flux as Vreth cried out for Marr to let him die.

title: Sela Marr
text:
As gunships arrived to extract him, Vreth wailed in terror of what was to come, claiming they were all going to die before one of the Ferriks used the whipcord within his vambrace and entangled Vreth within it, allowing Vek to stun him. Vek then told Marr that they would take it from there as Marr caught her breath and looked out at the crack in the dome Vreth had created.

#### Aftermath

> " With your help, the Aetheri can stop Mal before it's too late. " " Too late for what? The Republic to fall? It already has, and you just can't see it! There is no justice, no law, no order, except for the one that will replace it! " ―Sela Marr and Vreth

title: Sela Marr
text: As day broke on Ferrum, Marr arrived with the captured Vreth to regroup with Velara. Upon exiting the gunship, Velara exclaimed her disbelief in Marr's ability to capture Vreth, which she noted she was impressed by and handed Marr her flux blades back. In response, Marr noted that it was what the Aetheri Council wanted, with Velara following that by saying that it was still an impressive achievement due to the fact many had failed to capture Vreth in the past. As they continued to walk, Marr noted that this achievement was due to the fact that she had learned from the best the galaxy had, including Velara. However, Velara was not flattered as she expressed that she wished she was proficient in something other than combat. With this, Velara looked out at the ruins the siege had caused, and Marr followed up Velara's previous statement by saying that the people of Ferrum needed a new type of leader. However, Velara continued by saying that her sister had tried and failed to be a new type of leader for Ferrum, wondering if she could be any different.

title: Sela Marr
text: Before they could continue, Vek approached the two and informed Marr that he had managed to contact the Aetheri Council. Leaving Velara, Marr asked if Drayden was with them to which Vek noted that he had been when he had left to inform her about the meeting.
