Before leaving, Velara turned to Marr and gave her her blessing to leave, telling her that she could handle Vreth. With this, Marr left with Vek. As Marr and Vek walked into the meeting via hologram, the members of the Aetheri Council turned to look at the pair, with Koss noting that her mission had been a success. Marr confirmed this and reaffirmed their belief that she would be escorting Vreth back to Vantor once they departed. With this, Zho thanked Marr for her service to which Marr said that she was just doing her duty as a citizen of the Republic. Zho then asked if she did this act instead as an Aetheri, but Marr followed this up by informing them that she was not yet ready to be called an Aetheri once more. Moving on from this, Marr noted that she wished to speak with Drayden, but was instead informed that Drayden had left to inform Mal that Skarn had been located on Uthara. Having received an earlier report of Kade being sent to Uthara, Marr asked if he was the one who had engaged Skarn to which Zho confirmed that he had indeed engaged the Dissident forces on the planet. With this, Marr noted that the war could be over soon if Kade managed to kill Skarn, but, in response, Koss noted that

title: Sela Marr
text: Uthara, Marr asked if he was the one who had engaged Skarn to which Zho confirmed that he had indeed engaged the Dissident forces on the planet. With this, Marr noted that the war could be over soon if Kade managed to kill Skarn, but, in response, Koss noted that the war's conclusion depended on if Mal decided to end it or not. With Marr questioning what he meant, Koss explained that this was exclusively for the Council to discuss. Marr bowed her head and told Koss that she understood. The briefing was subsequently adjourned, although Zho remained in contact with Marr after the other masters ceased their transmission, and asked if she had more to say or if she had a message for Drayden. However, Marr said that she had neither, neglecting the information she had received from Vreth and informing the Grand Master that she would talk to Drayden herself once he managed to make contact with him. With this, Zho wished for Synth Flux to be with Marr and cut off his own transmission. With the meeting over, Vek walked over and noted that Marr had neglected to inform them upon the information Vreth had mentioned about Drayden, but Marr waved this aside and simply confirmed that she hadn't. The two then walked out to regroup with Velara and witness Vreth's transport into their Nura -class transport .

title: Sela Marr
text: As they walked out, Velara, Wrenna, and several other Ferriks walked by with the captured Vreth contained within an old Ferrik vault . Velara walked up to Marr and the two acknowledged each other with a bow of their heads with Vek leaving Marr to accompany the Ferriks as they escorted Vreth. As the Ferriks boarded the transport, Marr acknowledged the vault and noted that it was impressive, leading to Velara mentioning that the vault was from an era when the Ferriks were at war with the Aetheri. With this, Marr jokingly remarked that she thought Velara's sister, Satinna, had outlawed such devices as these while she was duchess of Ferrum, which Velara said that she had and that this was the last one the Ferriks possessed. With their conversation finished, Velara and Marr shook hands and the two said their goodbyes as Marr left to board the transport.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Now with Vreth in their custody, the transport took off to board the Iron Cruiser Tribunal . While onboard, Marr and Vek made conversation between one another. Arriving on the Vorash, Marr and Vek exited the transport and made their way to the ship's bridge. As Marr and Vek entered the bridge, the officers present turned and saluted Marr with a smile on their faces. The Iron Cruiser soon entered hyperspace as Vek and Marr watched. As Marr looked into the void of hyperspace, Vek asked if something was on her mind, leading Marr to explain that all she had ever been since she was an Adept had been a soldier, contrary to her training as a peacekeeper. To this, Vek said that all his life he had only been a soldier and that he and his brothers received a mixed feeling about the war because of it, but he knew that without the war, he and his brothers would've never existed. Marr then turned and smiled, telling Vek that the replicas' existence was one of the few good things that had come out of the Replica Wars, nothing that the Republic would never have been able to find better soldiers and that it had allowed her to receive her best friend in Vek. The two then saluted one another as an officer walked in to report that a new briefing had come in and, when asked if she would like to join him to look at it, Marr declined, believing it was more good news. Marr then looked back into streaking blue void of hyperspace.

#### Directive 66

Saving Vek

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Directive 66

Saving Vek

> " How widespread is this? " " Sela, it's all of us. The entire Grand Army of the Republic has been ordered to hunt down and destroy the Aetheri Knights. " ―Vek explains how widespread the betrayal of the Aetheri is — Link ▶️ ( file info )

As Marr stared into hyperspace, she received a vision of Koss dueling Mal within his office and Drayden betraying Koss, but did not fully understand what she was feeling. With this, Marr rushed into the command center and informed Vek that she believed something terrible had happened to Drayden. However, instead, the replicas began to turn their volt pistols towards her in accordance with Directive 66 . Joining them, Vek asked for them to lower their volt pistols so that he could kill her himself and raised his own volt pistols, a tear rolling down his face as he attempted to fight his inhibitor chip , an organic brain implant that compelled each replica trooper to comply with the directive.

title: Sela Marr
text: While his whole body shook and a tear rolled down his face, Vek asked for Marr to find Fivva before firing upon her. Marr, forced to jump out of the way, ran towards Vek and tackled him, igniting her flux blades to defend against the other replicas' incoming volt pistol bolts, managing to kill both attacking her. She then closed the blast door as Vek began to stand up, rubbing his head from being forced into the command console. However, Jesse along with several other replicas arrived, forcing Marr to divert her attention as all of the replicas present began to fire upon her. With this, Marr attempted to direct the volt pistol bolts into the wiring above in an attempt to escape. As she escaped, the replicas believed they had managed to kill her, but soon found that Marr had instead escaped into a vent above.

title: Sela Marr
text: Exiting the vents, Marr made her way to the detention level in a bid to free Vreth from capture in an attempt to create a diversion for herself. As she arrived, members of the Vantor Guard were taking aim at Vreth, ready to execute him, but she instead used Synth Flux to push one aside and knocked the other one out by throwing him into the ceiling. With this, Marr looked towards Vreth and told him not to make her regret her decision before she freed him from captivity. As Vreth fell out of the vault, he expressed his surprise that she had survived, but instead of feeling flattered, Marr held her flux blade to his throat and asked him if he was behind the replica's turning. Vreth instead explained that he did not know exactly what had transpired, but instead said that he was sure Marr had felt the voices crying out in pain and death as Aetheri across the galaxy were killed, including Marr's former mentor Tor Vayne. Marr then explained that her replicas had turned against her and she didn't know why to which Vreth began to laugh and say that he had not known what Mal'

title: Sela Marr
text: voices crying out in pain and death as Aetheri across the galaxy were killed, including Marr's former mentor Tor Vayne. Marr then explained that her replicas had turned against her and she didn't know why to which Vreth began to laugh and say that he had not known what Mal' had been playing, but that he now did—the Grand Army of the Republic had turned against the Aetheri Order. He then stood up and said that Marr had done the right thing in seeking his help and asked her to follow his lead, but Marr instead held her flux blade up to him once more and made clear that she just wanted to use him as a diversion and not as a partner. With this, Marr ordered Vreth to go cause some chaos as Vreth looked at her with hatred displayed on his face. As the two walked out of the cell, Vreth asked for one of Marr's flux blades so that he might be granted a fighting chance, but Marr declined his offer and commanded him to leave once more. Now having freed Vreth, Marr made her way to the droid storage room to recruit help from the droids located there.

title: Sela Marr
text: As replicas ran by, Marr snuck her way through the Vorash, eventually arriving at her destination. Once Marr arrived in the droid storage room, she reactivated her old astromech droid R7-A7 who was ecstatic to see her, but Marr told him to quiet down as she required his help. R7 began to beep profusely, but Marr continued to attempt to quiet him down as the other two droids CH-33P and RG-G1 activated. As they activated, the droids began to profusely ask Marr questions upon what was happening, but Marr couldn't give them answers as she didn't know herself; however, she asked them for their help in discovering why. With this, the droids pledged their allegiance to her as Marr ordered them to get started.

title: Sela Marr
text: With all of them in agreement, Marr ordered R7 to patch into the central computer and search for any secure file in relation to CT-5555 as asked of her by Vek. As R7 searched, he discovered files in relation to an incident that occurred aboard a space station above Ringo Vindra between CT-5385 "Tupp" and Aetheri Master Tiplee as well as a report from Gelvarian doctor Nalle Seris that said that Fivva had had a malfunction with his inhibitor chip. She went on to mention a grievance report filed by Vek, which Marr asked R7 to open for her, but soon discovered that it was sealed. In order to open it, Marr tried Drayden's passcode of 8108, which managed to open the file. Upon opening the file, Vek said that the inhibitor chips within the replicas' brains could possibly have an alternative purpose they did not yet know. With this new information, Marr took the droids in an attempt to capture Vek and remove his inhibitor chip.

title: Sela Marr
text: As Vek rushed across a hallway, R7 and CH-33P stopped him, sealing the blast doors between him and the other replicas to leave him and Marr alone. With Vek trapped, R7 displayed a hologram of Marr, informing Vek that she believes she knew why he turned against her and that she saw his report on Fivva. On top of this, she informed him that he had been programmed to turn against her and that his mind had been altered by the inhibitor chip, continuing by saying that she could help him. As Vek took aim at R7 and asked where Marr was, she appeared behind him, with R7 electrocuting him in order to bring him to the medical bay. As Vek fell to the ground, Marr asked the droids to be careful as they had not been trying to hurt Vek. As replicas began to yell from outside the blast doors, Marr asked CH-33P if all the doors were sealed between them and the medical bay, which he confirmed. With this, Marr lifted Vek and placed him on top of R7, G-G, and CH-33P, and the combined efforts of the three droids allowed Marr to bring him to the medical

title: Sela Marr
text: doors, Marr asked CH-33P if all the doors were sealed between them and the medical bay, which he confirmed. With this, Marr lifted Vek and placed him on top of R7, G-G, and CH-33P, and the combined efforts of the three droids allowed Marr to bring him to the medical bay. As the replicas broke through the blast doors, Marr sealed even more doors to cover their escape. Reaching the medical bay, Marr placed Vek on the medical bed. With Vek in position, Marr ordered R7 to run a scan for the inhibitor chip within Vek's brain; however, the initial scans came up empty prompting Marr to ask the medical droid to check again. As they scanned once more, CH-33P alerted Marr that the replicas had begun to hack into the door and, with this, Marr ordered G-G to reseal the door as fast as possible if the replicas managed to break through. Marr then asked R7 once more if anything had come up in the scans, but nothing had yet been located.

title: Sela Marr
text: With this news, Marr walked over to Vek and put her hands around his head, beginning to chant "I am one with Synth Flux and Synth Flux is with me." Continuing to chant, the unconscious Vek began to join in as the inhibitor chip was finally located. With its location finally having been discovered, Marr ordered R7 to remove the inhibitor chip to which R7 originally objected by asking if it would work, but Marr didn't know, only clarifying that if it didn't, the four of them were dead anyway. While they attempted to remove the inhibitor chip, the replicas finally broke through the door, and Marr, in an effort to ward them off, reignited her flux blades. As the replicas began to fire upon Marr, she deflected their volt pistol bolts and used Synth Flux to throw several of them while CH-33P attempted to reseal the door. As the replicas began to overwhelm Marr, Vek woke up from his surgery and used his volt pistols to kill several replicas as CH-33P finally resealed the door.

title: Sela Marr
text:
With Vek awake, Marr asked if he was alright. Vek assured her that he was and apologized for turning against and almost killing her earlier. With that, Marr asked how widespread the inhibitor chips were and how many Aetheri were currently being betrayed across the galaxy, to which Vek responded with the crushing news that the entire Grand Army of the Republic had betrayed their Aetheri and had been ordered to hunt down and kill the remaining ones. However, soon after, the replicas began to cut through the door again as Marr and Vek turned to watch.

Escaping the Tribunal

title: Sela Marr
text:
Escaping the Tribunal

With Vek now awake and on Marr's side, the two friends were ready to escape the Tribunal . Standing in front of the entrance as replicas attempted to break through, Vek asked how Marr was planning on getting them out of the medical bay, to which she informed him that she had an idea. As Vek asked what her idea was, Marr instead asked Vek to set his volt pistols to stun as they were not attempting to kill any of them. As the replicas continued cutting through the door, Vek informed Marr that they had almost finished cutting through, but Marr still told him to wait. As they finished cutting through, Marr used Synth Flux to push the door out and knock several replicas aside, making their escape easier. Briefly stunned, the three remaining troopers were easily knocked out by Vek; however, several more replicas appeared from both sides as Marr rushed out of the med bay, flux blades ignited, blocking each of their shots while Vek stunned all replicas standing in their way.

title: Sela Marr
text: As they fought the oncoming replicas, Marr ordered R7 to find them a path off of the Iron Cruiser. While doing so, R7 managed to close the blast doors around them, sealing off several oncoming troopers, allowing Vek and Marr to mop up the few remaining troopers. Now at a pause in the action, R7 informed Marr that all of the escape pods had been destroyed, leading Marr to conclude that taking a shuttle would be their best bet to escape. With this, Marr began to leave, but while she walked away Vek informed her that Vreth had escaped his imprisonment, but Marr, having let him out herself, informed Vek upon this fact, to his surprise. He began to question her on why she would do such a thing, but she simply said that it was for a diversion as Marr began to rush for the hangar, asking Vek to hurry.

title: Sela Marr
text: As they continued to run towards the hangar, the ship jolted as it exited hyperspace, having been stopped by Vreth who had destroyed the hyperrelay using Synth Flux, crippling it and causing it to be caught in the gravitational pull of a nearby moon . Finally arriving at the hangar's control center, Vek was the first to enter, stunning an unsuspecting officer shortly before Marr rushed in and used Synth Flux to push one aside as Vek stunned the other two. As they reached the controls, Vek informed Marr that the replicas had already locked everything down and that if they weren't trying to kill them, he would've been proud. As Vek said this, Marr ordered R7 to unlock the doors in Bay 12 , CH-33P to prep the shuttle, and G-G to find out what had happened to the ship that had caused it to jolt. As G-G attempted to discover what happened, he informed the pair that the hyperrelay had been completely destroyed to Vek's disbelief. The two soon discovered that they had become entrenched in the gravitational field of a moon nearby. With this, Marr asked R7 to open the main hangar doors, and with that, they

title: Sela Marr
text: to discover what happened, he informed the pair that the hyperrelay had been completely destroyed to Vek's disbelief. The two soon discovered that they had become entrenched in the gravitational field of a moon nearby. With this, Marr asked R7 to open the main hangar doors, and with that, they saw the oncoming moon, causing Marr to exclaim that they needed to get out of there. As the ship continued to jolt profusely, Vek asked about the status of the hangar doors as Marr asked about the shuttle. With that, R7 managed to open one of the hangar doors, revealing a shuttle for them; however, as R7 continued to open the rest of the hangar doors, it revealed an army of replica troopers, led by Jesse, waiting for them.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Fight in the hangar

As the replicas took their positions in the hangar, Vek quickly asked what they were going to do, but Marr admitted that there were too many replicas standing in their path to make a break for the shuttle and that she didn't want to hurt any of them, leading Vek to tell her that the troops did not care about what she wanted. Continuing on, Vek told her that the Iron Cruiser was going down and that all of the replicas aboard were willing to die in order to kill them both. With that, Marr walked over to Vek and removed his helmet, revealing his distraught state. With this, Marr explained that Vek was a good soldier, but that every one of the replicas trying to kill was too. Marr continued to state that they may be willing to die, but she wasn't willing to be the one to kill them, leading Vek to believe that she was admitting defeat.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr declined this, however, to Vek's puzzlement as he didn't see any other way besides killing them in a bid to escape. Marr then walked over to the viewport to see the army of replica troopers standing before them and informed him that she had an idea. As Vek began to look slightly puzzled, Marr handed him back his helmet and assured him that she thought it was a good idea. She then knelt down and asked the droids if she could count on them to which all three of them agreed that she could. With their acknowledgement, she stood up and informed her four allies that she would explain her plan on the way to the hangar. As they approached the hangar, Marr explained that Vek would feign her capture to the replicas as a distraction, while the droids snuck past them and activated the lifts beneath replicas' feet. Before they arrived, Vek took Marr's flux blades to make their ruse seem more plausible.

title: Sela Marr
text: As Vek and Marr reached the hangar, Vek asked for the replicas to hold their fire as he escorted a supposedly captured Marr with her arms on her head. As the replicas prepared to fire on Marr, Vek once again asked them to hold their fire as Jesse told him that he had his orders to execute Marr and asked him to eliminate her or else he would do it himself. As the replicas continued to aim their volt pistols upon Marr, Vek explained that the order had been to eliminate the Aetheri for treason and that since Marr was no longer an Aetheri, she should not be considered a traitor under the directive. This caused Jesse to briefly pause before he informed Vek that he himself had informed the replicas that they were under special orders from Vael Mal to eliminate Marr, even though she was no longer considered an Aetheri, as well as any replica who disobeyed the directive. As Jesse spoke, Marr turned to look at the droids who informed her that they needed a little more time, leading Marr to tell Vek to keep the replicas talking for a little longer.

title: Sela Marr
text: Responding to what Jesse said, Vek tried to appeal to his friend one final time, but the ARC trooper, despite taking another moment to process what Vek said, stripped Vek of his title of commander, accusing him of treason. However, the droids turned towards Marr again and signaled that they had completed their task prompting Marr to ask Vek if he was ready, which he responded to by saying that he hadn't much liked being a commander anyway. As Jesse signaled for the replicas to fire upon Vek and Marr, Marr's plan came to fruition; the lifts beneath the replicas began to drop. With that, Marr pushed Jesse down the shaft with Synth Flux and was thrown back her flux blades by Vek.

title: Sela Marr
text: Now wielding her flux blades once more, Marr, alongside Vek, easily managed to incapacitate the remaining replica troopers. However, as they fought the remaining replicas, Vreth appeared inside the hangar, also attempting to escape the crashing Iron Cruiser. As Vek and Marr continued to fight the remaining replicas, Vreth ran past them, and, noticing Vreth running past them thanks to G-G, Marr notified Vek. Finding the remaining replicas insignificant, Marr chased after Vreth and allowed Vek to deal with the rest of them as he followed her. As she arrived to stop Vreth, he threw several crates at her with Synth Flux, telling her that she had wanted this chaos and threw a cart at her as she jumped to avoid it. Finally arriving to attack Vreth, Marr slashed at Vreth before he used Synth Flux in a powerful push, knocking her all the way back to the lifts; however, before she could fall into the starship bay below, G-G managed to use one of his cables to help her back up. As G-G helped Marr up, the replicas began to regain consciousness, forcing Marr to use one of her flux blades to defend against the incoming volt pistol bolts.

title: Sela Marr
text: As she defended herself, Vek did all he could to assist her, stunning as many replicas as he could using his volt pistols. However, Marr began to lose the fight as the volt pistol bolts began to hit her beskar-plated armor. The replicas, realizing the droids were at fault, began to fire upon them, forcing CH-33P and G-G to move back. However, as this occurred, Vreth stole the shuttle and began to use it to escape the Vorash. Finally managing to fully climb up, Marr ran towards the shuttle and used Synth Flux in an attempt to stop Vreth from escaping. As she did this, Vreth increased power to the thrusters, causing her to begin sliding across the floor of the hangar and forcing Vek to grab her hand to stop her from slipping away. However, reinforcements began to arrive in the hangar, which Vek noted to Marr, who was still attempting to hold Vreth back. Being forced to divert his attention, Vek was forced to let go and defend her from the oncoming replicas. Marr continued to strain and witnessed as R7 was killed by one of the replicas' stray volt pistol bolts. However, seeing that Vek was beginning

title: Sela Marr
text: still attempting to hold Vreth back. Being forced to divert his attention, Vek was forced to let go and defend her from the oncoming replicas. Marr continued to strain and witnessed as R7 was killed by one of the replicas' stray volt pistol bolts. However, seeing that Vek was beginning to become overwhelmed by the replicas, Marr was forced to let go of the shuttle and allow Vreth to escape. Marr then rushed back into battle alongside Vek. Being forced to defend herself from all sides, Marr saw that they were vastly outnumbered and threw her flux blades into the ground, using Synth Flux to cut a hole through it in order to escape into the starship bay below. However, they were once again met by replicas—Jesse and the other troopers whom the astromechs had dropped below—ready to fight them once again. As Jesse ordered for the replicas to attack, Marr was once again forced to defend herself. Luckily, from above, CH-33P and G-G managed to manipulate the lifts once more, forcing many replicas back up into the main hangar. However, the two droids' efforts did not go unnoticed and the two were promptly executed by the replicas. Finishing off the remaining troopers, Vek and Marr began to look around the starship bay for another ship to escape with, coming up with nothing as most ships located there were under maintenance.

title: Sela Marr
text: Eventually, Marr managed to spot a lone Yarrow starfighter, but, before they could reach it, they were once again attacked by the replicas. In an attempt to reach the shuttle, Marr jumped across one of the lifts and used Synth Flux to push Vek onto the Yarrow. As many more replicas arrived on the lifts, Marr used Synth Flux to push them all aside, but still began to be overwhelmed. Concurrently, the Iron Cruiser began to break apart and lost all artificial gravity onboard, causing everything on the ship to begin falling towards the moon's surface. This forced Marr to use her flux blades in an attempt to stop herself from falling. As she did this, Vek asked her to hurry up and rush to the Yarrow, leading Marr to muster enough energy to run across the surface of the hangar and attempted to jump onto the Yarrow, but fell the into open air as the Yarrow fell out of the hangar.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr began to fly through the open air as Vek searched for her within the Yarrow, eventually spotting her and opening the gunner's hatch for her to climb inside. Marr attempted to use the air around her to reach the Yarrow, but, as she grabbed hold, she lost her grip and flew away. Marr was now forced to use the debris to her advantage and ran across one of the destroyed engines in an attempt to regroup with Vek. With one final jump, Marr was forced to use Synth Flux to pull herself closer to the gunner's seat, finally being able to grab hold and climb into the hatch. Having finally rescued her, Vek flew the Yarrow away as the Tribunal , and the replicas, went down in flames.

#### Burying the dead

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Burying the dead

Vek later landed the Yarrow near the Iron Cruiser's crash site and the two erected graves for each of the fallen replicas that they could find, placing their helmets on the graves of their fallen friends. They would also scavenge the remains of R7-A7 to rebuild him. Upon completion of the burial site, Marr stood over the fallen replicas, taking out her flux blades and looking at one of them one final time before dropping them to the ground and leaving them behind. Now fugitives and enemies of the Republic, Marr and Vek were forced to fake their own deaths and go into exile aboard their Yarrow. Marr also received a message from Kade sent to all surviving Aetheri, warning to stay away from the Aetheri Sanctum. She also came to understand that Mal had been an Umbra Lord, and she was forced to stay on the run as Mal transformed the Republic into his Imperium .

title: Sela Marr
text: Following the destruction of the Aetheri Order, Marr was listed amongst the Warden Order ' priority targets of presumed survivors of the purge. Some years later during the early Imperial Era , the flux blade she left behind was discovered and taken by Xarn Velgor, an Umbra Lord who was in fact Marr's former master, Kael Drayden. Neither Marr nor Vek were aware that Vreth's suspicions during the last days of the Replica Wars came true: Vael Mal used Drayden's frustration with the Aetheri Council and his fear of losing his Ondar in childbirth to lure him to the umbra side of Synth Flux. Drayden had clung closer to Ondar after losing Marr, who would have served as a counterbalance to his passions and fears, out of concern that she could leave him as well.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Ondar ultimately did pass away, but her body was prepared by the mortician Commodex Tahn to make it look like she was still pregnant at the time of her death, keeping the existence of the children a secret from the Umbra and, by extension, anyone who saw the late Senator's body. Wearing a hood to keep her identity a secret, Marr secretly attended Ondar's funeral in Ondara's capital of Serath, but she was noticed by Senator Bael Prestor Solen . She was left unaware of the existence of Drayden's children. Parting ways with Marr, Vek and the rebuilt R7-A7, meanwhile, began to work against the newly formed Imperium with Marr's friends Trayk and Ravin Martez. When Vek reunited with Replica Synth Flux 99 , he kept Marr's survival a secret, merely telling them that he had help when his chip was removed.

### Age of the Imperium

#### Life on Thabeska

title: Sela Marr
text:
### Age of the Imperium

#### Life on Thabeska

> " We all look like each other, everyone in my family. Our long hair and our brown skin. People don't try to tell us apart, and we fool them. It helped us avoid the shadow, and it keeps us safe from the law. I wish you looked like us, too. " ―Hedala Fardi, to Sela Marr Sela Marr fled into the Outer Reach , intent on hiding from the Imperium. Eventually, she found the planet Thabeska , a planet that dealt largely in small-scale water and technology trading, and one with a relatively small and unorganized population located far away from major hyperspace routes . Believing the rural world to be of little interest to the Imperium, and a steady stream of newcomers would allow herself to blend into the quiet world, Marr made landing on Thabeska. However, the refugee did not account for the presence of the local Fardi clan , an influential family that either touched or ran most of Thabeska's businesses, including their own smuggling operations, though the family fronted such with several legal businesses. In time, Marr came to hear rumors that some kind of dark lord who was serving the Emperor and hunting Aetheri, yet she was unable to confirm such reports.

title: Sela Marr
text: In order to hide her identity, Marr took on the name "Ashla," which was also the name of a moon that orbited the scared Aetheri world of Tython , another term for the light side of Synth Flux, and the name of an Aetheri youngling from the Replica Wars-era. Upon arrival on Thabeska, Marr was greeted by several young girls. They showed her where she could find food and a place to stay, and introduced her to Fardi , who bought Ashla's ship for what she thought was a nearly decent price. Nevertheless, Fardi did not inquire the reason for Ashla's arrival at the dawn of the Imperium, and the girls, who Ashla realized to be Fardi's daughters and nieces, took the Solinai arrival under their wing. Followed ceaselessly by the young Fardi sisters, Ashla soon found herself working for the Fardi family once they learned that she was a good mechanic, and the refugee was given her own room in the Fardi compound and paid fair amounts of money for her work. Ashla had secured her place in the Fardi clan, becoming a friend amongst the Fardi girls.

title: Sela Marr
text: Two months before Imperium Day , the first anniversary of Theron Mal's rise to power, Sela Marr was working on some droids in the shipyard on Thabeska when she noticed some of the Fardi children playing by a stack of crates. As Marr observed, the crates began to fall onto the children who cried out of fear, forcing Marr to save the Fardis by levitating the crates through Synth Flux. Marr had kept her Aetheri powers a secret since leaving Ferrum, and feared that she had revealed herself to the young Fardis. Ashla reminded them that they should not have been playing near the crates, and they begged her not to tell Fardi, giving up their sweets—their only form of currency—and ignoring the supernatural incident they had just witnessed. Only Hedala Fardi , the youngest of her family, looked at Ashla with fascination. Sometime later, the Solinai outlander discovered that Hedala Fardi was Synth Flux-sensitive, as the Fardi youngling lifted several small stones with subtle hand gestures before the eyes of Sela Marr.

title: Sela Marr
text:
On Imperium Day, Marr was informed by the Fardi girls that their father was having important Imperial guests over for dinner and that they wanted to meet anyone who was new to the planet. The girls offered for Marr to come and sit with them at the Imperium Day parade and flyby, and told her about how security was a disaster due to the high amount of ships in the shipyard.

Marr took this invitation as a subtle warning and opportunity to escape the planet, and Marr used this opportunity to her advantage. She gathered the belongings she had and escaped through the city streets for the landing field.

After numerous run-ins with Imperial shock troopers, Sela Marr was forced to steal one of Fardi's ships, leaving the planet. Once in orbit, Marr remembered Hedala Fardi and the danger that she was in, being a Synth Flux-sensitive child who would likely be sought out by the Imperium, but Marr knew that she was too late, so she left.

#### Raadan

A pastoral refuge

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Raadan

A pastoral refuge

Marr found herself on the remote agrarian moon of Raadan in the Outer Reach. Marr landed the Fardi ship at the planet's main settlement. Under the alias of Ashla, Marr befriended a local girl named Kaeden Larte , who was part of a farming community. Kaeden allowed Marr to move into an abandoned home formerly owned by Cietra . Marr agreed to work as a mechanic, repairing droids and other machinery in return for ration packs. While adjusting to her new surroundings, Marr reminisced about her droid friend Bolt-3 and having to hide her Synth Flux powers. The following day, Kaeden hired Marr to repair her thresher. While repairing the machinery, Marr learned more about Kaeden's life and work as a farmer and considered settling on the remote moon due to the lack of an Imperial presence. After repairing Kaeden's thresher, Marr explored the town and sighted several nearby hills and caves which she identified as a potential hiding place.

title: Sela Marr
text: On her third day on Raadan, Marr took the opportunity to explore the hills and caves ringing the settlement. She found a cave which she identified as her hiding place. Marr later met with Kaeden, her sister Miara Larte and several local friends including the farmer Tibbola , the work crew leader Vartan , and the twins Hoban and Neera at Selda's cantina , which had the best food in the settlement. The cantina was owned by the Solinai bartender Selda and run by the Garnethexan woman Malat , who reminded Marr of Aetheri Master Tor Vayne. While socializing with her hosts, Marr learned that Kaeden and Miara were orphans who had lost their parents in an accident. Vartan had adopted the two girls. When Kaeden asked "Ashla" about her family, Marr claimed that she was adopted. When Selda asked Marr if she was part of the influx of aliens that had migrated out of the Core Reaches, Marr claimed that she was not running from anything but only longed for quiet. Selda advised her to talk to him or Vartan if she encountered any changes.

title: Sela Marr
text: As time passed, Marr became the settlement's mechanic and repaired numerous broken threshers and other farming equipment. Kaeden and Miara came to regard "Ashla" as an adopted family member and regularly visited Marr to chat and deliver gifts including a door lock. Despite the friendship of the Larte sisters, Marr decided that she had grown bored with her new rustic, backwater adopted home. One free day, she packed up some supplies and went to meditate in the caves alone. Marr sensed a disturbance in Synth Flux and witnessed the arrival of an Imperial Iron Cruiser above the settlement. The Imperial official Jenneth Pilar had decided to exploit Raadan as a source of crops for the Imperial Military . Despite initially panicking, Marr decided that the Imperium had not come to hunt her.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr traveled to Selda's cantina and discussed the arrival of the Imperium with Kaeden and her friends. Miara speculated that the Imperium had come to explore the possibility of growing crops on Raadan. The arrival of Imperial rule saw the introduction of new restrictive measures including night curfews, rules forbidding large group meetings, and restricting cantinas' operating hours, food, and alcohol. In response, Marr advised her friends to start stockpiling rations. While several Imperial personnel visited the cantina, Marr and her friends avoided contact with the Imperials by playing a game of crokin . When they inquired about Sela's knowledge regarding their new situation, Marr decided not to reveal her past yet.

Stockpiling supplies

> " Why aren't you at work? " " I am at work. I mean, I'm not a farmer. I fix the equipment when it's broken, see? " ―A shock trooper questions Marr

title: Sela Marr
text:
Stockpiling supplies

> " Why aren't you at work? " " I am at work. I mean, I'm not a farmer. I fix the equipment when it's broken, see? " ―A shock trooper questions Marr

The following morning, Marr was visited by a pair of shock troopers who asked why she was working. Marr informed them that her job was fixing broken machines, and so one of them asked for her information, saying that she may be reassigned to field if they deem it necessary. Wishing to maintain the freedom she had under her job repairing machines, Marr used a mind trick to convince the shock troopers that her work was important for food production and they did not need to reassign her. With the pair in agreement with her, she asked if there was anything else she could help with and one reminded her of the new rules posted around the settlement. Marr closed the door on them and accumulated her rations to take to the caves. Being cautious of any surveillance that could be watching her, she made her way to the caves and hid the rations.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Wishing to move her freighter from the spaceport before the Imperium locked it down, Marr scouted a place to hide it, discovering a gully where the starship could fit. She then headed to the spaceport to retrieve the freighter. There, an Imperial officer took list of the starships in the port. He asked Marr of her purpose there, to which she told him that she wished to move her ship. The officer tried to assure her that the local garrison would keep it safe, but she then began mocking the security, making her way past the haggled officer before he could continue to dispute.

Marr proceeded to the pilot's seat of the freighter and prepared for takeoff. The Imperial officer reattempted to argue but was muffled out by the engines as she flew the ship away. Marr flew her freighter the opposite way to the gully, taking it the long way around Raadan to cover her tracks. Although she briefly considered abandoning the moon forever to run from the Imperium, she chose to continue instead and hid her ship in the gully with its nose positioned upwards towards the sky to ensure a swift take off.

Sowing seeds of insurgency

title: Sela Marr
text:
Sowing seeds of insurgency

> " I've seen them bringing in their own seed. Whatever we're planting, it won't be something we get to keep or sell. " " They'll buy off the overseers. They'll give them enough money to go off-world, and then work the rest of us to the bone. I've seen things like this before. " ―Miara and Marr discuss the Imperium's intentions on Raadan

Later, Marr met up with Kaeden, Miara, and number of other farmers at Selda's cantina. Neera informed Marr that Malat and her husband had already found work on the planet Garnethex . Marr lied that her freighter had been stolen when Kaeden asked why she had not also decided to leave Raadan. She and Miara then discussed the capabilities of the security lock the latter had created for her, with Vartan asking about making bigger charges. As Marr shut this down, Hoban argued that explosives would get rid of the Imperium, to which the Solinai claimed would provoke reinforcements from the Imperium, insisting that surviving with the Imperium was a better strategy.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr then learned from Kaeden and Miara that the overseers were adding two hours to the farmers' shifts, with the Imperium was planning on speeding up the crops and bringing their own seeds in. In this time, a number of uniformed Imperials entered the cantina. Marr then tabled the idea that the Imperium was going to buy off the overseers and overwork the farmers, brushing off Neera's inquiry into her past. Hoban insisted in blowing up Imperials, but as Marr began arguing with him, a drunken Tibbola got into a scuffle with an Imperial officer. The Imperial officer overpowered Tibbola and let a shock trooper shoot the farmer dead.

title: Sela Marr
text:
After Vartan, Hoban and Neera left, Marr watched Kaeden play crokin and suggested that the safest way to hurt the Imperium on Raadan was for the farmers to begin working slower to slow the growth of their crops. Before Kaeden and Miara departed, Marr told them to relay the suggestion to Vartan, who presumably knew how to slow crop growth. Marr briefly spoke to Selda, who deduced that she had seen deaths like Tibbola's before and told her to be careful. The bartender then gave her some leftover food. Marr quickly walked home after.

Building a coalition

> " By the time we harvest, the fields will be useless dirt. Nothing will grow for seasons and it's not like they're going to pay us anything we can use to buy fertilizer with. The whole moon will be ruined. " " Are there other fields? " " No. The whole of Raadan is nearly useless to begin with. " ―Vartan and Marr discuss the Imperium's artificial crop

title: Sela Marr
text:
For the next two weeks, Marr spent her days smuggling food, medical supplies, and water recyclers out to the caves. Marr was aided by the bartender Selda and several local vendors. In response to the slow growth of crops, thanks to the farmers, the new Imperial overseers extended the farmers' work shifts without increasing food rations, water, and breaks. Vartan discovered that the Imperium was growing a new artificial crop on Raadan that leached the planet's soils, preventing the farms from growing more crops. This fueled local resentment against the Imperium since Raadan had little arable land. In a conversation about the artificial crops, Marr convinced Vartan to lend her Miara and Kaeden, whom she recruited for assembling bombs that were to be used to attack Imperial forces. Marr showed Kaeden her caves on a map and later handed the farmer and Miara food at those same caves. The sisters became questioned Marr's intentions in stockpiling at the caves so early on, but Marr dismissed it as habits and directed the conversation towards Kaeden and Miara's parents. Over the next several days, Vartan recruited forty farmers including Hoban into a coalition movement for Marr. He briefed the Solinai on the matter at Selda's cantina, displaying how the recruits were organized into crews. Before leaving, Marr told him that she would brief the farmers the next day and departed the cantina.

Sabotage mission

> " I want to see the patrol a couple times. This might be our only chance to break in here this easily, and we should take advantage of this. " ―Marr, to her colleagues

title: Sela Marr
text:
Sabotage mission

> " I want to see the patrol a couple times. This might be our only chance to break in here this easily, and we should take advantage of this. " ―Marr, to her colleagues

Later, Marr led a mission to plant the corrosive charges on the Imperial walkers stored at the Raadian shipyard. For the mission she chose Miara, Neera and the Rodanori Kolvin to accompany her; Miara to help set the charges, Neera for her swift thinking, and Kolvin for his nimbleness. Due to the weak shock trooper security, Marr and her team infiltrated the spaceport easily. While planting charges, Marr took her time to observe the patrols, feeling that they would not be able to infiltrate the compound as easily after. After observing a couple patrol cycles passed, Neera advised the Solinai that it was time to leave.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr branched from the group with Miara to continue setting charges, and the Solinai was reminded of her time on Underra during the Replica Wars. During their work, she also discovered that Miara had smuggled a real bomb, asking the girl of it. Miara tried to dismiss this as an accident, but the Solinai pressed her inquiry, asking if her companion had been plotting behind her back. The pair were briefly interrupted when another patrol passed, this time scanning the compound for a moment. After they passed, Marr and Miara continued their mission and soon reunited with Neera and Kolvin.

After evading shock trooper sentries, Marr and her team headed back to Selda's cantina. There, she discovered that Vartan had sent Hoban and Kaeden on an unsanctioned mission to attack the Imperial admin building. Since the uprising was premature, Marr urged the farmers to return home and to disavow any knowledge of what had happened that night to evade any arresting that could ensue. However, Miara refused to abandon her older sister. A reluctant Marr agreed to rescue Kaeden and the others but warned Miara to follow her orders and bring the explosives.

An abortive uprising

title: Sela Marr
text:
An abortive uprising

> " What are you going to do Ashla? " " I'm going to the front. The fighting is the thickest there, but I might be able to help out long enough for our people to retreat. " ―Miara Larte and Marr

Marr ran through the streets with Miara and Neera towards the Imperial admin building when the alarms sounded from the Imperial compound, where the damage to the walkers had been discovered. As they continued to the compound, an explosion sounded and Miara denied that it was one of her bombs. When Marr told her two comrades to reveal the real plan, Neera revealed that Hoban had split the coalition fighters into three groups and that they were armed with explosives and volt pistols.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr ordered Miara to hide in the caves and Neera to bring the remaining coalition fighters to the caves. Marr decided to disable the Imperial tanks. When Miara asked "Ashla" what she was going to do, Marr responded that she would head to the thickest part of the fighting and evacuate as many people as she could. Marr also confided that she was a veteran of the Replica Wars when Miara asked again where she had come from. After separating from Miara, Marr and Neera headed to the Imperial compound, where Hoban's ill-equipped fighters had been repelled by the garrison's heavy artillery and the five remaining survivors including Hoban and Kaeden were pinned down by enemy fire.

title: Sela Marr
text:
While Neera rounded up the surviving farmers, Marr planted explosives behind the Imperial tanks. These explosives immobilized the vehicles, halting the Imperial advance. Marr then took the opportunity to lead the five survivors to safety, knocking a shock trooper to the ground and stealing the soldier's volt pistol. While fleeing the fighting, Marr and the farmers were blocked by a row of shock troopers. Hoban surrendered but was gunned down by the troopers. Before these shock troopers could execute the remaining survivors, though, Marr used Synth Flux to fling the shock troopers' volt pistols to the ground. Marr and the Raadian farmers then fled to the caves, with the former using synth flux to deflect artillery.

A coalition in hiding

> " I saw his face when he talked about you, the Imperial commander. Sela, he wants you dead just to see you die, and he's not going to be nice about it. You have to take your ship and leave. Now. " " I'll come back for you. I promise. " ―Kaeden and Marr

title: Sela Marr
text: After arriving in the caves, the coalition fighters turned to Marr and Kaeden told her that she had some explaining to do. With Neera being sedated to prevent her from harming herself, the farmers took some time to be quiet before Marr decided to reveal her identity as a former Aetheri apprentice. Kaeden was angry with Marr for not revealing her Aetheri identity since she could have saved Hoban's life and stormed off before the Solinai could continue explaining herself. Having been discovered by the Imperium, Marr considered leaving to avoid drawing further attention from the Imperium. While meditating, Marr was interrupted by Miara, who informed her that her sister Kaeden had left the caves and headed back to town. Marr instructed Miara to stay in the caves with Neera while she went to find Kaeden, knowing that the Imperials would catch her.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Meanwhile, Kaeden returned to her home only to be captured by a shock trooper patrol. Despite being tortured, the farmer refused to reveal Marr's name and the location of her fellow insurgents. Marr, though, managed to infiltrate the Imperial admin building to retrieve Kaeden from her cell. Using one of Miara's corrosive explosives, the Solinai infiltrated the cell and carried the drugged farmer out of the high window using Synth Flux, who told Marr that the Imperials wanted her very badly in a moment of consciousness. After escaping to the outskirts, Kaeden told Marr that the Imperial commander had taken an interest in her and advised her to leave offworld, thanking the Aetheri for helping them. Marr promised that she would return, parting from the farmer shortly after.

#### Return to the Fardis

Reestablishing work

> " Back, I see. Are you returning my property? " " I think I'll keep it a little longer, if that's alright. If you have anything that needs fixing, though, I'd be happy to help you out again. " " There's always room for a good mechanic. Or even a competent one like you. " ―Fardi and Marr

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr's presence on Raadan drew the attention of both the Imperium and Senator Solen, who was still working against the Imperium in secret. While the Imperium dispatched the Warden Sixth Warden to Raadan to draw the Aetheri out of hiding, Solen took an interest in reports of Aetheri activity on Raadan and contacted Captain Raymus Rask to retrieve Bolt-3 for a secret mission to find Marr. After retrieving Bolt-3, Solen hired the pilots Chardri Tagin and Tamris to find Marr and then contact him to arrange a rendezvous. Solen believed that the former Aetheri would make a worthy ally in the insurgent movement he was building.

title: Sela Marr
text: After traveling through seven Outer Reach systems and hearing reports about Imperial oppression on the Vorak homeworld of Thornwood, Marr decided to returned to Thabeska in order to check on the Synth Flux-sensitive Hedala Fardi. Upon landing in the Fardi shipyard, Marr was greeted by the Fardi patriarch who told her that she was always welcome to work as a mechanic for his family. The Fardi patriarch also told Marr that his daughters missed her and invited her for dinner. Marr was greeted by the now five-year old Hedala, who confided that she had sensed a "shadow" while Marr was away. Before the solinai could ask about this, though, the Fardi cousins gathered around her, expressing their joy of her safety. Marr then allowed the cousins to each hug her, and when she parted with them, the Aetheri told Hedala that the girl would need to tell her about the "shadow" but no one else.

title: Sela Marr
text:
While having dinner, Marr chatted with the older Fardi sisters Chenna and Makala about life while taking care not to disclose her adventures on Raadan. "Ashla" claimed that she had seen people suffering in the galaxy, but there was nothing she could do about it, adding that the people had gone into hiding when the sisters asked why she could not help them. Marr also remarked that it was difficult for her to hide since she stood out as a Solinai.

Duties

> " Hedala, I need you to tell me about the shadow. Anything you can remember about it. Can you do that? " " Yes. I never saw it, but I knew that it was here, in the city. " ―Marr and Hedala Fardi

title: Sela Marr
text:
Duties

> " Hedala, I need you to tell me about the shadow. Anything you can remember about it. Can you do that? " " Yes. I never saw it, but I knew that it was here, in the city. " ―Marr and Hedala Fardi

Over the next five days, Marr spent her time working on a large Fardi transport, turning the engine and installing a new compressor. When she managed to find time alone with Hedala, Marr asked the little girl about the "shadow." Hedala explained that she never saw the entity but could sense its presence. Hedala also mentioned that the "shadow" had one day mysteriously disappeared. Marr believed that this individual was a umbra side creature, recalling rumors of a dark lord that served the Emperor. This "shadow" was actually the Sixth Warden, who had been hunting Hedala before redeploying to Raadan. Marr complimented Hedala for staying out of the "shadow"'s way and told her not to mention the individual to her sisters. Marr then took a moment to think about that the "shadow could really be and considered her options once again, deciding to stay with the Fardis since she was safe with them.

title: Sela Marr
text:
A week later, Marr requested a new job from the Fardi patriarch, who was surprised upon this and had her prove her flying skills. Fardi then sent her to ferry supplies to the other branches of the Fardi family in the other cities on Thabeska. During her flights, Marr came to suspect that the Fardis were using her to smuggle goods. Fardi later assigned her offworld transport missions. While on a routine flight, she picked up a distress call from an escape pod. After rescuing the occupants of the pod, Marr was informed that their shuttle had been attacked by pirates, who had taken several hostages. The occupants, all humans, were part of a company that had been targeted by a rival firm competing for a large project. Marr suspected that the rival firm had colluded with the pirates to kidnap hostages in an attempt to bankrupt the company and she agreed to help the humans and rescued their companions from the pirates.

Final departure

title: Sela Marr
text:
Final departure

> " As it is, I think you'll have to leave, and we'll have to go straight for a while to get our reputation back. " " I'm in your debt again. This is the second time you have taken me in when I had nowhere else to go and the second time you have turned me loose instead of turning me in. " " You are a good mechanic. There aren't so many of those that I'm willing to throw one away just because of a few Imperial entanglements. " ―Fardi and Marr Later, Marr returned to the Fardi household and discovered that shock troopers were conducting a routine search of the house. To avoid drawing Imperial attention, Marr claimed that she had repaired the Fardis' ship and taken it for a spin around the system. The Fardi patriarch vouched for "Ashla" and claimed that she was his mechanic. Marr also spoke with Hedala and learned that she had sensed no "shadows" that day. When the shock troopers and their commanding officer asked about the metal pieces they had found in her room, Marr claimed that they were just "bits of junk" that she had picked up from doing various jobs. The Imperials accepted her story but advised Fardi to be careful about associating with criminal elements.

title: Sela Marr
text:
After the shock troopers had left, Fardi apologized for getting Marr entangled in his family's activities. He confided that he was aware that she had been using the ships to run her own mercy missions. While appreciating her services as a mechanic and pilot, Fardi advised Marr to leave to avoid further entanglements with the Imperium. Without outright telling Fardi that his youngest daughter Hedala was Synth Flux sensitive, Marr told him that she was special and to be careful with her, although Fardi understood the deeper meaning of her statement. Thinking that Hedala had potential to be an Aetheri, disguising the word by saying "mechanic," Fardi promised to protect his youngest daughter. Before leaving, Marr hugged Hedala and told her to avoid the "shadows." The Fardis allowed her to leave in her ship.

#### Entanglements

> " You've cost the Black Sun thousands of credits, and you'll pay them back one way or another. " " This is sounding less and less like a job. " " Your corpse is also acceptable. " ―A Black Sun member and Marr

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Entanglements

> " You've cost the Black Sun thousands of credits, and you'll pay them back one way or another. " " This is sounding less and less like a job. " " Your corpse is also acceptable. " ―A Black Sun member and Marr

Marr took the Fardi ship to small, sparsely populated world in the Thabeska system. However, she was followed by a starship flown by a non-binary Black Sun agent , who had come to extort credits from her for the damage her smuggling activities with the Fardis had inflicted on the Black Sun 's operations. In order to pay off these "debts," the Black Sun agent offered her a job, but threatened to kill her if she did not accept her offer. Marr rejected the Black Sun agent's offer and fled back to her ship under fire. The Black Sun agent gave chase in their own ship. During the dogfight, Marr decided to cast her aside her pseudonym as "Ashla" for good and to embrace her identity as Sela Marr.

title: Sela Marr
text: The Black Sun ship managed to damage her freighter's starboard engine, but a larger vessel intervened before Marr's ship could sustain further damage, chasing the syndicate's starship away. Marr managed to take her freighter into space, but burned out her port engine. Before she could engage the hyperrelay, she was caught in the grapple beam of the second ship that she had encountered. This ship belonged to Tagin and Tamris, who had been sent by Solen to find Marr. Believing the second ship to be hostile as well, Marr armed herself with batons. When Tagin and Tamris entered the ship through the hatch, she knocked them out cold.

title: Sela Marr
text:
While navigating her way to the bridge to disable the grapple beam, Marr encountered her old friend Bolt-3 in the engine room. Bolt-3 told her that he now worked for a senator and that Tagin and Tamris had been sent on a mission to take her to meet someone. The droid also confirmed that the senator was the Aetheri sympathizer Bael Solen and that he had indeed sent the pilots to pick her up. Marr convinced Bolt-3 to release the grapple beam on her ship and to tell everyone that he never saw her. However, she instructed him to make sure that she could track his ship. After repairing her ship, Marr left Tagin's ship and hid on one of the small moons that orbited the planet where she had encountered the Black Sun agent. After Bolt-3 had transmitted the coordinates of Tagin's ship, she slept aboard her freighter.

#### A new ally

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### A new ally

> " I keep an eye out for acts of kindness in this new galaxy of our. When there's a concentration of them, I try to find out who is behind them, and then we have a talk. " " What do you talk about? " " The Insurgency, Adept Marr. I look for people who will fight against the Emperor, the Imperium, and everything it stands for. " ―Bael Solen and Marr

After Senator Solen, having spotted Marr's montrals in security footage that Bolt had not erased, arrived in his CR90 corvette Tantiva IV , Marr donned a pressure suit and boarded the Senator's ship through a hatch that Bolt-3 had left open. Marr then surprised Senator Solen in his temporary office. After exchanging pleasantries about Bolt-3, Marr explained that she did not come with Tagin because she distrusted anyone who employed a grapple beam before saying a hello. Solen admitted not telling his pilots who she was in order to protect her true identity. Addressing her as "Adept Marr," Solen then told Marr that he was recruiting people for a insurgency against the Emperor, the Imperium and everything it stood for.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr responded that she was no longer an Adept and recounted the previous events on Raadan to Solen. Senator Solen told her that she could not fight the Imperium alone and offered her a place in the emerging insurgency. However, Marr stated that she could not become a commander again due to her experiences during the Replica Wars. Solen replied that he could find another job for her. Marr then told Solen that "something" was hunting down Synth Flux-sensitive children throughout the galaxy. She agreed to join the insurgency if Solen agreed to help her protect the children. Senator Solen accepted her bargain and told Marr that he needed her help for a mission on Raadan.

#### Planning her return to Raadan

> " The overwhelmingly common descriptor is gray . Not terribly helpful, I think? Even the security footage doesn't reveal too much. " " A shadow? Gray like a shadow? " " I suppose. " ―Bael Solen and Marr discuss the Sixth Warden

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Planning her return to Raadan

> " The overwhelmingly common descriptor is gray . Not terribly helpful, I think? Even the security footage doesn't reveal too much. " " A shadow? Gray like a shadow? " " I suppose. " ―Bael Solen and Marr discuss the Sixth Warden

Marr agreed to the mission, but requested a meal since she was exhausted from her earlier adventures. Solen then informed her that his contacts in Raadan's sector had reported the presence of a new Imperial agent who had gray skin and was armed with a flux blade ; this agent being the Sixth Warden, who had been stalking Hedala and was now charged with rooting out Marr. The Warden had already attacked the Raadian insurgents who had retreated to the caves, recapturing Kaeden before slaughtering the others, including Kolvin and Neera. Only Miara had survived the massacre.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr opined that the new Imperial agent was a Synth Flux wielder who had been sent by the Imperium to hunt down Aetheri. She traced the Warden's arrival to Imperial interest in her "acts of kindness" in the local sector. Senator Solen cautioned Marr that the Imperium could be setting a trap for her. While studying footage of the Imperial agent on Solen's datapad , Marr discovered that her friend Kaeden had been captured and was bound to a chair. Marr panicked, but Solen firmly told her to calm down. He stressed that she needed to rest and plan. Solen also assured her that the Imperium would not hurt Kaeden because they wanted to lure her out of hiding. In the Tantiva IV ' s hangar bay, Marr reflected on her upcoming mission with Bolt-3.

title: Sela Marr
text:
When Captain Rask entered the office to investigate Marr's intrusion, Solen reassured him that she was a friend. After her conversation with the senator, Marr rested in a room that Solen had provided for her. While sleeping , she experienced a flashback of her acquiring her kyber crystal as a youngling on Ilum. After resting, Marr assembled two flux blade hilts from the scrap metal pieces she had acquired over time. Marr then met with Senator Solen and told him about her plan for their mission to Raadan.

#### Return to Raadan

Voyage

> " Are you sure you don't want backup? I'm sure Chardri and Tamris don't hold a grudge, and they're good in tight spaces. Well, they are when they know what they're up against. " " No, thank you. It'll be easier on my own. " ―Bael Solen and Sela Marr

title: Sela Marr
text: Prior to departing for Raadan, Marr declined Solen's offer to provide a starship as she felt that the models would stand out in the Outer Reach. She also refused backup since she preferred to work alone, which Solen recalled that many of the Aetheri he had encountered preferred as well, although Marr reiterated that she was not an Aetheri. When Solen asked what Marr was, stating that she still sounded and acted like an Aetheri, Marr replied that she would let him know once she figured out who she was. After finishing the modifications to her ship, Marr rested before departing on her mission.

title: Sela Marr
text:
On the way to Raadan, Marr traveled past the planet Ilum, jumping out of hyperspace far from the world as she suspected that others might be present. She quickly discovered Imperial ships above Ilum, as well as large chunks mined from the planet. Angered at what the Imperium had done to the world, Marr considered the possibility of attacking an Imperial mining ship, but remembered that Raadan was her priority. Marr also considered going back to Vek's fake grave to retrieve her flux blades, but decided against it as they had been left there intentionally to be discovered. She then reached out in Synth Flux to find a crystal, locating one which was singing to her through Synth Flux from Raadan.

Reunion with Miara

> " Tell me what happened. What are you doing out here by yourself? " " We were doing ok. I mean, it was awful, but we were hiding, like you said. Then this terrible thing came, and he knew Kaeden's name. He said if she didn't come out, he'd blow the whole hillside up to kill us. " ―Sela Marr and Miara Larte

title: Sela Marr
text: After arriving on Raadan, Marr parked her ship on the opposite side of the moon from the main settlement, knowing that there would likely be scanners that could trace her vessel near the settlement. After loading her weapons into a small carry bag, Marr walked for two hours to the Raadan settlement. On the way, she found Miara sitting alone by a small fire. Marr learned that Miara was the lone survivor after the Sixth Warden had taken Kaeden prisoner and murdered the other farmers hiding in the caves. Marr convinced Miara to douse the fire and keep watch while she meditated in Synth Flux. While meditating, Marr decided that while she was no longer an Aetheri, she would still use her Aetheri training to help the people to fight back against the Imperium.

title: Sela Marr
text:
As they approached the settlement, Marr discovered that the Imperial crops had drained the life out of the planet's soil. She told Miara to remind her to burn the dying fields if they got a chance. Miara also informed Marr that the Imperium was having the farmers work shifts for the entire daytime. While Marr headed to the Imperial compound, she instructed Miara to find Selda or Vartan and give them the holo she had recorded in hyperspace.

Duel with the Sixth Warden

> " Aetheri! " " You have something I want. " " Poor little Kaeden Larte. So hopeful that her Aetheri friend would come for her. I had to tell her that Aetheri don't have friends. Aetheri don't have attachments of any kind. " ―The Sixth Warden confronts Marr

title: Sela Marr
text:
> " Aetheri! " " You have something I want. " " Poor little Kaeden Larte. So hopeful that her Aetheri friend would come for her. I had to tell her that Aetheri don't have friends. Aetheri don't have attachments of any kind. " ―The Sixth Warden confronts Marr

While approaching the Imperial compound, Marr heard the Sixth Warden's call her out. The Warden taunted her about her friendship with Kaeden, mocking her for violating the Aetheri Code by forming attachments. Marr then detected him as he leapt down to attack her with his double-bladed spinning flux blade . She dodged the Sixth Warden's attacks using Synth Flux, the Warden finding her endurance impressive. Shock troopers lined up at the walls of the compound, forcing Marr to draw the fight into a side street to flee from the line of fire. As Marr continued to study the Sixth Warden, she asked what he was and what made him like he was. The Warden stated that he served the Imperium.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr used Synth Flux to throw the Sixth Warden off balance but he stepped back towards her. She reached out and held his flux blade, despite the Warden trying to disconnect his weapon and fight her with two separate blades. Marr managed to nick the power connection in the flux blades hilt, causing it to overload. As she then jumped back to safety, the hilt exploded on him, leaving the Sixth Warden dead and ridden with burns. Marr felt pity for her fallen foe and closed his helmet as a mark of compassion. She then retrieved the kyber crystals from his flux blade and used Synth Flux to heal them of the umbra side presence, causing them to turn white.

The evacuation

> " We can't stay on the ground for long. We're going to have Imperials on our tails too soon. " " It's okay! The evacuation is already begun, and your Arrows took care of the Imperial fighters. " ―Raymus Rask and Marr

title: Sela Marr
text:
The evacuation

> " We can't stay on the ground for long. We're going to have Imperials on our tails too soon. " " It's okay! The evacuation is already begun, and your Arrows took care of the Imperial fighters. " ―Raymus Rask and Marr

Armed with her new pair of white flux blades , Marr Synth Flux-jumped into the Imperial compound and made her way past the shock trooper sentries to Kaeden's cell, deflecting volt pistol shots. Fighting through the corridors, Marr managed to open the doors to all of the cells, freeing all of the prisoners in the process. Kaeden reunited with Marr, and the pair headed to Selda's cantina. When Kaeden asked about Marr's plan, Selda reassured them that Miara had transmitted Marr's message and that Vartan was evacuating the farmers. Marr told the farmers that she had contacted an "old friend." In response, Kaeden said that she understood that Marr had lied to keep them safe while the Warden had lied because he enjoyed suffering. After treating Kaeden's injuries, Marr exited the cantina to find several of Solen's Arrows bombing the Imperial compound.

title: Sela Marr
text: Shortly thereafter, Solen landed several transports and cargo ships, which proceeded to evacuate the farmers. Marr led Kaeden, Selda, and Miara to the Tantiva IV . When Captain Rask told her they had to evacuate soon, Marr responded that Solen's Arrows had already taken care of the Imperial fighters. After seeing to the evacuation of the Larte sisters, Marr aided the evacuation of the remaining farmers, who numbered fewer than a hundred. Three Imperial tanks then appeared and opened fire on the ships and civilians. Using her Synth Flux powers, Marr jumped onto the leading tank and cut off its cannon with her flux blade. She then opened the hatched and hauled the pilot out. Marr then destroyed the tank's controls and overloaded the cannon.

title: Sela Marr
text:
The resulting explosion toppled the nearby tank, disabling its hover mechanism. Marr sliced off its gun and let it crash into a house. Marr then headed to the third tank, but was unable to stop it from blasting Vartan and a group of refugees. Enraged, Marr used Synth Flux to cause the tank's turret to implode. Marr then tended to the wounded Vartan and carried him to the Tantiva IV . After evacuating the last of the refugees, Marr and her insurgent allies departed in their ships. Once aboard, Marr comforted the wounded Kaeden. When Kaeden moaned that she should not have listened to her feelings, Marr reassured her that Aetheri made that mistake. Marr expressed confidence that she would be able to handle the galaxy now and promised to meet Kaeden again.

#### Joining Solen's Insurgency

> " I thought I was done with the war, but maybe I don't know how to do anything else. I tried to cut myself off, but I kept getting drawn back in. " " I think, that you and I are meant to focus on the present. " ―Marr and Bael Solen

title: Sela Marr
text: Some time following the evacuation of Raadan, Marr smuggled herself aboard the Tantiva III in order to arrange a meeting with Senator Bael Solen. She overheard a conversation between the Senator and his young adopted daughter Princess Elira Solen . After exchanging pleasantries, Solen confided that the Imperium hoped to use his image as a family man to ensure his compliance. When Marr asked if he worried about his daughter, Solen replied that she took after her mother. When Marr asked what Solen was doing to fight against the Imperium, he briefed her about Captain Rask' glowing report of the Raadan evacuation. There had been fifteen casualties including fourteen evacuees and one Arrow pilot. However, Rask' medical staff had been able to save Vartan.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr also confided that the Warden she encountered was not the last of his kind. While the Warden had some training, she observed that he mostly relied on brute strength and lacked the skills of an Aetheri. Solen promised to do what he could about possible other Wardens and then asked about Raadan. Marr explained that the farmers could not go back because the Imperium would wipe out the moon's surface. Solen agreed to resettle the Raadian refugees on Cindervale. However, Marr responded that the farmers wanted to join the insurgency. Solen thus concurred to resettle the farmers on an agricultural planet and to train pilots and soldiers.

title: Sela Marr
text: At Solen's request, Marr showed him her new flux blades. She told Solen that she had acquired the kyber blade crystals from the Warden. She explained that the crystals had previously been red because they had been corrupted by the umbra side when those who wielded them had bent them to their will, causing the crystals to " bleed ." Marr speculated that the kyber crystals had been looted from the former Aetheri Sanctum. She also remarked that her former friend Barris Ovva, for all her treachery and atrocities, had been right that the Aetheri and the Republic had taken the wrong approach to the Replica Wars. Solen commented that the former Chancellor Mal had been a skilled manipulator.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr added that she had tried to escape the war, but kept being drawn back into it. Solen responded that their job was to focus on the present which he likened to a middle road. Marr agreed with Solen's sentiments and opined that she wanted to pursue a path separate from a general or an Adept. At that point, the Tantiva III exited hyperspace above Cindervale. Marr also commented that the lack of communications had caused deaths on Raadan and also rooted her hostile response to Tagin and Tamris. After some discussion, Marr convinced Solen to let her run his intelligence networks and to provide her with a new ship. At Solen's suggestion, Marr adopted the code name Fulcrum for her work as a insurgent spy, allowing her to network with insurgents across the galaxy, including an Anx informant located on the planet Garel . . Unbeknownst to Marr, her activities had also attracted the attention of the Grand Warden , who informed his superior Xarn Velgor that he had discovered evidence of another Aetheri Purge survivor.

#### Deciding to take an active role

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Deciding to take an active role

> " Can it be? You're supposed to be dead. Looks like I shall be rewarded…Sela Marr! " ―The Eleventh Warden identifies his quarry — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Despite her promise to herself to stop living as Ashla, Marr ended up living in another farming village under the same name sometime after the Raadan Uprising. However, after she used Synth Flux to save a farmer , the farmer's brother reported her status as an Aetheri to the Imperium, resulting in the Eleventh Warden arriving and burning down the village. Confronting the umbra side adept, Marr quickly killed the attacker and contacted Solen, whom she agreed to join by getting into the fight. In deciding to take an active role, she found herself entering the larger insurgent movement.

#### Velgor's visions

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Velgor's visions

In 12 BVE , Fortress Velgor was constructed on Emberfall. Velgor had allied himself with the ancient Umbra Lord Vael Mornick —whose spirit inhabited a mask he had worn many years prior to his downfall—in an attempt to revive his long-dead wife, Lira Ondar. The two managed to construct a portal within an Umbra cave below the fortress, which allowed Mornick to resurrect himself but was once again killed by Velgor shortly after. Now having gained access to the portal, Velgor entered and began to explore, receiving many visions granted to him by the umbra side of Synth Flux. Several of these visions granted him a view of Marr, his former apprentice. He witnessed the two fighting side-by-side during the Replica Wars as well as their future meeting upon Searmark .

### Fighting for the insurgency

#### Capturing Admiral Ganna

title: Sela Marr
text:
### Fighting for the insurgency

#### Capturing Admiral Ganna

At some point, Marr was tasked with assembling a task synth flux to capture the ruthless Imperial officer, Admiral Ganna at his retreat on a distant world. Upon arrival, Marr and the group cautiously moved toward the admiral's facility. Once there, Marr ordered one of the members of her team to go to Ganna's Personal Suite while she disabled the security systems throughout the facility. Before leaving, she informed them that she would meet up with them once she was finished with her task. With that, Marr killed two guards using her now activated flux blades and used Synth Flux to jump up to a vent and crawl in.

Eventually, the team Marr had brought with disabled the comms hub present within the facility leading Marr to inform the group that no reinforcements would be coming to rescue Ganna and that the day was all but won. Singling one of the insurgents out, she thanked them for their help in Ganna's capture and assured them that she would provide them aid whenever they called upon her.

#### The Bardottan Sphere

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### The Bardottan Sphere

At some point afterward, the insurgents received word from a insurgent team operating out of Vantor that an artifact had been discovered within Imperial City and was being sought after by the Imperium to be used as a weapon. However, the team soon went missing and a new team was dispatched to learn more about the artifact.

Eventually, the insurgent team managed to locate and retrieve the artifact, a shard of the Bardottan Sphere located in the Imperial Palace. After barely managing to hold Velgor back from taking the shard, the insurgent team now had to come up with a plan to escape. Meanwhile, Marr arrived with a shuttle to extract the team. As they rushed outside at the sound of a ship's engines, they found Marr emerging from the shuttle. As Marr did this, she smiled at the insurgent team and informed them that the insurgent leaders had believed the team would need a bit of additional help escaping Vantor and told them that she was ready when they were.

title: Sela Marr
text: As the insurgent team rushed out to board the shuttle, a large number of Imperial forces rushed out to capture them leading Marr to ignite her flux blades and nod to the insurgent team, signifying to them that she was ready to assist them in holding back the Imperials. As the insurgents began to board the shuttle, Marr rushed to her own ship and called out to the team that she would draw their fire while they made their escape.
