However, the ship's engines were soon destroyed and the shuttle began to plummet toward the planet's surface. Before they crashed, Marr told them not to panic and that she would pick them up using her own ship after the team shut down the station's defenses.

title: Sela Marr
text:
After the insurgent team accomplished their task, Marr was able to land and extract the insurgent team, escaping into hyperspace. Back at the insurgents' headquarters, Marr and the insurgent leaders discussed what they should do with the shard before deciding that it was too dangerous to use. Initially, the insurgent leaders wanted to destroy the artifact, but Marr convinced them against doing so and instead, a task synth flux was assembled to take the shard to a remote corner of the galaxy where it would remain hidden.

#### Undercover messenger

> " Fulcrum. " " Sela. My name is Sela Marr. " ―Sela Marr introduces herself to the Shades

title: Sela Marr
text: By 5 BVE , Marr was a key member of Senator Solen and Senator Vela Sess 's insurgent network. Under the code name "Fulcrum," Marr facilitated the flow of intelligence and communications between the insurgent cells across the galaxy. One of these cells was the crew of the Wisp , which operated on and around the Outer Reach world of Lorath . She spoke only with Lena Kryll , the owner and pilot of the Wisp , and identified herself only by her codename. As Fulcrum, Marr provided the Shades with intelligence for missions in order to hit Imperial forces or interests, and those missions were part of a larger plan that the insurgents were part of—one that, amongst the insurgents, only Kryll knew. Marr's intelligence was generally accurate, but sometimes only partially so. One mission that Kryll, along with Cass Virel and Ryn Wrenna —the daughter of Ursa Wrenna, whom Marr had encountered during the Replica Wars—went on was an attack on an Imperial convoy. The intelligence that Fulcrum provided was correct about the route and timing of the convoy, but underestimated the Imperial defenses. As a result, the Phantom —the shuttle used by the insurgents—sustained minor damage while

title: Sela Marr
text: whom Marr had encountered during the Replica Wars—went on was an attack on an Imperial convoy. The intelligence that Fulcrum provided was correct about the route and timing of the convoy, but underestimated the Imperial defenses. As a result, the Phantom —the shuttle used by the insurgents—sustained minor damage while outrunning a squadron of SKREE fighters . Marr wrote a report to General Davits Draven about the Shades, praising them for their efforts in freeing Vorak prisoners , destroying an Iron Cruiser, and disrupting Imperial shipping lanes between Lorath and Garel. She expressed her opinion that Kryll's skills were wasted and that the team could do so much more with improved hardware and support.

title: Sela Marr
text: Shortly thereafter, Kryll—along with Wrenna, who insisted on knowing more about Fulcrum and the missions the insurgents were being sent on—traveled to Fort Anaxes , an asteroid base used by the Grand Army of the Republic during the Replica Wars, in order to pick up supplies from Marr. Marr contacted Kryll while she was en route and informed Kryll that the supplies were unloaded and ready for pickup. Wrenna, eager to know more about the individual giving them their intelligence, suggested that "Fulcrum" wait for them at the rendezvous, prompting Marr to wonder if something was wrong. Kryll convinced Marr, however, that Wrenna was just there to help with the mission. Nonetheless, Wrenna felt that she was not trusted and wanted to know why the insurgent missions were becoming so dangerous, but Kryll assured her that the less she knew, the safer she would be if captured by the Imperium. Once they arrived on Fort Anaxes, Marr was already gone.

title: Sela Marr
text:
At some point afterward, Marr assigned the crew of the Wisp a mission to pick up supplies on Kaller destined for the Lorath settlement Tarkintown . Marr had already set up crates for the group waiting for them to pick up upon their arrival. However, by the time the Shades arrived at the location Marr's coordinates had identified, the crates' contents had been stolen. Eventually, the Shades managed to regain the contents of the crates and left Kaller after becoming entangled with some Imperial forces.

Sometime later, the insurgents rescued Tseebo , a Rodanori in the Imperial Information Office whose AJ^6 cyborg construct headpiece contained vital Imperial information, including a five-year plan for the entire Outer Reach. After fleeing Lorath, the Wisp rendezvoused with Marr's vessel . Kryll turned Tseebo over to Marr, who would be able to analyze the information contained within Tseebo's headpiece. Later, Marr was able to provide Kryll with information on the senator-in-exile Gall Trayvis , confirming that he was visiting Lorath to meet with them. However, the Shades soon discovered that Trayvis was actually working for the Imperium.

title: Sela Marr
text: After the capture of Brenn Aldric , the leader of the Lorath cell, by the Imperium, and the Wisp crew's subsequent transmission of messages intended to inspire the public, Marr contacted Kryll and dissuaded her from attempting to rescue Aldric. After reminding her that Aldric understood the risks he took, and that Virel—the crew's remaining Aetheri—was too important to be risked, Marr informed her that their message had reached beyond Lorath and had attracted attention from the top ranks of the Imperium. Marr urged Kryll to take her crew into hiding to avoid further jeopardizing their mission. The crew ignored Marr's warning and set out on a mission to rescue their captive leader.

title: Sela Marr
text:
The insurgents soon learned that Aldric was being held on the Sovereign , the personal Iron Cruiser of Grand Moff Varrix, in orbit of Emberfall. The crew set out to rescue him and succeeded, but were overwhelmed by Imperial forces. The crew's astromech droid, C1-10P , nicknamed "Chomper," contacted Fulcrum and requested reinforcements. Marr—leading Ember Cell , a fleet of insurgent ships—arrived at Emberfall and helped the crew of the Wisp escape. When the insurgents were safe and away from Emberfall, Marr revealed her identity and told them that they were part of a wider insurgent movement. Marr wrote a report to General Davits Draven about the operation, summarizing the battle and in a post-action report, detailed on how the Shades had been integrated into Ember Squadron, and Kryll had received an Alliance officer 's commission.

At some point later, Marr flew a SKREE fighter that had been repainted by Wrenna after it was stolen by the Shades during a " meiloorun run" gone wrong.

#### A lesson for Virel

title: Sela Marr
text:
At some point later, Marr flew a SKREE fighter that had been repainted by Wrenna after it was stolen by the Shades during a " meiloorun run" gone wrong.

#### A lesson for Virel

> " How does it feel to be one of the few with a flux blade? " " Uh, strong, I guess, confident, powerful. " " Oh, so you're not powerful without it? " ―Sela speaks with Cass regarding his feeling on being one of the few with a flux blade, leading to a lesson from the former Aetheri Adept After the crew of the Wisp joined the Ember Squadron, Sela Marr acted as a mentor and adviser to the newer insurgents. She had a particular affinity with Brenn and his apprentice Cass Virel, fellow Aetheri who were resisting the Imperium. On one occasion, Marr and Virel traveled to a planet where Virel was practicing his flux blade form. While Virel practiced, Marr startled Virel and asked him where he got his weapon. Virel explained the origin of his weapon and handed it to Marr. With the weapon, Marr took out the kyber crystal and asked Virel how he felt to be one of the only ones in the galaxy with a flux blade. With his response not satisfying her, she decided to teach Virel a lesson and tossed the crystal into a nearby field. Exasperated, Virel was tossed back his weapon as Marr activated one of her own. Marr began to swing her flux blade at Virel who believed he had no way to defend himself as he questioned her motives. As Marr continued to attack Virel, she let him focus on Synth Flux to evade her, while simultaneously searching for where his crystal had landed. As he evaded,

title: Sela Marr
text:
began to swing her flux blade at Virel who believed he had no way to defend himself as he questioned her motives. As Marr continued to attack Virel, she let him focus on Synth Flux to evade her, while simultaneously searching for where his crystal had landed. As he evaded, Virel eventually discovered his crystal and activated his flux blade to stop Marr's oncoming blade. Deactivating her weapon, Marr questioned him on retrieving his crystal to which he told a joke and the two began to laugh. #### Attempting to rescue Janarda

> " No matter how hard we try, not everyone can be saved. " " Yeah, it's just hard knowing that. Janarda was a good man. He helped more people than he knew and over time, history will remember him as the heroic person he was. We'll lose more good people, other friends in this war, but I know we'll prevail. We have to. " ―Sela Marr and Ryn Wrenna, after the death of Janarda

title: Sela Marr
text: Sometime after the Wisp crew joined Ember Squadron, a distress signal was picked up from a Gozanti -class cruiser; sourcing from one of Wrenna's old friends, Janarda , who helped her escape from the Imperial Academy of Ferrum . Marr decided to join Kryll and Wrenna on the mission to rescue Janarda and joined them in the cockpit as they approached the ocean planet Quila , where the freighter had been ditched. On approach, Wrenna assured Kryll and Marr that the message being sent was from the freighter. Marr asked Kryll if any Imperial activity had yet been detected and Kryll assured her that there had been none, but Marr knew they could appear at any moment and that they needed to be ready. With this, Wrenna rose from her seat as she and Marr went to grab their scuba gear. While getting their gear, Marr asked Wrenna about the importance of Janarda to her and she explained her backstory with him, which was owing her life to him as he had saved her years ago. As they approached to jump into the water, Wrenna thanked Marr for assisting her in this mission, and, with that, Marr informed her of

title: Sela Marr
text: importance of Janarda to her and she explained her backstory with him, which was owing her life to him as he had saved her years ago. As they approached to jump into the water, Wrenna thanked Marr for assisting her in this mission, and, with that, Marr informed her of her underwater operations during the Replica Wars. Sensing Wrenna's fear of the ocean, Marr attempted to reassure her, but only managed to make Wrenna's fears worse. The two then jumped into the oceans of Quila. Inside the crashed freighter, Wrenna and Marr went to the holding cells to find Janarda since he had been a prisoner aboard the ship. However, their path was blocked by a fallen beam, which Marr and Wrenna easily moved aside with the help of Marr's flux blades. While moving the beams, Marr continued to attempt to reassure Wrenna about being underwater. Moving past the beam, the two were attacked by an eel . It quickly jumped on Wrenna as she attempted to ward it off with several volt pistol bolts, but Marr easily managed to wrestle it off of her and used Synth Flux to push it away. However, the eel had damaged Wrenna's oxygen tanks and she was losing oxygen fast. Marr quickly reconnected the oxygen tubes and gave her some of her oxygen to compensate for Wrenna's depleted tanks. Finally, the two reached the detention cells. As Wrenna opened the cell door, she and Marr rushed in with their weapons drawn, but they both quickly discovered that the cell was empty. With this discovery, the two left the detention level and continued to explore the ship.

title: Sela Marr
text: Shortly after, Wrenna and Marr reached an area of the ship not yet flooded, but they both knew that they were on the clock as water was still seeping in. Beginning to hurry, the two decided that they should check the front sections of the bridge when they heard volt pistol fire around the corner and began to believe that they had found Janarda. Turning the corner, the two discovered two shock troopers chasing after Janarda, who had managed to escape from Imperial custody. Wrenna quickly shot the two shock troopers and she and Janarda were reunited. Just as they began to turn to leave, more shock troopers arrived and Wrenna and Marr dealt with them in their own separate ways. Just then, the three of them began to hear rushing water as their area of the ship began to be flooded. Marr ordered them all to run and the three just barely managed to escape by Marr slamming a security door shut behind them with Synth Flux. Now out of danger, Marr told them that they should go to the bridge to try to contact Kryll for a pick-up.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Reaching the bridge, the three attempted to send Kryll a distress signal, but their signal was jammed by the arrival of another Gozanti -class cruiser. As they decided what to do next, they discovered more shock troopers and an Imperial officer standing in their way. Just then, Kryll arrived with the Wisp and began to attack the newly arrived cruiser as the trio saw their opportunity and attacked their newly arrived adversaries. As the Gozanti went down in flames outside, the Wisp arrived to pick up the three; however, Janarda was fatally shot in the back before he could leave, dying in Ryn's arms. As Janarda gave a heartfelt goodbye, Marr ordered Wrenna to get out of the crashed freighter, and the two jumped back into the ocean and went back to the Wisp .

On board the Wisp , Kryll attempted to comfort Wrenna for the loss of her friend. Marr, however, left her with the lesson that not everyone could be saved in a war, which Wrenna took to heart and reminded her that Janarda would be remembered in history as a good and heroic man.

#### The Siege of Lorath

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### The Siege of Lorath

> " The apprentice lives. " ―Xarn Velgor, upon realizing that Sela Marr—the apprentice of Kael Drayden—is still alive

During the Imperial Siege of Lorath , Marr, along with Kryll, Aldric, and the Ember Commander Jun Savren , sanctioned a mission to rescue the Imperial Minister Maketh Tua , who wanted to defect from the Imperium. The crew of the Wisp returned to Lorath but stumbled into a trap set by Xarn Velgor, Marr's former mentor and friend.

With much difficulty, the crew of the Wisp escaped Lorath in a shuttle . However, Velgor had planted a tracking device on that shuttle which allowed him to track down the Ember insurgent fleet. When Velgor attacked the insurgent fleet with his SKREE Advanced x1 starfighter, Marr joined the crew of the Wisp aboard their ship. During the battle, Marr and Aldric used Synth Flux to probe to discover his identity. As Virel realized that he was the Umbra Lord he and his master had faced, Marr connected with Velgor, screaming out and collapsing unconscious in shock. Velgor also sensed her presence, realizing that his apprentice had survived.

title: Sela Marr
text:
After escaping Velgor and recovering, Marr questioned Aldric and Virel about their earlier confrontation with Xarn Velgor on Lorath. Aldric and Marr recalled that they had not sensed a presence as evil as Velgor since the Replica Wars. When Virel asked Marr about the identity of the Umbra Lord, Marr stated that she didn't know who he was. However, she told them that she knew that Velgor would be coming for the insurgents again in an effort to destroy them. The rest of the Shades then entered the cockpit to reaffirm their camaraderie, saying that they would fight together against Velgor and anyone else who tried to stop the insurgency.

#### Reuniting with Vek

> " Commander. You got old." "Had to happen sometime, Vek. " ―Sela Marr reunites with Vek

title: Sela Marr
text: Following the destruction of the Ember flagship Ember Home , the Ember insurgents were on the run. When the insurgents discussed their next move, Marr suggested that the crew of the Wisp seek out an old friend: the former Replica Captain Vek. She revealed that she had been sending her old friend transmissions that had gone unanswered, but said that she had heard that he may be in the Seelos system . For their mission, she gave Wrenna and the crew of the Wisp the head of an old tactical droid and sent them to the desert planet of Seelos . Prior to departing, she told Aldric to trust her friend. Cass asked her why she was not coming with them, but she replied that she had to depart "to answer questions that need answering." After some difficulty, the crew of the Wisp managed to win over Vek, who supplied them with a datacard containing a list of Republic installations in the Outer Reach and Ferrum. After fighting off an Imperial assault , Vek agreed to join the Insurgency. After returning from Seelos, Marr reunited with her old friend, who commented that she had grown "old." Marr responded by saying

title: Sela Marr
text:
them with a datacard containing a list of Republic installations in the Outer Reach and Ferrum. After fighting off an Imperial assault , Vek agreed to join the Insurgency. After returning from Seelos, Marr reunited with her old friend, who commented that she had grown "old." Marr responded by saying that it "had to happen sometime." The two embraced after many years apart. #### Discovering more Wardens

With Vek's datacard, the Ember insurgents gained access to a list of abandoned Republic bases and installations. During a salvaging mission to an abandoned Republic medical station, the crew of the Wisp encountered two more Wardens—the Seventh Warden and the Fifth Warden . These Wardens were aware about the existence of Marr and attempted to synth flux Virel and Wrenna to divulge all information they knew about her. However, these insurgents escaped with the help of Gara-Zev Orrelios .

#### Rescuing infants

> " I know why you want the children!" "Well, who doesn't want to be a mother? " ―Sela Marr speaks with the Seventh Warden whilst dueling both her and the Fifth Warden

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Rescuing infants

> " I know why you want the children!" "Well, who doesn't want to be a mother? " ―Sela Marr speaks with the Seventh Warden whilst dueling both her and the Fifth Warden

While monitoring transmissions from Emberfall, Marr discovered that the Imperium's Wardens had a secondary mission which involved kidnapping Synth Flux-sensitive children. Traveling to the planet Garel, she related her discovery to Brenn Aldric. Marr had also decoded two sets of coordinates. While she decided to investigate the first set of coordinates, she sent Aldric to investigate the second set. Aldric accepted the mission and was accompanied by Virel, Zevik, and Chomper. The first set of coordinates led Marr to the planet Chandel , where she encountered a derelict passenger ship. She quickly encountered an elderly woman named Darja , who revealed that the Seventh Warden and Fifth Warden had abducted her grandchild, Alora . Marr comforted the grandmother and promised to find her grandchild.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Meanwhile, Aldric and his fellow insurgents traced the second set of coordinates to a flat in Hammertown , a settlement on the planet Takobo . After rescuing Alora and an Ithorian infant named Pypey , the insurgents ran into trouble with the Seventh Warden and Fifth Warden. Following a protracted pursuit and confrontation, the insurgents were bested by the Wardens outside the spaceport where they had berthed their ship, the Phantom . However, before long, Marr arrived and engaged the two Wardens in a flux blade duel. Through her mastery of Synth Flux and flux blade skills, Marr easily defeated the two Wardens. Before she could capture them, however, she was surrounded by Imperial reinforcements. Marr managed to escape Takobo with Aldric and his insurgents, who fled aboard the Phantom . As the Insurgents departed from Takobo, Marr recalled that a similar attempt had been made by an Umbra Lord to abduct children during the Replica Wars. In the past, the Aetheri had protected them, but since they were now eradicated, the Insurgency was now their only protection.

#### Anguish on Lorath

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Anguish on Lorath

> " Sela, why did you leave? Where were you when I needed you?" "I made a choice. I couldn't stay." "You were selfish." "No!" "You abandoned me! You failed me! Do you know what I've become?" "No. No! " ―Sela Marr, communicating with a vision of Kael Drayden through Synth Flux After Aldric and Virel were attacked by the Wardens on Oosalon , they realized their presence was endangering the insurgency's search for a base and met with Marr on the Wisp to discuss a plan of action. While waiting for them, she viewed a reliquary of Drayden giving a demonstration in flux blade combat, which Cass also watched when he arrived. Remarking on his skills, he asked her what happened to Drayden. Hesitant, she claimed to have seen him once more when he was sent to rescue Chancellor Mal, but did not know what happened to him as the Aetheri Purge unfolded. When Aldric arrived expressing his concerns, she mentioned in difficult times she would have asked Kade or Zho for advice. Aldric revealed that they had communed with Zho in the Lorath Aetheri Sanctum , and decided to return there in the Phantom .

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr declined to help them raise the entrance to the temple, pointing out she was no longer an Aetheri. Aldric and Virel raised the temple from the ground, discovering a new door below the one they had entered before. Inside, Marr, Virel, and Aldric had their own separate visions. Marr was confronted by a vision of Drayden, who expressed anger at her departure, calling her selfish and accusing her of abandoning him. He then asked Marr if she knew what he had become as the image of her former master faded into that of Xarn Velgor. Lashing out with her flux blade, she cried in agony as she was forcefully confronted with the realization that her master may have indeed become Xarn Velgor.

title: Sela Marr
text:
The Wardens arrived, but the visions in the temple took the shape of numerous Aetheri Sanctum Guards and distracted them, buying Marr and the Aetheri time to escape. As she fled, Marr turned and saw Zho on Mirefall , who waved at her. Smiling back, she turned and continued on her way back to the Phantom . On board, Virel revealed he had spoken to Zho and that he had been told to find Searmark. Marr explained that Searmark was not a person, as Cass assumed, but a planet.

#### Twilight of the apprentice

Traveling to Searmark

> Brenn Aldric : " Searmark has always been off-limits to Aetheri. " Cass Virel : " Why? " Brenn Aldric : " Old legends. Stories told to us as younglings in the temple. " Sela Marr : " There's always a bit of truth in legends. " ―Brenn Aldric, Cass Virel, and Sela Marr discuss Searmark

title: Sela Marr
text:
After the insurgency set up a new base on planet Atollon , Marr traveled there to meet with Aldric and Virel, to join them on their quest to Searmark. Before leaving Atollon, Virel told Marr about his predicament with the krykna and she explained that Synth Flux became more mysterious as one learned more about it. Virel then followed Marr back to the camp where they prepared to take off to Searmark.

On their way to Searmark, Vek contacted Marr and offered to join the crew on their mission to Searmark, as he would be there in just two rotations, but Marr declined his offer. After her talk with Vek, Marr moved to the cockpit of the Phantom . When Virel asked Aldric why Vek was so worried, Aldric explained that before the Aetheri Purge, the Aetheri were told to never travel to Searmark because of old legends about the planet. Marr remarked that legends always held a bit of truth, after which Virel wondered why Master Zho would send the three to Searmark.

title: Sela Marr
text:
The group eventually made it out of hyperspace and Marr explained that they were seeking knowledge that would help them defeat the Umbra. Before they landed on the planet, Chomper picked up a ship on the planet, but couldn't recognize what type it was. Aldric told him to trace it as someone was clearly after the same thing the three were after as well.

Once on the surface, they landed on a site with strange looking obelisks. As they moved closer to one of them, they noticed that it was covered in an ancient dialogue that Marr could partially translate. As Marr began reading the phrases out loud, Virel became hypnotized by them and touched the pillar, causing the surface below them to collapse and the three to fall underground. As they were recovering, they noticed that the place had a hidden, underground Umbra Temple, which might have been the reason Master Zho had sent them there.

title: Sela Marr
text: On closer inspection, they realized the place was a battlefield with some figures turned into stone. Virel also found an old crossguard flux blade . While discussing the events of the battle, they were attacked by the Eighth Warden who tossed explosives at them, breaking another layer of rock beneath them and causing Virel to fall further down. Marr and Aldric decided to pursue the Warden, as Virel tried to look for a way back up. In his search for a way up, Virel met a seemingly old and frail man trapped just as he was himself. Back on the surface, Chomper had discovered the Warden's SKREE Advanced , while Marr and Aldric pursued the Warden. Aldric had noticed that the Warden was surprised to meet the Aetheri here, which could mean that the Warden was searching for something on Searmark, further backing up his theory that the Warden was after something other than the Aetheri. At the Warden's SKREE, Chomper managed to hijack the ship and use it against the Warden, helping Marr and Aldric capture him. The pair deduced that the Warden was hunting someone, but not them. When Sela interrogated the Warden, he revealed that he was hunting "a shadow."

title: Sela Marr
text: When Virel and his companion, who had revealed himself to be named Vreth, managed to claim an Umbra reliquary which they had located beneath the temple, the whole structure went into "stand-by" mode with lights activating around it. This distracted Marr and Aldric, which allowed the Warden to secretly call for backup. They made their way to the temple, where they encountered the Seventh Warden and Fifth Warden. The two Wardens freed the Eighth Warden and a fight broke out between the Wardens and the two Aetheri. Vreth and Virel soon found Marr and Aldric, and Vreth activated his double-bladed flux blade, taking on the three Wardens single-handedly and forcing them to retreat.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr asked Vreth what "game he was playing," to which he responded, "the end game." Vreth then said that the four had little time, as Velgor himself was probably on his way to Searmark. The group slowly made their way to the top of the temple, but on their way, they met the Wardens again. Vreth told Virel to run to the top of the temple with the Umbra reliquary, while Vreth stayed back to help Marr and Aldric against the Wardens. Vreth killed two of them with ease, while Aldric indirectly finished off the last one. Not soon after, Vreth revealed his true intentions to Marr and Aldric, then lashed out at Aldric, slashing him in the eyes and blinding him, but before Vreth could deliver the killing blow, Marr intervened. The two fought briefly, but Marr realized time was running short and left Vreth with Aldric, who managed to throw Vreth off the temple.

The fateful duel

> " I won't leave you! Not this time." "Then you will die. " ―Sela Marr and Xarn Velgor

title: Sela Marr
text:
The fateful duel

> " I won't leave you! Not this time." "Then you will die. " ―Sela Marr and Xarn Velgor

Marr made her way to the top of the temple where she found Xarn Velgor about to execute Virel. She drew the Umbra Lord's attention away from Virel by addressing him. Velgor told Marr that she would be spared if she gave him the location of any remaining Aetheri. However, Marr told him that the Aetheri had all been killed by Velgor and his Wardens. Clearly disbelieving, Velgor obliquely threatened to torture any such information out of Virel if Marr would not cooperate. Marr replied in disgust that, though she had begun to suspect who Velgor was behind his mask, his cruelty now led her to believe that he could not possibly be her former master. Velgor stated flatly that Kael Drayden was weak and that he destroyed him. Angered, Marr snarled that she would avenge Drayden's death. While Velgor reminded her that revenge was not the Aetheri way, Marr retorted that she was not an Aetheri and attacked him.

title: Sela Marr
text:
After several minutes of intense swordplay, Velgor blasted Marr off of a ledge with Synth Flux, and went to claim the temple's Umbra reliquary from Cass. Marr, however, managed to survive her fall and rushed to re-engage Velgor. She managed to catch up to him at the summit of the temple as he used Synth Flux to pull Virel, Aldric, and the reliquary to himself. Marr then leaped into action, ambushing Velgor and managing to cut a furrow into his mask above his right eye. As Aldric and Virel escaped, Marr heard Velgor call out to her. However, because of the damage that had been done to his mask, his voice was no longer that of Velgor, but a combination of Velgor's mechanical baritone and Drayden's unfiltered voice. She turned around to face him, and saw through the gash in his mask the charred face of her former master, confirming beyond any doubt that Velgor and Drayden were one and the same. As Velgor regained his feet, Sela called him "Kael" and said she would not leave him as she had years ago. Velgor paused for a moment upon hearing this, but then coldly responded that she would die and reactivated his weapon. The two engaged in combat once again and the temple locked down with a burst of energy, allowing Virel and Aldric to escape.

Marr was thus lost to the shadow and rubble of the crumbling Umbra temple. Following the mission, Virel blamed himself for the disaster, believing that Marr had been killed by Velgor. Aldric however, reassured him that the mission's outcome had not been his fault.

#### The World Between Worlds

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr was thus lost to the shadow and rubble of the crumbling Umbra temple. Following the mission, Virel blamed himself for the disaster, believing that Marr had been killed by Velgor. Aldric however, reassured him that the mission's outcome had not been his fault.

#### The World Between Worlds

> " Wait, what happened? Where am I? " " You were fighting Velgor. I saw you in there. He was going to… So I… I grabbed you, and I pulled you out of there. " ―Sela Marr and Cass Virel Unbeknownst to Aldric and Virel, however, the duel between Marr and Velgor had had a very different outcome from the one in which they believed. As the reliquary chamber locked down, Velgor re-engaged Marr and quickly overwhelmed her. As the two engaged in a final bladelock, Velgor began to push through her guard, but became distracted by the enormous energy discharges emanating from the damaged reliquary dock. This allowed Marr to push Velgor back a step with Synth Flux and disengage. She then plunged her flux blades into the floor near her feet, destabilizing the floor beneath herself and Velgor. Velgor glanced down at the floor, but disregarded it and prepared to strike down his former apprentice. However, as Velgor struck what would have been a killing blow, a portal suddenly appeared from behind Marr and a figure grabbed her by the shoulder, pulling her into a mysterious dimension . Velgor's strike missed, and he fell through the collapsing floor into a pool of light.

title: Sela Marr
text: Once Marr came to, she realized the one who pulled her into the portal was in fact Cass Virel, although two years older. Marr was confused about what was happening and she wondered where Aldric was. Virel explained what had happened and where the two were located. Virel concluded that if he could save Marr, he could also save his master. Marr warned him that if he were to do so, Virel and the others would die, but Virel stubbornly raced away from her to seek out a portal that would allow him to save his master. Marr caught up to Virel, who gazed into a portal to see his master's final moments. She told Cass that he could not intervene because Aldric' sacrifice saved their lives. A crestfallen Virel told her that she didn't know what she was asking him to do, but Marr sadly said that she was asking him to let go of his master, just as she had let go of hers, after learning that Kael Drayden's destiny lay on a path separated from hers. Seeing the inevitable, Cass allowed the fire caused by the fuel pods to consume Aldric.

title: Sela Marr
text: After Virel let go of his master, he and Marr decided to head out of the dimension. However, the portal about Aldric turned out to be a trick by Vael Mal, who attempted to manipulate Virel into letting the Emperor travel into the world. Marr used Synth Flux to block the Emperor's fiery energy , but as she struggled to maintain the barrier, Cass helped her before the pair fled. When Cass was snared by a tendril of energy, Marr used her flux blades to free him. As they kept running, they were separated, but promised to meet each other once again in the future. As Virel headed back to the portal from where he arrived, Marr made her way into another portal, which brought her back to Searmark, near the base of the Umbra temple, accompanied by her convor friend Morai. She wished Synth Flux to be with Cass Virel and headed down into a dark tunnel with Morai.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Upon her entrance into the dark tunnel, Marr came across a flight of steps which took her deeper into the tunnel, eventually finding a stream and Morai waiting for her. She then entered the stream and followed Morai to another flight of steps that eventually led her to another portal into the World Between Worlds. With this, she stepped inside of it, returning to the mystical plane. Sela Marr thus embarked on a spiritual journey that changed the course of her life. Morai, meanwhile, left the temple and was seen by Velgor as he trekked across the surface of Searmark. Velgor assumed Marr to have died. With her supposed death, the Great Aetheri Purge came to an end.

### Lost and found

title: Sela Marr
text:
### Lost and found

In the aftermath of the Galactic Civil War, Sela Marr carried her white flux blades still. Five years after her encounter with Cass Virel in the World Between Worlds and the Liberation of Lorath , during which Virel, as a sacrifice to protect those he loved, went missing by taking himself, Imperial Grand Admiral Vorren, and the Chimaera away into hyperspace via a pod of purrgil , Marr and Wrenna began a search for Cass . Their mission entailed a venture into the Unknown Regions . Marr had also reunited with Huyang, who joined both aboard T-6 1974 .

Even though the Ferrik insurgent lacked Synth Flux-sensitivity, Marr eventually began to train Wrenna as her Adept. However, the two would ultimately part ways in on bad terms, with Wrenna later alleging that Marr had given up on her training. Marr, meanwhile, believed Wrenna was not ready to begin the path of an Aetheri. Wrenna returned to Lorath while Marr continued to live out of her T-6.

### Vorren campaign

#### Dealing with Morgan Elveth

Fight on Corvus

title: Sela Marr
text:
### Vorren campaign

#### Dealing with Morgan Elveth

Fight on Corvus

> " I've been expecting you." "Then you know what I want." "You will learn nothing from me." "I won't give you that choice. " ―Elveth and Marr

By 9 AVE , by which point she had not seen Wrenna in years, Marr began hearing whispers surrounding the return of Grand Admiral Vorren as heir to the Imperium. Concerned about the idea, Marr began searching for Vorren and followed a lead to the forested planet Corvus , looking for information on the location of the Grand Admiral. In order to obtain this information, Marr ventured to the city of Calodan , which was ruled by Magistrate Morgan Elveth , a servant and former apprentice of Vorren, and her army . Bo-Katin Velara knew of her journey to Corvus and directed the Ferrik Dinna Verrick to her location in order for him to complete his quest to bring an infant of the same species as Zho to the Aetheri.

title: Sela Marr
text: While making her way to Calodan, Marr met great coalition and was attacked by a legion of Elveth's scout guards . Marr managed to overpower them and synth flux them to retreat. As they retreated, Marr used her white flux blades to cut down one of the guards as they retreated further towards the city gates of Calodan. Turning off her flux blades and using the fog-filled forest to her advantage, Marr hid behind a tree and used Synth Flux to distract the guards before reigniting her flux blades and cutting through another one of them by slashing through a tree. In retaliation, the guards once again began firing at her with their A350 volt pistol rifles , leading Marr to use Synth Flux to throw a piece of the tree she had just cut down at one of the guards, before turning off her flux blades again, disappearing into the mist. Marr briefly emerged and cut down another guard using her flux blades before disappearing once more as guards continued to shoot at her.

title: Sela Marr
text: Sneaking behind of the guards, she cut them in half, leaving one guard remaining. As the last remaining guard attempted to retreat back to the city, Marr emerged from the mist and blocked the final guards' volt pistol bolts before cutting the guard down. As Marr returned to the mist, Elveth, from atop a sentry point on the walls surrounding Calodan, requested that Marr show herself, to which Marr obliged, flux blades once again ignited. Elveth announced that she had been expecting Marr, to which she replied that she must then know what she was after. Elveth declared that she will learn nothing from her, but Marr bluntly stated that she will not give Elveth that choice.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Calling up one of her HK-87 assassin droids , Elveth presented one of the town's inhabitants, now Elveth's captive, and asked how many lives Marr was willing to sacrifice to gain the information she sought. Elveth went on to note that the lives of the city's inhabitants meant little to her and that the people in the city would suffer because of Marr's interference. However, Marr declared that the people were already suffering under Elveth's rule and that Elveth should surrender if she did not want to face the consequences of her crimes. Raising one of her flux blades, Marr announced that she would give Elveth one day to make her decision as Elveth disdainfully smirked at her. Extinguishing her flux blades, Marr retreated back into the mist and away from Elveth.

The Ferrik and the foundling

> " Sela Marr! Bo-Katin sent me. We need to talk. " ―Dinna Verrick

title: Sela Marr
text:
> " Sela Marr! Bo-Katin sent me. We need to talk. " ―Dinna Verrick

By daybreak, Marr had retreated deep into the forest. Eventually, Marr discovered the Ferrik Dinna Verrick who had been searching across the landscape for her. Seeing him as a threat, Marr lunged at him using her flux blades; however, Verrick heard her and managed to block her flux blades using his wrist gauntlets. As she continued to strike, Verrick managed to block each of her slashes by continuing to use his wrist gauntlets before using his flamethrower to stagger her and his whipcord launcher to immobilize her. Seeing a branch above her, Marr leapt over it, freeing her and, as the whipcord was still attached to Verrick's wrist gauntlet, dragging Verrick up with her before the whipcord snapped. Now free, Marr reignited her blades, prepared to continue the fight before Verrick called out her name and declared that Bo-Katin had sent him, requesting to speak with the former Aetheri. Noticing Verrick's foundling , a youngling of the same species as Zho, sitting atop a rock, Marr moved out of her fighting stance and noted to Verrick that she hoped they would be talking about him.

title: Sela Marr
text: By nightfall, she and the youngling were telepathically communicating through Synth Flux under the light of a lantern and a moon above. Standing up, Marr picked up the youngling, who, as she had discovered through their telepathic communication, was named Pip and raised in the Aetheri Sanctum. Marr brought Pip and the lantern closer to Verrick and sat down next to the youngling. Verrick asked if Pip was speaking to her and if she understood him. To this, Marr answered that she and Pip could feel each other's thoughts. Verrick was shocked at learning Pip's name for the first time and questioned the name upon hearing it. Marr reaffirmed that his name was Pip and explained to Verrick that Pip had been raised in the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor and that he had been trained by many masters over his many years. However, she went on to explain that he had been hidden away by someone at the temple at the end of the Replica Wars when the Vantor Republic was reorganized into the Imperium, but, after that, his memory became clouded and he did not remember much of the years following. Continuing on, Marr explained that Pip had felt

title: Sela Marr
text: had been hidden away by someone at the temple at the end of the Replica Wars when the Vantor Republic was reorganized into the Imperium, but, after that, his memory became clouded and he did not remember much of the years following. Continuing on, Marr explained that Pip had felt lost and alone after the Aetheri Order's collapse. Moving on from Pip's origins, Marr explained that she had known another member of his species, Aetheri Grand Master Zho, and noted how wise he had been. Marr asked Verrick if Pip could still wield Synth Flux as he had done at the Aetheri Sanctum, to which Verrick questioned if she was referring to his powers. Marr explained that Synth Flux is what gives Pip his powers and that Synth Flux was an energy field created by all living things. With this, she explained that one would need to have a great deal of discipline and training in Synth Flux to wield such powers. Now knowing this, Verrick brought up the supposedly unexplainable things Pip had done prior and how he had been tasked to bring Pip to an Aetheri. However, to this, Marr simply explained that the Aetheri Order had fallen long ago, to which Verrick noted that even though the Imperium was gone, it still hunted Pip and that he would need her help if he was to evade them longer. With that, Marr recommended that they let Pip sleep and that she would test his abilities in the morning.

title: Sela Marr
text: At daybreak, Marr, Verrick, and Pip ventured to a clearing and, when they arrived, Marr walked up to Pip and playfully stated that they would find out what knowledge Pip possessed. With that, Marr motioned Verrick to place Pip down on one of the rocks, which he complied with. Grabbing a small stone, Marr used Synth Flux to slowly levitate the stone into Pip's hands and explained that she wished for him to return the stone to her outstretched hand. Before giving him a chance to do anything, Verrick interjected and attempted to inform Marr that Pip didn't understand, but Marr rejected his inquiry, simply stating that Pip could understand what she was asking of him.

title: Sela Marr
text: Arm still outstretched, she told Pip that it was okay and once again requested the stone from Pip. However, instead of returning the stone to her using Synth Flux, Pip simply dropped it, leading her to lower her arm in disappointment and walk towards him. Grabbing one of his small hands, Marr used Synth Flux to feel his emotions and calmly announced that she felt great fear in Pip and, as she stood up and walked back to her original position, she explained to Verrick that Pip had hidden his abilities over the years in order to conceal himself. Marr then announced that she wished to try something else and asked Verrick to come over to her. Verrick misunderstood and signaled for Pip to go to Marr instead and when he didn't move, he exclaimed that Pip was stubborn. However, Marr quickly stopped him and informed him that she was not the one who would be performing the test but Verrick himself, explaining that she wanted to see if he would listen to him. This prompted Verrick to begin complaining about how, if Pip would listen to him, it would be one of the first times, to which Marr jokingly told Verrick that she liked firsts, whether they be good or bad because of how memorable they were. Handing the stone to Verrick, Marr instructed him to hold the stone in the palm of his hand and to request for Pip to lift the stone using Synth Flux.

title: Sela Marr
text: As Marr walked past Verrick to witness the test, Marr whispered into his ear a request for him to use Pip's name as opposed to referring to him as "kid" as he had done when first requesting for him to take the stone. Walking away and leaning on a large boulder, Marr watched as Verrick requested for Pip to take the stone once more and him giving up moments later, once again claiming Pip was stubborn. To this, Marr instructed Verrick to try to connect with Pip prompting Verrick to pull out a small, silver ball used on one of the levers on his gunship, the Sable Crest , which Pip had become quite fond of. Kneeling down, Verrick asked if Pip wanted the ball and requested for him to take it. With little hesitation, Pip used Synth Flux to pull the ball to him.

title: Sela Marr
text: Verrick congratulated Pip on this, and, while doing so, Marr noted the attachment Pip had formed with him and that she could not train him. Verrick was shocked by this and asked why she could not, citing his abilities. To this, Marr explained that his attachment to Verrick made him vulnerable to the umbra side. Verrick, however, did not understand and insisted that this was even more of a reason to train Pip, but Marr once again refused, indirectly citing her former master, Kael Drayden, and how his emotions had gotten the best of him, turning him to the umbra side. She once again refused to allow Pip to go down that path and said that it would be better if they just let Pip's abilities with Synth Flux fade as he grew older. Hurrying, Marr informed Verrick that she had waited too long and that she had to return to Calodan and save its inhabitants.

title: Sela Marr
text:
As Marr walked away, Verrick noted how Elveth had sent Verrick to kill her and that he had not agreed to anything of what Marr had just told him. Attempting to strike a deal, Verrick told Marr that he would assist Marr in saving Calodan if she assisted him in training Pip. Agreeing to this, Marr and Verrick set off on their journey back to Calodan.

Liberating the city

> " How many lives is the knowledge I possess worth to you? One? Ten? How about a hundred? The lives of these citizens mean nothing to me. Now because of you, these people will suffer. " " They already suffer under your rule. Surrender or face the consequences. You have one day to decide. " ―Morgan Elveth and Sela Marr

title: Sela Marr
text: On their way back to Calodan, Verrick noted the forces Elveth had under her control, including the HK-87 assassin droids , scout guards, and her hired gunfighter, Lang , and mentioned how he believed that her flux blades would not be able to protect her from the amount of volt pistol bolts that would be shot at her. In response, Marr affirmed his remark and that he should also be wary of the magistrate herself. Upon Verrick's questioning of who Elveth, Marr revealed her name to Verrick and that her home had been ravaged during the Replica Wars with her people massacred. Continuing on, she further explained that this developed a great anger in her, which led to her helping construct warships for the Imperial Navy and ravage worlds herself. This led Verrick to note the burned forest that surrounded them. After quickly surveying the environment, Marr asked Verrick if he had seen any prisoners within the city's walls, leading him to note the three villagers that had been taken prisoner. Marr declared that they had to find a way to free them, to which Verrick noted that Elveth's army would never see the pairing of the two coming.

title: Sela Marr
text: At late dusk, the two finally completed their journey. Running at the city's entrance, Marr used Synth Flux to leap up to the sentry point at the city's gate, igniting one of her flux blades and kicking one of the scout guards. Blocking the volt pistol bolts fired at her by another scout guard, Marr grabbed the guard and flung them against a support beam of a gong , the city's alarm system, before promptly blocking the volt pistol bolts of another scout guard. She then threw the body of the scout guard she had grabbed prior and tossing him into the wall opposite of where he had been prior. Immediately afterwards, she used Synth Flux to grab the A350 volt rifle out of the hands of one of the scout guards and threw it at the scout guard firing their rifle behind her, knocking the guard out. The guard she had grabbed the volt pistol from then raised his hands in surrender and escaped from Marr. Dodging the strike of a heavy weapon, she then sliced a sentry guard in half, slicing the gong in half in the process.

title: Sela Marr
text: As Elveth's forces took formation outside of the city's main building, Marr emerged from around one of the city's huts and began to slowly walk towards Elveth's army. Slowing to a halt, she tossed the shoulder plate of Verrick's armor for Elveth and her army to see, claiming that Verrick had failed to kill her and once again asked for Elveth to give her what she sought. Instead, Elveth ordered her guards to attack Marr, forcing her to leap up to the roof of one of the huts and block the oncoming volt pistol bolts with her flux blades. Being forced to retreat, Marr leapt behind the huts and out of sight of Elveth's army.

title: Sela Marr
text: Leaping down behind two guards, Marr quickly used her flux blades to eliminate them before disappearing once more. Emerging behind another two scout guards, Marr slowly revealed her flux blades and dispatched the guards. Appearing upon a rooftop and igniting her flux blades, she jumped down to face Elveth's hired gunfighter. Quickly disarming Lang, Marr stood triumphant for a moment, but was soon forced to divert her attention away when Elveth's two HK-87 assassin droids revealed themselves from opposite corners. Reacting quickly, Marr rushed up to one and slashing them in half before retreating and disappearing around another corner. Standing atop one of the walls outside of the main building, Marr witnessed a faceoff between Verrick, who had snuck into the city during the chaos, and Lang before jumping down to face Elveth within her garden . Signaling a fight was about to take place, Marr and Elveth both took off their robes and readied their weapons, standing only a few meters away from one another. Using a spear made of pure beskar, Elveth lunged at Marr who quickly blocked her spear with one of her flux blades before blocking a second strike with the same blade. Having not moved any closer to one another, Marr and Elveth began to pace perpendicular to one another, looking for an opening in each other's defenses. With Elveth lunging at her, Marr blocked another one of Elveth's strikes, now with both flux blades as the two exchanged several more blows as the fight intensified. Starting to go on the offensive, Marr executed several strikes against Elveth's beskar spear before having to dodge two of Elveth's oncoming strikes. Switching positions, Marr went back on the offensive as Elveth blocked a strike from both of her flux blades and entering into a blade lock

title: Sela Marr
text: fight intensified. Starting to go on the offensive, Marr executed several strikes against Elveth's beskar spear before having to dodge two of Elveth's oncoming strikes. Switching positions, Marr went back on the offensive as Elveth blocked a strike from both of her flux blades and entering into a blade lock that resulted in Elveth being pushed back by Marr's brute strength. With Elveth having launched a strike at her throat, Marr was forced to dodge as Elveth quickly began aiming for her legs causing Marr to slowly walk backwards, blocking each one of her strikes before Elveth swept for her legs, forcing Marr to perform a front flip. Going back on the offensive, Elveth and Marr entered into a brief blade lock before Marr executed a strike at Elveth, leading her to duck below Marr's oncoming strike. Staggered for a brief moment, Elveth managed to knock one of Marr's blades out of her hand and into a small body of water nearby. Now armed with only her shoto flux blade, Marr slowly backed up before putting her single remaining blade into a reverse grip and attempted to regain her breath as she slowly pushed Elveth back. As Marr launched several heavy strikes, Elveth continued to parry them before unsuccessfully attempting to sweep Marr's leg, giving Marr the upper hand and allowing her to grab Elveth's weapon with her free hand and throw it to the ground. Putting her blade up to Elveth's throat, Marr asked her one last time where her master, Grand Admiral Vorren, was located.

title: Sela Marr
text: By the next day, Verrick and Marr, spear in hand, walked outside of the city's gates as the citizens of Calodan celebrated their liberation from Elveth's rule. Presenting the spear to Verrick, Marr stated that she believed Elveth's spear had been payment for Marr's defeat. However, Verrick refused the offer, citing how he hadn't completed the task, which Marr affirmed, but stated that she believed a Ferrik should possess the spear. As Verrick took the weapon, Marr asked where Pip was, to which Verrick revealed that he was on the ship and that he would retrieve the infant. As Verrick walked away, Marr gave a troubled look before she was joined by Governor Wing who she gesturing to head back into the city along with her as a gesture of friendship. The two then proudly walked back inside the city's walls.

title: Sela Marr
text: Later, Marr was present outside Verrick's gunship, the Sable Crest as Verrick was exiting with Pip in hand to give to her to train. As he stepped outside, Marr stated that Pip now saw Verrick as his father and once again stated that she could not train the youngling. Verrick was shocked by this, stating that he had held up his end of their bargain as Marr walked closer to him and took hold of Pip's left hand. As she reached the two, Marr directed Verrick to the planet Tython where she recommended that he place Pip on the seeing stone at the top of a mountain containing the ruins of an ancient temple with a strong connection to Synth Flux. Verrick then questioned what he was supposed to do from there, to which Marr answered that Pip would then be able to choose his own path and that if Pip used Synth Flux to reach out, an Aetheri might be able to sense it and come to the planet searching for Pip. However, she also stated that there were few remaining Aetheri, which could possibly present a problem for the two. Verrick then thanked Marr and she wished for

title: Sela Marr
text:
Pip used Synth Flux to reach out, an Aetheri might be able to sense it and come to the planet searching for Pip. However, she also stated that there were few remaining Aetheri, which could possibly present a problem for the two. Verrick then thanked Marr and she wished for Synth Flux to be with the two before smiling and bowing her head for Pip, watching as the pair left in their gunship. With this, Marr began walking back towards Calodan, smiling. #### Visiting Ossus

> " Will I see you again? " " Perhaps. May Synth Flux be with you. " ―Sela Marr wishing Joren Drayden farewell.

title: Sela Marr
text: Following the rescue of Pip, Marr met the son of her former master Kael, Joren Drayden , who was also the current owner of her friend Bolt-3. Shortly before the Battle of Port Vail , Marr joined Drayden and Pip on the planet Ossus , where Drayden was building a new Aetheri Sanctum to train a new generation of Aetheri. She observed that Pip missed his former warden Verrick a great deal, which she believed could complicate his Aetheri training. During her time on Ossus, Verrick himself visited the temple with the intention of reuniting with Pip and gifting him Ferrik chain mail . The Ferrik bounty hunter was ignored for sometime until Bolt-3 led Marr to him to deal with his desire to see Pip. While Verrick was surprised to see Marr on Ossus, she took the time to explain how the building would become "a great school," with Pip its first student, and promised the youngling was doing fine. When Verrick insisted on seeing him, Marr invited Verrick to accompany her on a walk through the bamboo forest and reminded him of her warning about how his attachment to Pip would be difficult to let go off.

title: Sela Marr
text: Just as she respected Drayden's decision to train Pip, Marr agreed to respect Verrick's wish to see the child he had kept in his care for so long, motioning to a hill where Drayden was seated with Pip. She did, however, ask him to consider if he was doing it for Pip or just himself, pondering if the armor was a way for the former foundling—who was possibly an Adept by that point, by Marr's reckoning—to remember his father figure. While Verrick declared that the armor would protect Pip no matter what path he chose, Marr offered to deliver it in his stead, believing that a reunion between Verrick and Pip would only make his training more difficult. Verrick acquiesced to Sela's offer and handed her the beskar armor, asking her to ensure Pip would be protected.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Marr then joined Joren in watching one of Pip's training exercises. She was impressed with both the child's progress and Drayden's teaching skills. Drayden replied that it was more like Pip was remembering his previous lessons, to which Marr observed the student sometimes guided their master. Drayden then revealed he knew the Ferrik had been present, to which she revealed the gift he had dropped off. When Drayden wondered whether Pip was committed to being an Aetheri, Marr told Joren he was just like his father and counseled him to trust his instincts. Marr then moved to leave to resume her search for Vorren, promising Drayden there was a chance they would meet again and bidding Synth Flux be with him. In the end, Pip would decide to return to Verrick and take on the life of a Ferrik. At one point, Marr traveled to Black Spire Outpost on the world of Batuu , a city Vorren and her master Kael Drayden had visited in the past.

#### Searching for Grand Admiral Vorren

The ancient temple

> " Anyway... I found it. " " The map? " " Right where Morgan said it would be. " ―Sela Marr, and Huyang

title: Sela Marr
text:
#### Searching for Grand Admiral Vorren

The ancient temple

> " Anyway... I found it. " " The map? " " Right where Morgan said it would be. " ―Sela Marr, and Huyang

Concerned about Vorren's possible return, Marr interrogated Morgan Elveth for any information regarding Vorren, his intentions, and how to find him. Elveth ended up revealing the location of a map to the alleged location of Vorren in the galaxy of Peridea . Elveth was delivered to Concordat custody after her capture as well. Marr soon began searching the ruins of an ancient stronghold on Arcana . She soon approached a runic circle in the middle of the stony courtyard and used her twin flux blades to cut a hole below her feet, allowing her to access to the chamber underneath. Marr gazed at several cloaked figures carved onto the wall, before walking over to a pillar, and using psychometry on it. Sensing that it was the key to retrieving the map, the former Aetheri rotated a part of it, before then rotating the tip of it, which caused an orb next to one of the carvings to glow. Marr smirked, before moving over to a second pillar. After rotating a part of the second pillar, she watched an orb in the heart of one of the other carved figures to glow. She then rotated a part of a third pillar, causing a third orb to glow, and an altar with a rectangular stony object to rise from the floor. Marr touched the stony box, which had crumbled and revealed a golden orb. She had informed Professor Huyang that she had found the object via comlink, but his transmissions had been jammed.

title: Sela Marr
text: Marr soon returned to the surface where she was confronted by a red HK assassin droid, who had demanded the map. She had found herself surrounded by five assassin droids wielding electrostaffs. Marr had drawn her twin flux blades in defense. Marr had jumped back into the hole she had created and had used her flux blade to cut holes between three of the droids. Marr then fought the other two and had cut across the torso with her flux blade. She had beheaded the fifth droid. As two droids had emerged from their holes, the lead droid had issued orders to initiate their self-destruct protocols. The other two droids had complied, and Marr had been forced to flee. While running, she had contacted Huyang, who had told her that their T-6 Aetheri shuttle was above her position. She had told him to drop his ramp at a distance outside the ruins. The two had escaped before they could be killed by the fiery inferno that had swept through the ruins.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Inside the cockpit, Marr had conversed with Huyang about their communication difficulty. He had told her that he had kept her ship at a safe distance in accordance with Aetheri mission protocol. She had replied that the Aetheri Order didn't exist anymore. When Huyang had said he had his programming, she had advised him to stick close and watch her back. Huyang had replied that it was the job of an Aetheri Adept learner, which he was not. Marr had told Huyang that he had found the map based on Elveth's information. When Huyang had asked how she had gotten Elveth to tell the truth, Marr had replied that she hadn't been following Aetheri protocol.

Speaking with Kryll

Not long afterwards, they received an incoming transmission from Concordat Fleet Command , who told Marr and Huyang about the recent attack from Baylan Skoll and his apprentice Shen Hadik to rescue Morgan Elveth. Marr and Huyang then traveled to Home One via hyperspace. Marr identified their ship as T-6 1974, and Fleet Command cleared them to land at hangar 2-9. Inside the hangar, General Lena Kryll greeted them and informed them about the loss of Elveth.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Kryll had prepared a briefing for Marr to catch up. In the briefing, Kryll told Marr and Huyang about the damage the two mercenaries had done, taking out an entire security detail and scuttling a new starship. Marr was unfamiliar with the attackers, who had demonstrated Synth Flux powers similar to the Aetheri. Huyang suggested that one of these intruders had once been an Aetheri. Marr told Huyang to scan Skoll's and Shen’s flux blades.

When Kryll asked about the mercenaries' connection to Elveth, Marr said that she had hired them for plausible deniability. Marr also showed Kryll the golden orb, explaining that Elveth had been interested in this map since she believed it would lead to the location of Vorren, the last Imperial Grand Admiral. Kryll was surprised that Vorren had survived the Battle of Lorath, but Marr explained that she had heard whispers of his survival. Kryll asked if this meant that Cass Virel was alive. Marr was uncertain but warned that their enemies were also searching.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Kryll wanted to look at the map, but the key required to activate the map eluded Huyang. Kryll remarked that it was never straightforward with the Aetheri. A Calavane officer informed Kryll that the Defense Council was requesting an update from her. Kryll said she would attend to the matter and told Marr she knew who could help her. Marr was uncertain that this friend would help, but Kryll reassured her that she would do it for Virel.

A difficult reunion A difficult reunion

Later that day, Governor Ryder Azadi gave a speech to the citizens of Lorath, celebrating the anniversary of its liberation shortly before the Galactic Civil War. Still residing on Lorath, Ryn Wrenna, who was set to speak to Lothals community, failed to appear at the celebration, instead returning to the communications tower . Marr soon arrived on the planet, and parked her T-6 shuttle near a ledge on a high tower. Wrenna arrived while Marr was talking to Governor Azadi. When Azadi said that Wrenna had missed the ceremony yesterday, Wrenna replied that it had slipped her mind. Azadi said everyone had missed her, but Wrenna replied that not everyone had been there. Huyang also greeted Ryn, who recognized him. Huyang said he still had 75 percent original parts before returning to the ship. Azadi told Wrenna to listen to what Marr had to say before leaving. Marr then told Wrenna that she knew a way to find Virel while showing her the orb.

title: Sela Marr
text: The two went inside Sela's T-6 Aetheri shuttle and discussed the situation. Wrenna gazed at a bunk with several wall drawings, including a loth-cat . When Wrenna asked if she was certain Virel was still out there, Marr responded that whilst nothing was certain, their enemy was seeking Vorren, which was what had led her to the map. Marr explained she had found the map on the planet Arcana, a Nightsister stronghold thousands of years ago. Due to her skills as an artist, Marr sought Wrenna's help in deciphering the map. Wrenna believed there was a code. Marr shared a scan of the Nightsister temple chamber where they had found it. When questioned about where home was, Marr described her soul as a home. Both women blamed each other for not making it easy for each other. Marr replied that the Aetheri way was hard.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Just then, Huyang had an update. Wrenna asked for permission to take the map and study it. Marr refused since she believed the map was not just about finding Virel but preventing another war. She warned Wrenna that the map stayed aboard the ship before entering the lab to chat with Huyang. Huyang had scanned Skoll's and Hadik's flux blades. The droid said that he recognized one of the two hilts, which was built in the Aetheri style. The one he knew belonged to Baylan Skoll, who had disappeared at the end of the Replica Wars. Huyang told Sela that Skoll had been Aetheri trained. Marr surmised that Hadik was Skoll's apprentice. He warned Marr that Skoll wouldn't be alone for long. When Marr returned to the briefing room, Wrenna had already left with the map despite Marr's instructions.

Pursuit of the Imperium

title: Sela Marr
text:
Pursuit of the Imperium

In the meantime, Wrenna rode her speeder bike back to the old communications tower. A probe droid then popped out from behind a signal crossing and reported back to Hadik and two HK assassin droids, who stood miles away on a hilltop. Upon returning, the Ferrik began to study the compass. Back on Sela's T-6, Marr and Huyang spoke to General Kryll about Wrenna via lumen projector. Marr was worried about Wrenna, but Kryll told her to give her some space. Kryll believed that Wrenna was their best chance of reading the map. Marr admitted she had a difficult relationship with Wrenna, describing the Ferrik as stubborn and bullish. Kryll attributed these traits to her Ferrik background and said that mentoring could be a challenge, suggesting that Kael Drayden may have found her difficult sometimes. Marr said that she had walked away from her Aetheri training and admitted walking away from Wrenna.

title: Sela Marr
text: Meanwhile, Wrenna was still trying to solve the puzzle of the star map back in her home. Soon, she began to understand how to translate it, before fully managing to do so. Just as Wrenna looked out over the balcony afterwards, she was attacked by the Imperium. She soon contacted Marr before engaging in a fight. Huyang soon interrupted, informing the pair that they had received communications from Wrenna, who was being hunted down by HK droids led by Shen Hadik. Marr and Huyang soon piloted the ship, and flew towards Wrens tower. As Hadik and Wrenna dueled, the former stabbed Wrenna through the abdomen, leaving her completely wounded. Upon seeing the ship arrive, Hadik fled with the map, as Marr quickly tended to Wrenna who lay on the floor dying. Wrenna was soon brought on board by Marr and Huyang, where she was set to receive urgent medical attention.

title: Sela Marr
text: After rescuing Ryn, Sela had her placed in emergency care. With the help of Bacta, Ryn healed quickly and managed to recover enough to tell Sela what she knew. She said she had unlocked it, and there was an image of two galaxies with a passway between them. Telling her to get some rest, Sela walked outside and recalled past events while glancing at Ryn’s speederbike and helmet. She then walked over to the old communications tower and glanced at the loth cat and equipment inside. She walked over and played an old hologram of Cass when one of the assassin droids jumped down to attack her. Swiftly decapitating it, she brought it back to Ryn.

title: Sela Marr
text:
The ferrik said she could use the backup systems to perhaps access its memory banks, but an incorrect power level would detonate the head. Huyang suggested that this operation be moved somewhere else, but Lena, who was on a hologram watching, and Sela disagreed, believing that time was of the essence. Ryn managed to discover that it was from Korrath at the Concordat Shipyards. before Huyang disconnected power to prevent an explosion. Sela stated that there were factories owned by Morgan Elveth, and Lena said that they should’ve been shut down after the war and she would meet her there.

Korrath Investigation

title: Sela Marr
text:
Korrath Investigation

Lena and Sela left for Korrath's shipyards after realizing that Morgan Elveth had owned manufacturing plants there. Lena met with one of the Regional Supervisors, Myn Weaver, to discuss possible Imperial remnant activity. Weaver stated that he was particularly busy at the moment, but Kryll pressed him, stating that this would be a far more formal investigation if she could not do so immediately. Weaver took them on a REV-2K personnel carrier through the production plant, telling them the insides of his operation. During the ride, he was questioned on the loyalty of his workers (most of them had been employed by the Imperium) to which he replied that average workers did not care about galactic politics. After this, Lena suggested that Marr take Ryn back on as an apprentice. Marr replied that neither of them was ready for that. Still, Lena believed it would be good for both of them, saying that Wrenna needed some structure in her life and so did Marr.

title: Sela Marr
text: Once Myn Weaver showed them into the control center, Marr asked about the purpose and clients of the manufacturing center. While Weaver was explaining the priority given to shareholders, Lena spotted a massive hyperrelay core. Weaver explained that it had been extracted from a Super Iron Cruiser. Lena was befuddled since the Concordat had not been constructing anything of that size. Weaver checked the logs and explained that it was of a classified nature and that it needed approval before he could unseal it. The supervisor asked for the protocol droid C1-D1 to explain the regulations surrounding it. Marr questioned him on the other types of droids in use, but the protocol droid interjected by stating that she had been interrupted by an HK earlier. The protocol droid stated that it was on the transport about to leave with the massive hyperspace core. Lena ordered the flight crew to stop the ship from leaving the planet, but the crew, and even Myn Weaver, had been Imperial loyalists the entire time.

title: Sela Marr
text: Several drew pistols in an attempt to kill the general, but Marr's lightning-fast reflexes had dispatched all of them in seconds. Lena rushed to the Phantom II to stop the transport as soon as possible. Marr leaped out of the window, sprinting towards the rapidly ascending transport, but an assassin droid and a former Imperial Warden named Marrok, who was working for Elveth as a mercenary, stood in her way. They dueled, with Sela defeating the droid as Marrok received a transmission telling him to leave. He hurled his flux blade as Sela flipped over it, and ran to a shuttle picking him up. The shuttle opened fire on Sela, who dodged everything, including Marrok's flux blade which flew back to him. She called Lena, hoping for good news, and was relieved to hear that Chomper had gotten a tracking device on the transport.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Lena and Sela later watched over the Imperial sympathizers' arrests and commented on how it was greed, not loyalty, that made them do this. Sela returned to Ryn at the Mural on Lorath, commenting on her haircut. Huyang reported that the tracking device was in the Denab System and orbiting Seatos. The trio got moving on their ship and made the jump to hyperspace, with Sela instructing Ryn to launch the hyperrelay, calling her "Adept."

Skirmish over Seatos

While in route to Seatos, Ryn practiced with Huyang as Sela watched. Her performance was mediocre, but she had still remembered the basics. Sela claimed that the basics were from her Ferrik upbringing, but that she needed to train the mind, not the body. They then trained with Ryn blinded with a visor, relying only on her other senses. Sela then proceeded to easily outwit and outmaneuver the unaware and frustrated Ryn. Huyang was caustic, claiming she was the worst Aetheri he had ever trained(which was nearly all of them).

title: Sela Marr
text: After the practice session, Sela consoled Ryn and told her it would take time. Ryn was still frustrated, hoping that their urgent situation would somehow hasten her aptitude for synth flux. Marr reminded her that all living beings were in Synth Flux, and that talent was only one aspect of its mastery. Synth Flux-pulling a cup over, she urged her to start with small objects. While in the cockpit, Huyang reminded Marr that Ryn would not have been accepted into the old Order and that very few ferriks ever became Aetheri. Lena then called and told them that the mission was not approved by the committee.

title: Sela Marr
text: As she elaborated, the ship entered the Denab System, and the comms began to break down due to jamming. A squadron of Morgan’s starfighters, commanded by Shen Hadik, flew in behind them and began to fire on the T-6. Ryn ran to the gun and took out several fighters. Coordinating with Wrenna, Sela flew towards the planet and dove at Ryn’s timing. This allowed Ryn to be able to get several shots off, missing them. She did redeem herself shortly and destroyed one craft. Now in the orbit of the planet, Ryn managed to destroy two more fighters. As this happened, they came into sight of the Eye of Sion. Huyang correctly guessed that it was a massive Hyperspace Ring. When they came into range, Elveth opened fire with pulse lances as the fighters pulled back. Huyang insisted on getting a scan. As soon as he completed it, they were struck by a direct hit, crippling the hit and short-circuiting Huyang.

title: Sela Marr
text:
Shen and Marrok swung back around to finish the job. Ryn quickly ran a diagnostics and did what she could to recover. Sela donned a space suit and deflected shots with her flux blade on the exterior of the shuttle. She sliced the wing off one that came too close but was propelled off the hull. As Ryn repaired the ship, Sela climbed back in and ordered her to punch it. They fled down to the planet’s surface, evading the fighters behind a school of Purrgil in the clouds. The two landed in a forest to do repairs, and Huyang woke up at this point. Trying to evade detection, Ryn shut down the power of the ship, while Sela turned Huyang back off. Marrok and Shen Hadik’s fighters flew overhead but could not find them, believing them to be hidden in the forest.

### Legacy

> Kael Drayden : " Synth Flux surrounds you, Nyla. " Ciel Venn : " Let it guide you. " Sela Marr : " As it guided us. " ―Voices of the past guide Nyla

title: Sela Marr
text:
### Legacy

> Kael Drayden : " Synth Flux surrounds you, Nyla. " Ciel Venn : " Let it guide you. " Sela Marr : " As it guided us. " ―Voices of the past guide Nyla

At some point, Joren chronicled Sela's history in a personal journal during his exile on the planet Tidehollow . Following the Battle of Saltmark in 34 AVE , Marr was mentioned in Galactic Explorer's Guide , a book written by her old enemy and ally Hondik Hosha. The book recounted that Aetheri Master Luminara Undula had been a mentor to Marr.

During the Battle of Umbrale in 35 AVE , the last Aetheri, Nyla , fell in combat against the resurrected Vael Mal, her grandfather, who had drained the life energy from the young woman. In a moment of tranquility, Nyla heard the voices of Sela Marr and the departed Aetheri who had come before her. The Aetheri spirits gave words of encouragement to Nyla, allowing her to muster the strength to rise and ultimately defeat Mal. Long after the reign of Vael Mal, when a member of the Whills began recording galactic history for an audience living in a faraway galaxy into the Journal of the Whills , another Whill mentioned Sela Marr as someone to be remembered.

title: Sela Marr
text:
### The fearless Synth Flux-sensitive

> " What is Sela's strength? " " She is fearless. " " That can also be a weakness...Is she a worthy apprentice? " " No one has her kind of determination. " " Except you. " ―Tor Vayne and Kael Drayden

Sela Marr was a Solinai female who had blue eyes, dark orange skin, brownish-grey lips, white facial markings, a slender build, and white lekku and montrals with blue stripes. The markings on her montrals were unique, and her montrals continued to grow as she matured. During her early childhood, Marr's trust in others was negatively impacted by an Aetheri impostor who tried to enslave her, and the memory of the scorn her fellow villagers felt towards her remained with her until her trip to Ilum; upon trusting Master Zho, she felt that trust came easier to her because she was again trusting her own instincts. The teachings and values of the Aetheri Order became sacred to her, and she always sought to protect the lives of innocents.

title: Sela Marr
text: As a teenager, Marr was snarky, cocky, stubborn, reckless, and impulsive, yet also brave, loyal, generous, and kind-hearted. The young Marr's emotions made her a perfect apprentice for Kael Drayden, with Grand Master Zho himself recognizing that the two became "twice the trouble" after being paired together. She was very feisty and snippy, earning her the nickname "Snips" from her master. Like her master, she could at times become aggressive and willing to use terror or threats to get the answers she wanted. She had a tendency to follow her heart, which negatively impacted her path to Aetheri knighthood. In her younger years, Marr's emotions inhibited her ability to make wise decisions, although she eventually gained the confidence to make the right ones, despite the great cost to her feelings.
