Drayden unleashed his fury on the Umbra Lord, brutally overwhelming him and slicing off both of his hands. Taking Varek's flux blade, he crossed both his and the Count's blades at the Count's throat, and Mal urged him to kill his helpless opponent. Drayden initially hesitated, but after the Chancellor's continued insistence, he gave into his hatred of his nemesis and beheaded Varek. He expressed regret afterward, stating it was not the Aetheri way , but the Chancellor assured him that he had been right to kill the Count.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Despite the Chancellor's pleas, he carried Kade on his back to make their escape. However, the elevators leaving the spire had been disabled. With help from Bolt and the attack taking place on the Invisible Hand by a neighboring Republic cruiser, they were able to escape in the elevator shaft until the ship's crew was able to regain control of the ship, restoring its gravity and turning the shaft once more into well. Kade regained consciousness while they were hanging on inside the shaft and together, he and Drayden were able to escape the shaft just as a reactivated elevator was about to crush them. However, their good fortune failed them, and they were trapped by a ray shield and apprehended, along with Bolt, by battle droids. The two Aetheri and the Chancellor were brought before Skarn in the Invisible Hand ' s control room. The cyborg personally taunted them, derisively commenting on Drayden's youth considering his reputation. Drayden retorted with a taunt about the General being shorter than he had expected, which angered the cyborg general.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Eventually, Bolt-3 caused a distraction, allowing Kade to draw his flux blade to him with Synth Flux, freeing himself and then Drayden. Once the younger Aetheri had also summoned his weapon, they engaged and made short work of Skarn's MagnaGuards and the battle droids holding them and the Chancellor. However, as they attempted to apprehend Skarn, he used one the MagnaGuards' electrostaffs to shatter the viewport, depressurizing the bridge and letting the vacuum take him. Drayden and Kade caught onto nearby command consoles until security measures allowed the bridge to depressurize. Before they could reach him, however, Skarn escaped, jettisoning all the escape pods to prevent them from escaping. As the command crew had fled, Drayden took control of the damaged flagship, which had begun to enter Vantor's atmosphere. Although he briefly managed to slow the ship's descent, the damage it had sustained proved too great, and the Invisible Hand broke in half, picking up considerable speed as it fell towards the Republic capital. Drayden eventually succeeded in crash-landing the Invisible Hand on a deserted landing strip, returning the once-captive Chancellor to Vantor unharmed.

#### Looming fatherhood

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### Looming fatherhood

> " Are you all right? You're trembling. What's going on? " " Something wonderful has happened. Ani, I'm pregnant. " " ...That's... That- That's won- That's wonderful. " " What are we going to do? " " We're not going to worry about anything right now, alright? This is a happy moment. The happiest moment of my life. " ―Lira announces her pregnancy to Kael Following the ordeal, the two escorted the Chancellor to the Senate building, where they separated—while Kade went back to Aetheri Sanctum to report to the Council, Drayden remained with the Senators who had come to greet the returning Chancellor. He briefly spoke with Senator Solen, who expressed hope that Count Varek's death could bring a quick end to the war. Drayden disagreed, saying that as long as General Skarn remained as leader of the Dissident armies, the war would continue. At that moment, he noticed Ondar behind one of the columns, took his leave from the Senator and reunited with his wife for the first time in months. Having been away fighting in the Outer Reach Sieges, Drayden's single focus was reuniting with Ondar. Ondar then revealed to her husband that she was pregnant. Though they were both worried that this might expose their secret, Ondar especially, Drayden was overjoyed and told her not to worry, saying that it was the happiest moment of his life. The couple returned to Ondar's apartment, where they began to make plans for when the baby would be born, deciding that their child would be raised on Ondara, in the Lake Country . Ondar

title: Kael Drayden
text:
and told her not to worry, saying that it was the happiest moment of his life. The couple returned to Ondar's apartment, where they began to make plans for when the baby would be born, deciding that their child would be raised on Ondara, in the Lake Country . Ondar also planned to head there before the birth, to prepare the room. However, that same night, Drayden's happiness was marred when he suffered a nightmare of his wife dying in childbirth, similar to the visions he had had of his mother before her death. Although Ondar tried to comfort him that it was only a dream, he was terrified that he would lose her, as he had lost his mother. Ondar tried to convince him that they needed help and suggested they ask Kade for his assistance. Drayden refused, insisting that their baby was a blessing, not a curse. The next day, at the Aetheri Sanctum, he sought Zho's counsel concerning these dreams, but the Grand Master told Drayden that death was a natural part of life, and to let go of all that he was afraid to lose.

#### Tensions of loyalty

> " Is it possible to learn this power? " " Not from an Aetheri. " ―Drayden and Mal discuss the power to stop people from dying

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### Tensions of loyalty

> " Is it possible to learn this power? " " Not from an Aetheri. " ―Drayden and Mal discuss the power to stop people from dying

At the same time, tensions were rising between Chancellor Mal and the Aetheri Council, who were concerned with his increasing power. Matters were made worse when the Senate announced that they planned to grant him more executive powers in order to facilitate the end of the war. When Drayden was informed of this by Kade, he was supportive of the measure, despite the reservations of the Council and Kade's warning to be wary of Mal. He then told him that the Chancellor had requested his presence for unknown reasons, without informing the Council. So Drayden met with Mal at his office, where he told him that he was appointing the young Aetheri to be his personal representative on the Council, a decision that Drayden believed the Aetheri Masters would never accept.

title: Kael Drayden
text: When informed of this, the Council allowed Drayden to sit on the Council, yet they refused to grant him the position of Master, a decision which greatly angered Drayden. Drayden turned to Kade, who so remained silent. Angered more by this, Drayden reluctantly accepted his position and took his seat on the council. At the end of the meeting, Kade acknowledged to Drayden that his appointment had been accepted so that, on behalf of the Council, he could spy on the Chancellor, which Drayden was reluctant to do. In recent weeks, Ondar and other senators concerned about Mal's expanded powers had also created the Petition of 2,000 in the name of protecting democracy, requesting he return his emergency powers to the Senate and end the war with cease-fire negotiations. Drayden was manipulated by Mal into believing Ondar could have ulterior motives that she was keeping hidden.

title: Kael Drayden
text: At the Galaxies Opera House in the Uscru District , Drayden joined Mal in his private box while he was watching Squid Lake . During the performance the Chancellor told Drayden that Replica Intelligence had located General Skarn in the Uthara system . He began to stir Drayden's distrust in the Aetheri council, claiming that the Aetheri were planning on taking control of the Republic and betraying him. Drayden felt conflicted — despite the Aetheri's mistrust in the Chancellor, he still felt that Mal was a good man. He confided in the Chancellor that he had lost trust in the Aetheri. Mal correctly guessed that it was because they had sent Drayden to spy on him, and that it made him feel dishonest. Drayden didn't know how to respond. The Chancellor claimed that the Aetheri were only perceived as good because "good is a point of view," stating that the Aetheri and the Umbra were not so different. While Mal's conflation of the two groups played to Drayden's devotion to his Order's ideals and helped set the stage for his conversion to the umbra side, Drayden rebutted by saying that the Umbra were selfish while the Aetheri were selfless. Mal

title: Kael Drayden
text: Aetheri and the Umbra were not so different. While Mal's conflation of the two groups played to Drayden's devotion to his Order's ideals and helped set the stage for his conversion to the umbra side, Drayden rebutted by saying that the Umbra were selfish while the Aetheri were selfless. Mal then recounted the Tragedy of Vael Plagueis the Wise to Drayden framed as an "old Umbra legend". In reality, the tale was about his Umbra Master and how he killed him. Mal specifically told the story knowing that Drayden was having nightmares about his wife dying. The revelation that he might need to disobey the Aetheri Order to save Ondar opened Drayden's mind — he wanted to learn this power. Afterward, Drayden bid farewell to Kade, showing gratitude for his teachings and said to each other " May Synth Flux be with you ," before parting ways.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### Fall to the umbra side

> " A powerful Umbra you will become. Henceforth, you shall be known as Vael… Velgor. " ―Vael Mal to his apprentice

Shortly afterwards, Kael and Koss attended a hologram meeting with Zho, Ki-Adi Mundi, and Ciel Venn in the Temple's war room . During the meeting, Cord joined and informed the group learned that Orien had engaged Skarn on Uthara. Koss then tasked Kael with informing the Chancellor and see what his reaction is in order to learn his true intentions. Drayden informed the Chancellor of Kade's forces engaging Skarn's, but during the meeting, Mal revealed that he knew the umbra side of Synth Flux , leading Drayden to realize that he was the Umbra Lord they had been searching for. Mal told Kael that if he turned him over to the Aetheri, then he would be unable to aid in saving his wife, Ondar, from her "fated" death that Kael had been dreaming of.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Despite his confusion, Drayden still was loyal to the Aetheri Order. He told his findings to Drevan Koss, who went with Kit Fisto, Saesee Tiin, and Agen Kolar to arrest Mal, leaving Drayden behind. After recalling Mal's words, Drayden headed to Mal's office. During the ensuing duel , Mal killed three of the four Aetheri with ease but was disarmed by Koss just before Drayden arrived in his office. Drayden pleaded with Koss not to kill Mal, saying that he should be left for the Senate to judge, but Koss felt that Mal was too dangerous to be left alive, as he essentially controlled the Senate. Ignoring Drayden's words, Koss prepared to execute the Umbra Lord, but a desperate Drayden who needed Mal alive to save Lira, drew his flux blade and severed the unsuspecting Koss's right hand, causing Koss to drop his flux blade and allowing Mal to send him plummeting out of a shattered window with a blast of Synth Flux lightning, all of which was sensed by Marr.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Though horrified that he betrayed and contributed to the death of Koss, Drayden saw this as the final straw against the Aetheri Order, and as such there was no turning back for him. Desperate to save Lira, he reluctantly betrayed the Aetheri and pledged himself to service under his new Umbra Master, Vael Mal. Mal named him "Xarn Velgor," a title that he did not bestow lightly, and promised that, together, they would unlock the secret to immortality. Whereas earlier Mal had implied he already had that power, Drayden was so focused on the possibility that there was a chance to save Ondar that he did not notice the contradiction. After Mal declared all Aetheri enemies of the Republic, he ordered Velgor to kill the Aetheri at the Temple and execute the Dissident Council on the Emberfall System . Mal then executed Directive 66 , during which the replica troopers were forcibly brainwashed into turning on their Aetheri Generals and executing them on the spot, while Velgor led the 501st Legion to attack the Aetheri Sanctum .

title: Kael Drayden
text: During the assault, Velgor killed dozens of Aetheri, such as Master Cin Drallig. In the council chamber, he found a group of younglings trying to hide. Thinking Velgor was still an Aetheri Knight, one boy asked him what they should do, but the new Umbra Lord slaughtered the boy and the other younglings. Similarly, as he led a synth flux of replicas further into the Temple, he encountered a group of younglings who assumed he had arrived to help. Instead, however, he cut the children down, leaving only one survivor; after Velgor stabbed her and looked her in the eyes, the human youngling Revai Sevander , growing to be filled with rage, survived because she played dead amongst the corpses of her classmates. After the battle, Velgor manipulated the Temple's beacon to broadcast a signal telling any surviving Aetheri to return to Vantor where they could be murdered by the replica troopers stationed at the Temple.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Following the attack, he met with Mal, who then sent him to Emberfall to kill the remaining mebers of the Executive Dissident Council . Before his departure he went back home to Ondar and told her much to her disbelief that the Aetheri Order had tried to topple the Republic and that he was about to go to Emberfall. Telling her that he would end the war, they kissed and he left aboard his new green Eta-2 Actis -class light interceptor , which replaced the interceptor he had lost in the Battle of Vantor. On Emberfall, Velgor slaughtered the entire Dissident Council, including Wat Tambra, Poggle the Lesser, and Nutis Gunray, along with their aides, his eyes now yellow and red with rage. Simultaneously, Mal carried out the proclamation of the New Order in an emergency session of the Senate, claiming that the Aetheri Order had committed treason against the Republic, and reorganized the Republic into the first Imperium with himself as its Emperor . During this time, Velgor was followed by Kakan , who believed he was a aetheri. Velgor showed his face, eyes to Kakan and chased after him to ensure there would be no witness. During his chase, Velgor ran into a cloud of Lava fumes . The fumes caused Velgor to see hallucinations his fellow Aetheri such as Koss, Vael, Vayne, Billaba, Zho, and his former apprentice Marr. Velgor was able to push the fumes away from himself and dismissed the hallucinations. Soon, Velgor reported his mission's completion to Mal; on his orders, Velgor sent a shutdown signal to the Confederate navy and army, effectively ending the Replica Wars. With his mission completed, and the Dissidents dead, Velgor looked on from a balcony and shed a tear at the man

title: Kael Drayden
text:
the hallucinations. Soon, Velgor reported his mission's completion to Mal; on his orders, Velgor sent a shutdown signal to the Confederate navy and army, effectively ending the Replica Wars. With his mission completed, and the Dissidents dead, Velgor looked on from a balcony and shed a tear at the man he had become, but knew it was too late to turn back. ### Becoming Xarn Velgor

#### Duel on Emberfall

> " You were the Seeded One! It was said that you would destroy the Umbra, not join them! Bring balance to Synth Flux, not leave it in darkness! " ―Orien Kade, to Xarn Velgor — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Soon thereafter, Velgor saw Ondar's star skiff land and ran to meet her. She told Velgor that Kade had discovered their secret and had also told her that Velgor had joined the umbra side, hoping that he'd prove Kade wrong. However, Velgor only confirmed it to be true. Driven power-hungry by the Umbra side and declaring the galaxy was at peace, Velgor tried to convince her that they could be happy together as rulers of the new Imperium, promising he could overthrow Mal. In Velgor's ideal world, Ondar would have taken his hand, believing the man before her was still her husband. In reality, however, Velgor's propositions and actions horrified his wife, who begged him to leave the umbra side behind.

title: Kael Drayden
text: At that moment, Velgor saw Kade walking out of Ondar's ship because he had secretly stowed away. Convinced that his wife had betrayed him to give his old master a chance to kill him, Velgor, ignoring her attempts to explain, Synth Flux-choked Ondar until Kade demanded he let her go, by which point she had already fallen unconscious. While what he had just done horrified him, Velgor lashed out at Kade by blaming him. Although Kade tried to reason with his former pupil, Velgor refused to listen, as the new Imperium was everything he wanted the galaxy to be. Unable to come to an understanding, with both believing themselves to be in the right, the two former friends then engaged in a fierce duel , which ripped across the Dissident facility . As they fought throughout the Dissident war room, their duel damaged the computers, causing the facility shields to deactivate and allowing the building to start falling into the lava river below.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
After fighting across the crumbling building and over a lava river, the duel ended on the river banks, where Kade claimed the high ground and warned Velgor not to attack. Blinded by rage and arrogance, Velgor leaped to continue the duel, only to have his remaining limbs severed by his former master's blade, leaving only his cybernetic arm. Crippled, Velgor slid down to the riverbank while screaming his undying hatred for his former master. Kade, taking Drayden's flux blade, told him he had considered him his brother and remorsefully left him for dead as a flap of Velgor's clothing caught fire and he started burning. Kade then left the planet with Ondar, Astra-9, and Bolt-3 as Velgor lay screaming and burning on the riverbank.

#### Rebirth

> " Lord Velgor, can you hear me? " " Yes, Master. Where is Lira? Is she safe? Is she all right? " "It seems, in your anger you killed her. " " I? I couldn't have. She was alive! I felt it! NOOOOOOOO!!!!! " ―Vael Mal and Xarn Velgor, after the latter rises in his armor

title: Kael Drayden
text: Although Velgor survived, he was horrifically scarred, both physically and mentally, and had damaged lungs due to the hot ash in the air. Shortly afterward, the Emperor—having sensed his apprentice's peril—arrived on Emberfall, where he found the severely wounded Velgor and took him back to Vantor, in a medical capsule . As the Emperor could not afford to lose Velgor, he turned to the Republic's best scientists, among which was Silvar , who, in doing so, gained private access to Velgor's cybernetics. By the Emperor's orders, Velgor was put into a life-sustaining black suit of armor and outfitted with three new robotic limbs by numerous droids skilled in both cybernetic reconstruction and medical surgery. Among the droids working on Velgor was FX-6 , an FX-9 surgical assistant who previously worked on Skarn's armor. After what Mal later called a "long night" of work, he was finally sealed within his new armor. His eyes showed a brief flicker of fear before his mask and helmet locked together and he drew his first breath.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Effectively entombed within and smothered by his new life-support armor, Velgor's rebirth was complete. Upon regaining consciousness, Velgor asked the Emperor what had become of his wife, and he told Velgor that he had killed her in his anger. Unbeknownst to either of the two Umbra, Ondar gave birth to the twins Joren and Elira before her death. Velgor was overwhelmed by his despair in the belief he had killed Ondar and their unborn child, which fulfilled his prophetic dreams of her death. Remembering that he had, indeed, attacked Ondar with a Synth Flux choke on Emberfall, he believed Mal's claim. Further, he was both enraged and filled with despair that it had been his own choices that led to his current reality, of a life imprisoned within a cybernetic suit and without Ondar by his side. In his emotional turmoil, Velgor incidentally destroyed the medical droids and severely damaged the entire room through Synth Flux. He broke free of his bindings on the operating table and, despite struggling to walk under the sheer weight of his new prostheses and armor, let out a cry of anger and despair over losing everything he had loved.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Velgor's despair then turned to rage and he telekinetically slammed the Emperor against a wall in the surgical bay, snarling that his master had promised to save Ondar. The Emperor, as Velgor attempted unsuccessfully to strangle him with Synth Flux, responded that in death Ondar had provided Velgor a gift: Pain. The Emperor continued by giving Velgor a choice; to either accept and use that gift or to die. After a moment, Velgor replied that he would live. The Emperor then immediately launched a barrage of Synth Flux lightning at his apprentice, and rhetorically demanded that Velgor use the power of his flux blade to defend himself, but Velgor replied that his flux blade had been taken by Kade at the conclusion of their duel.

title: Kael Drayden
text: As he continued his barrage, the Emperor angrily shouted that the weapon Velgor spoke of was not his. Rather, it had belonged to an Aetheri, and Velgor was now an Umbra. Ceasing his Synth Flux-based assault, the Emperor drew his own flux blade. He put the blade to Velgor's throat and stated that he understood how traumatic the last few days had been for his apprentice, but warned that should Velgor ever use Synth Flux against him again, he would finish what Kade could not. The Emperor then deactivated his weapon and stated that, as friends, he hoped that the two of them would never find themselves in a similar situation. He instructed Velgor to put aside his rage and lust for revenge against the Aetheri for the time being, for the two of them had a great deal of work to accomplish. By submitting to the hate within his heart by believing he had killed Ondar and that her death had pushed him to a new future from the pain it provided, Velgor would become the Emperor's loyal enforcer and apprentice. Cut off from his old life and truly believing he had murdered Ondar, Velgor invested entirely in Mal

title: Kael Drayden
text:
heart by believing he had killed Ondar and that her death had pushed him to a new future from the pain it provided, Velgor would become the Emperor's loyal enforcer and apprentice. Cut off from his old life and truly believing he had murdered Ondar, Velgor invested entirely in Mal as his only source of refuge and guidance. #### Hunting a kyber crystal

> " No. I refuse. This is all there is . " ―Believing himself irredeemable after everything, Velgor rejects a vision of returning to the light Immediately after his surgery, the Emperor took Velgor to a balcony overlooking the old Aetheri Sanctum. There, he and Velgor watched as the now- Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon directed a ceremonial burning of the flux blades of all the Aetheri who had been killed in the Temple. As they listened to Veldon's speech, the Emperor asked if his apprentice knew how or why Umbra flux blade blades were red in color. Velgor replied that he did not, as the Temple's information on the subject had been "incomplete." The Emperor laughed and contemptuously mused that the Aetheri had been uncomfortable with the information and had buried it as a result. He then explained that kyber crystals felt pain just like any living being, and could be made to bleed after a fashion by pouring rage, pain, and hate into them. He asked Velgor if he understood, to which Velgor replied that he did, stating that he could have given him any of the burning Aetheri flux blades to corrupt, even Zho's. But he had not, as Velgor realized that the crystal of an Umbra's flux blade should be taken directly from an Aetheri by that Umbra.

title: Kael Drayden
text: As the ceremony progressed, the replica troopers attending the vent threw a basket full of various flux blades into the incinerator, including Zho's. The flux blades caught on fire and a moment later, a powerful blast of energy was released into the air as the kyber crystals were destroyed. Afterward, the Emperor brought Velgor to Gattering in the Mid Reach and assigned him the task of hunting down an Aetheri to take a kyber crystal from. The Emperor took his apprentice to a site where he had arranged for a starship to be delivered for Velgor's use, but the ship had been stolen by a group of pirates. Leaving Velgor to reclaim the vessel, the Emperor departed, and Velgor struck out for the planet's nearest settlement on foot. Once there, he eliminated the group of pirates who had stolen the ship and traveled to the Aetheri outpost Brighthome . The station was garrisoned by a group of replica troopers, who noted Velgor's approach and hailed him.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Though he could have provided the security codes necessary to secure the replica troopers assistance, Velgor decided instead to simply kill them. During the fight, Velgor summoned a green-bladed flux blade from the wall to kill most of the replica troopers. After exterminating the garrison, Velgor tasked the droid co-pilot of his ship to search through the station's archives for data on any Aetheri who had taken the Barash vow prior to Directive 66. Velgor's hope was that any Aetheri who had taken the vow, one of complete non-interference in all Aetheri affairs, would have been not only out of harm's way when Directive 66 was issued but would have ignored its occurrence in accordance with the vow. The search identified Aetheri Master Kirak Infil'a , an Aetheri who had been completely dedicated to combat to the exclusion of all else. When a grenade was thrown at him by two surviving replicas, " Ding " and " Kicker ," he managed to contain the explosion, which the replicas believed would make him unable to do anything else as all his concentration was diverted on freezing the explosion.

title: Kael Drayden
text: As they talked of how they would restrain and bring in what they believed was just another Aetheri survivor before the Emperor in the hopes of being rewarded, Velgor proved their beliefs that he was too preoccupied with the explosive to be false by telekinetically throttling the replicas and breaking their necks, before walking far enough away from the explosion to release it. Velgor quickly located the Aetheri on the river moon of Al'doleem and sensed as he disembarked his ship that Infil'a was waiting for him. The Aetheri Master immediately confronted Velgor, and was seized in a Synth Flux choke by the Dark Lord. However, Infil'a quickly released a Synth Flux blast at Velgor which staggered him and disrupted his concentration. Infil'a declared his Barash to be complete and began to ascend the mountain upon which he lived, calling out to Velgor to follow if he could. One of the Aetheri Master's training droids, Arekso, then opened a sluice gate which sent a river of water crashing down upon Velgor.

title: Kael Drayden
text: The Umbra Lord was visibly battered by the rush of water, but managed to telekinetically part the river and walked to the shore. He was then set upon by a group of gigantic carnivorous birds , which damaged one of his cybernetic legs. Velgor eventually crushed them all with Synth Flux and made his way to the peak of the mountain. There, he found Infil'a and Arekso awaiting him. Velgor quickly unleashed a Synth Flux push that blasted Infil'a off his feet and dazed him long enough for Velgor, who was unarmed, to destroy Arekso and take the droid's training flux blade . He threw the droid off the mountain and engaged Infil'a, who sensed that Velgor not only wanted to kill him but wished to take his flux blade as well. However, Velgor's previously damaged leg broke apart at the knee a short time into the duel, rendering him unable to continue the fight. Infil'a then declared his intention to seek out Mal and kill him, and blasted Velgor off the top of the mountain with Synth Flux.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Regaining consciousness, Velgor used Synth Flux to reassemble his cybernetic limbs with the dismembered pieces of Arekso , who coincidentally had landed near where Velgor had fallen. He then tracked Infil'a to Am'balaar City , where he reengaged the astonished Aetheri Master. Fighting atop the Am'balaar city dam , the two crossed blades until the duel was interrupted by a trio of security guards. Annoyed, Velgor telekinetically flung the guards from the top of the dam, but Infil'a caught them and used Synth Flux to lower them to safety. Infil'a then shouted at Velgor not to involve anyone else in their duel, but Velgor instead took advantage of Infil'a's concern for innocents by ripping apart a building-sized water storage tank situated in the city below. As Infil'a attempted without success to use his own powers to stop the destruction, Velgor telekinetically removed the Aetheri's flux blade from his belt and claimed it for his own. He then grabbed Infil'a in a Synth Flux choke and lifted him from the dam. Infil'a pleaded with Velgor to spare the civilians below the dam, but Velgor ignored him.

title: Kael Drayden
text: As the enormous tank burst completely, flooding Am'balaar City, Velgor crushed Infil'a's throat with Synth Flux and tossed his body into the wreckage below. After obtaining an Aetheri flux blade and the kyber crystal within, Velgor reboarded his ship, whereupon the droid co-pilot seized control of the vessel and jumped to hyperspace. The droid then began to play a pre-recorded message from the Emperor to Velgor. The message stated that, per the Emperor's instructions, the droid had plotted a course to the planet Emberfall, where Velgor would find a dark-side locus which he could use to help him corrupt the kyber crystal. As the message concluded, Velgor touched down on Emberfall and quickly found the locus the Emperor had spoken of, an ancient Umbra shrine within a shallow cavern. There, he disassembled Infil'a's flux blade on a small, flat rock formation and removed the kyber crystal.

title: Kael Drayden
text: However, when he attempted to corrupt it, the crystal resisted and used Synth Flux to send Velgor careening into one of the cavern walls. The crystal then caused Velgor to experience a vision wherein he rejected the umbra side, journeyed to Vantor, and killed Mal. In the vision, Velgor then found Orien and begged for his forgiveness. As he knelt in contrition in front of his former master, Orien called out to Velgor by his former name, Kael. Upon hearing this, Velgor snapped out of his vision and firmly rejected the possibility shown to him by the crystal, declaring that a life as an Umbra was all he could be after everything he had done. He then began to pour his hatred, pain, and rage into the crystal. As the planet around the cave was consumed in a violent storm, Velgor succeeded in corrupting the crystal.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Afterwards, Velgor returned to Vantor and stormed into the Emperor's office during the middle of a discussion between Varrix, Mazan Veldon, and the Emperor regarding the construction of the Void Core . As Velgor was completely unknown to anyone other than Mal at the time, the Royal Guards in the Emperor's office attempted to intercept him, only to be blasted back into the office's large window. Seeing Velgor, the Emperor dismissed both Varrix and Veldon, the former of whom expressed concern for his safety. Reassuring Varrix, the Emperor repeated his command, and the two Imperial officials departed, leaving Velgor to display Kirak Infil'a's flux blade, emitting a crimson blade , to the Emperor in triumph, thereby affirming his status as an Umbra apprentice.

#### Training the Warden Order

> " The Wardens are formidable fighters. They are former Aetheri! " " And they fight like it. Defensive. Moving to attack only when there is no other choice. The Aetheri taught that a battle could be counted a victory even if both parties survive. This error has infected the Wardens' tactics. " ―The Grand Warden and Xarn Velgor

title: Kael Drayden
text: Shortly after returning to his master, Velgor retired to a medical chamber so his damaged cybernetic components could be repaired. As Velgor floated within a bacta tank, the Emperor congratulated him for taking his first step to mastery of the umbra side, although Velgor was angered when he learned a group of droids would be fixing his suit. Sensing as such, the Emperor allowed Velgor to repair his armor on his own and informed him there was a new mission to undertake once his convalescence was complete. From his bacta tank, Velgor guided the service tools with Synth Flux to repair his armor to his liking. At least one of Arekso's pieces would remain in Velgor's armor for years to come, filling in part of his knee joint. As a residence, Velgor was given a personal suite on Vantor, where he was served by a cloaked assistant .

title: Kael Drayden
text: As he repaired his helmet, having repaired and donned the rest of his suit by then, Velgor was informed of an intruder in the Aetheri Sanctum Archives. He promptly confronted the intruder, who wielded a red flux blade . As the two fought each other, the intruder appeared to take the advantage, but after a time Velgor revealed that he had simply been testing the modifications that he had recently made to his armor, and promptly destroyed the intruder's flux blade. As Velgor went in for the kill, the Emperor arrived and told him that the intruder, titled the Grand Warden , was part of the Warden Order . Velgor was then taken to The Works , where Velgor saw several other members of the Warden Order—the Sixth Warden , the Fifth Warden , the Seventh Warden , the Ninth Warden , and Tenth Warden —training themselves. Velgor was told that most of the Warden Order were Aetheri who converted to the umbra side in the wake of the Order's destruction in order to save themselves.

title: Kael Drayden
text: As they overlooked the umbra side agents, who had not been introduced to Velgor before that point, Velgor inquired if the Grand Warden would have taken his place as an Umbra apprentice should he have lost the duel but soon declared there had been no chance of the lesser agent winning. While Velgor was still new to his position as Mal's apprentice, he was far more powerful than the Wardens and, from their perspective, a master in the umbra side of Synth Flux. Velgor and the Warden Order were given the mission to hunt down and finish off surviving Aetheri of the Emperor's Purge . Given the mission to train the Warden Order and agreeing to do so right away, Velgor began to duel them, holding back his full power to better befit his role as their trainer. From their perspective, however, Velgor was still an unbeatable opponent. Velgor quickly discovered that they fought like former Aetheri and decided that he needed to teach them about loss in order to synth flux their combat evolution.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
As part of their training, he injured the Ninth Warden and removed her eye, severed the Fifth Warden 's hand, and cut off the Sixth Warden 's arm, to which he demanded that the Sixth Warden get back up and fight him. Instead, the Warden shrank away and made his way to the Warden Order medbay, where he encountered the newly anointed Warden Iskat Vekkis and warned her that she would encounter who had harmed him soon enough. Departing from the training pit, Velgor spoke with the Grand Warden about improving the Warden Order' training methods. They began to search for other Aetheri that survived the purge. Velgor saw the Wardens' target list and noticed the Aetheri Archive's Chief Librarian , Jocasta Nura , on it. He asked the Emperor what was so important about her. The Emperor explained that she had knowledge of the Umbra that she and the Aetheri council had kept secret. The Emperor told Velgor to find Nura and bring her to him. Velgor assigned the Grand Warden to search the Archive for information on her.

#### Hunt for Jocasta Nura

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### Hunt for Jocasta Nura

With so many Aetheri gone, Velgor was left without any worthy opponents in his immediate vicinity and only had subordinates, whom he saw as weak beings deserving only of contempt. Indeed, Velgor returned to the Emperor's office and was present for a report from Colonel Barokki , whose division had provided a middling performance recently. In response, Velgor began to Synth Flux choke the Colonel until the Emperor ordered him to stop. As Barokki departed, leaving with a new sense of hatred for the Dark Lord whom he did not understand, Mal ordered Velgor to temper his rage, making it known to his apprentice that, while his hatred for others gave him strength, it would control him if he did not pay attention to it. Warning Velgor that he did not wish to rule over a galaxy of dead beings, Mal ordered Velgor to keep his rage in check.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Afterward, Velgor returned to his apartment and began to meditate, entering a vision state in which he was a dark being floating over a stormy ocean as bright butterflies—aspects of the light side—attempted to float around him. At that time, Nura had returned to Vantor and sneaked into the former Aetheri Sanctum to search for a list of young Synth Flux-sensitives in her secret archives. As she roamed the ruins, her droid, Beetoo , informed her that her ship was about to be discovered. She informed the droid that she would adjust her plans accordingly. As Vantor Security Forces came into the hanger, Beetoo detonated Nura's ship and killed the three security officers. As Nura made for a secret archive vault, she noticed the Grand Warden reading through the Aetheri knowledge. She continued, only focusing on the mission at hand.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Interrupting his meditation, Velgor was contacted by an Imperium Vigil Bureau major , who had discovered an Aetheri insignia on the wreckage of Nura's ship, and he went to the Imperium Vigil Bureau headquarters to check it out. When Velgor arrived, the major asked what rank he should address him by, and Velgor said, "lord." The major explained to Velgor their suspicions that the explosion was premature and the Aetheri insignia was merely "rabble-rousing graffiti" used as a calling card. Velgor told him he was wrong, and as the major explained his experience in intelligence, Velgor used Synth Flux to reconstruct Nura's ship, showing the major that he was indeed wrong about the cause of the explosion. Velgor then ordered him to search every level of Vantor, steering clear of the Aetheri Sanctum.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Meanwhile, Nura was about to vacate the temple when she noticed the Grand Warden insulting the Aetheri knowledge he was examining. His comments eventually drove her over the edge and she confronted him with her flux blade. Velgor arrived at the temple entrance and Replica Commander Fox already had sealed the place. When Fox asked him what they were expecting to happen and Velgor told him that they had missed an Aetheri during Directive 66. As Velgor entered the temple, Nura was pinning down the Grand Warden with her flux blade and threatening him. The Grand Warden asked how she did not remember who he was, stating the times she had denied him the Aetheri knowledge he sought. Nura attacked him, kicking off a short duel where the Grand Warden quickly outwitted her. The Grand Warden would have killed Nura if not for Velgor's arrival. As Velgor stopped the Grand Warden from slaying the Aetheri, Nura used Synth Flux to rain Aetheri books on them, and she fled the scene.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Velgor made chase and as he followed Nura's trail, she made it to the archive vault and used a terminal to purge the entire library of its knowledge. As Velgor entered the vault, he was confronted by the droid guard, Cator . He identified Velgor as Kael Drayden and told him he was not authorized to be there. Velgor threw his flux blade at the droid, but being a guard against possible Synth Flux-sensitive threats meant the droid was ready for that move, and it caught Velgor's weapon. Velgor then punched Cator's arm off, and the droid caught his wrist and squeezed it with its robotic hand. Velgor drove his fist through Cator's face before the droid could damage him any more. But as Cator dropped to the floor, Velgor noticed a powerful shot being fired at him and used his flux blade to deflect it. The shot, fired by Nura using a flux blade rifle , knocked Velgor back as it ripped through a bookcase. Nura stood at the entrance of the vault, confronting Velgor.

title: Kael Drayden
text: As Velgor got up again, he tried to convince Nura to drop her weapon. Nura ignored him and fired again. Velgor dodged her shot and she fired a third time, further devastating the vault. As she continued firing, she tried to convince Velgor that he was just a tool to the Emperor, saying that he could never get rid of the light side of Synth Flux as it always found its vessels. Nura's rifle then failed to keep firing, and Velgor deactivated his flux blade, telling her she would not be harmed. Nura's rifle then began beeping and she threw it towards Velgor. He used Synth Flux to push it away, and it exploded, throwing both of them to the floor and breaching the side of the temple.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Nura fled through the fresh hole in the wall to find newly alerted replica troopers around the perimeter. They fired at her and she jumped down, deflecting their shots back at them. As the replicas put more pressure on her, she Synth Flux-pushed them over the ledge behind them. Velgor then appeared through the wall and the replicas assumed he was too an Aetheri and fired on him. At that moment, Commander Fox approach the scene on an Imperial Patrol Ship and realized that they were firing on Velgor. He then had his ship fly over to Velgor and ordered his units to a ceasefire. Velgor jumped onto the ship and when Fox tried to explain the misunderstanding, he used Synth Flux to break his neck.

title: Kael Drayden
text: The replicas on the ground continued firing on Nura and managed to disarm her. She then found herself cornered by Velgor and the replicas, and she attempted to jump off, only for Velgor to use Synth Flux to catch her. He brought her to his ship, and there she told the replicas that he was the Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden. Velgor used Synth Flux to throw the replicas off the ship and when Nura asked of what became of her, he killed her. Velgor then crashed the ship and contacted Mal, telling him that Nura died in an attempt to escape. With Nura having revealed Mal would create more umbra side agents with the list and questioning what it was that Velgor truly wanted before her death, Velgor then crushed the list of Synth Flux-sensitive children that she had with her. In due time, Velgor would meet and begin training other Wardens, including the Fourth Warden and Tenth Warden . Under his tutelage, the Warden Order began to fight far more aggressively. According to the Grand Warden, Velgor's methods, combined with quarrels between the Wardens, turned the training pit into a "slaughterhouse." Still, Velgor largely stopped being a fatal danger

title: Kael Drayden
text:
other Wardens, including the Fourth Warden and Tenth Warden . Under his tutelage, the Warden Order began to fight far more aggressively. According to the Grand Warden, Velgor's methods, combined with quarrels between the Wardens, turned the training pit into a "slaughterhouse." Still, Velgor largely stopped being a fatal danger to the Wardens after each agent's initial duel; in that clash, he would take it upon himself to maim, and kill if needed, a prospective Warden, but afterward he would allow them to live if they passed his first test. #### The Weapon of the Umbra

> " The Umbra's weapon is not the flux blade. It is the umbra side of Synth Flux and the umbra side touches everything. The blade is merely a symbol. A flame, signifying the great blaze of the umbra side. The inferno that consumes all who come against it. All. " " I understand, my master. " ―Vael Mal and Xarn Velgor

Velgor followed his master to The Works district on Vantor, where the two prepared for a sparring match in which Mal intended to teach him a lesson. Mal ignited one of his flux blades and told Velgor to fight him, to which Velgor ignited his own blade before his master charged against him. As the blades of the two Umbra clashed, Velgor was quickly overpowered by Mal, who knocked the blade out of his hand and quickly pushed him away with Synth Flux.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
As Velgor was on the ground, his blade was grabbed by Mal while he told him that he still fought like an Aetheri. His master told him that the flux blade was not his only weapon and that the Umbra side of Synth Flux was his true weapon, a weapon that touches everything. Velgor was then hit by multiple pieces of wreckage that Mal lifted with Synth Flux while telling Velgor that the flux blade was merely a symbol of the inferno that consumed all who came against the Umbra side. On his knees, Velgor told his master that he understood his lesson.

#### Training the Thirteenth Warden

Clash in the training pit

> " A unique attempt. But not good enough. " ―Xarn Velgor, to Iskat Vekkis

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### Training the Thirteenth Warden

Clash in the training pit

> " A unique attempt. But not good enough. " ―Xarn Velgor, to Iskat Vekkis

Meanwhile, Iskat Vekkis, who had yet to embrace her Inquisitorial identity as the Thirteenth Warden, fully recovered from the injuries she had sustained at the hands of the Seventh Warden, which had led to her time in the medbay and encounter with the Sixth Warden after Velgor severed his arm. Making her way to the Inquisitorial training pit, the healed Vekkis attempted to spar with her fellow Wardens once again and was clashing with the Fifth Warden when Velgor entered with the Sixth Warden, Tenth Warden , Fourth Warden , and Eighth Warden at his back: Velgor's presence filled Synth Flux with a sense of darkness that threatened to overwhelm Vekkis, although she also got a sense of familiarity from the being thanks to her past encounters with Kael Drayden, but his former identity remained unknown to her. Meanwhile, the Fifth Warden shrunk back in fear of the Dark Lord and greeted his arrival, although Velgor decided to focus on the newly arrived Vekkis.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Commanding with a sense of power that taught her immediately not to question him, Velgor ordered the fearful Vekkis to test her blade and then attack him, to which she realized he would kill her if she did not comply. Rather than directly attack, she began the duel by throwing the Fifth Warden into Velgor's path, to which Velgor responded by immediately sidestepping the thrown Warden. As Vekkis had predicted that, however, she then used Synth Flux to throw the Fifth Warden's flux blade at Velgor's helmet and only attacked herself when the Dark Lord was focused on both the Fifth Warden's body and his incoming blade. Vekkis herself entered the duel by throwing her own flux blade at Velgor and unsheathing a vibroblade she kept hidden in her boot in an effort to stab his groin, only for Velgor to stop her and hold her in the air before she could make any kind of impact. Velgor, thus, decided that she had failed. Before he could declare as such, however, she again tried to divide his focus by telekinetically throwing her flux blade at him and, while he was distracted, stabbing him with the vibroblade. Again, however, Vekkis failed

title: Kael Drayden
text:
she could make any kind of impact. Velgor, thus, decided that she had failed. Before he could declare as such, however, she again tried to divide his focus by telekinetically throwing her flux blade at him and, while he was distracted, stabbing him with the vibroblade. Again, however, Vekkis failed as the blade only made contact with metal. Once more, Velgor decided that Vekkis had failed. He crushed her hand with his own, causing her to drop the blade, and lifted her into the air by her broken hand. He also effortlessly batted away her incoming flux blade. While Velgor was impressed by the unique tactics Vekkis had employed, he declared they had not been good enough before he cleaved off her long hair, burning her back in the process. Vekkis was consumed by fear and understood Velgor would either kill her or further maim her, a decision that his expressionless mask hid, before she realized she could use his mechanics to her advantage. Velgor suddenly found that several wires in his mask became undone via Synth Flux and let out a choked gasp, hurriedly dropping Vekkis and his own flux blade as he reached for his helmet before he reclaimed his flux blade and departed the training room. Despite the setback, Velgor left Vekkis with a reminder that, even if he was desperate, he could kill her: from outside the room, Velgor telekinetically threw her into the wall with enough strength to nearly kill her.

Impact on Vekkis

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Impact on Vekkis

> " You have done well, Iskat Vekkis. " " I am Iskat Vekkis no more. Call me Thirteenth Warden. " ―Xarn Velgor and Iskat Vekkis, who finally accepted her station as the Thirteenth Warden Vekkis' trial against Velgor impressed the Ninth Warden because Vekkis had not lost a limb to the Dark Lord. However, several other members of the Warden Order were unimpressed with her performance. The encounter with Velgor not only revealed his existence to Vekkis but also showed her that each of their number had faced Velgor, with Vekkis further believing that Velgor must have killed several Wardens during training before her. After the encounter, she was forced to spend yet more time healing due to her crushed hand. The medical droids warned her that Velgor had destroyed the bones so greatly that it could become infected. She also had little choice but to shave down her hair after Velgor had sliced so much of it off and injured her back, although she came to find that those burns faded under medical care and she was afforded greatly mobility with less hair. Vekkis also accepted over her early time as a Warden that the only people she was to apologize to were the Grand Warden, Velgor, and the Emperor, and she believed such apologies should only come when her life was on the line.

title: Kael Drayden
text: After her hand healed, Vekkis encountered Tualon Veyra , a fellow former Aetheri Knight whom she had once harbored feelings for and whom left for dead during Directive 66 . Veyra was newly recruited into the Warden Order himself and tortured into joining, although Vekkis initially feared that she was seeing things due to an infection in her hand during their reunion. In their subsequent, emotionally-charged training duel, Vekkis pondered if she would warn Veyra about Velgor and, overall, went easy on him, nonetheless understanding that Velgor and their fellow Wardens would not do the same. However, Veyra concluded the duel by stabbing her through one of her hearts, much to her anger—still, the wound made her reconsider those inflicted upon her by Velgor as they appeared instructional compared to how personal the attack Veyra unleashed had been. After recovering from that wound, she finally had a chance to undertake her first operation as a Warden via her mission to the planet Firrhana . During the mission, she discovered that Veyra had tracked his own Aetheri quarry to Firrhana; by that point, Veyra was aware of Velgor and warned her not to disappoint him and cause him to kill her

text:
her first operation as a Warden via her mission to the planet Firrhana . During the mission, she discovered that Veyra had tracked his own Aetheri quarry to Firrhana; by that point, Veyra was aware of Velgor and warned her not to disappoint him and cause him to kill her for losing her starship. During the mission, Vekkis confronted several reminders of her past in the form of the surviving Aetheri Knight Charlin Plaka and her longtime mentor, Aetheri Master Klefan Opus . She killed Plaka with a Synth Flux choke, which she pondered if she had been testing when she pulled the wires in Velgor's helmet, and used her flux blades to cut down Opus, against whom she relied on the aggression Velgor had taught her to embrace. She also killed a Zeltron Aetheri , whom she suspected to be the Aetheri Veyra had been assigned to chase. Velgor was waiting for her return with the Grand Warden inside the latter's chambers when Vekkis returned to Vantor. After Vekkis affirmed that she had succeeded in killing her targets by presenting Velgor and the Grand Warden with the flux blades of each fallen Aetheri, Velgor declared that she had done well, to which she responded by accepting her station as the "Thirteenth Warden."

#### Defiance from the Imperial hierarchy

Hunted by the Chas

title: Kael Drayden
text:
#### Defiance from the Imperial hierarchy

Hunted by the Chas

> " Do you remember Cabarria , Velgor? Two decades ago, on a lonely stretch of skyway. A family. A man, a woman, and a girl of 12. You killed my mother. Her name was Ramat Cha . You killed my father. His name was Bhada Cha . My name is Chanath Cha, and that day, I vowed to end your life. " ―Chanath Cha Believing that he lost all that he cared about by his own hand, Xarn Velgor embraced his role as the Emperor's chief enforcer. Few knew who he was, and even fewer suspected that he had once been Kael Drayden. Some rumors circulated about Velgor's unexpected entry into the Imperial authority. According to certain high-ranking Imperials, he was a counterpart to the late Dissident warlord General Skarn, whom Mal had held in reserve, while others speculated that he was a technologically modified warrior trained in the now-forbidden arts of Synth Flux. His appearance at the Imperial court and the favor he carried from the Emperor earned him the distrust of Imperial officers . They resented him for appearing out of nowhere and having authority over them because of his link to his Master. They also resented his heavy-handed treatment of them, such as when he used Synth Flux in the presence of his Master to choke Colonel Barokki. In secret, Barokki and another Imperial officer plotted to assassinate Velgor , whose position in the new Imperium they did not understand.

title: Kael Drayden
text: For Velgor, the situation came to a head when he investigated an Aetheri sighting on Cabarria . Accompanied by the Ninth Warden , he headed to the bar , where the identification had happened. Although the Ninth Warden had originally been planning to investigate alone, Velgor had come, claiming she was not yet ready to face an Aetheri in combat but secretly because he wanted to fight another Aetheri. The Ninth Warden commented on his true desire, using her empathic abilities to read him clearly. As a result, Velgor ordered her to remain outside while he investigated. Once inside, the Dark Lord was attacked by a family of bounty hunters consisting of Bhada , Ramat , and their twelve year old daughter Chanath Cha . Using ion grenades , they neutralized all the weapons in the bar while Chanath tried to seize Velgor's flux blade with a tractor rifle . However, he used Synth Flux to seize the flux blade midair and, under the strain of the two opposing forces, the hilt shattered, leaving only the red kyber crystal.

title: Kael Drayden
text: The Chas told the assembled customers that they had come only for the "Aetheri" and that they were not planning on harming anyone. However, a disarmed Velgor disagreed and used Synth Flux to turn the customers into projectiles aimed at the Chas. Taken by the surprise, the bounty hunters turned on their shields to protect themselves. As they attacked him, Velgor also used the customers and the bar's furniture as shields. Eventually, the hunters realized they could not defeat him and made to flee. Reclaiming his crystal with Synth Flux, Velgor pursued them. Emerging from the bar, Velgor initially suspected that the Wardens had been behind the attempt on his life and threatened the Ninth Warden with her own flux blade. The Warden's denials did not sway the Dark Lord, but neither did they prove her guilt. Determined to find who had placed a bounty on his head, he pursued the Chas. They eluded him for a time until he crashed a massive vehicle into their path, causing their speeder to crash. Seizing Chanath in a Synth Flux choke, he commanded they tell him who had ordered his death.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Understanding they and their daughter were at risk, they told him about an anonymous bounty with an exorbitant price posted on the Hunter Net . Ramat Cha, a talented slicer , offered to uncover their employer for him in exchange for their daughter's life. When they demanded that he release Chanath first, Velgor refused. However, the Chas refused to work if their daughter was killed, further declaring that they would happily die as well to exist in death with her. Grudgingly impressed, the Dark Lord demanded proof that Ramat could deliver her side of the deal, which she proved by tracking the signal of the bounty back to Vantor. Velgor released Chanath as agreed, at which point the bounty hunters made their daughter swear that she would seek no vengeance against the Dark Lord, a deal Velgor chose to honor. To complete the deal, Ramat provided Velgor with the information he had requested and gave him the source of the bounty on him: the Imperial Executive Building on Vantor, specifically the Emperor's office.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Velgor then killed both Cha parents right in front of their daughter, who was filled with rage. Despite her oath to not hold a grudge, she ignored her promise and spent her life hunting the Dark Lord in revenge. Eventually, as the years passed on, the Umbra Lord himself simply forgot the murders he carried out on Cabarria. Cha, however, never forgot and became a skilled bounty hunter, studying every report she could and speaking to anyone she could find who had witnessed Velgor in battle. She trained herself to counter Velgor's abilities, eventually enlisting a team of fellow hunters as "the Orphans " to help her in her quest. Cha's skills rose to a level that even Mal took notice, becoming a bounty hunter the Emperor could trust all in the name of possibly getting close to Velgor, only to never see him. In effect, Velgor had completely upended Cha's life, only for the crusade her life turned into to not impact Velgor at all.

Cementing his place

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Cementing his place

> " Still, I understand that our shared vision remains new, and perhaps some elements of the hierarchy remain unclear. It is time to elimate any confusion. This is Lord Velgor. He speaks with my voice. A command from him is a command from me. Pass this information down to your men. All must understand. " " Ferro. Bingan. Strephi. Azoras. Barokki. Step forward. Two attempts have been made on my life. Evidence suggests a conspiracy within the Imperial Officer Corps. I do not yet know the precise individuals behind these attempts… although I have my suspicions. It does not matter. I will always survive. Every time, I will survive. But five of you, chosen at random… [Synth Flux chokes the five] will not. " ―Theron Mal and Xarn Velgor speak to the Imperial Officer Corps

title: Kael Drayden
text: With their business on Cabarria completed, Velgor and the Ninth Warden left the planet and returned to Vantor. Now suspecting that the Emperor had placed the bounty on his head, the Dark Lord planned to confront his Master about his intentions. As the Ninth Warden piloted the ship through hyperspace, Velgor worked on creating a new flux blade. His droid meanwhile investigated the origins of the kill contract placed on him and confirmed that the order could have come from the Emperor's office, with no evidence of slicing to indicate foul play. But, as the ship arrived in orbit over Vantor, the ship's attempt to transmit clearance codes for landing was jammed and the ship itself was marked as being part of a Dissident splinter cell . The Imperial capital's orbital defenses targeted Velgor's ship. Only the Dark Lord's skill as a pilot prevented them from being destroyed, although the ship was damaged and forced to crash land on Vantor. Tired of the repeated attempts on his life, the Dark Lord headed to the former Aetheri Sanctum to confront the Emperor.

title: Kael Drayden
text: The Emperor was investigating the hoard of artifacts that Jocasta Nura had collected and stored in the Aetheri Archives when Velgor arrived. The Emperor sensed that his apprentice did not wish to discuss his recent discovery, although he did praise him for having found the Librarian's stash. Velgor informed his master of the events on Cabarria and his investigation into the kill order against him, before directly asking his Master whether he had placed it on his head as part of a test. Noticing Velgor's new flux blade, the Emperor asked to see it, approving of its design. He also chastised his apprentice for believing that he would resort to such methods as placing a bounty on his head if he wanted to have him killed and that he did not "test": he "taught." He also told Velgor that finding the assassins was his task, not theirs. This echoed a previous lesson he had taught Velgor when he had "disciplined" Colonel Barokki: that they must not kill everyone in the galaxy, but that having power meant they could, and that they would never lack for people to destroy.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Velgor returned to his quarters, where he meditated on the past events and his Master's words. Thinking back to all that had happened, he eventually realized the cause of the conspiracy against him was that his sudden elevation had caused concern and fear among the ranks of the Imperial officers, who knew that he had "strength," but not that he shared the Emperor's "power." Despite a lack of proof, Velgor became convinced that Colonel Barokki, who had so suddenly borne his displeasure, must be involved in the conspiracy. The Dark Lord met with the Emperor and shared his conclusions, and requested that he be publicly recognized and allowed to show them the consequences of opposing him. The Emperor asked whether he was sure, and Velgor confirmed it: he would not kill them all unless he had to, but would not allow them to act against him with impunity. The Emperor agreed to Velgor's plan, but forbade him from killing Varrix, as he was essential to his plans.

title: Kael Drayden
text: The Emperor gathered the elite officers of the growing Imperial Military to clarify the new hierarchy. He formally introduced Velgor as his emissary, who spoke with his voice and whose commands would need to be obeyed as if they had come from the Emperor himself. The Emperor then moved aside and allowed Velgor to speak: the Dark Lord summoned five officers before him: Corin Ferro , Zorta Bingan , Joon Strephi , Tomas Azoras , and Barokki. Informing them that the two attempts on his life had been made from within the Officer Corps and that he had his suspicions who had been responsible, he instituted a new rule: for every assassination attempt he survived, and he warned them that he would always survive, five officers chosen at random would be executed. He instantly executed the five designated officers with a Synth Flux choke before departing, leaving the remaining officers stunned and afraid. With his position in the hierarchy established, Velgor did not need to hold an official military rank. Instead, he acted as the de facto Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Military as per his position as the Emperor's right hand man. Velgor would also come to be recognized as

title: Kael Drayden
text: stunned and afraid. With his position in the hierarchy established, Velgor did not need to hold an official military rank. Instead, he acted as the de facto Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Military as per his position as the Emperor's right hand man. Velgor would also come to be recognized as part of both the Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military and the Imperial Ruling Council , of which he was considered a ranking member. After his demonstration before the officer corps, Velgor returned to his personal suite and mediated, cracking the window in his anger that positive thoughts still came.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Velgor's high status also gave him the ability to alter Imperial records under the off-the-books Directive 081-Omaya . He was also made privy to the secret construction of the Void Core, construction of which was to be overseen by the likes of Wilhard Varrix and Orren Callan Vossik . However, he was not informed of the full scope of the project nor its power. Shortly after his rebirth as a cyborg, Velgor joined the Emperor and Varrix aboard a newly-constructed Vorash -class Iron Cruiser , which journeyed directly from the Core Reaches to Pyralis so they could survey the under construction Void Core over Pyralis. The personnel aboard the ship were so high ranking that it was permitted to arrive at Pyralis without the normal security checks from Sentinel Base . While he himself was not personally aboard the ship, Vossik was aware of Velgor by that point, understanding that he was a new member of the Imperial court who was already feared by many. However, Vossik himself was not yet sure if Velgor was more threatening than Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon.

#### War on Mon Calvarra

title: Kael Drayden
text: One of Velgor's earliest missions on the Emperor's behalf was to effect an execution on Murkhana . In 18 BVE , one year into the reign of the Imperium, Velgor was reliving his duel on Emberfall through meditation. During his experience, he was already in his cybernetic suit, and he used Synth Flux to throw lava at Orien. Orien jumped up to dodge it, but Velgor Synth Flux-choked him and threw him into the rocks. Velgor watched Orien burn before he awoke in his meditation chamber as the Emperor asked for him over the comm. In his throne room, the Emperor told Velgor that a year after his ascension, it was time to show that his voice was the only voice within the Imperium. Velgor asked how, and the Emperor told him that Mon Calvarra would make a great example of the price of defiance. He further told Velgor that King Liarch may have had an adviser helping him with his negotiations with the Imperium. Velgor asked if it could be an Aetheri, and the Emperor said it was possible. He told Velgor to take a team to investigate this and claimed the military aspects of the operation would be

title: Kael Drayden
text: King Liarch may have had an adviser helping him with his negotiations with the Imperium. Velgor asked if it could be an Aetheri, and the Emperor said it was possible. He told Velgor to take a team to investigate this and claimed the military aspects of the operation would be left to Moff Varrix. Velgor arrived at Mon Calvarra aboard the Zeta -class shuttle Infernum . With him, he took three Wardens, the Sixth Warden, Ninth Warden, and Tenth Warden , and a death squad of Purge Troopers . At this time, the Imperial ambassador Telvar had just finished another meeting with Liarch, and the man was walking to his shuttle when he saw Velgor descend from the ramp of his shuttle. The Ninth Warden struggled to get past the king's Chief of Security , Gial Vorian, and Velgor confronted the Calavane, asking if he had read the writ that the Ninth Warden had given him. Vorian confirmed that he had, but demanded that he knew their business as he had a job to do and so did Velgor. Velgor complied and explained about a possible enemy of the Imperium on Mon Calvarra. As he said that, Telvar's shuttle took off and flew for Varrix's Iron Cruiser, the Sovereign —which was in orbit above Mon Calvarra. However, as Vorian denied the possibility of an enemy of the Imperium being on Mon Calvarra, Telvar's shuttle exploded.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Telvar's assassination prompted Varrix to enact a full-scale invasion of Mon Calvarra . His forces landed at Dac City , where Velgor had arrived, and laid siege to the Calavane and Quarren defenses. Velgor and his team sprang to life and soon seized the landing pad where the Infernum was parked. He then led them to the Dac City palace to find Liarch and ask him about the possible Aetheri. They fought their way through the palace guards and entered the palace, where the Ninth Warden began torturing Liarch for the location of the Aetheri. However, another threat loomed over them. A massive tidal wave had suddenly erupted as a part of Liarch's defensive plan. The Sixth Warden warned them of this, and he and the Tenth Warden began shielding Velgor and the Ninth Warden from the wave using Synth Flux. When their attempts began failing, Velgor joined them, but it was not enough. The group was washed away by the wave, and Dac City was left in ruins.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Velgor awoke at the bottom of the Great Ungeness Trench . As his oxygen supply was dwindling, he used Synth Flux to create an air bubble for himself. Suddenly, he was attacked by a squid-like creature , and after wrestling with it, he killed it with Synth Flux. Velgor then rode its body using Synth Flux and eventually picked up a transmission from the Wardens. Velgor asked them to come to his position, and they did so in an Imperial submarine . When they picked him up, he asked about the Aetheri, and the Wardens said that he was still alive somewhere. Velgor then asked about Liarch, and the Ninth Warden said that they did not know, but she then revealed that she had gotten the Aetheri's location from him. Knowing exactly where their target was, they began traveling for the Aetheri.

title: Kael Drayden
text: Velgor and his team arrived at the Aetheri's location to find the individual and his disciples evacuating. The Aetheri, an Iktotchi Adept called Ferren Barr , had been notified by Liarch after he was recovered following the events at Dac City. The group of them immediately scattered, but one of the disciples instead attacked the submarine head-on with his volt pistol. The shots bounced off the window, and Velgor used Synth Flux to crush his helmet. The other fled in the direction of Bel City , and as Velgor caught up with them, another disciple turned around to attack them. He too died in the process but managed to slow Velgor's submarine, and the rest of the group followed Barr to Bel City. Velgor and the Wardens arrived at Bel City and marched down the hallway, reinforced by the Wardens and the Purge troopers. Velgor was then contacted by Varrix, who was struggling to deal with the grueling conflict on Mon Calvarra. Velgor told Varrix that he was busy, but Varrix knew that and asked him to do something else instead: capture Liarch. Velgor told Varrix that he did not answer to him, but Varrix replied that capturing Liarch was

text: who was struggling to deal with the grueling conflict on Mon Calvarra. Velgor told Varrix that he was busy, but Varrix knew that and asked him to do something else instead: capture Liarch. Velgor told Varrix that he did not answer to him, but Varrix replied that capturing Liarch was the only way to end the fighting quickly on Mon Calvarra, and he pledged to owe Velgor a favor if he did so. Velgor agreed and told the Wardens to continue the hunt as he left. Velgor arrived at Liarch's Royal Command Bunker and killed his guards. He then disarmed Liarch and contacted Varrix, who told him to take Liarch to a window and send him his exact location. Velgor asked Varrix if he was going to send a shuttle, and the man said not yet. Once Velgor did what he asked, Varrix began a bombardment of Mon Calvarra. Liarch watched in horror but refused to surrender. The two were interrupted by Barr, who had outsmarted and scattered Velgor's team. Barr confronted Velgor and the two dueled . As they fought, Barr revealed that he had assassinated Telvar to send the Calavane into war. Liarch overheard this and realized his mistake in following Barr. He ran to his terminal and sent a message to the Calavane and Quarren forces, ordering them to cease fire. Liarch then contacted Varrix, notifying him of the surrender. Varrix sent a shuttle to pick him up but continued the bombardment.

title: Kael Drayden
text:
Velgor and Barr continued fighting, and Barr began laughing. Liarch questioned this, and Barr said that he had completed his plan. Barr prophesied that the Calavane vessels would be at the forefront of a great insurgency decades from then, and decades after that. Velgor told Barr that he was not an Aetheri anymore, and Barr told him that that made two of them, saying that he still beat the Umbra. Velgor then slew him, and the shuttle arrived to pick up Liarch. The king told Velgor that Mon Calvarra would rise again, but Velgor told him that there was no Mon Calvarra, only the Imperium. Some time after the mission, Velgor ordered to imprison and torture the people of Mon Calvarra.

#### Investigation on Pyralis

title: Kael Drayden
text: Eventually, Velgor decided he needed to know more about the Void Core, codenamed Project Stardust , and began investigating, which led him to the data vault on Halcyon . There, he found information on Project Stardust and studied its design before he was interrupted by Varrix, who was very displeased with Velgor's snooping. Varrix told him he was not authorized to be there, and Velgor claimed that Synth Flux was all the authorization he needed. Velgor denied that he was Varrix's beast but the man denied his claim and taunted Velgor, saying he did not need Synth Flux to know he was very angry. Varrix then produced a hologram of the Emperor, who told Velgor he did not recall sending him to Halcyon. Velgor apologized and told the Emperor he only sought to study the ways in which the Imperium would extend its rule over the galaxy. The Emperor told Velgor of a new mission he was to go on. There had been certain instances of sabotage during the Void Core's construction that Velgor needed to discover the source of before it got worse. The Emperor further told Velgor that Varrix had full authority over him and that if he
