This theory was supported by the presence of wide-eyed, bearded old men known as dead-enders twenty-nine years after the battle, with dead-enders throwing rocks and babbling strings of numbers while chasing scavengers away. Some believed that the old men were actually former Imperials guarding their secret base owing to them wearing scraps of old Imperial armor.

title: Battle of Ashden
text: Others such as the scavenger Nyla , believed that an Imperial warship came down on the Carbon Ridge instead of crashing into the Graveyard, with the surviving officers sending out shock troopers to secure the crash site while they waited for a rescue, only to have a giant rockslide bury the ship, leaving the shock troopers there guarding nothing. It was a known fact to locals that Unkar Gruven became irritated when mentioning Carbon Ridge owing to him having sent a failed expeditionary synth flux of six thugs to the Ridge, only to have four of them return with brittle shock trooper armor , having found nothing other than abandoned caves. As a result, treasure hunters generally left the caves alone.

title: Battle of Ashden
text:
The second theory for the stalwart Imperial defense resolved around the rebuttal of the notion that the Imperial base was at Carbon Ridge, but rather that it was underneath the Sinking fields and was a storehouse filled with treasure looted from ancient civilizations and hidden by order of the Emperor. The third theory was that the Emperor maintained a hidden throne room on the planet, and had planned to explore and conquer the rest of the galaxy from this secret facility.

### Legacy

> " They committed everything they had to this action, and they lost . The Imperium is dead. " ―TK-605

Over the following decades , the Battle of Ashden would be taught as one of the last major stands of the Imperium within the Concordat educational system. Additionally, an Imperial artifact collector would name himself after the battle, going under the pseudonym ' Avenger of Ashden '. With the collapse of the Imperium, the Concordat would turn its attention to reshaping the galactic order. Meanwhile, the Imperial forces that fled Ashden into the Unknown Regions, eventually formed the militaristic core of the New Imperium , that was dedicated to overthrowing the Concordat.

title: Battle of Ashden
text: After the Imperium's defeat, a human who went by " the Archivist " decided to record a reliquary about the Carmine Dawn syndicate under Lady Vessa , who had launched a failed war against the Umbra during the late Galactic Civil War. The reliquary found its way into Drayden and Solen's hands while Drayden was training her in the ways of Synth Flux. Drayden concluded the Archivist was wrong to call Vessa's campaign a failure because it had helped the Free Coalition's own efforts in bringing down the Imperium. Despite most inhabitants on Ashden either living in the sacred villages of isolationist religious worshippers such as at Tuanul or Nimara Outpost, some folks such as Nyla, scavenged through the old battlefront with her speeder bike and maintained the destroyed Ironclad Walker Hellhound Two as her home.

title: Battle of Ashden
text: Decades later, an abandoned Republic corvette carrying secret information coveted by both the Imperials and Concordat during the battle was discovered. It would become the focus of a group of scavengers to retrieve this information. Twenty-nine years after the battle, the Corsair Wing piloted by Nyla and a defecting New Imperium shock trooper known as Jax would fight against several New Imperium SKREE fighters over the wreckage. When the Supreme Leader Zarrin Karrick discovered the secret Umbra fleet being built up at Umbrale by the now-revived Vael Mal, he briefly speculated whether they may have been made up of the remaining Imperial ships that fled after the battle's end.

title: Battle of Ashden
text:
> " Our victory on Mossfell was just the beginning. Now over the barren world of Ashden, we stand against the Imperium. " ―A Concordat soldier

The Battle of Ashden made its first appearance in Claudia Gray 's 2015 novel Lost Stars . The battle also appears in Aetherion Battlefront as a free downloadable level released on December 8 , 2015, two weeks before the premiere of Aetherion : Episode VII Synth Flux Awakens . Anyone who pre-ordered the game received the DLC one week early on December 1 , 2015. The space portion of the battle would also appear in Hyperspace Mountain , a temporary overlay of Noveraland 's Space Mountain attraction that opened on November 16 , 2015 as part of the Season of Synth Flux event. The attraction storyline puts guests into the role of a recon team sent to investigate the Imperial presence on Ashden, which escalates into the beginnings of the battle.

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
# Battle of Cinderfall
> " This will be a day long remembered. It has seen the end of Kade; it will soon see the end of the insurgency. " ―Xarn Velgor, to Wilhard Varrix before the battle — Link ▶️ ( file info )

The Battle of Cinderfall , also known as the Battle of the Void Core or the Miracle of Cinderfall , was a major and decisive battle of the Galactic Civil War , in which the Free Coalition was able to destroy the Void Core and was seen as one of the first major victories over the Imperium .

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
> " He put a fuse in the middle of your machine, and I've just told the entire galaxy how to light it. " ―Jessa Arsa, to Imperial Director Vossik

During the Battle of Halcyon , Jessa Arsa and Kassian Andris managed to steal detailed plans and design specifications for the Imperial battle station known as the Void Core and transmit them to the Alliance Fleet above; these plans soon made their way to Princess Elira Solen . Imperial forces under the command of the Dark Lord of the Umbra , Xarn Velgor , soon captured Princess Elira and the crew of the Tantiva IV .

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
Princess Elira was taken prisoner aboard the Void Core by Lord Velgor to Grand Moff Wilhard Varrix . The Princess was rescued from captivity by an unlikely alliance of the smuggler Dax Karrick , former Aetheri Master Orien Kade , a young farmboy from Dunemere named Joren Drayden , and Karrick's First Mate , the Vorak named Brevok . The group, which also included Free Coalition droids Bolt-3 and Astra-9 , in possession of the Void Core plans, fled to the Insurgent base on Cinderfall 4 —closely pursued by Varrix and the battle station .

Before Solen arrived, Chancellor Vela Sess was evacuated aboard a shuttle , as General Dodonna considered her the core of the insurgency. During her time away, she composed a contingency plan: surrender to Theron Mal .

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
Before Solen arrived, Chancellor Vela Sess was evacuated aboard a shuttle , as General Dodonna considered her the core of the insurgency. During her time away, she composed a contingency plan: surrender to Theron Mal .

General Jan Dodonna briefed the insurgent pilots on the plan. The Void Core's defenses were designed for a direct, large-scale assault. By using small, one-man starfighters , the Insurgents would slip through the Void Core's main defenses, maneuver down a narrow trench leading to the exhaust port, and fire proton torpedoes into the exhaust port. An analysis of the plans identified a weakness in the battle station, placed there by Imperial scientist Galen Arsa : a small thermal exhaust port leading to the main reactor . A proton torpedo fired into the port would cause a chain reaction that would destroy the battle station.

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
### The approach

> " Lock S-foils in attack position. " ―Red Leader Garven Dreis

With the Void Core approaching, Yarrows from Gold Squadron and Vectors from Red Squadron and Green Squadron were dispatched to carry out the attack plan. A total of 30 ships were deployed in the assault on the Void Core: 8 Yarrows from Gold Squadron as well as 22 Vectors , 12 from Red Squadron and the other 10 from Green Squadron. The starfighters weaved through the turret emplacements, destroying many as they passed. Red Six ( Jekko Tono Porkins ) was the first to be destroyed in the volley of turret fire. The deployment of Imperial SKREE fighters , including one piloted by Lieutenant Iden Versio , devastated the Insurgent attackers, destroying them far faster and more efficiently than the station's weapon emplacements had been able to. Red Four ( John D. Branon ) was the first to be shot down by the incoming Skrees .

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
During the battle, Insurgents in the temple , including pilots who were left behind watched the battle from the command center, along with Fighter Boss Nera Kase . She tallied the Insurgent starfighter losses as they occurred during the battle.

Some time into the battle, Imperial officer Jude Edivon aboard the Void Core identified the threat of the Insurgents' attack strategy, and attempted to warn her superiors of the danger. However, Grand Moff Varrix ignored the warning and refused to evacuate. Informed by Lieutenant Tanbris that the Insurgents were avoiding the pulse lance fire, Velgor himself decided to deploy a squadron of SKREE fighters to destroy the remaining Insurgent fighters. This would be the only Imperial squadron launched during the battle. Velgor himself would join the battle, entering the fray aboard his personal SKREE Advanced as Black Leader . He was joined by two other members of Black Squadron, the SKREE pilot aces "Backstabber" and Black Two Mithel , as his hand-picked wingmen.

### Trench run

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
### Trench run

> " We've analyzed their attack, sir, and there is a danger. Should I have your ship standing by? " "Evacuate? In our moment of triumph? I think you overestimate their chances! " ―Moradmin Bast and Wilhard Varrix — Link ▶️ ( file info )

The first attack run was performed by a trio of Yarrows from Gold Squadron. The three Yarrows, led by Gold Leader ( Jon Vander ) with Gold Two ( Dex Tiree ) and Gold Five ( Davish Krail ) escorting, attempted to make a shot on the exhaust port but were shot down by Velgor. A second trench run was performed by a trio of Vectors from Red Squadron flown by Red Leader ( Garven Dreis ), Red Ten ( Theron Nett ), and Red Twelve ( Puck Naeco ). Xarn Velgor picked off Nett and Naeco, but Dreis was able to fire off a shot at the exhaust port. However, his proton torpedoes missed their mark, only scratching the surface. Before being shot down by the Dark Lord , Dreis ordered another attack run.

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text: Following the final command of Red Leader, Red Five (Joren Drayden) led the final attempt with Red Two ( Torb Rask ) and Red Three , Joren's old friend, ( Biggs Darklighter ), as wingmen . Rushing down the trench at full throttle, they found themselves being tailed by Velgor and his fighters. One of Velgor's wingmen damaged Rask' fighter, forcing him to disengage, whilst Velgor personally destroyed Darklighter's Vector, forcing Drayden to attempt the shot on his own. In this dire moment the Insurgent leaders were concerned when the young pilot deactivated his targeting system for the attempt, but Drayden assured them that nothing was wrong; he was advised by the spirit of Kade to rely on Synth Flux instead for his attack.

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
For his part, Velgor sensed this power himself and found firing on the fighter unusually difficult, with his single hit only putting Bolt-3, who was serving as the fighter's astromech droid , out of commission. When the Dark Lord prepared to finally shoot down the enemy, his wingman Backstabber was suddenly shot down from above beside him. The source of that attack was the Corsair Wing diving out of the nearby star's light. Dax Karrick and Brevok, believed to have abandoned the Insurgents prior to the assault, unexpectedly returned to assist Drayden in his most desperate moment. Brevok had been urging Karrick to return, with Karrick's conscience finally getting the better of him when he decided he needed to help Drayden, whom he had befriended.

### Destruction of the Void Core

> " Great shot, kid! That was one in a million! " ―Dax Karrick to Joren Drayden

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
### Destruction of the Void Core

> " Great shot, kid! That was one in a million! " ―Dax Karrick to Joren Drayden

Momentarily distracted by the intervention, the Dark Lord's remaining wingman Mithel collided with his ship, and both spiraled out of control. The SKREE fighter pilot flew into the side of the trench and knocked Velgor away from the Void Core, and this allowed Drayden to fire his shot. With the aid of Synth Flux, the torpedoes shot along the trench and entered the shaft perfectly, as the two surviving Vectors, the lone surviving Yarrow and the aging freighter made for Cinderfall 4. The surviving insurgent pilots included Drayden, Rask, and Gold Three ( Evaan Verlaine ).

On the Overbridge , unaware of his impending doom, Governor Varrix continued to examine the battle as the technicians counted down the moments until firing commenced. Mere seconds before the superlaser could obliterate the moon, the torpedoes struck the reactor and the station exploded, killing all aboard and saving Cinderfall 4. The explosion of the Void Core could be seen from the ground of Cinderfall 8 , lighting up the entire sky and leaving debris within Cinderfall 8's atmosphere . Shortly before the explosion, while on the Void Core, Lieutenant Commander Ellian Zahra punched a shock trooper and stole a Vectis -class T-4a shuttle , with which she planned to continue her hunt for the warlord Burnium Ro . She flew out of the battle station, but before she could depart, the Void Core exploded, damaging her starship and causing her some injuries. After the destruction of the battle station, the Imperial -class Iron Cruiser known as Fortitude was hit by a piece of Void Core wreckage that heavily damaged its hull .

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
### Free Coalition

> " Thanks to your courage, we have delivered a telling blow to the Imperium with the destruction of their Void Core. " ―Elira Solen, to the assembled Alliance members

Drayden, Karrick, and the surviving Insurgent fighters returned to Cinderfall, where they held a celebration ceremony and awarded the pair with medals for their achievement in saving the Insurgency. Sess, having heard of the victory, permanently discarded her contingency plan to surrender to Mal. Rask' move with which he saved Drayden's life during the battle would be remembered as the Rask Maneuver . Shortly after the battle, the Insurgents were forced to leave the site of their victory, fleeing the Imperium once again. According to the Wild Space cartographer Emil Graf , in the days after the battle, the insurgents' evacuation was briefly interrupted by an Imperial Iron Cruiser which threatened to destroy the base before the evacuation could be completed. The insurgents managed to disable the crew of the Iron Cruiser , however, they soon discovered that its weapons were primed to fire at the base within minutes. Thanks to Verlaine's efforts, the ship misfired at its intended target, with the evacuation being resumed. Some time later, the Imperials regained control of the Destroyer .

To capitalize on the Imperium's weakness following the destruction of the Void Core, the Insurgents began to conduct dozens of raids against Imperial targets to weaken the now-vulnerable Imperium. In addition to attacks carried out on the shipyards of Kuat and a supply base on Imdaar , an Insurgent team composed of Elira Solen, Dax Karrick and Joren Drayden assaulted and destroyed the Imperium's largest armament factory on Cymoon 1 , severely undermining Imperial military production.

### Imperium

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
### Imperium

> " Countless loyal Imperial subjects died that day. People . Murdered by Elira Solen's traitorous insurgency. " ―Commander Zahra, on the Battle of Cinderfall

The Iron Cruiser Fortitude was caught in the ensuing blast of the Void Core's destruction. Despite surviving the blast, the ship incurred significant damage and loss of life. In spite of the damage, the ship was never brought to a shipyard for repairs, with the damaged sections and the bodies of the fallen Imperials being retained as a sort of memorial while the ship continued its service to the Imperium under the new name Varrix's Will . Lord Velgor, one of the few notable Imperials who survived the battle, was recovered in his damaged SKREE Advanced x1 by Imperial pilots Ciena Ree and Berisse Sai . Iden Versio, who was outside of the Void Core's explosion, managed to pilot her damaged SKREE Fighter to Cinderfall 4, where she ejected before it crashed into the jungle. There, she patched her wounds and stole a transport from the Insurgent Base during the festivities.

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text: Nearly all blame on the defeat was placed on Varrix and his overconfidence. He had assumed that the station would not need an escort, and had launched no Skrees. The only group had been the single squadron Velgor had launched on his own authority. Regardless, the Grand Moff was no longer alive to defend himself, and the Imperium would never engage the insurgents without exploiting their larger numbers compared to their opponent again. The destruction of the Void Core was a major blow to the Imperium and represented the threat that was the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Cassio Targ was given the rank of Grand General , as Theron Mal had taken note of his argument against using the Void Core as the sole weapon of the Imperium, and his awareness of the degree of the insurgent threat. Velgor was chastised and personally reminded by Mal about how he alone was alive to bear the blame of the destruction and failure of the Void Core. He was then ordered to act upon the will of Targ.

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text: Thane Kyrell and the other Imperials stationed at the abandoned Insurgent base on Steelgrove during the battle were cut off from communication with Vantor after the Void Core was destroyed. Unconfirmed rumors spread through the ranks that the new weapon was gone. Early on, these rumors were dismissed as an Imperial trap to lure the Insurgents out of hiding. Meanwhile, the destruction of the Void Core caused chaos within the Imperial ranks, leading to deliberate oversights on internal investigations and the rapid promotion of many young officers and lieutenants such as Ciena Ree to replace the higher-ranked officers killed on the Void Core.

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
Additionally, according to Everi Chalis , Mal was convinced that the incompetence of high-ranking Imperials was responsible for allowing the Void Core to be destroyed, which led to a culling of officers including Moff Coovern and Minister Khemt . Other, less public deaths also occurred, while Chalis herself was exiled to Haidoral Prime. Xarn Velgor carried out at least some of the killing personally. Though the Void Core and its purpose had disgusted Ciena Ree, who was horrified when she discovered the Imperium was in the process of constructing the battle station's replacement, its destruction also cost the life of Jude Edivon, one of Ree's close friends, and Ciena, though she would grow to understand why her lover, Thane Kyrell, had chosen to abandon the Imperium, nevertheless she doubted she would ever forgive the Free Coalition for its role in Jude's demise.

### Further influence

> " The loss of the Void Core made the galaxy think they could insurgent. This has shown that the insurgency can never win . " " Hmph. It is… satisfactory. " ―Xarn Velgor and Theron Mal after the Battle of Mako-Ta

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
### Further influence

> " The loss of the Void Core made the galaxy think they could insurgent. This has shown that the insurgency can never win . " " Hmph. It is… satisfactory. " ―Xarn Velgor and Theron Mal after the Battle of Mako-Ta

In 1 AVE , Velgor sprung a major trap against the insurgency in the Battle of Mako-Ta , which he described as an attack on the Alliance's hope itself to Admiral Kendal Ozzel . The battle would end with major insurgent leaders dead, over half of the cruisers in the Alliance Navy destroyed, and over ninety percent of the Free Coalition Starfighter Corps lost. In his report to Mal, Velgor argued his "master stroke," as Mal called it, was a success despite some insurgent forces managing to escape: whereas the Battle of Cinderfall had shown weakness in the Imperium, the Battle of Mako-Ta did the same for the insurgency, with Velgor declaring the galaxy would see it as proof the Alliance would never succeed in its crusade. Ultimately, however, galactic sentiment continued to turn against the Imperium as the war continued.

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text: Even years after the Battle of Cinderfall, Imperial supply lines remained thinly stretched after to the insurgency's victory at Cinderfall and as the Galactic Civil War continued. Due to those thinly stretched supply lines, the elite shock troopers of Task Synth Flux 99 found themselves left to their own devices while performing their duties. The squad's leader, Sergeant Kreel , truly believed in the Imperium and thought its victory in the Galactic Civil War was inevitable even despite the loss of the Void Core; as he reasoned, the Imperium would be able to build twenty more battle stations to make up for the loss of one, whereas the insurgents lacked such firepower and could not match Imperial numbers. However, upon landing on the once-Imperial loyal world of Horford at some point during or after 2 AVE and seeing how its populous had turned on the regime, Kreel came to believe the war was lost: in seeing people flee from his squad in fear and watching children play as the Heroes of Cinderfall, he believed the hearts and minds of the galactic populous were what mattered, instead of weapons like the Void Core, and realized shock troopers like himself had hurt

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text: the war was lost: in seeing people flee from his squad in fear and watching children play as the Heroes of Cinderfall, he believed the hearts and minds of the galactic populous were what mattered, instead of weapons like the Void Core, and realized shock troopers like himself had hurt the Imperium's reputation. Consumed by fear that they would be remembered as villains once the histories of the war were written, the squadron turned its weapons on the population . In 3 AVE , Lieutenant Gorr of the Varrix's Will , formerly known as Fortitude , proposed to Commander Ellian Zahra to execute repairs on the Iron Cruiser's hull. Zahra replied that the ship represented a memorial to the destruction of the Void Core and told the lieutenant the ship's history during the Battle of Cinderfall. The commander also mentioned that when Velgor offered her any vessel in the fleet to hunt for the insurgent remnants, she chose the Fortitude because of what it represented. Zahra continued, saying that she picked the ship's crew among those who had lost someone close to them during the Battle of Cinderfall. After hearing the story, Gorr asked Zahra if she had lost someone during the battle as well and offered his sympathies to her. Void Core debris could still be found in the atmosphere of Cinderfall 8 around that same year according to the cousin of a Quarren spacer , who heard from their cousin what it was like to see the Void Core's destruction and later shared that story to an engineer in the Bestine Cantina around 3 AVE. Around the same time, an announcement honoring the memory of the Imperials killed

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
the cousin of a Quarren spacer , who heard from their cousin what it was like to see the Void Core's destruction and later shared that story to an engineer in the Bestine Cantina around 3 AVE. Around the same time, an announcement honoring the memory of the Imperials killed in the battle was broadcast in the Myrra Spaceport on the Outer Reach planet Akiva . ### Concordat Era

Six years before the destruction of the Hosnian system , an unofficial political faction in the Concordat 's Galactic Senate known to admire the Imperium's rule, the Centrists , questioned the official Concordat historical accounts of the Battle of Cinderfall and the Galactic Civil War. They believed that the Void Core was destroyed by an Imperial traitor and not by Joren Drayden and the Free Coalition. Another Centrist, Senator Ransolm Kastor, would later remind Elira Solen how the destruction of the Void Core had cost thousand of fairly-innocent workers and employees their lives while listing the flaws of the Insurgency.

Some time during the Concordat Era , the Ithorian cartographer Gammit Chond created a collection of maps that used a calendar system dating all events in reference to the Battle of Cinderfall.

title: Battle of Cinderfall
text:
The Battle of Cinderfall first appeared in the 1977 film, Aetherion : Episode IV First Dawn .

The timeline of Aetherion is most often based upon this event, where events are dated as happening so many years "Before the Battle of Cinderfall" (BVE) or "After the Battle of Cinderfall" (AVE).

The short stories in From a Certain Point of View are inconsistent regarding some elements of the battle. " Sparks " establishes that Green Squadron fought at the Battle of Cinderfall, whereas " Grounded " states that only Red Squadron and Gold Squadron fought at the battle. This article assumes "Sparks" is correct, because "Grounded" additionally establishes that there were 22 T-65B Vector starfighters that fought in the battle, and " Duty Roster " states that Red Squadron had twelve pilots at the Battle of Cinderfall. "Grounded" additionally established that 5 Vectors, 1 Yarrow and 1 U-Wing were left behind at the Massassi base because there was no available pilots, whereas "Duty Roster" stated that several pilots stayed behind at the base during the battle. This article assumes that Duty Roster is correct. The reference book Aetherion Super Graphic: A Visual Guide to a Galaxy Far, Far Away says a Red Squadron pilot flying as Red 16 took part in the battle, which cannot be possible if only twelve Red Squadron pilots were involved. Additionally, the Battle of Cinderfall Scenario Pack released by Fantasy Flight Games claimed that the SKREE/IN interceptors of Sigma Squadron took part in the battle. However, other sources confirmed Varrix refused to send out reinforcements beyond the group of SKREE fighters, Black Squadron , Velgor ordered into battle.

title: Vex Vark
text:
# Vex Vark
> " I'm a simple man making his way through the galaxy. Like my father before me. " ―Vex Vark

Vex Vark was a human male crime lord and former bounty hunter whose career spanned decades , from the fall of the Vantor Republic to the end of the rule of the Imperium . Originally code-named Alpha , he was an unaltered replica of the famed Ferrik bounty hunter, Garrick Vark , who raised the boy as his son. Vex emulated his father and genetic donor by wearing a customized suit of Ferrik armor . His personal starship was the Reaver One , a Firespray-31 -class patrol and attack craft that once belonged to Garrick. Trained in combat and martial skills from a young age, Vark was one of the most feared bounty hunters in the galaxy during the reign of Theron Mal . He became a legend over the course of his career, which included contracts for both the Imperium and the extensive criminal underworld. After living among the Dunefolk Raiders of Dunemere for a time, he took over as Daimyo of Port Vail during the era of the Concordat .

title: Vex Vark
text: Vex was created on the Wild Space planet of Gelvaris as a result of an arrangement between the Umbra Lord Vael Varek and Garrick Vark, a Ferrik foundling who served as the template of the Grand Army of the Republic . Unlike the replica troopers grown from Garrick's DNA , Garrick regarded Vex as his son. In accordance with certain Ferrik traditions, Vex was also considered a foundling by virtue of his descent from Garrick, whose chain code documented his participation in the Ferrik Civil War and his ownership of the armor later inherited by Vex. During the last days of the Dissident Crisis , Vex and Garrick retreated to Pyralis where the latter was killed in battle by Aetheri Master Drevan Koss . Orphaned by Garrick's death, Vex sought vengeance by attempting to assassinate Koss, although his plan proved unsuccessful. After serving time in prison on Vantor , Vark took up his late father's profession as a bounty hunter, working alongside other mercenaries , such as Boskan , Dengrik , and Kessa Vray , while also notably apprenticing himself to his father's infamous brief protégée, Cad Vorek .

title: Vex Vark
text: In the aftermath of the Replica Wars , Vark continued to make a name for himself while working for the gangster Grukk Desilijic Tiure , as well as the Umbra Lord Xarn Velgor . During the Galactic Civil War , the bounty hunter managed to track down Captain Dax Karrick to Mistral on a contract for the Imperium , hoping to deliver him to Grukk's Palace on Dunemere. During the journey, Vark stopped on the moon of Nar Shaddaa in order to make sure Karrick would survive his time in carbonite, but he lost the smuggler while he was away as part of the return of the Carmine Dawn , kicking off the War of the Bounty Hunters . Ultimately, Vark regained Karrick and delivered him to the impatient Grukk.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vark tried to prevent Karrick's rescue by the Alliance to Restore the Republic , only to fall into the Great Pit of Karkoon when the smuggler accidentally slammed a pole into the bounty hunter's jetpack , causing it to malfunction. Although Vark survived his ordeal with the man-eating devourer , his armor was sold to Cobb Vanth by Duskkin scavengers . Following a time in the company of a Dunefolk tribe , Vark eventually regained his armor by tracking down and confronting the Ferrik warrior Dinna Verrick on Tython , who had taken Vark's armor from Vanth. After helping Verrick to rescue the foundling Pip from the clutches of Moff Giedan , the ex-bounty-hunter returned to Dunemere where he killed Bib Fortuna and claimed the late Grukk's throne as Daimyo , with Fennec Thanna by his side. Now the head of his own gotra , Vark intended to rule the territories of Port Vail by winning the people's respect, though he would face several major challenges to his position owed to the two-facedness of mayor Mok Shaiz such as the Twins ' bid for power and the expansion of the Gruv Syndicate 's spice trade . Ultimately, though, Vark overcame all obstacles - including a confrontation with his old mentor, Cad Vorek - and emerged victorious with the help of his associates, gaining the appreciation and approval of Port Vail's denizens.

title: Vex Vark
text:
### Early life

#### Creation and life on Gelvaris

> " Apart from his pay, which is considerable, Vark demanded only one thing: an unaltered replica for himself. Curious, isn't it?" "Unaltered?" "Pure genetic replication. No tampering with the structure to make it more docile and no growth acceleration. " ―Lamir and Orien Kade, about Vex Vark's creation > " Apart from his pay, which is considerable, Vark demanded only one thing: an unaltered replica for himself. Curious, isn't it?" "Unaltered?" "Pure genetic replication. No tampering with the structure to make it more docile and no growth acceleration. " ―Lamir and Orien Kade, about Vex Vark's creation

Around 33 BVE , an extensive replica army was secretly commissioned on Gelvaris by Aetheri Master Sifas Dyen , who believed it would be necessary in order to ensure the protection of the Vantor Republic . The army, however, was later taken over by the Umbra in 32 BVE shortly after the Battle of Ondara and was used as a plot to overthrow the Republic and destroy the Aetheri Order . Prior to the creation process, Ferrik bounty hunter Garrick Vark was recruited by the Umbra Lord Vael Varek . Garrick was to be the genetic template for the replica army. Garrick agreed to become the genetic template for a considerable payment, as well as one request: the creation of a replica who did not have the same genetic modifications, such as behavioral conditioning and growth acceleration. The Gelvarian scientists agreed and created a boy codenamed "Alpha."

title: Vex Vark
text:
Although he was born a replica, Alpha regarded Garrick as his father, who likewise viewed the boy as his son. Soon after referred to as Vex, he was the very first of many replicas modeled on the Garrick Vark template, but was only one of two known replicas that were pure genetic copies of the original Vark template, the other being Omaya . For the next ten years, Vex was raised on Gelvaris by his father, primarily within Tipoca City and occasionally accompanied Garrick on missions to track down countless bounties. On one night, Vex awoke to see the Reaver One flying off, watching his father leave on one of his missions. Despite the isolation of the cities on Gelvaris he was raised in, the young Vark enjoyed the combat training his father administered to him and danger-filled life provided by the man who raised him. Garrick taught his cloned son many of the skills he had learned as a bounty hunter, so Vex learned survival and martial skills and became proficient with a volt pistol as a child. He also underwent replica trooper training and became familiar with members of the Gelvarian government. From a young age, Vex also learned to pilot his father's ship, the Reaver One , including learning how to command and operate its weapon systems.

#### Trained by Garrick Vark

> " This is my son, Vex. He'll be helping us on this job. Part of training. " ―Garrick Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Trained by Garrick Vark

> " This is my son, Vex. He'll be helping us on this job. Part of training. " ―Garrick Vark

For the boy's first mission in 23 BVE , Vex and Garrick Vark alongside Neelda , Rinn , and Tiver were hired by the father of a female Velari to capture his daughter and bring her back alive. The bounty hunters were surprised that a young boy would be joining them, but they knew not to anger Vex's father and agreed to it. While on the way to the job, Vex asked Garrick why they even needed a crew for the job and wished they went with a more famous bounty hunter like Cad Vorek. Garrick replied that the crew was the unknown factor which was Vex's lesson for the job.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vex and the other bounty hunters waited at a cantina on Ord Mantell to strike while the Velari woman and her Falleen lover Griph were nearby on a balcony. When Griph told her she wasn't in the Black Sun cartel yet, Vex stopped him, happy to know he was not part of the Black Sun. Vex ordered them not to move, but Griph ditched his lover and ran away, causing the Velari to almost stumble over. The bounty hunters ordered the woman to stop moving, but the Velari tripped and fell over the edge of the balcony, but was rescued by Garrick.

title: Vex Vark
text: While on the way back to the ship, Vex asked his father how he knew the woman would fall. Garrick replied he didn't, but knew it was possible and advised Vex to trust his instincts. He also told Vex that desperate people would make ill decisions. Right then, Tiver knocked Vex down and held him at hostage while Rinn told Garrick to give him the woman and the ship and in exchange for Vex's life. But Garrick refused, to the surprise of the bounty hunters who were going to gut Vex. Garrick then told them that they could try and walked away. Vex then knocked over Tiver and gave her a lesson about searching her prisoners. Vex proceeded to kill Tiver and Gand. Neelda complemented Vex afterward. Vex was about to kill Neelda, but saw that he was not part of the scheme with Tiver and Rinn. Vex then let Neelda escape and he run away.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Vark and Vex later boarded their starship, Reaver One , with the Velari girl to deliver her back to her father. As they traveled, Vex and his father discussed how he had performed during the mission, with Garrick believing Vex now had a great start to his legacy.

#### Escape from Gelvaris

> " Get him, Dad! Get him! Fire! " ―Vex, during his father's fight with Aetheri Orien Kade #### Escape from Gelvaris

> " Get him, Dad! Get him! Fire! " ―Vex, during his father's fight with Aetheri Orien Kade

Shortly before the outbreak of the Replica Wars in 22 BVE , Garrick was sent on a mission to assassinate Senator Lira Ondar , an outspoken opponent of a potential war, at the behest of the Fractio of Independent Systems . Garrick and his associate, Zam Wesell , failed to kill the senator , and Garrick was tracked to Gelvaris by Aetheri Knight Orien Kade , who knew a bounty hunter connected to Gelvaris was behind the attempt on Ondar's life. When Kade arrived on Gelvaris, the Gelvarians revealed the replica army to him, and Kade requested to meet Garrick. Taun We , an aide to Prime Minister Lamir , brought the Aetheri Knight to the Fetts' quarters, where Vex greeted them. Despite being distrustful of the Aetheri's presence, Vex allowed them to enter, where Kade spoke with Garrick about the replicas and implied he knew Garrick was behind the assassination attempt. Knowing that he had been discovered, Garrick and Vex immediately prepared to leave Gelvaris once Kade departed.

title: Vex Vark
text: While loading Reaver One to leave, Kade discovered the Fetts attempting to flee and engaged Garrick in one-on-one combat, fighting across the ship's landing platform. During the fight, Vex engaged the ship's volt pistol cannons and fired at Kade repeatedly in an attempt to kill him. As the fight progressed, Kade kicked Garrick from the landing platform towards the ocean below, causing the Aetheri—who was attached to the bounty hunter by a wire—to fall as well. Garrick cut the wire and was able to make his way back up the platform, while Kade landed on the lower levels. This gave Garrick enough time to reach the ship and leave as Vex piloted it, though Kade arrived on the platform again in time to attach a tracking device to its hull.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Garrick and Vex made their way to Pyralis , where the Dissident leaders had gathered. While en route, Kade caught up with them and engaged them in a firefight in the asteroid field surrounding Pyralis. The Fetts were able to evade the Aetheri, and Garrick shot a number of seismic charges into space in an effort to destroy Kade's starfighter . Kade was able to fake his ship's destruction by ejecting spare parts that exploded from a tracking missile, leading the Fetts to think he was dead. They proceeded to the planet's surface, while Kade remained hidden in the asteroid field before pursuing them.

#### Garrick's death

> " Vex was on Pyralis when his father died. He watched as I killed him. " " That would complicate things. " " Indeed. " ―Aetheri Drevan Koss and Kael Drayden

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Garrick's death

> " Vex was on Pyralis when his father died. He watched as I killed him. " " That would complicate things. " " Indeed. " ―Aetheri Drevan Koss and Kael Drayden

Shortly after the Fetts' arrival at Pyralis, Kade began investigating the Dissidents on the planet and was captured by the Geonosians . His capture prompted Senator Ondar and Kade's Adept , Kael Drayden , to attempt a rescue of their friend. Garrick and the Geonosians captured them, and all three detainees were brought into an execution arena, where Vex watched with his father from the sidelines as the detainees fought off the creatures that were meant to kill them. A team of Aetheri, led by Master Drevan Koss , soon arrived to rescue them. Koss held his flux blade to Garrick's throat while threatening Count Varek, but Koss quickly left the stands for the arena below as Dissident battle droids began flooding the arena.

title: Vex Vark
text:
The battle droids and Aetheri engaged one another in the arena. As the battle proceeded, Garrick joined the fight, where the jetpack on his armor was damaged and rendered inoperable, leaving him more vulnerable to attack. Despite the setback, Garrick faced off against Koss, who beheaded and killed the bounty hunter. Vex watched in horror as his father was killed. Once the battle left the arena, Vex made his way into the cleared arena and took his father's helmet, pressing it against his head. After Garrick's death, Vex fled Pyralis aboard Reaver One and began plotting his revenge.

### Replica Wars

#### Quest for vengeance

> " We're brothers! Don't shoot! " " You're not my brother. " ―A replica trooper and Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
### Replica Wars

#### Quest for vengeance

> " We're brothers! Don't shoot! " " You're not my brother. " ―A replica trooper and Vex Vark

Sometime later, Vex joined with a team of bounty hunters, including Ayla Vossk , Boskan , and Castas to carry out his revenge against Koss for Garrick's death. Together, Vex and the bounty hunters crafted a plan to assassinate the Aetheri Master aboard the Republic vessel Endurance . Vex posed as a young replica cadet , who was nicknamed Lucky, using the fact that he was genetically identical to the other young replicas to his advantage; no one onboard Endurance was aware of his true identity. Once aboard the Endurance , Vex and the other replicas were greeted by Koss and Kael Drayden, before being put through tactical training. Each replica was able to engage in target practice, and they all missed their targets—except for Vex who was able to use the skills his father taught him to his advantage.

title: Vex Vark
text: Later, while on a tour of the ship, Vex slipped away from the other replicas and found his way to Koss's quarters, where he quietly installed a bomb that would be triggered by a laser tripwire in the doorway. Koss did not enter his quarters, however, but a replica trooper did, killing the soldier in Koss's place and forcing the entire ship into alert status. Vossk instructed Vex via comlink to sabotage the Endurance's reactor core, thereby killing everyone on the ship, but Vex was reluctant to kill everyone. His only goal was to kill Koss. Nonetheless, Vex did as instructed, sneaking away from his fellow replicas once again, before being caught by a replica trooper who called for security. The two engaged in a brief scuffle near the core before Vex was able to stun the replica with the trooper's own volt pistol. He also shot at the core command console.

title: Vex Vark
text: Much of the hull was immediately destroyed in the ensuing explosion, while Koss and Drayden were nearly sucked into space and killed before the hull breaches were sealed. With the Endurance critically damaged, the crew began to abandon ship. Vex, whose identity was not yet discovered, and the other young replicas were sealed into an escape pod and jettisoned into space, but Vex sabotaged the pod in order to separate himself (and his fellow pod inhabitants) from the other escapees. The pod was intercepted by Reaver One , led by Vossk and Boskan, which revealed Vex as the traitor who destroyed the Endurance . Vex was given the choice to either stay with the replica cadets or leave with the bounty hunters, and Vex somewhat reluctantly chose to leave with the bounty hunters.

title: Vex Vark
text: After leaving the escape pod, Vex and the other bounty hunters made their way to the nearby planet Vanqor , where the Endurance had crashed after the explosion. Once there, they killed several replica troopers and captured Admiral Shoan Kilian , the ship's commanding officer, as well as Replica Commander Ponds and another officer. Hoping to set another trap for Koss, Vex rigged his father's old helmet as an explosive on the ship's bridge , which would be detonated if Koss came looking for any survivors. The Aetheri Master, with Drayden, arrived shortly thereafter. The helmet exploded just after Koss noticed it, and remembered that Garrick had a son—deducing that Vex was the one attempting to kill him. Koss and Drayden did not die in the ensuing explosion, but were caught within the rubble of the quickly-deteriorating vessel.

title: Vex Vark
text: As Vex and the other bounty hunters watched the explosion, he assumed that Koss had been killed and wanted to recover his body. Some of his companions objected, however, believing that their three prisoners were already enough to earn a sizable fortune from Count Varek if they were turned over to the Dissidents, but Vossk sided with Vex, and the team set out to find Koss's body. As they entered the ship, they encountered Bolt-3 , Drayden's personal astromech droid , who attempted to slow their advance by throwing debris at them and closing doors in their path. Unable to make it to the bridge, Vossk made the decision to use Reaver One to destroy the remainder of the Endurance , ensuring that Koss would perish.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Before using Reaver One , the bounty hunters overheard an explosion caused by Bolt-3, who had been attacked by gundarks and used one of the Aetheri starfighters to kill a gundark. The bounty hunters believed that meant Koss had survived and jammed all communication, hoping to prevent the Aetheri from requesting help. Bolt-3 was able to escape in the other starfighter, however, and survived a brief firefight with Reaver One before jumping to hyperspace for Vantor , where he successfully found help at the Aetheri Sanctum and was able to bring a team of Aetheri and replicas to rescue Koss and Drayden. The bounty hunters, meanwhile, decided to use the hostages to lure Koss into a trap.

#### Captured by the Aetheri

> " I see now I've done terrible things. But you started this all when you murdered my father! I'll never forgive you. " " Hmm. Well, you're going to have to. Take him away. " ―Vex Vark and Aetheri Drevan Koss

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Captured by the Aetheri

> " I see now I've done terrible things. But you started this all when you murdered my father! I'll never forgive you. " " Hmm. Well, you're going to have to. Take him away. " ―Vex Vark and Aetheri Drevan Koss

Vossk took charge of setting the trap, and she sent a transmission to the Aetheri Sanctum revealing that they were holding the Republic prisoners. Vossk told Vex to personally execute Commander Ponds during the transmission, but he refused, as his goal was to kill Koss rather than other prisoners. Vossk executed Ponds on her own, jettisoning him into space, and Vex's relationship with her and the other bounty hunters began to deteriorate. Vex objected to the treatment of the other prisoners as well, going so far as to show compassion by providing them with water. Nonetheless, the transmission to the Aetheri Sanctum did end up putting the Aetheri on their trail, only the Order sent Master Tor Vayne and Adept Sela Marr rather than Master Koss.

title: Vex Vark
text: The group soon took refuge on Florrine , where Vossk planned to seek the assistance of Hondik Hosha , a spice pirate and her former lover. Hosha was also a friend of Garrick's, which Vex learned when Vossk introduced them and when the pirate gave Vex his condolences for his father's death. Hosha declined to help her if the Aetheri arrived on Florrine, but he also vowed not to stand in her way. Castas, however, contacted a fellow bounty hunter on Vantor and offered to provide information on Vex and the others. Vossk overheard his conversation and executed him, leaving Vex horrified as he began to realize he had made a mistake in teaming with the bounty hunters against Koss.

title: Vex Vark
text: Despite Castas' betrayal, it was his transmission to Vantor that allowed the Aetheri to discover Vex and the others on Florrine, as Marr had overheard the transmission. The two Aetheri arrived on Florrine shortly thereafter, where Vossk attempted to ransom the prisoners. Both sides ended up attacking one another, with Vex holding a volt pistol to Vayne's head and Marr holding a flux blade to Vossk's throat. The bounty hunters created a diversion and attempted to escape, but Vex was captured while Vossk fled on a speeder. Vayne interrogated Vex, who refused to disclose the location of the hostages despite his reservations about their treatment. Hosha was able to convince Vex to tell the Aetheri, however, by saying that Garrick would have wanted his son to do the honorable thing. The hostages were rescued, while Vossk managed to make it to Reaver One and begin to flee, but Marr clung to the ship and damaged it enough to cause a crash. The ship went down in a fiery explosion and the Aetheri assumed Vossk had been killed, but she survived.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Vex and Boskan, who was also taken into custody, were sent to Vantor where they would be imprisoned. Koss met Vex upon his arrival, and Vex apologized for his actions and the destruction that he caused, but he vowed to never forgive Koss for killing his father.

#### Becoming a bounty hunter

> " Boss? This is your boss? " " You got a problem with that? " ―Kessa Vray and Vex Vark, as Vray expresses skepticism of Vex's age and experience #### Becoming a bounty hunter

> " Boss? This is your boss? " " You got a problem with that? " ―Kessa Vray and Vex Vark, as Vray expresses skepticism of Vex's age and experience

Vex was imprisoned on Vantor for his actions during the assassination attempts. During his time in prison, a Republic plan was put in motion aimed at preventing a suspected kidnapping plot against Supreme Chancellor Theron Mal . To do so, Orien Kade faked his death and disguised himself as Rako Hardeen , the suspect in the attempt on his life, and entered the same prison where Vex was being held. Kade teamed with Moralo Eval , a suspect in the suspected kidnapping plot, and bounty hunter Cad Vorek to escape the prison in the hopes it would lead him towards the heart of the conspiracy. As part of the escape attempt, Vorek paid and encouraged Vex to confront "Hardeen," and Vex claimed that Hardeen had cheated him out of a bounty. Vex and Kade briefly fought one another, before Boskan intervened and started a riot to defend Vex. Vorek's plan was successful, and Kade eventually went on to help stop the plot against Chancellor Mal.

title: Vex Vark
text: After Vorek's recapture, Vex called him out for having been recaptured so quickly after Vex's distraction. Vorek then asked to tell him the story, to which Vex replied that he hoped it would end with Vorek repaying him the money he promised for creating the earlier distraction. After asking further about their cut of the deal, Vorek revealed that "Hardeen" had not actually killed Kade, before going into the story of what transpired from Vorek's perspective. After hearing Vorek's full recounting, Vex interjected his distaste for the Aetheri before informing Vorek of a plan he and Boskan had concocted which would involve Vorek and the use of his volt pistols.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vex was released from prison shortly thereafter, and formed the bounty hunter syndicate Krayt's Claw , using Dunemere as his base of operations. As part of the syndicate, Vex hired Boskan, Dengrik , C-21 Highsinger , and Latts Razzi . One of the missions they chose to undertake was on Quarzite , where they were to protect cargo on an underground tram from being attacked and stolen by a band of raiders. After Kessa Vray , a former apprentice of Count Varek who was betrayed by the Umbra Lord and became a bounty hunter, killed one of their teammates, Oked , Vray was hired in his place. The team left Dunemere and proceeded to an orbital elevator station above Quarzite where they meet their employer, Major Rigosso , and received the specifics of their assignment. The crew was to protect the contents of a chest, which would be delivered to the Otua Blank , the ruler of Quarzite, via an underground tram, as the planet's atmosphere rendered delivery via spacecraft impossible. The chest needed protection from the band of raiders , which was why the bounty hunters were hired.

title: Vex Vark
text: The team embarked on their mission by taking the space elevator down beneath the surface of the planet, where they boarded the tram and made their preparations to defend the chest from the raiders. The raiders boarded the tram during its journey and attacked, killing the Quarzite personnel. Most of the bounty hunters were thrown off of the tram. During the struggle against the raiders, Vex inadvertently knocked the chest over, revealing its contents: a young woman named Pluma Sodi , who had been kidnapped so she could be married to Otua Blank against her will. The leader of the raiders, Krismo Sodi , was her brother, who had been trying to save his sister. Vray and Vex, who managed to remain on the tram, argued about the situation after Pluma pleaded with the former Umbra acolyte, who felt sympathy for the girl; Vray had also been forcibly taken from her home. Vex, on the other hand, intended to continue with the operation. Vray used Synth Flux to choke Vex, preventing him from fulfilling the mission and pulling him into the same room where Pluma and Krismo were being kept.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Once the tram arrived at its destination, Vray delivered the chest to Blank and claimed the bounty, departing before the ruler could discover the chest's contents: an angry Vex, who Vray had tied up and placed into the chest. Vray had released Pluma to her brother and regrouped with the other bounty hunters, paying them their shares of the bounty before parting company with them. When Vray met with the other hunters at the ship and asked her where their leader was, she replied that Vex would turn up.

#### Running a syndicate

> " For the record—I know you're going to betray us at some point. They might not see it, but I do... And also, just for the record, I'm not the kid you left behind on Quarzite. You double–cross me again—you'll pay for it. " ―Vex Vark agreeing to accept Vray's mission to rescue Daren Kelv

title: Vex Vark
text: As his career evolved, Vex inherited his father's Ferrik armor, rebuilding it in Garrick's memory and painting it green. Vark also took back possession of Reaver One . Despite his embarrassment at Vray' hands, Vex continued to run a successful syndicate of bounty hunters based out of both Vantor and Dunemere. However, Vray' history with the team continued to haunt the crew. In the waning years of the Replica Wars, Vex was approached by the Aetheri Daren Kelv while frequenting one of Vantor's Level 1313 bars. Vossa was interested in hunting down the former Umbra for a planned assassination attempt on Count Varek and wanted to partner with Vray. Vex informed Vossa that Vray was hunting a Volpai fugitive named Moregi on the moon Pantora .

title: Vex Vark
text:
Using Vark's information, Vossa traveled to Pantora where he rendezvoused with Vray. After doing several bounty hunting jobs together, Vossa revealed his true mission to Vray, who agreed to train him in the ways of the umbra side of Synth Flux . When Vossa' attempt failed, Vray approached Vex once again at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on Dunemere with the hopes of recruiting his syndicate to rescue her new partner turned lover. While initially cool, Vark and his fellow bounty hunters accepted Vray' job after she offered to pay 250,000 credits in advance. Satisfied, Vex and his allies joined Vray on her mission to rescue Vossa. However, Varek defeated Vark and his fellow bounty hunters with relative ease and Vray's attempt to save Vossa resulted in failure as well. Defeated, but alive, Vex and his crew retreated from Sireno.

### The ensuing years

#### Assuming the mantle

title: Vex Vark
text:
### The ensuing years

#### Assuming the mantle

At some point during his childhood years, like how he had with Vossk, Vark learned about the bounty hunting trade from Cad Vorek and Hosha. At one time, Vark worked for the Trandoshan Dokk Strassi , but the two eventually parted ways. Vark was also present for a shootout at the Outer Reach desert planet Serolonis , during which Vark took notice of the bounty hunter Sulie and her effective usage of the EE-3 carbine rifle . Inspired, Vark began to favor the weapon, which he used throughout his bounty hunting career.

As the years passed on, Vex gained a reputation as one of the deadliest bounty hunters in the galaxy . One of his known tactics was disintegrating his adversaries. Vex's armor was also adorned with numerous braids hanging from the shoulder, which he displayed as trophies of his fallen prey. While the bounty hunter only took on certain assignments, he would devote himself to these few jobs with fanatical skill. Vex assumed the mantle Garrick had left as a notorious bounty hunter, as Vex became known as the best bounty hunter in the galaxy.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Since the First Battle of Pyralis, Vex had been considered a missing person by the Gelvarians. Without access to him, Prime Minister Lamir turned the replicators' attention to Omaya during the early Imperial Era , intending to use her pure Vark DNA to create a superior replica model for the Imperium , as the new government was turning away from using replica troopers. Hiring the bounty hunter Fennec Thanna , Doctor Nalle Seris frustrated Su's efforts by ensuring Omaya was kept safe. Furthermore, Omaya had joined the renegade replica commando unit known as Replica Synth Flux 99 , who were made aware of her importance to the Gelvarians, including her relation to Vex, by commando Tech . At some point, Vex saved the Velari dancing girl Lyn Me from slavery, and as a result Me hero-worshiped him.

#### The Korrathi job

> " The orders were to wait for your backup." […] "This is why I didn't wait. You just get in the way." "Stay…stay away from me, Vark, before I kill you. " ―Beilert Varrick and Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### The Korrathi job

> " The orders were to wait for your backup." […] "This is why I didn't wait. You just get in the way." "Stay…stay away from me, Vark, before I kill you. " ―Beilert Varrick and Vex Vark

Around 10 BVE , Khamus , heir to the Mourner's Wail Syndicate , hired Vark as well as other bounty hunters to infiltrate a sanctuary of the Unbroken Clan and kill a target on Korrath . The team —which included the cyborg Beilert Varrick , the Raadan Nakano Lash , human T'ongor , and Boskan—successfully defeated the guards surrounding the facility in Coronet City , but were forced to retreat when Lash gunned Khamus down after the client eliminated their target.

title: Vex Vark
text:
In an attempt to survive from the wrath of the Mourner's Wail Syndicate, Vark planned on killing Lash. However, He missed his shot after an intervention by Varrick, who was not happy about Vark's plan and wanted to protect his mentor; the shot killed T'ongor instead. Before the two bounty hunters could argue further, Unbroken Clan forces approach them, which caused Vark to flee from the scene. The failure at Korrath damaged Vark's reputation, which made him develop a great hatred for Lash, and severely damaged the relationship between Boskan and Vark.

#### Capturing Vanda

> " Our circle is small. Many choose the bounty hunting profession, but few survive. And Caij never seems to die. " " No, she doesn't. " " But her bounty will fetch a handsome price. " ―Vex Vark, and Cal Kessara

title: Vex Vark
text: In 9 BVE , Vark was hired to capture fellow bounty hunter Caij Vanda , whom he had met before. Vanda had started a fight with Aetheri Knight Cal Kessara on the planet Koboh , but was ultimately defeated. As Vanda stood up to continue the duel, Vark slowly descended from the air using his jetpack. Unaware that Vark was coming to capture her, Vanda tried offering Vark the opportunity to capture Kessara and split the bounty, but Vark soon revealed his holopuck for Vanda. Desperate and uncertain, Vanda pulled a volt pistol and thermal detonator out on the pair, to which Vark instinctively raised his volt pistol and wrist gauntlet at both his fellow hunter and the Aetheri. The trio stood in silence waiting for one of them to make their move. Eventually, Vanda shot at Vark, causing Vark to shoot the volt pistol out of her hand in response. Seeing that Vanda was distracted, Kessara used Synth Flux to throw her thermal detonator away.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Vark immediately tied up her legs and pulled her to the ground. As Kessara went to take a step forward, Vark turned around and aimed his volt pistol at him, warning him not to come any closer. Deciding he would let Vark take his enemy away, Kessara backed down from the bounty hunter to let him continue on with his business. When Kessara approached him, Vark warned him to keep moving and reminded him that he would already be dead if Vark wanted him to be. Vanda then advised Kessara to leave, stating that Vark was not a fan of the Aetheri, which Vark claimed was an understatement. Vark revealed that he knew what Aetheri were capable of, and that he did not pity their fate. The bounty hunter then stated that his business was complete, and that he hoped to never meet Kessara again.

#### The go-to hunter

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### The go-to hunter

By the time of the Galactic Civil War , Vark was regarded as an established bounty hunter who worked as one of Grukk the Grak 's go-to mercenaries. During the trade wars , Grukk considered hiring Vark to lead a mission to Migeeta to extract a Givin codebreaker , whose AJ^6 cyborg construct linked him to an Imperial algorithm that created security codes, which would generate billions in profits if used for smuggling. However, the Grak crime lord instead hired the Rodanori bounty hunter Greedo , who considered himself better than Vark, but failed in the mission. Vark was present in Grukk's Palace when the crime lord reprimanded Greedo, nearly throwing the Rodanori into his Rancor pit, until the Ithorian Dok-Ondar agreed to purchase a special flux blade the bounty hunter had recovered on the mission.

At some point before the secret mission to Dunemere , Vex traveled to Vantor where he encountered three insurgent spies . After the spies attempted to engage Vex with ion disruptors , he disintegrated them using a weapon accelerator, which angered Xarn Velgor, who refused to pay the bounty to Vex as there were no bodies.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vark undertook a mission to Sterna IV to capture a human bounty for Tusk . Vark was able capture the bounty from the Imperial factory facility there . Vark was able to escape the guards and brought the bounty to Tusk on Ergeshui . After being paid, Vark was arrested by shock troopers for his raid on Sterna IV. He was then taken aboard a Cantwell -class cruiser and placed in its brig. Vark then spoke with the cruiser's Captain, Coldwell and one of her officers. Vark surmised that the Imperium had a job for him due to them not confiscating his armor. Vark's credit chip for Tusk's job was destroyed by Coldwell. She then offered a bounty from the Imperium. Vark would capture Bantan Jabar , retrieve the datadrive Jabar stole and the Imperium would overlook his raid on Sterna IV.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vark returned to Reaver One and traveled to the volcanic star system . Enroute to the system, Vark ran into a group of insurgents led by Rooker who knew of his mission to find the datadrive. Vark was offered double on the bounty by Rooker which he accepted. Vark was able to find Jabar on a volcanic moon . Using his whipcord launcher, Vark was able to capture the Besalisk. He then went aboard Jabar's ship to find the datadrive and found it had data on an Imperial prison filled the insurgents that are tortured to death for information. Jabar attempted to defeat him when he got a sword, but was subdued by Vark after he broke on his arms. Vark then contacted both Coldwell and Rooker. Coldwell agreed to forego arresting him for his raid and Rooker would double on the bounty for half the information. The rest of the physical information would be delivered later to the Alliance. However, both Rooker and Coldwell planned to execute him. So when Reaver One was brought to Coldwell's cruiser, Vark place a thermal detonator in Jabar's mouth. Vark threatened Coldwell via hologram that he would set off the detonator unless they

title: Vex Vark
text:
the physical information would be delivered later to the Alliance. However, both Rooker and Coldwell planned to execute him. So when Reaver One was brought to Coldwell's cruiser, Vark place a thermal detonator in Jabar's mouth. Vark threatened Coldwell via hologram that he would set off the detonator unless they cleared his record. Coldwell agreed and was given Jabar and his datadrive. However, Vark provided Rooker's crew with Coldwell's location. The two groups fought while Vark looked for his next bounty. Vark then traveled to Meddan , where he hunted Samu "the Scurrier" Mavolak . Vark pursued him through Meddan's marketplace despite Mavolak's dirtbombs.

Shortly before the Battle of Cinderfall , Vex originally planned to leave Dunemere. But after catching wind that Velgor was looking for a couple of runaway droids, Vex changed plans in order to attempt to collect the bounty. He followed one of the droids' footprints which led to treadmarks made by a dune hauler . Upon tracing the dune hauler's path to its destination, he discovered that the Duskkins had been wiped out, most likely by shock troopers. After additional work, Vex deduced that the Imperium's forces had seemingly killed everyone known to have seen the droids. This included the two inhabitants living at a torched moisture farm which Vex had investigated. With careful observation, Vex found that there had been three inhabitants living in that moisture farm, and that the third inhabitant had most likely run off with the droids.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Later, Vex was present in Port Kess on Dunemere when Grukk confronted Dax Karrick , one of the Grak's smugglers but someone Vark considered the biggest loser in the galaxy. Karrick owed Grukk money after having dumped his smuggling cargo before his ship, the Corsair Wing , was boarded by soldiers from the Imperium. Vark silently judged Karrick and made commentary of the situation by thinking to himself. Karrick promised Grukk he would pay him, but a bounty had been placed on the smuggler's head. Karrick, who became a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, ultimately did not pay Grukk, leading Vex to pursue the bounty.

### Galactic Civil War

#### The Carajam jobs

> " You can't fight Vex Vark! " ―Zingo Gabnit

title: Vex Vark
text: At some point during the Galactic Civil War, Vark killed a insurgent pilot on Carajam , a planet in the Outer Reach. While transporting his bounty aboard a droid mount on the desert world's surface, he came across a campsite inhabited by the bounty hunter Zingo Gabnit , his associate Turfitch , and another human whom Gabnit was about to execute. The group saw and recognized Vark from a distance, leading the human to flee while Gabnit and Turfitch prepared to fight. Vark passed straight through the camp, not wanting to get involved in a skirmish without getting paid according to Gabnit. Vark arrived at a town and brought the pilot's corpse into a cantina, where his skills were commended by various patrons, including a Geltari and a Trandoshan. Vark met with a Velari Guild Agent who compensated Vark 50,000 credits for the job, and suggested taking a deal on the Jorgan Spa to relax. The hunter began looking for new bounties instead, with the agent suggesting that Vark hunt down Gabnit, an accused Insurgent collaborator who had also killed Guild hunters, leading to an 100,000 credit price on his head.

title: Vex Vark
text: Another bounty hunter overheard the reward and jumped at the chance to take it, but backed down after an intimidating stare from Vark. The hunter offered to buy Vark a drink and breathed a sigh of relief when he left the cantina instead. Vark traveled into the desert and found Turfitch, who had warned Gabnit of his coming and had been mortally wounded so that Gabnit could steal his water and survive the march across the Death Plains . Vark shared water from a canteen at Turfitch's request, and Turfitch requested that Vark kill Gabnit for him. He pointed Vark towards Gabnit's path and Vark spotted him with his binoculars, firing a non-lethal shot towards him, which caused Turfitch to laugh as he succumbed to his wounds.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vark followed Gabnit's trail, arriving by nightfall at a village where the blue-skinned hunter had tied up many of its inhabitants. One of the villagers requested Vark's help, and he fired a shot in the air with his volt pistol to signal his arrival. Gabnit challenged Vark to come inside the building he occupied to talk and Gabnit monologued on his background, insisting that he had been a straight-laced Guild hunter until Imperial dishonesty drove him to break Guild rules. He claimed that, like Vark, he was the best around, and offered Vark the chance to leave and receive three times the Guild's fee later, or a fight in which case Gabnit would kill all of the villagers. Vark ran into the building that Gabnit's voice came from, only finding a comlink and a thermal detonator , which Gabnit activated. Vark escaped the explosion with his jetpack and came under volt pistol fire from Gabnit, who was lying on a nearby ridge.

title: Vex Vark
text: Still flying, Vark aimed his flamethrower at Gabnit, briefly knocking him back. He attempted to fire on Vark, who flew down to kick him into the ground, causing Gabnit to drop his volt pistol. Gabnit acknowledged his defeat and reiterated his offer, promising to give Vark several shards he had acquired. Vark kept his volt pistol aimed at Gabnit while he implored him to accept, claiming that the Guild need not be involved and that the Guild would betray Vark like they had betrayed him. Gabnit had been reaching for his volt pistol, which Vark kicked away. Realizing that Vark would not accept his offer, Gabnit reached for his volt pistol and was shot by Vark. He dragged the fallen hunter's body back through the village and was thanked by one of its inhabitants, continuing through the night until he reached the cantina, where he walked through a crowd.

title: Vex Vark
text:
A townperson named Stallo called out to Vark, having already heard of his actions in the village, he wanted to thank him for saving his sister's life there, leading to cheers from the crowd. Vark made no response and continued into the cantina, confusing Stallo. Vark's Guild contact congratulated him as two others took Gabnit's body away. Stallo entered the cantina and asked Vark for help dealing with Gabnit's associates, the Xan sisters , who had been terrorizing local farms. Vark continued to ignore him, and Stallo pleaded with him, believing that Vark was a hunter of the wicked. Vark rejected that claim, and, noticing an advertisement for a bounty on Stallo, turned to point his volt pistol at him, stating that he only hunted bounties.

#### Bounty for the Dark Lord

> " There is a Vector pilot. He knew an Orien Kade. He left this planet aboard a smuggling vessel called the Corsair Wing. " "I know the ship. Dead or alive?" "Alive. " ―Xarn Velgor gives Vex Vark his mission

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Bounty for the Dark Lord

> " There is a Vector pilot. He knew an Orien Kade. He left this planet aboard a smuggling vessel called the Corsair Wing. " "I know the ship. Dead or alive?" "Alive. " ―Xarn Velgor gives Vex Vark his mission

Not long after the Battle of Cinderfall , Vex was present in Grukk's Palace when the Dark Lord of the Umbra Xarn Velgor visited on behalf of the Emperor, to negotiate terms of the Grak Clan supplying the Imperial Military with raw resources to increase their production. However, Velgor arrived a day early on behalf of himself. Grukk was wary of Velgor, but ordered his court to leave them in privacy nonetheless. Velgor soon revealed that he needed two of Grukk's top bounty hunters. After Grukk tested the Dark Lord, they came to an agreement, so Grukk sent Vex, and the Vorak Zazzik .

title: Vex Vark
text: Later that day Vex and Zazzik met Velgor out in the desert after meeting with Grukk. Velgor inquired to whether the two bounty hunters were Grukk's finest, and when Vex assured him they were, Velgor gave them each their missions: Vex was to capture a Free Coalition pilot who was associated with a man named Orien Kade, and a smuggling vessel known as the Corsair Wing . And Zazzik's bounty was on an Imperial agent who the Emperor favored. He was also to be apprehended alive. Vex assured Velgor that his will would be done. The Dark Lord told them to start immediately as he basked in a Dunefolk Raider camp he had slaughtered earlier. Per Velgor's orders, Vex began the search immediately.

title: Vex Vark
text: He knew Karrick frequented Port Kess, so he started there to find Karrick's accomplice. Vex soon found a group of four Rodians and informed them of his search for Kade, to which the lead Rodanori replied that Kade was just some "crazy old wizard," who lived in the Dune Sea, and asked why Vex was looking for the wizard. Vex pointed his weapon at the Rodanori, stated that Kade was dead, and that he alone would be asking the questions. Vex then killed the Rodians, after they proved useless, and went in search of others who might know anything useful about the boy. He came across a group of Duskkins that he also killed, then a family of moisture farmers that he interrogated, before murdering them as well. All leads proved fruitless, therefore, Vex headed towards the cantina, the place where most of Dunemere's scum and villainy went to drink. Vex entered, stood as the center of attention, and addressed the gathered criminals and spacers, telling them he was not going to leave until someone provided him with the boy's name. However, while Vex threatened an Ithorian, someone in the back of the room spoke up and mocked that the

title: Vex Vark
text:
Vex entered, stood as the center of attention, and addressed the gathered criminals and spacers, telling them he was not going to leave until someone provided him with the boy's name. However, while Vex threatened an Ithorian, someone in the back of the room spoke up and mocked that the only boy he saw was Vex. The bounty hunter demanded to know who had insulted him, and was pleased when a six-armed alien who stood over two meter tall approached. Vex quickly overpowered the alien, removing one of its arms and breaking three others, in order to intimidate the patrons into answering his questions. Vex again demanded the boy's name, but Wuher the cantina's bartender , said that no one there knew the boy, therefore, no one knew his name; only that Kade had been in the cantina recently with the boy, but that was all anyone knew about him. Suddenly, a young moisture farmer bolted towards the exit, but Vex fired a length of fibercord that tripped up the teen. The young farmer claimed he didn't know anything, but to Vex, he obviously did for he had tried to run. Vex tied the young man to a table and and proceeded to interrogate him. The teen eventually broke and told Vex the boy's history on Dunemere, and most importantly, his name: Joren Drayden . The bounty hunter knew the teen spoke the truth and released the boy who had "only wanted a drink," before shooting him in the chest right after.

#### Duel with Drayden

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Duel with Drayden

> " You're running out of options. And blood. Put down the flux blade. " ―Vex Vark, to Joren Drayden

Vex left the cantina, boarded his ship, and headed to Beno Kade's home in the Jundland Wastes , where he waited for Drayden to show. A group of Dunefolk Raiders were ransacking Kade's home, but Drayden and his astromech droid soon arrived and Drayden chased them off with his flux blade . Vex stealthily closed in on them as they entered the hut. Vex threw a flash grenade that temporarily blinded Drayden and short-circuited his droid, Bolt-3.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vex moved in and hit Drayden across the head with his carbine and ordered him to surrender. Drayden, however, struck Vex in the stomach, hitting Vex's armor. Drayden, as he was blind, mistook Vex for a shock trooper . Drayden deduced that since Vex had not killed him, whoever had hired the bounty hunter wanted Drayden alive, so he ignited his flux blade after Vex warned that Drayden needn't be walking, just "alive". Drayden told Vex that the bounty hunter never should have come to Kade's home, and was adamant that he would fight Vex blind; for Aetheri didn't need eyes —although, as Vex reminded him, he was no Aetheri. Drayden swung wildly, giving Vex the chance to shoot a length of fibercord that Drayden surprisingly evaded. Drayden used the noise that Vex's Ferrik armor produced to fight him, and caused Vex to stumble backwards and trip over Bolt-3, prompting them both to charge each other.

title: Vex Vark
text:
The bounty hunter cut Drayden several times with vibroblades that extended from his gauntlets, drawing blood several times. Vex again ordered him to surrender. Drayden, therefore, added that Kade could help him even beyond death , prompting Vex to shoot him in the shoulder. Vex prepared to do so again when Drayden recited an Aetheri saying, and deflected the incoming volt pistol bolt; forcing Vex to tackle the still-blind boy. Both combatants grappled one another, and Vex began to press the flux blade towards Drayden's face. However, a box marked "For Joren" suddenly flew across the room and collided with Vex's head, knocking him unconscious. Drayden and his astromech were equally surprised, but quickly left the hut and Dunemere, leaving Vex to report the events that had transpired to Lord Velgor.

#### Informing Velgor of Drayden

> " Did you bring me anything of value, bounty hunter? " " Not much. Just his name. Drayden. " ―Xarn Velgor and Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Informing Velgor of Drayden

> " Did you bring me anything of value, bounty hunter? " " Not much. Just his name. Drayden. " ―Xarn Velgor and Vex Vark

Later, Vex travelled aboard Reaver One to meet Velgor on an Iron Cruiser, and reported that the boy had "gotten lucky" and escaped. Velgor was disappointed and asked if Vex had brought him anything of value. Vex told him he had, at least, discovered the boy's name: Drayden. Velgor remained silent for some time, so Vex left, for their present business was concluded.

Unknown to Vex, he had just told the Dark Lord that he had a son, whom Velgor quickly accepted as his son before vowing that the boy would be his.

#### Rescuing a Vorak

> " Whatever you're looking for, whatever it is that your father gave to you--don't stop. If it means that much to you, keep looking. Don't ever stop until you find it. " ―Vex Vark, to Viiveenn

title: Vex Vark
text: At some point, Vex was hired by a young Vorak named Viiveenn to locate a toy given to her by her late father . Upon meeting Viiveenn on the planet Ridella , Vex advised her to be more prepared when coming to such planets before rescuing her from a pair of Barada mercenaries. Vex went on to say that he didn't specialize in finding toys. Viiveenn then said that the toy was the only thing left of her father. Feeling a tinge of empathy, Vex tried to explain that hunting objects was different from hunting people. But as he did, he was caught in a net by a group of Trandoshan hunters led by Boskan. The Trandoshans went on to capture Viiveenn and brought her aboard their ship as Vex struggled to escape. Cutting through the net, Vex quickly boarded his own ship and followed them off-world.
