Vex then slightly damaged their ship and used the distraction to sneak on. Once aboard, he subdued Boskan and his team and left with Viiveenn on his ship. As they flew away, Vex told Viiveenn he would drop her off on Vantor. However, they were intercepted by an Iron Cruiser. An Imperial then

title: Vex Vark
text: damaged their ship and used the distraction to sneak on. Once aboard, he subdued Boskan and his team and left with Viiveenn on his ship. As they flew away, Vex told Viiveenn he would drop her off on Vantor. However, they were intercepted by an Iron Cruiser. An Imperial then contacted Vex, informing him that they were responding to a report of a insurgent fugitive in the area. When Yarua responded, the Imperial exclaimed that the insurgent they were searching for was traveling with a Vorak. The Iron Cruiser then sent out SKREE fighters, which fired on Vex's ship and forced him to land on a nearby jungle world.

title: Vex Vark
text: As Vex and Viiveenn trudged through the foliage to wait out the Imperium, Boskan and the Trandoshans arrived to retrieve Viiveenn. Vex admitted to Boskan that the insurgent fugitive report was a smart plan for him, but that he still couldn't have Viiveenn. When Boskan told Vex that he was surrounded, outnumbered, and had his ship shot out of the sky, Vex said his ship was still operable as he used his wrist controls to have his ship fire on the Trandoshans. Taking out their own ship, Vex told Viiveenn to get inside his ship before dealing with the Trandoshans. During the struggle, Vex was caught in another net. As Boskan told Vex that he would suffer alongside the Vorak, Viiveenn piloted Vex's ship and opened fire on the Trandoshans. While they were distracted, Vex broke through the net and used his jetpack to fly up to his ship. Once Vex was inside, Viiveenn destroyed the Trandoshans' ship, leaving Boskan and his team stranded as she and Vex flew to Vantor. Upon reaching Vantor, Vex told Viiveenn that while he wasn't able to find her toy, she would now be able to live in peace. Before leaving her, Vex told

title: Vex Vark
text:
Vex was inside, Viiveenn destroyed the Trandoshans' ship, leaving Boskan and his team stranded as she and Vex flew to Vantor. Upon reaching Vantor, Vex told Viiveenn that while he wasn't able to find her toy, she would now be able to live in peace. Before leaving her, Vex told Viiveenn to never stop looking for her father's gift until she found it. #### The Dunefolk Wind

In 2 AVE , Vark was present when Grukk was threatened by some Dunefolk Raiders that claimed that the Duskkins and the Imperials were occupying their territory. Vark threatened them by raising his EE-3 carbine rifle . The Tuskens, frightened, left the Palace as Grukk assured them that there would have been no more trouble. Vark remained at the Palace and was present when Grukk discouraged a pair of travelers from seeking to acquire the alcoholic beverage known as Dunefolk Wind from a group of Tuskens. He later ambushed and killed the travelers, several Imperial soldiers, and some Duskkins that were attempting to steal the Dunefolk Wind. Afterwards, Vark returned to the Palace and watched as, in gratitude, the Tuskens gifted Grukk a container full of Dunefolk Wind, before he watched as the Grak drank it.

#### The hunt for Dax Karrick

> " There will be a substantial reward for the one who finds the Corsair Wing . You are free to use any methods necessary, but I want them alive. No disintegrations. " " As you wish. " ―Xarn Velgor and Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text: In 3 AVE , several years after the Joren Drayden encounter, Vex took his next job from Xarn Velgor, dropping a hunt for a Garnethexan and instead giving it to a rookie hunter to meet up with the Umbra Lord. He rendezvoused with the Sovereign in the Frostmark asteroid belt . Five other hunters, including Vark's old allies Dengrik and Boskan, were also gathered aboard the Star Dreadnought , though his two old partners were the only hunters he fully recognized. Though he realized they seemed familiar, Vark was unable to place the names of 4-VOX , Zuckusso , and VX-88B . Taking a twenty credit bet with Dengrik, Vex correctly guessed their bounty would be Karrick's ship, the Corsair Wing . Velgor intended to use Karrick, as well as Elira Solen and Brevok , as bait to lure Joren Drayden into a trap. Vex and the other bounty hunters were given permission to use any means necessary to capture Drayden's friends, as long as they were captured alive. Velgor singled out Vex and warned against disintegrations, to which Vark responded as the Umbra Lord wished.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vark then returned to the hangar bay with Boskan and Dengrik. As the trio discussed the matter, Dengrik smirked and suggested that they team up to track Karrick together, to which Boskan sarcastically remarked that "Krayt's Claw lives again." Vark turned down the suggestion, stating that he needed the credits, though he wished luck to his fellow bounty hunters, before they went their separate ways. After getting an idea, Vex went to work programming decoy coordinates on Reaver One to fool other Bounty Hunters that might pursue him. He jumped out and then jumped back into proximity of the Imperial Fleet, locating the Corsair Wing quickly, having previously deduced that Karrick would try to outlast the Imperium rather than risk losing it in a chase. Vex proceeded to dock within the Iron Cruiser Avenger , coming up with a story of having a leak on his ship as a reason for staying behind. As the Avenger began to prep for jump, the onboard personnel became concerned with dealing with Reaver One . Since Vex had seemingly disappeared from the dock, a member of waste disposal, Carl Ashon , was assigned to handle cleanup from the emitting coolant leak on Reaver

title: Vex Vark
text:
for staying behind. As the Avenger began to prep for jump, the onboard personnel became concerned with dealing with Reaver One . Since Vex had seemingly disappeared from the dock, a member of waste disposal, Carl Ashon , was assigned to handle cleanup from the emitting coolant leak on Reaver One . He quickly discovered what Vex had witnessed; the Corsair Wing was attached on the hull of the Avenger. As Ashon started to make plans on claiming the bounty, he was interrupted by Vex Vark. Ahson proposed splitting the bounty between him and Vex. Vex seemingly agreed before proceeding to knock Ashon unconscious. Vark then placed Ashon within a stripped-down Vectis shuttle that was promptly ejected from the Avenger , ensuring that Ashon would not interfere with Vex's plan. Vark's deduction that the Corsair was nearby was soon proven correct when he saw the Corsair Wing was attached on the conning tower of the Avenger . Vark was able to covertly blend in among the garbage dumped by the Iron Cruiser and watched as the Corsair detached from it. The Avenger then flew into hyperspace, and the Corsair departed for Mistral, followed closely by Vark.

#### Deal with the Imperium

> " You may take Captain Karrick to Grukk the Grak after I have Drayden. " " He's no good to me dead. " " He will not be permanently damaged. " ―Xarn Velgor and Vex Vark on Dax Karrick

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Deal with the Imperium

> " You may take Captain Karrick to Grukk the Grak after I have Drayden. " " He's no good to me dead. " " He will not be permanently damaged. " ―Xarn Velgor and Vex Vark on Dax Karrick

Vex then pursued the Corsair out of the system as they made their way to Aether Spire on Mistral . Vark and the Imperium arrived before the Corsair Wing , which allowed Velgor to manipulate Karrick's friend and the leader of Aether Spire, Dorian Quill , into helping them capture Karrick and the others. Whilst on Mistral, Vark kept the Reaver One on Aether Spire's East Platform and defeated VX-88, who had followed him to Aether Spire, leaving the droid to be collected as scrap. At some point, Vex visited the Azure Den , an underground gambling spot known for inviting only longtime players. While there, the establishment's owner, Elad Zhalto , attempted to speak to him.

title: Vex Vark
text: Needing Karrick alive for Grukk, Vark soon became concerned about Karrick's life when he learned that Velgor intended to freeze Karrick in carbonite , as a test to determine whether Drayden would be able survive the same process. Vark soon led the crew to the carbon-freezing chamber, where Karrick was to be frozen in carbonite. Vark then raised his concern of Karrick's potential death in the crude chamber, to which Velgor assured him that the Imperium would compensate him if Karrick were to die. Velgor then ordered his troopers to begin the freezing process, causing Brevok to attack the nearby shock troopers. As Vark raised his EE-3 carbine rifle to shoot the enraged Vorak, Velgor intervened by pushing the weapon down. Karrick calmed Brevok down, and was eventually lowered down on the platform. Vark watched as Karrick emerged, encased in carbonite. Quill checked on Karrick's state, concluding that he was alive and in perfect hibernation. After hearing this, Velgor gave Karrick over to Vark, who nodded in respect.

title: Vex Vark
text: Two Mistral Wing Guards and two shock troopers accompanied Vark, as they escorted Karrick to Reaver One . While en route to the ship, Vark swiftly turned his head after hearing heard Drayden draw his volt pistol from behind a wall. Aware of Drayden's presence, Vark continued walking down the corridor under the guise that he was unaware of the Aetheri Adept. The bounty hunter then waited at the end of the corridor for Drayden, as the Mistral Wing Guards and the shock troopers continued on. As Drayden prepared to sprint forward, Vark revealed his presence and shot at the wall Drayden was hiding behind, delaying the Aetheri Adept for enough time for Solen and Brevok to be dragged away, consequently leading Drayden into Velgor's trap. Quill eventually betrayed the Imperium, and freed Solen and Brevok before the crew attempted to catch up with Vark and free Karrick. Vark had already made it back to Reaver One however, and told one of the Mistral Wing Guards to place Karrick in the cargo hold. Although the crew soon found Vark, the bounty hunter took off, and departed the city.

title: Vex Vark
text:
After escaping themselves aboard the Corsair Wing , Brevok scolded Quill for not having chased Vark when they had the chance, to which Quill replied that they had already been lucky to survive meeting the bounty hunter. He also said that even if they caught Vark, they could not have blown up Reaver One since Karrick was on board. When the protocol droid Astra-9 realized that Vark wanted to take Karrick to Grukk, he claimed that the Grak would have certainly killed him immediately. Solen later informed Drayden that Vark had captured Karrick, and Drayden said they had to go after him, but Solen replied that they needed a plan.

#### Hunt for Nakano Lash

> " It's time to settle an old debt. " ―Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
After capturing Karrick, Vex learned from Syphacc 's Bountiful Bounties that Lash had resurfaced. Vex found the black market technician Jhorstek at a bar in Phelar Port on Eriadu . After killing the bar patrons, Vex had Jhorstek tell him where to find Lash. Vex was told that Lash on Galmerah . Vex was able to track Lash's ship to Ruusan. There, he boarded Lash's ship where he shot and wounded T'onga. Lash told Vex that Cadeliah was the reason she killed Khamus. As he prepared to kill Lash, Vex was attacked by Varrick. The two fought until Vex shot Varrick with a bioenergy disrupter . Vex then confronted Lash and Cadeliah. Lash and Vex shot at each other. As Lash got Cadeliah aboard a escape pod, Vex grabbed Lash by her tentacles. The two then fought again until Varrick grabbed him. However, Vex was able to subdue Varrick with his flamethrower. As Vark attempted to finish Lash off, Lash's ship came under attack by General Vukorah . Vark, knowing Lash would die eventually, returned to his ship to continue his journey to Dunemere and bring Karrick to Grukk's Palace.

#### War of the Bounty Hunters

Disguised gladiator

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### War of the Bounty Hunters

Disguised gladiator

> " I'm not going to disappoint him. I'm on the way. But... tell Grukk... it's gonna be a minute. " ―Vex Vark to Bib Fortuna, after he lost Dax Karrick Disguised gladiator

> " I'm not going to disappoint him. I'm on the way. But... tell Grukk... it's gonna be a minute. " ―Vex Vark to Bib Fortuna, after he lost Dax Karrick

During his flight to Dunemere, Vex contacted Bib Fortuna , Grukk's majordomo at the Grak's palace, assuring him that Dax Karrick was alive and that Grukk should have his payment ready. At the same time, an alarm signal from the carbonite block sounded and Vex discovered that strange stains had formed on the surface of the frozen Dax Karrick. He cut off his call with Fortuna and left for Nar Shadda, where he met with his old contact Doc Ragon . The doc informed him that the carbonite matrix with an organic being in it was unstable, but he also offered to solve the problem. Despite Velgor's promise that locating the Corsair Wing would grant him a "substantial reward," Vex realized that he would be unable to pay at the moment, so Ragon gave him an alternative: kill the Kanji Graks' arena pit warrior Wyrmen Lictor , whom the Doctor had hated since she killed a fighter he had bet a lot of money on.

title: Vex Vark
text: At first, Vex did not want to anger the Kanjis, especially since they would recognize him by his armor. However, Ragon offered to make his armor unrecognizable with a nano-spray paint , finally revealing to Vex that Wyrmen Lictor was the current champion of the arena. In all black armor, Vex competed in the arena under the name of his father. As "Beskar Brawler Garrick," Vex killed many fighters, including Jonny the Sting , Skullicon , and Bigbot , in order to finally fight against Wyrmen Lictor, despite the warning of another gladiator. With the arena designed as a web for their fight, Lictor and Vark started their conflict. After he shot her volt pistols out of her hands, Lictor ripped off his jetpack with a thread that she shot out of her body. Vark managed to sever one of her legs, but was hit in the shoulder by another. When Lictor stood over him and felt confident of victory, Vark let his jetpack explode, which led to the previous arena champion falling into the depths and being crushed by the falling stones.

title: Vex Vark
text:
After Vark asked for his credits from the Pa'lowick who worked at the entrance to the arena, he was denied by several Kanjis who wanted him to fight in the arena for them, as they wanted to win back the money they had bet on Lictor. Unwilling to return to the fighting arena and knowing he had to return to Ragon, Vark refused and returned to Ragon's quarters, where he found the doc to be dead and Dax Karrick to be stolen. At the same moment, Fortuna contacted him again, telling him that Grukk was slowly getting impatient for his prey. Vark assured the Velari that he would not disappoint Grukk, but that the Grak would have to be patient.

Betrayed by Grukk

> " I said at the beginning of all this that someone was going to die. Now I know who . " ―Vex Vark, to Bib Fortuna

title: Vex Vark
text: Afterwards, Vex visited a bar on the moon and told the bartender that whoever took Karrick from him was going to die. He then saw a reflection in a glass of one of the patrons aiming their volt pistol at him, to which he quickly shot them down. As he left the bar, Vark left a message for Fortuna, reassuring the Velari that he would deliver Karrick as agreed. However, as Vark entered his ship, he noticed a thermal detonator, which promptly exploded and sent him flying back. He was then met by Zukuss, who told Vark that he had questions for him. Vark responded by firing a rocket from his jetpack, which Zuckusso dodged. Zuckusso was then joined by 4-VOX, who took aim at Vark and forced him to stand down. Vark asked them what the attack was about and 4-VOX ordered him to tell them where Karrick was. Angered that they had gone inside his ship, Vark remotely turned on its weapons and flew out of the way as they fired on the two bounty hunters. Once the firing stopped, Vark came back down and found Zuckusso hanging by the edge of the landing platform. Vark went to

title: Vex Vark
text: Angered that they had gone inside his ship, Vark remotely turned on its weapons and flew out of the way as they fired on the two bounty hunters. Once the firing stopped, Vark came back down and found Zuckusso hanging by the edge of the landing platform. Vark went to kick him off, but Zuckusso tried to stop him by telling him his future. The future he described was of Vark drowning in a sea of red. However, Vark said he wasn't interested and kicked Zuckusso off the edge, sending him plummeting into the city below. Vark then discovered 4-VOX, blasted in half and telling Vark to stay back. However, Vark used one of his wrist blades to sever the droid's head and took it onto the ship with him. 4-VOX stated that Vark was his target, to which Vark said the droid must be mistaken. Vark then connected 4-VOX's head with the ship's computer and placed a restraining bolt on him. When Vark asked the droid who sent him and how he had learned of Karrick's whereabouts, 4-VOX revealed that an open contract had been placed on Vark himself, dead or alive with Karrick's delivery as a bonus. When Vark asked who had placed the bounty, the droid responded that the client was Grukk. As such, Vark was the target of Varrick, Dengrik, T'onga, and Boskan in the War of the Bounty Hunters .

title: Vex Vark
text: Armed with that new information, Vark returned to Grukk's Palace on Dunemere. As he approached the palace, 4-VOX tried to convince Vark that he could still be useful to him, to which Vark promptly tossed his head over the side of the bridge. Upon reaching the palace's entrance, Vark was stopped by two Gamorrean guards, who he told to stand aside lest they end up like the droid. He was then met by Bib Fortuna, who told Vark they could resolve the matter without violence. Vark disagreed before quickly dispatching the two guards. Fortuna attempted to threaten Vark, but Vark aimed his wrist-mounted flamethrower at the Velari and demanded to know why Grukk had placed a bounty on him.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Fortuna revealed that Grukk had learned about Vark's loss of Karrick and assumed the bounty hunter had sold him. Vark retorted that Karrick had been stolen from him and demanded to see Grukk. But Fortuna replied that Grukk was not there at the moment. When Vark asked the Velari where his boss was, Fortuna answered that he had received an invitation from the ones who had stolen Karrick to buy him from them. With more palace guards gathering around them, Fortuna suggested that Vark leave the premises. However, Vark threatened them and asked them if they truly wanted to die for Fortuna. They then responded by clearing the way for him, allowing him to enter the palace and see the invitation that Grukk had received. The invitation was a recording of a hooded woman with the still frozen Dax Karrick. In the message, she announced the return of crime syndicate Carmine Dawn and invited Grukk to a celebration on Jekara . After viewing the invitation, Vark told Fortuna that he was going to fix his ship for him. Then, he was going to fly to Jekara and get his property back.

Auction for Dax Karrick

title: Vex Vark
text:
Auction for Dax Karrick

> " What now, Vex Vark? We've known each other a long time—since you was young, just a little clutchling trying to avenge your pop. You gonna kill me? " " No. I'm going to use you to send a message. To anyone who wants to come after me to get Grukk's bounty. This is the message. Don't. " ―Boskan and Vex Vark Upon arriving at Jekara, Vark scoped out Carmine Dawn's fortress flagship, the Vermillion , and saw that it was well guarded. He then saw another group of gangsters heading towards the Vermillion. Vark stood in front of them and told their leader to give him their invitation and cloak. However, Vark was attacked and tied with a rope by Boskan, who had come to claim Grukk's bounty. Vark activated his flamethrower and burned the rope. He then used his jetpack and attacked the Trandoshan. Vark managed to blow off the Trandoshan's legs, subduing him. Boskan reminded Vark of their history together and asked if he was planned to kill him. But Vark said he was going to use him as a message to dissuade any other bounty hunters from coming after him. He then tied up Boskan to a rock and left him out in the cold as he retrieved his disguise. Boskan told him that he would not survive since he was cold-blooded, but Vark replied joking that he was too. He then walked toward the Vermillion , leaving Boskan behind.

title: Vex Vark
text: Once inside the ship, Vark found himself amongst a crowd of representatives from every major criminal faction in the underworld. Amongst the crowd, he recognized the face of the rogue archaeologist , Doctor Chelli Lona Vexa . Vark approached Vexa and took her by the arm, telling her associate Sana Starric to lower her volt pistol. Being a noted archaeologist who knew her history, Vexa recognized from Vark's voice that he was a replica. Vark then told Vexa that he was not and asked her to help him or he would alert Carmine Dawn to her presence. Giving her a comm button, he told Vexa to create a diversion once he triggered the button. However, they were then interrupted by Lady Vessa, who presented Karrick to the bidders and commenced the auction .

title: Vex Vark
text: After telling Vexa to be ready, Vark disappeared from the crowd. With the auction underway, he removed his disguise and got back into his armor. But as he was about to ambush Vessa to retrieve Karrick, he ran into Elira Solen, Dorian Quill, and Brevok, who were also there to rescue the smuggler. At the same time, Grukk won the auction and told his fellow Graks to wrap Karrick up for him so they could leave. However, the auction was then interrupted by the arrival of Xarn Velgor. Guarded by two death troopers , Velgor declared that Karrick belonged to him.

title: Vex Vark
text: While Velgor argued with Grukk over Karrick, Vark claimed to Solen that Karrick was his. Solen replied that Karrick was not a thing to be bought or sold and told Brevok to take Vark down quietly. After Vark taunted him with an assortment of hair braids taken from slain Voraks, Brevok charged Vark and tried to choke him. Vark managed to escape the Vorak's grip and burned him with a blast from his flamethrower. Solen threatened the bounty hunter with her volt pistol, but Vark disarmed her, but claimed that he did not need more enemies. Quill told Vark that if he had delivered Karrick to the Insurgency, they would have paid him as much as Grukk promised him, but Vark replied that it was against the bounty hunters' code. Vark handed the volt pistol back to Solen, and the Insurgents left the ship.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Velgor managed to convince the Graks to leave Karrick to the Imperium, but he claimed to Vessa that he would not have paid the requested one million credits. Vessa attacked Velgor, and while they were fighting, Vark prepared to attack Velgor himself. But after remembering how easily Velgor defended himself from Karrick's fire in Aether Spire, Vark decided not to attack. After defeating Vessa and taking possession of Karrick, Velgor contacted Joren Drayden and commanded the Aetheri to come to him or else he would cut his friend in half. Drayden refused, however, and told Velgor to come to him. Velgor conceded, ordering Romodi to bring Karrick aboard his iron cruiser and prepare his fighter. Vark then left the Vermillion to reclaim his property from the Imperium.

Uneasy alliance

title: Vex Vark
text:
Uneasy alliance

> " See that? The insurgents are going after him too. Lotta powerful people want Karrick. And here you and I sit, simple men, caught in the middle. " " What's your point? " " We can help each other. We both want the same thing -- Dax Karrick. You have a good reputation. We should work together. Both of us focused on the same goal…we might be able to make something happen. " ―Vex Vark and Beilert Varrick

As he watched a squad of shock troopers transport Karrick to Velgor's shuttle, Vark was suddenly cornered by Dengrik, who aimed his rifle at Vark's heart and ordered him to stand down. But Vark refused, saying that he was sick of being attacked by nobodies. Dengrik was then joined by Beilert Varrick before they both attacked Vark. Vark however quickly subdued Dengrik with a single rocket, leaving the Korrathi stranded on a floating iceberg. While Vark was distracted, Varrick held one of his palm volt pistols to the back of Vark's head and demanded to know where Karrick was. Vark then remarked that Varrick was too late as Velgor's shuttle departed from Jekara with Karrick onboard.

title: Vex Vark
text: As Velgor left with Karrick, Vark offered to work with Varrick to get Karrick back. Varrick initially refused, saying that he should kill Vark for what he did to Nakano Lash and that doing so would prevent Vark from betraying him later. Vark admitted that would be cleaner, but not easier. He then told Varrick that whichever one of them got Karrick after, at least the Imperium would not have him. With this, Varrick accepted Vark's offer and asked him how they would get to the Iron Cruiser, to which Vark told Varrick to let him worry about that. As they departed Jekara aboard Reaver One , Vark pointed out how Varrick made the right decision by joining him as Dengrik intended to betray the cyborg.

title: Vex Vark
text:
As they approached Velgor's Iron Cruiser, Varrick spotted the Corsair Wing nearby and warned Vark not to destroy it or else they would have a problem. Vark then deployed a seismic charge dialed back to twenty percent intensity, taking the Corsair out of the fight. Vark also noticed that the ship's crew had shut down the Imperial shuttle, leaving nothing between them and Velgor's ship. But before they could approach it however, they were suddenly met by a massive fleet of Grak ships.

As the Graks commenced their attack , Vark contacted the Sovereign and requested access to board, claiming he was working for Velgor on an urgent mission. Much to Varrick's surprise, the ruse worked and the two hunters were allowed onto Velgor's flagship. Once inside, Varrick used his knowledge of the Imperium to guide Vark towards the detention level. There, they were attacked by a KX-series security droid , though Varrick managed to dispatch it quickly. However, Vark then betrayed Varrick, who threw a thermal detonator at him and caused his body to explode. Vark then left Varrick to die as he went to retrieve Karrick once and for all.

Reclaiming Dax Karrick

title: Vex Vark
text:
Reclaiming Dax Karrick

> " I brought you Dax Karrick, Grukk. If you want to keep him… pay me. " ―Vex Vark, to Grukk the Grak

Upon reaching Karrick on the Sovereign , Vark once again encountered Solen, Quill, and Brevok. But before they could engage one another, a blast from a Grak ship blew a hole in the room they were in, causing Karrick to be sucked out into space. Vark quickly used his jetpack to fly after Karrick, chasing him all the way back down to the surface of the planet before fishing him out of the sea. After placing Karrick back in Reaver One , Vark returned to Dunemere, had a brief fight with VX-88 and finally delivered the bounty to Grukk.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Although Grukk had canceled his bounty on Vark's head, Vark nevertheless brought the subject up, but Grukk claimed it had never been a personal decision and even noted he would require Vark's services in the future, given that Carmine Dawn had returned. While Grukk explained how he had suddenly become the sole leader of the Grak Clans, as Xarn Velgor had executed the Grand Grak Council during the battle, Vark remained focused on the money he was owed. While he advised Grukk to throw Karrick into the Great Pit of Karkoon to spare him the trouble the smuggler would bring, he then returned his focus to business matters, demanding that Grukk pay him after all he had been through.

#### Joining T'onga's crew

> " Sssseeems ya got ssssoft bitssss under that bessskar . " " Yeah, but I also have pointy bits hidden in my armor. " ―Boskan and Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Joining T'onga's crew

> " Sssseeems ya got ssssoft bitssss under that bessskar . " " Yeah, but I also have pointy bits hidden in my armor. " ―Boskan and Vex Vark

Sometime later, Vark got a bounty on his head, put up by the Black Sun. He was waiting for people who attempts to claim his bounty in the wreckage of the old Rishi Station on the Rishi Moon . T'onga came with her crew , seemingly to collect the active bounty. There, he fought her and fellow hunters such as the Gen'Dai bounty hunter Durk , the assassin Deathstick , Boskan and Varrick. Vark briefly lost his helmet when T'onga knocked it off his head and held him at knifepoint. To his surprise, T'onga wanted to hire him. Vark picked up his helmet and agreed to help her after she does a favor for him.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Vark took T'onga's crew aboard Reaver One to Quantxi . Vark got into a fight with Boskan about dealing with Black Sun gangsters. However, T'onga turned Vark over Lord Xanak Grunseit , who wanted to kill Vark to secure his place in Black Sun. However, Vark, working for Grunseit's cousin, was able throw a Syntox capsule was able to kill him. Vark and T'onga's crew were able to fight their way out. Vark fullfilling his part in his deal with T'onga, gave here coordinates to a cyborg fixer, Tarr Kligson to help fix Varrick. Vark then left T'onga crew and went on his own.

#### Into the devourer

> " Vex Vark? Vex Vark? Where? " ―Dax Karrick, just before knocking Vark into the devourer

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Into the devourer

> " Vex Vark? Vex Vark? Where? " ―Dax Karrick, just before knocking Vark into the devourer

Vex continued working for Grukk after delivering Karrick to the Grak. In the meantime, a plan was developed by Drayden, Solen, Brevok, and Quill to rescue Karrick from the palace. Sometime later, he witnessed Drayden and Brevok be captured by the Grak, while Solen posed as the bounty hunter Boushh and Quill posed as a guard. Solen was, however, able to free Karrick from carbonite freezing, and the smuggler emerged temporarily blind as a result of the freezing process and Solen got captured and made a slave girl for Grukk. At Grukk's decree, Drayden, Karrick, and Brevok were to be taken to the Great Pit of Karkoon, where they would be fed to the devourer —a creature that lived in the pit that would digest them over the course of a thousand years. Vex made the journey to the devourer with Grukk's entourage.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Once at the Great Pit of Karkoon, Drayden and the others put their plan into motion, attacking Grukk's guards—and even leading to the death of Grukk himself, who was strangled to death by Elira Solen. During the firefight, Vex fought against Drayden, who used his flux blade to destroy Vex's volt pistol. In the ensuing chaos, Karrick—still somewhat blind— was alerted to Vex's presence and swung out wildly with a vibro-ax, striking Vex's jetpack as he took aim at Drayden with his wrist gauntlet. The impact caused the jetpack to ignite, sending Vex slamming into the side of Grukk's sail barge, the Khetanna , and then tumbling into the Pit of Karkoon.

### Interregnum

title: Vex Vark
text:
### Interregnum

When Vark fell into the devourer, he was assumed dead by the galaxy at large. He was remembered amongst his fellow bounty hunters, such as Dengrik and fellow bounty hunter Mercurial Swift who entered into a fight in Coronet City on the Core Reach of Korrath. During their scuffle, Dengrik pulled out his particle array gun and aimed it at Swift. Thinking of a way to survive, Swift pretended to see Vark on a nearby rooftop and said his name in false confusion, causing Dengrik to turn his gun towards the roof. Taking advantage of this, the younger bounty hunter defeated him. However, he let Dengrik live, as there was no bounty on his head.

### Survival

#### Escaping the devourer

> " She was left for dead on the sands of Dunemere, as was I. But fate sometimes steps in to rescue the wretched. " ―Vark, on his survival

title: Vex Vark
text:
### Survival

#### Escaping the devourer

> " She was left for dead on the sands of Dunemere, as was I. But fate sometimes steps in to rescue the wretched. " ―Vark, on his survival

Upon falling into the devourer, Vark found himself being digested with a Duskkin and Bith and quipped if either had a deck of Sabacc cards with which to pass the time, which the Duskkin happily held up. However, Vark was knocked unconscious and became trapped in one of its stomachs, beginning the process of being digested for a thousand years. Fortunately for the bounty hunter, he eventually awoke suddenly, gasping for air, and activated his helmet light to discover a shock trooper who had also suffered the same fate. He yanked out the trooper's air tube and attached it to his own helmet, and took a deep breath. Thinking quickly, Vark activated his flamethrower to burn through the Devourer's hide and dug himself out of the pit. Exhausted and suffering wounds from the encounter with the beast, Vark collapsed near the wreckage of the Khetanna .

title: Vex Vark
text:
Some time later, the bounty hunter was then found by Duskkins who separated him from his armor, which Vark somewhat helplessly witnessed. When he attempted to resist their attempts at theft, Vark was knocked out by the Duskkins and left for dead. His armor was later acquired by the Tatooinian sheriff Cobb Vanth . Still injured and lying in the middle of a sandstorm, Vark was found by a tribe of Dunefolk Raiders who took him as a prisoner. Vark was forced to travel a very long distance by foot, dragged along in chains by a strider ridden by members of the tribe. Some distance into the journey, Vark gave in to his dire pain, exhaustion, and dehydration and collapsed in the desert once more, dragged against the sand.

#### Prisoner of the Tuskens

> " We could have both escaped if you didn't sound the alarm. If you kept your snout closed, if we can get to Anchorhead, I can get us offworld. " ―Vex Vark complains to the Rodanori

title: Vex Vark
text: A little while longer, he awoke after the party had stopped at their home camp. Several adolescent Tuskens beat him with gaderffii sticks , knocking him unconscious again. That night, Vark awakened at his post, close to a Rodanori prisoner , and guarded by a massiff . Vark drew the attention of the massiff, which lunged at him. Vark knocked out the beast and used its sharp teeth to cut his bonds. Vark asked the Rodanori if he wants him to cut his bonds, but the prisoner cries, alerting the rest of the Dunefolk tribe. Vark fled into the desert with the massiff in hot pursuit. The creature caught up with him and they fight, until the Tuskens catch up with him and call the beast back. One of the Tuskens approached him with a gaderffii stick. After sizing each other, the two break into a duel. The Dunefolk had knocked Vark to the ground, and beaten him repeatedly when he attempted to rise and fight again. The other Tuskens surrounded the bounty hunter, with one kicking him to the ground. Vark slipped into unconsciousness.

title: Vex Vark
text: Following his unsuccessful escape attempt, Vark was woken up by a young Dunefolk and led away by his bound hands, with his feet chained to the captive Rodanori who followed. They reached a sand dune and watched a homestead, with several Kajain'sa'Niktos beating a man. The Dunefolk child instead led the Rodanori and Vark to a separate place and told them to start digging for black melons . The Rodanori complied immediately, although the bounty hunter had trouble understanding the Dunefolk's orders. After realizing what the child wanted, Vark proceeded to dig under the watchful eyes of the Dunefolk and the massiff. Vark attempted to drink from one of the melons, but was promptly stopped by the child, who proceeded to dump the water out for his massiff. Continuing to dig for the melons, Vark told the Rodanori that they could have both escaped had he kept his snout closed. Vark said that if he can get to Anchorhead , he can get them offworld. Vark grumbled about strangling the Rodanori and feeding him to the watchdog. The Rodanori returned an insult in Rodanori .

title: Vex Vark
text:
While continuing their dig, the Rodanori discovered a sand beast , which attacked him. The massiff attempted to counterattack before being thrown away by the creature, which then killed the Rodanori. Vark was lifted up by his chains by the beast and the Dunefolk stabbed the creature's foot while it was distracted, resulting in the creature throwing the bounty hunter and hitting the Dunefolk, causing him to hurtle onto the sand. The creature turned from Vark and went after the Dunefolk adolescent. However, Vark wrapped his chains around the beast's neck and asphyxiated the creature. After this encounter, the youngling presented the deceased creature's decapitated head as a trophy to his tribe, earning Vark respect from the tribe's chief . The chief wordlessly handed Vark a melon, which Vark drank.

#### Living among the Tuskens

> " No harm will come of you. " " We will die of thirst without our water car. " " We will give you each a black melon. You will survive on its milk as these people do. " ―Vark advises the Pykes to travel across the Dune Sea

title: Vex Vark
text:
> " No harm will come of you. " " We will die of thirst without our water car. " " We will give you each a black melon. You will survive on its milk as these people do. " ―Vark advises the Pykes to travel across the Dune Sea

Some time later, Vark learned to wield a gaderffii stick from the Dunefolk warrior, who taught him to hold the stick properly before parrying. She knocked the staff out of Vark's hand before telling him to practice again. He asks the Dunefolk to show him. An animal's roar is heard in the background and the Tuskens take up position as an armored hovertrain approached and its Gruv occupants fired on the group, leaving several Tuskens killed and wounded as the train rode away. Vark watched the tribe attending to their wounded and dead, and later that night, the Tuskens cremated their fallen. Vark himself carries the remains of a young Dunefolk.

title: Vex Vark
text:
After watching several Kintan Strider speeder bikes passing their encampment Vark had an idea. Vark spoke to the tribal elders, vowing to stop the train with a cycler rifle and his training gaderffi stick, promising to be back by morning. Vark travelled to Tosche Station in the small town of Anchorhead, where several Niktal bikers were harassing two patrons at a cantina. Vark, armed with his gaderffii and rifle, interrupted and fought the Niktal, wounding and killing some. After stopping for a drink, Vark inspected the speeder bikes that belonged to the Niktal, and returned to the camp with several bikes in tow as a gift to the Dunefolk Raiders.

Vark then offered to teach the Dunefolk how to operate and ride the speeder bikes (which the Tuskens had originally thought the bikes were meant for salvage), and helped them prepare for an assault on the hovertrain. As the Dunefolk got better with handling the bikes and leaping from their vehicles, Vark continued practicing with the gaderffi stick and learned how to knock the weapon out of his opponents' hands.

title: Vex Vark
text: One Dunefolk sentry spotted the approaching hovertrain, followed by the Tuskens in the trenches exchanging fire with the Gruv gunners, Vark and other Tuskens riding speeder bikes pursue the train. Vark rescues one and uses a grappling hook to latch onto the hovertrain and kills one of the Gruv gunners. Vark and the Raiders jumped across carriages and fight several of the emerging Pykes as they approached the train engine. After the lead Gruv gunner and his companions were defeated, turning the tide in favor of the Tuskens, the driver droid fired up the engine, causing a blast to knock off one of Vark's Dunefolk allies. After fighting more Gruv guards near the train engine, Vark forced his way into the train engine where he ordered the driver to stop the vehicle. The droid instead jumped out into the desert, leaving Vark to stop the train after a lengthy struggle, causing it to brake in the desert.

title: Vex Vark
text:
The Dunefolk Raiders rounded up the surviving Pykes. Vark demanded to know who is the leader and asked if he was carrying spice. After being exposed, with two Tuskens accidently dropping a chest of spice, Vark stated that the Gruv Syndicate would have to pay a toll to the Dunefolk to cross the Dune Sea. He then allowed the Pykes to go free in the direction of Anchorhead, escorted by a number of Tuskens. Soon afterwards one of the Tuskens caused the train's water cart to spill. This caused the Tuskens to collect as much water as they could while exclaiming in delight at such a rare treat.

#### Vision quest

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Vision quest

That night, Vark continued to strengthen his ties to the Dunefolk tribe. The chief presented Vark with a gift, consisting of a small lizard in a basket. The reptile crept into Vark's nostrils, causing him to experience a series of hallucinations as a vision quest. Vark wandered through the desert as his visions showed him a large, yet dead, wortwood tree and oceans in the place of the sands of Dunemere. He then saw himself trapped in the maw of the Devourer at the Pit of Karkoon, reliving his father Garrick's death on Pyralis, and finally saw himself as a child on Gelvaris, looking from his apartment as Reaver One landed on Tipoca City. The vision ended with him emerging while the ocean roared.

title: Vex Vark
text:
The following day, Vark returned to the camp carrying a branch from his night journey. After being greeted by the chief and his followers, the lizard emerged from his nostrils and he was asked by the Dunefolk chief about the branch. The Tuskens led Vark inside a tent where he was clothed with Dunefolk robes, scarves, and wraps. After emerging from the tent, Vark, accompanied by the young Dunefolk whom he saved from the six-limbed creature, headed into the desert towards a wrecked site where other Tuskens helped Vark build his own gaderffi stick from the branch he carried. Later that night, Vark presented his new weapon to the rest of the Dunefolk clan and took part on the corresponding ritual celebrations around the campfire.

#### Journey to Port Kess

> " We look forward to our partnership. " ―The Gruv boss, to Vex Vark in what would be a fateful deal

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Journey to Port Kess

> " We look forward to our partnership. " ―The Gruv boss, to Vex Vark in what would be a fateful deal

The Tuskens watch him with a sense of respect as he rides into the desert into Port Kess. He asks two Duskkins upon entering the town where the Pykes do their business and rides on his strider through the town, past spikes of shock trooper helmets. Vark tethers his strider outside a building guarded by two Pykes. Vark states that he has business with the Gruv Syndicate. The Pykes admit him into the building. Vark walks down the stairs and meets with the Gruv leader, who has received his message and explains that protection arrangements are all part of doing business in the Outer Reach Territories. Vark says that he will take payment and be on his way.

title: Vex Vark
text: The Gruv replies that he has spoken with his superiors on Oba Diah , who are unwilling to pay protection to more than one party. Vark replies that he is collecting on behalf of the Tuskens of the Dune Sea. The Gruv leader responds that the Kintan Striders have already collected protection money for the same territory that he lays claim to. Vark then replies that they don't need to pay protection to that speeder bike gang since the Sandpeople far outnumber them. Vark says that the sands have belonged to the Tuskens since the oceans of Dunemere have dried. But the Gruv says that they are willing to do business with either party, but that they do not want to be taken advantage of by paying money to both and tells Vark that he hopes he understands. Vark vows to resolve this and says that he will not hear from the Niktal sand flyers again. The Gruv then says that he looks forward to their partnership.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Vark rides across the Dune Sea on his strider to return to his Dunefolk camp. As he approaches the encampment, he notices flames in the distance. Vark walks on foot to the Dunefolk village only to find that the clan has been slaughtered . He discovers burnt tents and several fallen striders. While surveying the destruction, he finds the remains of Tuskens lying on the ground. Vark also recognizes the marking of a gang that he had encountered earlier on Dunemere. Feeling responsible for the massacre, Vark cremates the remains of his Dunefolk friends before recovering his Gaderffii stick. After paying his respects to the dead, Vark rides away on his strider.

#### Saving Fennec Thanna

> " I am Vex Vark. " " Vex Vark is dead. " " I was. Left for dead on the sands of Dunemere... like you. " ―Vex Vark and Fennec Thanna

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Saving Fennec Thanna

> " I am Vex Vark. " " Vex Vark is dead. " " I was. Left for dead on the sands of Dunemere... like you. " ―Vex Vark and Fennec Thanna

Some time later, Vex traveled to Grukk's Palace, which was controlled by Bib Fortuna, to locate his starship. Vark identified numerous guards protecting the hangar where the Reaver One was located. He decided that there are too many guards and turned away. That night, Vark ate a meal with his strider when two flares lit up the sky nearby, and Vark decided to investigate. When he arrived at the scene, he found only Fennec Thanna's body, slumped and near-lifeless by a hillside.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vex carried her to his strider and then traveled to the nearest mod artist to get her cybernetic implants due to being shot by Toro Calican . After brief persuasion, the artist agreed and Vark spectated the surgery. After the surgery was finished, Vark took Thanna back into the desert and started a campfire. When she awakened with pain, Vark offered her a black melon to drink. Thanna asked him what happened to her, and Vark informed her that she was dying and that he had also saved her life. Thanna asked what he did to her, and Vark responded by telling her that he took her to the mod-parlor at Port Kess, which is the best he could do for her under the circumstances.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vark recognized her as the Master Assassin , Fennec Thanna of the Mid Reach, to which Thanna assumed that her bounty is higher with her alive. Vark confirms this, and although Thanna immediately offered him more than double the price on her head, he told her that he is not after money. She asked him who he is, and although he had answered honestly, she dismissed it, as the thought that Vex Vark was dead. Vark responded that he was left for dead on the sands of Dunemere, just as she was. He told her of how the Tuskens had rescued him and accepted him into their tribe, and that he tried to help them, only for them to wind up dead after he attracted the attention of a gang of Niktal speed bikers. Thanna expressed her disbelief that mere speed bikers could have defeated the Dunefolk, but Vark changed the conversation and told her that he wanted her help to recover his gunship. When Thanna asked him why he did not simply ask for the ship's return, Vark replied that he may not like the response since he was less persuasive without his armor. Vark assured her that if

title: Vex Vark
text:
the conversation and told her that he wanted her help to recover his gunship. When Thanna asked him why he did not simply ask for the ship's return, Vark replied that he may not like the response since he was less persuasive without his armor. Vark assured her that if she helps him, her debt to him would be considered repaid. After the two recovered the starship, Thanna decided to stay with Vark, and Vark used the Reaver One to wipe out the Kintan Striders. Later, after killing the Devourer and finding that Vark's armor was not in in, the two sat by a fire, giving Vark a chance to explain to Thanna why his outlook on bounty hunting had changed. Hoping to build a crime family that emulated the Dunefolk tribe that had respected him, Vark convinced Thanna to join his new organization by offering her loyalty.

#### Finding his armor

> " I don't want your armor. I want my armor that you got from Cobb Vanth back on Dunemere. It belongs to me . " ―Vex Vark, to Dinna Verrick

Vanth later gave Vark's armor to the Ferrik bounty hunter Dinna Verrick in exchange for his help in killing a leviathan krayt dragon that was terrorizing Vanth's town of Port Pelgo . As Dinna returned to Port Kess and his ship, the Sable Crest , he was observed by Vark. After watching Verrick, Vark descended from the hilltop where he had been standing.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Eventually, Vark departed Dunemere with Thanna on Reaver One . Together, they tracked Dinna Verrick and Pip to Tython . Vark confronted Verrick, demanding his armour back and using Thanna as a threat as she was scoped on the child. The assassin remarked she did not miss, and Verrick immediately recognized her voice. With Verrick still threatening to kill both of them, Vark suggested that they all put down their weapons and talk, Verrick demanded that Thanna drop hers first. Vark and Verrick soon came to an agreement and Vark told Thanna to stand down. The assassin climbed down to Vark and Verrick, remarking about the latter's surprise at her presence. Verrick thought that Thanna had died at Dunemere, so she and Vark explained how the latter had saved her and that she was in his service.

### Indebted to Verrick

#### Confrontation on Tython

> " The Imperium. They're back! " ―Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
### Indebted to Verrick

#### Confrontation on Tython

> " The Imperium. They're back! " ―Vex Vark

However, Moff Giedan arrived in synth flux , intent on capturing Pip. Two V-82 dropships were sent down from his cruiser and deployed shock troopers in a skirmish against Verrick, Vark, and Thanna. Vark took on several shock troopers with his cycler rifle and gaderffii, and seeing the Sable Crest open and unguarded, took the opportunity to reclaim his armor. Once backed into a corner, Vark used a thermal detonator to defeat multiple troopers, now donning his beskar armor, which he had retrieved from the Sable Crest. Utilizing its full arsenal, including wrist volt pistols, knee rockets, and jetpack-mounted missile, Vark quickly eradicated the remaining shock troopers and their transports.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Suddenly, a pulse lance from a ship in orbit struck the Sable Crest , obliterating the ship. Four dark troopers then left the assailing vessel, abducting an exhausted Pip before Verrick and Thanna could reach him. Vark pursued the troopers in Reaver One , but Verrick told Thanna to use her comlink to tell him not to attack them so as to not risk Pip's safety. He still followed the troopers, recognizing the vessel harboring them as Imperial design before returning to Tython's surface.

#### The Morak affair

> " We agreed in exchange for the return of my armor, we will ensure the safety of the Child. " ―Vex Vark, to Dinna Verrick and Fennec Thanna

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### The Morak affair

> " We agreed in exchange for the return of my armor, we will ensure the safety of the Child. " ―Vex Vark, to Dinna Verrick and Fennec Thanna

After using the armor's chain code to prove his ownership of it to Verrick, Vark and Thanna agreed to help Verrick rescue Pip, saying the child's abduction meant they were still indebted to him to ensure Pip's safety. As the Sable Crest had been destroyed by Giedan's forces, Vark and Thanna brought Verrick to Nevarro aboard Reaver One ; there, Verrick met with Concordat marshal and friend Cara Dunmore to gain information on Migs Mayfeld , whom Verrick believed could help them locate Giedan.

title: Vex Vark
text: When Vark and the rest of the group arrived to collect him, Mayfeld confused Vark for Verrick due to his Ferrik armor, which had now been re-painted. Realizing he had no other choice, Mayfeld reluctantly gave Verrick the location of an Imperial refinery on Morak where they could access information from a terminal. Verrick passed this information over to Vark, who then entered the coordinates. After arriving, the group stood upon a hilltop and formulated their plan. Vark explained that he could not go with Mayfeld to access the terminal, reasoning that the Imperial remnant may recognize his face, leaving Verrick to assume the role of Mayfeld's companion. Once Verrick and Mayfeld completed their mission, Vark flew in with Reaver One to extract the duo. After boarding the ship, Mayfeld asked Verrick to give him one of the cycler rifles, which Mayfeld used to fire at the rhydonium within the refinery, destroying the cargo they had delivered and setting off a massive explosion. While being chased by two SKREE fighters , Vark released a seismic charge, destroying the two pursuing ships. After Reaver One had landed, Dune and Verrick decided to release Mayfeld from his prison sentence to thank him

title: Vex Vark
text:
refinery, destroying the cargo they had delivered and setting off a massive explosion. While being chased by two SKREE fighters , Vark released a seismic charge, destroying the two pursuing ships. After Reaver One had landed, Dune and Verrick decided to release Mayfeld from his prison sentence to thank him for his help. On board Reaver One , Verrick sent a transmission to Moff Giedan, warning him that he would be coming to reclaim Pip. #### Meeting Bo-Katin Velara

> " I didn't know sidekicks were allowed to talk. " " [Chuckles] Well, if that isn't the Quacta calling the Stifling slimy. Easy there little one. " " You'll be talking through the window of a bacta tank. " ―Vex Vark and Koska Reeves exchange insults

After acquiring Giedan's coordinates, Vark and the group used Reaver One to pursue an Imperial shuttle carrying Doctor Penn Pershing . After disabling the ship with Reaver One ' s ion cannons , it was boarded by Verrick and Dune who, after a brief standoff, captured Pershing. [ source? ]

title: Vex Vark
text:
After acquiring Giedan's coordinates, Vark and the group used Reaver One to pursue an Imperial shuttle carrying Doctor Penn Pershing . After disabling the ship with Reaver One ' s ion cannons , it was boarded by Verrick and Dune who, after a brief standoff, captured Pershing. [ source? ]

Following this, Reaver One arrived on Lafete , a planet dotted with large refineries, and landed among a number of parked starships, including a Gauntlet fighter . In a nearby diner , a hush falls as Verrick and Vex Vark enter and cross the room to approach Bo-Katin Velara and Koska Reeves . Verrick tells Velara he needs their help, and she replies that not all Ferriks are bounty hunters, and that some of them serve a higher purpose. Verrick tells her that Moff Giedan has taken the Child, and she says they'll never find him. Vark tells Verrick they don't need these two, and that they should leave. Velara says to Vark that he is not a Ferrik, to which he responds he never said he was. Vark and Reeves begin to argue, but Velara tells them to "save it for the Imps."

title: Vex Vark
text:
Verrick tells them they have Giedan's coordinates, and that he has a light cruiser which could help her regain Ferrum . Vark scoffs, saying the Imperium had reduced Ferrum to glass, and Bo-Katin retorts that he is a disgrace to the armor. Vark says the armor belonged to his father, but Velara mocks him, saying "Don't you mean your donor?" She says he's a replica and she's heard his voice thousands of times before. Vark says it may be the last voice she hears, and Reeves leaps up, swinging at him, and the pair fight before Bo-Katin orders them to stop and urged Verrick and Vark to rethink their position on freeing Ferrum, in turn Velara declared that she and Reeves would help Verrick.

#### Attack on Giedan's cruiser

> " Get the hell out of there as soon as they clear us to dock. And your shots have to look convincing. " " Power up those shields, princess. I'll put on a good show. " ―Bo-Katin Velara and Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Attack on Giedan's cruiser

> " Get the hell out of there as soon as they clear us to dock. And your shots have to look convincing. " " Power up those shields, princess. I'll put on a good show. " ―Bo-Katin Velara and Vex Vark

Following this meeting, Vark followed the Imperial Shuttle piloted by Velara in Reaver One as part of her plan; to send out a distress signal to the cruiser whilst under attack from Reaver One in order to board and take over the ship. As the group exited hyperspace, Vark began firing upon the shuttle as it sent out its distress signal. However, Giedan ordered for a squad of SKREE fighters to intercept Vark's ship. In the ensuing battle, as Velara crashed the shuttle into the cruiser's launch tube, with Vark disposed of the fighters before jumping away into hyperspace, leaving the infiltration team to finish their mission.

### Daimyo of Port Vail

#### Scum and Villainy

> " Grukk ruled with fear. I intend to rule with respect. " ―Vex Vark — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Vex Vark
text:
### Daimyo of Port Vail

#### Scum and Villainy

> " Grukk ruled with fear. I intend to rule with respect. " ―Vex Vark — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Vark and Thanna returned to Grukk's Palace on Dunemere, now under the control of Fortuna, who expressed surprise at Vark's survival after he fell into the devourer pit. Without responding to him, Vark shot Fortuna dead and threw his corpse off the palace's throne, taking his place on the throne as crime lord with Thanna by his side. Declaring himself the Daimyo of Port Vail, Vark then modified his armor once again and turned several palace rooms into his personal quarters.

title: Vex Vark
text: In the following weeks, Vark experienced dreams of his past, though they temporarily stopped. News of the former bounty hunter's survival spread swiftly across the galaxy. On one morning, Vark healed himself in a bacta tank he had installed in his quarters to heal from the devourer's stomach acid. During the healing process, he relived painful memories of his homeworld Gelvaris, the aftermath of his father's death, his escape from the Devourer, and his introduction to the Dunefolk Raider tribe he became so attached to. Eventually, Thanna woke Vark up. As he rose from the bacta tank, Vark told Thanna that the dreams were back. Thanna told him to prepare for the guests about to arrive. Vark, with the help of his droids, suited up and prepared for his first public moment as Daimyo.

title: Vex Vark
text: Back on his throne, he was gifted with tributes by Garfalaquox and Dokk Strassi, who he noted as having previously worked for the latter. However, he was not paid tribute by Mayor Mok Shaiz , who instead sent his majordomo to demand tribute from Vark. Vark expressed his confusion at the situation, to which Thanna explained the situation. She asked to kill the majordomo but Vark refused and Thanna then allowed the majordomo to leave with the gift of "unmolested". When two Gamorrean guards were presented to Vark, he spared their lives and informed the torture droid who brought them before him that he had no intentions of harming them. After hearing of their loyalty to both Grukk and Fortuna, Vark recruited them to be his own personal bodyguards.

title: Vex Vark
text: Later, Vark and Thanna visited the Sanctuary , a local cantina and announced their claim to power to the cantina's owner, Garsa Fwip , who in turn gifted them with riches as tribute. While on their way back, they were ambushed by mercenaries dressed in red uniforms. Vark was beaten and had to be taken back to his bacta tank. Meanwhile, Thanna tracked down two of their attackers, pushing one of them from the top of a building and taking the other as a prisoner. While in the bacta tank, Vark experienced memories of his time at the Dunefolk Raider camp.

title: Vex Vark
text:
After healing, he interrogated the captured mercenary at his throne, though the assassin of the Order of the Night Wind refused to say anything. When 8D8 explained that the warrior would not answer him, Vark dropped him into the Rancor pit. Though it was now empty, the opening of the door alone was enough to scare the mercenary, revealing his employment by Shaiz. Vark and Thanna returned to Port Vail with the assassin and confronted Shaiz. Shaiz then had the assassin executed and paid Vark for delivering him. When Vark threatened Shaiz, he told Vark to return to the Sanctuary for more information.

#### Power struggle

> " I'm the Daimyo of this district and I will bring order. " ―Vark proclaiming his status to the mod gang

title: Vex Vark
text:
#### Power struggle

> " I'm the Daimyo of this district and I will bring order. " ―Vark proclaiming his status to the mod gang

Upon returning to the Sanctuary, Vark and Thanna were met again by Fwip, who informed them that the Twins —a Grak brother and sister — had returned to claim their late cousin Grukk's territory through kinship. As Vark expressed disbelief over this, he was interrupted by the arrival of the Twins themselves, under the protection of Black Zazzik. When the Graks declared their ownership of Port Vail, Vark asserted his position as the Daimyo of Port Vail. Neither party acquiesced to the other's demands and Vark told the siblings they would have to kill him for his territory. The Twins reluctantly conceded for the time being, though the brother warned Vark to sleep lightly. Once they left, Vark told Fennec that they would likely have to kill the Graks, to which Fennec said they would need permission to do so. Vark then return to his palace to heal some more in the bacta pod.

title: Vex Vark
text: After learning about Port Vail's three ruling families from 8D8, Vark was met by local water-monger Lortha Peel , who informed Vark that the Mods , a gang of cyborg bikers were stealing his inventory. Peel promised to double his tribute to Vark if he dealt with the bikers. In turn, Vark and Thanna left with their Gamorrean guards to meet with the Mods personally. They quickly found the gang at a street corner and confronted them over stealing Peel's water. When one of the bikers, Drash , claimed that they had to steal due to there being no work, Vark offered to hire them himself for security. Peel angrily told Vark that they still owed him thirteen hundred credits, to which Vark gave him five hundred and told him he would have to accept it. The Mods then took Vark's offer and followed him back to his palace on their bikes.

title: Vex Vark
text: Vark then returned to his bacta tank and continued to heal. However, he was interrupted by Zazzik, who pulled Vark from the tank and attempted to kill him. After a brief struggle with Vark, Krrsatan was confronted by the Mods. They fought the Vorak out of Vark's chamber and into the palace throne room. While Zazzik fought off the bikers and the Gamorreans, Thanna opened the trap door beneath his feet and threw a knife at his hand as he held onto the edge, causing him to fall and trapping him in the Rancor Pit. Vark then told the bikers to get one of the Gamorreans to the bacta tank as Zazzik roared in anger. Afterwards, Vark and Thanna sat down to eat while they discussed sending a message to his enemies. They were then informed by 8D8 that the Twins had arrived to speak with him personally.

title: Vex Vark
text: Meeting Vark by the palace entrance, the Twins admitted they had made a mistake in sending Zazzik to kill him, apologizing and offering him a rancor calf as an apologetic retribution. They also announced their departure from Dunemere, as they had learned that Grukk's former holdings had already been promised to another crime syndicate by the Mayor and they had no interest in starting a war over a "worthless rock". Vark offered the shackled Zazzik back to the Twins, to which they allowed Vark to keep the Vorak, as tribute, before leaving the palace. Vark then released Zazzik and advised him not to take anymore jobs from the Graks before the Vorak ran off into the desert.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Bringing the rancor to the Pit, Vark was told by its keeper that it would imprint on the first human it saw. Vark removed the rancor's blinders and formed an immediate bond with the calf. However, he was interrupted by 8D8, who informed him that the Mayor was still unavailable. This did not deter Vark though, as he, Thanna and the Mods returned to Port Vail to confront the Mayor's majordomo. But this time, the majordomo fled in a landspeeder, leading the Mods to give chase. After pursued and damaged his speeder through the streets of Port Vail, the majordomo crashed into a meiloorun stand and was confronted by Vark, to whom he finally confessed that the Mayor was working for the Gruv Syndicate.

#### Preparing for War

> " As I'm sure you all know, the Gruv Syndicate are mustering troops in Port Vail. They have slowly absorbed our planet as part of their spice trade. They have bribed the Mayor and are draining Dunemere of its wealth. " ―Vex Vark, to the three ruling families of Port Vail

title: Vex Vark
text: Soon after, Vark and Thanna were informed by Skad that at least a dozen Pykes had arrived in Port Vail. Vark told him to keep an eye on them before Thanna ended the transmission. Thanna pointed out that this was only the first wave and that the Pykes were going to war, to which Vark said that they would be ready. After one final healing session, Vark was informed by Thanna that the majordomo was confessing, but the Mayor remained missing. As such, the Mods began combing the streets of Port Vail in search of him. Despite this, Vark still insisted on going to Port Vail himself to make his presence known and showing off his power. He then returned to the Sanctuary and witnessed Fwip try and fail to talk down Zazzik from ripping a Trandoshan's arm off. Following this, Vark greeted the Vorak on the street and told him that he looked like he could use a job, to which Zazzik obliged.

title: Vex Vark
text: Upon returning to his palace, Vark hosted a dinner for the heads of Port Vail's three ruling families. Vark explained that he was there to make a proposal in light of the Gruv Syndicate vying for control of Dunemere. When the head of the Klatooinian family threatened to simply kill Vark and take what he wanted, he and the rest of the attendants were frightened by the rancor calf directly beneath them. After giving the rancor a scrap of food, Vark asked his guests to remain seated while he made his proposal. He proposed forming a defensive alliance with the families until the Gruv Syndicate was vanquished. The Klatooinian then pointed out that the Pykes were only after Vark's territory and asked why the families should spill their blood for Vark's feud with them. To this, Vark claimed that he would fight off the Pykes himself and that he only asked for the families to remain neutral if the Pykes approached them to betray him. The families then agreed to Vark's proposal before taking their leave. As Vark and Thanna watched the families depart, Thanna asked Vark if he trusted them, to which Vark answered that he trusted them to

title: Vex Vark
text:
asked for the families to remain neutral if the Pykes approached them to betray him. The families then agreed to Vark's proposal before taking their leave. As Vark and Thanna watched the families depart, Thanna asked Vark if he trusted them, to which Vark answered that he trusted them to work in their own self-interest. When Thanna asked him how much treasure they had in reserve, Vark assured her that he had plenty of credits, though he was short on muscle. Thanna replied that credits could buy muscle if one knew where to look. Thanna travelled to Peli Motto 's hangar to recruit Dinna Verrick. Verrick accepted the offer, but asked to travel to Joren Drayden's Aetheri Sanctum to see Pip first. Meanwhile in his palace, Vark had arranged a meeting with members of his criminal imperium, figuring out the best course of action to defeat the Gruv Syndicate. When Vark was unsure where to find foot soldiers, Verrick travelled to Freetown to recruit Cobb Vanth and his people. Vanth considered the offer, valuing the freedom of his town. Meanwhile, the Gruv Syndicate sent two enforcers to plant a bomb in the sanctuary in order to send a message. They successfully accomplished this, killing Garsa Fwip and many other patrons. After this, Vark realized that the war had begun. [ source? ]

#### War for Port Vail

Ruins of the Sanctuary

> " We are at war. " " It was inevitable. " " Even if we win, there might not be anything left of this city. " ―Vex Vark, and Fennec Thanna

title: Vex Vark
text: Vark and his allies travelled to investigate the bombed-out remains of the Sanctuary. Vark finally realized that they were at war, to which Thanna replied that it was inevitable. Vark expressed his concerns that nothing would be left of Port Vail even if they win. The pair were soon joined by Dinna Verrick, Drash, and Skad. Verrick informed the group that he spoke to Marshal Cobb Vanth of Freetown, who was raising a garrison to assist in the fight against the Gruv Syndicate in exchange for the elimination of the spice trade. Thanna protested that Vanth's demand was not free since spice was a large part of the late Grukk's business. Verrick replied that is what the town wanted. Despite Thanna's protest that they can make a lot of money from spice, Vark agreed to these terms, believing that Port Vail could become a prosperous city under their protection and said that spice was killing their people. Vark told Verrick to convey that Freetown was under his protection. Vark suggested that he tell Cobb Vanth himself when he comes with reinforcements.

title: Vex Vark
text:
When Vark asked if Vanth would come, Verrick vouched for him. Since they were outnumbered, Vark stressed that without Vanth's reinforcements they were doomed and said that they needed to buy time. Vark initially proposed waiting for reinforcements within the palace. However, Skad thought that this is a bad idea and proposed waiting for reinforcements in Port Vail. Vark initially dismissed the idea of taking position in Port Vail. However, Drash insisted that they stay because the people of Port Vail need their protection. Vark ultimately decided to stay in Port Vail.

Unexpected reunion

> " I thought I smelled something. If you're looking for a job, you're late. " " I've already got a job. I'm here to negotiate on behalf of the Gruv Syndicate. " " I don't negotiate with gutless murderers. " " If that's not the Quacta calling the Stifling slimy. " ―Vex Vark and Cad Vorek

title: Vex Vark
text: In the ruins of the Sanctuary, Thanna briefed Vark and Verrick about her plan to send their people to patrol Port Vail to keep an eye on the Syndicate's next move and avoid surprises. Thanna believed that the truce that Vark negotiated with the Port Vail crime families will ensure that they remain neutral and allow them to gain the upper hand over the arriving soldiers. Thanna explained that she had deployed the two Gamorrean guards at the Klatooinian territory in star port, Zazzik in front of city hall within the Trandoshan territory, and the Mods in the Worker's District and the Aquari Quarter. Thanna believed that their flanks were covered and that the arrival of the Freetown forces would give them the forces required to pivot their strength to whatever region the Pykes chose to attack.

title: Vex Vark
text: Despite their measures, 8D8 reported that someone had arrived to meet with Vark. Vark was surprised that someone had managed to sneak up on their position. They took up position as Vark left to meet with the visitor, Cad Vorek, Vark's old mentor who he had not seen for decades. Vark remarked that he thought he had smelled something, before telling Vorek that if he was looking for a job, he was too late. Vorek replied that he was working for the Gruv Syndicate, who had sent him to negotiate on their behalf. Vark refused to negotiate with Vorek, whom he regarded as a "gutless murderer". Vorek accused Vark of hypocrisy, stating "if that's not the Quacta calling the Stifling slimy." Vark told Vorek to clear out and inform the Pykes that they were outnumbered. Vorek responded that he had met with Marshal Vanth, adding that Vark should have never left him without his armor. As Thanna and Verrick took up position, Vorek warned them that he also had backshooters. Two Pykes emerged on a balcony. Vorek told Vark to let the spice flow through Port Vail to avoid trouble.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Vark rejected Vorek's terms and responded that he would only negotiate directly with the Syndicate's head. Vorek revealed it was the Syndicate who murdered his Dunefolk tribe. This nearly goaded Vark into the first shot, but ultimately he was convinced by Thanna to stand down and begin the battle on their own terms. Vark wanted to fight Vorek but listened to Thanna's reasoning. Vark told Vorek to tell his client that negotiations were terminated. Before leaving, Vorek claimed that Vark had gone soft with age. Vark responded that everyone does.

Standing with Verrick

> " I suppose you'll be heading out. " " I'm not. " " You should. " " It's against the Creed. I gave you my word. I'm with you until we both fall. " ―Vex Vark, and Dinna Verrick

title: Vex Vark
text: Shortly later, Drash called Vark on the comms and reports that the locals had turned on them despite the treaty previously established. The Aquari family ambushed the Mods, cornering them in an alley. Vark attempted to touch base with Zazzik, who had been attacked by the Trandoshan family in the city center. The Gamorreans then tried to contact Vark, but were soon pushed off a cliff by the members of the Klatoonian family. With few options remaining, Vark confirmed with Shaiz' majordomo the location of the Syndicate's base in Port Kess—the Desert Survey Office —and sent Thanna to confront the Gruv Syndicate's enforcer. The Syndicate forces began to move into position around the Sanctuary. Vark offered Verrick the opportunity to leave, though Verrick refused to abandon his friend despite the odds. Verrick stated that they had two choices. The first option was to wait until they got into position, before launching a siege on their terms. The second option was to rush out and escape on the ship in Vex's palace. Vark refused to abandon Port Vail since the people were counting on him. Verrick decided that they would fight together and both die in the name of honor. When

title: Vex Vark
text: launching a siege on their terms. The second option was to rush out and escape on the ship in Vex's palace. Vark refused to abandon Port Vail since the people were counting on him. Verrick decided that they would fight together and both die in the name of honor. When Vark asked if he were sure he wanted to stay, Verrick replied that it was the way. The Velari majordomo volunteered to go out and try to speak to the Pykes and negotiate their freedom and surrender on Vark's behalf. Vark appeared to agree and wrote out his terms on the majordomo's pad. The majordomo emerged before the Gruv soldiers gathered in front of the Sanctuary and began to read out the "terms of surrender" Vark wrote out to the Gruv commander: "You will leave this planet and your spice trade. If you refuse these terms, the arid sands of Dunemere will once again flourish with flowered fields fertilized with the bodies of your dead." As the Gruv commander lifted his volt pistol , the majordomo reminded him that those were Vark's words. Vark and Verrick soared in on their jetpacks and began to gun the Syndicate soldiers down, standing together as friends, as brothers. With the advantage afforded by their Ferrik armor , weapons and surprise strike, Vark and Verrick took down many soldiers of the Syndicate on their own. Verrick also deployed his whistling birds , taking down several Pykes. However, the numbers proved to be too much even for them and numerous volt pistol shots slowly began to take them down.

title: Vex Vark
text:
Unexpected reinforcements soon arrived in the form of the people from Freetown in a large armored speeder. The surviving members of the Mods arrived and together they managed to drive the Pykes back. Drash and Skad took up position with Vark, Verrick and the people of Freetown. When a Freetowner remarked that they were here to save the tails of cityfolk, Vark told her to save it for the Pykes. They were soon joined by an injured Zazzik, who subdued several Pykes even in his weakened state. Vark helped him to safety while Verrick provided covering fire. Vark was pleased to see Zazzik and promised him a nice long soak in the bacta tank following the battle. Taanti told the defenders that the Pykes were falling back. The fighters began cheering but Verrick detected two approaching Scorpenek annihilator droids through his helmet's scanner. He warned them not to celebrate yet because they had "real problems".

Turning the tide

> " Do it. " ―Vex Vark, ordering his rancor to execute a Scorpnek droid

title: Vex Vark
text:
Turning the tide

> " Do it. " ―Vex Vark, ordering his rancor to execute a Scorpnek droid

The two Scorpenek droids advanced on Vark's forces line, unable to be stopped by volt pistols and even Vark's missiles due to their powerful deflector shields . The armored vehicle they'd been using for cover was soon destroyed, forcing them to flee. Vark and Verrick attempted to take the Scorpeneks on, to little avail due to their powerful shield generators. Even the Darksaber was incapable of piercing through their shields. Vark and Verrick discussed their options, ruling out both energy and kinetic weapons due to the large collateral effect on Port Vail. With instructions for Verrick to protect the others, Vark left for further reinforcements.

title: Vex Vark
text:
As carnage continued to ensue in the city, Vark soon arrived back on his rancor to rescue the others. The rancor slammed the Scorpenek droid into a building, which crumbled under the weight of the war machine. The rancor converged on the ruins of the building. The Scorpenek droid emerged with its shields deactivated, before the rancor once again pummeled the weakened droid, which put up a fierce fight and inflicted several scratches on the rancor. Vark helped by firing at the Scorpenek. The second Scorpenek fired a volley of laser bolts at the rancor. However, the rancor's tough hide absorbed most of the blasts and it resumed the fight. As the Mods and Freetown garrison watched, the rancor ripped one of the gun turret arms off the Scorpenek. After piercing through its red central processing sensor, the rancor ripped the droid apart by pulling off its limbs.

Stand-off with Vorek

> " You gave it a shot. You tried to go straight. But you've got your father's blood pumping through your veins. You're a killer. " ―Cad Vorek, to Vex Vark

title: Vex Vark
text:
Stand-off with Vorek
