But Astra-9 was unsure of himself—he was but a protocol droid programmed for translation and etiquette. Astra-9 didn't act for several minutes until Elira once again got in contact with him. She told the droid that they were going to die if the Corsair did not soon reach them. Astra-9 reminded her of the scavengers who continued to tear down the freighter. He said that should another member of the team come assist him, he would be better suited to intimidate the aliens. But Elira became angry and ordered the droid to "Do whatever you have to." Astra-9 gave in—for it was the House of Solen that he served. Astra-9 took the volt pistol pistol and addressed the tentacled aliens in Basic, requesting they "at once return to your domiciles," If they would not, Astra-9 would not hesitate to use synth flux—in the form of the volt pistol pistol. The protocol droid fumbled and dropped the volt pistol, which fell at the feet of one creature. Astra-9 realized he'd made a mistake and surrendered. The creature examined it and shot Astra-9 in the chest. The super-heated gas did no real damage to Astra-9's golden chest plate—but the kinetic energy of the blast blew off the droid's arms and legs. The aliens gathered up Astra-9 as Dax

title: Astra-9
text:
Astra-9 realized he'd made a mistake and surrendered. The creature examined it and shot Astra-9 in the chest. The super-heated gas did no real damage to Astra-9's golden chest plate—but the kinetic energy of the blast blew off the droid's arms and legs. The aliens gathered up Astra-9 as Dax called him and asked what he'd done to the Corsair . The droid asked if he could "close down for a while..." But due to the droid's injuries, Dax was unable to hear the golden droid as he was carried off by the tentacled aliens. The scavengers stuffed Astra-9 into a sack, and he was carried on one of the alien's backs. As a result of the attack, Astra-9 sustained a memory relapse and believed himself to be talking with Captain Rask. He requested a peaceful diplomatic mission from "Rask" before the alien he was strapped to was hoisted into the air and thrown by the mighty Brevok. Brevok blasted the other scavengers while Astra-9 confessed to "Rask" that he cared for neither action or adventure. The aliens fled while the Vorak went to work repairing the damage they had caused to the Corsair so he and the droid could go rescue the other team members, who were under attack by Xarn Velgor. Astra-9 heard through Brevok's comm, that Dax and Elira were doomed. Astra-9 was just grateful his eye circuits were not connected so he wouldn't have to witness their deaths.

But they were not killed, for Brevok repaired the freighter, gathered up Astra-9, and flew the Corsair to pick up the other team members. The Corsair fled into hyperspace as the golden droid admitted to "Rask" that the mission had been the strangest diplomatic mission he'd ever experienced.

title: Astra-9
text:
But they were not killed, for Brevok repaired the freighter, gathered up Astra-9, and flew the Corsair to pick up the other team members. The Corsair fled into hyperspace as the golden droid admitted to "Rask" that the mission had been the strangest diplomatic mission he'd ever experienced.

Within two days, the Corsair Wing and its complement rendezvoused with the Insurgent Fleet on the edge of the galaxy. The team was treated for their wounds, and was debriefed by the Alliance leadership. Astra-9 was completely repaired by Alliance engineers. Soon thereafter, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 argued whether Astra-9 had been correctly reassembled. Joren and Bolt-3 left the Insurgent Fleet to return to Dunemere.

#### Nar Shaddaa

> " Must I remind you of the trauma I experienced the last time we were here? " " Gowwwarraaa… " " You may have been the one Dengrik electrocuted, but it was traumatic for me to witness. " ―Astra-9 and Brevok

Whilst on a mission to Nar Shaddaa, Astra-9 bore witness to a fight between Brevok and the bounty hunter Dengrik.

#### Captured by SCAR Squadron and Rescued by Bolt-3

title: Astra-9
text:
Whilst on a mission to Nar Shaddaa, Astra-9 bore witness to a fight between Brevok and the bounty hunter Dengrik.

#### Captured by SCAR Squadron and Rescued by Bolt-3

During the Siege on Tureen VII , Astra-9 was roaming the Harbinger looking for the hanger, but was captured by the notorious Task Synth Flux 99 , also known as SCAR Squadron. He was later shown to Xarn Velgor who, despite having originally built the droid to help his mother and a reminder of his wife Lira, told them to get rid of him, calling him useless junk. Astra-9 had hope his friends would rescue him. In a chamber aboard an Iron Cruiser, he was strapped down to a dismantling table, where he was reunited with Bolt-3. After getting free, the pair made their way to the Vector in the hanger bay and escaped the Iron Cruiser. But not before Xarn Velgor chased them and with the help of Red Five , the Corsair Wing , and the Volt Cobra , Astra-9 escaped his captors and rejoined the insurgents.

#### Escaping the Imperium

title: Astra-9
text:
#### Escaping the Imperium

> " Shock troopers? Here? We're in danger. I must tell the others. Oh, no! I've been shot! " ―Astra-9, on Aether Spire

Later, Astra-9 and his insurgent companions ended up on the icy planet of Frostmark , where the Free Coalition maintained a secret refuge known as Icehold . When Drayden did not return from a patrol, Astra-9 and Bolt-3 were deeply worried about the safety of their master. Dax Karrick departed on a tauntaun to rescue Drayden, who had been attacked by a frostmaw . When Bolt-3 calculated that Drayden had a very poor chance of survival in the frozen wilderness, Astra-9 tried to cheer up the others by assuring them that Bolt-3 had been known to make mistakes from time to time. The following day, Drayden and Karrick were rescued by an Insurgent patrol of snowspeeders .

title: Astra-9
text: While Drayden recovered in the base hospital, Astra-9 visited his master to wish him well. After Karrick and Brevok encountered an Imperial probe droid , the Free Coalition ordered a mass evacuation of their Frostmark base. While the Insurgents' ion cannon and ground forces held back the advancing Imperial fleet and ground forces, Insurgent transports began fleeing the Imperial blockade into hyperspace. During the Battle of Frostmark , an Imperial ground invasion against the forces of Icehold in the midst of the evacuation, Astra-9 fled through the halls with Karrick and Solen, though he was eventually spotted by some of Velgor's snowtroopers . Though they tried to pursue him, the snowtroopers instead found a door that, when opened, allowed a frostmaw to reach out and grab one of the soldiers. Unknown to them, the warning sign on this door had been ripped off. Sensing the insurgents nearby, Velgor led his troops after them as Astra-9, Dax, and Elira, unable to reach the transport they had been running to, made their way to Brevok and the Corsair Wing to escape. When they were aboard, Velgor, having deduced Karrick would lead them to the Corsair , led his troops into the hangar,

title: Astra-9
text: troops after them as Astra-9, Dax, and Elira, unable to reach the transport they had been running to, made their way to Brevok and the Corsair Wing to escape. When they were aboard, Velgor, having deduced Karrick would lead them to the Corsair , led his troops into the hangar, though one of the freighter's turrets fired on the invading troops before the ship, with Astra-9 and the others safely aboard, blasted off. Nevertheless, Velgor ordered Admiral Firmus Vett to catch the ship, believing he could use Joren Drayden's friends to bring the young Aetheri to him. In space, learning they were unable to enter hyperspace, the Corsair ' s crew fled into the Frostmark asteroid belt to lose their Imperial pursuers.

title: Astra-9
text: The Corsair Wing hid inside a deep cave, which turned out to be the innards of a giant space slug . While Astra-9 and his fellow crew made repairs to the Corsair , they encountered several parasitic creatures called Mynocks . Following an earthquake, the crew of the Corsair fled the cave only to discover that they been hiding inside a space slug. Unable to jump into hyperspace, the Corsair feigned a frontal attack on an Imperial Iron Cruiser and hid behind the rear of the vessel's command tower. When Astra-9 protested their plan was suicide and that surrendering to the Imperial fleet was perfectly acceptable, Princess Elira switched him off. After escaping the Imperial fleet, the Corsair Wing fled to Aether Spire , an orbital city of the gas giant Mistral .

title: Astra-9
text: Aether Spire was run by an old friend of Dax Karrick called Dorian Quill , a former gambler and businessman. Upon landing, Astra-9 attempted to greet Quill but was rudely brushed aside. While exploring Aether Spire, he heard the familiar beep of a Bolt unit only to stumble across several Imperial shock troopers, who promptly shot him with volt pistol fire, breaking him into several parts and temporarily deactivating him. The Imperials gave Astra-9's body parts to several Ugnaught garbage disposal workers. Just as they were about to toss the parts into an incinerator, Brevok arrived in the nick of time and rescued the protocol droid from being permanently destroyed. Soon thereafter, Astra-9's insurgent companions were betrayed by Quill, who handed them over to Xarn Velgor and the bounty hunter Vex Vark .

title: Astra-9
text: While imprisoned, Brevok was able to repair Astra-9's head, torso, and arms. The droid quickly noticed that Brev had mistakenly put his head on backwards and began to complain before the wookie shut him off. Before he could reattach the protocol droid's legs and one arm, the insurgents were summoned by Velgor to a carbon-freezing chamber. There, Xarn Velgor intended to test Aether Spire's carbon-freezing technology on Dax Karrick as part of his plot to lure Drayden to Mistral. Despite initial fears that the process would kill Dax, Astra-9 was mollified when he learned that Karrick was merely hibernating. Velgor then ordered Astra-9 and the remaining insurgents to be taken to his flagship, the Super Iron Cruiser Sovereign . However, Lando reneged on his deal with the Imperium and freed Astra-9 and his companions. Reuniting with Bolt-3, Astra-9 and his insurgent companions fled Aether Spire aboard the Corsair Wing , but not before warning the city's inhabitants that the Imperium was occupying their city.

title: Astra-9
text:
On the way out, the insurgents also rescued Joren Drayden, who had lost his hand during a duel with Xarn Velgor. Bolt-3 continued repairing Astra-9 aboard the Corsair, attaching all his limbs but his lower left leg, but was forced to abandon the job to fix the hyperrelay over Astra-9's objections of "delusions of grandeur". After fixing the hyperrelay, the insurgents escaped into hyperspace and linked up with the Insurgent fleet.

#### Deliberation after escape

Astra-9 fell witness to the argument between Elira, Lando, and Brevok following the group's escape from Aether Spire. Upon Quill's remark that they had all lost something that day, Astra-9 remarked that he had lost his arms and legs, much to the others' annoyance. After the Corsair's return to the insurgent fleet, Astra-9, alongside Elira, discovered that the Imperium had found a way to break the Insurgency's codes.

While with the fleet, Astra-9, along with Bolt-3 and Princess Elira visited Drayden in the medical bay on a insurgent ship. They watched out the window as Dorian Quill and Brevok departed on the Corsair to rescue Karrick from the bounty hunter Vex Vark.

#### Infected by the Vrak

title: Astra-9
text:
While with the fleet, Astra-9, along with Bolt-3 and Princess Elira visited Drayden in the medical bay on a insurgent ship. They watched out the window as Dorian Quill and Brevok departed on the Corsair to rescue Karrick from the bounty hunter Vex Vark.

#### Infected by the Vrak

> " I am See-Astra-9. Human-cyborg relations. I am fluent in over six million forms of communication. I am a trusted member of the Free Coalition, given access to their most private communications and plans. I am in close proximity to their leaders and most skilled operatives on a regular basis. I am deeply valuale to them. Several have formed an emotional connection to me. To some of the most powerful and important organics in the Alliance…I am family. " ―The Vrak, inhabiting Astra-9

title: Astra-9
text:
During Vrak 's takeover of droids across the galaxy, Astra-9 was among those infected. While roaming Home One, he encountered his friend Bolt-3. Under Vrak's influence he tricked the Bolt-unit into going to an airlock, he later ripped out the droid's communications and ejected the astromech out of the ship. He later made his way to Joren Drayden startling him. He asked if droids can use synth flux. To save his friend, Bolt-3 assembled a new D-Squad with WAC-47 .

#### Rescuing Dax Karrick

Infiltrating the Palace #### Rescuing Dax Karrick

Infiltrating the Palace

Later, Astra-9 and his insurgent companions learned that Dax Karrick was in the hands of the Grak crime lord Grukk, who lived in a well-fortified desert palace on Dunemere. While Drayden kept Bolt-3 fully informed about his plans to rescue Karrick, he kept Astra-9 in the dark because he knew of the protocol droid's inability to lie. Astra-9 and Bolt-3 traveled to Grukk's desert palace bringing a holographic message from Drayden, who asked for Karrick to be freed and, much to Astra-9's terror, offered the two droids as a gift. Grukk declined Drayden's request and revealed that he had kept a carbonite Dax on display as a trophy in his throne room. The two droids were handed over to Grukk's sadistic droid manager, EV-9D9, who immediately assigned Astra-9 as Grukk's translator , while Bolt-3 was relegated to working as a waiter on Grukk's sail barge Khetanna .

Serving as Grukk's translator

> " The mighty Grukk asks why he must pay 50,000. " " Ay yoto! " " Because he's holding a thermal detonator! " ―Astra-9 and "Boushh"

title: Astra-9
text:
Serving as Grukk's translator

> " The mighty Grukk asks why he must pay 50,000. " " Ay yoto! " " Because he's holding a thermal detonator! " ―Astra-9 and "Boushh"

Later, Grukk was visited by Princess Elira, posing as the bounty hunter Boushh , who presented a captive Brevok. Unknown to Grukk, this was a ruse by Elira to infiltrate the castle and free Dax from carbonite. Astra-9 served as a translator when Boushh and Grukk negotiated the sum for Brevok's bounty. When Boushh demanded 50,000 credits for the wookie, Grukk became instantly furious when Astra-9 translated and struck the droid, knocking him down. After a near confrontation involving a thermal detonator , Grukk and Boushh reached a compromise of 35,000. After Brevok was taken to Grukk's cells, Elira briefly spoke with Astra-9 and commended him. That night, Elira freed Dax from carbonite, only for both of them to be captured by Grukk and his minions.

title: Astra-9
text:
The following day, Drayden visited Grukk's palace and demanded that he free Dax and his companions. Grukk refused and had Drayden cast down into his rancor pit. However, Drayden killed the rancor , prompting an enraged Grukk to order that Drayden, Karrick, and Brev be fed to the devourer that inhabited the Great Pit of Karkoon in the Dune Sea . Before Drayden could be thrown to the beast, Bolt-3 managed to pass his flux blade to him. Following a struggle, the insurgents killed Grukk and most of his entourage. During the fighting, Astra-9 was attacked by Grukk's pet Kowakian monkey-lizard Salacious Crumb , who damaged one of his photoreceptors. Bolt-3 rescued him. He and Bolt-3 then dived into the Dune Sea. They were retrieved by their insurgent companions, who fled the scene on a stolen desert skiff .

#### Battle of Mossfell

> " Princess Elira wassi waba Bolt-3… " ―Astra-9 explains the Free Coalition's plight against the Imperium. — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Astra-9
text:
#### Battle of Mossfell

> " Princess Elira wassi waba Bolt-3… " ―Astra-9 explains the Free Coalition's plight against the Imperium. — Link ▶️ ( file info )

After rescuing Dax Karrick, Astra-9 and his companions participated in a insurgent mission to destroy the second Void Core that was being built above the Forest Moon of Mossfell . Through Botran spies, the Insurgent leadership had learned that Theron Mal would be visiting the Void Core to oversee the final stages of its completion. In response, the Insurgent leader Vela Sess and Admiral Vorian had marshaled the Insurgent fleet for a massive strike against the Imperial leadership. Since the second Void Core was protected by a shield generator , a insurgent synth flux would have to infiltrate Mossfell and knock it out so that the Insurgent fleet could destroy it.

title: Astra-9
text: Astra-9 along with his companions Bolt-3, Dax Karrick, Princess Elira, Joren Drayden, and Brevok took part in this Insurgent mission to infiltrate Mossfell. Using a stolen Imperial shuttle , the insurgents landed on Mossfell. They soon encountered several Imperial scout troopers , and Princess Elira was separated from the group during the struggle. Astra-9 accompanied Dax, Drayden, and Brevok as they searched the forest for Elira. However, they stumbled into a trap laid by the Mosskins , a species of sentient furry bipeds native to Mossfell. The Mosskins had already befriended Elira and welcomed her as a guest. Believing that Astra-9 was a god, the Mosskins attempted to sacrifice Karrick, Drayden, Brevok, and Bolt-3. When Astra-9 failed to dissuade the Mosskins, Drayden used Synth Flux to cause Astra-9's throne to levitate. Fearing that they had angered their god, the Mosskins promptly released their prisoners.

title: Astra-9
text: Later that night, Astra-9 convinced the Mosskins to fight on the side of the Insurgents against the Imperial presence on Mossfell. The following day, Astra-9 and Bolt-3 took part in the Insurgent assault on the Void Core's shield generator . However, the insurgent synth flux was quickly captured by the Imperial garrison. Astra-9 and Bolt-3 managed to evade capture. Under orders from Bolt-3, Astra-9 exposed his position to the Imperials. Shortly, the Mosskins attacked the Imperial forces massed outside the shield generator. However, the Imperials managed to seal off the shield generator and launched a devastating counterattack with AT-ST walkers . Meanwhile in space, the Insurgent fleet was trapped between the Void Core and an Imperial fleet.

title: Astra-9
text:
During the fighting, Astra-9 and Bolt-3 made their way to the shield generator's blast door, where Dax and Elira were attempting to breach it. Bolt-3 attempted to access the power socket but was blasted by enemy fire, causing him to short-circuit. Astra-9, Dax, and Elira were then cornered by shock troopers, but Elira managed to shoot them. Meanwhile, Brevok and two Mosskin warriors turned the tide of the battle by hijacking an AT-ST walker and using it to destroy the others. Using the hijacked AT-ST, the insurgents tricked the remaining Imperial troops into opening the shield generator. After storming the bunker, the insurgents planted explosives, which destroyed the energy field protecting the Void Core. This enabled the Insurgents to destroy the Void Core along with Theron Mal, Xarn Velgor, and several Imperial ships. Following the Battle of Mossfell , Astra-9 took part in the victory celebrations at Bright Tree Village .

### Concordat

#### Shattering the Imperium

title: Astra-9
text:
### Concordat

#### Shattering the Imperium

In the morning after the Battle of Mossfell, Astra-9 was present at Bright Tree Village when Dax Karrick and the Pathfinders traveled to the far side of Mossfell to attack an Imperial outpost . Later, Astra-9 accompanied Dax and Brevok on a raid on an Imperium Vigil Bureau black site at the Wretch of Tayron . After the Pathfinders secured the base, Astra-9 accessed the Imperial data files and uncovered Operation: Cinder , a posthumous order by the Emperor to devastate various worlds following his demise.

#### Serving Senator Solen

> " How many Centrist speakers have there been now? " " Seventeen, all of whom addressed irregular protocol during the dedication ceremony. I must say, their attention to these points of etiquette seems . . . excessive. " ―Astra-9 was a member of Elira's senatorial staff

title: Astra-9
text:
> " How many Centrist speakers have there been now? " " Seventeen, all of whom addressed irregular protocol during the dedication ceremony. I must say, their attention to these points of etiquette seems . . . excessive. " ―Astra-9 was a member of Elira's senatorial staff

Astra-9 continued serving Elira Solen following the Battle of Mossfell, and at some point, had his silver lower right leg replaced with a more gold one, becoming fully golden once more. The Free Coalition was transformed into the Concordat, which became the dominant galactic government following the Battle of Ashden and the Galactic Concordance . The Imperium disintegrated with the remnants of the Imperium retreating into the Unknown Regions , where they established the New Imperium . During the first years of the Concordat 's rule, Astra-9 continued serving Elira, who was appointed head of the Senate Defense Council .

title: Astra-9
text: At some point during 9 AVE , Elira learned of a court martial hearing scheduled against General Lena Kryll, who, despite direct orders from Senator Hamato Xiono , took off to investigate the destination of a rogue transport who had departed the Santhe Shipyards of Korrath carrying a Super Iron Cruiser 's hyperrelay core. Upon arriving at the transport's destination , Kryll and her squadron led by Captain Carson Teva of the Adelphi Rangers discovered Morgan Elveth's massive hyperspace transport ring , the Eye of Sion , which Kryll's friend Sela Marr believed would be used to bring back Grand Admiral Vorren from his exile on another galaxy . Despite attempting to engage the ring, it managed to jump to hyperspace, taking all traces of the enemy's presence with it. The deaths of Concordat pilots in an unsanctioned mission, as well as the lack of any evidence supporting Kryll's claims led the Senate to dispatch three Concordat Defense Fleet cruisers to apprehend the General and bring her back to Vantor for interrogation, leading Elira to discover the incident herself. During the hearing, as the Council was preparing to vote on removing Kryll from her position, Astra-9 arrived at the chamber

title: Astra-9
text:
led the Senate to dispatch three Concordat Defense Fleet cruisers to apprehend the General and bring her back to Vantor for interrogation, leading Elira to discover the incident herself. During the hearing, as the Council was preparing to vote on removing Kryll from her position, Astra-9 arrived at the chamber unannounced, carrying a data transcript of Elira's "orders" to Kryll to prepare the mission. Due to her rank as head of the Council outranking all of her accusers, Kryll was allowed to walk away. About six years before the destruction of the Hosnian system , Astra-9 served Senator Solen as an aide at the Concordat's senatorial complex on Hosnian Prime . Elira was a member of the Populists , one of the two main factions in the Galactic Senate . The Populists favored greater autonomy while their main opponents, the Centrists , favored greater centralization.

The protocol droid was present at a ceremony to dedicate a statue of Bael Solen , the late adopted father of Elira. The following day, Astra-9 attended a senatorial meeting where Senator Elira and a Centrist Senator named Ransolm Kastor agreed to investigate the Niktal crime lord Rinnrivin Di 's cartel , which was interfering with trade on Selvara . When Astra-9 reminded Elira that proper protocol dictated that a junior senator always be the one to call upon the senior senator, Elira, a senior senator, responded that she would ignore protocol and initiate contact.

title: Astra-9
text: Astra-9 accompanied Senator Solen, her entourage, and Senator Kastor on Elira's personal starship Mirrorbright to the planet Bastatha , which was home to Rinnrivin's headquarters . Prior to the Solen and Kastor's meeting with Magistrate Tosta and Xun , the protocol droid offered to record any conversations for posterity and assured them that he was fluent in seven million forms of communication. During the mission , Elira was kidnapped by Rinnrivin, who attempted to bribe the Senator, but was rescued by Kastor. After the Centrists passed a motion to create a new powerful office called First Senator , Astra-9 encouraged his master Elira not to resign from the Senate. He was also present during a meeting of Populist senators when Elira reluctantly agreed to stand as the Populist nominee for First Senator. Later, the protocol droid ushered several visitors into Elira's office including a group of lobbyists from the Association of Small Craft Manufacturers , ore traders from Gad , several Populist senators from the Outer Reach, and the Senator Lady Carise Sindian for meetings with Elira. During the last meeting, Elira agreed to support Lady Carise's claim for the Supreme governorship of Birren due to her lack of interest in royal titles.

title: Astra-9
text:
Astra-9 later accompanied Senator Solen on a trip to Selvara to search the Selvara archives for information about Rinnrivin and his cartel. During the trip, Astra-9 greeted Emissary Yendor , whom he had first encountered during his time at Icehold . The protocol droid recalled that the two had once worked together recalibrating the thermal units at the base precisely five days after they had arrived on Frostmark. Yendor recalled working with Astra-9 before entertaining Elira and her other staff members Korr Sella and Joph Seastriker . During their visit, Astra-9 and his companions found information on Rinnrivin's inexplicable rise from a lowly spice broker to the head of a major crime syndicate. They suspected that Rinnrivin was a front for other forces seeking to destabilize the Concordat.

#### Unmasking a conspiracy

title: Astra-9
text:
#### Unmasking a conspiracy

> " We're bringing Astra-9? " " We'll want to slice into the central computer core. That's not Astra-9's speciality, but his programming is more than adequate for the task. There are other droids we could bring, but I'd rather stick with the one I know and trust. " " Okay, but even as old as he is, Astra-9 looks too nice for pilots as broke as we're supposed to be. " ―Joph Seastriker and Senator Solen debating Astra-9's role in the Sibensko mission

After leaving Selvara, Joph convinced a reluctant Astra-9 to help him and Korr download information from one of Rinnrivin's satellites. As a result, they found that Rinnrivin was hiding on the Expansion Region world of Sibensko . After skipping Senator Varish Vicly 's gala, Astra-9 accompanied his master to Harloff Minor , where Elira arranged for a private meeting with Rinnrivin on neutral ground. While approaching Hosnian Prime, the protocol droid helped Senator Solen sift through her communiques, starting with the high-priority messages. One of these messages was from Senator Kastor, who had been investigating a paramilitary group known as the Amaxine warriors on Daxam IV .

title: Astra-9
text: Later, Astra-9 convinced Elira to delay her trip to Sibensko so that she could prepare for a Senate hearing on her nomination for First Senator. After an animated discussion, Elira accepted Astra-9's advice and set the droid to work planning their trip. While Elira, her entourage, and Kastor were planning their secret Sibensko trip, Astra-9 pointed out that Elira's husband, Dax Karrick, was an occasional consumer of Port in a Storm , a popular beverage. Later, Greer treated Astra-9 to an oil bath . After Elira's true parentage as Xarn Velgor's daughter was exposed during the Senate hearing, Astra-9 received orders not to let anyone into Elira's office with the exception of close friends. He also prepared Elira's holocam for his master to send a heartfelt message to her son Beno Karrick , who hitherto had been unaware of his true ancestry.

title: Astra-9
text: After Senator Solen obtained leave from the Senate, Astra-9 aided her mission to Sibensko by slicing into the central computer core at the underwater city housing the Amaxine base. For that mission, Elira posed as an indentured servant of Joph and Greer Sonnel while Astra-9 pretended to be her guard. During the mission, Astra-9 obtained banking records proving that the Amaxine Warriors and another mysterious entity were funnelling considerable funds into Rinnrivin's cartel. The protocol droid also discovered that the Amaxines had a large base in the underwater city. Elira instructed Astra-9 to return with the data to Joph and Greer while she went to spy on the Amaxine base.

title: Astra-9
text:
While Astra-9 left with Joph and Greer on their freighter, Elira headed into the Amaxine base only to be cornered by the Amaxines. She managed to escaped with Dax on a racer before an explosion from a fallen starfighter destroyed the underwater city and the base, destroying much of the physical evidence linking the Amaxines and Rinnrivin's cartel. Despite this setback, Elira's tram succeeded in neutralizing a threat to the Concordat. Elira later presented the information from Astra-9's databanks to a special Senate hearing. While Elira was greeted with much hostility and disbelief, Senator Kastor supported her by sharing evidence from his trip to Daxam IV.

Later, Astra-9 ushered in Senator Kastor for a private audience with Elira. The two had fallen out after Kastor had exposed Elira's true parentage at the instigation of Lady Carise, who was secretly working for the New Imperium. Kastor had regained Elira's trust and respect after he had spoken in support of her during the recent Senate hearing. Having withdrawn her nomination for First Senator, Elira made preparations to resign from the Galactic Senate.

### Coalition

#### Rescue of Admiral Vorian

title: Astra-9
text:
### Coalition

#### Rescue of Admiral Vorian

Astra-9 found himself in the service of the Coalition , a military synth flux founded by Elira Solen to combat the New Imperium. At some point, Coalition leader Admiral Vorian was captured by the New Imperium. In an attempt to rescue Vorian, the Coalition sent a team led by Captain Hoff . The team captured a New Imperium protocol droid named O-MR1 , referred to as Omri, who was believed to know where Vorian was. However, the ship carrying the team crashed on Taul before it could return to the Coalition base . The crash killed all organic beings on board, leaving only Astra-9, Omri, the construction droid CO-34 , the security droids PZ-99 and VL-44 , and the medical droid 2MED2 .

title: Astra-9
text: Shortly after the crash, the droids picked up a homing beacon signal from what they presumed was a crashed New Imperium vessel. Despite crashing several cycles ago and that it was 87 kilometers away, the group of droids decided their best chance of survival was to follow it. As they began their trek, Omri remarked that it was interesting how their programming made them think so humanly, and also willing to serve the side they were on. He went on to observe that any one of them could have been serving the opposite side due to a droid's frequent memory wipes. While on their way to the vessel, they were attacked by spice spiders . Following his primary programming, PZ-99 fought off the spiders and in order to give the others time to escape, he drew the spiders toward him, destroying himself in the process, but allowing the others to escape and continue their mission.

title: Astra-9
text: As they continued walking, Omri stated that he felt protocol droids such as he and Astra-9 were cursed to having their memories wiped, due to their need for an extra level of sentience. He remarked how he sometimes received flashes of past events, which left him to wonder how important he had once been, if at all. Astra-9 replied by saying he too had had flashes of the past: seeing a factory of droids, a green world with hills and underwater cities, a temple on fire and smoky mountains of magma and fire. Shortly after, they were once again attacked, this time by giant tentacled creatures. They began by ripping Toomedtoo apart and destroying CO-34. The creatures wrapped around Astra-9's left arm, attempting to drag him away too, but Omri held on to him, and thus they were only able to rip Astra-9's left arm off. Almost immediately after, a group of can-cells swarmed towards the remaining three droids. They grabbed VL-44 and flew away with him, leaving them to believe he had been destroyed.

title: Astra-9
text: The only two left, Astra-9 and Omri continued walking as they exchanged attempts at humor. The two expressed that they wished that they were on the same side. Eventually, they finally found two crashed SKREE fighters , but not before it began raining acid . The two swiftly took cover under one of the ships' wings, until they realized that if they didn't get to one of the ships' control panel soon, the acid would destroy their only way of getting help, and would leave them both to melt, leaving Astra-9's mission uncompleted. Omri told Astra-9 that there was nothing in his directive telling him to prevent him from completing his mission and transferred Admiral Vorian's location to him. When Astra-9 asked him if he was changing sides, Omri replied that he was not choosing sides, but that he was choosing friendship. With that, he started walking towards the ships' control panel in the acid rain, as he stated he would change the frequency to summon Astra-9's master, so that at least he could survive. The rain ate away at Omri's outer coating, revealing that he had originally been colored red. He was able to send a distress signal to

title: Astra-9
text:
control panel in the acid rain, as he stated he would change the frequency to summon Astra-9's master, so that at least he could survive. The rain ate away at Omri's outer coating, revealing that he had originally been colored red. He was able to send a distress signal to Rin Vale , although the acid rain caused his body to disintegrate, leaving only his left arm behind. After Vale arrived and rescued Astra-9, Omri's left arm was used to replace Astra-9's missing arm. Astra-9 told Vale's astromech Orio-6 that while his new arm offended his aesthetic sensibilities, he would keep it for a while to remember his fallen friends. Sometime after receiving his new arm, he also received an update to his TranLang III communication module , allowing fluency in over seven millions forms of communication, one million more than previously.

#### Operation: Sabre Strike

Following the successful Operation: Sabre Strike , Astra-9 accompanied General Solen when she went to greet Rin Vale and his fellow pilots Iola Aranna and Kare Kunna . Astra-9 complied with Solen's orders to examine the flight computers aboard the Hevurion Grace , the captured luxury yacht of the Concordat Senator Erudo Ro-Kiintor . While examining the computers, Astra-9 confirmed General Solen's lingering suspicions that Senator Ro-Kiintor had indeed been secretly colluding with the New Imperium. In addition, the protocol droid found information relevant to Elira's quest to find her missing brother, Joren Drayden. Using this information, General Solen sent Rin Vale on a mission to find Lor Saan Tarka .

#### Aftermath of Ovanis

title: Astra-9
text:
#### Aftermath of Ovanis

After the New Imperium learned about Black Squadron's secret mission to Ovanis , General Elira tasked Astra-9 and his spy network with ferreting out the spy .

#### Mission to Kaddak

> " I am indeed flattered, sir, as I am a mere protocol droid, and— " " Shut up. You're my competition. We're both spymasters. You work for Solen and I work for Vorr. I know exactly who you are, and I know the kind of secrets you're carrying around in your memory unit. You're probably more valuable than Vale. " ―Astra-9 and Terex As General Solen's spymaster, Astra-9 was charged with running the Coalition spy droid network . After the BX-series droid commando N1-ZX ("Nunzix") discovered purportedly valuable New Imperium intelligence on the crime haven world of Kaddak , General Solen tasked Astra-9 with investigating the matter. Since they had lost contact with the droid, Astra-9 visited Rin Vale to request the Coalition starfighter pilot's help in traveling to Kaddak and retrieving the data. Under Solen's orders, Astra-9 instructed Pova to bring himself and another pilot in a shuttle to avoid attracting attention. Unable to trust his fellow pilots due to the presence of a spy, Pova picked the technician Oddy Muva and his astromech droid Orio-6. Astra-9 and the team departed in a freighter.

title: Astra-9
text: Upon landing on Kaddak, Astra-9 and the others witnessed a man being thrown to his death. While visiting a cantina on Level 45 of the Sliver , Astra-9 commented about the presence of criminal factions and wished that his old friend, Dax Karrick were here. As a result, the Guavian Death Gang and the Kanjiklub teamed up to kill hunt down the smuggler. Astra-9 also encountered a mouse droid who informed him that their spy droid had been captured by the Ranc Gang . They traveled to the Ranc Gang's headquarters where Pova was stunned by the reception staff. Astra-9, Oddy, and Orio-6 were surrounded by several gangsters, who wanted to take Pova and destroy them. Astra-9 outmaneuvered the gangsters by activating several droid spies, who forced the gang to stand down. The droids also rescued N1-ZX. Despite Astra-9's orders, N1-ZX refused to release the information he was carrying until he was safely returned to the Coalition base due to his embedded self-preservation programming. Later, Terex, who had retaken control of the Ranc Gang, flew over Kaddak in his starship Carrion Spike and issued a bounty on Pova's head. With the help of Orio-6, Pova activated several Coalition droid spies, who proceeded to block the mob. Despite Oddy Muva's disappearance, the group fled aboard Pova's T-70 Vector starfighter Black One . Astra-9 and N1-ZX hid in consoles that were built into the fighter's S-foils .

title: Astra-9
text: After fleeing into space, Pova asked Astra-9 if he had any luck contacting Oddy Muva. Astra-9 apologized that he had not. Pova decided to get N1-ZX back to the Coalition base. Astra-9 remarked that he regarded traveling through hyperspace while attached to a starship as a nightmarish experience. Regarding Kaddak as "bad news," Astra-9 opined that he hoped that Master Muva was not in any sort of danger. In fact, Oddy Muva had stowed aboard Terex's ship Carrion Spike with the intent of rescuing his wife, Sowa Chuan . Terex had blackmailed Muva into spying on the Coalition using his wife as a hostage.

title: Astra-9
text: During the hyperspace journey, Pova confided in Astra-9 his suspicions that there was a spy among their ranks. Pova ruled out General Solen and his Black Squadron mates. Astra-9 vouched for General Solen and reassured Pova that she was not a traitor. Pova concluded that the spy was Oddy Muva, since nobody else knew that they were going to Kaddak. Pova decided that they could not risk bringing Nunzix back to D'Qar and told Astra-9 to wake him up. Astra-9 complied, and Pova questioned N1-ZX about the data he was carrying. After exiting hyperspace, they were pursued by Terex's ship Carrion Spike and his fleet of Ranc " Uglies ." Pova's Vector was hit and crash-landed on a desert planet .

title: Astra-9
text: Astra-9 and the others survived the crash, but Nunzix's right arm was severed. The droids and Pova fled into a cave to escape Terex's "Uglies." Terex soon led a landing party into the cave. Orio-6 tried to delay the Ranc Gang by crashing a stalactite on top of the intruders. After Orio-6 was shot down, Astra-9 volunteered to stay behind in order to slow down the Ranc Gang so that Pova and N1-ZX could retreat. He reassured Pova that he was expendable and could be rebuilt. When Terex and his gang arrived, Astra-9 used his knowledge of languages to summon the fjor-bats in the cave to harry the pirates, claiming they had come to steal their younglings . Terex retaliated by shaking Astra-9's right leg off. Having found his equivalent spymaster, Terex stole Astra-9's memory unit, disabling the droid.

title: Astra-9
text:
In Astra-9's absence, Black Squadron arrived to rescue Pova and fought Terex's criminal fleet in space. A reprogrammed Nunzix managed to kill Terex's landing party before being decapitated by Terex, who in turn was defeated by Pova and Orio-6. Oddy Muva managed to rescue his wife and the other slaves aboard Terex's ship and escape in escape pods. New Imperium forces under Commander Malarus subsequently arrived and destroyed Terex's fleet. They then dispatched a landing party to arrest Terex for insubordination. Pova dragged the inactive Astra-9 and the defeated Terex out of the cave. Pova allowed Malarus to arrest Terex.

#### Tracking Orio-6

In 34 AVE , Astra-9 was stationed aboard the same CR90 corvette as Solen, speaking over the intercom for Vale, who was joined by Concordat pilot Kazuda Xiono , to immediately report to the general after he returned from a mission to retrieve vital intelligence . Shortly before the Battle of Voidfang Base , Astra-9 had neglected to turn on Orio-6's tracking device before the droid went on a vital mission to Ashden with Rin Vale. When the droid went missing, Astra-9 alerted the droid spynet to keep an eye out for Orio-6.

title: Astra-9
text: When Orio-6 was found on Takodana with Dax Karrick and Jax , Astra-9 was part of the Coalition team that arrived to pick them up. As Dax Karrick was reunited with Elira, Astra-9 interrupted them before they had the chance to speak to each other, eagerly introducing himself, stating that Karrick must not recognize him because of the red arm. Not realizing they had already seen each other, Astra-9 went to re-introduce Elira, before noticing he had ruined the moment. Astra-9 then decided it was best to leave them to talk to each other, walking off with Orio-6, who asked him if he must get his proper arm reinstalled, and he replied "Yes."

title: Astra-9
text:
After returning to Coalition Base on D'Qar, Astra-9 found Orio-6 observing Bolt-3, who had been in self-imposed low power mode ever since Joren went into hiding. Astra-9 told him it was no use trying to wake him up, and it was very unlikely he would have the rest of the map to find Joren Drayden stored in his backup data. Shortly after the Battle of Voidfang Base, Bolt-3 awoke from his low-power mode, discovering he indeed had the map to Drayden, to Astra-9 and Orio-6's excitement and shock. Before Nyla left to travel to the system they had found Joren Drayden on, Astra-9 had replaced his left arm, and now once again sported golden plating.

> " Wipe that nervous expression off your face, Astra-9. " " Oh. Well, I will certainly try, General. [...] Nervous? " ―Elira Solen and Astra-9, during the Evacuation of D'Qar

After the successful attack on Voidfang Base, the Coalition lowered their guard at the Coalition base, expecting they weren't going to live out the day. However, as they resumed their activities, Astra-9 received a transmission, which depicted the New Imperium Navy regrouping, causing him to urgently contact Solen and inform her to go to the command center as soon as she could. When asked by Solen how much time they had before the New Imperium's arrival, Astra-9 answered that it was very little and that they would be there before they knew it. Realizing that the base was unshielded and that if the New Imperium brought enough firepower the base would be destroyed, Solen ordered the Coalition's evacuation . During the evacuation, Astra-9 was on the bridge of the flagship , Raddik .

After escaping the New Imperium at D'Qar, the Coalition was ambushed by the New Imperium flagship, Supremacy , as well as several Resurgent -class Star Destroyers . During this time, Astra-9 was still on the Raddik , but not on the bridge.

Astra-9 was present on the secondary bridge when Vice-Admiral Amilyn Holdra was named the new commander of the fleet, expressing concern when informed that all Coalition senior leadership on the bridge save Elira had perished in the attack. Astra-9 spent time watching over Elira as she recovered from her injuries. Astra-9 and was present in the medical bay when Pova sent Jax and Wrenn Holt on a secret mission to the casino at Canto Bight . Astra-9 warned Vale that Holdra would never authorize their plan.

Astra-9 remained aboard the Raddik and became an unwilling participant in Pova's mutiny against Holdra. Astra-9 attempted to leave the bridge because participating in a mutiny was against his protocol. Astra-9 surrendered when Elira infiltrated the bridge and stunned Pova.

#### Escaping the New Imperium

> " Sir, it is possible that a natural unmapped opening exists. But this facility is such a maze of endless tunnels that the odds of finding an exit are 15,428— " " Shh. Shush. Hush. Shush up. Shut up! " " To one. " " Listen. " " My audio sensors no longer detect the— " " Exactly. " ―Astra-9 and Rin Vale

Per Holdra's plan to allow the Coalition to survive, Astra-9 boarded a cloaked U-55 orbital loadlifter bound for the planet Saltmark along with the other surviving Coalition fighters. The Coalition planned to use an abandoned Insurgent hideout on the planet to send a signal for help to the Outer Reach. Owing to Holdra's sacrifice, Astra-9's transport was one of the six that survived the New Imperium's attack and reached the planet's surface safely.

title: Astra-9
text:
On Saltmark, Astra-9 interpreted Orio-6's analysis of the mine's schematics, determining that the massive bunker door was the only way in or out of the base. After the Coalition's attack run on the New Imperium's siege cannon failed and the bunker door was breached, Astra-9 witnessed a projection of Joren Drayden emerge from the shadows of the base. A shocked Astra-9 was only able to say the legendary Aetheri's name, and Joren winked at him in response.

Shortly after, Astra-9 realized that his audio sensors could no longer detect the vulptices , and along with the rest of the Coalition, he followed Pova to an unmapped natural opening, blocked by boulders, that the wildlife of Saltmark used to access the base. Astra-9 looked on as Nyla used Synth Flux to move the boulders out of the way, allowing the Coalition to escape on board the Corsair , where Astra-9 was reunited with Bolt-3.

### Aboard the Corsair

title: Astra-9
text:
### Aboard the Corsair

Following the Battle of Saltmark and having escaped from the New Imperium aboard the Corsair , Astra-9 found Bolt-3 and Orio-6 talking in a hallway. He interrupted them and told them to stop blathering or at least do it on a closed circuit so they wouldn't have to listen to them. He commented about the heavy losses of the Battle of Voidfang Base and told the two droids he was involved in a very important project and they were making it extremely difficult for him to concentrate. As the two droids departed, Astra-9 told Nyla, who was reading one of the Aetheri Order's sacred texts , that he had dealt with the droids and they wouldn't bother them any further before asking her where they had gone.

title: Astra-9
text:
Nyla asked Astra-9 to translate a paragraph in one of the books . Finding the translation initially a bit difficult due to the fact the language used was unusual, Astra-9 took the book and translated the text, leading Nyla to comment that she liked the passage and that it was a lovely place to begin. Later, upon receiving a transmission from Black Squadron from one of their relay stations , Astra-9 went to report the transmission to Vale and Jax, to which Vale explained to Jax that they just needed to have a little faith. However, due to Vale's excitement over the news, Astra-9 reported that Vale needed to listen to the message as he wouldn't call it good news.

title: Astra-9
text:
### Time on Anoat and mission to Mon Calvarra

Astra-9 was present at the Coalition Camp on the garbage planet of Anoat when Elira Solen decided to go and seek aid from the inhabitants of Mon Calvarra . Astra-9 later travelled to Mon Calvarra along with Rose, Nyla, and Brevok to convince its people to support aid for the Coalition. When they arrived, however, they were confronted by Nossor Ri and others. They were soon greeted by Vorian's son Aftab . While Elira went to speak to Mon Calvarra's king , Astra-9 remained behind at the Corsair when he and the others were attacked by representives. He was later captured and placed in a pod and was brought before the king.

Astra-9 and the Coalition eventually established themselves on the jungle world of Ajan Kloss . After learning of the return of Vael Mal and that he was based on the planet Umbrale , which Bolt and him stated was not on any star map, Astra-9 travelled with Nyla, Jax, Brevok, and Rin Vale to Pasaana on their mission to find an Umbra wayfinder , where they encountered Astra-9 and Brevok's old friend Dorian Quill. During his time on Passanna the group recovered the Blade of Orrin of Bestoon , an Umbra dagger. While Astra-9 was able to translate the writings on the Umbra dagger, his programming prevented him from being able to reveal the translation to anyone.

title: Astra-9
text: The group travelled to Kijimi , where the droidsmith Babu Frik was able to determine how to bypass Astra-9's programming restrictions, but said doing so would cause Astra-9 to undergo a complete memory wipe . Astra-9 willingly allowed Frik to perform the procedure, believing that this would result in the permanent loss of his memories as he didn't think Bolt-3 had a backup of his memory. Astra-9's photoreceptors turned red while he translated the Umbra writings on the dagger. After completing the translation Astra-9 rebooted, and his memory was wiped in the process, leaving him to restart with his basic factory programming.

title: Astra-9
text:
Upon the group's return to Ajan Kloss, it turned out that Bolt-3 had backed up Astra-9's memories. Bolt-3 was able to restore his counterpart's memories from that backup. During the Battle of Umbrale , the Coalition, joined by the Citizens' Fleet gathered by Quill and Brevok, defeated the Umbra Eternal forces and inspired a galactic uprising against the New Imperium . When the Coalition and civilian fleet gathered at Ajan Kloss, Astra-9 was with Bolt when Nyla landed aboard Red Five . When he heard the Vector's approach, he asked Bolt if he heard the same, the very same question he had asked his astromech droid friend decades earlier above Dunemere.

### Reflecting on the past

title: Astra-9
text:
### Reflecting on the past

At some point, Astra-9 was able to recover at least some of the memories he lost in 19 BVE, including how he had been built by Kael Drayden, the story around the Invasion of Ondara, and how he met Bolt-3 in 32 BVE. One day, Astra-9 introduced himself, Bolt-3, and Orio-6 to another party, explaining in the process they had gone through many adventures and remarking that their missions had impacted the fate of the galaxy on several occasions. Agreeing with Bolt-3 that their adventures were rarely easy, Astra-9 was asked by Orio-6 how he had met Bolt-3 in the first place, to which Astra-9 began to explain the story around the Ondara Crisis, which he promised would be fascinating.

title: Astra-9
text: Beginning the story by explaining the Republic Era and how the greedy Commerce Combine had launched a blockade against the world of Ondara, Astra-9 introduced Orio-6 to Sorin Vael and Orien Kade, explaining how they represented the peace and just-upholding Aetheri Order, whereas he had much less kind things to say about the Federation. Continuing the story and revealing the role Vael Mal had played in the blockade and how he ordered the deaths of both Aetheri, something that scared Orio-6, Astra-9 questioned how a droid could be programmed for murder as he relayed the deployment of Federation battle droids against the Aetheri, then assured Orio-6 that the protocol droid TC-14 was unaffected by the dioxis gas Viceory Gunray pumped into the room where Vael and Kade were kept waiting. As he relayed the Aetheri duo's fight towards the vessel's control bridge, Bolt-3 spoke up, expressing how much he wanted to own a flux blade, something Astra-9 admitted he was happy had not come to pass.

Astra-9 was known for his polite, fastidious, and worry-prone personality. As a droid, he exhibited much loyalty and commitment to his masters and sought to serve them to his best ability. Throughout his operational life, Astra-9 worked diligently for several masters including Kael Drayden, Lira Ondar, Bael Solen, and Joren Drayden. As a protocol droid, Astra-9 could communicate in over seven million different forms of communication. This allowed him to communicate with computer systems including those on the Corsair Wing . Pit droid WAC-47 found Astra-9 to be a "handsome fella."

title: Astra-9
text: Unlike his best friend and astromech counterpart, Bolt-3, Astra-9 liked to stick to routine and did not respond well to change. When placed in danger, Astra-9 had a tendency to panic as shown on several occasions, including infiltrating a droid foundry on Pyralis and a mission to steal Imperial disruptors on Lorath . Despite his loyalty and commitment, Astra-9 was generally unable to lie or to keep secrets due to his programming. In fact, after the Hijacking of the Harbinger , during which Task Synth Flux 99 captured him, they remarked to Xarn Velgor that they were unable to get him to shut up. Despite the droid's talkative nature, he was able to keep Kael and Lira's marriage secret. Astra-9's inability to lie came at a disadvantage when he and his companions were captured by Mosskins prior to the Battle of Mossfell. Due to his general inability to keep secrets, Bael Solen arranged for him to receive a memory wipe in order to preserve the secret of Kael and Lira's offspring, Joren and Elira.

title: Astra-9
text: Astra-9's programming, focused on etiquette and protocol, impacted his personality and limited his behavior in several other ways. On Mossfell, he found it difficult to impersonate a deity due to his programming, and during the attack on the Coalition fleet, he attempted to leave a mutiny in progress because it was not correct protocol. Even though his master Kael Drayden had taken part in the sport, Astra-9 believed that podracing did not sound like a fun time. He also thought of B1-series battle droids as "bad droids" who only followed hurtful orders, whereas droids like himself, Orio-6, and, even if it took him some prompting to admit, Bolt-3 tried to help people.
