title: Brevok
text: Brevok piloted the Corsair to Nar Shaddaa while Drayden sat in the co-pilot's seat, reflecting on their prior encounter there with Grukkar the Grak. The Vorak traveled to Oruba Square alongside Astra-9, where he convened with a cloaked Mirialan. Brevok paid the informant, who then relayed to him that his contact, Sagor, would meet his fellow Vorak at the entrance to the local arena. The Vorak rebuffed Astra-9's complaints, claiming that Nar Shaddaa was "charming," not dreadful as the protocol droid has proposed, and reflected on his prior traumatic electrocution on the Smuggler's Moon before catching wind of "a familiar smell." Brevok barged into the crowd before bumping into an old acquaintance—cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Varrick.

title: Brevok
text: The cyborg recognized Brevok as Karrick's ally, while Brevok remembered Varrick's participation a shootout against the two smugglers on Abregado-Raena. The Vorak hoisted Varrick off his feet and growled at him, the bounty hunter claiming the situation to be a misunderstanding. Varrick's partner, rival bounty hunter Dengrik, watched, while Astra-9 flustered about Brevok's failure to maintain a low profile against Drayden's orders. Varrick punched Brevok, refusing to allow anyone to interfere in his own search for Karrick, while trying to defuse the situation. The bounty hunter lowered his palm volt pistols in deference, providing Brevok the opportunity to throw him into a table where Dengrik had taken a seat and ordered a drink.

title: Brevok
text:
Brevok then grabbed Dengrik, the very bounty hunter to electrocute the Vorak on his last outing to the Smuggler's Moon, Astra-9 informing him that the species were notorious for holding grudges. Dengrik pulled his volt pistol and attempted to shoot the Brevok, despite an attempt at intervention from Varrick, who then kicked the Vorak's legs out from under him and fashioned a sharpened stick out of a nearby pole. Varrick spoke to the events of Abregado-Raena, telling Brevok that he did not intend to kill them once he realized Karrick was the target, throwing down his weapon and reflecting on his time spent with Karrick as Imperial cadets. The bounty hunter concluded that he owed Karrick a debt and intended to aid him with or without the Vorak's permission.

The fight at its end, Brevok offered Varrick a hand up. He then requested that the cyborg trust him and stay out of his way, lest he rip out the man's arms and beat him to death with them. Astra-9 translated for the bounty hunter, who did not understand Vorak tongue, before departing with the Vorak.

Drayden and Sagor

title: Brevok
text:
Drayden and Sagor

> " HROOO! " " Brevok is reluctant to leave without more information on Vex Vark. " " Brev, we don't even know if it was Vex Vark. I think…we might have to find another way to track down Dax. " " ARRRGH! " ―Brevok, Astra-9, and Joren Drayden

Brevok met with Sagor, embracing him as Astra-9 explained their history to Drayden. Sagor informed Brevok that a new champion had risen in the Garkata arena; a larger than life hologram displayed the fighter, whose Ferrik armor, Drayden confirmed, indeed resembled Vex Vark, though the figure was operating under the name Garrick. Sagor, who worked a guard at the arena, led the Brevok and his allies to there to check its records for clues to "Garrick"'s current location. Drayden bribed and questioned the Pa'lowick attendant, only for them to betray the insurgents, summoning a band mercenaries working for the Kanji Criminal Enterprise.

title: Brevok
text:
Drayden drew his flux blade and attempted to talk his way past the criminals, culminating in a fight. Brevok joined in the confrontation with his bowcaster, but the group became overwhelmed, leading the Aetheri to suggest a retreat. The Vorak voiced his reluctance to leave without more information, but Drayden, unable to say for certain whether the arena warrior was indeed Vark, doubled down on the decision to escape. Brevok fired off a final round of support fire but left with Drayden, Sagor, and Astra-9.

The insurgents and Sawga encountered more hired guns. Drayden, under fire, directed Brevok to commandeer a nearby speeder, which the four used to successfully return to the Corsair . The Vorak later headed to the Corsair ' s cockpit, where he received a transmission from Solen, instructing the ship to return to the Insurgent Fleet, as she had received a transmission from a mystery party claiming to be in possession of Karrick. Brevok, requesting that the Aetheri join him, relayed the message to Drayden via Astra-9.

#### Arrival at Jekara

title: Brevok
text:
#### Arrival at Jekara

> " HROOOO! " " What? What's the matter, Brevok? Who's Carmine Dawn? " " HRRAGH! HROOO. HRRRRGH! " " If you will allow me to translate, Master Joren…It seems that Carmine Dawn was an extremely powerful criminal organization particularly known for tactics involving savagery and deception. While they have not been active in the galaxy for many years, Brevok has had dealings with them in the past. It did not go well. If they have returned and are in possession of Master Karrick, it could be a very delicate and dangerous situation indeed. " ―Brevok, Joren Drayden, and Astra-9

title: Brevok
text:
Solen rendezvoused with the others aboard the Corsair , declaring it was finally time to save Karrick. Drayden, though enthusiastic, raised concerns, leading Solen to produce a hologram sent by her friend and informant Amilyn Holdra. Solen told Drayden Hold had informed her that Karrick was being held by Carmine Dawn, sending Brevok into an agitated state. Astra-9 translated Brevok for Drayden, who was unaware of Carmine Dawn, as the Vorak conveyed the reputation and history of the crime syndicate. The Vorak also reluctantly suggested involving Quill, to which Solen gave the go-ahead. Brevok then departed, Astra-9 accompanying him. Brevok spoke to Quill aboard the insurgent frigate Redemption , where Quill affirmed his willingness to help. The Vorak later piloted the Corsair through hyperspace to Jekara, where the auction was to be held. Brevok backed Quill's assessment of Carmine Dawn to Solen before announcing their arrival. Shortly after, the Corsair suffered a minor collision with a frigate that emerged from hyperspace immediately in front of it. The ship, belonging to the Black Sun, launched its fighters, which fired on and pursued the insurgents' craft, leading Brevok to take it into Jekara's atmosphere. Navigating the planet's icy terrain, the Vorak managed a crash landing before emerging from the Corsair with Solen and the others, the princess claiming that the team was Karrick's only hope.

#### The auction

> " Though…my olfactory sensors detect the distinctive odor of singed Vorak fur. Are you quite all right? " " HNGGH. " " Set on fire? By Vex Vark? My goodness! The pain must be extraordinary! " " Brev's as tough as they come. Right, old buddy? Now hit it! Let's get out of here! " " HRRAGH! " ―Astra-9, Brevok, and Dorian Quill

title: Brevok
text:
Brevok, Quill, and Solen infiltrated the auction for Karrick, only to encounter Vex Vark, who Solen ordered the Vorak to take down quietly. Vark taunted Brevok with the braids of former Vorak opponents adorning his armor, causing the hairy insurgent to slam the bounty hunter into a wall, blocking Solen's line of sight with her volt pistol pistol. Quill dissuaded Solen from using a volt pistol and causing a disruption, instead trusting Brevok's superiority in hand-to-hand combat. Brevok tackled his opponent, but Vark torched the Vorak with his flamethrower, leading Quill to put out the fire with his cape. Vark then left, desiring no further trouble.

Seeing the host of the auction, Lady Vessa of Carmine Dawn, beaten by Xarn Velgor, who had earlier arrived unannounced to claim Karrick for himself, Quill observed that the woman probably deserved what was coming to her, causing Brevok to object to the sentiment. Quill elaborated that Vessa's fate had been of her own making; Vessa would not sacrifice her life for Quill, nor the Vorak. Velgor reflected on the Heroes of Cinderfall, Brevok included, as he considered Drayden.

title: Brevok
text:
Solen signaled Drayden, but the Aetheri was unable to fight Velgor, leading Elira to formulate a plan herself. The general rallied Brevok, outlining a plan in which she would occupy the Umbra Lord with volt pistol fire from above while the Vorak engaged him on the ground before Quill interrupted. As Solen and Quill debated, Drayden managed to distract Velgor by taunting him and fleeing in his Vector, leading Solen, Quill, and Brevok to return to the Corsair . Astra-9, who had repaired the ship along with Lobot, inquired about the Vorak's odd smell, to which he related the details of his fight with Vex Vark.

#### Insurgents in space

> " Brevok says the ship's diagnostic computer is back online, as Lando suggested it would be. He will begin repairing vital systems immediately. " " That's wonderful, Brev. " ―Astra-9 and Elira Solen, to Brevok

title: Brevok
text:
#### Insurgents in space

> " Brevok says the ship's diagnostic computer is back online, as Lando suggested it would be. He will begin repairing vital systems immediately. " " That's wonderful, Brev. " ―Astra-9 and Elira Solen, to Brevok

The insurgents pursued the Imperial shuttle that had taken Karrick, utilizing Lobot's implants to disable it. Vark and Beilert Varrick, with whom Vark had temporarily partnered, also aimed to capture Karrick, and incapacitated the Corsair with a reduced–intensity seismic charge. Dead in space, Brevok assisted Quill in attempting to repair the ships's systems from the cockpit. The Vorak observed that Vark's charge had rattled the Corsair , and Quill concurred that it had knocked various systems offline. Brevok also observed Grak starfighters heading towards the Imperial shuttle that was carrying Karrick, which Lando attributed to Grukk the Grak desiring Dax for himself.

title: Brevok
text: The trio went into the bowels of the Corsair to repair the ship, which proved hazardous as the offline engines caused the reactor conduits to let off a repeating cycle of bursts. Both Solen and Brevok volunteered to make the repairs, but Quill opted to fix the problem himself, the Vorak pulling him out at the last minute to prevent him from being fried. Quill told Brevok that the ship's diagnostic computer should be back online; the Vorak headed to the cockpit and confirmed as much to Astra-9, who relayed the good news to Solen. Solen offered to help conduct repairs, but Brevok believed that she would only get in the way. The Vorak was subsequently able to restore many of the Corsair ' s systems.

title: Brevok
text:
The Graks dispatched fighters to intercept Karrick, causing Brevok to scream at Quill for his role in precipitating the situation as Solen related the situation to Drayden over the ship's comms. With the repairs made, Quill and the Vorak succeeded in restarting the ships' engines. Solen noted that the point was moot—Karrick had already been brought aboard the Super Iron Cruiser Sovereign —when the Corsair received a message from the Imperial ship arranged by Vessa, inviting them to board.

Once safely aboard and welcomed by an agent of Carmine Dawn, Brevok participated in the insurgent attack, downing shock troopers alongside Solen and Quill. The insurgents, heaving reached Karrick, incapacitated all of the Imperials. Quill began trying to figure out how to defrost Karrick from carbonite when the group was approached and held at volt pistol-point by Vex Vark. At that moment, an errant blast blew out the Sovereign ' s hull, sending Karrick into space. Vark pursued the carbonite brick with his jetpack, leaving the insurgents devastated at their near victory.

#### Dawn of a revelation

title: Brevok
text:
#### Dawn of a revelation

> " I…I can't believe it. Dax's…alive? " " HRRRAOH? " " It's true, Brevok. Grukk has him. " " HRAAAOH! " ―Elira Solen, Brevok, and Vessa

Solen later confided in Brevok aboard the Corsair , sharing a newfound belief that hope was "for suckers," causing the Vorak to pull her into a comforting embrace. Quill and Lobot sought to return the pair to the Alliance but were interrupted by the arrival of the Vermillion , Carmine Dawn's flagship. The insurgents then received a transmission indicating from Lady Vessa indicating that she wished to meet with the princess. Solen relented, and Vessa boarded the Corsair , the Vorak keeping his bowcaster trained on her until the women left to talk in private.

The princess later called Brevok to provide her with a pair of binder cuffs, intending to bring Vessa before a insurgent tribunal. However, Vessa provided the revelation that Karrick was alive, stunning Solen and causing the Vorak to cry out and drop the binders. Solen ultimately allowed Vessa to leave to the ends of pursuing a possible future alliance.

#### Readying for assault

title: Brevok
text:
#### Readying for assault

> " Brev's been spending his time practicing an assault on Grukk the Grak's palace. He's visualizing it in his head, planning his assault. He even programmed training droids to act like Grukk's guards. He wants to go in there all alone to bring out Dax Karrick . " ―Elira Solen, to Vessa

Reunited with the fleet, Brevok was present at a insurgent strategy meeting headed by Senator Vela Sess and Admiral Gial Vorian aimed at addressing the Alliance's long–standing secondary objectives, including re-establishing a supply chain and recovering Lieutenant Shara Bay, trapped on the Iron Cruiser Varrix's Will .

Lady Vessa visited Home One and wished to visit Brevok before her departure. Elira Solen took her to the Vorak, explaining that he was practicing a simulated assault on Grukk's palace. Brevok had programmed remotes to act as Grukk's sentries and vividly visualized the attack in his mind. He desired to rescue Dax Karrick single-handedly, a course of action Vessa described as ill-advised. Interrupted by Solen and Vessa, Brev shot the latter a look for her role in recent events, a finger on his bowcaster's trigger.

#### The hunt for Zhara and Unity Day

title: Brevok
text:
#### The hunt for Zhara and Unity Day

> " Hello, beast . " " RRGH! " " Shame you have to die . You should be back with your people. In the mines . […] " " HROOAH! " " AAAH! " ―Commander Ellian Zhara and Brevok

Brevok joined Solen in her hunt for Commander Zhara on the planet Panisia, pursuing her into a cave. One of the insurgent Pathfinders offered him a knife, only for the Vorak to reveal that he had brought one himself. The insurgents eventually found Zhara, who engaged both the Pathfinders and Brevok in melee combat, incapacitating the former and seemingly gaining the upper hand over the latter.

The Imperial focused her attention on Kes Vale and consequently turned her back on Brevok, who hurled her over a ledge and into a cavern below. Solen, who had been similarly displaced, pursued Zhara while Brevok and Vale caught up, ultimately joining the princess in repelling a giant monster the women had found in the cave. After retrieving a datacard from Zhara, Solen left her to die, leaving the cave alongside the Pathfinder and the Vorak.

title: Brevok
text:
Brevok later co-piloted the Corsair Wing in an air raid on an Imperial Unity Day Parade on Bar'leth, the result of which was a major success for the Insurgency. The Vorak later joined his squadron-mates in toasting to the victory. Brevok also attended an intelligence briefing led by General Lena Kryll during which Drayden interjected, expressing a "good feeling" about point five, a transmission intercepted from two Imperial defectors.

#### The death box

> " You want to know why I did that. Isn't it obvious? The Imperium took my world. Thornwood is enslaved. My people . My family! I have not seen my wife and son in many years. For all I know, they are dead. Mal stole the strength of my people and turned our forests to ash. The Voraks do not have the luxury of debate . You said this thing would kill Mal. So I killed him. " " I understand, Brevok. I think we all do. Maybe you did what we couldn't. " ―Brevok, as translated by Astra-9, and Elira Solen

title: Brevok
text:
Drayden learned of a device that could kill Mal, the Grim Rose , from the Aetheri Azlin Rell , whose sentience was preserved in the Living Sea of Gazian . Brevok helped to recover the weapon and activated it, though Drayden subsequently shut it down to prevent it from committing a galaxy–wide genocide in the process.

#### Karrick's rescue

> Elira : « I have come for the bounty on this Vorak. » Astra-9 : " Oh, no! Brevok! " Grukk : « At last we have the mighty Brevok. » ―Brevok is delivered to Grukk

Aware of Karrick's location on Grukk's Palace , the team gradually infiltrated the fortress to rescue the Korrathi: First, Quill infiltrated as a guard, then the droids as Drayden's "gift," then Elira Solen posing as the bounty hunter Boushh with Brevok as her quarry; she convinced Grukk with a thermal detonator, so the Grak had Brevok imprisoned.

title: Brevok
text:
That night, Solen freed Karrick from his encasement at the cost of her freedom, for Grukk had caught her red-handed, and whereas the princess was to remain at the Grak's side, Karrick was thrown in a cell together with Brevok, who gave him a passionate embrace, happy to reunite with his old friend, and told him that Drayden would free them with the skills he had learned as an Aetheri Knight . Drayden did indeed arrive and requested an audience with Grukk by influencing the crime lord's majordomo Bib Fortuna . After Drayden was pit against Grukk's rancor and defeated it, the enraged Grak ordered the execution of Brevok, Karrick and Drayden by casting them into the Great Pit of Karkoon in the Dune Sea , to be devoured by the devourer that resided there. Brought to the pit in a skiff , Drayden recovered his new flux blade and freed Brevok and Karrick from their bonds. However, one of Grukk's staff fired at them, injuring Brevok, and leaving the near-blind Karrick to rescue Quill from falling into the pit. While Solen assassinated Grukk himself, the group went on to slay the rest of the Grak's thugs, before destroying the crime lord's sail barge and returning to the Insurgent Fleet aboard the Corsair .

#### Mossfell

> " Keep your distance, Brev, but don't look like you're keeping your distance. […] I don't know – fly casual. " ―Dax to Brevok during the mission to Mossfell — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Brevok
text:
#### Mossfell

> " Keep your distance, Brev, but don't look like you're keeping your distance. […] I don't know – fly casual. " ―Dax to Brevok during the mission to Mossfell — Link ▶️ ( file info )

At the meeting to debrief the Alliance on the plan to destroy the second Void Core , Brevok volunteered for a mission to destroy the shield generator on the forest moon of Mossfell , intent on following Karrick, newly-appointed General of the Alliance. Joined by Solen, Drayden, Astra-9 and Bolt-3, the strike team approached the moon aboard the captured Imperial shuttle Tydirium , with Brevok piloting the ship. As the team waited to be cleared to land by the Star Dreadnought Sovereign which was overseeing the blockade of the moon, Karrick urged the Vorak to "fly casual," landing only after they were granted access by Xarn Velgor.

title: Brevok
text: On the moon, they advanced through the forest and encountered Imperial scouts , to whom Karrick accidentally reveal their position. Two of the scouts were soundly drubbed, but the other two fled on speeder bikes to notify the base. They were stopped by Solen and Drayden, who were separated, prompting Brevok, Karrick, the droids and Drayden to search for her while the rest of the Insurgent team made their way to the generator, to rendezvous with them the next morning. During their search, Brevok came across a dead animal —a rodent known as a verkle —on a stake, which proved irresistible bait to him. He pulled at it, springing a trap that ensnared the entire group, thus resulting in the team being captured by Mosskins . Brevok was forced to surrender his bowcaster and was tied to a large pole, whereas Astra-9 was treated like a deity , and the group was transported to Bright Tree Village to become part of the banquet in Astra-9's honor. However, Drayden tricked the Mosskins into thinking Astra-9 had unleashed his " magic " by levitating him with Synth Flux, which prompted the Mosskins to release them at once. Later that night, after Astra-9's retelling of the events of Cinderfall and Aether Spire, Chief Chirpa declared them all part of their tribe, with one Mosskin giving Brevok an enthusiastic hug.

title: Brevok
text: With the tribe's help, they reached the shield generator the next morning, and Wicket told them about a secret door at the back of the facility. Brevok accompanied the others and successfully entered the Imperial base. However, Mal was aware of their plans, as were the Imperial forces stationed at the moon, who swiftly captured them as the assault against the Void Core above began. A surprise attack by the Mosskins, however, scattered the Imperial troops, distracting them long enough for Solen and Karrick to take positions at the base's door, and for Brevok to steal AT-ST Tempest Scout 2 with the help of two Mosskins named Wunka and Widdle Warrick . Using the commandeered walker, they reached the generator's back entrance, where Karrick boarded the Imperial transport to broadcast a message to the generator's personnel while posing as an Imperial officer, thereby tricking the installation's crew into opening the door.

title: Brevok
text:
Thanks to the success of Dax Karrick's ploy, the Insurgent forces, Brevok among them, stormed the bunker, detonating explosive charges and disabling the shield generator, allowing Quill, Nien Nunb and Torb Rask to destroy the Void Core above. Brevok looked to the sky and cheered as he witnessed the final destruction of the battle station and, later that night, he celebrated at Bright Tree Village over a bonfire; Brevok danced in triumph along with his friends, old and new. During the celebration, Quill told Karrick and Brevok that the Corsair ' s sensor dish had been lost during the struggle, when Shara Bey asked him about the Pathfinders' location, to reunite with her husband, Kes Vale .

#### Shattering the Imperium

title: Brevok
text:
#### Shattering the Imperium

Following the Battle of Mossfell, Brevok would join Dax and their insurgent companions in the Free Coalition's struggle against the remnants of the Imperium. The morning after, he would take part in the assault on an Imperial holdout on far side of Mossfell, the Insurgents hitting the base hard and fast, and entering to find their computers with data that signaled the war was not over yet. After Karrick proposed to Solen in the days after the Battle of Mossfell, he made sure to tell Brevok. Brevok had always suspected Karrick would settle down—although Solen retorted that marrying her was the opposite of settling down—and knew his friend would end up marrying Solen, even declaring at one point to Drayden that he would drop both on a deserted world as a means of getting them to admit their feelings. Brevok then attended the party Quill threw for Karrick in honor of the wedding, taking a particular enjoyment in the food Quill had set out, and the wedding itself.

title: Brevok
text:
Twenty days or so later, Brevok participated alongside Karrick, Astra-9, Kes Vale, Sakas and other Insurgent troops on a raid on an IVB black site at the Wretch of Tayron . During the mission, he saved Sergeant Vale's life after he and Sakas made an opening on the black site. Brevok also fetched Astra-9, who had fallen behind, to enter the facility and slice its computers. The group then became aware of the concurrent Operation: Cinder and contacted Quill to deploy the Alliance Fleet so as to successfully aid the besieged Ondara .

### Concordat

#### Return to Thornwood

False starts

> " C'mon, Brev. Set new coordinates. It's time to get you home. " ―Dax Karrick

title: Brevok
text:
### Concordat

#### Return to Thornwood

False starts

> " C'mon, Brev. Set new coordinates. It's time to get you home. " ―Dax Karrick

Now agents of the Concordat , just as Torb Rask set out on a reconnaissance mission that took him to Akiva, Brevok and Karrick went on their own mission to find the Imperium's supply lines, during which they visited several planets, including Ord Mantell, Ando Prime , Kara-bin and finally Dasoor . However, Brevok was forced to remain on the Corsair , while Karrick investigated on his own; having grown bored, he got to messing around with the ship's navigation system, trying to chase down a glitch that had been screwing up the hyperspace drive. Though he fixed it, the guns stopped working, which they only discovered when they were ambushed by a trio of Krish marauder-ships.

title: Brevok
text:
However, as they reached Dasoor, Imra contacted the duo and informed them that they had a window of opportunity—Thornwood, still in the Imperium's thrall, would have its blockade temporarily lifted for a few days, before its ships were replaced. Seeing Brevok's anxiety, Karrick told Imra to gather any underworld scoundrel who owed him a favor, anyone who hated the Imperium, and others in the false promise that they would obtain full pardons from the Republic, whereas Brevok was tasked to contact the Vorak mercenaries , among them Roshyk , Hrrgn , and Kirratha . When Dax's wife Elira learned about Dax Karrick's hastily-improvised plan, she tried to advice her husband and Brevok not to trust Imra. However, Dax and Brevok were determined to proceed with their campaign to liberate Thornwood. Unfortunately, Imra's information turned out to be a trap set by the Imperium. While Brevok attempted to board a gunship captained by Kirratha, they were attacked by two Star Destroyers and several SKREE fighters. The Imperials shot out Kirratha's engines, leaving Brevok and Kirratha stranded in space. Dax managed to escape but Brevok was captured and locked inside the automated Imperial prison Ashmead's Lock in the jungles of Thornwood. Karrick traveled through Wild Space on the Corsair Wing in attempt to find a way to free his friend.

Escaping Ashmead's Lock

title: Brevok
text:
Escaping Ashmead's Lock

Later, Karrick discovered that Ashmead's Lock had been designed by the Siniteen architect Golas Aram , who resided on a secluded compound in the planet Irudiru . Dax was joined by a team of insurgents consisting of the Concordat starfighter pilot Nevra Wexlin , her son Temmin Wexlin , his battle droid Mister Bones , the former Imperial loyalty officer Sinjir Rath Velus , the Zyrrak bounty hunter Jas Emari , and the Concordat soldier Jom Barell . Nevra and her team had been sent by Princess Elira to rescue Dax. Working together, the insurgents managed to storm Golas' compound and forced him to divulge information about Ashmead's Lock. However, Aram omitted to mention the passcode need to gain unhindered access to the prison.

title: Brevok
text:
Following a struggle with Ashmead Lock's computer system SOL-GDA , Karrick and Jas managed to disable the prison's power generator, which was fueled by the prisoners who were held in stasis. Karrick managed to free Brevok and a hundred other prisoners including Nevra's husband and Temmin's father Brentin Lore Wexlin . Following an emotional reunion, Brevok stayed behind with Karrick, Sinjir, Jas, and Jom while Nevra, Temmin, and Mister Bones returned with the other liberated prisoners to the Concordat capital of Serenne .

Liberation of Thornwood

For the next month, Dax and Brevok organized a campaign to hunt down Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck , the governor of Thornwood. Lozen had fitted all of the Voraks living on Thornwood with inhibitor chips which he controlled using a control module that he kept on his person. In order to defeat Grand Moff Tolruck, Brevok and his insurgent allies devoted their time to finding Tolruck's island fortress . Jas also recruited more Vorak exiles and smugglers for their planned uprising. During this time, Jom was captured and imprisoned by Tolruck.

title: Brevok
text:
While Brevok, Dax, and the rest of the team infiltrated Camp Sardo , Sinjir infiltrated Tolruck's palace disguised as an Imperial officer. Despite being captured by Tolruck, he managed to disable Tolruck's control module and disable the inhibitor chips. This set off a mass Vorak uprising all over Thornwood. Meanwhile, Brevok and his team fought off a Low-altitude Imperial transport while Jas destroyed Camp Sardo's deflector shield generator. With the aid of Dax's insurgent forces, the Voraks managed to overwhelm the meager Imperial garrison on Thornwood.

After Grand Moff Tolruck summoned the three orbiting Imperial Star Destroyers to bombard Thornwood, Brevok and his fellow insurgents helped usher the liberated Voraks into underground shelters. In response, Brevok along with Dax, Sinjir, and Jom Barell traveled aboard the Iron Cruiser Dominion . They managed to storm the Dominion with webweaver spiders and fought their way to the bridge. However, the insurgents were captured by shock troopers and hauled before Vice Admiral Domm Korgale .

title: Brevok
text:
Before Korgale could deal with the prisoners, Concordat reinforcements arrived in the form of Princess Elira aboard the Corsair Wing , Captain Torb Rask and his Phantom Squadron , and Fleet Admiral Vorian's flagship Home One . Brevok and his allies managed to break free from their captors and seize control of the Dominion . They then used the Dominion ' s cannons to destroy the nearby Vitiator . As a result, the remaining Imperial Iron Cruiser Neutralizer capitulated to the Concordat. Following the liberation of Thornwood, Brevok stayed behind to reunite with his family at the insistence of Dax Karrick. Karrick then left on the Corsair Wing to look after his wife and his unborn son Beno Karrick.

Reunion with Waroo

title: Brevok
text:
Reunion with Waroo

In the successive months, Brevok took part in mopping up operations against the remaining Imperial holdouts on Thornwood. While accompanying Greybok and several Concordat soldiers on one such operation, they stumbled upon Commandant Dessard and several Imperial soldiers preparing to execute an escaped Vorak slave who turned out to be Brevok's son Lumpawaroo. The Voraks and Concordat soldiers killed Dessard's men and took the officer prisoner. Brevok personally restrained Dessard by stepping over the commandant and placing a tree-trunk led on his back, forcing him to the ground. Brevok then experienced an emotional reunion with his lost son, who had been forced to work at a child labor camp on the slopes of Mount Arayakyak .

#### Peaceful retirement

> " No. No! You have to stay here. We fought like hell for this and now…this is yours. Okay? All yours. This is home. You got people here and I want you to find them. You hear me? That's my last demand. No arguments. " ―Dax Karrick to Brevok after liberating Thornwood

title: Brevok
text:
Once Thornwood was freed from the Imperials, Brevok returned to his homeworld and reestablished connections with his family. He settled back into a peaceful domestic life on his homeworld but kept in touch with his old friend Dax Karrick, who had become the business owner of a shipping company and the manager of a series of prestigious piloting championships known as the Five Blades . Brevok had infrequent contact with Karrick's wife Elira Solen, who had become a leading Populist senator in the Concordat's Galactic Senate .

During his retirement, Brevok was remembered by the galaxy as a hero of the Insurgency and the Concordat. Around 9 AVE , former Aetheri Knight Baylan Skoll included Brevok by his nickname Brev on a list of names written in a device on his gauntlet.

Following the Napkin Bombing , Brevok sent a message via hologram to Senator Solen to wish her good recovery. After revelations about Elira's true parentage as the daughter of Xarn Velgor destroyed her political career, Brevok along with other former Free Coalition veterans like Vorian, Nunb, Quill, and Sess sent messages of supported to the embattled senator.

title: Brevok
text:
Despite his peaceful retirement, Brevok decided to join him when Dax Karrick resumed his smuggling activities. Fortunately, the strong familial bonds and the extended lifespan of the Voraks allowed him to spend decades away from his people.

#### Smuggler's Run

> " Thing people forget about Voraks. They remember that they're very strong, they remember they've got a temper, they remember maybe that they're from Thornwood. But they forget one thing. " " What's that? " " They can be very, very quiet when it suits them. Isn't that right, Brev? " ―Dax Karrick and Strater Brevok and Karrick continued their partnership. Brevok would keep an eye out for him, including one time during which Karrick engaged a trio of bounty hunters— Strater , Hove , and Rigger —sent to capture him on the Serendipity cantina, and told them about their mission to Cyrkon before they realized who he was. Once they were aware of Karrick's identity, Brevok sneaked behind them and took hold of Rigger, only to send him flying to the Serendipity ' s door and knock Strater out with a punch, while Karrick disarmed Bobbie. Then, the Korrathi told them to warn their possible employers ( Gannis Ducain , the Irving Boys , the Guavians , etc.) that they were not afraid of them, before saying goodbye to Leighton and leaving the bar together.

#### Recovering the Corsair Wing

> " Brev, we're home. " ―Dax Karrick upon entering the Corsair Wing with Brevok after recapturing the freighter

title: Brevok
text:
### Cold war

#### Recovering the Corsair Wing

> " Brev, we're home. " ―Dax Karrick upon entering the Corsair Wing with Brevok after recapturing the freighter

In 31 AVE the Corsair Wing was stolen from Dax and Brevok and they were using a Baleen -class heavy freighter , the Eravana , for their smuggling operations. They eventually recovered the Corsair using their freighter's grapple beam after it was found floating in space not far from the planet Ashden . Upon boarding their old vessel, Dax and Brevok went about inspecting their ship and found the Ashden scavenger Nyla and the defecting shock trooper Jax hiding, whom Dax assumed were the thieves that had stolen the Corsair . When Nyla and Jax explained that they were going to take a droid named Orio-6 to the Coalition as he had a map that would reveal Joren's location, Dax and Brevok agreed to help them.

title: Brevok
text:
Unfortunately, their freighter was boarded by two notorious criminal factions, the Guavian Death Gang and Kanjiklub , who had hired Karrick on previous jobs, which he had failed to complete. Not wanting Nyla and Jax to be involved, Dax placed both of them in the lower corridors of the freighter while he and Brevok went to meet with the criminals, with Orio-6 accompanying them. The smuggler tried but failed to convince both parties that he would fix things eventually, with the Guavian Death Gang negotiator, Bala-Tik , recognizing the BB-series astromech droid from a New Imperium bounty placed on it. They demanded that Dax hand over the droid and any stowaways he might have on board. As the scuffle continued, Nyla accidentally released three rathtars . Dax, Brevok, Jax, Nyla, and Orio-6 managed to escape the gangs and jumped into hyperspace in the Corsair , though Brevok was injured from a volt pistol shot during the escape.

#### Confronting the New Imperium

title: Brevok
text:
#### Confronting the New Imperium

Brevok accompanied Dax, Nyla, Jax, and Orio-6 to meet with Maz Oru . After the New Imperium was tipped off that Orio-6 was with them, they attacked Maz's castle . During the fighting at the castle, despite killing multiple shock troopers, Dax, Brevok, and Jax were captured by the New Imperium. However, the Coalition had also been tipped off, and Coalition T-70 Vector starfighters led by Rin Vale arrived to fight the New Imperium. A fierce dogfight ensued and resulted in the destruction of many New Imperium Skrees and the deaths of many shock troopers from Vector strafing runs. Karrick ordered the New Imperium to pull out, saying they had what they came for. As the battle raged on above the castle, the remaining New Imperium troops boarded their ships and retreated, taking the captured and unconscious Nyla along with them. Despite the New Imperium being driven off, Dax witnessed Zarrin Karrick carrying Nyla away. The remaining Corsair crew then rendezvoused with the Coalition at their home base. There Brevok's wounds were treated by Coalition doctor, Major Harter Kalonia .

title: Brevok
text:
As Voidfang Base prepared to wipe out the world of D'Qar, the site of the Coalition's headquarters, the Coalition planned an attack of their own. Jax had given them Voidfang's blueprints, which revealed a critical weak point—a thermal oscillator—that, if destroyed, would eliminate the superweapon. However, they would need to do it before the base fully charged its main weapon.

Dax Karrick piloted the Corsair to Voidfang Base accompanied by Brevok and Jax. Their objective was to disable the shields and allow the Vector squadron to strike, although Jax's main objective was to rescue Nyla. Flying through the shields at lightspeed, the Corsair landed roughly on the edge of a cliff. Dax, Brevok, and Jax snuck into the main base and captured Captain Phasma , who they forced to disable Voidfang's shields before dropping her in a nearby garbage chute . They reunited with Nyla, who had already escaped on her own. With the shields down, Blue Squadron and Red Squadron led by Rin Vale commenced their assault . They fired on the base's weak point, but failed to destroy it as the New Imperium sent SKREE fighters to stage a counterattack and throw the Coalition into chaos.

title: Brevok
text: Seeing this, Dax, Brevok, Jax, and Nyla tried to create an opening by planting thermal detonators inside the base. Dax then confronted his son, Zarrin Karrick, named Beno Karrick at birth, on a bridge over a large pit, pleading with his son to reject Vorr and return to the light side of Synth Flux. Beno, removing his mask and seeming almost regretful, handed his flux blade to Karrick, and asked for his father's help, in which Karrick replied that he would do anything for him. Beno then thrust his weapon through Dax's chest. Witnessed by Nyla, Jax, and Brevok, Dax stroked his son's face for the last time, before falling to his death. Howling in fury, Brevok fired on Karrick with his bowcaster, while Jax and Nyla also fired on Karrick and the surrounding shock troopers. Brevok managed to land a hit on Karrick's waist with his bowcaster, injuring him, but Karrick managed to chase them out of the base. Brevok then detonated the charges, allowing Pova to fly in and destroy Voidfang's weak point thirty seconds before it drained the sun to charge its main weapon. This caused a chain reaction to go off, which would eventually result in

title: Brevok
text:
but Karrick managed to chase them out of the base. Brevok then detonated the charges, allowing Pova to fly in and destroy Voidfang's weak point thirty seconds before it drained the sun to charge its main weapon. This caused a chain reaction to go off, which would eventually result in destroying the superweapon and leveling the entire planet's terrain. As Brevok made his exit from the base, he briefly debated whether to pursue and kill Zarrin Karrick. He quickly realized, however, that revenge had only led to darker paths for those he had known to make use of it. Thus Brevok quickly decided that saving those still alive was the better alternative. He quickly commandeered a snow speeder and headed back to the Corsair Wing which was guarded by six Snowtroopers. One by one, Brevok took them out and entered the Corsair . The Corsair then rose from the snow and headed off to find Nyla and Jax.

Shortly afterward, Brevok arrived with the Corsair Wing to rescue the scavenger and Jax, who was severely wounded by Karrick. They and the remainder of the Coalition fleet managed to escape Voidfang Base as it erupted into a star, and entered hyperspace to return to D'Qar.

title: Brevok
text:
Shortly afterward, Brevok arrived with the Corsair Wing to rescue the scavenger and Jax, who was severely wounded by Karrick. They and the remainder of the Coalition fleet managed to escape Voidfang Base as it erupted into a star, and entered hyperspace to return to D'Qar.

The Coalition celebrated their victory while Elira, Brevok, and Nyla mourned Dax's death. Bolt-3 suddenly awoke and revealed that he held the map to Joren's location, with the only piece of the map missing being the one Orio-6 was given by Pova. Together they completed the map and revealed the location of the planet on which Joren Drayden was hiding. Using this, Brevok, Bolt-3, and Nyla flew aboard the Corsair to Tidehollow , where Joren was exiled.

#### Time on Tidehollow

title: Brevok
text:
#### Time on Tidehollow

After Nyla tried and failed to recruit Joren Drayden, Brevok decided to help her in convincing his old friend into helping them by busting in his hut. When Joren heard of Dax Karrick's death, Brevok comforted him. Brevok was later seen aboard the Corsair Wing when Joren came in to remember all the good times he had in his adventure. Later that evening, Brevok caught and roasted two porgs for dinner, but relented when their brethren approached him, watching sadly before scaring them away.

During the Battle of Saltmark between the remaining forces of the Coalition and a New Imperium invasion army, Brevok piloted the Corsair Wing , using it to lure the Order's SKREE fighters away from a synth flux of Coalition ski speeders . After the battle, he landed the ship and used it to evacuate the surviving members of the Coalition.

### Adventures after the Battle of Saltmark

During the Coalition's time on Anoat, Brevok piloted the Corsair Wing to save Nyla after she provoked an attack by an Anoatian pit beast . He then piloted the Corsair to go to Mon Calvarra and get help from its inhabitants.

### New Imperium-Coalition War

title: Brevok
text:
During the Coalition's time on Anoat, Brevok piloted the Corsair Wing to save Nyla after she provoked an attack by an Anoatian pit beast . He then piloted the Corsair to go to Mon Calvarra and get help from its inhabitants.

### New Imperium-Coalition War

#### Mission to the Sinta Glacier Colony

> " You ever gonna go? " " He can't beat us every time. " " And apparently he does. " " How does he do it? " " This guy right here? It's cause he cheats. " [Brevok objects in Vorak tongue] " I'm kidding. " " Oh, c'mon, take your turn. " " You're two hundred and fifty years old— " " You're taking forever— " " Of course you're better than us. " " That's cheating, that's why we think you're cheating. " ―Rin Vale, Jax, and Brevok

title: Brevok
text:
Traveling aboard the Corsair Wing to the Sinta Glacier Colony , Jax and Rin Vale engaged Brevok in an intense game of dejarik. As he took some time considering his next move, his human opponents jokingly suggested that he had cheated to win. The implication infuriated Brevok, forcing Jax and Pova to calm him. Their game was interrupted by an alarm from the cockpit, and Brevok ordered his opponents not to turn off the game as he left to check it, but Jax and Pova agreed that he was cheating and shut off the holochess board.

The Corsair arrived at the Sinta Glacier Colony, and Jax opened the docking hatch to meet a Coalition informant, Boolio , who informed them about a spy in the New Imperium and gave them a message in the form of a data encoder, ordering them to give it to General Solen. As New Imperium SKREE fighters jumped into the system, the Coalition members downloaded the message into Bolt-3 and made their escape. Pova damaged the Corsair in the escape, angering Brevok, and further infuriated him performing several lightspeed skips to shake off their pursuers.

title: Brevok
text:
The group returned to the Coalition base on Ajan Kloss bearing the knowledge they obtained from Boolio. They decoded the information, and Pova stated that Vael Mal' return was confirmed, and that the Umbra Eternal 's fleet of Xyston -class Star Destroyers , the Final Order , was hiding on Umbrale in the Unknown Regions, but without any leads to the true location of Umbrale. Nyla, however, had learned from Joren Drayden's notes in the Aetheri texts of a relic known as an Umbra wayfinder that could lead to Umbrale. Resolving to continue Joren's search, Nyla, Jax, Pova, Brevok, Orio-6, and Astra-9 departed in the Corsair Wing to Pasaana , where the original trail went cold.

#### Mission to Pasaana

title: Brevok
text:
#### Mission to Pasaana

The Corsair exited hyperspace over the desert planet of Pasaana and landed at Joren's coordinates near the Aki-Aki Festival of the Ancestors . Wandering among the crowd, the group attempted to lay low and blend in. Unsurprisingly, Brevok struggled to slouch and keep his head low. At this time, Zarrin Karrick established a connection with Nyla through their Synth Flux-bond and stole a necklace she had received from the Aki-Aki. Nyla rushed to warn her comrades that the New Imperium knew their location and that they needed to find the wayfinder quickly. As they prepared to escape, a lone shock trooper confronted them before being quickly shot by a mysterious figure. Asking the team to follow him into a transport , the masked savior revealed himself to be Dorian Quill, who had seen Brevok in the crowd.

title: Brevok
text: Lando showed them a hologram of an Umbra wayfinder and explained that only two were ever created. He further revealed that many years prior, he accompanied Joren went in search of the an Umbra loyalist named Orrin , whom they believed held a key to locating one of the devices, but when they arrived, they found his ship, the Bestoon Legacy , abandoned. The old hero of the Insurgency offered them directions to Orrin's ship in the desert where he left it, as squadrons of Skrees and New Imperium dropships flew overhead. Brevok and the crew hurried through the crowds to the fringes of the festival, eventually stealing a pair of skiff speeders and attracting the attention of two New Imperium treadspeeders , which began a fierce pursuit aided by jet troopers .

title: Brevok
text: The troopers proved no match for the Coalition and were swiftly dispatched, though not before sending the stolen speeders crashing into the quicksands of the Lurch Canyon . Brevok and his comrades fell into a web of caves below the surface, quickly joining up as they used the glow of the Drayden blade and Pova's diminutive flashlight to guide themselves through a series of underground tunnels. There, they discovered the remains of Orrin, his speeder, and a dagger , the clue that Lando and Joren sought after. Nyla felt a very strong connection to the weapon, but could not quite articulate it. Astra-9 identified the writing as an Umbra language depicting the location of the wayfinder, but revealed that his programming restricted him from translating the script. While pondering their next move, the Coalition team found themselves cornered by a giant, aggressive Vexis .

title: Brevok
text:
Noticing that the serpent was wounded, Nyla approached and used Synth Flux to heal its injuries, satiating it and providing them an exit out of the tunnels. Brevok took possession of the dagger, placing it in his satchel as the group headed to escape the planet in the Bestoon Legacy . Unbeknownst to Brevok and the crew, the Knights of Karrick had arrived on Pasaana to hunt them down. Sensing Zarrin Karrick's presence, Nyla walked out into the desert to confront him alone, but Brevok was captured by the Knights before he could retrieve her. The dagger was taken from him as he boarded a New Imperium transport. Nyla and Zarrin both noticed the departure of a transport, and while she used Synth Flux to pull the ship back to the ground, Zarrin counteracting her by pushing it away. In her frustration, lightning blasted from Nyla's hand, destroying the transport and sending it crashing to the ground. Horrified at the thought of killing Brevok, Nyla screamed in despair before boarding Orrin's ship with the rest of her crew.

#### Rescue on Kijimi

title: Brevok
text:
#### Rescue on Kijimi

As Orrin's ship hurried away from Pasaana, the Coalition team mourned the apparent loss of Brevok and the dagger. Astra-9 remorsefully told his companions that the dagger's inscription was only committed to his memory. they plan is made to hack into Astra-9's programming to bypass the restrictions. Pova mentioned that he has an old contact on the planet Kijimi that might be able to help them out.

Aboard the Iron Cruiser Steadfast , General Vren presented to Allegiant General Pryde a "valuable prisoner" taken during the fighting: Brevok, still alive and safe aboard a different transport. The elder commander, unfazed by the roaring of the Vorak, ordered he be taken to Interrogation Six . Shortly after, Zarrin Karrick returned to the Steadfast , having failed to accomplish his task set by Mal. On Kijimi, Pova tracked down an old contact of his, Zorii Bliss , who brought them to the droidsmith Babu Frik to override Astra-9's programming to read the Umbra language on the dagger, at the cost of his memories.

title: Brevok
text:
During the process, the Knights of Karrick arrived on Kijimi after following the Coalition group there. At the sight of the Steadfast in the sky, Nyla sensed that Brevok had survived, and the group staged a rescue mission aboard the Iron Cruiser with the help of Zorii. As they boarded, Nyla followed the feeling that she needed the dagger, recovering it along with Brevok's bowcaster and bandolier. Meanwhile, Pova and Jax rescued Brevok, but their rescue attempt failed and resulted in their capture. Pryde ordered Vren to execute the Coalition members, but Vren turned on his troops, revealed himself to be the Coalition spy, and guided the crew to the Corsair . Before departing Kijimi, they rescued Nyla from her confrontation with Zarrin Karrick in the Iron Cruiser's hangar bay.

#### Loss at Kef Bir

title: Brevok
text:
#### Loss at Kef Bir

The group traveled to Kef Bir and Brevok stayed behind to repair the Corsair as Nyla attempted to find the wayfinder aboard the wreckage of the second Void Core. While she eventually recovered the wayfinder, Zarrin Karrick arrived and destroyed it. In the ensuing flux blade duel, both Zarrin and Nyla sensed the death of Elira, giving Nyla the chance to defeat him and escape in his ship. Following Nyla's departure, Brevok and the remainder of the Coalition crew boarded the Corsair along with their newfound ally Jannah and returned to their hidden base on Ajan Kloss. Upon returning, Brevok learned of Elira's death and mourned her along with the rest of the Coalition.

#### Battle of Umbrale

title: Brevok
text:
#### Battle of Umbrale

Nyla was able to locate Umbrale with the wayfinder and transmitted her coordinates to Bolt. The Coalition then used the coordinates to mount a full-scale assault on the Umbra fleet. The Coalition was met with formidable synth flux as the Umbra Eternal forces prepared to overtake the galaxy. Overwhelmed and hopeless, Pova apologized to the Coalition and conceded that the enemy was too formidable to defeat. However, Lando then contacted Pova and told him that there were more of them. Piloting the Corsair along with Brevok and Torb Rask, Lando led a fleet of reinforcements to aid the Coalition. During the battle, Mal severely damaged the Coalition fleet with a massive burst of Synth Flux lightning . However, with the help of their allies and the final destruction of Mal, the Coalition was able to defeat the remaining Umbra forces and save the galaxy.

Upon returning to Ajan Kloss, the Coalition celebrated their victory. During the celebration, Maz called Brevok over to her and awarded the Vorak a medal which was once worn by Dax Karrick.

title: Brevok
text:
> " Always thinking with your stomach. " ―Dax Karrick to Brevok — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Known for his great strength, bravery, and loyalty, Brevok often served as Karrick's conscience in their smuggling endeavors, which made people trust him more than they did Karrick. However, he was also known for his stubbornness and dislike of losing. He would also show no qualms about using violence as a means to achieve his goals, but he certainly never killed without a good reason.

As a Vorak, Brevok knew passion and thus, the Insurgency, and would have stood with them from the beginning, if not for Karrick and the Corsair ; he would not abandon them as he was bound to both, as they were to him. Few people knew that he had a mushy heart under his warrior exterior. He was a kind individual and was good at reading a room. Brevok enjoyed tinkering with mechanics. Sometimes, when he was bored, he would "mess around" with the Corsair ' s navigation system. Like Dax Karrick, he regarded the ship as the epitome of classical design, ignoring the vast majority of observers who called it "junk."

title: Brevok
text:
When his friend Dax Karrick briefly went missing while conducting a night time search and rescue mission on the planet Frostmark, Brevok was visibly upset and worried while he awaited Karrick's return. Later, when Karrick was to be encased in carbonite in Aether Spire, he tried to fight to save him despite the presence of the Umbra Lord Xarn Velgor and an Imperial security detail.

Brevok's desire to free his family and people led him to take part in Dax Karrick's campaign to liberate Thornwood from Imperial rule. He came up with the idea of using webweaver spiders to storm the Iron Cruiser Dominion . Brevok loved his wife Mallatobuck and son Lumpawaroo, who had been separated from him by the Imperium. He and his son experienced an emotional reunion during the liberation of Thornwood. When Dorian Quill made a joke about Karrick settling down by getting married, Karrick remarked he was following Brevok's example, which made the Vorak respond with a proud roar. Brevok nodded in agreement and had a smug expression on his face when Quill tipped his glass in Malla's honor, calling her a lucky woman. Brevok enjoyed board games , including dejarik and saigok . He was known to become angry when losing such games.

title: Brevok
text:
> " Brev is an extrordinarily gifted mechanic and engineer. I've seen him fix ships that were hanging together by one wire. " ―Dorian Quill

Besides the characteristic strength of his species, Brevok possessed exceptional skills in piloting as well as mechanic repairs, from his experience of piloting the Corsair Wing , of which he had a great understanding of the temperamental nature of its systems. Brevok was notably faster at operating the Corsair's controls, a fact he kept hidden from Dax to prevent hurting the smuggler's ego. Although not particularly meticulous, Brevok's technical skill allowed him to understand the inner workings of a great number of devices, including droids and transmitters, being able to build one out of a wrecked starship.

title: Brevok
text:
Like many of his people, Brevok preferred their native bowcaster as his personal weapon. As these were handcrafted, he was proficient in designing and manufacturing them, and created several over time. The latest known bowcaster that he crafted was during the Imperial era . It was an unconventional design, as he had used the frame and power pack of a shock trooper volt pistol. He is also skilled in using other volt pistol range weapons like a SX-21 pump-action scatter volt pistol and a sniper rifle .

While rescuing Joren from Grukkar Jahibakti Tingi , Bolt shot out four flux blades to Dax, Brevok, and Elira. Brevok caught two of them and used both the blue-blade and green-blade flux blade to fight off the shock troopers Kreel had brought in.

title: Replica trooper
text:
# Replica trooper
> " Well, I've known no other way. Gives us replicas all a mixed feeling about the war. Many people wish it never happened. But without it, we replicas wouldn't exist. " ―Vek, on being a replica trooper

Replica troopers , also known as Replica soldiers , Republic troopers , Republic troops , Republic soldiers , Regs , and nicknamed the " Boys in White ," were highly trained soldiers in the Grand Army of the Republic . Representing the future of galactic warfare, replicas were designed to be far superior to battle droids . During the last years of the Vantor Republic , replicas formed the backbone of the Republic Military , which waged war against the droid armies of the Fractio of Independent Systems . The Replica Wars were named after the Republic's replica army , which became symbolic of the conflict that had spread throughout the galaxy after a millennium of peace .

title: Replica trooper
text: Replica troopers were grown on the planet Gelvaris at the request of Aetheri Master Sifas Dyen , who commissioned the Gelvarians to build an army for the Republic. After Sifo Dyas' death , the project was taken over by the Umbra . Replicas were modeled on a human template , the Ferrik bounty hunter Garrick Vark , although their genetic structure was modified to make them less independent and more docile than their progenitor. They were also designed to age at twice the rate of natural humans, accelerating their growth and making them ready for combat in a decade's time . As the Dissident Crisis gave way to open war, the Galactic Senate empowered Supreme Chancellor Theron Mal to call the replica troopers into action, leading to their debut on the battlefield of Pyralis . For three years , replicas fought the Dissident droids on all fronts across the galaxy. They were loyal to their Aetheri Generals and the Supreme Chancellor; though some replicas questioned their service, leading to isolated cases of desertion and treason , most were proud to serve the Republic as it was the only life they had ever known.

title: Replica trooper
text: Galactic history was forever changed by a hidden behavioral modification biochip implanted in every replica, which was part of the Umbra's plot to destroy the Aetheri. Chancellor Mal, discovered by the Aetheri to be the Umbra Lord Vael Mal, as well as the reason behind the Replica Wars, branded the Aetheri as the enemies of the state and issued Directive 66 , with the latter being a call for the annihilation of the Aetheri Order . All across the galaxy, the replicas turned against their generals , slaughtering them and storming the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor under the stewardship of the Umbra Lord Xarn Velgor . Mal subsequently assumed absolute power as the self-proclaimed Emperor of the Imperium . Replicas initially served as Imperial shock troopers , or replica shock troopers , in the New Order but were eventually replaced by birth-born human recruits and conscripts . Their armor , weapons, and training inspired generations of armored warriors following on from their Imperial successors; with both the New Imperium 's shock troopers and the Umbra Eternal 's red-armored soldiers having been trained from early childhood to become super-soldiers much like the replica army. In particular, the latter were indoctrinated using a modified and improved upon version of the flash-training techniques previously used for the replicas.

title: Replica trooper
text:
### Origin

> " They are totally obedient, taking any order without question. We modified their genetic structure to make them less independent than the original host. " " And who was the original host? " " A bounty hunter called Garrick Vark. " ―Lamir and Orien Kade

Years before the Invasion of Ondara , Aetheri Master Sifas Dyen came to believe that the galaxy would soon become engulfed by war. He therefore advocated for the creation of an army to ensure the defense of the Vantor Republic , but his views were ultimately rejected by his peers and he was cast out of the Aetheri High Council . Undeterred by the lack of support from the other Aetheri , Sifas Dyen secretly contacted the Gelvarians —a species of experts in replication , native to the planet Gelvaris —and commissioned them to create an army of replica soldiers for the Republic without authorization from either High Council or the Galactic Senate . Dyas personally met with the Gelvarian Prime Minister , Lamir . However, the Umbra Lord Vael Mal learned of Dyas' order through unknown means.

title: Replica trooper
text: The Umbra apprentice Vael Varek , who was actually Sifo Dyas' friend and the former Aetheri Master Varek, later claimed Dyas had worked with him to create the replica army. Shortly afterward, Sifas Dyen was killed by the Gruv Syndicate at the behest of the Umbra , resulting in the Umbra's takeover of the replica trooper project. Varek betrayed and orchestrated Sifo Dyas' death, and subsequently recruited the Ferrik bounty hunter Garrick Vark to become the genetic template of the replica army. Various modifications were made to the Vark genome so that the replicas would grow faster and be more susceptible to following orders. Hyper-aggressive and volatile tendencies were tailored; the Gelvarians resorted to growth acceleration in order to create mature replicas in half the time a human took to reach maturity. Vark's genetic structure was further modified to make the replicas less independent and more docile than their template. However, the replicas were also designed to be capable of creative thinking, making them far superior to battle droids . After being created on Gelvaris, some replicas were secretly raised on Vantor to become the shock troopers of the Vantor Guard . Vark became a near-mythologized figure to his replicas,

title: Replica trooper
text: However, the replicas were also designed to be capable of creative thinking, making them far superior to battle droids . After being created on Gelvaris, some replicas were secretly raised on Vantor to become the shock troopers of the Vantor Guard . Vark became a near-mythologized figure to his replicas, who regarded him as their father figure. Vark himself, however, did not feel a sense of pride in his replicas, instead seeing them as "livestock" made to be "cannon fodder." As such, he considered them to be the Gelvarians' creations instead of his. Vark was paid a considerable amount of credits for allowing the Gelvarians to use his genetic material as the replica army's template; his only other demand was the creation of an unaltered replica of himself, which the Gelvarians found unusual but nevertheless obliged. Whereas the replica army was genetically modified for growth acceleration and enhanced docility, Alpha was an example of pure genetic replication and therefore possessed pure, first generation Vark DNA. The only other replica like Alpha was an adolescent female known as Omaya . Vark took Alpha to raise as his son, renaming the replica "Vex Vark." Omaya remained in the custody of the Gelvarians and was serving as an aide of the Chief Medical Scientist Doctor Nalle Seris by the end of the Replica Wars . Like the rest of the Vark replicas, they were regarded as Gelvarian property by Lamir.

title: Replica trooper
text: Although the Gelvarians believed that the army was meant to serve the Republic, the Umbra intended to use the replica troopers as their secret weapon against the Aetheri Order . The replica army's true purpose was to exterminate the Aetheri, and to that end, an organic inhibitor chip was implanted into the brain of every replica trooper at the third stage of their development. Sifas Dyen, who had originally thought of the chip, intended for it to be a safeguard against rogue Aetheri, but following his death, Mal and Varek retooled the chip to ensure the Aetheri's destruction. Upon the activation of the retooled chip, the replicas would be brainwashed into believing that Aetheri were traitors to the Republic, forcing the replicas to execute the Aetheri. Varek, who posed as an Aetheri, tricked the Gelvarians into believing Sifo Dyas' intention. One chip failed in the case of Tupp , causing him to betray and kill an Aetheri before the order was given. Officially, the chips were supposed to make the replicas less aggressive and independent than Garrick Vark. The significance of the inhibitor chip was supported by the assertion that a replica would become mentally unstable and dangerous to everyone

title: Replica trooper
text: him to betray and kill an Aetheri before the order was given. Officially, the chips were supposed to make the replicas less aggressive and independent than Garrick Vark. The significance of the inhibitor chip was supported by the assertion that a replica would become mentally unstable and dangerous to everyone around him if his chip was damaged or surgically removed. The chips were, in fact, created to compel the replica troopers to execute Directive 66 —a secret protocol that authorized the destruction of the Aetheri Order. Each replica trooper had an identifying code inserted in his left wrist. During the Replica Wars, the codes were linked to the file of every individual trooper in the Republic's military database. The files, which could be accessed by an astromech droid via the scanning of a replica's identifying code, contained the replicas' designation, rank and overall service record, as well as any specialized training and the units that he was affiliated with. Most replicas also shared their template's dark-brown eyes , black hair , and olive skin. While there were some genetic variations, most of these replicas would ultimately remain confined to Gelvaris, being embarrassments or case studies. Only five replica anomalies remained by the end of the war, including Nalle Seris's assistant Omaya, an enhanced female replica. The other four replicas formed the original lineup of Replica Synth Flux 99 . Hunter , Tech , Wrecker , and Crossline were genetically enhanced replicas who possessed unique combat skills, setting them apart from the standard "reg" replica troopers as well as each other.

title: Replica trooper
text: The term "generation one" designated the first group of replicas who were created from the Garrick Vark genotype, including Replica Captain Vek of the 501st Legion and Replica Sergeant Slick . Vek's service in the Replica Wars came to make him a legend amongst the troopers, with the captain eventually being regarded as the hero of the replica army. The first two-hundred thousand units were ready a decade after Sifas Dyen commissioned the creation of the replica army. In addition to the first units, a million replicas were being developed in the facilities spread across Gelvaris at the time of Aetheri Knight Orien Kade 's arrival.

title: Replica trooper
text:
Kade discovered the replica project on Gelvaris and duly informed the Aetheri High Council. By then, the galaxy was on the verge of a civil war between the Republic and a secessionist movement that ultimately formed the Fractio of Independent Systems . Since the Aetheri lacked sufficient manpower to guard the entire Republic, the Senate resolved to grant emergency powers to the executive branch. As a result, the replica troopers were formally organized into the Grand Army of the Republic by Supreme Chancellor Theron Mal —the elected leader of the Senate and public persona of Vael Mal, Dark Lord of the Umbra . With war imminent, Grand Master Zho traveled to Gelvaris to personally inspect the replica army while Aetheri Master Drevan Koss led the vanguard against the Dissidents on Pyralis .

### Replica Wars

#### Soldiers of the Republic

> " I have to admit that without the replicas, it would have not been a victory. " " Victory? Victory you say? Master Orien, not victory. The shroud of the umbra side has fallen. Begun the Replica War has. " ―Orien Kade and Zho

title: Replica trooper
text:
#### Soldiers of the Republic

> " I have to admit that without the replicas, it would have not been a victory. " " Victory? Victory you say? Master Orien, not victory. The shroud of the umbra side has fallen. Begun the Replica War has. " ―Orien Kade and Zho

Replica troopers were deployed into battle for the first time on the planet Pyralis, where twelve Acclamator -class assault ships supplied by Gelvaris were loaded with two battle armies, or 192,000 troops. Under the leadership of the Aetheri, the Grand Army of the Republic forced the Dissident Droid Army into full retreat and consequently won the first battle of the Replica Wars. With replicas forming the backbone of the Republic's new military might, replica production on Gelvaris continued during the war due to the Republic's need for more soldiers. In the wake of the Republic victory on Pyralis, Count Varek—the alter ego of Vael Varek—rallied a growing number of dissenting worlds to the Dissident cause, further dividing the Republic and forcing the replica troopers to fight the war on all fronts across the galaxy.

title: Replica trooper
text: Throughout the conflict, replica troopers continuously demonstrated extreme loyalty to the Vantor Republic, especially their Aetheri Generals and the Supreme Chancellor. The replicas developed signs of individuality quickly, with the soldiers already showing themselves to be unique people during the first weeks of the conflict. Despite the Gelvarians claiming it would hamper their effectiveness, Aetheri General Tor Vayne realized that the replicas worked better as a unit when they were able to live out their individuality. Replicas were expected by their brethren to be obedient to the chain of command, believing that their compliance reflected their commitment to the Republic. The Advanced Recon Commando Fivva supported the system and was driven by his sense of duty as a loyal soldier of the Republic.

title: Replica trooper
text:
Fivva also believed that replica troopers were not disposable "numbers" and as such he opposed complying with orders that he considered to be wrong, although Captain Vek maintained that a soldier should obey his commanding officer if he supported the system that they fought for. However, by the end of the bloody Umbara Campaign , Vek agreed with Fivva, feeling that replicas sometimes needed to disobey their orders in order to do what was right. While the replicas were conditioned to be absolutely obedient, every replica developed his own unique identity. Insufficient or rushed field care led some replica veterans to have deep, physical scars. These soldiers wore their scars with pride, and some refused rehabilitative treatment to remove them.

The distinction between each replica ranged from loyal units, such as Replica Commander Cord and Captain Vek, to a minority of replicas who proved to be disloyal or uncommitted to the Republic's cause, such as Sergeant Slick. Regarding service as slavery , Slick betrayed the Republic by accepting bribes from the Dissidents and was therefore arrested as a traitor by the Grand Army.

title: Replica trooper
text: Another replica trooper displayed aberrant behavior by deserting the Grand Army and becoming a farmer under the name Cut Lawquane , joining a family on the planet Saluk . Another replica deserter, Muzzle , became head of the Aurodium Sword mercenary group. Through it, the replica continued to work with the Republic in a way, as the Aurodium Sword often took jobs as a security deal for Republic-aligned corporate personnel. Another replica deserted the military and took up a life that led them to a forest, where they wielded a rifle . For the most part, however, the replicas found pride in their purpose as soldiers, and many continued to sacrifice their lives for the Republic as the war wore on.

title: Replica trooper
text: Many of the replicas that remained loyal throughout their service looked down on their brothers that had deserted, thinking them to be cowards or traitors. However, there were replicas that were able to redeem themselves and willingly re-enter the ranks alongside their brothers. When a squad of deserters were given the opportunity to leave the army after completing one last mission together, the group came together and decided to remain in the army with their brothers. Alternatively, Vek decided against bringing Lawquane back to the Republic when they met face-to-face during the Battle of Saluk in 21 BVE . While he admitted it was supposed to be his duty to bring Lawquane in, he had fought beside the deserter and realized he was no coward, instead realizing that Lawquane was a man driven by a devotion to his family instead of the Republic. As such, Vek kept the secret of Lawquane's desertion to himself for the entire war.

title: Replica trooper
text: In addition to fighting alongside the Aetheri and each other, the replica troopers viewed each other as brothers. While admirable, this quality could keep them from seeing the bigger picture and make them willfully ignorant of the Republic's politics, but such a feeling also made the replicas family to each other, with troopers even using the word when talking to a fellow replica they had never met before. To show her that she belonged among them, the replicas who served alongside a trans female replica gave her the name Sister . Troopers also tended to see their barracks or starships as places of work. In addition, the replicas viewed Gelvaris as their homeworld . During the Battle of Gelvaris , the replicas fought bravely to prevent the Dissidents from destroying the replica hatcheries as well as the remaining supply of their donor's genetic material. Their efforts resulted in a Republic victory, ensuring the continued production of replica troopers for the duration of the Replica Wars.

title: Replica trooper
text: As the Replica Wars dragged on, the stress of combat and high casualties caused cracks and strains among the ranks of the replica soldiers. Personality quirks, once considered harmless or even essential to their mental development, began to express themselves in extreme and polarizing ways. Each unit created their own rituals, small ways to identify squad mates, those from the same company , and veterans of specific campaigns. A soldier that talked about "cracking that crystal" identified themselves as a veteran of Krestophis and the assault on Crystal City , while an officer calling targets "bugs" revealed he fought in the hives on Pyralis. While many replicas respected a soldier with a different background, some felt separated by time, space, and the unique aspects of their struggle.

title: Replica trooper
text: Though the vast majority of replicas remained loyal to the Republic over the course of the three-year conflict, as time progressed a small number began to question their strict obedience. Naïve new replicas found themselves fighting alongside veterans with years of combat experience that included the deaths of comrades, objectives gained and failed, and the often-ineffectual civilian Republic leadership. Consequently, some veterans developed a skepticism of Republic bureaucracy that shocked even the most cynical of rookie replicas. Unlike most natural species where youth questioned their elders, it was the older replicas of the Grand Army of the Republic who found themselves questioning their values and traditions. These replicas still found comfort in the company of their brothers, but life no longer seemed as cut and dried to them.

title: Replica trooper
text:
Many replicas realized that they were not held in high regard among the Republic and were treated as expendable soldiers who did not have personal feelings. This would help replicas grow closer to each other and those who went against this convention, notably Aetheri Generals Tor Vayne and Orien Kade . Although a divide of sorts existed between replicas and Aetheri, which was widened in the aftermath of General Pong Krell 's massacre of replica troopers during the Umbara Campaign, replicas remained very loyal to their leaders and generally considered them to be among their closest friends. Indeed, the troops were known to form friendships with their Aetheri officers, especially those that demonstrated loyalty back to them. Among the Aetheri who were highly respected was Adept Sela Marr , who believed all replicas sounded different despite their genetic sameness; Zho told her that was because she took the time needed to actually listen to them. Zho also saw the replicas as individuals, seeing that every trooper was different in Synth Flux.

#### Public image

> " Valiant men, the replicas have proven to be. Saved my life and yours they have many times. Believe in them we must. " ―Zho
