#### Adept lost

> " When I was out there, alone, all I had was your training and the lessons you taught me. And because of you, I did survive. And not only that, I was able to lead others to survive as well. " " I don't know what to say. " " I do. Thank you, Master. " " You're welcome, my Adept. " ―Sela Marr and Kael Drayden

Drayden, Marr, and 501st forces fought on Feldora alongside Tor Vayne and his replicas in taking out a reinforced Dissident outpost . Breaking their forces into three groups, Drayden and Vek's team were responsible for attacking the front gate and destroying the tactical droid , TZ-33 , securing the outpost together with Vayne and Marr's teams.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: However, Drayden then noticed that Marr had disappeared during the battle, and ordered a perimeter sweep. Drayden had his men search around the outpost, to no avail several times over. Master Vayne then informed that he had alerted all forces throughout the Outer Reach and assured Drayden that she would be found eventually, but also firmly told him that their mission on Feldora was finished and that they had to return to Vantor. However, Drayden refused to abandon her, to which Vayne observed his emotions were clouding his judgment. Drayden countered "I will not leave her fate up to others." Vayne insisted, "It's time to go." Only then did Drayden comply and call everybody in to leave the planet.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Back at the Temple, Drayden relentlessly searched for possibilities in the star charts, which prompted Vayne to suggest that he should trust in Marr's abilities. Following the events on Wasskah , Drayden's search for his Adept came to an end when she arrived to the Temple on the Halo , in company of her Vorak allies and the younglings O-Mer and Jinx . Upon seeing her, Drayden profusely apologized for all that happened, heavily blaming himself for his apparent inability to protect her. Marr, however, assured him that his instruction gave her the skills necessary to survive and thanked him for his guidance. The two bowed to each other in newfound mutual respect under the delighted eye of Master Zho.

#### Battle of Horain

> " Stand down! It's General Kade. And it looks like he's bringing a new friend. " ―Kael Drayden

Sometime later Drayden participated in the Battle of Horain , alongside Kade and Vek. Drayden was contacted by Vek, who was requesting assistance, though he was already preoccupied with a group of Vulture Droids. Drayden later met Kade and Vek in disbelief, noticing they had hijacked an AAT alongside faulty battle droid Bats .

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Skirmish on Retta

On Retta , Drayden ambushed a group of B1 battle droids alongside Grand Master Zho. Drayden was soon attacked by Kreeda , a Segredo who was attempting to scare the Aetheri away. However, Kreeda soon became friendly to the Aetheri, as she was an old friend of Zho. When Drayden attempted to recruit Kreeda as a spy, the Segredo left, and Drayden and Zho were attacked by battle droids soon after. After being separated with Zho, he met the Aetheri Master and Kreeda again, the latter of whom explained she was protecting refugees of the Replica Wars. Using a hat from one of the individuals she was protecting, Drayden pretended to be using the " cloaking cap " to distract General Flebek , allowing Zho to take out a B1. Believing there was no secret to invisibility and that it had been a trick, Flebek fled the area and boarded her ship. Upon asking what his report would entail, Zho told Drayden that he would tell Drevan Koss there was nothing of interest on Retta.

#### Battle of Mon Calvarra

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Battle of Mon Calvarra

> " Alright. I think I'm getting the hang of this. " [Drayden gets electrocuted] " Less talking helps. " ―Kael Drayden and Kit Fisto, restrained by Calavane eels

After the assassination of King Kolina of Mon Calvarra and new discord in the fragile peace between the Calavane and the Quarren , Drayden and Ondar, sent as representatives of the Republic, arrived to the planet at the behest of Captain Gial Vorian of the Calavane Guard and protector of young Prince Liarch , but so did Riff Tamson , Dissident ambassador . Though Drayden and Ondar tried to mediate between the parties, the Quarren left the council hall, dissatisfied with the Calavane rule. Along with Vorian, they contacted Zho and Koss, who dispatched a company of replica troopers equipped for underwater combat under the command of Kit Fisto and Marr.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: In the meantime, during the Quarren attack assisted by Dissident aqua droids, Drayden and Ondar accompanied Liarch, who in turn was bodyguarded by Vorian. He engaged the Quarren soldiers until he was recalled by his wife to help Senator Meena Tills , while leaving Marr to cover the prince and rescue him from Tamson. As the first Dissident/Quarren assault came to an end, Drayden reunited with Ondar, Marr, Fisto, Vorian, Liarch, and Tills to await the second assault, this time assisted by the Hydroid Medusas , which proved incredibly effective against the Republic-Calavane army. Forced to retreat into the caves below, they regrouped to decide their next course of action—to retreat to the surface, only return to the sea floor as their frigate was destroyed and they were attacked by more enemies.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: They split into two groups: Drayden went with his wife, Vorian, and Tills, whereas Fisto, Marr, and two troopers accompanied the Prince. Expecting Republic reinforcements to come soon, Drayden and his group proceeded to the Calavane central planetary scanner facility, where the Aetheri Knight collapsed the entire structure with Synth Flux, rendering planetary defenses blind to upcoming Republic reinforcements—the Mool Grand Army, and Representative Mool, sent at the behest of the High Council. However, Tamson used Trident -class assault ship to create whirlpools, disorienting the Republic-Mool forces, and though Drayden managed to destroy one of them, all but Marr and Liarch were captured.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Brought before Riff Tamson, Drayden and Fisto were restrained by electric eels , whereas Ondar and Greeb Mool were imprisoned within containment devices , interrogating the two Aetheri about the whereabouts of Prince Liarch. During the interrogation, Tamson attempted to synth flux them to talk by biting a tiny hole into Ondar's helmet, allowing her suit to fill up with water . However, Tamson left to see the located Prince in person, Drayden and Fisto used Synth Flux to remove the water from her helmet, while Mool used his saliva to seal the puncture, saving her from drowning. The four were soon taken to witness Prince Liarch's execution, in which Nossor Ri , the Quarren leader, saved the prince at the critical moment and turned his people against the Dissidents, resulting in the victory of the Mon Calvarra people. With the peace restored, Drayden and his friends were present for the coronation of Liarch , now recognized by both Calavane and Quarren as their new monarch.

#### Ondara

> " Lira, I'm sorry. " ―Kael Drayden, after being traded for Skarn

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Ondara

> " Lira, I'm sorry. " ―Kael Drayden, after being traded for Skarn

Following rumors that the Mools planned to aid the Dissidents in an attack on Serath, Drayden accompanied Ondar to Serath and later, to the Mool territory near Lake Paonga where they met with Mool, who confirmed the troubling rumors. He took the couple to Otoh Gunga, where they spoke to Boss Lyonie , and realized he was under the influence of a mind-controlling necklace , which Drayden telekinetically snatched, making him recover; Lyonie told them that new minister , Rish Loo , had given it to him.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Drayden, Ondar, and Mool assisted Lyonie as he confronted Loo, only to face droid commandos, and for Lyonie to be stabbed by Loo before the minister's escape. Taking the Boss to an infirmary, the couple noticed the uncanny resemblance between the unconscious Lyonie and Mool, who they convince to impersonate Lyonie and cancel the Mool assault on Serath. As he did so, uncovering Loo's deception to the army, Drayden pursued the fugitive minister to a trap set by Count Varek in Loo's laboratory . As Varek killed Loo and revealed his secret input in the Battle of Ondara, Drayden dueled the Count, only to be overwhelmed by Varek's powers and his four MagnaGuards.

Varek then contacted Ondar and offered an exchange—the Aetheri Knight for General Skarn, who had been captured by the Mool Grand Army, thanks to Mool General Tarpals's sacrifice. An hour later, Drayden was brought and handed over to Ondar, Queen Neeyutnee and the Mools, while Skarn was allowed to remain free.

#### Battle of Umbara

> " Does my battalion have to do everything? " " You seem to always volunteer. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Battle of Umbara

> " Does my battalion have to do everything? " " You seem to always volunteer. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

During the campaign on Umbara , Drayden and Kade discussed their attack strategy against the Umbaran capital city , which was being defended by Confederate and local militia forces. Together with Vek and Fivva, Drayden prepared to repel enemy reinforcements striking against Kade's joint attack with Aetheri Masters Saesee Tiin and Pong Krell , who would be supporting Kade from the south whereas Drayden and 501st Legion would advance from the north. Amidst heavy fire, Drayden and his battalion made it to the landing site, and then to a ridge which they used as a staging area. As he and Vek awaited the rest of their men, hoping to move out soon and reinforce General Kade's battalion, Dogma reported that all platoons had reported in, and Drayden told him to get some rest. Dogma replied that he was fine, but Vek told him it was a direct order, prompting Dogma to do as he was told. As Vek observed Dogma was "wound tight but loyal," Drayden joked that he reminded him of Vek, who disagreed, saying that was him in the old days.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Shortly after this, the Umbarans ambushed Drayden and his troops, but an airstrike by Master Krell and Odd Ball saved them. After the quick save, Krell approached Drayden with a disconcerting message: the Council had ordered Drayden back to Vantor, effective immediately, as requested by Supreme Chancellor Mal, for reasons unknown. Though reluctant to leave his troops in the midst of battle, Drayden was forced to relinquish command over his troops to Master Krell and make the journey back to Vantor. Despite Krell's efforts to sabotage the Republic effort by tricking the 501st and the 212th battalions into attacking each other, Kade was successful in taking the capital and routing the remaining Umbaran forces, securing all sectors of the planet for the Republic.

#### Kiros

> " Zygeran scum! I'll handle that slaver… " ―Kael Drayden, on Darts D'Nar

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Kiros

> " Zygeran scum! I'll handle that slaver… " ―Kael Drayden, on Darts D'Nar

After ten rotations of Zho's last contact with the Solinai colonists on Kiros , Drayden, Marr, Vek, Cord, Kade, and their forces arrived at the world to investigate its silence, with Drayden particularly worried they would be too late. After landing, suspicious of the lack of colonists in the town , they used BARC speeders to break through the city and surround the governor's tower , used as the Dissident Headquarters. The enemy commander, Darts D'Nar , then sent a message to Kade to discuss terms of surrender. Drayden then took the lumen projector out of Cord's hand and called D'Nar " Zygeran scum." Though Drayden wanted to deal with the slaver himself, Kade told him to locate the missing colonists while he negotiated. As Drayden contacted Admiral Yular to conduct a planetary bioscan to find them, Kade explained Drayden's behavior to Marr.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Overhearing from Kade's negotiations that D'Nar had planted bombs throughout the city, Drayden and Marr set out to disarm them. Despite sniper droids , they destroyed the bombs in the nick of time, just for Kade to tell them D'Nar was escaping on the Tecora . With some effort, they managed to board the ship, inside which D'Nar pitted a blixus against them, but Drayden managed to throw it off the ship, while Marr bested D'Nar in the cockpit. Soon, Drayden joined her and, with frightening intensity, threatened the Zygeran into revealing the colonists' location, much to Marr's surprise. However, it proved effective as D'Nar revealed that his Queen would hold the Royal Slave Auction.

#### Zygera

> " A most curious Aetheri who cares more about his friends than his own mission. Hero. General. And now, my servant. " ―Miraj Scintel

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Zygera

> " A most curious Aetheri who cares more about his friends than his own mission. Hero. General. And now, my servant. " ―Miraj Scintel

When Drayden, Kade, Yular, and Marr told the Aetheri Council of their findings, they were tasked with locating the colonists. On the Tecora , and disguised as Zygeran, they land on the capital city of Zygera ; splitting into two teams (Kade and Vek went to located the colonists), Drayden and Marr went to meet Queen Miraj Scintel , with Drayden posing as "Havel Quell" and bringing news of Bruno Denturri 's supposed death, and presenting Marr as a present. He quickly won Scintel's favor, with the Queen inviting him to accompany her during the slave auction, where she intended to have Drayden prove himself a slaver by torturing Kade.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Instead, he freed Kade and tried to escape with Bolt-3 returning their flux blades, Vek providing cover fire and Marr confronting the Queen. Despite their efforts, however, they were subdued, but Scintel saw Drayden's determination, for five electro-whips were needed to reduce him. Despite Varek and half her kingdom demanding his death, Scintel had Drayden brought to her quarters. There he woke up and interrogated Scintel about his friends' whereabouts, while he throttled the Queen with Synth Flux. However, Scintel gasped that his friends would die unless he obeyed her, and Drayden was forced to comply and become her bodyguard and escort, just as she became infatuated by him.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After a few days, Varek would arrive, and Drayden observed that she too was a slave to the Count, before she left to receive the Umbra Lord. With the help of Bolt-3, he escaped his guards and freed Marr from her cage and sent her to prep the ship, while he interrogated Scintel to tell him Kade and Vek's location. However, he found himself before Atai Molec , who had betrayed Scintel, and Varek, with whom Drayden futilely dueled before Varek blamed him of killing Scintel before her guards. Drayden then took Scintel and escaped to the Tecora , aboard which she told him Kade was in the Kadavo system and that she, just like Drayden, was a slave, before dying.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
After contacting Tor Vayne to send reinforcements, Drayden and Marr soon reached Kadavo and entered the slave-processing facility . During the battle that ensued, Drayden disabled the turrets that were attacking Vayne and his forces, while Marr saved the Solinai colonists from falling to their death (as caused by Keeper Agruss ) by placing Admiral Bartono Coburn 's Arquitens -class light cruiser Hand of Justice underneath the facility. Along with Vek and Kade, Drayden evacuated the facility before it was destroyed on Vayne's orders, before returning to the rest of Vayne's fleet.

#### Mal kidnapped

> " Drayden, a powerful Aetheri you are, yet unpredictable and dangerous you can be, to both your friends and enemies. For Orien, on your patience, everything depends. " ―Zho, to Kael Drayden

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Mal kidnapped

> " Drayden, a powerful Aetheri you are, yet unpredictable and dangerous you can be, to both your friends and enemies. For Orien, on your patience, everything depends. " ―Zho, to Kael Drayden

After the capture of Moralo Eval , rumored to be the mastermind of a plot to kidnap Supreme Chancellor Mal, Drayden, Marr, and Kade were recalled to an emergency meeting by the High Council while they walked through the nightly streets of Vantor. On their way to the Temple, however, a sniper opened fire at them, which prompted the three Aetheri to chase their aggressor. However, the sniper killed Kade before escaping on a speeder, prompting Drayden to return to his master, to find Marr crying and his old master dead, whom he called several times trying to get him to respond. Becoming withdrawn and grim, Drayden would not say a word since then, until after the funeral held to honor Kade, when he went on a self-imposed mission to locate his murderer, Rako Hardeen , at Trueping's . Though Drayden would rather kill him, he arrested Hardeen and ferried him to the Republic Detention Center.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After hearing that Hardeen had escaped from jail, Drayden held a meeting with his friend, Mal, when Koss informed the Chancellor that they would remove the bounty on Hardeen and the two other escapees, Eval and Cad Vorek; a decision did not sit well with Drayden. Mal suggested that the Council perhaps did not trust him to control his feelings, and Drayden felt the Council was doing nothing to catch the murderer of his master—his best friend. Exploiting this to his advantage, Mal told him not to deny his feelings, for they were what made him special, and deliberately sent Drayden and Marr to Grukh . There, two Aetheri harshly interrogated locals for information, which led them to Orondia , the fugitives last known location.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After spotting their quarry as they prepare to leave, Drayden rammed their ship into submission and board it in midflight, but was foiled by Vorek and a subsequent crash-landing of both parties resulting from the chase. Surrounded by smoke, Hardeen left the ship, and Drayden confronted him, ready to kill Hardeen when Vorek interrupted him. Hardeen intervened then and wrestled with Drayden, whispering to Drayden's ear "Kael, don't follow me." As he felt a connection, Drayden passed out, only for Marr to protect him for Vorek's attempts to execute him. As they returned to Vantor, Zho summoned Drayden to his chambers and revealed the truth to him—that Kade was "Rako Hardeen."

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Afterwards, Drayden was briefed along his Adept about the security plans the Council had for the Chancellor during the Festival of Light on Ondara. Drayden, Marr, and Koss would escort the Mal and Mazan Veldon to Serath, where Drayden was greeted by his wife. At the festival itself, the abduction was initially successful with Cad Vorek and Moralo Eval ferrying Mal away, while Drayden and Koss captured Embo and Twazzi ; however, Kade stopped Eval and Vorek, long enough for Koss and Drayden to arrive and take the two into custody.

As he reunited with his old master, he voiced his resentment for the Council's lack of trust in him as well as Kade's decision to hide the truth from him. Wondering how many other lies he had been told by the Council, he set out on his own to bodyguard Mal, who continued to place seeds of doubt in Drayden until they were greeted by Varek. After destroying two of his MagnaGuards, Drayden dueled the Count with ferocity, until Kade arrived to help him rescue the Chancellor, whereas Varek fled.

#### A phantom menace

text:
#### A phantom menace

> " I sense a disturbance. Something sinister. " " All the way out here? " " Yes. " " Do you know what…or who it is? " "[sigh] No. But whatever it is, it feels familiar. " ―Kael Drayden and Sela Marr

Sometime later, when Drayden and Marr were on their way to rendezvous with a cruiser, they decided to land at the Stobar Spaceport , as Drayden was hungry and tired of government rations. The two walked into Plop Dribble's , only to find police droids and an unconscious waitress . Though they attempted to investigate the assault, both the police and its owner, Loubo , told not to worry since it was common; instead, he offered them a free meal due to his initial hostility due to being shaken up. However, Drayden sensed a disturbance in Synth Flux , something sinister and familiar—which, unbeknownst to him, heralded the return of the now renegade Umbra Lord Vreth.

#### Underra Insurgency

> " I feel responsible for them. " " I know you do, Snips, but remember, purpose must come before feelings. " ―Sela Marr and Kael Drayden

#### Underra Insurgency

> " I feel responsible for them. " " I know you do, Snips, but remember, purpose must come before feelings. " ―Sela Marr and Kael Drayden

Following a plea made by a insurgent cell on Underra, the Aetheri Council considered how to help them fight the Dissidents. Drayden suggested training the insurgents in subversive combat tactics; though it verged on terrorism, which the Aetheri would not support, the High Council decided to send advisors to the insurgent cell for the upcoming battle . On the Nura -class transport Valkyrie 2929 , Drayden, Marr, Vek, and Kade reached the planet during the night, when they met Steela Vess and were guided to their insurgent secret base, where they met her brother, Torrik . The team trained the insurgents to combat droids, until Dissident probe droids discovered their outpost and attacked, which prompted the cell to enter Iziz .

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
After some successful operations, Drayden, Kade, and Vek decided to return to Vantor and report to the Council, while Marr stayed behind as a liaison to the insurgents, without revealing herself as an Aetheri. They kept in frequent communication with her, to provide guidance, but also to provide help by hiring Hondik Hosha to deliver missile launchers to the Underra insurgents for the final assault. Drayden attended the funeral service for Steela Vess.

#### Losing Satinna, saving Bolt #### Losing Satinna, saving Bolt

Drayden was later present when the Aetheri High Council met up with the chancellor to discuss Vreth's return, during which they decided to leave him alone even though they knew he was still alive. Drayden lent the Twilight to Kade, who used it to travel to Ferrum to rescue Satinna Velara. With all its technical problems, after landing on Ferrum, Kade vowed not to borrow another ship from Drayden. However, as he escaped, the ship was shot down by Ferrik commandos and destroyed, moments before Velara was murdered by Vreth during the Ferrik civil war . Drayden was waiting for Kade when the Aetheri Master returned to the Temple hangar, where Drayden saw through Kade's attempt to hide his sorrow. Kade explained he had lost someone important to him and that he had struggled with his rage, something Drayden knew all too well. Drayden offered to come with him for a report to the Council, which Kade happily agreed to.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Drayden was later present when the Aetheri Council sent Meebur Gascon and a team of Republic droids to steal an encryption module from the Dissidents. Later Drayden participated in the Republic strategy conference on the space station Valor , while on the station he noticed the Renown was going a little too fast. Varrix told Drayden that they are scanning Rhydonium on the ship, Drayden instantly realized it was a bomb, Drayden was later contacted and informed by Gascon of Bolt's sacrifice. Aftermath of Mokivj

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Aftermath of Mokivj

The mission ended with a catastrophe for Mokivj and an end to Solha's career. In an effort to collapse the Dissident's efforts to produce cortosis battle droids, Drayden accidentally sent lava, ash, and smoke into the planet's best cropland and water. Drayden did not know the cortosis in the mine would redirect the heat of the explosions, the heat was sent down the planet's crust, activating volcanic activity and leading to widespread devastation, deforestation, and desertification on Mokivj, resulting in the explosive synth flux doing more than merely collapsing the mine's tunnels. The catastrophe forced LebJau to move to another planet as the population knew he had collaborated with the ones who devastated Mokivj. Vorren had warned Ondar that Drayden's plan seemed reckless, yet she had known that he would be unable to be talked out of it, leaving the Aetheri and Senator to regret their actions as they looked upon the ruined world. Vorren had also warned Drayden that his theory about the replica armor being used to infiltrate the Republic seemed unlikely based on how great the risk of discovery would be. Despite Drayden's shortsighted plan, Vorren continued to respect the man and still viewed him as an effective warrior.

#### Crystal crisis on Uthara

> " How well would you sleep, knowing that I failed you? " " Not very well, I imagine. Luckily, that isn't true, and never will be. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

During the last months of the war, Kade and Drayden were sent to Uthara to investigate the mysterious death of Aetheri Master Tu-Anh . Once they landed on Pau City , Inspector Jen June led them to see the corpse at the morgue . After examining the body, they went to the place where she had been found, only to determine she had been hit in the optic nerve with a precision laser dart by a sniper. As they found the sniper's position, from the building's owner, Garri , the two Aetheri learned of the involvement of MagnaGuards and began to suspect the involvement of General Skarn, and had Inspector June analyze some slimy substance they had found—the secretion of an Amani 's skin.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Though Governor Torul Blom asked them to leave Uthara, Kade and Drayden persevered and rented two dactillions to go talk to the leader of an Amani tribe, who revealed that an Amani outcast had entered one of the caves. The two Aetheri entered it to find MagnaGuards. Despite some coalition, they managed to have the droids reveal the involvement of the Sulie and went to see Inspector June once again. Soon after, the two attended the funeral for Tu-Anh. As they reached the Amani settlement they had been looking for, the Amani scattered, leaving Drayden and Kade to follow the tracks of one that appeared to be their leader. During the hunt, Drayden mentioned Marr for the first time since her departure, and Kade asked if he wanted to talk about it, yet Drayden refused. Kade then suggested for them to set up a camp and rest. However, he insisted on the subject, prompting Drayden to tell Kade he missed Marr and to voice his anger at the High Council for turning its back on her. To Drayden's annoyance, Kade stood by the Council's authority, asserting that it had been Marr's decision to leave and that she had allowed her emotions to cloud her judgment, something against the Aetheri way. Then, Kade suggested he rest, but Drayden declined so that he could keep the first watch. Finally, he questioned Kade on what would happen if he had turned out to be a "major disappointment," but Kade wanted to believe it would never happen.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: However, they both fell asleep and were captured by a group of Sugis led by Chong , who brought them before Endente as Kade told Chong of their "intention" to buy weapons. They learned Endente was, in fact, selling a kyber crystal , and Drayden prompted him to show it before they made the deal. Brought to the starship where the crystal was being kept, they escaped from their captors, and Drayden eliminated all the Sulie, except for Endente, who fled. After they discovered the massive kyber crystal inside the ship, the two Aetheri managed to transport the crystal through Uthara's plains until they reached Pau City, where Blom had the two Aetheri surrounded with his men and Skarn's droids. As the kyber crystal was loaded into a shuttle and sent to a ship on orbit , Kade and Drayden stole a freighter to recover the crystal.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
During the persecution, Skarn damaged their ship, forcing them to perform a number five special ; they crashed it to disable the hyperrelay and, with their escape pods, boarded the ship where the crystal was then held. As they got separated, Kade was captured by Skarn, and Drayden recovered his flux blade, located the crystal, and freed Kade. Together, they made their way to the kyber crystal at the vault, where they were temporarily trapped until a squad discovered them. Using the crystal and Synth Flux to knock them out, he managed to get to a hangar, where Drayden stole a shuttle to escape. Meanwhile, Kade set several AATs to shoot and overload the crystal, destroying the crystal and the ship, while they escaped from the explosion in the nick of time and returned to Vantor to report to the Council.

Sometime later, while on a Vorash -class Iron Cruiser, Drayden discovered an unknown ship, the Silver Angel , in military airspace. Drayden then asked Admiral Yular who was on that transport. After he closed his eyes and sensed Sela Marr's presence through Synth Flux, he decided not to send a detachment to arrest the crew and to let Sela and her companions leave.

#### Vossa and Vray

> " Vray isn't capable of anything as selfless as love. And Vossa couldn't possibly have cared about a murderess like her. Besides, she's the one who took him to the umbra side in the first place. " " Stranger things have happened. And maybe, if she loves him, she's his way back from it. " ―Drayden and Ondar discuss Vossa and Vray' relationship

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Aetheri Master Daren Kelv had been tasked by the Aetheri Council to assassinate Varek with the help of Kessa Vray, but during a mission to Raxun Secundus the Aetheri turned to the umbra side due to Varek's manipulations and Vray's training. Vray staged a rescue mission , which failed and prompted her to contact the Aetheri Council. When she arrived at the Aetheri Sanctum, Drayden and Kade escorted her to the Council Chamber , where despite Drevan Koss's open disapproval, Zho dispatched Drayden and Kade to go with Vray to rescue Vossa above Tarisa . Soon enough, Kade, Drayden, and Vray were on the cockpit of her ship, the Banshee , to infiltrate the Dissident dreadnought from which Vossa, or rather "Admiral Enigma," was issuing orders.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Stealthily, the three boarded the ship and made their way to the bridge, where they found Varek, instead of Vossa. Drayden then engaged in a duel with the Count, distracting him while Kade and Vray discovered a captive Vossa. Though she knew Vossa was consumed by his hatred, they escaped to the Banshee , and Drayden joined with them to escape the enemy ship and return to Vantor. Back in the Aetheri Sanctum, Drayden saw as the Council welcomed Vossa and pardoned Vray. That same night, Drayden reunited with his wife, Ondar, for a moment of respite, during which Drayden told her of the ordeal—after which, Ondar conferred that perhaps Vray's love could be Vossa's way back from the umbra side, leaving Drayden at a loss for words.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: A month later, Drayden was sent alongside Kade, Vossa, and Akar-Deshu in a mission to take over a Dissident supply storage base and redistribute the supplies to worlds in need of them. However, their mission went awry when Vossa, unbeknownst to them, arranged the base's destruction. After another failed mission to Vossa's name, he was suspected of treason, Drayden and Kade were sent to spy on Vossa and Vray as they were deployed to assassinate Varek during the second battle of Krestophis . When they saw Vossa attempt to synth flux the Count to lead him to his master, Vael Mal, rather than kill him, Drayden and Kade intervened, taking the pair by surprise and arresting them.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
However, Vossa and Varek soon escaped from the Vigilance , causing the death of Akar-Deshu and Kav Bayons , and boarded Vray' ship, Banshee to escape Krestophis. Drayden had the Banshee fired on, forcing the renegades to land on the planet below. He and Kade pursued the three injured fugitives to a Dissident-controlled tower , where they surrounded them. There, Drayden and Kade witnessed what appeared to be Vray' last moments, sacrificing herself to save Vossa from Varek's fatal Synth Flux lightning . After her death, Drayden and Kade were joined by the redeemed Vossa, and they tried to capture Varek, to no avail. They then transported Vray' body and Vossa to Vantor, where the fallen Aetheri confessed his crimes and Kade defended Vray.

#### A New Droid Army

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### A New Droid Army

After confiscating a Munificent -class star frigate with Squad 326 , Drayden was joined by Grand Master Zho and informed about the mysterious Dissident project, Operation: Titan . Hacking into the frigate 's datacore , they were able to discover that Operation: Titan was being overseen on the planet Enthenium . Together, Zho and Drayden traveled to a Dissident base on Enthenium to uncover more information about the supposed "weapon" that was being developed under Project: Titan. Once they snuck onto the base, Zho climbed through the vents, found information on the "weapons", and confronted Skarn, who was stationed on the base. Meanwhile, Drayden and Squad 326 were battling battle droids as the base went on alert. After Zho came back and aided in the fight, the team escaped before reinforcements arrived. On the frigate once again, Drayden was informed by Zho that on Golatha the weapons being developed were a new army of megadroids four times taller than a human. Drayden quipped that they should have expected the Dissidents to eventually make their droids bigger.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Drayden and Zho then informed the Aetheri High Council via hologram about their planned mission to Golatha . Drayden believed that, because the planet was small, the forces guarding the droid factory would also be small. Zho warned against being overconfident, and suggested being more cautious. Master Koss agreed with Zho and wished them luck, ending the transmission. Drayden was offended by the idea that his plan was overconfident, doing an impression of what Zho had said to mock him. Replica Captain Cesar interrupted their brief argument and informed them that they had arrived. On the planet's surface, Zho and Drayden surveyed the valley where the factory was, but found no above-surface structure. They determined that the factory was fully underground and that an access point must be in the valley. Zho and Drayden, along with Company 326 descended into the valley, and found no droid guards. However, volt pistol fire shot out from the trees, with the replicas unable to stop whatever was firing at them. Zho was able to stop the droid guards firing on them and find the hidden access point, but only after Cesar and rest of the company were all killed.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: They entered the facility alone, with Drayden noting that the size of an attacking army didn't matter anyways. After taking out more droids, Drayden mentioned to Zho that he only had eight thermal detonators, and hoped that would be enough. Upon entering the main area of the factory, they saw a massive assembly line manufacturing hundreds of megadroids. Drayden didn't think they could destroy the whole thing, but Zho pointed out the central column holding up the factory. Drayden asked if he thought taking out the column would take out the whole facility. Zho cheekily responded with an impression of what Drayden had said earlier, with Drayden having to admit that the impression was pretty good. They set the charges and escaped just in time for the factory to explode. However, a sound erupted that wasn't just the factory caving in. A single megadroid shot out from the explosion, and landed right in front of Drayden and Zho. Drayden mentioned that it seems to big, to which Zho replied that size was only a matter of perspective. They try attacking it, but its durasteel coating was stronger than normal, leaving it immune to flux blade attacks. Zho climbed inside the

> " Tell me the sequence to disarm the bomb! " " Never. Varek would kill me for losing Anaxes. " " And you think I won't ? " " You're an Aetheri. Your nobility-- " " I don't have such weaknesses! Now, let's try that again. " ―Kael Drayden and Trench

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Following an assault on Cato Geltaria , Drayden was dispatched alongside Koss to participate in the Battle of Anaxes to defend the Republic shipyards on Anaxes . With mounting losses on the Republic side, Captain Vek told Drayden and Koss his theory that the Dissidents had learned his own strategy. Considering this possibility, Koss sent Vek and Commander Cord to take a squad, and Replica Synth Flux 99 , behind enemy lines to infiltrate a Dissident Cyber Center while he and Drayden held the line. The general staff was told about the possibility of sending a mission to Skako Minor , and Drayden was sure the Aetheri High Council would approve it. Replica Sergeant " Hunter " also stated The Bad Batch would go with them. Although Vek was eager to get going, Drayden informed him they had a "thing" to do, and, although Vek felt they did not have time, they both went to the barracks.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Vek remained outside on watch while Drayden, holding Vek's helmet, went in and contacted Ondar. Drayden apologized for being away for so long, but, as the two spoke, Orien Kade approached Vek. The Replica Captain knocked on the door to speed up Drayden. Drayden confided that he was worried about his captain, worrying that Vek was letting his personal feelings drive him too much on the mission, although Ondar believed Vek had learned that trait from him. Outside, Vek tried to lie about what Drayden was doing. However, Drayden and her ended their conversation, and both went on their way to Skako, although Kade revealed he knew he had been talking to Ondar by quipping that he hoped Drayden at least greeted Lira for him. In response the Aetheri stopped in his tracks, and although dismayed that his effort to be secretive had been for naught, Drayden kept his composure and only gave his master a knowing glance before walking away.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
As they reached Skako Minor on the Marauder , Drayden was captured by the Poletec on their keeradaks , prompting Vek and the Bad Batch to follow them to the village and rescue the Aetheri General. They apologized and explained the situation, and the chief helped them reach Purkoll , which they infiltrated with some effort. When they reached the antechamber, Foreman Wat Tambra sent a transmission saying they had violated the Artificer Union 's neutrality, and sent droid reinforcements. While Drayden, Hunter, Wrecker , and Crossline destroyed them, Vek and Tech found Echo—alive, but as a cyborg.

Tech managed to unplug Echo, and they escaped to the ventilation system before being vaporized by Tambra's Decimator , after which Wrecker destroyed the Foreman's main computers with explosives. As they escaped, however, they were surrounded by his D1-series aerial battle droids , but thanks to Tech, they rode keeradaks to the Poletec village . There, they convinced the natives to help them against the Artificer Union's forces, including their octuptarra tri-droids , with Drayden effectively destroying two of them.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Following the skirmish, Drayden, Vek, and Replica Synth Flux 99 returned to Fort Anaxes , where Koss and Kade were to take the Dissident assembly complex by air, whereas Echo was to be escorted by the Bad Batch, Drayden, and Vek into Trench's communications vault on a dreadnought on the planet's orbit, where he would plug himself to the dreadnought to feed the Dissident's strategic movements. When Echo did so and deactivated the droids attacking the assembly complex, he realized that Trench had initiated a countdown for an explosion that could destroy most of Anaxes. While Kade assisted in the evacuation efforts, and Koss deactivated the bomb, Drayden went to the dreadnought's bridge to confront Trench, destroying his droid bodyguards. Trench refused to give the final sequence number, believing that Drayden would not harm him. Drayden amputated Trench's prosthetic attachments, prompting the Harch to immediately give in. After relaying it to Koss, who deactivated the bomb, Trench then tried to electrocute him; in response, Kael thrust his flux blade through the Harch's chest, killing him. He then took the self-destruct detonator for the dreadnought and reunited with the rest of his team.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
As they left aboard the Marauder , Drayden let Wrecker destroy Trench's flagship, the Invulnerable , damaging the nearby Dissident fleet, and they went back to Fort Anaxes. Following the victory, the Republic prepared medals for the team, while Corporal Echo joined "The Bad Batch."

### Birth of Xarn Velgor

#### Battle of Yerbana

> " Sir, we've received a transmission from someone using your subspace frequency "Fulcrum"." "Torrik Vess?" "Perhaps the siege at Underra has taken a turn for the worse." "No, sir. It's not Vess. You had best take this transmission here on the ship. Both of you. " ―Yular, Drayden, and Kade

At some point before the Battle of Vantor , Drayden was on Tythe and had another encounter with Varek, yet he failed to defeat the Count. Along with the 501st and 212th, Drayden and Kade were sent to Yerbana to take down the Dissident forces on the planet. The fight caused Drayden and Kade to split their respective battalions into two fronts.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Drayden, Vek, and the 501st Legion defeated the Dissident Droid Army on their front, so they left to assist Kade and his 212th Attack Battalion, which was suffering heavy casualties from the ongoing conflict. While Kade and Commander Cord were taking cover from the blasts, Drayden ordered his men to hide under the bridge, while Bolt-3 would tell them when to launch. Next, Drayden stepped into the fight and convinced his Master to follow his plan. Drayden faked a surrender to draw out the droid commander , who saw through the lies of the Aetheri Knight; however, it was too late, as Drayden used his Synth Flux abilities to destroy the droid commander, allowing his 501st Legion led by Captain Vek to make a surprising ambush on the rest of the droid army, ending the conflict.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
The 212th Attack Battalion proceeded to help the 501st while Drayden was approached by Kade who complimented him, which Drayden answered by thanking Kade for helping achieve victory. The two were soon contacted by Admiral Wulric Yular, who informed them of an upcoming transmission going under the code " Fulcrum ," while the two Aetheri thought it might have been Torrik Vess, Yular confirmed otherwise saying it was necessary for the generals to attend the call themselves.

#### The last meeting of a friendship

> " You capture Vreth. I'll take care of Skarn. With any luck, this will all be over soon. " " Master Kade always said there's no such thing as luck. " " Good thing I taught you otherwise. " [Drayden begins to leave] " Kael! Good luck. " ―Kael Drayden and Sela Marr's final words to each other as friends

title: Xarn Velgor
text: At Yular's ship, Drayden and Kade were surprised to see Sela Marr and Bo-Katin Velara were the ones that had made the call. Emotionally shocked to see his former apprentice after several months of being apart, Drayden barely managed to control himself and proceeded to talk to Marr, who remarked the moment was not a reunion as Vreth had been located on Ferrum and they had an opportunity to capture him. Marr hoped Drayden and Kade would be able to join forces with her to confront him. Marr, Velara, and her Ferriks boarded the ship, where they were greeted by Drayden and Kade. The former tried to greet Marr, but his former apprentice turned him down saying they had to act immediately if they wanted to capture Vreth. The group went to discuss the possible attack, but Kade was not willing to help Marr and her allies unless the Aetheri Council gave their permission, causing Drayden to unnoticeably scowl at him. While Kade contacted the Council, Drayden had Marr accompanying him through the complex. Drayden led Marr to a room full of the 501st replica troopers, including Vek, who had painted their helmets as a way to honor her former Commander. Drayden then prepared to give Marr her old flux blades , but before he could do so, the ship's alarm suddenly went off.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Kade rushed in and informed Drayden and Vek that they would be jumping to hyperspace immediately. When Drayden asked if this meant the attack on Ferrum was approved, Kade revealed that they were actually heading for Vantor, where a dire situation was happening: General Skarn had launched a full-scale attack on the capital of the Republic, and the Aetheri Council had lost contact with Shaak Ti, Chancellor Mal's assigned protector. Drayden was visibly uncomfortable about this news, but Kade assured him that their fleet would arrive at Vantor very soon. Marr, however, was angered by her former Masters' decision to abandon Ferrum. Kade pointed out that they were entering a pivotal moment in the Replica Wars, but Marr countered that Kade was playing politics and that the Aetheri Order had lost their way by forgetting that their duty was to help people and not politicians, which was why the people, and Marr herself, had lost faith in them. Drayden heard the argument and weighed in; so as to help Marr in the upcoming siege while also taking part in the mission to rescue the Chancellor, Drayden promoted Vek to Commander so he could lead the a new formation of the 501st that was dubbed the 332nd Division , assigning Marr to assist as an advisor due to her being unable to hold an official military title. When Kade agreed, Marr accepted the proposal. Kade left the room to prepare their troops leaving Drayden and Marr behind. Drayden gave Marr her new flux blades complimenting them as better than before.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Drayden then headed to rescue the Chancellor, believing the defeats of Vreth and Skarn would mark an end to the war. While he was leaving, Marr stopped him by wishing him good luck in his mission. Happy to have been reunited with his apprentice, Drayden smiled and they both parted ways. Unbeknownst to either of them, this would be the last time they ever saw each other as friends.

#### Confrontation on the Invisible Hand

> " Good, Kael, good! [...] Kill him. Kill him now." "I shouldn't…" "Do it. " ―Theron Mal and Kael Drayden, on killing Varek #### Confrontation on the Invisible Hand

> " Good, Kael, good! [...] Kill him. Kill him now." "I shouldn't…" "Do it. " ―Theron Mal and Kael Drayden, on killing Varek

Having been away from Vantor for months due to the Outer Reach Sieges , Drayden and his Master finally returned to the planet after leaving Marr, to lead the rescue of the Chancellor from General Skarn before the cyborg's fleet could flee the besieged Capital . Assisted by a squadron of ARC-170 starfighters led by Replica Commander Odd Ball, the two Aetheri fought their way through a swarm of Vulture and tri-fighter droid starfighters protecting the Invisible Hand , General Skarn's flagship. Drayden and Kade headed for the ship while the replicas distracted the droids, but Kade's ship was damaged and partially disabled by Buzz-droids . Although Kade told Drayden to abandon him and complete the mission, the younger Aetheri refused and cleared his former master's ship of droids before escorting him to the Invisible Hand ' s hangar. After crashing landing, the two Aetheri disposed of the few remaining droids in the hangar while Bolt-3 located the Chancellor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Once they discovered that he was being held at the top of the ship's observation spire, they concluded that they were walking into a trap when Drayden sensed the presence of Count Varek. Not long after they arrived at the top of the spire, the Umbra Lord appeared before them and the two Aetheri engaged him in a duel. Varek managed to gain the upper hand and knocked Kade out, but his taunting, intended to erode Drayden's morale, instead enraged him. Drayden unleashed his fury on the Umbra Lord, brutally overwhelming him and slicing off both of his hands. Taking Varek's flux blade, he crossed both his and the Count's blades at the Count's throat, and Mal urged him to kill his helpless opponent. Drayden initially hesitated, but after the Chancellor's continued insistence, he gave into his hatred of his nemesis and beheaded Varek. He expressed regret afterward, stating it was not the Aetheri way , but the Chancellor assured him that he had been right to kill the Count.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Despite the Chancellor's pleas, he carried Kade on his back to make their escape. However, the elevators leaving the spire had been disabled. With help from Bolt and the attack taking place on the Invisible Hand by a neighboring Republic cruiser, they were able to escape in the elevator shaft until the ship's crew was able to regain control of the ship, restoring its gravity and turning the shaft once more into well. Kade regained consciousness while they were hanging on inside the shaft and together, he and Drayden were able to escape the shaft just as a reactivated elevator was about to crush them. However, their good fortune failed them, and they were trapped by a ray shield and apprehended, along with Bolt, by battle droids. The two Aetheri and the Chancellor were brought before Skarn in the Invisible Hand ' s control room. The cyborg personally taunted them, derisively commenting on Drayden's youth considering his reputation. Drayden retorted with a taunt about the General being shorter than he had expected, which angered the cyborg general.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Eventually, Bolt-3 caused a distraction, allowing Kade to draw his flux blade to him with Synth Flux, freeing himself and then Drayden. Once the younger Aetheri had also summoned his weapon, they engaged and made short work of Skarn's MagnaGuards and the battle droids holding them and the Chancellor. However, as they attempted to apprehend Skarn, he used one the MagnaGuards' electrostaffs to shatter the viewport, depressurizing the bridge and letting the vacuum take him. Drayden and Kade caught onto nearby command consoles until security measures allowed the bridge to depressurize. Before they could reach him, however, Skarn escaped, jettisoning all the escape pods to prevent them from escaping. As the command crew had fled, Drayden took control of the damaged flagship, which had begun to enter Vantor's atmosphere. Although he briefly managed to slow the ship's descent, the damage it had sustained proved too great, and the Invisible Hand broke in half, picking up considerable speed as it fell towards the Republic capital. Drayden eventually succeeded in crash-landing the Invisible Hand on a deserted landing strip, returning the once-captive Chancellor to Vantor unharmed.

#### Looming fatherhood

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Looming fatherhood

> " Are you all right? You're trembling. What's going on? " " Something wonderful has happened. Ani, I'm pregnant. " " ...That's... That- That's won- That's wonderful. " " What are we going to do? " " We're not going to worry about anything right now, alright? This is a happy moment. The happiest moment of my life. " ―Lira announces her pregnancy to Kael Following the ordeal, the two escorted the Chancellor to the Senate building, where they separated—while Kade went back to Aetheri Sanctum to report to the Council, Drayden remained with the Senators who had come to greet the returning Chancellor. He briefly spoke with Senator Solen, who expressed hope that Count Varek's death could bring a quick end to the war. Drayden disagreed, saying that as long as General Skarn remained as leader of the Dissident armies, the war would continue. At that moment, he noticed Ondar behind one of the columns, took his leave from the Senator and reunited with his wife for the first time in months. Having been away fighting in the Outer Reach Sieges, Drayden's single focus was reuniting with Ondar. Ondar then revealed to her husband that she was pregnant. Though they were both worried that this might expose their secret, Ondar especially, Drayden was overjoyed and told her not to worry, saying that it was the happiest moment of his life. The couple returned to Ondar's apartment, where they began to make plans for when the baby would be born, deciding that their child would be raised on Ondara, in the Lake Country . Ondar

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
and told her not to worry, saying that it was the happiest moment of his life. The couple returned to Ondar's apartment, where they began to make plans for when the baby would be born, deciding that their child would be raised on Ondara, in the Lake Country . Ondar also planned to head there before the birth, to prepare the room. However, that same night, Drayden's happiness was marred when he suffered a nightmare of his wife dying in childbirth, similar to the visions he had had of his mother before her death. Although Ondar tried to comfort him that it was only a dream, he was terrified that he would lose her, as he had lost his mother. Ondar tried to convince him that they needed help and suggested they ask Kade for his assistance. Drayden refused, insisting that their baby was a blessing, not a curse. The next day, at the Aetheri Sanctum, he sought Zho's counsel concerning these dreams, but the Grand Master told Drayden that death was a natural part of life, and to let go of all that he was afraid to lose.

#### Tensions of loyalty

> " Is it possible to learn this power? " " Not from an Aetheri. " ―Drayden and Mal discuss the power to stop people from dying

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Tensions of loyalty

> " Is it possible to learn this power? " " Not from an Aetheri. " ―Drayden and Mal discuss the power to stop people from dying

At the same time, tensions were rising between Chancellor Mal and the Aetheri Council, who were concerned with his increasing power. Matters were made worse when the Senate announced that they planned to grant him more executive powers in order to facilitate the end of the war. When Drayden was informed of this by Kade, he was supportive of the measure, despite the reservations of the Council and Kade's warning to be wary of Mal. He then told him that the Chancellor had requested his presence for unknown reasons, without informing the Council. So Drayden met with Mal at his office, where he told him that he was appointing the young Aetheri to be his personal representative on the Council, a decision that Drayden believed the Aetheri Masters would never accept.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: When informed of this, the Council allowed Drayden to sit on the Council, yet they refused to grant him the position of Master, a decision which greatly angered Drayden. Drayden turned to Kade, who so remained silent. Angered more by this, Drayden reluctantly accepted his position and took his seat on the council. At the end of the meeting, Kade acknowledged to Drayden that his appointment had been accepted so that, on behalf of the Council, he could spy on the Chancellor, which Drayden was reluctant to do. In recent weeks, Ondar and other senators concerned about Mal's expanded powers had also created the Petition of 2,000 in the name of protecting democracy, requesting he return his emergency powers to the Senate and end the war with cease-fire negotiations. Drayden was manipulated by Mal into believing Ondar could have ulterior motives that she was keeping hidden.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: At the Galaxies Opera House in the Uscru District , Drayden joined Mal in his private box while he was watching Squid Lake . During the performance the Chancellor told Drayden that Replica Intelligence had located General Skarn in the Uthara system . He began to stir Drayden's distrust in the Aetheri council, claiming that the Aetheri were planning on taking control of the Republic and betraying him. Drayden felt conflicted — despite the Aetheri's mistrust in the Chancellor, he still felt that Mal was a good man. He confided in the Chancellor that he had lost trust in the Aetheri. Mal correctly guessed that it was because they had sent Drayden to spy on him, and that it made him feel dishonest. Drayden didn't know how to respond. The Chancellor claimed that the Aetheri were only perceived as good because "good is a point of view," stating that the Aetheri and the Umbra were not so different. While Mal's conflation of the two groups played to Drayden's devotion to his Order's ideals and helped set the stage for his conversion to the umbra side, Drayden rebutted by saying that the Umbra were selfish while the Aetheri were selfless. Mal

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Aetheri and the Umbra were not so different. While Mal's conflation of the two groups played to Drayden's devotion to his Order's ideals and helped set the stage for his conversion to the umbra side, Drayden rebutted by saying that the Umbra were selfish while the Aetheri were selfless. Mal then recounted the Tragedy of Vael Plagueis the Wise to Drayden framed as an "old Umbra legend". In reality, the tale was about his Umbra Master and how he killed him. Mal specifically told the story knowing that Drayden was having nightmares about his wife dying. The revelation that he might need to disobey the Aetheri Order to save Ondar opened Drayden's mind — he wanted to learn this power. Afterward, Drayden bid farewell to Kade, showing gratitude for his teachings and said to each other " May Synth Flux be with you ," before parting ways.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Fall to the umbra side

> " A powerful Umbra you will become. Henceforth, you shall be known as Vael… Velgor. " ―Vael Mal to his apprentice

Shortly afterwards, Kael and Koss attended a hologram meeting with Zho, Ki-Adi Mundi, and Ciel Venn in the Temple's war room . During the meeting, Cord joined and informed the group learned that Orien had engaged Skarn on Uthara. Koss then tasked Kael with informing the Chancellor and see what his reaction is in order to learn his true intentions. Drayden informed the Chancellor of Kade's forces engaging Skarn's, but during the meeting, Mal revealed that he knew the umbra side of Synth Flux , leading Drayden to realize that he was the Umbra Lord they had been searching for. Mal told Kael that if he turned him over to the Aetheri, then he would be unable to aid in saving his wife, Ondar, from her "fated" death that Kael had been dreaming of.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Despite his confusion, Drayden still was loyal to the Aetheri Order. He told his findings to Drevan Koss, who went with Kit Fisto, Saesee Tiin, and Agen Kolar to arrest Mal, leaving Drayden behind. After recalling Mal's words, Drayden headed to Mal's office. During the ensuing duel , Mal killed three of the four Aetheri with ease but was disarmed by Koss just before Drayden arrived in his office. Drayden pleaded with Koss not to kill Mal, saying that he should be left for the Senate to judge, but Koss felt that Mal was too dangerous to be left alive, as he essentially controlled the Senate. Ignoring Drayden's words, Koss prepared to execute the Umbra Lord, but a desperate Drayden who needed Mal alive to save Lira, drew his flux blade and severed the unsuspecting Koss's right hand, causing Koss to drop his flux blade and allowing Mal to send him plummeting out of a shattered window with a blast of Synth Flux lightning, all of which was sensed by Marr.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Though horrified that he betrayed and contributed to the death of Koss, Drayden saw this as the final straw against the Aetheri Order, and as such there was no turning back for him. Desperate to save Lira, he reluctantly betrayed the Aetheri and pledged himself to service under his new Umbra Master, Vael Mal. Mal named him "Xarn Velgor," a title that he did not bestow lightly, and promised that, together, they would unlock the secret to immortality. Whereas earlier Mal had implied he already had that power, Drayden was so focused on the possibility that there was a chance to save Ondar that he did not notice the contradiction. After Mal declared all Aetheri enemies of the Republic, he ordered Velgor to kill the Aetheri at the Temple and execute the Dissident Council on the Emberfall System . Mal then executed Directive 66 , during which the replica troopers were forcibly brainwashed into turning on their Aetheri Generals and executing them on the spot, while Velgor led the 501st Legion to attack the Aetheri Sanctum .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: During the assault, Velgor killed dozens of Aetheri, such as Master Cin Drallig. In the council chamber, he found a group of younglings trying to hide. Thinking Velgor was still an Aetheri Knight, one boy asked him what they should do, but the new Umbra Lord slaughtered the boy and the other younglings. Similarly, as he led a synth flux of replicas further into the Temple, he encountered a group of younglings who assumed he had arrived to help. Instead, however, he cut the children down, leaving only one survivor; after Velgor stabbed her and looked her in the eyes, the human youngling Revai Sevander , growing to be filled with rage, survived because she played dead amongst the corpses of her classmates. After the battle, Velgor manipulated the Temple's beacon to broadcast a signal telling any surviving Aetheri to return to Vantor where they could be murdered by the replica troopers stationed at the Temple.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Following the attack, he met with Mal, who then sent him to Emberfall to kill the remaining mebers of the Executive Dissident Council . Before his departure he went back home to Ondar and told her much to her disbelief that the Aetheri Order had tried to topple the Republic and that he was about to go to Emberfall. Telling her that he would end the war, they kissed and he left aboard his new green Eta-2 Actis -class light interceptor , which replaced the interceptor he had lost in the Battle of Vantor. On Emberfall, Velgor slaughtered the entire Dissident Council, including Wat Tambra, Poggle the Lesser, and Nutis Gunray, along with their aides, his eyes now yellow and red with rage. Simultaneously, Mal carried out the proclamation of the New Order in an emergency session of the Senate, claiming that the Aetheri Order had committed treason against the Republic, and reorganized the Republic into the first Imperium with himself as its Emperor . During this time, Velgor was followed by Kakan , who believed he was a aetheri. Velgor showed his face, eyes to Kakan and chased after him to ensure there would be no witness. During his chase, Velgor ran into a cloud of Lava fumes . The fumes caused Velgor to see hallucinations his fellow Aetheri such as Koss, Vael, Vayne, Billaba, Zho, and his former apprentice Marr. Velgor was able to push the fumes away from himself and dismissed the hallucinations. Soon, Velgor reported his mission's completion to Mal; on his orders, Velgor sent a shutdown signal to the Confederate navy and army, effectively ending the Replica Wars. With his mission completed, and the Dissidents dead, Velgor looked on from a balcony and shed a tear at the man

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
the hallucinations. Soon, Velgor reported his mission's completion to Mal; on his orders, Velgor sent a shutdown signal to the Confederate navy and army, effectively ending the Replica Wars. With his mission completed, and the Dissidents dead, Velgor looked on from a balcony and shed a tear at the man he had become, but knew it was too late to turn back. ### Becoming Xarn Velgor

#### Duel on Emberfall

> " You were the Seeded One! It was said that you would destroy the Umbra, not join them! Bring balance to Synth Flux, not leave it in darkness! " ―Orien Kade, to Xarn Velgor — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Soon thereafter, Velgor saw Ondar's star skiff land and ran to meet her. She told Velgor that Kade had discovered their secret and had also told her that Velgor had joined the umbra side, hoping that he'd prove Kade wrong. However, Velgor only confirmed it to be true. Driven power-hungry by the Umbra side and declaring the galaxy was at peace, Velgor tried to convince her that they could be happy together as rulers of the new Imperium, promising he could overthrow Mal. In Velgor's ideal world, Ondar would have taken his hand, believing the man before her was still her husband. In reality, however, Velgor's propositions and actions horrified his wife, who begged him to leave the umbra side behind.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: At that moment, Velgor saw Kade walking out of Ondar's ship because he had secretly stowed away. Convinced that his wife had betrayed him to give his old master a chance to kill him, Velgor, ignoring her attempts to explain, Synth Flux-choked Ondar until Kade demanded he let her go, by which point she had already fallen unconscious. While what he had just done horrified him, Velgor lashed out at Kade by blaming him. Although Kade tried to reason with his former pupil, Velgor refused to listen, as the new Imperium was everything he wanted the galaxy to be. Unable to come to an understanding, with both believing themselves to be in the right, the two former friends then engaged in a fierce duel , which ripped across the Dissident facility . As they fought throughout the Dissident war room, their duel damaged the computers, causing the facility shields to deactivate and allowing the building to start falling into the lava river below.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
After fighting across the crumbling building and over a lava river, the duel ended on the river banks, where Kade claimed the high ground and warned Velgor not to attack. Blinded by rage and arrogance, Velgor leaped to continue the duel, only to have his remaining limbs severed by his former master's blade, leaving only his cybernetic arm. Crippled, Velgor slid down to the riverbank while screaming his undying hatred for his former master. Kade, taking Drayden's flux blade, told him he had considered him his brother and remorsefully left him for dead as a flap of Velgor's clothing caught fire and he started burning. Kade then left the planet with Ondar, Astra-9, and Bolt-3 as Velgor lay screaming and burning on the riverbank.

#### Rebirth

> " Lord Velgor, can you hear me? " " Yes, Master. Where is Lira? Is she safe? Is she all right? " "It seems, in your anger you killed her. " " I? I couldn't have. She was alive! I felt it! NOOOOOOOO!!!!! " ―Vael Mal and Xarn Velgor, after the latter rises in his armor

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Although Velgor survived, he was horrifically scarred, both physically and mentally, and had damaged lungs due to the hot ash in the air. Shortly afterward, the Emperor—having sensed his apprentice's peril—arrived on Emberfall, where he found the severely wounded Velgor and took him back to Vantor, in a medical capsule . As the Emperor could not afford to lose Velgor, he turned to the Republic's best scientists, among which was Silvar , who, in doing so, gained private access to Velgor's cybernetics. By the Emperor's orders, Velgor was put into a life-sustaining black suit of armor and outfitted with three new robotic limbs by numerous droids skilled in both cybernetic reconstruction and medical surgery. Among the droids working on Velgor was FX-6 , an FX-9 surgical assistant who previously worked on Skarn's armor. After what Mal later called a "long night" of work, he was finally sealed within his new armor. His eyes showed a brief flicker of fear before his mask and helmet locked together and he drew his first breath.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Effectively entombed within and smothered by his new life-support armor, Velgor's rebirth was complete. Upon regaining consciousness, Velgor asked the Emperor what had become of his wife, and he told Velgor that he had killed her in his anger. Unbeknownst to either of the two Umbra, Ondar gave birth to the twins Joren and Elira before her death. Velgor was overwhelmed by his despair in the belief he had killed Ondar and their unborn child, which fulfilled his prophetic dreams of her death. Remembering that he had, indeed, attacked Ondar with a Synth Flux choke on Emberfall, he believed Mal's claim. Further, he was both enraged and filled with despair that it had been his own choices that led to his current reality, of a life imprisoned within a cybernetic suit and without Ondar by his side. In his emotional turmoil, Velgor incidentally destroyed the medical droids and severely damaged the entire room through Synth Flux. He broke free of his bindings on the operating table and, despite struggling to walk under the sheer weight of his new prostheses and armor, let out a cry of anger and despair over losing everything he had loved.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor's despair then turned to rage and he telekinetically slammed the Emperor against a wall in the surgical bay, snarling that his master had promised to save Ondar. The Emperor, as Velgor attempted unsuccessfully to strangle him with Synth Flux, responded that in death Ondar had provided Velgor a gift: Pain. The Emperor continued by giving Velgor a choice; to either accept and use that gift or to die. After a moment, Velgor replied that he would live. The Emperor then immediately launched a barrage of Synth Flux lightning at his apprentice, and rhetorically demanded that Velgor use the power of his flux blade to defend himself, but Velgor replied that his flux blade had been taken by Kade at the conclusion of their duel.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As he continued his barrage, the Emperor angrily shouted that the weapon Velgor spoke of was not his. Rather, it had belonged to an Aetheri, and Velgor was now an Umbra. Ceasing his Synth Flux-based assault, the Emperor drew his own flux blade. He put the blade to Velgor's throat and stated that he understood how traumatic the last few days had been for his apprentice, but warned that should Velgor ever use Synth Flux against him again, he would finish what Kade could not. The Emperor then deactivated his weapon and stated that, as friends, he hoped that the two of them would never find themselves in a similar situation. He instructed Velgor to put aside his rage and lust for revenge against the Aetheri for the time being, for the two of them had a great deal of work to accomplish. By submitting to the hate within his heart by believing he had killed Ondar and that her death had pushed him to a new future from the pain it provided, Velgor would become the Emperor's loyal enforcer and apprentice. Cut off from his old life and truly believing he had murdered Ondar, Velgor invested entirely in Mal

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
heart by believing he had killed Ondar and that her death had pushed him to a new future from the pain it provided, Velgor would become the Emperor's loyal enforcer and apprentice. Cut off from his old life and truly believing he had murdered Ondar, Velgor invested entirely in Mal as his only source of refuge and guidance. #### Hunting a kyber crystal

> " No. I refuse. This is all there is . " ―Believing himself irredeemable after everything, Velgor rejects a vision of returning to the light Immediately after his surgery, the Emperor took Velgor to a balcony overlooking the old Aetheri Sanctum. There, he and Velgor watched as the now- Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon directed a ceremonial burning of the flux blades of all the Aetheri who had been killed in the Temple. As they listened to Veldon's speech, the Emperor asked if his apprentice knew how or why Umbra flux blade blades were red in color. Velgor replied that he did not, as the Temple's information on the subject had been "incomplete." The Emperor laughed and contemptuously mused that the Aetheri had been uncomfortable with the information and had buried it as a result. He then explained that kyber crystals felt pain just like any living being, and could be made to bleed after a fashion by pouring rage, pain, and hate into them. He asked Velgor if he understood, to which Velgor replied that he did, stating that he could have given him any of the burning Aetheri flux blades to corrupt, even Zho's. But he had not, as Velgor realized that the crystal of an Umbra's flux blade should be taken directly from an Aetheri by that Umbra.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As the ceremony progressed, the replica troopers attending the vent threw a basket full of various flux blades into the incinerator, including Zho's. The flux blades caught on fire and a moment later, a powerful blast of energy was released into the air as the kyber crystals were destroyed. Afterward, the Emperor brought Velgor to Gattering in the Mid Reach and assigned him the task of hunting down an Aetheri to take a kyber crystal from. The Emperor took his apprentice to a site where he had arranged for a starship to be delivered for Velgor's use, but the ship had been stolen by a group of pirates. Leaving Velgor to reclaim the vessel, the Emperor departed, and Velgor struck out for the planet's nearest settlement on foot. Once there, he eliminated the group of pirates who had stolen the ship and traveled to the Aetheri outpost Brighthome . The station was garrisoned by a group of replica troopers, who noted Velgor's approach and hailed him.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Though he could have provided the security codes necessary to secure the replica troopers assistance, Velgor decided instead to simply kill them. During the fight, Velgor summoned a green-bladed flux blade from the wall to kill most of the replica troopers. After exterminating the garrison, Velgor tasked the droid co-pilot of his ship to search through the station's archives for data on any Aetheri who had taken the Barash vow prior to Directive 66. Velgor's hope was that any Aetheri who had taken the vow, one of complete non-interference in all Aetheri affairs, would have been not only out of harm's way when Directive 66 was issued but would have ignored its occurrence in accordance with the vow. The search identified Aetheri Master Kirak Infil'a , an Aetheri who had been completely dedicated to combat to the exclusion of all else. When a grenade was thrown at him by two surviving replicas, " Ding " and " Kicker ," he managed to contain the explosion, which the replicas believed would make him unable to do anything else as all his concentration was diverted on freezing the explosion.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As they talked of how they would restrain and bring in what they believed was just another Aetheri survivor before the Emperor in the hopes of being rewarded, Velgor proved their beliefs that he was too preoccupied with the explosive to be false by telekinetically throttling the replicas and breaking their necks, before walking far enough away from the explosion to release it. Velgor quickly located the Aetheri on the river moon of Al'doleem and sensed as he disembarked his ship that Infil'a was waiting for him. The Aetheri Master immediately confronted Velgor, and was seized in a Synth Flux choke by the Dark Lord. However, Infil'a quickly released a Synth Flux blast at Velgor which staggered him and disrupted his concentration. Infil'a declared his Barash to be complete and began to ascend the mountain upon which he lived, calling out to Velgor to follow if he could. One of the Aetheri Master's training droids, Arekso, then opened a sluice gate which sent a river of water crashing down upon Velgor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: The Umbra Lord was visibly battered by the rush of water, but managed to telekinetically part the river and walked to the shore. He was then set upon by a group of gigantic carnivorous birds , which damaged one of his cybernetic legs. Velgor eventually crushed them all with Synth Flux and made his way to the peak of the mountain. There, he found Infil'a and Arekso awaiting him. Velgor quickly unleashed a Synth Flux push that blasted Infil'a off his feet and dazed him long enough for Velgor, who was unarmed, to destroy Arekso and take the droid's training flux blade . He threw the droid off the mountain and engaged Infil'a, who sensed that Velgor not only wanted to kill him but wished to take his flux blade as well. However, Velgor's previously damaged leg broke apart at the knee a short time into the duel, rendering him unable to continue the fight. Infil'a then declared his intention to seek out Mal and kill him, and blasted Velgor off the top of the mountain with Synth Flux.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Regaining consciousness, Velgor used Synth Flux to reassemble his cybernetic limbs with the dismembered pieces of Arekso , who coincidentally had landed near where Velgor had fallen. He then tracked Infil'a to Am'balaar City , where he reengaged the astonished Aetheri Master. Fighting atop the Am'balaar city dam , the two crossed blades until the duel was interrupted by a trio of security guards. Annoyed, Velgor telekinetically flung the guards from the top of the dam, but Infil'a caught them and used Synth Flux to lower them to safety. Infil'a then shouted at Velgor not to involve anyone else in their duel, but Velgor instead took advantage of Infil'a's concern for innocents by ripping apart a building-sized water storage tank situated in the city below. As Infil'a attempted without success to use his own powers to stop the destruction, Velgor telekinetically removed the Aetheri's flux blade from his belt and claimed it for his own. He then grabbed Infil'a in a Synth Flux choke and lifted him from the dam. Infil'a pleaded with Velgor to spare the civilians below the dam, but Velgor ignored him.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As the enormous tank burst completely, flooding Am'balaar City, Velgor crushed Infil'a's throat with Synth Flux and tossed his body into the wreckage below. After obtaining an Aetheri flux blade and the kyber crystal within, Velgor reboarded his ship, whereupon the droid co-pilot seized control of the vessel and jumped to hyperspace. The droid then began to play a pre-recorded message from the Emperor to Velgor. The message stated that, per the Emperor's instructions, the droid had plotted a course to the planet Emberfall, where Velgor would find a dark-side locus which he could use to help him corrupt the kyber crystal. As the message concluded, Velgor touched down on Emberfall and quickly found the locus the Emperor had spoken of, an ancient Umbra shrine within a shallow cavern. There, he disassembled Infil'a's flux blade on a small, flat rock formation and removed the kyber crystal.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: However, when he attempted to corrupt it, the crystal resisted and used Synth Flux to send Velgor careening into one of the cavern walls. The crystal then caused Velgor to experience a vision wherein he rejected the umbra side, journeyed to Vantor, and killed Mal. In the vision, Velgor then found Orien and begged for his forgiveness. As he knelt in contrition in front of his former master, Orien called out to Velgor by his former name, Kael. Upon hearing this, Velgor snapped out of his vision and firmly rejected the possibility shown to him by the crystal, declaring that a life as an Umbra was all he could be after everything he had done. He then began to pour his hatred, pain, and rage into the crystal. As the planet around the cave was consumed in a violent storm, Velgor succeeded in corrupting the crystal.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Afterwards, Velgor returned to Vantor and stormed into the Emperor's office during the middle of a discussion between Varrix, Mazan Veldon, and the Emperor regarding the construction of the Void Core .
