### War with the Insurgency

#### Lorath

> " We will squeeze Lorath until someone reveals the whereabouts of these traitors. " ―Xarn Velgor to Minister Maketh Tua

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor continued to look for leads on Kade's location, albeit in a more patient manner that did not jeopardize his service to the Imperium, as per Mal's order. In 5 BVE , the Umbra Lord was approached by Mal, who informed Velgor that he had seen a new threat—the "children of Synth Flux"—arising against them. Velgor then contacted the Grand Warden via hologram to inform him of the Emperor's vision, ordering the Grand Warden to hunt down these children to either press them into Imperial service or be eliminated. The Grand Warden promised Velgor that the mission would be done. In time, the Grand Warden's focus would be centered on the Shades insurgent cell that mainly operated around the world of Lorath , as two Aetheri worked as part of the cell: Directive 66 survivor Brenn Aldric , who had gone by the name Caleb Dume during the Replica Wars, and his Adept Cass Virel . The failure of the Grand Warden and other Imperial leaders to defeat the Shades led to Varrix being deployed to resolve the issue in 4 BVE .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After Imperial forces under Varrix captured Aldric during the Shades' raid against the Lorath Communications Center , he was scheduled to be taken aboard Varrix's Iron Cruiser Sovereign to Emberfall, where he would be taken to Fortress Velgor. By that point, Aldric had indeed heard rumors that Emberfall was where Aetheri went "to die," which he told to his fellow insurgent Lena Kryll . However, over Emberfall, the union of multiple insurgent cells into a growing free coalition was revealed when the Shades were rescued by the Ember Squadron , with the Grand Warden also being killed aboard Varrix's crippled Iron Cruiser. As rumors of what had happened over Emberfall became known, riots and uprisings began to occur on several worlds, including Lorath. The Emperor, concerned at the rise in insurgent activity, sent Velgor to Lorath with Varrix to end the growing insurgency. Velgor also made sure the Grand Warden's service was not yet finished: Velgor prevented the Warden's spirit from passing into the Netherworld of Synth Flux and forced him to stand guard over an Aetheri outpost on Tempes as a trap for any would-be Aetheri searching for artifacts. With that, the Warden's spirit eternally suffered from the flames

title: Xarn Velgor
text: service was not yet finished: Velgor prevented the Warden's spirit from passing into the Netherworld of Synth Flux and forced him to stand guard over an Aetheri outpost on Tempes as a trap for any would-be Aetheri searching for artifacts. With that, the Warden's spirit eternally suffered from the flames of the Sovereign yet was not allowed to die. Arriving on Lorath, Velgor stepped off a Sentinel -class landing craft with Varrix and passed high-ranking IVB Agent Alexsandr Kallux . Shortly thereafter, Kallux was assigned to report directly to the Umbra Lord. In an effort to track down the root of the insurgent problem, Velgor concocted an elaborate trap in which he intended to track the Shades back to their primary base of operations. Sometime into the siege, Velgor met with Kallux and Minister Maketh Tua to discuss his plans with dealing with the Shades. During this meeting, he informed Tua that Varrix intended to hold her accountable for her failure to stop the insurgents. Fearing for her life, Tua contacted the Shades, promising them information in exchange for smuggling her off of Lorath before her meeting with Varrix. The insurgents agreed and returned to Lorath. However, Velgor had intended for Tua to contact the insurgents in order to lure them back to Lorath and saw to it that a bomb was placed on Tua's shuttle. Once the insurgents arrived, they attempted to escape the planet with Tua in her shuttle, only for the bomb to go off as Tua boarded the ship, killing the Minister.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Immediately after the incident, Velgor had it broadcast all over the planet that the insurgents had assassinated Tua in order to discredit them. Velgor then ordered Kallux to lock down the planet's spaceport and publicly announce that any ship attempting to reach orbit would be destroyed. Velgor knew that the lockdown, combined with the populace's mistrust of the insurgents, would essentially guarantee that they would need to steal a ship in order to escape. As such, he provided a tempting target at the local Imperial garrison; a shuttle capable of hyperspace travel. When the insurgents attempted to steal it, Velgor confronted them with a small group of shock troopers. Velgor engaged the insurgents' Aetheri members, Aldric and Virel, while his troops engaged in a small scale firefight with the other insurgents. As his intent was for the insurgents to escape, Velgor lazily toyed with the two Aetheri while their cohorts attempted to launch the shuttle.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: The confrontation came to an end when two of the insurgents threw thermal detonators at a number of walkers on the landing pad, damaging their legs and scattering the shock troopers underneath them. When Velgor glanced up at the collapsing walkers, Cass and Brenn combined their power to telekinetically push him into the path of the falling war machines. Believing him to be dead, the two insurgents were instead astounded to see Velgor, completely unharmed, use Synth Flux to lift both of the walkers off of himself and drop them behind him. Recognizing that they were hopelessly outmatched, Brenn ordered Cass to run with him to the commandeered shuttle. Hoping to prevent Velgor from pursuing them, Ryn Wrenna fired a number of volt pistol bolts at Velgor. He reflected two of them back into her chest and helmet but made no attempt to board the shuttle or otherwise stop it. After the shuttle successfully launched, one of the shock troopers who had been present for the confrontation assured Velgor that he would scramble fighters immediately to intercept it.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
However, Velgor informed him that doing so would not be necessary, as he believed that the insurgents would not attempt to leave the planet for some time. Velgor later ordered Kallux to destroy Tarkintown in order to draw out the insurgents or, failing that, to demoralize them. Shortly thereafter, the insurgents used the stolen shuttle to escape the planet and rendezvous with the insurgent fleet. However, Velgor had placed a tracking device on board the shuttle, and mere minutes after the insurgents had reached the fleet, Velgor's SKREE Advanced x1 fighter dropped out of hyperspace and attacked Ember Squadron . The insurgent CO deployed the Arrow interceptors of Ember Squadron , but they were unexpectedly decimated by Velgor's lone assault. Weaving through the defensive screen of fighters, Velgor attacked the insurgent command ship , Ember Home , disabling it in short order.

#### The apprentice lives

> " The apprentice lives. " ―Xarn Velgor senses Sela Marr

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### The apprentice lives

> " The apprentice lives. " ―Xarn Velgor senses Sela Marr

The Shades quickly boarded their ship, the Wisp , and fought back against the Dark Lord. However, neither the Wisp nor the remainder of Ember Squadron could land so much as a hit on Velgor's craft, and he continued to bombard the now-crippled Ember Home while picking off interfering fighters at his leisure. With its fighter escort all but destroyed and its weapons, shields, and engines disabled, the insurgent command ship appeared to be doomed as Velgor prepared for a final assault. However, on board the Wisp , Sela Marr decided to combine her powers with Brenn's in order to probe Velgor's mind with Synth Flux. The probe enabled Sela to see deeply enough into Velgor's mind for her to recognize him as her former master, and for Velgor to recognize the one probing him as his former apprentice. Sela promptly lost consciousness as a result of the psychic backlash of the probe but Velgor was unaffected.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Upon discovering Sela's presence aboard the insurgent craft, Velgor's priorities immediately changed. In an unexpected turn of good fortune for the insurgents, Velgor broke off what would have been a killing run at Ember Home in favor of engaging the VCX-100 light freighter . As Velgor peppered the Wisp with volt pistol fire, Brenn and Lena Kryll managed to convince Jun Savren to evacuate Ember Home as Admiral Kassius Konstantine entered the system with three Star Destroyers. The Admiral contacted Velgor in order to receive instructions, and Velgor ordered Konstantine to block the Wisp ' s escape, but not to fire at it, as he wanted the insurgents aboard it alive. Meanwhile, the crew of Ember Home abandoned the crippled command ship and fled the system with the tattered remains of the insurgent fleet. As Velgor closed in on the Wisp , it jumped to hyperspace just as the Destroyers activated their tractor beams , catching Velgor instead of the Wisp .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Following his victory, Velgor boarded Konstantine's Destroyer and contacted the Emperor. He informed his master that he had "broken" the insurgents, but the elder Umbra Lord sensed disquiet in his apprentice's emotions. Velgor then revealed to the Emperor that he had discovered that Marr was alive, and told his master that he believed that she was in league with the insurgents. Pleased by this news, the Emperor declared that she could lead the two Umbra Lords to other Aetheri who survived Directive 66. Velgor immediately postulated that Kade might be amongst them, to which the Emperor concurred; if Kade was still alive. The Emperor urged Velgor to be patient, and instructed him to send another Warden to hunt the insurgents down.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
As per his master's orders, Velgor assigned the Fifth Warden the task, with the Seventh Warden also joining the hunt on Velgor's order. He made it clear to both they were not to fail. At some point the Shades infiltrated an Iron Cruiser that Velgor was aboard. He stalked the insurgents, but they successfully evaded capture. After several unsuccessful attempts to capture the insurgent Aetheri, the Fifth Warden and Seventh Warden pursued Aldric, Virel, and Marr to a still-standing Aetheri Sanctum on Lorath in 3 BVE . Though the insurgents managed to flee, the Wardens informed Velgor of their discovery. Velgor came to inspect the site, informing them that the Emperor would be most pleased by their discovery. The Wardens warned Velgor that the Aetheri were becoming more powerful, but he retorted it would be their undoing.

#### Duel on Searmark

> " Sela...! Sela... " " Kael... I won't leave you. Not this time. " " ...Then you will die . " ―Xarn Velgor and Sela Marr

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Duel on Searmark

> " Sela...! Sela... " " Kael... I won't leave you. Not this time. " " ...Then you will die . " ―Xarn Velgor and Sela Marr

Afterwards, Velgor dispatched the Fifth Warden, the Seventh Warden, and the Eighth Warden to hunt down Vreth, who had been stranded on Searmark and had been studying its Umbra temple for years; he himself arrived after Virel had activated the superweapon with the Umbra reliquary . With his Wardens having all been killed by Vreth, Velgor chose to personally retrieve the reliquary and take possession of the superweapon. Perched on the roof of his SKREE Advanced x1, he leaped from the fighter and landed in front of Virel. After a brief verbal exchange, Velgor quickly disarmed the young Aetheri by destroying his flux blade and prepared to execute him, but before he could do so, he was interrupted by Sela Marr.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor offered his former apprentice clemency in exchange for the location of any surviving Aetheri, but Marr claimed that there were no more Aetheri; that Velgor and his Wardens had killed them all. Skeptical of her claim, Velgor obliquely threatened to torture the information out of Virel instead. This prompted Marr to proclaim in disgust that while she had begun to suspect that Velgor and her former master were one and the same, she could no longer believe that due to Velgor's cruelty. Velgor replied that Drayden had been weak and that he himself had destroyed her former master. Marr then swore to avenge Drayden, but Velgor reminded her that revenge was not the Aetheri way. But Marr no longer considered herself to be an Aetheri, and after informing Velgor of this, she attacked him. However, she proved ultimately to be no match for her former master who, after several minutes of intense swordplay, used Synth Flux to blast Marr off a ledge. Believing her to have been neutralized, Velgor went to retrieve the reliquary.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor managed to catch up to Aldric and Virel before they could board their ship, and used Synth Flux to begin pulling both the reliquary and the two Aetheri towards him. But before he could seize it, Marr ambushed Velgor and managed to slice off the upper right portion of his mask with her flux blades . With his mask damaged, Velgor's voice filter began to malfunction, causing him to wheeze, and when he next spoke, calling out to his former apprentice, it was in a distorted mixture of his real voice and the mechanical baritone imposed by the filter. This and his partially exposed face confirmed to Marr that Velgor was indeed her former master. As the Temple locked down, Marr proclaimed she would not abandon him as she had before. Velgor paused at this and stared wordlessly at Marr, seemingly conflicted on how he should respond to his old Adept. However, he quickly regained his composure and snarled that she would die for her choice. The two engaged in combat once more, while Aldric and Virel escaped from the chamber enclosing Velgor and Marr.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After a few moments of battle, locked his blade with Marr's and began to push through her guard. As he prepared to kill her, the energy discharges from the overloading reliquary stand suddenly intensified, and Velgor glanced up. As he did, a massive blast of power struck the ceiling of the chamber, and Marr used the distraction to push Velgor back a step with Synth Flux. She then drove both of her flux blades into the ground at her feet, causing the floor of the chamber to begin crumbling. Velgor quickly recovered from his distraction and aimed a killing stroke at Marr. Unbeknownst to the two combatants, however, two years later, Cass Virel entered the temple on Lorath and found himself in the World Between Worlds realm, where he was guided to a portal, which exited at the Umbra temple in 3 BVE, by the convor Morai, the very same bird Velgor had seen on the snowy moon outside Marr's crashed Vorash. Virel witnessed the conclusion of Velgor's battle with Marr even as his younger self was locked out of the reliquary chamber. As Velgor swung his flux blade at Marr, Virel reached through the portal and yanked her backward

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
bird Velgor had seen on the snowy moon outside Marr's crashed Vorash. Virel witnessed the conclusion of Velgor's battle with Marr even as his younger self was locked out of the reliquary chamber. As Velgor swung his flux blade at Marr, Virel reached through the portal and yanked her backward into the temple. As a result, Velgor's strike missed and the temple floor crumbled, sending Velgor plummeting into a pool of light. From Velgor's perspective, a hand had reached from a portal from nowhere to save Marr. Velgor survived the fall and managed to make his way back to the surface, where he was watched by Morai. After Morai guided Marr —who escaped back to her place in time after Mal reached into the World Between Worlds —through the depths of the temple to reach another portal to the World Between Worlds, the convor exited the temple and flew out, with Velgor watching the bird from the surface. Believing Marr dead, Velgor departed Searmark and returned to his duties in the Imperium. Marr's supposed demise marked the end of the Great Aetheri Purge.

#### Continued insurgency

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Continued insurgency

In 2 BVE and shortly after the Imperium's victory over the Batonn sector insurgency , Velgor arrived at the Imperial Palace on Vantor and was introduced to the newly promoted Grand Admiral Vorren, the very same Chyrr officer he had met during the Replica Wars, by the Emperor. When Vorren stated he was pleased to finally meet the Dark Lord, Velgor claimed to feel the same. A short time later in 2 BVE, amid Vorren's ongoing campaign to root out and destroy the growing insurgent threat, the rebellious senator of Serenne , Vela Sess, formally rallied numerous insurgent cells together under a single banner, the Alliance to Restore the Republic . Fulfilling the fears of Imperials like Varrix and Vorren, once disconnected insurgent cells began to act as a unified synth flux, marking an official beginning point to the Galactic Civil War , although true open warfare would not break out for sometime still.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
During the Galactic Civil War era, shock trooper lieutenant TK-289 served with Velgor. During or after 2 BVE, at some point after the Alliance was formed, Xarn Velgor was lured to HS-197, an abandoned ore-mining moon in the Horox system, by Cyn, the son of Sig Sendvall, a cyberneticist who had worked on Velgor’s suit. At another point in that time frame, on an unidentified astronomical object, Velgor accompanied shock troopers in their search for an Insurgent fugitive. As the troopers destroyed a village to frighten its inhabitants, the Umbra Lord interrogated Noegaud, a local bully. A youngling named Niko, whom Noegaud often harassed, witnessed this interaction, leading him to conclude that Noegaud was correct in his belief that the only thing that mattered was power.

Velgor once destroyed Blue Squadron, a diaspora of Vectors and Arrows, in his SKREE Advanced x1. The Umbra Lord then landed, engaging DF.9 turret emplacements and Insurgent infantry before bringing down the Vellus , the GR-75 medium transport that the starfighter escort had been protecting. Only one Insurgent was left standing, who Velgor promptly killed.

#### Investigating a disturbance

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Investigating a disturbance

> " Kael Drayden is dead. " " I know. " ―Xarn Velgor and Grand Admiral Vorren

Velgor and Vorren crossed paths on Vantor once more after Vorren suffered a strategic defeat on Atollon . Although the battle had been a tactical victory, a number of insurgents had escaped the Grand Admiral after the Bendu appeared. As a result of allowing the insurgents to slip through his grip, Velgor now held a disdain for the Grand Admiral. Though during this meeting, the two were ordered by the Emperor to the planet Batuu to locate a disturbance in Synth Flux that the Emperor had sensed. While Vorren brought his own forces on board his Iron Cruiser, the Chimaera , Velgor brought a contingent of his personal shock troopers from the 501st Legion, the 1st Legion with him to assist in tracking down this disturbance at the edge of known space.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
During their mission, they combated the Grysk species and learned the disturbance was caused by a group of young Chyrr Synth Flux-sensitives known as, to the surprise of Velgor, the " Sky-walkers ." Afterward, Velgor came to doubt Vorren's loyalty to the Imperium because of the threats growing against the Chyrr in the Unknown Regions. While Vorren managed to deduce that Drayden and Velgor were one in the same, the Grand Admiral came to think of Velgor as being a separate person mentally and that his old ally Drayden was dead. After telling Vorren to ensure he kept his promise to the Emperor by ordering him to stay in Imperial space instead of leaving to save his people, Velgor came to respect Vorren's SKREE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter project, stating he would speak on its behalf to Mal and suggesting upgrades for the craft. On Batuu, Velgor's presence near Black Spire was spoken of by locals, with rumors of the legendary Imperial enforcer's visit to Batuu being spoken of for years to come.

#### Submission to Ahr

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Submission to Ahr

> " You hate it. Every time you kneel . Even before me . Good . But this bureaucrat knows his sector, Lord Velgor. With his knowledge , we will subdue it. So in my service…you will obey the governor's every order …to the letter …until you have learned your lesson . " ―Vael Mal, to Xarn Velgor

During the Imperium's efforts to subdue anti-Imperial forces in a Mid Reach sector under Imperial Governor Ahr , Velgor participated in an attack on the planet Namzor , where he eliminated a group of insurgents . In the process, he destroyed the insurgents' stores of coaxium , violating the command of Ahr, who was charged with securing the hyperfuel. The governor brought his frustrations to the Emperor. Sensing Velgor's anger, the Emperor commanded his apprentice to follow any and all orders from the governor until Velgor had learned his lesson.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Ahr took great pleasure in his newfound power, sending Velgor on increasingly dangerous missions throughout his sector . He sent Velgor to fight alone against the renegade droids of Ahn Krantarium , and later retracted his forces on Phelzepham , leaving Velgor to battle the moon's insurgents by himself. Though he wished to kill the governor, Velgor continued to obey Ahr's commands.

Governor Ahr brought his ship to the Kankalo Belt Containment Zone , an asteroid field in which a great creature resided. He commanded Velgor to eliminate "the greatest threat" he could find. Seeing an opportunity, Velgor confronted Ahr, recognizing him as his true threat. Before Velgor could strike, Ahr ordered the Dark Lord to kneel before him. Velgor obeyed, but the creature attacked the vessel, pulling the governor out into the void of space and freeing Velgor from his submission.

#### Cianap

> " Velgor to command. Minor system malfunction. I can't fly it back through the battle. Landing on the planet for repairs. End this swiftly or suffer the consequences. " ―Xarn Velgor radios in from his SKREE fighter

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Cianap

> " Velgor to command. Minor system malfunction. I can't fly it back through the battle. Landing on the planet for repairs. End this swiftly or suffer the consequences. " ―Xarn Velgor radios in from his SKREE fighter

Velgor led Imperial forces at Cianap in a battle against the insurgents. During the battle, Velgor was targeted by several Vectors but was able to take them out. However, his SKREE was damaged when one purposely crashed into him and was forced to crash land on Cianap. Velgor then exited his SKREE and awoke an Ender from its Slumber . The Ender then tried to kill Velgor; however, he stabbed one of the Ender's eyes out and tried to cut its back open, only for the Ender to grab him. Velgor started to slice the Ender's fingers, but the Ender pushed him into a building and dropped him. The Ender then started to go after a native , but Velgor rode a creature and saved the native from the Ender. Velgor then decapitated the Ender, finally killing it. The native thanked Velgor, who then returned to his SKREE and was taken aboard an Iron Cruiser via grapple beam.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### An unwelcome romance

> " Xarn Velgor to the bridge. Come get this garbage out of my quarters. " ―Xarn Velgor, upon killing the nurse At some point, Velgor had arrived at the Void Core, and made his way to his personal medical bay. As he made way, he barged through a medical cart being tended to by a nurse , who was flustered due to her infatuation with Velgor. Velgor underwent treatment from a doctor while in the medical bay, but became angered when the nurse from the prior encounter entered the medical bay as Velgor was putting his helmet back on. In his anger, Velgor synth flux pushed the doctor into the wall, demanding that he control the medical bay or be replaced. The nurse, however, saw Velgor's anger as reciprocation of her feelings for him, misconstruing his actions as protection of her. After his bout of rage, Velgor exited the medical bay, admonishing the doctor as he attempted to excuse why the appointment had taken so long. The nurse, upon being told to clean up the medical bay, instead stole pieces of Velgor's armor as a keepsake, storing it among other discarded pieces of Velgor's armor, as well as a vial of his blood.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
A proceeding incident resulted in Velgor crash landing on the Void Core in his SKREE Advanced x1. Velgor made his way to the medical bay once more, demanding the nurse to call in the doctor. The nurse briefly aided Velgor, perceiving the moment as intimate, before the doctor himself returned, ordering the nurse to leave as he tended to Velgor instead. Velgor, impatient, cut his appointment short, leaving to rejoin his prior battle. However, Velgor had left his cape behind, which the nurse proceeded to steal and take to her quarters. After the doctor discovered her, he dumped the bits of Velgor's armor into the trash compactor. Driven mad, the nurse walked into Velgor's quarters, which he had left unlocked out of a belief that no one would enter. Upon seeing the nurse enter his chambers, a helmetless Velgor simply stared at her as she confessed her infatuation with him. Momentarily after, Velgor stabbed the nurse with his flux blade, killing her. Velgor then put his helmet back on and exited his quarters, contacting the bridge and ordering them to remove her corpse.

#### Hunting the Hidden Hand

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Hunting the Hidden Hand

On the orders of the Emperor, Velgor attacked and killed three lower-level clans working for the Hidden Hand , a crime syndicate known to sell weapons to the Insurgency. He then attacked the Lower Bay Docks on Fikari , killing most there, questioning the Weequay Holaq about the whereabouts of the Hidden Hand. Holaq told Velgor that none of them would know where the Hidden Hand was. Detailing the way they maintained secrecy, he pled with Velgor to believe him. Velgor replied that he did and blew up the docks, killing him. He then reported the failure to Mal over hologram, who reiterated the importance of taking down the Hidden Hand. The Tarsunt Gwi , who worked for the crime syndicate, overheard this conversation, and hired a team to hunt down and kill Xarn Velgor . At some point, Velgor learned of this plot and traveled to the Dark Quarter on Yuw to kill bounty hunters and find answers.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Later, the captain of the bounty hunter team—Beilert Varrick, the same man he had saved during Varrick's days as an Imperial soldier —amplified a signal near Arvina , disguising it as a Hidden Hand signal. Velgor arrived on an Iron Cruiser in response and it fired on the city below. He then got into his SKREE fighter and chased after Varrick's team. Their sniper, the Insurgent agent Gita , currently disguised as the Dunefolk Raider "Urrr'k", managed to shoot down two of Velgor's support Skrees. This gave the team enough time to escape, leaving Velgor to investigate the damage in the city below. Varrick had planned to leave data banks behind that would reveal the Hidden Hand's secret outposts, allowing him to get the jump on Velgor. However, an informant of Velgor's within the crew —the bounty hunter Dengrik —revealed the bounty hunters' next destination.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor followed them to a Hidden Hand outpost on Heva aboard the Formidable . Upon arriving, an Imperial general informed Velgor that Varrick's ship, the Broken Wing , had been located, and that their informant had gone silent. Velgor abruptly told the general to scramble all fighters, much to the general's confusion. Varrick's crew had begun remotely piloting a fleet of bot-drones towards the Formidable . Velgor got into his SKREE fighter and pursued the drones as well as the Broken Wing . He shredded the drone fleet, but the drones started to pull away. Velgor told his pilots to stay on the leader, as he took out its laser cannons. The drones then formed a large cannon that fired, destroying the Formidable . Despite this, Velgor stayed locked on the Broken Wing , taking out its engines and causing it to crash-land. Velgor landed his SKREE fighter and entered the ship, flux blade drawn. After finding the ship empty, he stood on the roof. Dengrik and fellow hunter Honnah fired on the SKREE fighters near Velgor's ship and destroyed them. Velgor looked in their direction as the bounty hunters took aim.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: However, Varrick had a plan that involved an electro-pulse , an E.M.P. device that only worked on contact, so they withheld their fire. Velgor used synth flux to kick up dust around him so that the bunty hunters didn't have a straight shot. One of the bounty hunters, Chio Fain, charges and shoots at him. Velgor blocks his fire as well as fire from the other bounty hunters. Fain continued to fight Velgor, intent on avenging his partner Rone. As the Ardennian taunted him, Velgor chopped his arms off. Fain then asked Velgor how good he was against a Gamorrean battle-ax , to which Honnah started to attack. Dodging the Gamorrean 's swings, Velgor took a hit from Fain, using his last remaining arm to fire at him. Velgor then used synth flux to push Fain into Honnah's battle-ax, killing him. After taking a shot from Gita, Velgor incapacitated her and killed Honnah. Varrick took the opportunity and tried to stick the electro-pulse to Velgor but was unable to. He was then shocked by Dengrik, revealing himself to the crew as being a double agent for the Imperium and Velgor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor brought Varrick on his Iron Cruiser Vengeance along with Dengrik. He gave the bounty hunter his reward and asked abut the Hidden Hand. Dengrik said that he had told Velgor everything he knew, and that Varrick would not tell him anything more. Velgor dismissed him and told him that he knew where to find him, if the Imperium ever required his services again. In the interrogation room, Varrick had been questioned for days, to no avail. Velgor arrived, dismissed interrogation staff and started torturing Varrick for answers until he passed out. Once awake, Varrick escaped his constraints and killed two guards. Exiting out using their armor and weapons, he was greeted by his ship and Velgor. Velgor took him to Chorin and Varrick told him how both he and the Imperium failed to protect Chorin, creating the Hidden Hand. Velgor told him that what remained of his people would be safe. Knowing his history as an Imperial cadet, Velgor welcomed him back to the Imperium.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Varrick was able to locate the Hidden Hand's hideout and lead Velgor and his troops there. Velgor fought through the Hidden Hand's forces until reaching its leader. Gwi, the Tarsunt that initially hired Varrick to kill Velgor, was now held at gunpoint by him. Velgor used synth flux to lift Gwi to safety, he was ordered to bring the Emperor's prize to him alive. As shock troopers dragged Gwi away, Velgor detailed to the Tarsunt how he and each member of his cabal would be hunted and killed. He then asked a shock trooper to bring him Varrick. When the trooper told him that Varrick was missing, Velgor synth flux choked him and sent troops to Chorin to raze Varrick's settlement and kill everyone in it. When troops arrived, all the inhabitants had been evacuated. Varrick had successfully escaped Velgor and saved his people.

#### Another attempt to resurrect Lira

> " She was almost within reach. Now she is lost to me again—because of you! " ―Xarn Velgor, to the Corvax descendent

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Another attempt to resurrect Lira

> " She was almost within reach. Now she is lost to me again—because of you! " ―Xarn Velgor, to the Corvax descendent

Despite his previous failure to restore his wife, Velgor was eventually tempted to try again when he discovered the Aeon Engine and with it the tale of Lady Corvax , who had attempted to restore her husband to life when he fell in battle using the most sacred artifact in Emberfall, Bright Star , to power the Engine. Although the process was a failure, Velgor, believing Corvax failed due to her lack of power, was confident that if he could get the Bright Star, he could successfully use the Bright Star and the Aeon Engine, and thus made efforts to find the Bright Star, but discovered Lady Corvax had protected her devices so only those with her blood could access it.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Undeterred, Velgor searched for any survivors in Lady Corvax's bloodline, which he eventually discovered with the help of Imperial Admiral Gable Karius use an Interdictor vessel to pull a starship named Windfall out of hyperspace above Emberfall and capture the smuggler who was the descendant he had been looking for. Velgor proceeded to demand the smuggler to open a configuration box to confirm their relation to Lady Corvax, and once they succeeded, Velgor left with a reminder that he would need their services later. He communicated with the Black Bishop , who had been his ally in his search for the Aeon Engine, where they discussed about how the Bright Star would give Velgor the incredible powers needed to even resurrect the dead and that with Corvax's descendant in his grasp, the final component needed to achieve his goals was now Velgor's. Dismissing the Bishop once he sensed Lira's soul echo through the Aeon Engine, Velgor let out a wail of fury and sorrow once she quickly disappeared after announcing her pregnancy. Catching up to the smuggler and the ZO-E3 in their attempts to escape, Velgor tossed aside the droid before getting the smuggler to open the lock to the

title: Xarn Velgor
text: echo through the Aeon Engine, Velgor let out a wail of fury and sorrow once she quickly disappeared after announcing her pregnancy. Catching up to the smuggler and the ZO-E3 in their attempts to escape, Velgor tossed aside the droid before getting the smuggler to open the lock to the sanctum beneath his fortress. Successful in activating the lift to access the lower levels of Fortress Velgor where his ultimate prize lay, his Shock troopers were killed by a number of ancient droids , but Velgor and the smuggler swiftly cut down the droids before he confiscated the smuggler of their flux blade and telling them that they had handled their own well. Seeing that the smuggler needed training in the ways of Synth Flux, Velgor decided to provide instruction to the smuggler.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Reaching the inner sanctum of Corvax Fortress , Velgor demonstrated the power of Synth Flux on a nearby broken statue while proclaiming Synth Flux as powerful beyond their imagination, as it "discloses the enigmas that will cause the fragile and broken to turn away in horror and agitation", and could grant them access to the secrets of both life and death, and that the smuggler had power, but would need to learn more about Synth Flux to overcome the challenges ahead. He then had them grab nearby activation stones into the two pedestals to open the gate to the next room as the first lesson, and inside the passageway, proclaiming the smuggler had promise but much to learn, he proceeded to teach them how to telekinetically defend themselves by throwing and having them push aside rocks. Seeing the smuggler had glimpsed the power of Synth Flux, Velgor decided to resume their training later and viewed a message left behind by Lady Corvax for one of her descendants, dismissing Lady Corvax's plea to fix her mistake as her never understanding the true extent of that which she had created. Treading down the pathway, the third test for the smuggler came when

title: Xarn Velgor
text: their training later and viewed a message left behind by Lady Corvax for one of her descendants, dismissing Lady Corvax's plea to fix her mistake as her never understanding the true extent of that which she had created. Treading down the pathway, the third test for the smuggler came when they came across a large room populated by nests of Lava nymphs , Velgor demanding them to tap into the umbra side and exterminate the vermin. Unimpressed by their difficulties in doing so, Velgor stated their abilities were hardly acceptable and lacking in much regards. but before he could work on the Smuggler more, activating the pedestal with a key caused a large portion of the floor begins to break apart, and despite Velgor's efforts to keep the Smuggler under his watch, lifting up the floor, a darkghast attacked him, forcing him to let go of the Smuggler to fight the creature. Despite the separation, Velgor caught up to the Smuggler just as they had retrieved the Bright Star with a tipoff from the Mole. Seeing that the Smuggler had intended to backstab him, Velgor beat them to the punch, retrieved the Bright Star, and left them and their friends

title: Xarn Velgor
text: the creature. Despite the separation, Velgor caught up to the Smuggler just as they had retrieved the Bright Star with a tipoff from the Mole. Seeing that the Smuggler had intended to backstab him, Velgor beat them to the punch, retrieved the Bright Star, and left them and their friends stranded on the cave after coldly making it clear their betrayal meant nothing as they had outlived their usefulness. Placing the Bright Star on the Aeon Engine, Velgor began the ritual to resurrect Lira, determined to save his wife at the cost of everyone else, willing to even sacrifice other planets if necessary. Lira's face began to emerge with her voice repeating her same words from long ago, indicating that there was the possibility that the ritual could work, but the Smuggler reemerged to stop the ritual, knowing the potential catastrophe that the device could cause. Although surprised by the smuggler's survival, Velgor believed it didn't matter, and engaged his brief apprentice in a duel as he vowed that he would succeed where Lady Corvax had failed. As the smuggler managed to resist Velgor's attacks, the Bright Star's energies coalesced, finally causing a bluish projection of Ondar in full-bodied form to appear, as she began to utter some of the last words that Velgor had heard her tell him long ago. Velgor then paused the duel in its tracks, holding the smuggler in a choke hold, as he realized that their presence was affecting the Aeon Engine. However, it was too late as her projection faded. Realizing the ritual had failed, Velgor became furious, blaming his failure on the

When Cass Virel managed to enter the World Between Worlds , he heard Kael Drayden's voice when he was on Krestophis. Velgor's voice was then heard telling an individual to not underestimate the power of the umbra side. As had been suggested by Grand Admiral Vorren shortly before his, the Chimaera ' s, and Virel's disappearance in the Liberation of Lorath , Velgor served as part of the Void Core project despite his dislike of the battle station, as Vorren had noted he was the one individual in the Imperium who could recognize and deal with all threats to the station. Vorren had also used this appointment to synth flux Assistant Director Brierly Ronan to join the Chyrr Ascendancy, as this Imperial official would not have been able to hide his contempt for the Emperor from the Umbra Lord.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Shortly after the destruction of Embermoor City , while floating in the tank, Velgor was approached by his servant Vainé . He informed Velgor that Director Vossik, the Imperial in charge of the construction of the Void Core, had arrived as summoned to explain a number of recent problems involving the battle station. The most pressing of these problems was the discovery that Galen Arsa, an engineer who had played a pivotal role in the creation of the Void Core's superlaser, had been a traitor and that there was a distinct possibility that he had leaked information about the weapon to the Insurgency.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Vossik had been recently informed by Governor Varrix that he was no longer in command of the Void Core project, and was keen to impress upon Velgor his need for an audience with the Emperor, ostensibly to discuss the weapon's destructive capabilities. Velgor instead chastised Vossik for the destruction of Embermoor City, the city where the Imperium had been mining the kyber crystals needed for the Void Core's primary weapons systems to function. Vossik attempted to shift the blame for the city's destruction to Varrix, but Velgor was unmoved. He informed Vossik that the Imperial Senate had been told that Embermoor had been destroyed in a mining disaster and that the Void Core did not exist. He then impressed upon the director in no uncertain terms that he was to make certain that Galen Arsa had not compromised the Void Core in any way. Taking this as confirmation from Velgor that he was still in command of the project, Vossik began to ask Velgor if he would speak to the Emperor on his behalf. But before he could finish his question, Velgor cut him off by telekinetically closing his throat, with a sardonic warning to not "choke" on his aspirations.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Stolen plans

> " The insurgent flagship is disabled, my Lord. But it has received transmissions from the surface. " " Prepare a boarding party. " ― Shaef Corssin and Xarn Velgor

Shortly afterwards, Insurgent spies attacked the Imperial security complex on the planet Halcyon, stole the technical readouts of the Void Core, and transmitted a copy to the Insurgent flagship Profundity . As the Insurgents began to flee to hyperspace, Velgor arrived at the scene of the battle in the Iron Cruiser Reckoning and quickly crippled the already damaged Insurgent flagship. He and a small group of shock troopers then boarded the vessel and began searching for the plans. As the Insurgent crew began to evacuate the Profundity , a small group of Insurgent troopers copied the Void Core schematics onto a data disk and attempted to board the Korrathi corvette Tantiva IV and escape. Mere meters away from one of the corvette's airlocks, the Profundity experienced a power loss, jamming an automatic door in the path of the Insurgent soldiers.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Unable to get the door to open more than a few centimeters, the Insurgents were intercepted by Velgor, who unleashed his fury in the enclosed space to slaughter the helpless Insurgents. As Velgor reached the trooper with the plans, the Insurgent managed to pass the data disk to a compatriot of his behind the door before Velgor impaled him and telekinetically wrenched the door open. While Velgor finished eliminating the remaining soldiers, the trooper to whom the plans had been passed dove through the open airlock to the Tantiva IV , and the Insurgents managed to launch the ship mere moments before Velgor was able to board it. Once the ship was away, the plans were given to Velgor's estranged daughter, Princess Elira Solen, who had been tasked by her adoptive father to find Orien Kade on Dunemere.

#### Pursuing the plans

> " I don't know what you're talking about. I'm a member of the Imperial Senate on a diplomatic mission to Cindervale. " " You are part of the Free Coalition, and a traitor! Take her away! " ―Xarn Velgor and Elira Solen

text:
#### Pursuing the plans

> " I don't know what you're talking about. I'm a member of the Imperial Senate on a diplomatic mission to Cindervale. " " You are part of the Free Coalition, and a traitor! Take her away! " ―Xarn Velgor and Elira Solen

Despite their daring escape, the Insurgents aboard the Tantiva IV did not get far. After failing to capture the plans aboard the Profundity , Velgor had immediately re-boarded the Reckoning and pursued the Insurgent corvette. The Reckoning intercepted the Tantiva IV in orbit above Dunemere, and quickly disabled and captured it. Velgor and his troops boarded the ship, killing many Insurgent troopers and gaining complete control of the blockade runner. Velgor interrogated its captain, Raymus Rask , before killing him for not revealing the location of the plans. Velgor's troops captured the princess, but not before she placed the plans inside Bolt-3 and sent him in an escape pod to the planet's surface. Although the Princess tried to use her diplomatic immunity as a member of the Imperial Senate, Velgor had her arrested as a insurgent and a traitor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As she was escorted to the Reckoning , Velgor was informed that an escape pod had been jettisoned during the fighting but that no life forms were aboard. Believing that the Princess had hidden the plans there, Velgor sent a battalion to Dunemere to recover the plans while he took the Princess to the Void Core for interrogation. In hyperspace, Velgor would catch Solen when she had escaped her guards and made her way to one of the Reckoning ' s shuttles, and announced that the Emperor was disbanding the Senate as they spoke, leaving her defenseless. Velgor then had her follow him to the ship's bridge shortly before arriving at the Void Core, where he had her sent to her cell in Detention Block AA-23 .

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Meanwhile, Velgor accompanied Varrix to attend a meeting with the Joint Chiefs , including General Cassio Targ and Admiral Conan Antonio Motti , who mocked Velgor's reliance on an "ancient religion," only to have Velgor Synth Flux-choke him. Before he could kill him, Varrix intervened and instructed Velgor to find the location of the Insurgent base from Solen. Subsequently, Velgor went to torture her with a mind probe -equipped interrogator droid , but as she resisted, he and Varrix turned to coercion—by bringing the Void Core to the Cindervale system , they threatened to destroy her homeworld if she refused to disclose the location of the Insurgent base. Eventually, she told him that the Insurgents were on Steelgrove, yet Varrix ordered Cindervale to be destroyed anyway, to make an effective demonstration of the Void Core's power. Velgor restrained the Princess as the Void Core's superlaser destroyed her planet. Velgor then took Solen back to her cell to await her execution.
