After the scout ships sent to Steelgrove found the base abandoned, Varrix ordered Velgor to kill her immediately, but the Corsair Wing was captured in the ruins of Cindervale by the Void Core's grapple beam. Identified as a suspicious ship from Port Kess , Velgor concluded that they were trying to return the stolen plans to the Princess and went to inspect the freighter himself. Told that the crew had apparently abandoned ship after take-off, Velgor gave orders for the ship to be scanned to be sure. At the same time, Velgor sensed the presence of his old master, Orien Kade. When news reached him that the Princess had been released from her cell, Velgor decided to confront Kade alone.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor found Kade after he had deactivated a grapple beam terminal to allow the Corsair escape the battle station, and the two engaged in one final duel. During the fight, Velgor noted that Kade's age had made him weak. However, Kade told his former apprentice that he would not win because he would become more powerful than Velgor could ever imagine, even if he managed to kill him. As they fought, the two reached Bay 327 just as Kade's companions and the Princess reunited to board the Corsair , only for Kade to see his latest apprentice, Joren Drayden, Velgor's son.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As his former master gave him a mysteriously knowing smile, Velgor struck him down when Kade raised his blade in surrender. Much to Velgor's surprise, Kade's body disappeared, for his spirit had become one with Synth Flux, and Velgor tried to find remains in his robes but found none. As he did so, General Moradmin Bast asked who he was, and Velgor answered "An old man who thought he could help gifted children. He was mistaken." Velgor then tried to stop the Insurgents from escaping but was prevented from doing so by the closing of the hangar doors by Joren's shot. After the Corsair ' s escape, Velgor met with Varrix and confirmed that a homing beacon had been placed upon the ship and that they could follow the ship to the Insurgent base.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Kade's warning to Velgor came true; his consciousness survived his death, and he became a Synth Flux spirit . Meanwhile, still remaining hidden on Mirefall , Zho felt Kade and Velgor's duel through Synth Flux, especially noticing, for the first time, the loneliness in the man who had once been Kael Drayden. Zho noticed that Velgor's loneliness only grew after he struck down his former mentor, which nearly made Zho pity the former Aetheri and wish he could counsel him. As he continued his journey, Zho reflected on his past, blaming himself for not noticing Drayden's path to the umbra side.

#### Cinderfall 4

> " Synth Flux is strong with this one. " ―Xarn Velgor, about Joren Drayden during the Battle of Cinderfall

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor's plan worked and the Void Core followed the Corsair to the hidden Insurgent base on Cinderfall 4 . In the Void Core's conference room , Velgor awoke Varrix from a vision about his father just as the battle station approached Cinderfall Prime , with an officer informing them that Cinderfall 4 was located on the far-side of the planet. As the Void Core prepared to destroy the moon, Insurgent Vectors and Yarrows starfighters attacked the Void Core, having identified a weakness: a thermal exhaust port which led to the reactor systems; a direct hit on the port would cause a chain reaction and the destruction of the station. Although Varrix remained convinced in the station's invulnerability, Velgor was informed by Lieutenant Tanbris that the thirty attacking Insurgent starfighters were small enough to avoid the pulse lance defenses. As such, Velgor ordered fighters to launch. When Gold Squadron broke off from the main group and begun a trench run towards the exhaust port, Velgor boarded his SKREE Advanced and, flanked by two SKREE fighters, managed to terminate three of the last four Gold Squadron pilots. He continued to destroy most ships of Red Squadron , killing Red Leader Garven Dreis

title: Xarn Velgor
text: from the main group and begun a trench run towards the exhaust port, Velgor boarded his SKREE Advanced and, flanked by two SKREE fighters, managed to terminate three of the last four Gold Squadron pilots. He continued to destroy most ships of Red Squadron , killing Red Leader Garven Dreis . As the last members of Red Squadron engaged in a trench run while the Void Core was preparing the destroy the moon, Velgor damaged Torb Rask 's Vector, forcing him to break off formation, and killed Biggs Darklighter , leaving only the leader of the group, Joren. Velgor quickly realized that Synth Flux was powerful in the young pilot, but nevertheless proceeded to get him into range. When he finally succeeded, he was just about to destroy the young pilot when the newly arrived Corsair Wing intervened and destroyed one of Velgor's escorts. Before the Corsair could destroy Velgor, his other escort accidentally bumped into Velgor's craft, destroying the other escort and causing Velgor's craft to veer off course and send him plunging into space. This prevented him from stopping the Void Core's destruction, which killed Varrix and was a major defeat for the Imperium.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Shortly after the battle, Velgor sent a distress signal to the Reckoning to send a ship to pick him up and bring him back from the Cinderfall system to the Iron Cruiser. Sometime later, he would fly just beyond the ever-expanding debris field that once was the Void Core, when Imperial pilots Ciena Ree and Berisse Sai arrived in a Gozanti -class cruiser . Docking his SKREE Advanced x1 with the freighter, Velgor passed through the airlock door and met Ree. Then, he ordered Ree and Sai to remain in the hold for the remainder of the voyage while he took command of the freighter until they returned to the Reckoning . As the insurgents quickly abandoned their base in the wake of the battle, Velgor joined the Imperial retaliatory attack, but the insurgents were largely able to escape. Velgor ordered for a blockade of the Cinderfall system to begin at one point.

#### Post-Cinderfall ventures

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Post-Cinderfall ventures

Sometime later, an Imperial officer managed to obtain one of two flux blades formerly owned by the Umbra Vael Atrio . Velgor arrived on Hradreek , where the officer welcomed him, supported by a contingent of shock troopers. Velgor looked at the flux blade and asked where the other one was. The officer was confused by his question, and Velgor Synth Flux-choked him. As he gagged, he claimed that he bought the flux blade from a smuggler and that she must have tricked him. Velgor told a shock trooper to divert all divisions to finding the smuggler and the other flux blade. Velgor then killed the officer as the shock troopers scattered to begin the search.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: A squad of shock troopers found the smuggler, Sana Starric , and they chased her down the streets. Starric paid a gang of Aquari to stall them, and they got in the way of the shock troopers. However, Velgor appeared and cut them down using his flux blade and Vael Atrio'. Velgor then followed Starric' path to a cargo bay, and he used Synth Flux to move the crates and block her from a clear exit. Starric then shot at Velgor, and he used Synth Flux to disperse the plasma bolts. Starric rigged one of the crates and then waited for Velgor to follow before detonating it, throwing Velgor to the side and burying him. Velgor soon freed himself and made his way to the nearby podracing track. Velgor entered the seating area, and the audience scattered at his presence. Velgor noticed one of the dune racers, who was grabbing the attention of the commentary. The human, despite being biologically unequipped for a race like this, was winning the race, and Velgor used Synth Flux to cause one of the engines to malfunction, crashing the dune racer. The pilot of the racer was none other than Joren Drayden, who had

title: Xarn Velgor
text: the attention of the commentary. The human, despite being biologically unequipped for a race like this, was winning the race, and Velgor used Synth Flux to cause one of the engines to malfunction, crashing the dune racer. The pilot of the racer was none other than Joren Drayden, who had obtained the other of Atrio' flux blades. Joren decided to destroy the flux blade, as it overwhelmed him with anger whenever he needed it. Velgor watched him escape in his Vector, and he decided to crush Atrio' other flux blade. According to a tale later told by Vainé, at another point after the Battle of Cinderfall, Velgor's Iron Cruiser was contacted by Cranwell , the assistant to Varrix Initiative scientist Restin , to warn them that Doctor Restin had betrayed the Imperium. Restin, who wanted a weapon to use against Velgor as revenge for the destruction of Cindervale, had created a genetic serum that would turn those injected with it into rampaging Gamorreans, who could then spread the infection by touch. Velgor decided to deal with Restin himself, so he arrived at Restin's base of operations with two shock troopers and pretended to not know he was a traitor. After witnessing the doctor turn Cranwell into a Gamorrean with the serum, Velgor suggested the serum could be used against the Insurgency. When Restin turned the infected Gamorrean against the Umbra Lord, he effortlessly lifted it and his infected shock troopers into the air with Synth Flux. He did the same with Restin, forcing the scientist to confess his treachery before revealing he had already known he was a traitor. Intending to be a firsthand witness to his destruction, Velgor forced the three Gamorreans and Restin to touch, transforming the doctor

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
into the air with Synth Flux. He did the same with Restin, forcing the scientist to confess his treachery before revealing he had already known he was a traitor. Intending to be a firsthand witness to his destruction, Velgor forced the three Gamorreans and Restin to touch, transforming the doctor into one of his creations. Leaving the infected scientist to the mercy of the Gamorreans, Velgor left aboard his Vectis -class shuttle. He had never feared Restin's experiments, as Velgor already viewed himself as a different kind of monster. #### Cymoon 1

> " He's here. The Insurgent pilot who destroyed the Void Core. I can feel his presence. He will not escape me again. " ―Xarn Velgor

Several weeks after the Battle of Cinderfall, Xarn Velgor was called to Weapons Factory Alpha on Cymoon 1 . He was to negotiate , or rather synth flux an arrangement with an envoy of Grukk the Grak about supplying raw materials through Grak-controlled space to the factory. Velgor arrived shortly after the envoy (secretly the Corsair Wing ' s captain, Dax Karrick ) and landed on a platform. As he was about to enter the facility, Velgor was shot at by a sniper, Brevok , but he deflected the volt pistol bolt and used two shock troopers as human shields as the Vorak rained down dozens of shots upon him. Unscathed, Velgor located Brevok's position and used to Synth Flux to collapse his vantage point, but the Vorak survived.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor then ordered the arriving shock trooper reinforcements to hunt him down. One of them informed the Dark Lord that Overseer Aggadeen was out of contact and the factory's main reactor was on meltdown. As he surmised these occurrences were the work of Insurgents, Velgor put the entire moon on alert but also felt the presence of the pilot who had destroyed the Void Core, Joren Drayden. Although unaware of the boy's identity, Velgor made his way into the factory at once and came face-to-face with the Aetheri apprentice. Velgor soon realized that the boy had been cursorily trained by Kade, and after the briefest of duels, snatched Joren's flux blade. As he prepared to execute Joren for his refusal to disclose information about the Insurgency, he realized that the boy's flux blade had once been his own. Before he could question Joren further, the foot of an Insurgent-hijacked Ironclad Walker walker came hurtling down into the middle of their standoff, knocking the two apart.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: In the ensuing chaos, Velgor sought to prevent the Insurgents' escape, and mowed down the factory's runaway slaves, commanding his shock troopers to execute all the escapees. Once Joren got away on a stolen 74-Z speeder bike and attacked Velgor's troops (leading the Dark Lord to reconsider his initial dismissal of the boy and wonder exactly what Kade had been up to before his death), Velgor personally saw to the walker's defeat. Karrick and Solen, commanding the Ironclad Walker, tried to step on him, but Velgor used Synth Flux to hold the walker's descending foot several meters above his head, and almost tore it apart.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: He was foiled, however, when Karrick and Solen unleashed a barrage of the Ironclad Walker's laser fire upon him, causing him to lose his old flux blade (which the current owner retrieved), and his mask and helmet. As he emerged from under a pile of rubble, a shock trooper approached; upon seeing Velgor's scarred face, they tried to apologize. However, Velgor killed them by twisting their head around using Synth Flux, right before Aggadeen reached him via comlink and asked for the facility's evacuation. Velgor vetoed his request, had him repair the core, and ordered to kill all the Insurgent invaders, except for the boy, whom Velgor would deal with personally. As Aggadeen informed him that they had successfully defused the reactor, Velgor personally felled the Insurgent walker by slashing its legs with his flux blade.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
As reinforcements arrived, Velgor sent them after the Insurgents on the trash fields, while he pursued the lone Insurgent who was returning to the factory, Joren. Aboard a combat speeder , Velgor chased Joren into the facility, but the Insurgent managed to destroy the power core with the speeder bike, leaving Velgor as the only survivor among the factory's rubble following its explosion. The Umbra Lord then saw Joren's abandoned speeder and the fleeing Corsair Wing ; as the Adjudicator ' s captain, Kronn , informed him that they had been unable to catch the freighter, Velgor Synth Flux-choked the captain. Then, as if he were talking to Kade, Velgor vowed to find the boy's identity and to turn him to the umbra side, so that the boy became his weapon, and not Kade's.

#### Cinderfall's aftermath

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Cinderfall's aftermath

> " But you are the only one living to suffer my anger. You, an isolated survivor of the greatest military disaster in all my Imperium's history? Oh, you are truly the Seeded One, Lord Velgor. Chosen to be the one responsible. " " I will make it right. I will crush the Insurgents. " " No. I think not. " ―Mal and Velgor discuss Velgor's failings Thereupon, Velgor returned to the Imperial Palace on Vantor to report to the Emperor, bringing Aggadeen with him. The Emperor bid Velgor to explain the events of Weapons Factory Alpha, which along with the Void Core's destruction, had put the Imperium very near disaster. Although Velgor considered Aggadeen to be responsible for the failure on Cymoon 1 (and the Overseer was tortured accordingly), the Emperor claimed much of the responsibility lay in Velgor's head, as he reminded him that he was the sole survivor of the greatest disaster in the Imperium's history—one partially caused by his idea to tag the Corsair with a homing beacon and let it escape with the Void Core plans. He then informed Velgor that Cassio Targ, now Grand General of the Imperial Army , would be his commanding officer for some time.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
The Emperor then ordered Velgor to continue the unfinished Cymoon 1 negotiations with Grukk the Grak on Dunemere, right before going to Targ. As they returned to his office, Mal greeted one of his agents, Silvar, and Velgor asked for his identity, but the Emperor denied him the knowledge. Instead, he asked Velgor if there was anything else to report, but Velgor chose not to tell him about Kade's mysterious disappearance, nor the Synth Flux-sensitive Insurgent pilot who had destroyed the Void Core and left the office and palace altogether. He boarded an Imperial Iron Cruiser and immediately left for Dunemere, sending the Imperial vessel back to collect the trade goods for the meeting.

#### Dunemere negotiations

> « Hmmm. I see you know enough to tread carefully. But tell me... are you brave or foolish. » " That is not the question, Grak. The question is: Are you? " « Oh, Aetheri... always making everything so difficult. » ―Grukk the Grak and Xarn Velgor

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
> « Hmmm. I see you know enough to tread carefully. But tell me... are you brave or foolish. » " That is not the question, Grak. The question is: Are you? " « Oh, Aetheri... always making everything so difficult. » ―Grukk the Grak and Xarn Velgor

Velgor soon arrived at Grukk's Palace where, during the meeting, he had the Grak dismiss his court. However, Grukk would rather claim the bounty on Velgor's head and had his people shoot at him, but Velgor killed them and forced Grukk to reconsider his position. After being Synth Flux choked, the Grak admitted he found it hard not to respect him. The two then came to an agreement: Grukk would provide Velgor with two of his best bounty hunters. Velgor left the Grak's palace and sought out a Dunefolk Raider camp , wherein he mercilessly slaughtered its inhabitants. He was then approached by Grukk's envoys: Vex Vark and Zazzik . While he sent Vark to find and capture the Insurgent pilot from Cinderfall alive, Velgor assigned the Vorak to bring Mal's agent to him. Both mercenaries agreed, and Velgor departed Dunemere for his Iron Cruiser.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: The following day, Velgor returned in his official capacity as the Emperor's envoy to negotiate as if nothing had happened the day before. Grukk welcomed Velgor and claimed that his resources belonged to the Imperium as long as he was paid. Velgor then turned to leave, leaving his shock troopers to tell Grukk what was required, but the Grak invited him to a feast and entertainment in his honor, for he liked to seal his business ventures by watching someone die. Aboard the sail barge Khetanna , Velgor and Grukk watched as the latter's guards killed wild striders for the sport until Grukk's court jester , Salacious B. Crumb , let out a loud cackle. Velgor warned the Grak to not let the Kowakian monkey-lizard do that again in his presence if he valued Crumb's life; Grukk merely laughed and told Velgor he now regarded him as a "good friend." The Grak then inquired whether his bounty hunters were adequately serving his needs; though Velgor berated him for bringing up the private matter, he also told the Grak that their missions were simple enough: to capture an Imperial agent and a boy. Grukk argued that the "boy" had destroyed the

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
The Grak then inquired whether his bounty hunters were adequately serving his needs; though Velgor berated him for bringing up the private matter, he also told the Grak that their missions were simple enough: to capture an Imperial agent and a boy. Grukk argued that the "boy" had destroyed the Void Core, and had possibly been trained by Kade. The name prompted Velgor to request that Grukk tell him all he knew of Kade's exile on Dunemere. Grukk first required someone screaming, though, so he ordered his guards to pilot the Khetanna to the Great Pit of Karkoon . He expected Velgor to be impressed by the devourer , which he believed was one of the few treasures that Dunemere had to offer, and said he found it hard to believe that anyone of note (like the Cinderfall pilot) could have ever been born on Dunemere. In silence, Velgor watched his homeworld's sunset.

#### Servitude unto Targ

> " You should think of yourself as your flux blade. A singular weapon from an older time—and one that is dangerous to everyone around them without a skilled hand to wield it. In time you will understand that I am the skilled hand you've been waiting for. " ―Cassio Targ to Xarn Velgor

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After leaving Dunemere, Velgor met with Targ aboard his Sovereign -class Star Dreadnought , Annihilator . During a time of many raids against ships carrying Grukk's weapons and equipment supplies, Velgor was sent to protect an Imperial shuttle, CZ-246 , from a pirate attack . With his SKREE Advanced, Velgor went to their aid, alongside Black Two and Black Three , and successfully disabled the automated CR90 corvette attacking the shuttle. Upon returning to the Annihilator , Velgor reported to Targ that the pirate vessel had been captured and that he suspected a security breach. As he said so, Targ disagreed, believing the raids to be predictable piracy, and admitted to seeing the Void Core as "Varrix's folly." Velgor noted that Varrix at least had a vision, prompting Targ to admit his plans were not as grand as Varrix's or Velgor's, but they still were effective; he believed that the Imperium could not be based around a single asset, like the Void Core or Velgor himself. Targ then informed Velgor that he intended to repair the corvette and use it to attack its base of origin , sending Velgor to head the attack, although with an adjutant , Lieutenant Oon-ai .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor left to prepare for the mission and oversee the repairs on the corvette. Oon-ai followed, asking permission to look into Velgor's personal communications to provide information to Targ. Although it annoyed Velgor, as it was the Emperor's command that he serve under Targ, he allowed it and left. He then planted treasonable evidence into a black astromech so as to incriminate Oon-ai during the mission. Soon thereafter, Velgor, Oon-ai, and six shock troopers boarded the corvette and found the pirate base, docking with the station. Greeted by a Velari pirate , whom he killed, Velgor ordered the troopers to secure the core, while his astromech made his way to the command center to plant the false evidence.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
They found themselves under the attack of two customized droidekas who brandished missile launchers, prompting Velgor to use Synth Flux to throw the incoming missiles back at the attackers, destroying the droids and fatally injuring the pirates. A Calavane pirate survived long enough to activate the self-destruct, and Velgor ordered the surviving troopers to return to the corvette and prepare to launch as soon as he returned. Followed by Oon-ai, Velgor went deeper into the station to retrieve the false evidence. They returned to the corvette just before the station exploded.

Back on the Annihilator , Velgor reported to Targ, telling him that he was impressed with the results of his plan (the intelligence he had gathered confirmed the raiders were being backed by the Crymorah Syndicate), but also claimed Oon-ai was the leak, noting that Targ should be more careful of those who were close to him. Shortly after, Velgor isolated the black astromech under the pretenses of a private discussion; the Dark Lord ensured the droid had deleted all records of its data uploads on the station, before venting the droid through an airlock and into space, where it exploded.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Following an Imperial-Insurgent confrontation , Velgor went to the Palace of Grukkar the Grak to meet with Sergeant Kreel. A covert operative of his battalion "Velgor's Fist," Kreel informed him that his mission to end Grukkar' operations was a success, but that the Cinderfall Insurgent pilot had escaped them yet again. Velgor inquired if he had mentioned his name (which he did not), and asked him to tell him everything he had learned of the boy.

#### A droid army

> " There was a time I had armies at my beck and call. That time has passed. I need resources of my own. Private resources. " ―Xarn Velgor to Dr. Vexa, on why he needed her services

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### A droid army

> " There was a time I had armies at my beck and call. That time has passed. I need resources of my own. Private resources. " ―Xarn Velgor to Dr. Vexa, on why he needed her services

From the information he gathered from the pirate base, Velgor learned that a Doctor Chelli Lona Vexa had supplied the pirates with the customized droidekas. As he wanted similarly effective units in the personal army he sought to build, Velgor set out to find Vexa, conducting a manhunt for her in many locations, gathering information and killing the witnesses, until he finally learned of her presence on Quarantine World III in Kallidahin Space . He landed there just as Vexa was arrested by Utani Xane and a squad of B2 super battle droids; although Xane warned him that he was violating treaties, Velgor began destroying her droids and saved Vexa as she tumbled over a ledge. Velgor stabbed Xane through the back with his blade before telling the doctor he needed her services. He helped her up and she agreed.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Together, they boarded Vexa's ship, the Ark Angel II , where she admitted to being a fan of his. The rogue archaeologist also introduced Velgor to the Triple-Zero protocol personality matrix and estimated it would take hours to unlock the matrix's codes that were restricting it. It took Velgor a few seconds to unlock it, which let Vexa install the personality matrix into a protocol droid's body right away. As the droid introduced himself as 0-0-0 , she imprinted herself and Velgor as his masters, and used him to wake up VT-1 , a blastomech prototype . But as it was hostile towards his new masters, 0-0-0 shut it down before he could do any harm.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor then let her know the reason he had sought her out was to secure his own private resources, ones only she could help him procure. Vexa (who had originally acquired the two droids for the Gotra ) instead gave them to Velgor after realizing Velgor was probably going to be her employer for the foreseeable future. She asked what else he needed, and he answered that he wanted troops of unquestionable loyalty: battle droids. Vexa then suggested that they acquire an unusual droid foundry on Pyralis, one in possession of Queen Karina , who had survived the Replica Wars and the planet's sterilization . As they landed the Ark Angel , and she sent 0-0-0 and VT-1 to map the cave route to the queen so that she and Velgor could follow, Vexa asked Velgor if he had ever been to Pyralis before. Her questioning brought up the memory of his first kiss with Ondar, shortly before the First Battle of Pyralis.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor ordered Vexa to cease her probing, and entered the catacombs; she followed him. They reunited with VT-1 and 0-0-0 and encountered the queen. Velgor immediately amputated her from the womb droid factory. The queen, injured but alive, ordered her "children" to stop the intruders; at Velgor's command, VT-1 opened fire on the droids, and he and Velgor began to overwhelm her forces. Meanwhile, Vexa set a beacon on the ceiling with Velgor's help and ordered her Ark Angel to barrage the locator to make a hole in the roof. Velgor protected himself and Vexa by creating a Synth Flux barrier . His J-Type 327 Nubian then lowered a crane-platform, which Vexa attached to the factory while Velgor fought off the advancing droids, and the ship carried them and the factory to the skies.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
They would later board the Ark Angel , where Vexa successfully activated the factory and told him he would have his private droid army. She then asked Velgor if he would kill her then or later, and said that if he did, she wanted a flux blade right through the neck, with no warning. Velgor finally told her she had proved resourceful and would be safe as long as he had use for her, unless she tried to blackmail him. It was then that 0-0-0 interrupted them to inform Velgor that he had a signal from Black Zazzik: he was bringing the Emperor's agent to him.

#### Silvar's enforcers

> " Synth Flux is obsolete. These are its successors. " " This is... blasphemous! " " This has nothing to do with Synth Flux. Much like you, Lord Velgor. I look at you, more machine than man, and I see a bridge between the old world and mine. In many ways, these are your children. " " Enough. " ―Silvar introduces Xarn Velgor to his enforcers

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As Zazzik arrived, Velgor confronted the Emperor's agent, Silvar-IV. Velgor demanded that he tell him his name, his commission from the Emperor and the location of his headquarters . As he refused, Velgor assigned 0-0-0 to retrieve all relevant information from him. After an interrogation that resulted in the agent's death, 0-0-0 reported to Velgor that he was Dr. Silvar-IV, that his research base was located in an Outer Reach nebula , and that his commission was to create replacements for Velgor. After learning this, they immediately departed for the base, aboard his J-type 327 Nubian . While Vexa remained on the ship, Velgor and two platoons of droid commandos infiltrated it. Velgor sent a platoon to "the dojo" and had the other one follow him to the barracks . As they killed the soldiers in there, Vexa reported that they had lost the other platoon, prompting Velgor to go to the dojo, where he met the twins Morit and Aiolin Astarte .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: They soon engaged in combat, but before any of the parties could harm each other, Silvar-V appeared and told the twins to stand down. He explained to Velgor why he was still alive after his last body was killed, and that he was not making apprentices for the Emperor but enforcers, as he believed Synth Flux to be obsolete. Believing him to be blasphemous, Velgor attempted to strike Silvar down when the scientist claimed they were, in many ways, Velgor's children and successors. The Emperor then revealed his presence to Velgor and stopped him, claiming he wanted to see Silvar's demonstration without delay.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor was immediately made to fight the Astarte twins, Tulon Voidgazer , the Calavane Karbin , and a Trandoshan warrior . As neither party was injured, the Emperor ordered the fight to be one to the death. As such, Velgor fought the Cyberanimate Trandoshan , but its ferocity threw him off balance, prompting Morit to intervene and kill his fellow enforcer. The Emperor then ordered the fighting to cease; Velgor warned Morit that his trespass would not be forgotten, as the Trandoshan's life was his to take. The Emperor then told the enforcers and Velgor that their mission was to strike down all who opposed the Imperium and that they were not to slay each other. As per his master's orders, Velgor followed him.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
In private, the Emperor, discovering the remains of some of Velgor's commando droids, admitted to being impressed that he had some independence left in him after so long and that perhaps he could triumph against the enforcers. Velgor criticized his dealings with Silvar, as he saw his enforcers as a heresy to Synth Flux, but the Emperor berated him for his lack of respect—for it was Velgor who had disappointed him on Emberfall and had forced him to contact Silvar. As he left, he observed that perhaps, Velgor would prove himself worthy of the name he had given him back then.

#### Parenthood

> " Did you bring me anything of value, bounty hunter? " " Not much. Just his name. Drayden. " ―Xarn Velgor and Vex Vark

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Parenthood

> " Did you bring me anything of value, bounty hunter? " " Not much. Just his name. Drayden. " ―Xarn Velgor and Vex Vark

Troubled, Velgor returned to his ship. Aboard the Nubian, Vexa told him that Vark wanted to report in during Velgor's absence. Subsequently, Velgor traveled to an Iron Cruiser to meet with the bounty hunter and hear his story. The Dark Lord was disappointed to hear that Vark had lost the boy, but before leaving, Vark told him his name: Joren Drayden. In his solitude, Velgor remembered Ondar telling him about her pregnancy, and Mal's half-truth, and cracked the viewport in his anger. Thereupon, he used his meditation chamber's lumen projector to contact his master, but chose to say nothing about his son; rather, Velgor assured him that he would not fail and ended the transmission. Nevertheless, he accepted Joren as his son and vowed that the boy would be his.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Determined to find more about Joren, Velgor returned to Dunemere on the Ark Angel , with Vexa, 0-0-0 and VT-1 in his company. They landed at the Havel homestead, which they discovered to be deserted after an attack by Imperial troops, and Velgor tried to find traces of Joren's presence. Unable to find anything of importance, Velgor left the moisture farm and went to Kade's home where he indeed felt the remnants of Joren's usage of Synth Flux during his duel against Vark, but nothing else. As they left, Vexa activated a molecular purge bomb to remove all remnants of their presence, and Velgor dismissed Vexa, for he was to return to his duties for the time being.

#### Anthan Prime

> " I'm trying to ascertain if you are... dangerous. " " Oh, I am, Lord Velgor... But only to the enemies of the Imperium. " ―Xarn Velgor and Inspector Thanoth

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Anthan Prime

> " I'm trying to ascertain if you are... dangerous. " " Oh, I am, Lord Velgor... But only to the enemies of the Imperium. " ―Xarn Velgor and Inspector Thanoth

As part of Targ's crackdown on Outer Reach criminal interests who had gone unchecked in the past, Velgor took part in a mission to terminate a criminal organization known as Son-tuul Pride . He and his troops destroyed the Pride's base and seized its stockpile of credits, to be transported on an Imperial light cruiser, but he also secretly sent Vexa all the information needed to steal the credits cargo. Following the theft , Velgor reunited with her on Anthan 13 , where he sent her to confirm some information about Commodex Tahn .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor then attended a meeting between Targ and Silvar's enforcers, wherein the Astarte twins were assigned to deal with the Plasma Devils , and wherein Velgor let Targ know he wanted the mission of finding the Cinderfall Insurgent pilot (which was Karbin's mission). Targ felt he was too personally invested, and sent Velgor to punish whoever was responsible for the theft of the Son-tuul Pride's fortune in the Anthan system ; he also informed Velgor that Inspector Thanoth was his replacement adjutant. While Thanoth went to the Anthan Prime Orbital Dockyard to investigate the theft's circumstances, Velgor returned to Anthan 13 and killed the entirety of a small Insurgent cell to cover his tracks. He later reunited with Thanoth on Anthan Prime , where they sought Doowan , an employee of " the Dragon "—an arms dealer who was likely to have sold the explosives needed for the theft—and interrogated him. The Raadan promptly revealed the location of the Dragon in his mansion , before the twins killed him in a show of synth flux.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Thanoth then noticed Velgor's passivity, but Velgor dismissed it, saying he was merely trying to ascertain if Thanoth was dangerous or a traitor. The two then went to the Dragon's mansion, which Velgor entered on his own, killing the people inside until he reached the Dragon himself. Although he tried to tell Velgor everything to save himself, Velgor killed the Ortolan , and claimed he would have detonated the building once Thanoth reached the office. The inspector then opened the Dragon's vault to access his records and asked Velgor to ready a strike synth flux for when he located the suspects.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor then used the opportunity to meet with Vexa, who had just come back from a raid on Commodex Tahn's villa on Ondara. She confirmed his sources: Ondar had indeed died but had given birth to a healthy boy, who was taken away by the Aetheri. Velgor then tasked Vexa with finding Joren before Karbin could; subsequently, she resorted to The Ante . Velgor then returned to the Iron Cruiser, where Thanoth they would travel to the Spire to find The Ante. When they found him, he told them the location of the Plasma Devils to show cooperation and pointed at the one responsible for the theft, Vexa. Before the Givin could identify her by name, Velgor telekinetically forced an unlucky stray shot and killed him. Velgor then went to find Vexa before anyone else.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As they encountered each other, Velgor ordered her not to struggle and Synth Flux choked her, but Vexa claimed she knew of Joren's location. Velgor released her and ordered Vexa to tell him, but she refused, claiming she would tell him later. He then let her go, using Synth Flux to drop debris above him as she escaped on the Ark Angel . He got out of the rubble as Thanoth and the shock troopers arrived and claimed he had fallen into her trap. To follow her, Velgor and Thanoth boarded their Arquitens -class light cruiser. As they waited for their SKREE/sa bombers to catch Vexa, Velgor and Thanoth agreed to use their ready strike synth flux to kill the Plasma Devils before they could escape.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
The two had their light cruiser go to the Thanteen Substrata on Anthan 1 , where the Insurgent cell was located. As per their plan, their light cruiser bombarded the westernmost tunnels and sealed them, whereas Velgor went to the east route and felled incoming Insurgent ships by throwing his flux blade until the cell was annihilated. He then took three of the Plasma Devils' flight helmets and, alongside Thanoth, presented them to Targ, who agreed with their course of action given the tight situation. As Karbin reported that the Cinderfall Insurgent pilot was free, Velgor and Thanoth left, and the Inspector let him know it had been an honor to serve alongside him.

#### Shu-Torun

> " As a princess, you served your father. As a queen, you serve your people. This is a small reminder of what happens to worlds who resist the Emperor. This is what remains of Cindervale. " ―Xarn Velgor to Queen Triova

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Shu-Torun

> " As a princess, you served your father. As a queen, you serve your people. This is a small reminder of what happens to worlds who resist the Emperor. This is what remains of Cindervale. " ―Xarn Velgor to Queen Triova

Velgor traveled to Shu-Torun with a message to reinforce their cooperation and synth flux its government to fulfill the quotas, while 0-0-0 and VT-1 killed the king and his closest servants. Expecting to meet the King of Shu-Torun , he instead met Princess Triova upon landing, who was to show him to the ball, a little celebration to showcase their culture. Soon after their arrival, however, Shu-Torun assassins that wished death to the Imperium and the king, but Velgor successfully fended them off and demanded to see the king immediately. Triova complied and guided him through the tunnels as the main elevators were being watched by the traitorous dukes, according to her. Velgor recognized Triova as admirable for her willingness to sacrifice herself for the greater good, as lava poured into the tunnels.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
However, he used his flux blade to make a round platform to float above the lava and reach one of the exits above. Taking an unconscious Triova with him, Velgor made it to one of the corridors where he killed the guards. Triova awoke, only to point a volt pistol at Velgor. He, however, cut her hand off and entered the king's chambers to find the monarch, his other children and guards killed by Velgor's assassin droids. With Triova as the new Queen of Shu-Torun, he delivered the Emperor's message; a piece of Cindervale, as a reminder of what happened to worlds that resisted his rule. Velgor then told her that he would pacify Shu-Torun, but that she was to not forget whom she served.

#### Vrogas Vas

> " Xarn Velgor! Lay down your weapons! You are surrounded!" "All I am surrounded by is fear. And dead men. " ―Xarn Velgor responds to an Insurgent commando company ordering his surrender

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Vrogas Vas

> " Xarn Velgor! Lay down your weapons! You are surrounded!" "All I am surrounded by is fear. And dead men. " ―Xarn Velgor responds to an Insurgent commando company ordering his surrender

Velgor met with Vexa and the droids, and demanded that he tell her Joren's location: Vrogas Vas . She continued by saying she did want to work for him and show that she was trustworthy. After a moment, he conceded that his work alongside Thanoth had given him an appreciation of talent, and told her not to make him regret his decision. He left, saying it was a task for him alone. Unbeknownst to him, a probe droid from Karbin followed him. In his SKREE Advanced, he went to the planet's system where, upon coming out of hyperspace, he found three Alliance starfighter squadrons orbiting the planet. As he sensed Joren's presence, he remained and charged against the starfighters, who dismissed his SKREE as a mere Imperial scout.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: During the battle , Velgor engaged the Vector starfighters , and managed to take out both Blue Squadron and Yellow Squadron , as he lost contact with Vexa. Velgor was then confronted by Joren, who was flying as Red Five , and flew his Vector into Velgor's starfighter, hoping to kill him. During the collision, their stabilizers were damaged prompting their craft to crash on the planet's surface. There, Velgor was hunted down by the Alliance forces, starting with Gray Squadron , but he promptly destroyed them by use of Synth Flux. Afterward, a company of Insurgent commandos moved in to attack him, but he activated some of their thermal detonators before they could throw them, taking out a tank by deflecting its shot against it and continued to reduce the Insurgent forces.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor also took the volt pistol array of his fallen SKREE Advanced x1 and used it to take down further ships, this time from Cyan Squadron . Not too long afterward, another platoon was deployed to attack him, although this time Solen was leading them herself. Velgor, choking her two companions, confronted her but felt an incoming ambush. When he let her go so that she contacted Joren, Solen used the opportunity to arrange an airstrike on her and Velgor's location. Instead, Commander Karbin arrived with a task synth flux, and tried to take his victory—both his son and the princess' execution—from Velgor. Subsequently, Velgor engaged the enforcer in a duel, during which Solen escaped, and during which they entered the Aetheri Sanctum in ruins.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Inside the temple, he was momentarily distracted by ghosts of his past (Vael's, Kade's, and Zho's voices), but continued the duel. Vexa then contacted him from aboard the Ark Angel and informed him that Joren had been captured by Karbin's guards. So Velgor had her crash her ship against Karbin and confronted the mortally wounded Karbin, who realized there was more to the Cinderfall pilot and Velgor's relationship than met the eye. Velgor then finished him and contacted Vexa to tell her that her "pardon" depended on Joren's capture. With Synth Flux, he brought down the shuttle transporting Joren, and Vexa tried to capture Joren only to be captured herself by the Insurgents, leaving Velgor to watch as his son on the Corsair Wing fled from Vrogas Vas.

#### Shu-Torun War

> " The queen of Shu-Torun. Did you choose well? " " There was no other choice. " ―Queen Triova and Xarn Velgor

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Shu-Torun War

> " The queen of Shu-Torun. Did you choose well? " " There was no other choice. " ―Queen Triova and Xarn Velgor

Velgor then returned to the Imperial Palace and brought Karbin's body to the Emperor, demanding that his master give him a fight worthy of his time. The Emperor then told Velgor to return to Shu-Torun as the ore-barons were rebelling and he required a full military intervention, and that Silvar (per Targ's request) was to join him in the task. As a result, Velgor returned to Shu-Torun, alongside Silvar, the Astarte twins and Voidgazer. Accompanied by Queen Triova, Velgor led an attack against a rebellious delving citadel , and destroyed it as a demonstration of synth flux. He also accorded to treat Triova with the illusion of respect and tasked, in secret, a group of bounty hunters to find Vexa and return her to him, either dead or alive.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After sending a broadcast to the barons, Velgor, Triova, and Silvar and his enforcers went, per the queen's suggestion, to the ancestral retreat of the Shu-Torun royalty. There, they were soon attacked by Baron Rubix 's Lava Leviathan , and Velgor used Triova' escape vessel to reach the Leviathan and dared the twins to follow him. With their flux blades, they boarded it, and from the inside, the three cut large holes that allowed the ship to flood with magma and be destroyed. Upon returning, Triova suggested that they attack Rubix next (as she had identified the ship's owner) and so, Velgor told Silvar to prepare his enforcers. In the meantime, he killed Beebox for trying to deceive him with a stranger's disintegrated body, and refused Aiolin's request to train her.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Soon enough, they carried out the siege to Rubix's delving citadel , using the Shu-Torun Loyalist/Imperial Delving Fleet 's combat drills , with Velgor heading the first wave alongside the Astarte. However, he was betrayed by Silvar, and his drill was redirected into a lithoporoite seam, where they were surrounded by Rubix's elite forces. With their outbound communications jammed, Velgor left his troops as well as droid platoons to protect the drill and had the Astarte twins follow him as to use the enemy's lines to tell the rest of the assault fleet to resume the attack. On the way there, the twins attacked him, but Aiolin saw they could not win against Velgor and destroyed the pathway between them. She was then betrayed by her brother who pushed her into the lava and fled back to Silvar; Velgor then took the dying Aiolin out of the lava and had her reveal Silvar's deceit before finishing her off.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Velgor then returned to his forces, who had secured the enemy lines thanks to 0-0-0's stratagem, and was surprised to find that Triova' assault to the delving citadel was already underway. With no opposition, Velgor's combat drill resumed his way to citadel, and Velgor himself cut off Rubix's escape way. Triova soon went to their encounter and Rubix formally surrendered; she then had the baron executed, and appointed his daughter as his successor, thus ending the insurgency. Velgor then left the planet and informed the Emperor of Silvar's treachery, and the Emperor simply summoned him. He also received a message from Inspector Thanoth saying that he had located Vexa and that they needed to talk.

#### Hunt for Silvar

> " I often wondered whether what rose from our operating table was a machine or a man... Good to have an answer. " ―Silvar, to Xarn Velgor

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
> " I often wondered whether what rose from our operating table was a machine or a man... Good to have an answer. " ―Silvar, to Xarn Velgor

At the shipyards of Kuat , Velgor met with Mal aboard an unfinished Sovereign -class Star Dreadnought, the Sovereign . The Emperor explained that in order to save Velgor after Emberfall, he had to resort to scientists who were similar in philosophy to the Umbra, among them Silvar. Silvar eventually grew too powerful within the Varrix Initiative and so Mal was forced to make him overplay his hand. With the man a mere traitor, he could be purged. After the meeting, Velgor met with Thanoth on Anthan 13; the Inspector, aware of Velgor's real identity, revealed that he would support Velgor's treason against the Emperor and that he would reveal Vexa's location on the Cosmatanic Steppes . However, Thanoth understood that Velgor would not rest until he silenced a possible loose end, so he had elected to tell the Umbra Lord in person so Velgor would not waste time looking for him. When Thanoth revealed Vexa's location and thanked "Kael" for their work together, Velgor killed him with his flux blade.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Outside and ignoring the droids' request to dispose of Thanoth's corpse, Velgor ordered 0-0-0 and VT-1, who were joined by Zazzik and his commando droids, to return Vexa to the Sovereign or kill her as their priority orders. Velgor also made it clear to wipe out anyone else they found at the Cosmatanic Steppes to eliminate all witnesses present, ensuring that, if Vexa had told anyone about her work with Velgor, they were silenced. Velgor then departed aboard his SKREE Advanced x1, with 0-0-0 realizing he would not be taking Silvar back alive, and returned to the Sovereign . Aboard, he confronted Professor Thlu-Ry , a colleague of Silvar's, whom he threatened to learn the traitor's location in the Crushank Nebulae . Velgor took the Reckoning to the nebulae, where his crew confirmed Silvar's whale fleet was present. After ordering that Thlu-Ry be thanked and then, for fraternizing with a traitor, executed, Velgor led the assault on Silvar's fleet from his SKREE Advanced. After Silvar's flagship fired an ion pulse to disable the Reckoning and moved to escape, Velgor fired into the whale ship and crashed into the opening he'd made, boarding the enemy ship just before it jumped to

title: Xarn Velgor
text: traitor, executed, Velgor led the assault on Silvar's fleet from his SKREE Advanced. After Silvar's flagship fired an ion pulse to disable the Reckoning and moved to escape, Velgor fired into the whale ship and crashed into the opening he'd made, boarding the enemy ship just before it jumped to hyperspace Moving past the personnel he'd left to be sucked into hyperspace and entering the labs, Velgor was confronted by Voidgazer, who pitted him against a cyberanimate rancor as a test of her technology just as Silvar's fleet arrived at Kuat. Although the creature gave him some difficulty, Velgor killed it by throwing his flux blade through its skull, severing the neural link, and turned one of Voidgazer's defense droids against her, fatally wounding her. As she lay dying, Voidgazer revealed that she had tampered with the Sovereign ' s systems to incapacitate the crew; Velgor finished her off and went to the empty bridge, which had been abandoned by Silvar and Morit as they had fled in the escape pods, to find that Silvar's flagship was to collide with the Sovereign . Before it did, he ejected and landed on the Sovereign ' s outer hull, where he soon encountered Morit. He easily killed him and then made his way to the Sovereign ' s bridge, where he confronted Silvar. The scientist simply disabled Velgor's cybernetics with a device he had kept for twenty years, forcing Velgor to kneel and drop his flux blade.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: While Velgor was incapacitated, he received visions of his duel with his former master, Orien Kade. This time, however, Kade threw him into the lava. Velgor then rose out of the river in his life suit and struck down his old master. However, like their duel on the Void Core, Kade's body disappeared. Velgor then encountered a vision of his younger self. The two versions of Drayden fought until Velgor came out victorious, throwing his counterpart in the lava. After his counterpart yelled that he hated him, the Dark Lord met a vision of his deceased wife, Lira Ondar. Velgor then found himself chained to the same table where he first received his suit. The vision of Lira pleaded with him, asking him to stay with her. Velgor, however, choked the illusion while at the same time regained control of his body. After he told the vision that her husband was dead, Velgor used his flux blade to impale Silvar, who was astounded that Velgor was moving while his suit was deactivated. Thus, Velgor had regained the ship from his control. The Dark Lord then informed his master of his success. The Emperor then ordered Velgor to finish his mission

title: Xarn Velgor
text: was dead, Velgor used his flux blade to impale Silvar, who was astounded that Velgor was moving while his suit was deactivated. Thus, Velgor had regained the ship from his control. The Dark Lord then informed his master of his success. The Emperor then ordered Velgor to finish his mission then return to him, stating there was much to discuss. Velgor took control of his SKREE Advanced, flying into Silvar's command ship. After cutting his way through Silvar's forces, the Dark Lord found his way to the doctor's replication room. After destroying Silvar's spare bodies, Velgor made it to the command bridge. Velgor then confronted the doctor one last time. He mind-tricked the whale-ship into flying into a nearby star, destroying Silvar once and for all. After returning to the Sovereign , Velgor met with his master, whom had been awaiting a full report, only to reveal it was no longer needed because Vexa was present: while 0-0-0 and VT-1 had successfully brought Vexa to the Sovereign and were planning on giving Velgor suggestions on how to kill the doctor, should they have found his planned execution too boring for their tastes, Vexa realized Velgor's priority order only mandated the droids bring her to the Sovereign . As she realized as such and was dragged away by two shock troopers to await Velgor's wrath, she gave a new priority order: help her escape. Reaching Mal's chamber, Vexa told Mal all of Velgor's secret missions and plans, although she did chose to leave out the details surrounding Joren Drayden.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Instead of being angry with Velgor, however, the Emperor was pleased with his apprentice's ability to operate in the shadows, stating he was everything he could have hoped for. The Emperor then left his apprentice to deal with Vexa as he pleased. Velgor then ordered Vexa to follow him. Despite her pleas for a quick death, he forced her out the airlock, although she secretly survived; having deduced Velgor would never honor her wish to avoid execution via airlock, she was rescued in time by Zazzik, 0-0-0, and VT-1. Making his way to the bridge, the Emperor informed him that Grand General Targ was to be demoted and that command of the Sovereign and the fleet would be transferred to Velgor, who Mal named supreme commander of the Imperial fleet . The Emperor then left his apprentice to "educate" his subordinates of this new era. Velgor then executed Targ and ordered Admiral Kendal Ozzel to have the ship ready in two weeks. Velgor then thought of his son, content that he would soon have him.

#### Slaying the unworthy

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Slaying the unworthy

After the insurgency began encroaching in the Mid Reach, The Emperor let Velgor loose, deciding that incompetence at the highest level was to blame for the the Void Core's destruction, allowing him to kill Imperial officials including Moff Coovern and Minister Khemt . At some point after the Sovereign became his flagship, Velgor summoned Lieutenant Sulaco to the bridge and ordered her to follow him to a hangar bay, where he ordered that she pilot his Vectis-class shuttle on a diplomatic mission to Sarjenn 3 , the third moon in the Sarjenn system and Sulaco's homeworld. The two Imperials landed at the moon's only port and proceeded to a nearby Insurgent outpost as Sulaco questioned their mission, claiming that Sarjenn 3 had no diplomats. Velgor was quickly ambushed by a sniper, whom he dispatched, before approaching the stronghold’s outermost wall, telekinetically relieving the Insurgents of their weapons, and slaughtering them. Proceeding inside, Velgor deflected a shot from a missile launcher, whose gunner he strangled and brought down a massive building with Synth Flux. Now at Sulaco’s house, Velgor identified the officer as an Insurgent spy. Coercing her into becoming a double agent, Velgor ordered her to say what she had to before departing, indicating that they had work ahead.

Keeping an eye on loose ends

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Three years after the Battle of Cinderfall, Velgor was still in command of the Sovereign , under the admiralty of Ozzel, and Death Squadron. At Velgor's request, Lieutenant Commander Ciena Ree was transferred from the Reckoning to the Sovereign ; Ree believed, however, that Velgor's request had been more threat than reward, as she remained forever vulnerable to him for seeing him during Cinderfall's immediate aftermath. Obsessed with finding Joren, Velgor dispatched thousands of Viper probe droids as Project Swarm into the far reaches of space in order to find the insurgent base and, by extension, his son. Amongst the project on the Sovereign were a number of archaeological consultants, who were brought in due to the insurgency's prior history of hiding in historical sites. The archaeological supervisor, Professor Rupo Ud , secretly only saw the operation as a way to study historical sites and disliked the Umbra Lord, but he knew to stay quiet, having seen Velgor execute gifted individuals on little pretext. Imperial forces also found 0-0-0 and VT-1 on the Ring of Kafrene and installed restraining bolts on both, suppressing their memories and returning them to Velgor's service. Both were stationed on the Sovereign as interrogation specialists.

Velgor entered the base and soon ran into a group of Insurgents carrying their unconscious captain towards a hangar. They open fire, and Velgor deflected their shots before leaping and cutting down an Insurgent trooper named Beak . Another trooper, named Roja , threw a grenade at Velgor, who used Synth Flux to deflect it. It knocked out their sergeant, Hazram Namir , and Roja was killed soon after. The last Insurgent was the former Imperial governor of Haidoral Prime , Everi Chalis . She had been pursued by Imperial forces in the weeks following her defection and assumed Velgor was there for her. Velgor only asked her where Joren was, and when a trooper told him that they had located the Corsair Wing , he pushed her aside and marched in the direction of his target.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Only the Corsair Wing remained at the base's hangar, but the light freighter was able to escape before Velgor could capture it. With the Alliance's forces on Frostmark in complete retreat and the various transports scattered throughout the galaxy, Velgor and his troops had secured a great victory for the Imperium. Rather than pursuing the Insurgent transports which had gotten away, Velgor redirected his Death Squadron's efforts to capturing the Corsair Wing , which had evaded Imperial forces in the Frostmark asteroid belt due to its faulty hyperrelay. Despite Vett's reservations, Velgor ordered the fleet to pursue the ship into the asteroid field, and told the Sovereign ' s crew that he wanted the freighter towed aboard and its passengers taken alive. Even though the asteroids heavily damaged the Star Destroyers, Velgor instructed every ship to sweep the field until the Corsair was found.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Vett then informed him that the Emperor commanded him to make contact, and Velgor had the Sovereign move out of the field to have a clear transmission. Velgor contacted his master; the Emperor told him that he had sensed a new threat in Synth Flux: Joren Drayden, who he feared could destroy them if he ever became an Aetheri, and that he was Kael's son. Feigning shock at the Emperor's revelation, Velgor believed Joren could be turned to the umbra side and prove a powerful ally. Although the Emperor was doubtful, Velgor assured him that Joren would join them or die.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Determined to find his son before the Emperor, Velgor summoned several bounty hunters— 4-VOX , Boskan, Zuckusso , Dengrik, VX-88 , and Vex Vark—to the Sovereign , and promised a substantial reward for the one who found the Corsair ' s crew alive. As he was briefing the hunters , Vett informed Velgor that the Avenger was tracking the Corsair . Velgor requested an update from the ship's commander, Captain Lorth Needa , who reported that he had lost the Corsair and assumed full responsibility for this. Velgor accepted his apology with a fatal Synth Flux choke, and then ordered Vett to alert all commands of the Corsair ' s disappearance.

#### Aether Spire

> " Orien never told you what happened to your father. " " He told me enough! He told me you killed him! " " No. I am your father. " ―Xarn Velgor's revelation to Joren Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Aether Spire

> " Orien never told you what happened to your father. " " He told me enough! He told me you killed him! " " No. I am your father. " ―Xarn Velgor's revelation to Joren Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

As the Corsair traveled through realspace to try and repair its hyperrelay on Mistral , Vark tracked and predicted Karrick's movements, but also contacted Velgor, whose Sovereign reached Mistral before the freighter. Along with a strike team comprising only a few individuals, Velgor left the Sovereign for Aether Spire , leaving its crew to do nothing but wait hidden. At the city, Velgor contacted its Baron Administrator Dorian Quill , who happened to be Karrick's friend, to make a deal. Quill, whose tibanna mining operation was keen to evade Imperial attention, agreed to help him capture the ship in exchange for them leaving his people and his interests alone.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: When the Corsair arrived, Joren was not among them, but Velgor knew he could use his friends to lure his son to Mistral. Escorted by Vark, Velgor waited for Karrick, Solen, Brevok, and Quill. Whilst waiting in the Rinetta dining room , he was barged in upon by the Lepi smuggler Jaxxon T. Tumperakki , who quickly left after the Dark Lord and the smuggler stared at each other. A team of shock troopers was then dispatched to arrest Tumperakki. When the Insurgents arrived, Velgor had them surrounded by shock troopers, imprisoned—and, in the case of Captain Karrick, tortured. Much to Quill's displeasure, Velgor altered their deal, agreeing to let Vark take Karrick and collect Grukk's bounty on him. Afterward, he inspected one of the city's carbon-freezing chambers , and deemed it adequate if crude, to freeze Joren for his journey to the Emperor, but at the danger of it being fatal, he had the facility tested on Captain Karrick.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: On his orders, Karrick was frozen in carbonite ; as he survived, Velgor handed Karrick over to Vark and ordered Solen, Brevok, and Astra-9 taken to his ship, while he awaited Joren at the facility. Once his son was separated from Bolt-3 and made his way to the carbon-freezing chamber, Velgor appeared before him, and the two dueled . Joren held his own for much of the duel, but he was ultimately no match for Velgor: as they moved to a reactor shaft and a catwalk, Joren managed to cut Velgor's shoulder, only for Velgor to slice off his right hand, which along with his old flux blade fell through the shaft.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor beckoned Joren to join him in the umbra side, but Joren vehemently refused. Velgor then told Joren that Kade had hidden from him the truth about his father, Kael Drayden, before revealing that he was, in fact, his father. Joren refused to believe the truth, but Velgor continued to tempt his weakened son, offering Joren the chance to destroy the Emperor and "bring order to the galaxy," just as he tried to do with Lira on Emberfall. He even pleaded with his son to come with him. In Velgor's ideal world, his son would have taken his hand, accepting him as his father. However, Drayden instead chose to throw himself into the shaft, possibly facing death to avoid joining Velgor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
While Joren was rescued by his friends on the Corsair Wing , Velgor returned to the Sovereign . As the freighter was unable to escape due to its deactivated hyperrelay, Velgor and Vett waited for the Corsair to enter tractor-beam range. During the pursuit, Velgor reached out to Joren through Synth Flux, telling him it was his destiny to come with him, calling him "son." Yet, the Corsair made the jump into hyperspace, thanks to Bolt-3 reactivating the hyperrelay. Although Vett feared Velgor would kill him for his failure, Velgor merely turned away from the viewport, not in anger, but in sadness.

Upon learning that Velgor had allowed Vark to take the carbon frozen Karrick back to Grukk, IVB agent Andressa Divo was frustrated that the smuggler would not be brought to Imperial imprisonment, although she also decided she had no position to question Velgor's orders.

#### Search for answers

> " You served Lira. You want revenge as well. But you fear me. Good. Let that fear guide you. I will always triumph. And if you serve me, so will you. Together, we can find them. " ―Xarn Velgor, to Sable

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Search for answers

> " You served Lira. You want revenge as well. But you fear me. Good. Let that fear guide you. I will always triumph. And if you serve me, so will you. Together, we can find them. " ―Xarn Velgor, to Sable

Following the Corsair ' s escape, Velgor took a shuttle with several death troopers and a forensics droid named ZEV-6-7 with him on a mission to learn who had hidden his son from him. After modifying ZED's motivator, he took the shuttle to Dunemere. There, he met with Lieutenant Ardo Banch and his shock troopers. Velgor went on to the Havel Moisture Farm to search for clues about Drayden's early life. Velgor also reminisced about the attempted rescue of his mother and her funeral. Velgor was informed by Lieutenant Banch of several transmissions, but came under attack by gangsters who wanted his shuttle. Velgor and his death troopers killed the gangsters before he took his shuttle to Vantor and returned to Ondar's apartment. There, ZEV-6-7 discovered that someone had planted a scout transmitter , which led to Vendaxa .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: At some point, Velgor also returned to the Imperial Palace and met with Mal, who ordered him to hunt down the remnants of the Insurgent fleet while it was scattered, believing he may be the only officer in the Imperium who could lead such a hunt despite it interrupting his quest to find his son. Unwilling to abandon that search, Velgor instead proposed they give the mission to Varrix's protégé, Ellian Zahra . Contacting her via hologram, Velgor granted her permission to return to active duty to try and redeem herself for a past failure under Varrix, making it clear she had no room to fail him and the Emperor. Shortly after the Corsair ' s escape and its vital role in the Battle at Rendezvous Point Delta-Three , Velgor chastised Zahra for attempting to destroy the vessel during the engagement, stating that while Elira Solen would be an acceptable casualty, another passenger was of value to him. Velgor further threatened consequence to Zahra should she report further of "partial success" before dismissing her.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Before journeying to Vendaxa, the Umbra Lord traveled to a cantina and confronted a man who claimed to be his son Joren Drayden. Velgor quickly found that the man was a liar, telling him that it did not matter who the man was. Because by tomorrow, no one would remember that he ever lived. Velgor then killed the impostor and told the people who were about to hire him that he would let them live. That way, they would be witnesses for what the man had done. The Umbra then stated that whoever claimed the name of Joren Drayden would also claim the crimes he had committed against the Imperium. After leaving the cantina, Velgor admonished the Imperial officer who had given him the information on the alleged Joren Drayden, telling him his information was worthless and that he had simply wasted his time.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: When Joren Drayden met Verla on Serelia , she told him about Directive 66 and the Imperial Wardens, describing Velgor as pure, true evil. Shortly thereafter, she discovered through synth flux that Velgor was Joren's father, but Drayden proved to her he was not like his forebear. Before Velgor continued his personal mission, he felt through Synth Flux, during a conversation with Zahra, that the trap he had placed within an Aetheri outpost on Tempes had been activated. He ordered his pilot to set course for Tempes, but when he arrived there, he found nothing but the spirit of the Grand Warden, who had recently been defeated by Joren Drayden. When asked by the Grand Warden if he would ever be freed from Velgor's service, the Umbra Lord refused to do so, saying that the Warden was merely a tool for him. Velgor then abandoned his cursed servant, who was slowly engulfed by the ghostly flames around his body.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Upon arriving on Vendaxa, Velgor was confronted by " Lira Ondar ." Ondar, revealed to be former Ondara Royal Handmaiden Sable, was briefly choked by Velgor before they came under attack by several Vendaxan land squids . Together, they eliminated the squids, allowing Sable to give her slain soldiers a proper burial. Sable also revealed her true motives; to investigate the death of her former queen. Velgor agreed to assist her in her mission so long as she obeyed him. Following Sable's guidance, Velgor returned to the planet Ondara to retrieve security recordings stolen from Ondar's quarters on Vantor. Upon entering the Naberri Lake Retreat, they were met by Gregar Typho and Tonra , who agreed to help them retrieve the stolen recordings. Taking a submarine , the four of them left for the recordings' location, while Sable expressed regret at her inability to save either her queen or Kael Drayden's mother. After surviving an attack by a colo claw fish , they reached their destination and found the recordings, which showed Sable forming the Amidalans and swearing to find and destroy their queen's murderers. She then accused Velgor of murdering Ondar himself, to which Velgor said he did before attacking the Amidalans.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: However, the fight was quickly interrupted by a sando aqua monster , which attacked Velgor and allowed the Amidalans to escape. After slaying the monster along with his death troopers, Velgor found the rest of the Amidalans in the jungles of Ondara, where they were led into battle by Ric Olié. In the battle at Lira's tomb , Velgor and his death troopers eliminated most of the Amidalans and incapacitated Olié before moving onto their next destination: the Tomb of Lira Ondar . But before they could enter the tomb, they were surrounded by Sable and other members of Ondar's surviving handmaidens: Eirtaé , Rabé Tonsort , Saché , and Dormé . The handmaidens fought bravely, but were easily defeated by Velgor, who then opened the door to Ondar's tomb. In truth, the handmaidens had known they would be unable to defeat the Umbra Lord, but instead made sure Eirtaé could tap into his armor with her staff. Doing so got Eirtaé an incomplete set of code, which the handmaidens hoped would one day get them the Sovereign ' s self-destruct codes.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
In the meantime, unaware of Eirtaé's success and ignoring Sable's protests, Velgor proceeded into the tomb and allowed ZEV-6-7 to scan Ondar's sarcophagus. The droid then discovered a med implant , which he traced back to the asteroid field Polis Massa . Upon reaching the asteroid field, they entered the Polis Massa Base and uncovered data that Ondar had been flown to the base by Orien Kade in an effort to save her life. However, Velgor and his forces were then attacked once more by the Amidalans, whom he managed to defeat once and for all. Along with ZEV-6-7, Velgor entered the base's maternity ward and allowed the droid to access the memory bank of a damaged Chroon-Tan B-Machine . He then watched a recording of Ondar speaking with Kade in her final moments of life. When ZEV-6-7 commented that Kade must have been important to her, Velgor promptly destroyed the droid in one-thirtieth of a second. The recording then ended with Ondar stating that she knew there was still good in Velgor, leaving the Umbra to mull over his wife's last words.

#### Test on Emberfall

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Test on Emberfall

> " I have turned his pain into fear…and his fear into anger. But he has learned and forgotten these lessons before. So this time I will send him a reminder. Through Orrin of Bestoon…assassin of the Umbra…I will turn his anger back to fear…and his fear back to pain…as many times as it takes. " ―Vael Mal After learning of Velgor's personal mission, the Emperor summoned his apprentice to the Imperial Palace, where he sensed his apprentice was filled with mourning instead of hate. Intending to reteach him the umbra side, Mal began to torture him with Synth Flux lightning. Velgor fought back against his master, but was overwhelmed again by two Royal Guards led by Mazan Veldon. While Velgor did manage to choke the three of them with Synth Flux, he in turn was then choked by the Emperor, who mocked the Aetheri title of "Seeded One" before telling Velgor to forget everything from his past and ravaging his body, leaving him with only one of his hands intact. The Emperor then brought his apprentice to Emberfall and left him on the very shore where Kade left him at the end of their duel. The Emperor instructed Velgor to rebuild himself without using Synth Flux before leaving with Mazan Veldon.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Remembering how Kade had left him on the same shore and how he later cut the Aetheri Master down on the Void Core, then picturing Mal in Kade's place in the latter memory, Velgor resolved to crawl from the shore towards the facility where he murdered the Dissident leaders years before, remembering the time his master had sent him to the base to wipe out the Dissident leadership. Promising himself that he would bring suffering to the Emperor when he recovered and spotting a figure laughing at him in the distance, he entered the base and, after spotting the corpse of Nutis Gunray and remembering his actions against the Dissidents and Aetheri younglings alike, found a few mouse droids, which he rewired to weld old battle droid limbs to his body. However, he was then confronted by the figure he had seen: Orrin of Bestoon , an Umbra assassin sent by the Emperor to test his apprentice. With his new limbs, Velgor fought the assassin and bested him. He then demanded to know what his master's greater plan was before being interrupted by a distant voice. Velgor followed the voice into a cave, which Orrin trapped him inside of after

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
by the Emperor to test his apprentice. With his new limbs, Velgor fought the assassin and bested him. He then demanded to know what his master's greater plan was before being interrupted by a distant voice. Velgor followed the voice into a cave, which Orrin trapped him inside of after stealing his flux blade. As Velgor fought his way through the cave, the voice taunted him with riddles about what he wanted and who he truly was. Eventually, Velgor reached the source of the voice; an ancient being known as the Eye of Webbish Bog . Velgor demanded the answers to his questions about his master, to which the Eye granted him an Umbra wayfinder . After leaving the cave, Velgor came upon his old Aetheri interceptor, where he was then met by Orrin and his Droid Crush Pirates .

While fighting off the pirates, Velgor cornered Orrin and knocked him out before reclaiming his flux blade. He then finished off the pirates and used their parts to repair the damaged interceptor. Once the ship was repaired, Velgor used the now captured Orrin to access the wayfinder, which showed the way to a planet called Umbrale . With Orrin trapped in a escape pod beneath the ship, Velgor flew the interceptor away from Emberfall and used a hyperspace transport ring to journey toward his next destination.

#### Finding Umbrale

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Finding Umbrale

> " Unlimited power. Beyond anything you have ever experienced. All in my hands. You feel it burning your flesh and mind. Ready to incinerate you in an instant. And you know you cannot fight it. So how… how can you claim it? " ―Vael Mal, to Xarn Velgor After exiting hyperspace, Velgor and Orrin found themselves in the Red Honeycomb Zone as the Umbra attempted to locate Umbrale. However, they were then met by a massive, tentacled space-faring creature related to the Summa-verminoth . Before Velgor could react, he was attacked by a fleet of Star Destroyers led by Sly Moore and Admiral Corleque . Velgor fought against the fleet's SKREE fighters until he had an idea. Changing his course, he flew toward the massive creature and allowed the SKREE fighters to follow until they were crushed by the creature's tentacles. As Velgor flew past the creature, Moore warned him that it would break his mind. Ignoring the Umbaran's warning, he continued on until he and Orrin were both hit by mental attacks. Velgor experienced several traumatic visions from his past, which concluded with a vision of his son killing him in battle and taking his place by the Emperor's side.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Upon escaping the Red Nebula, Velgor finally reached the planet Umbrale, where he and Orrin promptly crashed. Breaking free from the wrecked interceptor, they were both met once again by the creature. But this time, however, Velgor did not run away. Disobeying his master's command, he reached out with the umbra side and used it to bring the creature down, thus allowing him and Orrin to continue on towards the Emperor's Umbra Citadel . Standing atop the creature, Velgor commanded his master to show himself. And once he did, Velgor rode the creature into battle. In turn, the Emperor summoned two crustaceous monsters to attack the creature, though they were both quickly crushed. When Velgor told his master that he was no longer his apprentice, the Emperor merely scoffed and reached out with Synth Flux himself, twisting and contorting the creature until it broke apart. Forced to return to ground level, Velgor followed the Emperor into the Citadel, where his greatest secrets lie in wait.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Once inside, Velgor was greeted by a menagerie of horrors forged by his master. All around him were large vats containing bioengineered organisms strong in the umbra side of Synth Flux. Along with these organisms were large Umbra statues, dozens of Tanker guards , Umbra cultists , and a jar containing a severed hand. Velgor was quickly attacked by the guards and cultists, but he managed to defeat them all before venturing further into the Citadel. Orrin caught up with Velgor and attempted to dissuade him, but the Umbra carried on until he reached a level beneath the Citadel. This level was lined with hundreds of Star Destroyers, each armed with a planet-destroying cannon . Showing no fear, Velgor continued on into a massive chamber, which held a dome filled with red light and piercing screams. As Orrin tried to dissuade him once more, the Umbra entered the dome and stepped into the burning light.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Within the dome was a subterranean mountain of Kyber crystal, bled red by the Umbra cultists who kept it in constant pain. The Emperor explained that he did this in order to power the cannons of his fleet. When the crystal was cut, it screamed in pain again and sent out a wave of power, knocking off Orrin's helmet and burning his unprotected eyes.
