Velgor suffered as well while his master mocked him for attempting to claim his power. The Emperor told his apprentice that if he chose to walk with him, he would never escape his pain. But only by walking with him would he be able to share his power. The Emperor then asked his apprentice if he had chosen, to which Xarn Velgor replied that Mal was his master. Even though he experienced a vision, in which Joren Drayden told him that he would, one day, kill the Emperor, Velgor had seen the power Mal commanded on Umbrale, so he fully decided to return to his master's service, departing Umbrale with Mal, Orrin, Mazan Veldon, and Sly Moore.

#### Hunting Joren Drayden

A new target

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Hunting Joren Drayden

A new target

> " You could still be strong, my son. I know there is power in you. But I have seen the true might and purpose of the Umbra. And there is no room for another. So this time…you will die. " ―Xarn Velgor Upon returning to Vantor, Velgor was brought to the very building where he had been transformed to undergo repairs. A medical droid told him to prepare for shutdown, but Velgor refused, choosing instead to remain conscious throughout the procedure. Once he was fully repaired, Velgor asked the Emperor his will, to which his master told him to decide that for himself. Velgor then called over Orrin, who had just been given a cybernetic visor so he could continue to see. With Orrin at his side, Velgor left Vantor in a Vectis-class shuttle and decided that he would hunt down and kill his son, believing that there was no place for him as an apprentice after the power he had seen on Umbrale. Truthfully, however, Velgor still wished Drayden had joined him on Aether Spire. Traveling to a remote outpost somewhere in the Outer Reach, Velgor and Orrin met with a Grak named Bokku . When Orrin asked for the whereabouts of Dax Karrick, Bokku reported that he had been stolen and assured the assassin that Grukk would recover him. However, Orrin then told Bokku that he would recover Karrick himself in exchange for power. Bokku then asked Orrin if he

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Grak named Bokku . When Orrin asked for the whereabouts of Dax Karrick, Bokku reported that he had been stolen and assured the assassin that Grukk would recover him. However, Orrin then told Bokku that he would recover Karrick himself in exchange for power. Bokku then asked Orrin if he served the Emperor, to which Orrin replied that they both served Velgor now. Velgor was then attacked by a group of Gamorrean guards, which the Umbra Lord slew with ease. Bokku quickly apologized for not recognizing Velgor and reiterated that he did not know where Karrick was. From this, Orrin determined that Grukk had likely hired someone to find Karrick and asked Bokku for their identity. Bokku expressed fear at the idea of betraying Grukk until Orrin pried into Bokku's willingness to take over the Grand Grak Council . Bokku then revealed that he had been tracking the hunters who had taken Grukk's bounty and that one crew of droids had gone in a different direction from the others. Bokku told Velgor the droids were deep in the heart of Grak Space and that it would be better to go in Bokku's barge so as not to scare them away. On their way to the droids' location, Bokku inquired as to his compensation for his assistance, to which Velgor assured him that he would be rewarded. Under the piloting of Bokku's nav droid Gak-Sixtoo , they arrived at Zee-Nine City Seven while Velgor and Orrin boarded their Vectis shuttle. But as they approached the city, their ship's engines were shut down, causing them

title: Xarn Velgor
text: for his assistance, to which Velgor assured him that he would be rewarded. Under the piloting of Bokku's nav droid Gak-Sixtoo , they arrived at Zee-Nine City Seven while Velgor and Orrin boarded their Vectis shuttle. But as they approached the city, their ship's engines were shut down, causing them to crash. After escaping the wreckage, Velgor and Orrin were confronted by the Droid Crush Pirates, who expressed shock at Orrin's service to Velgor. When Orrin claimed he had picked the winning side, the droid captain told him he had picked wrong as VX-88 revealed himself and fired upon both Orrin and Velgor. As Velgor deflected VX-88's attacks, the droid reminded his target that he had sustained damages while VX-88 himself had not. Velgor informed the droid that he had information he required and commanded him to lay down his weapons, to which VX-88 replied that Velgor would only access his information by downloading it from his severed head. Velgor went to attack VX-88, but the droid then took out a remote and used it to slice into Velgor's armor, taking control of the Umbra Lord. As VX-88 forced Velgor to hold his own blade to his head, Velgor demanded to know who had given the droid the code to breach his armor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
VX-88 responded that the terms of his employment prevented him from sharing that information. While the droid was distracted, Velgor used Synth Flux to take the device from him, allowing him to use it against his attacker. Velgor then forced VX-88 to hold his own volt pistol to his head and pull the trigger, incapacitating him. Velgor then continued his fight against the pirates until Bokku's barge fired upon him. Velgor blocked the blasts with his flux blade and redirected the energy at the pirates, knocking them back along with Orrin. As the pirates retreated, Velgor took VX-88's hand and used it to access a terminal he had been using earlier. Upon activating the terminal, Velgor and Orrin discovered various dead ends that the droid had been chasing, as well as the symbol of crime syndicate Carmine Dawn . After acquiring VX-88's information, Velgor returned to Bokku's barge and confronted him over his betrayal. When Velgor asked the Grak what he had learned, Bokku conceded that the Umbra Lord could not be defeated.

Pursuing Carmine Dawn

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Pursuing Carmine Dawn

> " What you see is what you get with Orrin of Bestoon. I'll always obey the most powerful. So as long as that's really you … " " Always. " ―Orrin and Xarn Velgor Investigating Carmine Dawn's involvement, Velgor sent Orrin to Arkanis to gather information on the syndicate. As Orrin prepared to sneak into a bar, Velgor told him to walk in the front door instead. After a brief scuffle, Orrin retrieved an invitation sent out by the syndicate and showed it to Velgor. He and Velgor then returned to Bokku's lair to interrogate him over the invitation. The Grak revealed that Carmine Dawn was holding an auction for Karrick and that Grukk would repurchase him. However, Velgor told Bokku that he would bid against Grukk and lose. This would humiliate him and make Grukk lose all fear of him, allowing Bokku to betray him. Once Bokku agreed, Velgor and Orrin returned to the Vectis-class shuttle and began to take off. But before they could leave the planet, Velgor grabbed Orrin and dropped him from the ship. Once Orrin hit the ground, Velgor ordered him to find out who else Bokku was working for. Later that night, Velgor observed as Orrin was offered a place in Carmine Dawn by a group of assassins. However, Orrin rejected their offer and managed to eliminate them.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor then approached Orrin, who quickly realized that Velgor already knew that Bokku was working with Carmine Dawn. He had only wished to test the Orrin's loyalty. As more assassins surrounded them, Orrin reaffirmed he would always obey Velgor as long as he remained the most powerful. Velgor assured Orrin that he always would be as the two of them set about eliminating the assassins. After discovering that Sly Moore had hired VX-88, Velgor and Orrin returned to Vantor to find her, her court and the rebuilt droid bounty hunter in Administrative Temple Garden 313A . As Velgor struck down VX-88 once more, Moore and her court fled into a nearby temple. As they attempted to escape into the streets, Velgor used Synth Flux to close the door in front of them. However, Moore then took out another remote and used it to freeze Velgor in his own armor, allowing her and her court to open fire on the Umbra Lord. But this did not last as Velgor overcame the Umbaran's control and struck down her entire court. Moore tried once more to take control of Velgor, but Orrin revealed that Velgor had fixed that vulnerability in his armor. Velgor

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
her and her court to open fire on the Umbra Lord. But this did not last as Velgor overcame the Umbaran's control and struck down her entire court. Moore tried once more to take control of Velgor, but Orrin revealed that Velgor had fixed that vulnerability in his armor. Velgor then knocked the remote out of Moore's hand and told her that she could not bend his will. Moore responded that she only wanted to see if Velgor was still plagued by fear, to which Velgor said that the only fear in that place was hers. Moore conceded that he could kill her effortlessly, but also pointed out that doing so would do nothing to save him from Joren Drayden. When Velgor asked the Umbaran what she knew of Drayden, she stated that the key to finding him, his friend Dax Karrick was currently being sold by Carmine Dawn. She also pointed out that if she secured Karrick for Velgor, then the Emperor would not learn of his plans. When Orrin asked Moore why Velgor should trust her, the Umbaran answered that she would be delighted to reunite Velgor with the only person who could kill him, to which Velgor agreed.

Auction for Dax Karrick

> " Who trained you? Who was your master? " " Someone who knew quite a bit about you, Lord Velgor. And your master as well. " ―Xarn Velgor and Lady Vessa duel aboard the Vermillion

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Auction for Dax Karrick

> " Who trained you? Who was your master? " " Someone who knew quite a bit about you, Lord Velgor. And your master as well. " ―Xarn Velgor and Lady Vessa duel aboard the Vermillion

Shortly after, Orrin and Sly Moore left with a few Imperial officers to attend the Auction for Dax Karrick . However, this was merely a ruse to humiliate the Umbaran in the Emperor's eyes. Amidst the bidding, Velgor himself arrived at the auction on Jekara along with a pair of death troopers. After cutting down a few Carmine Dawn guards, Velgor infiltrated the Vermillion just as Carmine Dawn's leader, Lady Vessa sold Karrick to Grukk the Grak. Velgor then declared that Karrick belonged to him. Velgor's presence sent Doctor Vexa, who had infiltrated the auction on behalf of the Targ Corporation with the smuggler Sana Starric , falling to the ground in a brief panic attack, but she managed to escape the room with Starric before the preoccupied Umbra Lord could spot her. After his attention was briefly diverted to the sounds of Vexa's panicked fall, he turned his attention back to his mission at hand.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As Velgor ordered the death troopers to transport Karrick to his flagship, Grukk pointed out that he had already laid claim to the smuggler. Moore attempted to explain the situation, but Velgor chastised her for her failure and warned her that the Emperor would hear of it. The Umbra Lord then told Grukk that he and everyone else within the Imperium belonged to the Emperor, to which Grukk feigned amusement. Velgor went on to point out that the Imperium could easily replace the Graks, while also pointing out the fear he could sense in Grukk and the rest of the attending Graks. When Bokku angrily interrupted, Velgor asked Grukk who he was, to which Grukk said that he was no one. Grukk then finally conceded and allowed Karrick to be taken with his compliments and regards to the Emperor. As Velgor approached Karrick, Lady Vessa informed him that she would not get in his way, but also still required the one million credits she was promised. When Velgor told her she was owed nothing, Vessa inquired if the Imperium was too poor or cheap to pay its debts. Out of patience, Velgor drew out his flux blade, to which Vessa

title: Xarn Velgor
text: not get in his way, but also still required the one million credits she was promised. When Velgor told her she was owed nothing, Vessa inquired if the Imperium was too poor or cheap to pay its debts. Out of patience, Velgor drew out his flux blade, to which Vessa bared her own pair of blades. As they dueled , Velgor recognized that she was no threat to him, yet nonetheless found her level of skill, which included knowledge of the Teräs Käsi fighting form, notable, and recognized Vessa's fighting style as that of his master's. When Velgor asked her who had trained her, Vessa only replied that she had been trained by someone who knew quite a bit about both Velgor and his master; in truth, she had been trained by Vreth as part of his revenge plot against the Umbra. Velgor then pointed out that she did not have Synth Flux and warned that her skill would not save her. After a brief struggle, Velgor pushed Vessa back with Synth Flux, knocking her into Karrick. Stating she would pay the price for her foolishness, he raised his flux blade and prepared to strike her down. But he was suddenly distracted the arrival of Joren Drayden, whose presence he sensed through Synth Flux.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
While Vessa retreated, Velgor was informed by General Romodi that Vett had established a secure channel to Drayden's starfighter. Accessing the channel, Velgor told Drayden he had Karrick in his possession. He then warned his son that if he did not come to him, then he would cut his friend in half. Drayden refused however, telling Velgor to come to him. Velgor conceded to this, ordering Romodi to bring Karrick aboard his Iron Cruiser and to prepare his fighter.

Chase above Jekara

> " I will leave you now, young Drayden. My goal here is complete. I sense your terror at the idea of facing me again. Your skill in Synth Flux does not matter. Only your fear . Because of it, you cannot threaten me, and you cannot threaten the Imperium. You are no Aetheri . " " That's true, Velgor. But the next time we meet…I will be. " ―Xarn Velgor and Joren Drayden

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After boarding his SKREE Advanced, Velgor took off in pursuit of his son. During the chase, Drayden used his Vector to kick up a wave of water, which instantly froze and collided with Velgor's fighter. Though Velgor crashed, he was able to lift his ship out of the water with Synth Flux and resume his pursuit. After freeing his Vector from a group of pirates, Velgor fired at Drayden, damaging one of his ship's stabilizers and causing him to crash back down onto the planet below. As Velgor closed in on Drayden, he was contacted by Sly Moore. When Velgor stated that he did not require her assistance, Moore informed him that she was not helping him. Velgor was then attacked by the Droid Crush Pirates, who landed on his ship and began to tear it apart.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: After causing some damage to the Umbra's fighter, the pirates fell onto Drayden's Vector and quickly repaired it for him, allowing him to take off from the planet. As Velgor continued his chase while fending off the pirates, he was informed by Orrin that the Graks were going after the Imperial shuttle transporting Karrick. Velgor was then contacted by Admiral Vett, who informed him of the Graks' attack on the Sovereign . However, Velgor chastised Vett for disturbing him, claiming that the activities of the Graks were irrelevant to him. He then warned Vett that if Karrick was not aboard his flagship by the time he returned, he would require an explanation in person. Later in the fight, Vett contacted Velgor again and told him that he had appraised the Emperor of the situation. Since the Emperor considered the Imperium's arrangement with the Graks to be valuable, he wished for it to be preserved by having Velgor eliminate the Grand Grak Council. Velgor conceded to the Emperor's wishes and abandoned his pursuit of Drayden, reminding his son that he was no Aetheri, though the boy then claimed that the next time they met, he would be.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Velgor then boarded the Grak Council's ship and summarily slaughtered them all, including Bokku. Before his death, Bokku revealed his allegiance to Carmine Dawn and had Gak-Sixtoo blow up their own ship in an attempt to kill Velgor, which the Umbra survived by using synth flux to rip apart the ship and use the metal pieces to form a large protective cocoon in which he was protected from the blast and then fell back down to Jekara. With the Grak Council eliminated, the Graks ceased their attack on the Sovereign while Vark reclaimed Karrick from the Imperium and delivered him to Grukk on Dunemere. Shortly after, Velgor was informed by Lieutenant Jyala Haydenn that Beilert Varrick —the very same bounty hunter who had previously tried to assassinate him and escaped his wrath —had infiltrated the Sovereign . Velgor found Varrick trying to escape on a ship and used Synth Flux to pull him from space, rendering him unconscious and taking him prisoner.

### Killing the Dawn

#### Hunting the new menace

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
### Killing the Dawn

#### Hunting the new menace

> " Carmine Dawn has barely shown its strength. To get this far, it must have agents at every level throughout the Imperium. Find these infiltrators, Lord Velgor…and show them who is stronger. " ―Vael Mal, to Xarn Velgor With the Graks dealt with, Velgor returned to the Sovereign to confront Sly Moore, who had been captured by Orrin during the battle for trying to help in Drayden's escape. When Moore revealed that the Emperor had wanted Drayden alive, Velgor revealed that the boy had fled from him, declaring that he was not who the Emperor believed he could be. When Moore pointed out that Drayden was still free and could still fight, the Umbra Lord choked her and stated that his hope would not be enough. Velgor was then contacted by Vael Mal, prompting him to release the Umbaran and kneel before him. After restating his loyalty to his master, Velgor was instructed by Mal to hunt down and eliminate Carmine Dawn's agents within the Imperium. Shortly after, Velgor was met on the Sovereign by Romodi, who presented him with all of the troops he would need to destroy Carmine Dawn. Velgor then instructed Orrin to meet with the Assassin's Guild and inform them that they would be serving him now.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: In secret, Orrin swore himself to Vessa's service after he arrived at the Assassin's Guild base, although the assassin would later claim he was acting as an Imperial double agent. Following Orrin's departure, Velgor had Varrick repaired and waited for him to awaken. Once he did, he was shocked to find himself restored to his former appearance. When Varrick asked Velgor what he had done to him, Velgor explained that he had had Varrick fixed since he would now be serving him. Varrick then realized that his heart was gone, to which the Umbra informed him that it had been removed and replaced with cybernetics, along with further upgrades to his body. Varrick attacked Velgor, but Velgor cut him in half before leaving him and telling a medical droid to put him back together. Once Varrick was repaired, Velgor, alongside Haydenn, informed him that he would be assassinating Carmine Dawn's agents within the Imperium. For if he did not, the Imperium would kill those he cared about.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
While he meditated aboard the Sovereign , Velgor was informed by Haydenn that Varrick had completed his first assignment in killing the alleged Carmine Dawn mole Tarl Sokoli . Velgor then revealed that there was no connection between Sokoli and Carmine Dawn. Sokoli had been publicly dissatisfied with the Imperium and Velgor had decided that killing someone from Varrick's childhood would be a good test for the bounty hunter. The Umbra then told Haydenn to alert Orrin that Varrick was ready to join them. Velgor also came to realize that Orrin had joined with Carmine Dawn but, deciding he could use it to his advantage in the hunt for the syndicate, kept his deduction a secret.

#### Confronting the Knights of Karrick

> " You…and your rabble…you are…the Knights of Karrick? Pathetic. " ―Xarn Velgor, to Karrick

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Confronting the Knights of Karrick

> " You…and your rabble…you are…the Knights of Karrick? Pathetic. " ―Xarn Velgor, to Karrick

Velgor learned that Zahra's campaign against the Insurgency ended in failure during the Battle of Panisia . Sometime after that engagement, Velgor investigated the assassination of the Emperor's Royal Guard on Vantor, which was secretly carried out in part by Orrin. During the investigation however, he was informed by Vainé that a band of thieves had infiltrated Fortress Velgor. The Dark Lord quickly returned to Emberfall and confronted the intruders in his castle; a group of umbra side marauders known as the Knights of Karrick , who were secretly working with Carmine Dawn. After Velgor killed one of them, Fyodor with a Synth Flux choke, their leader fought him with a flux blade while the rest of them retreated. The leader said he had taken the blade from his predecessor , from whom he also inherited his name; Karrick.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Velgor expressed pity for how far the Knights of Karrick had fallen before Karrick leapt from a window with a device known as the Screaming Key . As Karrick gloated below, Velgor used Synth Flux to pull the key back up toward his hand, prompting the knights to open fire on him. Karrick then pulled the key back down into his own hand before escaping with the knights on speeders. As the knights sped away, Velgor stepped outside to study the remains of his slaughtered troops.

#### Rooting out the Dawn

> " Carmine Dawn is just a symptom . I will destroy the disease . " ―Xarn Velgor

title: Xarn Velgor
text: While thinking in his mediation chamber, Velgor reflected on his promise to his son on Aether Spire that they would bring order to the galaxy. Velgor concluded that his master had only brought about chaos and decided to set out on a new quest to establish order, whether or not he had his son by his side. Resolving to destroy Carmine Dawn as the first step, Velgor left with Orrin to assist the Imperium in hunting down Dawn agents on various planets, including Vincorba and Calior . While on Vincorba, they fought alongside a group of mercenaries known as the Revengers . With Velgor's crew established, Orrin commented that they would serve well as expendable assets, to which Velgor reminded him that he was expendable as well. After finishing on Calior, Velgor, Orrin, and the Revengers rendezvoused with Varrick and a few other assassins on Laecor to continue their hunt. When Varrick asked Velgor why he was there instead of leading Dark Squadron , the Umbra Lord simply told him to do as he was told. As a squad of shock troopers attempted to move a group of civilians, the civilians refused to comply, prompting the shock troopers to fire

title: Xarn Velgor
text: When Varrick asked Velgor why he was there instead of leading Dark Squadron , the Umbra Lord simply told him to do as he was told. As a squad of shock troopers attempted to move a group of civilians, the civilians refused to comply, prompting the shock troopers to fire on them. However, Velgor then jumped in to deflect their volt pistol bolts and slaughter them. When Orrin showed confusion over his master's actions, Velgor revealed that the shock troopers served Carmine Dawn. As the group carried on, Velgor came upon a statue, which the locals said was of their village guardian who was killed fighting Carmine Dawn.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Upon locating more of the Dawn's agents, Orrin opted to use the Revengers as bait to lure them out of their stronghold. Velgor then used Synth Flux to grab Orrin and throw him toward the Revengers, using him as bait as well. As the agents surrounded them, Orrin requested that Velgor bomb the stronghold. But Velgor refused and instead mounted Gee-Ninety , balancing himself atop the droid as they rolled themselves to the stronghold's front entrance. Velgor then stormed the stronghold along with Orrin, who the Umbra stopped from killing all of the agents inside. When Orrin expressed more confusion, Velgor explained that Carmine Dawn was just a symptom and that he would destroy the disease. He then discovered a layout of every Dawn agent within the Imperium, which Orrin and Varrick noted went all the way to the top. Following this, Velgor and his followers returned to Vantor. Varrick, the assassins, and the Revengers left for the Zanchal Estate while Velgor and Orrin left for the Imperial Palace.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Upon entering the Palace, they struck down all of the Royal Guards and aides in the Emperor's throne room, except for Sly Moore. Unfazed by this, Mal pointed out Velgor should have kept one of them alive for questioning. When Velgor asked him if they were loyal, Mal said they were loyal to strength, which Velgor showed them. However, only one of them was Carmine Dawn, meaning that Velgor's list was flawed. When Mal questioned if his apprentice already knew that, Velgor hesitated before assuring his master that he would bring him order. Velgor and Orrin then left for the Zanchal Estate to confront Baron Espis Zanchal for his loyalty to the Dawn. Upon arriving, Velgor was thanked by a pair of hostages who the Revengers had rescued from the Baron. As he returned to his shuttle, Velgor informed Orrin that the list was a plant, which Velgor himself had deduced when Orrin could only confirm that half of the names on it were Carmine Dawn. Velgor told Orrin to find out what connected every other person on the list. That way, they would find out who planted it and why.

#### Hidden enemy

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Hidden enemy

> " Orrin of Bestoon. You spoke with Romodi …and then he attacked my soldiers …as if he knew they were coming. " " Uh…I did tell you…that he…he…Million hands, my ass! " ―Xarn Velgor reveals Orrin's betrayal

Later on the Sovereign , Velgor was informed by Orrin that Romodi and his soldiers were not Carmine Dawn after all. However, Orrin warned him that Romodi did not understand the Umbra and would come for Velgor someday. Stepping out of his chamber, Velgor asked Orrin what connected the false names on the list. Orrin revealed that they had all undertaken a mission for Romodi to execute the Amidalans on Ondara. Following this development, Velgor and his team of assassins traveled to Tranchar to capture and interrogate Lieutenant Grapa about the mission. After fighting their way through shock troopers and DT-series sentry droids , the assassins discovered civilians being tortured by the Imperials. Gee-Ninety broke from the mission to free the civilians, prompting Velgor to destroy the droid as punishment. Velgor went on to interrogate Grapa about her mission to kill the Amidalans.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
As she claimed to Velgor that they were all dead, Tanka blasted her in the head for revenge. Velgor then realized that the Imperials had known they were coming. When Velgor asked Varrick who had sent the droids, Varrick confirmed they were from Romodi's command. Velgor then remembered that Orrin had spoken with Romodi prior to their departure. When he confronted Orrin with that fact, Orrin tried to stammer out an explanation before giving up and running away while Varrick fired at him. After stealing a spare ship, Orrin escaped from Tranchar and eventually arrived on Ondara to meet with Sable. Velgor followed the assassin in his SKREE Advanced. As soon as Orrin stepped out of his ship, Velgor revealed himself and destroyed it with his SKREE. After landing in front of Orrin, Velgor revealed he had known of his allegiance to the Dawn and gave the assassin an out by commending him for leading him to Sable, which Orrin went along with and claimed was his plan all along. As Velgor confronted Sable, he took her Carmine Dawn badge from her and claimed that he was the Dawn.

#### Recruiting Sable

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Recruiting Sable

> " Does nothing scare you, handmaiden? " " Why should I be scared of Kael Drayden? " ―Xarn Velgor and Sable

Following this, Velgor took Orrin, Sable, and ZEV-6-7 to the carcass of the sando aqua monster he had slain. He then threw Orrin and Sable out of the shuttle and watched as they were attacked by a pack of ravenous creatures . Orrin attempted to assure Velgor of his loyalty, but Velgor silenced him and asked Sable why she believed in Carmine Dawn. As she defended herself, she said that she had merely infiltrated the syndicate. Orrin fought alongside her and claimed he had done the same for the Imperium. When Velgor asked Sable if she also intended to serve the Imperium, Sable said she did not as long as the Imperium served chaos. Sable went on to claim that she and Velgor wanted the same thing: order.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: To this, Velgor levitated the creatures with Synth Flux and told Sable that if she killed one monster, a thousand more would replace it. He then explained that one would have to either make the monsters agree or deal with them all. With that, Velgor threw the creatures at a group of long-necked beasts as they sprouted from the ground. Understanding Velgor's plan, Sable brought him to a Carmine Dawn outpost while Orrin returned to the Sovereign to speak with Romodi. Upon arriving at the outpost, Sable informed the Dawners there that they served Velgor now. To this, the Dawners attacked Velgor and were easily cut down by the Umbra Lord. Velgor then had Orrin use Varrick and the assassins as bait to draw the remaining Dawners and Romodi's forces to Oro Sankeria . As the Dawners and Imperials fought one another, they were suddenly wiped out by a pulse bomb, thus eliminating many of Velgor's enemies. Velgor informed Sable that Carmine Dawn and Romodi feared him now. When he asked Sable if she was scared, Sable asked him why she should be scared of his true self, Kael Drayden.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Velgor responded that Kael Drayden was dead. But Sable revealed that she had deduced Velgor's identity from his obsession with order, his investigation into Lira's death, and Lira's final words at Polis Massa. When Velgor drew his flux blade and asked Sable what she wanted, she claimed she wanted to help him achieve order. She went on to explain that when Drayden never returned to Dunemere to free his mother, she and Tonra secretly worked in her honor to free enslaved people and smuggle them from Dunemere to a colony on Gabredor III . Now, the colony was being exploited and neglected by the corrupt Governor Tauntaza , who was in league with Carmine Dawn. Sable told Velgor that if he helped her save the refugees, he would get the chance to destroy another Carmine Dawn cell and prove that Lira was right about him. To this, Velgor withdrew his flux blade and accepted Sable's proposal. He then warned her that she alone was responsible for where her path took her before they silently boarded the shuttle and left for Gabredor III.

#### Familiar faces

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Familiar faces

> " Your names? " " K-Kitster. " " «Wald.» " ―Xarn Velgor, Kitster Banai, and Wald

As they approached the planet, they were met by Tauntaza's flagship . When Velgor asked ZEV-6-7 if the ship's crew had detected them, the droid said they had not yet. Velgor then told him to take them to the planet's surface. Sable suggested summoning the Sovereign , but Velgor said they would first visit the colony to see if she was telling the truth. Once they landed at the colony, they stepped out of the ship as ZEV-6-7 introduced Velgor to the refugees and asked to see their protocol droid . Since their protocol droid had long broken down, ZEV-6-7 instead spoke with their astromech droid Em-Sevenbee . The droid and two of the refugees then confirmed Sable's story. The pair of refugees then showed off a terrestrial vehicle they had built, inspired by their earlier lives on Dunemere. When Velgor asked the refugees for their names, they introduced themselves as Kitster and Wald; Drayden's childhood friends.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: When Kitster asked Velgor if they could do anything for him, Velgor told them they could do nothing. He then sensed that the surrounding land was disturbed, to which ZEV-6-7 explained that it was currently suffering from drought. When another refugee claimed things would get better once the clouds came back, Velgor said they would only get worse as they were attacked by a pack of clawed beasts. While Velgor and Sable fought off the creatures, a few of them surrounded Kitster and Wald. Velgor then leapt in and cut them down, saving the refugees. Kitster thanked Velgor as the Umbra Lord silently walked away. Sable then asked Velgor if he had seen enough and told him it was time to take out Tauntaza. However, Velgor told Sable she was not ready, since the refugees had ignored her order to stay back and put themselves in danger. He then told her that if she wanted them to live, they would have to obey her. Afterwards, Velgor had Sable don a set of Imperial equipment and recruited her into the Imperial Military under the rank of Lieutenant Commander, granting her authority over all the forces he gathered.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: He then ordered an Imperial officer to open a channel to the Sovereign . When the officer reported that Tauntaza's ship was blocking their communications, Velgor ordered for his shuttle to be prepared. He and his team then traveled to the governor's facility and proceeded to fight their way towards the governor. After cutting down a few repurposed battle droids, Velgor was confronted by Tauntaza, who briefly subdued the Umbra Lord with a life-draining weapon. Velgor's team was then attacked by more battle droids and a few Carmine Dawn assassins. Once Velgor recovered, he Synth Flux-choked Orrin for allowing the governor to escape. Orrin explained that he was assisting Velgor, to which Velgor asked Orrin if he thought Tauntaza's weapon could destroy him. Sable then told Velgor that it might have, prompting Velgor to release Orrin and meet with one of the weapon's designers, Doctor Aira . Aira explained that the technology had been used to raze the planet Karolia and expressed remorse over not having known what the technology would be used for. As Sable reassured the rest of the regretful designers, Velgor seized Orrin's speeder and left to find the governor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Catching up to Tauntaza and her escorts, Velgor blocked a blast from one of her battle droids before reaching her at her escape ship. As the ship took off, Velgor used Synth Flux to hold it and destroy its interior controls. However, the ship's powerful engines ultimately allowed the governor to make her escape. Using a pair of Imperials as a diversion, Velgor boarded Tauntaza's flagship and fought off more battle droids and Imperials before confronting the one in charge. When Velgor asked where Tauntaza was, the Imperial claimed there had been a misunderstanding and recommended that the Umbra reconsider his "hostile stance". Velgor then had the ship's crew open a channel to his own ship and ordered Vett to lock onto the governor's flagship. After giving Vett the order to destroy the ship unless countermanded, Velgor asked the Imperial again for the governor's location. Upon learning the location, Velgor returned to his shuttle and flew toward the facility where she was hiding, only to be met by a sandstorm generated by the facility.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Despite the pilots' warnings, Velgor told them to continue approaching the facility while he held the ship together with Synth Flux. A lightning bolt then struck the ship, causing it to crash into the forest. Once Velgor stepped out of the wreckage, he was met by Orrin, who he asked for Sable's location. Orrin reported that the storm had taken her and a colonist claimed that the storm would kill them all. When Velgor asked the colonist if they had any ships, he said the only ship that had not been confiscated or destroyed was Kitster's racer. When the colonist said that only Kitster could drive it, Velgor said they would see as he approached the racer. ZEV-6-7 told Velgor that he could not trace Sable or the other colonists, to which Velgor told the droid he would command his assistance if he required it. Faced with numerous flashbacks to his past, Velgor then boarded the racer and sped off into the storm. While deflecting debris with his flux blade, Velgor located Kitster on the ground alongside a large tank. Landing next to him, Velgor asked Kitster where Sable was. Kitster explained that she was trapped beneath the tank and

title: Xarn Velgor
text: his past, Velgor then boarded the racer and sped off into the storm. While deflecting debris with his flux blade, Velgor located Kitster on the ground alongside a large tank. Landing next to him, Velgor asked Kitster where Sable was. Kitster explained that she was trapped beneath the tank and that he had been trying to move it. Once Velgor lifted the tank off of Sable, the three of them were overwhelmed by the surrounding storm. Velgor then contacted Vett and ordered him to have the Sovereign fire on his location. When Vett warned that would incinerate everyone and everything within range, Velgor choked him with Synth Flux, prompting him to open fire. The resulting bombardment destroyed the tank and dissipated the storm. After cutting himself out from the remains of the tank, Velgor took Sable from Kitster and carried her into the distance. Eventually, the three of them returned to the colonists and Velgor ordered Vett to open fire on Tauntaza's facility. However, the blasts were deflected by a shield, which ZEV-6-7 explained was drawing energy from the planet. Despite Orrin's doubts, Velgor remained certain the fortress possessed a weakness and, when ZEV-6-7 revealed that the facility's underside was unshielded, took Em-Sevenbee with him to the facility. While he defeated more monsters on his way there, Velgor placed his flux blade within the astromech's dome. Once they arrived at the facility, he had the droid fire the flux blade upwards into the unshielded underbelly. Velgor then used Synth Flux to guide the flux blade through the facility, disabling the weapon and carving an entrance for himself. With the shield down, Velgor entered the facility and struck down Tauntaza's soldiers.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: However, he was then met by Tauntaza herself, wearing a suit of powerful armor. Tauntaza used the suit's arm cannon to fire at Velgor. As he blocked the beam with his flux blade, Velgor told the governor she could not contain the power she was wielding. To this, Tauntaza accused Velgor of having no control over his own power before he destroyed her arm cannon. Tauntaza then flew away as the facility exploded, leaving Velgor severely injured without any power left in his suit. Sable soon found Velgor and begrudgingly restored his suit's power, allowing them to walk back to the colony. Once they returned, they learned from ZEV-6-7 that Tauntaza had been receiving her orders from the Emperor himself. When Velgor asked Sable why she was smiling, she said she now knew why she had saved him. Returning to his fortress, Velgor healed in his bacta tank, but broke it in anger upon remembering Sable's words about the good still in him.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Later, Velgor boarded the Sovereign and was met by Varrick, Haydenn, and the Revengers. Velgor chastised them for being early, to which Varrick demanded to know why they were there. Velgor then used Synth Flux to fix Varrick's collar, saying he expected those who served him to be held to a certain standard. Haydenn claimed that Varrick had the team operating at peak efficiency. To this, Velgor said they would get a chance to prove their loyalty and advised Varrick to channel his energies in a less self-destructive manner. When Varrick asked what their mission was, Vett explained that they had been selected to protect a medicine shipment to Bestine IV from Carmine Dawn. Velgor warned the mercenaries not to disappoint him as he would be watching before they left for their mission. Velgor then met with Sable and asked her about Tauntaza's location. When she said Orrin was searching for the governor, Velgor asked her what she advised they do. To this, Sable told Velgor he should do what he always did: directly confront the problem.

#### Return to Skako Minor

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Return to Skako Minor

> " Follow that speeder. Infiltrate their organization. Find Jul Tambra. I will take care of the rest. " ―Xarn Velgor, to Sable

Following Sable's counsel, Velgor and Sable arrived at the Imperial Palace on Vantor aboard a Vectis -class shuttle to confront Mal. As the two were unexpected, one of Mal's advisors tried to stop the Dark Lord, but Velgor only reacted by throwing the advisor against a wall before making his way into the Emperor's throne room. Although his two present Royal Guards pointed their Synth Flux pikes at Velgor, Mal reacted by calmly asking Velgor what his heart told him. Velgor proceeded to hold Sable in the air with Synth Flux as Mal laughed and claimed to her that she had only reminded Velgor, who was remembering moments of his past at the same time, of his weakness. Dropping her, Velgor refused to assist Sable as the Emperor had his Royal Guards attempt to destroy her. Once she outwitted them in combat, Mal killed the guards in anger and, seeing her worth as an agent, allowed Sable to continue working with Velgor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As they returned to their shuttle, Velgor and Sable were informed by ZEV-6-7 of their next mission. Jul Tambra , the grandson of Wat Tambra, was working to overthrow the pro-Imperial regime on Skako Minor through a nationalist uprising . According to Imperial intelligence, Tambra had also enlisted pirates to blockade the planet and stockpile technology to be used against the Imperium. As such, their mission was to end the Skakoan's uprising and restore Imperial control over Skako Minor. In truth, Tambra had known he would have to face Velgor as part of his crusade. Over the course of the last six years, the Skakoan had worked to collect and reassemble droids who had been killed by Velgor, thereby allowing him to analyze their databanks to study Velgor's moves. Amongst the droids he reassembled were B1 battle droids, B2 super battle droids, and Gee-Ninety. Tambra was very confident that he would be able to kill Velgor.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Upon reaching the planet, Velgor and Sable discovered a crashed commercial transport from Korrath . ZEV-6-7 explained that the ship had been boarded and those inside were killed by the planet's poisonous atmosphere. As they traversed the terrain, Velgor killed a pack of cliff worms , saving a group of pirates. When he noticed a pile of corpses on the ground, he struck down the pirates, while Sable hesitated and allowed one of them to escape. When Velgor asked her if the pirates deserved mercy, Sable admitted she didn't know who did anymore. Velgor reminded her that she was his shadow now and she said they would need one of the pirates alive in order to locate Tambra. To this, Velgor instructed Sable to follow the surviving pirate and find Tambra while he took care of the rest.

#### Confronting Varrick

> " Beilert Varrick…you have proven to be a disappointment. A betrayal that will not be tolerated. " ―Xarn Velgor

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Confronting Varrick

> " Beilert Varrick…you have proven to be a disappointment. A betrayal that will not be tolerated. " ―Xarn Velgor

Upon learning that Varrick had betrayed the Imperium, Velgor boarded the Righteous Fist and had Haydenn accompany him as he approached the surface of Bestine IV in his shuttle. Once they landed, Velgor and Haydenn confronted Varrick and the rest of the Edgehawk ' s crew. Drawing his flux blade, Velgor told Varrick that his desertion would not be tolerated. Charging into battle, Varrick told Velgor that he regretted ever serving the Imperium. As they fought, Velgor took note of Varrick's power, which he regarded as proof Varrick was a waste of potential. Once he was beaten into submission, Varrick said that the planet's people would still be free of the Imperium. However, Velgor revealed that Varrick had doomed them as his forces bombed the locals, as well as his troops.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Ignoring Varrick's chastisation of his lack of care for his own, Velgor prepared to strike Varrick down, but Haydenn insisted on finishing the job herself to make up for her previous failures, which Velgor allowed. Varrick tried to convince Haydenn to leave the Imperium with him, but Haydenn blasted him in the face and sent him falling over the edge of the cliff. Before leaving the planet, Velgor contacted Haydenn and ordered her to send in a group of Imperials to hunt Varrick down in case he survived. To accomplish this task, Velgor personally selected Inferno Squad .

#### Unmasking the Dawn

> " I did not train this woman. But perhaps…the one who trained her. If you had found this Vessa in a royal court, I would think Varek had a hand in this. But she wallows in the mud of the criminal syndicates, so the more likely answer is… " " Vreth . " ―Vael Mal and Xarn Velgor

title: Xarn Velgor
text: As Sable searched for Jul Tambra, Velgor was called to the Imperial Palace by Mal. Upon meeting with his master, Velgor was informed by Mal that the Umbra had an enemy, claiming that the recent attacks were part of a coordinated campaign of diversion. Mal then called in IVB Director Sliro Barsha to report on his current investigation. Barsha reported that his division within the IVB —the undercover criminal syndicate Zerek Besh —had learned of a rumor that the major crime syndicates were vying to obtain the Graks' long-standing arrangement with the Imperium. However, the rumor was coming from a single source: Carmine Dawn. As they walked through the Palace halls, Velgor agreed that Carmine Dawn had orchestrated the Syndicate War but pondered how deep its influence went.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Mal went on to state that they had orchestrated the other attacks as well, saying that Carmine Dawn had targeted the Umbra. He then asked Velgor about the syndicate's leader, Vessa, who Velgor fought and failed to acquire Karrick from. Velgor told Mal that while Vessa had not been a true threat to him, she was trained in Teräs Käsi and possessed a fighting style which reminded Velgor of his master's. From this, Mal and Velgor deduced that, since Vessa wallowed in the criminal underworld, she must have been trained by Vreth. Mal then concluded that Vreth must have trained Vessa to use her as an instrument of revenge and went on to ponder what else he had taught her. With the Umbra aware of Carmine Dawn's role in recent events, an alert was sent out the rest of the Imperial Military to track down the Vermillion , which made Vessa order her assets in the Imperium and other major factions to sow chaos across the galaxy to further distract the Umbra. With the Screaming Key they had stolen from Velgor, the Knights of Karrick, meanwhile, traveled to a location known as the umbra side hellscape , a location unknown

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Vessa order her assets in the Imperium and other major factions to sow chaos across the galaxy to further distract the Umbra. With the Screaming Key they had stolen from Velgor, the Knights of Karrick, meanwhile, traveled to a location known as the umbra side hellscape , a location unknown to Velgor and Mal, alongside " the Archivist " on orders from Vessa to retrieve an artifact known as the Fermata Vault . #### Dealing with Zerek Besh

After Director Barsha and Zerek Besh failed to bring in a single member of the Free Coalition, Velgor confronted him on the IVB space station Derosha Six . There Barsha tried to appeal to Velgor by announcing the successes of Zerek Besh, but Velgor countered that, because of the criminal syndicate's inability to bring in any insurgents, Zerek Besh and Barsha by extension were failures. Barsha continued to boast about the size of the network the IVB had created under Zerek Besh, and insulted Velgor about his and the Imperial army's failures on Frostmark. In his anger, Velgor destroyed a glass display behind him using synth flux, and surrounded Barsha in the shards. Forced to ground, Barsha pleaded with Velgor, saying that he was close. Velgor simply replied that he needed to find insurgents then.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Shortly after his departure, thiefs Kay and Riko Vess were able to steal access codes to Director Barsha's palace vault on Canto Bight . From there, Kay Vess' crew working under Barsha's brother Jaylen Vrax were able to steal a secret codex Barsha had that detailed sensitive information about almost all ranking Imperial officers. Vrax contacted Velgor and informed him of the database and his intentions to take control of Zerek Besh. They made a deal, in exchange for the codex and the coordinates to an Insurgent base on Akiva , Vrax would be given Zerek Besh. Later, Velgor ordered Barsha onto the bridge of the Revelator , where he condemned Barsha for letting such critical Imperial intelligence go. Velgor then looked to Vrax and said the Imperium had accepted his terms. He ended the call and gave up Barsha to the mercy of Vrax and his associates.

#### Finding the Fermata Vault

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor was amongst Mal's tools in the crusade to root out Dawn agents across the Imperium. During his effort to destroy the Dawn, Velgor bisected a traitorous shock trooper in an industrial environment. At one point, Velgor nevertheless returned to his castle on Emberfall, where he was called by the Eye of Webbish Bog. Upon entering the Eye's cave, the Eye showed Velgor a moment from the Replica Wars, where he, Zho, and their replicas had fought B1 battle droids, and glimpses of the future, including one of him being confronted by Ondar's surviving handmaidens. Velgor then realized that he had been lured there as a test before being attacked by Emberfallians. After killing them, Velgor claimed that the Eye had wasted his time with puzzles. To this, the Eye explained that the visions were warnings for the end of everything. When Velgor asked why he should care, the Eye reminded Velgor that he was a part of everything, but, if he refused to accept this, he could not be helped. Just as the Eye had shown him, Velgor, with his helmet slightly damaged, returned to his fortress and, after sensing a great disturbance in the umbra side, was contacted

title: Xarn Velgor
text: reminded Velgor that he was a part of everything, but, if he refused to accept this, he could not be helped. Just as the Eye had shown him, Velgor, with his helmet slightly damaged, returned to his fortress and, after sensing a great disturbance in the umbra side, was contacted by Mal to discuss the disturbance. Informed by Mal that Vessa claimed to possess the Fermata Vault, Velgor was ordered to find the artifact and kill anyone who knew of it. Mal also told Velgor about Vessa's central claim about the artifact: it contained an ancient Umbra Lord who was so powerful they had needed to be locked away. In truth, no such Umbra Lord existed; Vessa simply needed a claim that would draw both Umbra to the Cage, allowing her to lock them both into it and free the galaxy from their rule. Her initial effort to open the cage, however, had resulted in the Knights of Karrick abandoning Carmine Dawn out anger at being hurt in the attempt and out of fear of the ripple it sent out. Velgor made his way to the site of the disturbance, where he only found wreckage from the experiment. Although he was certain it was the origin of the disturbance, he deduced, due to a lack of bodies, that no Umbra Lord had been released. Velgor then returned to the Sovereign and reported his findings to Mal via its holoprojection chamber.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Velgor asked Mal if there truly was an ancient Umbra within the Cage, which Mal explained was possible: built by Vael Mornick himself, the Cage could imprison people and places outside of time and had never been used lightly. Mal further warned Velgor that, because of the urge within every Umbra to dominate others, the mere possibility was the greatest danger to everything they had built together. Amid their conversation, the two suddenly felt the Cage begin to open once more as the Archivist and her assistant, archaeologist Kho Phon Farrus , tried to use Ascendant -designed technology to focus nearby umbra side energy into it. Although Farrus shut off their technology as the Cage began to leach life energy from each of them, the experiment had carried on for long enough that Mal was able to track the disturbance to the planet they were on. With this, Mal sent Velgor to retrieve the Cage and destroy those present.

#### The Orphans

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### The Orphans

> " [Xarn Velgor] radiates a particular, dark energy. But he is also other, like whatever drives him is completely removed from motivations experienced by other beings. Do you know the feeling you get when you hear a story about an animal eating its own young? That's what being in Xarn Velgor's presence felt like to me. The first time I saw Xarn Velgor was when he came to kill me. He failed. I think that was rare for him. As a general rule, when Xarn Velgor tried to kill something…it died. " ―The Archivist Once the Sovereign arrived at the planet, Velgor, intending to handle the situation on his own, ordered Vett to prepare his Vectis -class T-4a shuttle and landed at the seemingly-deserted site with two shock troopers. In the vicinity of the artifact, where he could not single out the presence of the supposed ancient Umbra, Velgor sensed a great deal of umbra side power from the Fermata Vault. Velgor discovered the Archivist and Kho Phon Farrus trying to hide beneath the remains of their machine. In Velgor's presence, the Archivist found that the Umbra Lord radiated a dark energy. While Farrus, having been warned of Velgor by their rival Doctor Vexa, quickly surrendered, the Archivist refused, to which Velgor began to choke the agents with Synth Flux. However, he was interrupted by the arrival of Chanath Cha and her Orphans , consisting of Sear , Ladybright , and Imara Vex . When Cha asked Velgor if he remembered her, Velgor simply stated that he would kill her as he bared his flux blade.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Cha went on to introduce herself, explaining that Velgor had slaughtered her family and that she had spent every day since then plotting her revenge. Velgor quickly forgot her name once more before the Orphans attacked. After being electrocuted by Ladybright and burned by one of Cha's acid bombs, Velgor pushed the Orphans back and walked into the ocean to recover. Once he did, he returned to the shore and saw Ladybright, Vex, Pharrus and the Archivist fleeing for the Siroto . When Velgor mentioned Vessa's death to Cha and Sear, he sensed their confusion and lack of fear, indicating that Vessa was still alive. As he fought Cha and Sear, he chastised them for their arrogance and prepared to strike Cha down, only for Vex to snipe off one of his hands, prompting him to tip over the Siroto with Synth Flux and throw Vex into the forest. With Vex severely injured, Ladybright, Pharrus and the Archivist fled in the Siroto before returning to assist Cha and Sear. However, the Siroto then turned back around and left the planet, much to Cha's relief. With Sear and Vex defeated, Velgor twisted Cha's introduction of herself by re-introducing himself and stabbed

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Vex severely injured, Ladybright, Pharrus and the Archivist fled in the Siroto before returning to assist Cha and Sear. However, the Siroto then turned back around and left the planet, much to Cha's relief. With Sear and Vex defeated, Velgor twisted Cha's introduction of herself by re-introducing himself and stabbed her through the chest. With Cha dead, Velgor left the planet to find Vessa and reunited with his master. Both traveled a dark, smoky location, where Mal asked Velgor if he actually felt the presence of an ancient Umbra Lord in the Cage. With Velgor admitting he only felt intense umbra side power from it, he engaged Mal in a sparring duel, the first they had engaged in in some time, at his master's request, allowing Mal to explain how he would enforce the Rule of Two if another Umbra Lord indeed existed. After Mal pushed back Velgor with a final strike and declared the duel over, Velgor made one last rush at his master before stopping when his master repeated himself. Feeling they had no choice but to follow the ripple in Synth Flux caused by the next Cage opening, Mal took the moment to admit Vessa would be missed as he and Velgor looked across the location.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Vessa attempted to sure up her chances by reaching out the Knights of Karrick, reminding them that they had attacked Velgor's fortress and thus would be hunted by the Umbra if they did not help her destroy Velgor and Mal. Around the same time, the Everspark artificial intelligence, created thousands of years prior for use against the Umbra by the Ascendant cult, resolved to hunt down Velgor. The AI had taken over Doctor Vexa's body to carry out its mission, further collecting 0-0-0 and VT-1 to help in its quest. When Vexa used a virus she had installed into the two droids to regain control of her body, the Spark introduced, much to Vexa's horror, their Umbra hunting mission against Velgor. By possessing Vexa, it had access to her memories of Velgor and saw how she considered the Umbra Lord a monster, but the AI believed itself ready to take on the Umbra Lord and his master. Because Vexa had once outmaneuvered Velgor, the overconfident Spark thought itself skilled enough to engage him in one-on-one combat. In fact, Vessa contacted the Spark to request its help in destroying the Umbra.

#### Destroying the Dawn

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Destroying the Dawn

> " You wish to board the station, Lord Velgor. I sense your desire . To possibly meet an ancient Umbra, one so dangerous they were locked away in such a powerful prison as the Fermata Vault . To feel their power. To test yourself against it. And then… to destroy them. Or even… to be destroyed . I desire it too, Lord Velgor. But it is a foolish desire. And I am not a fool. " ―Vael Mal, to Xarn Velgor The Archivist moved the Fermata Vault and the equipment needed to finally open it to an ancient Amaxine Space Station in the Outer Reach, where the Cage could feed off the plant life and umbra side energy left behind by the ancient Drengir beings. Sensing the disturbance in Synth Flux caused by the opening of the Cage, Mal and Velgor, just as Mal said they would need to in the name of enforcing the Rule of Two, followed the disturbance aboard the Sovereign with a fleet of Star Destroyers at their back. The Umbra Lords and their forces reached the station shortly into the opening process. Overlooking the station from the Sovereign ' s bridge, Velgor found himself with overwhelming desire to board the station and meet the possible Umbra, hoping to test himself against that Umbra Lord's power no matter if he survived the encounter. Able to sense his apprentice's wish, Mal felt the same but declared it a foolish desire and ordered the Sovereign to destroy the station.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Before the Sovereign could fire, the warship's crew detected an entire enemy fleet emerging from hyperspace. While Velgor initially assumed it was the Free Coalition, synth flux was Vessa's secret Dawn Fleet , which targeted the Sovereign ' s long-range weapons, thereby forcing the Sovereign to divert power to its shield batteries and delay the Emperor's order to destroy the station. With his master unwilling to take any chances, Velgor boarded a Vectis -class T-4a shuttle with Mal and an escort of death troopers and Emperor's Royal Guards, flying through the space battle under the escort of crimson SKREE interceptors . As their troops engaged with Dawn soldiers who had set up a parameter in the hangar, Mal and Velgor disembarked from their shuttle into the station, which was filled with umbra side energy that Mal could tell was not all related to the Fermata Vault. Unsure of what they would find, the two Umbra Lords led the charge with the mission to totally destroy the Dawn.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Leading from the front, Velgor and Mal fought their way through the station. As the two Umbra could deflect volt pistol bolts with their flux blades, Dawn Squads Two and Three attempted to engage Mal and Velgor with electrified melee weapons, but both Umbra effortlessly fought through the guards. Still, Velgor toyed with one soldier until Mal ordered him to stop and simply kill them. As they journeyed closer to the Cage, they were confronted by the Everspark-possessed Vexa, who mocked the two Umbra. Velgor quickly deduced Vexa was under some kind of possession and stayed behind to deal with her while Mal carried on. Believing she could weaken him, the overconfident Spark engaged Velgor with the cortosis alloy-based Null Blade , which would temporarily shut down flux blades. To the Spark, the battle represented a chance to finally fulfill the dream of its long-dead creator, Miril , by destroying the Umbra Order, even if the battle proved too much for Vexa's body.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: The blades of Velgor and the possessed Vexa clashed several times, thereby shorting out the Umbra Lord's flux blade. While the Spark at that moment thought it was ready to destroy Velgor and jumped at him, Velgor effortlessly excised the Spark from Vexa's body with a Synth Flux push as a group of new arrivals watched: Vexa's former lover Sana Starric had gathered a crew of Vexa's friends and loved ones to rescue her from the Spark. Having abandoned the Dawn in fear after their run in with Velgor, Farrus was also among the group. Unknown to Velgor, who declared the Spark to be a weak enemy, he had effectively ended the dream of the Ascendant cult by defeating its main weapon without much effort. After a terrified Vexa awoke under Velgor and escaped as the opening Cage sent out a ripple, Velgor elected to return to his master's side rather than hunt down his former ally. With Velgor out of sight, the Spark attempted to possess Vexa once more, but the intervention of Farrus, Starric, and another one of Vexa's ex-lovers, Magna Tolvan, saved her.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Velgor took his place at an eager Mal's side as the Cage finally opened. However, only a small disc without any connection to Synth Flux fell out: inside, there had been no secret Umbra Lord after all, and Mal believed the disc was nothing important. Unknown to both, the disc was actually a droid locked away by the ancient Umbra. Watching from afar aboard each of their starships, the Archivist and Vessa remotely re-activated the Cage, encasing Velgor and Mal in a time-lock . Vessa intended to recover the Cage with the two Umbra trapped inside and throw their prison into a star. However, it was at that moment that cannon shots from beyond the space battle suddenly broke into the station and destroyed the Cage: while it remained physically together, the Cage's time-lock collapsed, freeing the two Umbra from its grasp but sending a Synth Flux Wave out across the galaxy. The cannon shots had come from the Night Buzzard , personal transport of the Knights of Karrick: although Karrick had watched Velgor and Mal fall victim to Vessa's plan from a distance, he believed Mal would ultimately find his way out of the Cage and thus believed the

title: Xarn Velgor
text: the galaxy. The cannon shots had come from the Night Buzzard , personal transport of the Knights of Karrick: although Karrick had watched Velgor and Mal fall victim to Vessa's plan from a distance, he believed Mal would ultimately find his way out of the Cage and thus believed the only way to save his crew was to align themselves with the Umbra. The wave sent out by the collapse of the Cage wiped out much of the Dawn Fleet, giving the Imperials a chance to wipe out the Dawn forces as the escaping Vessa gave a retreat order. As they collected the destroyed but intact Fermata Vault, Mal and Velgor sensed a great rending in Synth Flux sent out by its collapse, with Mal admitting it made his grasp on Synth Flux tenuous. Mal and Velgor then came face-to-face with the Knights of Karrick, who revealed themselves in return for mercy. Mal, however, responded with a blast of Synth Flux lightning to punish the Knights, promising that whatever was left of the group would be put to excellent use. Still, Mal declared the Knights' future a small matter and ordered Velgor to depart with him. In the aftermath of the Carmine Dawn war, the syndicate was shattered while the defeated Vessa fled into hiding. The effects of Synth Flux Wave varied at different times: Synth Flux-sensitives could find themselves with a limited connection to Synth Flux at one time but could wield great power when the Wave returned. Velgor came to fear the great energy provided by Synth Flux Wave because he

title: Xarn Velgor

into hiding. #### Reunion with the Handmaidens As Synth Flux Wave vanished for the time being, Velgor returned to the Sovereign and meditated, reflecting on Kade's words that only an Umbra dealt in absolutes and declaring that no one in the galaxy should forget his allegiance. Afterward, Velgor had Vett contact the recently-returned Orrin, who had returned to the Sovereign with Sable, to bring Sable into a room aboard the ship. Within, Velgor had also summoned Sable's recently assigned personal guards, shock troopers KA-336 and KV-222 ; both troopers had broken protocol by openly speaking about her classified assignment, with Velgor demanding the woman before him kill them both with a nearby E-11 volt rifle as punishment. In truth, Velgor suspected that the woman was not Sable, but another of Ondar's surviving handmaidens, and was testing that theory. Velgor also created a struggle when he urged the troopers to also run for the volt pistol. "Sable" grabbed it first and fired at them, injuring both but leaving them alive. This confirmed Velgor's suspicion that this was not Sable and instead another handmaiden, Dormé . Lifted into the air via a Synth Flux choke, Dormé claimed that Sable wouldn't have killed them, which Velgor declared meant Dormé did

title: Xarn Velgor
text: it first and fired at them, injuring both but leaving them alive. This confirmed Velgor's suspicion that this was not Sable and instead another handmaiden, Dormé . Lifted into the air via a Synth Flux choke, Dormé claimed that Sable wouldn't have killed them, which Velgor declared meant Dormé did not know Sable at all. Upon realizing that Orrin had helped her get inside as part of a scheme get rid of Sable, whom Orrin saw as a rival, Velgor threw Orrin into a wall and told Dormé that Sable served him willingly. Dormé denied Velgor's claim, saying Sable was the best of them. To this, Velgor brought her to a hangar and told her she should follow Sable's lead by claiming the same power. When Orrin advised against this, Velgor tossed him aside, saying he simply needed her to serve his purpose. Dormé stated once again that neither she nor Sable would serve Velgor. Velgor then said they would see before he took her aboard a Vectis -class T-4a shuttle and traveled to the planet Fedalle .

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Shortly after, Dormé's fellow handmaidens Eirtaé , Saché , and Rabé Tonsort arrived on the planet. When Dormé insisted they go after Sable instead, the handmaidens told her they wouldn't leave her as they engaged Velgor in combat. Despite their coordination, the handmaidens were subdued by Velgor, who gave them one final chance to join him. However, Saché revealed that Eirtaé had seized codes from Velgor's suit during the fight, allowing the handmaidens to complete Dormé's sabotage of the Sovereign . Before they could destroy Velgor's flagship, which would kill thousands in the name of rescuing Sable and defeating Velgor, Velgor declared they were just as bloodthirsty as he needed them to be to join him. However, he was contacted by Vett, who showed him a transmission from Tambra. After arriving on the planet Brentaal IV , Sable had confronted Tambra while he was helping out a village of exiled Skakoans, urging him not to go up against Velgor and declaring that the Umbra Lord had only grown more dangerous since her own failed efforts on Polis Massa. She was certain that Tambra's efforts against Velgor would fail and that the Umbra Lord would slaughter the hundreds of Skakoans on

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
Skakoans, urging him not to go up against Velgor and declaring that the Umbra Lord had only grown more dangerous since her own failed efforts on Polis Massa. She was certain that Tambra's efforts against Velgor would fail and that the Umbra Lord would slaughter the hundreds of Skakoans on Brentaal IV in retaliation. Unable to convince Tambra to call off his coming attack on the Skako Minor garrison , Sable shot him above his heart, keeping him alive but allowing her to take him away to a ship controlled by her and ZEV-6-7. Aboard, Tambra listened to her reasoning about the danger Velgor posed and declared that it was time to kill the Umbra Lord, capturing Sable after his rebuilt droids reached the starship. After showing Sable video footage of Velgor, Tambra sent his hologram to Velgor, in which he revealed her capture and baited him to come after him. While fully aware of the Umbra Lord's ruthlessness and not doubting Velgor's willingness to slaughter his refugee camp in retaliation, the Skakoan had come to believe that Sable was Velgor's weakness, which would finally give him an advantage over the Dark Lord. On Fedalle, realizing they would need Velgor and his forces to stage a daring rescue, the handmaidens reluctantly joined Velgor to go after Tambra, much to Orrin's annoyance. The group returned returned to the Sovereign aboard his Vectis shuttle and eventually left for Brentaal IV.

#### Corrupting Sable

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Corrupting Sable

> " The other handmaidens fled . But you are here . Stronger . And you will become stronger still . " " They only left … because I kept my secret . Your secret. If I'd told them what really happened… to Kael Drayden … they would never have escaped. I know… my sisters… will always think of me with grief … and they will always wonder what happened here… but they will go back to their lives … and their loves . This way… only one of us has to lose their soul . " ―Xarn Velgor and Sable after the fall of Jul Tambra

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Upon reaching Brentaal IV via a Vectis -class shuttle with the handmaidens and ZEV-6-7, Velgor reflected on his last meeting with Ondar on Emberfall and how he wished it had gone, privately declaring to himself he would finally have his idealized outcome. He also saw it as a way to have his idealized version of the duel on Mistral, privately comparing the situation to him reaching out to Joren Drayden. Entering a building on-world, Velgor and the handmaidens were met by Moore, who explained with Velgor how each of the handmaidens could benefit from serving the Imperium and the Umbra Lord. When none of the four agreed to his demands, he telekinetically threw all four outside through an opening created by Tambra's forces, who had tracked down the Umbra Lord and his reluctant allies, and forced them to fight the B1 battle droid horde alone. To Velgor, the battle was a chance for the handmaidens to earn their places at his side and show them their own power. Overlooking their victory, Velgor remained silent as Moore declared it an example of their skills, which she promised would only grow under Velgor's service.

title: Xarn Velgor
text: Shortly thereafter, Eirtaé discovered from one of the B1's memory banks that Tambra's command ship, in which she learned Sable was being held, was three klicks to the south of their position. However, Tambra, ignoring Sable's continued pleas that Velgor would wipe out his refugee camp if he continued, sent three platoons of B1s and a Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry to attack a civilian village , hoping it would trap his enemies into the village's canyon and let him escape with Sable. Both Velgor and Moore understood the attack was a trap, with Velgor declaring it an example of the weakness that the handmaidens would need to overcome. When the handmaidens demanded that Velgor assist them in aiding the populace, Velgor elected to use them as a distraction, effectively turning them into his pawns so he could get to and corrupt Sable, and teach them another lesson: as they fought the B1 horde, he could slip past the droids' lines, leaving the handmaidens to seize their true potential against a major enemy. Riding into battle on speeder bikes, Velgor cut down the gunship but left the handmaidens to the droids, cutting into Tambra's ship to save Sable and confront the

title: Xarn Velgor
text: the B1 horde, he could slip past the droids' lines, leaving the handmaidens to seize their true potential against a major enemy. Riding into battle on speeder bikes, Velgor cut down the gunship but left the handmaidens to the droids, cutting into Tambra's ship to save Sable and confront the revolutionary. Inside Tambra's ship, Velgor took position in front of Sable's cage but was met by the rebuilt Gee-Ninety, who fired upon the Dark Lord before releasing magnetic spheres. Having deduced that Velgor would attack with brute synth flux, Tambra and the droid had created the spheres specifically to immobilize him via electrocution. However, the handmaidens then arrived and used Eirtaé's own magnetic devices to synth flux down the spheres, although Tambra and Gee-Ninety managed to flee by detaching the room from the rest of the ship while Velgor recovered. The Umbra Lord maintained that he had not betrayed the handmaidens, instead declaring that he had granted them a chance to claim their true power, before Synth Flux choking Eirtaé and Dormé against the wall. Before leaving the room, Sable declared it meant she was the only one present who had to lose their soul by staying under his command. #### Vrak of the Umbra

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
#### Vrak of the Umbra

Upon assembling his army, Velgor returned to Emberfall with several of the droids, including ZEV-6-7, Arekso, and members of the Crush Pirates. Other droids from his new army were brought to the Sovereign for repairs. In his castle, he tested himself against a training droid and requested another when he destroyed it. He also tested his control over Synth Flux, but one of his attempts resulted in his power exploding out without control as soon as he tried. However, thanks to the Zaly Shield, Velgor was slowly but surely regaining control over his powers. Unknown to all, a new threat was emerging: when Velgor and Mal left the Amaxine Station, they left behind the disc dropped by the Fermata Vault, allowing the Everspark to flee into it. The merging of the Spark and the ancient droid created a new threat: the Vrak . The Vrak quickly corrupted the droids of Imperial I -class Iron Cruiser Chelator , which had been sent by Mal to collect everything from the station, and then spread across the galaxy by corrupting droids as the " vrak of the droids ."

title: Xarn Velgor
text: The Vrak soon set its sights on assimilating organics and controlling Synth Flux itself. Thus, it targeted Velgor, whose cyborg nature left him liable to the corruption, after Joren Drayden namedropped Velgor as a cyborg who could use Synth Flux to a Vrak-corrupted Astra-9. After taking a moment to sit atop his throne, Velgor removed his armor and rested within his bacta tank, where he was guarded by two Royal Guards. In secret, the Vrak, using information collected from Imperial databanks and from across its minds, infiltrated Fortress Velgor via a mouse droid that contained a spider-droid , with which the Vrak could spread itself, and infected several DT-series sentry droids stationed in the castle. As Velgor rested within his bacta tank, two DT-series units ambushed the Umbra Lord by murdering the guards and shattering the bacta tank, dragging the out-of-armor Umbra Lord across the floor via straps used to suspend him within the tank. While his control over Synth Flux was still lacking, Velgor tried to summon his nearby flux blade, which was instead caught by one of the DT units despite causing some minor damage to their back.

title: Xarn Velgor
text:
One of the DT droids then punched Velgor before both threw him against the wall. However, the Vrak suddenly had to refocus its conscious on the Chelator , which it had renamed ' Vrak 01 and turned into its command ship, upon realizing the vessel was under attack from the warrior-priest droid Ajax Sigma and his Second Revelation followers. With the droids before him distracted as the Vrak debated where to focus itself, an angered Velgor began to levitate with Synth Flux and stared down his attackers, crushing both with Synth Flux just as the Vrak totally refocused itself on fighting off Sigma's attack. Afterward, Velgor rested against the wall, only to snap to focus when the spider-droid jumped at him: after its victory over Sigma, the Vrak, which learned the secret to controlling organic life was turning its transmission into a heart-beat-like frequency, refocused itself on Velgor and attempted to infect him, but Velgor crushed the small spider-droid with Synth Flux, leaving him alone in the room with destroyed droids. While the Vrak had found cyborgs in the form of Magna Tolvan, Beilert Varrick, and Lobot , it continued to lust after Velgor, whose memories, knowledge, and sensitivity to Synth Flux made him especially valuable.
