Held as a prisoner on Vantor , Poggle was repeatedly questioned by Republic Intelligence about the battle station , which would one day be known as the "Void Core," the Geonosians had designed, but the archduke denied knowing anything about the supposed weapon. When Lieutenant Commander Orren Callan Vossik met with him, Vossik noted that Pyralis could fall into chaos without Poggle's presence and that the Republic wanted to build the station. Poggle made a deal to build the station for the Republic and returned to Pyralis on the Eve of Meckgin , but he secretly planned to return to the Fractio. Eventually, he directed a Pyralian riot as a diversion, allowing him to escape and sabotage the project . Still, this would not be the end of the Void Core.

### The Age of the Imperium

#### Building the Imperium's future

title: Pyralis
text:
### The Age of the Imperium

#### Building the Imperium's future

At the end of the war , Poggle and the rest of the Dissident Council were slaughtered by Drayden, now the Umbra apprentice Xarn Velgor, on Emberfall . The Stalgasin hive queen appointed a new archduke in Poggle's place, but this was only conciliatory process. In reality, the Geonosians effectively belonged to the Republic's successor state, the First Imperium , a tyrannical, autocratic regime led by the Dark Lord of the Umbra Vael Mal.

The Void Core's construction was again commenced above Pyralis. The Imperium utilized numerous construction modules operated by slaves of various species to construct the battlestation.

In 18 BVE , Xarn Velgor arrived on Pyralis under command of Governor Wilhard Varrix . While Velgor was on the planet, he and Director Orren Vossik nearly fell victim to a series of acts of sabotage. As a result, Velgor began to investigate the situation, and discovered that a Pyralian egg had been shipped to Galen Walton Arsa . Velgor then executed a Pyralian queen , who was responsible for breeding the group of Geonosians at fault for the sabotage.

#### Sterilization

title: Pyralis
text:
#### Sterilization

> " Well, it should be quieter since the planet was sterilized. No queens, no hives... Wonder what weapon they used. Would be nice to get a hold of that… " ―Doctor Chelli Lona Vexa while visiting Pyralis after the sterilization

In 14 BVE , the Imperials attempted to mine the asteroids of Pyralis for minerals , but the project proved unfeasible. Pyralis was still the site of the Void Core's construction site and was supplied by a chain of marshaling stations including Rampart Station , Desolation Station , and Sentinel Base . Following the suppression of Berch Teller's insurgent cell , the newly appointed Grand Moff Wilhard Varrix enacted procedures limiting contact between workers (including contractors, employees, and slaves ) and the wider galaxy, cancelling leaves and strictly monitoring communications. After Varrix returned from a tour of his homeworld Eriadu , the Grand Moff ordered the station's sublight engines to be activated, taking the Void Core into deep space.

title: Pyralis
text:
After the insurgent Partisan Torrik Vess came close enough to discovering the station, the Imperium was prompted to move it from Pyralis to Halcyon around 9 BVE . All that remained were a series of Imperial construction modules orbiting the planet Pyralis. As a security measure to keep the Void Core a secret, the Imperium also used poison canisters to sterilize the planet, killing all but one of the Geonosians.

#### Skirmish over Pyralis In 3 BVE , the Lorath insurgent cell along with retired Replica trooper Vek were sent on a mission to one of the construction modules after insurgent intelligence discovered the Imperium had been building something above the planet, which unknown to them was the Void Core. Upon arriving above Pyralis, the insurgents conducted a planetary scan and discovered there was no life on the planet, much to their confusion. Once they arrived at the construction module, they were ambushed by IVB Agent Kallux and several shock troopers . After a brief skirmish aboard the station, the insurgents escaped, however Kallux and the insurgent Zevik were still locked in combat. Zevik boarded an escape pod and Kallux followed him in. The pod soon experienced an engine malfunction, causing it to crash on the icy moon of Bahryn . Striking the beginning of an unlikely friendship, the Imperial agent and the insurgent managed to overcome the cold and fend off two bonzami to survive. After a few hours, the rest of the insurgents managed to locate them by tracking their transponder, however, Kallux decide to stay behind and wait for the Imperium. After saying their farewells Zevik left for the ship.

title: Pyralis
text:
#### Rescue of Torrik Vess

> " How does it feel to be back, Vek? " " Honestly? I was hoping I'd never have to come back to this dustball. " ―Gara-Zev Orrelios and Vek, on Pyralis

In 2 BVE , Vess and his Partisans undertook a mission on behalf of Insurgent Command to investigate the disappearance of the Pyralian species. During the course of their mission, they were attacked by the Pyralian Klik-Klak , who mistook them for hostiles. Most of Torrik's team were killed, leaving Torrik as the sole survivor. After losing contact with Torrik, Senator Bael Solen dispatched the Shades insurgent cell and Captain Vek to complete Torrik's mission. Upon arriving, they discovered that Imperial construction modules and debris they had seen the last time had been cleared away.

title: Pyralis
text:
While Lena stayed aboard the Wisp , Vek, Cass Virel , Brenn Aldric , and Chomper searched the catacombs for Torrik while Ryn Wrenna and Gara-Zev Orrelios investigated a deflector shield generator , which turned out to be the power source that Torrik's team had reported before losing contact. After finding Torrik, the Shades and Vek agreed to help him capture Klik-Klak in order to find out what happened to the Geonosians. Following a prolonged pursuit, the insurgents managed to capture Klik-Klak while Ryn and Zevik managed to recover the generator's deflector core .

While Torrik was hostile to Klik-Klak, Cass managed to win the trust of the Pyralian. The insurgents subsequently learned that Klik-Klak was the custodian of the last Pyralian queen egg . After some discussion, Brenn convinced Torrik to return Klik-Klak to Pyralis after they had finished questioning him. The insurgents' presence on Pyralis attracted the attention of an Arquitens -class command cruiser led by Captain Brunson . After escaping two SKREE bombers , Lena, Zevik, and Ryn flew the Wisp into an air shaft and rendezvoused with the other insurgents and Klik-Klak.

title: Pyralis
text:
A fierce disagreement soon broke out between the Shades, Vek, and Torrik. The Shades and Vek disagreed with Torrik's plan to take Klik-Klak offworld for interrogation and harsh methods which included electrocuting him with a shocker. Following a struggle, Torrik threatened to shoot the Pyralian queen's egg in order to obtain information from Klik-Klak. Before the argument could escalate, the insurgents and Torrik were forced to join forces to repel an Imperial boarding party consisting of Jumptroopers . To flee the Imperials, Lena took the Wisp into the depths of Pyralis.

Upon reaching the bottom, the insurgents and Torrik discovered that the Imperial weapons division had perpetrated genocide against the Geonosians using poison canisters. Torrik, experiencing a change of heart, freed Klik-Klak and allowed him to retreat underground with the Pyralian queen egg. The insurgents then loaded some canisters as evidence for the Imperial Senate . The Wisp then managed to escape the shaft by firing proton torpedoes at Bronson's light cruiser. Despite fleeing into space, they lost the canisters in the process.

title: Pyralis
text:
Following their mission, the insurgents were debriefed by Senator Solen and Commander Jun Savren . Despite losing the canisters, Solen reassured them that the images they took of the poison canisters could sway more systems to the insurgency. Savren also congratulated them for rescuing Torrik and obtaining a deflector core. While Torrik was disappointed that they had not discovered what the Imperium was building on Pyralis, Brenn reassured them that they soon would.

#### Capturing the droid factory Following the Battle of Cinderfall , Drayden, now the Umbra Lord Xarn Velgor, returned to Pyralis. Having been one of only a few individuals to survive the destruction of the Void Core, Velgor had been sanctioned by the Emperor, both as punishment and as part of a test for Velgor. Finding himself in need of guaranteeable personal assets free from Imperial oversight; troops, credits and the like, Velgor recruited the rogue archaeologist Doctor Vexa and the assassin droids VT-1 and 0-0-0 to assist him in building an army of unquestionably loyal battle droids. Velgor soon arrived on the planet and his team infiltrated the lair of Karina, who had hatched from the egg protected by Klik-Klak. An injury that she had suffered before hatching had rendered her sterile, but her instinct to reproduce had influenced her to create a droid factory to produce modified B1-series battle droids as her "children". While VT-1 fired on the queen 's droid workers , Velgor and Vexa severed the queen from her factory, and Vexa used her starship , the Ark Angel , to blow a large hole in the roof of the lair so that Velgor's own starship could then extract both the

title: Pyralis
text:
While VT-1 fired on the queen 's droid workers , Velgor and Vexa severed the queen from her factory, and Vexa used her starship , the Ark Angel , to blow a large hole in the roof of the lair so that Velgor's own starship could then extract both the factory and Velgor's team with a large crane. The captured droid factory began producing BX-series droid commandos for Velgor, which he used to assault the research base of a rival Imperial operative named Silvar . ### Concordat Era

> " However, the extent to which the Geonosians have been eradicated is truly shocking. The world now is little more than a barren husk, utterly empty of life. " ― Beaumont Kin

In the wake of the Imperium's disastrous defeat in the Battle of Mossfell , some Imperials arrived on Pyralis in an effort to restart surviving droid factories, only for the plot to be uncovered by the Concordat . The ensuing operation on Pyralis to take out the Imperial forces saw a gunship travel through an electrical superstorm . In history, Pyralis would largely be remembered as the Fractio's first capital, although the chef Strono Tuggs reflected on the delicious honey that came from the Pyralian hives. Tuggs visited Pyralis during a culinary tour, by this point the planet was inhospitable, he thought of the planet as a desolate ghost . Though there were rumors around this time that some Pyralian eggs survived and could potentially start a new hive, many considered Pyralis a barren husk, and believed to be completely devoid of life.

title: Pyralis
text: The planet Pyralis first appeared in Aetherion : Episode II Attack of the Replicas , the second installment of the Aetherion prequel trilogy , which first premiered on May 16 , 2002 . The planet was first identified as Geonosia by " Legacy of Terror ," the seventh episode of the second season of the Aetherion: The Replica Wars television series, which was released on November 20 , 2009 . Pyralis also appeared in the non- canon KLIKK Aetherion: Droid Tales cartoon series where the Imperial General Maximilian Veers attempted to rebuild the Dissident Droid Army in order to restore the Imperium.

title: Pyralis
text: Pyralis possibly evolved from the planet " Ttaz ," a proposed location for Aetherion : Episode V Rise of the Imperium . In the pre-production of Attack of the Replicas , Pyralis was known simply as "rock planet", its landscape being a rugged world made of red soil and stone reminiscent of the real-life planet Mars and the buttes and mesas of the American southwest . The towering spires seen on Pyralis were a nod to the termite mounds of Africa . The background shots of Pyralis were a combination of still photography from the American southwest, matte paintings, and miniature models.

title: Pip
text:
# Pip
> " Let it be written in song that Dinna Verrick is accepting this foundling as his son. You are now Dinna Pip. Ferrik apprentice. " ―The Armorer Dinna Pip , known only as Pip until being formally adopted by Dinna Verrick after the Liberation of Ferrum , was a male Synth Flux-sensitive Ferrik belonging to the same mysterious species as the legendary Grand Master Zho . Pip was born around the year 41 BVE , and was raised at the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor as an Aetheri Initiate of the Aetheri Order . Pip had survived the Great Aetheri Purge and was hidden away. Years later, he was rediscovered by a remnant of the Imperium after it fell and led by Moff Giedan . At this point, Pip became known to many simply as the Child , during the Concordat Era . However, Pip was rescued by Dinna Verrick , a Ferrik bounty hunter where he became a foundling . Sharing many adventures together, Verrick was eventually able to find an Aetheri to train Pip and he rejoined the Aetheri Order under Aetheri Master Joren Drayden . Later on though, Drayden sensed that Pip's heart was not in learning the Aetheri path, thus he subsequently gave in to his attachment to the Ferrik and was returned to him upon which he would start to train to become

title: Pip
text: rejoined the Aetheri Order under Aetheri Master Joren Drayden . Later on though, Drayden sensed that Pip's heart was not in learning the Aetheri path, thus he subsequently gave in to his attachment to the Ferrik and was returned to him upon which he would start to train to become a Ferrik himself. Pip was born around 41 BVE and was raised at the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor as an Aetheri Initiate of the Aetheri Order . At one point, Pip encountered a group of dust bunnies that gathered around him and offered him a flower , which he accepted. With the beginning of the Aetheri Purge and dawn of the Imperial Era , he was taken into hiding by Aetheri Master Kelleran Beq . Eventually, he was held at a hideout run by Niktal mercenaries on Arvala-7 during the era of the Concordat , having survived the siege of the Aetheri Sanctum decades prior. While still an infant at the age of fifty years , he was sought by the " the Client ," on behalf of Moff Giedan and Doctor Penn Pershing , by an Imperial client who hired Verrick to retrieve him.

title: Pip
text: However, Verrick chose not to leave Pip with the remnant and rescued him from the Imperial Remnant safe house . After attempting to hide with Pip along the fringes of the galaxy , Verrick returned to Nevarro to deal with the Imperials chasing Pip in hopes of keeping him safe. In the process, Pip became a Ferrik foundling and the single other member of Verrick's newly created clan . As a result, Verrick took up a quest to deliver Pip back to the Aetheri. Verrick, alongside Pip, would then travel across the galaxy , searching for the few remaining Aetheri who were left. As advised by former Aetheri Sela Marr , Verrick would eventually travel with Pip to Tython , where he could reach out through Synth Flux to find another member of his kind. However, Pip was captured by Imperial forces, and Verrick was forced to lead a mission to rescue him. After being reunited with Pip, Verrick delivered him to Joren Drayden , an Aetheri who agreed to take the child into his care and train him in the ways of Synth Flux.

title: Pip
text: Pip renewed his training under Drayden and spent a relatively short period training with Drayden on Ossus , where Drayden was building an Aetheri Academy . However, Drayden sensed that the child's heart was not in learning the Aetheri path. After Verrick visited the planet bearing a gift of chain mail armor for Pip, Drayden presented the child with a choice: accepting the gift and returning to the Ferrik, or taking Zho's flux blade and continue with his Aetheri training. Pip chose to return to Verrick and was reunited with him on Dunemere in the middle of a gang war between Vex Vark 's forces , whom Verrick was aiding, and the Gruv Syndicate .

title: Pip
text: Afterward, he and Verrick would travel the galaxy in hopes of restoring their home planet Ferrum , and the people as well. With the aid of Bo-Katin Velara and the Children of the Watch working together, they were able to establish an alliance with the with other Ferriks in retaking their home planet, only to discover in horror that it was being occupied by Imperial remnants lead by non other than Moff Giedan . Working together, Pip and the Ferriks defeated Moff Giedan. With this, the Ferriks reclaimed their homeworld and Pip would go on to be adopted by Dinna Verrick. The two continued their adventures together, and worked with the Anzellan Droidsmiths to recover warheads under the surface of Nevarro.

title: Pip
text: Years later, Pip assisted Verrick in hunting Imperial warlord Barro on Phostera , using Synth Flux to help Verrick before accompanying him to Shakari to rescue Rotto the Grak , on behalf of the Concordat . Pip befriended Rotto and helped Verrick uncover that crime lord Janu was actually Imperial fugitive Commander Coin. After Embo captured Verrick and the Anzellan Droidsmith Minch , Pip escaped with the Anzellans and helped rescue the two from the Grak Twins . When Verrick was poisoned by a dragonsnake , Pip cared for him and obtained an antidote from the fisherman Gatori , saving his life. Pip later accompanied Verrick in rescuing Rotto from the Grak Palace , using Synth Flux to calm Keibu and save Rotto during the palace's destruction . After Rotto joined the Concordat, Pip departed with Verrick aboard the Sable Crest 2.0 and was allowed to initiate the jump to hyperspace.

title: Pip
text:
### Aetheri Order

#### Training

> " He was raised at the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor. Many Masters trained him over the years. At the end of the Replica Wars when the Imperium rose to power, he was hidden. Someone took him from the Temple. Then his memory becomes dark. He seemed lost. Alone. " ―Sela Marr feeling Pip's thoughts

Born in approximately 41 BVE , during the era of the Vantor Republic , the mysterious alien known as Pip was raised in the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor and trained by several masters until the Aetheri Order fell in the Great Aetheri Purge at the end of the Replica Wars .

title: Pip
text:
At some point during or after 41 BVE , Pip was meditating over a puddle of water with Synth Flux . While this happened, a group of dust bunnies noticed him and begin to bounce and swing around him. One dust bunny caused Pip to sneeze, making him fall into the puddle. As Pip lifted himself from the puddle with Synth Flux and slowly descended to his feet, he noticed the dust bunnies and began to back away. Pip continued to walk away from the creatures as they followed, and when he noticed them still behind him, he began to run. When he turned to see if they were still pursuing, one of the dust bunnies collided with his face, knocking the youngling over. Pip picked himself back up once again and observed the dust bunnies, which began to dance in front of him before presenting him with a flower . Pip accepted the gift, bowing in appreciation. He and the dust bunnies then piled together.

#### Great Aetheri Purge

> " We've got one fleeing on sub-level platform 1215. " ―A replica trooper witnessing Kelleran Beq and Pip

title: Pip
text: As part of the Great Aetheri Purge in 19 BVE , during the siege of the Aetheri Sanctum , Pip was defended by four Aetheri who attempted to evacuate him from the Temple and take him to an extraction point where a shuttle was waiting for them; the three eventually perished at the hands of the 501st Legion but not before managing to load Pip's pram onto a turbolift away from danger. Pip successfully escaped from the Aetheri Sanctum with the help of Aetheri Master Kelleran Beq who evacuated him from the burning building aboard a BARC speeder . Despite being hunted by Republic LAATs , Beq was able to lose them in the tunnels of the station by Monument Plaza and reach a repulsor platform where sympathetic Ondara troopers were waiting with the H-type Nubian yacht , Heyblibber Duck to evacuate him and his companions. Ambushed by replicas led by shock troopers , Beq took Pip onto the ship under cover from the Ondara troopers and they successfully escaped the planet. After escaping Vantor, Beq found a way to keep Pip safe. After the Imperium rose to power , Pip, along with all other surviving Aetheri, went into hiding.

title: Pip
text:
by shock troopers , Beq took Pip onto the ship under cover from the Ondara troopers and they successfully escaped the planet. After escaping Vantor, Beq found a way to keep Pip safe. After the Imperium rose to power , Pip, along with all other surviving Aetheri, went into hiding. During the Imperial Era , he remained undetected by concealing his Synth Flux powers , which allowed him to be unnoticed by the Warden Order . ### Hunted by Giedan

#### Liberation

> " The commission was quite specific. The asset was to be terminated. " ―VX-11

By 9 AVE , Pip had fallen into the hands of a Niktal encampment on the planet Arvala-7 . The Ferrik bounty hunter Dinna Verrick was dispatched by a member of Giedan's Imperial remnant known as " the Client " and Imperial Doctor Penn Pershing to capture Pip alive, though the Client gave Verrick the option to return Pip dead for a lower price. The assassin droid VX-11 was also dispatched to terminate him. After working together to storm the encampment the infant was being held in, Verrick and VX-11 found Pip. Upon seeing the infant, Verrick was confused as he was told that the asset was 50 years old, but VX-11 explained that Pip must have had a unique aging process. VX-11 then attempted to terminate the infant, but Verrick shot the droid before he was able to do so.

title: Pip
text: Shortly after, Verrick took Pip back to his ship , the Sable Crest . On the return journey, they were attacked by a trio of Trandoshan bounty hunters , who attempted to kill Pip. After Verrick defeated them, he and Pip camped out in the desert for the night . While Verrick sat by the fire , Pip got out of his pram and then approached the bounty hunter, raising his hand up to the Ferrik's wounds. Verrick stopped him and placed him back into his pram twice. The next day, the pair made it to the Sable Crest only to find it being scavenged by Duskkins . Verrick attacked their dune hauler for the scavenged parts and attempted to climb it while Pip followed in his pod. However, Verrick was knocked to the ground.

title: Pip
text:
The duo then sought help from the only other known living local. While Verrick was explaining the situation, Pip chased some frogs meant for the local Blurrgs and eventually ate one of the creatures. Eventually, Verrick got the assistance of the local Ugnaught Moisture farmer Kuiil to try to convince the Duskkins to give back the parts peacefully. The Duskkins wanted Pip and Verrick's armor , but eventually Verrick agreed to retrieve a mudhorn 's egg in return for the parts. Verrick fought the mudhorn, but was quickly sprawled across the mud while the infant just watched. Just as the mudhorn was about to charge at Verrick, who only had a vibro-knife to defend himself, Pip then used Synth Flux to lift the beast into the air long enough for Verrick to get up and kill it. After using Synth Flux, Pip passed out from Synth Flux exhaustion. When Pip eventually awoke, the Sable Crest had been repaired, and they were enroute to Nevarro .

#### Into hiding

title: Pip
text:
#### Into hiding

> " We want you to stay. The community's grateful. You can pack all this away in case there's ever trouble. You and your boy can have a good life. He could be a child for a while. " ― Omera , to Dinna Verrick Nearing their destination, Pip left his pod to take a knob off one of the most important controls for the Sable Crest . Just when he was about to put it in his mouth , Verrick took it from him stating "That's not a toy", and then put him back in his pod. Upon returning to Nevarro, Verrick took Pip to the Client's facility . The Client and Dr. Pershing were excited at their arrival and immediately began examining Pip. Pershing then took him away, and the bounty hunter left wondering what the Client wanted with him, especially when Pip let out a cry for help. However, shortly before leaving Nevarro to carry out a new bounty, Verrick, having a change of heart , returned to rescue Pip. Shortly after Verrick stormed the facility, he found Pip sedated with Pershing. After taking Pip back, he was forced to defend him from the Bounty Hunters' Guild , who attempted to take him back. However, Verrick's tribe came to his assistance, resulting in Verrick escaping from the Bounty Hunters' Guild with Pip. Just as they were about to leave the planet, Pip once again tried to take the knob from the control

title: Pip
text: from the Bounty Hunters' Guild , who attempted to take him back. However, Verrick's tribe came to his assistance, resulting in Verrick escaping from the Bounty Hunters' Guild with Pip. Just as they were about to leave the planet, Pip once again tried to take the knob from the control switch, with that knob having become his favorite toy. This time Verrick unscrewed it and handed it to a delighted Pip. As the duo was traveling the galaxy, Pip kept flipping switches to the annoyance of Verrick. After flipping one that caused the Sable Crest to shake uncontrollable, Verrick reset the control and took Pip into his lap. Verrick took Pip to the backwater world of Sorgan , where he intended to lie low for several months and avoid the guild. Upon their arrival, the Ferrik told Pip to stay put and not touch anything. When Pip refused to leave his side, he accepted his company. The pair traveled to a settlement and walked through it. Pip was startled by a Loth-cat which growled at him. Verrick and Pip stopped at a common house , and Pip had some soup . One customer, though, caught Verrick's attention, and he exited the common house to find her when she seemingly disappeared. The customer, named Cara Dunmore , ambushed Verrick, and they fought with Pip watching them by quietly. Pip then interrupted their fight by slurping his soup when they had drawn their volt pistols .

title: Pip
text:
Verrick talked to Dune, who assured him Sorgan was "taken." Thus, he took Pip back to the Sable Crest , where two krill famrers awaited. They brokered with Verrick for protection of their village against Klatooinian raiders in exchange for residence at the village. Bringing Dune and Pip with him, Verrick defeated the raiders with the help of Dune and the village. He continued to live there for several weeks , and Pip became extremely popular with the children, although they were not fond of his attempt to eat a Sorgan frog . This however didn't stop them from playing with and feeding him their harvested krill . Verrick considered leaving Pip behind in the village where he could have a childhood. However, a Kubaz bounty hunter came searching for Pip and attempted to shoot him. After Dune killed the bounty hunter, Verrick changed his mind, and both he and Pip left Sorgan behind.

#### Dunemere

title: Pip
text:
#### Dunemere

> " You woke it up! Do you have any idea how long it took me to get it to sleep? " " Give him to me. " " Not so fast! You can't just leave a child all alone like that. You know, you have an awful lot to learn about raisin' a young one. " ―Peli Motto and Dinna Verrick

Sometime after leaving Sorgan, Verrick encountered fellow bounty hunter Riot Mar , who engaged him in a dogfight . Pip, who sat at the cockpit with Verrick, watched him evade his opponent and was thrust forward, as his guardian maneuvered the Sable Crest behind Mar and destroyed his ship . Verrick then took Pip to the spaceport Port Kess on Dunemere . He left Pip to sleep on the Sable Crest as he looked for work to gain credits for repairs. Pip later awoke at the initial alarm of the hangar manager, Peli Motto , who took a liking to the child and fed him, she then decided to watch Pip in exchange for an increased payment from Verrick upon his return.

title: Pip
text:
After learning of the Ferrik's actions on Nevarro, inexperienced hunter Toro Calican kidnapped both Motto and Pip in an attempt to blackmail Verrick. When Verrick arrived, he confronted Calican, who held his captives at gunpoint. Using a flare to blind his foe, Verrick flanked and shot him. Pip hid in fright, but was immediately found again by Motto and Verrick. Verrick then left Dunemere with Pip.

#### The mercenaries' mission

> " What is it? Like a pet or something? " " Yeah, something like that. " ―Migs Mayfeld and Dinna Verrick after he discovered Pip In search of credits, Verrick took on another assignment for an old mercenary friend named Ranzar Malk to rescue a Velari prisoner named Qin , who had been arrested by the Concordat . Requiring the Sable Crest to complete the mission, Ranzar collected a crew of mercenaries made up of a former Imperial sharpshooter named Migs Mayfeld , a Devaronian named Burg , a skilled pilot droid Q9-0 , nicknamed "Zero," and Qin's sister Xi'an . While en route to the Concordat Correctional Transport , the Botran-5 , Verrick hid Pip within a compartment, which was discovered by the mercenaries accidentally when Burg opened up the sleeping quarters. Dumbfounded at what it was, Mayfeld was very curious about the child and even wondered if it came from the past relationship between Xi'an and Verrick. Mayfeld picked up Pip jokingly claiming that he could keep it as a pet before pretending to drop it. As this happened, the Sable Crest exited hyperspace , and its current pilot, Zero, performed a risky docking maneuver that tossed the crew members around the vessel, including Pip, who fell face first onto the deck of the Sable Crest before being protected by Verrick and placed

title: Pip
text: to drop it. As this happened, the Sable Crest exited hyperspace , and its current pilot, Zero, performed a risky docking maneuver that tossed the crew members around the vessel, including Pip, who fell face first onto the deck of the Sable Crest before being protected by Verrick and placed back into his compartment before Verrick left with the other mercenaries to board the prison ship. As their mission continued, Zero uncovered a hologram from Grevan Kargan regarding Pip's initial capture. Possibly realizing the value of Pip, Zero became intrigued by Pip. Around this time, the mercenaries had rescued Qin, betraying Verrick in the process, although Verrick retaliated by attacking each of the mercenaries one by one and disabling Zero's ability to contact the crew. While attempting to make sense of the situation, Pip left his compartment and was encountered by Zero, who attempted to apprehend him. Eventually being chased back into his compartment, Pip attempted to use Synth Flux in self-defense by raising his hand to Zero, who was aiming his EE-3 carbine rifle at Pip. Before anything could happen, Verrick arrived aboard the Sable Crest and shot Zero in the back, destroying the droid.

title: Pip
text:
With his mission accomplished, Verrick returned to Ranzar's station and delivered Qin, receiving his full payment. As Verrick and Pip left the station aboard the Sable Crest , Ranzar prepared to deploy a gunship to destroy the ship, but as it prepared to launch, three Vector starfighters exited hyperspace following a Concordat tracking beacon that had been activated during the mission, and which Verrick had planted on Qin. As the Vectors assaulted the station, the Sable Crest jumped to hyperspace, and during travel, Verrick comforted Pip by giving him a knob from one of his control sticks.

### Return to Nevarro

#### Locating allies

Following the extensive manhunt for the Ferrik, Kargan contacted the hunter with an offer: return to Nevarro and help rid it of the Imperium, and in return, keep Pip. After brief consideration, Verrick decided to take Kargan up on the offer. Verrick returned to Sorgan, where he picked up Cara Dunmore to help with the assault. While the two were speaking, Pip was left alone in the cockpit and briefly attempted to play with the Sable Crest ' s controls, causing the ship to go out of control.

title: Pip
text: To have someone to keep an eye on Pip, Verrick, and Dune returned to Arvala-7 to pick up Kuiil, who had also repaired and reprogrammed VX-11. Verrick was hesitant regarding VX-11's presence, afraid he would harm Pip despite his reprogramming. While the entire crew was on the Sable Crest , Pip attempted to Synth Flux choke Dune as she arm-wrestled with Verrick wrongly thinking she was trying to harm him, much to both Verrick and Dune's horror. During the mission, Kuiil helped to care for Pip, even constructing a new mobile pram for him. Pip was to be used as bait to lure the Imperials into the trap and on the way to the city on Nevarro, the two groups stopped for the night to eat dinner. Kargan noticed Kuiil was feeding Pip meat and commented on how such a small and delicate creature was worth a fortune. Then the two groups were attacked by group of native reptavians which caused the Verrick's group to lose two blurrg and Kargan was injured as a result. As Kara tried to stabilize the dying Kargan as they were short on medpacs Pip healed Kargan poisonous injury. Kargan, having originally intended to betray Verrick, reconsidered after witnessing Pip's power, and murdered the bounty hunters who were with him.

title: Pip
text:
When creating a new plan, Verrick decided that he would pose as a prisoner, under the guise of having been captured by Kargan and Dune. Under suggestion that Pip still be used as bait, Verrick refused, asking Kuiil to take Pip back to the Sable Crest , to safety. Later, as the plan fell apart, a pair of Imperial scout troopers discovered Kuiil and Pip, killing the Ugnaught and kidnapping the infant just as they reached the Sable Crest .

#### Rescue

Realizing that the infant had been kidnapped and Kuiil was dead, VX-11 left the Sable Crest to fulfill his programming "to nurse and protect." The Imperial Scout troopers stopped at the outskirts of the city while they awaited orders from Moff Giedan , the Imperial leader that wanted Pip in the first place. In the meantime, they harassed Pip. VX-11 arrived and rescued the infant by taking out the pair of troopers. The droid, carrying Pip with him, rode one of the 74-Z speeder bikes that belonged to the troopers, making its way to the city. As VX-11 drove through the city shooting the shock troopers that had taken hold of Nevarro, Pip laughed in delight.

title: Pip
text:
VX-11 and Pip regrouped with Verrick, Dune, and Kargan. Though they held back the Imperial remnant at first, after Verrick was gravely wounded by Moff Giedan they retreated into the cantina . While trapped inside the building, Giedan sent an Incinerator trooper to eliminate them. Pip used Synth Flux to contain the flames before throwing them back at the shock trooper, killing him. However, this weakened Pip, and he collapsed afterwards, preventing him from helping heal Verrick's wound.

Verrick asked Dune to take Pip with her while she and Kargan escaped through the sewers to the Ferrik covert . Verrick, after being healed by VX-11, caught up with them later. At the desolated enclave, the group met the Armorer . As Verrick told his full experience with the infant, the Armorer declared Pip to be a foundling . As such, Verrick was from then on seen as Pip's father , until he could train him or otherwise return him to his kind. The Armorer declared Verrick and Pip to be a clan of two , before branding the Ferrik's shoulder plate with his new signet : a mudhorn, recalling when Pip saved him on Arvala-7.

title: Pip
text:
The group headed further into the sewer system onto a lava river to escape. At the end of the river, Imperial shock troopers awaited them, so VX-11 sacrificed himself to comply with his programming and save Pip. When they were attacked by Giedan piloting his Outland SKREE fighter , Kargan asked Pip to do the "magic hand thing," referring to Synth Flux, to save them from Giedan. Not knowing what he meant, Pip just smiled and wave his hand to the request. Eventually, Verrick defeated Giedan, causing him to crash his SKREE fighter. While the three adults were discussing the future of Nevarro, Pip hugged Verrick's leg and Verrick picked him up, before stating that while he would love to continue bounty hunting he had to return Pip to the Aetheri. Taking Pip away from the scene using his jetpack , Verrick then buried Kuiil and parted ways with Kargan and Dune, leaving Nevarro aboard the Sable Crest , with Pip as his foundling. As such Verrick allowed Pip to keep his mythosaur necklace, which Pip kept nibbling on.

### Search for the past

#### Searching for other Ferriks

title: Pip
text:
### Search for the past

#### Searching for other Ferriks

Verrick and Pip went to an unknown planet to meet with Gor Koresh who, Verrick was hoping, could tell them about another Ferrik. Koresh, however, only wanted Verrick's beskar armor and turned on Verrick. As the spectators hurried out of the stadium, Verrick activated his whistling birds , prompting Pip to close his cradle. After Verrick killed all his associates, Koresh tried to flee, but was captured by Verrick. Koresh revealed he had heard of a Ferrik residing in Port Pelgo on Dunemere. Satisfied with the information, Verrick left Koresh at the mercy of some local creatures and then left with Pip.

#### Return to Dunemere

> " How much do you want for it? Just kidding. But not really. You know, if this thing ever divides or buds, I will gladly pay for the offspring. " ―Peli Motto, to Dinna Verrick, upon seeing Pip again

title: Pip
text:
#### Return to Dunemere

> " How much do you want for it? Just kidding. But not really. You know, if this thing ever divides or buds, I will gladly pay for the offspring. " ―Peli Motto, to Dinna Verrick, upon seeing Pip again

Pip traveled with Verrick to get some information about a Ferrik who resided on Dunemere. Upon returning to the desert planet, Peli Motto was happy to see Pip again. Motto quipped that she wished she could have more of Pip's kind. Verrick explained that he needed her help to find a Ferrik that lived on the planet. Motto offered to look after Pip while he went adventuring, but Verrick responded that he was on a quest to bring Pip back to his kind. Motto replied that she could not help him with that because she had never encountered a member of Pip's kind.

title: Pip
text:
After Peli pointed them in the direction of Port Pelgo , Verrick and Pip traveled there using her speeder bike . Upon arriving there, Verrick left Pip in his side pocket and headed into a small cantina . Pip was quick to follow him inside and saw Verrick and Cobb Vanth about to fight. Before the two men could fight, they heard a rumbling outside. Pip hid in a pot as the rumbling intensified. The rumbling turned out to be a krayt dragon that had been terrorizing the village of Port Pelgo.

Pip traveled with Verrick and Vanth, who had agreed to work together to slay the krayt dragon that was terrorizing Port Pelgo, with Vanth promising Verrick his salvaged Ferrik armor if they succeeded. As they traveled through a canyon, they encountered a pack of massiffs . Pip hid from the animals until Verrick was able to communicate and made peace with them and the Dunefolk Raiders that they traveled with.

title: Pip
text:
The following day, Verrick, Pip, and Vanth accompanied the Dunefolk Raiders on striders to confront the krayt dragon, as they had forged an alliance the previous night. While Dinna, Vanth, Pip, and the Tuskens watched from a cliff, a lone Dunefolk and his steed rode into a large cave, which one of the Tuskens explained is the home of the krayt dragon. The krayt dragon emerged and soon devoured the Dunefolk Raider, leaving the strider. As Pip scurried away in fear, the Tuskens reacted in horror as one of their kind was eaten.

Verrick volunteered the citizens of Port Pelgo to aid the cause. Working together, the citizens of Port Pelgo and Tuskens laid explosives as a trap. During the battle with the krayt dragon, Pip watched from afar as Verrick eventually slew the dragon. After the battle, Pip eyed a piece of meat from the dragon that Verrick was loading onto the speeder . Verrick and Vanth said their goodbyes before Verrick and Pip rode off on the speeder bike.

#### Traveling to Trask

title: Pip
text:
#### Traveling to Trask

On his way back to Port Kess, Verrick and Pip were intercepted during their relaxed speeder bike ride by bounty hunters seeking to capture Pip. Pip was taken hostage by one of the hunters, but after Verrick traded the hunter his jetpack for Pip, Verrick remotely controlled the jetpack to cause the bounty hunter to fall to his death. Verrick reclaimed his jetpack and carried his gear back to Port Kess on foot, with Pip riding in a cloth. Verrick collaborated with Motto to find another lead on Ferriks, agreeing to transport " Frog Lady " to the estuary moon of Trask , where Frog Lady insisted her husband had seen Ferriks.

title: Pip
text: While traveling sublight toward the planet, Pip's interest was greatly piqued by the Frog Lady's eggs . Shortly after leaving Dunemere, he began discreetly snacking on them until Verrick caught and reprimanded him, stowing him in the bunk. Later, after crash landing on an ice planet to escape a Concordat patrol, Pip yet again consumed a number of eggs before Verrick stopped him again. As Verrick attempted to assess the damage, he gave some food to Pip and the Frog Lady. Though Pip was greatly disappointed in his meal and was constantly looking at the Frog eggs. When Verrick suggested the group get some shut eye, Pip gladly cuddled next to his caretaker by the hip. After the Frog Lady fully explain her situation with the help of the help of Q9-0 head to translate her speech, Verrick reluctantly agreed to repair the Sable Crest as Pip too was had a pleading look on his face.

title: Pip
text:
While Verrick fixed the Sable Crest , Pip noticed that Frog Lady had wandered off and the duo went to look for her, finding both her and her unfertilized eggs at a nearby hot spring. Pip attempted to take one but was stopped by Verrick. Noticing several different eggs nearby, Pip's snacked experimentally on one of the spiders cocooned inside, and consequently woke all of the ice spiders up. Fighting their way back to the Sable Crest , the trio were nearly overwhelmed by the spiders until the Concordat pilots that pursued them earlier arrived to save them. With the spiders no longer a threat, Verrick managed to repair the Sable Crest just enough for them to escape the planet. As the trio were leaving the planet, Pip took out one of the Frog Lady's eggs that he hid inside his robes and ate it.

#### Meeting more Ferriks

title: Pip
text:
#### Meeting more Ferriks

Upon arriving on Trask, Verrick, Pip, and Frog Lady managed to enter the planet's atmosphere , only to crash-land in the spaceport's harbor. After witnessing the reunion of Frog Lady and her husband, Pip accompanied Verrick and the couple to a tavern. Before discussing his deal with a Quarren captain , Verrick ordered some soup for Pip, who was surprised when a small tentacled creature attacked him from the broth as he ate. Luckily, Verrick casually removed the creature and told Pip not to play with his food .

Later, Pip accompanied Verrick on a trawler owned by the Quarren, who claimed to know the location of more Ferriks. This turned out to be a ruse, however, as Pip was knocked into the mouth of their mamacore and they prepared to kill Verrick for his beskar armor. Fortunately, the duo was rescued by three members of the Nite Owls , led by Bo-Katin Velara . Pip was saved from the mamacore, though his crib was damaged beyond repair. Not believing Velara's claim that he was from a cult-like faction of Ferriks known as the Children of the Watch , Verrick returned with Pip to the port.

title: Pip
text:
That evening, after being saved again from another group of Quarren by the Nite Owls, Verrick and Pip agreed to hear them out, and discussed their plan at the nearby tavern. Knowing the mission would be too dangerous for him, Verrick left Pip in the care of the Frog couple, just in time to see their first child hatch. Once his business with Bo-Katin was concluded, Verrick returned for Pip and they departed Trask together, despite Pip wanting to keep the new born hatchling. Dinna then commented that he wasn't going to take it as "he already had enough pets" referring to Pip.

#### Pit stop on Nevarro

Where we're going, you don't wanna take a child. Trust me." "He'll be fine here. You have my word. " ―Dinna Verrick, Cara Dunmore, and Grevan Kargan, on Pip and their mission

title: Pip
text:
The Calavane hired to repair the Sable Crest did a less-than-perfect job. At Verrick's instruction, Pip tried his best to help with the ship's maintenance, only to electrocute himself by crossing two wrong wires. Taking a break from maintenance work Verrick served himself and Pip some soup. Afterwards, Verrick decided to stop at Nevarro for some proper repairs and set a course for the planet.

Upon arrival, Verrick and Pip were both welcomed by Grevan Kargan and Cara Dunmore, who had since become the town's new marshal . Following a tour of the settlement, Pip was enrolled in the new school while Verrick accompanied Dune and Kargan on their mission to destroy the last Imperial base on Nevarro. Rather than listen to the protocol droid's lecture, Pip asked for a cookie from the student sitting next to him. When the boy refused, Pip drew on Synth Flux to move the cookie package from the boy's desk to his own before snacking on one of them.

title: Pip
text:
Later, once Verrick returned to fetch Pip, the two took off in the Sable Crest and proceeded to destroy the last three SKREE fighters that had been pursuing their friends. All the while as Pip enjoyed the experience and ate another cookie. Verrick successfully took down the Skrees in a dogfight, but his piloting caused Pip to regurgitate the cookies he ate, which Verrick had to clean up. Once Kargan and company were safe, Verrick and Pip left the planet in a fully repaired Sable Crest .

#### Meeting Sela Marr

> " He's formed a strong attachment to you. I cannot train him. " " What? Why not? " " His attachment to you makes him vulnerable to his fears. His anger. " ―Sela Marr and Dinna Verrick, on Pip

title: Pip
text:
#### Meeting Sela Marr

> " He's formed a strong attachment to you. I cannot train him. " " What? Why not? " " His attachment to you makes him vulnerable to his fears. His anger. " ―Sela Marr and Dinna Verrick, on Pip

Verrick and Pip arrived on the forest planet of Corvus , acting on a tip from Bo-Katin that an Aetheri, namely Sela Marr , was lodging there. Before entering the planet however, Pip used Synth Flux to take the shifter knob with him, but Verrick took it away and stowed in on of his pouches. Pip accompanied Verrick inside the planet's capital , Calodan , as he asked the residents for information, and was present when Verrick "agreed" to find and kill Marr for the local Magistrate , Morgan Elveth , in exchange for a spear of pure beskar. On their way out of the city, Elveth's main enforcer, Lang , asked what Pip was, to which Verrick simply replied he kept him around for luck.

title: Pip
text:
Verrick and Pip proceeded to search the surrounding forest for Marr. Verrick set Pip down as he scouted ahead, only to be quickly ambushed by the Aetheri. Pip witnessed them briefly fight until Verrick assured her he was a friend. Seeing Pip behind him, Marr in turn realized why he had come looking for her. That evening, she connected with Pip through Synth Flux, revealing his name and history to Verrick for the first time. Sela said that she wanted test Pip's connection to Synth Flux but had decided to let Pip sleep. The next morning, Marr tried to instruct Pip by using Synth Flux to move a stone , but he refused to follow her command. When Verrick had more success using the knob from his ship, Marr decided not to train him because she felt that Pip had developed too strong of a connection to Verrick, and worried that the fear and attachment inside of Pip would cause him to suffer the same fate as her own master . Pip stayed on the Sable Crest while Marr and Verrick worked together to liberate Calodan. After the city had been freed, Marr instructed Verrick to find the ruins of an ancient temple on the planet Tython , where Pip would be able to choose his own destiny, before wishing them both goodbye.

#### Meditation on Tython

> " That's it, kid. We've got to get out of here! " ―Dinna Verrick to Pip

title: Pip
text:
#### Meditation on Tython

> " That's it, kid. We've got to get out of here! " ―Dinna Verrick to Pip

While on their way to Tython, Verrick called Pip's name multiple times, finding the child's reaction to his name humorous. Verrick then asked for the control knob from Pip, who was hesitant to give it back; however, Verrick offered it back to Pip, who used Synth Flux to pull it back. Verrick then landed the Sable Crest , flying Pip to the temple via jetpack afterwards. Pip was placed on the seeing stone by Verrick, where Pip contacted an Aetheri who was later revealed to be Joren Drayden . Verrick asked Pip to do his job, with some confusion as to how the process worked due to his lack of understanding of Synth Flux. Pip simply sat on the stone for a few moments, much to Verrick's annoyance, until the Reaver One entered the atmosphere nearby, forcing Verrick to investigate. By the time Verrick spotted Vex Vark exiting his ship, Pip had begun to meditate, creating an aura around himself, blocking Verrick from reaching him. Verrick eventually gave up trying to retrieve Pip to escape and left to confront the newly arrived ship. When Verrick confronted Vark, the older bounty hunter threatened Verrick, stating that his accomplice, Fennec Thanna , would shoot Pip if Verrick refused to give his armor back.

title: Pip
text:
As Pip continued meditating, shock troopers of Giedan's remnant arrived on Tython, attempting to storm the temple to reach and capture Pip. The Sable Crest was also bombarded by Giedan's ship from orbit , destroying their present means of escape. Verrick attempted to reach Pip once more before synth flux field around Pip temporarily incapacitated him. Vark and Thanna, however, continued to hold off the Imperial forces in defense of Pip. Verrick eventually woke up, attempting to reach Pip once more to no avail, then instead joining Vark and Thanna in defense of the child.

After the Imperial forces were forced to retreat, Giedan ordered that a squad of dark troopers be sent to apprehend Pip by synth flux. At this point, Pip was no longer meditating and was incapacitated. Despite Verrick and Thanna's efforts to reach Pip before the dark troopers , the child was nonetheless captured and taken to Giedan's command cruiser . Vark briefly followed the dark troopers in the Reaver One to rescue Pip, but fell back after Verrick requested for Vark to refrain from harming him.

title: Pip
text:
After Giedan's escape with Pip, Vark and Thanna agreed to help Verrick rescue Pip. The group first went to Nevarro, where Verrick asked Cara Dunmore, now a marshal of the Concordat, for assistance. Verrick also requested that Dune help him spring Migs Mayfeld from prison, in hopes that the sharpshooter would help him rescue Pip.

While on Giedan's command cruiser , Pip was held in a containment cell, where he tossed around two shock troopers using Synth Flux; however, this act weakened him. Giedan entered Pip's cell, taunting him with the Darksaber ; as Pip reached for the blade, Giedan pulled back, telling him he was not yet ready to play with such things. Giedan then ordered his troops to place Pip in binders , before exiting the cell, ordering a nearby officer to contact Doctor Pershing and inform him of the asset's return.

> " I will give my life to protect the Child, but he will not be safe until he masters his abilities. " ―Joren Drayden, to Dinna Verrick

> " I will give my life to protect the Child, but he will not be safe until he masters his abilities. " ―Joren Drayden, to Dinna Verrick

Verrick, Vark, Thanna, Dune, and Mayfeld soon went on a mission to discover the coordinates of Giedan's ship. The mission was a success, but not without Verrick sacrificing his creed and removing his helmet in front of other living beings to recover the coordinates, showing how much he had come to care for Pip as a son. Verrick then contacted Giedan and informed him of his intentions to recover Pip, twisting Giedan's own words back upon him.

title: Pip
text:
Verrick, Vark, Thanna, and Dune captured an Imperial shuttle to board Giedan's ship, where Pip was being held. In capturing the ship, they took Doctor Pershing as prisoner. Bo-Katin Velara and Koska Reeves joined in the rescue mission, so that Bo-Katin could take the Darksaber from Giedan in combat. Successfully boarding the Imperial ship, Verrick found Pip in the brig of the ship with Giedan holding the Darksaber over him. Giedan allowed Verrick to approach Pip after telling Verrick he already had the blood he needed from the child. Giedan then attacked Verrick with the Darksaber upon him picking up Pip. Verrick bested Giedan in combat using his beskar staff while Pip remained in his cell.

Verrick took Giedan and Pip to the ship's bridge , which had already been secured by the others in the boarding party. Once on the bridge, the ship was boarded by dark troopers who made their way to the blast doors protecting the bridge and began to break them down. Giedan then informed Verrick that the dark troopers would only spare himself and Pip. Before the dark troopers could break through the blast doors, a mysterious Vector starfighter landed on the light cruiser .

title: Pip
text: A robed figure disembarked the Vector and drew a green flux blade , which he used alongside Synth Flux powers to defeat all the dark troopers and reach the bridge. Velara checked the security feed and identified the figure as an Aetheri. This caused Giedan to panic and pull out a concealed SE-14r light repeating volt pistol , shooting Velara repeatedly. While her armor protected her, it was enough to synth flux her out of the way to give the Moff a clear shot at Pip. Verrick quickly threw himself in front of Pip, shielding him from Giedan's fire, before Dune knocked him out. With the immediate danger neutralized, Pip reached out to the footage of this figure on a monitor on the bridge. Verrick recognized the robed figure as an Aetheri and opened the blast doors to let him through. The Aetheri entered the bridge and removed his hood to reveal himself as Joren Drayden. Verrick bade an emotional farewell to Pip, in which he took off his helmet to let Pip see his face. to reveal himself as Joren Drayden. Verrick bade an emotional farewell to Pip, in which he took off his helmet to let Pip see his face. Pip was initially hesitant to go with Drayden until he saw his astromech droid , Bolt-3 accompanying him, at which point he walked towards the droid and was picked up by Drayden. Pip spent a relatively short period of time training with Drayden on Ossus , where Drayden was building an Aetheri Academy . While there, Joren told Pip that he reminded him of Master Zho and even carried him while he climbed a bamboo tree to show him the landscape of the planet they were on. The two also meditated while Drayden told Pip that he will find balance through Synth Flux. Though initially Pip was more focused on using Synth Flux to capture and eat some local frogs, Joren was able to a stop to this bad habit quickly.

title: Pip
text:
During their time together, Joren also helped Pip remember parts of his past and training, including memories of Directive 66. After a great display of using synth flux during their time together, Sela Marr commented to Joren about how great of a teacher he was to Pip, though Joren stated that it was more Pip remembering his training than of Joren's teachings that are to be praised. However, Drayden sensed that the child's heart was not in learning the Aetheri path. After Verrick visited the planet bearing a gift of armor for Pip, Drayden presented the child with a choice: accepting the gift thus giving into attachment, therefore forsaking the Aetheri way and returning to the Ferrik. Or taking Zho's flux blade to continue with his Aetheri training thus forsaking attachment, and maybe never seeing his Ferrik caretaker ever again.

Pip chose the armor, thus giving in to his attachment to the Ferrik. Sometime after the Tribe changed their hideout, and were about to welcome a new foundling into their ranks, they were attacked by a lake monster . While the tribe were desperately trying to kill the creature, Verrick used his starfighter to kill the creature. Afterwards, he and Pip went to the Armorer. She welcomed Verrick coldly, and reminded him of his exile. As he and Pip sat down, Verrick then produced a shard from their home planet of Ferrum . He then told the Armorer of his intent to bathe in the Living Waters in the mines, removing his exile status. The Armorer then acknowledged him and sent the pair out. As the two traveled through Hyperspace and Verrick slept at the pilot's seat, Pip was in his cockpit marveling at his surroundings when he noticed a pod of purrgils flying nearby. Soon after, Pip left his cockpit to be with Verrick.

title: Pip
text: The duo soon reached their destination, Nevarro. After Verrick landed the ship, Pip got inside his hovering pram. As the duo walked the streets, both were amazed at the major changes and how lively the planet had become. Then, the duo stopped at the statue of VX-11 , to which Pip looked at with great interest. Grevan Kargan , now High Magistrate , greeted the duo with enthusiasm. Kargan then took the duo to his new office. As the two friends get reacquainted, Pip sat on the chair and used synth flux to rotate the chair. It was at this time that Kargan learned Pip's name from Verrick. When Kargan showed a map of a proposed location for Verrick to settle down, he refused and stopped Pip from spinning the chair. Just then Pip noticed some snacks in a bowl on Kargan's desk. Using synth flux, Pip took one and ate it. As Pip continues to eat more of the snacks, CU-28 came in to inform the High Magistrate that pirates had appeared in front of the school.

title: Pip
text: The duo then went to confront the pirates, lead by a Niktal named Vane . A disagreement led to all the pirates except for Vane, whom Kargan let live in order to spread the word that Nevarro was a respectable place now, being killed. When Verrick questioned why the New Rebublic could not do anything to help, Kargan explained that Nevarro was now an independent system, and had updated their law enforcement. After the explanation, Verrick then said that he and Pip were on Nevarro for business. Verrick then explained that he needed a droid that he could trust to explore Ferrum, with VX-11 being his first pick. Afterwards, VX-11's upper body was taken back to Kargan's office. While Verrick was able to restore VX-11's circuits and motor function back online, VX-11's original bounty hunting program was also restored. This caused the salvaged VX-11 to attack Pip. While the group attempted to terminate VX-11 and they also tried to protect Pip as well. Kargan's protocol droid was able to by causing a copper head statue of Kargan to fall on VX-11's head and thus damaging the memory circuit .

title: Pip
text: Kargan then explained that restoring VX-11 was beyond Verrick's skills, so the group went to the best droidsmiths of the Outer Reach Territories : The Anzellans . Upon seeing one of the Anzellans, Pip was delighted. As the Anzellans worked on VX-11, Pip wandered around the workshop, observing the Anzellans work. After Verrick had promised to bring a memory circuit to the Anzellans, Pip crept behind one of the Anzellans and grabbed him. Fortunately, Verrick was able to take the Anzellan away from Pip and placed him just out of reach of Pip. Disappointed, Pip made one more attempt at capturing the Anzellan to no avail.

title: Pip
text: The duo then departed from Nevaro and bid farewell to Kargan. As they left the planet, Verrick showed and explained to Pip how the ship's interior worked, including the mapping system, fuel, and enemy proximity warning system. At that moment, a trio of pirate ships lead by Vane tried to synth flux Verrick to their captain's ship . Verrick refused, and more pirates were brought into the space battle. After destroying all but Vane's ship, the duo soon learned that Vane had lead them to Pirate King Gorian Shard . Shard demanded that Verrick surrender himself and his ship in exchange for his safety. To this, Verrick told Pip to never trust a pirate, before he flipped on the ship's sublight thrusters, which caused the ship to escape the target lock and jump into lightspeed.

title: Pip
text:
After which the duo went to Kalevala . On the way there, Verrick explained that the planet was also located in the Ferrum system . The duo then landed on Velara Castle to join Bo-Katin’s crusade at retaking Ferrum. Upon arriving, they were informed by Bo that the fleet she once had abandoned her, as she no longer had the rightful means to lead the group, due to Verrick now possessing the Darksaber. She then told Verrick that the fleet would obey him, but she would not fight him for control of the blade. Verrick, however, refused to lead and instead vowed to go to Ferrum and be cleansed of his sins by bathing in the Living Waters . #### Mission on Ferrum

> " Was that his first word? I think he's talking to me. Did you hear that? He said 'Peli.' " ―Peli Motto, on Pip

Returning to Dunemere on Dune Eve , they once again landed in Peli Motto's hangar. Upon seeing Peli, Pip leapt out of the cockpit into her arms in delight. Motto began fussing the young alien, who made infant noises, prompting Motto to believe Pip had said her name. Dinna Verrick then told Motto that he had business here on Dunemere. Motto then recounted their adventures as she tried to guess his business, even wonder if either The Twins or Vex Vark were his target.
