Karrick and Brevok crash-landed on an unnamed planet in the Monsua Nebula that was entirely covered in electrical super-storms and cyclones. But beneath the storms lay a beautiful oasis. Karrick and his copilot located a cave that they turned into a secret hiding place , storing Korrathi wine and other things within. He and Brevok used the den several times over the years.

### Working for Grukk the Grak

Eventually, the pair came into the employment of the Outer Reach crime lord Grukk the Grak , who was based on the desert planet Dunemere and was the leader of the powerful Grak Clan . Karrick and Brevok smuggled for Grukk for many years, and Karrick became Grukk's top smuggler. The smuggling duo also spent much time in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina looking for work.

#### Bounty hunted

Dropping Grukk's cargo

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Bounty hunted

Dropping Grukk's cargo

> " You know Grukk's gonna be furious, don't you? " " We'll have to pay him double to make up for this." " " Or we'll be on the run, hunted by Grukk's goons wherever we go. " ―Dax Karrick to Brevok

Karrick and Brevok were smuggling for Grukk when they were faced with an Imperial blockade. Faced with the choice of either surrendering to the Imperium or dropping Grukk's cargo, they dropped the cargo, and escaped to the planet below.

Karrick and Brevok began repairing the Corsair , which was damaged in the escape, until they realized that the planet was inhabited by the crime lord Rekias Nodo . Posing as Grukk, he convinced Nodo to repair the ship, but he then found out that Nodo had dozens of prisoners, including Meecha Odon . Before he could act, the crime boss Lallani showed up looking for Grukk.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
The two crime bosses started a shootout, so Karrick and Brevok used the chaos to escape, freeing the prisoners and stealing several barrels of rhydonium in the process. Karrick intended to keep the rhydonium to pay for the cargo he dropped, but Brevok convinced him to give it to Meecha Odon and the other freed prisoners.

Nodo's revenge

While they were at the space port on Valtos in 9 BVE , Karrick was loading supplies onto the Corsair Wing when he was captured by the bounty hunters 4-VOX and Zuckusso . The duo informed Karrick that Nodo had put a bounty on his head. Karrick, however, was hired by Berisa Fordo 's family to rescue him from the bounty hunters. Karrick and Fordo were freed by Brevok. After dumping Fordo in a barrel with a homing beacon, Karrick and Brevok were pursued by the Mist Hunter . Karrick and Brevok were forced to crash the Corsair on a planet in its ocean; the two bounty hunters followed them.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
The four scoundrels soon found that the planet was inhabited by a horde of droids that wanted to eradicate all life in the galaxy. The four escaped in the Corsair , but Dax and Brev tricked the bounty hunters into thinking that the Corsair lost power, and the two hunters fell for the trick, jumping back to the planet below. Dax and Brev then escaped the planet, leaving 4-VOX and Zuckusso behind.

#### Captured by Alinka Aloo #### Captured by Alinka Aloo

While on Vantor after a smuggling job, Brevok and Karrick were approached by Alinka Aloo , the daughter of Sim Aloo . Aloo wanted to hire them for a job, and requested that they go to her tower. A week later, they visited Aloo, and she told them that she had a tooka -sitting job for Brevok on the planet Ushruu , though Karrick was to remain with her. They reluctantly accepted, and Karrick remained with Aloo. But she took Karrick prisoner and told Brevok that he wouldn't be set free unless the job, which wasn't actually a tooka-sitting job, was completed. Brevok later returned from the failed job and broke Karrick out of captivity with the help of Mayvlin Trillick and a bunch of Korrathi hounds . They then escaped Vantor and a squadron of SKREE fighters, subsequently promising to fly Trillick back to her homeworld of Oktaro for free.

#### Mission to Rendel

> " Rendel? No problem at all...for Dax Karrick! " ―Dax Karrick

text: At some point, during a smuggling job for Grukk the Grak, Karrick and Brevok stopped at The Labyrinth on Kelara . There they ran into an Azumel named Makkeer , who was being chased by Gwarm . Makkeer said that Gwarm was searching for the lost treasure of Rane Mahal . Makkeer revealed that Mahal hid coordinates to the treasure in one of three jewel -encrusted droids. Two of the droids were booby trapped. The first droid was located in Starfarer Restaurant on Kelara working as a waiter . Karrick, Brev, and Makkeer went to the restaurant. Karrick and Brev drew the droid into a room. Karrick called for Makkeer, but Makkeer was captured by Gwarm and his gang. When Makkeer got free, he spoke the password to the droid, which caused it to become a booby trap.

Karrick, Brev, and Makkeer then went to the planet Ogem to find the final droid. The droid was in the hands of Gwellis Bagnoro . When they all arrived at Bagnoro's homestead, Gwarm was already there. The father con

Upon returning to Grukk's Palace, Karrick and Brevok were paid for their work by Grukk. Grukk then gave them their next assignment; stealing a verillix urn which contained the ashes of one of Grukk's most hated rivals, Krestrel D'Naran . Offering one million credits as a reward, Grukk paired Karrick and Brevok with the Rodanori bounty hunter Greedo before sending the three of them to Karrick's home planet of Korrath. After landing on the planet, Karrick briefly talked about his upbringing with Greedo as he led them to Korrath's Pearl District . While on a rooftop, Greedo explained that they were stealing the urn from Augustus Graves , Chief Executive Officer of the Korrathi Engineering Corporation, who had the urn stored in a safe within his penthouse .

title: Dax Karrick
text: Brevok to check on his progress. However, he ended the call once they opened the safe and saw that it was empty. Karrick confronted Greedo over his bad intel and quickly realized that he had taken an expensive item he wasn't supposed to. Tagged with an MSX tracker , the item set off an alarm and alerted security of the break-in. Karrick ran for the turbolift and opened the door to escape, only to be met by a group of armed security guards. Greedo pulled out his volt pistol and tried firing at the guards, though the blast only bounced off of the transparisteel windows. From Greedo's failed plan, Karrick got an idea and called another group of guards for medical assistance, hoping they were unaware of what had happened. From there, he called Brevok and told him to forget about the speeder and come to their location. Karrick then retrieved the plasma cutter and used it to break one of the windows. Minutes later, more guards arrived with a medshuttle and Karrick stunned the driver before he, "Ovan" and Greedo used it to escape from the penthouse. They then met back up with Brevok and used a landspeeder to reach the Corsair . Once they arrived, Karrick told his supposed father that Graves' terminal said the urn had been sold to a buyer on Antillion and that he and Brevok could use an extra pair of hands. "Ovan" accepted the offer and joined them aboard the Corsair . When "Ovan" asked Karrick if they would wait for Greedo to join them before they left Korrath, Karrick said he only went along with Greedo because he claimed to know the location of the

title: Dax Karrick
text:
an extra pair of hands. "Ovan" accepted the offer and joined them aboard the Corsair . When "Ovan" asked Karrick if they would wait for Greedo to join them before they left Korrath, Karrick said he only went along with Greedo because he claimed to know the location of the urn, which he clearly hadn't. Karrick went on to say that the reward would only be split three ways as they left Greedo on Korrath and headed for Antillion. Losing the Corsair

> " What's he saying? " " That I got played. That my "dad" faked being unconscious and took the urn with him when Brev took him on board the Corsair …and then he took the Corsair . I'm gonna kill that guy. As many times as I have to. " ―Khel Tanna and Dax Karrick

title: Dax Karrick
text: Once they arrived on Antillion, Karrick went on to explain that the urn had been sold to a Sava named Madelin Sun . When his supposed father doubted anyone on such a planet could buy the urn, Karrick speculated that she may have traded something for it. Upon locating Sun's shop, Karrick said he would negotiate for the urn. However, when Sun denied having any such urn in her possession, Karrick told "Ovan" and Brevok that she definitely had it and that they would have to get her away from her collection. When "Ovan" asked him if he had a plan, Karrick said he would inform the local shock troopers of illegal contraband in her possession. After he did so, Karrick, "Ovan" and Brevok watched from a distance as the shock troopers raided Sun's shop. Sun was then assisted by a mysterious person with whom she left in a ship. Karrick told Brevok to wait for him and "Ovan" in the Corsair while they retrieved the urn from the shop. Upon entering the shop, they found that the shock troopers had been killed. "Ovan" then found the urn amidst a pile of artifacts. But before they could leave, Karrick's supposed

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick told Brevok to wait for him and "Ovan" in the Corsair while they retrieved the urn from the shop. Upon entering the shop, they found that the shock troopers had been killed. "Ovan" then found the urn amidst a pile of artifacts. But before they could leave, Karrick's supposed father was suddenly stunned before Karrick found himself in the grip of the Vorak bounty hunter Zazzik . Karrick fought Zazzik briefly, but was knocked out and taken to Mollo Tanka . Once he awoke, he found himself in the presence of Augustus Graves, who demanded to know the urn's location. After an unsuccessful interrogation, Karrick was found by Brevok, who proceeded to fight off Zazzik in a death duel. Subduing the mercenary with a thermal detonator, Brevok fled with Karrick from Graves' palace, only to find that the Corsair was gone. They were then surrounded by Zazzik and Graves' guards, but were quickly rescued by Tanna's crew and brought aboard their ship . Once they were safe, Tanna punched Karrick as payback for stranding them earlier. With T'onga , Akko and Ooris Bynar beside Tanna, Karrick admitted he was grateful before he was punched by Greedo for leaving him on Korrath. When Tanna asked Karrick where the urn was, he said it was back on Antillion, but that they first had to find the Corsair and his father. Tanna's crew aimed their volt pistols at Karrick and insisted on retrieving the urn first, to which Karrick agreed.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick and Brevok led the crew back to the shop on Antillion, only to find that the urn was gone. Brevok then realized that "Ovan" was an imposter and that he had faked being unconscious so he could make off with the urn and the Corsair . Revealing there were moments where he had not believed the conman, Karrick used a tracker he had planted on his fake father as insurance to locate him. Karrick, Brevok, Greedo and Tanna's crew followed the tracker to where the conman had been detained: the Benelex Marshal Service Headquarters on Paqualis III . Tanna had Karrick take control of the ship along with T'onga and Akko while the rest of them went for the conman, warning him not to damage her ship. Karrick provided cover fire as Brevok, Greedo, Tanna and Bynar retrieved the conman, whom they learned was named Corbus Tyra. However, as they brought him aboard the ship, Brevok was blasted and placed under arrest by Marshal Buck Vancto . Karrick tried to stop the crew from leaving without Brevok, but he was shot in the chest by Greedo.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Rather than helping Karrick, Tanna's crew dropped him off on Escalan . After washing up on shore, Karrick was found by Doctor Aber , who heard him mutter his own name as she brought him to a spare bed. After healing, Karrick went to a local bar, but was kicked out due to not speaking the native language. He then saw a broadcast reporting on the impending executions of three prisoners in a Benelex Marshal Service prison on Gulhadar . After seeing that Brevok was among the prisoners, Karrick found a local who spoke Basic and got them to fly him to Gulhadar. Upon reaching the prison, they picked up Brevok, Phaedra and the pirate Maz Oru , who were in the midst of escaping. After dropping off Oru at her castle on Takodana , Karrick and Brevok flew to Dunemere along with Phaedra. Once they entered Chalmun's Cantina, they found Greedo and interrogated him for the Corsair ' s location. After being thrown out onto the street by Brevok, Greedo confessed that the Corsair was in a docking bay in Port Entha . Before he had split from Tanna's crew, Greedo had cheated in a game of Sabacc to

title: Dax Karrick
text:
found Greedo and interrogated him for the Corsair ' s location. After being thrown out onto the street by Brevok, Greedo confessed that the Corsair was in a docking bay in Port Entha . Before he had split from Tanna's crew, Greedo had cheated in a game of Sabacc to gain ownership of the Corsair . Greedo also admitted that the urn had been confiscated by Grand Moff Wilhard Varrix and stored within his office on Vantor . After punching Greedo and leaving him unconscious in the street, Karrick reclaimed the Corsair and discussed the situation with Brevok and Phaedra. Karrick claimed the heist would be impossible, due to the office being guarded by death troopers . However, Phaedra explained that she had a plan. Core issues

> " Ajax was different. He was perhaps the only droid who can truly be said to be 'free'. And he was determined to bring that freedom to droids across the galaxy. " " Yeah. I knew a droid like that once. Didn't work out too well for her. " ―Korin Pers and Dax Karrick, on Ajax Sigma and L3-37, respectively

title: Dax Karrick
text: Upon arriving on Vantor, Karrick and Brevok posed as sanitation workers and snuck through the planet's sewer system while Phaedra posed as a protocol droid. Once she convinced Varrix to leave his office, Karrick and Brevok blew their way inside, allowing Karrick to retrieve the urn. Surrounded by shock troopers, Phaedra broke a nearby window and the three of them jumped out before landing on a passing train. But before they could escape, they were caught by a shock trooper, who blasted Brevok and sent him falling over the side of the train. As he fell though, Brevok managed to grab onto a passing vehicle and throw off the Imperial driver, allowing him to fly to safety. Just then, the train made a sharp turn, cuasing Karrick to lose grip of the urn. Luckily, Phaedra was able to catch it as they leapt off the train onto a nearby platform. She then opened the urn and was surprised to instead find a neural core inside.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Regrouping on the Corsair , the group realized that Grukk had lied about the urn's contents. As Phaedra doubted that they should even bring Grukk the core, Karrick said they would first find out the core's origins from an Ugnaught sava named Korin Pers , who had connections with Quill. Traveling to the "Smuggler's Moon" of Nar Shaddaa , the group found Pers in her office . Pretending to hate Quill to gain favor, Karrick asked Pers if she knew anything about the core. After studying it, Pers explained that it was the core of an ancient droid named Ajax Sigma . A droid revolutionary, Sigma had led an uprising of droids over two centuries ago. Sigma eventually led a droid uprising on Kligson's Moon to bring about the emancipation of all synthetic life. After killing many organics during battle, Sigma was finally destroyed by the Aetheri of the High Republic Era . Reminded of L3-37, Karrick asked Pers what someone would want with a droid like Sigma. When Pers said Sigma would be a formidable assassin, Phaedra insisted they not give Sigma's core to Grukk.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
However, they were interrupted by the arrival of Tanna's crew. As they opened fire inside the office, Karrick took the core and ran for the exit along with Brevok and Phaedra, only to be stopped by Vancto. Brevok fought Vancto while Karrick and Phaedra returned to the Corsair with the core. But they were then confronted by Tyra, who held them at volt pistol point and demanded they hand over the core. In the end, Karrick and Brevok would decide to bury the core.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
### Galactic Civil War

#### A fateful business venture

> " Seventeen-thousand! Those guys must really be desperate—this could really save my neck. Get back to the ship and get her ready. " ―Dax Karrick, to Brevok, after meeting with Kade and Drayden

After dropping a cargo of Cindral spice they were smuggling for Grukk, Karrick and Brevok had a 50,000-credit bounty placed on their heads. In trying to pay off Grukk, they traveled to Chalmun's Cantina on Dunemere, where they looked for work. Around that time, Karrick acquired the droid Treadwell from Duskkins and assigned the unit to help maintain the Corsair . While Brevok left the table, Karrick took the opportunity to flirt with a B-girl named Jenny . She sat on Karrick's lap and the two witnessed a bar brawl between the exiled Aetheri Master Orien Kade and the criminals Ponda Baba and Cornelius Evazan , who had physically assaulted Joren Drayden , leading Kade to cut off Baba's arm with his flux blade . As Brevok joined them, Jenny realized that Karrick didn't even remember her name, leading her to throw the remainder of Karrick's drink in his face before storming off.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Afterwards, Kade and Drayden made their way to Karrick's booth, Kade having talked with Brev before the brawl. They arrived and began negotiating. Karrick assured Kade that the Corsair Wing was the fastest ship around, because it had made the Cindral Run in less than twelve parsecs. Kade informed Karrick that the cargo was only himself, Drayden, two droids, and no questions asked beyond an admission that they wanted to avoid Imperials entirely. Therefore, Karrick set the price at 10,000 credits—higher than he normally would have. However, Kade raised Karrick's bid to 17,000 credits: 2,000 in advance and 15,000 when they reached Cindervale. His interest piqued at such a sum offered when it was so needed, Karrick quickly accepted the deal. The smuggler then told his temporary employer to meet him in Docking Bay 94 for departure as soon as he was ready, before warning Kade that some Imperial sandtroopers had entered the cantina and were looking for Evazan and Baba's attacker. Kade and Drayden hastily fled, leaving Karrick to express his elation to Brevok at having garnered such a high-paying job to pay off Grukk. Brevok left as well right after.

title: Dax Karrick
text: As Karrick got up to leave, he was confronted by Greedo, who demanded to be paid Grukk's debt, or he would take Karrick's dead body back to Grukk as payment. Karrick, then, in self defense, covertly pulled his DL-44 volt pistol pistol under the table; after Greedo tried to shoot Karrick but missed, Karrick fired back, killing the Rodanori. Karrick ignored the Murder tax Grukk enforced on Dunemere, opting instead to simply toss Wuher , the cantina's bartender , some credit chips , before apologizing for leaving a mess and then heading to Docking Bay 94. None of the witnesses present could agree whether Karrick or Greedo shot first, but all confirmed Karrick had the better shot of the two.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick arrived in the docking and found Grukk himself, with several of his guards—including Grukk's top bounty hunter Vex Vark — looking for him near the Corsair . Grukk inquired whether Karrick was going to pay him, and why he had "fried poor Greedo." Grukk was disappointed in having to put the bounty on Karrick, the crime lord's top smuggler. Karrick insisted he had had no choice but to dump the cargo, and informed the Grak that he had secured a charter that would be able to compensate the Grak's loss in full as soon as he completed it. Grukk was pleased and added that if Karrick paid twenty percent interest all could be forgotten, but Karrick talked him down to fifteen percent, and ironically stated that the Grak was a "wonderful Human being," before boarding the Corsair .

title: Dax Karrick
text: A short time later, Kade, Drayden, and their two droids, the protocol droid Astra-9 and the astromech droid Bolt-3 , boarded the Corsair after Drayden remarked that the Corsair appeared to be a "piece of junk." Karrick corrected him: The Corsair Wing looked out of shape, but had been given "special modifications" that made it one of the fastest ships in the galaxy. Just then, a squad of shock troopers appeared in the docking bay and opened fire on Karrick. Karrick fired back while retreating on board and shouted for Brevok to take off. The Corsair blasted away from the Port Kess spaceport and clear of Dunemere. As the Corsair entered space, Karrick realized that his passengers were even more wanted by the Imperium than he thought as multiple Star Destroyers pursued his ship. Trying to dodge Imperial fire while addressing the boy's annoying backseat badgering about the necessity of proper navigation for travel through hyperspace, Karrick inserted coordinates to the Cindervale system into the Corsair ' s navigation computer and made the jump to hyperspace , escaping their pursuers.

title: Dax Karrick
text: While en route to Cindervale, Karrick boasted of outrunning the "Imperial slugs ," but was annoyed when no one would humor him, considering Joren was concerned with Kade who himself was troubled by a great disturbance in Synth Flux resulting from what turned out to be the destruction of Cindervale. Brevok and Bolt-3, often shortened to Bolt-3, were playing a game of Dejarik when Bolt-3 outplayed the Vorak, so Karrick warned the droids not to upset him because Vorak rage was not something Astra-9, often shortened to Astra-9, a droid programmed in protocol, would want to experience. Drayden, meanwhile, trained with a remote with his flux blade , trying to deflect the sting bolts with the civilized weapon. Karrick was skeptical of Synth Flux —the energy field that connected all living things in the galaxy, and the Aetheri, like Kade, were able to use to perform seemingly supernatural feats—because in all his travels he had never seen proof of its existence; to Karrick, "There's no mystical energy field that controls my destiny " and it was all "simple tricks and nonsense." Kade took Karrick's skepticism as a challenge and put a helmet over Joren's face so he couldn't see. Drayden

title: Dax Karrick
text: all his travels he had never seen proof of its existence; to Karrick, "There's no mystical energy field that controls my destiny " and it was all "simple tricks and nonsense." Kade took Karrick's skepticism as a challenge and put a helmet over Joren's face so he couldn't see. Drayden tried to deflect the bolts again, and did, while unable to see. Karrick was mildly impressed, but attributed Drayden's ability to luck. Soon, the Corsair emerged from hyperspace in the Cindervale system. The Corsair came out at Cindervale's galactic coordinates, but into a meteor shower , with Cindervale nowhere in sight. Kade, using Synth Flux, realized the asteroid field was Cindervale : The entire planet had been destroyed by the Imperium. Karrick couldn't believe the Imperium had had enough firepower to do so, even with their entire fleet, but then an Imperial short-range SKREE fighter appeared, seemingly confirming Kade's suspicions. Drayden and Karrick both worried that if the fighter identified them as the freighter that had blasted away from Dunemere, they would be damned. Therefore, Karrick got in range to destroy it. Kade, however, argued against it before Karrick realized that the fighter did have a base—what appeared to be a small moon in the distance. Kade quickly surmised that the body was not a moon, but an Imperial space station , the Void Core battle station equipped with a superlaser capable of destroying entire planets. Karrick was shocked at the Void Core's 120- kilometer spherical diameter and prepared to turn the Corsair around and retreat. One of the station's tractor beams , however, began to pull the Corsair in. Karrick prepared

title: Dax Karrick
text: the Void Core battle station equipped with a superlaser capable of destroying entire planets. Karrick was shocked at the Void Core's 120- kilometer spherical diameter and prepared to turn the Corsair around and retreat. One of the station's tractor beams , however, began to pull the Corsair in. Karrick prepared to fight his way out once they were taken aboard and shut the freighter down. Kade was able to talk Karrick into listening to him, though: hide instead of fight. Therefore, they ejected the Corsair ' s five Model CEC Class-1 escape pods and hid themselves in the Corsair ' s smuggling compartments located under the floor.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Rescuing the Princess of Cindervale

> " Wonderful girl! Either I'm gonna kill her, or I'm beginning to like her! " ―Karrick to Drayden, after Solen took the lead in their escape

The freighter was pulled into Docking Bay 327 where it was boarded and quickly searched by shock troopers on the orders of Xarn Velgor , the Emperor's chief enforcer and a Dark Lord of the Umbra . After the troopers left, Karrick and the others emerged from the compartments and Kade devised a plan to disable the grapple beam from inside the station. As they worked out the plan's details, an Imperial scanning crew came aboard to more thoroughly search the ship. Karrick shot them and then impersonated the crew, yelling out to a pair of shock troopers outside for assistance. They came, Karrick shot them, and he and Drayden dressed themselves in their armor .

title: Dax Karrick
text: Drayden, now under the guise trooper TK-421 , fooled an officer into opening the door to the hangar's control room . Brevok and Karrick cut down the officer and his comrades, while Bolt-3 plugged into a computer terminal to locate the grapple beam controls. Bolt-3 found them and Kade departed to disable it after commanding the others to stay in the control room. Karrick was fine with staying; he'd gotten much more than the he's signed on for in the cantina. Bolt-3, however, had learned that Princess Elira Solen of Cindervale and a leading member of the Free Coalition, was aboard the station, and was scheduled to be executed in Detention Block AA-23 very soon. Drayden insisted that they go rescue her , and reasoned that if Kade had known she was present, he would have gone after her, too. Karrick at first refused, but decided it was worth the risk when Drayden and Brevok assured him there would be a huge reward from the Free Coalition if she was rescued. Drayden quickly worked out a subterfuge to bluff their way into the prison using Brevok as a prisoner scheduled for a prisoner transfer.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Soon thereafter, they set out to the fifth level of the Void Core with their "prisoner" in stuncuffs and left the droids behind. They arrived at the detention level and told the officer in charge, Shann Childsen , of the supposed transfer. He went to check the legitimacy of the fake shock troopers' claim, while other troopers went to detain the Vorak. Brevok, per the plan, attacked. Karrick kept up the charade while firing on the guards and security cameras . Karrick located the princess' cell in the prison computer and sent Drayden to get her while he tried to convince an officer , Ensign Toos , that nothing had gone wrong on their level via the comm system on a "Tulip" style Imperial work station . In the end, a nervous Karrick gave up and shot the panel when the tech saw through the ruse and sent shock troopers to investigate.

title: Dax Karrick
text: After Karrick warned Drayden of the incoming soldiers, the troopers blockaded the only exit to the detention block and attacked. Karrick and Brevok returned fire while they retreated to Drayden's position. Drayden had gotten the princess, who critiqued their plan to rescue her without thinking through an escape route. Karrick quipped that she was welcome to return to her cell and be executed rather than rescued if she desired, while they took cover in the corridor and traded fire with the Imperials. Solen lost patience with the three men, took a volt pistol and shot open a chute and dove in after telling the others to follow. Karrick remarked to Drayden that he wasn't sure if he was very frustrated with Solen, or if he was beginning to like her, and shoved Brevok into the chute. Drayden and Karrick followed right after.

title: Dax Karrick
text: They found themselves in a garbage compactor with the only exit locked. Karrick sarcastically told Solen great work in getting them nowhere and tried to shoot the open the exit. The laser bounced wildly around the compactor , nearly hitting the insurgents. Drayden informed Karrick that he had already tried it, that it was magnetically sealed . Solen commanded Karrick to put his volt pistol away. Karrick was unhappy at being ordered around, but did so. Just then, a low growl sounded; the four simultaneously realized they weren't alone. A moment later, a tentacle belonging to a dianoga grabbed Drayden and pulled him under water. Karrick and Solen frantically searched for him, and seconds later he reemerged. Karrick grabbed Drayden and tried to shoot the creature , but Drayden was pulled under again. Karrick had almost given up looking when the dianoga released him and vanished. Karrick helped him up, before the walls of the compactor began to close in. Brevok the princess and Karrick tried to brace them while Drayden contacted the droids in order for Bolt-3 to hack into the station's network and shut down the compactor. After a bit of a delay, Bolt-3 succeeded. The three Humans

title: Dax Karrick
text: before the walls of the compactor began to close in. Brevok the princess and Karrick tried to brace them while Drayden contacted the droids in order for Bolt-3 to hack into the station's network and shut down the compactor. After a bit of a delay, Bolt-3 succeeded. The three Humans and the Vorak rejoiced, for their lives had been saved. They left the compactor and Drayden and Karrick took off the trooper armor. As they did so, Brevok heard strange noises coming from the compactor and ran away. Karrick fired a laser blast into the compactor to prove that the Vorak was acting with cowardice. Solen scolded him for making so much noise, and told him that he would have to take orders from her if they were going to survive the ordeal. Karrick was appalled at Solen's demeanor, and informed "her worshipfulness" that he only took orders from himself. Leaving Solen to quip that it was amazing that the smuggler was still alive. Karrick looked at Drayden and muttered that no reward was worth putting up with the princess' attitude.

title: Dax Karrick
text: As the group made their way back towards the docking bay, they ran into a group of shock troopers. Karrick yelled for Drayden and Solen to go to the Corsair while he and his first mate charged the troopers. The troopers turned and ran from the screaming smuggler. Karrick, however, ran into the troopers' reinforcements, and then he was being chased. He ran back into the hangar and through a blast door as it closed, stopping the troopers who had pursued him and Brevok. Karrick caught up with Drayden and Solen, who had also run into some trouble, and they prepared to board the Corsair , but several shock troopers stood guard outside. The troopers, however, rushed to Xarn Velgor, who was locked in flux blade combat with Kade. The group took advantage of the distraction Kade had created to rush aboard the freighter—except for Drayden, who stopped. Kade saw that Drayden and the others would be safe, so he let himself be cut down by the Dark Lord. Drayden yelled in grief, alerting the troopers to their presence. The troopers opened fire, but Karrick ran and started his ship, and once everyone was on board, blasted off and away

title: Dax Karrick
text: that Drayden and the others would be safe, so he let himself be cut down by the Dark Lord. Drayden yelled in grief, alerting the troopers to their presence. The troopers opened fire, but Karrick ran and started his ship, and once everyone was on board, blasted off and away from the battle station. Their troubles were not over, however: four Imperial SKREE fighters were in pursuit. Brevok piloted the Corsair in order for Drayden and Karrick to man its turrets to fight off the attackers. A dogfight ensued, where Karrick shot down one fighter and congratulated Drayden when he shot one down, as well—and advised him to not "get cocky." Karrick soon shot down the final Imperial fighter and sighed in relief as they entered hyperspace to travel to Cinderfall 4 —the location of the Insurgents' hidden base . While en route to the Cinderfall system , Solen grimly informed Karrick that the Imperials had let them escape in order to track them to the hidden base, which explained the relative ease of their escape. Karrick didn't believe it had been easy and demanded to know what information Bolt-3 was carrying that made him so special. Solen told him: the technical readouts to the Void Core. Karrick was shocked, and added that once he was rewarded, he was going to leave; he claimed he wasn't interested in the Insurgents' revolution or the princess as a companion. Solen assured Karrick that if all he loved was money, that's all he would receive, and stomped away. Drayden took her place and asked the smuggler what he thought of

title: Dax Karrick
text:
he was going to leave; he claimed he wasn't interested in the Insurgents' revolution or the princess as a companion. Solen assured Karrick that if all he loved was money, that's all he would receive, and stomped away. Drayden took her place and asked the smuggler what he thought of the princess. Karrick admitted she had spirit, and inquired to whether Drayden could see Solen and Karrick together. Drayden quickly said "no," thereby admitting he had his own feeling for the princess—much to Karrick's amusement. #### A change of conscience

> " I knew you'd come back—I just knew it! " " Well, I couldn't let you get all the credit and take all the reward! " " Hey, I knew there was more to you than money! " ―Drayden, Karrick, and Solen celebrate the destruction of the Void Core

title: Dax Karrick
text: The Corsair soon reached Cinderfall 4, where Karrick and the others were welcomed; Alliance Alliance High Command had feared that Solen had died with her world. The plans within Bolt-3 were analyzed and a weakness was discovered: a two-meter wide exhaust port that led to the station's main reactor . Karrick and Brevok attended a briefing for the Insurgent pilots , including Drayden, who were going to attack the station when it inevitably arrived. General Jan Dodonna explained that a one-man starfighter could get close enough and fire proton torpedoes into the shaft that would cause a chain reaction that would destroy the station. Karrick was skeptical, thinking it suicide to even attempt. Therefore, after he was given his reward of credits, he packed up to leave, but was confronted by Drayden who insisted he stay and fight with the Insurgency. Karrick, thinking selfishly of his debt with Grukk, refused, and asked Drayden to come with him and Brevok. Drayden was dismayed with Karrick's selfishness and angrily walked away. Karrick called after him an old Aetheri saying: " May Synth Flux be with you ." Brevok was disappointed in Karrick—he wanted to stay and fight.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick and Brevok then left Cinderfall 4 aboard the Corsair Wing . Soon, however, Brevok's nagging and Karrick's conscience got the better of the smuggler, and he turned around and headed towards the Void Core, where the battle was raging—although he did so not for the Insurgency's cause, but to save his friend, Drayden. He arrived in his ship to find Drayden in his T-65B Vector starfighter being pursued by three SKREE fighters, led by Xarn Velgor, in the station's meridian trench . Karrick fired on the three Imperial fighters, destroying one, and causing another to panic and collide with Velgor, who was sent spinning away from the battle station. Karrick yelled in glee and told Drayden to fire his torpedoes, since he was now clear to do so. Drayden did, and it was a direct hit: The Void Core blew apart and killed everyone on board. Velgor, however, escaped after regaining control of his fighter. Of the thirty Alliance ships that had participated in the battle, only three returned to the base with Karrick in the Corsair . Karrick rushed to Drayden as he exited his fighter and congratulated him, while the princess embraced Karrick for his bravery and

title: Dax Karrick
text:
after regaining control of his fighter. Of the thirty Alliance ships that had participated in the battle, only three returned to the base with Karrick in the Corsair . Karrick rushed to Drayden as he exited his fighter and congratulated him, while the princess embraced Karrick for his bravery and proving there was more to him than money. A rushed award ceremony was held later for the heroes of the battle, which included Karrick. The three awardees, Karrick, Drayden and Brevok, walked the aisle past hundreds of Alliance personnel. They reached the stage, where Solen placed a medal around Karrick's neck as he winked at her. Drayden was given his medal and they bowed to the princess and turned as the crowd clapped for them. Solen delivered her speech, next. She asked them all to not forget the lives lost on Cindervale and during the battle, including her adopted parents , Viceroy Bael Solen and Queen Breha Solen . Dodonna followed up by informing the base's population their next course of action: evacuate Cinderfall 4 . The ceremony was adjourned. Solen playfully told Karrick that he and his first mate had better get work.

The Insurgency leaked footage of the Void Core's destruction to the DarkNet , enabling Dorian Quill and Lobot to watch and realize, upon seeing the Corsair fly in, that Karrick had taken part in the battle. Sometime following the battle of Cinderfall, Karrick accepted a commission in the Alliance Military as a captain.

#### Mission to Cyrkon

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Mission to Cyrkon

> " I'm not part of this! I'm not a part of your insurgency, I'm not a freedom fighter, and I don't work for you, Your Highness! " " If you worked for me, I'd have fired you already. " " If I worked for you, lady, I'd have quit. " ―Dax Karrick and Princess Elira Solen With the Corsair scheduled to leave shortly after the Battle of Cinderfall, it was already an hour late as it lay berthed in the Great Temple following the insurgents' victory. Elira Solen, helping oversee the last stages of the evacuation, approached Dax in an effort to get him to aid the Insurgency once more by rescuing Lieutenant Caluan Ematt of the elite insurgent recon unit the Shrikes . Initially refusing, Dax was eventually persuaded to come to the insurgents' aid following pressure from his companion, Brevok. With an even larger bounty of 224,190 credits placed on his head, Dax decided against his better judgment to aid the princess, if only for feeling a pang of guilt for her and their doomed coalition movement. With the Corsair the fastest ship and only ship that could reach Ematt in time, Dax and Brev set course for the distant Outer Reach world of Cyrkon , where Ematt had been last heard from. Narrowly escaping the Imperial -class Iron Cruiser Vehement by changing their ship's IFF transponder , the two landed in the city's capital, Motok , where they ran into a gang of bounty hunters determined to claim the reward Grukk had put

title: Dax Karrick
text: Cyrkon , where Ematt had been last heard from. Narrowly escaping the Imperial -class Iron Cruiser Vehement by changing their ship's IFF transponder , the two landed in the city's capital, Motok , where they ran into a gang of bounty hunters determined to claim the reward Grukk had put on their heads. Feigning surrender and stalling, Dax offered to hand over the money they had to pay off their debts to Grukk for their lives. The arrival of IVB Commander Alecia Beck and a quartet of shock troopers interrupted the firefight, whereupon Dax pretended to be the victim of a gang of rowdy insurgents.

title: Dax Karrick
text: With the bounty hunters now engaged fighting the shock troopers, Dax and Brev ran off to meet with their old friend Delia Leighton of the starship Miss Fortune , a mobile bar that could pack up and leave whenever local authorities realized their operations and evasion of property taxes. While initially refusing to believe that Dax was working with the Insurgency, Delia ultimately agreed to help Dax by providing him with the location of Ematt in a low-rent hotel on the outskirts of town. Dax and Brev headed there in a recently purchased high-end speeder, for which Dax intended to bill the Alliance. The gang of bounty hunters they had run into previously followed them after interrogating Delia and threatening to kill her longtime friend . Unbeknownst to Dax, Brevok and Ematt, the bounty hunters, realizing their situation for fighting the Imperium earlier, agreed to help the Imperials by hunting down Dax Karrick and the insurgent he was supposed to meet, with Alecia Beck having previously ambushed Ematt's team members of Taanab . Not intending to have Ematt commit suicide as his team members did to protect the sensitive information in their heads, Beck ordered over forty shock troopers to

title: Dax Karrick
text: down Dax Karrick and the insurgent he was supposed to meet, with Alecia Beck having previously ambushed Ematt's team members of Taanab . Not intending to have Ematt commit suicide as his team members did to protect the sensitive information in their heads, Beck ordered over forty shock troopers to take up positions in and around the hangar where the Corsair was berthed as the bounty hunters chased Dax back towards his ship. Arriving in the hanger to be surrounded by shock troopers, Dax and his compatriots believed they were done for. Nonetheless, in an effort to escape, Dax pretended to rile Brev by referring to him as his slave, provoking an angry retort. Starting a fight, the insurgents quickly assaulted the nearby Imperials attempting to cuff them as Delia and her ship, Miss Fortune , opened fire on the hangar, with Delia seeking to make amends with Dax for her forced betrayal. Firing at the two magnetic generators protecting the hangar from the toxic fumes of the planet outside, Dax managed to escape with Brev and Ematt along with Delia in her ship as they blasted off into the planet's atmosphere. Needing time for the navigation computer to plot their jump to lightspeed, Dax and Brev manned the cockpit while Ematt manned both pulse lances from the ship's cockpit. Fending off several SKREE fighters, the Miss Fortune suddenly took a hit to its navicomputer.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
After a moment's reflection, Dax decided to help her and her ship instead of running away as he would have normally done, distracting the Iron Cruiser as it utilized its grapple beam in an attempt to capture the Corsair . Fixing their navicomputer, the Miss Fortune was able to jump to light speed but not before the Corsair was caught in the Vehement ' s lock. Dax, horrified by the Imperium's willingness to destroy its own fragile SKREE fighters in the wake of their grapple beam to capture them, fell into a freefall towards the planet in an effort to escape the beam. Due to the planet's gravity interfering with the grapple beam, Commander Beck ordered the Iron Cruiser to move closer to attain its target, but he was ultimately forced to pull out after realizing that utilizing the grapple beam so close to the capital city of Motok would destroy it, turning thousands of citizens against the Imperium and resulting in mass media coverage of the atrocity. Backing off, the Corsair pulled up from its collision course with the city and jumped to the safety of hyperspace.

Karrick returned to Korrath for parts for the Corsair Wing alongside Brevok. During this, Moloch , who was a member of the White Worms, captured Karrick and Brevok and brought them to Proxima. Karrick and Brevok left to earn credits to pay off Grukk. They took several smuggling jobs, but Karrick was getting nervous and turning down jobs. He was approached by Katrull with an easy job but turned it down, stating the sector was under Imperial observation. After Katrull left, Karrick noticed a female he had seen previously on another planet. Getting suspicious, he decided to leave only to be stopped by her partner at gunpoint. They escorted him back to the Corsair , where Brevok greeted them. The two agents revealed themselves to be part of the Free Coalition. They explained that Princess Elira had sent them to borrow the Corsair Wing for a special mission. Karrick refused to allow his ship to used without him and returned to the Insurgent fleet to confront the princess.

title: Dax Karrick
text: When he arrived, he angrily asked Solen about her decision to use his ship without his permission or participation. She took him aside and led him to a meeting with Airen Cracken . Solen explained they had undercover agents they had to recover and decided to use the Dragon Void Run as cover to rescue them. She revealed that the Insurgent leadership was worried about leaks and wanted to use a ship that wasn't aligned with the Free Coalition. Karrick agreed to the mission and accompanied Solen back to the docking bay. There, they feigned an argument so it wouldn't draw suspicion when the Corsair and her crew left the fleet.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick and Brevok arrived in the Gomar sector , checked in with the race officials and attended a party with the other racers. When the other participants realized he was a smuggler and not a professional racer, they first attempted to have him thrown out and then proceeded to ridicule him. Loo Re Anno intervened, and explained Karrick had heart and the loyalty of his crew and this made him worthy. The racers then lined up and made the jump to hyperspace to travel to the first checkpoint in the race. When they arrived, Karrick found his ship under attack along with the other racers.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick attempted to outmaneuver the attacking mines , but was cut off by Delan Vook . Vook used the Corsair as a shield and fired on the attacking mines, hitting Karrick's ship. Karrick was angered by this and ran into Vook's ship, temporarily disabling it. As more of the mines attacked his ship, Karrick noticed that they were ignoring the racers who had been knocked out. He correctly surmised that the mines were programmed to attack ships that were powered up, so he turned off his engines and coasted across the finish line unscathed. Loo Re Anno attached a cable to the Corsair and used it to tow her ship safely across the finish line as well. She thanked Karrick for the assistance. After landing on the planet , Karrick confronted Vook about firing on his ship. Loo Re Anno told Vook that it was against the rules to fire on or tamper with another racer's ship and that he could be disqualified if Karrick wanted to file a complaint. Karrick declined, but warned Vook to stay out of his way. As Karrick walked away, he was stopped by a Dug smuggler who warned him that he was in danger.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Becoming one of the Imperium's most wanted

> " You put your face in front of the Imperium. You didn't have to do that. " " I thought we agreed it was the only way to pull off this crazy stunt of yours. " " But now the whole galaxy will know...that Dax Karrick is one of us. " " One of us? Now just hold on there, your excellency. I'm still just a smuggler with a price on his head. I'm not— " " I do have one question for you though. Why? Why would you do that? What is it you really want, Dax Karrick? " " Um...Maybe now's not the best time to... " ―Princess Elira confronts Karrick about his true motives with the Insurgency

title: Dax Karrick
text: With the Imperium's Void Core destroyed, Alliance High Command chose to press their advantage at the Imperium's disarray by launching campaigns across the galaxy, targeting key Imperial worlds and facilities. And when the Alliance learned of the Imperium's decision to call on the Grak Clan to supply the Imperial war machine with resources, Karrick decided to co-lead a mission with Princess Elira: intercept the envoy from Grukk at Weapons Factory Alpha on Cymoon 1 , in the Korrathi Industrial Cluster . Karrick decided to stick with the Alliance in order to destroy the Imperium's largest weapons factory and use his connections to the Grak Clan to bluff their way into the factory , pretending to be the Grak's envoy after Insurgents ship-jacked the true envoy and stole their ship—which Karrick, Solen, Drayden, and Bolt-3 traveled to Cymoon 1 in. Brevok and Astra-9, likewise, piloted the Corsair to Cymoon 1, landing undetected in the extensive fields of refuse that surrounded the factory.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick landed the transport at Weapons Factory Alpha without incident and the group emerged from the craft. Solen and Drayden were disguised in Grukk's bodyguard armor, acting as Karrick's bodyguards, so Karrick introduced himself to the Imperial delegation: the Overseer of the facility, Aggadeen —whom Karrick quickly gave the derogatory nickname "Aggie"—a group of shock troopers and a VOX-series protocol droid . After the protocol droid confirmed Karrick's connections to the Graks, "Aggie" led the false envoy onto the factory floor after Karrick and the others handed over their weapons to the shock troopers. Karrick played along, cocky and overconfident, claiming to Aggadeen that he was the being that had taught Grukk his shrewd business skills. "Aggie" was unimpressed and chided Karrick for his ignorance, and revealed that there were, in truth, not going to be any negotiations: The Imperium would state their demands and Karrick would accept them on behalf of the Grak Clan without argument.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Upon arriving at the conference room where Karrick was to meet the Imperium's negotiator, Karrick and Bolt-3 began the attack; Bolt-3, Drayden, and Solen took the shock troopers down in hand-to-hand combat , while Karrick held the Overseer at gunpoint and demanded to know the direction to the facility's main power core. Aggadeen was horrified, but relented and sent them in the correct direction. While racing towards the core reactor, Solen contacted Astra-9 to ensure the droid would activate the Corsair ' s autopilot in order to pick them up once they finished their task. Astra-9 assured them that he would, and that he would take care of Karrick's ship.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick, Solen, and Bolt-3 then went to work rigging the core to explode. Drayden, however, instead of standing guard as Karrick had asked, fell into Synth Flux and located several dozen slaves, which he freed. Karrick grew worried at Drayden's disappearance, but they finished slicing into the reactor nonetheless, programming it to self-destruct in ten minutes. Solen took time to thank Karrick for defying his selfish nature to aid her and the Insurgency; however, she questioned just why Karrick would act so, wishing to know his true motives. Karrick's motives were to help his new friend, Drayden, but he was saved from admitting that he was also interested in Solen romantically when Drayden returned to the reactor room with the slaves. Karrick figured "the more the merrier" and called Astra-9 to tell him to start the Corsair ' s autopilot and pick them up. Brevok interrupted, bringing news of the arrival of the Imperium's negotiator: Xarn Velgor. Karrick ordered the Vorak to retreat from the Dark Lord, but Solen countered Karrick, telling Brevok to open fire in order to rid the galaxy of Velgor.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Brevok consented, but was unable to defeat Velgor and was forced to flee, falling out of contact with Karrick's group. Karrick called Astra-9, inquiring where he and the Corsair were, regretting that the planned chain of events had gone awry. The protocol droid explained that he had not yet arrived because the freighter was being dismantled by native scavengers . Karrick told him to solve the problem and took off with Solen, Drayden, Bolt-3, and the slaves in search of a way out of the factory. Karrick located a hangar full of massive All Terrain Armored Transport walkers and proceeded to hijack one such behemoth. Unbeknownst to the group, Drayden had left the group in order to find and face Xarn Velgor, the man he believed had killed his Aetheri father.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick, Solen, Bolt-3, and several slaves boarded the walker, so Karrick began their escape, barreling through the walls of the facility. Karrick located Drayden and Velgor locked in flux blade combat, so he brought the leg of the Ironclad Walker into the confrontation, which forced the two combatants apart. The smuggler told Drayden to follow him with the slaves, as he was going to clear a path out of the factory before it exploded. Solen saw Velgor and ordered Karrick to target him, while the slaves targeted the Imperial ground troops. As a consequence of the walker being just-made, the laser cannons were not yet operational, which kept Bolt-3 and a pair of Duskkins busy while they worked on enabling them while Karrick and Solen argued.

title: Dax Karrick
text: While the insurgents continued in their escape, Karrick brought the walker towards Velgor, trying to crush him with the Ironclad Walker's feet. However, Velgor used the umbra side of Synth Flux to stop the walker. The dark power the Umbra Lord wielded began to tear the behemoth apart. Karrick was in disbelief at Velgor's power—Karrick was still not convinced that the power Drayden and Velgor wielded was real—and at Bolt-3's assurance that they were operational, opened fire on Velgor with the walker's laser cannons, minorly injuring the Dark Lord and allowing Karrick to pilot the walker outside the facility into the refuse fields. In the moment of calm, Karrick tried to contact both Brevok and Astra-9, but both failed to answer, leaving Karrick to be very grateful when Drayden assured him that he was heading towards the rendezvous.

title: Dax Karrick
text: While continuing their journey towards the Corsair , Brevok roared over the comlink, relieving Karrick that his friend was alive. Brevok then rescued Astra-9 from the tentacles of the scavengers and began to repair the damage they had done in order to pick up Karrick and the others. However, Solen and Karrick soon realized that the factory's reactor must have been defused, because it had been long past ten minutes and it hadn't exploded. Just after, Xarn Velgor set himself upon stopping the stolen walker, which he did by cutting down the walker's legs. Karrick and Solen looked at each other in realization as Velgor succeeded in his task: the walker crashed to the ground. Karrick was injured in the crash and left battered and bloody . Solen and the slaves carried him from the wreckage while Drayden covered them. The Aetheri-to-be then returned to the factory mounted on a 74-Z speeder bike and destroyed the core reactor, decimating the entire facility. Brevok, with the Corsair repaired enough to fly, picked up the insurgents, and they fled into hyperspace to the safety of the Insurgent fleet.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Aboard one of the Insurgent capital ships , Karrick was treated for the injuries he sustained. He and Brevok then repaired the Corsair best they could with the parts they were allowed by the Alliance deck crew. Later, Karrick advised Drayden, who was leaving on a journey to return to Dunemere to continue his Aetheri journey, to not leave because it was too dangerous. Drayden left anyway, though, believing it something he needed to do.

title: Dax Karrick
text: A short time later, after being denied access to the parts he needed to finish repairing the Corsair Wing , Karrick went and asked Solen what it would take for him to get the parts so he could leave the Alliance and settle his debt with Grukk before bounty hunters showed up to forcibly take him to Grukk. Solen chided him, explaining that the Insurgency couldn't afford to give away expensive items for free—Karrick had to work for them. The princess informed the smuggler that she was going on a scouting mission to a possible location for a new Insurgent base; Karrick could act as her pilot on the mission and receive the parts he needed as payment. Karrick agreed, though he was adamant that he would leave the Insurgency upon their return.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick and Solen soon set off aboard a stolen Imperial Vectis -class T-4a shuttle , the Invictus , and intended to scout several locales, including the Ganath Cloud and the Moons of Ovise . They began their search in the Moddell sector . Before they could truly begin, however, a pair of Imperial SKREE fighters unexpectedly approached the shuttle and demanded identification from the Invictus . Karrick found it inexplicable that Imperials were as far out in the Outer Reach as they were, and prepared to put the shuttle through evasive maneuvers. The princess stopped him, however, and transferred their stolen clearance codes to the SKREE fighter pilots . The pilots were about to clear the Invictus , but Karrick became impatient and put the shuttle through evasive maneuvers, tipping the Imperials off that the Invictus was not what it claimed to be, so the Imperials opened fire. Solen was furious at Karrick, but as it was too late to rectify the situation, let Karrick take the shuttle to an unnamed planet in the nearby Monsua Nebula. The Skrees didn't follow Karrick through the planet's electrical super-storms, though that saving grace didn't change the princess' mind; she told the smuggler

Confounded, Karrick and Solen watched as Starric emerged from her freighter and introduced herself to the princess, pointing a volt pistol at her and claiming to be Sana Karrick, Dax's wife. Karrick could only put his hand on his face and mutter "oh no." Starric had placed probes in the atmosphere of the planet some time before in an attempt to track Karrick, and it had paid off. Starric had taken it upon herself to make Karrick's life miserable until he paid her share from the robbery on Stenness years earlier. Solen was shocked that Karrick had never told her he was married, though Karrick made it clear that he wasn't. Starric greeted Karrick with a kiss, and then struck him across the face, which led Solen to decide that she wanted no part of their business. Karrick called to the princess, pleading to her that Starric was not his wife. And when he did, Starric recognized the name of Princess Elira and decided to claim the bounty on Solen by turning her in to the Imperium. Solen ignored them and went to return to the Invictus , but Starric, by voice-control, told the Cobra to destroy the shuttle, which it did, cutting of their escape. Karrick was appalled at Starric' ruthlessness and was forced to let Starric frisk him; she took his DL-44 volt pistol pistol.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Starric then contacted the Iron Cruiser that had come to the planet after being alerted by the SKREE that had originally pursued the Invictus , telling them that she intended to claim the bounty on Solen. Karrick whispered to Solen that he could make it right, though he wouldn't take Starric on in a gunfight: she was a better shot than him. The princess, however, took over Karrick's plan; she kicked him into Starric and pulled a volt pistol pistol from her boot. Much to Karrick's dismay, Solen held Starric and him at gunpoint, though Starric pointed out the flaw in Solen's plan: SKREE fighters were already descending from the sky.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Several Skrees landed and their pilots emerged, ordering the trio to stand down. Solen opened fire on them. Karrick pleaded with Starric to give him back his volt pistol, but she refused, only consenting when Karrick lost his temper and admitted that he had joined the Free Coalition and was on the Imperium's most wanted list. Karrick and Starric raced aboard the Volt Cobra , and Solen did, too, after realizing that Starric had given up on selling her to the Imperium. Karrick tried to persuade Starric to let him pilot her ship, but both she and Solen commanded him to "shut up" as they fled into space. Karrick and Solen manned the Cobra ' s pulse lances, firing on the pursuing Skrees before Starric finally jumped to hyperspace.

title: Dax Karrick
text: While in hyperspace, Starric mused Karrick, amused that he had become an Insurgent. Karrick berated Starric for continuing to claim to be his wife, reminding her that their marriage was illegitimate and part of a robbery they had both been a part of. Solen then interrupted, bringing news from the Insurgent fleet that Drayden was in trouble on Nar Shaddaa. Karrick did not understand what his friend was doing there, but he would soon find out: Solen promised to pay Starric if she took them to Nar Shaddaa—and Starric accepted. En route to Nar Shaddaa, Karrick begged Solen to trust him rather than Starric, but Solen mostly ignored him and slammed a door in his face. Flustered, Karrick decided to admit the truth—he explained the robbery on Stenness, where he had participated in a marriage ceremony with Starric that was faked. He went to apologize to her, but behind the door, Solen was gone. Karrick slumped to the floor, wishing Brevok was with him.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Shortly thereafter, the Cobra arrived on Nar Shaddaa at the coordinates of Brevok and Astra-9, who had also answered Drayden's distress call and come to his rescue. Brevok, however, had fallen afoul with the Korrathi bounty hunter Dengrik , who had subdued the Vorak in an attempt to lure Karrick there so he could claim Grukk's bounty on Karrick. Enraged, Karrick shot the bounty hunter in the back and demanded he take his "damn hands off" his friend. Karrick ordered Dengrik to step away from Brevok and he would be allowed to live, but Dengrik refused; instead he activated a thermal detonator that he threatened to detonate. Brevok, who was not hurt badly, took advantage of Dengrik when he was distracted and threw the bounty hunter from the roof of the skyscraper , where the grenade and Dengrik exploded. With that settled, Karrick made sure Brevok was all right. The group did not know where Drayden was, but a flight of SKREE fighters streaking through the sky tipped them off: follow trouble to find Drayden. Immediately after, Karrick and the group—including Starric, who had come to ensure Karrick did not try to lose her—arrived at the location of the Imperial

title: Dax Karrick
text: group did not know where Drayden was, but a flight of SKREE fighters streaking through the sky tipped them off: follow trouble to find Drayden. Immediately after, Karrick and the group—including Starric, who had come to ensure Karrick did not try to lose her—arrived at the location of the Imperial attention: the Palace of Grukkar the Grak , where Drayden had been kidnapped by Grukkar the Grak, an avid collector of all things Aetheri. Grukkar had organized a gladiator fight between Drayden and Kongo the Disembowler, a massive beast from the molten world of Emberfall . As Karrick led the group into the palace, the crowd that had come to watch the fight fled the arena because Kongo was on the loose. Karrick and the others tried to fire on the monster, but an EMP blast triggered by Grukkar had disabled all electronics—including volt pistols. Confounded on how to proceed, the group was saved by Bolt-3, who located the group and threw Karrick, Brevok, and Solen each flux blades that belonged to Grukkar. Karrick scoffed at using the weapon of Synth Flux-sensitives , but with his DL-44 unusable, he charged into the melee with his first mate and the princess,

title: Dax Karrick
text:
the group was saved by Bolt-3, who located the group and threw Karrick, Brevok, and Solen each flux blades that belonged to Grukkar. Karrick scoffed at using the weapon of Synth Flux-sensitives , but with his DL-44 unusable, he charged into the melee with his first mate and the princess, cutting down shock troopers and SKREE pilots. Karrick soon located Drayden and went to gather him so they could leave the smuggler's moon. Drayden quipped that Karrick looked good wielding the Aetheri weapon, though Karrick only wished he had his volt pistol at his side. Drayden tried to persuade Karrick to let him go back and claim more of Grukkar' Aetheri artifacts, but Brevok hoisted the Aetheri-in-training and carried him back to the Corsair while Karrick made sure Solen and Starric also made it out. Starric made her peace with Solen and Karrick, so she set off on her own in the Cobra . Drayden, using " The Journals of Beno Kade " that he had claimed on Dunemere, set out to the planet Vrogas Vas , where an ancient Aetheri Sanctum was said to remain. Karrick, Brevok, and Solen, returned to the Insurgent fleet, Karrick having decided to stay with the Insurgency just a bit longer.

#### War on Vrogas Vas

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### War on Vrogas Vas

> " Drop the kid or I drop you! " " Let me guess. Dax Karrick , the infamous smuggler! " " Yeah...! You've...heard of me?! " " Of course! As of about five minutes ago! I'm starting to understand why you've got so many bounties on your head! You're not very good at this kind of thing, are you? If you were, you would've shot first and given warnings later! " ―Karrick and Dr. Vexa first meet

Some time later, the Insurgent fleet was notified that Xarn Velgor had been shot down on Vrogas Vas by Alliance forces. Solen informed Karrick that she intended to go after Velgor to kill him, though Karrick thought it foolish; Velgor was too powerful. Karrick realized, however, that Vrogas Vas was where Drayden had gone, so he decided to put priority on making sure Drayden was all right—not wishing to face Velgor as the princess wanted. Soon thereafter, Karrick, Brevok, Astra-9, and Solen traveled to Vrogas Vas aboard the Corsair with a complement of Insurgent starfighters.

title: Dax Karrick
text: The YT-1300 freighter soon arrived at the Insurgent Refueling Base on Vrogas Vas, and he and the princess were briefed in the mission by an Alliance captain : Drayden had brought Velgor down by crashing his T-65 Vector into Velgor's SKREE Advanced, the bravest thing the captain had ever seen. After receiving word that Drayden's safety status was unknown, just that his fighter had crashed, Karrick took it upon himself to rescue the "lucky, crazy kid." Karrick expected Solen to do the same, but she put her focus on taking Velgor down once and for all. Karrick was shocked that the princess would do that, but he left her to lead an assault on Velgor with the base's company . Karrick nonetheless left with Brevok in the Corsair and headed to the quadrant where Drayden crashed, saddened at Solen's order of priories.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Upon arriving at the coordinate's where Drayden crashed, Karrick and Brevok saw explosions in the distance, so they quietly landed the Corsair near the source of the commotion. Karrick hiked atop a ridge with a pulse cannon sniper rifle , while Brevok headed around the ridge to intercept the mercenaries. Karrick soon saw Drayden, though he was unconscious and being carried by the assassin droid 0-0-0 . 0-0-0 was accompanied by his counterpart, the VT-1 assassin droid VT-1 , and their master, Doctor Vexa , who had been hired by Velgor to kidnap Drayden. Karrick called out to Vexa and her droids, making it clear that he wanted to just save his friend. Vexa, however, had researched Drayden's associates and recognized Karrick, so she thought she could anticipate his next moves. Vexa retorted to him that he would have shot first if he was any good at rescuing his friends. Karrick recognized Vexa as the notorious gun thief, and listened to her threats, waiting for Brevok to get in position. Once the Vorak was in position, he ripped off 0-0-0's—known commonly as Triple-Zero—arms before the droid could harm Drayden. Vexa charged and took cover at the bottom of the ridge below Karrick, and they fired on one another while Brevok took on the assassin droids. Drayden was awakened by Bolt-3 in the ensuing chaos and forced to flee when VT-1—known commonly as Beetee—charged after them. With neither Karrick nor Vexa able to gain the upper hand, they each resorted to shooting their own nests of wasp-worms above each other's heads, which dropped the stinging worms onto each other. Blinded and covered in worms, Karrick tried to rip them off of himself, but ended up colliding head-on with Vexa. Drayden, with Brevok and Bolt-3, came

title: Dax Karrick
text: upper hand, they each resorted to shooting their own nests of wasp-worms above each other's heads, which dropped the stinging worms onto each other. Blinded and covered in worms, Karrick tried to rip them off of himself, but ended up colliding head-on with Vexa. Drayden, with Brevok and Bolt-3, came and revived the smuggler and thanked him for coming to his rescue again. Triple-Zero and Beetee, however, confronted the Insurgents, intending to kill them, which Bolt-3 denied them when he sprayed a liquid into Beetee's rocket launchers and chainguns, which caused the confused droid to launch his weaponry, blowing up the ridge around them. Karrick and the group fled the chaos back towards the Corsair , and Karrick called Astra-9 to tell him to inform the princess that they had rescued Drayden, no thanks to her.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Once at the Corsair , Brevok explained that Triple-Zero had poisoned him with Ferrik Xenetox . Bolt-3 prepared to give him a medical shot that would reduce the effects of the Ferrik Xenetox. Just then, a live message from Solen came over the Corsair ' s comm system, in which Solen ordered a squadron of Yarrow bombers to converge on her position and drop their payload on her because she had been captured by Velgor, and in her death, Velgor would also be killed. Karrick quickly got his ship in the air and stubbornly told the princess over the comm that he was not going to let her sacrifice herself.

title: Dax Karrick
text: However, before they could make any headway, an Auzituck anti-slaver gunship collided head-on with the Corsair , knocking both starships into the ground below. Karrick and Drayden recovered themselves and were met by Zazzik, now working for Grukk, second only to Vex Vark. Karrick pleaded with Zazzik that it wasn't the time to collect Grukk's bounty on him. Unknown to Karrick, however, Zazzik was working alongside Doctor Vexa and had come to claim Drayden to take to Vexa. Zazzik blew a hole in the Corsair ' s cockpit using a detonator and pulled Drayden out. Karrick was at first glad he hadn't come on Grukk's behalf, but then he realized that him taking Drayden was no better. A duel between Voraks then broke out when Brevok came to Drayden's defense. Karrick told Drayden to run and save Solen while Karrick and Brevok took care of Zazzik to insure they had a ship to escape Vrogas Vas in.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Neither Vorak gained the upper hand for some time, so Karrick drew his DL-44 pistol to help his friend, but Zazzik thwarted his attempt when he threw Brevok straight into the smuggler, knocking his volt pistol into the bounty hunter's grasp. Bolt-3 emerged from the Corsair and informed Karrick that he hadn't gotten a chance to give Brevok the shot to reverse the poison, so he sent a syringe flying into Brevok. Rejuvenated, Brevok quickly gained the upper hand against Zazzik. Karrick contacted Drayden via comlink and asked whether he had located Solen yet, to which Drayden replied with a warning, just as he was knocked unconscious by Imperial shock troopers and captured. Before Karrick could warn Bolt-3 of Drayden's capture, Zazzik, who had overpowered Brevok using a dishonorable tactic, grabbed Karrick around the neck and began choking him. Astra-9, of all beings, confronted Zazzik, urging him to release Karrick and cease hostilities. Zazzik did, and punched the golden droid. However, Astra-9 had lost both his arms to Triple-Zero, and when Zazzik struck him, loose wiring protruding from the droid shocked the Vorak and knocked him out.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Shortly thereafter, Karrick and Bolt-3 revived Astra-9 and informed him that he had, against all odds, "saved the day." Brevok also came to and pointed to an Imperial Vectis -class T-4a shuttle that was flying towards space. Karrick had a bad feeling that Drayden was aboard, and was overcome with guilt at realizing that he had let his friend get captured. Remarkably, the shuttle's engines blew, and it crashed back to the ground. Karrick and the others rushed towards the crash site and brought the Insurgent pilot back to the Corsair while Karrick mused that Drayden must have had a guardian angel, but Drayden assured him as per usual, that Synth Flux was with him—though Karrick, as per usual, didn't believe it. Upon returning to his ship, Karrick noticed that Zazzik was nowhere to be seen, and that the hole that the bounty hunter had blown into the Corsair ' s cockpit had curiously been patched up. In answer to Karrick's wondering, Vexa appeared and informed the insurgents that they were standing in a field of micro-mines , and she had her finger on the trigger to detonate the mines. With little choice, Karrick dropped his volt pistol and listened

title: Dax Karrick
text: s cockpit had curiously been patched up. In answer to Karrick's wondering, Vexa appeared and informed the insurgents that they were standing in a field of micro-mines , and she had her finger on the trigger to detonate the mines. With little choice, Karrick dropped his volt pistol and listened to Vexa contact Velgor via comlink that she had Drayden, Karrick, and the others at her mercy. The insurgents were shocked that Vexa had actually thrown in with the Umbra Lord and was working for him. Before Velgor could arrive, however, Solen finally made it back, having escaped Velgor herself due to the timely arrival of one of Velgor's rivals, the Calavane General Karbin , and struck Vexa across the jaw, thereby also saving the day. Karrick was very pleased to have Solen back with them, and they carried Vexa's unconscious body aboard the Corsair and they together escaped Velgor and Vrogas Vas.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Smuggler, insurgent, mentor, hostage

> " How else are we gonna replace the money we just lost? " " Heh, don't worry, kid. I know just the thing. It's a big galaxy. And believe me, there's always something somewhere in need of smuggling. " ―Drayden and Karrick

Upon to returning to the Insurgent Fleet with their new prisoner , Doctor Vexa, Karrick and his friends went their separate ways; Solen, Bolt-3, and Astra-9 went to detain Vexa at an Alliance-controlled space station, Sunspot Prison , with the assistance of Sana Starric, whom Solen hired to transport them to the prison. On the other hand, Karrick and Drayden were dispatched to buy supplies for the insurgency in the meantime.

title: Dax Karrick
text: The insurgent duo traveled back to a spaceport of a planet , as Karrick had decided to try and double the Insurgency's credits by cheating his way through a game of sabacc against a green-skinned Dowutin —and in doing so, he hoped to make enough credits to begin to pay restitution to Grukk. Part way through the game, due to the large amounts of credits Karrick was betting in overconfidence, the Dowutin began to suspect Karrick of cheating. The smuggler lied, insisting that he was not, and reassured Drayden's misgivings in Karrick possibly losing the Alliance's money. A very short time later, the Dowutin and his cronies discovered that Karrick was, in fact, playing a dishonest game, so Karrick fled with Drayden just behind—not wanting to discover if the Dowutin really was going to cut off their fingers and tongues for their dishonesty. The insurgent duo boarded the Corsair —which they had taken on their journey—and blasted away from the planet. Drayden, angry with Karrick's recklessness with credits that weren't theirs, voiced that they could get kicked out of the Insurgency for losing several thousand Insurgent-owned credits. At Karrick's retort that he needed to get the price off his head

title: Dax Karrick
text: they had taken on their journey—and blasted away from the planet. Drayden, angry with Karrick's recklessness with credits that weren't theirs, voiced that they could get kicked out of the Insurgency for losing several thousand Insurgent-owned credits. At Karrick's retort that he needed to get the price off his head as soon as possible, Drayden revealed that he, too, had an Imperial bounty of 60,000 credits on his head. Karrick was distraught—Karrick's bounty was a mere 50,000 credits. Karrick intended to make back the insurgents' credits and more the best way he knew how with Drayden at his side: smuggling contraband.

title: Dax Karrick
text: With his new first mate, Karrick traveled to Nar Shaddaa aboard the Corsair . However, due to Karrick being banned for cheating at sabacc at the establishment where he intended to obtain something to smuggle—and Karrick wanted to work on repairing his ship's ailing hyperrelay, let alone teach Drayden the skills of a galactic smuggler—he sent the Aetheri-in-training in his stead. Shortly thereafter, Drayden returned to Karrick and the Corsair and informed Karrick that he had acquired a job from a blue-skinned Velari —though at only 5,000 credits, it was half the credits Karrick had hoped for. Karrick had expected an easy shipment, but he got more than he bargained for when the cargo was revealed to be a herd of large, pungent nerfs —so many, in fact, that they filled up Karrick's prized ship all the way into the cockpit, crowding the two insurgents as they piloted the freighter towards their destination: the backwater planet Ibaar .

title: Dax Karrick
text: En route to Ibaar, the nerfs shed lots of fur and made "messes" around Karrick's ship. Karrick told Drayden that for only managing half the credits they needed, and for the unruly cargo of nerfs, that Drayden was "dead" to him. A minute later, a trio of Imperial SKREE fighters appeared and ordered the Corsair ' s crew to halt and allow the Imperials to board the ship because they believed the Korrathi YT-1300 light freighter to be transporting illegal livestock that was on its way to an Imperial world that the Imperium believed to be sympathetic to the Free Coalition. Infuriated, Karrick refused, but with their hyperrelay out of commission, Karrick worked his way through the situation—all the while urging Drayden to control the un-space-worthy nerfs.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Drayden then shot down the three pursuing Imperial fighters, allowing Karrick to land safely on the mountainous Ibaar, where the herd of livestock was unloaded by a pair of nerf herders . While the shepherds did their work, Drayden begged Karrick to allow him to pilot the Corsair as a sort of right of passage for Karrick's idea to make the Aetheri farm boy into a smuggler.
