Karrick refused and retorted that Drayden had proven himself to be a poor smuggler by failing to make a profit on their cargo job to Ibaar, and told him that he was going to have to thoroughly clean the Corsair or Brevok would be angry with them both. But Drayden threatened to inform Princess Solen that Karrick had gambled with the Alliance's credits, and Karrick begrudgingly let Drayden fly his ship. While doing so, Drayden quipped that he felt the Corsair was sluggish, which offended Karrick, and he quickly took the controls back from Drayden. After receiving a distress message from Sana Starric, Karrick and Drayden rushed to Sunspot Prison in order to rendezvous with Solen and Starric there.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Upon arriving at the prison space station, however, Eneb Ray , former Insurgent spy and insurgent, covertly knocked the Karrick and Drayden out, tied them to the Corsair ' s landing gear, placed bandoliers of thermal detonators around their necks and used them as hostages while he revealed his identity to Solen, Starric, and Vexa—who had made a temporary truce with the two other women in order to repel the attack by Ray's forces . Shortly thereafter, Solen, Starric, and Doctor Vexa—who had come to a temporary truce with the other women in order to repel Ray's attack—arrested Ray after disorienting him by disabling the prison's artificial gravity , which also awoke Karrick and Drayden. The two insurgents were then freed and a portion of the Alliance fleet arrived and began the evacuation of Sunspot Prison. The smuggler then made sure Drayden wouldn't tell Solen of his mishap with the Alliance's funds, and the insurgents abandoned the space-bound prison.

#### The Harbinger

title: Dax Karrick
text: Later, Dax Karrick assisted the Insurgency in stealing the Imperial Iron Cruiser Harbinger as part of a mission to assist the people of Tureen VII . During the operation, he raced Elira Solen to decide who would be the captain of the stolen ship. As they raced, Task Synth Flux 99 infiltrated the Harbinger . He piloted the ship while the incursion took place, and later used a thermal detonator on the bridge so that he and Elira could escape. The two of the them, using breath masks , were able to board the Corsair and escape before the Harbinger crashed. Karrick later rescued Elira from Skorii-Lei and gave her medical attention. He then dropped off Pash Davane back on Skorii-Lei. Days later, he refused to go rescue Astra-9 from SCAR Squadron, though Bolt-3 went anyway. Bolt managed to rescue Astra-9 on his own, and when Xarn Velgor was pursuing Bolt, Dax saved them in the Corsair . Later, on Horox III, Dax and crew found dozens of insurgents killed and burned. After wondering who did it, they found that it was SCAR Squadron. Joren convinced them to bury the bodies, and they did so with great sadness.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### The Screaming Citadel

At the Horox III insurgent outpost , Karrick was told by S4 that Joren went with Dr. Vexa. Karrick, along with Brevok, Starric, Elira, and S4 took the Corsair to the Citadel of Ktath'atn . Upon their arrival at Ktath'atn, Karrick and the others met 0-0-0 and VT-1. They then met up with Drayden and Vexa at the Ark Angel II . Sol told her that the Ark Angel ' s aft thruster was misaligned. He was then confronted by Varroa and several of the Queen's guards. Karrick and the others then hid behind a door. Inside the door were Abersyn symbiotes . Karrick attempted to confront the Queen but was hypnotized.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Karrick was taken to the queen's chamber, where one of the symbiotes stung him in the neck. He was then forced to drink something that forced him to serve the queen. Karrick was given armor and forced to track down Elira and Starric. Karrick and the guards cornered Elira. He attempted to use a symbiote on her but was stopped when Starric and Vexa's droids arrived. Karrick attempted to shoot Elira and Starric, but Elira was able to convince him and the guards to lower their weapons. Varroa attempted to reassert the hive's control over him, but Karrick called in Black Zazzik. Karrick was able to take control of the other guards and killed Varroa. Karrick was named King by the guards, but did not want to tell people what to do. He was able to disband the hive and free the people. Karrick was then sedated by Triple-Zero. Karrick, Starric, Drayden, and Elira left Ktath'atn knowing that it was freed.

#### Escorting Grukkar

> " You're risking your life to take me to jail, bu the irony is... ...You're the one who's truly in prison, Dax Karrick. " ―Grukkar

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Escorting Grukkar

> " You're risking your life to take me to jail, bu the irony is... ...You're the one who's truly in prison, Dax Karrick. " ―Grukkar

Karrick was asked by Sess to take Grukkar to Akiva for interrogation and imprisonment by the Alliance. En route to Akiva, Karrick threatened to shoot Grukkar if he tried anything against him or Brev. Grukkar tried to convince Karrick to free him and return to his life as smuggler. As Karrick thought about Grukkar' offer, the Corsair came under attack by three Skrees. Karrick realized that Grukkar had disabled the hyperrelay. Karrick attempted to evade the SKREE patrol to no avail. He decided to contact the Skrees and surrender to them. Karrick landed the Corsair on a asteroid where the three SKREE pilots boarded the ship and met Grukkar. After Grukkar killed on of the pilots, Sol finished off the last two after hiding in the Corsair ' s secret compartments. Karrick turned Grukkar' offer and decided to resume his voyage to Akiva. Upon hearing this, Grukkar grabbed Karrick by the neck and demanded that Brev take him to Teth , where his safe house was. Upon confirming it, Karrick shocked Grukkar and sent the information to General Draven. Karrick told Grukkar that it was all a setup to get his safe house's location. After Vectors arrived, Karrick knocked Grukkar out and took him to prison.

#### Trouble on Odona

> " You left me to die for two measly tons of rock, Karrick. " " And now this is how it ends for you. You die here alone. " " A life worth less than a single stone. " ―Frax to Dax Karrick

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Trouble on Odona

> " You left me to die for two measly tons of rock, Karrick. " " And now this is how it ends for you. You die here alone. " " A life worth less than a single stone. " ―Frax to Dax Karrick

Karrick took Elira to Odona to see if it was a viable location for a new insurgent base. However, they got lost in a series of caves for three days and were attacked by a creature . Unbeknownst to Karrick or Elira, they were tracked and followed by Frax, Selt , and a droid. Karrick came under fire and took Elira to cover. He then told Elira to get to the Corsair . Karrick returned to the caves and was confronted by Frax, who wanted revenge against Karrick for dropping him into the Cordaxian Sea to be captured by the Imperium. Karrick tried to run, but was stopped by Frax and bounty hunters. However, Elira was able to light the droid on fire and escape Frax.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
As Karrick and Elira made their way back to the Corsair , they were confronted by Frax, who attempted to shoot him despite Elira's threat to shoot him. Despite missing Frax, Elira was able to cause ice to come at him and freeze him to death. Karrick and Elira were found by Brev and taken to the Insurgent fleet to recover.

#### Fighting with the Partisans

Karrick, along with Elira and Drayden, went to Embermoor . There, they met and rescued Chulco Gi and former Free Coalition Special Forces soldier and Partisan Ubin Des . After escaping the Imperial Snowtrooper Patrol, Karrick took the Corsair to Embermoor so Elira could speak with Des about a meeting with the surviving Partisans. Karrick allowed himself to be blindfolded and let Des and Gi fly the Corsair to the new Partisan base. Karrick and the others were brought before Benthic . Karrick told Benthic to either kill him or show them the Partisans' famous decisiveness. Benthic freed them and spoke with Elira, Karrick, and Drayden about destroying the Drill citadel .

title: Dax Karrick
text: As the partisans attacked the drill citadel. Karrick and Elira flew the Corsair towards the drill. Karrick was able to destroy the citadel and return to the Partisans' base. The Imperium then deployed the Leviathan . Karrick, Elira, and Benthic looked at the Leviathan and saw no explosive that could damage it. After Des' explosives failed to make a dent in the Leviathan , Karrick flew an airspeeder with Elira as his gunner. Together they rescued Des and her team from the Leviathan ' s tracks. Karrick chastised Des for making a suicide run and told her not to do it unless there was no other choice. Karrick was then informed Brevok was coming to help them finish off the Leviathan . Karrick met up with Brev at the base after Drayden rescued him with information from Shu-Torun.

title: Dax Karrick
text: With the Patisans, Karrick and the others made a plan to attack the Leviathan using the plans Brev acquired. Karrick agreed to fly the mission and keep an eye on the partisans. As the partisans boarded the Corsair , Karrick and the others came under attack by shock troopers. Benthic was wounded and Karrick told partisans to get aboard the Corsair to escape. As the Corsair made its escape, Karrick did not believe that Des should be leading the mission. Karrick was reluctant to take the lead, but was convinced by Brev to take charge since he was the Corsair ' s captain. Karrick saw that the Leviathan ' s guns were down and led the partisans in attacking the shock troopers stationed there.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Karrick and the Partisans were able to make their way to the bridge. On the bridge, Karrick, Elira, Des, and the partisans were able to pilot the Leviathan into Embermoor City's crater. Karrick ordered the Partisans to barricade the bridge to prevent the Imperium from stopping their plans. Karrick and the Partisans were able to return to the Corsair before it fell into the crater. Karrick took the partisans back to Embermoor. Benthic told Karrick that he and his fellow partisans would guard Embermoor's ashes until it was gone. Before leaving, Karrick awarded Des the Medal of Bravery for her actions, even though it was a copy.

#### Saltmark

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Saltmark

From the captain's seat of the Corsair Wing , Karrick led the defense of the Insurgent fleet from an attack by Imperial forces, buying time for the fleet to jump to Baraan-Fa . Shortly after, he accompanied Torb Rask , Elira, Joren, and Brevok on a mission to Saltmark , which the Alliance was considering as a location for its hidden base of operations. There they met Trusk Berinato , an old ally of Bael Solen who Elira thought would help the Alliance. Instead Trusk had forged environmental reports and summoned SCAR Squadron to eliminate the Insurgents. Karrick attempted to evacuate Elira while Joren and Wedge engaged SCAR Squadron, but Trusk shot him in the shoulder. Elira returned fire, incapacitating Trusk as the Insurgents regrouped and left the system aboard the Corsair Wing .

#### Mutiny on Mon Calvarra

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Mutiny on Mon Calvarra

Karrick took Admiral Gial Vorian , Drayden, and Elira to Mon Calvarra. There, they met with Mon Calvarra's Regent , Grand Admiral Dors Urtya . Vorian and Elira asked Urtya for the Mon Calvarra Mercantile Fleet to become part of the Free Coalition's fleet. Karrick spotted a patrol transport approaching their position and came under attack. The transport landed, and Karrick approached the troopers. Karrick was able to bribe the sergeant and toss a detonator into the transport. Karrick called to Brev to bring up the boat so they could escape. Karrick drove the boat past several creatures. Unfortunately, Urtya refused to give the Alliance the fleet, and Karrick took Elira and Vorian back to the Mako-Ta Space Docks . There, he gave Drayden a drink. In the mess hall, they met up with Torb Rask, "Hobbie" Klivian , and Zev Senesca . Together, they commemorated the fallen pilots of Red Squadron .

title: Dax Karrick
text: Elira arrived in the hall with a mission. With Drayden and Brev, Karrick went with Elira to Dex Acquisitions Depot on Meor Ain . Together they broke into the depot's ultra-security brig and took the Gloamite Tunga Arpagin with them aboard the Corsair . Karrick and the others were able to convince him to pose as Moff Tan Hubi while they used him to free King Liarch . With Drayden, Karrick and Brev were able to infiltrate the Moncaladrome through the refresher. Posing as an attendant, Karrick bluffed his way past a officer by allowing her to dry her hands on Brev. Karrick was then given a tip, much to Brev's chagrin. They were able to take Moff Hubi and switch him with Tunga.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick flew a submarine to Strokill Prime to rescue Liarch. Brev was able to use Hubi's bio-signature to get past Strokill Prime's defenses, in addition to codes provided by Queen Triova. Karrick flew the submarine past a monstrous fish . Karrick watched as Drayden allowed the fish to swallow him. After Brev rescued Drayden from the fish, Karrick took the submarine to the Imperial base and docked inside it. Karrick and Elira stunned several of the guards. Unfortunately, they discovered that the king was on life-support and could not be moved. Karrick and Drayden argued about their next move. Karrick and Drayden searched for recording droid so Elira could deliver Liarch's words to his people. Karrick found one and recorded Liarch's speech. After the guards killed Liarch, Karrick and the others returned to the submarine to escape. On Mon Calvarra, Karrick and the others met up with Astra-9 and Tunga Arpagin . They were confronted by Grand Admiral Urtya and several of his people who demanded Liarch's recording. After Urtya stunned Elira, Karrick allowed him to take Liarch's recording. As Karrick flew the Corsair away from Mon Calvarra, they were joined by the Mercantile fleet and a pair of Star Destroyers.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
As the Imperium sent in bombers to destroy the Corsair and the Mercantile fleet, Karrick was contacted by Urtya, who agreed to insurgent against the Imperium. They were then joined by the Free Coalition fleet under Vorian, that would protect the fleet. Karrick told Elira to get into one of the Corsair ' s turrets and destroy the bombers. Karrick saw that the Imperium was targeting the Calavane's escape pods and took the Corsair to stop several Skrees before they could destroy the pods. After the Aurora Flare blew up and destroyed one of the Star Destroyers, Karrick had the Corsair jump into hyperspace and escape with both the Free Coalition fleet and the mercantile fleet. Karrick dropped Tunga off at the Cosmatanic Steppes .

#### Escape from the Mako-Ta Space Docks

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Escape from the Mako-Ta Space Docks

At the same time as an Insurgent party to celebrate the expanded Insurgent fleet at the Mako-Ta Space Docks, Karrick, Brev, and Astra-9 went to the Ring of Kafrene to meet with an Alaphani in a bar for a deal for a set of transponder codes . Astra-9 translated the Alaphani language for Karrick, and the deal went well. During the closing phases of the deal, Karrick briefly joked about giving Astra-9 to the Alaphani for 10 percent off. Astra-9 was concerned by this, but Karrick explained he was joking and that no Alaphani would accept that deal. Brev then approached Astra-9 and Karrick to alert them that two of Grukk the Grak's bounty hunters were in the bar. After hearing this, Karrick finished the deal, and the trio quickly left. The two bounty hunters followed, but Karrick and Brevok hid behind their field of view to surprise them. Karrick had Astra-9 take the bounty hunters' weapons, and as the trio ran back to the Corsair , Karrick yelled back and promised that Grukk would get his money.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Astra-9 put the bounty hunters' weapons on the table on board, and Karrick assured Brevok that they were not missing the party. He then explained to his partner that he had a contact who would pay them week for the set of codes. As the Corsair Brev reminded Karrick that Joren Drayden had a role at the party, as he and other Vector pilots planned to do a flyby for the gathered insurgent allies. Karrick admitted he would have liked to see it as well, and the Corsair left for the Space Docks. Karrick arrived at the docks and found the Insurgent fleet under attack by the Imperium's Death Squadron . Elira said that Queen Triova had betrayed them and disabled all the cruisers and their hangar bays. Elira told Karrick to fly into a bay door in order to open it. Karrick, despite his better judgment, took the Corsair close to Iron Cruiser and several Skrees following him as he made a run towards one of the cruisers. The Corsair then came under attack by Lord Velgor in his SKREE Advanced .

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick was able to evade Velgor while Brev tried to shoot him down. Karrick flew the Corsair towards a cruiser as Velgor fired several missiles at him. However, Velgor was able to synth flux the Corsair away from the cruiser's hangar doors. After Commander Lajaie 's cruiser was destroyed, Karrick decided to send a messenger to Elira by sending Astra-9 by escape pod. Karrick flew the Corsair through the cruiser's debris, hoping Velgor would not follow him. Brev was able to launch Astra-9 to land on the Republic . Karrick received helped from Drayden's newly formed Renegade Squadron . Karrick led the squadron in taking out the Skrees.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick was forced to land the Corsair on Vorian's cruiser after taking heavy damage from Velgor. He then took a Flight suit and took a Vector and rejoined the fight. Karrick and Drayden came across a SKREE that was acting weird and realized that an ally was aboard. Karrick and Drayden led the SKREE back to the cruiser. There, they learned that Elira was the pilot and got her to the Republic ' s bridge. The Republic was able to escape into hyperspace. Karrick, Drayden, and the rest of Renegade Squadron returned to help the surviving cruisers. Karrick defended Elira and Drayden's ship as they boarded the base to rescue Sess and the other ambassadors. During the retreat, Karrick and Bolt's Vector was damaged but was rescued by a insurgent Quasar Fire -class carrier.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
As the carrier went into hyperspace, it engines were fried and cruiser had to land on Corosi 7 . Karrick was unable to contact Vorian or Brev due to the Insurgent fleet being kept hidden throughout the Outer Reach. Despite that, Karrick was then given a promotion to the rank of colonel by Sess, though he refused it. Karrick then came up with plan to find Brev and the Corsair . Karrick took Elira and Drayden to Nar Shadaa to meet with Starric, who agreed to help them.

Starric was forced to drop them off on Hubin , where they were stranded for weeks. They eventually stole a shuttle when SCAR Squadron arrived. The team then hunted the remaining insurgents and arrived at the Kaliida Nebula and met Home One .

Later, Solen came up with a plan to destabilize Shu-Torun's industry. She recruited her team, the tech Meorti , actor Tunga Arpagin, and the Partisans to pose as Queen Triova and disrupt the Spike .

#### Investigating Lotho Minor

> " And I'm not giving up on this planet yet. " ―Elira Solen

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Investigating Lotho Minor

> " And I'm not giving up on this planet yet. " ―Elira Solen

Dax, Elira, Joren, Brevok, and Astra-9, were sent by the Alliance to Restore the Republic to investigate the planet Lotho Minor for a new base. During the investigation, they ran into native droids and a male Kessith named Akar Duel . Their actions drove Dax and the rest from Lotho Minor knowing that the planet was not a good location for a new insurgent base.

#### Insurgent duty on Frostmark

> " Listen sweetheart, I'm no hero. I saw a fight and pointed my ship at it. " ―Karrick's response to Corwi Selgrothe asking what the Insurgency meant to him

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Insurgent duty on Frostmark

> " Listen sweetheart, I'm no hero. I saw a fight and pointed my ship at it. " ―Karrick's response to Corwi Selgrothe asking what the Insurgency meant to him

Over three years after the Void Core's destruction at Drayden's hand at the Battle of Cinderfall, the Alliance established a new base in the Anoat sector on the ice planet Frostmark , far from the Imperium's reach. The base was aptly designated Icehold , as it was carved into the rocky caverns of the Clabburn Range of mountains. Within months of the new base being established, Karrick, Solen, Drayden, and the others of Solen's team were deployed by Insurgent High Command to Frostmark aboard the Corsair . Karrick and Drayden scouted out the land around the base on regular recon missions as a part of their duties, using reptilian tauntauns as mounts to better traverse the freezing landscape.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Karrick took well to mounting and riding the unruly tauntauns and was sent on a reconnaissance mission in order to locate a ship that had gone missing a month before during a snow storm. The deflector shield which protected Icehold from attack had been damaged and made inoperative, and the equipment aboard the lost ship was needed to repair the shield's generator. At dawn, Karrick, Solen, and the insurgent veteran Velari General Lena Kryll ventured into the frigid mountains in search of the lost ship. Throughout the day, however, Karrick and Kryll mastered tauntaun riding, while Solen had trouble controlling her beast and—to Karrick's amusement—was de- saddled . While Karrick helped the Princess re-mount her tauntaun, he informed the search team that night was fast approaching and they would soon have to return to Icehold empty-handed. For her part, Solen insisted they couldn't return without first finding the lost ship. As she spoke, Solen again lost control of her tauntaun and stumbled backwards and fell from a steep embankment into a pit. Panicked, Karrick and Kryll rushed to the cliff edge and were relieved to see the princess unharmed, having literally stumbled across the lost Insurgent ship at the bottom

title: Dax Karrick
text: As she spoke, Solen again lost control of her tauntaun and stumbled backwards and fell from a steep embankment into a pit. Panicked, Karrick and Kryll rushed to the cliff edge and were relieved to see the princess unharmed, having literally stumbled across the lost Insurgent ship at the bottom of the pit. Karrick and Kryll made their way safely to the bottom of the pit, arriving at Solen's position minutes later, and learned that Solen had found the equipment that could be used to repair the shield generator, and had fought off a massive carnivorous frostmaw . The trio then returned to Icehold victorious.

title: Dax Karrick
text: At some point, Karrick and his allies ran into the bounty hunter Skorr on Ord Mantell . The encounter convinced him to leave and fulfill his debt to Grukk, so he began repairing the Corsair on Frostmark. Believing himself to be leaving, he, after scouting around the frozen wastes of Frostmark with Drayden under the callsign Echo Seven , had a heated conversation with Elira, claiming that she had romantic feelings towards him. After this debate, Karrick learned Joren had gone missing on patrol. Riding out on a tauntaun named Murra in the midst of snowstorm, Dax found Joren had been attacked by a frostmaw.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
After Murra collapsed and died from the cold, Dax used Joren's flux blade to cut the animal open and placed him inside to prevent him from freezing to death. After bringing Joren back to recover from his injuries, Dax and Brevok went out to investigate a signal and encountered an Imperial probe droid . Realizing the Imperium had discovered their location, the Insurgents decided to evacuate. During the ensuing battle , Dax rescued Elira from the collapsed command center, leading her towards her transport. A tunnel collapse cut off their way there, so Dax, Brev, Elira, and Astra-9 escaped on the still-unrepaired Corsair .

#### On the run from the Imperium

> " What are you doing? You're not actually going into an asteroid field? " " They'd be crazy to follow us, wouldn't they? " ―Princess Elira Solen and Dax Karrick

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### On the run from the Imperium

> " What are you doing? You're not actually going into an asteroid field? " " They'd be crazy to follow us, wouldn't they? " ―Princess Elira Solen and Dax Karrick

In space, the Corsair was pursued by several Star Destroyers and SKREE fighters. While Karrick was working on repairs, the ship drifted into an asteroid field . Claiming that the Imperials would be "crazy" to follow them, Karrick flew into the asteroid field, which would cause extensive damage to the pursuing Imperial Fleet. After the immediately pursuing SKREE fighters were destroyed by asteroids, Karrick landed the Corsair in a cave on a large asteroid, where he continued to work on repairs. While repairing the Corsair , Dax and Elira shared a kiss before being interrupted by Astra-9.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Inside the cave, Elira saw something outside the ship, so she, Dax, and Brevok went out to investigate. Discovering that mynocks were the cause, Brevok accidentally fired a shot into the cave, which caused a tremor. Karrick realized something wasn't right; he fired his volt pistol into the ground, causing another tremor. The three returned to the Corsair , flying out of the cave, which they discovered was actually the inside of an exogorth slug named Syra-O . Although Syra-O attempted to keep them inside the internal ecosystem of itself by closing its mouth, the Corsair escaped, with Karrick and the others never knowing Syra-O had loved them as friends despite their brief stay. Fleeing back towards the Imperials, Karrick flew straight towards the bridge of the Iron Cruiser Avenger , then hid on the back of the bridge. The ruse worked; the Imperials were unable to find the ship. Preparing to spread about the galaxy to search for the Corsair , the Imperial fleet dumped its trash, and Karrick detached the Corsair , which floated off with the rest of the trash. Karrick then decided to go to Aether Spire , a tibanna gas mine on Mistral run by

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Preparing to spread about the galaxy to search for the Corsair , the Imperial fleet dumped its trash, and Karrick detached the Corsair , which floated off with the rest of the trash. Karrick then decided to go to Aether Spire , a tibanna gas mine on Mistral run by his old friend Dorian Quill. Unknown to the insurgents, however, Vex Vark had also hidden his ship, the Reaver One , among the Imperium's trash, and followed them to Aether Spire. #### Imprisonment in carbonite

> " I love you." "I know. " ―Elira Solen and Dax Karrick

On Aether Spire, Dax met his old friend Dorian Quill, who despite showing initial hostility, embraced his old friend. Quill provided the insurgents with lodging and promised to repair the Corsair . While Dax said he didn't trust Lando, due to his knowledge of Quill being a scoundrel, he appeared to be at ease in Aether Spire, while Elira felt suspicious due to Astra-9 going missing and then reappearing in pieces. Quill then invited Karrick, Solen, and Brevok for refreshments, and told them about a deal that would keep the Imperium out of Aether Spire. To Karrick's surprise, he led them into a room with Xarn Velgor. Karrick immediately drew his volt pistol and fired several shots at the Umbra Lord, but Velgor blocked the shots and pulled the volt pistol out of Karrick's hands with Synth Flux.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Karrick was then tortured by the Imperium, but he claimed they didn't even ask him any questions. When placed in a cell, Quill arrived and told the prisoners that Karrick would be handed over to Vark, who would take him to Grukk, and that they were a trap set by Velgor for Dax and Elira's friend Joren Drayden. Angrily, Karrick attacked his "friend", but was restrained.

Velgor planned to take Drayden to his master, Galactic Emperor Theron Mal , by encasing him in carbonite . Unsure if a human could survive the process, he decided to test it on Karrick. Tearfully, Elira confessed her love to Dax, to which he simply replied that he knew. Elira, Brevok, Quill, Vark, and Velgor looked on as Dax was lowered into the carbon-freezing chamber and frozen. He survived the freezing process and fell into hibernation. He was then handed over to Vark and loaded onto Reaver One . Despite a rescue attempt by Elira, Lando, and Brev, Vark escaped Aether Spire, taking the frozen form of Dax Karrick with him.

#### Stolen by Vessa

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Stolen by Vessa

> " They all love him. Hate him. Need him. Owe him or are owed by him. Dax Karrick unites the galaxy. And that, right now, is exactly what I need. Dax always wanted to save me. Now he'll get his chance. " ―Lady Vessa, to Margo Due to the instability of the carbonite freezing process, Dax began to melt aboard Reaver One , forcing Vark to make an emergency landing on Nar Shaddaa. He met with Doc Ragon , a doctor with whom Vark had a history, and the Besalisk tasked Vark with killing Wyrmen Lictor in exchange for his help. As he fought against various pit warriors, Doc managed to halt the melting and keep Dax alive. However, he was then killed by a group of assailants who took Dax and left Nar Shaddaa. After securing Dax, they arrived at the Vermillion , where he was delivered to the reformed Carmine Dawn and its new leader, Vessa, who intended to use Karrick to lure together major galactic players for her own plans . With Dax in her custody, Vessa sent out a message to various factions in the criminal underworld, inviting them to an auction on Jekara . After delivering the message, Vessa then explained to her associate Margo that Dax was directly connected to almost every powerful faction in the galaxy. Thus, he would be useful to both her and Carmine Dawn. Still, Vessa fully intended for Karrick to end up back with the

title: Dax Karrick
text: on Jekara . After delivering the message, Vessa then explained to her associate Margo that Dax was directly connected to almost every powerful faction in the galaxy. Thus, he would be useful to both her and Carmine Dawn. Still, Vessa fully intended for Karrick to end up back with the Insurgency and ensured his location was leaked to agent Amilyn Holdra . She also placed a tracker on his carbonite slab. Once the representatives of the various syndicates arrived, Vessa thanked them for coming as she introduced herself and officially announced Carmine Dawn's return. She then revealed Dax to the crowd and started the bidding at one hundred thousand credits. After multiple bids from different parties, the present members of the Grak Clan began to bid over one another with increasingly higher offers. But this soon ended when Grukk bid with one million credits. With no other bids, Vessa congratulated Grukk and told him that the smuggler was his. However, the auction was then interrupted by the arrival of Xarn Velgor. Guarded by death troopers, Velgor declared that Dax belonged to him, to which Vessa smiled and decided to see where this would go. After Grukk conceded his ownership of Dax to the Umbra Lord, Vessa briefly sparred with Velgor before being knocked into Dax and incapacitated. But before Velgor could kill Vessa, he suddenly sensed Joren's presence through Synth Flux. After establishing communication with Joren's Vector, Velgor informed him that he had Dax in his possession. He then warned his son that if he did not come to him, then he would cut his friend in half. But Joren refused

title: Dax Karrick
text:
kill Vessa, he suddenly sensed Joren's presence through Synth Flux. After establishing communication with Joren's Vector, Velgor informed him that he had Dax in his possession. He then warned his son that if he did not come to him, then he would cut his friend in half. But Joren refused and told Velgor to come to him instead. Velgor conceded, ordering General Romodi to bring Dax aboard his iron cruiser and prepare his fighter. Dax was then loaded onto an Imperial shuttle before it took off from Jekara. After being brought aboard the Sovereign , Dax was transported to the ship's detention level under heavy guard. However, a surprise attack from the Grak fleet allowed Elira, Lando and Brevok to infiltrate Velgor's flagship and eliminate the shock troopers guarding Dax. But before they could escape with him, they were once again intercepted by Vark. One of the Grak ships then blasted a hole in the room they were in, causing Dax to be sucked out into space. Utilizing his jetpack, Vark pursued Dax all the way down to the surface of Jekara. He then fished Dax up before he hit the sea and returned him to Reaver One before flying him to Dunemere, fighting off VX-88 and finally turning him in to Grukk. Though Vark suggested dumping Dax into the Great Pit of Karkoon , Grukk ultimately decided to put the smuggler on display in his palace.

### Rescue and marriage

#### Rescue from Grukk

Prelude

title: Dax Karrick
text:
### Rescue and marriage

#### Rescue from Grukk

Prelude

> " Over and over, he fought and risked his life and sacrificed and personally saved the entire Alliance more than once. He stayed because even if he couldn't admit it, even to himself, he believes in this cause. Dax Karrick's a smuggler because he likes it, but he's a insurgent because he's Dax Karrick. And Dax Karrick complains and jokes and is generally half-useless…but he doesn't leave. That's inspiring. He matters . To the Insurgency…and to me. " ―Elira Solen, on Dax Karrick Through her tracker, Vessa learned that Karrick had been brought to Grukk's Palace and discovered he had been placed on the Grak's wall as a decoration. Traveling to the Corsair Wing , where everyone aboard believed Karrick had died in the fall to Jekara, Vessa revealed Karrick's survival and imprisonment in Grukk's Palace. Solen agreed to wait for Vessa to confirm the time was right to launch a rescue operation, knowing she was needed with the Alliance and could not spend time on a rescue mission at the moment. Vessa promised to reach out, even arguing that Karrick would be safe in Grukk's Palace while the insurgents waged their war with the Imperium, but Carmine Dawn would be destroyed in the Battle at Amaxine Station .

Later, the Free Coalition began preparations for the mission. Elira, Brevok, and Bolt-3 sought the help of Maz Oru, but were forced into a brief skirmish with the Ubese bounty hunter Boushh . After quickly overpowering him, Elira took his clothes, helmet, and thermal detonator as a disguise to sneak into Grukk's palace.

The rescue

title: Dax Karrick
text:
The rescue

> " Victims of the almighty devourer: His Excellency hopes that you will die honorably. But should any of you wish to beg for mercy, the great Grukk the Grak will now listen to your pleas. " " Astra-9, you tell that slimy piece of worm-ridden filth he'll get no such pleasure from us. Right? " ―Astra-9, translating for Grukk the Grak, and Dax Karrick

After almost a full year in captivity, Karrick was released from the carbonite by Elira, disguised as the bounty hunter Boushh. Due to hibernation sickness, Karrick was temporarily blind, but recognized Grukk's laugh when he revealed himself to be watching the rescue. Karrick was then placed in a prison cell with his partner Brevok, while Elira was taken as a personal slave by Grukk. After Elira was captured, Joren Drayden arrived, and faced off against Grukk's prized Rancor, killing it. In rage, Grukk sentenced Drayden, Karrick, and the Vorak to be fed to the devourer in the Great Pit of Karkoon.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
At the pit, Grukk offered the prisoners one last chance to plead for mercy, to which Karrick replied that Grukk would receive no such pleasure from them. Drayden then offered Grukk one last chance to free them, which he denied. Bolt-3 then released Joren's flux blade ; Joren caught it and began a battle. In the ensuing struggle, Dax was still mostly blind, rendering him unable to contribute much. However, after being told by Brevok that Vex Vark had joined the battle, Dax unintentionally swung an axe into Vark's jetpack, sending him flying into Grukk's sail barge and then rolling into the devourer. After a volt pistol shot knocked Lando, disguised as a palace guard, off the skiff they were on, Dax lowered the axe for Lando to grab, but Quill's foot was caught by one of the devourer's tentacles. Claiming his vision had "gotten a lot better," Dax shot the tentacle and pulled Lando back up into the skiff. Joren then rescued Elira, Bolt-3, and Astra-9 from the sail barge and destroyed it, and then the insurgents escaped.

#### The Battle of Mossfell

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### The Battle of Mossfell

> " I love you." "I know. " ―Dax Karrick and Elira Solen during the Battle of Mossfell

After being rescued, Dax joined the Alliance and was given the rank of General. As part of the attack on the second Void Core , with Drayden, Solen, and Brevok, Dax commandeered the Tydirium , a captured Imperial shuttle, and took an Insurgent strike team to the forest moon of Mossfell to disable the shields protecting the superweapon. Shortly after landing on the forest moon, the strike team encountered a group of scout troopers . Karrick attempted to sneak up on them, but failed to do so, alerting them and allowing two to escape. Joren and Elira hopped on a speeder to pursue them, leaving Karrick and the rest of the strike team behind.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Joren eventually made his way back to the rest of the Insurgents, without information on Elira. Joren, Dax, Brev, Bolt-3, and Astra-9 set off to find Elira, while Dax sent the rest of the strike team to move towards the shield generator. While looking, the insurgents came across a verkle trap laid by the native Mosskins . Despite Karrick urging him to ignore the dead animal, the verkle's smell ended up being irresistible to Brevok, who triggered the trap. Upon releasing the insurgents, the furry tribesmen believed Astra-9 to be a god, and they attempted to cook the others at a banquet in his honor. However, Joren used Synth Flux to levitate the "god" in a demonstration of his "magic", frightening the Mosskins into releasing the others. At the village, the Insurgents found Elira, and Astra-9 managed to befriend the Mosskins. Joren then left the other insurgents to confront his father, Xarn Velgor.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
The next day, Karrick's group met up with the main Insurgent strike team at the shield generator, but Mosskin scouts informed them of a less-guarded rear entrance. After three of the four guards were distracted by the Mosskin Paploo , the Insurgents neutralized the last guard and entered the shield bunker. But the operation proved to be a trap, and Karrick and the Insurgents were captured. However, the Imperium had not expected the Mosskins to attack, which allowed the Insurgents to escape. For most of the battle, Dax stayed at the door, trying to open it. After Bolt-3 was damaged while attempting to open it, Dax unsuccessfully tried to hotwire the door open. He then impersonated the pilot of an AT-ST that had been captured by Brevok and two Mosskins, getting the Imperials to open the doors. Dax was then able to place detonators inside the shield generator, destroying it and leaving the Void Core vulnerable to attack. Dax and Elira witnessed the Void Core's destruction, and she revealed to him that Joren was her brother. Karrick participated with the other Insurgents and Mosskins in the victory celebration held that night.

#### Aftermath of the battle

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Aftermath of the battle

Following the battle, Karrick, Brevok, and Bolt-3 were sent by Solen to General Kryll's camp to obtain food rations for the Mosskins as a means to keep the furry creatures from making a meal out of the captured shock troopers. While at Kryll's camp, Kryll forced Karrick to admit that her ship the Wisp was superior to the Corsair in order to get the rations.

The morning after the Battle of Mossfell, Karrick led the Pathfinders on an assault on an Imperial outpost on the far side of Mossfell. Knowing that the Imperial outpost was preparing for a counterattack, the insurgent commanders dispatched Dax Karrick on a mission to destroy the base. Dax outlined a plan for the Pathfinders and their Mosskin allies to strike the outpost with limited air cover. During the assault, the insurgent pilot Lieutenant Shara Bey served as the transport's pilot. The Pathfinders quickly wiped out the garrison, and Karrick uncovered a lot of data in the outpost's computers, which led him to conclude that the war was not over.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Two days after the Battle of Mossfell, Karrick proposed to Solen, who accepted the marriage proposal . While in the Bright Tree Village, Dax and Elira were then married; their ceremony was attended by only people they trusted. Karrick and Solen departed Mossfell to have their honeymoon on the luxury Star Cruiser known as the Halcyon , where they encountered an Imperial synth flux. She also told him she had met Vessa, much to his surprise. As a wedding gift to his wife, Karrick reconfigured some of the crew quarters on the Corsair to include a galley.

### Concordat

#### Honoring a life debt

Gathering intelligence

title: Dax Karrick
text:
### Concordat

#### Honoring a life debt

Gathering intelligence

Before the formal establishment of the Concordat , Karrick, Astra-9, and the Pathfinders participated in a raid on an IVB black site at the Wretch of Tayron . During the assault, the Pathfinders managed to down an AT-ST walker, which caused a breach in the facility's hall. This allowed Karrick and his men to enter the base and secure the computers before the base commander could initiate a purge of the computers. With the aid of Astra-9, the Pathfinders were able to hack into the Imperial data files and discovered that the Imperium had begun to execute Operation: Cinder , a posthumous order issued by the Emperor to devastate several worlds including Ondara as retribution for his demise. The Pathfinders' actions enabled the Free Coalition to deploy forces to halt Operation: Cinder, saving many lives and worlds.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Several months after the Battle of Mossfell, Dax arrived at Maz Oru's castle on Takodana to rendezvous with an Imperial defector named Ralsius Paldora , who had stolen intelligence crucial to the liberation of Thornwood. The Imperium had quickly discovered his treachery and followed him. Recovering the data cubes and fighting their way back to the Corsair , Dax and Ralsius were saved by the arrival of Inferno Squad , buying them time to escape the planet.

False leads

> " C'mon, Brev. Set new coordinates. It's time to get you home. " ―Dax Karrick to Brevok, on the way to liberate Thornwood

Some time later, Dax and Brevok received additional intelligence from the smuggler Imra that the Vorak homeworld of Thornwood would have a decreased Imperial presence. Against the advice of his wife, Elira, the two friends gathered several fellow smugglers and people who owed them favors for a hastily planned campaign to liberate the planet. However, this turned out to be disinformation from the Imperium to lure Dax and his companions into a trap.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
While Brev attempted to board a gunship captained by the Vorak pirate Kirratha , they were attacked by two Star Destroyers and several SKREE fighters. The Imperials disabled Kirratha's engines, leaving Brev and Kirratha stranded in space. Dax managed to escape, but Brevok was captured and locked in an Imperial prison called Ashmead's Lock . While traveling through the edge of Wild Space , Dax contacted his wife to discuss the recent developments. However, he came under attack from Imperial forces and lost communication with Elira.

Princess Elira was unable to get help from the Concordat since they were preoccupied with fighting against the Imperium. Since Dax had resigned his commission as general in the Concordat Defense Synth Flux , he was low on their list of priorities. Desperate, Elira turned to the Concordat starfighter pilot Nevra Wexlin for help. Nevra and Captain Torb Rask traveled to Karrick's last known coordinates in Wild Space but found themselves under attack by Imperial forces. After being rescued by the Concordat Starfleet, Nevra resigned her commission in the Starfleet to find Karrick out of respect for Princess Elira.

Finding new allies

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Finding new allies

Nevra, her son Temmin Wexlin , his battle droid Mister Bones , the Zyrrak bounty hunter Jas Emari , the former Imperial loyalty officer Sinjir Rath Velus , and the Concordat soldier Jom Barell traveled to the planet Irudiru after learning that Karrick had last been sighted at Warrin Station . There, they found Karrick while scouting the compound of the Siniteen prison designer Golas Aram . At a nearby cantina , Karrick informed his allies that he had discovered that Brevok was being held at Ashmead's Lock and that Aram was responsible for designing the prison. During their initial encounter, Karrick was accosted by Mister Bones, who mistook him for a threat.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Working together, Karrick and Nevra's team managed to breach the compound and capture Aram. Under duress, Aram told the insurgents how to enter Ashmead's Lock. However, he omitted the password that would allow them unhindered passage inside the prison. Traveling to the Thornwood system in the Corsair Wing and Emari's ship Halo , Karrick and Nevra's team gained clearance to land at Ashmead's Lock by claiming to be a repair team. Upon entering the prison, Dax and the insurgents were accosted by the prison's computer security system SOL-GDA , which dispatched droids to integrate them. Temmin discovered that the prison was being powered by the prisoners who were being housed inside stasis cells. Using this information, Dax and Nevra managed to disable the power generator. As a result, Dax and Nevra's team were able to free Brevok and a hundred other prisoners including Nevra's husband and Temmin's father Brentin Lore Wexlin . While Nevra, Temmin, and Mister Bones took the liberated prisoners back to Serenne on the Corsair , Dax stayed behind with Brevok, Jas, Sinjir, and Jom to complete their mission to liberate the Voraks. Unknown to Dax and his allies, the Imperial Fleet Admiral Gallard Raxen had inserted inorganic bio-chip implants inside the prisoners as part of a plot to assassinate the Concordat leadership.

Liberating Thornwood

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Liberating Thornwood

Dax and his team learned that Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck had fitted all of the Voraks on Thornwood with inhibitor chips . Tolruck controlled these inhibitor chips with a control module which he kept on his person. For the next month, Dax and his team spent their time searching for Tolruck's island fortress and gathering Vorak exiles and smugglers for a mass uprising. On one mission, Jom Barell was captured by Tolruck's forces and imprisoned at his island fortress . While Sinjir entered the island fortress to free Jom and disabled Tolruck's control module, Dax and his team disabled the deflector shield generator at Camp Sardo . Despite being attacked by Imperial forces, Jas managed to take out the shield generator.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
After Sinjir disabled Tolruck's control module, a mass planetwide Vorak uprising broke out. The Voraks and their insurgent allies quickly overwhelmed the outnumbered Imperial garrison. When the orbiting Imperial Star Destroyers began bombarding Thornwood, Dax, Brevok, and their fellow insurgents managed to evacuate the civilians underground. They then took a ship loaded with webweaver spiders aboard the Iron Cruiser Dominion and fought their way through the ship's corridors. However, they were captured by shock troopers who brought them before Vice Admiral Domm Korgale .

Before the admiral could eliminate Dax and his team, Concordat reinforcements arrived in the Thornwood system in the form of Elira and the Corsair Wing , Rask' Phantom Squadron, and Admiral Vorian's flagship, Home One . Dax and Brevok managed to break free of their captors and seize control of the Dominion . Dax and his team then turned the ship's guns on the Iron Cruiser Vitiator . As a result, the remaining Iron Cruiser Neutralizer surrendered to Admiral Vorian.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Following the battle, Dax and Elira experienced an emotional reunion aboard the Dominion . Returning to Thornwood, Dax, Brevok, and Elira learned about the Liberation Day attacks on Serenne. With the Voraks undertaking mop-up operations against the remaining Imperial holdouts on Thornwood, Dax insisted that Brevok stay behind and reunite with his family . However, he told Brevok that he would return if he ever needed help. Dax then left Thornwood aboard the Corsair with Elira and their unborn child, Beno Karrick .

#### Balancing family and duty #### Balancing family and duty

Over the next several months leading to the Battle of Ashden , Dax Karrick and Princess Elira prepared for the coming of their child. With Elira approaching labor, Karrick hired a protocol droid named T-2LC (or "Elsie") as a nanny. One day, Karrick bought his wife a sack of jogan fruits . Elira was annoyed with Karrick for overdoing it and reminded him that Dr. Harter Kalonia had said to incorporate jogan into her diet and not to replace everything with it. While chatting with his wife about the liberation of Thornwood and galactic politics, Dax and Elira were contacted on hologram by the Concordat operative Nevra Wexlin. Nevra said that she was traveling to the Inner Reach world of Ashden to hunt down Grand Admiral Raena Vexana , the purported instigator behind the Liberation Day attacks on Serenne.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Nevra Wexlin's team subsequently discovered that most of the Imperium had retreated to Ashden. While Nevra, the bounty hunter Jas Emari, and the battle droid Mister Bones infiltrated Ashden, Temmin and Sinjir returned to Serenne with news about the Imperial presence. They visited Elira's domicile and warned Princess Elira and Dax Karrick about the Imperium. Temmin tried to convince Karrick to lend him his famous freighter, the Corsair Wing . However, Karrick thought that the mission was too risky and was unwilling to risk his ship.

Before the argument could escalate, Chancellor Vela Sess entered the domicile and asked Temmin and Sinjir about the Imperial presence on Ashden. Following the meeting, Temmin and Sinjir managed to convince Dax and Elira to lend them the Corsair Wing . However, the two were stopped from leaving Serenne by Senate Guards who had been dispatched by Senator Tolwar Wartol , a rival of Chancellor Sess. Wartol had secretly installed a listening device inside T-2LC. In an attempt to discredit Chancellor Sess, Wartol leaked news about the Imperial presence to HoloNet News . Karrick and Elira learned about the leak while watching the morning news.

#### Unmasking a conspiracy

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Unmasking a conspiracy

Dax and Elira were later confronted by an angry Sinjir, who believed that they had double-crossed him and Temmin. Dax and Elira managed to set the record straight. They then realized that Senator Wartol's leak and the Senate guards stopping Sinjir and Temmin were linked. When Sinjir voiced his suspicion that there was a spy bug in Elira's domicile, Dax did not believe it, but Elira shared Sinjir's suspicion. Sinjir brought his former lover Conder Kyl , a slicer, to Elira's domicile. Conder found that the listening device was inside T-2LC. Following the discovery, Dax told Elsie to hold still and warned that it was going to sting a little.

title: Dax Karrick
text: After removing the listening device and handing it to Chancellor Sess, Dax led a team consisting of Sinjir, Temmin, Conder, and Jom Barell to the Concordat's new capital of Nakadia . Their mission was to investigate the five senators who had opposed Chancellor Sess's resolution to send military forces to Ashden: Ashmin Ek , Rethalow , Dor Wieedo , Grelka Sorka , and Nim Tar . While Sinjir and the others trailed four of the senators at a restaurant called Izzik's in Nakadia's capital Quarrow , Dax went to spy on Senator Dor Wieedo. The Rodanori senator was aboard his ship at the northernmost spaceport outside Quarrow.

title: Dax Karrick
text: After several hours had passed, Karrick witnessed two Niktal and a Klatooinian approach Wieedo's ship. Unknown to Karrick, these aliens were members of the Red Key Raiders , a crime syndicate that was plotting with Black Sun to prolong the war. Karrick managed to warn his comrades. However, the criminals discovered his presence and locked him in a rubbish bin. Meanwhile, Conder was kidnapped by other Red Key gangsters. Sinjir and Temmin found Karrick and returned to the Corsair . Despite their setbacks, Jom managed to kidnap Senator Rethalow, who confessed to his dealings with Red Key and Black Sun.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Before they could spirit Rethalow away into hiding, Dax and his team members decided to rescue Conder, Nim Tar's child , and Sorka's pet jerba . Conder used his transceiver tooth to transmit his coordinates to Sinjir. Dax and his team flew the Corsair Wing through a red warehouse roof, which turned out to be the Red Key's base. After subduing the gangsters, they rescued Conder and Nim Tar's child. Posing as an adviser to the Chancellor, Sinjir transmitted a missive offering the five senators pardons and other political favors if they changed their votes during the re-vote scheduled to be held at the Quarrow Senate house . As a result, Sess's resolution passed, and the Concordat was able to dispatch military forces to Ashden.

#### War's end

> " Yeah. You, me, Joren. Brev. The Corsair . Those two walking talking garbage cans. It feels weird we're not part of it. " " We've got our own adventure. " ―Dax and Elira

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### War's end

> " Yeah. You, me, Joren. Brev. The Corsair . Those two walking talking garbage cans. It feels weird we're not part of it. " " We've got our own adventure. " ―Dax and Elira

Following the events on Nakadia, Dax returned home and reunited with his wife. When Elira praised him for "making things right", Karrick told her that the Battle of Ashden was happening. He predicted that it would be a big battle. In private, Dax confided that it felt strange that he, Elira, Joren, Brevok, Astra-9, and Bolt-3 were not part of the final battle. Elira reassured him that they had their own adventure. Dax responded that it was the end of an era while Elira replied that it was the start of a new one.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
The Battle of Ashden turned out to be a decisive victory for the Concordat. Facing imminent defeat, Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon on Vantor sent peace overtures to Chancellor Sess. Dax and his wife attended the peace talks where Chancellor Sess and Grand Vizier Veldon signed the Imperial Instruments of Surrender and the Galactic Concordance . The signing occurred during the third hour of Elira's labor, but she only told her husband after the ceremony was complete. Karrick rushed her to the birthing chamber in the heart of Hanna City .

Elira gave birth to a son named Beno Karrick. Following a gathering of family and friends, Dax stared into his son's eyes and pondered how he had become a father. While Elira was showering in the next room, Karrick told his son that while the whole galaxy was against them, they would still make it through okay. Though Karrick confided that he might not make a good father, he promised to keep them pointed in the right direction. Karrick also gave Beno his first lesson: sometimes doing the right thing doesn't mean following a straight line. Karrick told his baby son not to tell his mother.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
When Beno cried, Dax tried to comfort him with a small tooka doll , but this failed to pacify the baby. Elira then heard her son crying. When Dax said that it was not his fault, Elira reassured him that babies cried. Dax sensed that Elira had a connection through Synth Flux that he could never have with Beno. Dax suggested using Synth Flux, but Elira advised him to pick up their son and snuggle him. Dax reluctantly snuggled his son and Beno stopped crying. When Dax sighed that he could never have the same Synth Flux connection, Elira told him that fathers had a special connection with their offspring.

#### Fighting the Zantarrk Gang

> " You Heard the bounty hunter. Nobody's dying today. " ―Dax Karrick

Around 6 AVE , Karrick was a in Alshuey Town on Guat'a . There, he helped Varrick after was thrown out of a bar by the Zantarrk Gang . Karrick sent out a warning shot against the gang members and saved Varrick. The two of them then fought the Zantarrk in a gun fight. After dealing with the Zantarrk, Varrick went with Karrick to the Corsair Wing .

#### Baylan Skoll's gauntlet

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Baylan Skoll's gauntlet

Around 9 AVE , during the search for Grand Admiral Vorren , the former Aetheri Knight and General turned mercenary Baylan Skoll listed Karrick's name in a device on his gauntlet, as well as the names of other key members of the Heroes of Cinderfall .

#### Starting a family

> " I'll be back. We're not done, you and I. We'll see each other again. I'm gonna be a father and no way my kid won't have you in his life. " ―Dax Karrick parting ways with Brevok

Finding himself husband of an important politician, Dax passed the time by becoming a successful racing pilot. On one occasion he returned to Korrath to compete in The Gauntlet , where he raced against Greer Sonnel and offered her a spot on his team for the Five Blades race.

In the years after the end of the Galactic Civil War, Karrick became the owner of a shipping company and developed a reputation for being a vigilant and responsible owner. Outside of his work, Dax often raced for charity and sponsored several piloting matches. Due to his work, Karrick found himself traveling through different systems, working on ships.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Their son, Beno, proved to be Synth Flux-sensitive and was sent to be trained by his uncle Joren Drayden in the ways of Synth Flux. Meanwhile, his wife Elira served as a prominent Senator in the Galactic Senate on Hosnian Prime , the capital of the Concordat. Dax and his family lived separate lives but he kept in touch with his wife via hologram.

#### Working toward someday

> " You really think you'd enjoy the life of a racer? Bouncing around from one system to the next, working on ships, never knowing where you're headed next? " " Doesn't sound that different from being a member of the Free Coalition. " ―Dax and Elira talking about their plans to travel the galaxy together

title: Dax Karrick
text: Twenty-four years after the Battle of Mossfell, Dax Karrick traveled to the planet Theron to manage a prestigious racing championship called the Five Blades. While staying in temporary quarters, he corresponded with Elira, who told her husband about the fractured state of the Galactic Senate. When Elira told Dax about her desire to resign from the Senate, Dax expressed puzzlement, since his wife had devoted much of her adult life to politics. Sensing Elira's frustration, Karrick invited his wife to take a break and travel around the galaxy with him for three months. Despite their different personalities, Elira agreed that she needed a break from her senatorial career.

title: Dax Karrick
text: However, Elira was forced to suspend her vacation plans after her faction, the Populists , convinced her to stand for the position of First Senator . The rival Centrist faction, which supported a stronger central government, had successfully passed a motion calling for the creation of First Senator in order to end the deadlock plaguing the Republic. Despite their initial opposition, the Populists, who preferred a more decentralized government, had decided to change tactics in order to prevent a Centrist from holding that office. Due to her prestige as a prominent former insurgent leader, Elira had reluctantly agreed to allow an exploratory committee to explore her suitability for First Senator.

title: Dax Karrick
text: While Dax was repairing the rear engines of a starship, he was contacted by his wife. Karrick was mildly disappointed with his wife's change of plans but agreed that a Populist should serve as First Senator. Karrick also informed his wife that he was supervising the lunar relays of the Five Blades. Due to the complicated nature of the repairs, Dax remarked that he wished that Greer Sonnel, a former racer and Junior Blades champion who was serving as Elira's pilot, was still on his team. When Elira apologized for delaying their planned holiday, Dax reassured her that she was doing the right thing by putting duty to the Concordat first. Elira promised to take a break with her husband "someday."

title: Dax Karrick
text: In addition to the First Senatorship, Elira was involved in a sensitive Senate investigation into the Niktal crime lord Rinnrivin Di 's cartel , a new criminal outfit that was choking the economy of the Gaulus sector . Elira was assisted in this investigation by an unlikely ally, the idealistic Centrist senator Ransolm Kastor . Over the course of their investigation, the two discovered that Rinnrivin was linked to a paramilitary faction called the Amaxine warriors . In an attempt to sow discord, Arliz Hadrassian , a former SKREE fighter pilot who had become the Amaxines' leader, bombed the Concordat senatorial complex 's conference building . Elira survived the bombing and transmitted a voice-message telling her husband that she was safe and that he did not need to come to Hosnian Prime. While on Theron, Karrick received news about the Senate bombing and saw footage of the damage. Later, Karrick contacted Elira to send his wife a goodwill message and to keep in touch.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
While Elira was visiting Selvara as part of her investigation, Dax Karrick sent a holomessage expressing hope that his wife's side project was going well. He informed her that the Five Blades was heading to the fourth stage of the Blades. Due to the sublight relay round, Dax told her that he would be out of comm range for a while. He also told her to take care of herself and complimented her.

#### Rescue on Sibensko

> " Sorry, I'm late, sweetheart. " " Honey, you're right on time. " ―Dax reuniting with his wife on Sibensko

Dax and Elira would cross paths again due to unforeseen circumstances. Later, the Centrist Senator Lady Carise Sindian , a secret agent of an Imperial remnant known as the New Imperium , discovered information about Elira's true parentage as the daughter of Xarn Velgor on Birren . Alarmed at the friendship between Ransolm Kastor and Elira, Lady Carise shared this information with him, knowing Ransolm's hatred for Velgor. Feeling betrayed, Kastor upstaged the Senate hearing into Elira's nomination for First Senator by revealing Elira's parentage to the assembled senators. This revelation destroyed Elira's credibility and forced her to withdraw her nomination.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Still determined to continue her investigation into Rinnrivin's cartel and the Amaxines, Elira and her team took leave to travel to Sibensko , where the two groups were hiding. There, Elira discovered that the Amaxines were funding Rinnrivin's cartel and were also marshaling troops, weapons, and starships for an attack on the Concordat. During her mission , Elira was pursued by the Amaxine warriors and fled up a landing platform, where she was corned by two Amaxine starfighters. Dax arrived on a racer and rescued his wife. Together, the couple shot down the enemy fighters. One of the fighters, a Bulwark , collided with the underwater base's ammunition depot, triggering a massive explosion that destroyed the underwater city and the Amaxine army.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Following the Sibensko mission, Dax and his wife returned to Elira's apartment in Hosnian Prime. When Elira expressed despair that many of her former colleagues and comrades were shunning her for simply being Velgor's daughter, Karrick reassured her that this storm would pass and that people would remember her for who she was. Dax counseled his wife to remember those friends who stuck by her and to ignore the rest of the galaxy. When Dax criticized Kastor, Elira sprung to her former friend's defense by pointing out that he was a decent man who hated Velgor. Dax then advised his wife to forget Kastor and to use the political scandal as an opportunity to retire from politics for good.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
However, Elira still had one piece of unfinished business left: the findings of her investigation into Rinnrivin Di's cartel and the Amaxines. Elira wanted to address the Senate, but she needed to gain a quorum from a majority of senators. While Dax thought that no more threats to the Republic existed with the demise of Rinnrivin and the Amaxines, Elira suspected that there were other like-minded groups seeking to overthrow the Republic. Dax counseled his wife to rest for the night, and the couple expressed their love for each other. The following morning, the sports channels reported that Dax Karrick had left the Theron system after the end of the last Blades round. There was also speculation on whether he would return for the final championship race. Later that evening, Dax bought his wife Bilbringi cheesy meat pies for dinner. While eating, the couple received news that Elira had received a quorum to address the Senate due to Kastor's favorable vote. Dax then told his wife that things would improve and that he would stay with her for as long as she needed him. Elira reassured her husband that she would be able to handle the hearing on her own and told him that he could return to the Blades championship. Shortly, Karrick returned to the Five Blades race.

### Cold War

#### Family strife

> " And Karrick… Did you know that's not even his real name? He's a lie . " ―Beno Karrick, to Vorr, about his father

title: Dax Karrick
text:
### Cold War

#### Family strife

> " And Karrick… Did you know that's not even his real name? He's a lie . " ―Beno Karrick, to Vorr, about his father

At some point after the public revelations about Elira and Beno's relationship to Xarn Velgor, Dax's son, Beno Karrick, was seduced by Supreme Leader Vorr and eventually succumbed to the umbra side, killing the Aetheri Joren was training . Taking the blame for Beno's fall, Joren exiled himself . Unable to cope with the loss of their son, Dax and Elira separated.

Dax and Brevok went back to being smugglers, which Dax claimed was "the only thing he was ever good at." Meanwhile, Elira became the leader of the Coalition , a paramilitary organization aimed at fighting the New Imperium, which had begun to pose a threat to the Concordat. Dax then got himself into a lot of debt with various creditors including the notorious Guavian Death Gang and Kanjiklub .

#### Losing the Corsair

> " Short-handed? I can help. I can be your co-pilot. " ―Gannis Ducain to Dax Karrick

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Losing the Corsair

> " Short-handed? I can help. I can be your co-pilot. " ―Gannis Ducain to Dax Karrick

In 31 AVE Karrick traveled to Maz's castle, where he spoke with Oru about Brevok being unable to do a job with him. Gannis Ducain , who worked for Oru, overheard and suggested he help on the job. The job was to deliver cargo to Krestophis . When Dax and Ducain arrived, Dax left Ducain to guard the Corsair Wing whilst he met with his contact. Ducain, however, stole the Corsair . Ducain became a rich gunrunner . One day the Irving Boys stole the Corsair from him.

After losing the Corsair , Dax and Brevok obtained a Baleen -class heavy freighter named the Eravana that they used for their smuggling operations and even assembled a crew to assist them. Dax spent the majority of his free time trying to track down the Corsair .

#### Smuggler's run

title: Dax Karrick
text:
After losing the Corsair , Dax and Brevok obtained a Baleen -class heavy freighter named the Eravana that they used for their smuggling operations and even assembled a crew to assist them. Dax spent the majority of his free time trying to track down the Corsair .

#### Smuggler's run

Sometime later, Karrick and Brevok went to the Serendipity , a yacht that was owned by Leighton. There, Karrick engaged a trio of bounty hunters— Strater , Hove , and Rigger —sent to capture him on the Serendipity cantina, and told them about their mission to Cyrkon before they realized who he was. Once they were aware of Karrick's identity, Brevok snuck behind them and took hold of Rigger, only to send him flying to the Serendipity ' s door and knock Strater out with a punch, while Karrick disarmed Bobbie. Then, the Korrathi told them to warn their possible employers (Ducain, the Irving Boys, the Guavians, etc.) that they were not afraid of them, before saying goodbye to Leighton and leaving the bar together.

#### Cindervalean data archive heist

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Cindervalean data archive heist

Karrick and Brevok stole a Xi -class light shuttle from the shipyard of the Fluzhi Clan . They escaped from the shipyard and planned to use codes from Finwej to steal a weapons archive from Mek Nura'Tiv . Karrick hoped to use the archive to get several people they owed money to off their backs. Karrick, posing as a New Imperium officer, boarded Mek Nura'Tiv's cruiser and spoke with her and her crew. Nura'Tiv, however, realized that Karrick had used Finwej to get credits and had her crew hold him at gunpoint.

#### Retaking the Corsair

> " The Aetheri were real? " " I used to wonder about that myself. Thought it was a bunch of mumbo jumbo. A magical power holding together good and evil, the umbra side and the light. Crazy thing is, it's true. Synth Flux, the Aetheri. All of it—it's all true. " ―Nyla and Dax Karrick

title: Dax Karrick
text:
In 34 AVE while transporting a cargo of three Rathtars aboard the Eravana for the King Prana , Dax and Brev found the Corsair floating in space near the desert planet of Ashden, pulling his prized vessel in with a grapple beam. Upon boarding their old vessel, the two went about inspecting their ship and found two stowaways, Ashden scavenger Nyla and former New Imperium shock trooper Jax , who he assumed were the thieves who had stolen the Corsair . When Nyla and Jax explained that they were going to take a droid named Orio-6 to the Coalition as he had a map to the location of Karrick's old friend Joren Drayden, Dax and Brev agreed to help them.

Karrick rediscovered the Smuggler's Guide that was previously owned by Unkar Gruven aboard the ship, thinking it was a bad omen that this thing keeps resurfacing. However, Brevok thought it was a good luck that it keeps coming back and was happy to see the logbook and kept opening different pages. Dax thought if that was true his life would have turned out differently. These reflections were recorded in the logbook.

#### Skirmish aboard the Eravana

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Skirmish aboard the Eravana

> " What are you going to do? " " Same thing I always do, talk my way out of it. " ―Nyla and Dax Karrick

Dax's freighter had been boarded by the Guavian Death Gang and Kanjiklub, whom Karrick was indebted to. Not wanting Nyla and Jax to be involved, Dax placed both of them in the lower corridors of the freighter while he and Brev went to meet with the criminals, with Orio-6 accompanying them. The smuggler tried but failed to convince both gangs that he would fix things eventually, with one of the gang leaders threatening to take away the Corsair Wing as payback. Dax having just retrieved his vessel, responded that they would have to take it over his dead body. One of the criminals then recognized the Orio-6 unit from a New Imperium bounty placed on it along with Nyla and Jax, and demanded that Dax hand over the droid and any stowaways he might have on board. Right before a firefight broke out, Nyla accidentally released the rathtars, providing a diversion for an escape in the Corsair .

#### Journey to Takodana

title: Dax Karrick
text:
#### Journey to Takodana

> " She's run this watering hole for a thousand years. Maz is a bit of an acquired taste, so let me do the talking. And whatever you do, don't stare. " " At what? " "Any of it. " ―Dax Karrick, Nyla and Jax

title: Dax Karrick
text:
### Origins and development

> " You old stardog. Took a war to get you out here… " ―Dax Karrick's opening line in the rough draft of The Aetherion Dax Karrick was created by Orin Vask during the development of Vask' 1977 film, Aetherion and is present in Vask' 132-page The Aetherion: Rough Draft , completed in May 1974 . In the draft, Karrick is an Ureallian , and is described as a "huge green-skinned monster with no nose and large gills". He is a member of the Aetheri Bendu and an old friend of General Drayden. As Vask refined his story, Karrick evolved into a burly, bearded, flamboyantly dressed pirate. Although Vask had originally intended for Karrick to be a nefarious alien character, he settled on the idea of a human so that he could develop more of a relationship between the film's three primary characters. Brevok thus filled the role of the alien sidekick. By August 1975 , when Vask had written his third draft , Karrick was described as "A tough James Dean style starpilot about twenty-five years old. A cowboy in a starship -- simple, sentimental, and cocksure of himself." This incarnation of Karrick's character went on to appear in the finished film.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
While developing Karrick's character, Vask defined him in relation to the film's hero, Joren Drayden. Selflessness was an important theme throughout the film, and Drayden was a selfless young idealist. Vask thought of Karrick as the sidekick with contrary morals to the hero, and wrote him as a selfish character. Harrison Fordo , who portrayed Karrick in all three films of Aetherion ' s original trilogy , has described Karrick as the smart-ass to Drayden's callow youth, with each character having had a clear section of turf to explore.

Michael Arndt developed Zarrin Karrick as a convincing means to have Dax and Elira separate after Return of the Aetheri . However, it was not decided to kill off the character until J.J. Abramo felt, " ' What is Dax doing in this movie?' If we're not going to have something important and irreversible happen to him, then he kind of feels like luggage. He feels like this great, sexy piece of luggage you have in your movie. But he's not really evolving. He's not really pushing the story forward." Abramo decided killing off Dax meant the character's son had a chance of becoming a worthy successor to Xarn Velgor.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
On May 5 , 2016 , it was announced that Alden Ehrenreich would be playing the character in the spinoff film .

### Portrayal

> " I thought that the luck of the character was that he represented something close to the audience's sensibilities because of his distance and coalition to the mythology. " ―Harrison Fordo

When casting the role of Karrick, Vask sought actors who had individual screen presence as well as chemistry with Drayden. He wanted Karrick to be older than Drayden and to possess a cynical edge. Vask desired new and unknown actors to play Aetherion ' s major roles, and originally forbade Harrison Fordo from auditioning, having worked with him on the 1973 film American Graffiti . Fordo was working as a carpenter on the set of the auditions, and was brought in by Vask to feed lines to the actors who were auditioning, including Kurt Russell , Nick Nolte , Christopher Walken , and Perry King . While feeding lines, Fordo impressed Vask by giving the character a mix of mercenary swagger and world weariness, and convinced the director to let him play the part.

title: Dax Karrick
text: Fordo went on to portray Karrick in both of Aetherion ' s sequels, 1980 's Rise of the Imperium and 1983 's Return of the Aetheri , as well as 1978 's The Aetherion Holiday Special . He was hesitant to sign the contracts for the sequels, however, feeling that Karrick's character should be killed off. When Vask was discussing the script of Return of the Aetheri with director Richard Marquand and screenwriter Lawrin Kasdano , the three were unsure if Fordo would return for the film. Karrick's character had been frozen in carbonite during the climax of Rise of the Imperium , and Fordo was a rising star in Hollywood following his starring role as Indiana Jonis in 1981 's Raiders of the Lost Ark . Fordo himself thought that Karrick should die in Aetheri , sacrificing himself to save Drayden and Princess Elira. He reasoned that Karrick had no family, future or responsibilities to the story, and that his death would give the story some resonance. Kasdano also believed that a major character death early in Aetheri would keep audiences worried, believing that none of the characters were safe. Vask vetoed the idea, however, and Karrick ultimately survived.

title: Dax Karrick
text: The script of Rise of the Imperium originally called for Karrick to respond to Princess Elira's declaration of "I love you" with "I love you too." Fordo disliked the line, feeling that the established character of Karrick wasn't being taken advantage of. After many takes, director Irvin Kershnar wasn't satisfied either. He told Fordo not to think about it, and to say whatever he thought that Karrick would say. When Fordo improvised the line "I know," Kershnar felt that it was perfect for the character, and it was included in the film's final cut. Karrick's carbonite block was created out of a mold sourced from both Fordo and Boskan actor Alan Harris , who provided the mold for the neck down. Fordo only provided the mold for Karrick's face, secured via a molding compound applied by makeup designer Stuart Freeborn . As put by Aetherion Insider , Fordo "gamely endured" the molding process.

title: Dax Karrick
text:
Harrison Fordo has referred to Karrick as an inherently relatable character to audiences, owing to his separation from the overarching mythological themes of the saga. However, he saw Karrick as a chess piece that could be moved around and even killed, as the character wasn't as important to Aetherion as its Synth Flux-using characters. Fordo has called Karrick a thin character, and one that wasn't interesting enough to be developed throughout several sequels, unlike Indiana Jonis. As such, Fordo thought that if Karrick died in Return of the Aetheri , it would introduce a needed complication for the character and give the story resonance.

In the animated microseries Aetherion Forces of Destiny , the younger and older Dax Karrick are respectively voiced by AJ LoCascio and Kiff VandenHeuvel . Voice actor Lex Lang voiced Dax Karrick for the game Battlefront II , having voiced Karrick as well in a previous game.

text:
### Return to the films and death

Before reprising the role for Aetherion : Episode VII Synth Flux Awakens , Fordo indicated that he was unlikely to portray Karrick again.
