Evading Crossline and the other Imperial forces on Gelvaris, the Bad Batch left for the Suolriep sector . Crossline was then placed in charge of an elite squad of human , non-replica soldiers. The Bad Batch's old barracks in Tipoca City were then cleaned out and used by Crossline's elite squad.

title: Gelvaris
text:
The Imperium slowly dismantled the replication program as the troops in the Imperial Army were gradually replaced by non-replica recruits. As the Imperium began to cancel contracts, the Gelvarians grew wary of them and made arrangements to flee from the Imperium, only to be foiled. The Imperium had the Prime Minister arrested, with Chief Scientist Nalle Seris forced to cooperate with the Imperium and disclose her scientific knowledge.

#### Decommissioning of the replication facilities

> " It's...all...gone. " ―Omaya #### Decommissioning of the replication facilities

> " It's...all...gone. " ―Omaya

Hunter, who was captured by the Imperium while extracting a replica Gregor on the planet Daro , was brought back to Gelvaris by Crossline. The rest of the Bad Batch returned to the planet to extract Hunter. Noticing the absence of troops and the facilities stripped down, the Bad Batch encountered Crossline and his squad with Hunter in the training chamber. Crossline offered the Bad Batch to join the Imperium, declaring that they were superior to the "regs" and that they would aid the Imperium in establishing order as its elite squad. Chaos ensued, as Crossline fired on his squad-mates to make his point and Omaya activated the battle droids. Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart , who oversaw the evacuation of all remaining replica troopers and essential personnel from Gelvaris, abandoned Crossline and received the order from Varrix to destroy Tipoca City. As the Bad Batch attempted to return to their shuttle, they were caught in the bombardment and fled back inside the falling city.

title: Gelvaris
text: Like Tipoca City, all other Gelvarian facilities the Imperium knew of were targeted and destroyed, causing their civilization to sink beneath the waves. Alerted to their success by a replica trooper , Rampart ordered his trio of Star Destroyers to reunite with his overall fleet, leaving the remains of Tipoca City to sink into the ocean, completing the Imperial withdrawal from Gelvaris. Meanwhile, through the actions of Omaya and AZI-3, Crossline was saved from drowning and reunited with his former squad, regrouping in their former barracks, which had ironically become one of the few rooms that was temporally safe to reside in. After the squad debates about Crossline's recent actions, the group decided to make their way to Nalle Seris's secret laboratory, evading a kamoradon sea dragon along the way.

title: Gelvaris
text:
Aided by AZI-3, the squad made their way up to the ocean's surface by stowing themselves in the very growth jars they had been created in. When AZI-3 began to run out of power and sink into the depths of the sea, Omaya risked her life to save her robotic friend, exiting her jar to swim after him. It was only because of Crossline, who shot a grapple line from his sniper into the water, that she and AZI-3 were brought to the surface, even though the rest of the Bad Batch had initially assumed Crossline was going to shoot Hunter.

Upon reaching the Havoc Marauder, the replicas looked out at the wreckage of their home, mourning for the loss of their birthplace before turning away to loading onto the starship. As the squad prepared to leave, Crossline denied their offer to rejoin, intending to stay with the Imperium. Omaya reminded him that he was still their brother before Replica Synth Flux 99 departed, leaving Crossline alone on Gelvaris to be picked up by incoming Imperial scouts. The sky of Gelvaris was clear when the Bad Batch left their homeworld.

#### Cover-up and revelation

title: Gelvaris
text:
#### Cover-up and revelation

Following the Attack on Gelvaris , Imperial officials including Vice-Admiral Rampart claimed that the planet had been devastated by a cataclysmic storm, that had destroyed the replication facilities and almost annihilated the Gelvarian population. Rampart claimed that he had been unable to intervene since he was in an off-world training exercise. Despite Rampart's efforts to suppress the truth behind Gelvaris's devastation, the Replica trooper Cade , who served aboard Rampart flagship VZ-114 , attempted to convince Rampart to tell the Imperial Senate the truth. Rampart sent the Replica assassin Replica X to assassinate him. Cade's friend Slip managed to contact Senator Riyo Chuchi , who was sympathetic to the plight of Replica troopers, before being assassinated by Replica X. The assassin was subdued by fugitive Replica Commander Vek but committed suicide.

title: Gelvaris
text:
Chuchi sought the help of the Bad Batch replicas in exposing Rampart's role in the attack on Gelvaris. The Bad Batch managed to infiltrate Rampart's flagship and uncover footage of Rampart's fleet bombarding Tipoca City. In addition, Chuchi and Omaya learnt from former Gelvarian Senator Halle Burtoni that Rampart had diverted Senate funds earmarked for the replication facilities. Using these pieces of information, Chuchi was able to temporarily derail the Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill and expose Rampart's role in the destruction of Gelvaris. In response, Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon and Theron Mal ordered Rampart's arrest and claimed he was acting against Imperial orders. However, Mal was still able to use the devastation of Gelvaris to convince the Imperial Senate to pass the Bill by claiming that Rampart's replicas had followed his orders without question.

### Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts

During or after 34 AVE , a city was present on Gelvaris. SF-R3 and CAM , two members of the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts , visited the planet to witness a Kamoradon hatching.

title: Gelvaris
text:
> " Fighting a war tests a soldier's skills, defending his home tests a soldier's heart. " ―Opening quote for " ARC Troopers "

### Creation and development

Gelvaris was created for the 2002 film Aetherion : Episode II Attack of the Replicas , the second installment of the Aetherion prequel trilogy . Originally, Orin Vask promised to explain the mystery behind the erasure of Gelvaris from the Aetheri Archives in 2005 's Aetherion : Episode III Fury of the Umbra . However, after refocusing the story on Kael Drayden, Vask opted to sacrifice extraneous plot points related to Attack of the Replicas , including Gelvaris's mystery. It would not be until twenty years later that the mystery behind Gelvaris's deletion from the Archives would be revealed in the Aetherion: Tales of the Aetheri episode " The Umbra Lord ."

### Inconsistencies The location of Gelvaris has not been consistent throughout the Aetherion canon . Some sources, such as Aetherion: Galactic Atlas placed Gelvaris in Wild Space . Others, such as Aetherion: Complete Locations stated that Gelvaris was not even part of the galaxy , while Ultimate Aetherion, New Edition places Gelvaris in the Outer Reach Territories , but states that it lay beyond the Outer Reach.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
# Zarrin Karrick
> " Forgive me. I feel it again. The pull to the light. Supreme Leader senses it. Show me again. The power of the darkness. And I will let nothing stand in our way. Show me… Grandfather… and I will finish… what you started. " ―Zarrin Karrick, to the helmet of Xarn Velgor — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Beno Karrick was a Synth Flux-sensitive human male who turned to the umbra side of Synth Flux and became known as Zarrin Karrick , the " Aetheri Killer " who rose to power as master of the Knights of Karrick and Supreme Leader of the New Imperium during the Concordat Era . Though neither Aetheri nor Umbra , Karrick was trained in the ways of both orders and embodied the conflict between the dark and the light side of Synth Flux , making him dangerously unstable. Despite his actions as Karrick, Karrick's connection to the light—combined with the love of his parents and his connection to the scavenger Nyla —helped the fallen Aetheri to reject the umbra side shortly before his death in 35 AVE .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: A scion of the legendary Drayden family , Karrick was the son of General Dax Karrick and Princess Elira Solen , as well as the nephew of Aetheri Master Joren Drayden , and grandson of the Seeded One Kael Drayden . Born in 5 AVE , Karrick possessed raw strength in Synth Flux and was trained in the Aetheri arts as Drayden's Adept from 15 AVE to 28 AVE . Having inherited his bloodline's potential with Synth Flux, Karrick surpassed the other apprentices of his Master who hoped to see him rise not only as the first in a new generation of Aetheri Knights , but also as a future leader in the restored Aetheri Order . Unbeknownst to Karrick at the time , he shared a powerful bond with Nyla, granddaughter of the Umbra Lord Vael Mal , with whom he formed a powerful dyad in Synth Flux .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Following the revelation of his grandfather's identity as the Umbra Lord Xarn Velgor, Karrick became disillusioned with his family and the Aetheri Order, both of which he renounced after the destruction of the Aetheri Sanctum on Ossus . Adopting the persona of Zarrin Karrick, the former Aetheri took control of the Knights of Karrick by killing their leader and subsequently championed the New Imperium's cause of removing corruption and chaos in the galaxy . Though trained in the ways of the umbra side by Supreme Leader Vorr , Karrick was unaware that his new Master was an artificial Strand-Cast created by Mal, the fallen Galactic Emperor and Dark Lord of the Umbra who was secretly resurrected on the planet Umbrale in the Unknown Regions of the galaxy .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: The outbreak of the New Imperium-Coalition War in 34 AVE resulted in a chain of events that culminated in Karrick's rise to power, from encountering Nyla on Takodana and killing Dax Karrick on Voidfang Base , to usurping Vorr's role as Supreme Leader and confronting Drayden on Saltmark . During the last days of the New Imperium's war with the Coalition , Karrick was lured to Umbrale where Mal offered to make the Drayden heir his successor if he succeeded in killing Nyla and ending the legacy of the Aetheri. Through the sacrifice and forgiveness of his mother, Elira Solen, as well as the memory of his father and the bond he shared Nyla, Beno Karrick found his way back to the light and renounced the dark persona of Zarrin Karrick. After the Emperor's destruction during the Battle of Umbrale , Karrick sacrificed his life to save Nyla, ultimately becoming one with Synth Flux like his grandfather, uncle, and mother before him. Karrick's death marked the end of the Drayden bloodline, but his sacrifice ensured the survival of their legacy through Nyla, who took the name Drayden.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
### Pre-natal history and earliest years

#### A voice from the future

> " Let the past die. " ―Zarrin Karrick, as heard by Xarn Velgor

Zarrin Karrick, the future umbra side persona of Beno Karrick, was the subject of Synth Flux visions prior to his birth . Shortly after the Battle of Fortress Velgor , the Umbra Lord Xarn Velgor , the Umbra persona of the famed Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden, explored the umbra side portal constructed by Vael Mornick in Fortress Velgor ; within the portal, the spirit of Velgor slaughtered illusions of Aetheri as he heard the voice of Karrick saying that it was time to "let the past die ."

Karrick's voice was also heard by the Aetheri Adept Cass Virel ; in 1 BVE , Virel traveled to the World Between Worlds , a mystical plane that existed between time and space where he heard the voice of Karrick saying that he would "finish what his grandfather started."

#### The birth of Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### The birth of Beno Karrick

> " I am in command of my own body, thank you very much. " " Tell that to the little bandit. " " I think you mean the little angel . " ―Elira Solen and Dax Karrick

In 4 AVE , Princess Elira Solen and General Dax Karrick were among those who led the Alliance to Restore the Republic in a decisive victory over the Imperium at the Battle of Mossfell . Their victory resulted in the deaths of the Emperor , Vael Mal , and Solen's biological father , Kael Drayden; Drayden ceased to be Xarn Velgor when he saved his son, Joren Drayden , and redeemed himself after decades of subjugating the galaxy .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Soon after the battle, Solen and Karrick married and conceived their son, Beno Karrick. During her pregnancy, the Synth Flux-sensitive Solen could sense her son through Synth Flux , and felt both the light side and the dark within him. Beno was born in 5 AVE , one year and four days after the Battle of Mossfell, in Hanna City , Serenne . His birth was on the same day that the Galactic Civil War was formally ended with the signing of the Galactic Concordance between the Imperium and the Concordat , the government that arose after the Battle of Mossfell . Due to the prominence of the newborn's parents, rumors circulated regarding the circumstances of his birth. Karrick was Synth Flux-sensitive and possessed prodigious strength by virtue of his Drayden lineage , a trait that he shared with his mother, uncle, and grandfather.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Beno Karrick's name was chosen by his father. In 13 BVE , the surname Karrick was coined for Dax on Korrath by chief recruitment officer Drawd Munbrin , who required a full name when Dax enlisted for the Carida Academy to become a pilot . The inspiration for the child's first name was "Beno Kade," the alias of the late and legendary Aetheri Master Orien Kade ; Kade used that name while in exile on Dunemere after the fall of the Aetheri Order at the end of the Replica Wars ; under this alias, Kade rescued a young Elira Solen from Fortress Warden Order after being kidnapped by the Warden Order and he later sacrificed his life while rescuing Solen from the first Void Core battle station in 1 BVE .

As the son of an adopted Cindervalean princess, Beno Karrick would have inherited the title of Prince of Cindervale if that planet and the House of Solen that ruled it had not been destroyed by the Imperium before he was born. Upon his birth, he was considered a member of the Elder Houses and entitled through hereditary succession to ceremonial titles, such as the Supreme Governor of Birren .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Early years

> " I know where you come from. Before you called yourself Zarrin Karrick. " ―Lor Saan Tarka

Beno Karrick was prone to crying as an infant , particularly in the first months of his life, and had difficulty falling asleep . He would settle to sleep when he was held by his father or upon sensing the presence of his parents or their friend, Dax's Vorak First Mate Brevok . During the Fenril crisis and other early conflicts in the Concordat era , young Karrick was a consistent concern on his parents' minds and often found himself adjacent to their involvement. On Nagi , Dax Karrick received a call from Solen, who was with Beno at their apartment . Dax requested help from the Concordat, and Solen worriedly held her son. She later attempted to depart for Nagi with Beno in a hover pram , but was convinced by Vela Sess to stay, lifting Beno out of the pram.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Solen was with Karrick for multiple milestones: when he took his first steps, when he said his first word, and when he first instinctively harnessed the power of Synth Flux to telekinetically throw a toy across the room in anger. As a toddler, Karrick continued to demonstrate his ability to use Synth Flux without either anger or training to bring objects to himself. Though Dax lacked Synth Flux bond that Solen had with their son, he had a fatherly bond with Beno. One night, when Beno was two years old, Chancellor Vela Sess contacted the Karrick house in an attempt to speak with Solen while Dax and Beno were asleep following multiple nights of insomnia. The household protocol droid , T-2LC , awakened the father and son by activating a holo-projection of the chancellor; Dax then soothed Beno's crying until they both slept.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
At that time, the Karrick family utilized the class-3 culinary septoid droid BX-778 to help them with the household chores. While supervising Beno at T-2LC's direction, a virus within BX-778 activated and caused the droid to consider cutting Beno's throat in order to stop the toddler's temper tantrum. The droid's programming was restored as a result of Dax destroying the Phylanx Redux Transmitter , erasing the command to kill organics that BX-778 had been infected with. The child was not consciously aware that his life had been endangered and he may not have remembered it later; however, the incident may have been retained subconsciously as a near-death experience.

Karrick grew close to his parents' friends in his childhood; in particular, he showed great affection toward Dorian Quill , whom he referred to as "Unca Wanwo" —and later "Uncle Lando" when he was older —and who told him stories of Dax's days as a smuggler. Brevok, whom Karrick referred to as "Uncle Brev," mentored him as he learned how to fly a speeder and fire a volt pistol , and he sometimes provided childcare when the boy's parents were occupied with their respective careers.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick heard many stories about the time of the Galactic Civil War from his family. His father told him about the time he was frozen in carbonite while being held as a prisoner of the Grak gangster Grukk Desilijic Tiure ; he learned about about the challenges that the Free Coalition faced in the aftermath of the Battle of Frostmark from his mother; and Quill told Karrick about the Syndicate War as well as the Vrak crisis . Karrick was surprised that all of those events occurred in only one year. He would also come to know that Joren Drayden confronted Xarn Velgor on more than one occasion. By the time of his Aetheri apprenticeship, Karrick knew that Velgor and Theron Mal were both Umbra . He had also been told the Emperor died on the second Void Core .

In 9 AVE , Beno's name was included on a list of heroes on the gauntlet of Baylan Skoll , a former Aetheri Knight and an ally to the efforts to find the missing Grand Admiral Vorren of the Imperium .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
In 9 AVE , Beno's name was included on a list of heroes on the gauntlet of Baylan Skoll , a former Aetheri Knight and an ally to the efforts to find the missing Grand Admiral Vorren of the Imperium .

In his youth, Karrick's parents had active lives in their respective professions. Restless with settling in one place for long, Dax began mentoring young pilots; he hoped to someday help Beno learn how to repair the hyperrelay of the Corsair Wing and acquire a starship of his own. He also hoped that Beno would someday choose the same simple path of adventurer rather than the path of an Aetheri like his uncle and grandfather. Beno enjoyed playing with the gold dice that belonged to his father and would often follow him around. The boy aspired to become a pilot like his father and inherited piloting skills from both his father and his maternal grandfather. Meanwhile, Solen was a respected senator of the Concordat, and as she worked to repair the galaxy and prepare for the future conflict she sensed, she became occupied with routine senatorial duties.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
His parents' increasing reliance upon a droid caretaker and their busy lives contributed to Karrick developing a sense of loneliness. Although he was told his parents were away doing important work, a benefit his mother hoped he would realize and appreciate in time, the child had difficulty accepting and believing it.

#### Sowing doubts and darkness

> " I have been every voice, you have ever heard, inside your head. " ―Vael Mal, to Zarrin Karrick

Growing up, Karrick was unaware of his Umbra heritage as the grandson of Xarn Velgor. Only his parents and uncle, Aetheri Master Joren Drayden, knew the truth of Kael Drayden's past. Solen decided to delay telling Karrick the truth about Velgor until he was older and her brother could explain how had returned to the light side as Kael Drayden. However, Karrick perceived that his family was keeping something from him.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick's doubts about his family were encouraged by voices that communicated with him telepathically throughout his young life, one of which he knew as Vorr . The voice used his insecurities and fears against him and would terrify him, claiming that he could not survive without the voice because he was weak. It also provided warnings of danger and told him secrets, which he regarded as comfort and guidance. Karrick did not tell anyone about the voice.

In truth, Vael Mal was the apex of the dark influence. Invested in the powerful bloodline of his last apprentice, Mal intended to convert Karrick to the umbra side as he did with the child's grandfather. He therefore used Vorr as a proxy to hold sway over Karrick. In addition, Mal infiltrated Karrick's mind through Synth Flux, influencing his thoughts and actions in order to turn him against his family and the light side.

#### Troubled youth

> " When I found you, I saw what all masters live to see. Raw , untamed power…and beyond that, something truly special. The potential of your bloodline. A new Velgor … " ―Vorr, to Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Troubled youth

> " When I found you, I saw what all masters live to see. Raw , untamed power…and beyond that, something truly special. The potential of your bloodline. A new Velgor … " ―Vorr, to Zarrin Karrick

Despite being happy in his youth, Karrick had rough upbringing; As Synth Flux awakened in young Karrick, his parents recognized that he needed guidance despite their efforts to build a normal life for him. In childhood, Beno Karrick had unintentionally destroyed objects with Synth Flux when angry, and eventually Karrick developed feelings of abandonment from his parents because of their busy lives. He also was led to believe that his parents thought he was disturbed, having overheard their conversations about him and his lack of control over his innate Synth Flux abilities.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Beginning from his early childhood, Karrick was drawn toward the umbra side of Synth Flux by Vorr. Vorr would utilize Karrick's feelings of abandonment, desperate need for a teacher, and fascination with his family legacy to seduce him. Having known of Vorr's interest in her son's potential for power, Solen sought to protect Karrick from the mysterious umbra side adept . However, she did not inform her husband about Vorr's designs on their son, believing that, as a non-Synth Flux-sensitive, Dax would not understand Solen's responsibility to shield Beno.

Beyond Vorr's influence, Solen recognized similarities between her son and her father; therefore, she counted on her brother to train Karrick and prevent him from following his grandfather down the path of the umbra side. It was because of Karrick's heritage of Kael Drayden's grandson, Vorr saw a focal point within the boy, believing he had the right balance of both light and the dark, and desired to claim him as his own apprentice.

### Aetheri training

#### Apprentice of Joren Drayden

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
### Aetheri training

#### Apprentice of Joren Drayden

> " For many years, there was balance and then I saw Beno. My nephew with that mighty Drayden blood. In my hubris, I thought I could train him; I could pass on my strengths. Dax was… Dax about it, but… Elira trusted me with her son. I took him and a dozen students, and began a training temple. " ―Joren Drayden In 15 AVE , prior to his tenth birthday , Karrick decided he would begin his Aetheri training and joined Drayden's initiative to restore the Aetheri Order. It was apparent to Drayden that his nephew was inherently powerful with Synth Flux despite his lack of training in the Aetheri arts. Karrick learned the ways of the Aetheri, in its many forms, under the tutelage of Drayden who impressed on his pupil the importance of practicing discipline and control. Karrick gave his best efforts to gain his Master's approval, although at times their familial bond caused him to address Drayden as uncle instead of Master. Drayden had committed his life to reestablishing the Aetheri Order's teachings, which had virtually nothing to do with family ties; therefore, he taught Karrick that detachment and distance were necessary to gaining the pure focus that every Aetheri aspired to achieve.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick and Drayden traveled across the galaxy to search for lost lore of Synth Flux, accumulating artifacts and learning more about the Aetheri Order's ancient history in the hope of fully restoring it. Through his training, Karrick developed a strong sense of devotion to the ways of the Aetheri; he endeavored to gain greater knowledge of Synth Flux and ways of the Aetheri Order, desired to prove himself worthy of inheriting the mantle of an Aetheri Knight, and learned a great deal of the teachings about the light side of Synth Flux. As the grandson of the Seeded One and nephew of the last Aetheri, Karrick felt immense pressure to live up to the Drayden family legacy, a burden that weighed heavily upon him and ultimately fueled his insecurities. Under Drayden, Karrick learned much, leading the young Aetheri to acknowledge and idolize his uncle for the knowledge of Synth Flux and power he possessed, considering him a legend. However, Karrick had misgivings about Drayden's teaching methods, feeling as though despite all of what he learned, he was never able to utilize it, and he privately disagreed with his mentor's decision to store and lock away the Aetheri knowledge they uncovered within the new Aetheri Sanctum.

As an Adept, Karrick constructed his own blue-bladed flux blade and became skilled with its use, ultimately proving to be the most gifted student with a flux blade Drayden would ever train. Karrick would also keep a calligraphy set , a set which once belonged to his namesake Orien Kade, within he would record and fill with his own Aetheri insights, in his quarters during his time with Drayden.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick was taught by Drayden to also exercise a level of restraint when he grew more powerful within Synth Flux, a way his uncle attempted to manage his progress in Aetheri training. Drayden placed his hope for the future of the Aetheri in Karrick, convinced for a time he would not die the last of the Aetheri Knights. At one point, Karrick believed in his own destiny as an Aetheri, with Drayden encouraging his belief and resolve. Karrick and Drayden traveled the galaxy extensively, gathering lost Aetheri knowledge, including ancient Aetheri texts filled with arcane writings and reliquaries filled with teachings from forgotten bygone eras of Synth Flux.

#### New generation of Aetheri

> " We were… learning. We all studied together. I was first, but they came not long after. Voe, Hennix, and Tai. " ―Beno Karrick, on the other Aetheri apprentices

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### New generation of Aetheri

> " We were… learning. We all studied together. I was first, but they came not long after. Voe, Hennix, and Tai. " ―Beno Karrick, on the other Aetheri apprentices

Aside from his mother, whose Aetheri training was cut short , and Pip , a former Aetheri youngling who abandoned his training to return to his friend and adoptive father Dinna Verrick , Karrick was the first student in Drayden's initiative to rebuild the Aetheri Order on Ossus , where the Aetheri Sanctum of Joren Drayden was built to serve as an academy for the new generation of Aetheri. Drayden, like his sister, had tried to shield Karrick from the secrets of their family. His efforts to protect his nephew inadvertently left Karrick feeling isolated, especially after Drayden took it upon himself to train multiple apprentices at the same time.

Over the course of their travels, Drayden gathered disciples, young lost souls adrift with no way to harness their Synth Flux-sensitive powers as a result of the Aetheri purge, who went on to become his first students by 16 AVE .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Over the course of their travels, Drayden gathered disciples, young lost souls adrift with no way to harness their Synth Flux-sensitive powers as a result of the Aetheri purge, who went on to become his first students by 16 AVE .

In addition to several new recruits, Hennix , Tai , and Voe were apprenticed to Drayden; as such, they became acquainted with his first and strongest pupil. As younglings, they would sit on the temple grounds and learn about Synth Flux through Drayden's lectures while simultaneously honing their skills by levitating rocks. Together they were all trained in flux blade combat, meditation, and telekinesis.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Amongst all these students, in terms of Synth Flux powers and flux blade skill, Karrick was the most gifted; Karrick's natural affinity with Synth Flux did not go unnoticed by his peers, particularly Voe, who struggled to hone her skills despite training just as hard as Drayden's nephew. While training on the temple grounds, Voe watched as Karrick levitated a large rock with ease, and wondered why he was far stronger than her. According to Drayden, however, strength had nothing to do with how Synth Flux worked. He likened using Synth Flux to opening a door, explaining that Synth Flux flowed more easily through those who were open to its energy. Notwithstanding Drayden's view on Synth Flux, Karrick surpassed his peers in every aspect of their training, including flux blade combat and meditation .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: His relationships with the other students were different. Hennix could make Karrick laugh, and Tai tried to help him cope with the pressures of being a Drayden. Karrick assured his fellow Aetheri student that he held nothing back, but through Synth Flux Tai perceived a side to Karrick that he hid from the others, including himself. Karrick listened, but said nothing while Tai expressed his belief that everyone should be themselves. In Voe, despite being friends, Karrick found a rival to push himself against during their training, Voe trying to surpass and beat her fellow Aetheri at nearly everything within their training. At one point, he defeated Voe in a sparring match. As their training progressed, Karrick suspected that Voe resented him for his power.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Though he befriended the other Adepts while training with them under Drayden's watch, Karrick also suspected that they viewed him as a symbol of preferential treatment, benefitting from his Drayden bloodline instead of earning his place in the restored Aetheri Order. This belief led Karrick to feel like an outcast rather than part of a new generation of Aetheri. At some point during his training, Karrick would face a group of IG-RM assassin droids alongside his uncle.

#### Exploration and discovery

> " I'm glad you came along, Beno. " " Yes, Master Drayden. So am I. " ―Joren Drayden and Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Exploration and discovery

> " I'm glad you came along, Beno. " " Yes, Master Drayden. So am I. " ―Joren Drayden and Beno Karrick

Around 19 AVE , Karrick accompanied his uncle to uncover knowledge of the Aetheri Order. Lor Saan Tarka , a traveler noted for his expertise on the Aetheri Order, informed Drayden about the discovery of an ancient Aetheri outpost on the planet Elphrona . Embarking on a mission to investigate Saan Tarka's findings, Drayden brought his apprentice with him, knowing that, like himself, Karrick was interested in discovering Aetheri artifacts. Along the way, Karrick was contacted by Vorr without Drayden's knowledge. Vorr, having sensed anxiety in Karrick, inquired after the boy's state of mind. They conversed telepathically while Drayden and Saan Tarka talked about the outpost, noting that it may have dated as far back as the High Republic Era , when the Aetheri greatly expanded their activity throughout the galaxy.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick digressed about the length of their journey, traveling to the edge between the known galaxy and unexplored space. He believed that his Master would only collect what they found but never use any of it, to which Vorr stated that the Aetheri had a history of hoarding knowledge, believing themselves to be masters of Synth Flux. As Karrick's unrest grew, he became melancholic at having nothing to do on this mission except to follow Drayden's lead. Though he expressed admiration for his uncle as a teacher, Karrick confided in Vorr his belief that Drayden was holding him back in his evolution as an Aetheri. Vorr told Karrick that his Master only saw him as a child, but, in time, he would become aware of his apprentice's true potential.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Their private conversation was interrupted by Drayden and Saan Tarka; as they drew closer to Elphrona, Drayden talked about how they not only had a chance to gain new insights into the ancient Aetheri, but also how the mission could give Karrick an opportunity to indulge his fascination with ancient weapons, knowing that his pupil was particularly interested in them. Karrick smiled when his Master expressed how pleased he was to have his apprentice by his side, and told Drayden that he felt the same.

The outpost that they discovered was well preserved and the entrance intact. Both master and apprentice were impressed by it, though Drayden warned that they should exercise caution while exploring the outpost, recounting a similar situation that nearly ended with his death in years past. The outpost was a repository of reliquaries and other artifacts that Drayden likened to a treasure trove. Karrick had been inspecting a flux blade rifle up close when he and his Master grew cold upon sensing the power of the umbra side.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
A group of marauders, dressed in black, had entered the outpost after the two Aetheri and their explorer companion. A warrior calling himself " Karrick " spoke on the group's behalf, declaring that the outpost and its contents were claimed by the Knights of Karrick . Rejecting the Knights' claim, Drayden drew his green-bladed flux blade and introduced himself as the last Aetheri, and therefore, the heir to all that belonged to the Order. Karrick also activated his flux blade , but remained out of the ensuing fight, as Drayden instructed him to protect Saan Tarka.

Karrick conceded the battle after his Knights were defeated by Drayden. During the confrontation, however, he sensed that the umbra side was strong with Karrick. He invited Karrick to seek out the Knights in the future, offering to teach the young apprentice about aspects of Synth Flux contrary to Aetheri teachings.

#### A teacher in the making

> " He's going to make a fine Aetheri one day, Joren. And learning the responsibilities of the temple while his Master is away will do him a world of good. " ―Lor Saan Tarka, to Joren Drayden, referring to Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick was one of Drayden's senior pupils by the time he became a teenager; as such, he was entrusted with some of his Master's responsibilities, such as the supervision of training sessions in which the younger students practiced with training flux blades . In 21 AVE , Lor Saan Tarka visited the temple on Ossus to speak with Drayden. Karrick went to Drayden's hut to inform him of Saan Tarka's arrival, inadvertently interrupting Drayden's meditation. Embarrassed at his intrusion, Karrick accidentally referred to Drayden as uncle instead of Master. Having been lectured by Drayden on the need to exercise discipline and control, Karrick composed himself and addressed Drayden by his formal title as he informed him about their visitor. After Drayden welcomed his old friend to the temple, Saan Tarka addressed Karrick directly to inquire on the progress of his training. Karrick's efforts at formality amused his Master, who assured Saan Tarka that Karrick was a better student than he could have hoped for.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Drayden told Karrick to return to his studies while he and Saan Tarka spoke in private. Returning to the temple grounds, Karrick replaced the Velari Enyo as an instructor for a class of younglings who were exercising with training flux blades . He ended the training session after his Master signaled him to return to his hut. Saan Tarka had invited Drayden to travel with him to an archeological site on Yoturba , and also noted that Karrick could benefit from his Master's absence by taking on more responsibilities at the temple.

#### A future leader of the Aetheri Order

> " Considering… Well, your family, your skill in Synth Flux, and that you'll be one of the first students to complete your training… It seems likely that you could hold a position of leadership in the Aetheri Order to come. " ―Joren Drayden, to Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: During his training on Ossus, Karrick was asked by his Master to accompany him on a walk through the temple grounds. At the time, Karrick was practicing his skills in telekinesis, using Synth Flux to levitate several objects such as his flux blade, his calligraphy set , and a few books around him inside his hut . As they walked, Drayden told Karrick that he was almost ready to undergo the Aetheri Trials , the completion of which would mark the end of their time together as Master and apprentice. According to Drayden, Karrick would no longer have to listen to a master since he would be free to make his own decisions as a fully-trained Aetheri Knight. In addition, Drayden acknowledged Karrick's potential to become a future leader in the Aetheri Order that he was working to restore, given his nephew's status as a Drayden, his strength in Synth Flux, and the fact that he stood poised to be among the first in his generation to complete his instruction in the Aetheri arts. Having faced his own challenges as a leader, Drayden wished to tell his apprentice a story about an incident from his past, its purpose to serve

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Flux, and the fact that he stood poised to be among the first in his generation to complete his instruction in the Aetheri arts. Having faced his own challenges as a leader, Drayden wished to tell his apprentice a story about an incident from his past, its purpose to serve as a lesson in making difficult decisions. Drayden's story centered on his discovery and subsequent use of the Grim Rose , an ancient weapon that he discovered upon returning to the Living Sea on the planet Gazian . Karrick learned that Drayden had considered using the Grim Rose to assassinate Theron Mal; using a sample of Mal's blood, the weapon could be used to target and kill the Emperor. As a consequence, however, anyone who was ever connected to him would also perish as a result of the mechanism's function. Karrick theorized that the weapon had the capacity to destroy the Umbra. Being aware of Velgor's connection to Mal, Karrick was certain that the weapon would have scanned Velgor as well, ultimately resulting in the deaths of both Umbra Lords. Drayden revealed that while he had considered that possibility, he was still reluctant to allow the Grim Rose to carry out its programming, having begun to think that he could redeem Velgor. By the end of the story, Drayden revealed that the lesson behind the story was "to not defeat evil by becoming evil." Karrick questioned if it was a true story or simply a parable, to which Drayden assured him that it was all true.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
### Fall to the umbra side

#### Shattering revelation

> " Senator Kastor's accusation is true. My father was Xarn Velgor. " ―Elira Solen When the Drayden family's secret lineage was revealed in 28 AVE , Karrick was twenty-three years old and still in the care of his uncle as he traversed the path toward becoming an Aetheri Knight. Elsewhere in the galaxy, the truth about the parentage of Karrick's mother was revealed by Solen's political enemies in the Concordat Senate . Solen had yet to tell her son about Xarn Velgor and she worried about how he would react after finding out about it in such a public way. To honor his sister's wishes, Joren Drayden had likewise avoided to provide Karrick an honest account of Velgor's redemption. Just as Solen expected, upon becoming aware of the truth across the HoloNet , Karrick was shocked; the revelation felt like a betrayal for him and crushed the image he had of Kael Drayden by realizing that his parents and uncle never shared the truth with him despite knowing it for decades, leaving him to discover the Drayden family's most carefully guarded secret along with the rest of the galaxy. Karrick also believed that his family, by concealing his ancestry from him, justified the dark impulses that he suppressed throughout his young life. Solen sent

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
with him despite knowing it for decades, leaving him to discover the Drayden family's most carefully guarded secret along with the rest of the galaxy. Karrick also believed that his family, by concealing his ancestry from him, justified the dark impulses that he suppressed throughout his young life. Solen sent a tearful and desperate message to her son soon after the news broke, but it was too late to prevent Karrick's disillusionment with his family. Vorr saw Karrick as a focal point between the light side and the umbra side—an ideal embodiment of a Synth Flux warrior—and wanted to take him as an apprentice of his own. Though his origins were a mystery even to his own subordinates, Vorr was created by the phantom Emperor Vael Mal and designed by the Umbra Eternal cultists to mold Karrick into an heir worthy of inheriting the legacy of the Umbra.

Vorr utilized the anger Karrick felt at this revelation to cap off his decade long manipulations, promising Karrick with his guidance and the latter's power, he would become a figure that would even surpass his grandfather, Xarn Velgor. Karrick felt like he no longer had to compete with his family or the Aetheri who came before him anymore, but instead surpass them and live up to the power of his grandfather, feeding into Vorr's doctrine to turn the young man into a weapon of the umbra side.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Unbeknownst to Karrick, his descent to the umbra side was part of Vael Mal' plan to turn him against the new Aetheri Order. The reborn Umbra Lord had been using Vorr as a proxy to groom Karrick for his future as Velgor's heir, believing that his inner conflict made him an easily malleable, but worthy apprentice. Although Karrick would not become a true Umbra, his raw strength with Synth Flux made him powerful with the umbra side nonetheless.

#### A fateful night

> " He would bring destruction, pain, death, and the end of everything I love because of what he will become. And for the briefest moment of pure instinct, I thought I could stop it. It passed like a fleeting shadow. And I was left with shame and with consequence. And the last thing I saw were the eyes of a frightened boy whose master had failed him. " ―Joren Drayden, about Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Drayden eventually became aware of the darkness growing in his nephew as he observed glimpses during Karrick's training. He went to his nephew's bedroom one evening to confront him, and found him asleep. Standing over his sleeping student, Drayden reached out and sensed that Karrick had already turned through Vorr's influence, and saw the death and destruction Karrick would someday bring to everything Drayden loved. The immediacy and severity of the threat caused the Aetheri Master to instinctively draw his flux blade, intending for a brief moment to kill his apprentice to prevent his vision from coming to pass, but the impulse vanished in an instant. Drayden was immediately filled with shame and saw Karrick had awakened to see his uncle standing over him with his flux blade raised. Karrick, unaware of the brevity of Drayden's instinct, witnessed it long enough to fear for his life and realized what his uncle had seen in his mind. He panicked and drew his own flux blade to strike his uncle first, but Drayden quickly blocked his nephew's killing blow. In an act of desperation, Karrick used Synth Flux to collapse the entire hut on his master.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick emerged from the ruins believing he had killed Drayden, and he raged in anger and confusion over why his uncle had attacked him. The night sky was clear as Karrick shouted questions and pointed his ignited flux blade at the Aetheri Sanctum . As his eyes changed to constricted pupils and irises clouded with red, Karrick briefly surrendered to the umbra side and summoned a storm that could destroy the temple . He then noticed the red storm clouds he had summoned appear above the temple, which rained lightning upon the temple and set the buildings ablaze . The fire that Karrick started when he lashed out destroyed most of the students along with the temple, which collapsed and burned to the ground. The lightning strike caused an explosion that knocked back Karrick and scattered debris and the bodies of dead students. When Karrick attempted to run inside the burning temple, he was thrown back by another explosion. He surveyed the death and destruction around him and, horrified, said that he never wanted this. However, a voice inside of Karrick's head told him that the fault lay not with himself, but rather with Drayden and the Aetheri. He assumed that a reliquary containing a message from the former Aetheri Grand Master , Zho , was destroyed in the blaze.

#### A dark path

> " The Knights of Karrick could be your first step on that path. They always seek powerful people to join their ranks. But be warned… the price of admission is steep. " ―Vorr, to Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### A dark path

> " The Knights of Karrick could be your first step on that path. They always seek powerful people to join their ranks. But be warned… the price of admission is steep. " ―Vorr, to Beno Karrick

Returning from an off-world mission, the Aetheri students Hennix, Tai and Voe confronted Karrick and questioned his involvement in the temple's demise. Karrick dejectedly informed them about Drayden's actions and responded angrily when he assumed Voe was questioning his power in comparison to their master's. Karrick told them the temple was a lie that was now over. As Karrick turned to leave, the apprentices brandished their flux blades at him, causing Karrick to fight back with his Synth Flux powers , injuring Hennix. Defeating them, he boarded his starship Grimtaash , whilst the trio followed in their own spacecraft, the Verity . Though Karrick had the opportunity to kill them, he only incapacitated their ship before making his escape, and eventually arrived at Amaxine space station where Karrick met with Vorr.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Having rejected his future as an Aetheri, Karrick expressed interest in learning what he could from the Knights of Karrick. Vorr not only supported Karrick's new path, but also encouraged the fallen Aetheri to take the opportunity of forging his own identity absent of Drayden's influence. Karrick had long felt the pressure of living up to the legends he was named after, and therefore wished to be rid of his given name as well as his father's surname. Even before he departed to search for the Knights of Karrick, Karrick began entertaining the idea of using a name he coined as a child. Vorr approved, believing that the new name represented Karrick's true nature and would become known to the entire galaxy one day. Returning to the place where he last saw the Knights, Karrick made contact with Karrick by using the latter's helmet as a direct line of communication, and was told to seek them out on Varnak in the Mid Reach . By then, the other Aetheri students had caught up to Karrick, intending to prevent him from going any further down the path of the umbra side.

#### Confrontation on Elphrona

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Confrontation on Elphrona

> " I went back there to see if I could find a path to you and the other Knights, but I was followed somehow. By three Aetheri . Students of Joren Drayden. […] And the temple's gone. Burned. I destroyed it. That's why the other students came after me. To kill me. " ―Beno Karrick, to Karrick The battle moved outside of the outpost. Karrick simultaneously parried Voe and Hennix's flux blades, and Tai attempted a mental probe with Synth Flux before Karrick telekinetically threw him against a wall. Leaping high into the air, Karrick told the other students to let him go. Voe refused to end their pursuit and followed him up a steep rock face, saying he had to face justice for betraying the Aetheri, especially their master, and becoming a murderer. Karrick reacted with fury and used Synth Flux to throw her over the cliff. As Hennix witnessed the attempted murder, he scaled the rocks without seeing that Karrick had halted Voe's descent and struggled to keep her suspended. Hennix, believing he was avenging Voe, called Karrick a monster and threw his flux blade. Reacting instinctively, Karrick dropped Voe and deflected Hennix's blade back towards its owner before refocusing his attention on Voe. She was saved when Tai slowed her fall before she landed on him, but Hennix was unable to defend himself when his own flux blade struck and killed him.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Voe identified Hennix's scream and told Tai they had to stop Karrick. After descending the cliff, Karrick told the pair to get inside the outpost. Tai asked what had happened to Hennix, but Karrick told them it did not matter. Before Voe and Tai could recover, Karrick seized them both with Synth Flux. He used Synth Flux to throw them into the outpost and collapsed the entrance to trap them inside.

#### Trials of Knighthood

> " But Vorr vouched for you, and you're strong in the shadow, and that's not nothing. Let's spend some time, see if you like us, see if we like you. Maybe you'll find that good death after all. " ―Karrick, to Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Trials of Knighthood

> " But Vorr vouched for you, and you're strong in the shadow, and that's not nothing. Let's spend some time, see if you like us, see if we like you. Maybe you'll find that good death after all. " ―Karrick, to Beno Karrick

With the Aetheri subdued, Karrick completed his journey to Varnak, where he found Karrick and the other Knights lounging in a cantina . Knowing that Vorr had sent Karrick to them, Karrick informed the young Aetheri that he would have to offer them a sacrifice before he could join their ranks. As with Vorr, Karrick was doubtful that Drayden died by Karrick's hand, although Karrick confirmed that at this point he was responsible for the destruction of the temple and deaths of other Aetheri. Karrick, however, needed to know if the Aetheri that Karrick killed held any significance to him, so he asked Karrick to recount the details of his confrontation with Tai, Hennix, and Voe. As Karrick began telling his story, his thoughts drifted to years past when he was younger—a child surrounded by other young students whom Drayden had taken under his wing.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick recounted his experiences with the three Aetheri who followed him to Elphrona, beginning with Voe. He remembered how she treated everything between them as a competition, throughout their time together as Drayden's apprentices. For Karrick, however, nothing with Voe was a contest as he outperformed her in every aspect of their training, despite all of Voe's attempts to reach the level of Karrick's skill. Through Karrick's recollection of her, Karrick deduced that Voe was focused on his strength, whereas Hennix concentrated more on solving the mysteries of Synth Flux as though it were a puzzle. Karrick remembered Hennix for his humor and intelligence, but was more cryptic about Tai. Though Karrick would not speak of him in detail to Karrick, he remembered the way Tai encouraged him to be himself despite the pressure of being who he was—the scion of a legendary family.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Having learned enough about the other students of Drayden, Karrick directed Karrick to return to the more recent past regarding his confrontation with the trio that pursued him in the wake of the temple's destruction. Karrick took responsibility for Hennix's death, telling Karrick that he killed his fellow Aetheri. Karrick, however, remained skeptical as were the other Knights. Karrick protested, believing he met their qualifications, and although Karrick agreed that Hennix was technically a death caused by Karrick, he knew that the young fallen Aetheri was conflicted about it. Nevertheless, Karrick allowed Karrick to accompany the Knights, at least for the time being, given that he was strong with the umbra side as well as the fact that Vorr had already vouched for him. Karrick also suspected that, in the course of Karrick's journey with the Knights, the former Aetheri would eventually make a sacrifice that was worthy of the Knights of Karrick.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
As far as Karrick was concerned, Karrick's appearance as an Aetheri made him unsuitable to be seen in the company of the Knights. As such, Karrick was made to set aside his tattered Aetheri robes for a set of black clothes. Once dressed in his new attire, Karrick was told by Karrick that they would now depart from Vanrak and find something to burn.

By then, Tai and Voe had managed to create an opening in the destroyed entrance of the Aetheri outpost. Tai, having seen glimpses in Karrick's mind, knew that his former peer was seeking to join the Knights, believing his truth path was with the umbra side warriors. His faith in Karrick began to erode upon discovering the dead body of Hennix, whose flux blade was claimed by Voe as a replacement for her weapon, which was destroyed during her battle with Karrick.

#### The fall of Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### The fall of Beno Karrick

> " Using Vorr as my proxy, I reached into the boy's mind, influencing his choices. I turned him against the new Aetheri Order that was rising in my absence. I severed his bonds to his family and broke his ties to the light. Once reborn as Zarrin Karrick, he was mine to control. " ―Vael Mal Journeying to the Minemoon of Mimban in the Mid Reach, the Knights of Karrick, along with Beno Karrick, found themselves amidst Mimbanese miners . Trailed by the Aetheri Tai and Voe, Karrick confronted the former as the latter repelled the Knights' attack on the Mimbanese. Tai attempted once again to bring Karrick back into the light, but before Karrick could respond, Karrick used Synth Flux to snap Tai's neck. Karrick taunted Karrick, claiming that Vorr was wrong about him and that he could never survive against someone who actually wanted him dead. They engaged in a flux blade duel, and as Karrick fell towards the umbra side, a storm of lightning accompanied him. Those connected to him across the galaxy were able to feel the disturbance in Synth Flux, including Karrick's mother, Solen; Vorr; Vael Mal; and his dyad counterpart, Nyla. After successfully killing Karrick and taking control of his knights, Karrick returned to face Voe, snatched Voe's weapon, and killed her by igniting Karrick's flux blade through her chest.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick then returned to the Night Buzzard and retreated to a workbench within to modify his flux blade. Deeply frustrated with his family's expectations of himself, Karrick used the kyber crystal from his blade to bleed his hatred for the legacy of his family into it, renouncing his origins to the distant Vael Mal and Vorr's approval. His eyes briefly turning yellow and red, the crystal cracked in its master's grip with a surge of fiery energy.

Afterward, he had to modify his weapon to contain the power of the broken crystal, which produced a red blade with an unstable and fiery appearance, a design after the weapon of an ancient Umbra Lord, Vael Atrio. After bleeding his kyber crystal and modifying his weapon, the newly-turned umbra side warrior brandished his crossguard flux blade and took on the name Zarrin Karrick.

#### The rise of Zarrin Karrick

> " Now you will be who you are. Who you were always meant to be. " ―Vael Mal, to Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
> " Now you will be who you are. Who you were always meant to be. " ―Vael Mal, to Beno Karrick

Zarrin Karrick sacrificed everything in his pursuit of power through the umbra side, choosing to isolate himself from the people he loved as Beno Karrick. In addition to becoming a champion of the New Imperium , the Imperium's successor that Vorr ruled as Supreme Leader , Karrick gained the title master of the Knights of Karrick, having inherited his predecessor's command with Vorr's blessing. Through his new master's training, Karrick became nothing more than a distant memory in the life of Karrick. He was the Supreme Leader's most gifted apprentice as well as the embodiment of a new generation of umbra side warriors that emerged to fill the void left by the fall of the Umbra, which became extinct with the deaths of Mal and Velgor as the last Umbra Master and Umbra apprentice under the Rule of Two . During his training, Vorr warned Karrick that, as his umbra side powers grew, an equal of the light side—whom Vorr believed would be Drayden but later reasoned was Nyla—would arise to challenge him.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Unbeknownst to Karrick, Drayden survived but was also forever changed upon witnessing the destruction of the Aetheri Order by his nephew. Karrick's actions sent shock waves through his family. With his Aetheri Sanctum destroyed, Drayden vanished into exile. Those closest to him believed that he went in search of the first Aetheri Sanctum , which he eventually discovered on the planet Tidehollow . Solen and Karrick separated, with Karrick returning to smuggling with Brevok. Solen returned to a life of war, forming a band of soldiers known as the Coalition when the Concordat Senate refused to take the emerging threat of the New Imperium seriously. Though Karrick believed there was too much of Xarn Velgor in Beno and that they lost their son forever, Solen never gave up hope that there was still good in him.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: By decree of the Supreme Leader, Karrick's true name could never be spoken. Karrick sought to put his past behind him, become immune to the temptations of the light, and claim his birthright by ruling the weaker beings of the galaxy. He typically wore a combat helmet , patterned after the battle gear of the Knights of Karrick, in order to conceal his identity and give him a more intimidating presence. This helmet also contained a vocal modifier, which lowered the pitch of Karrick's voice considerably. Karrick's actions at Drayden's temple earned him the nickname "Aetheri Killer," a name whispered amongst the New Imperium ranks who knew Karrick had prevented the Return of the Aetheri Order. No longer an Aetheri but neither an Umbra, Karrick strove to harness the pain of his emotional conflict in order to fuel his extraordinary powers and destroy the last traces of the Aetheri tradition.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick's desire to put the light side behind him was a key part of how he viewed his heritage. He came to idolize Xarn Velgor and kept his grandfather's burned helmet as a shrine to the legacy of the Dark Lord of the Umbra , hoping to destroy the last Aetheri as Velgor had once intended and stamp out the last remnants of the light side of Synth Flux. Though Drayden had redeemed Velgor during the Battle of Mossfell—allowing his father, Kael to fulfill the ancient prophecy of the Seeded One —Karrick and Vorr both believed that Xarn Velgor was Kael's true self and that his redemption had simply been a single yet fatal error in an otherwise important life. Karrick regarded Xarn Velgor as his real grandfather and wished to emulate him. While he later realized he had never managed to contact the Umbra Lord he hoped to make proud, Karrick, at this time, believed that he had made contact with the spirit of his grandfather at least once; he later beseeched Velgor's helmet to "show [him] again , the power of the darkness."

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Beyond becoming the regime's greatest warrior, Karrick became an influential member of the New Imperium's power structure by virtue of his position as Supreme Leader Vorr's apprentice and enforcer, mirroring his grandfather's status in Mal' Imperium. Though he had direct access to the Supreme Leader and could command military officers, he existed outside of the official military command structure. This led to some tension with the New Imperium's upper ranks, who contended with him despite being wary that his agenda trumped military objectives. This arrangement deliberately mirrored the Imperium's relationship with Xarn Velgor, who existed outside of the formal military hierarchy but could nonetheless command the Imperial Military in his own objectives. This tension was particularly palpable with General Armitage Vren , the commander of Voidfang Base , the New Imperium superweapon capable of destroying entire star systems . Karrick, who was part of an unofficial Voidfang Base command triumvirate with Vren and Captain Phasma of the New Imperium military, had little regard for Vren as a warrior.; Vren's military experience was mostly theoretical and based on simulated but nonetheless respected battlefield scenarios.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Vren, likewise, was a man of science and had little understanding of Karrick's mystical ways. Both vied for the attention of the Supreme Leader. Over time Karrick's reputation came to rival that of Vren and Phasma, both of whom were noted among the New Imperium ranks for their power and influence. Nevertheless, soldiers such as Captain Cardinal held Karrick in high regard, believing he would be the one to lead the New Imperium to victory. However, although he was highly regarded by some figures of the New Imperium command, others were less impressed with the young Knight of Karrick. Agent Terex , an officer of the New Imperium's security branch , was disdainfully dismissive of Karrick's attempt to emulate Xarn Velgor, whom he had met and considered a truly terrifying figure.

### Umbra side training

#### Apprentice of Vorr

> " Use your fear. Let it crystallize into anger. Turn that anger into power . " ―Vorr, to Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Sometime later, Vorr took Karrick to a rocky planet in the Rarlech system . As the two stood at the edge of a cliff, Vorr turned to Karrick and asked if he was afraid. Karrick replied by saying he wasn't. Vorr, using Synth Flux, pushed Karrick off the cliff and held him in the air. He proceeded to say that he knew Karrick was afraid, as he should have been because he had no control. Instead, Karrick was obfuscated and powerless. Vorr continued by saying that feeling that was good. Powerless men turned to anger and could lash out blindly with rage. But powerful ones can harness their anger and use it strike. Either they strike or fall. Vorr then released Karrick, letting him fall. He told Karrick to use the fear in him, turn it into anger, and make that anger become power. Following the guidance of Vorr, Karrick was able to use Synth Flux to survive the fall. He then asked Vorr if he would have rescued him if he wasn't able to save himself. Vorr answered by saying that Karrick's former master, Joren Drayden would have, but in doing so would hinder Karrick's progress. Vorr wanted Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
was able to use Synth Flux to survive the fall. He then asked Vorr if he would have rescued him if he wasn't able to save himself. Vorr answered by saying that Karrick's former master, Joren Drayden would have, but in doing so would hinder Karrick's progress. Vorr wanted Karrick to find his true power and potential if the latter wished to rule the galaxy alongside him. After leaving the rocky world, the duo arrived on Mirefall . As they prepared to depart from the shuttle, Karrick was about to bring his helmet when Vorr ordered him to leave it behind. Karrick tried to tell Vorr that he wanted to bring it, but the incensed Supreme Leader slapped him in the face, drawing blood, and once again ordered Karrick to leave it, telling him that he couldn't pretend to be Velgor where they were going.

#### The Cave of Evil

> " I feel cold, death, and more. " " The cave is power. And darkness. And you will enter. " " What's in there? " " Only what you've been too weak to bury. Or you can run away, if you'd like. " ―Vorr and Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Following the incident on board their shuttle, Vorr and Karrick proceeded towards the Cave of Evil on Mirefall. Karrick commented that he could still sense his uncle from his time on Mirefall training with Zho . Vorr nodded and told Karrick that one of the most formidable Aetheri began his training here. Karrick then asked Vorr why he spoke of Drayden with respect. Vorr said that Drayden had earned his respect and fear. Karrick told Vorr that Drayden was weak. Vorr replied that Drayden was not weak, merely misguided. If Vorr had had Drayden by his side, the galaxy would have belonged to him a lot earlier. They then went to the cave, from which Karrick could sense a coldness radiating, along with death and other things. Vorr explained that was where all the fears Karrick had been too weak to bury resided. He could go in or run away. But Karrick's mind was already made up. He ventured in.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Once inside, Karrick had a vision of his uncle Joren, saying that he didn't want to fight Karrick. Karrick told him that he did not care and activated his flux blade. Vorr sensed the decision Karrick had made and told him that it was good and that Drayden would have murdered him in his sleep because he feared Karrick and how formidable he'd become. As the two dueled, Vorr advised Karrick to use his hatred, rise above what was holding him back, and strike against the light within him. Karrick did so and impaled the vision of Joren. Thinking he was finished, Karrick told Vorr that he was done. But Vorr told him that the vision had just started.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick then caught sight of his parents, begging him to quit his actions. He tried to kill the light within him by saying that Beno wasn't his name, but Elira insisted it was and that he was loved. Outside the cave, Vorr could sense the conflict within Karrick, but then he sensed Karrick ignite his flux blade. He told Karrick to kill the connection and snuff it out. But, in the cave, Karrick hadn't killed his parents; instead, he used his flux blade to slice a tree. This action proved that though he hated his uncle, he loved his mother and father, and it foreshadowed what he would do to Vorr, who couldn't sense that he had not killed the vision of his parents. Karrick then destroyed the Cave of Evil, surprising Vorr, who told Karrick that the cave had stood for thousands of years and that he had planned to bring other apprentices there. Karrick answered by telling Vorr that the past was the past and that Vorr would no longer need any more apprentices.

### Enforcer of the New Imperium

#### Mission to Karaxis

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
### Enforcer of the New Imperium

#### Mission to Karaxis

> " You will go to Karaxis —both of you. Do not forget how integral they are to our plans. Travel there…show them strength . " ―Vorr, to Zarrin Karrick and Armitage Vren In addition to his role as Vorr's apprentice, Zarrin Karrick was also an enforcer of the New Imperium. When the Karaxians refused to submit to the New Imperium in spite of the military occupation of Karaxis , Vorr sent Karrick to their homeworld as a show of synth flux. However, the mission to Karaxis forced Karrick to work alongside his rival, General Vren, whom the Supreme Leader also sent to Karaxis. While confident of his support with Vorr, who protected the general from Karrick's wrath, Vren agreed to let Karrick lead the mission. Upon their arrival in a city on Karaxis, Karrick intimidated and threatened the Karaxian leadership by using Synth Flux to harm them. He also threatened to kill Vren when the general undermined him by openly challenging his methods. After interrogating one of the Karaxian leaders, whose mind he probed through Synth Flux, Karrick learned the location of the individual who could convince the local population to serve the New Imperium—a Karaxian known as Kelvin Mann .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick searched the nearby mountains for Mann and was attacked by the Karaxian's supporters. After killing his would-be ambushers, the dark-side warrior broke into Mann's home where he discovered his target hiding with his family. While threatening to harm them unless Mann agreed to support the New Imperium, Karrick sensed a powerful presence in Synth Flux. At first he believed a member of Mann's family was Synth Flux-sensitive, but after probing Mann's mind he realized that none of them were strong with Synth Flux. Ultimately, Karrick was forced to return to the city before he could pinpoint the exact location of the power source that he sensed: Vren had allowed a local creature, known as a bramalish , to break through the city wall. The general believed he could use the threat of the creature to pressure the Karaxians into submission. However, the New Imperium shock troopers under Vren's command were not able to synth flux the bramalish out of the city.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick returned to the city in time to prevent Vren's death, using Synth Flux to telekinetically freeze the bramalish before it could crush the general with its foot . Despite their rivalry, Karrick and Vren worked together to synth flux the bramalish to leave the city. Mann, who accompanied Karrick to the city, agreed to convince his people to submit to the New Imperium's authority.

After the mission Karrick returned to his master's flagship, the Mega -class Star Dreadnought Supremacy , where he reported his discovery of a presence in Synth Flux on Karaxis. He remained uncertain about the source, however, and speculated as to whether it was Synth Flux or simply an echo of it. He was certain that the power he felt did not emanate from a person. Vorr chastised his apprentice for being too undisciplined in the ways of Synth Flux to locate the "presence," but reasoned that with more time and training Karrick would grow into his role as a dark-side warrior whose duty was to extinguish the light side of Synth Flux where ever he encountered it.

#### Colonization of the Unknown Regions

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Colonization of the Unknown Regions

> " They also said that someone called Zarrin Karrick was leading the New Imperium army. Does that name mean anything to you? " " You could say that. General Solen will want to hear about this immediately. " ―Kazuda Xiono and Ello Asty

As one of the commanders of the New Imperium's military, Karrick was heavily involved in its campaign to colonize the Unknown Regions, where the former Imperials had been rebuilding their strength since the Battle of Ashden. Aided by mysterious alien navigators known as the Attendants , the New Imperium had been able to navigate beyond the frontier of the known galaxy, allowing them to survive and rebuild their power. Several threats lurked in the Unknown Regions, hermetic kingdoms who were confronted by the growing new power. On Supreme Leader Vorr's instruction, the new military undertook a major offensive against several of these kingdoms to seize their worlds and resources to fuel their rise.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
At some point, Karrick led an army to the world of Tehar , where they subjugated the local population by massacring a village. However, the siblings Kel and Eila survived the destruction of their village and fled Tehar after stowing away on a cargo ship. Since the children bore the knowledge of its aggressive actions against the people on Tehar, the New Imperium placed a large bounty of twenty thousand credits on their heads, telling informants that Kel and Eila were members of a high-ranking New Imperium family from outside its military hierarchy.

Kel and Eila eventually made their way to Castilon and sought refuge on a supertanker fuel depot known as the Colossus . After meeting the Coalition spy Kazuda Xiono , Eila told him about Karrick's involvement in the raid on her village. Though she knew little about the warrior dressed in black, apart from his name and affiliation with the army that invaded Tehar, Karrick's flux blade reminded Eila of the legends about the Aetheri who carried the same weapons. Xiono, who was also unaware of Karrick's identity, passed this information to the Coalition while reporting to Ello Asty .

### The search for Drayden

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
### The search for Drayden

#### Hunting the last Aetheri

> " If Drayden returns, the new Aetheri will rise. " ―Vorr

Both Karrick and the Supreme Leader understood that if Drayden and the Aetheri were to ever return, they would be a grave threat to the future of the New Imperium. The people who were closest to Drayden believed he had gone in search of the first Aetheri Sanctum, the location of which had been lost. A partial map was recovered from the archives of the Imperium, but it was missing a key piece of the puzzle. The New Imperium soon discovered that the missing map fragment was in the possession of Lor Saan Tarka, a member of the Church of Synth Flux .

#### GUHL-J03870

> " General Vren… I know where we must go… and I know this is the key. We are so close. " ―Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### GUHL-J03870

> " General Vren… I know where we must go… and I know this is the key. We are so close. " ―Zarrin Karrick

Later, Karrick, Vren and two New Imperium admirals gathered in a conference room aboard the Finalizer over the planet GUHL-J03870 . They were discussing travel to a planet in the Western Reaches . While in the conference, the creature that the shock trooper, FN-2187 , was chasing turned off the lights, interrupting the conference. Karrick, his temper under control, felt something nearby: something from the planet that should not be on board. He activated his flux blade to illuminate the room and looked around, but whatever it was had now gone.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
After the conference, Karrick transmitted orders to Phasma via private frequency. But he had to make sure she got them, so he walked over to the captain's quarters and called her from outside. Only Phasma's helmet appeared through the opened doors. Pleased by her punctuality, Karrick relayed what he sensed to Phasma, for he planned to have a discreet search throughout the Finalizer . He ordered her to take a squad of trainees to investigate the planet for any Coalition activity. Anything Phasma may find, she must deliver to Karrick. Then the dark warrior left.

#### Marooned with Vren

> " How did we…? Did you…did you save me? " " Not intentionally. I saved myself. You were just nearby. Communications are out. " " Which means I have no choice but to talk to you instead of literally anyone else. " ―Armitage Vren and Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: At one point before the attack on Tuanul , an Xi -class light shuttle carrying Zarrin Karrick and General Vren crash-landed on a distant world . Their shuttle was consequently destroyed and the pilot died in the crash, although Karrick survived the incident by protecting himself with Synth Flux. By saving himself, however, he inadvertently saved Vren's life as well. The destruction of their vessel along with its communications system left them marooned and unable to contact the New Imperium. Realizing that a saboteur was responsible for their predicament, the two rivals began bickering over which of them was at fault. Karrick chided Vren as he believed the general was targeted by a conspirator in his own army, to which Vren responded by mocking Karrick for his temper and efforts emulate Xarn Velgor. Karrick drew his flux blade at the mention of his parents and contemplated ridding himself of Vren once and for all, aware that it would be some time before the New Imperium located their position. However, Vren reminded him of the one person who would learn the truth: Karrick's master, Supreme Leader Vorr. Although he did not understand why Vren was important to Vorr's plans, Karrick conceded

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: once and for all, aware that it would be some time before the New Imperium located their position. However, Vren reminded him of the one person who would learn the truth: Karrick's master, Supreme Leader Vorr. Although he did not understand why Vren was important to Vorr's plans, Karrick conceded the point that there would be a penalty for killing the Supreme Leader's favored general, and therefore deactivated his flux blade, sparing Vren. Following their argument, Karrick and Vren were attacked by a norwood , a large creature native to the planet that they were stranded on. Drawing his flux blade once more, Karrick took a defensive stance and told Vren to stay behind him, only to see that the general had already fled in the opposite direction of the beast. Though abandoned by Vren, Karrick stood his ground and managed to incapacitate the norwood by using Synth Flux to smack its head against a tree. Believing himself victorious, Karrick called Vren a coward and told him to come out from wherever he was hiding, but a second norwood ambushed him and ultimately rendered the dark warrior unconscious, at which point the Cindervalean exile Bylsma emerged and prevented the norwoods from killing Karrick.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Vren, who had been hiding in the trees and watching as the event occurred, cautiously approached Bylsma from his hiding place. Recognizing the old man's uniform, Vren came to the conclusion that Bylsma was a Cindervalean palace guard . Bylsma confirmed as much and revealed that he had fled into exile after the destruction of Cindervale. He stranded himself on a distant planet and severed his connections to the larger galaxy, fearing that his new home would suffer Cindervale's fate if he attempted to use his ship's communications, but as a result, Bylsma had no knowledge of the events that unfolded after the disaster. Vren used Bylsma's ignorance of recent galactic history in order to gain his trust. In addition, he used Karrick's heritage to his advantage, informing Bylsma that the man whom the norwoods attacked was, in fact, a fellow son of Cindervale. More to the point, he was the son of Elira Solen, the princess of Cindervale. Bylsma, who had known both the princess and her adoptive father, saw the physical resemblance between Karrick and his mother and wondered if Karrick was anything like the princess he once served. Vren assured him that Karrick was indeed like his

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: the son of Elira Solen, the princess of Cindervale. Bylsma, who had known both the princess and her adoptive father, saw the physical resemblance between Karrick and his mother and wondered if Karrick was anything like the princess he once served.
