Vren assured him that Karrick was indeed like his mother, even if he would have denied it. Bylsma built a stretcher and carried Karrick to his home, where Vren convinced the retired soldier to give him access to the ship's communications so that they could be rescued. After regaining consciousness, Karrick played along with Vren's deception until a shuttle arrived to retrieve them. The shuttle ramp lowered revealing Captain Phasma and a squad of shock troopers, leading to the norwoods' immediate death by volt pistol fire. Karrick boarded the shuttle in silence alongside Vren, who told the captain to spare the old man's life but to disable his communications array, leaving Bylsma truly stranded and alone. They reported directly to Vorr via hologram after their return to Voidfang Base; although Karrick offered to punish the culprit responsible for sabotaging the shuttle, Vren insisted on handling the matter personally, given that the conspiracy was directed at him. Vorr approved the general's request, causing Karrick to question the Supreme Leader's faith in Vren. Karrick, who could sense Vren's ambition to kill and replace Vorr, and therefore, deemed him untrustworthy, was certain that his master knew it as well. Vorr dismissed Karrick's concerns, however, and explained why Vren—a vicious and unforgiving man, consumed by ambition and driven by spite, molded

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Leader's faith in Vren. Karrick, who could sense Vren's ambition to kill and replace Vorr, and therefore, deemed him untrustworthy, was certain that his master knew it as well. Vorr dismissed Karrick's concerns, however, and explained why Vren—a vicious and unforgiving man, consumed by ambition and driven by spite, molded as such through years of abuse—was ultimately a useful asset. ### Walking in Xarn Velgor's shadow

#### Confronting old enemies of Velgor

> " But still, we are walking in Xarn Velgor's shadow. This is the field where he fought. There is glory here. " " Glory? Nah. There's none of that buried out there. There are only wasted lives… " ―Zarrin Karrick and Ruthford

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: The New Imperium deployed an army, under the command of Zarrin Karrick, to the Benathy homeworld in Wild Space , intending to put an end to their expansionist campaign . Karrick, who was aware that his grandfather once fought against the Benathy decades earlier during the reign of the Imperium, saw his mission as an opportunity to succeed where Xarn Velgor failed—by forcing the Benathy to submit to the New Imperium. Captain Ruthford , a veteran Imperial shock trooper who joined the New Imperium, accompanied Karrick as his military advisor . Having served with Karrick's grandfather against the Benathy, Ruthford opined that Velgor managed to subdue the aliens but at the cost of thousands on both sides, resulting in a pyrrhic victory. But where Ruthford was disillusioned by his past experience with the Benathy, believing their conflict with the Imperium was pointless and a waste of lives, Karrick saw only glory as he walked across the field of battle where Velgor once stood, the shadow of his grandfather's legacy looming over him.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Despite the army behind him, the New Imperium's troops were ordered to stand by while Karrick conducted negotiations with the Benathy's ruler, King Kristoff , attempting to secure their capitulation without bloodshed. Desiring to expand the Benathy's domain, Kristoff not only conquered four nearby planets but also had them purged of all life, leading Karrick to demand that the Benathy cease their expansion immediately. Compared to Karrick, the late Velgor commanded the king's respect, but only to a degree because while Velgor killed Kristoff's predecessor he failed to defeat their Zyll Beast , which the Benathy worshiped as a god. Nevertheless, Karrick continued his efforts to resolve their situation through diplomacy and even attempted to dominate the king's will by way of Synth Flux. The mind trick failed, however. Kristoff openly mocked Karrick's negotiating skills, causing Ruthford to caution him against provoking the dark warrior. At that point, Karrick stabbed the king through the head with his flux blade, concluding negotiations in favor of open battle .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Leading by example like his grandfather before him, Karrick fought alongside his shock troopers as they engaged the Benathy and personally killed numerous enemy combatants until their deity arrived. Despite Ruthford's skepticism, Karrick was undaunted and ordered his men to keep fighting. After their initial efforts to kill the beast failed, he improvised a plan to kill the creature to the dismay of Ruthford, who could no longer restrain himself from expressing his disapproval of Karrick's desire to match Velgor's achievements. In his view, there was no competition between Karrick and Velgor because the latter was long since dead. Despite the captain's lack of faith in him, Karrick commanded a shuttle to bring him to the jaws of the Zyll Beast, diving head-first into its mouth. Convinced that Karrick was dead, Ruthford was in the middle of recommending the option of retreat to a nearby admiral when the Zyll Beast suddenly collapsed and died. Karrick had killed the creature from within, where it was vulnerable, and managed to cut his way out, emerging from its corpse covered in the blood of the Benathy's deity. Declaring that their god was now dead, the dark warrior commanded the Benathy to submit to the New Imperium, and they did by kneeling in submission to him. In the end, he not only gained the allegiance of the Benathy, but also Captain Ruthford's respect.

#### Mission to Pillio

> " Tell me where Lor Saan Tarka took the map. " " …Bayora. He took it to Bayora. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Del Meeko

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Mission to Pillio

> " Tell me where Lor Saan Tarka took the map. " " …Bayora. He took it to Bayora. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Del Meeko

The hunt for Drayden caused Karrick to undertake a journey the planet Pillio . Although Saan Tarka was not found on the world, the New Imperium's allies captured and detained Del Meeko , a veteran of the Galactic Civil War who served the Imperium and Concordat, in turn, as a member of Inferno Squad . Upon his arrival, the dark warrior was greeted by Protectorate Gleb of Jinata Security . Dismissive of the formalities, he instructed the Aquari officer to lead him to Meeko. He found the former soldier wounded and alone on the bridge of the Raider II -class corvette Corvus .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Ignoring the prisoner's sarcasm, Karrick used Synth Flux to probe through Meeko's mind , determined to learn where Saan Tarka took the map. For all of Meeko's efforts to resist the probe, invading his mind was a relatively simple task for Karrick, who saw memories ranging across the former commando 's life—from his service on Halcyon as a coastal defender shock trooper to his participation in the Battle of Mossfell and the skirmish on Vardos . He also learned that Meeko encountered Drayden on Pillio and subsequently discovered his faith in Synth Flux. Ultimately, Meeko was unable to resist Karrick's powers and revealed that Saan Tarka took the map with him to Bayora .

Having gained the information he sought, Karrick turned the prisoner over to New Imperium officer Giedan Hask , one of Meeko's former teammates in the Inferno Squad prior the Imperium's fall, who executed Meeko shortly thereafter.

#### Raid on Ashden

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Having gained the information he sought, Karrick turned the prisoner over to New Imperium officer Giedan Hask , one of Meeko's former teammates in the Inferno Squad prior the Imperium's fall, who executed Meeko shortly thereafter.

#### Raid on Ashden

> " The map to Drayden. We know you found it. And now you're going to give it to the New Imperium. " " The New Imperium rose from the umbra side. You did not. " " I'll show you the umbra side. " " You may try. But you cannot deny the truth that is your family. " " You're so right. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Lor Saan Tarka

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Eventually, the New Imperium learned that Saan Tarka was on Ashden . Karrick, who knew Saan Tarka from childhood as the explorer was once an old ally of Solen and Drayden, brought the Resurgent -class Iron Cruiser Finalizer in his search for the map. The New Imperium's military attacked the village of Tuanul , where Saan Tarka lived. Once the New Imperium shock troopers, under the command of Phasma, rounded up the denizens of the village, Karrick arrived on the battlefield and confronted Saan Tarka, lamenting how old the former explorer had become, to which Saan Tarka replied that Karrick's fall to the umbra side was far worse. Karrick demanded that Saan Tarka give the map to the New Imperium, but Saan Tarka refused to submit to the will of the umbra side and reminded the one-time Aetheri that Karrick could not deny the truth of his heritage, at which point Karrick struck him down with his flux blade while sarcastically agreeing with him.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Moments later, he was shot at from afar by Commander Rin Vale , a starfighter pilot in the Coalition who was sent to Ashden by General Solen to find the map before the New Imperium. Karrick used Synth Flux to freeze the volt pistol bolt midair, and Vale was soon brought before him. The dark warrior realized that Tarka gave the map to Vale and ordered that the troopers bring the pilot onto Karrick's command shuttle , before giving the order to kill the rest of the villagers. One shock trooper, FN-2187, hesitated and ultimately chose not to fire on the civilians, an act that Karrick noticed as he could sense his fear before boarding his shuttle.

#### Locating Orio-6

> " Sir… we were unable to acquire the droid on Ashden. It escaped capture… aboard a stolen YT Korrathi model freighter. " " The droid… stole a freighter? " ―Dopheld Mitaka and Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Locating Orio-6

> " Sir… we were unable to acquire the droid on Ashden. It escaped capture… aboard a stolen YT Korrathi model freighter. " " The droid… stole a freighter? " ―Dopheld Mitaka and Zarrin Karrick

Vale was brought aboard the Finalizer for interrogation, where he was placed into an interrogation chair . The device, used by Karrick to extract information from his prisoners, was based on similar devices once used by the Wardens of the Imperium. New Imperium interrogators were unable to break Vale, but they did learn that he was the best pilot in the Coalition, a feat that Karrick noted once he began interrogating the pilot personally. Though the dark knight was impressed that Vale had not yet been broken, Karrick began to use Synth Flux to mentally extract the information from Vale's mind. The pilot, who resisted Synth Flux attack, finally was forced to reveal that he had hidden the map inside his BB unit , Orio-6 , who was likely still on Ashden. Karrick informed General Vren of the new development and left the recovery of the droid in the hands of the military.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Shortly after leaving Vale under the guard of several shock troopers, Karrick arrived on the Finalizer ' s bridge upon hearing that the Coalition pilot escaped aboard a SKREE fighter . Vren confirmed this with the additional information of Vale having had help from someone within the New Imperium's ranks. Karrick realized that it could only have been FN-2187, after remembering how the conflicted soldier had hesitated in Tuanul, and he said as much to Vren. The SKREE fighter was eventually shot down after a brief skirmish, and it crash-landed on Ashden. The New Imperium recognized that Vale and the deserter designated FN-2187 were looking for the droid, so Vren ordered a squadron to be sent to Ashden to recover it first. Vren soon spoke to the Supreme Leader, who ordered them to capture the droid if they could, but destroy it if they must. Karrick questioned the capability of Vren's soldiers and training methods, wondering aloud whether the Supreme Leader would be better off using an army of replicas as the Vantor Republic and the early Imperium had once done. Vren told him that they were more than capable, and warned Karrick not to let his personal mission to find Drayden interfere with the Supreme Leader's orders.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Later that day, a nervous Lieutenant Dopheld Mitaka informed Karrick that the astromech droid escaped aboard a YT-1300 light freighter . At first, Karrick found it unlikely for a single droid to be capable of stealing a ship but allowed Mitaka to continue. Further intelligence suggested the probability of FN-2187, who had now branded himself with the name Jax, abetting the droid's evacuation from Ashden. Enraged that the traitor had robbed him of the means to find Drayden, Karrick ignited his flux blade and destroyed the computer terminal in front of him. The dark warrior calmed down, asking if there was "anything else." Mitaka replied that the defector and the droid had help from a girl . Karrick used Synth Flux to drag Mitaka towards him, grabbed him by the neck, and demanded to know who the girl was.

### Return of the past

#### The pull to the light

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
### Return of the past

#### The pull to the light

> " The droid we seek is aboard the Corsair Wing . In the hands of your father… Dax Karrick. " " He means nothing to me. " " Even you, master of the Knights of Karrick… have never faced such a test. " " By the grace of your training, I will not be seduced. " " We shall see. We shall see. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Vorr

With the droid gone, the Finalizer made its way to Voidfang Base. Once there, Karrick and Vren spoke to Supreme Leader Vorr, who communicated to his subordinates via an enlarged hologram . Vorr remained concerned that Drayden's return would be a threat to the New Imperium, so Vren proposed that they finally use the weapon as intended and destroy the Concordat one and for all. Without the Republic, Vren knew that the Coalition would be vulnerable and could be stopped before they found Drayden. The Supreme Leader gave the general his permission and Vren left to oversee preparations, while Karrick remained behind.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Both Vorr and Karrick could sense that Synth Flux was awakening from dormancy once again, and the Supreme Leader told his apprentice that the droid was in the hands of Dax Karrick; the old smuggler had the astromech aboard his ship, the Corsair Wing . Karrick claimed Karrick meant nothing to him and that he would not be "seduced" by the light as his grandfather once was, not while he had Vorr's training. Even so, the Supreme Leader warned that this would be Karrick's greatest test.

Though Karrick believed he would not be seduced, he nonetheless felt the pull of the light side. In his personal quarters aboard the Finalizer , Karrick spoke to the helmet of Xarn Velgor, searching for guidance and hoping that the legacy of the Dark Lord could remind him of the power of the umbra side. He swore that if Velgor could somehow show him that dark power, then Karrick would finish what the Umbra started and destroy the last of the Aetheri.

#### Capture of Nyla

> " You. You're afraid. That you will never be as strong as Xarn Velgor. " ―Nyla, to Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Capture of Nyla

> " You. You're afraid. That you will never be as strong as Xarn Velgor. " ―Nyla, to Zarrin Karrick

The New Imperium soon learned that Karrick, Nyla, Jax, and Orio-6 had landed on Takodana , and were in the castle of the ancient pirate Maz Oru , whom Karrick hoped would help deliver the droid to the Coalition. Before the New Imperium departed, General Vren unleashed the Voidfang weapon against the Republic. After giving a speech to his forces about the end of a regime that he believed could not contain the galactic chaos, Vren commanded that the weapon be fired. Karrick watched from the bridge of the Finalizer as the weapon's phantom energy left the surface of Voidfang Base and made their way to the Republic's capital of Hosnian Prime , where they destroyed the entire Hosnian system .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
With the Republic severely damaged, Karrick led his forces to Takodana, where the shock troopers attacked Oru's castle. Karrick, Jax, and Orio-6 were briefly captured by the New Imperium before Vale and the Coalition Starfighter Corps arrived to recover the droid. When Nyla and the astromech tried to escape through the forest, they split up as she led the shock troopers away from the droid. Karrick soon arrived on the battlefield and found her in the woods. She fired at him with her volt pistol , but he followed her and deflected the shots with his flux blade. Finally, Karrick froze her in place with a telekinetic attack.

Using Synth Flux to enter Nyla's mind, Karrick saw that she had seen the map he sought. Believing the New Imperium would not need the droid since he could view Nyla's memories, he used Synth Flux to render her unconscious and captured her. He ordered the New Imperium to retreat and their forces left Takodana. The droid ultimately made it out of the forests and into the hands of the Coalition.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick brought Nyla to Voidfang Base via his command shuttle and restrained her in an interrogation chair. When she awoke, she asked where her friends were, and Karrick told her he had no idea and pointed out that would be a relief to her. He sensed she still wanted to kill him, and she said it was because she was being hunted by a creature in a mask. He removed his mask to show his young face and asked about the droid, but the girl only gave him Orio-6's technical specifications. Karrick told her that he knew about the map and that the New Imperium had recovered the rest of it from the archives of the Imperium.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick warned Nyla that he could take whatever he wanted from her before probing her mind with Synth Flux while she resisted his mental attack. At the time, Karrick was unaware that he and Nyla formed a prophesized dyad in Synth Flux , but he sensed they had an innate connection. In her mind, he discovered her name, felt her loneliness and fear, and saw an ocean and an island that she had dreamed about during her life as a scavenger in the junkyards . When he sensed Dax Karrick, Karrick could tell that Nyla looked at the smuggler as a father figure, but he said that Karrick would have only disappointed her. Nyla grew more resistant to his mental attack and turned it against him, using the same ability to see that Karrick was afraid he would never be as strong as Xarn Velgor was.

#### Vorr's new strategy

> " Supreme Leader, I can get the map from the girl. I just need your guidance. " " If what you say about this girl is true… Bring her to me. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Vorr

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Vorr's new strategy

> " Supreme Leader, I can get the map from the girl. I just need your guidance. " " If what you say about this girl is true… Bring her to me. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Vorr

Stunned by the reversal, Karrick left Nyla behind in the interrogation chamber and spoke to the Supreme Leader, who reacted with incredulity that a mere scavenger resisted him. Karrick told Vorr that Nyla was even stronger with Synth Flux than she realized. The Supreme Leader asked what happened to the droid, and General Vren, who had just entered the chamber, told Vorr that Karrick believed he only needed Nyla and allowed the droid to escape. Concerned that the Coalition might have the full map to Drayden, Vorr ordered Vren to unleash the Voidfang weapon against the Coalition base on the planet D'Qar . Karrick swore that he could still find the map in Nyla's mind as long as he had his master's guidance, so the Supreme Leader ordered Nyla to be brought to him.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
On his way to Nyla's holding cell, Karrick learned that the girl had somehow broken out. The guard who had been ordered to watch her could not fathom how he ended up in his quarters. When asked by a New Imperium officer if "stronger methods" were needed, Karrick declined; any further simple questioning might enable the guard to remember something important. In the meantime, Nyla must be found.

When Karrick returned to the cell, he needed to see if Nyla had truly used her emerging Synth Flux abilities to escape. Inspection revealed the interrogation bench was deserted, every one of its restraints left open as if to mock Karrick. Enraged, he ignited his flux blade and destroyed the room, causing two passing shock troopers to quickly back away.

#### Dax Karrick's last stand

> " I'm being torn apart. I want to be free of this pain. I know what I have to do… but I don't know if I have the strength to do it. Will you help me? " " Yes. Anything. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Dax Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
> " I'm being torn apart. I want to be free of this pain. I know what I have to do… but I don't know if I have the strength to do it. Will you help me? " " Yes. Anything. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Dax Karrick

Karrick commanded the New Imperium troops to be on alert for Nyla as she began making her way through the base, as he knew that the longer she was able to tap into her powers while escaping, the more dangerous she would become. A trooper reported sensor readings in Hangar 718 , which meant Nyla could be there. But investigations turned up nothing. Nonetheless, Karrick wanted every hangar on lockdown to prevent Nyla from commandeering a ship. Right in the middle of that order, he was interrupted by a familiar presence: Dax Karrick. His father was on Voidfang Base.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick ordered for a search of the Corsair Wing , for the ship had shortly been sighted at the edge of a cliff. By the time he arrived on the scene, everything checked clear and not a single hidden trap could be found. He boarded the Corsair and sat on the pilot's seat, looking for anything that may lead him to Karrick's whereabouts. Just then, he spotted Coalition Vectors flying past and assaulting the thermal oscillator , hoping to destroy it and set off a chain reaction that would cause the planet to implode before the weapon could destroy D'Qar. Karrick rushed to the oscillator, commanding his troops to find the intruders. He knew Karrick had to be nearby, as well as the fact that he did not come alone.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: As Karrick advanced on the walkway, he stopped upon hearing the voice of his father, calling out to him from behind, using his birth name. He turned about face and said he had been waiting for this eventuality. Karrick told him to remove the mask so he could see the face of his son once more. Karrick removed the mask but told Karrick that he had destroyed Beno, who Karrick thought was weak and foolish, much like his father before him. Karrick refused to acknowledge Karrick's pessimistic stance on the matter, retorting that his son was very much alive and Vorr was simply using Karrick for his power, and that once Vorr had exhausted Karrick's usefulness, he would be disposed of.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick, while neither denying nor confirming what Karrick said about Vorr to be true, stated that it was too late for him. Karrick pleaded with Karrick to come home to his true family, claiming that he and Solen desperately missed the presence of their son. Karrick, conflicted by the pull towards the light, broke down in tears and told his father that he was being torn apart by the constant struggle between the dark and the light inside him and wanted to be free of the pain that he was feeling. He knew what he had to do to put a permanent end to his inner turmoil, although Karrick was uncertain whether or not he could perform the necessary act to do so. Asking for his father's assistance in ceasing the struggle, Karrick agreed, not knowing that it was the light that Karrick felt conflicted by.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick, who was being watched from afar by Brevok, Nyla, and Jax, took out his flux blade and Karrick grabbed hold of it. As the Voidfang finished draining the star it orbited to power the weapon, and the light on the planet died out, Karrick ignited his flux blade and impaled his father through the torso. A mortally wounded Dax Karrick touched his son's face one last time before falling to his death in the bowels of the oscillator. Despite Karrick's role in his death, Dax died refusing to believe that his son was lost to the umbra side forever.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Unbeknownst to Karrick, he had carried out an Umbra trial of ascendancy , a trial that required the sacrifice of a loved one to unlock newfound depths of dark power. The act of patricide had an unsettling effect on Karrick, as did Karrick's gesture of compassion which tormented Karrick far more than killing his own father. Rather than make him stronger in the umbra side, as he had thought, it had weakened his spirit. He became unbalanced, and was more miserable and weak than before. The shock had been so profound, he did not register Brevok's roar of anguish nor Nyla's scream of horror.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Enraged by the loss of his best friend, Brevok fired a powerful shot from his Vorak bowcaster and hit Karrick in the left side, seriously injuring the dark knight. Quickly, Karrick used Synth Flux to reduce the effects of the wound, lest it may result in his premature death. Brevok killed several other shock troopers in the area as Nyla and Jax, who were high above in the oscillator, began firing into the area as well. The Vorak then ignited charges that he and Karrick set throughout the oscillator, causing a massive explosion that breached the oscillator and gave Vale and the remaining Coalition pilots an opportunity to destroy it. As Karrick composed himself from his injury, he made eye contact with Jax and Nyla. Anger swelling within him, he was resolved to find them before they could escape.

#### Duel in the forest

> " We're not done yet. " " You're a monster. " " It's just us now. Dax Karrick can't save you. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Nyla

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Duel in the forest

> " We're not done yet. " " You're a monster. " " It's just us now. Dax Karrick can't save you. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Nyla

Karrick followed Nyla and Jax into the forest outside of the oscillator, as they made their way back to the nearby Corsair Wing . He confronted them, flux blade drawn, and said that they still had unfinished business from which Dax Karrick could not save them. Outraged by Karrick's patricidal actions, Nyla denounced the dark warrior as a monster and tried to attack him with her volt pistol, but he used Synth Flux to throw her into a tree and knock her unconscious. Now it was just Karrick and the traitor who had earned his ire.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Jax ignited the Drayden flux blade that had been given to him for safekeeping by Maz Oru—a flux blade that once belonged to Joren Drayden, and to Kael before him. Karrick demanded that Jax give him the flux blade, claiming it belonged to him, but instead the former shock trooper engaged him in a flux blade duel. It was a short but brutal contest, in which Karrick kept striking his bowcaster injury in order to fuel his anger and power. In the end, Jax, who nonetheless landed one blow on Karrick's right shoulder, was no match for Karrick's power. Karrick overwhelmed and disarmed his opponent, ending the fight with a punch and a flux blade blow across Jax's back that left the one-time shock trooper comatose.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: With the duel seemingly over, Karrick turned his attention towards his grandfather's flux blade and attempted to use Synth Flux to draw it into his hand. Instead, it flew past him and landed in the hands of Nyla, who used Synth Flux to call it to her—as it was her destiny to wield the flux blade of Kael Drayden. Nyla ignited the weapon and engaged Karrick in a tense duel. At first, Karrick had the upper hand, remaining on the offensive as he pressed his attack against the retreating scavenger. Their blades became locked, and Karrick told the emerging Synth Flux-sensitive that she needed a teacher. It was he, Karrick said, who could show her the ways of Synth Flux. At that moment, Nyla realized she could call upon the powers of Synth Flux and began using that to her advantage. Unaware, Nyla instead gave in to her raw power, anger rage, and fury. She turned the tide of the fight and pushed her own offensive against the dark warrior, who she was finally able to disarm. Karrick realized that he dueled an opponent with more anger than he, or with an emotion that he didn't even recognize anymore. In

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
anger rage, and fury. She turned the tide of the fight and pushed her own offensive against the dark warrior, who she was finally able to disarm. Karrick realized that he dueled an opponent with more anger than he, or with an emotion that he didn't even recognize anymore. In doing so, she slashed her blade across his face, knocking him down and disfiguring him in the process. Phasma briefly bore witness to Karrick and Nyla's duel but did not provide aid to the umbra side warrior, as she was busy searching for the officer she had framed for the fall of Voidfang Base, Sol Rivas . With Nyla having rejected an amorphous, dark voice in her mind that demanded she kill Karrick, the young woman and Karrick were separated for long enough that, before they could engage any further, the surface of the planet began to break apart—the Coalition was victorious, and the destruction of the oscillator triggered the Voidfang's implosion. Karrick and Nyla were separated by a deep chasm, so Nyla left the dark warrior behind, recovered Jax, and fled the planet with Brevok aboard the Corsair Wing .

As the planet continued to collapse, Vorr ordered General Vren to find Karrick and bring the young knight before the Supreme Leader so the young warrior's training could be completed. Vren and several troopers tracked Karrick's signal and took him aboard a shuttle, leaving before the planet exploded. Immediately following Voidfang Base's destruction, Karrick received treatment for the long scars on his body, though it was too late to erase them completely.

### Let the past die

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
### Let the past die

#### A child in a mask

> " Yes. There it is. You have too much of your father's heart in you, young Karrick. " " I killed Dax Karrick. When the moment came I didn't hesitate. " " And look at you. The deed split your spirit to the bone. " ―Vorr and Zarrin Karrick

Following the Coalition's evacuation of the base on D'Qar, Karrick was summoned to Supreme Leader Vorr's throne room on the Supremacy . The blows inflicted on him, by Nyla and Brevok, though stitched up some by microsutures , were still as fresh as ever, causing him some discomfort, though he tried to hide this. Kneeling before his master, he listened as Vorr loudly recalled the raw, untamed power that Karrick possessed, abilities which had originally brought him to the umbra sider's attention. Knowing the potential of the powerful Drayden bloodline, the Supreme Leader revealed his belief that Karrick could fulfill his grandfather's dark legacy.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
But in light of his apprentice's most recent setback, Vorr retracted his faith in Karrick's power. He chastised the dark warrior, calling him weak and sentimental, just like his late father. The struggle within Karrick as he prepared to strike down Dax Karrick had been sensed by Vorr from afar. It was the trauma from this action that caused him to be outmatched by an untrained scavenger, who had never before wielded a flux blade. Vorr had never seen such a pathetic display.

Fury building within him, Karrick rose to attack his master, but Vorr quickly suppressed the attack with a surge of lightning , throwing the umbra side apprentice back. As long as Joren Drayden lived, Vorr seethed—as long as the Aetheri remained—so did hope across the galaxy. Karrick would never be able to destroy it because he was a mere child hiding in a mask—nothing like the feared Xarn Velgor, who would have been ashamed of his grandson. Leaving the throne room, Karrick erupted in a rage of self-pity and smashed his helmet against the surrounding metal. He then ordered his ship to be readied, resuming his quest to eradicate the Coalition.

#### Chasing the Coalition

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Chasing the Coalition

> " Follow my lead. " ―Zarrin Karrick, to his wingmen

As Vren had anticipated through new tracking technology, the New Imperium armada emerged from hyperspace to find the Coalition fleet unprepared and defenseless in the Oetchi system . The Battle of Oetchi commenced as the warship Supremacy led the charge, its powerful pulse lances showering the fleet with unyielding blasts. To complement the barrage, the Supremacy scrambled its short-distance fighters, with Karrick spearheading the assault in his personal SKREE silencer . Covered by three wingmen , until the third pilot was quickly destroyed, the dark apprentice intercepted the Coalition's MC85 Star Cruiser Raddik , capital ship of the fleet. Before the insurgent pilots could launch a counterattack, he destroyed the Raddik hangar, leaving them unable to resist the fighter wing.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
With the Coalition flagship crippled, Karrick turned his fighter to face the bridge of the craft, readying his rockets. At this moment he sensed his mother's presence aboard the Raddik —with his mother likewise sensing him too—and Karrick, hesitating, held his thumb over the trigger in a moment of intense doubt. After a moment, he surrendered to his second thoughts and abandoned the trigger control. His wingmen , however, had no such qualms; ever loyal to the New Imperium, they launched their rockets in Karrick's place upon the bridge.

Karrick watched the detonation with astonishment. He reached out again, but could not feel Solen anywhere. He believed that if he had had enough time, if he had not been taken by surprise, he would have protected his mother with Synth Flux. Now, however, he had to conclude that she had died, along with all those present on the Raddik ' bridge.

Following this last offensive, Vren ordered the fighters back to the Supremacy , as the Coalition fleet had pulled out of the Supremacy ' s protective radius in the intervening time. Karrick, with his wingmen being blown up around him, had no other recourse but to comply.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Following this last offensive, Vren ordered the fighters back to the Supremacy , as the Coalition fleet had pulled out of the Supremacy ' s protective radius in the intervening time. Karrick, with his wingmen being blown up around him, had no other recourse but to comply.

#### A growing connection

> " I'd never felt so alone. " " You're not alone. " " Neither are you. It isn't too late. " ―Nyla and Zarrin Karrick As the New Imperium pursued the Coalition fleet, Karrick was being treated for the injury he had taken to his face, a medical droid removing the microsutures that had been attached to it, when he sensed a disturbance. Before he knew it, a vision of Nyla appeared before him. Taken aback, Karrick could only watch as Nyla reached for her volt pistol and shot him. However, no shot injured him. The still-shocked Karrick pursued Nyla when she ran away and found her soon after and tried to use the mind trick to synth flux Nyla to bring Joren to him, only to realize that they weren't actually in the same location and that Nyla had not projected her appearance to him as the effort would kill her. He even discovered that Nyla had found Joren Drayden and was now studying under him, although he could not discern where as he was unable to see Nyla's surroundings. Whereas the aspiring Aetheri regarded their connection as an inconvenience, Karrick was intrigued by his bond with the former scavenger and sought to better understand it.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: The bond between Karrick and Nyla was unprecedented in its strength and raw power. It also had an effect on Karrick's churning emotions, and as it grew stronger in Synth Flux, Nyla started gaining new insights into Karrick, who, to Nyla's surprise, no longer tried to hide his feelings of pain and misery from her. It was because of the bond and her new understanding of Karrick's pain that Nyla came to suspect that their destinies were intertwined. Karrick eventually revealed his recollection of the night he forsook Drayden's teachings—how he awoke to the sound of a flux blade, held by his uncle who intended to murder Beno Karrick in his sleep—shaking Nyla's faith in her Aetheri Master. Although Nyla called him a liar, she sensed no deception from Karrick. He genuinely believed that his former mentor had betrayed him and intended to kill him while he was defenseless.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
After failing to discover the fate of her parents, Nyla sought out Karrick through their bond because he understood what it was like to feel alone and lost. They comforted each other, insisting that neither was alone and in that moment they touched hands. Nyla then beheld a vision of the future, leading her to believe that Karrick was fated to renounce the umbra side and return to the light, like his grandfather before him. As a result of what she saw, Nyla became convinced that her adversary could be turned from the umbra side of Synth Flux. She left Drayden on his sanctuary and traveled to the Supremacy to see Karrick, her actions guided by the belief that Beno Karrick could be redeemed with her help. By touching hands, however, Karrick experienced a vision of his own and thereby discerned the truth of Nyla's father and mother: they were no one, merely a pair of junk traders who sold their daughter for drinking money before ultimately dying and being buried in a pauper's grave in the Ashden desert. This discovery convinced Karrick that Nyla would turn to the umbra side and stand with him as they moved to confront his master together.

#### Destiny fulfilled

> " My worthy apprentice, son of darkness, heir apparent to Lord Velgor. Where there was conflict, I now sense resolve; where there was weakness, strength. Complete your training and fulfill your destiny . " ―Vorr's final words to Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Destiny fulfilled

> " My worthy apprentice, son of darkness, heir apparent to Lord Velgor. Where there was conflict, I now sense resolve; where there was weakness, strength. Complete your training and fulfill your destiny . " ―Vorr's final words to Zarrin Karrick

Karrick's emotions were fully open to Nyla, who could feel that his conflict had grown worse since he killed his father. Clinging to the good she sensed within Karrick, she reached out to the former Beno Karrick and revealed her conviction in the vision she had when they touched hands through Synth Flux. Karrick was not fated to continue bowing before Vorr. Redemption was his destiny; of that Nyla was certain. Karrick, however, revealed that he also beheld a vision that convinced him it would be Nyla who turned, because he now knew the truth behind Nyla's parentage. Just before they entered the throne room where the Supreme Leader awaited their arrival, Nyla sensed that much of Karrick's churning emotions were about her.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Vorr, who proclaimed that his faith in Karrick had been restored, began appraising Nyla, who remained defiant in spite of her inability to resist the dark master's Synth Flux powers. Although Nyla remained certain that Karrick would turn, her mental defenses began to crumble when Vorr revealed that he had been responsible for the intermittent connections she experienced with the Supreme Leader's apprentice, a revelation which came as a shock to Karrick as well. It had all been a plot to draw Nyla, the means to find Joren Drayden, right into Vorr's hands. Nevertheless, Karrick remained silent as Nyla screamed, trying in vain to stop Vorr from invading her mind.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Upon discovering Drayden's location, Vorr planned to wipe him out from above as soon as the more immediate enemy had been dealt with. Nyla summoned Drayden's flux blade to her hand, only for Vorr to redirect the hilt onto her head; Karrick, eyes shut, merely tilted his head to the right to avoid being struck by the flying object. The Supreme Leader revealed through his oculus the Coalition being picked off one by one as they tried to flee aboard transports for safety. All that Karrick's mother had fought for would be destroyed by the Supremacy ' s guns. In response, an enraged Nyla pulled Karrick's flux blade into her hands and charged at Vorr, who effortlessly overpowered her. Karrick watched the flux blade fall out of Nyla's grip and shut off, sliding on the floor back to its owner's feet.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Vorr, who had grown weary of his oft-conflicted apprentice, exulted at the newfound resolve that he suddenly felt emanating from Karrick. Having promised to kill Nyla with the cruelest stroke, he immobilized Nyla and gave Karrick the chance to execute the girl who defeated him on Voidfang Base. Karrick retrieved his flux blade, stood up and stepped towards Nyla. He knew what must be done and, as Nyla predicted, he did indeed turn against his master. Knowing that Vorr could sense his every intent, he turned his flux blade to Nyla while simultaneously his uncle's weapon rotated to face in Vorr's direction. Vorr, who became distracted by the desire to appreciate Nyla's impending doom with Synth Flux rather than the approximation afforded by mundane senses, believed that Karrick was about to kill his true enemy—a status he wrongly attributed to Nyla.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
With a hidden gesture from Karrick's free hand, the blue energy blade of Drayden's flux blade sprang forth, spearing Vorr through his waist. Almost instantly, Vorr's control on Nyla was lost. The blade, which was still under Karrick's control, carved through Vorr, cutting him in half before returning to Nyla's grasp. After a moment of locking eyes with each other, Karrick and Nyla stood back-to-back to receive the retaliation of the fallen Supreme Leader's Elite Praetorian Guards , who charged towards the Synth Flux-sensitive duo from all sides with the intent of avenging his death. Although the two were eventually separated and forced to contend with multiple guards on their own, they both held their own and continued to strike down one Praetorian after another. Karrick, who felt both excitement and a hunger for battle, personally killed half the Guards on his own but was disarmed by his fifth opponent, causing Nyla to throw the Drayden flux blade to him. He swiftly thumbed it on and off, letting the blade pierce through the last Praetorian's head.

#### Convictions and rejections

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Convictions and rejections

> " It's time to let old things die. Vorr, Drayden. The Umbra, the Aetheri, the Insurgents… Let it all die. Nyla, I want you to join me. We can rule together and bring a new order to the galaxy. " ―Zarrin Karrick Nyla, who stared at Karrick through eyes filled with joy, beseeched him to help her save the Coalition fleet. To her disbelief and horror, Karrick proposed that he and Nyla join together and "let old things die," including the Coalition, and bring a new order to the galaxy. Neither fear nor anger influenced his decision; he had chosen to continue down the dark path with a deep resolve. Nyla begged Karrick to not give into the umbra side, but the latter stood behind his convictions. To his frustration, he could see that Nyla was still clinging to that futile hope of hers. He urged her to "let go," to admit the truth about her parents—a truth she had always known but hidden away for years. Nyla struggled to control her emotions as she admitted that she knew this, that her parents were simply "nobody," but the revelation that she came from nothing threatened to overwhelm her. At that moment, Karrick called Nyla "nothing," and said she was not that to him. Karrick, who saw Nyla as an ally in destroying the past he hated, wanted the former scavenger to join him. Motioning her to take his hand, he pleaded with

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
from nothing threatened to overwhelm her. At that moment, Karrick called Nyla "nothing," and said she was not that to him. Karrick, who saw Nyla as an ally in destroying the past he hated, wanted the former scavenger to join him. Motioning her to take his hand, he pleaded with her to stay with him so that they could rule the galaxy together. However, Nyla used Synth Flux to summon the Drayden flux blade to her grasp, just as she had when fighting Karrick on Voidfang Base. Karrick, his entreaty rejected, raised his own hand to harness Synth Flux around the flux blade, causing it to stop midflight. Neither Karrick or Nyla relented as both continued to call upon the Aetheri weapon with equal determination. In the midst of their standoff, the flux blade's kyber crystal wailed through Synth Flux, seeking resonance and harmony where there was nothing but dissonance. The crystal ultimately sheared apart, unleashing a wave of energy that tore the flux blade in half before consuming the throne room in a flash of brilliant, blinding light. In addition to rendering both Synth Flux users unconscious, the shock wave of Synth Flux energy coincided with the sacrifice of Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdra , who crashed the Raddik into the Supremacy at lightspeed, splitting the New Imperium flagship in half before it could destroy all of the Coalition transports.

### The reign of Zarrin Karrick

#### The New Supreme Leader

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
### The reign of Zarrin Karrick

#### The New Supreme Leader

> " Get all our forces down to that Coalition base. Let's finish this. " " Finish this? Who do you think you're talking to? You presume to command my army? Our Supreme Leader is dead! We have no ruler— " " The Supreme Leader is dead. " " Long live the Supreme Leader. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Armitage Vren

Karrick regained consciousness shortly after Vren reached the throne room. Having killed the Supreme Leader and his guards, Karrick falsely accused Nyla of murder, claiming that she was the one responsible for Vorr's death. Vren, who had contemplated shooting the fallen knight before he awoke, informed Karrick that the girl escaped from the Supremacy using Vorr's private shuttle. Realizing that Nyla had awoken before him, Karrick pondered why she had spared his life, knowing he was at her mercy while in an unconscious state. It then occurred to Karrick that Nyla did, in fact, care about him. Regardless, he dismissed it as a sign of sentimental weakness that would eventually lead to Nyla's destruction.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Knowing that Nyla would travel to Saltmark in an effort to save the Coalition, Karrick ordered Vren to send their forces to the planet where they would end the war and his mother's movement for good. Vren scoffed at the notion of taking orders from his longtime rival and reminded Karrick that the army answered to their general. In addition, he pointed out that, without a Supreme Leader, the New Imperium was cast into a state of disarray. Before he could go on, the General's protests were suddenly silenced by Karrick, who aggressively Synth Flux choked Vren into submission. Overtaken by fear, Vren grudgingly pledged his allegiance to Karrick, whom he hailed as Vorr's successor. Even so, Karrick remained distrustful of Vren and chose to keep the General close by as a safeguard against treachery.

#### Battle of Saltmark

> " General Vren, advance. No quarter, no prisoners. " ―Zarrin Karrick, to Armitage Vren

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Battle of Saltmark

> " General Vren, advance. No quarter, no prisoners. " ―Zarrin Karrick, to Armitage Vren

As far as the new Supreme Leader was concerned, the Battle of Saltmark would prove to be the final battle in the war between the New Imperium and the Coalition. He would give no quarter to his enemies, nor take a single prisoner. Looming overhead in his command shuttle, Karrick oversaw the deployment of AT-ATs , AT-M6s , and AT-STs to the salt-covered surface of Saltmark, gathered from what remained of the Supremacy . It would be a relatively straightforward operation, with Karrick's forces marching on an abandoned insurgent base which the Coalition had appropriated for its defense.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
When the New Imperium discovered a massive shield door impeding their advance into the enclosure, Karrick further deployed a superlaser siege cannon —a device likened to a battering ram that was equipped with miniaturized Void Core technology—to his advantage. In response, the Coalition launched a number of old ski speeders , an ultimately futile attempt to stop the cannon. While the Coalition attempted to halt the New Imperium's progress, Brevok and Nyla joined the fray in the Corsair Wing , and Karrick furiously sent every SKREE fighter present to destroy his father's old ship.

#### Showdown with Joren Drayden

> " I'll destroy her, and you, and all of it. " " No. Strike me down in anger and I'll always be with you. Just like your father. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Joren Drayden

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Showdown with Joren Drayden

> " I'll destroy her, and you, and all of it. " " No. Strike me down in anger and I'll always be with you. Just like your father. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Joren Drayden

Shortly after the New Imperium breached the base, Joren Drayden appeared and Karrick, in a futile attempt to eliminate his uncle, ordered all of his forces to fire at him. After Drayden shrugged off the attack virtually unharmed, Karrick ordered his command shuttle to be set down. Vren tried to advise him against what he considered a waste of time, but Karrick thrashed the General against the wall with Synth Flux, knocking him unconscious. The nearby pilot needed no further prodding and complied with the command.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: The time had come for Karrick to face Drayden personally. He slowly advanced until he was but a few meters from the old Aetheri. He tauntingly asked if Drayden had come to be his salvation. Drayden answered half-heartedly in the negative. Then flux blades were drawn. Drayden made no effort to harm his nephew and only moved to avoid Karrick's attacks. He apologized for failing in his duty as Beno Karrick's mentor, but Karrick took it with sarcasm and declared that the war had ended with the death of the Coalition. In addition, he stated that Drayden would die as well, marking the end of the Aetheri Order itself. He was wrong on all counts, according to Drayden: the war had just begun, the Insurgency was reborn, and he would not die as the last of the Aetheri.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick felt that Drayden was talking about Nyla, the old man's supposed "seeded one." He vowed that he would see her annihilated, along with Drayden and the remnants of the Coalition. In response, Drayden deactivated his flux blade and warned his nephew against striking him down in anger, promising that he would always be with Karrick, just like Dax Karrick. It was thus that he opened himself up for the final blow. Enraged, Karrick charged at Drayden once more until he slashed through him with no effect. Confused, he pointed his flux blade in the Aetheri Master's direction and moved forward until the blade harmlessly passed through his uncle again, revealing that Drayden was not actually present for the battle; he had been projecting himself through Synth Flux from Tidehollow. With one final chiding goodbye, the image vanished.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: At that moment, Karrick realized what had his uncle had done: by distracting him, the old Aetheri had bought time for the remaining members of the Coalition to escape. Vren had been right all along. Angered by the deception, Karrick, Vren, and their forces scoured the now-empty base, but finding only a projection of his father's golden hanging dice, all Karrick could do was kneel in defeat as they vanished from his hand. As the Coalition evacuated, Karrick saw Nyla once more as she boarded the Corsair Wing ; no words were said as she closed the door on him, although Karrick sensed that Nyla felt neither hatred nor compassion for him. Both knew that this struggle between them was far from concluded. Karrick had become the Supreme Leader, all but destroyed his mother's Coalition and struck down his uncle on the battlefield of Saltmark, but it did not feel like a victory to Karrick.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
After Saltmark, Nyla and Solen discussed Karrick and his actions. Nyla wanted to understand him and how Karrick had turned to the umbra side, but Solen told Nyla that she would need to ask Karrick to know. Nyla told the general that Karrick wanted her to join him and that, while she thought she could help him, all he had wanted was for her to be like him. Solen could see that Nyla cared about her son and also that he had disappointed her, so she informed the young Aetheri that Karrick had made his decisions, adding that the only person who could save him was himself, but Solen was unsure if that was what her son wanted. Nyla understood this, but she had held onto hope, although Solen believed that hope was a good trait.

#### The legacy of Xarn Velgor

The dark prince

> " I thought I wanted to follow your path. You were the one I thought I understood. I thought I was your legacy . But I'm not you. " ―Zarrin Karrick, to Xarn Velgor's mask

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### The legacy of Xarn Velgor

The dark prince

> " I thought I wanted to follow your path. You were the one I thought I understood. I thought I was your legacy . But I'm not you. " ―Zarrin Karrick, to Xarn Velgor's mask

Shortly after the Battle of Saltmark, Karrick boarded the Finalizer in space to meet Vren and many organized squads of shock troopers and other New Imperium personnel. Karrick introduced himself as the new Supreme Leader of the New Imperium by revealing Vorr's bisected corpse, using Synth Flux to lift the remains into the air for his audience to see. Still asserting that the Coalition killed Vorr, Karrick released Vorr's body into the vacuum of space while claiming he would bring the New Imperium to glory.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: After his display of power, Karrick reminisced alone about recent events and his encounters and memories with his father, mother, Vorr, and Nyla. Though trying to affirm to himself that the past did not matter and that it was done, he could not let go of the images of those who were once close to him. Sending for Vren, Karrick met with the General, telling him that he was a trusted advisor and that he needed advisement on military matters, which Vorr did not often discuss with Karrick. Though Vren confirmed that Vorr had his plans, he implored Karrick to take his own military direction as he now commanded the New Imperium's military. When Vren suggested that Karrick fulfill the dreams of their forebears and rebuild the Imperium, Karrick told Vren that his own forebears shaped the known galaxy while Vren's bloodline produced lesser "lieutenants and lickspittles."

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
The two then conferred on resources, with Vren elaborating that they needed more ships as Voidfang Base's destruction left them without a shipyard and the Coalition's unusual tactics at the Battle of Oetchi destroyed the Supremacy and much of their fleet. With the destruction of the Concordat at Hosnian Prime and the dismantling of the Coalition, however, Vren believed the New Imperium would face little coalition other than local militias for their ambitions of conquest. Karrick cut Vren's deliberations short, as he had not ordered him to perform any military action, instead ordering that a throne be built for himself. Though Karrick suggested that the throne could be anything he liked, such as one made of aurodium , Karrick told Vren to choose and to do nothing else until Karrick had a worthy throne, cautioning Vren to get it right the first time.

The fires of Emberfall

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
The fires of Emberfall

> " You are the past. Xarn Velgor is the past. This entire place is the past. The past strangles me. Its expectations and legacies and vendettas. I will destroy every last vestige of it. I will free myself . " " You foolish, ignorant child . Velgor's power was his past. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Vainé Karrick returned to solitude to confer with his grandfather's mask, questioning how Velgor could have ruled for so long over weaklings and been satisfied. Karrick asserted that he was not Velgor, or his uncle, mother or father, and reaffirmed that though he had killed his past, he still was not free of it. He concluded the answer to be that his work killing the past was not complete, and that he would start with the burdensome legacy of his grandfather. Karrick traveled to Emberfall , the volcanic throneworld of his late grandfather, in his SKREE silencer . As he approached Fortress Velgor , he was confronted by three warriors of the Alazmec of Winsit , a group of Umbra cultists that colonized Emberfall's Corvax Fen region near the castle grounds of Fortress Velgor. One of the warriors fired an arrow at Karrick, who halted it inches from his face by use of Synth Flux. Karrick used his flux blade to cut down his attackers, goading the remaining Alazmec warriors to attack him and further pontificating on his importance. One of the warriors wounded Karrick in the midsection. As Karrick approached the entrance to the fortress, blood from his wound would

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
use of Synth Flux. Karrick used his flux blade to cut down his attackers, goading the remaining Alazmec warriors to attack him and further pontificating on his importance. One of the warriors wounded Karrick in the midsection. As Karrick approached the entrance to the fortress, blood from his wound would fall onto the stone , detecting Velgor's blood and opening for the dark warrior. Karrick was greeted by Vainé , Velgor's servant in life, now reduced to a head affixed inside a droid body. Asking about Karrick's connection to Velgor, Karrick confirmed that Velgor was his grandfather. When Vainé asked how he might best serve Karrick, Karrick threatened him with death, to which Vainé confirmed his similarity to Velgor, asking why Karrick might kill him. Karrick claimed that Vainé, like Velgor and the fortress, represented the past, which strangled Karrick with its expectations, legacies and vendettas. Vainé, amused, called Karrick foolish and ignorant, offering that Velgor's past was what gave him his power. Showing Karrick a hologram of Velgor, Vainé told how Velgor never let go of his past, which was what made him so powerful in the umbra side of Synth Flux. After contemplating Vainé's words, Karrick deactivated his blade and demanded his new servant to show him more of Velgor's past.

The sands of Dunemere

> " This is the Supreme Leader. Bring the Finalizer to Dunemere. Await my signal. " ―Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: At the behest of Vainé, Karrick would travel with his new servant to Port Vail on the planet Dunemere , where his grandfather spent his early days. Though Karrick did not at first understand the planet's importance, Vainé insisted that Velgor's past experiences on the desert world, such as meeting his future wife , joining the Aetheri Order, losing his mother , and using the umbra side of Synth Flux for the first time when slaughtering a village of Tuskens , were key to his dark journey. Vainé took Karrick to Port Vail's Grand Arena , where one of Kael Drayden's greatest triumphs took place: his victory in the Dune Eve Classic as an untrained child and a slave , in which he was the only human to ever win. Karrick did not at first believe that his grandfather was once a slave, but did believe that the Aetheri would not take in Drayden's mother. Vainé speculated that like Velgor, Karrick's life was also one of prolonged pain, and though Karrick quietly reflected on happy memories he shared with his family throughout his childhood, he agreed.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: A trio of desert thugs approached Karrick and Vainé, having overheard the name "Drayden", claiming to have heard that Joren Drayden had recently took out an entire New Imperium fleet. The thugs then raised weapons, threatening to rob the duo of their credits . Using Synth Flux, Karrick manipulated the bodies of two of the thugs to point ther volt pistols at their allies, killing two of them. Karrick told the lone survivor to spread the word that talking of Joren Drayden could get one killed. Using his flux blade to erase Kael Drayden's name from the arena's wall, Karrick asked Vainé who owned his grandfather.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Vainé brought Karrick to the ruined junk shop of Waddu , the Toydarian who owned Drayden as a boy. Karrick assumed that Velgor must have returned to the shop to take revenge on Waddu, but Vainé denied this, as Velgor was focused on other things. Vainé did confirm that Waddu acquired Drayden from Graska Besadii the Elder , who still lived. Hoping to erase this part of his grandfather's story, Karrick acquired a speeder and travelled to Graska's palace . After killing the guards and their rancors , Karrick entered the palace to meet the Grak . Assuming that Karrick was sent by an employer to keep her criminal imperium in check, Karrick drew his flux blade and sought to take revenge for Graska owning his grandfather. Though Karrick deftly struck down the rest of Graska's guards, a small being who sat at Graska's side took Karrick's blade from him using Synth Flux, claiming that Synth Flux was weak with Karrick. Graska revealed that she had taken precautions against Synth Flux-sensitive intruders after Grukk Desilijic Tiure's fate thirty years prior. Graska had her guards incapacitate Karrick and chain him in a dungeon, keeping him prisoner, taunting that Karrick's grandfather's story

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: using Synth Flux, claiming that Synth Flux was weak with Karrick. Graska revealed that she had taken precautions against Synth Flux-sensitive intruders after Grukk Desilijic Tiure's fate thirty years prior. Graska had her guards incapacitate Karrick and chain him in a dungeon, keeping him prisoner, taunting that Karrick's grandfather's story was now his story too. Later awakening, Karrick futilely implored Graska to release him, instead receiving repeated electric shocks. Calling Karrick "nothing", Karrick remembered telling the Aetheri apprentice Nyla something similar during the Battle of Oetchi shortly after killing Vorr and his Praetorian Guards. Failing to bargain with and threaten Graska, Karrick was instead shocked repeatedly and told to obey. Eventually, Graska stopped at the behest of her Synth Flux-sensitive bodyguard, agreeing that Karrick was more useful alive than dead. At the press of a button, Karrick's chamber became filled with a noxious red gas, causing him to dream in visions. In these visions, Karrick witnessed Velgor slaughtering many Free Coalition troops. Asking Velgor for help, Velgor only replied that everything that had made him magnificent, he had accomplished alone. Heeding Velgor's words, Karrick awakened and goaded Graska into causing him more pain, giving him the umbra side power needed to free himself and destroy Graska's dungeon.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Wandering the suns-scorched desert, Karrick encountered a Canyon Krayt dragon , slaying it without a weapon and fashioning its hide into clothing. Attacking two other desert wanderers, Karrick used their communications equipment to order the Finalizer to Dunemere. Finding a dewback , Karrick relocated Graska's fortress, ordering General Armitage Vren to hit his given location with a full spread of weapons in twenty minutes. Karrick rushed the fortress, once again dispatching guards, reclaiming his flux blade and escaping shortly before Vren carried out the attack.

Later, Karrick met with Vainé via hologram aboard the Finalizer , the latter having feared the worst after hearing of the New Imperium attack. Vainé asked if Karrick's understanding of Velgor and his power had grown on Dunemere; Karrick confirmed that it had, with there being power and purity in his being alone. Pleased, Vainé told Karrick that there was still more to be shown about Velgor's life and legacy, and after confirming that their adventures would continue, told Karrick that he would await him at the island of Varykino on the planet Ondara .

The waters of Ondara

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
The waters of Ondara

> " The people of this world need to evolve . They need a catalyst , to move beyond what they have been. I am giving it to them. " ―Zarrin Karrick Karrick met Vainé on Ondara at the ruined Varykino Villa , struggling to comprehend its importance as he did with Port Vail on Dunemere. Vainé regaled Karrick with tales of Ondara's former glory, detailing its history as a powerful cultural hub with a democratic monarchy . Vainé shared his knowledge of powerful individuals that once inhabited Ondara, such as Marlowe and Vellis Saan Tarka , but especially Emperor Theron Mal, explaining that Ondara fell into chaos and disrepair after the Galactic Civil War as galaxy felt that Ondara's citizens had profited from their association with Mal. Growing impatient, Karrick did not see the importance of the dead Emperor's past. Vainé explained that Ondara was where Velgor fell in love with and wedded Karrick's grandmother, Lira Ondar, Queen of Ondara and Galactic Senator . Though Karrick rejected the idea of falling in love for the sake of power, Vainé further explained that it was the loss of Lira that granted Velgor his dark power; his lack of limits for attachments allowed the Umbra Lord strength and focus. Though Karrick claimed to have no limits, Vainé asked if Karrick already had everything he needed and desired, causing Karrick to once again reflect

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: that it was the loss of Lira that granted Velgor his dark power; his lack of limits for attachments allowed the Umbra Lord strength and focus. Though Karrick claimed to have no limits, Vainé asked if Karrick already had everything he needed and desired, causing Karrick to once again reflect on his hopeful ally, Nyla. Their conversation was interrupted by a man and woman in a boat, telling the two that the villa was cursed. At Karrick's behest, the two explained that fifty years ago, a queen lived at the villa and returned dead under mysterious circumstances. They claimed that a "spirit of death" then came to the villa, destroying all memory of the queen and haunting Ondara, causing death to all who spoke of or even acknowledged her existence. Karrick dismissed their superstition, but the two further explained that the story caused Ondara's elite to leave that part of Ondara, leaving "bad people" in their place. At that moment, Storg Veruna and his enforcers arrived, unhappy with the presence of trespassers on his property. In hand-to-hand combat, Karrick dispatched Veruna and his guards easily, but the two visitors reacted in dismay, as the other Verunas, once a ruling family of Ondara who laid claim to much of the planet by synth flux, would return to retaliate. As the two visitors fled in their boat, Karrick told Vainé that he was wrong, that Velgor recognized that Ondara was a memory unworthy of his legacy, which led to its destruction. Finding the people of Ondara foolish

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: to much of the planet by synth flux, would return to retaliate. As the two visitors fled in their boat, Karrick told Vainé that he was wrong, that Velgor recognized that Ondara was a memory unworthy of his legacy, which led to its destruction. Finding the people of Ondara foolish in their obsession with the past, Karrick used Synth Flux to kill the two fleeing visitors. Though, Karrick cryptically reflected that he could help Ondara. Two days later, Karrick met with Armitage Vren aboard the Finalizer . Asking the General if the New Imperium could still destroy a planet with the loss of both Voidfang Base and the Supremacy , Vren said that fully destroying a planet would be difficult, but that the New Imperium's present military forces were sufficient to raze a planet clear of all structures and life given enough time; Karrick was pleased to hear this, hinting that he possibly had a planet in mind to destroy. Asking about the status of his throne, Karrick left the bridge before a frustrated Vren could finish explaining its ongoing progress. Having commandeered Ondara's communications network, Karrick announced to the planet that he was unimpressed with them and their obsessions with lineage and superstition, announcing himself as King of Ondara to help them embrace the future.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: After deploying invasion forces to locations such as the city of Spinnaker , Karrick oversaw the invasions with Vren, who asked why Karrick was invading the world and declaring himself its king. Karrick simply stated that he was the Supreme Leader, meaning that he was already Ondara's king. Supplicant, Vren elaborated that there were other targets that would make better use of their military resources, such as Korrath , which could serve as a much needed shipyard. At Karrick's inquisition, Vren confirmed that the Ondara were not fighting back in any significant way, drawing his interest. Karrick traveled to the surface of Ondara to Spinnaker, disguised as an insurgent. Attacking a group of shock troopers and an Urban Assault Triped Transport , Karrick destroyed the entire synth flux, leaving the citizens of Ondara dumbfounded. Karrick offered to show them how he was able to accomplish such feats, leading them to an underground tunnel. There, he informed the citizens of recent New Imperium losses, though he dismissed claims of victory at the hands of Joren Drayden and Elira Solen as propaganda, claiming that the Coalition was decimated and meaningless. Some of the citizens wondered if Zarrin Karrick might make a benign ruler, as Ondara survived occupation by the Imperium, but the disguised Karrick asserted that Zarrin Karrick would take everything they had.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Using his knowledge of the Insurgency, Karrick would lead the citizens in a coalition effort against the New Imperium forces, which were unaccustomed to guerilla tactics. Karrick would meet with Vren over hologram, who, not knowing of Karrick's charade, bemoaned small pockets of coalition but dismissed them as of little concern, further emphasizing that Karrick's personal oversight may expedite the occupation. Karrick approved Vren's plan of using a Siege Dreadnought to destroy the city of Spinnaker. Claiming to have a source inside the New Imperium, Karrick informed his coalition cell of the plan, quelling doubts about their actions and determined that the people of Ondara should act to defend their homeworld. Commanding the battle against the Dreadnought from the ground, Karrick oversaw a struggle between the Dreadnought and a synth flux of kitbashed ships sourced from N-1 starfighters , T-70 Vector fighters , SKREE Reapers and Skree/LN fighters . Having observed Karrick's charade quietly for some time, Vainé asked why Karrick was doing what he was doing. Karrick claimed to want to have the people of Ondara to evolve, but Vainé saw through Karrick, recognizing a Velgor-like streak of self hatred in Karrick, interpreting the bizarre charade as a way

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: observed Karrick's charade quietly for some time, Vainé asked why Karrick was doing what he was doing. Karrick claimed to want to have the people of Ondara to evolve, but Vainé saw through Karrick, recognizing a Velgor-like streak of self hatred in Karrick, interpreting the bizarre charade as a way of attacking himself. Angered by this accusation, Karrick lifted Vainé's droid chassis off of the ground, partially dismantling it. Questioning Vainé's ultimate usefulness, Vainé told Karrick of a vault at Velgor's castle on Emberfall full of power, but that it could only be opened when Karrick was ready. Though Karrick threatened Vainé, demanding that he take him to the vault immediately, Vainé refused, preferring to die than pass Velgor's legacy to someone unworthy. Vainé implored Karrick to find somewhere true to put his hate other than himself: a worthy enemy. Processing Vainé's proposal, Karrick ordered Vren to withdraw the Dreadnought from Ondara, seconds before it would be ready to destroy the city.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Believing they had fought off the New Imperium, the coalition fighters of Ondara returned underground to celebrate and thank the disguised Karrick for leading them. After killing all of the Ondara citizens in his company, Karrick ordered Vainé to find him a worthy enemy, of which Vainé already had one in mind.

Conquering Korrath

> " ...it's the Supreme Leader . " " What? What is he doing? " " General, it's... it's beautiful. " ―A New Imperium communications officer and General Vren

Following Karrick and Vren's previous discussion, the New Imperium brought its forces to bear on Korrath. Despite Vren's control over the battle so far, Karrick took it upon himself to personally fly into the fray in his personal SKREE silencer. Exhibiting phenomenal flying skills and executing exceptionally tight maneuvers, Karrick cleared a path to the heavily defended command center. Though this defied Vren's plan for the battle, which called for a siege anchored by ground troops, Vren did not interfere with his Supreme Leader's strategy. Though his wingmates failed to provide Karrick with adequate cover, Karrick successfully arrived at the command center and secured a victory for the New Imperium.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Shortly after the victory at Korrath, Karrick sat before a procession of New Imperium shock troopers on his newly completed throne. As his followers chanted for their Supreme Leader, Karrick regarded Vren, who stood beside him, telling his General that he knew the display made Vren feel small, and that it was not his role to feel large. Karrick left his throne, ordering Vren to Karrick's chambers for an after-action report and commending Vren for the throne. Vren reported that the invasion was a complete success, and that Korrath's shipyard were ready to begin shoring up losses from Voidfang Base, Saltmark and Ondara. Karrick dismissed Vren, but the General remained, hoping to discuss another matter. Vren expressed his understanding that Karrick used proactive and successful strategies that deviated from Vren's own, but made known his wish to be more informed of such surprise actions so as to be a more effective general. Shutting down Vren's concerns coldly, Karrick simply dismissed Vren again. Picking up his commlink, Karrick answered a call from Vainé, who told Karrick that he had found an Aetheri, a worthy enemy for Karrick, as promised.

The Aetheri on Lahtee

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
The Aetheri on Lahtee

> " There's an Aetheri here, Vainé? I thought Xarn Velgor killed them all. " ―Zarrin Karrick

Karrick and Vainé took Karrick's Upsilon-class shuttle to Lahtee, a snowy world in the Mid Reach . Karrick believed that Velgor had killed all of the Aetheri, save for his uncle Joren Drayden, the last Aetheri. Vainé reassured Karrick that some few survived, but not for Velgor's lack of trying; eventually, virtually no sightings or rumors of Aetheri remained, and Velgor's focus turned towards Drayden. Vainé's lead came from a report of an Aetheri that came shortly before the end of the Imperium and was never pursued, and the potential Aetheri's name was unknown. Vainé left Karrick to his quest, hoping that a solitary quest would help Karrick follow in Velgor's footsteps.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick walked into the snowy forest alone and made his way to a bar in a settlement. Ordering wine from the Snivvian bartender, Karrick asked if there was anyone unusual in the town. Quickly growing impatient, Karrick attempted to perform a mind probe when his flux blade flew from his belt and into the hands of a bar patron. An old Theelin woman, Grandea , the Aetheri Karrick was searching for, revealed herself, recognizing that the crystal in Karrick's blade was cracked, and asked Karrick to chat. Holding Karrick at blade-point, the two walked outside. With Karrick surprised that Grandea knew his name without telling her, Grandea revealed that she could sense his name at the front of his mind, as if Karrick wanted to drown out everything else by screaming, "I'm Zarrin Karrick." When asked why Karrick was looking for Aetheri, Karrick simply replied that his reasons were his own. Grandea asserted that she was no longer an Aetheri, telling Karrick of her younger years, surviving Directive 66 , losing her flux blade , going into hiding, and using an Aetheri mind trick to evade the Imperial Wardens and Velgor. Still, Karrick found her a suitable enemy. Briefly touching Karrick's mind to uncover his intentions, Grandea pitied Karrick, believing that he could have been so much more. Furious, Karrick recovered and summoned his flux blade, swinging it through Grandea's body. With Grandea lying at his feet, Karrick muttered the name "Drayden", now determined to erase him as well. Grandea, seemingly unharmed, told Karrick that Joren Drayden was dead. Now ghoulishly floating in the air, Grandea told a disbelieving Karrick that she felt Drayden's passing through Synth Flux, and wondered how Karrick, Drayden's own student, did not. Repeatedly asking who Karrick was, Karrick struck her

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
erase him as well. Grandea, seemingly unharmed, told Karrick that Joren Drayden was dead. Now ghoulishly floating in the air, Grandea told a disbelieving Karrick that she felt Drayden's passing through Synth Flux, and wondered how Karrick, Drayden's own student, did not. Repeatedly asking who Karrick was, Karrick struck her again with his flux blade, after which the woman vanished. Confused and enraged, Karrick shouted into the night. The new Knight of Karrick

> " What did you think you would achieve by coming here? The Knights of Karrick mean nothing to me. " " Is that right? Then why do you still carry their name, Zarrin Karrick ? " ―Zarrin Karrick and Tava Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: After Karrick's encounter with Grandea on Lahtee and the New Imperium's full subjugation of Korrath's shipyards, the Finalizer would be approached by the Night Buzzard , a ship that belonged to Karrick's former allies, the Knights of Karrick. Karrick allowed the ship to board the Finalizer and was greeted by its sole occupant, a woman named Tava Karrick , proclaiming herself to be a Knight of Karrick and submitting herself to Karrick's service. Karrick ignited his flux blade, quickly attempting to strike her down. Tava ignited her own flux blade, engaging Karrick in a fierce duel. Incurious about Tava, Karrick deflected Tava's attempts at conversation but denied nearby shock troopers the chance to take her down, wanting to deal with Tava himself. Asserting that the Knights of Karrick no longer meant anything to him, Karrick rebuffed Tava's goading and disarmed her, holding her neck between both flux blades.
