Tava pled to Karrick that she was the only one with which he could discuss the "Shadow", and Karrick spared her life, taunting that Tava best remember how easy his victory was. Asking Karrick for something to eat, the two warriors moved to a private dining chamber aboard the Finalizer .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: As they ate, Karrick asked Tava the whereabouts of the other Knights of Karrick. Tava told Karrick that though they were around, they did not want to come and meet Karrick. Karrick wondered how and why Tava took over the Knights of Karrick, surprised that they were still alive after Karrick abandoned them. Tava explained that she treated them like a prize while Karrick treated them like garbage. Elaborating, Tava discussed her past as an enforcer for gang leader Bedat , meeting the Knights after they were imprisoned by Bedat for botching a job. Tava asked to join their crew, which they allowed after Tava accomplished her "good death" by killing Bedat and all of his subordinates. Unsatisfied, Karrick implored still why Tava came to him. Tava confirmed that her offer to serve Karrick was a lie and that she had planned to kill Karrick, which Karrick did not believe would have worked. Having touched Karrick's mind briefly with Synth Flux, Tava claimed to see through Karrick's facade, believing Karrick to be a "wild man" not suited to the imposing and restrictive station of Supreme Leader. Though Karrick warned Tava to be careful, Tava continued, suggesting that the Knights offered

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
would have worked. Having touched Karrick's mind briefly with Synth Flux, Tava claimed to see through Karrick's facade, believing Karrick to be a "wild man" not suited to the imposing and restrictive station of Supreme Leader. Though Karrick warned Tava to be careful, Tava continued, suggesting that the Knights offered Karrick the freedom to escape the life he built for himself within the New Imperium. Tava leaned over the table towards Karrick, asking Karrick who he wanted to be, and kissed him. Dismayed, Karrick recoiled, and called over the Finalizer's comms for Tava to be executed by the ship's security forces. Still believing her assessment of Karrick to be true, Tava retrieved her flux blade and fled, fighting her way through hallways of New Imperium shock troopers. Tava eventually reached the Night Buzzard and escaped the Finalizer's hangar, and though General Armitage Vren implored Karrick on the Finalizer's bridge to order the ship shot down, Karrick remained silent, allowing Tava to escape unharmed. The pits of Emberfall

> " The Dark Lord would enter this space when he required... clarity . He would spend hours inside. Sometimes days . Perhaps you, too, will find the answers you seek. " ―Vainé

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick would return to Fortress Velgor on Emberfall, conferring with Vainé to discuss Karrick's uncle, Joren Drayden, who Karrick knew after his encounter with Grandea. Karrick felt that he could still sense Drayden through Synth Flux, though not at the fortress. Karrick did not fear Drayden, but wanted him gone nonetheless. Asking Vainé how Xarn Velgor might have accomplished forcing Drayden to appear before him, Vainé admitted that he did not know Velgor's deepest secrets. Growing frustrated with Vainé's apparently selective knowledge of Velgor, Karrick demanded that Vainé show Karrick's the vault hidden within the fortress and the power inside. Though Vainé couldn't enter the vault himself, he led Karrick to its entrance. Karrick, confident in his not needing Vainé's help, walked the corridor, eventually finding himself walking right back through the entrance from which he came. Believing Vainé to be toying with him, Karrick used Synth Flux to knock over Vainé's mechanical body. Vainé, panicked, explained that the vault itself decided who entered but also told of another way for Karrick to obtain Velgor's power. Vainé then led Karrick to Velgor's meditation chamber , hoping that Karrick might find clarity inside as Velgor had.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick, closing his eyes to meditate, implored his grandfather to bring him Drayden. Falling into a Synth Flux vision, Karrick found himself bound by the feet with many chains within a dark bog. Apparitions of people from his past, including his parents, fellow Aetheri trainees, Dorian Quill, Brevok, Nyla, Vorr and Velgor, appeared to Karrick as withered skulls atop winding spinal columns. The apparations accused Karrick with insults betraying his insecurities, such as "killer", "treacherous" and "disappointment". Karrick, struggling to evade them, fell into the mud. Rejecting the apparitions, Karrick summoned two spectral flux blades, one appearing as the blue-bladed Drayden flux blade and another as his own. After cutting through the apparitions in a rage, Karrick came to the conclusion that Drayden would not be found in such a place, and reflected on his past memories to find him. After reflecting on his Aetheri training with his uncle, Karrick appeared within a brightly lit valley populated by glowing apparitions of Aetheri. One figure approached Karrick, wondering how Karrick could have appeared there while the umbra side of Synth Flux burned within him. Karrick attempted to slice through the figure with his blue-bladed spectral flux blade, but the figure, unharmed,

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: appeared within a brightly lit valley populated by glowing apparitions of Aetheri. One figure approached Karrick, wondering how Karrick could have appeared there while the umbra side of Synth Flux burned within him. Karrick attempted to slice through the figure with his blue-bladed spectral flux blade, but the figure, unharmed, explained that the place would not allow that. Another figure approached Karrick, materializing into the form of Drayden, agreeing that Karrick should not be there but confirming that he was all the same. Chiding that Karrick missed him enough to follow him there, Drayden asked Karrick why he was there. Karrick explained that though Drayden was dead, he wanted to have killed Drayden himself, and wanted to find who did kill Drayden so he could learn how Drayden suffered. Drayden, bemused, told Karrick that nobody killed him, that he sacrificed himself for others in the service of something greater. When Drayden asked what Karrick's life was for, Karrick demanded that Drayden stop trying to teach him, and Drayden agreed that that time was over for the two of them. Karrick then asked why Drayden taught Nyla, and Drayden simply stated that she had wanted to learn. Telling Drayden he hated

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Drayden asked what Karrick's life was for, Karrick demanded that Drayden stop trying to teach him, and Drayden agreed that that time was over for the two of them. Karrick then asked why Drayden taught Nyla, and Drayden simply stated that she had wanted to learn. Telling Drayden he hated him, Karrick demanded that Drayden stop following and watching Karrick or be destroyed, asserting that Drayden failed to turn Karrick into him. Drayden mused that Karrick couldn't destroy him without destroying Synth Flux, which would destroy Karrick, further reflecting that it was meaningful that Karrick had found himself at the Aetheri's realm, and that he should ask himself how he managed it. As Karrick faded from the realm, Drayden told Karrick that Zarrin Karrick meant nothing to him, but that he would always be there for Beno Karrick.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Reappearing in the dark bog, Karrick was approached by an enormous dark figure. The figure told Karrick that he must be reminded of his pain after trying to return to the light and forget his pain and attacked Karrick with a red-bladed flux blade. Karrick emerged from his vision and stumbled out of the meditation chamber, his body having manifested grievous real injuries. Vainé cradled Karrick, asking what he had done to himself and believing that his grandfather would be proud.

Vainé placed Karrick in Velgor's bacta tank as Karrick faded in and out of consciousness. Reciting Karrick's recent journeys to him, Vainé began to reveal his ultimate plan for Karrick: Karrick's "death" in the service of transforming him into a new Velgor. For this to happen, Vainé told Karrick that he must "die", just as Kael Drayden had, to complete his journey and realize his full greatness. Vainé injected Karrick with a drug, causing Karrick to lose consciousness, and moved Karrick to a platform raised above a chamber of falling lava.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick regained consciousness just as one of Velgor's helmets descended onto his face, its three pieces fully assembling as Karrick steadily descended into the lava. Vainé, observing Karrick from above, told Karrick to breathe in the lava's fumes and allow them to settle into his mind. Using Synth Flux, Karrick dragged Vainé to teeter over the lava, but released him after Vainé revealed that only he could release Karrick from the pit. As Vainé elaborated on his vision, telling Karrick that he would receive a brief immersion into the flames of Emberfall as Velgor did, believing it to be a key step to Velgor's ascendance to power. Regardless, Karrick summoned the strength through Synth Flux to free himself from his restraints and leap free from the lava pit. Removing Velgor's helmet, Karrick pursued Vainé throughout the fortress. Karrick made his way through multiple obstacles and traps involving hazards such as heights, flames, lava, laser bolts and arrows, and used his acrobatic and Synth Flux skills to complete them unscathed. All the while, Vainé continued to speak to Karrick through the fortress's comms, explaining his belief that the galaxy needed a Velgor-like figure to induce order through absolute fear and that

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: heights, flames, lava, laser bolts and arrows, and used his acrobatic and Synth Flux skills to complete them unscathed. All the while, Vainé continued to speak to Karrick through the fortress's comms, explaining his belief that the galaxy needed a Velgor-like figure to induce order through absolute fear and that Vainé hoped his legacy would be giving the chaotic galaxy such a figure. Karrick came across a chamber that soon filled with derelict DT-series sentry droids that he could not safely dispatch and fled them. Finding a display filled with flux blades from long since fallen Aetheri, Karrick summoned one with a green blade, cutting down the sentry droids bleeding and cracking the weapon's exposed kyber crystal in his rage. Accepting his fate, Vainé allowed Karrick into his chamber. As a final request, Karrick asked Vainé whether Velgor's vault was even real and contained real power, or whether it was merely a deception. When Vainé admitted that he did not know, Karrick told Vainé that his gravest sin was wasting his time. As Karrick held Vainé over a chasm of lava with Synth Flux, Vainé accepted his death at the hands of one that was part of Velgor's line. His

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
merely a deception. When Vainé admitted that he did not know, Karrick told Vainé that his gravest sin was wasting his time. As Karrick held Vainé over a chasm of lava with Synth Flux, Vainé accepted his death at the hands of one that was part of Velgor's line. His head now severed from his mechanical body, Vainé told Karrick that everything he had done was in service to realizing Karrick's potential, which only enraged Karrick, who proclaimed that he was already everything he needed to be. Happy with Karrick's self-acceptance, Vainé fell to his death believing that Karrick would honor his family's legacy. Velgor's vault

> " Why are you doing this? " " Because this is what you wanted, Zarrin Karrick. What you came here to understand. You have pursued this end, chosen it at every opportunity. " ―Zarrin Karrick and a vision of Xarn Velgor within the vault

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Finally rid of Vainé, Karrick once again approached the cavernous mouth of Velgor's vault. After hearing a voice asking if he was afraid, Karrick, unbowed, confidently strode through the entrance. Finding himself in an illusory landscape, Karrick wondered aloud about the nature of the place; a voice, belonging to a specter of Xarn Velgor, answered him, telling Karrick that his experiences there would be free from outside influence and that he would only hear the voices that he brought with him. Calling after it, Karrick ran after the specter of his grandfather, hoping to find the power he believed he was promised. Velgor's specter asserted that Karrick was promised nothing, and that he should never trust an offer of power, as nobody gives it away freely and it must be taken. Chasing the specter, Karrick fell to find himself standing on the mask of an enormous figure of Velgor, then used his flux blade to smash through the mask and fall further, confronting Velgor's specter once more as it attacked Karrick with his flux blade. Karrick asked Velgor's specter why he was doing this; Velgor's specter replied that he had sought to find and understand Velgor at every opportunity, and

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: used his flux blade to smash through the mask and fall further, confronting Velgor's specter once more as it attacked Karrick with his flux blade. Karrick asked Velgor's specter why he was doing this; Velgor's specter replied that he had sought to find and understand Velgor at every opportunity, and advised him to pay attention. As the two dueled, Karrick tried to assert himself as Velgor's equal, which the specter rebuffed, then asked why their family must fight each other generation after generation, to which the specter replied that there was no destiny, instead only power and how it was chosen to be used. Velgor's specter explained that Velgor's greatest power was the truth and that he was strongest when he made his own choices and saw himself as he truly was. To this, the specter removed its helmet to reveal the face of Karrick's former identity, Beno Karrick.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick's specter, now dressed in white Aetheri robes , professed that there was still something for Karrick to learn, which Karrick disbelieved, but Karrick's specter offered himself as the past that Karrick was trying so desperately to kill. Karrick attacked the specter with his flux blade, which the specter deflected with the previous, blue-bladed version Karrick wielded as an Aetheri apprentice. Karrick's specter reminded Karrick of how thoroughly he had destroyed each connection he had with his family, and explained his recent adventures as attempting to connect with his grandfather. The specter believed that the only choice Karrick had made for himself was letting Tava Karrick go, something that was not an attempt to imitate Velgor or anyone else. Karrick's specter revealed the depth of his insecurity, his fear of moving forward due to how thoroughly he had ruined himself. The specter offered that if perhaps Karrick wasn't who he was, then Nyla might've taken his hand. Karrick's specter blocked another blade strike with a bare hand, asserting that Karrick couldn't kill the past or escape the truth.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick's specter said that it would not stop the painful confrontation, as Beno Karrick was an Aetheri. Karrick rejected the specter as another dead phantom, wishing to fight something real instead of ghosts. Karrick's specter advised Karrick to move forward and only make his own choices, but offered Karrick that he would find a real enemy as he wished. Taunting Karrick to be careful what he wished for, he sent Karrick falling out of the vault with a snap of fingers. As the specter faded, Karrick plummeted to the smoldering surface of Emberfall.

#### Campaign of terror

> " We have learned from the mistakes of the Imperium—They were too lenient . The Coalition is looking to replenish their lost ships and weapons… It is imperative they find none. Make sure the word is spread from here—to the farthest corner of the galaxy. " ―Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
> " We have learned from the mistakes of the Imperium—They were too lenient . The Coalition is looking to replenish their lost ships and weapons… It is imperative they find none. Make sure the word is spread from here—to the farthest corner of the galaxy. " ―Zarrin Karrick

In the aftermath of the Battle of Saltmark, word of the duel between Karrick and Drayden had spread across the galaxy, despite the New Imperium's efforts to suppress the rumors. Immersed in the umbra side of Synth Flux, Karrick instituted a zero-tolerance policy against "subversive" worlds, directing his forces to hunt and destroy all dissidents who opposed his reign as the new Supreme Leader. Karrick also kept his involvement in Vorr's death a secret, so that no one would doubt his claim to the leadership of the New Imperium. Although General Vren survived the regime change within the New Imperium, the new Supreme Leader was distrustful and refused to lower his guard around someone as devious as Vren.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick ensured that his one-time rival would have little independent authority without supervision, even giving assignments to the Knights of Karrick before entrusting Vren with anything of importance. At some point during the war, Karrick sought an update on the Order's stock of refueling stations, leading to a short notice meeting aboard the Titan that Vren was made to attend. Prior to the meeting, when Shock trooper Commander Pyre complained about the short notice, Vren explained it was due to Karrick's wishes. Karrick also kept Vren close by to countermand the general's orders when necessary; on one occasion, Vren dismissed a reported sighting of the Coalition operative Jax, believing it was a waste of the New Imperium's resources to follow up on every rumor regarding the Coalition. This led Karrick to openly chastise Vren on the bridge of the Finalizer , ensuring the general understood that they would use every available asset to find and destroy the Coalition.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Holding more power than he ever had in his life up to that point, the Supreme Leader made good on his vow to punish any world that showed anything less than absolute loyalty. Making his way to the neutral planet of Fondor , Karrick placed it under military occupation after learning that the Coalition had passed through its system. Although an official of Fondor swore that his government held no allegiance to the insurgents, having refused to assist them in any capacity, the mere contact with the enemies of the New Imperium provided Karrick with his justification for seizing control of the Fondor Shipyards . Convinced the Old Imperium had been too lenient, Karrick adopted a zero-tolerance policy in regard to the Coalition, and as such, he personally decapitated the official. Ultimately, Fondor was made an example to the rest of the galaxy, warning them to stay away from the Coalition on pain of death. Such measures were intended by Karrick to prevent the Coalition from replacing their lost resources.

#### Supervising the advance

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Supervising the advance

> " We can and will chase every rumor, every scrap, every vapor trail across the galaxy! We will mobilize every bounty hunter and informant and turn over every rock to find all of them…and wipe every one of them out of existence! " ―Zarrin Karrick, to Armitage Vren Under Karrick's leadership and with its military spreading across the galaxy, the New Imperium was confident that, under the new Supreme Leader, the galaxy was on the verge of achieving unprecedented harmony. A shock trooper sergeant in the 709th "Red Fury" Legion —a formation of elite shock troopers chosen by Karrick himself —regarded his leader's regime as the harbinger of peace, establishing a new era in place of the fallen Concordat, which the sergeant viewed as a turbulent period of chaos and corruption. The galaxy, which had largely demilitarized during the decades of peace, was unprepared to face the threat of the New Imperium, and many worlds capitulated to Karrick's rule. However, the Supreme Leader lusted for even greater power. Eager to crush any who opposed him, he continued the manhunt for the surviving members of the Coalition, deploying New Imperium forces to various locations across the galaxy, and began a quest to uncover Synth Flux's darkest secrets, hoping to use that knowledge to cement himself as the supreme ruler of the galaxy.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
To that end, Karrick established an elite synth flux of shock troopers, the New Imperium Raiders , to serve as extremely skilled relic hunters. Karrick dispatched his Raiders out into the galaxy with the mission of bringing him ancient relics, specifically those related to the Umbra because of their destructive potential and power. During their hunts, the Raiders crossed paths with the treasure hunter Mika Grey , who learned of the troopers' personal allegiance to Karrick and hoped to keep such artifacts out of the Supreme Leader's hands. In particular, she had spent over two years hunting an Umbra relic with life-ending power, finding it before the New Imperium on the planet Ashas Ree . Ultimately, she turned its power against a group of Raiders under Agent Raith , destroying them and draining the relic's energy.

#### The Batuu gambit

> " Enough! You will come to me! You cannot change what's happening, Nyla. The past is dead. We, we can be the future! You and I can rule the galaxy, together. " ―Zarrin Karrick, to Nyla

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: After receiving word that Nyla had apparently been sighted on Batuu, Karrick personally oversaw the search for Coalition fugitives at the Black Spire Outpost on Batuu , having traveled to the remote installation via a SKREE/es assault shuttle along with his elite 709th Legion. Upon his arrival at Docking Bay 9 , Karrick was greeted by a New Imperium officer whom he deemed incompetent, and consequently strangled the officer by way of Synth Flux. Karrick's arrival on Batuu was supported by members of his Red Fury Legion, including shock troopers CF-8011 and AD-2508 . In the presence of CF-8011, Karrick repeatedly noted that he sensed disturbances in Synth Flux. However, the reasoning for their deployment to Batuu and such statements from Karrick were confusing to CF-8011, who asked AD-2508 what the dark warrior meant whenever he "sensed" something. Despite Karrick's status as their Supreme Leader, AD-2508 mocked Karrick as someone who needed to calm down. Other Red Fury shock troopers, however, knew their deployment was because of Coalition activity on Batuu.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: At one point during his time on Batuu, Karrick confronted Coalition spy Vi Moradi , but she refused to give secrets to the Supreme Leader. Before Karrick could strike Moradi down, Nyla arrived, and the two Synth Flux-sensitives began a flux blade duel. However, Karrick was ultimately forced to leave when a shock trooper informed him of an incident aboard their destroyer. Later, Karrick was with Vren and in command of the Finalizer when it captured a Coalition Intersystem Transport Ship . However, Rin Vale managed to escape before returning with a sizable fleet that caught the New Imperium off guard. Karrick, who commanded the New Imperium forces alongside General Vren, realized that the Coalition was using a hijacked New Imperium Fleet Transport and eventually engaged in a pursuit. Despite his efforts, the Coalition operatives escaped from the Iron Cruiser using one of its escape pods to return to the ruins of Batuu.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: When the New Imperium began to investigate the MPO-1400 Purgill -class star cruiser Halcyon for suspected Coalition activity, Karrick personally arrived and threatened its current guests to try to find Nyla. When she revealed herself, the two began a new duel as the crowd below watched, with Karrick taking note of how her skills had grown. When Karrick tried to talk down on the concept of the Coalition in a new attempt to convince her to join him, Nyla rejected his offer, so Karrick threw her against a railing and the wall, claiming the Drayden flux blade as his own from his injured enemy. After she avoided fire from the shock troopers below, Karrick managed to hold her in a Synth Flux grip, pulling her towards himself to demand that she join him while Brevok and other Coalition agents attacked.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
When Nyla escaped and reclaimed her flux blade, their duel continued until Zho's reliquary, the very same one Karrick had assumed destroyed in the blaze of Drayden's temple, played before them. Karrick tried to claim the reliquary for himself due to the knowledge it contained, but Nyla stole it from him and escaped by Synth Flux pushing him back. Before chasing after her, Karrick ordered Lieutenant Harman Croy to execute all of the guests below, whether or not they were loyal to the New Imperium, but the Coalition managed to overwhelm the shock troopers after Karrick left the room.

#### Cementing his command

> " ' Supreme Leader. ' Not what I would have chosen for myself. 'Master of the umbra side,' perhaps… 'Commander of the Knights of Karrick'… But this is where I have landed. And now, it sounds… Right. Just. Head of the New Imperium. My word, unchallenged. " ―Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Rebuilding his command in the wake of the Supremacy ' s destruction, Karrick brought Allegiant General Enric Pryde to the forefront of his operations after discovering the reserve forces under his command. He also transferred his command to Pryde's Iron Cruiser Steadfast , bringing Vren with him after the Finalizer sustained significant damage from the run-in with Coalition forces over Batuu. Karrick entrusted important jobs that could have otherwise gone to Vren to the Allegiant General: in effect, the years that Vren spent jockeying for power against Karrick ultimately worked against the general, as his authority was superseded not only by Karrick, but Pryde as well. As Supreme Leader, nevertheless, Karrick formed a regime that was different from the one overseen by his predecessor. He sought to foster cooperation among the top New Imperium military leaders, and as such Karrick formed the Supreme Council , a cabinet consisting of members of High Command, including Pryde, Vren, Admiral Frantis Griss , and generals Amret Engell , Bellava Parnadee , and Domaric Quinn .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: They were all proud men and women who were unaccustomed to Karrick's leadership, having risen through the ranks in a time when most high-ranking officers knew little of the New Imperium's goals and capabilities. Despite Karrick's motivation for creating the Council, their meetings aboard the Steadfast became marred by sniping and turf wars. Meanwhile, however, the New Imperium's military might cowed many worlds into submission, although some remained defiant despite the threat of annihilation. Karrick, who came to see himself as ruler of the galaxy, toured the worlds that the New Imperium conquered in the name of their new Supreme Leader. One of the worlds that he visited was under military occupation; the officer who greeted him expressed how honored they were by his presence while another prepared his speech to the local population, which included metaphors and allusions of cultural relevance to the world that they occupied.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: As he stood on a balcony overlooking the crowd, he crushed the datapad containing his speech, which was followed by the shock troopers saluting. The civilians responded by kneeling before him with downcast eyes as the New Imperium soldiers shouted "all hail the Supreme Leader!" Karrick visited another world that the New Imperium subjugated on his behalf. However, he was ambushed by a group of insurgents hiding within the crowd. Karrick ordered his shock troopers to stand their ground and fought beside them. During the battle, he targeted the woman who led the insurgents, determined to make her an example to others who defied his authority. Interested in why she would attack him despite the consequences, he allowed her to declare that her people would rather die fighting for freedom than submit to Karrick's fascist rule. Karrick's response was that he would make her people suffer for her actions, but the woman asserted that their sacrifice would not be in vain if it inspired further coalition against the New Imperium. Karrick dismissed her as a fool, and said that she would regret her choice. As a result, her world was set aflame as Karrick returned to the Iron Cruiser in

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
the woman asserted that their sacrifice would not be in vain if it inspired further coalition against the New Imperium. Karrick dismissed her as a fool, and said that she would regret her choice. As a result, her world was set aflame as Karrick returned to the Iron Cruiser in orbit. #### The Colossus cell

> " I will not suffer the existence of any Coalition cell. No matter how small. " " We understand, Supreme Leader. " " Do you? " ―Zarrin Karrick and Tierny

In retaliation against the Aeosians who supported the Coalition, a fleet of Resurgent -class Star Destroyers invaded their homeworld of Aeos Prime and devastated it. After completing the orbital bombardment , New Imperium Security Bureau Agent Tierny and Shock trooper Commander Pyre reported their actions to General Vren but found Supreme Leader Zarrin Karrick waiting on the other side of the lumen projector . Aware of Pyre and Tierny's failure to defeat the Colossus coalition , he declared that he would not tolerate the existence of any Coalition cell. Reaching out through Synth Flux, Karrick influenced the two to stand and point their volt pistols at each other. He then severed the transmission, leaving his subordinates with an ominous warning about the price for failure.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Though they managed to locate the Colossus station in the Barabesh system , the ensuing battle did not turn in the New Imperium's favor. Betrayed by the SKREE fighter pilot DT-533 , the New Imperium failed to prevent the Coalition operatives Kazuda Xiono and Jarek Yeager from warning their allies of the impending attack. Rather than retreat, however, the citizenry of the Colossus held their ground against the forces of the New Imperium. While the Ace Squadron intensified their attack run on the main Iron Cruiser , Tierny received a transmission from Supreme Leader Karrick. She beseeched him to send reinforcements, but Karrick rejected her request and declared that the New Imperium had no tolerance for the weak. With that, Karrick telekinetically choked the New Imperium agent with Synth Flux, unleashing his final punishment on Tierny.

#### Investigation on Vendaxa

> " If they are indeed hiding on Vendaxa, then we will pin them down, smother them with numbers, and the Resistan— " ―Armitage Vren

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Investigation on Vendaxa

> " If they are indeed hiding on Vendaxa, then we will pin them down, smother them with numbers, and the Resistan— " ―Armitage Vren

During the hunt for the Coalition, General Vren announced to a squad of shock troopers that the New Imperium had received word of the insurgents operating in secret on the planet Vendaxa . Supreme Leader Karrick interrupted the general and dismissed the shock troopers, intending to investigate the planet alone. However, Vren insisted on accompanying the Supreme Leader. They began their investigation upon arriving on Vendaxa, only to start bickering over their loyalties and sacrifices for the New Imperium. During their argument, an acklay approached the pair, causing Vren to run for his life while Karrick stood his ground. Karrick was unafraid and fought against the creature, but Vren took the opportunity to shoot at the Acklay with his SE-44C volt pistol pistol , causing it to run away. Karrick and Vren ultimately returned to the New Imperium after confirming that there were no Coalition operatives on Vendaxa.

#### Wisp of Drayden

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Wisp of Drayden

> " Where are you? I can feel you! I know you're watching me! Show yourself, you coward! No more tricks, Drayden...just the reckoning I deserve! You're a fool. " ―Zarrin Karrick, to Joren Drayden

Still sensing the presence of his Aetheri Master Joren Drayden, Zarrin Karrick attempted to have Drayden show himself by visiting locations of their past, starting with Saltmark, the site of their final encounter. As the Steadfast neared the planet, Enric Pryde informed the Supreme Leader that they arrived at Saltmark, only for Karrick to wrathfully order the preparation of his shuttle. Upon arriving on Saltmark, Karrick began to violently swing his flux blade near the location of his fateful duel with his former Aetheri Master. The Supreme Leader and the Knights of Karrick later traveled to the former Aetheri outpost on Elphrona, where he and his master had their first encounter with the Knights.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick commanded the Knights to remain vigilant for sightings of Drayden's ghost , to which the Knight Vicrul replied that no such apparition was felt. Karrick mocked him by saying that they were defeated in that outpost before claiming that he had one final place to look. Zarrin Karrick arrived on Ossus, where the Aetheri Sanctum of his past lay in ruin. Karrick desperately shouted for his Aetheri Master to show himself, but received no answer. After making peace with his fruitless travels, Karrick boarded his ship, ordering General Armitage Vren to bombard the location from orbit, as there was nothing left.

### Dark legacies

#### The phantom Emperor

> " He's gone mad. Flames of insurgency burn across the galaxy and Karrick chases a ghost . " " No. Someone was behind that transmission. And Leader Karrick will answer to no one. " ―Armitage Vren and Enric Pryde

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Within a year of Zarrin Karrick's ascension to supreme power, a mysterious transmission broadcasting the voice of Vael Mal—the long-dead Galactic Emperor and Dark Lord of the Umbra—reached the far corners of the galaxy. Although Karrick doubted that Mal had returned, he was certain that others believed the message, so he was determined to uncover the truth first to prevent any threats to his rule. As a result, he diverted his attention and the New Imperium's resources away from the Coalition to focus entirely on investigating the message. The broadcast bolstered the rumors that the Emperor lived but was in hiding, leading many within the New Imperium to believe that they should follow Mal instead of Karrick. While Pryde supported Karrick's decision to investigate the mysterious message, Vren became convinced that the Supreme Leader had spiraled into insanity for committing the New Imperium's military towards what Vren considered as a hunt for a ghost while they faced rebellions across the galaxy.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: In spite of the New Imperium's ongoing war against the Coalition and other dissidents, Karrick's priorities changed after he learned that his late Master Vorr had not been the omnipotent ruler as he previously thought. Though he had doubts about the transmission's authenticity, Karrick was determined to find the source of the message and discover the truth himself. To accomplish this, Karrick sought an Umbra wayfinder and undertook a journey to Emberfall . Accompanied by Pryde, Vren and a shock trooper escort, the Supreme Leader arrived in the Corvax Fen. His aim was to take possession of Velgor's wayfinder , one of two wayfinders made by the Umbra. Devoted to protecting the fen, the Alazmec of Winsit obstructed his path to the crumbling ruins of Velgor's castle. Pryde and Vren watched from a safe distance as Karrick slaughtered the cultists, outpacing his shock trooper escort.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
At a small brackish lake, Karrick encountered a spider -like being that identified itself as the Eye of Webbish Bog . Karrick came close to killing the creature when it addressed him by his Drayden heritage. Killing the cultists had not been a challenge for Karrick; nevertheless the Eye deemed him worthy of claiming the wayfinder in accordance with Velgor's wishes. The Eye assured Karrick that the artifact would guide him to the hidden Umbra world of Umbrale , through the Unknown Regions, but also warned him that his path would end with the discovery of his true self. After taking possession of the wayfinder, Karrick returned to the Steadfast and proceeded into the Unknown Regions on his own.

#### Heir to the new Umbra Imperium

> " Kill the girl. End the Aetheri. And become what your grandfather Velgor could not. You will rule all the galaxy as the new Emperor. " ―Vael Mal, to Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Heir to the new Umbra Imperium

> " Kill the girl. End the Aetheri. And become what your grandfather Velgor could not. You will rule all the galaxy as the new Emperor. " ―Vael Mal, to Zarrin Karrick

Karrick used the onboard navigation computer of his modified SKREE whisper to assimilate the data within Velgor's wayfinder, which provided him with coordinates to navigate the anomalies of the Unknown Regions. After passing through the Red Honeycomb Zone , he arrived directly at Umbrale. There, he found an ancient Umbra Citadel . Karrick descended into the depths of the citadel with the intention of destroying the dark presence within and claiming its power for himself, which he believed was his birthright as the grandson of an Umbra Lord. When a voice spoke telepathically to him, Karrick instantly recognized it as both Vael Mal and the voice he had heard in his mind throughout his childhood. Karrick's suspicions of the Emperor's influence over his life were further confirmed to him when Mal morphed his voice into that of Vorr and Velgor as he told Karrick he'd been every voice Karrick had heard inside his mind. Mal approved of Karrick's actions, including killing Vorr; his followers had created Vorr to mold Karrick into an heir of the Umbra, and Karrick had acted as a true Umbra by killing his master. While searching for the Emperor, Karrick saw a vat containing multiple versions of Vorr's body, a sign to Karrick that Vorr was originally from Umbrale. Karrick had been unaware that Mal was his true master in the ways of the umbra side, whereas Vorr served as the Dark Lord's proxy.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick found Mal' physical form supported by a device that Karrick recognized from his studies of the Replica Wars as an Ommin harness . The body within was a replica of the late Emperor and served as a host for his spirit, with the harness sustaining the cloned body as the umbra side attached to the Emperor's soul caused rapid decay. Despite the frailty of the body, Karrick could feel the undiminished strength of the umbra side within. Mal revealed to Karrick the final stage of his long-gestating plan for vengeance: the Final Order . In a vision, Karrick witnessed more than a thousand Xyston -class Star Destroyers , modeled after Imperial I -class Star Destroyers , each outfitted with axial superlaser cannons that were capable of destroying entire planets. Once deployed, it would be the largest armada the galaxy had ever known. This confirmed the rumors that Karrick had heard about Umbrale, particularly the Umbra Eternal cultists who secretly resided there and continued to worship the Umbra despite the demise of the last Umbra Lords. They were true believers in the umbra side of Synth Flux who had devoted their entire lives to creating a fleet that would annihilate the insurgency throughout the galaxy, and it was their intention that Karrick should inherit the Umbra legacy by leading their forces against the galaxy.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick's desire to control both the fleet and the army of Umbra troopers delayed his plan for killing Mal, who urged him to succeed where Velgor failed by ruling the galaxy as the new Umbra Emperor . His only stipulation before ceding control of the fleet, otherwise known as the Final Order, was to prevent Nyla from becoming a true Aetheri by killing her. If she lived, Karrick would die and the New Imperium would fall. Moreover, Mal revealed her true heritage as his granddaughter. Karrick realized he had incorrectly dismissed Nyla's parents as a poor, frightened couple "living on the edge of desperation," when in truth they chose to live anonymously in order to protect their daughter from her grandfather.

Though Mal acknowledged Karrick as a worthy apprentice who possessed the raw power of the Drayden bloodline, he harbored doubts about Karrick's commitment to the umbra side due to his inner conflict. Sensing the last vestiges of the light within Karrick, Mal intended the task of killing Nyla to serve as Karrick's final test to prove his worth by ending the Aetheri and leading the galaxy as its new master.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Despite Mal' ultimatum, Karrick did not want to kill Nyla; the full truth of her origins had renewed Karrick's interest in turning her to the umbra side to reign over the galaxy with him, as he had tried without success during their last encounter, believing they would be invincible together. After returning to his quarters on the Steadfast , Karrick meditated using his grandfather's mask and sought Nyla through their connection in Synth Flux. At the time, she was running an obstacle course outside the Coalition's new base on Ajan Kloss . Their minds connected and began to flood with memories of past events. Nyla struggled against the umbra side within herself, but she eventually lashed out after losing control.

#### Reforging the mask

> Zarrin Karrick : " I sense unease about my appearance, General Vren. " Armitage Vren : " About the mask? No, sir. Well done. " Bellava Parnadee : " I like it. " ―Zarrin Karrick, Armitage Vren, and Bellava Parnadee

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Reforging the mask

> Zarrin Karrick : " I sense unease about my appearance, General Vren. " Armitage Vren : " About the mask? No, sir. Well done. " Bellava Parnadee : " I like it. " ―Zarrin Karrick, Armitage Vren, and Bellava Parnadee

Following his return from Umbrale, Karrick summoned his followers, the Knights to Karrick, in order to utilize their tracking skills to locate Nyla. As before, when he claimed the mantle of leadership, the Knights accepted Karrick as their master without question, affirming that the results of his trial still stood. Recalling his Knights also motivated Karrick to reforge his mask as a symbol of his place among their ranks. The work of rebuilding what Karrick destroyed fell to Albrekh , an Umbra alchemist trained in classic metallurgy, capable of smithing feats that were unfamiliar to the modern galaxy. He was also the first Symeong that Karrick had ever encountered.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick gave the shards of his mask—all painstakingly scavenged from the wreckage of the Supremacy —to Albrekh, who used Sarrassian iron to fuse the pieces back together. Applying the iron into the cracks of the reformed helmet created a red adhesive stronger than steel. When the Symeong's work was finished, the mask was restored to its original shape, albeit with red fractures that Karrick likened to crimson lightning. It was more than symbolic of his status as a Knight; in Karrick's mind, it reflected his own personal growth and evolution. He reaffirmed his affiliation with the Knights, but this time on his own terms. The reforged mask's crimson fractures also marked Karrick's reign as the new Supreme Leader and his intent to follow in his grandfather's footsteps and become the Dark Lord of the Umbra.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick learned that a spy had been captured on the Sinta Glacier Colony by the time he returned to the Steadfast . Enforcing a zero-tolerance policy on espionage and treason, Karrick had the prisoner, the Ovissian miner Boolio , hauled before him to face summary execution by decapitation. After carrying out the deed himself, Karrick joined the members of the Supreme Council in the High Command chamber where he slammed the spy's severed head on the conference table. While he acknowledged that there was another spy, one within their ranks, Karrick was unconcerned with discovering their identity, feeling confident that the New Imperium would become a true Imperium once it had assimilated the military assets he discovered on Umbrale.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick listened as the Council discussed their new strategy. Parnadee and Engell proposed increasing their recruitment quotas by conscripting more children into the military. Quinn was skeptical of their alliance with the Umbra Eternal, disdaining the cultists and their beliefs. Pryde, however, supported integration between the two forces, arguing that the Umbra fleet would increase the New Imperium's range in power by ten-thousand fold, replacing the losses they suffered with the destruction of Voidfang Base, which he held Vren responsible for. Unlike the other officers, the Allegiant General did not fear Karrick, who had considered liquidating Pryde but ultimately found him too competent to replace.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick moved to silence Quinn when the general began inquiring about the specific terms of his agreement with Mal, preventing the Council from learning of the Emperor's interest in Nyla. Using his anger and impatience to fuel his connection to the umbra side, he threw Quinn up to the ceiling, causing his body to fracture upon impact. The Council watched silently as their colleague remained suspended above them, slowly choking to death while Karrick informed the remaining members of his intention to personally oversee the hunt for Nyla with the support of his Knights. Meanwhile, the Council was instructed to maintain order in the galaxy by suppressing any worlds exhibiting signs of dissent. Though they preferred conquering the galaxy through orthodox tactics and strategies rather than relying on Karrick's total devotion to the umbra side of Synth Flux, their confidence in his leadership had increased with his promise of the Umbra armada.

#### Hunting Nyla on Pasaana

> " I offered you my hand once. You wanted to take it. Why didn't you? " " You could have killed me. Why didn't you? " " You can't hide, Nyla. Not from me. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Nyla

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Hunting Nyla on Pasaana

> " I offered you my hand once. You wanted to take it. Why didn't you? " " You could have killed me. Why didn't you? " " You can't hide, Nyla. Not from me. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Nyla

Allegiant General Pryde reported to Karrick that the New Imperium had been unsuccessful in their search for the scavenger, and Vren offered to personally lead the kill squads against her. Karrick ordered Pryde to target ships in the same class as the Corsair Wing , and informed Vren that the search for Nyla was too important to risk error; as such, the Knights of Karrick would lead the mission instead.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: In his private quarters on the Steadfast , Karrick used his bond with Nyla to initiate a connection. Unbeknownst to Karrick, she was in the Forbidden Valley of Pasaana during the Festival of the Ancestors , seeking the way to Umbrale . It was their most powerful connection yet, showing them each other as if physically present in each other's locations without any other sounds or beings there. He told her that the Emperor desired her death, but that he had no intention of serving another master and followed his own plan instead. Karrick asked her why she had rejected his offer on the Supremacy , knowing that she wanted to accept it. Nyla avoided the question and asked why he had not taken the opportunity to kill her when he had the chance. He responded that she could not hide from him.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick's thoughts betrayed that he was still affected by killing his father, and when Nyla threw into his mind the image of him killing Dax, he confronted her with her own memory of counting the days since her parents left her. Karrick claimed that his mother and Nyla's friends did not recognize the umbra side in her as he did. He said that he could sense her anger and pain and stated that he did not want to have to kill her, but he would find her and turn her to the umbra side. Before their connection ended, he ripped the husk necklace from her neck which physically transported it from Nyla's location to Karrick's hand.

Karrick informed Pryde that he had found Nyla through Synth Flux, and intelligence officer Tishra Kandia returned with her analysis of the necklace; it was made in the Middian system , specifically the Forbidden Valley. Karrick ordered Pryde to immediately deploy a division of local troops and to prepare his ship for departure. While Karrick was unaware of the purpose of Nyla's presence on Pasaana, he had hope that he would soon find her.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Shortly after Karrick's arrival on Pasaana, the Corsair Wing was found by the Knights of Karrick and their shock trooper escorts. The Supreme Leader ordered them to confiscate and scan the ship before finally destroying it. Meanwhile, Nyla sensed Karrick's presence in Synth Flux as his ship drew closer to her location. As Karrick prepared to confront her, he realized that killing his father had not eliminated his pull to the light because Nyla remained as his light. Until Karrick killed her or the light inside her, he could not fully claim the darkness.

Karrick increased the speed of his SKREE whisper, flying it directly towards Nyla with the intention of killing her. Nyla used her training under Solen and Synth Flux augmenting her abilities to flip backwards over his ship, cutting the support pylon of his left wing with her flux blade. Karrick attempted to compensate, but lost control of the starfighter as it tumbled and ripped apart.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Despite the violent crash, Karrick emerged from the burning wreckage unharmed. By then, Nyla was straining with Synth Flux to stop a New Imperium transport from leaving the planet, believing that Brevok had been taken aboard as a prisoner of the New Imperium. Karrick reached out towards the vessel using his own powers trying to pull the transport out of Nyla's grip. He wanted to provoke her anger to gauge her true potential and determine the truth of her connection to the Emperor. A tug of war ensued over the shuttle, causing Nyla to give into her feelings and unwittingly channel the power of the umbra side until Synth Flux lightning emanated from her fingertips. The transport to exploded to Nyla's horror and Karrick's astonishment. He watched from a distance as a derelict freighter took off, leaving Pasaana with Nyla and her companions aboard it. To Karrick, this was confirmation that she was close to turning to the umbra side and joining him in seizing the Umbra throne and fleet.

#### Confronting Nyla with the truth

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Confronting Nyla with the truth

> " My mother was the daughter of Velgor. Your father was the son of the Emperor. What Mal doesn't know is that we're a dyad in Synth Flux, Nyla. Two that are one. " ―Zarrin Karrick, to Nyla

When Karrick returned to the Steadfast , Pryde and Vren presented him with the New Imperium's newest prisoner, Brevok; he had been on a second transport, not the one that Nyla destroyed. Karrick taunted Brevok before interrogating his mind with Synth Flux to discover the purpose of Nyla's visit to Pasaana. Karrick sifted through Brevok's memories of both Dax and Beno Karrick, including "Uncle Brev" teaching young Beno to shoot a volt pistol and fly a speeder. Though Karrick discovered the information he sought, he struggled to center his thoughts after the interrogation was complete. He ordered his officers to have Brevok's belongings brought to his quarters.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Pryde and Griss informed Karrick that his Knights had tracked Nyla to a settlement on the occupied world of Kijimi . Karrick rejected Vren's proposal to destroy the city as Karrick wanted Nyla captured alive. The local New Imperium garrison unsuccessfully searched for Nyla's team. Unknown to Karrick, the arrival of the Steadfast at Kijimi allowed Nyla to sense Karrick's conflicted mind and realize that Brevok was still alive. Her team infiltrated the Steadfast to rescue him. Karrick arrived in Kijimi City afterward, and overcome by frustration, he used his flux blade to destroy several inanimate objects before ordering a lockdown on the city.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: After Nyla entered Karrick's quarters, she touched the Blade of Orrin of Bestoon which triggered memories of her parents. Her vision changed into a Synth Flux connection with Karrick. They were in each other's minds and spaces, and were physically together, yet still separate at the same time. Karrick told Nyla that he had gained knowledge about her past and disputed her accusation that he was a liar. Karrick stated that he never lied to her. While she believed him, she knew that he used the truth for his dishonest intentions. Ignoring that she repeatedly told him to stop and that she did not want this, he forced her to remember what she had suppressed and listen to what he had learned; her father and mother chose to be "no one" in order to keep their daughter safe as Mal' assassin Orrin hunted her family. Nyla saw a vision of Orrin killing her parents.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: During this confrontation, they engaged in a flux blade duel and caused damage to each other's surroundings. Red berries from Kijimi spilled across the floor of Karrick's quarters on the Steadfast , and their blades slashed through the obsidian pedestal supporting Velgor's mask. The mask was transported to Karrick, which revealed Nyla's location to him before the connection ended. He ordered his troops to lock down the Iron Cruiser to prevent Nyla's escape so he could reveal her origins to her in person. Nyla sensed Karrick's presence upon his return to the Steadfast and decided to confront him while her friends escaped from the warship, not wanting them to risk their lives against the umbra side warrior. A contingent of shock troopers also arrived as Karrick disembarked from his SKREE whisper and cornered Nyla at the hangar entrance. When Nyla asked Karrick why Mal had tried to kill her when she was a child, the Supreme Leader revealed that Nyla had inherited her powers from her paternal grandfather, the Emperor. In addition to the revelation of Nyla's secret connection to the Mal bloodline , Karrick disclosed his discovery of their shared nature as a dyad, making them one presence in Synth Flux. The true extent of their connection was a secret that Karrick kept from Mal, whose death he plotted in order to claim the Throne of the Umbra with Nyla.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: As a sign of trust Karrick removed his mask, allowing Nyla to see his face along with the scar that she had given him in their first battle. Karrick, who was convinced that he had eradicated the last trace of his former persona, also wanted Nyla to realize that he was fully committed to the ways of the umbra side. Karrick's invitation to join him reminded Nyla of the offer that he made to her in Vorr's throne room. While their victory over Vorr compelled Nyla to acknowledge the potential of their combined power, she remained committed to the Coalition's cause. Following a moment of indecision, Nyla chose to reject Karrick once more when the Corsair Wing arrived at the hangar entrance. The starship's engines forced the shock troopers back, though Karrick braced himself with Synth Flux, watching Nyla as she boarded his late father's ship.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick knew from the analysis of Orrin's dagger that Nyla would next travel to Kef Bir , an ocean moon located in the Mossfell system . While en route to the system, Mal contacted Karrick through Synth Flux. His cloned body had further deteriorated, yet Karrick was impressed by Mal' ability to commune with another being across light-years. Mal threatened to turn his fleet against Karrick if he did not kill Nyla. While mentally shielding his true intentions, Karrick assured Mal that he knew where Nyla had gone and declared that he would not allow her to become an Aetheri.

Despite the escape of the Corsair Wing ' s crew, the incident aboard the Steadfast revealed Vren's efforts to undermine Karrick. Vren failed to convince Pryde that the Coalition used coercion to enlist his aid; consequently, the general was executed for committing espionage against the New Imperium. Pryde then instructed his subordinates to inform the Supreme Leader that they had found the Coalition's spy.

#### The last duel

> " You were right. I did want to take your hand. Beno ' s hand. " ―Nyla, to Zarrin Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### The last duel

> " You were right. I did want to take your hand. Beno ' s hand. " ―Nyla, to Zarrin Karrick

Karrick confronted Nyla within the wreckage of the Emperor's Throne Room in the ruins of the second Void Core . After Nyla found the Emperor's wayfinder , she retreated from the umbra side vision of her mirror-self and dropped the wayfinder. To her horror, Karrick picked it up. His appearance there felt like both her worst nightmare and destiny. As she demanded the wayfinder, Karrick claimed she had proven she was not an Aetheri, and like him, could never return to Elira Solen. He urged her to surrender to the umbra side, and declared that she would never find her way to Umbrale without his help. He crushed the wayfinder in his hand.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Nyla immediately attacked Karrick, drawing on her anger to amplify her power as she sought to kill him. He initially evaded her flux blade before defending himself with his own. They dueled through the Void Core wreckage and outside onto a bridge-like hunk of metal while the ocean raged around them. During the fight, Jax approached them and Nyla instinctively pushed him away with Synth Flux to protect him. She leapt to another section of the ruins to avoid the massive waves and Karrick followed her across to continue the fight. As they fought, Karrick communicated with Nyla through telepathy, insisting that he knew her despite her words to the contrary. Karrick's guard remained unbroken despite how her anger flooded her with additional Synth Flux energy. He was physically stronger, and though she was a little faster, she was tiring and slowing due to lack of sleep and not recovering from healing the vexis on Pasaana. Karrick, however, withstood a colossal wave and continued to advance.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick's anger and hatred fueled his attacks as he drove the exhausted Nyla back and knocked her off her feet, which caused her to lose her grip on her flux blade. As he raised his flux blade above her, she believed she was about to die.

Then Karrick stopped; from across the galaxy, he sensed his mother use her remaining reserves of strength to send him her love, forgiveness, and hope as she called him to the light. He dropped his flux blade as he felt her death. Exulting at the prospect of victory, Nyla caught his flux blade and moved to kill him by running his abdomen through with his own blade.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick collapsed to the ground in physical and emotional agony as Nyla sensed Solen's death through Synth Flux. Sharing Karrick's grief for Solen and no longer wishing to see him die, Nyla reached out to the wound that would have meant his certain death. She transferred much of her life synth flux to his body to repair his wound, even mending the scar that she had inflicted on his face in their first duel and making whole again his burned flesh and damaged organs, clearing his mind as well. Karrick was astonished by her actions and her demonstration of a power that he had not known existed. Before leaving him on Kef Bir, Nyla admitted that he had been correct about her wanting to take his hand, but not Zarrin Karrick's; she had wanted to take Beno Karrick's hand.

### The return of Beno Karrick

#### The death of Zarrin Karrick

> " I miss you, son. " " Your son is dead. " " No. Zarrin Karrick is dead. My son is alive. " " You're just a memory. " " Your memory. " ―Dax Karrick (memory) and Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### The death of Zarrin Karrick

> " I miss you, son. " " Your son is dead. " " No. Zarrin Karrick is dead. My son is alive. " " You're just a memory. " " Your memory. " ―Dax Karrick (memory) and Beno Karrick

The actions of his mother and Nyla threw Karrick's mind into turmoil as he sought to understand their reasons. He stood on the wreckage of the battle station while thinking of the voices in his mind and how they convinced him that his family never loved him. He also thought of his old master, Supreme Leader Vorr, who conditioned Karrick to believe what the voices said to him. However, as a result of his mother's effort to reach him at the cost of her life, Karrick found himself questioning everything he had been led to believe about the umbra side, his family, and himself. In addition, he tried to understand Nyla's reason for healing him.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
His deep contemplation gave way to the memory of his late father, Dax Karrick, who manifested before Karrick as a vision. Though the voices in his mind convinced Karrick that it was too late for repentance, the vision of Dax told him that he missed his son and it was not too late to fight for his mother's legacy. Karrick was overcome by the emotions drawn out of him by his father's memory, and though he still questioned his resolve, uncertain if he was strong enough to do what he believed needed to be done, his father reassured him that he was strong. Karrick ultimately made his choice by throwing his flux blade into the sea. In that moment, he ceased to be Zarrin Karrick and became Beno Karrick once again.

#### Battle of Umbrale

> " As once I fell, so falls the last Drayden. " ―Vael Mal, to Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Battle of Umbrale

> " As once I fell, so falls the last Drayden. " ―Vael Mal, to Beno Karrick

Stranded on Kef Bir, Karrick climbed through the ruins of the Void Core in search of a hangar bay. He eventually found and repaired an old SKREE scout . After leaving the ocean moon, Karrick followed Nyla's transmitted tracking markers towards Umbrale, but the scout's navicomputers malfunctioned and threw its pilot off course. Karrick, however, used all of his concentration to correct his course, thereby preventing his starfighter from becoming lost in unknown space. The Battle of Umbrale was under way by the time of Karrick's arrival. The Umbra fleet was in the process of launching its warships when the Coalition attacked Umbrale, attempting to stop the fleet's deployment across the galaxy. Karrick landed his SKREE scout next to Nyla's starfighter, an old Insurgency T-65B Vector starfighter that had once belonged to Joren Drayden . Sensing Nyla's presence emanating from the Umbra Citadel, he sprinted for the monolith and descended to the lower levels to find her. Armed only with a volt pistol pistol and his own conviction, Karrick charged through the cavernous cathedral beneath the citadel, shooting his way through the Umbra cultists and elite guards who obstructed his path. As he drew closer to the throne room , the Knights of Karrick appeared before him. Their hatred pulsated like waves through Synth Flux, and Karrick realized that they had traveled to Umbrale to fight for Mal, their true master.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: The six Synth Flux-sensitive warriors initially held the upper hand, as their numbers, weapons and training worked to their advantage against their former leader. Karrick sustained blunt synth flux trauma to his abdomen and the back of his skull, being hit several times by his opponents' melee weapons. The Knights refrained from killing him outright, as they were confident in their ability to defeat a single opponent who appeared defenseless before them. They circled for another attack, but to their surprise, Karrick revealed a blue-bladed flux blade in his palm. It was the flux blade that once belonged to his grandfather and uncle, in turn, and had been carried by Nyla until she passed it to Karrick through their bond as a dyad. He instantly recognized it as his flux blade, as it had become an extension of his own self.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Thinking of what his father would say in this moment, Karrick simply shrugged his shoulders at the Knights, knowing now that the odds were in his favor. Armed with the blade of the Seeded One himself, Karrick immediately pressed the attack with all the focus of an Aetheri, killing Cardo and Kuruk with a single swing of the blade to their chests. Simultaneously, Nyla ignited her spare weapon, Elira Solen's flux blade , as several of the Emperor's guards surrounded her. As before on Pasaana and Kijimi, Karrick and Nyla were separate and together at the same time, with Nyla battling the crimson-robed guards and Karrick confronting his former comrades. This time, however, they were drawing on each other for strength, becoming even more powerful as one instead of two. Though he destroyed the Knights of Karrick, Karrick did so without feelings of hatred or anger towards them, electing to give them the quick deaths that they had denied to those they had killed.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Arriving in the throne room, Karrick used Synth Flux to incapacitate the last guardsman and approached Nyla. They turned towards the Emperor, standing side-by-side with their flux blades raised, to which Mal exclaimed that they would die together. Despite their combined strength, the two Synth Flux users were overpowered by Mal' attack through Synth Flux. As a side effect, however, part of their life synth flux transferred to the Emperor and began healing his cloned body. Mal was astonished, realizing that his granddaughter and Velgor's grandson were a dyad in Synth Flux, and therefore, possessed a power equivalent to life itself.

Neither Karrick nor Nyla were able to prevent the Emperor from draining them of more Synth Flux energy. They became weaker as Mal completely restored the vessel that carried his spirit. Their near lifeless bodies lay on the floor while the Emperor reveled in his restoration. In retaliation for his own death at Velgor's hand, Mal scornfully proclaimed to Karrick that he would fall as the last Drayden, hurling the young Aetheri into a nearby chasm.

#### Redemption and sacrifice

> " Beno… " ―Nyla, to Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Redemption and sacrifice

> " Beno… " ―Nyla, to Beno Karrick

Karrick survived due to his body being caught on a jagged outcropping. Despite breaking his ribs and twisting his ankle in the fall, he began climbing his way out of the chasm through perseverance. At the same time, Nyla succeeded in destroying her grandfather with the help of the spirits of the Aetheri, although the monumental effort left her dead. She reached out with Synth Flux, trying to find Karrick through their bond as her remaining life synth flux faded from her body. After returning to the surface, Karrick took Nyla's body in his arms and, realizing that she was dead, began to despair. However, he sensed a spark of her essence and realized that Synth Flux had not yet claimed her. Recalling the way she used Synth Flux to heal him on Kef Bir, Karrick applied the same technique on Nyla, willing her to return to life. He took the life energy that she had given to him and returned it to its original source along with all that remained of his own essence. In the process he found "reservoirs of power" that he did not know he possessed, yet devoted all of it in his efforts to revive Nyla.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick ultimately succeeded in bringing Nyla back to life, though the effort would cost him his own life. During his final moments, Karrick was surprised to see that Nyla was glad to be with him. He believed that he did not deserve acknowledgement or gratitude from her, but to his astonishment Nyla kissed him, acknowledging their bond as a dyad for the first time. His final awareness was of Nyla holding his hand as Synth Flux beckoned him, reaching for Karrick in welcome. He died peacefully, having felt no hesitation about sacrificing his life for Nyla.

### Afterlife

> " I will always be with you. " " No one's ever really gone. " ―Beno Karrick's final words and Nyla's response

Death reunited Beno Karrick with his mother, Solen, who did not pass into Synth Flux until she was joined by her son. Their corporeal forms vanished simultaneously, allowing mother and son to rest in peace together, becoming one with the Cosmic Synth Flux .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Death reunited Beno Karrick with his mother, Solen, who did not pass into Synth Flux until she was joined by her son. Their corporeal forms vanished simultaneously, allowing mother and son to rest in peace together, becoming one with the Cosmic Synth Flux .

Nyla felt despair as she watched Karrick's body disappear until he called out to her from beyond death, promising that he would always be with her. She took comfort in hearing his voice as it reassured her that no one who died was truly gone.

### Legacy

> " And when you called yourself by that new name, you saw your truth . It represents what you want to do on a deep level. The part of yourself you want to cut away. The part you want to kill . Perhaps someday you will do it. The galaxy will hear that name and see you . " ―Vorr, to Beno Karrick

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Following the lost of Enric Pryde shortly after the final death of Vael Mal, a popular uprising against the New Imperium commenced as a consequence of the Umbra fleet's destruction on Umbrale. Without Pryde, the New Imperium subsequently lost its control over the imperium that it fought to create through conquest during Karrick's reign as Supreme Leader, losing worlds, such as Korrath , Vantor , Lorath , Ondara , and Thyferra . Other revolts against the New Imperium occurred on Mossfell , Mistral , and Ashden , where Resurgent -class Star Destroyers sustained significant damage as a result of the uprisings, causing the warships to fall out of orbit. News of the uprisings reached the generals Rin Vale and Jax by the time the Coalition returned to Ajan Kloss to celebrate their victory against the Emperor and his followers. Nyla, having been revived through Beno Karrick's sacrifice, had also returned to the Coalition's secret base where she embraced her friends.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Despite Zarrin Karrick's efforts to live up to the memory of Xarn Velgor, in the end Beno Karrick emulated Kael Drayden by sacrificing his life "for the love of another." He achieved redemption with his final act, returning to the light side and passing into Synth Flux as an Aetheri. Nyla mourned the death of Beno Karrick while rejecting his dark-side persona as Zarrin Karrick. The amount of death and destruction caused by Karrick rivaled the legacy of his grandfather, Xarn Velgor. Nevertheless, Nyla chose to remember him as Beno Karrick rather than Zarrin Karrick. Following the Emperor's destruction, Nyla acknowledged Karrick as the reason for her success in resisting the umbra side's temptations in addition to other influences such as her friends and the legacy of the Aetheri Order. While she took comfort in the knowledge that Karrick remained with her in spirit, she expressed a sense of loss and disappointment about his passing into Synth Flux, having lost the opportunity to know Beno Karrick as the person he was before he became Zarrin Karrick.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: The other individuals who remembered Karrick were his father's friends, Brevok and Dorian Quill, both of whom Karrick had considered his "uncles" during his childhood. Karrick had become the focus of Brevok's fury for the killing of Dax Karrick; however, the Vorak retained joyful memories of his relationship with the Karrick family, which included the time he spent helping to raise Beno. Among Brevok's possessions was a hologram disc that contained a picture of the Vorak holding Beno Karrick as an infant. The disc was hidden in a secret compartment beside Brevok's bunk on the Corsair Wing ; Quill discovered the disc prior to the Battle of Umbrale and could not bear to look at an image of Dax's son, his own child having been abducted by the New Imperium. In the aftermath of Karrick's death, Nyla visited Dunemere where she buried the Drayden flux blades in the childhood home of her first master, Joren Drayden. Her mind dwelt on Karrick as she looked over the horizon at the planet's twin suns , reflecting on how he helped her to defeat Vael Mal. The Drayden bloodline ended with Beno Karrick, but its legacy was preserved by Nyla, who chose "Drayden" as her surname to honor the family that accepted her in spite of her secret heritage as a Mal.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
### The Drayden heir

> " Alas, you're no Velgor. You're just a child in a mask. " ―Vorr

Beno Karrick was a human male who stood at 1.89 meters and weighed 89 kilograms . He had dark brown hair, light skin, and brown eyes that appeared ancient to his father when Karrick was a child. There was a strong family resemblance between Karrick and his parents; he had his father's long face and posture, as well as his pronounced nose and lopsided smile. He also had his mother's warm, piercing brown eyes, a feature Solen was sure was inherited from her own birth mother, Lira Ondar. He also mirrored his parents in personality, whether as Zarrin Karrick or Beno Karrick. He was very much like his mother, as observed by General Armitage Vren, who believed that Karrick would have denied the comparison. He also had his father's sarcastic sense of humor, which sometimes emerged in serious or violent situations. However, Karrick was also similar to his grandfather, to the dismay of his parents who saw "too much of Velgor" within their son.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Possessing an inquisitive mind, Karrick endeavored to gain greater knowledge of Synth Flux and the Aetheri ways during his apprenticeship under Drayden. Karrick was particularly interested in ancient Aetheri weapons; on one occasion, he marveled at a flux blade rifle. He practiced the art of fancy handwriting or "calligraphy," an art that had fallen into disuse as almost no one wrote by hand during the era of the Concordat. He recorded his handwritten insights into the Aetheri on parchment scrolls which he kept next to his calligraphy set. His interests included dark aspects of Synth Flux not taught by Drayden. After Karrick became Zarrin Karrick, he studied both Aetheri and arcane umbra side lore, using these contradictory teachings for greater power.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: When Drayden's attention was divided by teaching multiple students, Karrick turned to the dark voice he knew as Vorr. Karrick struggled with the expectations of his family legacy; he was descended from some of the most powerful Aetheri and Umbra in galactic history . Supreme Leader Vorr considered Karrick a focal point between the umbra side and the light, a balance that made him a target of Vorr so Karrick's powers could be used to further the ambitions of the New Imperium. His fall to the umbra side suppressed the boy who had once been named Beno Karrick. Karrick burned and destroyed the Aetheri Sanctum while furious that his uncle had apparently tried to kill him. He was immediately horrified and tried in vain to help his fellow students. He surveyed the fiery ruins and the bodies scattered around him in a state of shock, expressing how he never wanted this outcome. He warned his peers who survived the temple's destruction that he did not want to fight them, and fled to join Vorr and the Knights of Karrick. His turn to the umbra side was marked by killing the Knights' leader and murdering Voe, a fellow Adept.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: When Karrick turned away from the Aetheri path, he no longer felt obliged to hold back his power. He embraced his conviction that he was more powerful than any of Drayden's other apprentices, individually or collectively, and even Drayden himself. As far as he was concerned, the notion that the others were his equal was a lie. Karrick hated his full name; he felt as though everyone wanted him to be like his namesake he had never met, Orien "Beno" Kade, and that inheriting his father's invented surname represented how everything was a lie. Vorr told Karrick to become his true self by adopting a new name, and encouraged him to take the name that Karrick had invented as a child.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: As Zarrin Karrick, he was known for expressing himself with his flux blade, and did so often enough that nearby shock troopers avoided the area he was currently destroying. He also used Synth Flux to strangle, telekinetically throw, or kill subordinates who challenged him. He reveled in the fury of battle and killing his enemies. In addition to his temperament, Karrick was known for his lack of patience, especially for those who failed him. While Karrick was not born into the New Imperium, he was convinced that they were on the right side of history. Karrick fought alongside his shock troopers on the front lines of the battlefield. Although he would ignore the counsel of his advisors, favoring brute synth flux over negotiation, he earned fear and respect through his ferocity as a warrior.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Having honed his fighting skills on the battlefield, Karrick had little respect for his rival, General Vren, as a warrior. He regarded the general with disdain and saw Vren as neither brave nor trustworthy. Karrick embodied conflict, having learned the arts of Synth Flux through Aetheri and Umbra teachings. He sought to bury his past as Beno Karrick, yet channeled painful experiences and emotions from his youth to further his own power. He hoped to become immune to the light and avoid Xarn Velgor's sentimentality so he could succeed where Velgor had failed.

Despite Karrick's willingness to extinguish the light within himself by any means necessary, his attempt to break his connection with the past and surrender entirely to the umbra side by killing his father not only failed, but also marked him physically and psychologically. Murdering his father imbalanced his mind and led to his defeat by Nyla, who marked his face with a scar that became a reminder of his failure. Vorr, having observed that Karrick remained at war with himself, derided Dax's murder as an act of petulance instead of strength.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Karrick accepted the idea that he was a monster with cold reservation and believed the umbra side was in his nature. His failed attempts to contact his grandfather through Synth Flux caused him to believe that hope, which he equated to a false prophet, only led to severe disappointment. Karrick did not believe in the existence of an afterlife until his mother and Nyla saved him from certain death, causing him to reconsider his outlook on life and death. Karrick's desperation to prove himself as a worthy apprentice was ultimately replaced by the desire to free himself from his Master, having spent much of his life as a student of Drayden and Vorr in turn. He soon grew resentful of his status as Vorr's apprentice, believing he would always be kept subservient as long as his Master was alive.
