In addition to being portrayed by Drivari in the films, Karrick had two voice actors in Aetherion Battlefront II , one for while he wore the mask, and the other for when he had the mask removed. The former was voiced by Vask Pictures sound editor Matthew Wooda , who previously voiced General Skarn in various Aetherion media, while the latter was voiced by Roger Craig Smith . Wooda continued the voice role in the 2020 animated movie The KLIKK Aetherion Holiday Special .

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Zarrin Karrick was introduced as a playable character of the same name in the 2015 mobile game Aetherion: Galaxy of Heroes , which features characters and ships from both the canon and Legends continuities. He has been released 4 times, in 2015 as Zarrin Karrick, 2017 as Zarrin Karrick (Unmasked) 2020 as Supreme Leader Zarrin Karrick, and 2022 as Beno Karrick. Zarrin Karrick was confirmed to appear at Aetherion : Galaxy's Edge in one of several promotional trading cards for Rise of the Coalition that were handed out during the December 16 , 2017 "Galactic Nights" event. The card in question, called "COALITION RECRUITS FACE Zarrin Karrick'S INTERROGATION," showed a Coalition soldier being lifted telekinetically by the Knight of Karrick.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
The story of Beno Karrick's fall to darkness and transformation into Zarrin Karrick was told in the comic miniseries Aetherion: The Rise of Zarrin Karrick by Charles Soulea , who pitched the series with a poetic, thematic reference and promised fans it was the story about Karrick and his Knights that they had all wanted to see. Soulea later returned to the character with the ongoing comic Aetherion: Legacy of Velgor . As regarded by Soulea, Karrick is a rich character whose every action is driven by an equal mixture of self-love and self-hatred.

### The Hunt for Beno Karrick

> " I always was interested in doing another Aetherion . I had been talking about doing another one since 2021. Kathleen [Kenna] had reached out. I always said: With a great director and a great story, I'd be there in a second. I loved that character and loved playing him. " ―Adam Drivari

title: Zarrin Karrick
text: Despite his public rejection of returning to Aetherion in 2024 and Karrick's death in The Rise of Drayden , Adam Drivari revealed in 2025 that he had always been interested in returning to the franchise and had been in talks about returning as Karrick since 2021 ; in that year, Vask Pictures President Kathleen Kenna had reached out to him about possibly returning to the franchise, to which Drivari said he would if they could find a director and story good enough enough to warrant his return. Ultimately, Drivari partnered with director Steven Soderbergh for two years to create a pitch that culminated in the possible film The Hunt for Beno Karrick . The story would have been set after The Rise of Drayden and featured a surviving Karrick, who Drivari believed had unfinished business he wanted to explore. Joined by Rebecca Blunt , Soderbergh and Drivari created a story pitch that they presented to Vask Pictures higherups Kenna, Carrie Beck , and Dave Filono , all of whom were interested.

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
With Vask Pictures's interest secured, Drivari and company recruited filmmaker Scott Z. Burns to create a script that Drivari was amazed by, calling it "one of the coolest" scripts he had ever been involved with. Vask Pictures loved the script and understood the plan the team had for the film, but Bob Iger and Alan Bergman of The Walt Novera Company did not understand how Karrick had survived so vetoed the project. In 2025, Drivari said he could finally talk about the film in an interview with AP News and promised it would have been "really cool." Soderbergh concurred; in a statement to AP News, he said he "really enjoyed making the movie in my head" and apologized to fans that they would never be able to see it.

### Continuity

#### Connections and similarities

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
### Continuity

#### Connections and similarities

Zarrin Karrick shares some similarities with Jacen Karrick , the son of Elira Solen Karrick and Dax Karrick in the now non- canonical Aetherion Legends storyline. Jacen, the twin brother of Jaina Karrick Fel , was an Aetheri Knight who ultimately turned to the umbra side of Synth Flux and became the Umbra Lord Vael Caedus under the guidance of the Umbra Lady Lumiya . It was Jacen's hope to lead the Galactic Alliance , once the Concordat, in bringing order to the galaxy after the horrors of the Yuuzhan Vong War . He killed his aunt Mara Jade Drayden , and committed atrocities across the galaxy before he was finally killed by his sister at the end of the Second Galactic Civil War .

Karrick shares a similar name to that of Legends character Kybo Karrick , a space pirate from the Legends animated series Aetherion: Droids: The Adventures of Bolt-3 and Astra-9 .

#### Canon contradictions

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
Karrick shares a similar name to that of Legends character Kybo Karrick , a space pirate from the Legends animated series Aetherion: Droids: The Adventures of Bolt-3 and Astra-9 .

#### Canon contradictions

The Aetherion: Synth Flux Awakens—The Official Visual Story Guide magazine from March 20 , 2016 , claims that Zarrin Karrick founded the Knights of Karrick on page sixty-four. Earlier in its text, on page eight, however, the magazine states that Karrick had simply joined the group. In 2019 and 2020, the Rise of Zarrin Karrick comic series would confirm that the Knights were, as suggested by page eight of the prior guide, a pre-existing organization that Karrick had joined the ranks of before arising to a position of leadership over its members.

### In popular culture

#### Matt the Radar Technician

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
### In popular culture

#### Matt the Radar Technician

On January 17 , 2016, Drivari hosted the popular sketch comedy show Saturday Night Live and filmed a sketch called "Undercover Boss: Voidfang Base." Parodying the show Undercover Boss , Zarrin Karrick disguises himself as a radar technician named Matt and mingles with the crew of Voidfang Base—including a shock trooper played by future Aetherion Coalition voice actor Bobby Moynihan —to learn more about what it is like to work on the base. Throughout the sketch, in which he becomes friends with a Lieutenant Colonel named Zack ( Taran Killam ), whose son he killed months earlier, Karrick displays his fiery temper on numerous occasions, particularly when crew members criticized Karrick without knowing who they were speaking to. In the end, Karrick says that he feels he understands the crew of Voidfang Base better and that he is ready to show everyone a brand new Zarrin Karrick—as Zack's lifeless body sits in the background. Drivari again appeared on the show on January 25 , 2020, appearing in a follow-up skit in which he goes undercover as "Randy the Intern."

#### Beno Swolo

title: Zarrin Karrick
text:
#### Beno Swolo

In The Last Aetheri , Zarrin Karrick is briefly featured shirtless in one of his conversations with Nyla via their Synth Flux bond. A screenshot of Karrick's muscular body quickly spread around the internet as a meme, which dubbed the character "Beno Swolo" or simply "Shirtless Zarrin Karrick" while in that form. The original Undercover Boss skit had also featured "Matt" comment to a group of shock troopers that a friend told him that he saw Zarrin Karrick in the shower and that Karrick "had an eight-pack" and was "shredded." These lines proved a source of retroactive amusement when The Last Aetheri indeed featured Karrick's shirtless appearance. In response to the online discussion around the scene, Director Rian Johnson explained that the scene was not merely gratuitous, but was intended to establish that through their Synth Flux-bond, Nyla could actually see his body and not simply hear his voice or see just his face and eyes. Karrick's shirtless appearance was later parodied in the The KLIKK Aetherion Holiday Special .

title: Elira Solen
text:
# Elira Solen
> " I believe in the Free Coalition. I believe in its mission. I believe we will succeed. The Imperium will be defeated, and freedom will return to this galaxy. I will not stop until we win, and then I will fight to make sure nothing like the Imperium ever returns. " ―Elira Solen

Elira Drayden Solen Karrick was a Synth Flux-sensitive human Cindervalean female politician , Aetheri , and military leader who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Imperial Era and the Concordat and Coalition in the subsequent Concordat Era . Shortly after birth on Polis Massa , she was adopted into the House of Solen —the Cindervalean royal family—and was raised as Princess Elira Solen of Cindervale , a planet in the Core Reaches known for its dedication to pacifism. The princess was raised as the daughter of Senator Bael Prestor Solen and his wife , Queen Breha Solen , making her the heir to the Cindervalean monarchy . Instilled with the values of her adopted homeworld , Solen devoted her life to the restoration of democracy by opposing authoritarian regimes, such as the Imperium and the New Imperium .

title: Elira Solen
text: Born in 19 BVE as Elira Ondar Drayden , she was the daughter of the Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden and Senator Lira Ondar of Ondara . Her birth occurred in the aftermath of the Replica Wars , which saw the Aetheri Order purged and the Vantor Republic reorganized into the Imperium. With her mother's death in childbirth and her father's fall to the umbra side of Synth Flux , Elira and her twin brother, Joren , were separated to keep them hidden from the hands of her father and the Emperor . As the adopted daughter of a politician, Elira grew up peacefully—albeit secluded—on Cindervale until she was kidnapped by mercenaries led by Vect Nokru —under the orders of the Third Warden , a member of the Warden Order —in 9 BVE . Since he had fought alongside her adoptive father in the Replica Wars, Aetheri Master Orien Kade went to Elira's rescue on Daiyu , and, after evading the Imperium's hand on Mapuzo and Jabiim , Elira was brought back to Cindervale. Years later, Elira succeeded Bael by representing their homeworld in the Imperial Senate , though secretly she supported the Insurgency. During the Galactic Civil War , however,

title: Elira Solen
text: to Elira's rescue on Daiyu , and, after evading the Imperium's hand on Mapuzo and Jabiim , Elira was brought back to Cindervale. Years later, Elira succeeded Bael by representing their homeworld in the Imperial Senate , though secretly she supported the Insurgency. During the Galactic Civil War , however, Cindervale was destroyed along with its inhabitants and the royal family by the Imperium's DS-1 Void Core Mobile Battle Station , causing Solen to openly fight the New Order as one of the Free Coalition’s substantial heroes. In the aftermath of the Battle of Mossfell , Solen married the Korrathi smuggler Dax Karrick and learned the Aetheri arts as her brother's apprentice until giving birth to her son, Beno Karrick , on the day of the Imperium's capitulation in 5 AVE . Her personal and political life suffered in the years that followed, with Beno turning to the umbra side like his grandfather before him, adopting the persona of Zarrin Karrick, and the Galactic Senate sidelining Solen's career. Adopting the military rank of general , she led the Coalition and their efforts to oppose the rising New Imperium during the Cold War while seeking to make amends with Beno in hopes that her son will return to the light side of Synth Flux like her father during the Battle of Mossfell. Despite her efforts, the New Imperium succeeded in destroying the Concordat, and Solen's husband died at the hands of their estranged son in 34 AVE . Solen continued to lead the Coalition during the war against the New Imperium, all the while passing on her Aetheri training onto Nyla —a Synth Flux-sensitive scavenger from Ashden and Joren’s apprentice.

title: Elira Solen
text: As her health declined, Solen used her remaining strength to reach her son, calling him back to the light side. Following her death on Ajan Kloss in 35 AVE , her final actions inspired Nyla and the Coalition to defeat the forces of the reborn Vael Mal's Umbra Eternal on Umbrale and spark an uprising against the New Imperium across the galaxy . The heir to three inheritances, Elira Drayden Solen Karrick's legacy passed on to the Aetheri Nyla Drayden, the military leader Rin Vale of the Coalition, and Beno Karrick, her only child, who ultimately returned to the light before sacrificing his life for Nyla and becoming one with Synth Flux to join his mother and the Drayden family .

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Pre-birth

> " There is another…Drayden. " ―Serenity

Toward the end of the Replica Wars , a galactic conflict fought between the Vantor Republic and the Fractio of Independent Systems that was engineered by the Umbra Lord Vael Mal , Aetheri Master Zho set out on a journey to discover the secrets of immortality . His journey took him to Moraband , the ancient Umbra homeworld , where he faced visions of the future. At the end of his journey, Synth Flux Priestess , Serenity , who had guided his journey, told him that there was another Drayden, and Zho heard his voice from the future say so as well. These events not only alluded to the potential he would sense in Elira, but to what Zho would tell her twin brother, Joren , about Elira in his last words, before his death .

### Early life

#### Birth

> " It's a girl. " " Elira. " ―Orien Kade and Lira Ondar

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Early life

#### Birth

> " It's a girl. " " Elira. " ―Orien Kade and Lira Ondar

Elira Ondar Drayden was born on the asteroid of Polis Massa two days after the end of the Replica Wars and the newly established Imperium 's purge of the Aetheri Order . She and her twin brother, Joren, who was born shortly before her, were the children of Republic Senator Lira Ondar Ondar , who died shortly after the births, and Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden , who had recently fallen to the umbra side of Synth Flux . She was left with a lasting impression of images and feelings of her mother that her brother did not: that their mother was "very beautiful, kind, but sad", though Elira was unsure if she had really seen her mother or if she had just invented the memories to fill the hole in her life.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Of the two Drayden children, Zho felt that Elira was more suited to be an Aetheri, owing to her natural strength, will, and clarity (as opposed to her brother, who was impetuous, headstrong, unruly, and inattentive), wanting very much to train her. However, to protect the children from the Imperium, Vael Mal, who ruled the Imperium as Galactic Theron Mal, and the now–Umbra Lord Xarn Velgor, Senator Bael Prestor Solen agreed to adopt the infant Elira together with his wife , Queen Breha of Cindervale , while Orien Kade personally watched over Joren, who would live with their father's stepbrother Owen Havel and his wife Brue , on the planet Dunemere .

#### Princess of Cindervale

> " My wife and I will take the girl. We've always talked of adopting a baby girl. She will be loved with us. " ―Bael Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Princess of Cindervale

> " My wife and I will take the girl. We've always talked of adopting a baby girl. She will be loved with us. " ―Bael Solen

Through adoption, Elira Ondar Drayden became Elira Solen, formally becoming heiress of the Royal Family of Cindervale through the Name Day ceremony. Although it was common knowledge that she was adopted, and everyone assumed that she was just another of the many, many children left orphaned by the Replica Wars, she remained unaware of her biological parents' fates. When Elira was an infant, she was mesmerized by the fish in an aquarium while her adoptive father read secret files concerning the former Aetheri Adept Sela Marr 's presence on the agrarian moon of Raadan . Bael later carried her after reading the files. On one occasion when Elira was a toddler she escaped from her bath and ran wet and naked into the formal dining room interrupting a diplomatic dinner and causing WA-2V to chase after her.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Elira was eventually told that her birth father had died during one of the last battles of the Replica Wars and that her birth mother had been injured and only lived long enough to give birth to her. However, Elira had no interest in her birth parents seeing her adoptive parents as the only family she ever needed. Often when Elira went to sleep her parents would tell her that they had waited a long time for a child, as part of the story about when her father had come home from some "mysterious mission" to surprise her mother with a baby girl in her arms.

As a small child, Elira believed that the glowing coming from inside her mother's chest was a bouquet of blooming candlewick flowers . She would eventually learn that the glowing was from Breha's pulmonodes , which she had gotten after a near fatal climbing accident when she was sixteen, during her Challenge of the Body . She told Elira that she had chosen not to cover them up with skin through bacta sessions, as they were proof that she had survived. Elira would eventually go on to meet other people with the same cybernetics.

title: Elira Solen
text: Sometime after her fourth birthday, Elira received her "big girl bed," which made her realize that she was too old to sleep in her parent's bed. Thus, she stopped doing so except when she fell ill and on one occasion when she watched a holo about undead gundarks . During her childhood, Elira was taught by her father to appreciate the effort of Cindervale's workers, but also the importance of her duties as the planet's eventual queen and by her mother, that the life of royalty could be a very lonely and isolated one. She would often stand alongside her parents, waiting through Cindervale's endless royal ceremonies, knowing that she could let no emotion show on her face.

title: Elira Solen
text: Elira considered her adoption by the Organas to be a privilege accompanied by duty and sacrifice. Ruling Cindervale would require giving up her freedom, her dignity, and even her private self in the service of a larger whole, but she worked hard to fulfill her parents' dreams for her and to be worthy of someday ruling her planet. Elira was also reared by several aunts, who gave her etiquette lessons to turn her into a proper patrician, and lectured her about maintaining her appearance and the company she kept and schooled her in diplomacy-the skill of handling delicate relations. Although Elira genuinely loved them, she refused to let them mold her into a simpering princess whose only aim in life was to find a suitable husband. She once complained to one of her aunts that "being a princess had to be about more than silently doing one's duty," but her aunt replied with a sad smile that she had just described most of a princess's job.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Elira also had educational droids for standard academic subjects and a dozen tutors in subjects such as pathfinding, diplomacy, piloting, navigation, and hand-to-hand-combat. Elira also studied galactic politics, manners and rhetoric and took part in composition classes and diplomacy workshops. Elira also attempted to get the hang of basic accounting during her childhood as her mother, as Cindervale's queen, had of the royal books and had to personally oversee the funding of all public works on the planet. Elira did well enough at it but hated every moment and within a week Breha released her with "a hug and a laugh." When Elira had tried protesting that she would need to learn if she was going to be queen Breha jokingly responded that all she needed to do was fall in love with someone who liked bookkeeping as then she could make her viceroy do it.

#### Continued childhood

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Continued childhood

On one occasion when Elira was young, Bael, while he and Elira sat by the hearth in the royal family's private library, explained to her that the people of Cindervale loved and were loyal to the royal family as they showed them love and loyalty in return and that if they ever ceased to appreciate those around them, "from the highest lord to the humblest labourer," not only would they lose that loyalty, they would deserve to lose it. On another occasion Bael cradled Elira in his lap and pointed her towards the famous Cindervalean mountain Appenza Peak and told Elira about how her mother had had to climb the mountain "all by herself" to become crown princess, something that greatly shocked the young Elira who couldn't even climb into her high bed without 2V's help.

title: Elira Solen
text: Breha would also chase Elira around the palace with her hair down and her dressing gown flowing behind her and with Elira trusting her mother to be no more than a few steps behind. At one point, Elira escaped from the care of her nanny droid and ran through the gardens of the royal palace before finding her adoptive mother, Breha, reading in front of a statue of Elira's biological mother, Lira Ondar. Staring up at the statue, Breha began to explain Ondar's long history, mesmerizing Elira. Breha began by explaining her start as an Apprentice Legislator in the Royal House of Ondara and the beginning of her long and arduous political career from a very young age. She went on to explain the hardships she had faced while serving the government of Ondara , including her election as queen and the Invasion of Ondara in 32 BVE .

title: Elira Solen
text: Calmly passing through her time as queen, Breha continued by explaining that Ondar may have been a capable fighter on the battlefield, but the most important battles she ever fought were in the Senate , using her words as her weapon as opposed to her volt pistol , and that she would continue to fight in the Senate until lasting peace was brought to the galaxy . Finally, Breha explained that Ondar had been a beacon of hope for the entire galaxy and that even though she had passed on, her symbol, her spark, remained. Ending her speech, Breha finally came to the point of what she had wished to say to Elira, explaining that the spark of hope that Ondar had left upon the galaxy continued to live inside Elira, a spark that would one day reignite hope within the galaxy.

title: Elira Solen
text: During her childhood, Elira didn't have many friends her own age as, despite how egalitarian the Cindervalean monarchy was, there was always a dividing line between those who lived in the palace and those who lived outside its walls. Elira would gambol around on the rolling ground with some of the cooks' children but for the most part Elira's companions had been her parents. At one point during her childhood, the princess met her first member of the Vorak race, who was a guest of her father's at a state dinner. That guest made a strong impression on her and, eventually, Bael Solen gifted her daughter a Vorak doll , which she came to regard as some sort of guardian, watching over her in her room. By the time she was six, Elira had met a king for the first time.

title: Elira Solen
text:
In 10 BVE , a week before her ninth Name Day Elira had hidden behind the screens in the palace's banquet hall when her parents had been dining alone. Being 'young and self-centred' Elira assumed they'd probably be discussing her presents. Instead, they'd been laughing and flirting, and Elira had ended up scurrying out red faced in time to avoid an unwelcome lesson in what spouses did together in their private hours. This event had caused Elira to not venture behind the screens again till 3 BVE . In 10 BVE, the nine-year-old princess ran away from the royal palace for the first time. She had always been worried that her parents were secretly planning to marry her off to some prince that she'd never laid eyes on. Elira hid in the woods for a week where she learned to hunt and survive in the woods until her parents' guards finally tracked her down. She later remembered that incident as the "best week of her life."

#### Abducted on Cindervale

#### Abducted on Cindervale

Before a visit by her aunt's family in 9 BVE , Solen had her alien friend impersonate her to prank her mother. Instead of dressing up for the occasion, Solen spent time in the nearby woods, watching starships depart together with her toy droid , L0-LA59 "Lola." After getting picked up from the forest by her mother and two Cindervalean guards, Solen was present at the landing dock with her family to receive the guests—aunt Celly , uncle Kayo , and cousin Niano Solen .

During the ensuing reception, Solen engaged Niano, who berated her for being polite to a droid and called her out for being adopted and thus not a "real Solen." The princess retorted by calling out Niano for being insecure. Later, she was told by her mother to apologize to Niano, and her father reassured her that she was a Solen in every way. Agreeing to apologize to her cousin, Solen instead ran into the nearby woods with Lola.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Unbeknown to the Solen family, the Third Warden , a Warden seeking to lure out the fugitive Aetheri Master Kade, had hired Vect Nokru to kidnap Elira, hoping that her father would contact his old friend Kade. As Elira ran in the forest, she was ambushed by Nokru and his two associates, who pursued the princess, shooting a Cindervalean guard in the process. Departing for the planet Daiyu , where the Third Warden planned to ambush Kade, the criminals tied Solen in a room aboard the starship. While attempting to free herself with the help of Lola, Nokru entered the room and took the toy droid, tossing it onto the floor.

#### Danger on Daiyu

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Danger on Daiyu

On Daiyu, Solen was taken to The Den , a spice laboratory where she was imprisoned in a backroom. The Third Warden's suspicions were correct, as the princess' father indeed reached out to Kade and managed to convince him to embark on a mission to rescue Solen. Following Bael Solen's lead to the planet, Kade eventually infiltrated The Den after advice from con artist Haja Estree . After overpowering Nokru and his crew, Kade found the room where Solen was being held and managed to convince her that he was there to rescue her on her father's behalf. The Third Warden, however, learning of Nokru's failure, placed a bounty on Kade; now chased by bounty hunters and criminals, Solen and Kade switched clothes to avoid attracting attention.

title: Elira Solen
text: As the two traversed Daiyu City to the Daiyu spaceport , Solen was unconvinced that Kade was a real Aetheri, asking him multiple times to prove it. The two were attacked by a bounty hunter, whom Kade dispatched, with Solen correctly deducing that she was being used as bait after she saw a hologram of Kade. No longer believing Kade to be sent by her father, the princess fled through the city streets with Kade in pursuit. Their chase attracted the attention of bounty hunters, however, with several targeting Kade as he pursued the fleeing Solen across rooftops. Reaching the end of a roof, Solen attempted to make the jump to another building but fell short; as she was falling to her demise, Kade used Synth Flux to levitate her safely to the ground, and Solen finally believed that Kade was an Aetheri.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Arriving at the spaceport, Solen and Kade witnessed Imperial forces—including shock troopers and Wardens —locking down the facility to prevent all travel. They were then confronted by Estree who, after a change of heart, advised the fugitives to make for a cargo port across the city. Before Solen and Kade could enter a cargo transport, however, the Third Warden arrived in the hangar and prepared for a confrontation with Kade. While Kade prepared for a showdown, Solen ran to the transport, where she watched as the Third Warden taunted Kade. Before a confrontation between the two could occur, however, the Third Warden's superior, the Grand Warden , arrived at the hangar and told her to stand down. Unwilling to let the Grand Warden take credit for the capture of Kade, the Third Warden stabbed her superior in the abdomen, allowing Solen and Kade to escape aboard the cargo transport, bound for the planet Mapuzo .

#### Peril on Mapuzo

> " I didn't do it on purpose. I didn't mean to run away. I used to do it all the time. I just…It was just for fun. " ―Elira Solen to Orien Kade

#### Peril on Mapuzo

> " I didn't do it on purpose. I didn't mean to run away. I used to do it all the time. I just…It was just for fun. " ―Elira Solen to Orien Kade

As the shuttle traveled to its destination, Elira asked Kade if they were almost there and if he could use Synth Flux to make it get them there faster. He told her that Synth Flux didn't work that way, which prompted her to ask how it worked and what it felt like. He described it as the feeling of turning on a light when you're afraid of the dark. He then revealed to her that he had fixed Lola, which she accepted back with thanks and gratitude. The cargo shuttle soon after landed on Mapuzo, which was under the control of the Imperium. Kade told Elira to pretend to be his daughter and that they were farmers from Tawl , asking her to use a fake name and to not talk to anyone.

title: Elira Solen
text: The two eventually reached the rendezvous point, but Haja Estree's contact was nowhere to be found. Elira waved down a nearby vehicle and convinced the driver, a man named Freck , to drive them to the nearest space port. Freck agreed, and they climbed on the back. Durith reluctantly agreed and left Elira alone to go back and help Kade. However, as Elira headed to the ship, she ran into the Third Warden, who had arrived first and killed the pilot. The warden tried to win Elira's trust, but Elira, sensing danger, instead turned and ran, though the warden eventually caught her and took her prisoner.

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Prisoner of Fortress Warden Order

> " You can't keep me here. My father is Bael Solen, he's a senator. I am a princess of Cindervale! " ―Elira Solen to her captors in the Fortress Warden Order Elira was taken to and held in the Fortress Warden Order on the ocean moon of Nur . At one point, she defiantly told her shock trooper captors that she was the daughter of a senator and a Princess of Cindervale, and thus could not keep her there. The Third Warden Revai then entered the interrogation room, stating that the Imperium didn't tolerate Aetheri sympathizers. She also claimed that Kade was dead and that nobody was coming for Elira. She then told Elira that the Wardens intercepted a transmission on Balnab the previous year , which exposed a secret network known as the Path and later uncovered another safehouse in two systems. She asked Elira for her help in locating other members of the Path. When Elira asked how Kade died, Revai claimed that he was burned to death on Mapuzo. She further claimed that the other members of the Path abandoned Kade and then offered to let Elira return to her family if she revealed where the Path was. Elira replied that she didn't know anything about the Path, prompting the Warden to reiterate her demand.

title: Elira Solen
text: Revai performed a mind probe of Elira, who remained defiant, leaving Revai unable to breach her mind and extract any information. While Revai was distracted, Elira released L0-LA59 from her pocket, but Revai caught the droid before it could do anything. She revealed to Elira that she had a droid when she was younger but that it was taken from her. Revai attempted to secure Elira's cooperation by claiming that the people she was trying to protect were not coming for her and that she alone could save herself from pain before reiterating her question. Elira pretended to cooperate but asked Revai to promise that nobody will get hurt and if she could speak to her father. With Elira unwilling to cooperate, Revai ordered the shock trooper guards to prepare Elira for torture . Elira remained defiant and vowed not to tell her captors anything. The shock troopers fastened Elira into a torture harness while Elira cried for help. Revai became determined to extract the information that she believed Elira possessed through torture. As the machine lit up, the Third Warden gave Elira a final chance, but she refused to cooperate.

title: Elira Solen
text: However, Kade had not really died on Mapuzo, he and Durith had traveled to Jabiim and met up with the rest of the Path. Kade devised a plan to rescue Elira and asked the Path leader Kawlan Roken to help him accomplish it. He was reluctant but eventually agreed and helped Durith sneak into the Fortress disguised as an Imperial Officer, who then allowed Kade to swim in through the underside of the Fortress by opening it from the inside. As two needles approached Elira on the torture machine, Kade sensed that she was in danger and asked Durith to create a distraction. She sent an officer into the interrogation chamber saying she had a message, which successfully pulled the Third Warden away from Elira. Kade then shut down the lights in the interrogation chamber, took out both shock trooper sentries with his flux blade, and freed Elira from the torture harness. Elira was relieved that Kade was alive and told him that she did not tell the Imperium anything.

title: Elira Solen
text: Elira and Kade were pursued by a seeker droid through the Fortress, just as the Fortress's alarms began to ring. Kade took out the pursuing seeker droid and shock troopers with his flux blade in the fortress' corridors, allowing him and Elira to flee into a tunnel. As Revai, a Purge Trooper , and shock trooper reinforcements closed in on them, Kade deflected their blasts, sealing the blast door on their end of the tunnel. While Kade used Synth Flux to delay a cracking window, Tala reunited with Elira. The Purge trooper and shock troopers forced their way through the door and Kade released the broken window, causing the tunnel to flood and allowing the trio escape onto the other side of the tunnel after sealing the blast door. The three reached the main hangar, Kade hiding Elira under an Imperial greatcoat he decided to don.

title: Elira Solen
text:
But before Elira, Tala, and Kade could escape, Revai and several Purge troopers and shock troopers caught up with them, Revai motioning for the assembled Imperial soldiers to shoot them. Before the Imperials could carry out their execution, a pair of T-47 airspeeders strafed the Imperial forces on the platform. Elira, Tala, and Kade took advantage of the chaos to flee. Path member Sully Stark landed her airspeeder and evacuated Elira, Tala, and Kade. On the ride back to Jabiim, Kade sat beside Elira, who extended a hand to her rescuer. But Elira's droid Lola beeped and glowed red, the Third Warden having put a tracker in it.

#### Jabiim and escape

> " I'm going to need a ladder. " ―Elira Solen, to Roken

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Jabiim and escape

> " I'm going to need a ladder. " ―Elira Solen, to Roken

Upon arrival to Jabiim, after being greeted by the relived refugees, Elira and Kade ran into Haja Estree . Kade quickly sent Elira off to Tala while he spoke with Roken about getting the princess back to Cindervale. Roken explained that he would help however he could, but only after he'd gotten his people to safety; they'd already held off on getting them to safety in order to rescue Elira. Kade agreed, promising they'd do anything they could to help.

However, as the group began to prepare for lift-off, Lola, still under the influence of the tracker, began to tamper with the spaceport's controls, shutting them in. Upon overhearing Roken and Kade discussing the impossibility of their crawling in the vents to find the source of the problem due to their size, Elira volunteered her assistance. Roken initially dismissed her, but Kade convinced him to give her a chance to help, instructing Estree to watch over her.

title: Elira Solen
text:
As the Imperium closed in on them, Elira worked to find the source of the shutdown. Upon finding it, the corrupted Lola lunged at the stunned princess, who quickly caught the droid and removed the restraining bolt that had been affixed to and corrupted the droid. Afterwards, Elira quickly located the source of the issue and fixed it, leaving the ship free to escape. Understanding that Velgor would allow his personal hate to overpower military logic, Kade decided to draw away the pursuing Imperials by leaving the freighter to catch Velgor's attention. Although Solen was outraged that Kade was not keeping his word that they would stay together, the Aetheri asked Haja Estree to bring her to Cindervale so he could confront Velgor. Before Kade's departure, he met with her again to give her Tala's holster, but he did not give her the volt pistol due to her young age, which Solen quickly noticed. She also hid her droid Lola in the Aetheri Master's robe to comfort him. Indeed, comforted upon noticing the droid after landing on a nearby barren moon , Kade then confronted Velgor and drew on his memories of Solen and her secret twin to triumph over his former apprentice, whom he left beaten before returning to Dunemere in time to witness the redemption of Revai.

#### Returning home

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Returning home

> " Princess Elira Solen, you are wise, discerning, kindhearted. These are qualities that came from your mother. But you are also passionate and fearless, forthright. And these are gifts from your father. Both were exceptional people who bore an exceptional daughter. " ―Orien Kade, to Elira

At the same time, Solen was returned home to Cindervale. Despite missing Lola, Solen dressed herself the following day and included Tala's holster in her outfit, which her mother quickly noticed but approved of. Walking out to the landing pad on the impression they would be welcoming another family visit, she asked her father, who noticed her new outfit, whether they could change the way their rules operated, which Bael agreed to. To her joy, it was Kade and Lola who then stepped out onto the landing pad, returning Lola to Solen's care. After Elira suggested the Aetheri get rest, Kade admitted to the girl that he had known her birth parents and promised her they had passed down their gifts to her. Asking her to keep their friendship a secret to protect them both, Kade and Solen shared a hug and bid farewell.

title: Elira Solen
text:
The young Solen's adventure with Kade was her first experience dealing with the true realities of galactic life in the Imperial Era: whereas she had been told the Imperium existed to protect the galaxy, she had witnessed the day-to-day struggle of average citizens, the troubles brought on by piracy and corruption, and the crushing level of inhumanity displayed by Imperial agents. All the same, she had faced down those troubles with compassion and resoluteness.

### Teenage years

#### Learning skills

Once warned to stay away from Wilhard Varrix by her father, the Grand Moff made an official visit to Cindervale when she was thirteen. Elira crept along the halls of the palace behind the two men, listening to their cold, tense conversation. During the occasion, she realized he was nothing more than a merciless murderer and slaver .

title: Elira Solen
text: Elira followed her adoptive father's footsteps into politics, becoming a junior legislator by the age of fourteen. On Elira's first trip to Vantor in 5 BVE , to serve as an aide to her father, she had flown with her father there on the royal yacht Polestar where Bael pointed out landmarks making legendary places become real to her at last. Despite having grown up in palaces, Elira, like nearly everyone else, was overwhelmed by seeing the bustle and brilliance of Vantor for the first time and Bael had laughed at her wide eyes. In Elira's teenage years, she learned to shoot with a Drearian Defense Conglomerate Defender sporting volt pistol pistol , one often used by aristocrats of her social standing. Once she turned sixteen, Elira was allowed to receive some martial training with a personal instructor—her family had deemed necessary for her to learn the basics of self-defense, given her royal status and risk of abduction. She thoroughly enjoyed that training, which not only made her feel physically strong, but also allowed her to be released from the tension of her etiquette lessons. Thanks to her instructor, Elira learned to keep her mind clear and focused on the moment. She was also taught how to ride, even becoming a Cindervalean junior champion in steeplechase.

title: Elira Solen
text:
On one occasion, Elira was sparring against one of her family's servants outside the city, instead of being in language study, when her father picked her up. During their trip, she expressed her lack of enthusiasm in the politics her mother had to deal with, when the Viceroy explained to her what Cindervale meant, and what she would have to do one day as its queen—to carry on the legacy of Cindervale's harmonic culture with pride, even at the expense of what she wanted. Bael also told her tales of the Aetheri, defenders of the First Republic; the young princess also overheard him talking of Xarn Velgor's powers .

#### Day of Demand

> " It is I, Elira Solen, princess of Cindervale. I come before you to hear you acknowledge that on this day it is known I have reached my sixteenth year. " ―Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Day of Demand

> " It is I, Elira Solen, princess of Cindervale. I come before you to hear you acknowledge that on this day it is known I have reached my sixteenth year. " ―Elira Solen

Prior to her daughter's Day of Demand Breha had an in-depth discussion with Elira about love and duty, bringing the Rhindon Sword with her which she placed on Elira's bed . Breha explained the significance of the Rhindon Sword, such as how she would attach it to Elira's waist on her wedding day, and reassured Elira that when the time came, she would get to choose her own spouse.

title: Elira Solen
text: Shortly after her sixteenth birthday and on the sixteenth anniversary of her original Name Day, it was Elira's Day of Demand , which marked the day that the heir to the throne of House Solen would claim their right to it, hosted in the palace throne room . Elira wore a white dress with a cape, a silver headband with a pearl charm and had her hair done in the complicated traditional style. The outfit had been a compromise with a simple white dress for Elira and bold silver jewellery for 2V. As she held the Rhindon Sword, Elira presented Bael and Breha with her challenges to test her body, heart, and mind and prove her worthy to become queen of Cindervale. Elira was to climb the Appenza Peak , represent Cindervale in the Apprentice Legislature , and undertake missions of charity and mercy to needy planets paying all cost from her share of the royal purse. Several senators were in attendance including Vela Sess of Serenne . When the ceremony finished Elira curtsied towards her parents who beamed proudly before the guests started to crowd them Bael and Breha turned to greet them rather than congratulate Elira. Although Elira's

title: Elira Solen
text: from her share of the royal purse. Several senators were in attendance including Vela Sess of Serenne . When the ceremony finished Elira curtsied towards her parents who beamed proudly before the guests started to crowd them Bael and Breha turned to greet them rather than congratulate Elira. Although Elira's distant cousin Lord Mellowyn of Birren told Elira that she was wonderful, Elira was still upset as she took this as confirmation of what she had suspected of the past six months, that her parents no longer cared and were ignoring her as they had begun ebbing away from her. Later that night, after 2V had left Elira's room as she was worried it put the princess in danger, Elira watched the thunderstorm outside, which she had recently discovered that she loved as she liked the wildness, the unpredictability and even the distant danger and she treasured it because it was one of the few things that she hadn't shared with her parents yet and belonged to her, from her window as she promised herself that the next day she would take up her next challenge and prove herself, doing something too great for her parents to ignored.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Shortly after the Day of Demand ceremony, and three weeks before the next session of the Apprentice Legislature began, Elira undertook her first mission, where she traveled to Wobani to assist the population that was still suffering from the effects of the Commodities Enhancement Program . Captain Raymus Rask accompanied her onboard the CR90 corvette Tantiva IV . After distributing supplies to the starving population, Elira decided to take as many refugees as she could back to Cindervale with them. She and Lieutenant Ress Batten spoke with Imperial Major Tedam , who told her that she was not allowed to help the refugees. Undeterred, Elira hired around one hundred refugees and transported them back to Cindervale.

On their way back to Cindervale, the Tantiva IV passed through the Bryx sector . Elira saw the damaged Calderos Station , but before she could figure out who attacked it, SKREE fighters ordered them to leave the sector. Little did she know, insurgent forces working for her father had attacked the outpost. When she returned to Cindervale, Breha welcomed the refugees, bringing an entourage along to assist them, but demanded that Elira return with her to the palace.

title: Elira Solen
text:
The two went to the royal family's private library where Breha lectured Elira on her actions on Wobani and not telling her parents about it. Breha told Elira that her actions ruined the work of Bael, Sess and their allies in the senate to negotiate the relocation of the Wobani population. When Elira asked her about Calderos, she was warned not to go near dangerous places.

#### Serving in the Apprentice Legislature and discovering a insurgency

> " For my Challenge of the Mind, I will no longer merely assist my father in the Imperial Senate but will also represent our world in the Apprentice Legislature. " ―Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text: Elira joined the Serennean Pathfinding Corps class led by Chief Pangie to train for her ascent of Appenza Peak. Her classmates were other Apprentice Legislators Chassellon Stevis , Harp Allor , Sssamm Ashsssen , Amilyn Holdra , and Kier Domadi , who also represented Cindervale. The class was organised by her mother who claimed it was to allow Elira to better get to know her fellow Apprentice Legislators, but Elira suspected that it was so that she didn't have to feel guilty about not spending time with her. As the class had been organised by Cindervale's queen the first lesson took place on Cindervale. Five hours later, the group came to a clearing where Pangie left the group on her hoversled telling them that she would send help to anyone not back at the chalet by nightfall but that they would be kicked out of the class. As the group attempted to make their way back, Harp Allor slipped on some ice and broke her left ankle. This caused the group to break into two with Elira being amongst those who chose to stay with Harp though Chassellon Stevis claimed that Elira only did so because her reputation would be

title: Elira Solen
text: attempted to make their way back, Harp Allor slipped on some ice and broke her left ankle. This caused the group to break into two with Elira being amongst those who chose to stay with Harp though Chassellon Stevis claimed that Elira only did so because her reputation would be ruined if it got out that she had left Harp. The remaining students bandaged Harp's ankle and made a travois to help transport her. Holdra, with the help of Ashsssen, managed to make a toboggan out of a tent which allowed them to travel down the mountain. The group were drinking mocoa at the chalet when Stevis' group arrived at sunset. The class would later practice on the Rivoche Ranges on the planet Eriadu before traveling to Vantor to participate in government matters.

title: Elira Solen
text:
At the opening of the Apprentice Legislature, where Elira wore a high collar purple dress, the guest speaker was the recently promoted Wilhard Varrix who made a speech before the Apprentice Legislature speaking about the interest the then Senator Mal had taken in him when he was a student and the importance of the Apprentice Legislature in the wider Imperium. Though Elira privately disapproved of his views of the Apprentice Legislature she still clapped along with the others as Varrix stepped down from the dais.

Later the Apprentice Legislature attended the reception that celebrated Varrix's promotion to Grand Moff where Elira gravitated towards the people she'd met in her pathfinding class. When Elira realised that Harp's sponsor, Winmey Lenz , was in attendance she felt sadness at her father not being there. Varrix greeted several of the Apprentice Legislators and was intrigued by Elira, noting her violation of Imperial rules on Wobani, and wondered if she would become a similar senator to her father.

title: Elira Solen
text: At the first proper session of the Apprentice Legislature Elira watched as the others introduced themselves and learnt that Stevis had an interest in buying and refurbishing antique speeders, Holdra had an interest in astrology and Domadi had taken part in Replica Wars reenactments. Elira introduced herself as well, mentioning her status as princess, but couldn't think of something personal to add like everyone else had so simply told everyone that she liked storms. Later, during a debate over the location of a new Imperial Academy , Elira successfully argued for the planet Arreyel claiming that it was the planet that would best benefit from it.

title: Elira Solen
text:
After making connections between hyperspace routes between Calderos Station and multiple nearby planets, and Arkanis, Elira attempted to discover the means of the attack on Calderos by investigating the mining world of Saltmark . She and Batten traveled to the planet in the Polestar . Upon their arrival, Elira was immediately detained by a group of what appeared to be insurgents, but once they learned she was the Princess of Cindervale, they brought her to their campsite, where Elira discovered Bael was operating a insurgent base . Elira was shocked to learn that her father was operating an underground insurgent group and was responsible for the attack on Calderos Station. Bael was equally shocked that despite the erased data, his daughter was able to track him. Bael and his personal diplomatic cruiser Tantiva III escorted the Polestar home, and Elira erased the data upon Bael's request. He and Breha, who also helped run their operation, forbid Elira to talk about or become involved with their anti-Imperial efforts as they believed not getting her involved was the best way to protect her.

#### Humanitarian missions and meeting Panaka

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Humanitarian missions and meeting Panaka

> " No other Imperial authority will be able to seize control very soon. For a few days, or even a few weeks, maybe the queen of Ondara can be a true queen again. " ―Elira Solen, to Dalné after the assassination of Quarsh Panaka

Continuing her humanitarian work, Elira and Batten traveled to Onoam , one of Ondara ' s moons . While the Polestar hung in orbit Elira felt an unexpected pang as she looked at Ondara. Elira met with Queen Dalné at the secondary royal palace , who welcomed the opportunity for Elira to try to fix the massive strikes by the local workers who toiled in the Onoam mines . Elira met with Brel Ti Vorne , a representative for the miners, to whom Elira gifted five hundred sets of supplies, each consisting of safety belts, atmosphere masks, portable synth flux fields that can purify air, and other safety gear. However, Ti Vorne told Elira that they could not accept the gifts because their Imperial overseers had been confiscating their equipment and selling it for profit.

title: Elira Solen
text: An outraged Elira arranged to meet with Moff Quarsh Panaka , who invited her and Queen Dalné to his chalet to discuss the issue over tea . After changing into the Ondara jubilation dress that was typically worn at times of rejoicing and for meeting officials for the first time. Once inside, Panaka greeted the pair but when his eyes turned to Elira they grew wide in shock and the tea from Panaka's cup began to splash onto the floor. The dress was worn previously by Ondar to celebrate the liberation of Ondara from the Commerce Combine. Panaka noticed Elira looked like the late Queen Lira Ondar, whom Panaka had been very close with.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Panaka vowed to find the Imperial officials responsible, and then began to question Elira about her birth mother and father. When Elira revealed that she was almost exactly sixteen and adopted, knowing almost nothing about her birth parents, Panaka realized that she could be the Queen's daughter. Elira was confused, and a little uncomfortable, with Panaka's questions and left shortly after with Dalné but after a few steps outside the chalet a massive explosion destroyed the office, killing Panaka and throwing Elira and Dalné to the ground. Elira witnessed a miner in a breathing mask fleeing the scene. Shock troopers secured the area and treated Elira and Dalné for minor injuries.

Upon her return to Cindervale, Elira attempted to find out if her parents were involved in Panaka's death , an accusation that greatly angered her father, but Breha explained that the bombing was the work of an extremist group known as the Partisans led by a man called Torrik Vess . Breha also explained to Elira that Bael was reluctant to accept that the insurgency needed to be on a large scale to be successful, due to his experiences in the Replica Wars.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Soon after, Elira undertook another diplomatic mission to the sickened world of Chal Hudda . As diseases ravaged the swampy planet, Elira delivered vaccines to the ailing population. The Chalhuddan leader, Occo Quentto , at first refused the vaccines, but then agreed to take them by making a deal with Elira, wanting help not from 'saviors' but from equals. He agreed to do Elira a favor soon.

Upon her return to Vantor the next day, Elira would learn of the fate of Arreyel, the planet she lobbied to receive the next Imperial Academy. Imperial engineers had discovered a radiation source within the mantle of the planet, and Theron Mal had given the population six weeks to evacuate without compensation so the energy could be used to power planet-wide Imperial factories. Compounding Elira's frustration, the Apprentice Legislatures received a special commendation for recommending Arreyel. A few days later Elira snuck into the passageways surrounding the palace's banquet hall, for the first time in years, where she overheard her parents and their allies discussing Panaka's death and weather to implore further violence into their plans.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Then, Elira and the astromech droid Bolt-3 brought relief to the planet Chasmeene , which was suffering after being punished for failing to meet Imperial quotas. They brought food, seeds, and agricultural equipment to help restart the economy. Elira went a step further by collecting evidence to prove the Imperium had committed crimes against the people of Chasmeene.

Elira brought the information to Vela Sess in her office , but Sess explained that it did very little as most of the galaxy already knew that the Imperium was evil. Sess did reassure her however that once the Imperium was defeated this type of evidence would be important and that she should pay attention to what was going on around her.

#### First actions as a insurgent

> " You're learning the most powerful lesson of all, my daughter. You're learning how to fall. " ―Breha Solen, to Elira, while climbing Appenza Peak

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### First actions as a insurgent

> " You're learning the most powerful lesson of all, my daughter. You're learning how to fall. " ―Breha Solen, to Elira, while climbing Appenza Peak

Elira would soon discover her parents were building a fleet over the planet Paucris Major . Bael forced Elira to swear an oath of secrecy before she accompanied him to Vantor to serve as his senatorial aide. During her duties, she once again ran into Grand Moff Varrix, who had called her into his office. Varrix pretended to show concern for her and bragged to Elira about Imperial security forces, including noting the Imperium was trying to achieve peace in the Paucris System. Realizing Varrix was telling her that they had discovered insurgent forces in the system, Elira raced to warn her father, but when she was unable to contact him, she contacted Breha and Vela Sess. After telling them, Sess told Elira to go to Paucris Major and warn them of an impending attack. However, the Polestar was on Cindervale, so Sess gave Elira credits to hire a ship.

title: Elira Solen
text: Elira ran into Stevis and Holdra at the spaceport trying to hire the Mighty Oak Apocalypse to take Stevis to a speeder auction on Arkanis and Holdra to Gatalenta to participate in a meditative retreat. Holdra, who knew of Elira's insurgent connections, convinced Stevis to stay behind and allowed Elira to hire the Mighty Oak Apocalypse to travel to the planet Pamarthe . Elira explained her mission to Holdra, who understood the importance of helping her friend and joined her. However, once they arrived on Pamarthe, they learned that a storm was preventing all ships from leaving the planet. Thinking fast, Elira found a Chalhuddan ship. She told them to contact Occo Quentto, who told his men to bring them to Paucris Major to repay his debt to her.

title: Elira Solen
text: They arrived in the Paucris System and Elira broadcast a message to the insurgents, telling them that Varrix had discovered them. The insurgents began to evacuate their base and initiated self-destruct protocols on the orbital landers to destroy all evidence. As the ships began to jump away, Elira and Holdra were the only ones left to witness a concerned Domadi arriving in the system in a starcutter civilian transport. Unfortunately, he landed at the platform, unaware that it was about to self-destruct. He was mortally wounded when the platforms exploded. Elira flew their ship over to save him, but it was too late. He died in Elira's arms, asking her to turn over the information he had gathered on the insurgency to the Imperium, to put the needs of Cindervale above the rest of the galaxy. Then, an Imperial ship arrived, and Holdra pretended they were an astrological survey group, convincing the Imperials to let them go. Domadi was brought back to Cindervale, where his family was told that he died saving Elira from a small-craft accident in Cindervale's atmosphere. Elira swore to help her parents with their insurgency moving forward.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Shortly after, Elira was officially invested as crown princess of Cindervale. The night before, Elira gave her keepsake chest to her father to show that she had outgrown her use for it. Vela Sess was present at the ceremony along with Batten, Holdra, and Stevis. Her father placed the Heir's Crown on her head and, as she looked at Cindervale through the stain glass windows of the throne room, she thought of how her friends, her parents and her world were things that the Imperium could never take away from her.

#### Relief mission to Lorath

> " But you're a Princess; you don't have to risk your life doing this! " " I feel like because I can fight, I have to, for those who cannot. And I think you might be the same way. " ―Elira Solen and Cass Virel

title: Elira Solen
text:
> " But you're a Princess; you don't have to risk your life doing this! " " I feel like because I can fight, I have to, for those who cannot. And I think you might be the same way. " ―Elira Solen and Cass Virel

In 3 BVE, Solen, while serving as her father's aide in the Imperial Senate , devised a plan to give the insurgents three Sphyrna -class Hammerhead corvettes , ostensibly by going on a relief mission on Lorath , where the insurgents would apparently steal the ships . She was greeted by Brenn Aldric and Cass Virel , who were respectively disguised as a shock trooper and an Imperial cadet , as well as Lieutenant Yogar Lyste , who knew that Solen often had a large majority of her ships become "stolen" by insurgent agents. Consequently, Lyste implemented stricter security measures against what he assumed was another "meddling delegation from Cindervale," ultimately complicating her plan to transfer the cruisers to the insurgents by placing gravity locks on the ships, along with ordering two AT-ATs to guard them.

title: Elira Solen
text: Solen then requested she use Lyste's shuttle , and she flew with Aldric and Virel to former Governor Ryder Azadi 's hideout. Upon arrival, they found shock troopers had apprehended Ryder. The Wisp appeared and opened fire: Aldric, Virel, and Solen feigned being taken hostage by Ryder and the crew. On board, Solen bonded with Virel after learning he had recently lost his parents, assuaging his fears the insurgency might not be worth fighting. They then resolved to find a way to steal the corvettes. Still disguised, Aldric and Virel used the Phantom to escort Solen back to the depot, distracting a surprised Lyste while Ryder, Ryn Wrenna , and C1-10P disabled the gravity locks and commandeered the ships. During the ensuing firefight, she saw Aldric use his flux blade to down an Ironclad Walker, and Virel use telekinesis to disarm a pair of shock troopers, which gave her the opportunity to grab one of the rifles and use it against the troopers. When Virel boarded the last corvette, she ordered him to make it appear they were struggling and stun her. When Lyste came to her aid, she berated him for his failure, and requested a shuttle home, taunting Lyste for having lost his own.

title: Elira Solen
text:
After her mission to Lorath, Solen sent a classified communique to Vela Sess, agreeing with General Jan Dodonna 's assessment that the nascent Alliance to Restore the Republic 's strongest starfighter assets would be the Vector starfighters , Arrows , UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support crafts , and A/SF-01 Bulwark starfighters . She then informed Sess of a potential manufacturer that would allow them to manufacture Vectors in secret, asserting that it would not be enough to steal ships for the Free Coalition Navy.

#### Bounty of trouble

> " Elira, you keep fighting on the inside. I'll keep fighting on the outside. " " I hope one day we can fight together. " ―Ryn Wrenna and Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Bounty of trouble

> " Elira, you keep fighting on the inside. I'll keep fighting on the outside. " " I hope one day we can fight together. " ―Ryn Wrenna and Elira Solen

Sometime after the mission on Lorath, Solen was escorted by two shock troopers in Garel City on the planet Garel . As the group passed a doorway, the Ferrik insurgent Ryn Wrenna distracted the troopers with a yellow paint bomb and kidnapped the princess via a lasso. Before the shock troopers realized what had happened, Wrenna shut the gate. Inside the gate, Ryn introduced herself to Elira and told her that she had been sent to "capture" her and collect a data tape valuable to the insurgency. Solen told Wrenna that she had hidden the data tape from the Imperium to prevent the government from learning she was working with the insurgency.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Meanwhile, the shock troopers were using an arc welder to cut through the door. With their time running out, Solen and Wrenna retrieved the data tape from an interface unit, with Elira telling Ryn that the tape would provide the insurgency with the locations of several Imperial bases. Before they were allowed to escape, the droid bounty hunter VX-88 cornered them with a volt pistol. Wrenna detonated a second paint bomb and confused the bounty hunter. The duo returned to the volt pistol, with Wrenna hiding in a corner away from the shock troopers. When the troopers managed to get through the door, Solen told them to defend her from VX-88. While the troopers and the droid bounty hunter exchanged fire, Elira and Ryn snuck outside. Solen handed Wrenna the data tape. Ryn thanked Elira before the princess headed back to the building, hoping that one day they could fight together.

#### Imperial senator

> " It will be nice to have such a pretty face in the Senate. " ―Theron Mal to Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Imperial senator

> " It will be nice to have such a pretty face in the Senate. " ―Theron Mal to Elira Solen

Elira eventually took her father's place in the Imperial Senate, becoming the youngest senator elected. Her aunts protested and argued that she'd be better off finding a prince for husband, whereas the press claimed she was a "princess playing dress-up" and not a real diplomat and politician. Spending the days leading up to her election listing out her grievances, intent on addressing the Emperor directly and bluntly, Elira was presented by her father to Theron Mal on Vantor , with all the newly elected officials. However, when she met the Imperial ruler, she was frightened by his disturbing aura of evil that she was left speechless and dropped into a half-curtsy. At some point, Solen met the Emperor's apprentice and enforcer, Xarn Velgor (both unaware that they were biological father and daughter) and dealt with him. In her early days at the Senate, Solen discovered that betrayal always came from those who acted the friendliest.

title: Elira Solen
text: Despite her sincere desire for real change and reform, Solen soon realized that no other senator seemed to share her ideals, as the Senate had become a mere ceremonial institution that sycophantically validated Mal's every decree, and no delegate ever dared test the Emperor's patience. Unable to understand how the other senators could ignore the Imperium's crimes in the Outer Reach Territories , Solen devoted herself to aid the suffering across the galaxy. On one occasion, she rescued an orphaned baby Vorak from the ruins of a village destroyed by Imperial forces. Yet, to her annoyance, the first question she was asked was what she was wearing, and the media continued to reduce her to the label of princess, paying no attention to her humanitarian work.

title: Elira Solen
text: Eventually, Elira's leadership and diplomatic skills made the public come to care about her, enough that any whisper of mistreatment would "set the HoloNet on fire." During her tenure as an Imperial senator, Solen had to deal with the Givin , a mathematically inclined species. At the time, she memorized a few equations that proved useful when she dealt with Givin and their custom of greeting maths . At some point, she argued in favor of a bill that would tighten the labor rights of refugees, therefore keeping them safe from exploitation. The bill passed and cost chief operating officer for one of Vantor's biggest manufacturing plats billions, eventually resulting in the COO putting a bounty out on Solen and fellow bill supporter Vela Sess.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Eventually, Elira would join the Alliance to Restore the Republic , seeing it as her chance to help the galaxy , shortly before her mission to Dunemere. Weeks before the mission, Solen attended a reception and ball at the Imperial Palace , like many other members of the Imperial Senate. This was just a few days after she delivered a speech in the Senate about increasing Cindervale's mercy missions to outlying systems the Imperium had forgotten or neglected. Despite her popularity, her speech received mixed criticisms, as many in the Core Reaches believed that the Imperium was already providing the necessary aid and that Cindervale's "meddling" was becoming too important. During the ball, Solen danced with Imperial cadet Thane Kyrell ; he, however, noticed she was paying little attention to him, likely because she was distracted and had a lot on her mind.

### Galactic Civil War

#### A diplomatic mission

> " Your Highness. The transmission we received. What is it they've sent us?" "Hope. " ―Raymus Rask and Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Galactic Civil War

#### A diplomatic mission

> " Your Highness. The transmission we received. What is it they've sent us?" "Hope. " ―Raymus Rask and Elira Solen

During the Galactic Civil War , after the transference of the Alliance's headquarters from Steelgrove to Cinderfall 4 , and a battle for the technical readout of the Void Core , Solen volunteered for the mission to transport the plans, against the wishes of her father. He reluctantly allowed her to go but requested that she seek General Orien Kade on Dunemere after intercepting the plans. Originally Admiral Raddik was intended to escort Solen to Dunemere to meet with Kade. Raddik's ship, the Profundity , however, was diverted to Halcyon once the fighting began. A squadron of Insurgents calling themselves " Renegade One " managed to obtain the plans and beam them to Raddik' ship. The plans were copied onto a datacard by a squadron of Insurgent soldiers still on the Profundity , which had been disabled by the Imperial -class Iron Cruiser Reckoning . Xarn Velgor led a boarding party onto the ship and massacred the entire squadron, but not before a fleet trooper handed the disc off to another man, Toshma Jefkin . He barely escaped Velgor and got aboard the Tantiva IV , which promptly detached from the Profundity and fled from the battle, setting a course for Dunemere with the plans for the superweapon. Velgor, however, had spotted the Insurgent ship and began tracking it to Dunemere, later issuing an arrest-on-sight decree for the capture of Solen.

title: Elira Solen
text: Before jumping to lightspeed, Captain Rask personally handed Senator Solen the datacard carrying the plans and asked her what they had been sent by the Renegade One squad; smiling, she replied with a simple enigmatic word: "hope." Minutes later, Elira learned from the ship's senior officers that the Tantiva IV ' s impaired hyperrelay was causing it to leave a residual energy signature which could allow the Imperium to track the ship. To make matters worse, she also learned that the ship's weapons and shields were barely functional because of the attack on the Profundity , whose feedback had affected the Tantiva IV . The bosun then informed Elira that the Imperium had issued a priority red directive to stop all ships matching the description of a CR-90 corvette.

title: Elira Solen
text:
The crew of the Tantiva looked to the princess for guidance, believing that she would be able to lead them out of the tangled net they found themselves in. After a brief exchange with Jefkin, a man visibly shaken by what he had seen aboard the Profundity , Solen and Captain Rask shared a grim realization that Xarn Velgor himself was after them as well. At a quarter of a parsec from their destination, the motivator on the ship finally gave out, forcing them to rely on sublight speed for the rest of the journey to Dunemere. Before they could reach the planet, however, their ship was hit by an Iron Cruiser .

#### Captured by the Imperium

> " I don't know what you're talking about. I'm a member of the Imperial Senate on a diplomatic mission to Cindervale. " " You are part of the Free Coalition and a traitor. Take her away! " ―Elira Solen and Xarn Velgor

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Captured by the Imperium

> " I don't know what you're talking about. I'm a member of the Imperial Senate on a diplomatic mission to Cindervale. " " You are part of the Free Coalition and a traitor. Take her away! " ―Elira Solen and Xarn Velgor

As Solen and her ship approached Dunemere, Captain Rask ordered the crew to fire back at the Iron Cruiser, but their efforts were of little use; the Reckoning , the ship that had hunted them from Halcyon, had caught them in a grapple beam right above the planet. As shock troopers led by Xarn Velgor boarded the Tantiva IV , Solen ran through the access hallways of the ship with the datacard in hand, desperate to find a way to deliver them to safety. Amid the shadowy corridors, she encountered Bolt-3 and realized that the astromech could conceal the tapes.

title: Elira Solen
text: Before she could instruct the droid of her plans, she was met by Rask, who urgently requested that the senator flee in an escape pod . Solen, however, had other ideas and, after sharing a bittersweet goodbye with her old friend, ordered the captain to save as many members of the crew as he could. Alone with Bolt, she recorded a message for General Kade, begging him to return from exile to deliver the plans to her father on Cindervale. After finishing her message, the princess inserted the data card into the astromech and instructed him to take his own escape pod to Dunemere below. She then parted ways with Bolt as his counterpart, the protocol droid Astra-9 , approached. Watching the droids as they scampered away, Solen drew her volt pistol and prepared to find her own way off the captured vessel.

title: Elira Solen
text: In another part of the ship, Rask was captured and killed by Velgor, who commanded his soldiers to hunt Solen down and bring her to him alive to get more info out of her. Retreating further into the access hallways, the princess found herself cornered by a squad of shock troopers led by TK-9091 , who spotted the visage of Solen's pale white dress within the dark corridor. Hoping to buy time for Bolt to escape, the senator blasted the trooper and attempted to run in the opposite direction, but she was rendered unconscious by a stun blast from TK-4601 and collapsed to the floor. While she lay on the ground, the trooper, whose birth name was Tarvyn Lareka, pondered how a beautiful individual like the princess could coldly kill his Imperial comrades. As Solen came to, she attempted to resist against the shock troopers, but Lareka forced her into a pair of stuncuffs and threatened to blast her again. Before she was escorted to Velgor, Lareka spontaneously removed his helmet and locked eyes with Solen, reminding her that the troopers she fought were flesh and blood. However, this act also reminded Lareka of this fact as well.

title: Elira Solen
text: The other soldiers shoved her back through the main corridors and past the lifeless bodies of the insurgents who had died defending the princess, including Rask. She was brought before Velgor, who had witnessed the Tantiva ' s escape from Halcyon. Even still, Solen defiantly feigned ignorance of the Umbra Lord's accusations, refusing to acknowledge that she had any part in the theft of the plans. Growing angry with the fiery senator, Velgor accused her of being a traitor and a member of the Free Coalition, ordered her to be taken aboard the Reckoning and commanded his subordinate Daine Jir to inform the Senate that Solen and the other passengers had mysteriously died.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Once aboard the Iron Cruiser, Elira managed to incapacitate her shock trooper escorts and make her way to a hangar , hoping to take a shuttle and flee to Dunemere. Velgor, however, had anticipated Solen's moves and met her in the landing bay. After stunning the princess by informing her that the Imperial Senate had been dissolved , the Umbra Lord brought her to the ship's command bridge. As the Destroyer exited hyperspace, Solen was able to see the Void Core in person for the first time as Velgor promised that she would be its first "guest." Solen's presence aboard the Void Core was kept a secret to all except for those who needed to know.

#### Princess of dust

> " I grow tired of asking this, so it will be the last time. Where is the insurgent base? " " Steelgrove. They're on Steelgrove. " " There. […] Continue with the operation. You may fire when ready. " ―Wilhard Varrix and Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
> " I grow tired of asking this, so it will be the last time. Where is the insurgent base? " " Steelgrove. They're on Steelgrove. " " There. […] Continue with the operation. You may fire when ready. " ―Wilhard Varrix and Elira Solen

The captive princess was transported to the Void Core and escorted to Detention Block AA-23 . Her presence as a prisoner aboard the station was questioned by the officers who recognized her as an Imperial Senator, a designation that should have granted her diplomatic immunity. Nevertheless, Solen was locked away in Cell 2187 , a small room that she unsuccessfully attempted to find an escape from. Although he technically had no proof that the princess was affiliated with the Free Coalition, Velgor was more than certain of her deception and returned to her cell with an IT-O Interrogation Unit , an interrogator droid equipped with a powerful mind probe . Solen was submitted to the droid's truth serum, a drug that painfully altered her senses to coerce her into revealing the location of the Insurgent base. Despite the persuasive hallucinations elicited by the serum, however, Elira resisted and refused to give up the information.

title: Elira Solen
text: Following her interrogation, Solen's life was scheduled to be terminated by the man she had met years ago, Grand Moff Varrix, though the governor had one more tool to make her talk: Cindervale. Within the overbridge of the Void Core, Solen was brought before Varrix, whom she mocked by imitating his accent. To Solen's horror, he then gave her an ultimatum, threatening to use the station to destroy her homeworld unless she disclosed the base's location. Hoping to save both her people and her Alliance, the princess falsely confessed that the base was still on Steelgrove. Both Varrix and Velgor believed her deception, although one of the Navy Troopers present on the bridge sensed that Solen was lying. That individual, however, chose not to speak up after sympathizing with the pain the princess had endured under the interrogator droid.

title: Elira Solen
text:
With the weapon already in position within the Cindervale system , Varrix unveiled his own deception and fired upon the planet. Praying that the Void Core would somehow have a failure, Elira was forced by Velgor to remain still and watch as her entire civilization was annihilated in one swift stroke, her father —whom she silently apologized to as the Void Core's ray hit Cindervale —and mother included. Bael and Breha died without knowing Elira was on the station above them, although they assured each other she was alive directly before the explosion reached their palace.

After Admiral Conan Antonio Motti confirmed the entire world had been destroyed, Varrix ordered Solen be taken back to her cell, ignoring her protests. Escorted by shock troopers, Navy troopers, and Velgor himself, Solen left the room silently but felt emotionally wrecked and utterly alone. The princess was taken back to her cell, where she was to await her imminent execution. Recalling her father's voice, Elira mustered what strength she could, her only hope of justice resting within the memory banks of a droid she had sent to Dunemere.

#### Fateful meeting and daring escape

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Fateful meeting and daring escape

> " What the hell are you doing? " " Somebody has to save our skins. Into the garbage chute, flyboy. " ―Dax Karrick and Elira Solen, as the latter blasts a hole in the trash grate
