text: Arriving on Mistral , Solen and the others were greeted by Quill, whom Solen was immediately skeptical of. He agreed to repair the hyperrelay of the Corsair Wing , and in the meantime, Solen and the others stayed at Aether Spire . However, unbeknownst to them, Quill had made a deal with Velgor to hand over the insurgents in exchange for non-interference from the Imperium. Captured by Velgor, where the Dark Lord waited for Drayden's arrival, Elira and the others were taken to a carbon-freezing facility , where Karrick was to be frozen in carbonite to test if the chambers were suitable for trapping Drayden. As the smuggler was lowered into the freezing pit, Solen's parting words were "I love you," to which Karrick responded that he knew. ( Listen ( help · info ) ).

title: Elira Solen
text: On their way to Velgor's ship, Solen caught sight of a recently arrived Joren Drayden and tried to warn him, but she, Brevok, and Astra-9 were taken away by Imperial forces. Before long, Quill betrayed Velgor by disarming the shock troopers with the help of his men, setting the Insurgents free. Though Brevok almost strangled Quill, Solen let him live when he told them of Karrick's location at the East Platform . With Bolt-3 joining them, they attempted to save the frozen Karrick from being taken away by Vark, but they were too late—the bounty hunter had already left on the Reaver One with Karrick. All the while, Drayden dueled Velgor until he lost his right hand , flux blade , and learned that the Dark Lord was his father.

title: Elira Solen
text: Jumping down a shaft, Drayden eventually ended up hanging on a weather scanner vane below Aether Spire and called Solen out of instinct. The princess, who was escaping aboard the Corsair Wing with Brevok, Bolt-3, Astra-9, and Quill, sensed Drayden's presence through Synth Flux, and they turned around to retrieve Drayden at her insistence. Once they rescued Drayden, the ship was chased by Skree/LN starfighters into orbit and confronted by the Sovereign . Thanks to the astromech droid, the hyperrelay worked, and the Corsair escaped the Imperial threat. Aboard the Corsair , Solen was still angry at Quill for making his deal with the Imperium and introduced him to Drayden. She then comforted her friend, who chose not to tell her that Velgor was his father, instead revealing to her that Orien Kade had not responded when he reached out. Solen was certain the Aetheri Master would answer and that, if he did not, Drayden was strong enough to find his own path. Knowing they could not save Karrick but that they could help the insurgency, Solen ignored Quill's concerns about the Imperium and chose to return to the Insurgent fleet, commandeering the Corsair for the Alliance. She also reminded

title: Elira Solen
text: if he did not, Drayden was strong enough to find his own path. Knowing they could not save Karrick but that they could help the insurgency, Solen ignored Quill's concerns about the Imperium and chose to return to the Insurgent fleet, commandeering the Corsair for the Alliance. She also reminded Quill that he had betrayed them to the Imperials, which was something she felt they would not move past for some time, though the Aether Spire administrator felt he deserved credit for getting the team off Mistral. They arrived in the Mid Reach to meet with the Fourth Division at Rendezvous Point Delta-Three . There, they assisted in helping the Division's and Green Squadron's ships in escaping Commander Ellian Zahra 's Hunter Fleet 's blockade. Solen then all of Zahra's Skrees chase after the Corsair . Solen and Drayden manned the turrets as Quill and Brevok flew the Corsair into an attack run. Solen, the Corsair , the 4th division were able to escape. Though her other forces had destroyed the Eighth Division , Zahra was forced to report her failure to Velgor, who was aware of her hatred for Solen. Seeking to keep Drayden alive, Velgor allowed her to kill the Insurgent princess if she could but informed her that the Corsair was off limits. Having escaped to Backup Rendezvous Point Gamma-Nine , Solen then went to meet with Commander Grek aboard his ship. They discussed how the Imperium found them and the Eighth Division at Malastare, and Solen realized that the Imperium had broken their codes. Thus, the insurgents knew if any cell contacted another, both groups could be found and destroyed. Solen and the others were unable to warn the other scattered insurgents because

title: Elira Solen
text:
how the Imperium found them and the Eighth Division at Malastare, and Solen realized that the Imperium had broken their codes. Thus, the insurgents knew if any cell contacted another, both groups could be found and destroyed. Solen and the others were unable to warn the other scattered insurgents because of this, and Quill even feared they could be all that remained of the Free Coalition. A short time afterward, Quill promised he would head to Dunemere to learn if Vark had delivered Karrick to Grukk yet. If not, he intended to look for leads on the bounty hunter. Solen elected to stay behind to help the Insurgent fleet, though she had Brevok go with their new ally to make sure he went to the desert world and then right back. Solen then spoke with Drayden about getting a prosthetic hand , though the young Aetheri was still questioning himself after learning Velgor was his father. Solen, Astra-9, and Bolt accompanied Drayden when he received the new hand and watched as Quill and Brevok left to find Karrick aboard the Corsair Wing . Solen then spoke to Commander Grek's crew, pilots, and the Pathfinders about the Imperium's continuing hunt for the Alliance. She proposed to find and contact the other cells without using their codes. Solen agreed to use Grek's Operation Starlight .

#### Return to Aether Spire

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Return to Aether Spire

Solen, along with Quill, Drayden, and Bolt returned to Aether Spire to assist Drayden in recovering his flux blade. After landing in Aether Spire, she went to the carbon-freezing chamber . There, Solen studied how to work the decarbonization sequence. She was then found by a shock trooper and stunned. Solen was frozen in carbonite.

Solen and other prisoners were then freed from the carbonite by Drayden. Solen led the prisoners in fighting the Imperial Garrison's shock troopers and escaping aboard a Sentinel -class landing shuttle.

Aboard a Nebulon-B frigate , Solen greeted Drayden after his mission to Tempes . Relieved at his return, she asked him to show the Alliance officers onboard his newly acquired flux blade , to give her and them hope.

#### Encounter with Zahra

title: Elira Solen
text:
Aboard a Nebulon-B frigate , Solen greeted Drayden after his mission to Tempes . Relieved at his return, she asked him to show the Alliance officers onboard his newly acquired flux blade , to give her and them hope.

#### Encounter with Zahra

Commander Grek received a transmission from the Seventh Division . Solen gave the orders to respond to the transmission, despite knowing that it would compromise their position. Solen, along with the Fourth Division joined the Seventh shortly after the Hunter Fleet began their assault on the division. During the battle, Solen's ship is boarded by Commander Zahra. She deactivated the safety controls on the ship's main reactor, and asked for Solen specifically. Knowing that the ship would explode if the reactor's limiters aren't reactivated, Solen agreed and entered the engine room with Grek's volt pistol .

title: Elira Solen
text:
As she entered, Zahra explained that she blamed Solen for the deaths of Varrix and of her family. Before she can fully enact revenge, she is ordered to board her flagship, the Varrix's Will , before the ship flees the battle. Drayden comes to Solen's rescue and Zahra flees. Solen mentioned to Drayden how much hatred she could see in her eyes, and how she felt this enemy was different.

#### Operation Starlight

After the battle, Solen began Operation Starlight by discussing a plan to reunite the scattered Insurgent divisions without using communication the Imperium could intercept them with. She let Astra-9 discuss their plan to steal a linguistic droid that could speak Trawak , an extinct language. Solen sent Quill to use the Corsair Wing for the mission.

title: Elira Solen
text: After the mission was a success and the droid was reactivated, Solen discussed with it the terms of his service and how he would translate messages for the Free Coalition. She then sent Starlight Squadron on a mission to check rendezvous points for Insurgent cells and given them the new Trawak codes if found. When Starlight Squadron is ambushed and Lobot started to die from being interfaced with the linguistic droid, Solen decided to have the droid contact the squadron, despite the possibility of Lobot dying. A fight broke out between Quill and Kes Vale due to this, where Solen ordered Quill to be imprisoned for the time being. After Astra-9 reconstructed the Trawak language and turned the linguistic droid off, Solen checked to see if Lobot was still alive, and had him taken to the medical bay where she realized he was. When Starlight Squadron was able to recontact the group aboard the frigate, they informed Solen and Vale that Shara Bey had to be left behind on the Varrix's Will . Solen reassured Vale that his wife would be safe.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Aboard the Redemption , Solen and Vale talked about the people they loved, Rin Vale, Shara Bey, and Dax Karrick. They exchanged stories about them, before being informed of a signal from Lieutenant Bey. Solen let Vale speak to her first, after which he informed Solen of intelligence Bey had gathered during her stay on the Varrix's Will .

#### Auction for Dax Karrick

Solen received a message from Amilyn Holdra which indicated that Karrick was to be put on auction by Carmine Dawn . She showed Drayden, Brevok, and Astra-9 the holomessage aboard the Corsair Wing . Translated by Astra-9, Brevok told Solen and Drayden about his past encounters with Carmine Dawn, and that he suggested enlisting Quill's help in dealing with them. She sent Brevok to talk to him. Drayden talked with Solen, concerned over the mission and for her wellbeing. She reassured him that both would be okay.

title: Elira Solen
text:
In the cockpit of the Corsair Wing , Solen and Quill discussed about their approach to getting Dax Karrick back. Once they exited hyperspace, they noticed that multiple capital ships from multiple crime syndicates had arrived to bet on Dax Karrick. They tried to fly to the far side of the planet to avoid detection, but a Black Sun ship exited hyperspace right in front of them. The Corsair Wing was able to escape oncoming Black Sun fighters, and crash land on the Jekara 's surface.

#### Operation Yellow Moon

> " You make the Alliance proud every day. By representing our cause—and by doing your duty. But duty won't give you comfort, Elira—and you need that. We all do. The comfort of friends—and of love. You were Bael and Breha's greatest joy, Elira—the love you shared was what sustained them through the dark years. Don't deny yourself another chance at love because of what the Imperium did to them. Don't give Mal that victory, too. " ―Vela Sess, encouraging Solen not to give up her love for Karrick

title: Elira Solen
text: Following Sess and the Insurgent leadership's order to scatter the fleet, Solen and Astra-9 were on Captain Volk Aymeric 's Nebulon-B frigate, the Remembrance , when the ship and the rest of the convoy were attacked by SKREE fighters; despite the Ranolfo ' s critical condition, Aymeric was forced to abandon them to protect Solen. She was then informed that she had to rendezvous with the rest of the Alliance leadership on Zastiga , her transport pilots being Nien Nunb and Lieutenant Ematt. On the Mellcrawler , they reached the planet, wherein Solen was greeted by Bolt-3 and Drayden, who told her that Quill was attempting to infiltrate Grukk's Palace to acquire more information on Karrick's location, just before escorting her to the top-clearance meeting.

title: Elira Solen
text:
During the gathering, Solen and the Generals were informed of the construction of the second Void Core , located over Mossfell —which, they knew, had to be destroyed before it became operational. After swearing to secrecy, Solen was escorted by Drayden to her quarters, where she devised a strategy to present at the meeting the day after— Operation Yellow Moon —to divert the Imperial attention to her, instead of the upcoming mission to Mossfell. After a confidential exchange with Sess, Solen was allowed to take part in the mission, her crew consisting of Nien Nunb, Kidi Aleri , Antrot , and Major Lokmarcha .

While in hyperspace Elira read up on intel for their mission. A fight broke out between Kidi and Lokmarcha. Kidi was discussing her former colleagues in the Imperial Intel Agency and how she wished for them to be given amnesty after the war. The Dressellian said that they would face prison or a firing squad if he was in charge. Elira settled the fight and told them that they would face that issue after every single General, Admiral, and Moff had surrendered, and the Imperial Starfleet and Shock trooper Corps had been defeated.

title: Elira Solen
text: They soon reached Basteel 's capital, Eladro City , where she met with Bon Yoth to know where to place the first hyper-transceiver —in the cave system above his house . They had to climb one Kilometer up to the surface. During this, some sort of night feeders attacked her. She quickly got up to the surface where they ran from the light. The temperature began to drop as the sun set, but Nein Numb arrived in the Mellcrawler just as the sun finally set. They were Successful in their ordeal, but now tailed by Khione and her Shieldmaiden . They continued onto the Sesid system , where they placed another transceiver in a volcanic island on Sesid . They were soon chased by Imperials until the intervention of Aurelant and his Draedan pirates on the Daggadol . At first, they thought the Draedans would sell them off, but thanks to his maneuver to get them off-planet on Sesid's special escape pods they made their way to Jaresh , where they met with Nyessa , placed the last transceiver, and took part of the Riot on Jaresh , after which the Shieldmaiden tried and failed catch the Mellcrawler .

title: Elira Solen
text:
After briefing her team about the true mission Solen decided to change the operation, warning any incoming Insurgent ships to abandon the place. Once in the rendezvous point on Galaan 's orbit, they warned the Sapphire Renegade and other ships before being caught in the Shieldmaiden ' s grapple beam. They were taken aboard the iron cruiser and taken to interrogation rooms. Khione went into Elira's cell and brought Lokmarcha inside. The commando had hidden an ion bomb inside of his clothing and sacrificed himself. Elira took the captain's uniform and Antrot, Nein, and Kidi pretended to be her prisoners. When shock troopers realized the ploy, Antrot ran as a distraction and was shot as Nein launched off in the shuttle Tydirium . All the ships they had warned, returned, and destroyed the Shieldmaiden .

With Aleri's help, Solen then contacted Drayden, who informed her that most of the fleet was nearly assembled, and that Karrick was still frozen in carbonite in Grukk's palace. They arranged a rendezvous on Kothlis , where he would inform her of his plan to rescue Karrick. Although Sess tried to talk Solen out of the dangerous plan, they nevertheless carried on with it.

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Visit to Ord Mantell

Carrying out the rescue of Dax Karrick, Elira required an adequate disguise to fool Grukk the Grak. Because of this, Solen, Brevok, and the droid Bolt-3 traveled to Ord Mantell to meet Maz Oru , who was the one to provide her with the disguise. Elira proceeded to ask Oru how she would provide them with a cover story for Grukk, with Maz cautioning patience. At that moment, the bounty hunter Boushh fired shots at the group. While hiding behind crates, Oru explained to Elira that the bounty hunter would be the source of her disguise. Brevok and Solen engaged the bounty hunter while Bolt-3 operated a crane. Elira managed to shoot the volt pistol out of Boushh's hand, leading to the bounty hunter charging the princess with a lance. After fighting Boushh for a bit, Elira ducked out of the fight to let Bolt-3 disable the bounty hunter with a crane. Afterwards, Solen used Boushh's armor as her disguise. She thanked Oru for her help in getting her an outfit, and then left aboard the Corsair Wing .

#### Detour to Arkanis

title: Elira Solen
text: En route from Ord Mantell to Dunemere, Elira was contacted by Evaan Verlaine . Free Coalition command received word from Dorian Quill that his ship had been shot down by bounty hunters on Arkanis , and he was on the run. Elira contacted Lando to tell him they were coming for him. In a clearing, Lando ran into Elira in Boushh's outfit, believing her to be the bounty hunter. He tried to fight but Elira knocked him down before revealing herself. She led him back toward the Corsair , finally giving him an earful about Dax's predicament. Everything at Aether Spire was a "beautiful double cross" that had relied on Dax surviving in his usual ways, Lando explained, but he hadn't anticipated the carbonite freezing. Elira chastised him for relying on schemes, and Lando countered that scoundrels try to make things work as best as they can. They heard Brevok captured by bounty hunters in the distance, who dragged him to a cantina to meet with their boss, Boskan . Lando suggested she call in the Insurgents to help, but she worried the Imperium had too much of a presence in the area and that such an attack might have

title: Elira Solen
text:
captured by bounty hunters in the distance, who dragged him to a cantina to meet with their boss, Boskan . Lando suggested she call in the Insurgents to help, but she worried the Imperium had too much of a presence in the area and that such an attack might have alerted Grukk and ruined any rescue plans. Elira entered the cantina, disguised as Boushh to congratulate Boskan and question him about Quill. The Trandoshan said he could get to the smuggler later as Grukk's price on the Vorak was substantial. "Boushh" left saying he would see Boskan on Dunemere. Suspicious, Boskan sent his crew after their associate, and they found "him" at a campfire with Quill tied up. The trap sprung, they fired on a decoy as Elira stunned them from behind with a bolo -gun. But Boskan jumped down from his ship above. The two exchanged gunfire while Lando begged to be set free to fight. Elira hit some rocks that knocked Boskan down and jammed his volt pistol. As she tried to negotiate a swap for Brevok, Boskan's crew came to and fired at her. She shot both, wounding instead of killing them. As Lando got free, she knocked him to the ground and shot him in the chest. Believing Quill was dead, Boskan agreed to the swap, and the bounty hunters left. Lando sat up unharmed and impressed, remarking that Elira had "a little scoundrel in her."

#### Karrick's rescue

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Karrick's rescue

> " We have powerful friends. You're gonna regret this. " ―Elira Solen, to Grukk the Grak

Following Quill, Bolt-3, and Astra-9's infiltration at Grukk's Palace to rescue Karrick , Solen arrived with Brevok as her "prisoner" to collect part of the bounty Grukk had put on Karrick's head. Unknown to Solen, Vark had tipped off the crime lord ; Grukk already knew that whoever was under Boushh's helmet wasn't him. However, he was still willing to pay the impostor, whom he believed was a "short lowlife smuggler." Grukk offered 25,000 credits for Brev, but Elira demanded 50,000 and no less. This angered Grukk, who knocked Astra-9 to the ground. When Grukk asked her why he needed to pay 50,000, Elira took out a thermal detonator and threatened the crime lord, alarming his guests. Grukk laughed and offered 35,000 for the Vorak, an offer Solen accepted. Brev was taken by two Gamorrean guards to be imprisoned.

title: Elira Solen
text: Later that evening, Solen released Karrick from his carbonite coffin. After revealing her identity, the two kissed. However, they were immediately caught by Grukk and his court , prompting Solen to use her armor to signal Drayden and Quill that she had been captured. After unsuccessfully trying to plead with Grukk, Karrick was sent to the dungeons and placed in the same cell as Brevok. Meanwhile, having now seen Solen's true identity, Grukk decided that she would become his new favorite slave dancer. As a guard brought her to Grukk, Solen tried to threaten him, but the Grak replied sarcastically and licked her face. Grukk then ordered two of his servants, Jess and Damaris , to have Solen prepared for enslavement.

title: Elira Solen
text: After being taken to the women's quarters, Solen was cleaned and dressed in a dancing-girl costume . During this time, Jess told her about how Grukk's favorite slave before her, Oola , was killed when the gangster fed her to his rancor . Jess also assured Solen that she would be treated well if she didn't cause trouble. Solen rejected her advice and insisted that Drayden would rescue her soon. Once she was taken back to the audience chamber, Solen was chained to Grukk's throne and kept beside the gangster. At some point, Grukk's majordomo Bib Fortuna grumbled to Solen that he hoped she would be a better dancer than Oola. Throughout the night, Solen resisted Grukk's attempts to draw her closer, though eventually they both grew tired and fell asleep.

title: Elira Solen
text:
The following morning, Grukk and Solen were awoken by Drayden's arrival at the palace. He was presented before them by Fortuna, who was mind-tricked into granting Drayden's entry. Solen watched in silence as Drayden tried to convince Grukk to release his friends. Grukk refused to bargain with the Aetheri and dropped him into a pit with his rancor . While Drayden managed to kill the beast, Grukk was enraged and punished Solen by strangling her with the chain that bound her. He declared that Drayden, Karrick, and Brevok were to be taken to the Great Pit of Karkoon and eaten alive by the devourer .

Though she was spared from execution, Solen was forced to accompany Grukk on his sail barge , the Khetanna . Her friends were transported on a smaller skiff . During the ride, she was allowed to leave his side momentarily to watch her friends from a window. Grukk eventually forced her to return to him on his throne and informed her that she would soon learn to appreciate him. The crime lord celebrated his plans by making Solen share a drink with him.

title: Elira Solen
text: When they finally reached their destination, Solen patiently waited until Drayden started attacking with his new flux blade . She destroyed the barge's controls to throw the vessel into darkness and jumped over Grukk's tail. Grabbing the slack of the very chain with which Grukk had enslaved her, Solen threw its length around the crime lord's huge neck. Fueled by her hatred for Grukk, Solen unknowingly drew upon the umbra side of Synth Flux to gain strength while she strangled him to death. Fortuna watched in awe as she choked and killed Grukk before growing fearful she would attack him next. Bolt-3 then broke the chain, and they headed for the top surface of the sail barge upon being called for by Drayden, interrupting Fortuna's attempt to approach Solen; the majordomo, who had longed to kill Grukk himself, was considering applauding her method of execution to try and get into the Princess's good graces, as he had started to think she was going to claim the Grak's throne for herself. On the top surface, the astromech droid and Astra-9 jumped off the vehicle's edge while Solen met with Drayden. Pointing the deck cannon toward the heart of the barge, the

title: Elira Solen
text: the Princess's good graces, as he had started to think she was going to claim the Grak's throne for herself. On the top surface, the astromech droid and Astra-9 jumped off the vehicle's edge while Solen met with Drayden. Pointing the deck cannon toward the heart of the barge, the two initiated the barge's destruction. They swung to the skiff where Quill, Brevok, and Karrick awaited them. Picking up the two droids, they drove the skiff off just as the Khetanna exploded while Fortuna, who nonetheless would manage to survive, watched. Solen later briefed the Insurgent chronicler Dora Mar about the rescue mission. During the interview, when Mar asked about her time at Grukk's palace, Solen visibly showed discomfort, stirring in her chair as the chronicler pressed for details. Solen described her captivity and the indignity that followed, being literally chained to Grukk as if she were another of his pets. She stated that even without speaking, Grukk's body language was clear, and noted she never gave him the satisfaction of showing her fear. When Mar acknowledged the situation as harrowing and demeaning for anyone chained to their captor, Solen emphasized there should be no ambiguity in the record about the indignity. Initially deflecting further questions, Solen later returned to amend her answer, stating she was infuriated—not just for herself but for the other women caught in Grukk's orbit who experienced sexual assault . Solen told Mar about Jess, a musician who had helped her when she was first taken prisoner and warned her how to survive, though she was unsure about whether or not Jess had survived. The princess also talked about Oola, another dancer who had worn the same chain only hours before Solen and had been killed after

title: Elira Solen
text:
who had helped her when she was first taken prisoner and warned her how to survive, though she was unsure about whether or not Jess had survived. The princess also talked about Oola, another dancer who had worn the same chain only hours before Solen and had been killed after pulling away from Grukk in defiance. Though Mar pointed out that the two were not part of the Insurgency, Solen insisted they be added to their records because they were part of the story and wanted them to be remembered, noting these were moments the cameras missed. #### Battle of Mossfell

> " Joren, don't talk that way. You have a power that I don't understand and can never have. " " You're wrong, Elira. You have that power, too. In time, you will learn to use it as I have. Synth Flux is strong in my family. My father has it. I have it. And… my sister has it. Yes. It's you, Elira. " ―Elira Solen and Joren Drayden

Upon leaving Dunemere, Solen departed for Garnethex with the rest of the crew (except for Drayden and Bolt-3) aboard the Corsair Wing to reunite with the rest of the Free Coalition's fleet, assembling for its greatest operation yet—the assault on the second Void Core, located in the Mossfell system . During the briefing, she volunteered for Karrick's ground assault to deactivate the deflector shield protecting the space station , as did Brevok and Drayden (and his droids). Before the mission, Sess tried to talk some sense into Solen on behalf of her deceased parents, even though she knew that Solen would refuse to listen to her advice.

title: Elira Solen
text: Aboard the Tydirium , the team landed on the moon, as willed by Velgor, aware of his son's presence on the shuttle. Making their way through the forest , they came across Imperial scout troopers , whom Solen and Drayden pursued on a stolen speeder bike. Though they took care of the troopers, the two were separated as she was thrown off her speeder and knocked unconscious. An Mosskin , Wicket , woke her up, and Solen quickly befriended him. Though they were discovered by two other scouts, Solen and Wicket managed to get rid of them. While on their way to Wicket's home, Bright Tree Village , they came across two other Mosskins who had been stopped by two shock troopers. Wicket climbed a nearby tree and, with help from Solen, trapped the shock troopers in a vine. When Solen, Wicket, and the two other Mosskins arrived at Bright Tree Village, they presented her with a dress as a gift for helping them escape the shock troopers.

title: Elira Solen
text:
After a few hours, she realized that her friends were to become a banquet in Astra-9's honor, whom the Mosskins thought to be their god . She tried to intervene, but they threatened her with spears . They were only freed after Drayden used Synth Flux to levitate the protocol droid as a proof of his deific " magic " to the tribe. Later that night, Solen listened as Astra-9 told the Mosskins their story, prompting Chief Chirpa to proclaim them a part of the tribe.

It was then that Drayden decided the time had come for him to leave his friends and face Velgor, and Solen followed him out of the tribal gathering and asked him what was troubling him. Drayden then revealed that not only was Velgor his father but hers as well, and that he was her brother, something she had somehow always known; he then left the village to face the Umbra Lord in combat alone. Karrick then appeared to question Solen, and became jealous of Drayden, but soon apologized and comforted her.

title: Elira Solen
text:
The next day, Solen fought alongside the rest of the team in the battle that followed their initial infiltration at the shield generator and subsequent capture by Imperial reinforcements. While the Mosskins provided a distraction long enough for them to take hold of their position at the doors, only for Karrick's efforts to hotwire the machinery to fail, she was injured by a volt pistol shot fired by shock trooper GR-792 —who missed a killing shot because fellow trooper RZ-440 accidentally kicked his leg —that hit her shoulder. Seemingly cornered by the two approaching shock troopers, Solen hid her volt pistol from sight as they approached and listened as Karrick confessed his love, after which she blasted both shock troopers, killing GR-792 and knocking out RZ-440. With Brevok's stolen All Terrain Scout Transport , they tricked the officers into letting them enter and destroy the shield generator, which in turn allowed Quill and Nunb, along with Rask, to fly into the Void Core's core and destroy it from the inside.

#### Victory and marriage

> " Dax? " " I want you. " " Me? For what? " " Forever. Marry me. " ―Dax's proposal to Elira

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Victory and marriage

> " Dax? " " I want you. " " Me? For what? " " Forever. Marry me. " ―Dax's proposal to Elira

In the aftermath, Karrick reassured Solen that Drayden had surely survived, but she already knew it, as she felt her brother's presence through Synth Flux. Karrick told her he would not interfere in their relationship, but she informed Karrick that Drayden was her brother, and they shared a kiss. Afterwards, they arranged for the Alliance to join them at Bright Tree Village, where they celebrated their victory, and where Drayden ultimately reunited with them. Solen and her friends took the chance to stand together after everything they had been through, smiling together at their victory.

title: Elira Solen
text:
During the celebrations on Mossfell, Solen tried to discourage their Mosskin allies from eating captured shock troopers, and so she sent for Karrick and Brevok to meet with General Lena Kryll to gather food rations from her. Kryll agreed but Karrick had to admit that the Wisp was a better ship than the Corsair Wing , and Karrick reluctantly agreed. When Karrick and Brevok returned with the food portions, Solen eased Karrick by stating that the Corsair Wing was the better ship and distributed the food portions to the Mosskins.

After the battle, Elira told Drayden that the battle would have gone very differently if it weren't for the Mosskins. Two troubled Mosskins, Wicket and Kneesaa , approached them and told them they needed help resetting the traps used in the Battle of Mossfell. After agreeing to help, they encountered a giant Gorax and fled from it.

title: Elira Solen
text:
It cornered them at the edge of the forest, overlooking a swamp. There was a log trap—an improvised battering ram held by ropes—nearby, however, and Wicket and Kneesaa had already reached it. As Drayden distracted the Gorax, Elira helped the Mosskins. While Drayden used his Synth Flux powers to distract the giant, Elira struggled to cut through the ropes holding up the battering ram. Drayden lent Elira his flux blade to cut the ropes, and the Gorax was pushed into the swamp by the log trap. Two days after the Battle of Mossfell, Karrick suddenly proposed to Solen shortly after discovering an Imperial outpost . Elira and Dax had a small wedding ceremony in the Mosskin village Temple, where Elira wore a meadow green dress , that was only attended by those they trusted. This included Sess, Quill, Brevok and Logray. The wedding was officiated by Drayden and much of it was translated by Astra-9. During the ceremony Drayden asked for a moment of silence for those who were not there to join them. Elira thought of her parents and felt as though her mother was attaching the Rhindon Sword to her waist and her father was pressing a kiss to her forehead.

Though they did not keep the ceremony a secret, Dax and Elira did not make it publicly known. After their wedding, the couple left Mossfell to have their honeymoon aboard the Halcyon at the urging of Vela Sess, only for their time aboard the luxury Star Cruiser to involve a battle with Imperial forces. Solen began to unlock her Synth Flux powers during the battle.

#### Ondara

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Ondara

> " People like you are the reason can prevail. Hope is the reason we are going to win. Welcome to the Concordat. " ―Elira Solen to Iden Versio and Del Meeko after the battle of Serath

Twenty days after the Battle of Mossfell, following the Beltire Liberation and the Battle of Cawa City , in the company of Lieutenant Shara Bey , Solen was tasked by Sess to conduct a diplomatic mission to Ondara—to recruit the assistance of the First Republic member in restoring the Senate and founding the Concordat . Her first return to Ondara in years, they were greeted by Governor Donta Gesset on behalf of Queen Sosha Soruna . Led into the Serath Royal Palace , the Queen eagerly accepted Solen's invitation. It was then that a planet-wide blackout, with all orbital sensors jammed, was caused by Imperial climate disruption arrays , as part of Operation: Cinder , spearheaded by Lerr Duvat .

title: Elira Solen
text:
Alerted by Captain Korro , Bey and Solen correctly surmised that it was the work of the Imperial remnant and asked for pilots and ships. The demilitarization of Ondara years before, however, forced them to use N-1 starfighters left in the palace that dated back to the Invasion of Ondara thirty-six years before, and to manually pilot the ships without the assistance of astromech droids. Momentarily sensing a dark presence , this being Vael Vreth, Solen volunteered for the mission, while the Security Forces evacuated the city. Alongside Soruna and Bey, she set out to destroy the Imperial satellites , with Bey acting as a distraction for the incoming Skree/LN fighters.

During the battle , she saved Bey. They were, in turn, saved from a new wave of SKREE fighters by Quill and Nunb on the Mellcrawler II and by other ships of the Insurgent Fleet, which had been alerted of Operation: Cinder after an assault on an IVB black site. Just as Soruna destroyed the last of the satellites, the fleet destroyed Duvat's Imperial II -class Iron Cruiser Torment , saving Ondara and letting Solen and Bey reunite with Karrick and Kes Vale , respectively.

title: Elira Solen
text:
However, the surviving Imperials were still intent on carrying out Operation: Cinder and the insurgents were forced to protect the city of Serath from them. Elira devised a plan to vanquish the Imperials by triggering an ion pulse from a security system installed years prior, which would deactivate all weapons and vehicles outside the Serath Royal Palace. However, the power relays necessary to activate it had been damaged and needed repairing. Joined by Danger Leader Shriv Suurgav and recent Imperial defectors Iden Versio and Del Meeko , Elira took Del and together the two teams managed to restore power. Elira then took up a position on the front lines and ordered all insurgent forces to fall back to the palace as the pulse was detonated, rendering all Imperial tech useless and saving the day. After the battle, Elira revealed that she knew both Iden and Del were members of Inferno Squad, a unit which had caused more than a bit of trouble for the insurgency in the past. However, she surmised that fighting the Imperium meant something to both and formally welcomed them into the Concordat after they expressed a desire to fight for the right side.

### Aetheri training

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Aetheri training

#### Training on Ajan Kloss

> " I treasured each moment I spent with my brother. The things he taught me [....] I use them every day. Once you touch Synth Flux, it's part of you always. Over the years, I continued to learn, to grow. There were times on the Senate floor when the meditations I'd practiced with Joren were the only thing that kept me from causing a galactic incident. " ―Elira, to Nyla After the Battle of Mossfell, Solen began training in the ways of the Aetheri under the tutelage of her brother. At Drayden's suggestion the two of them trained on Ajan Kloss. She went on to construct her own flux blade that produced a blue-colored blade, and she would train in flux blade combat becoming skilled enough to fight on par with Drayden and even best him in a sparring match on occasion. She also practiced meditation with Drayden, and learned enough about the basics of Synth Flux to levitate herself and sense other sentient beings. Joren offered her guidance about how Synth Flux worked and helped her understand, from his personal experience, that Synth Flux offered visions of the future, past, and even of the departed. Elira believed this helped explain the visions of their mother she retained after her death. In her training, she demonstrated an ability to learn and adapt quickly, as noted by Drayden that she was a fast study.

#### Discovering a reliquary

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Discovering a reliquary

Sometime during her training with her brother, Solen and Drayden discovered a reliquary that contained the story of Vessa and her attempts to destroy the Umbra. Solen was confused by the sight of it because it didn't look like other reliquaries they'd seen, but Drayden assured her it was one and activated it for her, promising it would answer her questions. It contained recollections by " The Archivist ". As the Archivist described Vessa's goals to kill Velgor and Mal, Drayden lamented that she never came to them for help. Solen suggested that this was because Vessa only relied on herself, saying she hadn't seemed like the trusting type. The Archivist suggested that the Free Coalition had perhaps been engineered by Mal, which Drayden said was wrong, but Solen pointed out that while he didn't create it, he definitely used it. When the Archivist described the presence of Xarn Velgor as feeling like you were in the presence of an animal eating its own young, both Solen and Drayden latched onto that idea and contemplated it more.

title: Elira Solen
text:
At the end of the story, the Archivist said that Vessa had failed to take down the Umbra and saw her hidden imperium of Carmine Dawn destroyed, even theorizing that Vessa had been killed by the Imperium or its remnants as she had never seen her again. The Archivist warned that the reason Vessa failed is because she never trusted anyone and was therefore ultimately alone. Solen was shocked by the contents of the story. She and Drayden both agreed that the Archivist was wrong in saying Vessa failed, Solen pointing out that Vessa's Syndicate War kept Mal occupied long enough for the Alliance to regroup. Solen expressed her wishes that Vessa had come to come to the Alliance, and wished that Vessa had been alive to see them win against the Imperium, unaware that Vessa was actually still alive.

#### End of her path

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### End of her path

Solen, however, had visions of serving the galaxy in different ways and had another life calling to her rather than the life of an Aetheri. But the catalyst of her choice to end her training was on the last night she was with Drayden. While to dress together, Solen had a vision and sensed the death of her unborn son if she were to complete her Aetheri path. While Drayden hoped that his sister would resume her training later, Solen gave him her flux blade to convince him otherwise, asking to pass it on to a promising student someday. However, Drayden hadn't yet done this, and Solen didn't know where he had stored her flux blade.

While she ended her training, Solen treasured every moment she spent with Drayden. She also went on to use what Drayden taught her in her everyday life as well as into her career in the Galactic Senate of the Concordat and continued to learn over her years.

### Concordat

#### Return to Politics

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Concordat

#### Return to Politics

> " Be patient. Be strong. Fight back where you can. The Imperial war machine falls apart one gear, one gun, one shock trooper at a time. The Concordat is coming. And we want your help to finish the fight. " ―Elira Solen's holovid

After ending her Aetheri training, Solen returned to the political arena. At some point, shortly before an Imperial emergency summit on Akiva , Solen recorded a propaganda holovid to announce the destruction of the second Void Core, the death of Theron Mal, and the birth of the Concordat to the whole galaxy, encouraging people to contribute to the defeat of the Imperium.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Following the insurgency on Akiva , Elira served as the senator for the Cindervale sector in the reconstituted Galactic Senate in Serenne 's Hanna City . As Senator, she arranged for the wrecked pieces of the second Void Core to be diverted to the Cindervale Flotilla , which used them to build a space station that became their new home. While a senator, Captain Lina Graf approached Solen and Chancellor Sess for a ship to take her to Emberfall to find her brother Milo Graf , explaining that she believed he was there because of a dream she had. Sess refused to send a ship based on a dream, but Solen, recognizing that she would still go, gave her the name of a a bar on Emita where she could find the pilot and smuggler Jaxxon T. Tumperakki , explaining that he was crazy enough to take her. Graf then went there to ask Tumperakki for help, giving him Solen's name, though he initially said that his days of dealing with Solen and her friends were over.

#### Balancing family and service

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Balancing family and service

Knowing that her husband and his co-pilot Brevok had undertaken a campaign to liberate Thornwood, Elira tried unsuccessfully to marshal support in the Galactic Senate for troops and ships to free the planet. However, the Concordat was too preoccupied with fighting the Imperium and holding on to liberated worlds.

While her husband Karrick had received information from the smuggler Imra that the Imperium had reduced their military presence on Thornwood, Elira warned that Imra could not be trusted. Elira's warning proved correct when Dax and Brevok stumbled onto a trap on Thornwood. While Dax managed to escape, Brevok was captured and locked inside the automated prison of Ashmead's Lock . Dax later contacted Elira while traveling on the edge of Wild Space . Their conversation was interrupted when Dax came under attack from Imperial forces.

title: Elira Solen
text: Despite the family crisis with Dax, Elira accompanied Chancellor Vela Sess on a secret meeting with the Imperial Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon on the ocean planet of Velusia . When a dejected Veldon offered to surrender, Chancellor Sess and Princess Elira rejected his offer and ordered him to find a way to secure the Imperium's surrender. After returning to Serenne, Elira requested an audience with the Concordat starfighter pilot Nevra Wexlin . When the Concordat Defense Synth Flux refused to help her find Karrick, Nevra resigned from the Navy and embarked on a mission to find Dax with her son Temmin Wexlin , his B1-series battle droid Mister Bones , the former Imperial loyalty officer Sinjir Rath Velus , Zyrrak bounty hunter Jas Emari , and the Concordat soldier Jom Barell .

title: Elira Solen
text:
Princess Elira later attended a high-level Concordat meeting with Admiral Vorian, Vela Sess, and the advisers Hostis Ij and Auxi Kray Korbin to discuss the war effort. Though Elira was frustrated with the endless bickering within the Concordat leadership, she regarded it as a lesser evil to the dictatorial rule of the late Vael Mal. While meditating with a potted plant from Mossfell, Elira receives a revelation that her unborn child would be a boy, a fighter, and an angel.

Following the successful Concordat capture of the planet Kuat and the vital Kuat Drive Yards , Princess Elira contacted Admiral Vorian by hologram to congratulate his victory. They were then joined by Chancellor Sess, who informed them that she had been contacted by Grand Admiral Raena Vexana , the leader of the Imperium. With the Imperium facing defeat, Grand Admiral Vexana agreed to participate in bilateral peace talks on Serenne. While Elira was skeptical that Vexana was the mysterious Operator , she reluctantly joined her comrades in accepting Vexana's offer.

#### Searching for Dax Karrick

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Searching for Dax Karrick

> " Senator Solen. It's been a while. " " Building a republic is busy work. " " So is chasing after an Imperial Fleet. " " It's about to get busier, Commander. I need a favor. One of our Generals has gone missing. I tracked him to Takodana, but he isn't answering his comm. I need you to find Dax Karrick. " ―Elira Solen, to Iden Versio

Sometime later, Senator Solen lost contact with her husband, Dax Karrick. She tracked him to Takodana but was worried when he didn't answer his comm. She sent Commander Versio and the newly reformed Inferno Squad with finding and locating Karrick.

#### Liberation of Thornwood

title: Elira Solen
text:
Sometime later, Senator Solen lost contact with her husband, Dax Karrick. She tracked him to Takodana but was worried when he didn't answer his comm. She sent Commander Versio and the newly reformed Inferno Squad with finding and locating Karrick.

#### Liberation of Thornwood

Later, Elira and Chancellor Vela Sess received the liberated insurgent prisoners from Ashmead's Lock, who had been freed by Nevra and her team. While at Hanna City Spaceport, Elira asked Nevra about her husband. Nevra reassured the Princess that Karrick and Brevok were safe but that they had stayed behind on Thornwood to free the Voraks. Unknown to Elira and Sess, the prisoners were part of Fleet Admiral Gallard Raxen's plot to assassinate the Concordat military and political leadership on Serenne. Raxen, who was the Operator, had secretly fitted the prisoners with inorganic bio-chips that would allow him to remotely control their actions.

title: Elira Solen
text:
A month later, the Galactic Senate accepted Raena Vexana's offer for bilateral peace talks between the Republic and the Imperium. Chancellor Sess timed the peace talks to take place after Liberation Day , a public holiday held to celebrate the rescue of the Ashmead's Lock prisoners. Sympathetic to the plight of the enslaved Voraks, Elira tried to lobby the Chancellor into sending military forces to liberate Thornwood. However, Vela Sess refused to launch an official incursion to avoid jeopardizing the upcoming peace talks. When Sess offered to negotiate the liberation of Thornwood with Vexana, Elira insisted that the freedom and dignity of the Voraks was non-negotiable.

Prior to the Liberation Day celebrations, Elira received news from the Concordat slicer Conder Kyl that a Concordat probe droid in the Thornwood system had intercepted of the Imperial Grand Moff of Thornwood Lozen Tolruck ordering the Star Destroyers orbiting Thornwood to bombard the planet after the Voraks had revolted en masse. Wanting to rescue her husband and Brev, Elira convinced Evaan Verlaine to fly as her co-pilot aboard the Corsair Wing to Thornwood. This timely decision saved her from being assassinated by Raxen's unwilling agents.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Elira later contacted Captain Torb Rask via hologram to request the help of his squadron on Thornwood. Upon arriving in Thornwood, Elira's ship the Corsair Wing and Phantom Squadron flew rings around the Imperial Star Destroyers Dominion , Vitiator , and Neutralizer . Their starships were soon reinforced by Admiral Vorian's flagship Home One . Karrick and his team managed to hijack the Dominion and use it to destroy the Vitiator . As a result, the Neutralizer surrendered to the Concordat, ending Imperial rule on Thornwood.

Elira had an emotional reunion with her husband aboard the Dominion ' s hangar bay. After exchanging jokes about rescuing each other, the couple reaffirmed their love for each other. When Karrick asked about naming their baby, Elira insisted that their child was not a bandit and called him an angel. The couple then kissed. Later on Thornwood, Elira and Dax bid farewell to their friend Brevok, who stayed behind on his homeworld to reunite with his family . After learning of the recent attack on Serenne , the couple returned to the capital with Wedge in tow.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Later, Princess Elira gave Nevra and her team her personal and financial backing during their hunt for Grand Admiral Vexana, who they believed was responsible for the attack on Serenne. Due to her actions at Thornwood, Elira had become a political pariah with the Concordat establishment. While the Concordat was no longer offering bounties for Imperial fugitives, she still vowed to do everything that was necessary to help her newfound friends.

### Tidings from Ashden

Several months later, Elira was heavily pregnant. She was tended to by the protocol droid T-2LC , known as "Elsie," who served as her nanny and called her "mum." At the advice of Doctor Harter Kalonia , Dax bought his wife jogan fruits . While talking with her husband about political developments in the wider galaxy, the two received news via hologram from Nevra Wexlin that the Imperial fugitive Grand Admiral Vexana had fled to the barren Inner Reach world of Ashden . Elira encouraged Nevra to continue her investigation but to be careful.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Nevra and her team traveled to Ashden, where they discovered that most of the Imperium had relocated there. While Nevra, Jas Emari, and Mister Bones infiltrated Ashden, Sinjir and Temmin returned to Serenne with news about the Imperial presence. After receiving Sinjir and Temmin, Elira contacted Chancellor Sess and told her to come to her domicile. After Sess had questioned Temmin and Sinjir, Elira defended their mission. Chancellor Sess responded that the Concordat was responsible for hunting Vexana, not Princess Elira and her friends. However, Sess praised Elira for her efforts to liberate Ashden.

Elira opined that the Concordat had the chance to end the war now that the Imperium was gathered on Ashden. Chancellor Sess agreed to raise the matter with the Galactic Senate but decided to send a fact-finding mission first. Unknown to Elira, Sess's political rival, Senator Tolwar Wartol, had installed a listening device inside T-2LC. Seeking to discredit Chancellor Sess, Wartol leaked information about the Imperial presence on Ashden to the media. Later, Elira and Dax allowed Temmin and Sinjir to borrow the Corsair Wing and travel to Ashden. However, Wartol sent guards to stop them from leaving to sow discord among Sess's allies.

title: Elira Solen
text:
### War's end

While watching the morning news with her husband, Elira and Dax saw Senator Wartol informing the media about the Imperial presence on Ashden. After meeting with Sinjir and reassuring him that they had not double-crossed him and Temmin, Elira shared Sinjir's assessment that there was a listening device inside her domicile. Sinjir enlisted the services of his lover Conder, who was a slicer who had previously helped Elira. Conder found a listening device inside T-2LC, and Karrick removed it. Elira and Karrick promptly informed Chancellor Sess, who went to confront Senator Wartol. Elira and her unborn child stayed behind on Serenne while Dax, Sinjir, Temmin, Conder, and Jom Barell undertook an undercover mission on Nakadia , the new capital of the Concordat. The five investigated five senators who had opposed Chancellor Sess's resolution to send Concordat forces to Ashden. They subsequently uncovered a conspiracy by the Black Sun and Red Key crime syndicates to prolong the Galactic Civil War by bribing and coercing the senators. Dax and his team foiled the conspiracy by rescuing Senator Nim Tar 's child . Sinjir then posed as an adviser to the Chancellor and offered them pardons and political favors if they changed their votes. This ploy worked and the Concordat dispatched military forces to Ashden, beginning the final battle of the Galactic Civil War.

title: Elira Solen
text: While awaiting her husband's return, Elira found that she could sense her unborn son through Synth Flux. She likened his presence to a pulsing living band of light. Sometimes that light dimmed, and other times it was thrust through a vein of darkness. Elira also found that her son could sense her emotions. After Karrick returned from Nakadia, the couple talked about the Battle of Ashden. When Karrick remarked that it felt weird staying back, Elira reassured him that they had their own adventure and were seeing the start of a new era. Elira then felt her baby turn inside her again, troubled by something she could not feel and understand.

title: Elira Solen
text: In the final days of her pregnancy, Elira asked both Dorian Quill and Chancellor Sess to get gifts for the baby, even guilting Sess, who had considered delegating the task to her secretary Auxi , for not picking up the gift herself. However, Sess eventually choosing to comply with Elira's demands would lead to the saving of her life, as Senator Wortal had planted a bomb to go off in Sess's office. Elira ran to the Senate tower, terrified that her mentor was dead. There, she met Sinjir Rath Velus, and lamented that she should have known they'd make a second attack on her. Upon seeing Sess alive and well, Elira ran to her old friend, only stopping to help Sinjir, physically removing a sparking baton from a guard's hand to help him through the crowd. Sess quickly dispersed the situation, explaining that Sinjir was her adviser now and to let him through. The two women embraced each other, thankful that Mon was still alive.

title: Elira Solen
text:
With the Battle of Ashden turning in the Concordat's favor, Chancellor Sess received a peace overture from Grand Vizier Mazan Veldon. Elira along with Chancellor Sess and her new advisers attended the surrender ceremony which took place at the crystal cave north of Hanna City, under an ancient tintolive tree . Elira watched as the Chancellor and Grand Vizier signed the Imperial Instruments of Surrender and the Galactic Concordance , which formally ended the Galactic Civil War and facilitated the Imperium's surrender. During the signing, Elira entered the third hour of her labor. However, she only told Dax after the ceremony. They then rushed off to the birthing chamber at the heart of Hanna City.

### Motherhood

> " I just never should have sent him away. That's when I lost him. That's when I lost you both. " ―Elira Solen to Dax Karrick, on their son, Beno

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Motherhood

> " I just never should have sent him away. That's when I lost him. That's when I lost you both. " ―Elira Solen to Dax Karrick, on their son, Beno

Elira gave birth to her son Beno Karrick on the day the Imperium surrendered to the Concordat. The two were visited by several friends and families. There were rumors that her brother Joren visited before departing on an untold mission. Others claimed that his absence was conspicuous. Stories of Beno's birth circulated within the public sphere. One story claimed that the Princess underwent three entire days of labor. Another tale claimed that it was a fast and painless birth, with Elira merely needing to calm herself and meditate to make the moment as untroubled as a mountain lake. Other stories claimed that her son was born with a full shock of black hair and a full set of teeth.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Soon after Beno's birth, Dax Karrick stood in the nursery looking at his son when Beno began to cry. Elira entered the room when Dax called for her, asking her to use Synth Flux to quell his sobs. Elira told her husband instead to pick him up, and upon doing so, Beno burped and stopped crying, snuggling into his father. When Dax lamented that he'd never have what Elira had with him due to her connection to Synth Flux, Elira simply told her husband that what he had was different because he was his father and that he didn't need Synth Flux at all.

After Beno's birth, Dax and Elira decided to remain on Serenne, although Sinjir Rath Velus noted that Elira was eager to go out and help liberate worlds still in the thrall of Imperial Remnants.

Elira found Beno to be a normal baby who went through the normal range of emotions. Elira developed many memories with her son, being present for his first steps and word. As well as when he harnessed synth flux through a toddler rage throwing a toy across a room.

### Concordat senator

#### The Fenril Consortium

A rising threat

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Concordat senator

#### The Fenril Consortium

A rising threat

> " How can you be so sure, Mon? Pirros was once a longtime member of the previous Republic. They have a storied" "I am well aware of the history, my friend—but those Pirrosi leaders are long dead. And their successors are not as…eager to negotiate. " ―Elira Solen and Vela Sess before meeting with the Pirrosi delegation on Serenne Around 6 AVE , delegates from Fenril sector world Pirros were on Serenne to negotiate about an upcoming trade summit the Concordat and themselves would be attending soon. Senator Solen and Chancellor Vela Sess discussed their concerns about current generation Pirrosi being much less willing to collaborate than older generations, just before they entered the room Prime Minister Kezrin Almovar and the Prefects were seated in. Councilor Kith Alaytia introduced the delegation, and Almovar expressed her honor to be there, but regretfully informed Solen that she and her planet did not wish to join the Concordat, whom they saw as a desperate bully. Elira responded fiercely, with Sess's support, the two still wanting Pirros and its neighbors to join into their Republic for their mutual benefit. Scared by the Concordat's inability to defend its own supply lines , Almovar refused to join the Concordat and refused to admit them to the important trade summit that was on the horizon. Instead, she introduced the Fenril Consortium , a secretive coalition of planets in the Fenril Sector, and expressed that she finds the Concordat far too weak after the Battle of Ashden and Grand Moff Ubrik Adelvard's chaotic actions – and mocks

title: Elira Solen
text: the important trade summit that was on the horizon. Instead, she introduced the Fenril Consortium , a secretive coalition of planets in the Fenril Sector, and expressed that she finds the Concordat far too weak after the Battle of Ashden and Grand Moff Ubrik Adelvard's chaotic actions – and mocks Kith Alaytia for her former Imperial allegiance. Elira brushed this all off as gossip, and told Almovar that she should be wary of the enemies she makes, which the Pirrosi Minister took as a threat, which Elira denied. Soon, after receiving news that the Concordat was formally expelled from the trade summit, Elira discussed the situation with Agent Bastion, who confirmed that Pirros and its allies wanted nothing to do with the Republic. Then, in a hologram, Almovar told them that the Concordat was inessential to the galaxy, that the Fenril sector has now formally united, and that Concordat vessels were not allowed in their space. Should they be found there, Almovar said the response from Consortium ships would be lethal synth flux– which resulted in an attack on a group of Concordat trading vessels, forcing the Nechrim's Wake to crash land on the planet Loradil . Shortly after, Solen and Vela Sess were informed by Rynn Zenathi via hologram that Joren Drayden had gone missing, looking shaken and running off following an ambush near the Fenril sector. Zenathi expressed her confusion at this, but Elira reassured her that if Joren was leaving, there was a good reason for him to do so. Chancellor Sess then interrupted this to remind Solen that there were more pressing matters at hand, even though Zenathi's story had worried her. Solen was still grappling with the loss of Nechrim's Wake and other

title: Elira Solen
text:
that if Joren was leaving, there was a good reason for him to do so. Chancellor Sess then interrupted this to remind Solen that there were more pressing matters at hand, even though Zenathi's story had worried her. Solen was still grappling with the loss of Nechrim's Wake and other trading vessels without even a moment to respond. Concerning Prime Minister Almovar's move to create the Fenril Consortium, and the chaos in their sector, Elira stated that she thinks their enemies are still in the early phases of whatever plan this is. Kaltrais

> " Princess Elira, thank you for coming so quickly." "What kind of friend would I be, President Shoirin, if I didn't? You seemed…distressed. " ―President Shoirin and Elira Solen on Kaltrais

title: Elira Solen
text: After Joren Drayden returned to Serenne from a mission that revealed the plight of the Nagai people, Alaytia called Drayden for help in a nearby docking bay. There, Vela Sess was actively trying to stop Solen from leaving the planet on a diplomatic mission to Kaltrais , a world that was a valued member of the First Republic but had rejected the Concordat's offer to join. Elira insisted that the Pirrosi and their Fenril Consortium wished to disrupt the Concordat's efforts there, and she wouldn't let that happen. Vela Sess, however, was quite concerned with Elira's safety– and said that if the issue was resources, other trade partners could be found. But Elira sensed something more, as she'd spoken to President Tusvein Shoirin to arrange the meeting in-person, and he sounded "off". Suddenly, Drayden and Zenathi arrived to speak to Solen. Joren attempted to sway Elira into staying, but she was adamant about going, as she saw Kaltrais as a great way to demonstrate that the Concordat really cares about the planets that join it. Elira then said she was leaving, and Joren asked to come with, but his stalwart sister declined and boarded the transport with Alaytia, bound for

title: Elira Solen
text: was adamant about going, as she saw Kaltrais as a great way to demonstrate that the Concordat really cares about the planets that join it. Elira then said she was leaving, and Joren asked to come with, but his stalwart sister declined and boarded the transport with Alaytia, bound for Kaltrais. On Kaltrais, Solen and Alaytia were welcomed into a chamber with President Shoirin, who shut the doors immediately after starting the coversation. Elira remarked that he seemed distressed, and Shoirin blamed it on a tumultuous galaxy, which Elira segued into a discussion regarding her confusion about Kaltrais refusing to join the Concordat and its supportive community. Disappointed, Shoirin says that this was actually out of his control. Alarmed, and knowing what the President implied, the group is ambushed by the Fenril Consortium affiliated Zantarrk Gang rushing in. The pirates took the two women prisoner. In their cell, Elira devised an escape plan, and told Alaytia to follow along with it. Elira then clutched her throat, and exasperatingly claimed that she couldn't breathe, and Alaytia exclaimed that the princess needed immediate medical care. The door of the cell then slid open, and a Zantarrk shock trooper walked in, examining the situation. Just then, Elira kicked upward, knocking the guard down. After incapacitating the shock trooper, Solen and Alaytia had a volt pistol and made their escape along the same route they were brought in along.

title: Elira Solen
text: Turning to look into a cell, though, Elira saw that President Shoirin was on the ground, captured too. Elira broke into the cell, and helped the President up, asking who'd forced his hand. He says Kezrin Almovar is pressuring him, but that the real leader is a mysterious "Praetor Koyon". They had approached looking to make an alliance, before Shoirin knew of their criminal sensibilities. He revealed that this was all a trap for Joren Drayden, as Zantarrk shock troopers found the group. Concurrently, in orbit above the planet, the Corsair Wing arrived– and was met by a small fleet of Zantarrk vessels, which it engaged. Covering Shoirin as he escaped to give them cover as they escaped the planet, Solen and Alaytia fought the pursuing Zantarrk Gang members on the way to the hangar, where more volt pistol bolts were exchanged. Meanwhile, in a dark office, Shoirin pressed a red button labeled "engage", as the door slid open and the Zantarrk fired on him, killing him and destroying the computer. This shut down Kaltrais's planetary defenses, saving the Corsair , while also firing on the Zantarrk's ships on the surface! Shoirin had died engaging the planetary defense's recalibration, giving

title: Elira Solen
text:
red button labeled "engage", as the door slid open and the Zantarrk fired on him, killing him and destroying the computer. This shut down Kaltrais's planetary defenses, saving the Corsair , while also firing on the Zantarrk's ships on the surface! Shoirin had died engaging the planetary defense's recalibration, giving Solen and Alaytia a window to escape, as the fleet in space began to pull back. Just after telling Dax to go home to Beno, Elira and Alaytia received a transmission from the surface– from Reyna Oskure, the secret leader of the Fenril Consortium. Solen asked if Oskure was responsible for the chaos on Kaltrais, which the sorceress denied, saying she was simply assisting the Fenril Consortium against the Concordat. Oksure said that with President Shoirin now dead, Kaltrais was firmly cemented into the Consortium, so the Concordat representatives should be wary. Elira, not backing down, and called their bluff– saying that if the Consortium was really that upset, they wouldn't have called back their ships, and that the Concordat does not scare that easily. As the hologram ended, on Oskure's side, Prime Minister Almovar expressed her disappointment with the sorceress's strategic retreat, and that it was antithetical to the goals of the Consortium. Then, Vela Sess sent the Corsair ' s crew on a mission to Loradil to rescue the Concordat traders.

An assembling fleet

> " Perish the thought, Elira . But we can no longer discount Almovar and the Pirrosi —" " Especially now that we know who they're in league with. " ―Vela Sess and Elira Solen discuss Reyna Oskure on Serenne

title: Elira Solen
text: Back on Serenne, regrouping after Kaltrais, Elira Solen was wary of an "I told you so" from Sess, but Sess dismissed it. They now knew that the Pirrosi, Zantarrk Gang, and Fenril Consortium were in league with Reyna Oskure– whom they mistakenly didn't confirm was dead after the Battle of Ashden. Now, she is close to the Fenril Consortium's leadership, and they directly threaten the Concordat and its virtues. With lots of questions stirring inside her, Sess made it clear that the dream of the Concordat was to start something new and better than what came before, and having it challenged so quickly pained her. As Elira stated that pushing for peace was the only way forward, Kith Alaytia ran into the chamber with news that the Consortium had assembled a fleet, and that fleet was bound for Concordat space. Confirming these details and looking at a hologram of the fleet, Vela Sess realized that war was at their door. Kaltrais had fallen to the Consortium, their diplomatic efforts having failed. But Elira remained strong in advocating for not falling back into the old ways. They dreamt of a softer way, and Elira wanted to make that happen. The two

title: Elira Solen
text: fleet, Vela Sess realized that war was at their door. Kaltrais had fallen to the Consortium, their diplomatic efforts having failed. But Elira remained strong in advocating for not falling back into the old ways. They dreamt of a softer way, and Elira wanted to make that happen. The two women discussed how the situation with Pirros had gone down, and examined their own feelings of rejection and how complicated it made things in this new era. With a fleet heading their way, Sess asked Solen how they should respond, to which the senator said she already had– she had activated agent Bastion, a Concordat operative secretly operating on Kaltrais.

title: Elira Solen
text:
After the Nagai insurgency had finally found its footing on Kaltrais thanks to the Concordat's help and pushed back the Fenril Consortium's fleet, Reyna Oskure assassinated an uncertain Kezrin Almovar. This isolated the Fenril Consortium under the Anzati witch's control, pushing the battle to Nagi as the Nagai intended to free their homeworld, pulling the Consortium's fleet away from targeting the Concordat. Seeing the movement of the Fenril's fleet towards Nagi, Vela Sess ran toward Solen's location, banging on the door. Elira was confused, thinking Bastion had simply done her part successfully. But Sess then revealed to her hat the fleet was now bound for the Nagai homeworld, to Elira's shock.

Nagi

> " We have to bring them home now !" " Elira—your place is here! " ―Elira Solen and Vela Sess on a Concordat landing platform

title: Elira Solen
text: While at the Karrick family apartment with Beno and Astra-9, Solen called Dax Karrick to ask for an update on Bastion, Joren, and Rynn as they were caught in the middle of the Battle of Nagi . But Dax picked up the hologram while he and Varrick were sprinting away from a group of Zantarrk shock troopers blasting them. Stopping to answer the call, Dax told Elira that Oskure had captured Rynn and Jesrit, and that he doesn't know where Joren is but he's not particularly worried about that. As Dax hinted that Venk had been killed as well, an explosion went off behind the two men– prompting an end to the call as Dax asked for some Concordat help and ran off toward Bastion's location. Worried for her husband, for her brother, and for the Concordat, Elira held her son and questioned what Dax had done. Some time later, in a hangar near a CR90 corvette, Solen begged Vela Sess to help her bring them home. Mon told her that her place was there on Serenne, and that the Republic needed her– governing thousands with a word. Elira still wanted to go save her family, but Sess was able

title: Elira Solen
text: in a hangar near a CR90 corvette, Solen begged Vela Sess to help her bring them home. Mon told her that her place was there on Serenne, and that the Republic needed her– governing thousands with a word. Elira still wanted to go save her family, but Sess was able to convince her to stay. Though she wasn't going to go, Elira placed Alaytia in charge of the Republic's response, walking away with Beno and Astra-9. As the battle raged on Nagi, the Fenril Consortium fleet held position in orbit. But the Concordat fleet Solen had sent, led by Alaytia, consisting of a Defender -class cruiser , at least two escort frigates , several corvettes, and many starfighters arrived over Nagi to peacefully ask the pirate vessels to stand down. But Oskure, cornered by Drayden on the surface, detonated the fleet, causing mass chaos And debris raining down. News of this got back to Solen and Sess on Serenne, along with the fact that Bastion had been killed on Nagi. The people of Pirros, acting independently from the tyrannical Oskure, then contacted the two Concordat leaders– begging for their help in stopping Oskure. Elira, always willing to make an ally, and realizing her place as a political leader for the Republic, agreed to help. Sess believed that this was because of Bastion's death, but Solen explained that it was about more than that– she wanted to fight for peace, protecting what they've built. Sess reassured Solen, and the two set off to do good.

title: Elira Solen
text:
While the Concordat's agents fought Oskure's combined Tof , Zantarrk, and traitorous Nagai forces at Nagi, a Concordat transport accompanied by two Vectors landed. and Solen and Sess emerged to announce that the Concordat stood with the Nagai. The fighting ceased upon this proud declaration, the combatants looking at the arriving dignitaries. Jesrit took this opportunity to address the crowd– saying that they now stood on the precipice of true peace, a free Nagi, and freedom from mainpulators, monsters, and their lackeys. Elira denounced the Fenril Consortium as a shadow government run by Oskure, and stated that the Concordat stands with Nagi as a free, independent world they will help rebuild. Jesrit spoke of unity amongst Nagai, united in Garlev's dream, and the enemy Nagai removed their salvaged Imperial trooper helmets, cheering the phrase "in Garlev's name", raising their fists to the sky.

Victory & freedom

> " The Concordat is committed to helping rebuild Nagi—as an independent world, ruled by its own people." "Not as a proxy state—or as a pawn." "As Garlev intended. As I will ensure. " ―Elira Solen, Vela Sess, and Jesrit looking upon the rebuilding of Nagi.

title: Elira Solen
text:
In the city of Siva , the Concordat heroes celebrated and gathered with the Nagai, as they began clearing debris and rebuilding. There, Elira reassured Jesrit that the Concordat was committed to helping the Nagai rebuild their world as a new independent Nagi, which Jesrit said was what Garlev intended. The young Nagai leader thanked Joren and his friends, and Joren clarified that he was just keeping his promise from Gadrilam. Solen told Jesrit she hoped this was the beginning of a strong partnership, and Jesrit told her she hoped for the same, and that she had a lot to learn from Elira in how she unified her people. But Solen told the young woman her own words only nudged along what Jesrit had done. Pulling Solen away from the conversation, Dax had a question for his wife: why had they been apart for so long? Zenathi saw this and all the rest of it, and reflected on the moment of happiness with Joren, who told her that these moments were incredibly important. Nagi was free, after Solen had committed much to the effort.

#### Family life

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Family life

> " Take him in the bedroom, please? We’ll talk about this later. There’s something going on that Mon and I have to attend to. " ―Elira talks to Dax about Beno while she works.

In 7 AVE , Dax, Elira, and Beno were paid a visit by their longtime friend Dorian Quill, who had come to recruit Dax to help him save Aether Spire. Elira gave Dax her blessings as he departed her and Beno to join Quill's crew. Later, Elira helped them by ordering Concordat Captain Krull to allow the group of "Concordat agents" to pass through their blockade and leave Substation Grimdock , and later revealed to them that the pilot they hired, Taka Jamoreesa , was an undercover Concordat bodyguard. Upon Dax's return, Elira was pleased by her husband's vow to spend more time together.

title: Elira Solen
text:
As Beno grew, he shared his mother's Synth Flux sensitivity . However, he struggled with the umbra side. Beside his darker tendencies, Solen also sometime struggled with raising a son who had some of his father's tendencies. In one instance, Beno could not pay attention to his schoolwork as his father worked on a speeder at their apartment. Solen attempted to refocus her son on his lesson that day, asking what his lesson was about– but Dax pushed back, wanting Beno to have fun and drive the speeder. Dax reached into the speeder, and accidentally sent it crashing into a tree, and Solen chastised her husband's responsibility. Solen sent her son to train under her brother in 15 AVE , as Drayden had begun to rebuild the Aetheri Order, in the hope that he would learn to control his darker tendencies.

#### Assisting Kryll

> " The honorable Senator Solen has become aware of an unfortunate situation and wishes to present this data transcript, which she hopes may resolve the matter. " ―Astra-9 to the court

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Assisting Kryll

> " The honorable Senator Solen has become aware of an unfortunate situation and wishes to present this data transcript, which she hopes may resolve the matter. " ―Astra-9 to the court

In 9 AVE , Grand Admiral Vorren of the Imperium planned to return to the galaxy, having previously been taken to Peridea due to the actions of Solen's old ally, Commander Cass Virel. Around this time, Elira's name was included on a list of heroes on the gauntlet of Baylan Skoll , a former Aetheri Knight and an ally to the effort to find Grand Admiral.

title: Elira Solen
text: After being informed of rumors regarding Vorren's return, General Lena Kryll spoke with Vela Sess and other senators, requesting resources to aid in searching for the missing Aetheri and the Grand Admiral, though the request was soon declined. In response, Kryll took a small squadron of Vectors and decided to continue with the search regardless. Solen was soon informed of this, though supported Kryll's actions and decided to cover for her. The Concordat were quick to respond to this however, and Solen soon contacted Captain Carson Teva and told him that she could only cover for them for so long. Teva passed the message down to Kryll, who searched for her friends Ryn Wrenna and Sela Marr. Marr was eventually found and pursued the hunt for Vorren and Virel, whilst Kryll was left to deal with the consequences from the Concordat.

title: Elira Solen
text:
During the prosecution of Kryll by Senator Hamato Xiono for disobeying direct orders, Solen sent Astra-9 to represent her in the trial and defend her friend. Before claiming that Solen had only recently become aware of the situation, the protocol droid presented a data transcript on the senator's behalf to prove that Solen had personally authorized Kryll's reconnaissance mission to Seatos while she was unaware of Xiono's vote against it. Astra-9 also added that Solen was willing to overlook the alleged mistake, with the request that further concerns be addressed directly to her. As Xiono reluctantly claimed to be satisfied, Sess dismissed the case despite knowing that Solen did not authorize the mission beforehand as claimed.

#### Late Concordat Era

An unlikely ally

> " I don't have time for a conversation about galactic politics with someone so profoundly ignorant of their greater implications. " " Nor do I have time to discuss these matters with someone so intolerant of other points of view. " ―Elira and Kastor exchanging views about the Imperium

title: Elira Solen
text:
