> " I don't have time for a conversation about galactic politics with someone so profoundly ignorant of their greater implications. " " Nor do I have time to discuss these matters with someone so intolerant of other points of view. " ―Elira and Kastor exchanging views about the Imperium

Twenty-three years after the Battle of Ashden, Solen was still a senator in the Galactic Senate of the Concordat on Hosnian Prime , as part of the Populists , a powerful, yet unofficial, political faction. The Populists believed that individual member planets should retain their full sovereignty, while the Centrists favored a stronger galactic government and a larger military. After Sess, former chancellor , left the office, the tension between the two factions threatened to cripple the Senate.

title: Elira Solen
text:
During this period, Solen attended a dedication ceremony of a new statue of her father, Bael Solen, on Hosnian Prime. At this ceremony, Solen addressed the Senate and attempted to inspire the senators to stop bickering and begin to act. However, her efforts proved unsuccessful, further demonstrating that the Senate was no longer effective. Losing faith that the government could function any longer, Solen resolved to resign as senator at the end of her term.

Following the ceremony, Solen met privately with the Centrist senator Lady Carise Sindian , who informed her that Lord Mellowyn , the Supreme governor of Birren had died without leaving any heirs. Since Mellowyn was a distant kinsman of her adoptive father Bael Solen, Elira was his next in line to inherit the position per the rules of the Elder Houses . While Solen was not interested in matters relating to royalty, Sindian wanted to preserve that tradition. Solen reassured Sindian that she would have her staff investigate the matter immediately.

title: Elira Solen
text: Later during a session of the Senate, Solen was present when Yendor , a Velari emissary from the planet Selvara , appeared before the Senate to ask for help in investigating a Niktal cartel that was threatening his home planet. The cartel was run by a Kajain'sa'Niktal known as Rinnrivin Di , who operated from the planet Bastatha . After Yendor's request was made, the Senate debated whether Yendor's accusations were true and whether the Senate should act upon them. Feeling partially responsible that she was part of the government that allowed this to happen, Senator Solen volunteered to personally investigate Rinnrivin Di's cartel on Bastatha. She was pleased to think that she would see some action again before she retired, until Senator Ransolm Kastor , the junior senator from the Centrist planet Riosa , suggested that the investigation to be bipartisan and volunteered to accompany Solen.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Soon after the session of the Senate ended, Solen went to visit Kastor in his office—contrary to senatorial protocol, where he would be expected to visit her in the morning. Upon her visit, Kastor welcomed Solen into his office, which she discovered to be full of Imperial memorabilia. Disgusted by his infatuation with the Imperium, Solen and Kastor entered a heated debate where Kastor showed his support not for Mal, but the dream of the Imperium, and that he wished that the Imperium had been reformed under better leadership. Solen began to argue that Mal was not the only problem with the Imperium, and that he had only been a child while she was fighting in the war. Solen then left Kastor's office, the two of them agreeing that Astra-9 and the rest of Solen's staff would plan for their trip to Bastatha at another time.

Mission to Bastatha

> " Rinnrivin Di, I presume? " " Princess Elira Solen. I apologize for your unorthodox journey here. However, I thought you unlikely to accept a straightforward invitation " ―Elira's first meeting with Rinnrivin Di

title: Elira Solen
text:
Mission to Bastatha

> " Rinnrivin Di, I presume? " " Princess Elira Solen. I apologize for your unorthodox journey here. However, I thought you unlikely to accept a straightforward invitation " ―Elira's first meeting with Rinnrivin Di

A few days later, Solen and Kastor, along with Elira's chief of staff Greer Sonnel , 16-year-old office intern Korr Sella , Vector pilot Joph Seastriker , and Astra-9, began to prepare their trip to Bastatha. The trip on board Solen's personal ship the Mirrorbright was an awkward one, as Kastor and Solen attempted to avoid each other after their confrontation in Kastor's office earlier. However, by the time they reached the planet, Kastor apologized for being insensitive to Solen's personal experiences in the war, and they agreed to leave the past in the past so that they could do what they came to do.

title: Elira Solen
text: Solen and Kastor remained civil with each other as they exited the Mirrorbright to greet the local authorities, and they were welcomed to Bastatha by Niktal Magistrates Tosta and Xun . The senators and their staff were all welcomed to dinner, and they were taken to a luxurious casino. The group was offered a splendid meal, but Solen insisted on playing her hand in a game of Sabacc . The Niktos believed that she would likely lose some money in the challenging game, but Solen, having learned the game from the best, intended to impress her hosts with her cunning rather than her decorum.

title: Elira Solen
text: While Elira's actions won the favor of her Niktal hosts, Ransolm was uncomfortable with his colleague for fraternizing with what he regarded as "lowlives." During their time at the casino, Elira noticed a party of visitors from the planet Daxam IV . One of the party was an elderly woman who appeared to be watching her while trying to remain unnoticed. After exiting the casino, Solen and Kastor argued about her style of fraternizing with constituents and the alleged "terrorist" activities of the Free Coalition. Later, Elira received news from Greer that a "business delegation" was coming to meet her.

title: Elira Solen
text:
This "business delegation" turned out to be a party of kidnappers sent by Rinnrivin. Without firing shots, Rinnrivin's underlings spirited Solen away on a hoversled for a private audience with Rinnrivin at his underground headquarters . The crime lord attempted to ingratiate himself with the Concordat senator by serving vintage Toniray wine from Cindervale and presenting a holocube of her killing Grukk, an act which had won her the respect of the Niktal species, who called her "Huttslayer." However, Elira rebuffed Rinnrivin's attempts to bribe her into persuading the Concordat to ease its ban on the sale of illegal spice .

Solen's meeting with Rinnrivin was interrupted by Kastor, who had tracked her down using a tracking device he had planted in her cloak. Following a brief scuffle with Rinnrivin's guards, the two senators escaped on a hoversled and alerted the Bastatha authorities. Rinnrivin and his henchmen escaped before the Bastatha security forces could secure his underground lair. However, Elira and her team managed to find information about Rinnrivin's operations including his funnelling of funds to shadow corporations in the Outer Reach. They suspected that Rinnrivin was part of a larger criminal network.

First Senator and the Napkin Bombing

title: Elira Solen
text:
First Senator and the Napkin Bombing

Following their return from Bastatha, Solen and Kastor addressed the Galactic Senate and called for further investigations into Rinnrivin's cartel. Their speeches were greeted by partisan infighting with the Populists accusing Kastor of endangering Elira's life and the Centrists accusing Elira of withholding critical information. Later, Lady Carise took the floor to advocate the creation of " First Senator ," a powerful position that would wield considerable power over the economy and military. While many senators distrusted Lady Carise's motives, Kastor managed to sway the Senate into adopting the motion by pointing to the endemic deadlock in the Concordat. As a result, the Populist attempt to block the motion was defeated.

title: Elira Solen
text: While Solen and her Populist colleagues Tai-Lin Garr and Varish Vicly were dismayed by the results, they decided to change tactics by nominating a Populist for First Senator to prevent a Centrist from holding that position. Since Solen was considered a powerful and charismatic senator, Tai-Lin and Varish convinced her to run for First Senator. Despite her reluctance, Solen agreed to form an exploratory committee to consider the possibility at the urging of her staff including Astra-9, her aide Korrie, and her pilot Sonnel. Elira later contacted her husband, Dax, by hologram to discuss the recent developments. Though Dax expressed disappointment, he understood her devotion to keeping the Concordat in one piece.

title: Elira Solen
text: The following day, Elira met with Lady Carise to conclude their discussion on the Supreme governorship of Birren. During the meeting, Elira revealed that she had been adopted by Bael and Breha Solen. Since Elira and her son Beno had little interest in inheriting the governorship, Elira agreed to support Lady Carise's claim to the title in return for keeping her parentage a secret. While conversing with Lady Carise, Solen admitted that the position of First Senator might not be such a bad idea. In addition, Elira dispatched Greer and the starfighter pilot Seastriker to the watery planet Pamarthe to investigate whether Rinnrivin was hiring pilots from there. Instead, the two Republic pilots learned that Rinnrivin was hiring a shadowy militia group known as the Amaxine warriors , who operated from a base in the Centrist world Daxam IV.

title: Elira Solen
text: Greer and Joph discussed their findings with Elira and noted that the Amaxines tended to operate in predominantly Centrist worlds. Suspecting that several Centrist senators were colluding with Rinnrivin's cartel, Solen decided to turn to Kastor for help since she regarded him as the only Centrist she could trust. During a private dinner at Hosnian Prime's hanging gardens , Solen discussed her concerns about the connection between the Amaxines and Rinnrivin's cartel with Kastor and convinced the senator to visit Daxam IV. During the dinner, Kastor confided in Elira and told her about his harsh childhood on Riosa, which had led him to hate Xarn Velgor and the Emperor. In return, Elira told him about her torture at the hands of Velgor but omitted the fact that the late Umbra Lord was her father. Because of this meeting, the two became unlikely friends.

title: Elira Solen
text:
The following day, Elira and Tai-Lin met in the Concordat senatorial complex's banquet hall to discuss her planned nomination for First Senator. There, Elira discovered a hand-scribbled note with the word "RUN." Acting quickly, Elira managed to evacuate the senatorial complex's conference hall moments before a bomb destroyed half of the building. While nobody was killed due to Elira's quick thinking, several senators and staff were wounded by the blast. Elira survived the bombing unscathed apart from some concussion. After receiving treatment for concussion, Elira transmitted a voice message for again to assure him that she was safe.

Missions to Selvara and Harloff Minor

The Populists and Centrists accused each other of staging the bombing for political capital. Despite this bickering, Solen and Kastor resolved to continue their investigation into Rinnrivin's cartel and the Amaxines. After seeing news footage showing an alleged Velari bomber, Elira decided to travel to Selvara to search the planet's archives with Astra-9, Korrie, and Joph for information about Rinnrivin's cartel. Meanwhile, Kastor and Greer would travel to Daxam IV to investigate the Amaxine presence there under the pretext of purchasing an old Imperial artifact from a local dealer.

title: Elira Solen
text: On Selvara, Elira and her entourage were greeted by Emissary Yendor, a veteran of the Galactic Civil War who was familiar with the former insurgent leader. In the Selvara archives, Elira and her team discovered that Rinnrivin had been a lowly spice dealer who had risen to power under unusual circumstances in the past seven years. Elira and Korrie pondered whether Rinnrivin's sudden fortunes were connected to the Centrists. Later, Senator Solen attended a private dinner hosted by Yendor. In her absence, Astra-9, Joph, and Korrie contacted Kastor, who informed them about Rinnrivin's secret satellites above Selvara. Astra-9 sliced into one of the satellites and discovered that Rinnrivin was hiding on the Expansion Region planet of Sibensko . While Elira was annoyed with Joph for acting without consulting her, she was pleased that he had pinned down Rinnrivin's location.

title: Elira Solen
text: After departing Selvara, Elira and her team discovered that Rinnrivin was visiting the upmarket planet of Harloff Minor , which lay near the former galactic capital Vantor. Seeking to question him, Elira delayed her return to Hosnian Prime and took the Mirrorbright to Harloff Minor. Solen and Rinnrivin met at a comfortable restaurant. Rinnrivin denied any role in the "Napkin Bombing" and condemned the incident as a terrorist act. While Elira accepted Rinnrivin's compliment that she would make a worthy candidate for First Senator, she rebuffed his second attempt at bribery and took the opportunity to return her "Huttslayer" holocube on the grounds that she did not need to be reminded of the past. However, Elira had secretly fitted the holocube with a transmitter to keep an eye on Rinnrivin's movements.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Upon returning to Hosnian Prime, Solen learned that her colleague Varish was recovering from her injuries. She also received a hologram recording from her husband, who informed her that he was heading to the fourth stage of the Five Blades race. After listening to news reports of the Populist and Centrist media blaming each other for the Napkin Bombing, Elira chatted with her aide Korrie, who feared the collapse of the Concordat. Addressing Korrie and Joph, she theorized that the current infighting in the Senate could lead to a schism. In private, Elira feared that another war was imminent. After Kastor returned to Hosnian Prime later that night, the Senator briefed her about the Amaxine warriors he had encountered on Daxam IV. Kastor explained that he had gained the trust of the Amaxines and convinced them that he was an Imperial sympathizer. He revealed that the Amaxine warriors had amassed considerable forces and starfighters in preparation for a war. Having determined that the Amaxines and Rinnrivin's cartel were connected, the two decided to investigate whether the Amaxine warriors were responsible for the Napkin Bombing. Rinnrivin also informed her that the Amaxines' main base was located on Sibensko, which was also Rinnrivin's hideout. Elira agreed to steer the official investigation into the Napkin Bombing in the "right direction" while Rinnrivin agreed to investigate whether his fellow Centrists were colluding with the Amaxines.

Secret revealed

title: Elira Solen
text:
Secret revealed

With Elira's approval, Joph and Greer traveled to the seedy space station of Chrome Citadel to arrange a smuggling "cover job" to Sibensko, which had a reputation as a seedy place. Since Elira's nomination as the Populist candidate for First Senator was scheduled to take place within a few weeks, Solen began to prepare for her trip to Sibensko. She discussed her travel plans with Senator Kastor, who advised her that Concordat law prohibited them from using Concordat pilots and ships for illegal work such as traveling to a known criminal hub like Sibensko. Elira invited Kastor to accompany her on this trip to give their mission more credibility in the eyes of the divided Galactic Senate.

title: Elira Solen
text:
While Elira's friendship with Kastor blossomed during this time, a major crisis emerged from an unexpected quarter. While visiting Birren, Lady Carise had uncovered a keepsake chest and a music box which revealed Elira's true parentage as the daughter of Xarn Velgor. As a clandestine agent of the New Imperium and a leading Centrist politician, Lady Carise saw an opportunity to both create a wedge between Kastor and Elira and to destroy Solen's political credibility. Knowing Kastor's hatred for Xarn Velgor, she informed Kastor about Elira's parentage.

Feeling betrayed by Elira, Ransolm upstaged the Senate hearing on Solen's nomination for First Senator by revealing her true parentage as Xarn Velgor's daughter. After Kastor presented her keepsake chest and music box as evidence, Elira confirmed that she was indeed Xarn Velgor's daughter. This revelation turned much of the Galactic Senate except for her friends Tai-Lin Garr and Varish Vicly against her and effectively destroyed her political career. After barricading herself and her staff in her senate office, Elira consoled herself by watching a holographic recording of her late adopted father Bael Solen. She then penned a message to her son to comfort him about the recent revelations concerning their family's ancestry.

title: Elira Solen
text: While Korrie stormed off in outrage at Elira's perceived indiscretion, Astra-9 along with Joph and Greer remained loyal to her. Elira and her remaining team resolved to stop Rinnrivin's cartel and the Amaxine warriors. The following day, Elira marched into Kastor's office and confronted her former friend. Kastor responded that he had been a fool for sharing his most personal and painful life stories with Elira, never guessing that she was Velgor's daughter. When Elira revealed that she had not shared her true parentage with her son, Kastor pointed out that Beno was no longer a child but a man. After destroying one of Kastor's glass display cases and knocking a noodle carton out of a servant droid's hands, Elira stormed out of Kastor's office.

title: Elira Solen
text: After regaining her composure, Elira addressed the Galactic Senate to formally withdraw her nomination for First Senator and to seek permission for leave. She also took the opportunity to clarify her and her brother Joren Drayden's origins as the offspring of the Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden, the man who had become Xarn Velgor. Solen also identified her birth mother as the late Ondara Senator Lira Ondar. Following her speech, Lady Carise took the opportunity to cast doubt on Joren Drayden's integrity since the Aetheri Master had kept a low profile for many years. In response, Elira pointed out her brother's services for the Insurgency and the Concordat including his role in destroying the first Void Core.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Fortunately for Elira, Tai-Lin Garr spoke in Joren's defense and reiterated that the Concordat did not blame children for the sins of their parents. While accepting the withdrawal of Elira's candidacy, he defended Elira's past record and stressed that she retained his personal friendship and support. The Senate then discussed her request to obtain a brief leave of absence from her duties. After some deliberation, the Senate reluctantly approved her request. Guilt-stricken over his actions, Ransolm did not oppose her request and remained silent throughout the deliberations. Elira and her team then prepared to depart on a junker ship for Sibensko. Despite Greer succumbing to a bloodburn attack, the team proceeded with their mission.

Mission to Sibensko

title: Elira Solen
text:
Mission to Sibensko

For their mission to Sibensko , Elira disguised herself as an indentured servant who wore a heavy robe and veil. Greer and Joph posed as a Ferrik and Ubese bounty hunter respectively, while Astra-9 pretended to be Elira's minder. The Concordat team docked their junker ship in an underwater city in Sibensko's southern axis. Using a tracker, Elira detected that Rinnrivin was somewhere in the underwater city. Upon landing, Elira and team discovered that they were transporting a cargo of detonators to Hosnian Prime. While Greer and Joph loaded the cargo, Elira and Astra-9 headed into the city.

The two accessed a computer terminal in a cantina. Astra-9 downloaded banking records proving that the Amaxine warriors had transferred billions of credits in start-up capital to Rinnrivin Di's cartel over the past seven years. In addition, Astra-9 found that Rinnrivin was linked to nameless sources on Centrist worlds. Elira feared that the Amaxine warriors were planning a major military buildup or that a coalition of Centrist worlds was preparing for war. In addition, Astra-9 uncovered information about a large Centrist base within the underwater city.

title: Elira Solen
text: Elira contacted Joph and informed him about the Amaxine military presence on Sibensko. She decided to send Astra-9 back with his data to rendezvous with the pilots while she went to spy on the Amaxine military base. Since Joph and Greer were scheduled to depart in an hour, Solen planned to stay longer to spy on the Amaxines. Astra-9 reluctantly left to return to the freighter. Before Elira could proceed further, she was cornered by Rinnrivin and two of his bodyguards, who had detected Elira's tracking device on his holocube. Since Elira had accessed classified information regarding his operations, the crime lord intended to kill the intruders.

title: Elira Solen
text: However, Elira shot one of the Niktal henchmen with her volt pistol and then targeted the central strut supporting the hydraulic tunnel above Rinnrivin, crushing the crime lord and his remaining bodyguard to death. Elira then reiterated her orders for Joph and Greer to leave with Astra-9. Unknown to Elira, the Sibensko base served as the Amaxine warriors' headquarters and contained their entire army. Elira then took a lift down to the Amaxine base and discovered that it housed a squadron of starfighters. She then encountered six Amaxine warriors, who attempted to apprehend her. However, Solen fled up a landing platform that took her to the surface of the ocean.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Shortly thereafter, Elira was attacked by a Yarrow and Bulwark starfighter . Before the Amaxine starfighters could finish her off, Dax arrived in a modified racer and shot down the Yarrow. After boarding Dax's racer, the wife and husband shot down the remaining Bulwark fighter, which crashed into the underwater city's ammunition depot. This triggered a massive explosion that wiped out the entire Amaxine base and eliminated the Amaxines and Rinnrivin's cartel as threats to the Concordat. However, the explosion also destroyed much of the hard evidence on the two factions' financial records, which concealed their link to several Centrist senators and the New Imperium.

Warning the Concordat

title: Elira Solen
text:
Warning the Concordat

After returning to Hosnian Prime, Elira confided about the political fallout resulting from the revelations of her parentage to her husband, Dax Karrick. While many of her former Populist allies had abandoned her for being Xarn Velgor's daughter, she expressed relief that Tai-Lin, Varish, and her former insurgent comrades Vorian, Nien Nunb, Lando, and Vela Sess had stood by her. Elira also discussed her mixed feelings about Ransolm Kastor's motives for betraying her. Karrick advised his wife to resign from the Senate once her term was up and to join him traveling around the galaxy for a change. Elira then informed Dax that she planned to address the Senate about her investigation into Rinnrivin's cartel and the Amaxines but that she needed to obtain a quorum.

title: Elira Solen
text: Due to the political fallout resulting from the revelations of her parentage, Elira struggled to obtain a quorum to address the Senate. However, Kastor cast a deciding vote in her favor. Elira related this turn in fortunes to her husband, who was preparing to depart for the hyperspace championship round of the Five Blades which had been postponed due to family commitments. After Dax had left, Elira discussed her plan to address the Senate with her remaining friends Tai-Lin and Varish, who expressed suspicion about Ransolm's motives for voting in her favor. Tai-Lin then informed Elira that he was planning to stand as the Populist nominee for First Senator.

title: Elira Solen
text: The following day, Senator Solen briefed the Galactic Senate about her investigation into Rinnrivin's cartel and the Amaxine warriors. She revealed that Rinnrivin had been funding the Amaxine warriors, who were responsible for the Napkin Bombing. To back her testimony, Solen's chief of staff supplied each senator with an extensive data packet. Elira's testimony evoked finger-blaming between the Populists and Centrists. In addition, Solen submitted visual logs from her Sibensko mission and reported that Amaxine base had been destroyed during the firefight with the Amaxine fighters. When a senator accused her of justifying murder like her father, Elira warned the Senate that her investigation had foiled a conspiracy by the Amaxine warriors to wage war on the Republic. She warned that the Amaxine warriors were not the only threat to the Concordat and urged her colleagues to end their political bickering and not to let their views of her cloud the evidence.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Elira's former friend Senator Kastor then addressed the Senate to support her findings. He vouched for Senator Solen's integrity and then offered visual logs from his trip to Daxam IV, which showed the Amaxines' training facilities and some measure of their military might. He also testified that the Amaxine warriors advocated war and admired the "Old Imperium." Kastor's testimony vindicated Elira's findings and aroused several senators. Due to Kastor's courage and selflessness, Kastor regained Elira's respect. However, Kastor's action earned the ire of Lady Carise, who was covertly working with the New Imperium to undermine the Concordat.

Tying up loose ends

> " The sun is setting on the Concordat. It's time for the Coalition to rise. " ―Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
Tying up loose ends

> " The sun is setting on the Concordat. It's time for the Coalition to rise. " ―Elira Solen

The day after Senator Solen's final address to the Senate, Kastor visited his former friend. The two reconciled with Kastor praising her for her good work in the Sibensko mission. Ransolm then announced his intention to support further investigations into the Amaxines and Rinnrivin's cartel. While Elira did not thank him for supporting her testimony, she praised the junior senator for putting the greater good ahead of his own political faction and ambitions. She told Kastor that he was the kind of politician that the galaxy needed. With Elira's political career at an end, she counselled Kastor to work with other like-minded senators to prevent a war, even if it meant leaving the Centrists. Kastor agreed to do his best to protect the Republic before departing.

title: Elira Solen
text: Ten days following her final speech to the Galactic Senate, Elira accompanied Tai-Lin Garr on his first campaign rally for the position of First Senator. While visiting one of Hosnian Prime's parks, Elira encountered her former aide Korr Sella, who apologized to the Senator for abandoning her. She offered to serve Solen again, a request which Elira accepted. While Tai-Lin was mingling with the crowd, Elira spotted Arliz Hadrassian, the woman she had earlier encountered on Bastatha and witnessed in Ransolm's holos of Daxam IV. Before Elira could react, Hadrassian assassinated Tai-Lin with a volt pistol. Before turning the volt pistol on herself, Hadrassian told the Senator that she was lucky that Hadrassian was thinking strategically.

title: Elira Solen
text: Following Tai-Lin Garr's assassination, the Galactic Senate unanimously declared an official period of mourning. Based on the data from Sibensko, both Populist and Centrist senators believed that Hadrassian was the mastermind behind the Napkin Bombing, Rinnrivin's rise, and the Amaxines. While most senators believed that Hadrassian's suicide ended the danger to the Republic, Elira disagreed and urged the authorities to investigate the source of Hadrassian's money, pointing out that a former Imperial soldier and small-time businesswoman could not bankroll an entire militia. During Tai-Lin Garr's memorial service , she raised the matter. However, her friend Varish was more concerned with mourning Tai-Lin Garr's loss.

title: Elira Solen
text: Two days after Tai-Lin Garr's assassination, Elira heard a news report that her friend Kastor had been arrested for aiding Hadrassian and the Amaxine warriors. After consulting Greer, Solen ascertained that the Centrists had framed Kastor by planting fake footage of him shaking hands with Hadrassian. Before Kastor was deported to face imprisonment, trial, and sentencing on his homeworld Riosa, Elira spoke to him and offered to help her former friend. While Kastor was pessimistic that her help would succeed, he apologized for breaching Elira's trust. In return, Elira apologized for initially assuming that he was an Imperial loyalist. Based on her final conversation with Kastor, Elira determined that the Centrists were behind the recent crisis and were eliminating dissenters among their ranks.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Before resigning as Senator, Elira took the opportunity to settle scores with Lady Carise for revealing her parentage and conspiring against Kastor. Claiming Lady Carise had violated her oath to secrecy as Supreme Governor of Birren, Solen convinced the Elder Houses to strip the Lady of all her royal titles permanently. A smug Elira personally delivered the news to a distraught Carise and chastised the younger woman for her obsession with royalty and privilege. Later that evening, Elira organized a private meeting in the Senatorial complex hangar bay that was attended by several Concordat military personnel including Joph, Greer, Nunb, Ematt, Vorian, Kalonia, Snap Wexlin, and Zari Bangel . With the Galactic Senate too preoccupied with petty squabbles to defend the Concordat, Elira announced the formation of a new paramilitary organization called the Coalition .

### Coalition

#### The new insurgency

> " You are a symbol of the Coalition and an inspiration to all soldiers who follow our cause and do their duty in hard times. " ―PZ-4CO, to Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text: Following the formation of the Coalition, Elira Solen became its leader and began to be addressed as General rather than Princess. All of the Coalition leadership was made up of people who had a personal connection to the General, including Vorian, Idrosen Gawat , and Amilyn Holdra . In the wake of the revelations about Elira and Joren's true parentage, her son Beno became obsessed with carrying on the legacy of Xarn Velgor, all the while under the influence of Vorr , Supreme Leader of the New Imperium . Beno destroyed Drayden's Aetheri Sanctum and his fellow students , turned to the umbra side, and became a Knight of Karrick . Abandoning his former identity, the renamed Zarrin Karrick assumed a high-ranking position in the New Imperium, a remnant of the Old Imperium. Dax Karrick and Solen each blamed themselves and separated, whereas Drayden went into exile, though Solen and Karrick suspected he had gone to the first Aetheri Sanctum . While General Solen continued leading the Coalition, Karrick and Brevok resumed their smuggling operations.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Sometime during the Cold War Elira approached and recruited two new Coalition members: Rose and Paige Holt . They were fleeing the genocide on Hays Minor . During the rise of the New Imperium, numerous Velaris feared another occupation of their independent homeworld, Selvara, and so pledged their allegiance to Solen and the Coalition. Meanwhile, New Imperium shock trooper LB-1033 came to develop a series of conspiracy theories about where Solen was born and what her relation to Cindervale was.

#### Prelude to Ashden

> " The problem with a reputation is that it can become a legend. Don't be deceived, Pova. I'm not a legend. " " You're not sitting where I'm sitting, General. " ―Elira Solen and Rin Vale

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Prelude to Ashden

> " The problem with a reputation is that it can become a legend. Don't be deceived, Pova. I'm not a legend. " " You're not sitting where I'm sitting, General. " ―Elira Solen and Rin Vale

As the brewing conflict against the New Imperium advanced, Solen was informed of the Rapier Squadron 's involvement in a dogfight against New Imperium vessels over Suraz 4 , trying to protect the Yissira Zyde , which ultimately was captured by the New Imperium. Interested in any information about the Order, Solen traveled to the squadron's base of operations to meet the squadron's leader , Rin Vale —who had gone to investigate the whereabouts of the NK-Witell -class freighter by himself and had ultimately located it at a New Imperium staging point in OR-Kappa-2722 .

title: Elira Solen
text:
When Vale finished talking about the encounter , Solen noted that he had been very foolish, but his need to do what was right (partly to find adventure) and his piloting skills reminded Solen of her brother, and so, she offered Vale the chance to join the Coalition. He accepted immediately, and in the following months, as he carried out missions for the Coalition, Vale became one of Solen's most-trusted operatives. Eventually because of his skills and determination, Solen recruited him for Operation: Sabre Strike so that he would steal the Hevurion Grace (and its navicomputer data) from its owner, Hevurion senator and New Imperium sympathizer Erudo Ro-Kiintor .

#### Attera Campaign

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Attera Campaign

While on a reconnaissance mission in the Atterra system , the bomber crew of the Cobalt Hammer met Reeve Panzoro and his grandmother Casca Panzoro . They were then brought to D'Qar where they told General Elira about how the New Imperium was destroying their planet. They were members of a local coalition group called Bravo Rising . Reeve told them about the supplies they needed most, and Elira authorized the mission . The campaign would ultimately be successful, but at the loss of 3 MG-100 StarFortress SF-17s bombers.

#### Search for Lor Saan Tarka #### Search for Lor Saan Tarka

After he, Kare Kunna and Iola Aranna completed the mission despite the odds, Solen assigned Astra-9 to see what he could get from the flight computers while she congratulated Vale. Afterwards, as he rested, Solen analyzed the information obtained from the Hevurion Grace . The following morning, she summoned Vale to her office, and asked what he felt about the dilemma, when he remembered the hopelessness of the Imperial Era that his parents had told him about. Thanks to him, she resolved to find her brother and restore hope to the galaxy. Solen then resolved to find Lor Saan Tarka , who Solen believed held a clue to her brother's location.

title: Elira Solen
text: Following Operation: Sabre Strike, General Solen dispatched Rin Vale on a quest to find the explorer Lor Saan Tarka. When Pova assured her that he knew what was at stake, she explained that he had grown up in a galaxy where the Imperium had already been defeated and that he had only learned about the Imperium from others. When Pova recounted his previous encounter with the New Imperium, the two agreed that the faction was not yet as powerful as the Old Imperium. During the briefing, Solen praised Pova for intercepting information from the Hevurion Grace before it could reach Supreme Leader Vorr. She told Pova that they could not allow the New Imperium to find her brother, Joren Drayden, at any cost.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Elira told Pova that Tarka held the key to finding Drayden and that she trusted him to accomplish the quest. For the quest, Elira allowed Pova to select a small squadron consisting of four more pilots and a technician. Elira believed that Pova would not run into trouble due to D'Qar's remote location. When Pova reassured her that he would pick good people, Elira warned him to be careful since she knew that missions could fall apart easily. For the quest, Pova handpicked his fellow Black Squadron pilots Temmin Wexlin, Kun, L'ulo L'ampar , Jessika Pava , and the technician Oddy Muva .

For their first mission , Pova and his comrades traveled to the rocky planet Ovanis where Tarka had visited the Crèche cult years earlier. However, Pova was followed by the New Imperium Security Bureau Agent Terex . With Elira's help, Pova and his comrades bribed their way into Megalox prison on the high-gravity world of Megalox Beta . Pova wanted to question Grukkar, who had encountered Lor Saan Tarka years ago. However, Terex followed them there as well.

title: Elira Solen
text:
After helping Grukkar escape offworld, Pova discussed the information that Grukkar had shared with General Solen. After reading the information on her datapad , Elira opined that the information was legitimate. When Pova asked if he wanted her to take Black Squadron to visit the worlds that Lor Saan Tarka had traveled to, Elira confided that she suspected that a spy had been leaking Black Squadron's movements to the New Imperium.

#### Spy games

Rin Vale later embarked on a solo mission to obtain information about the New Imperium's illegal rearmament efforts in violation of the Galactic Concordance from the Galaxy Beacon journalist Suralinda Javos . Javos wanted to use the story to boost her own career. However, Javos and Pova were ambushed and captured by the New Imperium agent Lieutenant Weel . After escaping Weel, Javos returned with Pova to the Coalition base. General Solen met with Javos, who apologized for exploiting Pova. Experiencing a change of heart, Javos decided to join the Coalition and provide whatever information she had about the New Imperium.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Later, one of the Coalition's droid spies on the Outer Reach world of Kaddak obtained a trove of intelligence about the New Imperium including the location of Vorr. General Solen dispatched her spymaster Astra-9, Pova, and the technician Muva to Kaddak to recover the droid. On Kaddak, they discovered the spy was the BX-series droid commando N1-ZX , who insisted that he could disclose the information once he had been delivered back to the Coalition base. Pova soon realized that this was disinformation planted by Terex to uncover the Coalition base and that Oddy Muva was a spy. Black Squadron and Terex's Ranc Gang proxies were subsequently involved in a battle over a desert planet .

#### Starling in the Unknown Regions

> " When the galaxy is on the line, I have a way of skipping past the formalities of my youth. " ―Elira Solen to Vi Moradi

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Starling in the Unknown Regions

> " When the galaxy is on the line, I have a way of skipping past the formalities of my youth. " ―Elira Solen to Vi Moradi

During the cold war with the New Imperium, Solen Karrick worked with spy Vi Moradi , codenamed Starling, to gain information about the Order's movements throughout the Unknown Regions. After jumping out of hyperspace, Moradi provided vital information to Solen on an encoded comm frequency. The general provided one more set of coordinates for Vi to investigate. However, the New Imperium Iron Cruiser Absolution promptly captured her, but after a lengthy interrogation, Moradi managed to escape with the New Imperium Captain Cardinal .

#### Map to Drayden

> " I saw him. Elira, I saw our son. He was here. " ―Dax Karrick to Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text: Thirty years after the Battle of Mossfell, with the two factions on the brink of war, Lor Saan Tarka finally contacted the Coalition, informing them that he had the map to Joren Drayden and was on the desert world of Ashden. Believing that her brother would solve their crisis, Solen thought the planet was a perfect location, surmising that the New Imperium would be defeated on the same world as the Imperium. Meeting with Vale, she informed the pilot that he was being tasked with retrieving the map, but she also stated he would go without the help of Black Squadron, fearing that four Vector fighters arriving on the planet would spread word of their sensitive mission. Though she believed the mission to Ashden could be their only chance to get an advantage over the New Imperium, their enemy also arrived and attacked the town of Tuanul . Seeing this, Vale gave his astromech droid, Orio-6 , the map fragment. Additionally, the New Imperium attack squadron had been led by none other than Solen's son, who was still using the name "Zarrin Karrick." As he spoke with Tarka, the old explorer told Karrick that he could not deny his heritage

title: Elira Solen
text: Vale gave his astromech droid, Orio-6 , the map fragment. Additionally, the New Imperium attack squadron had been led by none other than Solen's son, who was still using the name "Zarrin Karrick." As he spoke with Tarka, the old explorer told Karrick that he could not deny his heritage as the son of Solen and Karrick, but the umbra side warrior murdered Tarka, took Vale captive, and had the village massacred. Solen, who had been asked to record her memoirs by PZ-4CO , as prepared by Major Ematt, and had rejected all seven of her requests in forty-four days, agreed to pass on a lesson about duty as regards to Operation Yellow Moon. When she was finished, Ematt interrupted them, for she was awaited in the D'Qar command center. Around the same time, the New Imperium took over the refueling station Colossus . The Coalition agent Kazuda Xiono sent the Coalition a message requesting assistance, but Solen was unable to send help as her forces were spread thin. But she did give Kazuda the coordinates to the Coalition base on the planet D'Qar. The she wished that Synth Flux be with Xiono in her reply. As they waited for news, Solen conversed quietly with Captain Snap Wexlin and an attendant droid, until Lieutenant Taslin Brance handed her a readout that informed her that Tuanul had been wiped out, Tarka had died, and Vale's Vector fighter had been destroyed, which would have likely killed him as well. However, she suspected Orio-6 had survived and told Astra-9 to use the tracking system to locate the spherical droid. Afterwards, she met with her personal

However, she suspected Orio-6 had survived and told Astra-9 to use the tracking system to locate the spherical droid. Afterwards, she met with her personal envoy, Commander Korr Sella, and sent her to the Senate to try and convince them to act against the New Imperium. Elsewhere, Vale and Orio-6 had indeed survived, with the former having escaped Karrick's command ship, a Resurgent -class Iron Cruiser named the Finalizer , with the help of a treasonous shock trooper, who he gave the name Jax . The two were separated, but Jax met up with Orio-6 and a scavenger named Nyla in Nimara Outpost . They escaped the New Imperium aboard a ship very familiar to Solen, the Corsair Wing itself, leading to them being found by none other than Brevok and Solen's husband, Dax Karrick. Because the two smugglers took the trio to Maz Oru's castle on the planet of Takodana, Astra-9 located Orio-6 within the castle thanks to his droid network. Alerted to the finding, Solen prepared to recover the droid until news reached her that the New Imperium had used its superweapon, Voidfang Base , to destroy the Hosnian system , then-current seat of the Concordat. Vale managed to return to D'Qar aboard the Beloved Bophine but dreaded reporting his failure to Solen. When he met with her, Vale reported what had happened, including that he had escaped imprisonment with the help of a treasonous shock trooper. Solen let Vale talk through his feelings
