When he met with her, Vale reported what had happened, including that he had escaped imprisonment with the help of a treasonous shock trooper. Solen let Vale talk through his feelings before telling him that his droid had been located. Understanding that there was a bounty on the droid and knowing the type of clientele Oru's castle attracted, Solen told him that the New Imperium likely knew Orio-6's location as well, meaning they needed to launch their operation fast. After Solen felt a disturbance in Synth Flux , she deployed a Coalition squadron to Oru's castle, with the recently returned Vale as its leader. In the aftermath of the Battle of Takodana , Solen, Astra-9, and a team of Coalition troops arrived at the ruins of Oru's Castle in a transport ship , and she saw Brevok and Karrick upon exiting the craft. Though their meeting was briefly interrupted by Astra-9, the protocol droid quickly left after realizing she and Karrick wanted to speak, giving Solen and her husband the chance to reunite for the first time in years. The two briefly flirted about their appearances before Brevok greeted her, and Karrick then told his wife that he had seen their son, Zarrin Karrick, during the battle. He also told her about Jax, who was the very shock trooper who had helped Vale escape, and Nyla, who had tried to take Orio-6 back to the Coalition, but that the latter had been abducted by Karrick on Takodana. At some point he also warned her that they would be unable to find her brother with the map Orio-6 had recovered, as Karrick had already seen that it was an incomplete

title: Elira Solen
text: to take Orio-6 back to the Coalition, but that the latter had been abducted by Karrick on Takodana. At some point he also warned her that they would be unable to find her brother with the map Orio-6 had recovered, as Karrick had already seen that it was an incomplete fragment. After traveling back to D'Qar, Vale, now reunited with Jax, brought the former shock trooper to see Solen as she was speaking with several other Coalition members. She complimented him on deserting the New Imperium and saving Vale, but, when he mentioned that Nyla had been taken captive, she revealed that Karrick had told her about the young woman and apologized for what had happened.

title: Elira Solen
text: Desperate for any information about Voidfang Base, which was the very location Nyla had been taken, Solen promised Jax that she would do everything she could to help her, though she noted he first needed to tell them everything he could about the superweapon. Afterwards, Solen conversed with other senior Coalition officers, and using Jax's information about Voidfang, they planned an attack on the superweapon , the location of which they learned by tracking the trajectory of the shots that destroyed the Hosnian system. Solen had tasked Wexlin, Kare Kunna, and Jessika Pava with putting together a reconnaissance run on Voidfang Base. During the flight, as Wexlin's recon pod failed, Kun recalled that Solen had once stated every heist needed luck, telling Wexlin that he was not out of it yet. Shortly afterward, Wexlin would manage to pilot his pod back to her Vector. Elsewhere, at the Coalition base , while Solen and the others waited for Wexlin and Kun to return from the flight, Astra-9 informed her that the map Orio-6 was carrying was only a fragment and that it matched no system on record. Solen thought she had been foolish to think she could find her brother, but

title: Elira Solen
text: while Solen and the others waited for Wexlin and Kun to return from the flight, Astra-9 informed her that the map Orio-6 was carrying was only a fragment and that it matched no system on record. Solen thought she had been foolish to think she could find her brother, but she tried to avoid Karrick after he started speaking to her. Shortly after, however, they finally talked about their son, with Solen expressing that she wanted him back. She told her husband that he could succeed where Drayden had failed, as her brother was only an Aetheri, while he was Karrick's father. Afterward, at a Coalition briefing discussing Wexlin's recon mission, Solen was informed that the New Imperium was charging their superweapon to target their system. Thus, she agreed with Karrick's idea to "blow up" the weapon, prompting the Coalition attack plan to destroy the base's thermal oscillator in Precinct 47 . Karrick also agreed to take Jax to the planet to disable its defensive shields, though he refused to tell Solen how he planned on getting the Corsair onto the base, citing that she would not like the strategy.

title: Elira Solen
text: As the Coalition prepared for its starfighter attack run, Karrick was about to depart to Voidfang Base with Brevok and Jax when Solen approached him. They both recognized they still loved each other even after everything that happened; Solen asked him to try and bring Beno back home if he saw him. Thus, Karrick departed to Voidfang Base and successfully arrived using the strategy he had not wanted to tell her: making their landing approach at lightspeed to get through the shield's fractional refresh rate. Yet during the next phases of the battle, as she oversaw the operation, she felt Karrick's death at the hands of their son through Synth Flux and collapsed into a chair in grief as curious and concerned Coalition personnel watched. However, Karrick's actions had allowed the starfighter attack, led by Vale, to destroy the oscillator and, with it, Voidfang Base. As Vale and his squadron flew away from the oscillator, Pova contacted Elira, telling her of the target's destruction. Elira, reeling from the loss of Dax, ordered Pova and his squadron to head back immediately, citing the fact that the loss of Black Squadron would take away the Coalition's ability to fight at all. Despite

title: Elira Solen
text:
flew away from the oscillator, Pova contacted Elira, telling her of the target's destruction. Elira, reeling from the loss of Dax, ordered Pova and his squadron to head back immediately, citing the fact that the loss of Black Squadron would take away the Coalition's ability to fight at all. Despite her protests, however, Pova and the squadron continued with rescue efforts for the Coalition's ground team. When those who had been involved at Voidfang Base arrived back at the Coalition base, Solen gave Nyla, who had witnessed Dax's death, a sympathetic hug. Upon their return, it was revealed that Bolt-3 had the rest of Orio-6's missing part of the map that would reveal Drayden's location. Solen looked on with fellow members of the Coalition as the two hologram maps fit together, revealing the location of her brother. Sometime after, Solen wished Nyla luck by telling her " May Synth Flux be with you " before she departed D'Qar. Solen and the rest of the coalition bid Nyla, Brevok, and Bolt-3 goodbye as they set off in search of Drayden.

At some point following the Battle of Voidfang Base Solen wrote an entry in the Smuggler's Guide , a logbook that had passed through the hands of many criminal figures before ending up in Karrick's possession for the third time. In the Guide , Solen reflected on her and Dax's relationship, and wrote that she was putting the logbook back in the Corsair Wing .

#### Evacuation of D'Qar

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Evacuation of D'Qar

In the wake of the destruction of Voidfang Base, Solen offered condolences to Inferno squad after the loss of its Squad Leader and got the intel about the Dreadnought and then afterwards send Inferno Squad to call for reinforcements. The Coalition was forced to abandon their base on D'Qar, fearing a counterattack from the New Imperium. Solen commanded the Coalition fleet from the cruiser Raddik , while Vale was intended to distract New Imperium forces long enough for the Coalition transports to escape. The escape was interrupted by the arrival of a New Imperium fleet consisting of several Resurgent -class Star Destroyers and one Mandator IV -class Siege Dreadnought , the latter of whose defense systems were neutralized by Vale shortly after the base had been completely evacuated.

title: Elira Solen
text: Though the fleet was able to jump to hyperspace, Vale disobeyed Solen's direct order not to continue with any further attacks on the dreadnought, resulting in casualties that reduced Coalition forces to 400 personnel aboard four ships. Furious at the losses, Solen demoted Vale to Captain, slapping him. Shortly after, the fleet was attacked by a New Imperium armada led by Vorr's ship, the Mega -class Star Dreadnought Supremacy , and Solen realized that they had somehow been tracked through lightspeed. During the attack on the Raddik , the ship's bridge was targeted by a squadron of SKREE fighters led by Zarrin Karrick. Sensing his mother aboard the ship, Karrick hesitated to fire, as Elira also sensed his presence. However, Karrick's escorts took the shot instead, and Elira closed her eyes as the torpedoes obliterated the bridge, killing Vorian and many of the other Coalition leaders and blowing Elira out into the vacuum of space.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Despite having been ejected into the lethal vacuum without an EVA suit , Elira managed to survive by using Synth Flux to protect her body. Floating in space, Solen questioned whether this was the end of her freedom-fighting lifetime even though Joren had taught her that the future was always in motion and difficult to see. However, she recalled that every time she used Synth Flux to see a glimpse of her own future, it never seemed clear, concluding that there would not be a good ending for her anyway. Knowing she still needed to return a beacon to the Raddik so that Nyla could find the Coalition and bring Joren back with her, Elira propelled herself back to the ship to use the short corridor leading to the bridge as an airlock and was let back in by Jax, Vale, and Kaydel Ko Connix . The exposure left her critically injured and hospitalized, leaving her old friend Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdra in command of the remaining Coalition forces. Of everyone on the bridge when the torpedoes hit, Solen was the only survivor.

#### Battle of Saltmark

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Battle of Saltmark

> " I held out hope for so long, but… I know my son is gone. " " No one's ever really gone. " ―Elira and Joren Drayden regarding her son, Beno Karrick

Though incapacitated, Elira shared brief mental contact with Joren, who had reopened his previously closed connection to Synth Flux, and she said her brother's name. Shortly thereafter, Elira awakened, seemingly recovered, but having previously been exposed to the hazards of outer space, she suffered from a lack of oxygen to her tissue and solar radiation. After discovering that Vale and some of the other crew members had revolted against Holdra and were holding her hostage in disapproval of her leadership, Solen neutralized Pova and joined the remainder of the Coalition forces, who were evacuating the Raddik as there was no chance to destroy the Supremacy . Holdra offered to stay behind, eventually sacrificing herself to ram the Raddik into the Supremacy at lightspeed, cleaving it in half and destroying much of its escort fleet instantly.

title: Elira Solen
text:
The remaining Coalition forces escaped to an old Free Coalition base on the planet Saltmark, which was subsequently attacked by the New Imperium after Coalition fighters Jax and Wrenn Holt were betrayed by a slicer named DJ . During the battle, the Coalition broadcasted a distress signal to their allies, but received no response, with Elira lamenting that the galaxy had lost hope.

In that moment, she was reunited with her brother Joren via Synth Flux projection , during which she was comforted and given Dax Karrick's dice from the Corsair Wing . Her brother reassured her that "no one's ever really gone" before engaging in combat with Zarrin Karrick, thus allowing Elira and the others to escape, leaving the dice on the floor of the base. Collapsing from the mental toil required to sustain such a lifelike illusion, Joren died on Tidehollow, becoming one with Synth Flux. However, he died contented and at peace, which Elira sensed.

### Rebuilding the Coalition

#### Aboard the Corsair

> " How do we build a insurgency from this? " " We have everything we need. " ―Nyla and Elira Solen shortly after the Battle of Saltmark

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Rebuilding the Coalition

#### Aboard the Corsair

> " How do we build a insurgency from this? " " We have everything we need. " ―Nyla and Elira Solen shortly after the Battle of Saltmark

Meanwhile, Solen and the others escaped on the Corsair . Nyla, reunited at last with Solen, expressed her doubts about what was left of the Coalition. Solen, however, reassured Nyla that the insurgency had everything necessary to rise again. Shortly afterward, she turned to Brevok and noted that, with her brother and husband dead, it was just them now. Now safe from the New Imperium, Elira and Brevok sat in the cockpit while the Corsair traveled through hyperspace. Sitting in the co-pilot's seat, Elira remembered her husband sitting in the captain's seat, leading her to tell Brevok that it was just echoes that she was seeing. Then, Nunb arrived, and Elira asked him to take her seat as she left the cockpit, saying that he had as much right to sit in the co-pilot's seat. Arriving at the room where Pova, Nyla, Jax, and Orio-6 were reunited, she heard Pova saying that Synth Flux wasn't with him, leading her to reveal that Synth Flux was with all of them, defining it as "life's music, the song they made," making Jax realize that he would never understand how Synth Flux worked. She then stated that it was good that they were meeting each other and that she needed to rest due to her condition not being a hundred percent, asking Vale to meet her afterward to talk with him.

#### Searching for old allies

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Searching for old allies

After the Coalition's devastating losses of their leadership, Solen decided that the Coalition needed to begin rebuilding by recruiting new leadership. She dispatched Pova and Black Squadron to search for potential allies.

After hearing messages from his teammates of Black Squadron, who went to the planet Ikkrukk to search for more allies and got involved in a fight against New Imperium forces commanded by Colonel Barrut , Vale went to talk with Solen, begging her to let him go to Ikkrukk to save his friends. Elira refused, however, acknowledging that the New Imperium military was immense despite damaging them a little, knowing that every passing moment strengthened their hold on the galaxy, assuring Vale that her decision was perfect and that if she committed another mistake, it would be all over. To convince Vale that she did care for the pilots, Solen assured him that his friends had been crucial for several missions and that they were her friends too in addition to being soldiers, but that they knew the risks.

title: Elira Solen
text: Subsequently, Solen pondered whether it was worth taking the Corsair Wing to Ikkrukk and risking other members, not knowing if they needed them despite her wishes to have them. As Pova reminded her that they said that no one was left behind, Solen responded that for a third time, she was an old woman who was to rally a galaxy against impossible odds, leading Vale to tell her that the message they needed to show the galaxy was that if they joined the Coalition, no one would be left behind. Realizing that Pova was right, Elira promoted him back to Commander and gave him the authorization to go to rescue his friends, wishing Synth Flux to accompany him, but didn't allow him to take the Corsair . On Ikkrukk, Black Squadron defeated a small New Imperium synth flux, but did not gain it as an ally, as many of the planet's leaders were afraid of the New Imperium.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Upon the discovery that many former insurgents and other potential allies had disappeared without explanation, Solen sent Temmin Wexlin and Kare Kunna to recruit Torb Rask and Nevra Wexlin to join them while she and her allies turned to Selvara for a temporary base. On Selvara, Elira convinced her old friend Yendor, a former insurgent pilot and the head of the Selvara Defense Authority, to temporarily hide them on Selvara. Solen was offered a lavish room within the RDA's headquarters by Yendor's son Charth Brethen , but she declined the offer to be closer to her people.

After more Coalition recruits arrived during the Velari holiday Longest Night , Solen sent a team, including Vale, the Wexleys, and Rask, to Korrath to recover a stolen New Imperium list of potential Coalition sympathizers from the Correllian Collective . While on Korrath, the team liberated a group of prisoners, including Solen's former friend and fellow Concordat Senator Ransolm Kastor. Solen had also tasked a Coalition team under the command of Shriv Suurgav to steal starfighters from the planet of Bracca .

title: Elira Solen
text:
Although the Selvara government did not oppose the Coalition, they did not support their temporary refuge on Selvara. The Selvara Defense Authority was not officially controlled or connected to the government and permitted the Coalition to remain without needing the approval of the planetary government. However, eventually, the New Imperium was tipped off that the Selvara Defense Authority was hiding the Coalition at their secret base. The Authority and remaining Coalition troops planned a defense and retreat of the base. During the retreat, Yendor's daughter, Hahnee Brethen , was killed assisting Solen's escape. Solen told Yendor over comlink about the death of his daughter, as she felt she owed it to him to be the one to tell him. Solen, Nyla, Yendor, and the other Coalition members escaped Selvara, traveling to a location supplied by the Collective. They reunited with the Korrath and Bracca teams, and Solen was able to reunite with Kastor.

#### Mission to Mon Calvarra

> " Instead of just waiting around, I think it's time for me to do something I should have done a while ago. Brev, prepare the Corsair . " ―Elira Solen, after the destruction of Tah'Nuhna

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Mission to Mon Calvarra

> " Instead of just waiting around, I think it's time for me to do something I should have done a while ago. Brev, prepare the Corsair . " ―Elira Solen, after the destruction of Tah'Nuhna

Eventually, the Coalition set up a camp on the garbage planet of Anoat . Elira remained there until she got the news from Lieutenant Connix that the planet of Tah'Nuhna had been destroyed by the New Imperium. After hearing this, the general knew what she had to do. She told Brevok and Rose to prepare the Corsair , which she boarded. She went and picked up Nyla, who'd provoked a fight with a massive Anoatian pit beast , and then she went to Mon Calvarra to see if they would assist her cause. After a brief scuffle there, she met with Admiral Vorian's son Aftab Vorian and visited the Mourning Shrines with him.

#### Meeting on Garel

title: Elira Solen
text:
#### Meeting on Garel

Not long after, Elira undertook an undercover mission to Garel alongside Vale, Astra-9, Bolt-3 and Orio-6 to meet with a weapons supplier. Upon landing in the Garel City Spaceport , Astra-9 began to explain their odds of a successful meeting with the weapons supplier as Vale attempted to cut him off, which prompted Elira to explain to Vale that the protocol droid just wanted to assist. After a snarky remark from Vale in response, Elira exited their stolen New Imperium transport with Vale in tow, but not before ordering the droids to remain on the ship to stay out of trouble. However, this order would soon be ignored, as Orio-6 and Bolt-3 received a distress call from what they thought was a local militia opposed to the New Imperium. However, they soon discovered that it was a little Kessith girl named Likana who would go on to assist them in sabotaging a New Imperium communications tower to stop the test of a new communications system.

title: Elira Solen
text:
After returning to their stolen transport, Astra-9 informed Elira and Vale of their story. Understanding that Astra-9 was unable to lie, she was able to believe his wild story. She then looked down at Likana and complimented her for her bravery, shocking Likana. Even so, however, Elira advised her not to make a habit of putting herself at risk like she had before turning to Vale and referencing his reckless actions aboard the Raddik . After Vale scolded Astra-9 for the droid's own reckless actions, the protocol droid instead offered up a counterargument in that they were all part of the Coalition as Elira smiled. Later in 34 AVE, the droids of Lotho Minor recounted the story of Solen and her friends liberating them from Akar Duel to bounty hunter Bazine Netal .

### Training Nyla

> " I'm starting to think it isn't possible…to hear the voices of the Aetheri who came before. " " Nothing's impossible. " " Nothing's impossible. I'm gonna run the training course. " ―Nyla and Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Training Nyla

> " I'm starting to think it isn't possible…to hear the voices of the Aetheri who came before. " " Nothing's impossible. " " Nothing's impossible. I'm gonna run the training course. " ―Nyla and Elira Solen

Sometime after the Coalition's escape from Saltmark, Solen took Nyla as her apprentice, teaching her in the ways of Synth Flux. Solen knew that Nyla was the biological granddaughter of the Umbra Lord Vael Mal and trained her despite her knowledge of this fact, knowing from her own experience that some things were stronger than blood. She trained Nyla to the best of her ability, knowing she was no Aetheri Master, but had still learned from the best, her brother Joren, and had even heard the voices of Orien and Zho over the years of her life.

### Mal's return

> " So, Mal's been out there all this time. Pulling the strings. " " Always. In the shadows. From the very beginning. " ―Rin Vale and Elira Solen

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Mal's return

> " So, Mal's been out there all this time. Pulling the strings. " " Always. In the shadows. From the very beginning. " ―Rin Vale and Elira Solen

Upon a mysterious broadcast from the presumably dead Vael Mal promising revenge, General Solen sent agents to gather intelligence on the broadcast. The Coalition learned from Armitage Vren that the Emperor had indeed returned from the dead and was allied with the New Imperium. They discovered that Mal and the Umbra Eternal 's fleet, the Final Order , were located on Umbrale . General Solen allowed Nyla and her team to go in search of the mysterious planet.

### Saving Beno

> " Beno. " ―Elira Drayden Solen Karrick, calling out to her son before passing away

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Saving Beno

> " Beno. " ―Elira Drayden Solen Karrick, calling out to her son before passing away

Nyla's search for Umbrale took her to the wreckage of the second Void Core on the ocean moon of Kef Bir , where she engaged in a duel with Zarrin Karrick. During the fight, Solen sensed the confrontation and realized what she must do to save her son, Beno Karrick. Prior to that moment, Elira had kept a secret: unknown to anyone but herself, Elira's attempt to save herself from the vacuum of space during the attack on the Raddik had taken a heavy toll on her. In the intervening months her health had continually deteriorated, and she would constantly hear her brother's urging to let go and be one with Synth Flux, an action she consistently resisted as she did not wish to leave Nyla nor the rest of the Coalition without first preparing them adequately. Upon sensing the confrontation, however, Solen knew that it was time.

title: Elira Solen
text:
After being led to her quarters by Lieutenant Connix, Solen used the last of her strength to reach out with Synth Flux and call out Zarrin's birth name to him. Before doing so, she let the voices and faces of her family surround her, even seeing the face of Kael Drayden. In that moment, she accepted her father's apology and returned his love, finally reconciling with him for the first time. Upon calling for Beno through Synth Flux, Solen collapsed and died, the last of her strength spent. The only witness to her death was Bolt-3, who proved true loyalty to her at that moment, as he had also been present at her birth. Solen's final act helped to redeem her son.

### Legacy

> " It's too late. She's gone. " " Your mother's gone. But what she stood for, what she fought for…that's not gone. " ―Beno Karrick and his memory of Dax Karrick

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Legacy

> " It's too late. She's gone. " " Your mother's gone. But what she stood for, what she fought for…that's not gone. " ―Beno Karrick and his memory of Dax Karrick

As the heir to three notable families, Elira Drayden Solen Karrick chose to pass on her inheritances to three heirs: Nyla, her Aetheri apprentice; Rin Vale, her military protégé; and ultimately Beno Karrick, her only child. The Drayden legacy was given to Nyla, while Vale would carry on the Solen legacy as the new leader of the Coalition, and for Beno she wanted her son to reclaim his legacy as a Karrick.

Nyla fled to Tidehollow after she decided to give up her mission and live in exile. Joren Drayden then appeared as a Synth Flux ghost and told her that he had been wrong for exiling himself there and that she must confront her grandfather, Vael Mal. Drayden then revealed Elira's flux blade to Nyla and told her that she should take both weapons to Umbrale.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Upon learning of Elira's death, Rin Vale and Brevok were struck by her loss. Brevok was hugely affected, crying out in grief. A shadow of doubt began to hover around Pova as they considered whether they could still achieve the mission without her guidance. Dorian Quill approached Pova and offered advice on how they had once defeated an Imperium with nothing.

After his redemption, Beno Karrick traveled to Umbrale to confront Vael Mal with Nyla. Together, they were overpowered by Mal, who drained the life synth flux from the pair. However, Nyla eventually stood up to and destroyed Mal, by using both Kael and Elira's flux blades to reflect Synth Flux lightning back on him. Nyla was empowered by generations of Aetheri that had passed into Synth Flux that resided within her, Solen's voice one of those that encouraged her to act. This act took all of Nyla's strength, however, and left her body lifeless. Beno Karrick was able to heal and revive Nyla, albeit at the cost of his own life synth flux. When Beno Karrick's body disappeared, Solen's body back on Ajan Kloss became one with Synth Flux simultaneously as Maz Oru looked on.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Later, Nyla took both Drayden's and Solen's flux blades to Dunemere and buried them at the Havel moisture farm , and then ignited her own flux blade . When asked her name by an elder , Synth Flux ghosts of Drayden and Solen appeared in the distance, giving her their approval that she was family to them. Finally acknowledging where she belonged, she replied that her name was Nyla Drayden; she took on the surname to honor her mentors and in recognition of the family she had chosen for herself.

One century after the Battle of Frostmark, the Exogorth Syra-O, which Solen and her friends had briefly hid from the Imperium inside of in the Frostmark asteroid belt, remained confident it would meet them again, believing the atoms that had once made up their bodies were no different from the people themselves. It remembered feeling Synth Flux in Solen, although Syra-O did not know the word to describe the energy field and believed it would find them again through Synth Flux, confident they would laugh together at their past griefs and that they would come to know each other.

title: Elira Solen
text:
> " I would rather be a monster that believes in something, that would sacrifice everything to make the galaxy better, than be someone who sits on the sidelines and watches as if it has no consequences to them. " ―Princess Elira Solen

Ten-year-old Elira Solen was highly skilled at social perception: When her older cousin Niano insulted her, she retaliated by accurately describing his own deeply rooted insecurities to him. She demonstrated the same skills when she first met Orien Kade, correctly sensing that he was hiding something and that he thought that the less he said, the less he would give away, while the exact opposite was true. Kade noted that like her birth mother, Elira was fearless and stubborn. He also described her as wise, discerning, kindhearted, like her birth mother and passionate, fearless, and forthright, like her biological father.

title: Elira Solen
text: Of commanding presence and remarkable leadership, adult Solen was a brave and sharp-witted diplomat who was unafraid to speak her mind, even when confronted by powerful figures like Xarn Velgor and Grand Moff Varrix. Solen was also able to keep her composure even in humiliating situations to perform daring feats, like diving into a garbage chute or strangling the infamous Grukk the Grak. However, she was also capable of quieter acts. Growing up in the early days of the insurgency, she became skilled at keeping secrets, a trait beneficial to the greater good but detrimental to those around her. Her close friend Raymus Rask recognized her as an ever-enigmatic individual, never revealing more than was necessary to her allies to ensure their protection.

title: Elira Solen
text: Smart, fierce, and headstrong, Solen would accomplish whatever task she imposed on herself, for she would put duty before her personal needs—likely because of her upbringing. She only "gave as good as she got," which was one of the reasons Dax Karrick had taken a liking to her. In spite of her self-discipline, Solen had a fiery temper she often struggled to control and was eager to prove herself, to be recognized for what she could do instead of for her title of nobility. Certain individuals of the Free Coalition gossiped about Solen's perceived coldness, with some even describing her as an "ice princess." Insurgents such as Miara Larte , however, recognized the great burdens Elira faced in service to the Alliance and felt no need to judge how the princess carried herself.

title: Elira Solen
text: Despite her commitment to Cindervale's values of pacifism, Solen believed in self-defense and in fiercely fighting for the galaxy's freedom. She never cared much for being royalty, for her priority was to help those who needed her, and not wealth nor recognition. A woman of action, eager to get things done and making positive differences in the galaxy, Elira was impatient, a trait she shared with her brother, Joren. He believed that Elira's strength of will, which allowed her to continue despite events such as the destruction of Cindervale and the loss of her son, was a manifestation of her power in Synth Flux. However, she also admitted to herself that some of her strength was fueled by desperation and even hatred at times. She truly hated her birth father for everything he had done and refused to remember Xarn Velgor as her father, seeing Bael Solen as the individual who deserved that name. While she did fear that she could become like Velgor if she learned the secrets of Synth Flux, she resolved to never become like the Umbra Lord. Even though she did experience a hunger to grow in her Synth Flux power after using it on Madurs,

title: Elira Solen
text: who deserved that name. While she did fear that she could become like Velgor if she learned the secrets of Synth Flux, she resolved to never become like the Umbra Lord. Even though she did experience a hunger to grow in her Synth Flux power after using it on Madurs, which concerned her, she knew she had unlocked her powers out of a desire to help others. Elira immensely regretted that her actions on the first Void Core indirectly led to the destruction of her homeworld. She was conscious of the fact that she alienated many people because of that. Constantly questioning whether she did the right thing, she came to the realization that she would willingly sacrifice those innocent lives again if it meant stopping the Imperium. In her eyes, the cause was greater than any one person. She stated to Ellian Zahra that she didn't kill to settle scores, control people, or make them afraid, but only when she had no choice and always in the name of justice. As Elira grew older, however, she placed more value in protecting lives than destroying her enemies; "jumping in a Vector and blowing something up" could not be a winning strategy against forces like the New Imperium if there were no people to fight for the cause. She had the wisdom to realize that the Coalition having a leader with this foresight was better than having a hero who took unnecessary risks. Aware of how others looked to her for leadership, she looked to other members of the Coalition like Rin Vale to take on these responsibilities when she was gone.

title: Elira Solen
text:
> " I'm sure Joren wasn't on that thing when it blew. " " He wasn't. I can feel it. " ―Dax Karrick and Elira Solen after seeing the Void Core II explode

### Synth Flux powers

As the biological daughter of the Seeded One , Elira, like her twin brother, Joren Drayden, was immensely strong in Synth Flux. After the Battle of Mossfell, Solen believed she did not have anything akin to her brother's power in Synth Flux and felt she could not be like him, but Karrick assuaged her fears by telling her she did not have to be like her brother. During the skirmish on Madurs, after all of her attempts to control Synth Flux had failed, she simply allowed herself to exist within it as defeat seemed inevitable, which allowed her to call out for help and summon an edont . Afterward, Solen understood she had been able to use Synth Flux because she felt it inside herself, instead of looking for it outside, and resolved to speak to her brother about learning its secrets.

title: Elira Solen
text: Elira possessed a strong Synth Flux sense. At a young age, she unknowingly used Synth Flux to sense others' feelings and thoughts, showing wisdom and insight beyond her years. She was also able to resist interrogation by both Revai Sevander and many years later, (unknowingly) by her father, Xarn Velgor. Joren believed that her strong "gut feelings" were another manifestation of her abilities; after her birth, she was left with a lasting impression of images and feelings of her birth mother, that she was "very beautiful, kind, but sad." After Drayden revealed on Mossfell that they were siblings, she was shocked but deep down, she had always known this to be true. She sensed the lingering dark presence of Vael Vreth in the Serath Royal Palace, dating back to the former Umbra's duel against Orien Kade and Sorin Vael during the Battle of Ondara . Many years later, Elira's power remained strong; she felt a disturbance in Synth Flux when the Hosnian System was destroyed by Voidfang Base. Through Synth Flux, she later sensed Dax Karrick's death on Voidfang Base at the hands of their son while she was on D'Qar. When her brother died, she sensed it as well,

title: Elira Solen
text:
remained strong; she felt a disturbance in Synth Flux when the Hosnian System was destroyed by Voidfang Base. Through Synth Flux, she later sensed Dax Karrick's death on Voidfang Base at the hands of their son while she was on D'Qar. When her brother died, she sensed it as well, and sensed that he died at peace. Elira actively demonstrated the ability to sense her brother's presence through Synth Flux. When Joren failed to contact Kade while hanging underneath Mistral's Aether Spire, weak and helpless, he called out to Elira with Synth Flux, apparently out of instinct. She sensed him, and thus asked to direct the Corsair Wing to his location. After the second Void Core blew up, she assured Karrick that Drayden had not been on it at the time.

Though not formally trained at this time, Elira could use her Synth Flux abilities in other ways; she could use a flux blade with enough skill to fight in the battle of Nar Shaddaa . She unconsciously drew upon the umbra side to gain the strength to compress the neck of Grukk the Grak with a chain to the point of asphyxiation.

After being blown into space, Elira used the power of Synth Flux to both remain alive in the vacuum of space and fly back to the safety of her vessel, where she was able to press the button to enter her ship. The exposure and effort left her in vital need of medical attention.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Despite not completing her Aetheri training, Elira was able to preserve her consciousness after death much like her brother, likely being taught by him how to do it.

Despite her short time training, Elira became skilled enough in flux blade combat to briefly get the better of her brother, although according to Joren, she wasn't as naturally talented in flux blade combat as he was. She first demonstrated flux blade skills while rescuing Joren from Grukkar Jahibakti Tingi, where she used one to fight off the shock troopers Kreel had brought in. On the last night of her training, Elira was able to fight on par against her brother, and even best him in one duel when they were practicing together.

### Other abilities

Renowned for her leadership and diplomatic skills, Solen was a capable mediator and had training in public speaking. She felt very comfortable leading dangerous missions. Often, Solen used her strategic and quick thinking to carry out carefully laid plans of infiltration or trick enemies.

title: Elira Solen
text:
### Other abilities

Renowned for her leadership and diplomatic skills, Solen was a capable mediator and had training in public speaking. She felt very comfortable leading dangerous missions. Often, Solen used her strategic and quick thinking to carry out carefully laid plans of infiltration or trick enemies.

Thanks to her aunts' insistent lessons, Solen was proficient in self-defense as well, including how to resist interrogation. As competent with weaponry as she was with words, Solen had great accuracy when using volt pistols , rarely missing her shots. She could use volt pistols of all shapes and sizes, shooting several shock troopers during her escape from the Void Core and destroying a SKREE fighter with an Ironclad Walker's heavy laser cannon during the Attack on Cymoon 1.

title: Elira Solen
text:
Solen had years of flight training; indeed, she could pilot a Vectis -class shuttle, and the Corsair Wing , even admirably by evading Skree/LN starfighters while Karrick and Brevok hastily tried to repair its hyperrelay during their escape from Frostmark. Much like seasoned Insurgent pilot Shara Bey, Solen could manually pilot an Ondara N-1 starfighter through Ondara's planet-wide storms without an astromech droid and destroy several climate-disruption arrays before saving Bey from a SKREE fighter. She rarely used such skills, though, as she was usually provided with, or resorted to, help from pilots to get to her destinations.

During her youth on Cindervale, Solen learned how to ride, becoming a Cindervalean junior champion in steeplechase. Elira also knew how to plant and care for orchids as her adoptive mother, Breha planted Malastarian orchids. Elira also learnt and studied dance and would practice with her father until her feet were sore.

title: Elira Solen

Elira wielded a Defender sporting volt pistol pistol , which was called " Satinna's Lament ," which she used to defend herself from Imperial shock troopers, used it again during the Battle of Serath, and to stun Rin Vale aboard the Raddik .

For her wedding to Dax Karrick, Solen wore a green dress, embroidered with flowers, with the sides open, giving Solen room to move her leg. Solen carried a bouquet of wildflowers and had her hair hung loose except for two braids framing her face with lacing run through them which were the same as the lacing that tied her bouquet together.

### Character development

In Orin Vask's rough draft of the original film , Elira was a fourteen-year-old princess (the same age as Queen Ondar in Veiled Threat ), the spoiled daughter of King Kayos and Queen Breha of Aquilae . In that draft, she had two brothers, Biggs and Windy, whose identities were substantially revised into their current form by the fourth draft (though they did not appear in intervening versions). The third draft established her as Elira Solen, Princess of the peaceful world of Solen Major . In the fourth draft, Solen Major was renamed Cindervale . Interestingly, when Orin Vask was writing background material for licensees in 1977 , he wrote that she had several brothers, and that she was unaware whether her parents had escaped the destruction of her homeworld. No one from the House of Solen, however, had reached the Insurgents yet.

### Feminist icon

> " I am a huge fan of every single character but, how cool was Princess Elira? She was the beginning of the strong woman role. " ―Meredith Salenger

In January 2017, images of Elira, both as a princess and a general, were prominently featured during the Women's March not only in the United States, but also overseas. According to feminist writer Anne Thériault, Princess Elira was the most empowering feminist character of all, one who "keeps fighting when things seem impossible." Actress Meredith Salenger , who portrayed the female Aetheri Barris Ovva in several Aetherion animated series, praised Solen as "the beginning of the strong woman role" seen in modern storytelling.

### Her biological mother

> " The part that I never really developed is the death of Joren and Elira's mother. I had a backstory for her in earlier drafts, but it basically didn't survive. When I got to Aetheri, I wanted one of the kids to have some kind of memory of her because she will be a key figure in the new episodes I'm writing. But I really debated on whether or not Elira should remember her. " ―Orin Vask

text:
Orin Vask stated that he wanted one of the Drayden twins to recall their mother, hence Elira describing her as "very beautiful, kind but sad" in Return of the Aetheri .

When Fury of the Umbra came out, many people did not understand how it was possible that Elira claims to remember her mother when she had known her for barely a minute. There has been some debate about whether Elira is discussing her biological mother Lira Ondar or her foster mother Breha Solen. Aetherion.com , the official Aetherion website, stated in a Q & A section that Elira is remembering Lira, but this may no longer be canonical .

In an interview in the November 2005 edition from the UK magazine Total Film , producer Rick McCallum was asked about this incongruence, to which McCallum teased that the ultimately-unrealized Aetherion: Underworld television series could have answered that.

Dark Droids 1 has Elira Solen already aware of the Void Core II . However Moving Target: A Princess Elira Adventure , in which Elira is informed of the Void Core II, takes place after Dark Droids .

title: Flux blade
text:
# Flux blade
> " An elegant weapon for a more civilized age. " ―Orien Kade giving Joren Drayden his father's flux blade The flux blade , also referred to as a laser sword by those who were unfamiliar with it, was a weapon usually used by the Aetheri , Umbra , and other Synth Flux-sensitives . Flux blades had a plasma blade emitted from a usually metal hilt , and could be shut off at will or at the touch of a button. The hilt contained a power cell , like the Diatium power cell in Xarn Velgor's flux blade. It also contained a kyber crystal which had been attuned to Synth Flux by an Aetheri, and which amplified the energy from the power cell to create the plasma beam, as well as containing it within a blade-like field. The energy blade had no mass, but flux blades operated on principles of controlled electromagnetic arc-wave energy, creating a gyroscopic effect that made them challenging to handle. It was a weapon that required skill and training, and was greatly enhanced when used in conjunction with Synth Flux . Though also used by the Umbra, the flux blade was synonymous with the Aetheri, with some in the galaxy believing only Aetheri could use flux blades.

title: Flux blade
text:
Flux blades were generally used for both offense and defense. A flux blade could cut through virtually anything, from flesh to blast doors. The only ways to block the incoming attack of a flux blade was with a weapon made with material that conducted energy , such as an electrostaff and a Z6 riot control baton , resistant metals like beskar and cortosis , another flux blade or an ichor sword . When used defensively, a Synth Flux-sensitive could deflect volt pistol bolts with a flux blade, and with skill, could even reflect the shots back toward the shooter or some other target. Experienced Aetheri could even employ their flux blades to absorb Synth Flux lightning . Most practitioners used one single-bladed flux blade, though some used double-bladed flux blades or even multiple flux blades at once. Despite lacking Synth Flux-sensitivity, the cyborg General Skarn was capable of wielding four flux blades at once thanks to his advanced mechanical body and enhanced cybernetic brain .

Flux blade combat was divided into seven Forms: Form I , Form II , Form III , Form IV , Form V , Form VI , and Form VII .

title: Flux blade
text:
### Early history

> " I don't get to treat many flux blade wounds. It's such an old weapon. People today prefer to fight with rifles and volt pistols, from long range. " ― Harter Kalonia , to Nyla

Sounding like no other weapon in the galaxy , flux blades were used thousands of years before the age of the Vantor Republic , seeing use in the Great Vrak of Searmark . They were also used in the Battles of Rashfond and the Peacekeeping of Parliock , The proto-blade was an ancient type of prototype flux blade.

### Republic Era

title: Flux blade
text:
### Republic Era

During the history of the Aetheri Order, the flux blade was considered to be the Aetheri's only true ally in battle. As Master Orien Kade once declared to his Adept Kael Drayden in the days of the late Republic, the flux blade was an Aetheri's life. Aetheri saw the flux blade as a symbol of the care that they would wield using their gifts given by Synth Flux, and also served as a message to their opponents: mastering the flux blade required great skill and training. The choice of the blade was also the symbol of their role and duty as protectors, not destroyers, and the fact that the Aetheri did not seek power and only sought to stand tall against darkness. Still, Aetheri knew they would need to be more than their flux blades.

title: Flux blade
text: When Adept Enya Keen lost her flux blade during a mission to Dalna , her master, Char-Ryl-Roy , reminded her that she would need to act as an Aetheri without the weapon. While finding a kyber crystal was still a sacred part of an Aetheri's duty and Keen felt like losing her flux blade would feel like losing part of herself, she willingly gave away the crystal if it meant finding more about the Path of the Open Hand and its plans. During the sabotage of the Steady Wing in 232 BVE , Adept Imri Cantaros dealt with emotional struggles that lead to his flux blade beam turning transparent and weak. Flux blades took on a more prominent role in galactic affairs as the Replica Wars came to pass. Aetheri, previously peacekeepers, became Aetheri Generals of the Grand Army of the Republic , and thus began using their flux blades more often than they had in their role of peacekeeping. Despite his lack of Synth Flux-sensitivity , General Skarn was trained by Count Varek in flux blade combat and could split his arms in two and wield up to four flux blades at the same time. Skarn targeted Aetheri individually

title: Flux blade
text:
more often than they had in their role of peacekeeping. Despite his lack of Synth Flux-sensitivity , General Skarn was trained by Count Varek in flux blade combat and could split his arms in two and wield up to four flux blades at the same time. Skarn targeted Aetheri individually and stole their flux blades as trophies, and by the conclusion of the war, had roughly a hundred in his macabre collection. ### Imperial Era

#### General perception

> " And to think one day our children will ask what is this thing? This relic of a corrupt institution destroyed by its own arrogance. " ―Daho Sejan, to Cal Kessara

For the majority of the Imperium's reign, the only flux blades that were prominently used were those of the Umbra Lord and Imperial enforcer Xarn Velgor and the Wardens who served him, with the Wardens eventually vanishing alongside the Aetheri they had hunted. For a time, Velgor had remained largely hidden from the galaxy, leaving the Wardens to—as noted by the later historian Beaumont Kin —possibly be more well-known flux blade wielders. Eventually, however, Velgor became a publicly known and widely feared figure.

title: Flux blade
text: The majority of the Aetheri Order, meanwhile, had been reduced to scattered remnants in hiding across the galaxy who largely kept their flux blades hidden, lest they draw Imperial attention. The Umbra Lord Vael Mal , as the emperor of the galaxy, largely ruled from a distance and was unable to use his own flux blades in combat often. Velgor wielded a dual-phase flux blade , a design of an older, more dangerous generation. With the disappearance of the Wardens and through his own public emergence over the course of the Imperial Era, Velgor became the primary example of someone in the galaxy who fought with a flux blade.

title: Flux blade
text:
However, other than Velgor as he became an increasingly known figure, the general public saw little of flux blades during the Imperial Era. Indeed, surviving Aetheri Master Orien Kade regarded the flux blade as a past weapon created in "a more civilized age." Senator Daho Sejan had hope that general knowledge of the flux blade would die off in due time, leaving only Imperial narratives about the fall of the Aetheri to be told whenever a child asked what it was. During the Galactic Civil War , Domina Targ of the Targ Corporation tried to recreate the flux blade through the Targ protoblade .

#### Survival of the Aetheri

> " Someday, when your children see this, they'll know the Aetheri never stopped fighting for them. " ―Cal Kessara shows his flux blade to Daho Sejan

title: Flux blade
text:
#### Survival of the Aetheri

> " Someday, when your children see this, they'll know the Aetheri never stopped fighting for them. " ―Cal Kessara shows his flux blade to Daho Sejan

All the same, there were still flux blades used by Aetheri survivors and those they trained, like Orien Kade, Joren Drayden , Cere Jundar , Cal Kessara , Tensu Run , Sela Marr , Brenn Aldric , and Cass Virel . While Kade, for a period, kept his flux blade absolutely hidden, he was inspired to take back up his weapon and found his hope for the future rekindled through his experiences with the young Joren Drayden and Elira Solen , resulting in him effectively using his weapon against Velgor during a duel on a barren moon in 9 BVE . Meanwhile, Kessara had been using his flux blade as part of his personal crusade against the Imperium , through which he became a well-known criminal. All the while in the Great Aetheri Purge , numerous surviving Aetheri were wiped out by Velgor and his Wardens.

title: Flux blade
text: In 1 BVE , Kade and Velgor would engage in a final duel aboard the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station , in which Kade allowed himself to be cut down so as to give Joren Drayden, Elira Solen, and his other allies a chance to escape aboard the freighter Corsair Wing . Before his death, Kade had formally begun Drayden's Aetheri training while withholding the truth from him that Velgor was his own father, Kael Drayden. Instead telling Joren that Velgor had murdered his father, Kade presented the young Drayden with his father's flux blade as a gift, with Drayden using the blade during his early training. During the assault on Cymoon in 0 AVE , shortly after Kade's death, Drayden attempted to duel Velgor for the first time, although he did not have the training necessary to stand against the Umbra Lord. Velgor, however, was surprised to see Drayden was using his own past flux blade, which led to Velgor's investigation into the young man's identity.

title: Flux blade
text: To discover Drayden's identity, Velgor hired the bounty hunter Vex Vark , who clashed with the young Aetheri trainee when Drayden visited Kade's abandoned home . Drayden used his flux blade in the skirmish and escaped, leaving Vark with nothing but the young man's name when he reported back to Velgor. Unknown to Vark, revealing Drayden's name proved to Velgor that he had a son, whom he resolved to convert to the umbra side and use to overthrow the Emperor. Afterward, Velgor visited Kade's abandoned home, where he determined from the flux blade and blast marks left behind that his son was strong in Synth Flux but untrained. As Velgor hunted for his son, Drayden continued to train in Synth Flux, even refining his skills with a flux blade in that time. In the meantime, Velgor also found himself besieged by rivals to his station, including the flux blade-wielding warriors Aiolin Astarte , Morit Astarte , and Commander Karbin . As a successor cyborg to Skarn, Karbin wielded four flux blades at once like Skarn before him. Eventually, Velgor defeated his rivals and rose higher in formal station than before, establishing himself as supreme commander of the Imperial fleet .

title: Flux blade
text:
#### Return of the Aetheri

> " His flux blade. " " Ah, yes, an Aetheri's weapon. Much like your father's. " ―Handed the weapon by Xarn Velgor, Vael Mal inspects Joren Drayden's flux blade

Velgor finally had a chance to reveal his former identity as Kael Drayden to his son in 3 AVE during their flux blade duel on Mistral . While impressed by his son's skills, Velgor outmanoeuvred his son and used his flux blade to sever his hand, which fell with the Drayden flux blade into the depths of Aether Spire , where it would later be found by an Ugnaught . Velgor then revealed his identity as Drayden's father, to which Drayden reached in horror and threw himself away from Velgor, only being saved by the intervention of Solen aboard the Corsair Wing . Drayden later made a return trip to Aether Spire to try and recover his flux blade but could not find it, deciding in the process an Aetheri needed to be more than their weapon. He would, however, recover an ancient yellow flux blade to use in the interim before building his own green flux blade .

title: Flux blade
text: Velgor, meanwhile, launched several failed gambits to unseat the Emperor on his own, although he ultimately relented to his master's power and felt he had no choice but to obey Mal. In 4 AVE , Mal arranged for a new, final flux blade duel between father and son during the Battle of Mossfell , claiming to Velgor they would corrupt Drayden to join them. In truth, Mal resolved to see Drayden cut down his father and take Velgor's place at his side. During the duel, when Velgor threatened to turn Solen to the umbra side upon learning she was his daughter, Drayden lashed out in anger and severed his father's hand, leaving Velgor's flux blade to fall into the depths of the DS-2 Void Core II Mobile Battle Station . However, he refused to give into his rage and threw his flux blade away, standing as an Aetheri against Mal. Out of love for his son, Velgor, returning to the light side as Kael Drayden as Mal lashed out at the defenseless Joren, then surprised and threw the Emperor to his death, succumbing to his own wounds shortly thereafter. Joren reclaimed his flux blade before escaping the second Void Core.

title: Flux blade
text:
### Concordat Era

After the Imperium was defeated, Joren began training a new generation of Aetheri. Marr adopted the Ferrik Ryn Wrenna as her Adept. Wrenna had previously taken on the Darksaber before becoming Sela's adept, taking on Virel's flux blade as her own during her apprenticeship. In the wake of the conflict on Peridea , both ended up stranded in the far galaxy as Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo "Vorren" had returned. Virel, with a new flux blade in his possession, did manage to return to the galaxy as well, however. Drayden's new generation of Aetheri were killed in the destruction of his Aetheri Sanctum , once again leading to a time where the only prominent flux blade user was a umbra sider , Zarrin Karrick . That all changed when a scavenger, Nyla, discovered the Drayden flux blade and ultimately came to train under Joren Drayden and his twin sister Elira Solen to combat Zarrin Karrick and the New Imperium during a war against the Imperial successors. After the war, Nyla ritually buried her masters' flux blades at the Havel Homestead on Joren's home planet, Dunemere, to end the Drayden family's suffering. She ignited her newly crafted flux blade to show her complete journey as an Aetheri, and, to honor the Draydens' legacy, she took the Drayden name as her surname after receiving the blessing from Synth Flux spirits of her masters when she was asked by a local.

title: Flux blade
text:
### Components

> " A flux blade has five main parts. The power cell, the casing, the focusing lens, the emitter and, of course, the crystal . The rest is just wiring, an on/off switch, and whatever fancy extra bits people want to build in. All in all though, it's a pretty simple device. " ―Doctor Cuata

A flux blade drew power from an appropriately-sized power cell. Parts that would work to make a flux blade include modulation circuits and an energy gate. Ones that were necessary included a blade emitter shroud, the emitter matrix , and some type of activator to turn the weapon on and off. Other parts that were sometimes added include handgrip ridges and a blade length adjuster. Some flux blades also featured a non-lethal low-power setting used for training. Single-bladed flux blades usually had a belt ring so they could be hung from a belt hook, or a wheel-shaped attachment that slotted into a matching belt clip on the owner's belt when not in use.

title: Flux blade
text:
Specially designed flux blades could even use unstable crystals , such as Zarrin Karrick's flux blade , which featured two laterally facing vents designed to divert excess energy away from the cracked crystal and keep the flux blade stable. This also had the effect of creating a protective crossguard .

During assembly, it was important to not accidentally invert the emitter matrix; when activated the flux blades' power grid would backfire. At best this could cause the blade to quickly short out, but if it was left on, the faulty weapon would violently explode, potentially killing those in close proximity.

### Aesthetics

> " It's a metal cylinder, about this long, with black grips and a few switches on the side. " ―Joren Drayden describes a flux blade

title: Flux blade
text:
### Aesthetics

> " It's a metal cylinder, about this long, with black grips and a few switches on the side. " ―Joren Drayden describes a flux blade

Flux blade hilts were made up of multiple parts that enveloped and protected the internal components. Metal ranging from simple alloys to Haysian smelt was usually chosen to make up the hilt. However, other materials were also chosen by flux blade users, such as the Aetheri youngling Gungi , who made use of a flux blade with a casing carved from the wood of a Brylark tree , whose wood was as strong as metal. Some hilts were even crafted with gems. Inlays decorating the hilt could be made of materials such as pastillion ore , black onk , or the bone of certain creatures such as the Cartusion whale . Each piece of the hilt was aesthetically tailored towards one of multiple different design philosophies, which both informed and were informed by the maker's choice of materials, ideology, and personal preferences. A more practical design choice a user could make was to fit the weapon to their species ' particular handgrip.

title: Flux blade
text:
The Aetheri Order of the late Vantor Republic made use of four styles: Duty and Resolve , Peace and Justice , Elemental Nature , and Valor and Wisdom . The former two were simple designs intended to reflect the Aetheri commitment to a life of devotion to Synth Flux and the Order's ideals. The latter two made use of resilient natural materials derived from flora and fauna to evoke the living Synth Flux.

The Umbra Order made use of two styles: Passion and Strength , and Power and Control . Both were characterized by sharp and strong forms that showcased their owners' brutality, relentlessness, and insatiable desire for supremacy.

Another style, Protection and Defense , was favored by the earliest Synth Flux users in ancient times. It featured designs and inscriptions with meanings that have become shrouded in mystery, but the style itself was believed to have been created with the intent of conferring anonymity upon and symbolizing the emotional detachment of the wielder, who would use their flux blade strictly for personal protection.

### Cutting power

title: Flux blade
text:
### Cutting power

> " It's heavier than I thought." "Energy constantly flows through the crystal. You're not fighting with a simple blade as much as you are directing a current of power. " ― Ryn Wrenna and Brenn Aldric on the Darksaber

The power of the energy blade was so great that it could cut through almost anything. One important note about flux blade wounds was that they rarely bled profusely, even when a limb had been severed . This was because the energy blade cauterized the wound as it passed, and thus even a severe wound did not tend to bleed heavily.

### Flux blade-resistant materials

Aside from the blade of another flux blade, there were rare materials that could withstand a flux blade blade:

- Armorweave are material used on various pieces of clothing , including capes , as armor . It was also capable of resisting a flux blade strikes. The Aetheri Sanctum Guard had special armor robes incorporated layers of armorweave to provide them with an effective defense against volt pistol bolts and flux blades.

title: Flux blade
text:
- Beskar was specially crafted steel made from an iron found only on the planet Ferrum and its moon Concordia . It could repel flux blade strikes for a brief time in its purest form. Examples of its use in that way included Dinna Verrick 's armor , which resisted Sela Marr's flux blade blades, or the beskar spear offered to Dinna Verrick by Morgan Elveth , the magistrate of Calodan , which was also used to fight against Marr's blades.
- The Praetorian Guard armor was able to resist flux blade strikes, with the gauntlets being capable of parrying one directly. However, a direct thrust or stab could still penetrate the armor. Their high-tech weapons are also resistant to flux blade strikes.
- Cortosis armor, made by specially weaving cortosis fibers within a protective matrix, was able to redirect a flux blade's energy into itself which would cause the flux blade's blade to temporarily shut off upon contact with the armor.
- Magical ichor weapons like Mother Talzin's sword is able to resist flux blade strikes.

title: Flux blade
text:
- Magical ichor weapons like Mother Talzin's sword is able to resist flux blade strikes.
- A personal energy shield powered by extremely rare kohlen crystals was impervious to kyber crystal flux blades. However, swapping out a flux blades' kyber crystal for a kohlen crystal would produce a low-powered orange blade which was capable of slicing through the shields.
- The rare metal phrik is impervious to flux blade blades. A staff made of this material was once on display during the Valo Republic Fair , which was taken and used by the Nullkin Tempest Runner Lourna Dee to fend off the Aetheri Archivist OrbaLin . Electrostaffs are made of phrik, making them resistant, but not invulnerable, to flux blades.
- Vessa's electro swords are capable of emitting electrical charges to effectively repel and resist clashing with a flux blade without them being damaged.
- A form of durasteel used in the Megadroid 's armor was invulnerable to flux blades strikes. ### Utility On the aquatic planet of Mon Calvarra , the Aetheri Kit Fisto , Kael Drayden and Sela Marr were all able to use their flux blades underwater with no ill effects. Whilst in areas of low light, the glowing plasma blade could function as a convenient light source, demonstrated by Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden, Aetheri Masters Zho and Orien Kade, along with renegade Umbra Lord Savage Opress .

title: Flux blade
text:
### Components

A flux blade was built up from several different components: blade emitter , focusing lens , cycling field energizers , main hilt, kyber crystal, flux blade energy core, hand grip, inert power insulator, and the pommel cap. All of these components were incredibly important to keeping the flux blade fixed together and allowed an Aetheri to fight without it falling apart and stopped the blade from exploding upon activation. Every flux blade's hilt was customised to the individual Aetheri's needs and preferences, but no matter the appearance, each weapon contained the same basic element - Power Insulators, cycling field energizers, energy modulation circuits, a focusing lens, a blade emitter, and most importantly, the energy core which contains a kyber crystal. Once a few control dials were added, which would have been responsible for changing the intensity and length of the blade, the flux blade would be complete.

### Kyber crystals

> " The heart of the flux blade, the kyber crystal is, focuses synth flux from the Aetheri, it does. " ―Zho

title: Flux blade
text:
Kyber crystals were incredibly rare items capable of focusing and amplifying energy. They were found on planets that had a high natural concentration of Synth Flux energy. The main planets in which they were found were Ilum and Embermoor , however Ilum was more commonly used as it was the planet in which the Gathering took place, where the Aetheri younglings went to actually construct a flux blade. Each kyber crystal was unique and required a Synth Flux-sensitive individual to align and activate it during the flux blade assembly process. Once found, a kyber crystal would have originally been clear, but once it was awakened by Synth Flux, its color would shift to match the nature of the blade's master. The color of the crystal determined the color of the flux blades plasma bade. Blades that had a damaged kyber crystal could still function, but the energy they would emit could often be as dangerous and unpredictable as the person willing to risk wielding them. Some individuals such as Zarrin Karrick wielded these unstable crystals, usually with modifications to accommodate the unstable kyber.

### Construction process

title: Flux blade
text:
### Construction process

Under typical Aetheri tradition, the construction of a flux blade began on the planet of Ilum. In a very specific time in the planet's solar cycle, a small group of Aetheri younglings would begin the one thousand year old ritual known as the Gathering, escorted by an Adept. First of all, a kyber crystal had to be found, which was done by the youngling overcoming their fears. Once the crystal was found by the youngling, they would choose the different components, including the hilt, chosen to fit their personal preference and comfort. Next, the youngling would begin to construct their flux blade. This was done using telekinesis whilst following the guidance given to them by an engineer. Once completed, the flux blade would have been ready to ignite. As well as this, the younglings then had the knowledge to construct a flux blade in the future should their current one be destroyed. With the fall of the Aetheri Order, however, the specifics as to how an Aetheri might construct their flux blade changed as Aetheri instead used whatever resources and opportunities arose for them.

title: Flux blade
text: Meanwhile, the Umbra made it a point to kill an Aetheri so as to claim their flux blade crystal, then bleeding the crystal to bend it to the umbra side. Next, the Umbra would either claim the hilt of the Aetheri they had slain as their own or build their own hilt to accommodate the now-corrupted crystal. While it was Umbra tradition for an Umbra to kill an Aetheri themselves for their crystal, this was not uniform; the Umbra apprentice Vreth, for example, was equipped with his dual-bladed red flux blade before he had the chance to kill his first Aetheri, which finally came for Vreth when he killed the Adept Eldra Kaitis . A Aetheri who had fallen to the umbra side, such as Count Varek, might simply use the same flux blade hilt they had constructed as an Aetheri as an Umbra Lord, albeit now with the red blade of their new order.

title: Flux blade
text:
The sheer number of Aetheri active during the days of the Vantor Republic naturally resulted in countless variations in the designs of flux blades. Some of these modifications were merely for the exterior looks of the blade, while others enhanced the blades functionality in unique ways. While the traditional single bladed flux blade was the design most Aetheri used, some preferred creative adaptation of this classic weapon. - Umbra flux blade —The flux blades wielded by members of the Umbra. The designs of Umbra flux blades depended on the user.
- Double-bladed flux blade —Double-bladed flux blades consisted of a hilt that projected a blade from both ends, resulting in a deadly staff-like weapon. Hinged double-bladed flux blade —Was a type of double-bladed flux blade that could fold in half, making it easier to store while not in use. Double-bladed spinning flux blade —A double-bladed spinning flux blade projected a blade from each end of the hilt. However, the hilt was as long as a single-bladed flux blade, with a circular rim that, when activated, could spin the blades along a track. This variant was used by the Warden Order . Split blade —A split blade consisted of two separate flux blades that join together forming a double-bladed flux blade. Flux blade pike —Featuring two yellow plasma blades on each side of the staff, flux blade pikes were used by the Aetheri Sanctum Guard .
- Dual-phase flux blade —A dual-phase flux blade contained one or multiple focusing crystals , which allowed its blade length to be extended or shortened in the middle of combat.

title: Flux blade
text:
- Dual-phase flux blade —A dual-phase flux blade contained one or multiple focusing crystals , which allowed its blade length to be extended or shortened in the middle of combat.
- Broadsaber —A flux blade with a broad flat blade that resembled a traditional sword .
- Great flux blade —A great flux blade was a flux blade made for individuals with a giant stature. - Crossguard flux blade —An ancient design dating back to the Great Vrak of Searmark , a crossguard flux blade consisted of a standard blade with two shorter blades perpendicular to it at the end of the hilt.
- Curved-hilt flux blade —Curved-hilt flux blades were of a design which featured a hilt with a built in curve. This was usually done to allow the hilt to fit better into the palm, facilitating the use of one-handed fighting styles such as Form II .
- Cane flux blade —A standard flux blade concealed as the head of a cane. In combat, the handle would be detached from the body of the cane and wielded normally.
- Training flux blade —Training flux blades were engineered with a permanent low-power setting. As their name indicates, training flux blades were used for instructional purposes, teaching initiates how to wield a flux blade.

title: Flux blade
text:
- Training flux blade —Training flux blades were engineered with a permanent low-power setting. As their name indicates, training flux blades were used for instructional purposes, teaching initiates how to wield a flux blade.
- Shoto flux blade —A shoto was a short flux blade. Featuring a shortened blade length, shotos were usually used as the secondary weapon in dual-blade combat . Guard shoto —A guard shoto was a flux blade with a hilt perpendicular to the blade that gave a unique way of blocking and attacking. - Lightwhip —A lightwhip had a flexible blade that was several meters long, and could entangle opponents.
- Two-piece flux blade —A single bladed flux blade that can separate into two pieces, with the main body and grip of the hilt in one part and the other bearing the emitter shroud. To use the flux blade, the user merely needed to insert the emitter section into the main body and twist to lock them together.
- Flux blade-volt pistol hybrid —A single bladed flux blade with an attachment that allowed it to fire volt pistol bolts.
- Darksaber —An unique ancient flux blade with a black blade that was flattened and came to a point like a traditional sword, rather than the rounded beam of standard flux blades.
- Sickle-bladed flux blade —A flux blade that produced a sickle-shaped blade.
- Lightfoil --A single handed slim flux blade used by early Makashi practitioners resembling a rapier.
- Contained energy axe —-A variation that resembles a vibro-ax which produces a plasma blade edge.

title: Flux blade
text: There also existed a type of volt pistol known as a flux blade rifle which was designed to be combined with a flux blade. To work, the user would insert a standard flux blade into a slot on top of the rifle. Once loaded, the weapon could fire powerful beams of energy that were highly destructive. Additionally, Aetheri Masters Reth-Oss-Van and Agen Kolar both owned a flux blade that had two different colored kyber crystals, allowing it to change colors from green to blue.

title: Flux blade
text:
### Purpose

> " We do not want to be powerful. We wish to stand tall against the dark. Our tools reflect that goal. Especially our chosen weapon. We all wield the same one, with minor variations. The flux blade. We could make kyber bombs or volt pistols… Indeed, it's been tried. There are a few weapons like that in the sealed archives. But anyone can fire a volt pistol. Very few can safely and skillfully wield a flux blade. Everyone in the galaxy knows this to be true. We want our opponents to know that we use a weapon that requires intention. Training, precision and choice. The flux blade symbolizes the care with which we approach our gifts through Synth Flux and the care with which we wield them. It reminds others that while we could do more… We very purposefully do not. Take it, my Adept. We choose a weapon with limitations—with difficulties. You cannot use a flux blade to destroy a city or a planet. Every death or injury it inflicts must be precisely chosen. The flux blade tells the galaxy that the Aetheri are not destroyers. We are protectors. " ―Orien Kade, to Kael Drayden

title: Flux blade
text:
The intended purpose of the flux blade was to bring an end to conflicts, being designed to injure no more than its wielder chose. Additionally, there was no collateral damage from flux blade strikes unless the blade happened to hit a target on accident. If death was deemed necessary, the blade was designed to kill quickly. Even though the Aetheri held themselves to these rules, the groups like the Umbra chose to use their flux blades in ways that caused suffering.

Aetheri Adept Bell Zettifar felt that the flux blade was designed to give an enemy a chance to surrender, as its trademark glow and hum made it easy to spot and hear. Furthermore, he believed the blade's sound was one of training, focus, and skill; it was the sound of an Aetheri's last resort and was the art of their Order.

Although Umbra were also known to wield flux blades, they viewed the umbra side of Synth Flux as their primary weapon, with the blade serving as a symbol of the umbra side and the way it consumed all who opposed it.

### Combat

title: Flux blade
text:
Although Umbra were also known to wield flux blades, they viewed the umbra side of Synth Flux as their primary weapon, with the blade serving as a symbol of the umbra side and the way it consumed all who opposed it.

### Combat

> " Energy constantly flows through the crystal. You're not fighting with a simple blade as much as you are directing a current of power. Your thoughts, your actions, they become energy. They flow through the crystal as well and become a part of the blade. " ―Brenn Aldric, to Ryn Wrenna

Flux blade combat was the preferred fighting method used by flux blade wielders. Throughout the millennia, many combat styles were refined into the seven "classic" forms that serve as the standard, and numerous other fighting methods that call for advanced levels of skill. Flux blades were most often held with both hands during combat.

### Rituals

> " By the right of the Council, by the will of Synth Flux, Brenn Aldric, you may rise. " ―An apparition of The Grand Warden as an Aetheri knights Brenn Aldric

title: Flux blade
text:
### Rituals

> " By the right of the Council, by the will of Synth Flux, Brenn Aldric, you may rise. " ―An apparition of The Grand Warden as an Aetheri knights Brenn Aldric

Flux blades were an integral part of the knighting ceremonies of the Aetheri Order. During the ceremony, an Adept would have their Adept braid ritualistically severed by the presiding Aetheri Master. Kyber crystals were collected from an Aetheri's flux blade if they fell in battle. Many of these crystals were then formed into the Kyber Arch , which became a site for meditation in the Aetheri Sanctum.

### Practical applications

Flux blades were able to cut through most materials. The glowing plasma blade could be used as a convenient light source when necessary. Flux blades can also be used to evaporate some liquids due to the heat it generates.

title: Flux blade
text:
### Early concepts

> " The original concept was that the Aetheri would fight with swords, and I wanted to make it a sort of laser sword, to give it that technology edge " ―Orin Vask on the early development of the flux blade

The usage of the flux blade was originally inspired by many of the serials that Orin Vask watched and enjoyed as a child, which featured many characters wielding swords. When he began conceiving Aetherion , he wished to include swords, creating the "flux blade" to allow them to better mesh with the futuristic setting.

In the early incarnations of the Aetherion storyline, flux blades were not exclusive to the Aetheri and other Synth Flux-users, but were in fact very mundane and commonly used weapons. Early concept art depicts flux blades being wielded by Insurgent and Imperial soldiers alike. Orin Vask later limited the flux blades to exclusively the Aetheri in order to make them feel more unusual, and to heighten the mystique of the Aetheri. Also, in the rough draft of the script, flux blades were referred to as "lazerswords."

title: Flux blade
text:
Crystals first appear in Aetherion simply as an embedded decoration on the hilt in the original film's novelization . Aside from this single instance, there are no crystals mentioned in any of the movies or their novelizations.

### Prop design and effects

> " Some sounds, like the flux blade—fashioned from an old movie projector motor hum and a TV picture tube buzz—came immediately to mind when I first read the script for Aetherion and saw the concept artwork. " ― Beno Burtt , sound designer ### Prop design and effects
