> " Chances are...This is the last voyage of the Harbinger . So let's make it a memorable one. " ―Drayden to Solen and Karrick

Sometime later, Drayden and Solen rendezvoused with insurgent leadership. Admiral Vorian, General Dodonna, and Vela Sess presented them with the task of providing aid to the people of Tureen VII , a planet that had provided aid to the insurgency in the past. A heavily blockaded planet with Imperial bases on both of its moons and swarms of SKREE fighters in orbit, the Alliance could not risk sending the fleet. Joren and Elira proposed stealing an Imperial Iron Cruiser and using it to infiltrate the blockade. Despite some reluctance from Dodonna, Vorian and Sess realized that it was the only choice left.

#### Skorii-Lei Rescue

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Skorii-Lei Rescue

Afer the hijacking of the Harbinger , Elira ended up grievously injured on the planet Skorii-Lei . Cared for by former engineer Pash Davane and carrying vital Alliance information, Solen was pursued by shock troopers and barely managed to escape aboard the Corsair Wing with Drayden, Karrick, and Brevok. Aboard the Corsair , Davane provided Drayden with Elira's data tape, which he noted was a sign of great trust between the two of them. With her place as a friend of the Alliance confirmed, Drayden and his allies returned Davane to her home on Skorii-Lei.

#### Journey to Vagadarr system

> " You remind me of him. But more than that... you remind me of me. You... you're nothing but a frightened child, just like I was. Do you know the only thing I was good at... when I was a child? Walking away. " ―Garro to Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text:
> " You remind me of him. But more than that... you remind me of me. You... you're nothing but a frightened child, just like I was. Do you know the only thing I was good at... when I was a child? Walking away. " ―Garro to Drayden

Despite the escape from the Harbinger , the heroes quickly realized that Astra-9 was captured during the commotion, and Drayden was unable to stop Bolt-3 from commandeering a Vector to rescue the protocol droid on his own. With his own Vector's hyperrelay temporarily disabled, he resumed reading Beno Kade's journal. Identifying a symbol in the journal as a star map , Drayden decided to visit the Vagadarr system after reading of an Aetheri Master who had ventured there in the past and encountered enormous giants made of living stone that gave those in close proximity a power known as Stonepower . Drayden hoped that going there would give him the knowledge he needed to save Bolt-3 and Astra-9.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Like the Aetheri Master before him, Drayden was able to navigate through the planet 's heavy debris field and land on the surface, where he encountered Garro , the last remaining native human, who initially wanted to use Drayden's life synth flux to kill the few remaining giant children. Determined to protect them, Drayden inspired Garro to change his mind and sacrifice his own life synth flux to revive a dead giant. Drayden and the giant children then ventured into the giant's cave to find the heart of the mountain and finish what Garro started in reviving the giant, thus completing the mission of the Master from years past and taking another step in his journey to becoming an Aetheri .

#### Horox III

> " So, come, shake hands, have dinner with the nice lady, and we walk away with an actual sentient Ancient Aetheri. You get your teacher, I get an eyewitness to the Ancient past." "I'm not sure.." "C'mon, are you out, farm boy? Or are you in, Aetheri Knight? " ―Vexa and Joren Drayden on the visit to Ktath'atn

title: Joren Drayden
text: Sometime later, as the Alliance was setting up a temporary outpost on Horox III , Drayden went to a local bar . Threatened by its denizens for being a human, he was forced to defend himself against them despite his warnings that he would be able to defeat them in a fight. The fight was compounded when Doctor Vexa, who had lied to Sana Starric in order to find Drayden, arrived and sparked the anger of the entire bar after saying Drayden was with her, forcing Drayden, Vexa, and Black Zazzik to fight the entire bar. After the fight, Drayden told Vexa he did not want her following him because he did not want to have anything to do with someone who worked for Velgor, but she caught his attention by saying she knew where to find an Aetheri Master.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden first refused to admit he was trying to be an Aetheri, Vexa explaining that she had figured it out from Velgor's vendetta and Drayden's one-in-a-million shot to destroy the Void Core plus his general talent. She introduced him to the Rur crystal of the ancient Aetheri splinter group known as the Ordu Aspectu with an ancient Aetheri personality inside of it. By playing off Drayden's hopes to be better with Synth Flux and a true Aetheri Knight, Vexa convinced an initially hesitant Joren to visit the Screaming Citadel with her, explaining that that introducing him to the Queen of Ktath'atn as an Aetheri would convince the Queen to reactive the crystal for them. On the way there, Drayden reaquainted himself with 0-0-0 and VT-1, remembering the former for electrocuting him and the latter from Bolt kicking him. Drayden lamented not telling Karrick, Solen, or Starric about where he was going, but he and Vexa both agreed they would have tried to stop them and they had no time to waste.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Meanwhile, at the Insurgent Outpost on Horox III, Karrick then enlisted Starric' help in communicating with Drayden's temporary R5 astromech droid S4 , who could only speak Binary and thus was not easily able to communicate with Solen. Solen asked the droid for Drayden's whereabouts but the droid responded that he could not tell. Questioning the droid, Starric learned that Drayden did not go by himself but that he went with Doctor Vexa. An unhappy Elira and Karrick wondered why Drayden would go with Vexa, Solen suggesting she kidnapped Drayden while Karrick and Starric suspect she could have reprogrammed the droid to keep a secret.

#### The Screaming Citadel

The Queeen of Ktath'atn

> " I know every sort of creature you can image, Doctor. And many I'm sure you cannot. They have all been paraded through the halls of this citadel. All by people desperate to gain my favor. But never once has anyone brought me an Aetheri " ―The Queen of Ktath'atn to Drayden and Vexa

title: Joren Drayden
text: After arriving on Ktath'atn, Drayden and the others encountered a mob of villagers. Drayden wants to help feed them and Vexa just calls him adorable and has Zazzik scare them off. After making the trek to the the entire party, except for Zazzik were allowed into the citadel. Drayden was curious how Vexa met Zazzik but she just said it was a long story and that she owed him a lot of money. Drayden then asked how Vexa had found him. Noticing he was struggling, Vexa helped Drayden put his Spavat on to meet the Queen, and after finished he insisted that he was more than just a farm boy. While walking toward the main hall, 0-0-0 teased Drayden for stuttering when Vexa commented on her attractiveness but she told the droid only she was allowed to tease him.

title: Joren Drayden
text: In the ballroom, Drayden was mesmerized by the crowd. Vexa told Drayden to follow her lead and advised him to hide his flux blade, but implies he is used to keeping his Aetheri identity, which he hopes to solidify, a secret. When Drayden asked about the Aetheri in the crystal, Vexa said she only met him briefly but that he had strong opinions. After encountering an Ezaraan guest, Drayden was initially excited by them wanting to take down the Imperium, but after they explained they wanted to replace it with a Dominion of the Ezaraa where they would consume the flesh of all "lesser species," Drayden expressed that he thought the guests were crazy. The two soon saw the Queen of Ktath'atn , and after being welcomed by one of her servants, Varroa , Vexa presented Drayden, describing him as a very interesting Dunemere farm boy, but was rejected. When the Ezaraan mocked Drayden, Vexa defended him, but the Ezaraan grabbed her arm. Drayden warned the Ezaraan to leave Vexa alone and used Synth Flux to throw the Ezaraan to the ground, intriguing the Queen and earning a compliment from Vexa. Varroa ordered all the guests to leave but allowed

Later, the Queen told her servant Vespinax that Drayden's power and little experience made him perfect for her intentions to eat him. She then grew her power in anticipation of eating the Aetheri.

title: Joren Drayden
text: The next morning, Drayden and Vexa made their way to a dining hall to have breakfast with the Monarch. On the way, after Drayden expressed how creepy he thought the place was, Vexa assured him that the Queen's obsession with Aetheri would get her to do what they wanted, but Drayden was worried by this because of his encounter with Grukkar the Grak and Vexa's mention that the Queen "keeps" her oddities. Vexa told Drayden to let her do the talking and then the two walked inside and sat at a table with the Queen, Vexa introducing the both of them. Letting go…feeling…and more than anything…the Aetheri feel free. " ―Drayden, to Eternal Rur After attempting to run, Drayden prepared to use his flux blade to defend them, but Karrick, Solen, and Starric arrived at their location on Vexa's ship, the Ark Angel II , with her droids 0-0-0 and VT-1 in tow. Starric attempted to shoot Vexa, but Drayden blocked the blast with his flux blade, claiming that she was a good person and his friend, he willingly went with her, and he knew what he was doing, despite Solen's attempts to call his decision unwise and threats to court-martial him if he did not follow orders. Meanwhile, the Queen's servants and armed security guards pursued the group, so they escaped into an Abersyn symbiote laboratory, which Drayden decided people needed to know about. There, Drayden and Vexa got into an argument about the merits of the Imperium in which Vexa revealed her mother was killed in the Replica Wars, claimed that regular people preferred the Imperium's peace to war, and insisted that she was not like Karrick as Drayden thought. She attempted to mock him for his upbringing until Drayden revealed everyone on his farm was killed by the Imperium. Vexa led Drayden to a nearby room and sold him out to

text: people preferred the Imperium's peace to war, and insisted that she was not like Karrick as Drayden thought. Vexa led Drayden to a nearby room and sold him out to the Queen of Ktath'atn, who promptly mesmerized him to capture him. Vexa warned the Queen not to do the same to her too or she would blow up charges she placed in Drayden's pockets. Solen, Karrick, and Starric then saw Drayden get captured, the former calling out to him and later refusing to leave him behind.

title: Joren Drayden
text: The Queen connected Drayden to a machine that would allow her to directly feed on him. As Vexa left with the activated Rur crystal, she asked what would happen to Drayden, and the Queen revealed she would not infect him with a symbiote, but started to drink his life synth flux to increase her power. Upon speaking to to the crystal outside, Rur revealed to Vexa that she felt guilt over leaving Drayden behind and felt guilt over blaming her actions on her tragedy, when Drayden's tragedy made him a good person. Karrick attempted to rescue him, but was quickly enthralled and forced to lead the Queen's forces, as Solen and Starric' desperation to save Drayden lead them to place a symbiote into Zazzik despite Solen's misgivings. Drayden eventually tore free of the machine and in the ensuing struggle managed to re-arm himself with his flux blade. While the Queen attacked him with her powers, Vexa bombed the room and came inside, revealing that she had scaled the Citadel and was there to rescue Drayden. She also revealed that she had realized the reason the Queen did not put a symbiote in Drayden was because he was more powerful than

text: attacked him with her powers, Vexa bombed the room and came inside, revealing that she had scaled the Citadel and was there to rescue Drayden. She also revealed that she had realized the reason the Queen did not put a symbiote in Drayden was because he was more powerful than her and the Abersyn hive would follow him instead. Drayden then fell under the influence of an Abersyn symbiote, becoming more powerful than even the Queen, and proclaimed himself King of the hive. Drayden entered a psychic duel with the Queen to synth flux her to submit. Vexa allowed Eternal Rur from the crystal to enter his mind to assist him. Rur advised Drayden to use the symbiote to his advantage, claiming that tying Synth Flux's abilities into the parasite's emotional drive would make him immensely powerful. Realizing Rur was not a true Aetheri and only a person with the knowledge of one, Drayden ignored him and instead let go and connected to Synth Flux. He was able to free himself of the symbiote's influence and strike down the Queen, believing that being free was more important to be an Aetheri than just Rur's knowledge. Karrick and all those under the Queen's control were freed, Drayden reunited with Solen, and the Citadel was destroyed by VT-1. Later, after telling Starric it was time to go, Drayden told Vexa that he did not want the crystal because it was not an Aetheri in any real way. But he said that he had learned from it that there would not be any shortcuts to be an Aetheri, and that people who tried to take them to get what they wanted, like her, were deluded. Finally,

Drayden spoke with Starric on the way back, learning that Vexa had ruined S4 and shocked that Starric and her could have ever been together. #### Among the stars

> " You're right, Elira. This is war. Our war. And despite everything we've already been through, everything we've won and lost...this war...has only begun. May Synth Flux be with Us. May Synth Flux be with us all. " ―Joren Drayden to his team

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden later took part in a mission with Elira, piloting a Taylander shuttle with the princess. With Imperial SKREE Fighters in pursuit, Drayden was forced to fly into a nebula , which disabled the shuttle's systems, forcing them to crash land on an ocean planet . Stranded on the planet for three weeks , Drayden's experience with machinery, such as moisture vaporators helped keep himself and Elira alive. Having to live off of the land, the two grew closer, relating to each other because of their status as orphans. They eventually realized that there was a native species living in the planet's ocean. Not wanting to bring the war to these people, Drayden and Solen set a trap for the Imperial forces that were pursuing them. Joren used the native's resources, as well as his own flux blade, to fend off an Ironclad Walker and shoretroopers . Although close to being defeated, Elira used a flaming arrow to light explosive chemicals and disable the Ironclad Walker . Afterwards, they were able to repair the shuttle and return to the Insurgent Fleet.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Shortly afterward, Drayden and his team intercepted a message from Bolt-3, who had successfully rescued Astra-9 from Imperial capture. They saved Bolt's Vector from Xarn Velgor and escaped in hyperspace.

By then, Task Synth Flux 99 had destroyed the Horox III insurgent outpost. The team arrived there, discovering the devastation. Fearing further danger, they left without burying the insurgent troopers, but Drayden insisted that they honor the dead. Together they built a cremation pile before leaving.

#### Ashes of Embermoor

> " I've been thinking about Jessa and the rest of Renegade One. How many things went wrong for them? And Renegade One took whatever steps they needed. People making distractions, sacrificing themselves, amping up the signal. All improvised. This chain of sacrifice... All leading to me taking that shot. " ―Joren Drayden contemplating the sacrifice of Renegade One

title: Joren Drayden
text: Having traveled throughout the galaxy with his friends, Joren and his fellow insurgents journeyed to what remained of the moon Embermoor , the site of one of the Void Core's tests. On the ashy moon, Joren and Elira defended what remained of Torrik Vess 's Partisans from invading snowtroopers and brought them aboard the Corsair Wing . Moving to Embermoor , the planet that Embermoor orbited, Joren met Chulco Gi , an aspirant to the Disciples of the Whills , someone who could potentially guide him in learning about Synth Flux. Gi led the insurgents to the rest of the Partisans on Embermoor and placed hoods over their heads, in keeping with Partisan tradition. Led by Benthic , Torrik Vess's former second-in-command, the remaining extremists held guns at their fellow insurgents' heads.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Benthic questioned why the Alliance would attempt to mend their relations with the Partisans and return to Embermoor, and Elira revealed that the Imperium had resumed mining Kyber crystals on the planet and that the Alliance hoped to aid the Partisans in fighting against the Imperium. Though wary of Alliance support, Benthic was nonetheless willing to accept some aid. Joren, shaken by the Partisans' extreme methods, was conflicted by agreeing to help them, but specforces operative Ubin Des reassured him that it was the right thing to do. Later in the ruined settlement of Ai-jed , Joren, Chulco, and Ubin contemplated why people would stay on a ruined planet. Shock troopers armed with flamethrowers attempted to incinerate the remaining civilians, but Joren lashed out against them with his flux blade, cutting them all down. Realizing all that was at stake in the Galactic Civil War, Drayden approached Benthic with Dax Karrick and wholeheartedly agreed to assist him in his fight. Their first target was the drill citadel , a mining device from the planet Shu-Torun that the Imperium began using to mine Kyber crystals on Embermoor.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Benthic and Joren scaled the drill citadel and the Tognath ruthlessly killed the station's guards, much to Drayden's chagrin. Benthic held a technician at gunpoint and forced him to lower the citadel's shields before killing him as well. This allowed Dax Karrick, aboard the Corsair Wing , to destroy the drill citadel after Benthic and Joren escaped. Later, a disillusioned Chulco asked Joren to accompany him to meet the Central Isopter , a death-worshipping cult that Gi claimed was wise in Synth Flux. Although Joren was hesitant to seek the guidance from someone other than a disciple of the Aetheri, he nonetheless was willing to go along. Elira attempted to convince him that his duty to the Alliance was most important, but Joren believed that becoming an Aetheri and avenging all those slain by Xarn Velgor was the most important duty to him. Entering a chasm alongside Gi, the duo were attacked by a sand slug , a giant, normally herbivorous animal negatively influenced by the Umbra side of Synth Flux. Able to slay the beast, Drayden and Gi were finally confronted by the Central Isopter, who claimed that they had come to join them "in the shadow of death."

title: Joren Drayden
text: At the edge of the planet's blast crater, Chulco and the Central Isopter presented Joren with the Temple of Central Isopter , a shrine surrounded by the Umbra side of Synth Flux. The cult implored Drayden and Gi to meditate and listen to the chasm's call. They both did, but Joren refused to let the Umbra side take hold of him. However, Chulco was possessed by the darkness and attacked Joren, forcing the Aetheri trainee to strike him down. The cultists then announced that they had received a distress call from Brevok, who was being pursued by a SKREE fighter over Embermoor. Joren borrowed a ship, was able to destroy the SKREE fighter and bring an injured Brev to the planet, where he provided the Alliance with the plans for the Leviathan , a mobile fortress able to strip mine Kyber crystals from Embermoor.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Dax, Elira, and Benthic formed a strategy to destroy the Leviathan using the plans Brevok obtained. After the meeting, Joren ruminated on the sacrifice Renegade One made to get the Void Core plans to the Alliance, ultimately leading to him making the shot that destroyed the battle station. A newly motivated Joren accompanied Elira, Astra-9, and Bolt-3 aboard the crawler and readied themselves for taking control of it. Drayden made his way to the bridge of the Leviathan and held its commander, Kanchar , hostage but the Imperial's cybernetic arm was equipped with a blade able to defend against Joren's flux blade.

Kanchar pursued Joren throughout the ship with his cybernetic arm's blade and flamethrower. Eventually leading the officer to the crawler's hangar, Drayden activated an ion torpedo, which shut down Kanchar's cybernetics and allowed Joren to knock him out. Having taken total control of the Leviathan with the help of the double-crossing Queen Triova , the insurgents brought it to Embermoor's chasm, destroyed it, and escaped with not much time to spare. Having saved what remained of Embermoor and made allies in the form of the Partisans and Queen Triova, Joren and his friends left Embermoor.

#### Saltmark

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Saltmark

> " I'm just a farmboy from Dunemere. One of many sand-planet farmboys. But one thing was true there, just like it's true here. When someone comes for what's our, they don't try it twice. We work an honest day and long one. We're the good guys. But you wouldn't want to meet us in the dark. Where I come from—when someone pushes you, you push back harder! " ―Drayden to Kreel while dueling him After a mission with a plan made by Karrick went awry, Drayden, who had helped fight in his Vector, escaped to Baraan-Fa with the rest of the Alliance. Solen then put him in charge of a mission to the planet Saltmark to survey its facilities as a base. Drayden, flying there in a GR-75 medium transport , believed the mission was just delivering farm equipment, and was reluctant to go there as he directed those on the mission to land. Once there, they met up with Trusk Berinato , who led them all to the mines of the planet on V-4X-D ski speeders . After receiving new orders from Solen, Joren stated that he found the mission particularly irritating, as it reminded him of his life as a farm boy. Once they arrived, Karrick encouraged him to enjoy the mission since they were not in danger. He told everyone to follow him.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden and his team, which included Rask, began using the farming equipment to make trenches in Saltmark's surface, though he said he would rather do anything else. Green worms then appeared from the ground and Rask and Karrick tried to shoot them, but Drayden realized they would leave you alone if you left them alone. Still being reminded of home, Drayden reluctantly continued an environmental assessment, discovering and rationalizing an underground ecosystem where the worms came from and realizing it was drying up quickly. Following a hunch, Drayden took Rask with him on the ski speeders and they discovered bodies that appeared to have been flash dried. Realizing what happened, Drayden rushed to tell the others. He reached Solen and told her he resented her for sending him on this mission, but she said he reminded him of her and complimented him before giving him a kiss on the cheek. He then finished what he was trying to say and explained that they need to leave because a deadly salt storm was coming in. After Drayden realized Berinato forged environmental reports, Karrick warned that Berinato called SCAR squadron on them.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden got in a ski speeder and attempted to shoot at the incoming troopers, but one shot a canon at his and destroyed it. Kreel then approached him and ignited his flux blade, a determined Drayden lighting his too. The two dueled, Drayden turning Kreel's taunts against him by taking pride in being a farm boy as they were hard working good people who would push you back harder if you pushed them. The worms he saw earlier then tackled Kreel and Drayden cut the shock trooper's flux blade in half. Drayden made his way back to the Corsair and revealed that SCAR squadron lived, but that they needed to get out of the storm or they would die. Later, in orbit on the Corsair , Solen asked how Drayden was and he said that he was the same, living a small life and trying to make a difference. She told him not to change.

#### Mon Calvarra and Mako-Ta

> " I guess you don't need a wingman anymore. " " WEDGE! " " I thought you'd forgotten me! " " No way! Red squadron forever! " ―Wedge Antiles and Drayden reunite

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden joined Solen, Karrick, Vorian and others to meet with Grand Admiral Dors Urtya of the Mon Calvarra Mercantile Fleet at an island preserve on Mon Calvarra with the hope of getting the fleet to join the Insurgency. Drayden was surprised the Imperium cared about nature preservation, but Solen clarified that they wanted to exploit it. After Dax revealed he used to smuggle from there, which upset Drayden, Vorian and Solen began to negotiate as an Imperial LAAT/le patrol gunship approached. Drayden immediately assumed they had been betrayed, but Karrick thought otherwise and advised Drayden not to use his flux blade while he spoke with them. It fired on Urtya's ship, the explosion knocking Drayden down. When Karrick's plan resulted in shock troopers pursuing them, Drayden went with the others through the forest to a boat where Brevok was waiting. On the boat, Solen continued to try an convince Urtya, but he said that he did not want to sacrifice Mon Calvarra, but Drayden shot back, insisting he could not talk to the Princess of Cindervale about sacrifice. They eventually made it back to the Corsair and then to the Mako-Ta Space Docks that the Insurgency was using as a

title: Joren Drayden
text: but he said that he did not want to sacrifice Mon Calvarra, but Drayden shot back, insisting he could not talk to the Princess of Cindervale about sacrifice. They eventually made it back to the Corsair and then to the Mako-Ta Space Docks that the Insurgency was using as a production center, where Drayden rejected going drinking with Karrick. However, Drayden did go with Karrick to the bar, but insisted on only getting milk, to Karrick's dismay. There, someone put their hand on Drayden's shoulder so he pushed them away with Synth Flux, but it turned out to be Torb Rask and the two had a cheerful reunion, Drayden insisted that he had not forgot about Rask and declared that Red Squadron was forever. Karrick then tried to get Drayden a drink to celebrate, but Drayden just ordered the biggest milk they had. Rask introduced Drayden to Hobbie and Zev Senesca , who he explained they had met during Alliance training exercises, which he clarified were to ensure enough people could operate cruisers. Senesca said he was honored to meet Drayden, but Drayden just told him not to use honorifics and told him he would have also taken the shot. Karrick then lead a toast to Red Squadron, Drayden reciting all its members that had died. Karrick was surprised he remembered all the names, but Drayden expressed that he wished to know the names of all the Insurgents that had died. Solen then arrived and told them to finish up because they had a mission.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
During the mission, Drayden accompanied Solen and Karrick to the Dex Acquisitions Depot on Meor Ain to retrieve a Gloamite. With Astra-9 unable to slice the door to the room where he was, Drayden used his flux blade to cut around and remove the locking mechanism before Brevok kicked the door. After retrieving the shapeshifter, who briefly pretended to be Bael Solen, the group left. After debriefing the Gloamite, whose name was Tunga Arpagin , that he was to impersonate the Moff of the Calamari sector Tan Hubi while they kidnapped him, Drayden insisting the ordeal would make Arpagin more famous. At the Moncaladrome on Mon Calvarra, Drayden impersonated a shock trooper, Solen ordering him to wait until they drugged the Moff and then bring him back to their hideout. Karrick and Brevok went into a refresher and anticipated kidnapping Hubi while Drayden stood outside as a shock trooper and told everyone around that the room was for the Moff's private use, though one Imperial officer did manage to Synth Flux themself through. After successfully kidnapping Hubi, Drayden returned to Solen and warned her to be quick so that others would not notice the switch. After Arpagin copied Hubi's appearance, Drayden told him "May Synth Flux be with you" before departing with the others and a tied up Hubi in a Mon Cal ship to rescue Mon Cal King Liarch from Strokill Prime .

#### Mon Cal Mutiny

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Mon Cal Mutiny

> " The King… He couldn't be moved. He was too ill. " […] " But we've got his last words. If this doesn't inspire Mon Calvarra, nothing will. " " It has to be worth it. So many people are counting on us. " ―Drayden and Solen to Astra-9 on King Liarch Once there, Drayden commented that it made sense they would keep Liarch on a water world, though admitted the place looked bleak. After avoiding the planet's security using Hubi's biosignature, they took the ship to the planet and underwater, where they encountered a giant terrifying sea creature. Solen realized that the creature was attracted to their ship because of the light. Karrick was skeptical, but Drayden told him not to question her and informed them he was going to carry out a plan with Brevok's help and to be ready. Donning a full body diving suit while Brevok set up an underwater sled, Drayden shot out far away from the ship after Brevok gave Drayden a hug and he thanked the Vorak. Away from the ship in the expanse of the ocean, Drayden ignited his flux blade, leading the creature away with the light. Brevok then used a water sled and a breath mask to quickly go after Drayden and bring him back to the ship as he turned off his flux blade.

title: Joren Drayden
text: With the creature distracted, they all safely made it to the underwater base, where he commented that hope and luck were working out for them. They then discovered that Liarch was hooked up to a machine that was the only thing keeping him alive, and Karrick said Drayden jinxed them. Drayden attempted to calm an angry Karrick, and Liarch suggested that they could just carry his words to his people instead of having to lead them directly, prompting Drayden to suggest they search for a recording droid there. After bringing back a camera droid, Drayden watched as the King recorded his message, before noticing shock troopers and screaming out to everyone that they had been noticed. The shock troopers shot into the room, killing Liarch, but the group escaped with the recording back to their ship, Drayden defending them with a volt pistol and directing them to get onboard and get to hyperspace quickly. He then pointed out that the Corsair with its touchy hyperrelay would not have been able to pull that off, but Karrick warned him to stop disparaging the ship.

title: Joren Drayden
text: They met back up with Astra-9 in a deserted cove on Mon Calvarra, Drayden revealing to the droid that the king could not be moved but having hope that his message was worth it because people were counting on them. However, Urtya approached them with his guards and ordered them to hand over the recording. As he forcefully took it from Solen, Drayden screamed that Liarch would be ashamed, though Karrick told him to top talking and that they needed to get out of there. However, Urtya decided to show the footage too all of the fleet captains. Back on the Corsair , Drayden heard on an earpiece that the people on the Calavane ships were rebelling because of footage of Liarch. Because of this, however, the Imperial fleet arrived.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Later, on the Corsair , Drayden revealed that they were getting a message from the regent on the planet. The regent apologized for acting without warning and revealed he had called the Insurgent fleet. As the fleet arrived, Drayden and Solen got into gunning positions for the Corsair . Drayden tried to ask her if she remembered what to do, but she had already begun shooting. Seeing SKREE bombers approach, Karrick told Drayden he was going to give him an angle to take them out, and Drayden successfully did. Antilies then commed the Corsair and asked if they were having trouble, but Drayden just expressed his happiness that he was there and promised to buy him a drink after they made it out of their situation. Drayden kept shooting to help protect jetisonned escape pods, and the Corsair escaped to hyperspace after a Calavane ship full of coaxium crashed into the Iron Cruiser and exploded it. Later, Drayden accompanied Solen, Karrick, and Brevok to see Arpagin off on the Cosmatanic Steppes .

#### Renegade Squadron

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Renegade Squadron

> " No time for sentiment, Joren. […] So, flight leader…what's our call sign? " " You know, Wedge, if we're acting like Jessa Arsa, I have to disagree. It is time for sentiment. Renegade Squadron, form up. " ―Torb Rask and Drayden, as the latter forms Renegade Squadron

Later, Drayden participated in a celebration of the commencement of the Insurgent fleet at the Insurgent Base at Mako-Ta, using his Vector to create a display trail of blue light alongside other Vectors creating trails of other colors. After landing back in the hangar bay, Drayden expressed his enthusiasm that amount Insurgents present could definitively defeat the Imperium, though had to assure General Dodonna that he was not being overconfident and was just excited. However, due to a betrayal by Queen Triova of Shu-Torun, the commencement failed and the Imperial Navy arrived, which Drayden saw from a window and suspected was led by Velgor. He prepared to get in his Vector and fight, assuring Bolt that everything would be fine, but the bay doors were sabotaged by Triova and kept them trapped there.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
He then watched with shock as one of the Alliance's cruisers was destroyed and others started to be, but still assured Zev that they had survived the Void Core and would not die there. Drayden and Rask then spotted the Corsair taking on the fighters, both confused as to what Karrick was doing there. Unbeknownst to them Karrick was trying to get to them to let them know that the bay doors would open if they just flew toward them because of a fail-safe.

Drayden was disturbed by feeling powerless to help and only watch the ships get destroyed, but Karrick sent Astra-9 in an escape pod to the hangar bay, who informed him that they could leave by flying at the doors. Drayden rallied all of the fighters to get ready to launch and readied Bolt. Dodonna commed Drayden, who informed him of the situation, but Dodonna warned him that they needed to test the doors first, which Drayden ignored.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
As he proceeded and Dodonna continued to insist he stand down, Drayden realized that his situation was making him feel how Jessa Arsa must have felt when she took her rogue mission to steal the Void Core plans. Though Bolt warned that the doors might not open, he continued, trusting in Synth Flux, but saying he would blame his potential death on Astra-9. The doors opened and the rest of the fighters went to meet Drayden, him telling Wedge that he was glad for their company. Wedge advised against sentiment and asked Drayden what their call sign should be. He told Rask that sentiment was timely because they were acting like Jessa Arsa, and named the squadron Renegade Squadron after Arsa's crew called Renegade One .

### Insurgent Commander

#### Battle of Mako-Ta

> " We have more important business. Elira Ogana: You are now a general. Joren Drayden: You are now a commander. Dax Karrick: You are now a colonel. " " We're being promoted?" " The Insurgency command has been decimated. Every candidate of quality needs to step forward. " ―Vela Sess and Elira Solen, the former speaking to Solen, Drayden, and Karrick via hologram

title: Joren Drayden
text: Entering the battle , Drayden called out to Renegade Eight to warn them that someone was on their tail, but their Vector was destroyed. Karrick advised the squadron to stay close to the destroyers, and as they did, Drayden noticed the decrepit state of the Corsair and asked what happened to it, Karrick merely replying that Xarn Velgor got to it and warning Drayden that he was still there somewhere. After Karrick's plan paid off, Drayden made a joke to him by calling him an Admiral, which Karrick told him never to do again. From the base, Solen hoped out loud that Drayden would spread the word after learning that he was out there.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Knowing that they needed to spread the word to the other cruisers that they could launch their fighters but not wanting to split up to land on them, Drayden told Renegade Squadron to form up on him as he made a run past Vorian's ship with his display trail on, ignoring Rask' warnings against it. As Vorian watched, his attention grabbed by the display trail, Drayden flew toward the bay doors on one of the cruisers, which opened. Seeing this, Vorian moved to communicate this so that all of the cruisers could deploy their fighters. Karrick then announced to Drayden that the Corsair was too damaged and so he was flying a Vector.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden pursued a rogue SKREE fighter that had escaped, and that unbeknownst to him was piloted by Solen, who decided to take it while fleeing Velgor and his Iron Cruiser the Sovereign . Sensing something was off and noticing the pilot's skill, Drayden had Bolt try and scan and message it, to no avail. When Organ shot down another SKREE, Drayden realized the pilot was on their side. He ordered Renegade Squadron to form up and protect the SKREE as it came in to land on a cruiser, knowing it needed Insurgent transponders surrounding it for the bay doors to open. This was successful, but Drayden's fighter was shot as he did this and crashed into the bay. Karrick and Solen rushed to make sure he was all right, leaving Drayden shocked Solen had been piloting the SKREE, but all of them were happy things worked out well for them.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Due to the counter-codes Solen had retrieved from the Sovereign , the cruiser escaped to hyperspace, though Drayden wanted to go back and try and rescue more people, pointing out that his chance had worked out before. Dodonna criticized him for this and told him the decision was not his, merely telling Drayden and Solen to prepare for war. After it was decided to attempt a rescue, Karrick returned to Mako-Ta with Renegade Squadron, Drayden telling them he would fly with them again soon, causing Solen to make a comment implying he was neurotic. As Solen told Vela Sess to get the ambassadors to board their ship, he spotted a SKREE fighter coming to them, but it was shot down by Karrick. Soon after, Drayden tried to inform Karrick that they were almost ready to leave, but could not get ahold of him.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Solen and Drayden told Sess to leave in the main transport with everyone while they tried to save Karrick, which they did by attaching cables to his Vector and then jumping to hyperspace. Drayden brought them to a moon called Corosi 7 where Sess sent them a transmission informing them that in the midst of the Alliance's dispersal, Drayden was promoted to a Commander and Solen to a General, instructing them to find more ways to hurt the Imperium. Receiving no information on the location of Brevok or the Corsair , Drayden wondered how they would find them. Karrick decided to take them to Nar Shaddaa, where they met up with Sana Starric, who agreed to bring them all along in her ship the Volt Cobra .

#### Er'Kit

> " Insurgent intelligence heard some strange things about the Searmark Company, and as soon as I got here to investigate I felt an... echo in Synth Flux. I don't quite know how to explain it, but there's more going on here on Er'Kit than meets the eye. " ―Joren Drayden, during the operations on Er'Kit

title: Joren Drayden
text: Following the attack on the Mako-Ta Space Docks , Drayden was promoted to the rank of commander. After being promoted, Drayden was sent to the desert world of Er'Kit, where the locals were being oppressed by a group of mercenaries known as the Searmark Company . Upon arriving on the desert world, Drayden sensed through Synth Flux that there was something more at play beyond the actions of a few mercenaries. He requested the assistance of an agent who had a reputation for desert warfare and, together, the two defeated the mercenary outposts. The two also discovered from Imperial operatives in the sector that Imperial supplies were being ferried from Nar Shaddaa to Er'Kit, suggesting a large-scale operation was under way. Eventually, Drayden and the agent arrested the mercenary leader and tracked down the last members of Searmark Company, who had holed up in an empty village.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Among the mercenaries' possessions, Drayden and the agent discovered a document proving that Searmark Company was preparing to ship supplies somewhere, and its coordinates led Drayden and the agent to an Imperial base on the planet. They subsequently attacked several Imperial bases until they found intelligence pertaining to the Imperium's operation on the planet. Once they located the base from which the Imperials deployed most of their forces on the planet, Drayden assaulted it with the assistance of Princess Solen. The Insurgents razed the base, dealing an important blow to the Imperium's operations on Er'Kit, but they still lacked vital information on what the Imperium's true purpose was on the planet. Drayden gradually discovered Imperial logs detailing how Searmark Company had been hired by the Imperium Vigil Bureau and were tasked with forcibly relocating natives to make room for Project Hidden Eye . This IVB operation was intended to create cybernetic sleeper agents who could be deployed throughout the galaxy and spy on galactic citizens on behalf of the IVB. Upon its discovery, Project Hidden Eye was nearly ready to deploy its first wave of spies.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
To prevent the operation from being carried out, Drayden and the agent led their troops to the base that housed Project Hidden Eye. They fought through its staging area and ultimately took out the installation, ending the Imperial project for good. Drayden thanked the agent for their service and then remained on Er'Kit for a short time, helping the Free Coalition execute additional missions on the desert world.

#### Shu-Torun

> " You asked the Partisans to join you. Do not be surprised when they act like the Partisans. " […] " I…just don't push it. We have all the advantages here. Only we can open doors. We make our way to each of the cores, blow them up and bring the Spike down. " ―Benthic and Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text: Eventually, Solen presented an idea to Drayden, Karrick, and Brevok to take down Shu-Torun and all of its facilities. Drayden was on board immediately and thought it was time considering how much Queen Triova was responsible for. When Solen revealed they needed a shape-changer, Drayden pointed out that they knew Tunga Arpagin and the three went to find him, finding him on Gralack while he was performing a show using Drayden's visage about a character based on Drayden named "Luc Swordswinger" freeing the Calavane people. When shock troopers tried to shut down the show for being treasonous material, Drayden confronted them, but thinking he was just Arpagin in Drayden's form, ignored him. Drayden disarmed all of the Shock troopers by destroying their volt pistols while yelling with rage as the others extracted Arpagin. Solen later revealed that they also needed people who were used to fighting on a hell world, which Drayden realized meant they needed to go back to Embermoor. While Solen recruited the remaining Partisans there, Drayden went to the Temple of the Central Isopter with Karrick in the hopes of receiving advice from them about the dangers of Synth Flux and controlling his anger but was surprised

title: Joren Drayden
text: which Drayden realized meant they needed to go back to Embermoor. While Solen recruited the remaining Partisans there, Drayden went to the Temple of the Central Isopter with Karrick in the hopes of receiving advice from them about the dangers of Synth Flux and controlling his anger but was surprised to find it empty, especially knowing that the cult hunted disasters like Embermoor was experiencing and wanted to be around them. Back on the Home One , Drayden was not happy Starric was busy and could not help them, but pointed out that they had nearly everyone they needed. When they arrived on Shu-Torun, Drayden had to assuage their slicer Meorti , who had become scared by Karrick calling the mission suicidal, by insisting that they had a good plan and Karrick liked to be dramatic. On the Corsair , Solen explained to Drayden and the others her plan to destroy a massive tower called the Spike , thus systematically causing the destruction of the rest of the planet's infrastructure. Drayden then revealed that they were planning to get access to the master security controls and lock down everything on the planet like they did to them at Mako-Ta. While Solen worked to get an eye scan of Triova to achieve this, Drayden, Brevok, and the Partisans waited on the Corsair .

title: Joren Drayden
text: Eventually, Solen contacted Drayden and told him they were prepared to perform the slice of the shields around the Spike and told him to get ready to storm it and place bombs. He launched the Corsair and told Benthic and the Partisans to get ready to deploy quickly. Karrick told Drayden to take care of the ship, but Drayden pointed out that the only danger it would be in would be if Karrick and the others did not get the shields down in time. Once he got the word from Solen that he was able, Drayden took the Corsair through the shields and he and the others stormed the base, noticing how weird it was that they had control and the element of surprise. Drayden disarmed all the guards, but the Partisans shot and killed them, which upset him, Drayden warning them not to push their luck. Drayden revealed that they had control of all the doors now and instructed them to stick together so they could blow up the cores, but told Brevok to get back to the ship to stay in contact with Solen.

title: Joren Drayden
text: They eventually took down three of the cores, and Drayden took down the guards at the fourth one with his volt pistol and flux blade while the Partisans gave him cover, before instructing Bolt to set it to explode. Drayden told them they had one more left to destroy and instructed them to make it quick so they could go back to the ship and make contact. After clearing the room of guards at the last core, Benthic tried to get Bolt to ignore Drayden's intructions to set a charge and instead rig the entire Spike to explode and destroy the planet. He told Bolt to stop and told the Partisans it was not just, but they did not listen. Drayden then feigned surrender as Bolt emitted a bunch of gas into the gas, allowing Drayden and the droid to run off out of sight. Fearing the Partisans had gone crazy, Drayden was determined to find a way to stop them.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden ran through the Spike, using his flux blade to deactivate a blast door's controls and close it. As the Partisans started to open it, Drayden told Bolt that they could not do anything without the droid, instructing him to hide while he led the Partisans away. He did so successfully, but was cornered by the Partisans, who then contacted Bolt and told him that if he did not come to them they would kill Drayden. Bolt did what they said despite Drayden insisting his life was not worth it and begging him to stop. As Bolt set the Spike to destroy the planet, Drayden told the droid that he did not understand him because saving his life was not worth killing millions. Drayden secretly hoped shock troopers would show up and take down the Partisans. He unsuccessfully tried to talk Benthic into stopping, but Solen and Karrick arrived and the former successfully talked him down. As Drayden and the others escaped in the Corsair , refusing to give in to Imperial forces that had arrived, Astra-9 revealed that Bolt kept telling Drayden to "trust in Synth Flux" when he was beeping. After making it to hyperspace, Drayden asked what they would do about the Partisans, who he called traitorous, them all eventually deciding to drop them off on Salobea . Back at the Home One , Drayden asked Meorti if they had gotten an appetite for the field, but she said she had not and sped off. Solen then listed off a bunch of possible locations for a new insurgent base provided to her by General Dodonna, one of which was Frostmark, Drayden declaring that one of the places would be their new home.

#### Sergia

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Sergia

> " And look at this . Didn't I just spend all my life trying to get off a desert planet? " ―Joren Drayden on the desert planet Sergia

Following their mission to Shu-Toran , Drayden, along with Karrick and Solen, returned to the Insurgent fleet where General Carlist Rasken , noting his skill as a pilot, assigned Drayden a mission to the Inner Reach planet Sergia to lure all Imperial forces and probe droids that had recently been released en mass from a refueling station the Free Coalition had established on the planet. When Drayden arrived, he found a massive Iron Cruiser in orbit. After failing to lure it away, Drayden landed on the planet and tried to look for the Insurgents on foot, though was upset that he could not influence the Iron Cruiser's pilot with Synth Flux to do what he wanted like he believed Kade could have. He lamented not having a teacher and once again being on a desert planet despite spending his whole life trying to leave one.

title: Joren Drayden
text: After destroying a probe droid that was caught in a stampede of plain hundas with his his flux blade, Drayden found that the insurgents were operating out in the open, and sent Bolt-3 to deliver a message to the insurgents to lie low until he could help them to escape. He spent hours attempting to find pods released by the Iron Cruiser, eventually trying and failing to use Synth Flux to find them, before finding a town and deciding to check it out. There, in a bar, Drayden saved thief Warba Calip from an individual that was threatening her because he believed she was cheating at sabacc by beating them with a broom. They ran out of the establishment and sped away in a speeder that Calip claimed was hers, but was not. Drayden was annoyed by the experience and asked her to drop him off as soon as possible, but she was elated and asked why he was not, before suggesting that the reason she had won so much at the bar was because she knew Synth Flux, saying she recognized Drayden as someone who sought it.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Eventually the speeder Drayden and Calip were in was deactivated from afar by the owner and the two introduced themselves to each other. When he questioned his decision to rescue her, she claimed she had cheated earlier using an Aetheri mind trick, though she was not an Aetheri. She also saw his flux blade and told him to tell her all about it after they moved the speeder and then hid. Once they did, and saw the owner coming for it, they hid out in a forest of dead trees, though Calip no longer was interested in hearing about his flux blade or helping him with Synth Flux because she said using Synth Flux got people killed. He insisted he just needed a little help, before noticing that Calip had stolen his flux blade and pulling it back to him to activate it. After contacting someone named Tinga about the flux blade, Calip tried to suggest that Drayden run away and settle down, but he insisted that he needed to learn about Synth Flux to fight the Imperium and tried to convince her to help him with his mission to destroy the shuttles that had arrived there, explaining that he

title: Joren Drayden
text: flux blade, Calip tried to suggest that Drayden run away and settle down, but he insisted that he needed to learn about Synth Flux to fight the Imperium and tried to convince her to help him with his mission to destroy the shuttles that had arrived there, explaining that he was unable to locate them with Synth Flux. She claimed that she could teach him to reach out with his mind and find them, but that it would take too long and they should just rob a bank instead, confusing Drayden. Drayden was unsure about Calip's plan, but he insisted that they needed to steal the money from the Imperial payroll garrison so they could buy the information about the shuttles from the secretary of the local sub-governor. Drayden and Calip analyzed the defenses before she taught him the Guardian's Mantra , claiming he would become more powerful if he had the belief of the the priests who said that mantra. While saying the mantra, Drayden took down Imperial droids with his flux blade and barged into the garrison, though he lost his flux blade in a flurry of volt pistol fire shot by turrets on the building, though Calip collected it. After an explosion rocked the building, Drayden exited the building with a bag full of credits. He hugged Calip, saying that Synth Flux was with him and she was right that he would be able to do it despite his doubts. She said she was always right, which Drayden said he would remember.

title: Joren Drayden
text: After escaping in an Imperial speeder, Drayden expressed his delight that they could now buy information from Calip's source, but Calip instead suggested that they take the money for themselves. As Calip continued to discard Drayden's insistences that he needed to find the patrol to save thousands of lives and stared to suggest that he would be a great thief, Drayden started to believe that Calip was testing him as part of his training and insisted they find her source. They then stumbled upon shock troopers threatening a person named Ranja . #### On Frostmark

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### On Frostmark

> " I know where we can dig to free ourselves. See? Aetheri aren't all bad. " " Solving the same problem you caused is supposed to make me like you? " "You could have caused the problem, too, I'll remind you. It's okay. I'll work on you. I have a feeling we're going to be on Frostmark for a long, long time. " [laughing] " Gods, I hope not. " ―Joren Drayden and Nylaé Hollis In 3 AVE , Drayden and the Renegade Squadron were transferred to the Icehold , a insurgent base on the iced planet Frostmark , where he participated in regular patrols of the frozen perimeter under the callsign Echo Three . Upon Drayden's arrival at Icehold, Insurgent leadership expected him to use Synth Flux to help excavate the tunnels by sensing where and when to dig, even though he was unsure of how to do that. His belongings, including his flux blade, were placed in a decontamination unit in case of off-world pathogens. Sergeant Nylaé Hollis from Free Coalition Special Forces was assigned to familiarize him with the location. After they introduced themselves to each other and shook hands, Drayden declared that he was there to help.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden hoped to get to know Hollis since they would be working together, and they both thought the other had attractive qualities, but the sergeant's anti-Aetheri sentiments gave Drayden the initial impression that the other man disliked him. He did not recognize that Hollis had an Ondara name, but he could sense that Ondara was beautiful through Hollis' mental images of home. Hollis made a derogatory remark about the Aetheri and Drayden defended them. He also promised not to let the Ondara man down, just before a giant fork-nosed ice worm broke through the ground next to them and they were trapped by a cave-in.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Unused to total darkness, Drayden experienced claustrophobia. He could hear but not locate Hollis until he tried to use Synth Flux to stretch out his senses. He tried to remember that darkness had been a comfort back on Dunemere, but that did not work and he still felt suffocated by the darkness. He successfully detected that Hollis was nearby using Synth Flux and told the other man to stay still. When Drayden approached, they bickered briefly over what was responsible for the cave-in, Hollis urging him not to use Synth Flux. Hollis, recognizing that the Aetheri was panicking, grabbed Drayden's hand and pressed it to a gap in the wall that had air flowing through it. Drayden clutched Hollis' hand and asked for his trust. They sat down and kept holding each other's hands as Drayden thought about the light and warmth of his home on Dunemere. Drayden began to reflect on his fear of what the darkness would do to him psychologically, referring both to the literal situation they were in and the general darkness in the galaxy he faced. As their hands warmed, Drayden could sense where they could dig through the ice to free themselves in Synth

text: reflect on his fear of what the darkness would do to him psychologically, referring both to the literal situation they were in and the general darkness in the galaxy he faced. They teased each other and laughed before they started digging, Drayden recognizing that Synth Flux had never steered him the wrong direction and suspecting it never would. While the base was still being built, two insurgent soldiers, Kes Vale and his wife, Shara Bey found themselves trapped after an ice collapse caused by Arrow cannon. Thinking they would have died, they recorded a message for their little son, Rin Vale to explain why they joined the Insurgency. Drayden, however, rescued them, helped by Brevok by opening a hole in the ice using his flux blade, him, Solen, and the others willing to risk the tech in the control room to save their lives. He allowed Bey to use him as a crutch so she could limp out. Vale and Bey were eventually treated by a 2-1B surgical droid .

title: Joren Drayden
text:
At some point, Drayden walked outside of Icehold to speak with Captain Magna Tolvan , Vulaada Klam , and Korin Vexa , the latter of which had been very excited by the idea of the Synth Flux-sensitive pilot and the former recognizing him as the man who destroyed the Void Core, which Drayden confirmed. After confirming that they were the friends of Doctor Chelli Vexa, Drayden told them that an Insurgency spy had revealed that he had learned from a comms jockey on the Sovereign that someone had sabotaged the Imperium's computers and made it hard for them to search for the Alliance. He explained that the Imperium had put out a warrant for the culprit, and then revealed that their description matched that of Doctor Vexa and her droid companions. Drayden revealed that sabotage had set the Imperium back enough for them to set up their shields and finalize their evacuation plans. He told them that he had always known that there was good in Vexa before turning and leaving, the three then discussing and then deciding against telling him that Vexa had also saved the Emperor's life.

#### The Battle of Frostmark

Some time later, while reconnoitering the surroundings of Icehold on the tauntaun Riba , after Karrick had departed back to base, Drayden was attacked by a frostmaw , only to regain consciousness in its cave . He severed its arm with his flux blade and escaped; after a long walk in the icy wind, he collapsed from exhaustion. Near death, he had a vision of Kade, who told him to seek the teachings of Zho in the Mirefall system .

title: Joren Drayden
text: Rescued by Karrick, Drayden recovered from his wounds in a bacta tank operated by the medical droids 2-1B and FX-7 . However, Velgor had located Icehold with one of his probe droids and prepared an imminent attack on the recently-opened Alliance base, thus prompting the Alliance to evacuate the base at once. After bidding farewell to his friends, for the impending battle , Drayden was to lead Renegade Squadron in an airspeeder . Before he departed to the battlefront, he was spotted by insurgent journalist Corwi Selgrothe , who wanted to quickly interview him for propaganda footage, but she was instead led to the escape transports by insurgent trooper L'cayo Llem . During the battle, Drayden led his speeders against the walkers, ordering Renegade Squadron to pull the AT-ATs down with tow tables after realizing their armor could resist their volt pistols. Though he was shot down, and his gunner Dak Ralter was killed, he got out of his damaged speeder and single-handedly destroyed walker Blizzard 4 by using a harpoon gun and then used his flux blade to cut a hole and throw a thermal detonator . As Imperial forces breached the Insurgents' defenses, the last Insurgent transport departed,

text:
Dak Ralter was killed, he got out of his damaged speeder and single-handedly destroyed walker Blizzard 4 by using a harpoon gun and then used his flux blade to cut a hole and throw a thermal detonator . As Imperial forces breached the Insurgents' defenses, the last Insurgent transport departed, and Drayden fled the planet aboard his Vector with Bolt-3. ### Traveling to Mirefall

#### Meeting Zho

> " Will he finish what he begins? " " I won't fail you. I'm not afraid. " " Oh, you will be. You will be. " ―Zho and Joren Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Drayden then traveled to Mirefall , which turned out to be a remote swamp planet, where he encountered Zho, the former Grand Master of the fallen Aetheri Order. In their initial meeting, Drayden was frustrated and impatient and was rather short-tempered with the diminutive Zho, who did not initially identify himself and purposefully tested Drayden's patience, telling him a story about three brothers, and taking him back to his hut to partake in a meal of rootleaf stew , which he did not find very appetizing.

However, Drayden gained a new appreciation for the small creature upon learning his identity, and Zho agreed to train Drayden only at the insistence of Kade's spirit. Drayden's training proved to be difficult, as his adventurous past had shaped his mind toward action and emotional instinct.

#### Renewed training

text:
