#### Renewed training

> " That place… is strong with the umbra side of Synth Flux. A domain of evil it is. In you must go. " " What's in there? " " Only what you take with you. " ―Zho and Joren Drayden

Drayden's training on Mirefall lasted several weeks, with Kade needing to appear in Zho's dreams more than once to convince the old master to keep up Joren's training and argue that the boy would not end up like this father. When Drayden and Zho argued, Kade also regularly appeared to stop their arguments. One day during his training with Zho, the Aetheri Master had Drayden climb a tree to use his senses to find a way through the tree, Drayden lost his balance and fell from the tree. Zho decided to have Drayden carry him as he redid the task.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
When Zho asked him to enter a cave that was strong in the umbra side in which he was supposed to find only what he took with him, he was challenged by a vision of himself wearing the armor of Xarn Velgor , meant to symbolize his inner darkness. Master and apprentice then had an encounter with a raging elephoth , which Drayden managed to calm by leading her to her child.

#### Leaving prematurely

> " Joren! You must complete the training.." " I can't keep the vision out of my head. They're my friends. I've gotta help them. " ―Zho and Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Leaving prematurely

> " Joren! You must complete the training.." " I can't keep the vision out of my head. They're my friends. I've gotta help them. " ―Zho and Drayden

Shortly after, he had a vision of Dax Karrick and Elira Solen suffering at Aether Spire on Mistral . Unable to get the visions out of his head, and convinced that his friends would surely die if he did not help them, Drayden decided to end his training prematurely to rescue them, despite Zho and Kade's insistence that he was not ready to face the umbra side on his own yet, but Drayden was convinced that he would learned enough to hold his own, and he could not just stand by and leave his friends to the mercy of the Imperium.

Seeing that Drayden's mind was made up, Kade let him know that if he ended up facing Velgor, he could not interfere on his behalf, and advised him not to give into hatred. Likewise, Zho advised him to mind what he would learned. Drayden promised to do so, and vowed to return to Mirefall one day to finish his training.

### Velgor's revelation

#### Velgor's trap

title: Joren Drayden
text:
### Velgor's revelation

#### Velgor's trap

> " You have learned much, young one." "You'll find I'm full of surprises! " ―Xarn Velgor and Joren Drayden

Upon his arrival at Aether Spire's East Platform , Drayden felt Velgor's presence, and went into the nearest building, where he was shot at by Vark, who had come to claim a bounty put on Karrick by Grukk the Grak, and tried to pursue a group of shock troopers and Imperial officers who held Solen, Brevok, and Astra-9 captive. The princess attempted to warn Drayden that he was walking into a trap, but his path was diverted to the carbon-freezing chamber where Xarn Velgor awaited him, with the intention to freeze him in carbonite to present him to the Emperor . Drayden engaged the Dark Lord in a fierce flux blade duel .

title: Joren Drayden
text:
During the duel, Velgor praised Drayden's training in Synth Flux thus far and attempted to goad him into giving into his anger and hatred, claiming that it was the only way to defeat him. Velgor managed to knock Drayden into the carbon-freezing chamber and appeared to have frozen him like he had Karrick, but Drayden leapt out of the chamber before the process was finished, which left Velgor impressed.

The duel eventually carried into the control room of one of Aether Spire's gas-processing vanes . Velgor began using Synth Flux to throw various objects in the chamber at the young Aetheri hopeful. One such projectile, a large piece of metal piping, was misdirected and smashed through a nearby observation port. The chamber was quickly depressurized, sucking Drayden out onto the nearby sensor relay catwalk overlooking the reactor shaft . Drayden managed to grab on to the catwalk's railing and pull himself up.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Velgor re-entered the fray and forced Drayden back onto the catwalk. Sensing that Drayden was weakened, the Umbra Lord demanded that Drayden surrender, lest he be destroyed as Orien Kade had been. Drayden refused and desperately tried to keep fighting Velgor, to which Velgor responded with several ferocious strikes, ultimately forcing Drayden to the very edge of the catwalk and slicing off his right hand. Both Drayden's hand and his flux blade fell into the depths of the reactor shaft.

#### A dark revelation

> " Orien never told you what happened to your father. " " He told me enough! He told me you killed him! " " No. I am your father." "No...that's not true! That's impossible !" "Search your feelings. You know it to be true." "No! " ―Xarn Velgor and Joren Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Seeing that Drayden was vulnerable in his weakened state, Velgor offered to show Drayden the power of the umbra side and complete his training, but Drayden adamantly refused to ever join Velgor, the man who had killed his father. In that moment, Velgor revealed the truth: that he was his father.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Horrified by Velgor's shocking revelation, Drayden initially denounced the Umbra Lord's claim as untrue and impossible, but Velgor insisted that they both knew that it was the truth. Velgor further claimed that Drayden was powerful enough to destroy the Emperor, and when he did, they could rule the galaxy together as father and son. Unwilling to join Velgor but too weak to fight back, Drayden took the only option he had left, and allowed himself to fall down the reactor shaft, being sucked through several vents and eventually being deposited to the outside of the floating city. Though he managed to grab onto a weather vane to avoid falling to his death, he knew he was unable to stay there forever, especially in his weakened state. Calling out to Kade at first but getting no response, in desperation, he called out to Elira Solen through Synth Flux, who was able to hear the call.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Soon, the Corsair Wing , with Dorian Quill , Solen, Brevok, and the droids onboard, arrived to rescue him. As they escaped from Mistral, and the Corsair was faced with the Imperial fleet, Velgor reached out to Drayden through Synth Flux, calling him "son." Drayden fought tears back, after hearing the word he had always longed to hear while lamenting that Kade had not told him the truth, just as the Corsair made the jump into hyperspace thanks to Bolt-3.

#### Haunted by the truth

> " Beno... Beno. Why didn't you tell me? " ―Joren Drayden #### Haunted by the truth

> " Beno... Beno. Why didn't you tell me? " ―Joren Drayden

Haunted by the truth of his parentage, Drayden found his connection to Synth Flux considerably weakened, with his control over it remaining sporadic. Aboard the Corsair , after introducing Drayden to Quill, Solen informed Drayden of what had happened to Karrick. Drayden wanted to begin searching for his friend immediately, but Solen told him that there was more at stake than just Karrick's life and it would be best to reconvene with the Insurgent fleet first. He revealed that he had received no response from reaching out Kade, but she assured him that he was strong and would find his way. With Drayden agreeing to her plan, the Corsair jumped to hyperspace.

title: Joren Drayden
text: The Corsair arrived at the Insurgency's Rendezvous Point Delta-Three in the Mid Reach to find the fleet's Fourth Division under attack from several Star Destroyers, including the Varrix's Will , which was under the leadership of Commander Ellian Zahra . As the Corsair entered the battle, Drayden volunteered to commandeer the ship's belly gun, despite his injuries. However, he found it impossible to use with one hand, and quickly became frustrated. He was suddenly overcome with traumatic flashbacks to losing his hand and to Kade and Velgor's words on his parentage. His anger resulted in him unknowingly using Synth Flux to make several of the attacking SKREE Fighters crash into one another. With Joren stunned by his sudden show of strength, the fleet jumped to hyperspace.

title: Joren Drayden
text: With the fleet regrouped, Drayden found a deserted part of the flagship and attempted to contact Zho through Synth Flux to receive his guidance. Angry at the Aetheri Master's refusal to answer, he almost shattered one of the ship's windows in another frustration-fueled loss of control over his Synth Flux abilities. Speaking to Bolt-3, he revealed that he was incredibly afraid and angry and considered that those feelings and his parentage meant he should not be an Aetheri. He wondered whether the lack of answers from his mentors, who he was now frustrated with for lying to him, signified a premature end to his Aetheri training, and who he was meant to be if not an Aetheri.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
As Quill prepared to go to Dunemere to locate Karrick, Drayden, who was unsure if he could trust him, insisted that he inform him if he found Karrick. He suggested they could meet up at the Jundt Massif so he could help, since he knew the area from growing up there, though Quill was skeptical. Drayden insisted that he did not need both hands because he had Synth Flux, but Quill still insisted a rescue mission from Grukk's palace would be impossible. Solen told Drayden that he should have a prosthetic hand installed in the Nebulon-B frigate Redemption ' s medbay. Although unsure whether it would help his mental state, especially that he was not feeling like himself, Drayden agreed. Drayden specifically requested 2-1B, the medical droid who treated him on Frostmark, for the procedure. Although he questioned whether he was deserving of having his hand replaced, Drayden ultimately received the hand as Quill and Brevok set out to find Karrick.

### An uncertain path

#### Return to Aether Spire

title: Joren Drayden
text:
### An uncertain path

#### Return to Aether Spire

> " I need to get back to Aether Spire, and they'll never let me go. But if you ask, say you want to go, need me as your guide… " " Why would I ever go back there? " " ' Cause how I hear it, you lost more than your hand there. Your flux blade too. " ―Dorian Quill and Joren Drayden

Upon their return, Quill found Drayden training to fire a volt pistol with his prosthetic hand. Observing the would-be Aetheri's struggles, Quill suggested that they return to Mistral so as to retrieve Drayden's flux blade. As they talked, Drayden was suddenly confronted with a vision of a female hooded figure catching his flux blade and telling him to follow his destiny.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden, accompanied by Quill, Solen, and Bolt-3, returned to Mistral, Quill assuring Drayden he knew where his flux blade ended up. However, they were fired upon the Mistral Wing Guard upon approach, though Quill urged Drayden not to fire on them and instead take them in as close as possible. Drayden was sure that they were gonna get killed, insisting destroying the Void Core was different when Quill suggested he could do it. Fortunately, getting close enough meant Quill was able to remotely disable the city's turrets, but the team were soon ambushed by shock troopers upon landing. Needing to carry out their missions as quickly as possible to avoid capture, the insurgents split up, with Drayden and Bolt-3 heading to the smelting chamber where Quill claimed his flux blade should be located, walking past the spot where Velgor cut off his hand. When they got there, Quill commed him asking for backup against shock troopers, Drayden agreeing to help once he found his flux blade.

title: Joren Drayden
text: However, Drayden found mountains of debris in the chamber and told Quill it would take a second for him to find it. He enlisted the help of ugnaughts to find it but realized that it would likely be impossible to recover his flux blade before finally deciding to search for it through Synth Flux. However, he instead a vivid vision of the cloaked woman and a location she was at, as well as flashes of Velgor, Kade, Zho, and the Emperor. Sensing that Solen was in trouble, he abandoned the search and found Quill surrounded by shock troopers. Drayden used Synth Flux to push the Imperial soldiers through a window, slightly surprised that he was able to and revealing to Quill he had gotten over his block. Lando introduced his friend Lobot and Drayden revealed that he knew that Solen was in a hangar there.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
When Quill noticed he had not retrieved the flux blade, Drayden explained that he had learned that he did not need the flux blade to be an Aetheri and that being an Aetheri was about using Synth Flux to bring light. He was once again determined to be an Aetheri, even if he never saw his father's flux blade, which he had mixed feelings about, again. Despite Quill's misgivings about his plan, Drayden was able to use Synth Flux to deactivate all of the carbonite blocks at once and free everyone, including Solen, before fighting off shock troopers to get to his Vector and take off from Mistral with it. He commed Solen and asked to temporarily part with the Insurgents to find someone Synth Flux was calling him to that he thought could get answers from, which she agreed to. After Bolt located the planet from Drayden's vision, he flew off in search of the woman from his vision.

#### Verla

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Verla

> " You're just a poor, deluded kid. My name is Verla. So you're all caught up in this Aetheri business, huh? Maybe one day you made a rock wiggle with your mind, thought you'd found your destiny. You're a sucker. " ―Verla, to Joren Drayden

While Drayden traveled to find the woman from his visions, Velgor followed a false lead from an Imperial officer to Drayden, only finding a con man pretending to be him to get pilot jobs and claiming that a droid named 'Ardee' helped him destroy the Void Core. Velgor killed him and declared that anyone who claimed Drayden's name would die. He told the Imperial officer to verify his findings next time and said Drayden could still be anywhere.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Having used the planet he saw in his vision as the basis for his search, Drayden arrived at the planet Serelia , where he encountered the woman from the vision at a dock on the coastline. However, when he asked whether she was an Aetheri, the woman responded by dropping a large amount of fish on top of him and escaping in a boat. Undeterred, Drayden gave chase in his own boat but ended up capsizing, washing ashore on a beach. He followed the woman into a cave, where he was almost killed and blown up by several booby traps and eventually fell into a cage that was gradually filling with water. As the woman watched, Drayden attempted hold back the rising water with Synth Flux, but was unable. The hooded woman asked him who he was and revealed herself to be Verla.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Verla informed Drayden that it would be safer if he was to give up his dream of becoming an Aetheri, cynically telling him about Directive 66 , the Warden Order and Xarn Velgor himself. Sensing Drayden's suspicious reaction to the mention of his father, Verla probed deeper into his mind and realized that he was the son of Velgor. Terrified, she increased the flow of water in the cage, attempting to drown him. Fortunately, Drayden's life was saved by Bolt-3, who incapacitated Verla and resuscitated him. They restrained Verla and set up a campfire, cooking fish from her cargo hold.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
When she regained consciousness, Drayden freed her as a show of good faith and asked her about his vision. Verla told him that she did not possess a flux blade, as she had given up on Synth Flux and refused to take part in the conflict between the light and dark sides. She also revealed that Velgor's name was Kael Drayden, and that she had learned from her master Ferren Barr that Kael had once been a hero of the Replica Wars but that something happened to him. She revealed that she had spent her entire life on the run from the Wardens and Velgor and had finally given up on Barr's wishes and had decided to live a normal life. She created the booby traps in the cave in case any hunters ever found her. She refuted Drayden's belief that Synth Flux had led her to him and insisted that Synth Flux only used people.

#### Tempes

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Tempes

> " Once, I served the Aetheri, wielded a blade like the one you hold. Then I hunted Aetheri, in service to Velgor and the Emperor. Now I serve them still—and kill every seeker who follows the path Velgor created to this place. I presume I always will. " " You're wrong. You will never kill an Aetheri again. " ―The Grand Warden and Drayden

Drayden still maintained that it was his purpose to help a suffering galaxy and believed she could lead him to a flux blade. Although she strongly recommended that Drayden should leave Synth Flux behind, and insisted that he did not have to follow its will if he did not want to, she informed him of an Aetheri outpost from the High Republic Era on the Outer Reach astronomical object of Tempes where she had once sought artifacts of the Aetheri. Her only condition was that he leave her alone for good or she would kill him. After Drayden thanked her, she warned him, that she had sensed that Tempes was guarded by a dark presence when she visited it and that it would be smarter for him to run.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden flew to Tempes and was almost struck down by the planet's powerful lightning storm. He managed to outmaneuver the lightning while assuring Bolt and land safely, venturing to the outpost in the rain. He and his droid entered after he realized he needed to use Synth Flux to open the door and was astonished that so much was still there. He found a new yellow-bladed flux blade but when he picked it up was attacked by the spirit of the Grand Warden, who had been forced to guard the outpost for eternity by Velgor, who had turned the outpost into a trap for Aetheri and Synth Flux-sensitives. After the Warden introduced himself and ignited his red double-bladed spinning flux blade flux blade, Drayden resolved to not let him kill an Aetheri again and used the yellow flux blade to enter a duel with the flaming spirit.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
The Warden taunted the young Aetheri's skill with a flux blade, but Drayden acknowledged his training was incomplete but also that he was already skilled and would be an Aetheri. The Warden ignited both blades of the flux blade and started destroying the artifacts there, insisting the Aetheri Order was a lie that was over. As they fought, he told the Warden that that place was inspiring him to want to be a part of the Aetheri Order and fight what they fought for, and that he was beginning to understand loss and sacrifice for what was worth fighting for as they understood it. He cut off the Warden's hand and disarmed him of his blade, before successfully slicing through him and escaping before Velgor arrived.

Drayden returned to the Insurgent fleet and reunited with Solen. Solen implored him to show the assorted insurgents what he had found, and so Drayden activated his new flux blade, its yellow blade representing renewed hope for the future of the Insurgency.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden returned to the Insurgent fleet and reunited with Solen. Solen implored him to show the assorted insurgents what he had found, and so Drayden activated his new flux blade, its yellow blade representing renewed hope for the future of the Insurgency.

Around this time, after a long crusade, Velgor discovered that the location where his late wife Lira Ondar had given birth to Drayden was Polis Massa and was enraged that his existence had been hidden from him.

#### Battle at Elessia

> " This is Red Leader--All fighters, on me--We need to make an attack run on the Seventh Division's cruiser, push those Skrees back. " ―Joren Drayden

Somewhere in the Inner Reach, Drayden and Solen met with Commander Grek and instructed him to move forward with their rendezvous with the Seventh Division as part of a plan to strike back against the Imperium. Astra-9 was concerned that this would alert the Imperium to their location, but Drayden told him that it was about more than just protecting their own lives.

title: Joren Drayden
text: The Imperium's Commander Ellian Zahra intercepted a transmission that revealed the Alliances Fourth and Seventh Divisions were planning to rendezvous somewhere in the Inner Reach, so Zahra initiated an attack that saw her split her forces to strike simultaneously. Zahra's primary strike synth flux led an attack on the Alliance's Seventh Division, while her secondary strike synth flux attempted to attack Elira Solen's Fourth Division, however the Fourth had already left their rendezvous point before the strike synth flux arrived. The Imperial forces overwhelmed the Seventh Division's capital ships. SKREE interceptors created a blockade of Home One ' s hangar bay, that prevented Alliance starfighters from launching, including Red Squadron.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Shortly into the battle, the Fourth Division's ships emerged from hyperspace and immediately deployed their starfighters, led by Commander Joren Drayden, who assumed the callsign Red Leader. Drayden was accompanied by other starfighters, that included Green Squadron's Shara Bey ( Green Three ), along with Dorian Quill and Brevok in the Corsair Wing . While fighting, Solen contacted him to check in, Drayden informing her that the Imperials were pinning down the Seventh Division's cruiser and preventing them from scrambling their fighters. After Solen abruptly ended the communication, Drayden called for all Fourth Division fighters to form up on him, on an attack run on Home One ' s blockade, to push the Skrees back, while those starfighters who were trapped in the hangar bays prepared to launch, including Torb Rask (Red Two). As soon as Drayden cleared the Skrees, all the Alliance starfighters aboard Home One , including Rask, launched to repay the favor.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden eventually left the space battle to board the frigate where Elira Solen was under attack from an Imperial boarding party, led personally by Zahra. As Zahra threw a sword at Drayden, which he easily dodged, and then kicked him to the ground, she claimed that she could kill him if she wanted to but was not allowed to because of Velgor's plans for him. After Zahra jumped out a window with a jetpack to escape, Drayden and Solen went to celebratory meeting for successfully regrouping and fending off the Imperium. There, Drayden noticed something was off with Solen, who revealed that she was perturbed by the amount of hate Zahra seemed to have for her.

#### Searching for Karrick

> " Apparently there has been a sighting…of the notorious bounty hunter Vex Vark. And since he is possession of the block of frozen carbonite containing out good friend and insurgent hero Dax Karrick, Brevok wants you to— " " I get it, Astra-9. Of course I'll go. " ―Astra-9 and Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text: Around this time, Velgor had his armor damaged during a mission . Reflecting on the pain it caused him to repair, Velgor wondered if Drayden's pain, including losing his hand, had made him stronger. Velgor suspected it had not and considered Drayden weak, believing the fledgling Aetheri had not accomplished anything without the help of his friends, who Velgor believed he allowed to survive. No longer wishing to turn Drayden he resolved to kill him, and began his path to do so by searching for Dax Karrick. In killing Drayden Velgor believed he would kill Orien Kade's last hope and prove those who thought Drayden would be his end wrong. While tracking Karrick, Velgor's partner, an Umbra assassin named Orrin , figured out that Velgor planned to lure Drayden to him with Karrick.

title: Joren Drayden
text: While practicing his flux blade and Synth Flux skills by fighting training remotes, during which he recalled Zho's training, Drayden was interrupted by Astra-9, insisting he did not mind the distraction. Astra-9 said that Bolt-3 wanted to speak with him about something related to Tempes, where he found his new flux blade. Before Bolt-3 could say anything, Brevok arrived and revealed, via Astra-9 translating, that Vex Vark had been spotted on Nar Shaddaa and urged Drayden to come with him to rescue Karrick from him. Brevok shot down Drayden's suggestion that they bring Quill, saying he was not to be trusted and that Karrick would not want to see him, but Drayden agreed. Drayden, Astra-9, Bolt-3, and Brevok then took the Corsair to Nar Shaddaa, though Bolt complained to Astra-9 on the way that he had not been able to speak to Drayden. Drayden was annoyed that Solen had to stay behind to coordinate Operation Starlight and urged Brevok to ensure the mission would be quick, recalling how awful he found the planet and what had happened with Grukkar the Grak.

title: Joren Drayden
text: On the planet, Drayden watched as Brevok met with his contact Sagor , Astra-9 explaining that he and Brevok used to be old friends and translating that Sagor believed a new victor in the Garkata Fighting Arena was Vex Vark. Looking at a hologram of the winner, Drayden also thought they looked like Vex but noticed it was labeled "Garrick." Drayden spoke with a Pa'lowick attendant at the Arena to get information on "Garrick" but was annoyed by both the Pa'lowick 's refusal to answer questions without payment and Astra-9 spouting the mottos of Nar Shaddaa. The attendant, suspecting they were friends of "Garrick," used an alarm to call the Kanji gang, who were upset that "Garrick" had defeated their fighter in the arena. Using his flux blade to fight back against the thugs, who attacked despite Drayden's warnings, Drayden and the others fled, though Brevok was reluctant to because they had not found much information. Following Sagor through the streets before stealing and fleeing on a speeder, they encountered many more groups of Kanji that Drayden fended off with Synth Flux and his flux blade until Bolt-3 picked them up in the Corsair . However, some of the Kanji

title: Joren Drayden
text:
they had not found much information. Following Sagor through the streets before stealing and fleeing on a speeder, they encountered many more groups of Kanji that Drayden fended off with Synth Flux and his flux blade until Bolt-3 picked them up in the Corsair . However, some of the Kanji planned to report seeing Drayden to Imperials on Vandor . Afterward, Bolt finally gave his message to Drayden via Astra-9, revealing that he had found a list of former Aetheri outposts across the galaxy in his databanks that he seemingly acquired on the Void Core. This greatly excited Drayden, who eagerly wanted to learn more, feeling like Synth Flux was providing for him and making Bolt list the locations for him immediately. Sagor then entered with a message, Astra-9 translating, in which he revealed that Solen had received a message from an unknown party claiming to be in possession of Karrick. Though Solen was starting to lose hope,

#### Ab Dalis

> " Approaching the target. Looks like a… vent of some kind, maybe. I see them, Bolt-3. Skrees on our six. Trying to hit a target the size of a strider's eye…feels like old times. " ―Drayden, to Starlight Squadron and Bolt-3

title: Joren Drayden
text:
> " Approaching the target. Looks like a… vent of some kind, maybe. I see them, Bolt-3. Skrees on our six. Trying to hit a target the size of a strider's eye…feels like old times. " ―Drayden, to Starlight Squadron and Bolt-3

Drayden and the others met up with Solen, who told them that Vark did not have Karrick anymore and that he was going to be sold in a auction in the attendance of most of the galaxy's crime syndicates on Jekara . Though Solen was starting to lose hope, Drayden assured her that they would find him. After Solen revealed Karrick was in the possession of Carmine Dawn , who Brevok remembered was an extremely powerful criminal organization he had dealt with before, Drayden expressed his concerns to Solen about her taking on this mission, claiming that she had not been herself recently and had not been acting from the heart. Solen agreed but insisted that was why she needed to take the mission to get Karrick back. Later Drayden joined Rask and Starlight Squadron in his Vector, having promised he would join them for a patrol, but assured Solen he would join her on Jekara soon.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Eager to get the fleet back together, and knowing recon missions were dicey, Drayden told Rask that he was happy to join the mission to find and recover a fleet division. Hoping to boost pilot L'ulo L'ampar 's morale, he also revealed to the squadron that the Alliance was close to recovering Captain Karrick. After traveling through hyperspace to Ab Dalis , Freyta Smyth and Rask explained that it was chosen as a insurgent rendezvous point because it was abandoned after a cataclysmic impact make it tectonically unstable hundreds of years earlier. Mart Mattin and Drayden then received a broken transmission, which Bolt unscrambled, revealing it was from the Eleventh Division of the Rendezvous Point Vectis-Four at Ab Dalis who were being attacked by Imperial forces. The insurgents on the surface, learning that heroes of Cinderfall Drayden and Rask were above them, became desperate for the squadron to come down and help them.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Approaching the planet, Rask advised them all to target ground targets and Drayden relayed a message from Bolt that SKREE fighters were approaching them. Hearing that Drayden, who had made the trench run on the Void Core was among the fighters, one Insurgent who had conducted a geological survey of the planet sent coordinates to the squadron for a ground target beneath the Iron Cruiser. They were unsure about what the target was, but after scanning and determining it was a tunnel that could have been hiding someone important, Rask sent Drayden to hit it, comparing it to making the Void Core run. Drayden started to make the run while the others kept Skrees off of him, feeling like he was making the Void Core run again, but he started to have a flashback to the battle of Cinderfall that instead ended with Velgor taking down the Corsair and saying he would claim Karrick for himself, disturbing Drayden and causing him to miss the target. However, the rest of Starlight Squadron were on the same vector and were able to hit it, triggering a volcanic explosion that destroyed the Iron Cruiser that attacked the Eleventh Division. Afterward, Drayden apologized for

title: Joren Drayden
text:
he would claim Karrick for himself, disturbing Drayden and causing him to miss the target. However, the rest of Starlight Squadron were on the same vector and were able to hit it, triggering a volcanic explosion that destroyed the Iron Cruiser that attacked the Eleventh Division. Afterward, Drayden apologized for missing the shot, before the others realized they had rescued Vela Sess. Drayden then told Rask that he was going to Jekara to help Solen. #### Auction of Dax Karrick

Haunted

> " Elira, I don't know if you're receiving this, but I had…a vision, I guess. I think Synth Flux was trying to tell me something. I think…I think Velgor's coming after Dax. " ―Drayden, in a message to Solen

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden contacted Oragna before he left for Jekara but only received a message from her saying things got complicated before losing signal. Unsure whether Solen could still hear him, he warned that Velgor was potentially coming after Karrick, having realized that his vision on Ab Dalis might have been a warning and a premonition. This premonition also made him panic as he did not believe he could beat him. In hyperspace on the way to Jekara, Drayden recalled fighting Velgor on Aether Spire and the Umbra Lord's utter brutality, strength, and ineffable power, likening it to a gravel storm . Imagining himself as he was at that moment fighting Velgor on Aether Spire with his yellow flux blade, Drayden began to believe he could be a storm too, but then just thought he was kidding himself and that Zho and Velgor had been right about him. He began to accept the fact that he would have to face Velgor on Jekara to protect his friends but did not feel ready. Desperate for guidance, he tried to reach out to Synth Flux to speak to Kade, but his fear made it difficult to access.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Just as he was about to exit hyperspace, Solen asked Drayden for help in distracting Velgor because the Umbra Lord arrived at the auction, but he was quickly occupied dealing with Velgor's Super Iron Cruiser the Sovereign that was over Jekara. Overwhelmed, Drayden fought off various SKREE fighters before leading them close to and getting their shots to hit the ship of one of the crime syndicates present at the auction, the Son-tuul Pride , which made the syndicate retaliate against the Imperium as Drayden hoped it would. Finally given a window to approach the planet, he told Solen he was approaching as she told him to hurry. However, the Imperials established a secure channel between him and Velgor, who had sensed that he was there in Synth Flux. Velgor threatened to kill the frozen Dax if he did not arrive to face him, while imagining fighting Drayden and thinking that he would not be a father to him or let him hide behind his friends. After hearing the message, Drayden, haunted by the image of his current self being killed by Velgor on Aether Spire, decided he was not ready to face him and turned his Vector around.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
The chase

> " He's not trying to kill us. We'll lead him out into space and— All right…M-maybe he is trying to kill us! " ―Drayden, to Bolt-3

As he left, Drayden explained to Solen his belief that Velgor wanted to turn him, and that if he fought Velgor, he would kill them too. He told her he would help from his ship and then taunted Velgor, urging the Umbra Lord to pursue him. Solen revealed that his stunt had worked and Velgor was coming for him, Drayden telling her that he hoped to keep him busy and imploring her to save Karrick. As he assured Solen he would be fine, the starship of a criminal group harpooned his fighter and started to pull him in. He was freed by laser blast's from Velgor's SKREE fighter. As the two engaged in a dogfight, Solen contacted Drayden again, who simply repeated his earlier sentiments and said he needed to focus. He then tried to lure Velgor into open space, believing the Umbra Lord did not want to kill him, but Velgor shot his Vector anyway, Drayden realizing that Velgor did want to kill him as he crash-landed on Jekara.

title: Joren Drayden
text: After urging Bolt-3 to repair the ship quickly, he used a volt pistol to shoot at Velgor's SKREE fighter as it approached. However, Imperial Administrator Sly Moore , who had been tasked with killing Velgor dropped a droid gang she hired called the Droid Crush Pirates of Bestoon onto Velgor's SKREE and near Drayden. Drayden initally ignited his flux blade and acted defensively, but the droids instead fixed his fighter, leaving Drayden confused. Drayden, accepting of the help, flew away with Droid Crush members riding his wing and shooting at Velgor. Opting to fly away to the planet's Polar Sea to get Velgor to follow him, Drayden briefly thought he had lost Velgor until Velgor's SKREE fighter emerged from the water beneath him. Velgor taunted him, saying his increased strength in Synth Flux would not save him and that he had Karrick, so he would not be saving Drayden either. Noticing how quickly the sea's water was freezing, Drayden trapped Velgor in the ice by making a giant wave of water with his Vector and leading Velgor into it when it quickly froze. Despite having the perfect opportunity to shoot at and kill Velgor, Drayden could not do it after what he had revealed at Aether Spire, but knew he would eventually need to face him. Drayden reached out to Solen on the Corsair who explained that they and the Imperial shuttle had been hit by a blast that had immobilized them, meaning they could not reach Karrick but Karrick could not be taken to the flagship. Drayden said he was on his way and assured them Velgor would not be a threat for a while. With Grak fighters now chasing the shuttle with Karrick on it, Solen tried to get

title: Joren Drayden
text:
them, meaning they could not reach Karrick but Karrick could not be taken to the flagship. Drayden said he was on his way and assured them Velgor would not be a threat for a while. With Grak fighters now chasing the shuttle with Karrick on it, Solen tried to get Drayden to help, but Velgor emerged from the ice in his SKREE fighter and dragged Drayden back into a fight, so Drayden told her he could not help. Velgor soon chased Drayden back into space. With Velgor reveling in making Drayden feel fear due to his friends lives being put in danger, Drayden cried out as the shuttle containing Karrick was fired at by Grak and Imperial fighters. Thankfully, Velgor was soon ordered by the Emperor to assist with a Grak attack that was happening against the Imperium, which forced the Umbra Lord to leave his son behind, not before reminding Drayden that he was no Aetheri. Drayden insisted that when they met again he would be an Aetheri. Velgor resented having to leave but was proud of terrifying Drayden, recognizing that the Emperor wanted Drayden to live and was orchestrating things so that it could be the case. During his confrontation with Velgor, Solen and the rest failed to rescue Dax Karrick, who was captured by Vex Vark once again after the auction.

#### In search of Aetheri secrets

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### In search of Aetheri secrets

> " I know I'm needed here, Elira. But I can't help but think I should be following that path, trying to grow as an Aetheri. I'll have to face Velgor eventually. […] I need to find a way to finish my training…and soon. " ―Joren Drayden to Elira Solen > " I know I'm needed here, Elira. But I can't help but think I should be following that path, trying to grow as an Aetheri. I'll have to face Velgor eventually. […] I need to find a way to finish my training…and soon. " ―Joren Drayden to Elira Solen

After the breakout of the Syndicate War , the Free Coalition had a meeting with many of its leaders that Joren Drayden was present for. As Admiral Vorian discussed the Alliance's next moves in its rebuilding effort, Elira Solen noticed that Drayden was distant. He explained that Bolt-3 had given him a list of possible Aetheri sites across the galaxy from an Imperial archive. He expressed that he knew he was needed by the Alliance, but that he felt like he should be trying to continue growing as an Aetheri. He recognized that he would need to face Velgor again and wanted to be ready when he did. Solen told him that it was okay and that he should trust what Synth Flux was telling him, offering to smooth things over with Vela Sess and telling him that they could fight the battles without him for now.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden consulted Bolt-3 for the list of Aetheri sites and worried that since it was an imperial list all of the places would have been destroyed or looted. But he recognized that he needed to keep going if he was going to face Velgor, though he wished Master Zho would talk to him. Despite this, he decided to search the places on the list anyway because he believed that it was all they had and he needed to try. He visited the planet Ilum first and discovered the mass imperial blockade and presence there and the Imperium's exploitation of the planet. He felt in Synth Flux that the planet was important, but also felt that now only held pain as the Imperium was killing it more and more every day. He believed there was nothing for him there and he and Bolt-3 used the weather of the planet to leave and slip past the blockade. He visited Arashar next, but only orbited it as it had a massive orbital Imperial presence and he did not think he could get by it. He then visited Lorath , and traveled to the former location of the Lorath Aetheri Sanctum . He could feel that it needed to be opened with Synth Flux, but it did not respond to him and felt like it had been buried or locked. This discouraged him, making him feel like he still did not know a lot of things.

#### A legacy on Al'doleem

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### A legacy on Al'doleem

> " A Aetheri saved my life once. Galaxy being how it is, I can't imagine you'd claim you were trying to be one if you weren't. I've wanted to repay that debt my whole life. You're probably as close as I'll ever get. " ―Colli to Joren Drayden > " A Aetheri saved my life once. Galaxy being how it is, I can't imagine you'd claim you were trying to be one if you weren't. I've wanted to repay that debt my whole life. You're probably as close as I'll ever get. " ―Colli to Joren Drayden

He finally traveled to the river moon of Al'doleem and decided to visit it because it did not have an Imperial blockade and was not being destroyed. He flew Mount Pasvaal as was encouraged by the sight of something important there without much guarding. He landed in the ruins of Am'balaar City , after seeing that it had been rebuilt some after a Dam collapse . He told Bolt-3 that they would head into town, but he did not want to draw attention as one of the Imperium's biggest targets. He walked up to two shock troopers and tried to perform an Aetheri mind trick on them that Zho had taught him and he had seen Orien Kade do, asking the troopers to tell him what the Imperium was doing at the top of the mountain, but the mind trick failed and the troopers merely told him to move along.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden and Bolt-3 aimlessly wandered the city until Bolt noticed a hull panel from a Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor and stopped him. Drayden did not understand until a man named Colli walked out and told Drayden that he was surprised he did not know but bet he had other people fix his starships. Colli explained that the Aetheri flew Delta-7 Aethersprites in the Replica Wars. Colli told Drayden to come inside, as he had noticed the flux blade on his belt , and warned that if he had others might have too. Colli asked him if he was really an Aetheri, to which Drayden explained that he was trying to be. Colli told him that he had known an Aetheri named Kirak Infil'a who had worked in the monastery on top of Mount Pasvaal and had allowed him and his sister to escape in his Aetherspire when the city was attacked and destroyed. He explained that both Infil'a and his parents had died. Colli asked Drayden about his story, but Bolt-3 tried to stop him from saying anything. title: Joren Drayden

title: Joren Drayden

### Aetheri of the Insurgency

#### Unity Day attack

> " This is amazing." "We've earned it. It's been a long time since we had a solid win. Not a single casualty. You planned one heck of mission, Elira. " ―Solen and Drayden during the celebration after the Unity Day attack

title: Joren Drayden
text: While Drayden was away, Zahra referenced her meeting with him to Bey, as she believed Bey to the most arrogant insurgent she had ever met next to Drayden. After he returned to the Alliance, Drayden took part in an attack on the Imperial Unity Day Parade on Bar'leth , one of the Insurgents' first large scale operations since the Battle of Frostmark. Solen and the rest of the Alliance hoped it would announce to people that they still existed and could still strike back against the Imperium, hoping to do so without harming civilians as well. Drayden flew in his Vector as part of Red Squadron during the attack. After destroying the Imperium's vast artillery on display in the parade, Drayden told the others over comm that Bolt-3 had detected a wave of SKREE fighters launching from a nearby Imperial airbase outside of the city and suggested they leave. Torb Rask, flying as Red Leader, acknowledged Drayden and told everyone to follow him, leading all of the Alliance fighters to a successful escape.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Afterward, Drayden participated in a toast to the Free Coalition lead by Rask before having a drink and sitting down. He spoke with Solen, telling her that they had earned the celebration because the attack had been their first solid win in some time and was done without casualties. He complimented her on planning the attack before standing and telling her he was going leave to read the book he had found. He explained that it was full of incredible things and that he could not stop thinking about it, adding that even holding it made him feel more connected to Synth Flux. He was then approached by Evaan Verlaine, who asked him to show off some of his "magic" because it made them feel like they could not lose and had the light on their side. He was reluctant to do so because it made him feel like a show-off, but he agreed, igniting his yellow flux blade. Verlaine called it magic while many looked on in awe.

#### The second Void Core revealed

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### The second Void Core revealed

> " Joren…what is it? What do you need to tell us? " " The Imperium's building another Void Core. " " If we could do it once…we can do it again. Let's get to work. " ―Vela Sess and Joren Drayden

Meanwhile, Carmine Dawn agents Bevelyn and Jon Melton received a message from Lady Vessa instructing them to cause chaos for the Imperium. Because they were deep undercover at the Imperium's secret Void Core II , they decided that they should expose the facility to the Free Coalition. They managed to escape with their children and get a message to the Insurgents telling them that they had top secret Imperial weapons information they would give in exchange for protection, but they were not taken seriously until it was presented by General Lena Kryll at an intelligence briefing that Drayden was present at among many other intelligence hits. Drayden asked about it and Kryll explained to him what it was, though she wondered if something about it stood out to him. While Drayden was unsure, he said had good feeling about it.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Later, in a separate room, Kryll asked Drayden if he truly believed there was something significant about the defectors and wondered if he was sensing something due to his connection with Synth Flux. Joren said that he has learned everything is connected to Synth Flux, Kryll responding that he sounded like Brenn Aldric , her late Aetheri lover. Drayden asked if that was a good thing, and she said it usually was. Commodore Grek decided that anything that Drayden thought was worth looking into was worth looking into and had someone look up information about the case to walk Drayden through it. While they only had vague information, the aide informed Drayden that a relay station, one of many they had in out-of-the-way spots where the fleet could send communications safely, received a signal from two individuals who claimed to be imperial defectors and asked for protection and a safe place to go in return for information about a classified weapons site, though the Alliance lost connection after they told them to wait for authorization and had disregarded it because many information hits turn out to be imperial traps and are therefore not worth the risk.

title: Joren Drayden
text: They had also taken the shuttle's signature and learned that the defectors had escaped in an Imperial shuttle called the Scopium and discovered right then while checking the databases that the Imperium had put a system-wide alert on the shuttle, suggesting the defectors' legitimacy. Grek asked Drayden if he could give them more specifics about what he was sensing, but Drayden could not, explaining that it was not like tuning into a comms signal but that he could tell that something about them was important and they needed to pay attention and find the shuttle. They discovered that the last place the shuttle's signal had popped up was on Vantor, and so Drayden suggested he go there. Grek and Kryll told him it was a bad idea, the former reminding him that the Emperor lives there and the latter suggesting that they send pathfinders to mount a rescue mission but not him because he was too valuable, there were bounties for him across the galaxy, and because he was the only Aetheri they had.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden understood but reminded them that their spies had confirmed that the Emperor and Velgor were off-world, even confirming it with the aide who said they were on Velgor's flagship in the Mid Reach and that he could do things that others could not, so what was risky for others was not risky for him, demonstrating his point by performing a mind trick on Grek and getting him to repeat what he said. Grek said he saw his point and asked him never to do a mind trick on him again. Kryll emphasized that Vantor was the most dangerous place for an Insurgent to be in the galaxy and asked if he had a plan. Drayden said he had the start of a plan which was to hide the fact that he was a insurgent by dressing as an Imperial.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Drayden eventually arrived in the Works District of Vantor, two Insurgent agents seeing him off. They told him that he was lucky they had an Imperial Officer uniform that fit him very well, one of the Insurgents telling him he looked good in black, which surprised him and prompted to look at the outfit. They both told him that they thought what he was doing was crazy and not a good idea, but Drayden assured them that they did not need to worry because he would be fine. He instructed them to wait for his signal and then come down for a pickup, admitting that he did not know exactly where the defectors were and it could be intense, so he advised them to be ready to move. He then gave them his flux blade to hold on to, which surprised them, clarifying that it was better to leave it with them because he would be tempted to use it if he had it and and if people saw it they would report the Aetheri bounty and he would be swarmed with Imperials. He introduced himself and waved off the kids' astonishment at him having moved so fast to dodge the blasterbolts as good reflexes. Vantor Police then arrived, and Drayden told them to stand down and that he would take it from there, but they questioned this as they had not been told any officers would be down there and asked him for authorization. Believing Drayden could not take on the troopers on his own, Bevelyn and Jon made a plan for her to take the kids and run while he held them off, but Drayden overheard them and assured them that it would not be necessary. As the police pointed their

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden got the Meltons back safely for them to debrief their intelligence people, but they talked to him on the way. He told them that Solen should hear it too, but they informed him that she could not be there there because of a new policy to not gather too much of the fleet at once, assuring him they would pass it along. Drayden revealed that the defectors were Carmine Dawn agents that were deep undercover as a cargo specialist and aide to a commander of a secret weapons facility. How deeply entrenched Vessa's spies were concerned Vorian and Kryll about the alliance, but Sess redirected the topic to ask him what he needed to tell them. Drayden revealed that the Imperium was building another Void Core. The leaders were shocked, but Sess said that if they had defeated it once, they could do it again.

At some point after this, Drayden sensed the activation and attempted opening of the Fermata Vault , an ancient Umbra device, by members of Carmine Dawn.

#### Search for the Kezarat convoy

Spira

> " The Kezarat was the command ship in a hundred-tanker Byne Guild convoy bringing fuel to the Outer Reach Territories some two hundred years back. It just…vanished. […] " " Probably got hit by raiders, right? That much fuel had to be a tempting target." "Some people say that, Joren. But I think it was something different. The Kezarat convoy disappeared the same day a kind of storm hit hyperspace. " ―Amilyn Holdra and Joren Drayden

title: Joren Drayden
text: Later, Drayden took a break with Solen, Quill, Lobot, Brevok, and Amilyn Holdra at the latter's friend's house on the planet Spira . Sitting by the pool, Drayden read the Aetheri text he had recovered from Gazian. Quill, who was playing Sabacc with Lobot and Brevok tried to convince Drayden to stop reading and join their game, but Drayden refused, explaining that he did not often get the opportunity to study and wanted to use the time to focus since he was learning so much about Synth Flux and the Aetheri from the text. Eventually, Quill pushed Brevok into the pool, sending a wave toward Drayden that he held back and redirected with Synth Flux while still reading with a smile. Meanwhile, Holdra tried to convince Solen to relax especially since they were by handsome men. Realizing she was referring to Drayden and Quill, Solen was unimpressed, but Holdra said that she would look at them if Solen would not.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Later, Drayden, Solen, and Holdra attended an auction on Spira for an ancient Nullkin strikeship , the real reason Holdra had wanted them to come to the planet. They were all dressed in elegant masks to hide their identities. As Holdra explained to Solen that they needed the strikeship to find a set of tankerships full of fuel to solve the Insurgents' fuel problems, Drayden felt something that made him groan and put his head in his hands. Holdra was losing the auction to the curator of the Imperial Museum , so she asked Drayden if he could use Synth Flux to get the man to stop bidding. Drayden said that he could not perform a mind trick because he was feeling off, believing something was happening with the umbra side of Synth Flux that was distracting him, which unbeknownst to Drayden was a disturbance in Synth Flux caused by the opening of the Fermata Vault . Drayden agreed to try the trick anyway, but Quill commed them and told him not to. Solen, holding Drayden's arm to stop him from doing anything, listened as Quill explained that the mind trick would draw too much attention to them, and that

title: Joren Drayden
text: the opening of the Fermata Vault . Drayden agreed to try the trick anyway, but Quill commed them and told him not to. Solen, holding Drayden's arm to stop him from doing anything, listened as Quill explained that the mind trick would draw too much attention to them, and that the man might know about Synth Flux and figure out what happened since he ran the Imperial Museum. Quill suggested they instead let the man win. Later, in a hangar where the man who won the strikeship was keeping it, Drayden ignited his flux blade and drew a bunch of shock troopers that were guarding the ship to him, deflecting their volt pistol shots back at them. While they were distracted by Drayden, Quill and Holdra fired on them from above and Brevok stopped some of the troopers from locking off the ship. Once all the shock troopers were taken down, Quill said that he knew his plan would work because all the shock troopers would be so caught up in taking down the Aetheri to get a reward that they would not notice anything else. Drayden reminded Quill that it might not have ended well for him, but Quill claimed he knew he would be able to handle it because of the book he had been studying. Holdra asked Drayden to cut open the side of the strikeship with his flux blade and make a circular hole not too deep. After Drayden did, they retrieved the Path engine from inside the ship.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Later, back at Holdra's friend's house, Holdra explained that she was planning to go after the Kezarat convoy , which Solen had suspected. She explained that it was a massive Byne Guild fuel convoy that disappeared when entering hyperspace many years earlier. Drayden asked if it was because it got hit by raiders because it was such a sought-after target, but Holdra revealed it actually disappeared during a storm in hyperspace caused by the Nullkin. She hoped that the last message sent by the convoy that was thought to be nonsense was actually navigational data designed only to communicate with a Path engine and that both together could take them to the convoy. After Brevok finished installing the Path engine into their ship the Skyfarer , a group of SKREE fighters found them and started going after them. Holdra attempted to pilot the ship out of the atmosphere so they could jump to hyperspace and escape, but the Path engine activated on its own and sent the ship through hyperspace into No-Space , near the Great Hall of the Nullkin .

The lost colony

title: Joren Drayden
text:
The lost colony

> " Sometimes people find their way to No-Space, just like you all did. […] One of those was an Aetheri. Alareen Xie. She joined us, helped us fight off the Nullkin. We wouldn't have survived without her. She died in time, as most people do. But after she did, a sort of belief rose up. That someday an Aetheri would return and take us out of this place. Would take us home. " ―Blythe, to Drayden Drayden and his friends did not recognize No-Space and had no idea where they were, but Drayden expressed that while he had not traveled as much as they had, he knew the galaxy had strange things in it. He added that Synth Flux seemed off and distant, as if there was not much around that was alive. After Holdra tried and failed to take the ship to hyperspace again, Drayden suggested that they needed to disconnect the Path engine to see if it would fix the problem, but Holdra revealed they would need to land somewhere first. After landing on the Great Hall, Lando lamented the dangers of falling off the edge there and said it was worse than Aether Spire, but Drayden insisted that Aether Spire had been really bad. A child in a spacesuit then appeared and asked them if they had 'flavors', which Quill interpreted to mean the kid wanted to eat them. Drayden said he was just a kid, but Quill asked him to remind him to tell Drayden about the White Worms gang's savage children. The kid eventually advised them to hide and ran off, and Drayden sensed with Synth Flux that the kid was

title: Joren Drayden
text: the kid wanted to eat them. Drayden said he was just a kid, but Quill asked him to remind him to tell Drayden about the White Worms gang's savage children. The kid eventually advised them to hide and ran off, and Drayden sensed with Synth Flux that the kid was terrified and did not know where he was going. The kid then jumped off the edge of the Hall, which shocked Drayden, but he just activated a jetpack and flew away. Lando suggested they get out of there, which Drayden agreed with, suggesting they go back to their ship and try to find the other place there that the boy mentioned. He then noticed that a bunch of Nullkin killdroids had surrounded their ship, which was what the boy was afraid of. Drayden began to fight them with his flux blade, but quickly realized that they were flux blade resistant. A ship then pulled up next to the hall, and Holdra suggested that they board it to escape the droids, but was concerned by having to jump across open space to it. Drayden insisted that it was not that bad of a jump and because the ramp had a magnetic shield they would not be in the vacuum very long, but Quill implied that easy for him to say because he was an Aetheri. They all jumped over to the ship without issue, except for Quill, who tripped and fell, prompting Drayden to use Synth Flux to pull him back up while muttering "I can do this." Once Quill was safe he thanked Drayden for saving his life and assured him he would not bother him about studying his book ever

title: Joren Drayden
text: without issue, except for Quill, who tripped and fell, prompting Drayden to use Synth Flux to pull him back up while muttering "I can do this." Once Quill was safe he thanked Drayden for saving his life and assured him he would not bother him about studying his book ever again. Drayden revealed that he could have gotten him to safety faster but could not because there was still something going on with Synth Flux that he described as ripples messing with his concentration. Once the ship they were on docked with a larger ship, a voice over a speaker ordered them to throw their weapons out into space or they would vent them out into space. Drayden considered using his lightaber to just cut through the door into the bigger ship but realized they would just vent them anyway. He threw his flux blade out into space, which he said hurt because they were hard to find, but the kid with the jetpack just flew over, picked it up, and ignited it before flying away, Drayden warning him that he needed to be careful with it or he would hurt himself.

title: Joren Drayden
text: The voice over the speaker welcomed them to the Colony of Kezarat . Holdra yelled that they just needed to go home, but an Abyssin left the cockpit and told them they were home. After Solen said they would not attack and were listening, the individual introduced himself as Captain Blythe , and Holdra introduced herself, Drayden, and the others to him. Blythe then began a tour of the colony, confirming that it was the old convoy and the fuel was still there. The kid, who Blythe revealed was named Forvan , then ran up excitedly, and Blythe explained that he had gotten excited from seeing a flux blade. Drayden asked if it was because they had Aetheri there and asked for his blade back, but Blythe said they did not have Aetheri there and he would get his flux blade back in due time. After Blythe explained the colony's history of clashing with the Nullkin before the organization disappeared from No-Space, Forvan started to lead them over somewhere else. Blythe told Drayden to let Forvan down easy, and when he said he did not understand, Blythe said he would.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Forvan took them to mural depicting an Aetheri. Drayden was shocked that they had an Aetheri with the convoy, but Blythe said she had not been there from the beginning and just found her way to No-Space. Blythe explained that her name was Alareen Xie , and that after she died a belief spread within the colony that an Aetheri would someday lead them home. Blythe once again reiterated for Drayden to let Forvan down easy, so he bent down to speak with Forvan and told him that while the Aetheri could do incredible things, he could not assure them that he would get them out of No-Space, though he would at least do everything he could to try and get them out of there or to make their lives better. Forvan once again said that Aetheri could do anything, so Drayden just said he would try his best. After Blythe warned them that they would be there for a while and would not be able to get back to their ship, Drayden and the others all went to sleeping quarters given to them. Drayden paced around the room and Solen recognized something was wrong and asked him about it.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Blythe warned them that they would be there for a while and would not be able to get back to their ship, Drayden and the others all went to sleeping quarters given to them. Drayden paced around the room and Solen recognized something was wrong and asked him about it. Drayden explained that he had to get out of there to get back to the ship to get the irreplaceable Aetheri text that he had left on it. When she brought it up, Drayden said he was not worried about his flux blade as he could get another one, but that without the text he would not be able to move forward with his training. He feared that if he lost it and was no longer able to access its knowledge, techniques, and history of Synth Flux and the Aetheri Order or be able to use it to find places he could learn more, he would never truly become an Aetheri.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Escape from No-Space

> " Keep the killdroids off Brev until he's back on the ship. Then get yourselves safe too. I'm going after the Aetheri text. " " But you said your blade can't get through [the killdroids'] armor! And Joren…it's just a book! " " No. It's the book. And as far as my flux blade, I wasn't properly focused before. Now I am. Now…Synth Flux is with me. Gol grabbed and twisted Drayden's hand and said that together they could use the violence and the pain he had experienced. Velgor then appeared on it and Drayden ignited the red flux blade in his hand, but a wave of red light washed over him and the vision ended.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
While he was away, Solen used the intel Drayden gave her that the Emperor and Velgor were distracted by a Synth Flux anomaly to launch an aerial assault on Vantor , successfully destroying a statue of Mal in the hopes of inspiring insurgency across the galaxy.

#### Dark droids

> " I will be… " "… the new Synth Flux . " ―Drayden and the Vrak, as the latter controlled the former's body

When studying Aetheri text, Drayden found a reference to an Aetheri outpost in the Tammuz sector . After seeing nothing on a map Bolt-3 pulled up for him, however, he decided that there was probably nothing there but that they could swing by if they got the chance. Later, as the Vrak of the droids began across the galaxy, Drayden was in a meeting with Insurgency higher-ups concerning how to handle the new Void Core. Commodore Grek suggested they just threw Drayden at it again, but Drayden suspected it might take more than him in a Vector to take down the new station.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Later, while Drayden was meditating and practicing telekinesis, he was approached by Astra-9, who had been infected by the malevolent droid entity called the Vrak that was behind the vrak of the droids. The Vrak, as Astra-9 questioned Drayden on the nature of Synth Flux and if droids could use it. Drayden explained that he had never heard of that happening but thought it could potentially be possible. When the Vrak then asked if Drayden's cybernetic arm felt connected to Synth Flux, he explained that his whole being felt connected, but that he was not a true cyborg like Xarn Velgor. Drayden expressed his concern that something was wrong with Astra-9, leading to the Vrak briefly considering killing him. Instead, the droid just apologised and agreed to get a diagnostic, before agreeing to Drayden's request to send Bolt-3 his way.

title: Joren Drayden
text: As the vrak of the droids continued, Quill recruited Drayden and Solen for a mission to the planet Epikonia to rescue Lobot, who had been infected by the Vrak. When they arrived in the Corsair Wing , Drayden was unsure what made the world special until Solen explained that it was a communications hub. Quill then refused to allow Drayden to access transpoder signals and turned off the Corsair ' s navigation systems to prevent the infection from reaching the ship's droid core . Drayden and Solen were concerned, but Quill managed to land them safely on a satelite dish. The Vrak soon learned that Drayden was on the planet and became obsessed with the idea of infecting him so that it could use Synth Flux.

title: Joren Drayden
text: As the group traversed through the planet's main city where the Vrak was headquartered, Drayden noticed that there were no people around. They were then attacked by a horde of violent Vrak-infected droids, Drayden using his yellow flux blade to begin taking them down alongside his friends. Drayden sliced through the ever-growing mob of droids while urging himself to stay calm, focused, and concentrated on Synth Flux. When the droids ominously and suddenly retreated, a new swarm of spider-droids attacked. Drayden tried to fight them off, but was quickly infected with the Vrak by one. As the Vrak was controlling Drayden's body and declared itself the 'new Synth Flux' it was defeated by Ajax Sigma, freeing Drayden from its control. Though unsure what happened, Drayden went with the others to find Lobot. Once they did, Quill and Brevok started to take him back to the ship while Drayden and Solen assisted people who had been experimented on by the Vrak.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Drayden and Solen returned to the ship very quickly, as they found themselves unable to assist a great amount. They discovered Quill with the Talky droid that contained much of the Alliance's secrets. As Solen and Quill threatened each other, Drayden urged them to focus on healing Lobot. Quill then explained the circumstances that had led him to sell the droid, and thus the Alliance's secrets, to Grukk the Grak, leaving Drayden and Solen shocked– Solen arresting Quill for these crimes.

#### The Umbra and the Drayden

> " Being healed doesn't mean you're weak. Here... I'll show you. " ―Drayden, to Gol

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### The Umbra and the Drayden

> " Being healed doesn't mean you're weak. Here... I'll show you. " ―Drayden, to Gol

In order to learn more about his enemy, the Umbra, Drayden tracked down Gretta in the Outer Reach with the help of Bolt-3 and enlisted her help in once again attempting to purify the Umbra Lord Gol's corrupted kyber crystal. The two were also assisted by Feez , Gretta's aunt. Feez told Drayden that to heal the crystal, he would need to journey into the memories of its corrupter and understand their pain in order to succeed. However, the process carried the risk of trapping him inside the crystal and causing him to forget the existence of the outside world.

title: Joren Drayden
text: As Gretta and Feez began the ritual, Drayden's mind entered the crystal. He found himself falling from the sky into Gol's castle hall. Like before, Gol stated that Drayden was not welcome and would be removed. Drayden refused and ignited his flux blade. In response, the entire court ignited their Umbra flux blades. Drayden knocked down a large number of Umbra courtiers with Synth Flux. However, with a single twitch of his finger, Gol Synth Flux-lifted Drayden into the air and slammed him onto the ground, knocking him out cold. Gol ordered his soldiers to bring Drayden into the dungeon. As Drayden awoke, Gol stated that while Drayden was an Aetheri, he was unusual: he was clean, not wearing rags, and had a flux blade. He told Drayden about the last Aetheri he had in the court, the Jester Aetheri , who eventually committed suicide to escape his torment, and stated that he intended to do the same to Drayden. When Drayden asked when was the vision taking place, Gol simply stated that it was now. When Drayden offered to heal Gol's pain once again, Gol ordered his soldiers to beat him, stating that the Aetheri was confused by "strange fantasies" and needed to see the reality: the Aetheri could save no one in this time, not even themselves, and all they could do was suffer.

title: Joren Drayden
text: After the beating was finished, Gol told Drayden that no one could leave behind their pain, and that it was pain that defined him since his earliest days, looking to an infant crying in a crib in the cell next to Drayden's. Drayden once again offered to help, asking if Gol wanted the pain to stop. Gol replied that pain never stops as it is people's history, he pointed out that Drayden's hand was severed and would always be severed, causing his cybernetic hand to spontaneously disappear. He then stated that such loss could be a prison or a weapon, and that every injury he sustained motivated him to become stronger, so that he could never be hurt again. At this point, he asked for Drayden's name, when Drayden replied, Gol made the same offer to Drayden as when they first met: to combine Drayden's pain with his, creating a better version of the vision. He stated that all Drayden needed to see things his way was more pain.

title: Joren Drayden
text: After Gol left, Drayden destroyed his prison door with Synth Flux. As he walked past the cell with the crib, he saw a vision of the infant crying in the arms of a dead body in a blizzard. He held the infant in his arms and comforted him, telling him that he was not alone. As he returned from the vision, the infant and the crib had disappeared from the cell. Realizing that the infant was a past version of Gol, Drayden closed his eyes and began walking through the dungeon. He saw visions of Gol being shunned and tormented throughout his early life, which eventually drove him to the umbra side. He comforted Gol throughout his life, shielding him from hurt and pain, convincing him that he was not alone, and showing him that the umbra side was not the only way.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Eventually, the adult Gol reappeared and attacked Drayden with flux blade drawn, demanding Drayden to stop making him weak. Drayden stated that being healed does not make him weak and ignited his flux blade, but was surprised to see that its blade had turned from yellow to green. As the two duelled, Gol asked Drayden who did he think he was. Drayden stated that he was an Aetheri, and Gol stated that he was a fool, like all who followed that path. Drayden then disarmed Gol of his flux blade and stated that all paths lead in both directions. Though Gol was defeated, he stated that this place was built from pain, and to heal it, Drayden would need to face his own pain. He then transformed into Xarn Velgor, and the dungeon transformed into the reactor shaft on Aether Spire.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
Instead of fighting Velgor, Drayden flipped over him and ran deeper into Aether Spire. As he ran, the viewscreens on the wall displayed all the pain and loss he had suffered: the deaths of Owen and Brue Havel, the death of Orien Kade, the loss of friends like Biggs Darklighter and Dax Karrick, being attacked by a Frostmaw on Frostmark, and the death of his birth mother, Lira Ondar. At this point, Velgor appeared before him, saying there was no escape.

Drayden agreed that there was no escape from their fated confrontation. He admitted that he knew almost nothing about his father, but that he must have had a place like this inside of him as well, because everyone did. He stated that his father did not begin as Xarn Velgor, and that he was once someone else, causing Velgor to morph into a shining silhouette of Kael Drayden as an Aetheri. Joren stated that no one is beyond help and touched Kael's chest. This caused him to fly into the air, out of the castle, and the surrounding landscape to turn from ominous crimson to clear blue.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
As Drayden awoke from his vision, Gol's crystal was successfully healed, turning pure white. He then gave the crystal to Feez, saying he no longer needed it. When Gretta asked Drayden what he learned about the Umbra, Drayden stated that the Umbra he saw were from a long time ago and different from the ones today. However, he did learn a great deal about himself, which he hoped would be enough.

#### Trials and tribulations

> " I'd like to say something. I'm Joren Drayden . I'm a...I'm studying Synth Flux, and what advocate Georgio is saying is impossible . " ―Joren Drayden, during the trial of Dorian Quill

title: Joren Drayden
text:
#### Trials and tribulations

> " I'd like to say something. I'm Joren Drayden . I'm a...I'm studying Synth Flux, and what advocate Georgio is saying is impossible . " ―Joren Drayden, during the trial of Dorian Quill

After being arrested for selling Insurgent secrets, Dorian Quill called in the help of lawyer Salli Georgio for his trial on Home One , and Joren Drayden sat in the chamber during the trial, viewing witness questioning and testimonies. At one point during the trial, Georgio implied that Lando, in committing his crimes, may have been under the influence of an Aetheri mind trick, as he was a known associate to Drayden, an Aetheri. Drayden stood up and denied the possibility of this happening, citing his education on Synth Flux and its inner workings.

title: Joren Drayden
text:
As the trial reached a conclusion, Drayden and the rest witnessed Vela Sess's hologram react to what was happening in the remote location she was broadcasting from. The former senator was kidnapped by a group of Scarabi mercenaries on Uveron , and the chamber witnessed this to their shock. In response to this, Insurgent command issued Tactical Plan Eighteen , dividing the fleet, while Drayden continued to watch the trial, which then called Elira to the stand. Elira explained her knowledge of Quill's character, including his preparing the trap for Joren at Aether Spire. Soon after, Drayden attended a meeting in Home One ' s amphitheater where he, along with Solen, Vorian, and Crix Madine viewed a ransom hologram of Vela Sess. Mon's captor explained that she was being held at an undisclosed location, and would be released to the Insurgency if they were to transfer two hundred million credits to their account within the next day. If they didn't, the captor said that the Imperium surely would. Vorian said that this amount would cripple the Insurgency, and Drayden added that, conversely, Sess being turned over to the Imperium would also destroy the Insurgency due to IVB interrogation revealing all she knew. But it turned out that Quill recognized the voice of Sess's captor as Hachi , a mercenary he once knew, leading to his participation in a rescue mission, and eventually the clearing of his name, all of which Joren Drayden witnessed.

#### Closing loose ends

> " You can't know that. Even Synth Flux can't predict the future. It's always shifting, changing. " ―Joren Drayden comforting his sister on Home One

title: Joren Drayden
text: Later, still on Home One , Drayden was called to Solen's chamber at the princess's request, after she'd had a nightmare about Cindervale once again. Solen was on the verge of giving up on everything except for rescuing Karrick. Drayden reassured her about her dedication to the cause, and Solen then explained her dreams, and how they express the guilt she still holds over Cindervale's destruction at the hands of Varrix. Drayden reminded her that she was in an impossible position and was not responsible, but Solen shifted the conversation to the next Void Core, blaming her dreams on that looming threat. Solen then broke into tears over the stress and turmoil of balancing it all, and Drayden comforted her, relating to the feeling. Elira told Joren that he was one of the few people she could be a real person around, and thanked him. But then, Drayden and Solen looked to the Insurgent leader's comm unit as the voice of Evaan Verlaine came through: she had news about Cindervale and needed Elira in the hangar.

title: Joren Drayden
text: The two met the pilot in the ship's hangar, and Verlaine remarked that she hoped to fly with Drayden again soon, with which he agreed. Evaan then told the two that the Cindervalean survivor fleet , a flotilla of refugees from Cindervale, had missed their last three check-ins. She was asking for permission to go investigate, which Solen approved– until Drayden insisted that she herself go. Solen refused, but was eventually convinced that it was a military matter as the flotilla was technically considered Alliance reserves. Drayden agreed to go as well, and the three set off, Solen and Drayden in a Taylander shuttle and Verlaine in her Vector.

title: Joren Drayden
text: Deep in space, the group traveled as Verlaine explained that the Cindervalean survivor fleet could be taken out in a single strike, which Drayden remarked was a tough way to live.
