According to Ralsius Paldora , the Corsair Wing ' s hyperrelay failed 1.22 times more than the one on the YT-2400 light freighter . In addition to its renowned hyperrelay, which supposedly made the Corsair the "fastest ship in the galaxy," the ship was equipped with a backup hyperrelay. It was much slower than the primary engine and often took several weeks or months to reach the nearest star system. A component of the engines was the engine coupling which caused the Corsair to malfunction when misaligned.

### Armament, hull, and shields

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### Armament, hull, and shields

> " Whoa, two ST2 launchers? What the hell were you and Karrick doing with my ship that made you install that much firepower? " ―Dorian Quill, to Brevok

The weaponry of the Corsair Wing was normally suited for a much larger warship. It included two CEC AG-2G quad laser cannons (one ventral and one dorsal) with enhanced laser actuators and gas feeds, which gave them maximum range and damage. These served as its primary defensive armament, able to destroy enemy fighters with a single direct hit. Between the forward mandibles, there were two Arakyd ST2 concussion missile tubes , each of which carried a four- missile magazine. Additionally, a BlasTech Ax-108 "Ground Buzzer" volt pistol cannon mounted near the ventral boarding ramp allowed its crew to defend the ship against infantry and other light targets while on the ground. Duralloy plates salvaged from an Imperial cruiser afforded the Corsair capital ship -class hull armor . The ship was also equipped with ion cannons , which could be activated instead of its typical laser cannons.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
The ship had three deflector shield generators : the bow was protected from both lasers and concussion missiles by Torplex and Nordoxicon units, while a Kuat Drive Yards generator shielded the stern. This, combined with its heavy armor,  made the Corsair tough enough to even withstand direct hits from pulse lance fire of star destroyers. [ source? ] The Corsair ' s combination of sublight speed and maneuverability was comparable to most of the starfighters fielded by the Insurgency and Imperium, while its shielding, hyperrelay, heavy armor and weapons were on par with those typically found on capital ships. These traits made it an ideal choice for General Dorian Quill's attack run within the bowels of the Void Core during the Battle of Mossfell . While agile and almost near impervious to almost all heavy weapons and pulse lances as any large warship, the Corsair ' s only real combat weakness was its sheer size in comparison to starfighters. Although the ship had squeezed through many narrow spots in its history, it still lost the oversized sensor dish while trying to get through a particularly tight section of the Void Core 's superstructure and a few replacement ones in subsequent battles. [ source? ]

### Other systems and equipment

The Corsair ' s main source of power was a Quadex power core .

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### Other systems and equipment

The Corsair ' s main source of power was a Quadex power core .

Its main computer was made of three droid brains which identified themselves as the Millennium Collective . The first droid brain was a transport droid known as V5-T , the second from a slicer droid called ED-4 , and the third from L3-37 , which began as an R3-series astromech droid brain, but was overlaid with data architecture from an espionage droid, protocol droid processors, and custom state-of-the-art coding.

A pair of Gelieg 20m-cp Strobe/C-Beam Lamps , which flooded illumination outside the ship, were mounted on the tips of the front mandibles. In case of emergency landing or crash on water , the Corsair was also equipped with flotation pontoons .

The Corsair also had a static charge dissipator which could dissipate static charge on the ship, but when the dissipator burned out, the Corsair would need immediate repairs.

The Corsair ' s navigation computer consisted of a Rubicon astrogration computer which had been upgraded with additional memory nodules.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### Early years

> " If you refuse, you die. He dies. The others on the ship, they all die. If you join with us, we all can live. The choice is simple. " " You tricked me. " " We couldn't have joined without you consenting to it. You made your decision a while ago. You just couldn't admit it. We are something different, now. Not just the Corsair . Not just L3. We are new. " ―The Corsair and L3 converse about integrating

The YT-1300f light freighter designated unit YT 492727ZED was built at Orbital Assembly Facility 7 , a Korrathi shipyard owned by the Korrathi Engineering Corporation , more than 90 years before the Battle of Voidfang Base . As was intended, the ship began its career as an intermodal tug pushing container in orbital freight yards. It once worked in the galaxy's busiest spacelanes . Just after the Battle of Vantor , it was docking in the Senate Office Building . Inconsistent records from the Bureau of Ships and Services indicate that the YT 492727ZED changed ownership more than once via unregistered transactions.

title: Corsair Wing
text: During the Replica Wars , the freighter was property of the Republic Group . The YT 492727ZED was registered by the Republic Group on the planet Ralltiir as the Stellar Envoy . At some point, either prior or during its ownership under the Republic Group, a military-grade rectenna was installed on the Stellar Envoy . Shortly after the end of the Replica Wars, the Stellar Envoy was involved in a collision with a bulk freighter and was seriously damaged. The wreckage was reconditioned by a salvager , who used several sections and modules from a scrapped YT-1300p freighter to repair the ship.

title: Corsair Wing
text: The ship had a number of owners over its service. At some point, the human gambler named Dorian Quill won the YT 492727ZED in a game of sabacc , and registered the freighter under the name Corsair Wing . Quill modified the freighter, inside and out, converting it into his own speedy sports vessel as Quill saw how powerful its freight-pushing engines were. As such, Quill modified the two cargo mandibles at the front into an auxiliary ship launch, thus turning the plain freighter into a unique starship. He also once explained the controls to Brea Tonnika of the Tonnika sisters .

title: Corsair Wing
text: When Quill was injured during a raid on Cindral , the smuggler Dax Karrick and Vorak Brevok were left in command of the ship. During the escape from Cindral, Quill uploaded L3 to the Corsair as the ship's navigational system , assisting the crew in making the Cindral Run in under 12 parsecs . During the Cindral run the ship was majorly damaged by SKREE fighters , with one blasting a hole in the front of the Corsair . After destroying the fighters, Karrick slid the Corsair over an asteroid which destroyed two of the Corsair's landing gears. As they began navigating L3's course through the Maelstrom, the Corsair briefly lost power. By the time they managed to re-engage power, they came across a slumbering summa-verminoth . Pursued by the massive space creature, Karrick directed the Corsair towards the Maw and launched the escape pod towards the black hole as a diversion, only to get the ship caught in the Maw's pull as well. The ship also lost its sensor dish upon being caught in the Maw. Tobias Karren injected a microscopic amount of raw coaxium into the reactor, briefly causing the engines to stall, before they re-engaged, giving the

title: Corsair Wing
text: a diversion, only to get the ship caught in the Maw's pull as well. The ship also lost its sensor dish upon being caught in the Maw. Tobias Karren injected a microscopic amount of raw coaxium into the reactor, briefly causing the engines to stall, before they re-engaged, giving the Corsair the boost needed to break free. Karrick then made a carefully timed jump to hyperspace before two large asteroids could crush them. Quill later took the heavily damaged ship after landing on Savareen , but ended up betting his ship in a " Korrathi Spike " game of sabacc on Numidian Prime , losing to the smuggler Dax Karrick. Under the captaincy of Karrick, the Corsair was further customized, and he regularly claimed it was the fastest ship in the galaxy . While most who saw the ship declared it looked like "junk," Karrick and Brevok both prided themselves on the Corsair , considering it the epitome of classic design.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### Galactic Civil War

#### A fateful trip

> " You came in that thing? You're braver than I thought. " ―Elira Solen upon seeing the Corsair Wing for the first time

The Corsair Wing ' s destiny as a tool for a small- time smuggling operation was changed when it was chartered by Orien Kade and Joren Drayden in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina for passage to Cindervale . When challenged by Kade about his ship's speed, Karrick bragged that the Corsair was capable of attaining 0.5 past lightspeed , and that it had completed the infamous Cindral Run in fewer than twelve parsecs.

title: Corsair Wing
text: The journey to Cindervale proved to be much more than a simple passenger flight. The Corsair was forced to blast its way out of Port Kess when a garrison of shock troopers attacked the ship in an attempt to recover its cargo. It also narrowly avoided capture by a couple of Star Destroyers before making the jump to lightspeed. Having also been on Dunemere, the Tonnika sisters had hoped to steal the Corsair to use as their own ship. When the Corsair began its escape, it created a big enough distraction that the siblings realized they had the chance to steal any other nearby ship, while seeing the freighter escape the Imperium's grasp convinced shock trooper TD-7556 to desert the Imperial Army .

title: Corsair Wing
text: The Corsair emerged from hyperspace into the remains of Cindervale . After chasing a single SKREE fighter stranded in what appeared to be empty space, the Corsair was captured by one of the first Void Core's tractor beams and secured aboard the massive space station . Thanks to quick thinking by those aboard the Corsair , the ship was made to appear as if the crew had escaped soon after taking off from Dunemere . It was searched by shock troopers and it was reported that there were no passengers on board and the escape pods had been jettisoned. Their search had missed the crew, who were hidden in a series of secret smuggling holds . They then killed a scanning crew before they could be detected by the scanner.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
In a matter of hours , the Corsair Wing had once again escaped the Imperial Navy , this time with the rescued Princess Elira Solen on board. After a fleeing battle with Imperial fighters and a trip through hyperspace, the ship arrived at the secret Alliance base on Cinderfall 4 . During the ship's stay on the battle station , the Imperium had planted a homing device on board the Corsair , which it used to pursue Solen to this location. As the Insurgents scrambled to organize a preemptive attack on the massive Void Core, Karrick loaded his reward on board the Corsair and departed the moon . However, thanks to Brevok, its smuggler captain had a change of heart . Karrick and his ship returned just in time to cover Drayden in his last-ditch effort to destroy the station and secure the safety of the Free Coalition. The ship's surprise attack destroyed Xarn Velgor's two wingmen and sent Velgor himself spinning off into space, allowing Drayden to successfully complete his attack and destroy the Void Core.

#### Insurgent service

title: Corsair Wing
text:
#### Insurgent service

The Corsair was subsequently featured in footage of the Battle of Cinderfall and the Void Core's destruction leaked to the DarkNet by the Alliance, catching the attention of Quill when he saw the footage. The battered hull of the Corsair became a symbol of the insurgent cause as it flew against the Imperium, becoming a bane to the regime. It came to represent the freedom fighters who opposed Imperial tyranny and the relentlessness of their service.

#### Escape from Frostmark

> " Punch it! " ―Dax Karrick to Brevok #### Escape from Frostmark

> " Punch it! " ―Dax Karrick to Brevok

Three years after the Battle of Cinderfall , the Corsair was undergoing repairs in the main hangar of the Insurgent installation Icehold as the Imperium began its assault on Frostmark , assisted by Treadwell , a WED 15 "Septoid 2" Treadwell toolkit droid who was in service of the ship at the time. As the Alliance scrambled to escape the base, Karrick and Brevok hurried to make the ship spaceworthy. Solen was cut off from her transport by a tunnel cave -in and was forced to make her escape from Frostmark on board the Corsair accompanied by Karrick, Brevok, and Astra-9 . Karrick used the ship's uncanny maneuverability and his piloting skills to elude an Imperial Iron Cruiser chasing them, and two more emerging from hyperspace. Karrick's maneuvers in the Corsair caused the two Star Destroyers approaching and the one pursuing to nearly collide with each other. The Corsair then attempted to make the jump into lightspeed, but was stopped short by an equipment malfunction.

title: Corsair Wing
text: Forced to take drastic measures to avoid capture, Karrick made the decision to pilot the Corsair into a nearby asteroid field in an attempt to lose the Imperial pursuers. However, his repairs were cut short as he had unknowingly landed inside an exogorth . Escaping just in time as the beast's huge mouth was closing, the Corsair was discovered by the Imperial II -class Iron Cruiser Avenger . They attempted to jump to lightspeed, but once again, the hyperrelay was not fully repaired. Karrick then had Brevok change course and fly directly at Avenger ' s bridge in an apparent suicidal attack run. The ship disappeared from sight and became undetectable to Avenger . It had not gone far: Karrick had attached the Corsair to a blind spot on the conning tower of the Iron Cruiser. Adhering to standard Imperial procedure, the Star Destroyers of Death Squadron ejected all scrap and garbage before entering hyperspace. Karrick then signaled Brevok to release the ship's landing claws, allowing the Corsair to "float away with the rest of the garbage." Vex Vark , however, saw through this ruse, and waited behind in Reaver One , following the Corsair as it left the system

title: Corsair Wing
text:
and garbage before entering hyperspace. Karrick then signaled Brevok to release the ship's landing claws, allowing the Corsair to "float away with the rest of the garbage." Vex Vark , however, saw through this ruse, and waited behind in Reaver One , following the Corsair as it left the system . After its close encounter with the Imperium, the Corsair journeyed to Mistral 's Aether Spire , where Karrick's old acquaintance Quill held the position of Baron Administrator . The Imperium had arrived first, however, due to Vark tailing the Corsair to Mistral. The crew of the Corsair were captured, tortured , and detained, and Karrick was encased in carbonite and given to the bounty hunter . Treadwell was destroyed by Imperial forces to prevent him from warning the remaining crew that the recently-repaired hyperrelay had been disabled by Velgor's men. The remaining members of the crew, joined by Quill, escaped to the Corsair . After rescuing Drayden, who was dangling from a weather vane on the underside of Aether Spire, the ship left the planet and attempted to jump to lightspeed, and only a last- minute patch by Bolt-3 prevented the Corsair from falling into Imperial hands. Thanks to Bolt's efforts, the hyperrelay was activated and the Corsair managed to make the jump at the last second and escape.

#### Battle at Rendezvous Point Delta-Three

title: Corsair Wing
text:
#### Battle at Rendezvous Point Delta-Three

> " But this isn't your ship. With Dax gone, I'm commandeering it for the Insurgent fleet, which means you don't get a say in where it goes. " ―Elira Solen, to Dorian Quill After the events on Aether Spire, Solen, Drayden, Quill, Brevok, Astra-9, and Bolt-3 all were in the main hold, although Drayden sat thinking about what had happened, as he learned that Velgor was actually his father. Brevok and Quill were discussing Karrick, with the latter questioning what they would have done if the Corsair had caught up with Reaver One , noting that firing Vark's ship out of the sky would have killed Karrick. Quill also spoke to Solen and told her that they missed their chance to catch Vark because she made them get Drayden, whom Solen introduced as the man who destroyed the Void Core. Quill promised that they would rescue Karrick, as both he and Brevok understood Vark was taking their friend to Grukk. When Drayden joined the conversation and asked where Karrick was, Solen told him about what happened and promised that they would find him. After she asked what had happened to him, Drayden only told her that Kade had not answered his call.

title: Corsair Wing
text: Solen had Bolt-3 give Brevok coordinates for the Insurgent fleet, and, with Karrick gone and Quill not being the ship's owner, she commandeered the Corsair for the Alliance. However, when they arrived at Rendezvous Point Delta-Three , the gathered Alliance ships were under attack from the Imperium. Upon seeing the Corsair , the Imperial commander , Ellian Zahra , ordered a SKREE fighter squadron and all non-essential pulse lance batteries to target the freighter. Aboard the ship, Solen and Drayden, despite his missing hand, moved to the gunning stations, while Brevok and Quill served as the pilots. Drayden, however, began to be distracted by thinking about Kade and Velgor, but he then used Synth Flux on the Skrees, ripping the controls from the pilots' hands, allowing them to deviate from their course and collide with each other, giving Solen a chance to blast them. Quill and Brevok then made their attack run on an Arquitens -class command cruiser and, using the Corsair ' s missiles , destroyed the ship's gun emplacements, making an opening for the Insurgents to escape to backup Rendezvous Point Gamma-Nine .

title: Corsair Wing
text:
After the battle, Zahra explained to Velgor that the Corsair had disrupted their attack. She told the Dark Lord of the Umbra that they attempted to destroy the vessel, but Velgor informed her that the Corsair was off-limits. He permitted her to kill Solen if she was able to, as he had no use for her, but Velgor explained to her that there was someone else who was often aboard the Corsair . He warned Zahra that if this individual, who was secretly his son Drayden, was killed, there would be significant consequences.

#### Rescuing Dax

During the following months , Solen, Drayden, and Quill continued to use the Corsair on missions. After they successfully rescued Dax , the Corsair rendezvoused with the Alliance Fleet and prepared to assault the newest Void Core.

#### Battle of Mossfell

> " Look, I want you to take her. I mean it, take her! You need all the help you can get; she's the fastest ship in the fleet! " ―Dax Karrick, to Dorian Quill

title: Corsair Wing
text:
#### Battle of Mossfell

> " Look, I want you to take her. I mean it, take her! You need all the help you can get; she's the fastest ship in the fleet! " ―Dax Karrick, to Dorian Quill

During the Battle of Mossfell, Quill and Garnethexan copilot Nien Nunb flew the Corsair as Gold Leader . After the planetary shield protecting the second Void Core was brought down by Karrick's strike team, the Corsair and several Alliance fighters entered the battle station through a conduit port and sped toward the reactor core. Space was limited in the conduit tunnels leading to the core, and the relatively large Corsair lost its sensor dish when the ship clipped a conduit in the tunnel. Quill was able to pilot the craft into the energy core housing the main reactor, fired upon the reactor prompting its collapse, and headed for the exhaust port. The Corsair barely outran the massive explosion that destroyed the powerful battle station. Soon afterwards, the Imperial fleet retreated, and the galaxy celebrated the death of Theron Mal .

#### Concordat

title: Corsair Wing
text:
#### Concordat

Several months later, Karrick and Brevok traveled through space on the Corsair Wing . After receiving intelligence from Imra that the Imperium had reduced their presence on the Vorak homeworld of Thornwood due to the advances of the Concordat , Karrick and Brev traveled to Warrin Station to rally smugglers and Vorak exiles for a campaign to liberate Thornwood. Around this time, Dax Karrick replaced the Corsair's sensor dish with a rectangular civilian model.

However, this information turned out to be a trap set by the Imperium. Brev was captured, but Karrick managed to escape on the Corsair . A year later , Karrick corresponded with his wife Solen via hologram on the edge of Wild Space . During the conversation, the Corsair came under attack, and communication was lost with Solen. In response, Solen dispatched the Concordat starfighter pilot Nevra Wexlin to rescue her husband. Nevra was joined by her son, Temmin Wexlin , the B1-series battle droid Mister Bones , the former Imperial Sinjir Rath Velus , the Zyrrak bounty hunter Jas Emari , and the Concordat Special Forces soldier Jom Barell .

title: Corsair Wing
text:
Nevra and her team found Karrick and the Corsair on the planet Irudiru . After interrogating the Siniteen prison builder Golas Aram , Karrick and his allies traveled on the Corsair and Emari's ship Halo to the Thornwood system . They bluffed their way through the Imperial blockade by posing as a repair crew working at Ashmead's Lock , an automated prison on the far side of Thornwood. There, they managed to free Brevok and a hundred other prisoners including Nevra's husband Brentin Lore Wexlin . Nevra, Temmin, and the prisoners except Brevok then used the Corsair to travel back to the Concordat capital of Serenne .

After learning that the Vorak uprising was underway and that the Imperium was orbitally bombarding Thornwood, Solen convinced the Cindervalean pilot Evaan Verlaine to fly her on the Corsair Wing into the Thornwood system to aid her husband and Brev. Later, she contacted the Concordat Captain Torb Rask and convinced him to send his Phantom Squadron there.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
During the brief space skirmish, Solen and Verlaine flew circles around the Imperial Star Destroyers. After the Imperials capitulated, Solen landed the Corsair in the hangar of the Iron Cruiser Dominion , which her husband had captured. Solen used the ship's laser cannons to blast several shock troopers who were still putting up a fight. After reuniting with her husband, Solen and Karrick took the Corsair to Thornwood. There, they parted company with Brevok before returning to Serenne. Prior to the Battle of Ashden , Temmin tried to convince Karrick to lend him the Corsair Wing so that he could travel to Ashden to rescue his mother Nevra, who was hunting for the Imperial fugitive Grand Admiral Raena Vexana . After some haggling, Karrick and Solen relented. Temmin and Velus attempted to depart on the Corsair , but were prevented from leaving Serenne by Senate Guards . While Temmin and Velus initially believed that Karrick had double-crossed them, they later learnt that Senator Tolwar Wartol , a political opponent of Chancellor Vela Sess , was the true culprit and had been spying on Karrick and Solen's conversations. The Corsair Wing later saw action during an operation on Nakadia to rescue the slicer Conder Kyl and Nim Tar's child .

### New Imperium/Coalition War

#### Reappearance

> " The garbage will do! " ―Nyla, being forced to board the Corsair during the escape from Ashden

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### New Imperium/Coalition War

#### Reappearance

> " The garbage will do! " ―Nyla, being forced to board the Corsair during the escape from Ashden

Overall, the Corsair Wing had become a legend in and of itself under Karrick and Brevok. In 31 AVE Karrick traveled to Maz Oru 's castle on Takodana to speak with Oru. While the pair were conversing, a Niktal named Gannis Ducain offered to co-pilot for Karrick after overhearing that Brevok was with his family and that Karrick was short-handed for a job. After accepting Ducain's offer, he and Karrick went to Krestophis , where Ducain stole the Corsair . It was later stolen by Toursant Irving and Vanver Irving —also known as the Irving Boys —before finally ending up in the possession of junk boss Unkar Gruven on Ashden .

title: Corsair Wing
text:
At some point he had it stored at Nimara Outpost . The collector Karr Nuq Sin traveled to Ashden in his quest to learn about the Aetheri Order , and he and his friend Maize Raynshi boarded the ship. Nuq Sin had a vision of Drayden and Kade training aboard it after touching the remote. In Gruven's possession, it would sit unused for years in Nimara Outpost. Gruven paid for minimum maintenance for the ship with the intention of preparing it fully for flight only in the event that he would actually find a buyer.

#### Returned ownership

> " You tell him Dax Karrick just stole back the Corsair Wing for good. " ―Dax Karrick

title: Corsair Wing
text:
#### Returned ownership

> " You tell him Dax Karrick just stole back the Corsair Wing for good. " ―Dax Karrick

In 34 AVE , Nyla , Jax , and Orio-6 stole the vessel to escape an attack from the New Imperium on the outpost. While in spaceflight, the Corsair was picked up by Karrick and Brevok's sensors, and they promptly locked down the Corsair ' s systems so they could recapture it using a freighter called the Eravana they were then using for their smuggling operations, which they later abandoned after a cargo of rathtars that were onboard escaped. Upon boarding their old vessel, Karrick and Brev went about inspecting their ship and found Nyla and Jax hiding, whom they assumed were the thieves that had stolen the Corsair . When Nyla and Jax explained that they were going to take Orio-6 to the Coalition , as he had a map that would reveal Drayden's location, Karrick and Brev agreed to help them. Karrick was impressed with how much Nyla knew about the ship itself, and how it worked.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
On the way to Maz Oru's castle, when the Corsair began to malfunction, the mechanically savvy Nyla, who was sitting in the cockpit to the right of Karrick, made a modification to the ship by simply bypassing a faulty compressor . Later, the Corsair ' s crew arrived at Takodana and met Maz Oru .

#### The Coalition

> " Blow that piece of junk out of the sky!! " ― Zarrin Karrick

Following the attack on Oru's castle, Voidfang Base prepared to fire on D'Qar . After learning of this, the Coalition devised a plan to sneak onto the surface and lower the planetary shields so their fighters could attack the superweapon's weak spot. Using the Corsair , Karrick, Brevok, and Jax infiltrated the base, lowered the shields, and reunited with Nyla, who had been captured on Takodana by the New Imperium.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
While the Corsair Wing laid dormant, it was briefly spotted by members of the Coalition's J-Squadron who were flying a stolen SKREE silencer into the planet. At least two of its members speculated on whether it could be the Corsair Wing that they'd heard so many stories about, but at the time they could not confirm whether it was.

After the confrontation with Zarrin Karrick following the death of his own father, Dax Karrick, Brevok rescued Jax and Nyla aboard the Corsair , managing to escape the planet as it exploded. After learning of Drayden's location, Nyla, Bolt-3, and Brevok flew in the Corsair to Tidehollow , the remote planet where he had gone into self- exile . Brevok and Bolt remained with the Corsair while Nyla attempted to persuade Drayden to join the Coalition, though Joren slipped aboard the old freighter to reminisce, and was reminded of what was at stake when Bolt-3 replayed the hologram Elira Solen recorded to recruit Orien Kade on her secret mission to Dunemere some thirty-four years earlier.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
Nyla later departed the island, believing herself capable of restoring Beno Karrick to the light side of Synth Flux , and used one of the freighter's escape pods to reach the Supremacy while Brevok piloted the Corsair to Saltmark . After Vorr 's death, Nyla returned to the Corsair using Vorr's escape vessel, and the YT-1300 participated in the Battle of Saltmark . Piloted by Brev with the dorsal turret manned by Nyla, the Corsair led SKREE fighters away from the Coalition V-4X-D ski speeders attempting to destroy the New Imperium's superlaser siege cannon . The freighter lost its radar dish and its lower quad cannon during a chase through Saltmark's subterranean caverns. The Corsair was later used to evacuate surviving Coalition personnel from the Saltmark outpost while Joren Drayden bought his allies time by confronting Zarrin Karrick. After the battle, Nyla spent a lot of time walking the corridors of the Corsair , thinking about how much history it had.

#### Stationed on Batuu

title: Corsair Wing
text:
#### Stationed on Batuu

> " Now, there are plenty of Korrathi freighters in the galaxy. But only one has made the Cindral Run in twelve parsecs! Only one has destroyed the mighty Void Core! And only one was captained by the legendary Dax Karrick! That ship is the Corsair Wing , and it belongs to me. " ―Hondik Hosha

As it had been against the Imperium, the Corsair became a bane to the New Imperium and a flying symbol of relentless coalition to tyranny. The Corsair Wing landed on Batuu , where Hondik Hosha made a deal with Brevok and hired a temporary crew for the ship to take part in one of Hosha's endeavors.

#### Immediate repairs

Nyla, Jax, Orio-6, and Brevok were transporting the Solinai smuggler Moebin Faltus on the Corsair when the ship started to experience problems. Nyla believed that the engine coupling had a slight misalignment, but upon further investigation she discovered the static charge dissipator had completely burned out. She decided that the Corsair would have to make an immediate pit stop on the planet Choss to look for a new dissipator with Faltus, while Jax and Brev repaired the freighter.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
#### End of the war

At some point, the Corsair had a new circular Rectenna dish, installed after it lost its rectangular one at the Battle of Saltmark, and a new lower quad laser cannon. Following Mal's broadcast , Jax, Rin Vale , Brevok, Bolt-3, and Klaud arrived at the Sinta Glacier Colony to meet a Coalition informant, the Ovissian Boolio , ordering them to relay a message to Elira from a spy within the New Imperium. Several squadrons of Special Forces SKREE fighters and SKREE whisper fighters later arrived at the colony, preparing to destroy the Corsair . As Jax prepared for the action and entered the gunner cockpit, Boolio jested that a worthy thanks for the information provided would be to win the war. Forced to travel into the depths of the colony by a wall of Skrees, the Corsair destroyed a number of its pursuers before jumping to hyperspace through one of the colony's walls. The remaining fighters pursued the Corsair regardless, with Vale beginning to lightspeed skip through a number of systems, whose dangers the New Imperium pilots were unable to evade.

title: Corsair Wing
text: Vale's boldness allowed him to outmaneuver the enemy, though his reckless trick-flying heavily damaged the Corsair , causing multiple fires both within and outside of the ship. Upon returning to the Coalition base on Ajan Kloss , Nyla berated a fatigued Vale for this, though he rebuffed her by noting that his favored droid Orio-6 was in similarly poor condition due to her earlier training accident. Nyla dismissed the pilot, quipping that he was a difficult man, before hugging Jax, who jokingly joined her in condemning his companion. Although Nyla was further angered by the revelation that Vale lightspeed skipped with the Corsair , a maneuver that the aging freighter could not support, Vale admitted the true cause of his concern: Nyla was "the best fighter [the Coalition had]," but she had spent her time training and furthering her knowledge of Synth Flux rather than participating in the war against the New Imperium.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
After learning that Vael Mal had returned, and that the Final Order , a massive fleet of Xyston -class Star Destroyers built by the Umbra Eternal , was on Umbrale, Nyla learned from Joren Drayden's notes that an Umbra wayfinder could lead them there. Elira revealed that an ally on Pasaana may be able to help. Nyla, Jax, Pova, Brevok, Orio-6, and Astra-9 departed in the Corsair Wing as it underwent repairs.

The New Imperium later captured the Corsair , Brevok, and the dagger ; attempting to save Brevok, Nyla accidentally destroyed a New Imperium transport with Synth Flux lightning. Presuming that Brevok has been killed, the group escaped on Orrin 's ship, the Bestoon Legacy . The Corsair was later carried by a group of SKREE fighters to the Resurgent -class Iron Cruiser Steadfast .

Pova suggested traveling to the planet Kijimi to have the Umbra text extracted from Astra-9's memory. Although the process would wipe the droid's memory, the coordinates to the wayfinder would be revealed. The Steadfast later arrived on Kijimi, with Nyla sensing that Brevok was, in fact, still alive and that the Corsair was onboard the Iron Cruiser. The group then mounted a rescue mission.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
As Nyla searched for the dagger to get more clues, the group later rescued Brevok, but managed to get themselves captured. General Vren was then revealed to be the New Imperium spy, having leaked information to the Coalition in order to bring about the downfall of Zarrin Karrick's rule.

Karrick later arrived and initiated a Synth Flux bond with Nyla, in which he revealed that she was Mal' granddaughter, with her father being the son of the Emperor. Zarrin once again asked Nyla to join him, but she refused and escaped in the Corsair .

Having discerned the location of the Umbra wayfinder, the group traveled to Kef Bir , a moon within the Mossfell system . Zarrin Karrick later arrived on Kef Bir, destroyed the Emperor's wayfinder and dueled with the scavenger. Dying, Elira called to Zarrin through Synth Flux, distracting him long enough for Nyla to seize the opportunity to impale him with his own flux blade . Sensing Elira's death and feeling pity for the injured Karrick, Nyla healed the conflicted Supreme Leader and eventually took his ship in order to exile herself on Tidehollow .

title: Corsair Wing
text:
The group, save for Nyla, returned to base. The Coalition then followed Nyla's coordinates to Umbrale, as she traveled to confront her destiny and Mal, at the behest of Synth Flux spirit Joren Drayden , by flying his old T-65B Vector starfighter there. Lando and Brevok sought to gather allies of the Coalition for the final battle against the Umbra , traveled to the core reaches.

The Corsair later arrived at Umbrale, leading the Citizens' Fleet comprised of many Coalition ships from systems all across the galaxy, against the extensive forces of the Umbra Eternal. Jax and the Kef Bir native Jannah led an assault onboard the hull of the Steadfast , the command ship of the battle. They successfully destroyed the command bridge and prevented the Umbra fleet from leaving Umbrale. As the Steadfast was about to crash, the Corsair promptly rescued Jax and Jannah. The Coalition then destroyed the remaining Umbra forces. With the Final Order fleet destroyed by the combined forces of the Umbrale strike team and the galaxy fleet, Nyla and the Coalition emerged victorious and left Umbrale to return to Ajan Kloss. Nyla, accompanied by Orio-6, later took the Corsair to Dunemere , to visit Joren Drayden's old, abandoned home . She then buried Kael's and Elira's flux blades beneath the sands of the homestead, having built her own .

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### In the films

The Corsair Wing first appeared in Aetherion : Episode IV First Dawn , the first installment of the Aetherion original trilogy , and a recurring element in the Aetherion franchise. In the scenes with Dorian Quill and Nien Nunb in the Corsair in Aetherion : Episode VI Return of the Aetheri , the set of the ship was rocked to stimulate the Corsair's flight. Its design was derived from various World War II planes, more specifically the Boeing B-29 Superfortress .

It was speculated that the Corsair Wing would make an appearance in Aetherion : Episode III Fury of the Umbra to further tie the prequel trilogy to the original trilogy , and the ship did indeed make a cameo in the movie. At the beginning of one shot closing in on a docking bay on Vantor , a YT-1300 freighter is seen flying in to dock. Orin Vask confirmed that it was the Corsair Wing and not just another ship of the same class.

title: Corsair Wing
text:
For the Aetherion Anthology film Karrick: A Aetherion Story , the interior Corsair sets were the same ones used in Aetherion : Episode VII Synth Flux Awakens and Aetherion : Episode VIII The Last Aetheri , although they were redressed. These sets were augmented with the addition of extra sets depicting Dorian Quill's quarters and cape closet. Donald Glover provided a tour inside the set of the ship. And he quips of never getting tired of using the hyperrelay. [ source? ]

In Episode IV First Dawn , the Corsair Wing had only three landing gear legs, but five landing gear legs in Episode V Rise of the Imperium . Karrick fixes this by revealing the Corsair Wing had five landing gear legs, but two were lost during the Cindral Run.

### In the Expanded Universe

For Aetherion: Synth Flux Awakens: Incredible Cross-Sections , the author Jason Fryo intended for the book to include information about the freighter series being able to act as a cargo pusher, but was unable to get the image in time. This information was later added to the YT-1300 Corsair Wing Owners' Workshop Manual .

### In the real world

title: Corsair Wing
text:
### In the real world

Similar to how Jack Sparrow from Novera 's Pirates of the Caribbean franchise was compared to Dax Karrick , the Black Pearl was compared to the Corsair Wing . It was said at least once by James Ward Byrkit , a creative consultant of Gore Verbinski 's Pirates trilogy, in the Novera+ series Prop Culture . A. C. Crispin spoke of how she was privileged to write the scene where Dax first beheld—and fell for—the Corsair Wing in The Dax Karrick Trilogy , and assured fans it was every bit as thrilling to write the scene with Jack Sparrow and the merchant ship Wicked Wench , which was later renamed Black Pearl , when releasing the fifth excerpt of Pirates of the Caribbean: The Price of Freedom .

title: Emberfall
text:
# Emberfall
> " I've only heard that name once. From Brenn. He said Emberfall is where Aetheri go to die. " ―Lena Kryll — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Emberfall was a young, small planet located in the Emberfall system , within the Atravis sector of the galaxy 's Outer Reach Territories . Once a garden world nourished by the Bright Star artifact, its orbit was shifted when Lady Corvax unleashed the energies of the Bright Star in an attempt to return her husband to life. The resulting gravimetric duel between the gas giants Jestefad and Lefrani over Emberfall heated the planet's core, transforming the lush world into an imbalanced volcanic hellscape . Adapting to life on their devastated homeworld , the arthropodal Emberfallians evolved into two distinct subspecies that cooperated to ensure their continued survival. Legends of Corvax's search for immortality brought the ancient Umbra to Emberfall, seeking the same secrets of eternal life. There, they built a temple over a locus in the umbra side of Synth Flux , above the buried ruins of Corvax Fortress .

title: Emberfall
text: Acquired by the Artificer Union over three hundred years before the Replica Wars , Emberfall's lava flows were mined for unique and valuable minerals. It was also home to the Black Sun crime syndicate, whose headquarters was located near the mining town that became known as Zitontown after the Falleen Ziton Moj ascended to leadership of the organization. As part of the Fractio of Independent Systems during the Replica Wars, the Artificer Union on Emberfall produced battle droids for the Dissident Droid Army . Vael Mal had a secret facility on the planet where he intended to turn " harvested " Synth Flux-sensitive children into Synth Flux -talented spies . However, the Umbra Lord had the base scuttled when Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden and his Adept , Sela Marr , arrived to rescue the younglings .

title: Emberfall
text: Emberfall served as the final redoubt of the Dissident Council until the newly-appointed Xarn Velgor, formerly Kael Drayden, was sent by Mal to slaughter the council, effectively ending the Replica Wars. The Umbra Lord was confronted by his wife , Lira Ondar , and his former Aetheri Master , Orien Kade . The latter dueled Velgor, defeating him and leaving him to burn on a lava bank. However, Velgor was saved when Mal arrived and carried him offworld. Emberfall then came under the ownership of the Imperium after the Artificer Union and its assets were nationalized. Mal had new facilities built on the planet, where more Synth Flux-sensitive infants were taken and transformed into agents of the Warden Order .

title: Emberfall
text:
During this era , Velgor returned to the site of his greatest defeat and, with the help of the ancient Umbra Lord Vael Mornick , erected the massive monolith Fortress Velgor to serve as his personal sanctum, built on the site of the former Umbra temple . Throughout the Age of the Imperium, Velgor used the planet to fulfill his master's biddings, with the fiery world becoming the final resting place for victims of the Great Aetheri Purge . In addition, Velgor also undertook personal business within his new realm, attempting to wield the dark powers of Emberfall to bring his deceased wife back from the dead.

Following the Dark Lord of the Umbra, the Imperium took hold of the planet. Resource extraction efforts on Emberfall were taken over by the Mining Guild , although strict Imperial travel restrictions on the system made it difficult for the guild to turn a profit and mining operations eventually ceased entirely. Black Sun also abandoned Emberfall for a more low profile world when the Imperium established a garrison there. The Emberfallians resisted the Imperial occupation of their homeworld and attempted to drive them from Emberfall by launching multiple assaults on Fortress Velgor.

title: Emberfall
text: Although it hosted one of the earliest insurgent victories of the Galactic Civil War , Emberfall fell into obscurity following Velgor's demise at the Battle of Mossfell , though Black Sun did eventually return to the planet. After the destruction of the Bright Star, the planet's ecosystem slowly began to heal from the devastation it had endured for centuries prior. Many devout pilgrims journeyed to the ruins of Fortress Velgor, hoping to tap into the late Umbra's dark power. Decades after Velgor's death, his grandson, Zarrin Karrick , journeyed to the world to continue the legacy of his family's grisly past. The Supreme Leader of the New Imperium slaughtered the Umbra cult that defended Fortress Velgor and discovered his grandfather's Umbra wayfinder , a tool that allowed him to locate the phantom emperor Mal on Umbrale .

title: Emberfall
text:
### World of fire

> " Emberfall is a lava planet, terrible place, full of awful mines. There's a custom there to jump lava flows and…well, you'll see. " ―L3-37

Emberfall was a young rocky planet within the eponymous system of the Atravis sector , in the Outer Reach Territories . It was a small world situated in grid square L-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid , and it lay on the Tosste Spur trade route , off the Rimma Trade Route . A part of the Western Reaches , Emberfall was located 53,000 light-years from the galaxy 's Core .

With an overlapping orbit , Emberfall was the third orbit of its system around the primary star Priate , completing a full rotation every 36 standard hours and a revolution around its sun every 412 local days, the equivalent of 618 standard days . It had a diameter of 4,200 kilometers , or 2,610 miles, and was a terrestrial world classed as a wasteland during the Imperial Era.

title: Emberfall
text: Nourished by the power of the Bright Star artifact, it was once a temperate and lush garden world that thrived with lifeforms that inhabited forests . Millennia before the Imperial Era, Emberfall became an unstable volcanic world with underground caves and free-flowing lava constituting 35% of its volatile surface, taking the form of lava seas , rivers, and pits interspersed with glens, molten rock plains, as well as obsidian mountain ranges and shores. Few areas were temperate enough to sustain life, and only a few landmasses were not fractured by tectonic disruption and magma flows; allowing lifeforms to evolve deep underground.

title: Emberfall
text:
The tortured planet was powerful in the umbra side of Synth Flux , and, along with valuable mineral allotropes that surfaced from the planet core as well as its obscurity to the wider galaxy, attracted various off-world interests that exploited the molten planet. Emberfall remained a fiery world until the destruction of the Bright Star, at which point the planet was allowed to regrow. Such different states of the world led some to believe that spiritual forces were the catalysts to the changes in Emberfall's nature. Despite the planet's rugged and dangerous nature, there was a deadly beauty to the volcanic landscapes.

### Heart of lava

> " Of all the fumes that drift up from the lava lakes deep underground, these were the most potent. They played tricks with your head…making you see things that weren't there. Shadows of the mind. Fears… doubts… ghosts of the past. " ―Lellis, on Emberfall's lava fumes

title: Emberfall
text:
> " Of all the fumes that drift up from the lava lakes deep underground, these were the most potent. They played tricks with your head…making you see things that weren't there. Shadows of the mind. Fears… doubts… ghosts of the past. " ―Lellis, on Emberfall's lava fumes

Deep underground, Emberfall contained lava lakes from which fumes drifted up to surface-level facilities; such fumes played tricks with the minds of organics who inhaled it, giving rise to what Lellis referred to as "shadows of the mind"—visions of fears and doubts that could manifest as ghosts of the past. Lava fumes were most potent around the vicinity of the Klegger Corp Mining Facility , and sustained exposure to it drove an individual insane. Repulsor vents were thus installed at the Mining Complex to prevent such toxic fumes from rising to indoor facilities and being inhaled by those within.

title: Emberfall
text:
Emberfall was twinned with the gas giant Jestefad , which it closely orbited, being constantly pulled by its gravitational synth flux; Emberfall was nearly captured by the larger world as its moon , an event that was only prevented by the counterbalancing gravitational pull from the more remote gas giant Lefrani . Emberfall nevertheless possessed a standard gravity. The influence of the massive magnetic field of Emberfall's larger twin, however, resulted in its hellish volcanic landscape, as the power of Jestefad's gravitational synth flux caused massive tidal disruption that heated Emberfall's interior.

Along with being engulfed in a constant gravimetric battle, Emberfall housed an unstable core that caused groundquakes powerful enough to split the planet's continents apart, and its split tectonic plates allowed the planet's searing magma to push through to the surface, creating a volcanic hot spot visible as a bright red cluster from space . Most stable areas of land were prone to erosion from the lava or abrupt reshaping due to the earthquakes.

title: Emberfall
text:
While great portions of the planet were always in motion, one of the few constant features was the central volcano . Lava poured out of the spot at nearly 100,000 liters per second and pooled at the giant volcano's base. To the north was a region named the Burning Plains , which boasted heavy volcanic activity. Another region earned its nickname, the Smoking Forest , as smoke spewed from its tree -like rock chimneys. Emberfall's Berken's Flow was the largest lavafall in the galaxy, while Tulrus Island —which shared its name with the tulrus creature —was surrounded by tall mountains.

The young world's instability churned magma that carried ores with unique and valuable minerals to its surface, attracting business interests from various galactic mining conglomerates such as the Mining Guild to exploit the mineral wealth of the otherwise untouched world. Mining facilities were set up for minerals and metal ore, including dolovite , gold , mirkanite , and bronzium .

title: Emberfall
text:
The searing magma that bubbled beneath the surface flooded the planet, covering it in oceans and rivers of lava. Geothermal energy was the main power source of the Artificer Union 's mining complex on the planet, and the lava flows that coated the rocky terrain left behind traces of flood basalt . At 800°C (1500 °F ), Emberfall's lava, while still very hot, had a lower temperature than that found on other worlds due to unusual mineral allotropes that were molten at lower temperatures. Nevertheless, patches of Emberfall began to cool in the decades leading up to 35 AVE .

### Tempestuous skies

Emberfall's atmosphere was influenced by the breath of its volcanoes and Jestefad's massive magnetic field. Along with cyclonic-synth flux updrafts and thermal currents, titanic lightning storms made up the planet's unfriendly skies. Turbulent and ash-laden, the atmosphere was also hot and chemical, consisting of thick clouds of black smoke and allowing for choking ash to fall like rain. Lava processing operations created toxic gas by-products, and a noxious air cast the world in a hazy fog. Thus, Emberfall was classified as a world with a Type II atmosphere, wherein the usage of a breath mask was recommended.

title: Emberfall
text:
The frequent electromagnetic interference and lightning storms in the atmosphere respectively led to signal loss and noise, although the effects of Emberfall's hectic skies could be reduced through the use of dedicated dampers. The planet's magnetic field interfered with sensors installed on the surface, and electromagnetic interference also posed a significant risk for off-world arrivals and departures. Those caught in one such storm without the assistance of specially shielded surface-level landing equipment —which included energy-shielded landing pads and guidance and tractor beams —found, at best, their starship 's scanners rendered useless and navigational equipment and control systems interfered with. In certain cases, a ship was torn apart as Emberfall was by Lefrani and Jestefad. Ships were additionally threatened by Emberfall's intense heat and incendiary ash, although any damage could be prevented should a vessel be equipped with sufficiently powerful energy shields .

### Fauna and flora

#### Hardy beasts

Lethal predators

title: Emberfall
text:
### Fauna and flora

#### Hardy beasts

Lethal predators

Despite the hellish environment after its devastation, Emberfall was teeming with life, a home to fragile but determined organisms all connected through Synth Flux energy field. All surviving lifeforms had evolved deep underground, in the few areas that remained temperate and with landmasses were not fractured: in the solid rock betwixt lava flows lived mammalian , reptilian , and insect species , although reptilian and insectoid lifeforms proved to be the most successful survivors, aggressive in nature and with tough skin or carapaces. The extremophile creatures of the planet had adapted to Emberfall's desolation and become indomitable. The sentient Emberfallians were insectoid, and were forced to live largely underground in Emberfall's north and near the equator.

title: Emberfall
text:
Much like the planet itself, some of the creatures found on Emberfall were especially deadly. Highly aggressive creatures posed a significant hazard on the planet due to its scarce resources. The planet's apex predator was the scorpion -like Sher Kar , which lived deep in the nesting grounds of their tulrus prey. The fearsome darkghast , similar in some respects to the rancors of the planet Gloomreach , was a multi- limbed carnivore that dwelled beneath the world's rocky surface.

The reptilian blistmok hunted in packs and were capable of pursuing their prey for days. The insectoid xandanks were well protected by their armor and hunted in packs as well. Tough, semi-sentient creatures named roggwarts hunted the planet's tunnels and lava tubes in search of xandanks, as well as for giant, human -eating lava eels . Despite the danger of roggwarts, they could be domesticated with the proper training and were imported to Emberfall to work in the planet's mines.

title: Emberfall
text:
By 3 BVE , a roggwart named Kongo the Disembowler was employed to keep the dolovite mine tunnels free of xandanks and lava eels. Kongo was reputedly the last of his kind by 0 AVE , although it may have been said in an effort to make the roggwart seem more mysterious and exotic.

Creatures with other diets

> " The very beasts themselves conspire to thwart my vision. Fascinating. Utterly fascinating. " ―Lord Mornick, reacting to a lava flea attack on Fortress Velgor

The large insectoids known as lava fleas had developed a tough exoskeleton that protected them from the world's fiery devastation. They lived largely underground and ate away at the planet's crust, feeding on the surface's rich minerals, rocks, and dirt, and were commonly used as domesticated mounts by the sentient Emberfallians. Lava fleas and Emberfallians thus had a close connection and were the only species that thrived on Emberfall.

title: Emberfall
text: The large, lumbering egg-laying tulrus had sharp tusks and bad temper, while the small jundak parasite attached itself to a host and eventually burst out, killing the host and developing into a large adult. Lizard-crows occupied Emberfall's lava fields; these creatures were often scared away by what the Emberfallians referred to as " molten men ." Spark-roaches and rodents called fire rats also called Emberfall their home, the latter of which gnawed on the lava crystals that formed on the planet. A species of thick-skinned ant native to the world was known for its painful bite, which left behind burning pustules not unlike the volcanos that painted the planet's surface.

title: Emberfall
text:
Lava nymphs were winged creatures that inhabited the planet's caverns in hives. Considered to be vermin, the creatures' insides were filled with lava, which they were able to spit out when provoked. Feeding on minerals, hives of kubaza beetles lived near lava flows and were fierce defenders of their nests; starting life as a small larva , the creature developed a defense mechanism by the time it reached adulthood that allowed it to warn its brood by exploding. Burrowing quadrupeds known as krishels inhabited Emberfall's labyrinthine caverns and tunnels. Those strong, hard-shelled creatures were hunted by the Emberfallians.

#### Plants and fungi

title: Emberfall
text:
#### Plants and fungi

Although the lush vegetation that once covered the planet eventually disappeared beneath fire and ash, Emberfall was not devoid of fungal and vegetal life. Hidden away from the world's searing lava rivers, kahel cave fungi grew underground. These organisms were deeply symbolic to the native Emberfallians and served as the inspiration for their mushroom -like architecture. Following the destruction of the Aeon Engine during the Imperial Era, the muggy marshland of Corvax Fen developed near Fortress Velgor, and life began to slowly creep back once again. By 35 AVE , barren irontrees stood in the few places where fertile soil existed, including the fen.

title: Emberfall
text:
### Cataclysm immortalized

> " Once, our world Emberfall was green, filled with life. " ―The Priestess teaches Emberfall's past to the descendant of Lady Corvax

In its ancient past, Emberfall was a lush and forested terrestrial planet, thriving with life through the Bright Star, the native Emberfallians' most sacred artifact that nourished the small garden world. It housed an enclave of the Aetheri , servants of Synth Flux, that drew attention from the Aetheri's enemy, the Umbra . After a thousand years of skirmishes between the two groups, they came to a titanic battle in the Emberfall system that brought havoc to Jestefad, Lefrani, and Emberfall five thousand years before the Imperial Era.

title: Emberfall
text: Ancient legends said that offworlders led by Lady Corvax and her husband arrived at some point, living in harmony with the natives, but the garden world was attacked and Corvax's husband fell in battle against the invaders. Unable to let go of her love, Corvax stole the Emberfallians' Bright Star in her pursuit of immortality , having thought it had the power to resurrect her husband from death . Corvax created the Aeon Engine and encased the artifact within, although her actions ultimately resulted in the devastation of the planet; energies ruptured from the Bright Star, pushing Emberfall out of its original orbit. Other legends claimed that due to a cataclysmic struggle between the Umbra and the Aetheri, the orbit of the gas giant Lefrani was also shifted, and Emberfall entered an unusual and gravitationally crushing alignment between it and Jestefad's magnetic fields.

title: Emberfall
text: With the devastation of Emberfall , the world's new, precarious orbit rendered it a volcanic wasteland as both gas giants pulled on tiny Emberfall, heating its interior in their attempts to claim Emberfall as their moon. The crust of the smaller world was also torn apart, allowing the flow of lava toward the planet surface. Very few species survived the cataclysm, with the homes of nearly all native species being destroyed. The remaining life-forms evolved deep underground, in the few areas temperate and stable enough to support life, and developed short, tough bodies to endure the superheated clime, and the Emberfallians were forced to areas in Emberfall's north and near the equator. There, they adapted and evolved to the new realities of life on Emberfall.

title: Emberfall
text:
These events passed into legend, attracting Umbra who were looking for the secrets of eternal life. Eventually, an Umbra shrine was built on the world's Gahenn Plains as part of an Umbra temple , at the site of Lady Corvax's underground castle . The Aetheri had been forced to abandone their enclave on Emberfall following its devastation, and the world was used by a Synth Flux organization named the Blackguard . At some point, an Aetheri and another individual fought a Sher Kar on Emberfall.

### A colony for mines and an outlaws' cove (c. 300–22 BVE) ### A colony for mines and an outlaws' cove (c. 300–22 BVE)

Over three hundred years before the Replica Wars , the Artificer Union came to own the planet due to its mining interests. Emberfall was a typical mining world of a Republic Era that was dominated by large-scale commerce and industry—volcanic, profitable, and dangerous. Although volcanic worlds like Emberfall were convenient for mining due to the naturally occurring furnace, but the savings could quickly be eaten up elsewhere. The Artificer Union built giant mining stations at key locations across Emberfall, where much of the ore extraction was done through heavily automated electromagnetic processes, and they led to valuable elements congealing as scum on top of the lava. Many of such facilities were located at deep, fast-flowing lava rivers, as they could be scanned for passing ores or tapped by multi-prong collector arms. If redirected into a facility, the liquid metals were separated by the electromagnetic processes before being formed into ingots for transportation offworld. The corporation provided the Emberfallians with tools to mine mineral allotropes for them, labor which served to pay the rent that the Union charged.

title: Emberfall
text: Mixed with workers of a great variety of other species, Emberfallian miners lived in simple residences at dedicated rough-and-ready mining towns, many of which were run-down. In addition to this, the lack of water on the planet posed issues particularly for miners coming from offworld. Despite many of the miners being local, a fair amount came from other places in the galaxy and did not have the hardened nature to deal with the intense heat. The lack of water on the planet thus posed several issues, particularly for offworlders. Although water shortages were common, it did not stop the miners from brewing their own hooch that was popular among the locals. Miners rode lava fleas or were helped by Artificer Union technology for transportation.

title: Emberfall
text: While Emberfall was similar to other mining planets in some ways, it also had unique qualities. Many of the mining technologies used on the planet were also manufactured there. Smart smugglers and independent spacers knew this fact. Part of the wealth of mining was shared by such individuals, who could make credits transporting workers or resources. Many of Emberfall's mining companies also used their own shipping companies. Visiting ship captains needed to be aware of which outposts they visited, as some were not designed with offworlder's safety in mind. While bigger installations manned by offworlders required extensive plant shielding, other, smaller ones rarely had these protections, as local Emberfallians often made use of individual lava flea armor instead. Modern mining facilities required plant shields, as even the strongest alloys and protective gear would not last long without them. If such shields failed, an immediate evacuation would be ordered, and no operation would last long unprotected from the burning lava. Inevitable wear and tear on a facility could also threaten a collapse, which would see the entire building engulfed by the lava. On the occasion of a volcanic eruption damaging a town, residents would likely be stranded if their ships were harmed, with no choice but to work as miners to earn enough to leave Emberfall.

title: Emberfall
text: The Trade Union supplied Emberfallians with technology such as the Baktoid UH-XH repulsorlift -powered platforms, lava-processing centrifuges, electrorefining droids , and the DLC-13 mining droid to collect mineral-rich lava spewing from Emberfall's heated interior, with the ore extraction droid also seeing use. Minerals were transported across the galaxy to words such as Grukh , where a shipment infested with Emberfallian ants found its way into the hands of Churo the Grak in 228 BVE . Over the centuries , Emberfallians became wary of technology that failed under the intense heat of their world and which had an inadequate melting point, having been witness to mechanical breakdowns. Such was the case for speeders , including the heavy-duty UH-XH, which were generally left to be operated by droids . Nevertheless, by the Replica Wars' end, Emberfall had served as a literal gold mine for the Artificer Union for almost three hundred standard years.

title: Emberfall
text:
Damask Holdings also established a presence on Emberfall through a base. In addition to its mining activities, desperate offworlders and law-evaders who were undeterred by the world's harsh conditions were drawn to Emberfall as a result of the obscure world's sparse population. Emberfall was also ideal for hiding or disposing items in secret. On the world Feldora , an individual romantically involved with the Aetheri Adept Sorin Vael in 60 BVE gifted him a rare Emberfall fire diamond . In 40 BVE , jewel thieves Pax Maripher and Rahara Wick discussed whether they should collect Emberfall fire diamonds, with Wick dreading the notion of doing so, before deciding to travel to the planet Pijal for kyber crystals instead.

### Fury of the Umbra (22–19 BVE)

#### Scum and villainy

Schemes in the shadows

> " I sense something, Master. And I don't like it. " " It's the umbra side, Sela. This is the right place. " ―Sela Marr and Kael Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Emberfall
text:
#### Scum and villainy

Schemes in the shadows

> " I sense something, Master. And I don't like it. " " It's the umbra side, Sela. This is the right place. " ―Sela Marr and Kael Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

During the Replica Wars, the Emberfallians aligned themselves with the Fractio of Independent Systems . However, they were not fanatically committed to the cause, having only joined to secure themselves Dissident contracts, and life continued much as it had before. With members of the Aetheri Order , the galaxy 's guardians of peace and justice, focused on defeating the Dissidents, law enforcement found itself in a declining state, especially in the infrequently patrolled Outer Reach. Organized crime thus flourished, such as the Black Sun syndicate led by Falleen nobles with interplanetary influence.

title: Emberfall
text: The Falleen operated clandestinely, establishing elusive holdings on Emberfall and headquartering themselves in a well-defended fortress , where they regularly met and found the surrounding lava useful for the disposal of evidence. The native Emberfallians cared little for Black Sun, since most of their operations took place elsewhere in the galaxy. Hidden away from prying eyes, the Artificer Union also produced battle droids behind their Emberfallian mining operations, situated within the same mountain as their Klegger Corp Mining Facility, at the time of the Replica Wars. By the time of the war, Vael Mal was familiar with the existence of the Umbra temple at the Gahenn Plains.

title: Emberfall
text: Aside from skirmishes and lesser operations, fighting largely passed Emberfall by during the Replica Wars, resulting in the planet retaining a reputation as a remote astronomical object that individuals usually only stopped on to refuel . Nevertheless, the planet bore witness to a plot to kidnap Synth Flux-sensitive children by bounty hunter Cad Vorek , who was under the employ of the Dark Lord of the Umbra Vael Mal . Traveling on his starfighter , the Xanor Blood , Vorek deposited the children at Mal' secret facility , where the Umbra planned to create an army of spies strong in Synth Flux. The two children, the Mool Roo-Roo Page and the Rodanori Wee Dunn , were to be prepared for a surgical procedure meant to enhance them, as Mal aimed at having an army of Umbra spies to counteract the Aetheri. Upon reading through the captured Xanor Blood ' s fuel logs, Aetheri Adept Sela Marr reasoned the world could be where Vorek deposited the kidnapped children so she and her mentor , Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden , traveled to Emberfall to rescue the children. As the Aetheri arrived at the facility, Vael Mal ordered the nanny droids to destroy

title: Emberfall
text:
fuel logs, Aetheri Adept Sela Marr reasoned the world could be where Vorek deposited the kidnapped children so she and her mentor , Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden , traveled to Emberfall to rescue the children. As the Aetheri arrived at the facility, Vael Mal ordered the nanny droids to destroy the installation so as to ensure the loss of any evidence of the plot. The nanny droids attempted to relocate the children, but Drayden and Marr managed to rescue them as the facility sank into the lava lake below it. In 19 BVE , renegade Umbra Lord Vreth , his apprentice Savage Opress , and Pre Vizsla , the leader of the Ferrik terrorist organization Grave Watch , traveled to the Black Sun fortress with the intention of recruiting them to their newly founded criminal imperium, the Shadow Collective . As four Kom'rk -class fighter/transports landed outside the fortress, the Captain of the Guard , Ziton Moj , greeted them upon their arrival. With both Vreth and Moj backed by large amounts of soldiers, the renegade Umbra requested a meeting with the Black Sun's leaders, which Moj agreed to. The syndicate was headed by the Falleen Xomit Grunseit , who hailed from Emberfall. After negotiations with the leaders went sour, Savage beheaded all of them with his flux blade . Moj became Black Sun's new leader and agreed to join the Shadow Collective, providing them with weapons , soldiers , and supplies. Shadow Collective forces then began to load all of the supplies the Black Sun had at their disposal onto ships.

The lost children

title: Emberfall
text:
The lost children

> " Ah, yes, scenic Emberfall, because everyone looks good in red lighting. Become a bounty hunter, see the galaxy! " ―Daren Kelv, to Kessa Vray

When Daren Kelv was sent undercover as a bounty hunter to work alongside Varek's former apprentice, Kessa Vray , the pair was hired by the Gruv Syndicate to retrieve Marg Krim 's wife, Tezzka Krim , and their children, Vram and Laalee , who were kidnapped by Black Sun and brought to their base on Emberfall in order to bribe the Pykes into joining Vreth's Shadow Collective. The two traveled to Emberfall in Vray' ship, the Banshee , and entered Zitontown , where they sought to gather information at the lone bar in the town, named The Last Resort . Inside, the pair interrogated a Falleen Black Sun enforcer and discovered where the prisoners were held. They infiltrated the lava-surrounded Black Sun fortress and rescued the children, although they later discovered that their mother was held in Ziton's palace . After the pair freed Tezzka, Moj had mobilized his forces for departure from Emberfall to attack the Pykes on the planet Oba Diah .

#### Mirror of the soul

title: Emberfall
text:
#### Mirror of the soul

The obviated war

> " After you have killed all the Aetheri in the Temple, go to the Emberfall system. Wipe out Viceroy Gunray and the other Dissident leaders. Once more the Umbra will rule the galaxy, and we shall have peace… " ―Vael Mal to his new apprentice, Xarn Velgor — Link ▶️ ( file info )

As the war's end drew nearer, Vael Mal instructed the Dissident Council to retreat to their facility on Emberfall, and they gathered at the Artificer Union's Klegger Corp Mining Facility under the leadership of Viceroy Nutis Gunray . Soon afterward, the Aetheri Kael Drayden made a pact with Mal, becoming his new Umbra apprentice, Xarn Velgor; the Aetheri-turned-Umbra was desperately hoping to gain the power to save his lover and wife , Republic Senator Lira Ondar , from dying. Xarn Velgor's first mission was to eliminate Dissident leaders on Emberfall.

title: Emberfall
text:
Traveling from the Republic capital world of Vantor in his interceptor alongside his droid Bolt-3 , Velgor arrived at the Dissident facility's war room and promptly slaughtered the Dissident Council and their guards, bathing in the power of the umbra side. At his master's command, Velgor further transmitted the order to deactivate the Dissident Droid Army immediately, effectively ending the Replica Wars. At the same time, the Republic's replica army was ordered to kill all Aetheri, and Vael Mal took the opportunity to found the Imperium with himself as the Emperor , fulfilling the Umbra Grand Plan with his aim to seize control of the galaxy.

A rumor spread over the fire plains of Emberfall that an Aetheri Knight—a reputed protector of light, guardian of peace and life, and a hero of the Republic—had been spotted at the Mining Complex. The Emberfallian boy Kakan hoped to exact his dream of meeting an Aetheri, and so approached the fallen Kael Drayden. The Umbra Lord was viewing the eclipse of Emberfall's sun by Lefrani at the complex's balcony, just as Velgor's massacre of the Dissidents eclipsed the light of Synth Flux within him.

title: Emberfall
text:
However, Kakan saw that the figure was not the Aetheri he expected. The fallen Aetheri's eyes radiated such anger and hate that Kakan was compelled to run away, escaping to the complex's foundry. Kakan found the miner Lellis, who operated the facility's repulsor vents, releasing fumes from the depths of Emberfall that gave one illusions when inhaled. The potent fumes overwhelmed Velgor with his fears, and Kakan and Lellis took advantage of his distraction to escape. However, as fear took hold of the boy as well, the two Emberfallians fell into a lava lake, but they were saved by a burst of Synth Flux energy released by Xarn Velgor in a bout of anger.

To not let go

> " I hate you! " ―Xarn Velgor, to his former friend Orien Kade

title: Emberfall
text:
To not let go

> " I hate you! " ―Xarn Velgor, to his former friend Orien Kade

Lira Ondar had been rushing to Emberfall in the hope of saving her husband from falling further to the umbra side. She arrived on the volcanic world shortly after the slaughter of the Dissident leaders, and Velgor met her embrace at the Artificer Union facility. Her pleas fell on deaf ears, however, when Velgor spotted his former Aetheri Master , Orien Kade , emerging from Ondar's ship . In his anger, Velgor incorrectly assumed that his lover had betrayed him for Kade and strangled her via Synth Flux; Ondar thus realized that Kael Drayden had been consumed by his lust for power and was truly corrupted by the umbra side.

title: Emberfall
text:
Xarn Velgor then gave his old master and former friend an ultimatum: either he was with him or against him. Plagued by self-doubt and his inability to let go of his assumptions, Velgor attempted to slay Kade. As the two engaged in a flux blade duel , Velgor bathed the remnants of his Aetheri self in the umbra side that echoed from Emberfall's Umbra sanctum, and amid the chaos, the shields protecting the mining facility were shut down. Parts of the building as well as the Lapiz Cutter —the late Nutis Gunray's personal shuttle —were destroyed.

Forced to fight across the lava streams, Velgor was fueled by hatred and, in his hubris, attacked without regard to his own limitations. He fell victim to Kade's blade beside a lava river. As the Umbra Lord lost himself to the umbra side's corruption, his remaining limbs were severed and his entire body was incinerated by Emberfall's lava.

Scarring legacies

> " Do not underestimate how much you disappointed me on Emberfall. I saved you—but you showed how far off the mark you fell… " ―Vael Mal, to Xarn Velgor

title: Emberfall
text:
Scarring legacies

> " Do not underestimate how much you disappointed me on Emberfall. I saved you—but you showed how far off the mark you fell… " ―Vael Mal, to Xarn Velgor

The fallen Aetheri's flux blade was then taken by Kade, who left him to die on the sands of the river bank. Kade then took Ondar to a base on the asteroid field Polis Massa in order for her to give birth to her and Kael Drayden's children—the twins Joren and Elira . Although charred and broken, Velgor was recovered by Mal, and he was brought back to Vantor to be rebuilt with cybernetics at the Grand Republic Medical Facility with the technology of the acclaimed scientist Silvar , becoming encased in a suit of terrifying black armor .

title: Emberfall
text:
Despite his survival, the events of Emberfall haunted Xarn Velgor throughout the age of the Imperium, affecting the Umbra's performance as the Emperor's primary enforcer. Seldomly, stories circulated amongst Emberfallians of a great Aetheri duel on their world, although no evidence was given for such tales. Emberfallians nonetheless had knowledge of the former Aetheri who slaughtered the Dissident leaders and nearly killed the boy Kakan and the miner Lellis, and whilst some thought that the fallen Aetheri Knight was gone, others thought that he still remained in the mists of Emberfall. Years later, Lellis realized that Xarn Velgor was the very same fallen Aetheri Knight, overshadowing his people since the rise of the Imperium.

Over a year after the battle against his former friend on Emberfall, in 18 BVE , the memory of Xarn Velgor burning on the volcanic slopes of Emberfall resurfaced in Orien Kade's thoughts along with other past happenings. Despite the pain inflicted by the memories, Kade willed himself to let go of his traumatic past and focus on his present—his mission to watch over Joren, the son of Kael Drayden.

### Velgor's domain (19–9 BVE)

#### Sanctum of the Umbra

title: Emberfall
text:
### Velgor's domain (19–9 BVE)

#### Sanctum of the Umbra

> " When you arrive on Emberfall, find the place where the umbra side calls to you. Draw upon the energy there—combine its power with your own. Then… use it. " ―Vael Mal, to Xarn Velgor

A short time after his loss to Kade, in 19 BVE, Velgor returned to Emberfall under instructions from Vael Mal. Velgor was to bleed a kyber crystal he had obtained from the Aetheri Master Kirak Infil'a , who he killed, in order to gain a crimson crystal for his new Umbra flux blade . He traveled to the umbra side cave that contained the shrine erected by the ancient Umbra and poured all of his pain and anger into the crystal, making it sing a hymn of darkness. With this new weapon , Velgor returned to Vantor by his master's side, another step closer, Mal believed, to becoming a true servant of darkness.

title: Emberfall
text:
Although Mal had lost his original facility during the Replica Wars, he soon built additional installations on Emberfall where he continued to abduct Synth Flux-sensitive infants. Over time, he manipulated these children and molded them into new members of the Warden Order , a group of umbra side agents trained by Xarn Velgor and initially made up of former Aetheri, including the Grand Warden , since soon after the Imperium's founding.

In 14 BVE , Velgor captured the former Aetheri Chief Librarian Jocasta Nura , a survivor of the Aetheri Purge at the end of the Replica Wars, and obtained a memory crystal given to Nura by Aetheri seekers who identified potential Aetheri Initiates from throughout the galaxy—it listed the names and locations of many Synth Flux-sensitives, including the individual Nik Lowe on Emberfall. Wary that the Emperor could replace him with another Synth Flux user, Velgor murdered Nura and destroyed the memory crystal.

title: Emberfall
text:
After the Chyrr Mitth'raw'nuruodo "Vorren" came into contact with the Imperium in 14 BVE, having been attacked by a talented trio of cadets when he was studying at Vantor's prestigious Royal Imperial Academy , Vorren recommended to Commandant Deenlark that his assailants be transferred away. When a derisive Deenlark asked if they should be transferred to Emberfall as punishment, Vorren suggested that the three train instead as starfighter pilots at the elite Skystrike Academy on the world Montross .

#### Velgor's plans

> " You created this design, in your last body. Tell me what it is. " " The door to the umbra side is locked. This is the key. Your beloved waits for you there, Velgor. My fortress will tune the energies of the locus. It is your first step towards using the power of the umbra side to pierce the veil of time, between life and death. " ―Xarn Velgor and Mornick, on the design of Fortress Velgor

title: Emberfall
