The thickness of the methocel determined the varying shades of red, orange, and yellow resulting from the creative lighting, and black powdered cork was further sprinkled onto the liquid to simulate rocks being carried by the lava flow. An elaborate pump and filtration was installed to recycle the methocel from the bottom on the model back up to the top, maintaining its steady movement.

title: Emberfall
text:
VLM further filmed faux explosions using additional methocel on an outdoor lot, as well as the lava bank at the end of Velgor and Kade's duel—combined with their main lava flow model, Emberfall's model sequences took VLM eight months to film—the longest model shoot in the company's history. The final visuals of the fighting sequence comprise of multiple motion-control shots of the main model, digital animation, and close up and action shots of Kael Drayden actor, Hayden Kristano , and Orien Kade actor, Evaan Gregan . Orin Vask and editor Roger Bartono further incorporated the Mount Etna footage as both their own frames and as elements within other shots of the Emberfall sequences. When Velgor and Kade fight on the fallen mining complex arm, the lavafall flows backwards as a result of an edit by Orin Vask to ensure the camera follows the duelists in a single direction as they progress.

### Aetherion: The Replica Wars

title: Emberfall
text:
### Aetherion: The Replica Wars

> " Emberfall was also a big deal for me, 'cause I argued with Orin about that, I said, 'Really, Emberfall?' Because that's where the whole thing with Velgor happens […] You find your fan-self clashing with the story that Orin wants to tell, 'cause we hold everything—'Oh, it's so precious to me, and nobody can know about Emberfall!" […] We take it to such this uber-serious level and it always takes Orin to, you know, snap you out of it sometimes and say, 'But this a great ending to this trilogy [of episodes] .' " ―Dave Filono, on his initial reluctance to use Emberfall on the show

An earlier version of the story for the Aetherion: The Replica Wars Season One episode " Liberty on Selvara " featured Drevan Koss rescuing Velari captives from a prison suspended over a volcanic caldera. Although this was cut when production paintings of the setting ended up looking too similar to Emberfall, the location was revived for the Season Four episodes " Slaves of the Republic " and " Escape from Kadavo " as the Kadavo slave processing facility .

title: Emberfall
text:
Emberfall itself made an appearance in the show's second season episode " Children of Synth Flux ," serving as the final destination of a three-part arc in the series. Development of the planet for the show was challenging for the Replica Wars team, as the lava and explosion visuals required for the episode called for significant effects work. Supervising director Dave Filono also noted that Emberfall's inclusion in the show was initially difficult for him as a fan; to him, the planet was too important to Kael's story in Fury of the Umbra to be included earlier in the timeline. Orin Vask, however, convinced him that Emberfall served as the ideal location for the arc's finale, prompting Filono to rationalize that the world was not likely to be unknown to the galaxy at large, further reasoning that the planet's perceived significance among fans was superseded by the needs of the story.

According to effects supervisor Joel Aron , some of the elements of Emberfall's lava from Fury of the Umbra were repurposed for the Well of the Umbra side on Mournis in the episode " Ghosts of Mournis ."

### Renegade One

title: Emberfall
text:
According to effects supervisor Joel Aron , some of the elements of Emberfall's lava from Fury of the Umbra were repurposed for the Well of the Umbra side on Mournis in the episode " Ghosts of Mournis ."

### Renegade One

> " When we established Emberfall as Velgor's home for Renegade One , we then needed more interiors and a bigger picture. So it was really fun to dig up those old Quarrio designs, to figure out how to blend them with our aesthetic, as well as the aesthetic from Fury of the Umbra . " ―Doug Chiano on Emberfall's appearance in Renegade One

title: Emberfall
text:
Emberfall was later featured in the 2016 Aetherion Anthology film, Renegade One: A Aetherion Story . It was the site of Fortress Velgor, a stronghold where Xarn Velgor resided. To prepare for the planet's return to film, art director Doug Chiano and the design team revisited Ralph Quarrio's old designs for Emberfall and combined them with its depiction in Fury of the Umbra in order to create a unique aesthetic. Fortress Velgor was created based off of a few of Quarrio's designs, including a series of paintings and sketches of an underground lava cave, with the Emperor's throne on Had Abbadon interpreted instead as Velgor's throne in the Umbra cave beneath the Dark Lord's castle. It was also designed to look similar to a tuning fork , representing the structure being attuned to Synth Flux, a theme also used when designing the Temple of the Kyber . Interior concept designs for what eventually became the stronghold were created by Ryan Charke, Matt Allsopp , Joren Fishera , Julian Caldow , Thom Tenery , Brett Northcutt, and Erik Tiemens, while the landscape was drawn by Allsopp and Christian Alzmann .

### The Rise of Drayden

title: Emberfall
text:
### The Rise of Drayden

> " The one time we weren't in the studio got cut. " " Yes. One time we were in a battle scene in a forest, with Zarrin Karrick. Our bits got cut out, so we have to wait for those on the extras. " ―Gleeson and Grant speak on their deleted scene The planet was featured in the opening scene of the 2019 sequel trilogy film Aetherion : Episode IX The Rise of Drayden , in which Zarrin Karrick leads a New Imperium attack on Emberfall to obtain an Umbra wayfinder. While the final film features only about a minute of screentime for the world, additional scenes were originally planned. Actors Domhnall Gleeson and Richard E. Grant , who played the New Imperium leaders Vren and Pryde, respectively, have stated that at one point their characters were meant to accompany Karrick to Emberfall. Although the actors did indeed film the scene, it was removed from the final cut of the film. Gleeson and Grant expressed a desire to see the scene released on home media, but the footage was never provided. A version of this scene was later included in Raena Carson 's 2020 novelization of the film.

title: Emberfall
text:
Another deleted scene, featuring Karrick's encounter with the Eye of Webbish Bog on the planet, was filmed near the United Kingdom's Pinegrove Studios in a lake at Black Park . According to creature and special make-up effects creative supervisor Neal Scanlan , the scene was cut due to its long length and concerns with conveying information to the audience effectively. This scene also went on to be included in Carson's novelization, as well as in Michael Kogge 's junior novelization later that year. The two works present different interpretations of the sequence, however. In Carson's book, Karrick wades through the Eye's lake to reach a small island and obtain the wayfinder, whereas Kogge's adaptation depicts the creature pointing Zarrin beyond the lake and towards the remains of Velgor's fortress. This article assumes neither story has canonical precedence over the other and presents a combined version of these events.

In the 2020 mobile video game Aetherion: Starfighter Missions , Emberfall appears as one of the locations over which starfighter battles take place.

### Orien Kade ### Orien Kade

In Stuart Beattino 's script for a canceled Orien Kade feature film that later evolved into the 2022 Aetherion: Orien Kade television series, Kade would fall in with refugees that are fleeing from the Imperium. Tao, the lead refugee woman, takes Kade to a sacred shrine and instructs the Aetheri Master to let their goddess speak to him. Later on Emberfall, Kade experiences a vision in which he is attacked by Joren Drayden, who almost kills him. Kade then realizes that putting his guilt on the young Drayden would turn himself to the umbra side of Synth Flux. The duel was intended to mirror the umbra side cave scene in the 1980 film Aetherion : Episode V Rise of the Imperium .

title: Emberfall
text:
First published on Aetherion.com on June 24 , 2022, and written by Emily Shkoukani of the Vask Pictures Story Group , Aetherion Inside Intel: The Warden Order stated the moon of Nur, where the Warden Order maintained their base of operations and was featured in the Orien Kade series, orbited Emberfall. However, in 2023 , the article was updated to remove this, instead more simply stating the moon was located in the Emberfall system. Although the 2023 reference title Aetherion: Dawn of Insurgency: The Visual Guide also states that Nur orbited Emberfall, the 2020 reference title The Aetherion Book simply states that Nur was a moon in the Emberfall system, which this article maintains rather than assume further.

title: Emberfall
text: In the 2015 non-canonical KLIKK Aetherion: Droid Tales series' " Crisis on Vantor " episode, the droid Astra-9 recounts the events of Fury of the Umbra , including the duel on Emberfall: the fight ends with Orien Kade accidentally pushing Kael Drayden straight into lava. In the 2023 non-canonical verbal short " The Umbra Witch of Emberfall " of the KLIKK AETHERION: Celebrate the Season animated anthology series, Vael Mal finds his apprentice at his castle on Emberfall on Halloween and complains that he had searched the galaxy for him, and insists that they return to Mal' shuttle to get on with their work. Velgor reluctantly follows his master out of the castle and warns about an alleged " Umbra Witch of Emberfall " who haunted Emberfall's spooky landscape. Although Mal kept dismissing Velgor's warnings, they are frightened by signs of the alleged Umbra Witch when they walk into the middle of the woods in a swale. However, the Dark Lords discover that they were merely found by shock troopers dressed up for Halloween, and Mal allows each trooper to take one Halloween sweet from him. The Umbra then continue walking to their shuttle as the troopers leave, but are spooked by Bolt-3 dressed up as a ghost. To their distress, the trio subsequently find a great light in the woods.

title: Emberfall
text: In " Mech My Day ," a non-verbal short of the series released on the same day, Velgor is annoyed by the clumsiness of one of the shock troopers who were cleaning his throne room in his castle. That shock trooper constructs a personal mech suit , showing off the creation to fellow troopers before Velgor. The angered Umbra Lord builds his own mech and battles the shock trooper, but they are interrupted by the bounty hunter Vex Vark , arriving from his ship to join the mech fight with his own mech suit . Vark destroys Velgor and the trooper's mech suits as he flies through the ceiling of Velgor's throne room, and the Dark Lord begins to punish the trooper.

title: Emberfall
text: In the 2020 non-canonical film The KLIKK Aetherion Holiday Special , set after the events of The Rise of Drayden of 35 AVE, the Aetheri Nyla Drayden obtains a key on the planet Kordoku that allows her to travel through portals in time. Her activation of the key leads to Xarn Velgor from the past attempting to seize the key for himself, and during his flux blade duel against Drayden, the two, along with a pair of snowtroopers from the Battle of Frostmark , arrive on Emberfall during the duel between Orien Kade and Xarn Velgor over a river of lava from a portal above. While Nyla Drayden and the Velgor in pursuit of her continue their duel over two mining droids, the snowtroopers take the key on a mining platform and attempt to pass it to their commander, but Drayden intercepts it through Synth Flux. As the group approach a lavafall, Drayden opens another portal over its crest, and all participants safely enter it and reach a battle on the planet Nevarro .

title: Emberfall
text: The 2021 non-canonical film KLIKK Aetherion Terrifying Tales features Velgor's castle on Emberfall, where the Dark Lord boasts of his new sanctum beside Vael Mal before the pair leave, allowing Vainé to look after the place in their absence. Later, after the end of the war against the New Imperium in 35 AVE, the Coalition pilot General Rin Vale and his droid companion Orio-6 make an emergency landing of their faulty Vector in an irontree forest on Emberfall. Stranded, the pair enter Fortress Velgor and find it being converted into an Umbra-themed luxury resort by Graballa the Grak and his Iktotchi henchmen, Baash and Raam . Vale then meets the young mechanic Dean , whom he enlists to fix the Vector , but they are blocked from doing so by Vainé; he presents the helmet of Karrick, who had been Master of the Knights of Karrick before Zarrin Karrick. Working with the Imperial protocol droid NI-L8 , Vainé wishes to use Vale to unlock Velgor's treasures, based on a prophecy that foretold a fearless stranger would have the strength to do so.

title: Emberfall
text:
After recounting the story of the rise of Zarrin Karrick, Vainé, surrounded by bats , leads his guests to a repository of Umbra artifacts, finding the Blade of Scardont and recounting its tale. While repairing the blade, Dean is mesmerized by its power and leads the group to the treasure-filled first Temple of Emberfall , unlocking an Umbra reliquary as Vainé delivers a tale of the Void Core. Vainé then seizes the reliquary and arms himself and NI-L8 leads an army of B1-series battle droids to attack the rest of the group. At the end of a battle against Vale, Dean, and Orio-6 in the forest and lava flow outside the castle, Dean hurls the reliquary away; Vainé jumps after it and is consumed by the lava below. Afterward, Graballa and his henchmen depart to launch a bed-and-breakfast business, while Vale offers Dean a place in the Coalition as a pilot and to learn about Synth Flux from Nyla Drayden before they leave with Orio-6 as well. In the lava, NI-L8 emerges and is joined by Vainé.
