#### The Drayden Saga

In the 2022 non-canon video game KLIKK Aetherion: The Drayden Saga , Emberfall is one of the worlds that players can freely explore and a setting in the story missions for Aetherion : Episode III Fury of the Umbra . It is also shown in cutscenes for Aetherion : Episode IX The Rise of Drayden .

Elsewhere in the game, a Lanai Caretaker wishing to make invulnerable obsidian wheelbarrow on the planet Tidehollow 's Temple Island asks the player character to find out where obsidian could be obtained, having been frustrated by the destruction of wheelbarrows during Nyla's visit in 34 AVE. A Devaronian in the city Port Vail on the planet Dunemere then suggests that obsidian could be found on Emberfall. On the planet Pasaana during the Festival of the Ancestors in 35 AVE, an Aki-Aki Storyteller describes the duel between "Dopi-Won" and "Panakin Slytalker" on an "oven" world to a group of Aki-Aki children as part of a puppet play. The stage's backdrop for the scene is a tapestry that depicts the mining facility on Emberfall.

title: Ondara
text:
# Ondara
> " If I grew up here, I don't think I'd ever leave. " ―Kael Drayden, about Ondara

Ondara was a bountiful planet in the Chommell sector of the Mid Reach , in the Trailing Sectors and close to the border of the Outer Reach Territories . It was home to the indigenous Mool species and to a population of humans known as the Ondara . Ondara was pushed to the forefront of galactic politics as the birthplace of the Dark Lord of the Umbra Theron Mal , who served as its representative in the Senate of the Vantor Republic .

title: Ondara
text:
Under the guise of his Umbra title Vael Mal, Mal secretly engineered an invasion of his peaceful homeworld by the Commerce Combine , a megacorporation in a bid for power. Ostensibly done in protest over proposed taxation of formerly free trade routes , the Federation's invasion led to an outpouring of support from the Senate for both Mal and the newly-elected Queen of Ondara , Lira Ondar . Ondar led a successful coalition movement and removed the Federation from her world during the Battle of Ondara . Mal subsequently rose to the office of the Supreme Chancellor of the Republic, with Ondar eventually taking his place as the planet's senatorial representative.

Ondara would commit itself firmly to democracy in the intervening years , staying loyal to the Republic during the pan-galactic Replica Wars , which saw several military engagements against the Fractio of Independent Systems come to the planet. By the time of the war's end, Mal had amassed considerable power and proclaimed himself the head of a new Imperium . Mal's reign would eventually be ended by the Alliance to Restore the Republic , a insurgent movement led by Ondar's children, Elira Solen and Joren Drayden .

title: Ondara
text: Despite his origins on the planet, Mal did not care at all for his homeworld and, following his death , Ondara was named a priority target for Operation: Cinder , a protocol that the Umbra Lord had put in place to destroy Imperial worlds should they fail to protect their Emperor . Through the intervention of Solen and Queen Sosha Soruna , however, Ondara was spared from ruin and went on to become a member of the successor state to the Alliance, the Concordat . Decades later, the planet would again fight against tyranny, rising up against the military junta of the New Imperium during its war with Solen's Coalition .

title: Ondara
text:
> " It's beautiful . " " Yes, it absolutely is. " ―Shara Bey and Elira Solen, about Ondara

Ondara was a small pastoral world in the Mid Reach , located near the border of the Outer Reach Territories , 34,000 light-years from the Core Reaches . Unlike most other worlds, the ancient planet lacked a molten core, and instead comprised a conglomerate of large, rocky bodies that made up a network of tunnels and flooded caves. The native Mools , who built their homes in the waters of Ondara, so deep that they went right through the planet, which they rarely ventured into the core, fearing the ravenous sea beasts which resided in areas such as the Caves of Eleuabad . Despite this, certain Mool navigators utilized time-honored trade routes through the planet's structure, which served as the most expedient avenues to reach other areas of the planet. Ondara's interior was rich with plasma , a naturally-occurring energy unique to the planet, and this coupled with its lack of molten core gave Ondara a reputation as an enigma to astrophysicists, who regarded the world's structure as an extremely rare phenomenon in the galaxy .

title: Ondara
text:
Ondara's surface comprised a vast array of different landscapes, from rolling plains and grassy hills to swampy lakes caused by the water-filled network of deep-sea tunnels. The swamps acted as a gateway to the world's seas, where legendary creatures dwelt. Beside its natural features, Ondara was considered a world of classical beauty due to the aesthetics of its population centers. The porous crust's natural plasma was harvested for energy and building material, and was generally thought to be the key to many of the planet's secrets.

While most of Ondara's land animals were peaceful, as exemplified by the gentle shaak , the planet's oceans , which held an abundance of life, teemed with menacing creatures, such as the opee sea killer , the sando aqua monster , and the colo claw fish .

title: Ondara
text:
#### Pre-human colonization

Originally, Ondara was home to the amphibian Mools. The earliest offworlders to arrive were a Reptilian species known as the Elders who warred against the Mools. Eventually, the Elders vanished as mysteriously as they arrived, leaving only stone statues behind.

#### Arrival of humanity

> " Take a moment and look around this glorious city of yours. It wasn't long ago this was all plasma mines. Ondara has indeed come a long way. But as we chart a bold course for the future, let us never forget our past. " ―Theron Mal

Approximately around 4000 BVE , Grizmallti people had discovered the planet, which they had named Nabu , after one of their principal deities. Ondara quickly became notorious as a vacation spot and as a private hunting preserve amongst big-game hunters across the Mid Reach, although it would be around a century before permanent human settlement. Initially, the Mools retreated underwater and avoided the colonists and new interlopers.

title: Ondara
text: While the Mools flourished for thousands of years before, this only lasted until around 3900 BVE . Fleeing a brutal civil war, a group of humans from the planet Grizmallt crash-landed on Ondara and set up a small colony. As they established their own society, they initially kept separate from the Mools. Led by Kwilaan , the colonists ventured into the Gallo Mountains , created a farming community at the Dee'ja Peak , establishing their presence on the planet and eventually taking its name for themselves. The Ondara calendar based its epoch around the arrival of Kwilaan. When the colonists made contact with the Mools, tensions arose between the two peoples, culminating a series of wars between the two species. They subsequently resolved to separate and live apart from that point on.

title: Ondara
text:
The Ondara colonists later expanded to other uninhabited planets in the Chommell sector , such as Karlinus . Ondara imposed a contract on the colonists of these other planets, wherein Ondara would give the new colonies a loan to cover the start-up costs of colonization. In exchange, the colonies became legally obligated to provide Ondara with any supplies it deemed were necessary if called upon in times of emergency. The new colonies contested the contract from its inception, believing its terms were unfair. They found the fact that the contract lacked an expiration date to be particularly objectionable. Under the contract, Ondara took advantage of every other planet in the Chommell sector from time to time.

#### Mool tribal war

> " Mools no dyin' witout a fight. Wesa warriors. " ―Greeb Mool

title: Ondara
text:
#### Mool tribal war

> " Mools no dyin' witout a fight. Wesa warriors. " ―Greeb Mool

Following the wars with humans, the Mool tribes engaged in war with each other. The war came to an end due to the actions of Boss Gallo , a Mool who united the tribes under one banner through diplomatic and military means. Gallo eventually attacked the city Spearhead , which was the home of the rogue warlord Boss Rogoe and the other Mool holdouts, with a massive Mool army . Gallo then founded the Mool capital Otoh Gunga on Spearhead's foundations.

#### Times of Suffering and Peace

Struggles give way to peace

> " It is an honor to be here for this momentous occasion. The pride I feel for this planet cannot be put into words. 847 years ago, Ondara joined the Republic. And tonight. we celebrate that union. " ―Theron Mal

title: Ondara
text:
Struggles give way to peace

> " It is an honor to be here for this momentous occasion. The pride I feel for this planet cannot be put into words. 847 years ago, Ondara joined the Republic. And tonight. we celebrate that union. " ―Theron Mal

Meanwhile, the Ondara had fallen prey to a long period of brutal infighting among the large city-states of humans that inhabited the planet. Eventually, a general named Jafan managed to end the war, uniting the opposing factions through both synth flux of arms and synth flux of will. He became King Jafan, ruler of all the Ondara, and ushered in the Great Time of Peace .

In 867 BVE , Ondara joined the Vantor Republic , the democratic union that sought to govern the galaxy . The people of Ondara celebrated this event during the Festival of Light . In 832 BVE , under the direction of King Jafan, the capital city of Serath was founded along the banks of the Solleu River with the Serath Royal Palace built on the Cliffs of Serath .

High Republic Era

title: Ondara
text:
High Republic Era

In 382 BVE during the High Republic Era , Ondara was under the rule of a queen , from whom Axel Greylark , a gambler and son of Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark , wanted to buy a yacht . At the same time, fellow Supreme Chancellor Orlen Mollo traveled across the Galactic Frontier aboard the Paxion , which displayed different vistas from various currently-distant worlds on a wall of its library. During a mission to end the Eiram and E'ronoh War , it displayed the Serath Royal Palace and other sites. The Ondara Palace and the city of Vantor were the only locations Aetheri Knight Gella Nattai recognized. Asked to attend along with delegates from numerous other worlds by Chancellors Mollo and Greylark, delegates from Ondara, wearing their cultural clothing, arrived on Eiram for the wedding of Phan-tu Zenn and Xiri A'lbaran that promised to end the war. At least two Mools attended the celebration.

title: Ondara
text:
Later in the High Republic Era, the former Aetheri Adept Kantam Syra found the Synth Flux-sensitive Lula Talisola amongst the children cared for at an orphanage on Ondara. Returning to the Aetheri Order , Syra became an Aetheri Knight and Talisola's master. A Aetheri Sanctum on Ondara, the Gallo Temple , was also established at some point and regarded as a much-prized posting for Aetheri Knights . It was the first posting of Elzar Mann after being knighted. By 232 BVE, the scion of the wealthy Saan Tarka clan , Vellis , was based on Ondara, alongside his husband, Marlowe , living in a large estate by the lakes .

Reign of the Nullkin

title: Ondara
text:
Reign of the Nullkin

In 228 BVE , with the creation of the Stormwall by the Nullkin and its subsequent expansions, Ondara was eventually included in the Occlusion Zone . The Nullkin General Abediah Viess led an invasion of Ondara , establishing the planet as a military base and putting it under Nullkin occupation . Serath was conquered after a barrage of Nullkin ion blasts took out the capital's plasma mine shafts, creating a planet-wide blackout. Without energy, two-thirds of the Royal Space Fighter Corps were left inactive, facilitating the Nullkin takeover of the planet. The mools remained retrated in their underwater cities, and the reigning queen managed to escape into hiding with help from the Royal Security Forces .

title: Ondara
text:
Under the supervision of Viess, the Nullkin occupation of the planet enacted a widespread forced disarmament, and subsequently took a considerable amount of resources from the richer inhabitants of Ondara as "tribute". Although the quick Nullkin victory meant that the occupation on Ondara was less ruthless on the general population than the ones on other planets inside the Occlusion Zone, the initial raid led to some amount of casualties. A joint Aetheri- Republic Defense Coalition assault on Ondara was later able to liberate the world.

By 232 BVE , , Marlaa Jinara had been to Ondara, and she experienced difficulty while exploring in the forest on the planet.

Late High Republic Era

By 132 BVE and as the light of the High Republic had begun to fade, Ondara and the rest of the Chommel sector were represented in the Galactic Senate of the Republic by Senator Sahen Idane , a longtime ally of the Aetheri Order and also someone who enjoyed close ties with Ondara royalty. Queen Yovité , who by that time had been elected Queen, had gifted a belt sash to Yovité by that year. Yovité also donned fabric sourced from a refinery in Serath.

title: Ondara
text:
### Twilight of the Republic

#### Invasion of Ondara

> " I was not elected to watch my people suffer and die while you discuss this invasion in a committee. " ―Queen Ondar, to the Galactic Senate — Link ▶️ ( file info )

The fourteen year old Lira Ondar was elected to be the new Monarch of Ondara after Queen Sanandrassa decided to only have a single term. While Sanandrassa favored isolationism, Ondar wanted to promote friendship with other planets in the Chommell sector, leading to her hosting the Chommell sector summit . Additionally, after being urged to by Captain Quarsh Panaka , Ondar took on a group of Handmaidens , whom she quickly befriended, planning her days with them instead of Panaka.

Right as the Ondara summit ended, about ten years before the Replica Wars , Ondara was blockaded and invaded by the Commerce Combine . Ondar guided her home planet through the invasion and sealed a new friendship with the Mools. In an upsurge of sympathy and solidarity toward the invaded planet, the queen 's emissary in the Galactic Senate , the seemingly unassuming Senator Theron Mal , was made Supreme Chancellor of the Republic.

title: Ondara
text:
Ondara recovered quickly from the invasion under Ondar's remaining years, managing to almost completely restore its harvests and crop yields by the end of her final term. One of Ondar's final projects, which continued under the reign of her successor, was the implementation of an ion pulse in Serath in case of future invasions. The decision to install the pulse, whilst meeting with general approval, was nevertheless controversial as some, such as Quarsh Panaka, favored the idea of more robust and extensive defenses whilst others felt that installing any weapon system was against everything Ondara stood for in terms of peace.

#### Replica Wars

> " I need you to convince the Senate, or the Aetheri Council, or whoever is in charge of this terrible war that we are threatened. " ―Neeyutnee, to Lira Ondar

title: Ondara
text:
#### Replica Wars

> " I need you to convince the Senate, or the Aetheri Council, or whoever is in charge of this terrible war that we are threatened. " ―Neeyutnee, to Lira Ondar

A series of miners strikes occurred on the moons of Ondara. A mudslide disaster occurred on Ondara's secondary continent in 22 BVE . Both the Ondara and the Mools remained loyal to the Republic during the Replica Wars, though many on Ondara were in despair at the idea of a galaxy-wide war. Senator Lira Ondar and Representative Greeb Mool worked together to represent the interests of the Ondara and Mools respectively in the Galactic Senate. During the Replica Wars, Neeyutnee served as Queen of Ondara. Early in the war, Ondar and Drayden returned to the planet for their wedding and spent several days on world for a honeymoon.

title: Ondara
text: When a number of new battles, including the Battle of Teth , rocked the Outer Reach Territories a few months into the war, Ondara was put under the protection of several new security measures at the order of Mal himself. Ondar wanted to discuss those measures with the Chancellor before learning of the Battle of Teth, which had endangered Drayden's life and changed her priorities to focusing on the Grak–Republic treaty . Ondar and Mool, with the help of the Aetheri Order and the Mool Peppi Bow , discovered the Dissident scientist Nuvo Vindi 's secret laboratory in the Eastern swamps . They managed to prevent Vindi from releasing stockpiles of the Blue Shadow Virus into Ondara's surface. During the Battle of Mon Calvarra , elements of the Mool Grand Army led by Representative Mool were dispatched to the watery planet of Mon Calvarra to aid Senator Ondar, the Aetheri, the Replica SCUBA troopers , and the Calavane Prince Liarch 's forces against the Dissident commander Riff Tamson and his Quarren allies.

title: Ondara
text:
Later, the Mool Boss Lyonie came under the influence of the pro-Dissident minister Rish Loo . Under Loo's control, Lyonie ordered the Mool Grand Army to march on the Ondara capital of Serath. Their plan was to rendezvous with a Dissident droid army led by General Skarn , who had been sent by Count Varek himself. Rish Loo and Varek's plot was foiled by the combined efforts of Senator Ondar, Representative Mool, the Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden , and General Roos Tarpals . However, the Ondara and Mools were forced to release Skarn after Varek took Drayden hostage.

During the Festival of Light, Varek sent Cad Vorek and his team of bounty hunters to kidnap Mal in order to free Dissident prisoners from Republic captivity. At first, Vorek and Moralo Eval were successful in capturing Mal. However, they were stopped by one of their fellow bounty hunters, Rako Hardeen , who was really Orien Kade in disguise. But, Vorek planned a diversion in order to lure the Republic forces away while Varek carried out the kidnapping. This failed, however, when he fought Kade and Drayden.

### The dark times

title: Ondara
text:
### The dark times

> " Mal's stain is heavy on our people, and we carry that shame still . " ―Sosha Soruna

Following the rise of the Imperium and Mal's self-proclamation as Emperor , Ondara hosted one of the new regime's military garrisons. Shortly after the end of the Replica Wars, thousands of citizens gathered in the streets of Serath in order to assist to Ondar's funeral procession . At that time, Sio Bibble had finally decided to retire from governorship over Ondara, setting the stage for an election that Saché was seemingly going to win. However, Ondara's internal politics were also interfered with by the new regime; while the people were still permitted to elect their monarchs, those who gained the office had little real power or influence. The position of governor was also abolished. Instead, all major decisions regarding Ondara were placed firmly in the hands of the sector's Moff , a position held by Mal's close ally and former Security Forces officer Quarsh Panaka, who was appointed before the election for governor could even happen.

title: Ondara
text:
Some time around 18 BVE , Luthen Rael and his adoptive daughter Kleya Marki bombed Imperial vehicles on an Ondaran bridge as an early act of their insurgency.

Though one of the less corrupt Imperial officials, Panaka was assassinated by Torrik Vess 's Partisans insurgency in 3 BVE . Due to its status as Mal's homeworld, Ondara prospered during the Age of the Imperium . Its economy and environment were regarded to be far healthier than most worlds which had been subject to Imperial rule. Nevertheless, the people of Ondara resented the fact that it was their world that brought forth a man like Mal. The Imperium also demilitarized Ondara and dissolved the Royal Ondara Security Forces 's starfighter wing. As a result, Ondara lacked any combat-trained pilots by the time of the Battle of Mossfell .

title: Ondara
text:
Sable , former handmaiden of Padme Ondar, brought Xarn Velgor to Ondara in 3 AVE . Typho and his insurgent team fought him. The insurgents went as far as baiting a Sando aqua monster into fighting the Dark Lord of the Umbra . Ric Olié and his insurgent cell, the Amidalans , attempted to protect Lira's tomb from Velgor, but were killed in the process. The handmaidens gathered for a final stand. They were unable to prevent Xarn Velgor from breaching the tomb.

### A new era

#### Rise of the Concordat

> " …Very simply this, that Ondara represents the best of the First Republic. Its assistance— your assistance, Your Highness—would be invaluable in leading the way to a restoration of the Senate . As we attempt to form a new government, we hope we may rely on Ondara's support, counsel, and aid. " ―Elira Solen, to Sosha Soruna

title: Ondara
text: When news of Theron Mal's death during the Battle of Mossfell—which resulted in the apparent defeat of the Imperium by the Alliance to Restore the Republic —spread across the galaxy after the battle, an outpouring of joy occurred on Ondara, the inhabitants of which considered themselves free at last. While it quickly became apparent that the war was not over as the Imperium survived, even without its Emperor, Ondara was liberated from Imperial control. Nonetheless, all equipment stored within Mal's small countryside retreat was stripped bare by the time it was explored by the Concordat , preventing the government from discovering whatever secrets Mal had kept within.

title: Ondara
text:
Some twenty days after the Battle of Mossfell, the Royal House of Ondara received a visit by Princess Elira Solen of Cindervale , who had been sent by Vela Sess , Chancellor of the Alliance, which was in the process of reorganizing into the Concordat. In the royal palace's throne room, Solen met the then-Queen of Ondara, Sosha Soruna , and asked for Ondara's support in the establishment of the Concordat and the restoration of the Senate . The queen heartily accepted Solen's offer, claiming that the Ondara felt great shame over Mal's actions.

#### Operation: Cinder

> " Jamming at full power, Captain. Climate disruption array now at twenty percent. We count three class-five hurricanes already, another dozen forming . " " I want one hundred percent within eight hours, Lieutenant Gulin. By order of the Emperor…Ondara is to be scoured … " ― Gulin and Lerr Duvat

title: Ondara
text: During the meeting, gigantic storms suddenly began to rage, and Ondara's orbital sensors were all jammed. The Imperium had set up a climate disruption array in orbit , as ordered by the late Theron Mal. Named Operation: Cinder , the Imperium's plan was to disrupt Ondara's environment and climate, and thus render the planet inhospitable. The storms caused fires and flooding across the world, and many buildings were demolished. Soruna, Solen, and Alliance pilot Shara Bey finally decided to use three old N-1 starfighters —that had been stored by Queen Neeyutnee in the Serath Hangar during the Replica Wars—and go protect Ondara by destroying the Imperium's satellites . Once in space , the three women were attacked by a squadron of SKREE fighters , but managed, nonetheless, to knock out all of the satellites. A Insurgent fleet led by Dorian Quill and Nien Nunb soon arrived to take care of the Imperial forces. The fleet consisted of members of Danger Squadron , which arrived in T-65B Vector starfighters led by Danger Leader Kessith Shriv Suurgav , Nunb in the Mellcrawler II , and the MC80 Star Cruiser Restoration .

title: Ondara
text: Danger Squadron temporarily included former Inferno Squad members and recent Imperial defectors Iden Versio and Del Meeko to assist the three women in the destruction of the satellites. After their destruction, the Imperial II -class Iron Cruiser Torment was then engaged by Danger Squadron and several Yarrow bombers , and the Restoration delivered the fatal blow to the hull of the Torment . The Alliance forces then gathered upon the ground to immobilize remaining Imperials in the final ground assault to try and take control of Serath. Imperial forces were immobilized by the ion pulse courtesy of Elira, Del, Shriv and Iden taking the fight from the marketplace, courtyard and all the way to the palace and once they are inside the pulse activates and rendering all of their weapons and vehicles inoperable leading to the surrender of Imperial forces. And Shriv commented that they just won and after all that happened Iden and Del are formally welcomed by Elira into the Concordat.

title: Ondara
text:
Due to the fact that Ondara had been the Emperor's homeworld, the planet became a rallying point for Imperial sympathizers. Months after the failed Operation: Cinder, the Imperial Navy deployed three attack forces to wipe out the Concordat's presence in the Ondara system . However, these attempts were successfully foiled by Corona Squadron .

### Rise of the New Imperium

> " People of Ondara. This is the Supreme Leader of the New Imperium. I have commandeered your communications network. I am unimpressed with you. Your focus on events that happened decades ago, your obsession with lineage and superstition…have caused your society to fester. Because you cannot let go…you hold yourself back. Now that will change. All that was will be swept away. Ondara will embrace the future. You have been ruled by queens. You have been ruled by an emperor. Now…I am your king. " ―Zarrin Karrick

During the Cold War nearly thirty years later between the New Imperium and the Coalition , Senator Thadlé Berenko represented Ondara in the reconstituted Concordat Senate, and was killed when the New Imperium destroyed Hosnian Prime , the home of the Senate at the time.

title: Ondara
text:
During the Cold War nearly thirty years later between the New Imperium and the Coalition , Senator Thadlé Berenko represented Ondara in the reconstituted Concordat Senate, and was killed when the New Imperium destroyed Hosnian Prime , the home of the Senate at the time.

By 35 AVE , Ondara's skies were being patrolled by Star Destroyers from the New Imperium as part of its expansive efforts to establish galactic dominance. At some point later, Ondara engaged in open insurgency against the New Imperium, simultaneous with other planets such as Mistral and Vantor leading to the successful overthrow of the entire regime.

title: Ondara
text:
> " You and the Ondara form a symbiont circle. What happens to one of you will affect the other. You must understand this. " ―Orien Kade, to Rugor Nass

Ondara was inhabited by two societies: an indigenous species of intelligent amphibians called the Mools and a group of peaceful humans who were referred to as the Ondara. In the distant past, a cultural misunderstanding resulted in a serious quarrel between the Mool and the human colonists. Both sides refused to acknowledge their responsibilities in the rift, and the two groups ostracized each other for the longest time. That situation lasted until the Invasion of Ondara by the Commerce Combine forced the humans and Mools to join forces.

Ondara culture fostered the artist in every citizen, encouraging children to become musicians, performers, painters, and similar professions. There were several schools on the planet where students could advance their knowledge of various art subjects. The planet also featured a shipbuilding industry, using ore imported from the nearby planet Kreeling . Both the Ondara and Mools had a close relationship with water. Fish was an important food to the people of Ondara. Ondara had engagement rituals during the High Republic Era intended to be performed between the betrothed individuals.

title: Ondara
text:
Ondara first appeared in the 1999 film Aetherion : Episode I Veiled Threat , the first installment of the Aetherion prequel trilogy . It was later featured in 2002 's Aetherion : Episode II Attack of the Replicas and 2005 's Aetherion : Episode III Fury of the Umbra .

In the revised rough draft of the script for Veiled Threat , Ondara was called Uthara .

After many months of general research into where to shoot, the real-world shooting locations for Ondara were Villa del Balbianello and Royal Palace of Caserta in Italy and Plaza de España in Seville , Spain , among others. The buildings of Ondara were based on the Hagia Sophia , a cathedral turned mosque then turned museum located in Istanbul , Turkey . On the other hand, the architecture of Ondara was inspired by the domed and scalloped roofs of the Marin County Civic Center . The crew hoped to depict Ondara with classical architecture, thereby establishing the planet's scale and giving the idea of a sophisticated society.

title: Ondara
text: The exact number of moons in Ondara is currently unknown. In Attack of the Replicas , Drevan Koss mentions "spice miners on the moons of Ondara." However, the 2016 reference book Aetherion: Complete Locations states that Ondara has only one moon. The 2018 novel Vorren: Alliances confirms that Ondara has three moons. There is also a discrepancy over the names of the three moons: Nexus of Power states that the moons where Ohma-D'un , Rori , and a small third moon that has no in-universe name, while Rise of the Dissidents , a sourcebook from Aetherion Roleplaying , states that the three moons of Ondara are Rori , Veruna , and Ohma-D'un . However, the novel Elira, Princess of Cindervale prominently includes the moon Onoam . Rori and Onoam have similar descriptions, but as yet there has been no clarification for the discrepancy.

title: Orien Kade
text:
# Orien Kade
> " You can kill me, but you will never destroy me. It takes strength to resist the umbra side. Only the weak embrace it. " " It is more powerful than you know. " " And those who oppose it are more powerful than you'll ever be. " ―Orien Kade and Vreth — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Orien Kade was a legendary Synth Flux-sensitive human male Aetheri Master who served on the Aetheri High Council during the final years of the Republic Era . As a High Aetheri General , Kade served in the Grand Army of the Republic that fought against the Dissident Droid Army during the Replica Wars , and was nicknamed " the Negotiator ." Kade, however, was forced into exile as a result of the Great Aetheri Purge initiated by the Republic's own replica troopers when Republic Supreme Chancellor , secretly Vael Mal , implemented Directive 66 . As a mentor, Kade was responsible for training two members of the Drayden family , Kael and Joren Drayden , both of whom served in turn as his Adept in the ways of Synth Flux .

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade was born on the planet Stewjon in 57 BVE . He was Synth Flux-sensitive, and therefore taken from his family and inducted into the Aetheri Order as a child . Raised in the Aetheri Grand Temple on the planet Vantor , Kade was assigned to Aetheri Master Sorin Vael . In 32 BVE , Kade attained the rank of Aetheri Knight by defeating the Umbra Lord Vael Vreth during the Invasion of Ondara . He also chose to train Kael Drayden—the prophesied Seeded One who was destined to destroy the Umbra and restore balance to Synth Flux—having promised Vael who died in the flux blade duel against Vreth.

title: Orien Kade
text: With the advent of the Replica Wars in 22 BVE , Kade adopted the military rank of High Aetheri General in the Grand Army of the Vantor Republic , and was given command of the Open Circle Fleet , the Third Systems Army , and the 7th Sky Corps . Replica Marshal Commander Cord served as his second-in-command throughout the galaxy -wide conflict, with their forces achieving multiple victories over the Fractio of Independent Systems . In the midst of the war, his old enemy Vreth re-emerged into galactic affairs, bent on revenge against Kade for his debilitating defeat decades prior. Though they clashed in heated duels on multiple occasions, Vreth failed to end Kade's life or cripple his spirit, despite murdering his former love, Satinna Velara , Duchess of Ferrum .

title: Orien Kade
text: In 19 BVE , Kade killed the Dissident Supreme Martial Commander , General Skarn , during the Battle of Uthara , effectively ending the Replica Wars. He later survived the initial onslaught of the Great Aetheri Purge against the Aetheri Order, which resulted from the machinations of the Umbra Lord Vael Mal. After discovering that Drayden had betrayed the Aetheri and turned to the umbra side of Synth Flux , becoming Mal' Umbra apprentice under the name of Xarn Velgor, Kade defeated his former Adept on Emberfall and exiled himself to the Outer Reach planet Dunemere as the Imperium rose to power . Adopting a hermit lifestyle as " Beno Kade ," he watched over Velgor's and Senator Lira Ondar 's son, Joren.

title: Orien Kade
text: Ten years later , Kade left exile to rescue Elira Solen , Joren's twin sister, and was pursued by the Imperium's Warden Order and Velgor himself. Later, Kade was hunted down once again by Vreth, whom he finally slew to protect the young Joren. Kade began the boy's Aetheri training in 1 BVE , and soon after encountered Velgor aboard the first Void Core , where he sacrificed himself to ensure that Joren and his allies escaped from the Umbra Lord. In death, Kade became one with Synth Flux which allowed him to continue guiding Joren throughout the Galactic Civil War . In 4 AVE , Kade reunited with his former student, Kael Drayden, who died destroying his Umbra Master in order to save his son. Kade was remembered as a legendary Aetheri Master during the rise of the Concordat ; Beno Karrick , the son of Joren's twin sister, Princess Elira Solen, was named after Kade. Karrick's turn to the umbra side left Joren disillusioned with the Aetheri Order's legacy, and he held Kade responsible for Kael's transformation into Velgor. However, Joren's faith would eventually be restored with the aid of Vael Mal's granddaughter Nyla , to whom Kade would lend his voice and strength in a final battle and victory against her resurrected ancestor on Umbrale in 35 AVE .

title: Orien Kade
text:
### Early life

> " As Aetheri, we're taken from our families when we're very young. I still have glimpses, flashes really, my mother's shawl, my father's hands. I remember a baby. [...] I think I had a brother. Really don't remember him. I wished I did. " ―Orien Kade

Orien Kade was born on the planet Stewjon in 57 BVE . Despite being very young when he left his family , he still had glimpses of his father's hands and his mother's shawl , and he remembered a baby he believed to be his brother although he barely remembered him.

### Joining the Aetheri Order

> " …I never had problems with that as a youngling. Being independent, I mean. I broke rules right and left. They even called me rebellious. Probably the Masters were surprised anyone was willing to take me on as an apprentice. " ―Orien Kade to Sorin Vael, about his early life — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Orien Kade
text:
When Kade was discovered to be Synth Flux-sensitive , he was taken from his homeworld to the Aetheri Sanctum on the Core Reaches planet Vantor to be trained as an Aetheri within the first six months of his life. In the Aetheri crèche he was placed with other Aetheri younglings in the Kybuck Clan during his early years , including his friends Gehren and Prie . Kade received basic Initiate training alongside his peers in the Aetheri Order 's Temple and began training in several simple Synth Flux techniques by the age of three in 54 BVE . Kade studied in the ways of Synth Flux and Aetheri traditions under Grand Master Zho , eventually coming to respect him and the Aetheri Council greatly. He also received instruction in the art of flux blade combat from Aetheri Master Cin Drallig in the basic flux blade forms and techniques. At some point before he was selected as an Adept , Kade attended a class centered around meditation . Unlike how he acted as he got older, Kade, during his days as a youngling, gained a reputation for breaking rules and having a rebellious nature, resulting in very few Masters who were willing to train the boy as their Adept. To curb Kade's behavior, Zho searched for a teacher for Kade that had unorthodox methods, which would mold the student into rebelling by being dutiful.

### Sorin Vael's Adept

#### Initial endeavors

title: Orien Kade
text:
### Sorin Vael's Adept

#### Initial endeavors

> " It worries me, this misunderstanding between you and your Adept. This isn't the first time you've reported such difficulties. " " It worries me as well. Orien is strong in Synth Flux, and eager to do his duty. The failure must be mine. Fundamentally, I fear we are a mismatch. " ―Depa Billaba and Sorin Vael, about Orien Kade's training — Link ▶️ ( file info ) Around 44 BVE , Aetheri Master Sorin Vael chose Kade as his Adept learner when he was thirteen years old. During his apprenticeship he became friends with Jape , a fellow Adept who he kept correspondence with, and also maintained contact with crèche-mate Prie and the Calavane Bant Eerin . In their first months together, Vael attempted to adapt his teaching methods to suit Kade's strengths, but felt he failed to do so adequately. At some point during his training, Kade constructed his first flux blade , modeled after Vael's flux blade hilt style and his own personality. As the pair struggled to establish a workable affinity, the Master continued to train his Adept in the basic cadences of flux blade combat, preventing him from picking a specialty. Vael was proud of his apprentice's skills, and sparred with him in training sessions while at the Temple between missions. Kade, in turn, spent a significant amount of time in the training dojos to hone the techniques taught to him.

title: Orien Kade
text:
In their lessons, Vael taught Kade that there was a strength and nobility in restraint. As time passed, Kade's demeanor shifted to become more serious and respectful of the Council, in contrast to the maverick Vael's usual way of approaching situations based on his instincts in the present, even if that meant going against the Council's wishes. Both carried differing philosophies on focusing on the future versus the present, and interpreted Synth Flux in varying ways. Despite their differences, Kade strived to be a good student, and supported his Master's hobbies regarding ancient Aetheri prophecy research. To Kade's chagrin, the majority of his free time in the Temple was consumed by gathering information from the Aetheri Archives and the reliquary of prophecy under the watchful eye of the Aetheri Master librarian Jocasta Nura . Over time, he learned the language Old Cindervalean , which many of the reliquary 's prophecies were written in. As an escape from the workload, Kade played rounds of the game dejarik in the lower levels of Vantor in the evenings after finishing his Master's research requests.

#### Early travels and visit to Thornwood

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Early travels and visit to Thornwood

> " The Trandoshans—they capture and hunt for sport. And they knew today was Life Day. And they knew the Voraks would be vulnerable. Come Orien…we have to stop them! " ―Sorin Vael to Orien Kade The pair's continuing training issues were discussed with Aetheri Councilors Depa Billaba and Drevan Koss in an attempt to find a remedy, without success. At some point during his time as an Adept, Kade and Vael visited a fortress on the planet Lah'mu , the world Cindervale 's royal palace , and the planets Selvara and Gatalenta . While training, he became acquainted with the Aetheri trainee Siri Tachi and developed some feelings for her, but refrained from acting on them. Around 41 BVE , three years after becoming Vael's Adept, a sixteen-year-old Kade was eager to prove himself on a mission, but when he and Vael were set to leave on one, his Master was nowhere to be found. Feeling angry by his master's abandonment, Kade decided to set off on the mission to the planet Lenahra alone. While he was there, he encountered a group of teenagers and datachips hidden on the world by the Aetheri Orla Jareni long before his visit. He met a Besalisk named Dexter Jettster , who became a close friend.

title: Orien Kade
text: During his training, Kade traveled to the planet Thornwood with his Master during the Life Day holiday. Vael used the trip to teach his student about the Vorak's way of life and harmony, and how it related to their own connection to Synth Flux. The festivities slightly overwhelmed Kade, though he took the lessons to heart, and met one of Vael's acquaintances, the Vorak Brennonn . However, their gathering was interrupted by Trandoshans who captured several Voraks, intending to use them in a hunt for sport. Despite Kade's best efforts, Vael was snared in a net as well and taken away.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Though held captive, Vael believed that his Adept would rescue him from the Trandoshan hunters. Kade, though reluctant to put any more Voraks in danger, formulated a plan with Brennonn to break the imprisoned individuals free. He proceeded to surrender himself to the Trandoshans, claiming that as a simple student, he stood no chance against them. While conversing with the hunters' leader, Kade subtly used Synth Flux to open the cage holding Vael. Once both Aetheri brandished their flux blades, several other Voraks rushed to the scene and assisted in setting their friends free. After the situation was settled, the Voraks opted to leave the group in peace, citing Life Day as reason to pursue a resolution without violence. When back at the festivities area, Kade remained confused as to why Vael did not break himself free. However, the Master informed him that it was intended as a learning experience, and to gain insight from Vorak perspectives on life.

#### Protecting Satinna Velara

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Protecting Satinna Velara

> " You and Satinna have a history. " " An extended mission when I was younger. Master Sorin and I spent a year on Ferrum protecting the duchess from insurgents who had threatened her world. They sent Bounty hunters after us. We were always on the run, living hand-to-mouth, never sure what the next day would bring. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

Sometime between the years 41 BVE and 40 BVE , Kade and Vael spent a year on the planet Ferrum protecting Duchess Satinna Velara from insurgents who were threatening her world. Bounty hunters were sent after them, forcing them to live as fugitives, never knowing what the next day would bring them. The mission forced them to work and fight together as a team, resulting in them forging a close bond.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Velara called Kade by the nickname "Beno." During that time, they had an incident with a swarm of venom-mites on the terrestrial object Draboon , where Kade carried Velara to safety. However, he fell and dropped the Duchess, who then acquired a scar as a result. Kade fell in love with Satinna during his stay on Ferrum, but despite his feelings toward her, he continued with his training and was reassigned to another mission after his objectives were complete. Kade regretted leaving her, but ultimately followed the Aetheri Code he had sworn to live by. Meanwhile, Satinna chose to stay and lead her people, having not asked Kade to stay, knowing it would have been a difficult choice.

#### Incident on Teth

> " Master? Are you all right? " " Just get us a ship if you can! " ―Orien Kade and Sorin Vael on Teth — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Incident on Teth

> " Master? Are you all right? " " Just get us a ship if you can! " ―Orien Kade and Sorin Vael on Teth — Link ▶️ ( file info )

In 40 BVE, a seventeen-year old Kade and a forty-year-old Vael were sent to the planet Teth to investigate the disappearance of agricultural shipments through the Triellus trade route . The pair ran into difficulties finding information, and their investigations quickly aroused the suspicions of the guilty parties. As their situation rapidly turned violent, Kade and Vael stormed a building, using their flux blade skills to synth flux their way through the compound. In the chaos, Vael felt that Kade was not responding to instructions well, and chose to make an escape.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Vael instructed Kade to find a ship , though the Adept failed to do so upon being stopped in a hangar. Kade was briefly held hostage by Wanbo the Grak's majordomo , Thurible , but was soon released in exchange for Wanbo, who had been captured by Vael. Eventually, the Aetheri managed to depart the planet after making tenuous peace with Wanbo. Though both Aetheri attempted to remain lighthearted about the outcome of the mission, Kade felt that he had failed his Master.

Once on Vantor, Vael recounted the communication issues that had plagued him and Kade during the Teth mission to the Aetheri Council. While citing their continued inability to form a strong bond, he surmised that they may not have been meant to be a pair. Vael received an invitation to join the Council after the mission, which displeased Kade when he found out shortly after during a meeting with Supreme Chancellor Kirames Kaj . Vael resolved to make a decision regarding the invitation after meditation, knowing accepting the invite would result in Kade's reassignment to another Master.

#### Mission to Pijal

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Mission to Pijal

> " The Aetheri Council—the Council has named me the rightful representative of the Republic, for the purposes of the ceremony. " ―Orien Kade, on Pijal — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Days after his mission to Teth, a political dispute erupted on the Inner Reach planet Pijal , which caught the attention of Kaj. Initial reports suggested a performance troupe called the Opposition was engaging in increasingly violent initiatives protesting the signing of the Governance Treaty — a move would end the absolutist monarchy . Vael and Kade were informed that Lord Regent Rael Averross had requested their aid on the planet and its moon to curb the attacks, discover more about their origins, and ensure the opening of the Pijal Hyperspace Corridor hyperspace route . Both Aetheri were additionally instructed to to protect the Pijali Crown Princess Fanry until she could sign the treaty at her coronation , and ratify the initiative on behalf of the Republic.

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade and Vael were dispatched to the planet, and the Master took the opportunity to inform his Adept about Averross's training under Varek. Upon their arrival to the Pijal system , they spotted several soulcraft vessels suffering from plasma attacks, and moved to save the ships. Helped by an antiplasma charge, Kade and Vael rescued several soulcraft and the slaves inside. Vael and Kade were regally greeted by Fanry upon their arrival to the Pijali palace . Upon being briefed on the situation, the pair used a small shuttle to meet with the gemstone thieves Rahara Wick and Pax Maripher on the world's moon . After some negotiation, the thieves agreed to assist the Aetheri in their search for the Opposition and its leader, Halin Azucca .

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade and Vael made several trips to the moon, and their scans for the Opposition came up unsuccessful. While on the palace grounds, Kade participated in the ritual Grand Hunt while riding a Pijal varactyl . During the ceremonial hunt, the crab droid prey of the event attacked Fanry, prompting Kade to destroy the threat. Upon investigation, he and his Master concluded that the sabotage must have been conducted by someone within the palace, and not the Opposition.

Eventually, Kade and Vael met with Azucca on Pijal's moon, and she claimed that her group of performance artists had been framed for the attacks blamed on them. With this knowledge, Vael refused to ratify the Governance Treaty at Fanry's upcoming coronation after receiving a violent Synth Flux vision about the events. Azucca later provided information to the Aetheri proving that the attacks on Czerka facilities were found to have originated from blackguards , a division of the Pijali royal guards secretly under the orders of Captain Deren and Fanry.

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade, knowing that Vael would refuse to sign the treaty, was appointed to ratify the initiative on the Republic's behalf in his place by the Aetheri Council. However, at Fanry's coronation, the princess violently seized power as an absolute monarch to prevent the signing of the treaty, decrying democracy. Kade attempted to protect the Skykeeper leader from her when Fanry ordered the death of those she percieved had betrayed her. Kade listened to Fanry's speech about the greed of her elders, and used his kohlen crystal sabotaged flux blade to attack Deren. Following the injury of her captain, the newly crowned queen escaped the Celestial Chalice where the event had been held with her confidante Cady , leaving the Skykeeper, the jeweler , and Kade behind.

title: Orien Kade
text:
While Vael tried to negotiate with Fanry over hologram , Kade helped the slaves aboard the Czerka cruiser, Leverage , with Maripher's help. Eventually, Cady ended her rule by holding her at volt pistol -point until she surrendered. However, because Fanry had threatened to harm Kade while he was acting as a Republic representative, the crowning was deemed illegitimate. Kade and Vael helped the planet establish a democratic Assembly after Fanry's abdication, and reported back to Vantor afterwards. Kade felt that the mission had been one of the first that he and his Master were able to work well together. However, he also realized that his pairing with Vael had strengthened his resolve to be a "Perfect Aetheri" and follow the Aetheri Code in all aspects, if only to be rebellious towards an unorthodox teacher.

#### Saving Th'er

> " Where are we heading, Master? " ―Orien Kade to Sorin Vael when escaping from the Metal Clan

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Saving Th'er

> " Where are we heading, Master? " ―Orien Kade to Sorin Vael when escaping from the Metal Clan

The Aetheri Order later sent Kade and Vael to the planet Bri'n to resolve a conflict on the world. On Bri'n, the leader of the Metal Clan attempted to capture priestess Th'er so that either her word or her blood could be used to destroy her trees . Surrounded by forces of the Metal Clan, Vael chose to escape with Th'er in an Eta -class shuttle and return to Vantor. Once on planet, Kade watched, without interjection, as Th'er attempted to convince Sorin to intervene in her conflict. However, she eventually chose to seek allies on Vantor instead.

#### Operating near Botor

> " Holy…volt pistol bolts. How did [Zho] take out a whole room full of pirates? " ―Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Operating near Botor

> " Holy…volt pistol bolts. How did [Zho] take out a whole room full of pirates? " ―Orien Kade

At some point around 40 BVE, Vael and Kade were operating in the vicinity of a planet that served as a base of the Flesh Mongers pirate group, flying a pair of Delta-7 Aethersprite -class light interceptors . The two received a message from the surface of the planet from Aetheri Master Zho, who was asking for assistance. Landing on the planet, Vael and Kade discovered that Zho had taken out the entire pirate gang in order to rescue a young Synth Flux-sensitive child, known as Lo , as the pirate had planned to sell him due to his abilities in Synth Flux. After leaving the child in Kade and Vael's care, Zho departed for his next objective.

### Invasion of Ondara

#### Ambassadors to the Supreme Chancellor

> " I have a bad feeling about this. " " I don't sense anything. " " It's not about the mission, Master. It's something elsewhere… elusive. " ―Orien Kade and Sorin Vael — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Orien Kade
text:
### Invasion of Ondara

#### Ambassadors to the Supreme Chancellor

> " I have a bad feeling about this. " " I don't sense anything. " " It's not about the mission, Master. It's something elsewhere… elusive. " ―Orien Kade and Sorin Vael — Link ▶️ ( file info )

In 32 BVE , by the time Vael considered Kade to be ready for his trials , they were sent by Vantor Republic Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum to negotiate with the Commerce Combine , who had set up a blockade around the planet of Ondara . Both Aetheri extensively studied political documents and trade relations between the parties prior to the endeavor, sensing its necessity. The two Aetheri were tasked with negotiating a settlement with Commerce Combine representatives.

title: Orien Kade
text: The pair traveled to the system on the Consular -class space cruiser Radiant VII and landed on the modified Lucrehulk -class LH-3210 cargo freighter Saak'ak , the flagship of the blockade . There, Kade and Vael were brought to a conference room, where protocol droid TC-14 informed them that a Commerce Combine representative would be with them shortly, and invited the pair to make themselves comfortable. However, upon learning that the pair were Aetheri from TC-14, Viceroy Nutis Gunray of the Commerce Combine instead sent the protocol droid back into the room to distract them, with the droid offering Kade and Vael drinks. Gunray then ordered his security to get rid of the Aetheri and their assets, with an overhead turret destroying the Radiant VII and its crew.

title: Orien Kade
text:
The two Aetheri sensed the loss of their vessel and rose from their seats, drawing their flux blades before noticing poisonous dioxis gas being pumped into the room around them and holding their breaths. OOM-series security droids were then sent to confirm that the Aetheri were dead, however Kade and Vael escaped into the hallway and destroyed the battle droids before making their way to the Saak'ak ' s bridge. Kade held off the battle droids while Vael attempted to cut through the doors to the bridge. However, droidekas summoned by Gunray arrived, and the two Aetheri were forced to flee into a nearby ventilation shaft, using Synth Flux speed to escape. The two escaped to Ondara's surface by stowing away on separate C-9979 landing crafts in the Saak'ak's hangar bay, discovering a droid army preparing to invade Ondara in the process.

#### Rescuing Queen Ondar

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Rescuing Queen Ondar

After arriving on Ondara, Kade was attacked by two Federation Single Trooper Aerial Platforms while en route to Vael's location. He was rescued by his Master, who was accompanied by Greeb Mool , a member of Ondara's native Mool species . After some debate, Mool agreed to lead the two Aetheri to Otoh Gunga , a hidden underwater Mool city where the group was brought before the Mool leader Boss Nass . Though unable to convince the Mools to help the humans of Ondara, Vael influenced Nass to obtain transport , to allow them to reach Ondara's capital Serath . Piloting the transport through the planet's core , the trio was attacked by an Opee sea killer at one point, which led to the ship being damaged and electronic systems shutting down. Kade quickly fixed the issue with some rewiring, and after a brief encounter with a Sando aqua monster , Kade, Vael, and Mool reached Serath.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Upon their arrival, the group discovered that the Commerce Combine had already taken control of Serath, finding empty streets. The two Aetheri came across a group of battle droids taking Queen Ondar and several others to an internment camp, and quickly engaged the droids, freeing the queen and her companions. Following this, the Aetheri moved to a nearby hangar, intending to use an Ondara starship to take the queen to Vantor. Kade moved to liberate several pilots who were held prisoner by battle droids, while his master took the rest of their group to a ship. After a brief skirmish, the group fled Ondara in the queen's starship in an attempt to reach Vantor with news of the Commerce Combine invasion. During the escape, the ship's hyperrelay was damaged by droid starfighters , preventing them from jumping straight to Vantor and forcing them to instead land on Dunemere for repairs.

#### Return of the Umbra

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Return of the Umbra

After landing on the desert world, Kade remained on the ship, while Vael, Mool, the droid Bolt-3 , and Ondar, who was disguised as a handmaiden , went to search for a new hyperrelay unit. While searching, Vael discovered Kael Drayden , a young enslaved human from whom he retrieved a blood sample for analysis, believing the child to be strong in Synth Flux. Vael sent the data to Kade on the ship, with instructions for Kade to analyze it. Kade's analysis revealed that the boy's synthcell count was higher than that of any Aetheri. When Vael arrived, accompanied by Drayden, Vael Vreth , an Umbra apprentice, attacked Vael prompting Kade to order the ship to take off, with Vael leaping into the ship as it ascended. The group then proceeded to Vantor.

title: Orien Kade
text: Upon their arrival on the planet, Vael and Kade went directly to the Aetheri Council to report on the mysterious attacker, whom Vael believed to be an Umbra Lord . After being briefed on what to do about their mysterious attacker, Vael discussed about Drayden with the Council, believing him to be the Seeded One . Nevertheless, the Council was determined that the boy not be trained. However, Vael persevered, telling them that he would take the boy as his Adept, despite the Aetheri Code's restrictions, but Kade insisted he was ready to take the trials, and his master agreed. Instead of discussing the matter further, Drevan Koss sent the pair back to Ondara to protect the Queen and also as an attempt to lure out the mysterious assailant.

title: Orien Kade
text: After returning to Ondara, Mool located the Mools and Ondar, revealing herself to be the true Queen, begged Boss Nass to provide assistance in fighting the droid armies of the Commerce Combine. Boss Nass agreed to fight the droids as a diversion, while the Queen's forces slipped into Serath and captured Gunray. However, they soon encountered Vreth once again and engaged in a duel with him, biding time for Ondar and her forces to reach the throne room. During the duel with Vreth, Kade was separated from his master and forced to watch as Vreth impaled Vael with his double-bladed flux blade so, when the opportunity arose, Kade, filled with rage, retaliated against the Umbra. However, the Gloomreachian Zyrrak gained the upper hand and knocked Kade into a nearby shaft, where he was barely able to grab onto a knob jutting out from the side before falling to his death. Vreth used this opportunity to kick his flux blade into the shaft. Despite his predicament, Kade was able to use his Vael's flux blade to cut the Umbra in half, whose body fell down the shaft, presumably dead. Kade then ran to his master's side and promised a dying Vael

title: Orien Kade
text:
Vreth used this opportunity to kick his flux blade into the shaft. Despite his predicament, Kade was able to use his Vael's flux blade to cut the Umbra in half, whose body fell down the shaft, presumably dead. Kade then ran to his master's side and promised a dying Vael that he would train Drayden. ### Master of the Seeded One

#### The first years

> " Confer on you the level of Aetheri Knight, the Council does. But agree with your taking this boy as your Adept learner, I do not. " " Sorin believed in him. " " The Seeded One, the boy may be. Nevertheless, grave danger, I fear, in his training. " ―Zho and Orien Kade — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Orien Kade
text: Following the end of the Battle of Ondara, Kade was promoted to the rank of Aetheri Knight by the Council, with Zho reluctantly accepting his decision to train Drayden. Kade was later present during Vael's funeral , where he informed the boy that he would become an Aetheri. Along with Ondar and her court, Kade and Drayden remained at the funeral long after the Aetheri Council had left, waiting until every last ember had gone out. Though he deeply grieved the loss of his teacher, Kade also felt that Vael had abruptly cast him aside in favor of prophecies and unbending belief in Drayden as the Seeded One. Nonetheless, as he watched his mentor's body in its final moments, he promised that he would chose to believe the prophecies. Later on, Kade, alongside his new Adept and several members of the Aetheri Council, took part in a victory celebration in Serath.

title: Orien Kade
text:
During his first year as Drayden's Master, he sometimes woke up at night to see his Adept was sleeping on the floor next to his bed; he realized Drayden, having lost both his mother and Vael, was clinging onto him, desperate to ensure his new master did not vanish one night. During one of their many adventures, Kade fell into a nest of gundarks , prompting Drayden to rescue him. At the Aetheri Sanctum, Kade trained Drayden in meditation and levitating rocks. Though Drayden wished to know more about his mentor's early life, he did not remember much of it by that point. Kade had several misgivings toward taking on Drayden as his Adept, but stuck to his firm commitment of honoring his late master's dying wish. But Kade was still mourning Vael, and he began to have the perspective that Drayden got a very raw deal being forced to be with a master who was hardly fit to be a teacher and had just barely got beyond the Aetheri trials himself.

#### Mission to Dallenor

> " Thank you for coming master Aetheri. My name is Clatriffe. I'm in charge of the Dallenor excavation. " ―Clatriffe

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Mission to Dallenor

> " Thank you for coming master Aetheri. My name is Clatriffe. I'm in charge of the Dallenor excavation. " ―Clatriffe

Kade was given a mission to go to the planet Dallenor , where an archaeology team had discovered an Aetheri reliquary . Kade decided to take Drayden with him as part of his training. Kade went to the Temple Archives to find information on Dallenor and about any Aetheri that went there, to no avail. He told Master Zho that he would bring his apprentice with him, to which Zho surprisingly agreed. Kade and Drayden took a T-6 shuttle to Dallenor.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Upon their arrival, Kade met mistress Clatriffe , who told of her troubles with the local pirates. Kade was told of Clatriffe's discovery of centuries-old droids and how she had to hire several of the locals for protection. Kade examined the Reliquary, but did not open it due to the arrival of the Krypder Riders and their leader, Hudso Shaku . Kade attempted to convince them to leave, but Shaku and the riders demanded the artifacts and Kade's flux blade . Kade fought the riders and subdued them. Kade then saw that Shaku had taken Drayden hostage and demanded his flux blade. Before Orien could give a reply, Kael was able to knock Shaku out with rocks.

#### Other adventures with Drayden and a crisis of faith

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Other adventures with Drayden and a crisis of faith

> " To leave the Order, does Kael wish? " " Possibly, Master Zho. He believes that his path lies elsewhere. He wishes to leave his training behind, at least for now. He says he will return, but… I don't know where I failed . I have done my best to teach him. He belongs here. He's not ready . He's too young . " " As are you, Orien. As are you. Your fault it is not. A child Kael remains. His path before coming to us…difficult. His questions…natural. " ―Zho and Aetheri Knight Orien Kade debate about the future of Kael Drayden

title: Orien Kade
text: A couple of years later, Orien and Kael traveled to the planet Ilum so that Drayden could build his first flux blade ; after its construction, Kade said to him, "Kael, this weapon is your life." When Drayden was twelve years old, Kade was assigned a mission to study a star system that revolved, seemingly impossibly, around a dead dwarf star . Upon realizing Drayden had secretly snuck aboard his starship, Kade elected to turn the mission into a teaching experience, telling Drayden of the dead star as a metaphor for how Aetheri needed to learn to let go of their attachments. Despite his initial misgivings about Drayden, having once believed him to be dangerous and would do more harm than good, Kade soon grew to view the boy as a his equal, finding a partner in their missions, and came to see him as his brother.

title: Orien Kade
text:
At some point, Kade and Drayden, during a mission in which they were they were joined by Aetheri Master Shaak Ti , were involved in complicated business on the terrestrial astronomical object of Naran-Shiv . In 29 BVE , Drayden sought to impress his peers at the Aetheri Sanctum. During a training session, he defeated a training droid , which he had programmed to mimic the appearance of the Umbra of Ondara. All the while, Drevan Koss, Kade and Supreme Chancellor Theron Mal watched—the latter of whom was impressed.

Sometime later, Drayden struggled to learn the skill of taming creatures when Kade told him that the Chancellor wanted to see him. The two arrived at his office , where Mal requested that Drayden accompany him on an errand, declining Kade's company. Upon Drayden's return to the Aetheri Sanctum, he confided in Kade that he wished to leave the Order, feeling uncomfortable at the prospect of his entire life being decided when he was only nine years old, and surrendered his flux blade to his master. Though Kade took the weapon, he pleaded Drayden to reconsider.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade later confided to Zho about Drayden's thoughts about leaving the Aetheri Order and that he himself thought he had failed Drayden despite doing the best he could to teach him, that Drayden belonged with the Aetheri Order and that he was too young not ready to be out on his own. Zho confirmed that Kade himself was still young as well and that Drayden was still a child and that it was natural for him to have questions. Zho then asked if Kade would be breaking his vow to Sorin Vael by allowing Drayden to leave, but Kade asserted that he would still train Drayden in Synth Flux in case the umbra side found him. Zho reminded Kade that Aetheri training was exclusive to the Aetheri Order, to which Kade responded that if Drayden left, so would he.

#### Mission to Carnelion IV

> " The road lies before you, Kael Drayden. Will you walk it alone? " " No, Master. As an Aetheri. If you'll show me the way. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Mission to Carnelion IV

> " The road lies before you, Kael Drayden. Will you walk it alone? " " No, Master. As an Aetheri. If you'll show me the way. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

Before Drayden could give his definite answer, at Zho's behest, both student and master responded to a mysterious distress signal from the supposedly-dead world of Carnelion IV that specifically called for Aetheri intercession. They began their journey to the coordinates, but their shuttle was damaged due to the planet's atmospheric debris field and the two had to eject from the doomed vessel, landing below the Celadon Sea . Not too long afterwards, they came to be aware of there being life on the planet as a sky battle raged over them, and Kade returned his flux blade to him so that he could defend himself. As one of the combatant airships began to fall, Drayden and Kade saved its two-person crew by delaying the crash.

title: Orien Kade
text:
The survivors, Kolara and Mother Pran , were unaware of the distress signal and who the Aetheri were. Kade was then able to use a mind trick on Pran to lower her weapons. However, they came under attack by the other airship. Kade then used his flux blade to destroy the airship. Kade then stopped the pilot, Grecker from shooting at Drayden, Pran, and Kolara. After Drayden destroyed their volt pistols, Kade then pulled their knives away. Kade reasoned with Grecker, Kolara, and Pran that they needed to get to safety. As they made their way, they came across Corpse-leeches . Kade and Drayden then drew their flux blades and tried to use synth flux to connect with them to no avail. Kade and the others then boarded an airship.

Kade then refused to give them the location of the distress signal. He also told Grecker that Drayden was not his son, but his Adept at the dying request of his master. Kade and Grecker then defended the airship against the corpse-leeches. However, Pran and Kolara took Drayden with them and abandoned the airship. Kade was then left behind on the airship as Pran destroyed it.

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade and Grecker were then able to jump off the airship before it crashed. Kade was then able to use synth flux to make the creatures understand him. Kade then asked Grecker to tell him where Drayden was taken to. Grecker told him that he did not know where the open was. Kade then decided to go after him with Grecker after getting air masks on. Kade and Grecker then found the location of the distress signal. They then came under attack by a creature. Grecker then fired a flare. Kade and Grecker then fought until a masked man came out and let them in. Kade was able to get inside before Grecker closed the door. The man, Sera , then showed Kade his collection of his world's remnants. Kade was then told that Sera was the one who sent the distress signal. He then told Kade about his collection of relics and how both the open and closed wanted him dead.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade then learned about how Sera sent the signal and learned about both the Aetheri and Umbra. Kade and Sera then went to the roof to watch as Grecker's forces attacked his fortress. Despite Sera's pleas for Kade to kill them, Kade told her that the Aetheri spare everyone. Kade then spoke with Grecker and convinced him to stop their attack. However, Mother Pran attacked with her machines. Kade was then saved by Drayden. Kade then took Drayden to the Sera's communication unit. There, Drayden was able to send out a signal off-planet. Republic and Aetheri forces arrived where they ended the conflict.

#### Mission to Glee Anselm

> " Master Zho has been kidnapped from the Aetheri Sanctum! " ―Kael Drayden

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Mission to Glee Anselm

> " Master Zho has been kidnapped from the Aetheri Sanctum! " ―Kael Drayden

Grand Master Zho was captured by battle droids and taken to the planet Glee Anselm . Kade and Drayden were sent to rescue him. Whilst on Glee Anselm, they located Zho in an underwater base, where they learned that the Grand Master had never really been captured. In reality, the operation was a test for Kade and Drayden, which they passed. The adventure marked the start of Kade and Drayden coming to view each other as brothers. Kade and his Adept were also dispatched on a mission to Tarisa at one point.

#### Capturing a thief

> " Not at all, Dex. What are friends for? " ―Orien Kade to Dexter Jettster

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Capturing a thief

> " Not at all, Dex. What are friends for? " ―Orien Kade to Dexter Jettster

While visiting Dex's Diner, the Pa'lowick thief Tri Tellon stole an object from Kade. She escaped through the world's lower levels, through CoCo Town and to her den, which she shared with the old rogue Magreda . Expecting to find Magreda, she instead found Kade who explained that the object she had stolen was just a tracking device wrapped in some paper. In came Dexter, who had asked Kade to trick Tellon as she had stolen a lot of goods from his customers. Dexter thanked him and told Kade he owed him one, which the Aetheri accepted.

> " A Aetheri's goal is to defend life, not take it. " " Mercy doesn't defeat an enemy, Master. Which is why you're going to lose. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

text:

Sometime after Drayden reached adulthood, Kade and Drayden would engage in a flux blade sparing session in the Aetheri Sanctum. After Drayden thought he was victorious, Kade told him that despite his victory, his need to win blinded him, and Kade was able to overpower Drayden and take Drayden's flux blade away from him.

#### Protecting Senator Ondar

> " You know I don't like it when you do that! " " Sorry, Master, I forgot you don't like flying. " " I don't mind flying, but what you're doing is suicide! " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

text:
### Dissident Crisis

#### Protecting Senator Ondar

> " You know I don't like it when you do that! " " Sorry, Master, I forgot you don't like flying. " " I don't mind flying, but what you're doing is suicide! " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

In 22 BVE , Kade and Drayden were involved in a border dispute on Ansion that involved Presidente Shu Mai of the Commerce Guild . Following their success on Ansion , the two Aetheri were sent by the Aetheri Council—at the behest of Supreme Chancellor Mal—to protect the now Senator Ondar from future attacks following an assassination attempt on her life. Kade and Drayden made their way to Lira's Apartment and whilst they traveling up a turbolift, Kade sensed Drayden's anxiety and warned him of over-stepping their duties, only to be told later of Ondar's plan to use herself as bait.

title: Orien Kade
text: That night, Zam Wesell attempted to kill the Senator with venomous kouhun deployed from a probe droid , but her plot was foiled when Kade and Drayden sensed a disturbance in the Senator's room. While Drayden eliminated the creatures, Kade leaped out of the window and held onto the droid as it attempted to flee into the skylanes of Vantor. The probe droid moved rapidly between the express ways in an attempt to dislodge the Aetheri, unsuccessfully. As the droid moved closer to Wesell's position, the assassin shot the droid with her rifle, destroying it and causing Kade to fall rapidly towards the surface of the planet. Drayden was quickly approaching Kade's position in a speeder, and moved beneath him in order to catch him. The pair then proceeded to pursue the bounty hunter through the skyways of Vantor through traffic lanes and industrial areas, until Drayden leaped to her speeder and disabled it, causing it to crash outside the Outlander Club .

title: Orien Kade
text:
The pair followed her in, realizing she was a changeling , able to mask her appearance. Kade made his way to the bar where he was offered death sticks by Elan Sel'Sabagno , an offer he declined. Kade encouraged Sel'sabagno to return home and rethink his life, using synth flux for persuasion. He sensed Wesell's presence and cut her arm off with his flux blade before she could shoot him. Before she could tell the Aetheri who she was working for, Wesell was shot and killed by a toxic dart fired by Garrick Vark . Subsequently, Kade and Drayden were sent on separate missions by the Council—while Kade continued an investigation on Ondar's aggressors, Drayden would protect her on Ondara. Despite thinking his Adept was not prepared for his first solo mission, he abided by Council's request. Kade, then, took the toxic dart to his friend Dexter Jettster , who told him that it was a Gelvaris saberdart . Using Dex's information about Gelvaris , Kade visited the Archives, but he was unable to locate the system. When he asked Jocasta Nura about it, she surmised that the system must not exist since it was not in the archives. Unconvinced, Kade visited Master Zho, who was teaching the Bear Clan , and the two agreed that someone had erased the files on Gelvaris from the Archives, and that Kade needed to visit the location of the lost planet.

#### Discovery of the Replica Army

> " I have successfully made contact with the Prime Minister of Gelvaris. They are using a bounty hunter named Garrick Vark to create a replica army. " ―Orien Kade, to Drevan Koss and Zho

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Discovery of the Replica Army

> " I have successfully made contact with the Prime Minister of Gelvaris. They are using a bounty hunter named Garrick Vark to create a replica army. " ―Orien Kade, to Drevan Koss and Zho

Upon arriving on Gelvaris, Kade was greeted by the Gelvarian Taun We who told the Aetheri that they had been expecting him. She took Orien to Prime Minister Lamir , who said Sifas Dyen would have been proud of the army they had created in accordance with his request—to create a replica army for the Republic. Kade was then shown the replicas' prowess and growth, and was told that the original template was Garrick Vark. After asking to meet Vark, Taun We took Kade to Vark's quarters, where the Aetheri Knight asked the bounty hunter questions concerning any recent visits to Vantor.

title: Orien Kade
text:
After their meeting, Garrick and his replica son, Vex Vark , attempted to flee Gelvaris in the bounty hunter's ship, Reaver One . Orien confronted Garrick, and the two fought on the landing platform. At the end of the battle, Orien fell off the platform, and Garrick believed he had fallen into the sea. However, Orien managed to catch hold of a bridge, and he returned to the platform to see Reaver One taking off with just enough time for Orien to attach a homing beacon to Garrick's hull.

#### Capture on Pyralis

> " You must join me, Orien… and together, we will destroy the Umbra! " " I will never join you, Varek. " " It may be difficult to secure your release. " ―Count Varek and Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Capture on Pyralis

> " You must join me, Orien… and together, we will destroy the Umbra! " " I will never join you, Varek. " " It may be difficult to secure your release. " ―Count Varek and Orien Kade

Kade pursued the Reaver One in his starfighter all the way to Pyralis and managed to survive Vark's attacks with seismic charges . Tricking him into believing he had died, Kade managed to land on the planet, where he discovered a multitude of Commerce Combine ships. Furthermore, he infiltrated and overheard Count Varek addressing the Dissident Council and mentioning the attempts on Senator Ondar's life were at the request of Nutis Gunray. Realizing the importance of his discoveries, Kade sent a message to Drayden in Dunemere as his signal could not reach Vantor on its own. Before he could end his message, however, Kade was attacked by a droideka and knocked unconscious, captured by the Dissidents and imprisoned.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Inside the prison tower , Varek visited him; he revealed that the Republic was under the influence of an Umbra Lord named Vael Mal, and tried to convince Kade to join him and destroy the Umbra together, but Kade refused. Kade did not believe what Varek said about the Republic being controlled by the Umbra, just as Varek had hoped.

### The Replica Wars

> " You fought in the Replica Wars? " " Yes. I was once an Aetheri knight, the same as your father. " ―Joren Drayden and Orien Kade

#### First Battle of Pyralis

> " No, sir, I wasn't involved in the first assault on Pyralis. " " You didn't miss much. Last time, I was chained to a pole and attacked by several humongous monsters. " " That sounds entertaining. " " It was, for the Geonosians. " ―Commander Cord and Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text: Sentenced to execution in Pyralis' Petranaki Arena , Kade was joined in the arena by Drayden and Ondar who were also captured in their attempt to rescue him. Though reassured that his message had been re-transmitted, he expressed disappointment that Drayden had come and failed to free them from the situation. The trio worked to control the three creatures deployed to kill them—a reek , an acklay , and a nexu .
