After they had freed themselves from their restraints, Kade fought the most formidable of the three creatures—the acklay. Kade, Ondar, and Drayden were saved by the arrival of an Aetheri task synth flux led by Drevan Koss who refused to surrender to Varek, intending to complete their rescue. The Aetheri fought back against the overwhelming droid armies, but soon only a few survivors were left in the center of the arena surrounded by battle droids. When Koss declined Varek's offer to let the Aetheri surrender, Kade stood in solidarity with the decision, intending to go down fighting.

title: Orien Kade
text: Moments prior to their execution, replica army forces arrived in transports led by Master Zho. The replicas fought back against the droids and rescued the Aetheri and Ondar, forming a perimeter around the survivors. Kade then boarded the same Republic LAAT/i transport with Drayden and Ondar while the rest of the Aetheri task synth flux also escaped. As they flew, Drayden instructed their replica pilots on how best to shoot down enemy forces, which Kade complimented. Soon, both caught sight of Varek fleeing on his speeder with a droid escort. Kade felt that there was not enough time to pursue reinforcements, assuring Ondar that he and his Adept could handle the situation alone. When Varek's escort rattled their LAAT/i, the Senator fell out of their vehicle, causing Drayden to panic.

title: Orien Kade
text: Drayden pleaded to rescue her, though Kade insisted that catching up to Varek was the highest priority and that if the Adept stayed behind he would be removed from the Aetheri Order. Once they landed, Kade and Drayden pursued Varek as he prepared to flee the planet. After confronting him about the Aetheri he had killed earlier that day, the pair engaged in a flux blade duel with Varek. The former Aetheri's use of Synth Flux lightning revealed his fall to the umbra side, prompting Kade to be wary when his apprentice was downed by it. Now knowing that he had underestimated Varek's skills, dueled Varek, but was eventually disarmed by the former Aetheri during the duel and injured on the shoulder and thigh. Kade tossed his flux blade to Drayden so that he could continue the fight.

title: Orien Kade
text:
However, after the Adept's arm was cut off by Varek's flux blade, he too was tossed to the floor beside his Master. Varek moved toward them both, but Zho arrived shortly after to fight his former apprentice in a flux blade duel. However, he was forced to focus on saving Drayden and Kade from being crushed to their deaths by falling debris moved loose by Varek. As a result, the Dissident leader escaped in his ship, leaving the three Aetheri behind. Ondar arrived with a group of replica troopers shortly afterward, embracing Drayden as Kade stood nearby.

#### Promotion to Aetheri General

> " I must admit without the replicas, it would not have been a victory. " " Victory? Victory, you say? Master Orien, not victory. The shroud of the umbra side has fallen. Begun, the Replica War has. " ―Orien Kade and Zho about the Pyralis battle

title: Orien Kade
text: Following the Pyralis battle , Kade traveled back to Vantor while his Adept escorted Ondar to Ondara. Drayden's absence was noticed by Vice Chancellor Mazan Veldon , who informed Chancellor Mal of his whereabouts after seeing he did not return with Kade. In the Temple on Vantor, Kade met with Drevan Koss and Zho in the Aetheri Council room to discuss the confrontation that had just taken place. He told the Councillors that his apprentice was escorting Ondar back to Ondara before returning to the Temple, which they accepted. Although Kade noted that the Pyralis battle would not have been a victory without the replicas, Zho did not think of it as victory, as it marked the beginning of the Replica Wars . Though Kade passed on Varek's warning about an Umbra controlling the Senate to his peers—both mostly dismissed it due to the former Aetheri's actions and fall to the umbra side. However, the trio resolved to continue monitoring the Senate instead.

title: Orien Kade
text: While Drayden was on Ondara to escort Ondar home, he wondered how his Master was doing in the aftermath of the battle. Additionally, the Adept reflected on what their responsibilities in the upcoming war would be like while having to collaborate with replica troopers in battle. However, he firmly chose to keep knowledge of his relationship with the Senator secret from Kade despite the strain of the deception. Drayden married Ondar, despite knowing his Master would disapprove. As days passed, Drayden eventually chose to return to Vantor, citing that he had not informed his Master of a reason to remain on Ondara. After meeting with their superiors, both Kade and Drayden were sent on their first deployment.

title: Orien Kade
text: Now greatly respected both in and outside of the Aetheri Order, Kade was promoted to Aetheri General like many of his colleagues and was later bestowed the rank of High Aetheri General while he led the Third Systems Army and commanded the Open Circle Fleet in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Replica Wars. While deployed, he held command of the 7th Sky Corps and often led its 212th Attack Battalion into combat personally until the war's end. The Replica Marshal Commander Cord served as his second-in-command, accompanying him on many missions against the Dissident Droid Army and other Dissident targets. Kade's military engagements, often alongside Drayden, led to many famed victories that he was praised for by the Republic.

title: Orien Kade
text:
For his diplomatic skills, he came to be known as "the Negotiator"— a title mirrored by the name of his flagship, the Vorash -class Iron Cruiser Negotiator . Early in the Replica Wars, Kade met the Supreme Martial Commander of the Dissident Droid Armies , General Skarn . The two developed a rivalry and fought each other numerous times during the war, with Skarn considering Kade to be an Aetheri he needed to kill "face to face." Their skills were equal, and they quickly became mortal enemies. Skarn harbored a deep animosity for Kade. At some point during his travels, Kade visited the planet Gazian , which was strong in Synth Flux. The planet, which had a Synth Flux vergence , captured an imprint of those who traveled there, including Kade. As his last flux blade was destroyed, Kade built a new flux blade , which he would break in through his service in the conflict and use throughout the remainder of his life.

#### Initial engagements

Rocky planet deployment

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Initial engagements

Rocky planet deployment

Shortly after the battle on Pyralis, Kade was sent to a rocky planet alongside his Adept, Commander Cord, and several troopers, including a replica soldier named Sister , to destroy Dissident forces. Kade was dismayed by how much Drayden seemed to enjoy combat, and asked how his apprentice found enjoyment in their combat. After receiving a reply, Kade worked with his student to complete their objectives and resolved to find better cover for their future engagements. The general fought in several skirmishes with droids while on the world, and mourned the four replica troopers their team had lost during the mission alongside Sister.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Feeling that the Aetheri needed more generals, he resolved to suggest to the Aetheri Council that Drayden take the Aetheri trials after watching him in combat. He mused that it was a move that would allow them to work together, but also afford the younger man the freedoms of a higher rank along with his own command. Not long after on Vantor, the handmaiden Sable initially worried that Kade would notice her posing in Ondar's place while at a meeting in the Aetheri Sanctum. When Drayden left the gathering, Sable noticed Kade attempt to convince his former apprentice to talk to the Cindervalean Senator Bael Solen . Drayden's time as an Adept ended, as he was risen to the rank of Aetheri Knight for the war not long after. As a result, Kade was promoted to Aetheri Master after his apprentice's knighting.

Rising through the ranks

title: Orien Kade
text:
Rising through the ranks

After Drayden had already been promoted, Kade attended his former apprentice's official Knighting Ceremony , which was being officiated by Master Koss. Kade had just recently become the next of many Aetheri to rotate into the council seat of the late Coleman Trebor, and it was unknown if this arrangement would be permanent. Kade treated the tasks presented to him in this role with a certain amount of seriousness, and even treated the ceremony as if it was a war decision. As Koss gave his speech, Kade stared at Drayden, who could feel the weight of the stare. When Koss brought up the possibility of the recently-knighted Aetheri receiving Adepts of their own, Kade caught Drayden's eye, smirking as the thought of an apprentice irked Drayden.

title: Orien Kade
text: Following the conclusion of Koss's speech, Kade, confused, glanced around the other Aetheri Masters present. Despite his usual skill with improvisation and negotiations, Kade found himself flustered by scheduling problems. Drayden was amused by Kade's confusion, as his former master ran his fingers through his now-longer hair. Upon noting that the Chancellor, various senators, and multiple replica commanders were still not present, Kade commented that their guests were late, albeit certain that they would arrive shortly. However, the Chancellor's attendance was not in person, but instead via a holo-transmission. Addressing Zho and Koss, Mal announced that the Purse World Cato Geltaria had been bombed . As Zho instructed the Adepts and younglings to leave, Kade grabbed Drayden's shoulder, ensuring him that they were equals, and he was welcome to stay. Drayden then asked if he still had to call Kade "Master," and Kade jokingly replied that it would only be the case if he knew his place.

title: Orien Kade
text:
As the group was informed that the Cadesura district of Cato Geltaria's capital city , Zarra , had collapsed, Kade stood side by side with Drayden. His thoughts lingered on his former apprentice for several seconds , pondering how his emotional transition into an Aetheri Knight had been rougher than expected. He believed that, while Drayden had made progress in coming to decisions confidently, he often reverted into deference, unsure of what his place was. It reminded Kade of his own ascension to the rank of Aetheri Knight, thinking about how long it had taken for him to feel as though he had earned his title, in contrast to his peers who had taken their promotions in stride. Remembering Vael's advice to not linger on his anxieties, Kade exhaled, focusing his mind on the moment.

The Cato Geltaria affair

> " …you owe me one, and not for saving your skin for the 10th time. " " Ninth time. That business on Neimoidia doesn't—doesn't count. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
The Cato Geltaria affair

> " …you owe me one, and not for saving your skin for the 10th time. " " Ninth time. That business on Neimoidia doesn't—doesn't count. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade

Kade was then sent to look into the explosion , which was being blamed on the Republic by the Purse World Cato Geltaria, the headquarters of the Commerce Combine. As Kade investigated with the help of a Geltari guard named Ruug Quarnom , the newly-knighted Drayden disobeyed orders and joined him. During their mission, events transpired that led to a situation where the two Aetheri were in peril. Drayden believed that he had saved his former mentor from the danger, while Kade believed the action did not count towards the ever-growing total of times his former apprentice had saved his life.

title: Orien Kade
text:
For his actions on Cato Geltaria, it was decided Kade's council seat would be permanent. Drayden and Kade also returned to Cato Geltaria shortly thereafter to rescue Quarnom. With the passage of the Aetheri Military Integration Act , Kade was provided with body armor to wear over his robes, but he did not immediately adopt that gear, much like Drayden. Accepting they were no longer master and apprentice, the two left the Cato Geltaria mission as brothers-in-arms.

Krystar rescue

> " You replicas will never be fodder, not on my watch. The Aetheri, replicas, senators, our allies—all of us. We're in this together . And I will fight for each and every one of us in equal measure, now and until the very last day of this was. " ―Orien Kade to his troopers

title: Orien Kade
text: At some point that year, Kade and his battalion were sent to the planet Krystar to rescue several replicas being held captive. Though hesitant to pursue an assault on the planet, which was aligned with the Republic, he agreed with Cord that saving the hostages was important. After meeting with Ondar, he was made aware of intelligence gathered from Senator Vishar Koss of Krystar. Using this, Kade helped form a plan for the operation to infiltrate a compound rumored to be built near the Krystar palace with Ondar's assistance. Escorted to the planet's surface by Ondar under the guise of an aid mission, Kade and his troopers investigated the claims of the captured replicas.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Though his soldiers wished to take action immediately to free their brothers, the Aetheri insisted on having adequate proof before responding accordingly due to the planet's Republic affiliation. Kade's men proved able to confirm the claims made by Koss when they found trapped troopers in the compound and contacted their commanding officer about it. Kade then received a transmission from Ondar, who informed him that Krystar's Regent Queb was selling the captured replicas to Trandoshans. Kade instructed his men to free their brothers, which they did successfully before returning to their ship. Though a Trandoshan hunter was upset at the recapture of the replicas, Kade faced his fury by throwing him out of range with Synth Flux. The general then allowed Koss and Ondar to travel off the planet with them, with the former seeking protection until Queb was taken care of. After the event, Kade vowed to protect his allies until the end of the war as much as possible—despite the political challenges—and promised that Queb would be arrested.

Caliban bridge building

title: Orien Kade
text:
Caliban bridge building

> " As clearly stated in the Galactic Accords regarding prisoners of war, no prisoner shall be forced into manual labor or— " " Aetheri scum! You belong to me, Kade, and you will do as I say…or you will die. " ―Orien Kade and Skarn on Caliban

Kade and his troopers were present on the Outer Reach moon Caliban and were captured by General Skarn. Though the Aetheri attempted to argue that prisoners of war cannot be forced into labor due to a provision in the Galactic Accords war statutes, Skarn insisted that they build a lunar ice bridge for him. Skarn claimed he would kill them if they did not complete the task, and that they would be lucky to leave alive. Despite the frigid temperatures, Kade made a plan to construct a sabotaged project to replace the bridge the Dissident leader had originally destroyed and instructed the replica troopers with him to assist.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Near the build site, the Aetheri and his men climbed a rise and met a qubey native of the world trapped on one side of a ravine, attempting to reach its parent on the opposite end. After Kade saw this, he decided to rebuild the bridge out of compassion and relayed this order to his troopers. Further observation of the creatures showed indication of their displeasure with the Dissident presence on their world, leading to Kade counting them as allies. As the structure was being made, the qubey distracted Skarn enough for Kade to retrieve his flux blade when the enemy leader came to inspect it's construction in a surprise ambush. After the bridge's completion, Kade implored the general to let his men leave the planet. When Skarn declined, the qubey attacked him and his droids while the Aetheri also engaged the Dissident in flux blade combat. Kade goaded the general into stepping onto the sabotaged new bridge, then used Synth Flux to start an avalanche. Skarn fell into the ravine after being swept away, allowing Kade to escape the planet with his men in a ship and destroy the bridge after takeoff.

Hisseen siege

title: Orien Kade
text:
Hisseen siege

> " Sorry we were late, Cord. We were still in pursuit of Vray and Varek when we received Vek's distress call. " " Not to worry, General. Everything went as easily as always. " ―Orien Kade and Cord

Kade traveled to the planet Hisseen and participated in a siege of the planet alongside Drayden, Aetheri Master Tor Vayne , and their battalions. After working swiftly to destroy an encampment of battle droids, Vayne instructed the trio that their objective was to prevent the Hisseenian premier from revealing the location of his fellow parliament members to Varek and his apprentice, Kessa Vray —who would kill or threaten them. The Aetheri leave and headed into mountainous terrain while leaving their troopers to handle the Dissident ground assault. The Aetheri searched to discover the location of the parliament, initially coming up with nothing. However, they soon met Varek and Vray, engaging in a flux blade fight with the pair that prevented them from seeking out the parliament. Vayne attempted to contact their replica commanders of the deteriorating situation while Kade and Drayden fought the Dissident darksiders, though the message broke up due to the mountainous terrain surrounding them.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Vayne relayed the coordinates of the Hisseenian government members to Wolffe, trusting him and the other commanders to rescue them while he helped Drayden and Kade. As Varek continued keeping the trio occupied, their soldiers freed the parliament members by destroying the droids guarding them, reminded of the situational similarity of the Krystar mission that Kade had embarked on. The siege on Hisseen continued with more waves of droids attacking, reminding Cord of the mission to Caliban. As the replica troopers prepare to fight, Kade, Drayden, and Vayne return, slicing the Dissident reinforcements into pieces. Though Vray and Varek escaped, Kade congratulated the soldiers on their success rescuing the parliament. He then relayed that Zho had called them back to Vantor for their next deployment.

Deployment to Kudo III

> " …you're not wrong. The people in the foundry aren't soldiers. But if he's right about the risk to our replica soldiers… " " There has to be a better way to approach this. Isn't that thr whole reason the Aetheri are a part of this war? To help save lives? " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade traveled to the Corvair sector with Drayden during the Battle of Corvair , watching the skirmish take place from a Vorash -class Iron Cruiser. Following the battle, the pair received instructions to investigate rumors of a droid foundry being established on a moon in the sector, Kudo III . Kade encouraged his former Adept to trust in Synth Flux in the investigation, and while acknowledging the skepticism of Yular, supported Drayden's intuition on the matter.

As they shared a meal together, Kade shared Drayden's concerns about civilians being involved in the Kudo III developments. He encouraged him to protect any innocents, while still dealing with discovered Dissident threats. Ultimately, Drayden found that the Dissidents had been attempting to goad the Republic into attacking the facility with falsely fed information to kill the innocent slaves inside, then using the assault as negative war propaganda against the Aetheri. Kade praised Drayden for his approach of the situation and discovery of the plot. Afterward, Kade and Yular discussed the implications of attacking a neutral party, and whether the planet Kudo would consider joining as a result of the discovery on their moon.

Arrival on Krestophis

title: Orien Kade
text:
Arrival on Krestophis

> " Well, here I am. Tell me about this new weapon. " " You're looking at it. " "'I'm looking at what? " "'Two steps forward, and you'd actually be kissing it. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade, about the stealth ship

Kade and Drayden were sent on a mission to bring relief supplies to Senator Solen and the Republic forces that were trapped on the planet Krestophis because of a thirty-ship strong Dissident blockade led by Admiral Trench . Kade, who arrived later than his former apprentice, brought with him a stealth ship prototype provided by the Republic. He ordered Drayden to retreat from his current position and meet him aboard his cruiser, where he presented the stealth ship and its capabilities to his companion. Kade then gave orders to Drayden to sneak past the blockade and deliver the supplies to Solen's encampment in secret, which his former apprentice felt was similar to an errand. Though Drayden wished for more of the prototypes, Kade informed him that only one was available—which was not to be used to attack Trench's ship alone.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Emboldened by his own skills, Drayden tested the capabilities of the ship further and found that Trench's initial missiles were unable to detect it. Kade attempted to order his former apprentice to cease and head to Krestophis' surface with increasing urgency after making contact with Solen's bombarded command center and hearing the senator's pleas, but was ignored. Closing communications with his former Master, Drayden proceeded to attack the flagship of the Dissident Admiral Trench with his stealth ship and broke the blockade with the attack. Afterward, Kade issued Drayden his congratulations after the supplies were safely delivered to Solen on the world's surface. Following the skirmish in space, the two Aetheri Generals and their replica troopers were sent to the planet's surface to fight off the droid army taking control of the world.

Traitorous replica

> " …I believe the number of eyes watching us has been steadily growing. " " Great. Perhaps this means our adversary has learned about our mission. Of course, nobody's tried to stop us yet. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

title: Orien Kade
text:
Traitorous replica

> " …I believe the number of eyes watching us has been steadily growing. " " Great. Perhaps this means our adversary has learned about our mission. Of course, nobody's tried to stop us yet. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

After flying to Krestophis' surface on gunships, he and the troopers with him established a base of operations on the planet. Kade and Drayden then planned and prepared to lead a surprise assault on Dissident forces in the world's crystalline capital city Chaleydonia with their men. However, they were forced to abort their mission due to a large droid ambush. Drayden led his troopers to Kade's trapped position and both escaped with their soldiers into a ship from the roof of a double-towered building . One of the troopers with them took the severed head of a T-series tactical droid .

title: Orien Kade
text: After analysis, Cord and Drayden's replica officer, Replica Captain Vek , reported to the Aetheri that the enemy had known exactly where their ambush was going to be. Kade ordered both to root out the spy within the Republic's forces, insisting on the secrecy of the operations at hand while he left base with Drayden to further investigate. When the Aetheri took BARC speeders behind enemy lines, Dissident forces jammed their transmissions, which left Vek and Cord unable to contact them. Acting under their generals' orders, both replica officers discovered that the replica trooper Slick was the traitor and arrested him, but not before the traitor destroyed the majority of the Republic base's weapons depot. As Kade and Drayden continued heading towards the Dissident headquarters , both surmised whatever was waiting for them there was a trap due to the number of droids observing them from a distance.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Upon entering the headquarters, both Aetheri met minimal coalition on the lower level. After meeting Vray in the building, however, Kade and Drayden engaged in a flux blade duel with her. Kade exchanged banter with Vray as they engaged, but eventually was forced to escape with his colleague on stolen droid STAPs after an ambush. When the two Aetheri returned to the command center, Vek and Cord presented an apprehended Slick. Kade and Drayden expressed disappointment in Slick and the destruction of the weapons depot. Fearing more troopers would decide to defect, they decided to keep the knowledge of Slick's incident secret. The Aetheri Master informed Vek and Cord that they should prepare for a large number of incoming battle droids, with minimal heavy cannons to defend their position with. As Republic forces prepared to engage the droids, the blockade above Krestophis began reforming.

Chaleydonia defense

> " That shield is certainly putting a crimp in my day. " ―Orien Kade during the Battle of Krestophis — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Orien Kade
text:
Chaleydonia defense

> " That shield is certainly putting a crimp in my day. " ―Orien Kade during the Battle of Krestophis — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Kade and Drayden maintained control over the planet for a short period of time, reporting its capture to the Aetheri Council. The Aetheri Master then sent a ship back to the Republic fleet above Krestophis for a supplies restock, regretting the decision shortly after. Not long after, Mal requested that Aetheri be sent to return Rotto —the son of the Grak crime lord Grukk —to his father in exchange for the usage of Outer Reach trade routes. As a result, Koss and Zho sent orders through Admiral Wulric Yular to ensure that the new Adept Sela Marr landed on Krestophis to inform Kade and Drayden of their next rescue mission assignment—assuming that the Aetheri pair was done with their current engagement. However, on Krestophis, the Aetheri pair continued to fight against more waves of enemy Dissident droids. While deflecting blast fire alongside Cord, Kade surmised that reinforcements would be needed soon.

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade defended the Republic's defensive positions alongside his men, helping Drayden with a plan to wipe out droids in a large avenue while heavy cannons gave them cover fire. The Dissident General Whorm Loathsom decided to order his forces into a tactical retreat, surprising the Aetheri. Seeing a Republic ship fly overhead, both assumed reinforcements or assistance had arrived. However, Kade and Drayden then met Marr, who had arrived in the ship alone. Kade and his former apprentice used the ship to contact Zho, who told them to return to Vantor for a new mission . When Zho learned of the impending Dissident threat preventing their departure from Krestophis he promised to send reinforcements, but cut off mid-transmission. Though the Kade assumed Marr would be his new apprentice, she corrected him, relaying that Drayden was to be her teacher.

title: Orien Kade
text: While they awaited assistance, Loathsom used a deflector shield to protect his droids from attack while steadily advancing on the Republic's heavy cannons. Kade used a holographic display to brief others about the location of the shield generator, after which Drayden and Marr brainstormed a plan to take it out while the Aetheri Master and Vek stayed behind as a diversion. As the shield boundary increased, Kade ordered his men to fall back to a position further into the city. Meanwhile, he went under the shield with some of his troopers and began attacking enemy forces. Seeing that their efforts were in vain, Kade instructed Vek to have his men guard the heavy cannons while he delayed the droids. The Aetheri Master proceeded to offer himself up in defeat to Loathsom, claiming that there were terms of surrender to discuss.

title: Orien Kade
text:
After Kade spent an extended period of time stalling by delaying to set terms of surrender or offer a flag of truce during which he was held at point-blank, Drayden and Marr destroyed the shield using explosive charges. His refusal to stand down his forces angered and distracted Loathsom who had Kade seized and threatened to destroy him. On the destruction of the shield, Kade freed himself and was able to quickly restrain the Dissident general as Republic reinforcements arrived on the planet. Upon landing in a gunship before Kade, Zho greeted the Aetheri Master to begin telling him of Rotto's capture. While he managed to give Marr and Drayden enough time to win the day for the Republic, his capture and subsequent stalling was a boon to Dissident propaganda for they were able to paint Kade's ruse as a false surrender and proof of Republic treachery. Ultimately, it ensured very few peace talks were held over the course of the war, with Kade indeed coming to show regret for the conflict's ongoing bloodshed.

Teth and Dunemere

title: Orien Kade
text:
Teth and Dunemere

> " We know of Varek's plot to turn the Graks against us. It will not succeed. " " It will when the truth dies with you. " ―Orien Kade and Kessa Vray

After greeting Zho on Krestophis, Kade gave parting advice to Drayden about training Marr before heading to Dunemere to negotiate with Grukk. The Aetheri Master promised that Republic forces would successfully rescue his son, and listened to the Grak's additional terms about capturing the kidnapper of his son, dead or alive. Kade then informed Drayden that he had one planetary rotation to return Rotto —and also privately reflected that his meeting with Grukk had made him believe the Grak had never bathed in his life due to the smell. The Aetheri Master ordered his troops to depart for Teth next in an effort to reinforce his former Adept's forces. After Drayden and Marr rescued Rotto from Teth's B'omarr Order Monastery , Kade arrived and fought with a fleet of fighters in Teth's atmosphere, but was unable to contact the other Aetheri due to jammed transmissions.

title: Orien Kade
text:
From the skies, he noticed a battle occurring on the rooftop of a building and followed his men down to the surface to find Drayden. Kade found Vray inside the monastery and fought in a brief flux blade duel with her while exchanging banter. Drayden and Marr escaped the planet with Rotto during their fight, and he eventually forced Vray to flee after disabling one side of her flux blades . Once the fight concluded, Kade contacted his former apprentice and informed him that he would come to Dunemere to help as soon as Teth's situation settled. After Drayden and Marr successfully returned Rotto to Grukk and cleared their name from the framing schemes of the Grak Ziro and Varek, Kade and Zho met the Aetheri pair on Dunemere to negotiate a treaty with the crime lord.

A suspected defection

> " Our spies have spotted Dissident agents at the port where the Halcyon arrives tomorrow... That's where he'll try to make a rendezvous. And Orien already has it staked out with a unit of replica troopers, so— " ―Kael regarding Orien's role in the Aetheri Council's plan to catch the defected senator Zast Tri'vak

title: Orien Kade
text:
At some point following the negotiation of the Grak Clan and Republic's treaty, the Aetheri Council caught wind of Lannik Senator Zast Tri'vak 's plans to defect to the Fractio of Independent Systems. Due to the risk Tri'vak's defection would present to important Republic supply routes, the Council took action. Drayden and Senator Ondar were sent on board the Grak-owned MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser known as the Halcyon to catch the rogue senator, while Kade staked out the planned arrival port of the Halcyon with a unit of replica troopers. As things went awry on board the star cruiser when Kessa Vray arrived to extract Tri'vak, the Dark Adept taunted Drayden, claiming he was not much of a challenge without Kade by his side. Ultimately, the risk of Tri'vak's defection was negated with his death, as Vray killed him to prevent him from spilling Dissident secrets to the Grak Clan.

Selvara's blockade

> " Senator, the fleet protecting Selvara has been destroyed, and the supply lines have been cut. The troops are out of fuel, food, ammunition. And the civilian population is starving. " ―Orien Kade, to Senator Bael Solen — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Orien Kade
text:
Selvara's blockade

> " Senator, the fleet protecting Selvara has been destroyed, and the supply lines have been cut. The troops are out of fuel, food, ammunition. And the civilian population is starving. " ―Orien Kade, to Senator Bael Solen — Link ▶️ ( file info )

At some point, Kade met with members of the Aetheri Council in a hologram call to meet with Admiral Dao from his post in the orbit of the planet Selvara, who was calling for aid at Aetheri General Ima-Gun Di 's request. Dao informed the Councillors that his fleet was unable to continue aiding Republic forces on the world's surface due to the Dissident blockade around the planet, and his plea for help cut off mid-sentence when his flagship was destroyed. Following this, the Kade and his colleagues sent a CR90 corvette blockade runner loaded with relief supplies to planet Toydaria accompanied by Representative Greeb Mool of Ondara.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade and his colleagues then proceeded to contact Senator Bael Solen and request his assistance in negotiating with King Katuunko of the planet Toydaria. Doing this, Kade explained, would allow Republic relief supplies to flow through the world as a staging ground . Moved by Kade's words, Solen agreed to travel to the negotiations to help the starving citizens of Selvara. Eventually, the Senator was successful in delivering some of the supplies and gaining the favor of the Toydarian king.

#### Missions across the galaxy

A secret superweapon

> " Tell me, has there been any word from Master Tor Vayne or his fleet? " " …actually, I just received word that Kael has found the remains of Master Plo's fleet and is searching the debris for survivors. " ―Chancellor Mal and Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
A secret superweapon

> " Tell me, has there been any word from Master Tor Vayne or his fleet? " " …actually, I just received word that Kael has found the remains of Master Plo's fleet and is searching the debris for survivors. " ―Chancellor Mal and Orien Kade

When Master Tor Vayne's fleet was destroyed in the campaign of the Malignar —a secret Dissident superweapon—during the Battle of Abregado , and Drayden reported the Kel Dor 's interrupted message and loss of contact from the Abregado system . Kade watched his report alongside with Chancellor Mal, Koss, and Zho, remarking that the Dissident operations were unusually tidy to maintain the secrecy of their weapon. In the meeting, Drayden was ordered to reinforce Kade's fleet to protect supply convoys and not send a rescue for the attack's possible survivors from the Abregado system. Though Marr disagreed, she was overruled, with Kade fondly remarking that her outspoken behavior was likely learned from her Master.

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade's forces were joined by Admiral Yular, who was commanding Drayden's fleet. Upon questioning where his former apprentice was, Yular explained the other general's self-redeployment to search for survivors in the Abregado system against orders. Kade then confronted Drayden about his deviation from orders in a holographic call, prompting the wayward Aetheri to meet with the Republic fleet as soon as possible. Though Marr claimed that the idea was hers, the Aetheri Master doubted her claim, ordering them back to defensive escort duty upon learning no survivors had been found. In a meeting with Mal, Koss, and Zho, Kade relayed Drayden's detour and his hope to find Vayne and his troopers still alive. Though the decision was deemed reckless by Zho, Kade assured the group that his former apprentice's fleet was where it needed to be in defensive formation, as he had gone with only a small ship and his Adept. Shortly after, Drayden and Marr managed to rescue Vayne and some of his men from the debris of their destroyed ships, escaping Dissident pursuit. As the first survivors of the superweapon, they were able to report to the Aetheri Council what the Malignar ' s capabilities were, including its

title: Orien Kade
text:
Adept. Shortly after, Drayden and Marr managed to rescue Vayne and some of his men from the debris of their destroyed ships, escaping Dissident pursuit. As the first survivors of the superweapon, they were able to report to the Aetheri Council what the Malignar ' s capabilities were, including its ion cannons . Upon learning of the Malignar ' s next target—the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center in the Outer Reach—Kade and Drayden formulated a daring plan to engage and destroy the Malignar ' s ion cannons with his Shadow Squadron replica pilots. While Drayden traveled through the nearby Kaliida Nebula with his squadron, Kade led the Republic fleet of ships through hyperspace to the medical station. As his former apprentice engaged the enemy vessel, Kade entered the system and began destroying the massive warship using the combined firepower of his fleet as the enemy vessel fled. Along with Wulric Yular, Kade helped organize the evacuation of the medical center with Yular, dispatching medical frigates. While Drayden's task synth flux proved successful in destroying its cannons, the Malignar ' s defenses withstood the fire of Kade's fleet for some time. After thanking Drayden for his assistance, Kade ordered the ships under his command to continue pursuit of the Malignar as it fled to Dissident space with a damaged hyperrelay.

Malignar encounter

title: Orien Kade
text:
Malignar encounter

> " That's your plan— Just fly there, land, hope they don't spot us, and walk in the door? " " Basically. " " Oh, brilliant. Let's get going. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

During the pursuit, Kade discussed contacting additional reinforcements with Vayne, but resolved to continue with the ships he had due to a lack of available forces in the area. The Master concluded that this could be the Republic's opportunity to destroy Skarn by firing on the enemy ship's bridge, having surmised that the Malignar ' s hyperrelay was damaged due to the vessel not fleeing. Shortly after, in a trap arranged by Varek and executed by Mal, Ondar arrived at the battle's scene having been fed false information regarding a diplomatic mission in the system. Using her as a hostage, Skarn forced the Republic's fleet to stall their attack, further encouraged by Drayden's insistence on mounting a rescue.

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade joined Drayden in a small ship, intending to sneak on the Dissident warship by slipping past the ship's damaged sensors and docking at an emergency airlock. Though the older Aetheri was skeptical of the plan and his former apprentice's flying tricks, Drayden claimed that the enemy forces were focused on handling repairs rather than watching for intruders. After successfully landing on the Malignar , the pair quickly destroyed the battle droids greeting them. Kade and Drayden were patched through to direct communication with Ondar, who informed them of her location and also berated them for coming to rescue her rather than continue with destroying the warship. Marr informed the trio that the best place to meet would be a large, open area in the center of the ship, which the Aetheri and Senator began heading to.

title: Orien Kade
text: After the Aetheri rescued Ondar from droids at their rendezvous, Kade used Synth Flux to levitate C-3P0 toward him, though the droid got carried away by a rail jet hovertrain . He informed Drayden of this, and left his former apprentice to reacquire the droid while he would sabotage the hyperrelay. Kade's transmission was intercepted by Skarn, who challenged the Aetheri's skills in front of the droids on his bridge. The Aetheri Master then made his way to the ship's hyperrelay, but was met with an ambush consisting of many battle droids and Skarn himself. After escaping the situation by destroying the majority of the droids, Kade fled to the rail jets on the Malignar while followed by Skarn. He and the cyborg engaged in a brief flux blade duel that ended when the Aetheri landed on a lower platform and made his way to Drayden's escape ship.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Ondar, Drayden, Kade, and their droids fled the Malignar and contacted the Republic fleet as Skarn pursued in a personal starship. As they fled towards safety, the droids aboard the enemy warship completed repairs of its hyperrelay. Skarn gave the order for the Malignar to flee, which resulted in the warship crashing into the nearby Dead Moon of Antar due to the coordinates in its navi-computer being sabotaged. Kade was surprised by the move, and was informed by Drayden that it was always part of their plan. After the destruction of his warship, Skarn fled in his ship while the Aetheri and their fleet celebrated.

Attack of Rishi Station

> " General Kade, General Drayden. " " Cord. How goes the inspections? " " The tracking station in Pastil is fully operational. Captain Vek and I are proceeding to the outpost in the Rishi system. " " Good. Report back once you've arrived. " ―Cord and Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
> " General Kade, General Drayden. " " Cord. How goes the inspections? " " The tracking station in Pastil is fully operational. Captain Vek and I are proceeding to the outpost in the Rishi system. " " Good. Report back once you've arrived. " ―Cord and Orien Kade

As weeks passed, Kade and Drayden continued their search for Skarn and his fleet and sent Cord and Vek on an inspection run of their quadrant of space. The pair briefly discussed the intelligence they had regarding the matter, with Kade noting that they would find the enemy general eventually. He and his former apprentice were present for Cord's report on his inspections to a Pastil tracking station, and the commander further said that his next inspection would be at a listening post station in the Rishi system —an outpost crucial to warning Gelvaris of potential Dissident attacks. After thanking Cord for his work, Kade praised the replica to Yular and Drayden, then suggested that his former Adept get some rest.

title: Orien Kade
text: While on the Rishi Moon outpost, which had been taken over by droid forces, Cord and Vek's ship was destroyed and they lost contact with Kade's fleet. Hours after their scheduled check in, Yular attempted to contact them to no avail. Though Kade felt that perhaps Vek was the cause of the delay, Drayden retorted that the opposite could be true of Cord. Both resolved to devise a more efficient strategy to find Skarn, leaving Yular in charge of contacting the replica officers. Not long after, Yular was notified that the all-clear-signal on Rishi had been deactivated, prompting Kade to sound an invasion alarm and order his fleet to the Rishi system. The Aetheri's fleet arrived just in time to synth flux Skarn' ships out of the system, foiling the cyborg's plot to launch a surprise attack on Gelvaris. After the incident, Kade thanked the surviving replicas that had defended the station— Echo and Fivva —in a medal ceremony.

title: Orien Kade
text:
At some point, Kade and Drayden crashed their Yarrow into a shield protecting a city near the Senatorial Palace as they investigated the activities of some rogue Nightsisters on Rodanor . When the shield was abruptly activated, the starfighter was entirely destroyed, while the dome remained unaffected.

Skytop Station campaign

> Sela Marr : " Suicide is not the Aetheri way, Master. " Orien Kade : " You should listen to your Adept. " Kael Drayden : " As you listened to yours, my old master? No, we're going to stay and fight. " ―Sela Marr, Orien Kade, and Kael Drayden Listen ( help · info )

title: Orien Kade
text: Following his escape, Skarn began ambushing Republic fleets in the Skytop Station campaign and defeated forces on the planet Falleen . Both the Aetheri and the Republic has struggles against Skarn, who achieved many victories for the Dissidents, proving to be a nearly indestructible opponent for them, leaving a trail of conquest and destruction across the galaxy. Kade advised Drayden to retreat from his post at the gas giant Bothawui , citing that Skarn' fleet outnumbered his. Marr agreed with the Master, though Drayden insisted on staying to protect the sector . Drayden managed to destroy the cyborg's flotilla at the cost of losing his droid, Bolt-3.

title: Orien Kade
text:
A captured Bolt-3 managed to send the coordinates of Skytop Station —a secret Dissident listening post—to Drayden and Marr. After reporting the information to Kade using scramble code 1477 , he instructed them to wait for reinforcements. Though Drayden wanted to rescue his droid, Kade ordered him to destroy the station instead. After the mission and unsanctioned rescue, an exasperated Kade grudgingly accepted Drayden's retrieval to the droid with only a brief rebuke for the reckless behavior. While Marr agreed that the Kade's reasoning, Drayden explained that he knew she could complete the mission on her own so he could rescue Bolt-3.

Varek on Vanqor

> " Kael when I tell you to run, run. " " Master! You're alive. " " And where's your flux blade? " " It got knocked out of my hand. " " By a rock? " " Yeah, by a rock. " ―Kael Drayden and Orien Kade, in Vanqor's caves

title: Orien Kade
text: In their efforts to track the location of Varek, Kade helped devise a plan to trick the Umbra into revealing his location. As part of this plot , Drayden allowed himself to be captured by pretending his Delta-7B Aethersprite -class light interceptor was dead in space, which prompted the Count to tow it aboard a Dissident Munificent -class star frigate to discover where it was stationed. Kade then traveled to his friend's last known location—an ice field near the Outer Reach planet Vanqor —using an enviro-suit and jetpack to travel through space. After sneaking aboard the frigate, Kade successfully freed Drayden from his detention cell and returned his flux blade to him. The younger Aetheri felt annoyed that he had been the one to be captured, which led Kade to tease that when he became an Aetheri Master, he could make the plans.

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade and Drayden confronted Varek in his meditation chamber, acting in a proud way that disgusted the older man. The Umbra quickly used an escape chute to head towards the vessel's hangar to head to his Punworcca 116 -class interstellar sloop , followed by Drayden. After Varek successfully took off in his escape vessel, Kade and Drayden pursued him in a stolen Sheathipede -class transport shuttle and called on Marr to rally Republic reinforcements. The Aetheri scored a direct hit on Varek's sloop that knocked out his engines, forcing him to make a crash landing on Vanqor. However, the damage done to Kade and Drayden's stolen shuttle by the Umbra's escort also necessitated their own emergency landing on the same world. As their ship touched ground, both Aetheri exchanged playful banter about piloting and destroyed the homing beacon on Varek's crashed ship.

title: Orien Kade
text:
The Aetheri pair surveyed the area, deciding to start their search for the Umbra in Vanqor's caves. Varek manipulated Synth Flux to flare the barest hint of his Synth Flux presence within the caves, which the Aetheri picked up as he had planned. When Kade and Drayden entered the caves, Varek crashed down the loosened rock above the entrance using telekinesis , trapping them inside. Though both survived, Drayden had lost his flux blade, which Kade chided him for while cleaning his own weapon. The Aetheri Master watched in amusement as a large gundark went after his former apprentice, but eventually helped him throw rocks at the creature to cease its attacks. When the caves started to fill with poison gas, Marr rescued the pair—though both indignantly claimed that they had not needed help and were productively tracking Varek. After escaping, Kade and Drayden contacted the Aetheri Council.

Hosha's pirates

> " They are devious and deceitful and, most importantly, stupid. " " It's a wonder you don't get along with them, Varek. You have so much in common. " ―Varek and Orien Kade, about Hosha's pirates

title: Orien Kade
text:
Hosha's pirates

> " They are devious and deceitful and, most importantly, stupid. " " It's a wonder you don't get along with them, Varek. You have so much in common. " ―Varek and Orien Kade, about Hosha's pirates

After learning that Varek was captured by Captain Hondik Hosha 's pirates on Vanqor and brought to the planet Florrine , who hoped to trade him for a hefty ransom from the Republic, the Aetheri Council agreed to send Kade and Drayden to verify his capture following the suggestion of Ondar. Koss informed the Aetheri of their next assignment, and the stipulation that they arrive unarmed. Though both Kade and Drayden were uneasy with what could become a hostile situation, Koss insisted on the importance of the mission. After landing in a small ship, both were led to the pirates' stronghold cells and saw Varek hanging from restraints. Though the Umbra attempted to warn the pair that the pirates would turn traitor on them, both refused spent time sneering and scoffing at him. When the two Aetheri reported in after speaking to Hosha, Mal had Mool and Senator Kharrus lead a diplomatic mission to trade a ransom for the Count.

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade and Drayden attended a feast after their business concluded, and accepted offered refreshments. However, before a toast both swapped their cups with their pirate neighbors and discovered shortly after that Hosha had attempted to poison them when both collapsed. After taking a sip of their drinks, both woke up in restraints connected to the Varek's bindings. After briefly arguing with the Umbra, Kade and Drayden agreed that they would form a plan to escape their situation. When Varek opened their cell using a Synth Flux-levitated knife, Kade grudgingly told his former apprentice to let the Dissident focus. Though the trio escaped from the room they were in, they were recaptured by Hosha's pirates shortly after.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Hosha confronted Kade, Drayden, and Varek, warning them not to escape again to ruin his chance at a profit. When the captain left Kade mind tricked a guard into opening their cell. The trio crept through the pirate compound, exchanging tense banter. Eventually, Varek broke them through a wall and they raced to the edge of the compound. However, Hosha caught up to them and put them back in a cell, eventually having them separated from Varek and hung by restraints in front of a group of pirates. The captain informed them that their Republic had not arrived with Varek's ransom and proceeded to electrocute the pair. When Varek escaped the compound and knocked out the area's electrical supply, Kade and Drayden were freed, holding Hosha as a hostage using their flux blades. Mool and his replica escort arrived, providing the Aetheri with transport off Florrine. Though it surprised Hosha, Kade ordered Drayden to let him go free, as Aetheri do not take revenge—though warned that Varek did not share their same mindset.

Orto Plutonia

title: Orien Kade
text:
Orto Plutonia

> " Now that you have created peace between your people and the Talz, remember one crucial thing… " " Yes, Master Kade? " " Make it last, senator. Make it last. " ―Orien Kade and Riyo Chuchi

Called to the cold planet Orto Plutonia to ascertain why the Republic had lost contact with a replica outpost , Kade and Drayden, along with Pantoran Chairman Chivva and Senator Riyo Chuchi from the nearby moon Pantora , traveled to the Republic base. They found it to be to be devoid of life, as all replicas stationed there having been killed—with a monument of their helmets erected inside. After visiting a nearby Dissident base , similar destruction was found, leading Kade to believe that the murders at the Republic's base were done by a third unknown party. Logs showed mysterious warriors had taken out the Dissident droids when investigating the world's southern canyon, which Kade decided would be a good starting point for their investigation.

title: Orien Kade
text: When Drayden and Kade headed to the location they met the leader of the Talz people Thi-Sen and their associates, communicating with the natives using rudimentary hand signals and drawings. The Aetheri learned that battle droids had attacked the Talz and the replicas were accidentally caught in the middle of the conflict. The pair returned to the Republic base, and knowing that the Talz only wanted peace, arranged a diplomatic meeting between the Pantorans and Talz. However, Chivva angrily refused to accept any peaceful outcome and provoked a war between him and Thi-Sen's people as he refused to accept peace despite the protests of Chuchi and the Aetheri. He declared it an internal affair of Pantora to remove the Aetheri from the equation, ordering them to submit to him because they were under the Senate's jurisdiction.

title: Orien Kade
text:
When Drayden and Kade appealed to Chuchi to find a way to resolve the political matter diplomatically, she contacted the Speaker of the Pantoran Assembly who granted her the authority to negotiate peace and declared the Chairman out of order. Though Chuchi wanted the Aetheri to negotiate on Pantora's behalf, they refused, as it was her people who the Talz were warring with. However, the solution came too late as Chivva was attacked before Kade, Drayden, and Chuchi landed and halted the Talz's attack. To settle the conflict between the Pantorans and the Talz, Chuchi met with Thi-Sen, establishing an agreement that allowed the Talz to live in peace on the planet. As the Senator and the Aetheri boarded a gunship off-world, Kade congratulated the Senator in establishing peace and urged her to make it last and act as an example to others. The Aetheri Master felt that the peace achieved through the balancing of both sides had been a unique challenge.

Blue Shadow Virus

> " A great leap forward often requires taking two steps back. " ―Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
Blue Shadow Virus

> " A great leap forward often requires taking two steps back. " ―Orien Kade

The Aetheri Council later agreed to send Kade, Drayden, and Marr, to Ondara in response to intelligence that suggested that a Dissident bio-lab had been set up on the planet at Ondar's suggestion. When Ondar and Mool lost contact while searching for the lab, Drayden sent Marr along with the Mool native Peppi Bow to locate them. Meanwhile, Kade and Drayden arrived on Ondara learned from new information discovered by Captain Gregar Typho that Dissident scientist Nuvo Vindi was using the lab to perfect the deadly Blue Shadow Virus so as to release it into key Republic star systems. Kade and Drayden proceeded to plan an infiltration of the facility to prevent the virus from being spread across the galaxy .

title: Orien Kade
text: While they waited in the hangar bay, Kade took note of Drayden's increased levels of agitation during the mission. After being contacted by Marr, Kade and Drayden left instructions for her to cause a diversion. On the other side of the lab, the pair entered and met with her before beginning a search for Vindi's viral bombs . Kade located the room where the bombs were held with his replica troopers, instructing his men to deactivate them all. Though Vindi attempted to release the virus, the Aetheri were able to apprehend him and rescue Ondar and Mool. As Kade and Drayden prepared to transfer Vindi to Vantor for trial, Marr, Ondar, and several replicas discovered that a vial of the virus was missing. Though the alarm was sounded prior to the vial's detonation, the virus was released throughout the lab. Marr, Ondar, and the replicas with them were compromised and infected by the virus. As they worked to ensure droids would not escape the facility, Drayden and Kade implored the Ondara as to what the cure for the virus was. Upon learning it, the Aetheri then flew to planet Iego to search for the reeksa root antidote to the virus found there.

title: Orien Kade
text:
While on Iego, Drayden destroyed a number of reprogrammed battle droids owned by the local native Jaybo Hood , which Kade chided him for. Hood then told the pair where to find the antidote they were looking for, though warned it was dangerous. The young man also informed the Aetheri that the phantom leader of Iego, Drol , would not allow any individual to leave the planet. Kade and Drayden rode a xandu to the bottom of a ravine and quickly gathered some reeksa root before escaping from the carnivorous plant. Upon trying to leave Iego, the two Aetheri discovered that "Drol" was actually a Dissident laser security system surrounding the planet and enlisted Hood's help in destroying it despite the skepticism of the other natives. When successful, Kade and Drayden traveled back to Ondara and delivered the antidote that saved Marr, Ondar, and the replica troopers. Kade also offered Mool volt pistol training to hone his skills, which the Mool enthusiastically accepted. After the event, the Aetheri Master became more keenly aware of Drayden's emotional instability when around Ondar and resolved to watch the pair more closely as the war continued.

Invasion of Selvara

title: Orien Kade
text:
Invasion of Selvara

> " We need to remember why we're here. We came to aid the Velaris, not destroy their home. " ―Kade to Wisp Company aboard the Crumb Bomber — Link ▶️ ( file info )

After the Artificer Union leader Wat Tambra seized control of the planet Selvara and its inhabitants , he implemented a blockade around the world with his Lucrehulk -class Battleship and two Munificent -class frigates. The Aetheri Council devised a plan for Kade and Koss to lead a ground assault to invade and liberate the planet after the Senate requested them to intervene. Drayden and Marr were dispatched to destroy the Dissident blockade surrounding the planet to support their effort.

title: Orien Kade
text: The initial attempt to break the blockade was unsuccessful, which Drayden reported to Kade and Koss as a heavy loss through hologram, considering the deceased replica pilots and sacrifice of the Vorash -class Iron Cruiser Redeemer . Kade advised him to give Marr time to grieve the loss of her squadron , but added that he would need her assistance to complete their objectives. Koss informed Drayden that he needed to break the blockade within the next planetary rotation for the invasion to continue. When Drayden and Marr's second attempt is successful, Kade arrived with the rest of the invasion forces in the planet's vicinity. Kade contacted Marr and she cleared them to begin their ground assault.

title: Orien Kade
text: In preparing their assault, Koss asked Kade to consider capturing the city Nabat first to secure a landing zone, which he agreed to. Kade then boarded a small transport with some of his men from Wisp Company and instructed them to do minimal damage to the local habitat and not harm natives. In space, the rest of Koss's fleet came under attack by Dissident forces. Koss contacted Kade and informed him that the Republic would be unable to use Acclamator -class transgalactic military assault ships and other gunships from Crumb Bomber until the Dissident surface proton cannons were wiped out.

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade and his men landed and steadily made their way to the outskirts of the city, taking out droids as they went. Using telekinesis, the Aetheri helped levitate the droid poppers thrown by his troopers Waxer and Boil to take out a bunker. After securing the wall perimeter Kade ordered Cord to send his best men to scout ahead, and the commander ultimately selected Waxer, Boil, and Wooley . Scouting yielded useful intelligence, leading Cord to report to Kade and Koss the placements of the gun encampments as well as the Dissidents' use of living Velari shields. However, one of the tactical droid commander TX-20 's probe droids recorded their strategy session and provided it to the leader. When Waxer and Boil failed to report in from scouting after meeting the Velari child Numa , Kade became concerned.

title: Orien Kade
text: The general and his troops decided to move forward without the missing troopers, entering the village outskirts. They soon encountered starved native gutkurrs that began to attack them. The Aetheri lured the creatures into an alley using Synth Flux so that the replicas could trap them by collapsing a bridge between them. Shortly after, a pothole near them began to rattle, though Kade ordered his men to hold fire. When Waxer and Boil then emerged out of an underground tunnel with Numa, Kade talked to the girl in Velarian and learned that she could lead them to the prisoners. Tasking Cord with creating a diversion for the droids, Kade went with Waxer, Boil, and Numa to the underground passages and freed the Velari hostages who fled into the tunnels.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Then, the general proceeded to take control of a proton cannon and managed to take out their cannons with the help of Waxer and Boil loading fuel cartridges in. However, TX-20 blasted the three aside and threatened Kade, who was holding Numa in his arms. Before the droid could blast them, other Velaris rushed the droid and protected Kade, with the Aetheri attempting to shield Numa's eyes from the violence. As Koss's transports from the Acclamator landed, Koss commended Kade on his victory and they continued with their next mission.

As the Republic's forces departed for the capital city Lessu Waxer and Boil inquired Kade about the meaning of "nerra," which the Aetheri General translated as "brother." After Koss and and his forces reached Lessu, Kade led his contingent to capture the southern hemisphere of Selvara and was able to successfully capture the Jixuan desert . With Koss taking Lessu and capturing Wat Tambra, the two Aetheri Generals freed the planet from Dissident rule.

A stolen reliquary

title: Orien Kade
text:
A stolen reliquary

> " A reliquary is no good without an Aetheri to open it. What are they up to? " " They must be trying to gain access to the communications center from the vault. " " Let's get in there. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden pursuing Cad Vorek > " A reliquary is no good without an Aetheri to open it. What are they up to? " " They must be trying to gain access to the communications center from the vault. " " Let's get in there. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden pursuing Cad Vorek

During the First Battle of Feldora , Kade was sent along with Drayden and Marr to the Dissident-invaded planet Feldora . While Kade stayed with the main body of troops to defend their clearing-based emplacement of AT-TE walkers, Marr led two AT-TE walkers and a Juggernaut tank on a patrol of the dense jungle. Kade realized that they were outnumbered, seeing that droids would soon outflank their position. He ordered an immediate retreat as soon as General Vayne arrived to help them, prompting replicas to prepare gunships for fleeing. The Aetheri Master contacted Marr to do so as well, but the Adept refused to retreat—claiming her foes were retreating. When Drayden and Kade arrived to pick her up, she refused to pull back until Drayden convinced her that the battle was lost. As their gunship flew away, Kade, Drayden, and Marr observed the position she had been at erupt in flames.

title: Orien Kade
text: Once back at the Aetheri Sanctum, Kade reported to rest of the Aetheri Council about Marr's reckless actions during the battle. As a result, she was assigned to guard duty in the Aetheri Archives under the supervision of Jocasta Nura. Kade and Drayden attended a strategy session after the meeting to discuss the effects of Feldora's loss. As they talked, Zho felt a disturbance in Synth Flux and warned the pair that there would be intruders in the Temple soon. Kade and Drayden surmised that any intruders would likely be breaking in to steal Aetheri transmitter codes and military information, and set out to protect the communications center . However by using the assistance of the helper droid Todo 360 , the bounty hunter Cad Vorek managed to sneak into the Temple. The Aetheri pair noticed their systems rebooting and acting strangely and located a disturbance in the Temple's ventilation shafts with advice from Zho.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade and Drayden discovered the vent Vorek had entered, but were unable to locate the criminal despite their best efforts. Zho informed them that their intruders were deep in the Temple and had likely received outside help. From the Archives, Marr captured Vorek's changeling associate Cato Parast and informed the pair of this. Kade and Drayden assumed that Vorek would try to access the communications tower from the Reliquary Vault and headed to the tower. Vorek took the opportunity to steal an Aetheri reliquary and sneak out of the building while Kade and Drayden narrowly avoided a bomb set off by Todo 360 in the ventilation shafts. Parast revealed Vorek's next target would be the Aetheri Bolla Ropal , the keeper of a kyber memory crystal that stored the names of every Synth Flux-sensitive child in the galaxy. Kade then proceeded to lead Parast away while Drayden and Marr set out to warn Ropal.

Pursuit on Rodanor

> " There are thousands of children on that list. Which will he go after first? " ―Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
Pursuit on Rodanor

> " There are thousands of children on that list. Which will he go after first? " ―Orien Kade

Vorek managed to capture and torture Ropal, only stopping when Aetheri arrived on his ship. Despite Drayden and Marr's best efforts, the criminal escaped in his ship. Both reported back to Kade and Zho afterward, who worried about the future harm done to the children on the list. Kade and other Aetheri meditated to sense through Synth Flux which children would be harmed first, coming up with a small list of locations for their efforts—including a child on the planet Rodanor that he sensed. Kade then flew to the planet and met the Rodanori Mahtee Dunn , the child's mother, and informed her that her child Wee Dunn had been taken by a bounty hunter posing as an Aetheri. He caught up to Vorek shortly after while he was holding the child while using an Aetheri cloak as a disguise.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Using a grappling hook , Kade pursued Vorek across several rooftops, but eventually watched the bounty hunter escape in a Renegade -class Porax-38 starfighter Xanor Blood . Though the bounty hunter successfully delivered two children to the planet Emberfall , he was caught on Ondara by Drayden and Marr in his third kidnapping attempt. Kade interrogated Vorek aboard a Vorash -class Iron Cruiser, and used a combined Synth Flux mind trick alongside Drayden and Koss to compel him into agreeing to locate the reliquary. Though Koss felt that this was an internal matter, Drayden insisted on reporting to Mal of the discover, which the younger Aetheri's former Master eventually agreed to.

Kade and Koss then traveled with a restrained Vorek to Black Stall Station and retrieved the missing reliquary, but were forced to let him escape through an escape pod after being caught in the station's traps. After Marr and Drayden retrieved the pair of missing children, they reported to the full Aetheri Council. Kade's efforts to assist the stolen child were remembered by the Rodanori Chekkoo clan . Stories of the event were circulated shortly after and he was regarded by many on the world as a hero.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Feldora and bounty hunters

> " We can't just wander around aimlessly. We need a plan. " " You always taught me to go on instinct, and my instincts tell me to go that way. " " No that—that doesn't seem right. I think we should go this way. " ―Orien Kade and Kael Drayden

The disappearance of a medical station orbiting over Feldora prompted the Aetheri Council to send Kade, Drayden, and Marr to investigate the issue. Once in the system, their ship was shot down by Dissident vulture droids from an automated vulture droid deployment station . Forced to make a crash landing, the trio ejected from the ship moments before it exploded. Kade and Drayden proceeded to argue about which direction to go, but eventually followed Marr's lead after seeing smoke in the sky indicating civilization. They soon came across a nysillin farm village, confounded by its apparent desertion.

title: Orien Kade
text:
After discovering that the village had been undergoing pirate raids, the three Aetheri met the four bounty hunters that the local Felucian farmers had hired to protect them— Sulie , Embo , Rumi Paramita , and Seripas . The village elder Casiss Midagatis explained their current situation, pleading for the Aetheri's help. However, Kade declined and insisted on reporting the missing medical station even though Marr disagreed. Hosha's pirates arrived at the village shortly after, and Kade conversed with their leader while the rest of the gang looked on as they reflected on their past meeting on Florrine.

The Aetheri Master proposed a deal to the pirates to trade a large sum of credits for a ride to the nearest Republic outpost. However, Hosha declined and left, insisting that he would stay for his share of nysillin. Though not willing to directly commit to fighting pirates, Kade and the other Aetheri agreed to help train the Felucian farmers to fight for themselves. Kade expressed skepticism with Sulie's methods, but grudgingly resolved to hope she could do her job. Drayden struggled to train the civilians with him as his former Master watched, but eventually helped the villagers learn some skills.

title: Orien Kade
text:
After a pirate scout was killed by Embo near the village when caught, Kade noted that when the spy failed to report it would be noticed by Hosha. A skirmish ensued shortly after, ultimately ending in a win for the villagers, Aetheri, and bounty hunters. Sulie then offered Kade, Drayden, and Marr a ride back to the nearest Republic outpost, which they accepted.

The Zyll Beast

> " Why would the Chancellor want to bring the beast here? He thinks that by studying it, the knowledge could prove beneficial, but from what you reported, it hardly seems worth the effort. " ―Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
The Zyll Beast

> " Why would the Chancellor want to bring the beast here? He thinks that by studying it, the knowledge could prove beneficial, but from what you reported, it hardly seems worth the effort. " ―Orien Kade

Following the discovery of the Zyll Beast during the Battle of Malastare and its transference to Vantor, Koss shared his concerns with Kade while in the Temple. He agreed with the other Aetheri Master, he suggested to let Drayden convince Mal to send the beast back to its origins. Kade then approached Senator Ondar to help him—who in turn helped him convince Drayden to reason with Mal. However, the Chancellor had already ordered Doctor Sionver Boll to kill the beast to extract its scales by using poison. When the administration of it agitated the creature, it smashed its way out of the laboratory and started rampaging across Vantor to reach the Senate building with Mal in it.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Deployed to contain the beast, Kade and Koss managed to save the Chancellor using Synth Flux and, later, commanded gunships to distract the beast together with Zho and the Aetheri Ciel Venn while the Chancellor escaped with Drayden, Ondar, Bolt-3, and Astra-9. Kade and Koss worked to use Synth Flux to hold their escape ship from falling off the edge of a roof, saving Mal. As the gunships arrived and killed the creature by firing poison gas bombs into into its mouth, they and the others looked on in regret. When the Zyll Beast succumbed to the poison, it fell from the roof of the Senate to its death below.

### The war drags on

#### Many meetings

Kade later participated in a meeting in which he and the council assigned Ondar to spy on Rush Korvex , whom they believed to be a Dissident spy. He was also present alongside Master Zho and Master Koss to assign Billaba and her battalion to engage the enemy on Migeeta .

#### Second Battle of Pyralis

> " I cannot believe we're back here again. " ―Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Second Battle of Pyralis

> " I cannot believe we're back here again. " ―Orien Kade

Assigned to capture Pyralis, alongside Reth-Oss-Van , Luminara Undula , Drayden, and Marr, Kade participated in a conference to delineate the invasion plans to destroy Poggle the Lesser 's primary droid factory, which was being protected by a massive ray shield. With their primary target being the shield generator at the Ray Shield Fortress the Aetheri mounted a three-pronged attack on the Pyralian defenses. Kade and Cord commenced the central push while Mundi and Drayden led the northern and southern assaults, respectively. Though Kade was able to reach the landing zone, which was known as Point Rain , the Aetheri General was injured and forced to wait for Drayden and Mundi's arrival who, despite their crashing, managed to fight their way up and join Kade. In a combined effort, they managed to destroy the shield generator, and Kade and Mundi returned to the fleet with the rest of the wounded for treatment.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Following the Republic's hard-won victory that was cemented after the factory's destruction by Drayden, Marr, Undula, and Undula's Adept Barris Ovva Kade returned to the planet and mounted an intense campaign to find Poggle, with Undula spearheading the search only to follow Poggle to the Progate Temple , where she was captured by the Archduke and taken to the lair of Pyralian Queen Karina the Great in the catacombs below. Tracking Undula's last known location, Kade and Drayden set out with a replica platoon to rescue her, and entered the catacombs only to find themselves before the Queen and her "undead" servants. Soon enough, and thanks to Kade's plans, they freed Luminara, captured Poggle and escaped the temple, while destroying much of the Queen's lair during their escape, burying Karina the Great and her warriors beneath. Kade, Mundi, Undula, and Drayden, then, took Poggle to Vantor for interrogation, while Ovva and Marr brought to supplies to Koss and Kit Fisto on Steelgrove .

#### Saluk

> " The story of Orien Kade ends here. " ―General Skarn, about to finish Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Saluk

> " The story of Orien Kade ends here. " ―General Skarn, about to finish Kade

Soon after Aetheri Master and Council member Etha Korrin was captured by Skarn, Kade, Drayden, and Adi Gallia volunteered to engage the Fractio at Saluk, rescue Korrin, and capture General Skarn.

General Kade was the first of the Aetheri to arrive at Saluk and engaged Skarn's forces with a fleet under the command of Admiral Yular. Early in the battle, Kade's light cruiser , the Surrogator , was caught in a grapple beam from Skarn's warship and boarded by the cyborg himself. Once Drayden and Gallia rescued Korrin, Skarn dueled Kade until understanding that the Aetheri Master had the upper hand. As the cyborg retreated to his destroyer, he ordered his ship to destroy Kade's—who managed to board Skarn' ship with Cord and two other replicas before it was too late thanks to Gallia's help. Afterwards, they reunited with Drayden on the hangar so that they could escape from Skarn' ship. Meanwhile, Skarn was forced to flee in an escape pod and landed on the planet.

title: Orien Kade
text:
While his fellow Aetheri generals continued the battle in orbit, Kade led a synth flux of replica troopers to the planet's surface to hunt down Skarn. The cyborg general evaded and fled from the Republic forces, hoping to reach an escape pod with a functioning transmitter in order to call for an evacuation transport. When Kade caught up with and engaged Skarn, the cyborg fled the battle once a shuttle arrived to ferry him away. Seeing as the mission had failed, Kade contacted Vek and told him to meet them to leave the planet.

#### Ferrum's Grave Watch

> " We'll have to stand and fight. Or in your case, just stand. " ―Orien Kade to Satinna Velara — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Orien Kade
text: When rumors spread that the new leader of the Council of Neutral Systems , Duchess Satinna Velara, was secretly building her own army to fight for the Dissident cause, Kade was sent to Sundari by the Aetheri Council to investigate the matter. There, he met Prime Minister Almec and re-encountered his old friend, Velara, who assured him that she was not behind an attack on a Republic cruiser. Angered at the accusations, she claimed the Senate was eager to intervene in the planet's affairs before being corrected by Kade, who claimed to be there on the Aetheri Order's interest. Assuaged, the Duchess then took Kade for a walk on Peace Park and informed him of a renegade group of warriors known as Grave Watch when a terrorist blew up the Memorial Shrine where Velara and Kade were walking. When Kade had the guards round up everyone at the scene, a man fled with Kade after him and committed suicide instead of being captured. As the Duchess spoke to the dying man, she realized he came from Concordia and helped Kade reach the moon, where the Aetheri Master met its Governor , Pre Vizsla .

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade went out to investigate the mines and discovered that the Grave Watch was using one of the facilities as a base. Taken hostage by the Grave Watch, he contacted Velara, who freed him, and together, they tried to escape when they were attacked and the Commander of the Grave Watch arrived. Revealing himself to be Vizsla, he returned Kade's flux blade and dueled him with the Darksaber , until he ordered his warrior to kill him with missiles. Kade and Velara managed to escape, barely surviving, and returned to Ferrum. The next day, Kade told the Duchess that he believed the Dissidents were involved, which only angered her; the Aetheri Master, then, was joined by Drayden so as to bodyguard her during her and other senators' trip to Vantor onboard the Coronet .

title: Orien Kade
text: On their way to the Republic's capital, Kade took part of a heated debate with the Duchess over what the best course of action was to deal with the conflict until they took a small break. Then, Drayden asked him Kade of their past, which Kade explained he and his master, Vael, had been protecting her during a year-long, dangerous mission during a civil war on Ferrum. It was then that assassin droids were activated, prompting Kade to defend Velara. When the droids were stopped, Drayden reported to Kade that one of the senators was a traitor, and Kade then devised a plan to uncover the traitor's identity by using the last active droid.

title: Orien Kade
text: It turned out to be Tal Merrik , who took Velara as a hostage and made his way to the cockpit to jump out of hyperspace, so that droid reinforcements could enter the ship. While Drayden engaged the droids, Kade found and followed Merrik, who would blow up the ship, as he got near the escape pods, unable to make a move on the senator. Afraid she might not see Kade again, Velara confessed her feelings for him, to which Kade replied he would have left the Order if she had told him earlier. Then, Velara took the opportunity to escape a disgusted Merrik and take his volt pistol. However, neither Kade nor Velara made a move to stop him, leaving Drayden to sneak up from behind and stab him in the back, branding himself as a "cold-blooded killer."
