His worst fears confirmed, Orien headed for his escape route and cautiously returned to the location where he had recently battled. He was relieved to find the small, flat-landing form deserted and fled Uthara aboard Skarn's personal starfighter, the Soulless One , running past the smoking remains of his former cyborg rival one final time without even sparing Skarn a fleeting glance. Orien as quickly as he could into space, trusting in the element of surprise to whip past his old flagship and away.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Taking Skarn' starfighter, he left Uthara and made contact with Senator Bael Solen, who had seen the siege of the Aetheri Sanctum firsthand and was trying to locate other surviving Aetheri. Reuniting on the Tantiva III , Kade met with the Senator and Master Zho, who told him of the retreat message telling all Aetheri to return to the Temple, saying that the war was over. Kade then suggested to dismantle the signal, so that others wouldn't fall into the trap, and Zho agreed.

On their way to Vantor, Solen was contacted by Vice Chancellor Veldon, who told him of an emergency session to be held by the Senate. Kade and Zho entered the Aetheri Sanctum and witnessed with their own eyes the massacre that just taken place. During that, Chancellor Mal told the Senate of the Aetheri's "sedition" against the Republic and declared the birth of the Imperium . Ondar's former handmaiden Sable believed Kade died with the rest of the Aetheri during the rise of the Imperium.

### Age of the Imperium

title: Orien Kade
text:
### Age of the Imperium

> " This is Master Orien Kade. I regret to report that both our Aetheri Order and the Republic have fallen, with the dark shadow of the Imperium rising to take their place. This message is a warning and a reminder for any surviving Aetheri: trust in Synth Flux. Do not return to the Temple. That time has passed, and our future is uncertain. Avoid Vantor . Avoid detection. Be secret ... but be strong . We will each be challenged: our trust, our faith, our friendships. But we must persevere and, in time, I believe first dawn will emerge. May Synth Flux be with you always. " ―Orien Kade's warning in the recall signal

#### The fallen apprentice

> " It can't be. It can't be. " ―Orien Kade learns that Kael Drayden has turned to the Umbra side

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### The fallen apprentice

> " It can't be. It can't be. " ―Orien Kade learns that Kael Drayden has turned to the Umbra side

Intending to infiltrate the building to shut off the Aetheri recall beacon, Kade and Zho made their way to the still-smoking Aetheri Sanctum, where they found replicas were wearing Aetheri robes in an attempt to deceive Aetheri survivors into a false sense of security. Both Aetheri fought the 501st patrols outside and entered, finding the aftermath of a slaughter that distressed Kade even more than the smoke and robe-wearing replicas. When he made it to the central security station of the Aetheri Sanctum, Kade remembered Caleb Dume's suggestion that the signal could warn Aetheri away; instead of disabling the Aetheri recall signal, he changed it into a heartfelt holographic message of himself, warning any of the surviving Aetheri to stay away from the Temple and the planet, to persevere for the future, and to trust in Synth Flux. Copies of the message would persist and be seen by Aetheri in hiding in the following years.

title: Orien Kade
text: Desperate for answers and despite Zho's warning that he would only find pain, Kade checked the security recordings to find that Drayden had led his battalion of replicas to attack the Temple, where he fought the Aetheri & their Younglings and knelt to the newly-proclaimed Emperor , who was proud of his apprentice , now going by a new name—"Velgor." Though Kade was horrified, Zho determined that they had to destroy the Umbra; Kade, however, refused to fight Velgor and requested that he be sent to kill the Emperor instead, but Zho vetoed the idea, claiming that Kade wasn't strong enough to go head-to-head with Mal on his own. Kade expressed that Drayden was like a brother to him and that he did not have the heart to kill him, but Zho explained that the boy he had trained no longer existed and that he needed to be put out of his misery, and told Kade to use his instincts to find Velgor.

title: Orien Kade
text:
After that, he visited Senator Ondar, thinking she might know of Velgor's location. He revealed what he'd discovered about Drayden's betrayal of the Aetheri and how the Replica Wars had been a lie orchestrated by Mal. Ondar harshly denounced Kade's accusations, believing that Orien intended to kill Kael if she revealed where he'd gone. Correctly deducing that Kael was the father of Ondar's child, knowing that the two had been together all that time, he apologized for everything wish he'd been supportive to them both and what he has no choice what he must do, as he left her apartment.

#### Duel on Emberfall

> " You were the Seeded One! It was said that you would destroy the Umbra, not join them! Bring balance to Synth Flux, not leave it in darkness! " " I HATE YOU! " " You were my brother, Kael. I loved you. " ―Orien Kade, to the fallen Kael Drayden following their duel

title: Orien Kade
text: Unbeknownst to Ondar, Kade stowed away in her star skiff, just as she and Astra-9 departed for the Emberfall system to meet with Velgor, who had already killed the Dissident leaders taking refuge there. Hiding in one of the compartments, Kade emerged from the ship, only for Velgor to think she had betrayed him and brought Kade to kill him, choking her in a paranoid rage. As Kade checked her vital signs, Velgor accused him of turning her against him, but the Aetheri Master stated Kael betrayed her for himself and that his anger & lust for power had already done that, and that he had allowed Mal to twist his mind becoming an Umbra.

title: Orien Kade
text: Unaffected by the Aetheri's "lies" and unafraid of the umbra side, Velgor claimed that he'd brought peace, freedom, justice, and security to "[his] new Imperium," and told Kade, who declared his allegiance was to the Republic and the democracy it represented, that if he was not on his side, then, he was his enemy. Realizing that his former apprentice was already too far gone to be reasoned with, Kade vowed to stop him at all costs, prompting the two to engage in a ferocious duel that caused substantial damage to the facility, just as Zho and Mal dueled in the Senate. Ultimately, Kade and Velgor were hovering over the lava sea, when the Aetheri Master reflected on his failure while Velgor stated that he should have known about the Aetheri's lust for power and domination. Kade tried again in vain to convince Velgor to return to the light again and that Mal was, in fact, an evil mastermind, but Velgor continued to denounced the Aetheri as the true evil.

title: Orien Kade
text: Eventually, Kade jumped to high ground on the embankment of the lava river, gaining advantage over Velgor. Despite Kade's warning not to try the jump, the Umbra apprentice ignored him and did so anyway, allowing Kade to sever his remaining natural arm and both legs in one strike. Heartbroken over his former pupil's betrayal and fall to the umbra side, Kade retrieved Velgor's flux blade and tearfully expressed his disgust and sadness over Velgor's betrayal of the Aetheri Order, shouting that his destiny was to restore balance to Synth Flux and defeat the Umbra, not join them and leave Synth Flux in darkness. Velgor responded by screaming his hatred towards his former master, his voice shaking with rage and despair. This statement only further crushed Kade, who responded that he had loved him like a brother.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Velgor's garments then burst into flames from the lava, along with his sliced flesh, severely burning him. Unwilling to help his former friend or murder him in cold blood, Kade left him to his apparent fate and returned to Ondar's ship, where Astra-9 had already brought her back on board. When she asked if Drayden was all right, Kade couldn't respond to that and let her rest as they left the planet. Kade was left with the belief that his former apprentice had died, while thinking of how he's partly to blame for Kael and Padme's relationship ending, unaware of how the Emperor had arrived and saved his life by giving the new Umbra Lord a suit of life-support armor .

#### Birth of the Drayden twins

> GH-7 : " Medically, she is completely healthy. For reasons we can't explain, we are losing her. " Kade : " She's dying? " GH-7 : " We don't know why. She has lost the will to live. We need to operate quickly if we are to save the babies. " Solen : " Babies? " GH-7 : " She's carrying twins. " ―GH-7 medical droid, Orien Kade and Bael Solen

title: Orien Kade
text:
Just as the Emperor rescued Velgor from the lava beach and gave him prosthetic limbs and the life-support suit, Kade, Astra-9, and Bolt-3 took Ondar to Polis Massa . There, he, along with Bael Solen and Zho, were informed that the dying Ondar was carrying twins. Kade was in the birthing room with Ondar as she gave birth to her two children, Joren and Elira . As she took her final breath, Ondar told Kade she knew there was still good in Drayden. After arriving on Ondara so that Ondar's funeral arrangements could be made, Zho suggested that the children should be kept hidden and separated until the time was right: Solen would adopt Elira and take her to Cindervale as he and his wife, Queen Breha , had always talked about adopting a baby girl and promised that Elira would be loved. Kade volunteered to take Joren to Dunemere where the boy would live with Drayden's step family, Owen and Brue Havel . Kade also pledged that he would watch over him. As the trio prepared to go their separate ways, Zho asked Kade to remain for a brief moment, revealing that he had training for him during his solitude on Dunemere and that Sorin Vael had reached the path to immortality , having returned from the Netherworld of Synth Flux . Zho told Kade he would teach him on how to communicate with Vael.

#### Hiding on Dunemere

The beginning

> " And what of the boy? " " To Dunemere. To his family, send him. " " I will take the child and watch over him. " ―Orien Kade and Zho discuss the future of Joren Drayden

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Hiding on Dunemere

The beginning

> " And what of the boy? " " To Dunemere. To his family, send him. " " I will take the child and watch over him. " ―Orien Kade and Zho discuss the future of Joren Drayden

Kade carried the newborn Joren onboard the late general's starfighter to Nar Shaddaa , where he sold ship for transportation to Dunemere. Upon arriving on Dunemere, Kade purchased an eopie he named Akkani . While the twin suns set, Kade arrived at the Havel moisture farm to leave Joren with his uncle, Owen, and aunt, Brue. When he delivered Joren to them, Kade stood at the door, explaining what had happened and asking for their help. Like Kade, Owen believed his stepbrother had been killed and blamed the Aetheri Master for his fate. Owen agreed to the task of raising Joren, though he told Kade to play no role in his upbringing. Fearing the boy would end up following his father's footsteps, Owen did not want the Aetheri Master to see or train Joren, so he told Kade to stay away and not speak to him, hoping that Joren would learn nothing of his father.

title: Orien Kade
text: After leaving them with Joren, Kade left on an Akkani, heading to his exile. He found a home surrounded by Western Dune Sea . Kade had known immediately after finding this building, which was actually a long since abandoned prospector's hut, that it would serve him well. Nonetheless, he instead set up living quarters in a cave , where he had little outside of a few necessities and keepsakes. To conceal his identity, he would once again use the alias of "Beno Kade," as he had done with Satinna Velara and during the Replica Wars. He also forfeited the use of his flux blade for years. He spent little time in the cities and kept to himself, spending most of his time watching over the young Drayden, who he hoped to eventually train. However, to avoid becoming too recognizable, Kade worked temporary jobs, including that of a farmhand, a barback, a custodian, a mechanic , and a laborer.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Despite having taken the Barash Vow , he struggled to repress his sense of duty as an Aetheri and spent years battling monotony and inactivity. He was haunted by the horrific events of the Replica Wars, with no amount of soothing able to stop his recurring nightmares. Over the course of his exile, he learned much about the noises and sights of Dunemere's wilds, including how to mimic the call of a krayt dragon . While Kade stayed on Dunemere to watch over Joren, the adopted parents of his twin, Elira, told her numerous stories of the Aetheri Master during her youth. Over time, Elira came to cherish the memories of Bael Solen's Replica Wars adventures with Kade, regarding them as exciting and heroic, but she would not learn his name until she was ten. Desperate to remain hidden, Kade buried his flux blade, alongside Kael's blade, in a box in the desert. He also had Sorin Vael's flux blade on-world.

Sins of Drayden

> " Don't destroy yourself to punish the Order for our failures! You're worth so much more than this! " ―What Orien Kade wished he had told Kael Drayden

title: Orien Kade
text:
Sins of Drayden

> " Don't destroy yourself to punish the Order for our failures! You're worth so much more than this! " ―What Orien Kade wished he had told Kael Drayden

Within the second year of the Age of the Imperium , Kade visited the grave of Shira Drayden Havel , mother of Kael and apologized for what had happened to her once innocent and promising young son. Standing at her grave, he felt a deep shame that the Aetheri had broken Sorin Vael's promise and had never rescued her and that he had prevented Ankain from returning. During the early years of his exile, Kade began to meditate deeply on synth flux. On one of these occasions that year, he began to experience visions of the past causing Synth Flux spirit of Sorin Vael to counsel him to let go of his attachments. Kade came to wonder many times what would have happened if he had directly begged Kael not to destroy himself for the Order's failings, yelling to his apprentice he was worth so much more.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Unknown to Kade, who still believed his former Adept to be dead, Kael carried on his path as the Umbra Lord Xarn Velgor. During his attempt to bleed the kyber crystal from Kirak Infil'a's flux blade , the kyber crystal gave Velgor a vision where Velgor renounced the umbra side, killed Vael Mal, and then tracked down Kade to an unknown world, where he pleaded for forgiveness. However, Velgor rejected the vision and remained on the path of the umbra side, becoming obsessed with finding his former master and inflicting the pain he had received onto Kade.

Protecting Joren Drayden

> " We don't need your protection. We don't need you at all. I could have handled this alone. " ―Owen Havel, to Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
Protecting Joren Drayden

> " We don't need your protection. We don't need you at all. I could have handled this alone. " ―Owen Havel, to Orien Kade

On one particular morning, Kade was awoken by sensing a young 3-year-old Joren Drayden and his family in danger. He arrived to find a group of bandits attacked the Havel homestead, and he quickly started defending them. After successfully defeating the last of the bandits, he was punched to the ground by Owen for his interference and his influence on Joren getting involved. Out of fear that the boy could become like his father, Owen shouted for Kade to never come back.

Kade came to consider that morning the moment he had failed the young Drayden. Both he and Owen had seen the defiance and bravery in the boy's eyes, yet Kade listened to Owen, staying away instead of training Joren.

#### Hunted by the Warden Order

A simple life

> " What about the people that need us? What about the fight? " " The fight is done. We lost. " ―Nari and Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Hunted by the Warden Order

A simple life

> " What about the people that need us? What about the fight? " " The fight is done. We lost. " ―Nari and Kade

In 9 BVE , the Warden Order—including the Grand Warden , the Fifth Warden , and the Third Warden —arrived in Dunemere's Port Kess in search of a fugitive Aetheri rumored to be hiding on the planet. By that same year, Kade had come to reside in a cave in the Dune Sea desert. Working at Tibidon Station , a sand whaling station, he rode a hovertrain into Anchorhead with his co-workers, continuing on his eopie Akkani to his cave. One day, Kade was visited by the Duskkin Teeka , who presented the Aetheri with several spare parts for a toy T-16 skyhopper . Teeka also offered to sell spare parts to Kade's malfunctioning moisture vaporator, but the Aetheri realized that the Duskkin had been stealing his parts and chastised Teeka. Before departing, the Duskkin showed spare parts from an alleged Aetheri starship that had crashed in the Dune Sea to Kade, who remarked that the Aetheri were believed to be extinct.

title: Orien Kade
text: That night, Kade was haunted in his dreams by memories of Kael Drayden, Lira Ondar, Sorin Vael, and Zho. The following day, Kade rode his eopie to the Havel homestead, where he observed with macrobinoculars the young Joren Drayden and Owen Havel from a distance. While riding his eopie through the desert the following night, Kade was confronted by the fugitive Aetheri, a human male named Nari , who had managed to escape the Wardens earlier and pleaded for the Aetheri Master's help. However, Kade urged the Aetheri to bury his flux blade and flee, much to the disappointment of Nari, who still believed in the fight—which Kade believed to be over and lost.

title: Orien Kade
text: In Anchorhead, Kade met with Havel to hand over the toy parts he had acquired from Teeka earlier, but the farmer refused to accept the presents and asked Kade to stay away from his family. After arguing with Havel about the future of Drayden, Kade hid nearby as the Fifth Warden and the Third Warden arrived to address the inhabitants regarding the fugitive Aetheri they were looking for. The Third Warden took a particular liking to Havel and threatened to kill his family unless information about the fugitive was brought forward, but the farmer stayed quiet until the Fifth Warden intervened. Afterward, Kade thanked Havel for not revealing anything about him or his whereabouts.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Obsessed with finding Kade, the Third Warden plotted to lure out the fugitive Aetheri Master and arranged for the kidnapping of Elira Solen on Cindervale. As she suspected, Kade received a distress call from Bael and Breha Solen, who pleaded with the Aetheri to help retrieve their daughter. However, Kade—intent on protecting Joren and believing himself to have been out of the game for too long—declined the request. Later, after witnessing the dead body of Nari in Anchorhead, Kade was visited in person by Bael Solen, who again pleaded with the Aetheri to help him. After relenting, Kade retrieved his flux blade from the desert and headed for a spaceport, where be boarded a freighter to depart Dunemere in a commercial transport .

Rescuing Elira Solen

> " You have no idea what I'm risking being here, Your Highness " ―Kade, to Elira Solen

title: Orien Kade
text:
Rescuing Elira Solen

> " You have no idea what I'm risking being here, Your Highness " ―Kade, to Elira Solen

Arriving on Daiyu , the planet to where Bael had tracked the mercenaries who had kidnapped Elira, Kade first encountered a homeless veteran replica trooper and gave him some change, and then a female spice dealer named Tetha Grig . Eventually, Jayco , a young boy, encouraged Kade to seek out Haja Estree , supposedly an Aetheri who helped people, and took him to his lair, where Kade overheard Estree helping a mother and her Synth Flux-sensitive son, Corran , by mind tricking a spaceport worker to let the two leave the planet. However, Kade correctly suspected that Estree was nothing more than a con artist and confronted him at gunpoint. Pressuring Estree into locating Elira, Kade was advised by the con artist to look in the The Den .

title: Orien Kade
text: Infiltrating the Spice Den in a stolen cape and mask, Kade used the chaos brought on by the explosion of a small vat to steal a keycard from an employee and access a closed-off area of the laboratory complex. Confronted by two employees, a Zyrrak and a human, he managed to overpower both, before finding a room with a small human-like figure with a cloak. As Kade entered the room, Vect Nokru —who had kidnapped Elira from Cindervale—and two companions ambushed the Aetheri, but he was able to defeat the trio with the help of a vial of red spice. Checking another room, Kade found Elira and told her he was sent by her father, Bael, to rescue her.

title: Orien Kade
text: As the two changed clothes to avoid detection and started making their way to a port on the other side of the city, the Third Warden arranged for Kade to be hunted by bounty hunters and criminals throughout the planet. However, Elira eventually became suspicious of Kade and his intentions, not believing him to be a real Aetheri. After Kade knocked down a bounty hunter in pursuit, the two saw a hologram of the Aetheri Master, leading Elira to believe that Kade lied to her and correctly deducing that the kidnappers used her as bait. As Elira tried to flee through the streets and to a rooftop, Kade attempted to catch her, only for the two to be ambushed by bounty hunters looking for the Aetheri. As Kade returned fire, Elira attempted to make the jump to another building, but fell short; as the Aetheri used his Synth Flux powers to stop her from falling to her death, Elira finally believed he was a real Aetheri.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Realizing the spaceport of Daiyu was closed for travel, Kade and Elira made their way to a cargo port on the recommendation of Estree, who confronted the two in an alleyway after having a change of heart. However, the Third Warden—who had mind probed Estree—intercepted the two in a hangar before they were able to board a cargo transport. Telling Elira to go for the transport, Kade prepared to confront the Third Warden, who informed him that he was to be taken to Lord Velgor, only to realize that Kade was not aware of the fact that Velgor survived their duel on Emberfall. Kade was horrified when she revealed Velgor was indeed alive and has been hunting for him ever since. Before a confrontation could occur, however, The Grand Warden arrived in the hangar and ordered the Third Warden to stand down; unwilling to let her superior take the credit for catching Kade, the Third Warden stabbed him while Kade used the ordeal to make his way to the cargo transport where Elira was waiting. As the transport departed, Kade was shaken by the revelation of Velgor's survival.

Arriving on Mapuzo

title: Orien Kade
text:
Arriving on Mapuzo

> " How does it work? Synth Flux. What does it feel like? " " Have you ever been afraid of the dark? How does it feel when you turn on the light? " " I feel safe. " " Yes, it feels like that. " ―Kade explains the nature of Synth Flux to Elira While cargo shuttle transported Kade and Solen to the planet Mapuzo , the Aetheri reflected on the news of his former apprentice's survival. As he repaired the princess' smashed toy droid , Lola , the two conversed about the nature of Synth Flux, with Kade comparing it to the feeling of safety lights were turned on in a darkroom. After the shuttle landed on Mapuzo, Kade and Solen began traveling to a rendezvous point to meet a contact of Haja Estree. Walking across the barren desert planet, Kade told the princess of Mapuzo's past as a lush planet filled with life, before the age of the Imperium. As the two continued toward the rendezvous point, Kade spotted a hooded figure on the horizon—a vision of Kael Drayden. To avoid attracting any unwanted attention, he fabricated a cover-up story, where the Aetheri was a traveling farmer and the princess was his daughter.

title: Orien Kade
text: The two eventually reached the rendezvous point, but the contact was nowhere to be found. As they noticed a vehicle on the horizon, Solen waved it down despite Kade's protests. When the driver, Freck , offered the two a ride to the nearest spaceport, Kade reluctantly followed Solen on the back of the vehicle. During the ride, Freck made conversation, revealing that he was a staunch supporter of the Imperium; noticing a squad of shock troopers, he pulled over and offered them a ride. The Imperial soldiers disclosed that they were searching for a nearby Aetheri, and as they questioned Kade and Solen over their presence on Mapuzo, the Aetheri accidentally used Solen's real name, instead of the fabricated name. However, Kade was able to cover up the mistake by claiming that his daughter reminded him of his late wife; satisfied with the explanation, the shock troopers got off Freck's vehicle.

title: Orien Kade
text:
After the close call, Kade was asked by the princess if he knew her actual mother or if he was her real father, with the Aetheri denying both claims and telling Solen that he could barely remember his own family before his indoctrination into the Aetheri Order. As they arrived at an Imperial checkpoint, Freck exited the vehicle and advised the stationed shock troopers to investigate the two travelers. Asking Kade and Solen to step outside the vehicle, the shock troopers called in a probe droid to perform a facial scan. Just as the probe droid identified Kade's face, he pulled out a volt pistol and quickly dispatched the droid and the shock trooper squad before knocking Freck unconscious. Disabling the checkpoint barrier, a squad of shock troopers led by Imperial officer Tala Durith intercepted the two—however, Durith killed the troopers, revealing herself to be Estree's contact.

Rematch with Xarn Velgor

> " What have you become? " " I am what you made me. " ―Kade and Xarn Velgor

title: Orien Kade
text:
Rematch with Xarn Velgor

> " What have you become? " " I am what you made me. " ―Kade and Xarn Velgor

Durith brought Kade and Solen to a nearby settlement and explained that they would have to wait several hours before one of her pilots could take them off-world. The trio sought shelter in Durith's workshop, where she revealed that she was working to help surviving Aetheri and other Synth Flux-sensitives to escape the Imperium as part of an underground organization called the Hidden Path . Kade was delighted to find that Daren Kelv had passed through Durith's hideout at some point in the past. Shock troopers arrived at the hideout but were unable to find the fugitives, leading to Durith advancing the plans to get the two off Mapuzo.

title: Orien Kade
text: As they were about to leave for the spaceport, Kade felt a sudden disturbance in Synth Flux: Xarn Velgor, accompanied by a contingent of Wardens and shock troopers had arrived in the settlement after being alerted by the probe droid Kade had destroyed earlier. Hoping to draw out Kade, Velgor walked through the town, terrorizing and killing civilians at random. Intending to distract Velgor, Kade urged Durith to get Elira off-world and back to Cindervale. Fleeing into a nearby quarry, Kade wandered aimlessly until he was confronted by Velgor, who ignited his flux blade. The Aetheri, however, ran deeper into the quarry without igniting his flux blade, but he was again cut off by Velgor.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Fleeing once more, Kade was ambushed by the Umbra Lord, and the Aetheri engaged in a brief yet fierce duel with his old apprentice. Overpowered, Kade was forced back by Velgor, who knocked over a container filled with flammable rocks. Thrown into the flames by Velgor, Kade was dragged across the burning rocks before the Umbra ordered a shock trooper to seize the wounded Kade. However, before Kade was caught by the Imperium, Durith, who was nearby watching the events unfold, shot the trooper and reignited the rocks. Blockaded by the sea of flames, Velgor was unable to catch Kade, who managed to escape, albeit wounded, with Durith.

Infiltrating the Fortress Warden Order

title: Orien Kade
text:
Infiltrating the Fortress Warden Order

Following his rematch against his old apprentice, the barely-conscious Kade was taken by Durith to Jabiim , one of the worlds where the Path helped move hunted Aetheri to safety. He was submerged in a bacta tank tank to heal the burns on his upper body after Velgor dragged him through the flames, but a mental link between he and Velgor brought Kade back to consciousness. Durith took him to Kawlan Roken , one of the insurgents helping Aetheri and Synth Flux-sensitive individuals in the galaxy. Initially reluctant to help Kade rescue the young Solen , Roken relented and assisted Kade in the operation. They used Durith's Imperial security clearance to fly to Nur , a water moon in the Emberfall system, where the Fortress Warden Order was located. Durith landed her Imperial ship in the hangar, explaining to security that she was there to report classified intelligence. She then found a control room where she guided Kade in the stronghold via an underwater hatch.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Once inside, Kade evaded seeker droids and shock trooper patrols to eventually find Solen who was on the verge of torture at the hands of Third Warden. With Durith's help, he managed to create a diversion that drew Third Warden away, he dispatched the shock troopers on guard, and retrieved Elira to escape. Rendezvousing with Durith, he donned a gray Imperial trench coat to blend in with the Imperial forces while they made their way back to the shuttle in the hangar. However, Third Warden was waiting for them with a platoon of shock troopers. Vastly outmatched, the trio almost surrendered but Sully and Wade arrived in two T-47 airspeeders , dispatching most of the Imperial ground forces in the hangar. Kade, Durith, and Solen boarded Sully's airspeeder , though as they made their retreat Third Warden managed to destroy Wade's airspeeder, killing him. They arrived aboard Roken's ship and they departed Nur, mourning the death of Wade.

After their departure, an infuriated Velgor nearly killed Revai for disobeying his orders until she revealed that she planted a tracker that would lead them to Kade and the Path, revealing that she had modified Lola.

The Siege of Jabiim

title: Orien Kade
text:
After their departure, an infuriated Velgor nearly killed Revai for disobeying his orders until she revealed that she planted a tracker that would lead them to Kade and the Path, revealing that she had modified Lola.

The Siege of Jabiim

After arriving with Solen and Durith on Jabiim, Kade would reflect on a duel he had long ago with Drayden when the latter was a adept. Though Drayden had been the stronger duelist and had skills to match his master's, Kade was still able to to defeat Drayden because of his adept's obsessive need to win. However, his thoughts on the matter were interrupted by an attack by Revai, now promoted to Grand Warden, on the Path's base, locking their escape doors with Lola, which had been modified with a restraining bolt to make her obey the Warden's commands. This began the attack on Jabiim , as Revai and Velgor's troops began bombarding the doors.

title: Orien Kade
text: To stall for time, Kade parlayed with Sevander, during which he was able to deduce her origin; she had been a adept during the attack on the Aetheri Sanctum by Velgor and the 501st, and had become a Warden to hunt Velgor down and kill him for his slaughter of her friends and fellow Aetheri. She also revealed her hatred for Kade to be part of her quest for vengeance, as she believed he was to blame for Velgor succumbing to the Umbra side. As a result, she was distrustful of the Aetheri Master as he was not at the Temple to help her and her "family" escape the massacre, and thus rejected his help, pointing out that the Dark Lord had been his own Adept and asking why he did not stop him.

title: Orien Kade
text: After a brief but fierce exchange of fire between the Imperial troops and the members of the Path in which Kade fought beside the defenders, Kade was forced to watch as Durith sacrificed herself against the oncoming troops after explaining her reasons for turning against the Imperium to help the Path after bering mortally wounded. Kade then decided to surrender with the intention of bringing Revai to Velgor himself, asking her if she will let him slaughter more civilians, including children, and offered her the chance to stop him again. When asked if the Dark Lord would see it coming, the Aetheri Master reassured her that he would be too fixated in settling the score with his former teacher to see her deception.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Soon, Kade was able to escape with the Path and Solen, leaving Velgor, who had just reached the fortress, behind, open to Sevander's attack. Playing upon Velgor's desire to win the battle, he and the Path used an empty decoy ship to cover their escape. Velgor predictably took the bait as Kade, Solen and the Path retreated into space. With their hyperrelay damaged, the Imperial forces would soon be able to catch up with them. Beyond this, Kade could sense something wrong, but was forced to put it aside for the time, unaware that Revai, after being defeated by Velgor and mortally wounded, found his communicator with Bael Solen, and had learned of Joren's location on Dunemere.

#### The Second Rematch

> " Kael… " " Kael is gone. I am what remains. " " I'm sorry. I'm sorry, Kael. For all of it. " " I am not your failure, Orien. You didn't kill Kael Drayden. I did. The same way, I will destroy you. " " Then my friend is truly dead. Goodbye, Vael. " ―Orien Kade says goodbye to Xarn Velgor

title: Orien Kade
text: With Velgor aboard the Reckoning as it pursued the Path's freighter, Kade knew that he would have to act in order to save the Path from the Umbra lord's wrath. After conferring with Roken, Kade decided to take a starship from the hangar and used it to draw Velgor's attention, knowing that his former apprentice would be too obsessed with pursuing him to follow the Path any longer. Kade left the Path's freighter on a drop ship with Lola, whom he had brought to aid him by calming his spirits. After landing in the dry lands in an Imperial shuttle, Velgor found Kade nearby and asked if he had come to destroy him. Kade replied that he will do as he must before igniting his flux blade. Velgor vowed that Kade would die and the two engaged in a flux blade duel, with Velgor utilizing a combination of one-handed and two-handed combat. During the duel, Kade lured Velgor in with his trademark Soresu before switching to the more aggressive Ataru to go on the attack and take Velgor by surprise. As the battle moved into the nearby labyrinth of rock pinnacles , Kade also attempted to collapse a pinnacle on

title: Orien Kade
text: two-handed combat. During the duel, Kade lured Velgor in with his trademark Soresu before switching to the more aggressive Ataru to go on the attack and take Velgor by surprise. As the battle moved into the nearby labyrinth of rock pinnacles , Kade also attempted to collapse a pinnacle on Velgor, who stopped it with Synth Flux. Remarking that Kade's strength had returned since their last duel but that his weakness remained, Velgor hurled the pinnacle at Kade before resuming their duel. Velgor collapsed the ground beneath Kade and hurled rocks to keep him down there. Before leaving, Velgor taunted Kade for thinking that he could win against him. However, Kade, drawing on his desire to protect Kael's children, managed to break free and charged at Velgor again. On the offensive, Kade used his superior use of Soresu and Ataru to overwhelm the Umbra Lord before using Synth Flux to hurl Velgor against a rock. With Velgor stunned, Kade then pummeled him with a maelstrom of stones, briefly overwhelming the Umbra lord. Kade then resumed his flux blade duel with Velgor, critically damaging Velgor's chest plate with multiple strikes from his flux blade's pommel, pummeling him with a boulder, and slashing him across the back before pushing him back with Synth Flux again, and then leaping at him, striking Velgor's helmet with his flux blade and revealing the scarred face of Kael beneath. Horrified, Kade addressed him as Kael Drayden, prompting Velgor to respond that Kael was gone and that he was what that remained. Kade was visibly distraught and apologized to Kael. Velgor replied that he was not Kade's failure and that Kade did not kill Kael: instead, Velgor replied that

title: Orien Kade
text:
beneath. Horrified, Kade addressed him as Kael Drayden, prompting Velgor to respond that Kael was gone and that he was what that remained. Kade was visibly distraught and apologized to Kael. Velgor replied that he was not Kade's failure and that Kade did not kill Kael: instead, Velgor replied that he killed Kael and vowed to destroy Kade as well. Kade responded that his friend was truly dead before bidding Velgor, whom he simply called "Vael," farewell. As Kade left, Velgor called out to him while trying to rise to his feet. As Kade fled off-world, he could sense Joren was in immediate danger and jumped into hyperspace towards Dunemere.

#### Return to Dunemere

After arriving on Dunemere at the Havel homestead, Orien found Owen and Brue desperately searching for Joren, who had fled after Sevander, still badly wounded by her duel with Velgor, had attacked the homestead, defeating both adults and chasing after Joren when he fled into the desert. Kade was quick to ask about Joren's whereabouts and joined the search, prepared to search out in the Dune Sea. Suddenly, Brue called out to Kade, as she saw Sevander return, Joren unconscious in her arms. As she laid him out on the sand before him, Kade and the Havel' feared the worst, only for their fears to be alleviated by Joren moving as he tried to wake. Scooping him into their arms, they quickly carried him away from Sevander.

title: Orien Kade
text: As Sevander broke down in tears, Kade approached, now assured she was no longer a threat. Stating that she tried to bring herself to kill the young Drayden but could not, she broke down saying that she had failed all of her friends that Velgor had murdered. Kade, kneeling beside her, told her she hadn't failed her fellow adepts, stating that through her mercy, she gave her deceased friends peace and honored them. When asked if she had become like Velgor, Kade assured Sevander that through her refusal to commit any further to the umbra side, she had redeemed herself and that who she decided to become was now her choice. Rising to her feet, Sevander abandoned her Warden flux blade, and was helped to stand by Kade, who stated they were both free from their grief before they parted ways. Soon after he reunited with the Organas, during which he returned Lola to Elira and told her that if she ever needed help, he will be there.

title: Orien Kade
text:
After departing from his cave, Kade went to the Havel Homestead to speak with Owen. After being allowed to see the boy, Kade approached Joren with his customary greeting of "Hello there." Later, as Kade continued on through the Dune Sea, he finally saw Synth Flux Spirit of his former master, Sorin Vael, appear to him. After Vael revealed he had always been with his former Adept, they ventured deeper into the Dune Sea together, and Kade set up himself in the hut he had found years prior.

### Continued exile on Dunemere

#### The Journals of Beno Kade ### Continued exile on Dunemere

#### The Journals of Beno Kade

In preparation for Joren's future training, Kade wrote a set of journals and placed them in a box labeled "For Joren." In one of his journals, Kade wrote about how he stopped Grukk the Grak's men from collecting their " water tax " on the local farmers during the Great Drought . He kept Grukk's thugs from extorting the Havel family into paying their water tax; following an action which involved subtle use of Synth Flux to cause the thugs' firearms to misfire with the intention of preventing harm from coming to the townspeople, he decided not to go into town anymore.

title: Orien Kade
text: That same night, he sensed Drayden to be in danger, for the boy had gone to take the water back from Grukk's men and give it back to the farmers. Kade went to the encounter, but blew their vehicle's lights with Synth Flux to hide his identity and proceeded to disable all of Grukk's henchmen with Synth Flux. One of them became startled and pushed Drayden to the ground, causing him to hit his head and pass out. Once Kade handled all the thugs, he carried Drayden to the Havel' homestead and left before he woke up. Joren's courage assured Kade that it wasn't the end of the Aetheri and renewed his up-until-then waning hope.

title: Orien Kade
text: A year later the Great Drought had ended, and Kade found himself observing a young Joren piloting a T-16 skyhopper through Beggar's Canyon . Kade noted how similar Joren was to his father Kael, and expressed worry at the prospect. While attempting to impress his friends with an ostentatious maneuver through the canyon, Joren badly damaged the skyhopper and was subsequently grounded from flying by his uncle. Kade, feeling sympathy for the boy, took a job protecting a Duskkin dune hauler that had been experiencing troublesome raids by Dunefolk Raiders . That night, Kade meditated outside of the dune hauler, communing with Sorin and expressing his hope in Joren's abilities. Soon the Dunefolk Raiders arrived and Kade was able to easily dispatch the party with a disarmed raider's Gaderffii stick . He used whatever payment he earned from the job to hire the Duskkins to deliver the necessary parts to fix the skyhopper. At a droid auction at an unidentified outpost, Joren received the the parts Kade had provided for him. Joren believed the parts had been a gift from his uncle and thanked Owen, as he eagerly rushed back home. Deriving pleasure from the boy's enthusiasm, Kade grinned fondly

title: Orien Kade
text: fix the skyhopper. At a droid auction at an unidentified outpost, Joren received the the parts Kade had provided for him. Joren believed the parts had been a gift from his uncle and thanked Owen, as he eagerly rushed back home. Deriving pleasure from the boy's enthusiasm, Kade grinned fondly as he observed from behind a nearby tent. Later that day in his hut, Kade was cooking dinner when he was interrupted by a visit from Owen. Owen had put two and two together and sternly demanded that Kade have no part in his family's life. He had brought back the box of tools that he presumably confiscated from Joren, and dumped it on the floor of the hut. Kade responded back with several snarky replies before finally relenting and saying he that he only ever wanted to help. Owen continued to berate him, calling him dangerous and troublesome. As Owen departed, Kade regretfully admitted to himself that danger did in fact seem to follow him, remembering his confrontations with Count Varek, General Skarn and Vael Vreth. But he steeled his resolve and claimed that no danger would come to the young Drayden boy as long as he lived. Coincidentally, Grukk the Grak chose this time to send a Vorak bounty hunter Zazzik after Owen, who he believed was responsible for roughing up his tax collectors during the Great Drought.

title: Orien Kade
text: The next day, Owen had a change of heart and himself purchased a box of parts. He searched through the Havel homestead looking for Joren, hoping to fix the skyhopper with the boy as a way to apologize for his coarse actions the previous day. However, he was ambushed by Black Zazzik and kidnapped. Joren, in childish defiance, was running away from home. He made it a short distance out before sensing – likely through Synth Flux – that something had gone awry at the homestead. Back home, he encountered a wounded Brue who informed him about what had transpired and warned him to stay home. She ran out of the house armed with a rifle, leaving Joren with the discarded pile of tools Owen had earlier dropped.

title: Orien Kade
text: While meditating in the Dune Sea among a herd of Striders , Kade felt a disturbance in Synth Flux. He traversed the side of a rocky mountain before finding Zazzik beating Owen. In the ensuing conflict, Kade was trapped under a mesh of stun net that was dispatched by the Vorak. Zazzik then knocked Owen off the mountain, who quickly grabbed hold onto a protrusion on the side of the mountain. Kade escaped the net and stunned the Vorak, sprinting over to Owen to grab him back up. However, Zazzik intervened and threw an enormous boulder at Kade. Kade used his flux blade to split the rock in two, also blinding Zazzik in one eye during the process. The debris from the rock crashed into Owen's ledge and he nearly fell if not for Kade's use of Synth Flux. Kade held Owen in place using Synth Flux before losing focus as a result of Zazzik's constant attacks. Owen fell, but was deftly saved by Joren, who used the repaired skyhopper's turret to break Owen's fall.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade then used this opportunity to disarm the Vorak, who plunged off the side of the mountain. He did not die, however, and proceeded off-world to escape Grukk's wrath. Owen reunited with Joren at the foot of the mountain and held the boy in a deep embrace. He cast a knowing glance up toward Kade who looked on in triumph. There were no words of thanks exchanged between Owen and Kade, but Kade was simply happy to see the family reunited. Kade then returned to his family, which was what he fondly called his herd of Striders. Among them, he looked up into the sky to see Joren's skyhopper, soaring off into the sunset.

Kade was later visiting Port Kess for supplies when he experienced a vision of a mysterious man. Kade recognized the man as Garro from a tale Aetheri Master Zho had told him. He would go on to recount this in his journal.

#### Introducing himself once again

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade was later visiting Port Kess for supplies when he experienced a vision of a mysterious man. Kade recognized the man as Garro from a tale Aetheri Master Zho had told him. He would go on to recount this in his journal.

#### Introducing himself once again

When Drayden was twelve years old in around 7 BVE , he went on an adventure with his friend Windy , riding a dewback , but they soon encountered a sandstorm and both lost consciousness. When Drayden awoke, there was a krayt dragon nearby sneaking up on him. Just as the dragon attempted to attack, Kade, his hood over his face, appeared and beheaded the giant creature. When Drayden asked who the hooded figure was, Kade answered that his name was "Beno Kade" and revealed that he was an old friend of Drayden's father.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade took Drayden and Windy back to their village, meeting with Drayden's uncle, Owen Havel. Havel thanked him for bringing Joren back safely but told him to stay back from the kid, because he did not want to put his nephew in danger. In return, Kade said he was observing Drayden and claimed that Synth Flux was strong in him, telling Havel that he would leave the farm one day. Havel responded that the Aetheri were done since the Republic had fallen, warning him once again to never visit their homestead again.

#### The knight and the dragon

> " Yet you have wronged the people of the town, for you have taken your pain and made it theirs. This too, shall cease, for if you ever raid the settlements of others, I shall learn of it, and I shall return with this dragon and your village shall be destroyed. " ―The knight to the Dunefolk

title: Orien Kade
text: At some point in time, a story was spread on Dunemere of an altruistic knight, once a mighty warrior who had made the desert his home while guarding a treasure in solitude. The knight learned of the actions of a tribe of Dunefolk that had been raiding other settlements and capturing prisoners. Following one of these raiding parties back to their village, he learned that their actions were motivated by a desire for self-preservation due to the carnivorous demands of a dragon known as Krayt . Upon being discovered, the knight was held in captivity with the others which gave him the opportunity to break out all of the other prisoners while he stayed behind. Angered by his actions, the nomadic tribe placed him in view of the dragon, offering him up in sacrifice. Slipping free of his bonds, the knight produced a glowing sword of light which he used to hold back the flying dragon for a time.

title: Orien Kade
text:
For more than an hour, he and the dragon engaged in a sort of dance, with neither one able to wound the other. Finally, the dragon sensed an opening when the knight seemed to tire. Just as the dragon was about to pounce, the knight held up his hand which seemed to put the dragon under a pacifying spell. Upon seeing the knight exercise control upon the creature, the nomads cheered. The knight, however, chastised them for their actions. He stated that while the dragon would no longer bother them, any whisper of wrongdoing from their end would lead to him and the dragon returning to punish them. The knight thus led the dragon away, never to be seen again. His actions eventually led to the nomadic tribe forever ceasing any attempts to raid or kidnap from other settlements, a trait which became unique to them.

#### The Oil-Bringer and aid to needy

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### The Oil-Bringer and aid to needy

> " I always get extra for that old hermit, out in the Jundland Wastes. " " I haven't seen him in a couple cycles. " " I hope he's alright. One time, I was getting chased by a wild massif and he managed to calm it down. I don't know how, just held up his hand and stared at it. " ―The human entrepreneur to human gambler — Link ▶️ ( file info )

At some point, Kade took actions to aid and repair the droids of Dunemere. His efforts resulted in his earning the moniker Oil-Bringer. Tales passed around said that his heroics took place on a single night once a year, and that he traversed the entire galaxy. Kade rescued one such droid, LA-R1, and its companions from the clutches of Duskkins. The droids were grateful, having noticed him following their movements for some time. LA-R1, upon meeting Kade, felt that he matched the description of the Oil-Bringer legends. At some point after, he escorted a lost Dunefolk home, out of compassion.

title: Orien Kade
text:
On another occasion, Kade witnessed an individual being chased by a wild Massiff and used synth flux to calm it down. The individual would get extra supplies from Bestine for Kade who they referred to as an "old hermit". They later recounted the tale to a gambler in the Bestine Cantina in 3 AVE . Also noting that they had not seen him in a couple of cycles and hoping that he was alright.

#### Encountering Vreth

> " Look what has become of you. A rat in the desert. " " Look what I've risen above. " ―Vreth and Orien Kade

title: Orien Kade
text:
#### Encountering Vreth

> " Look what has become of you. A rat in the desert. " " Look what I've risen above. " ―Vreth and Orien Kade

In 2 BVE , Vreth arrived on Dunemere in search of Kade, following his vision of the twin suns. Kade managed to keep Vreth from tracking him until Vreth used an Umbra reliquary to lure Insurgent Adept Cass Virel from his base on the planet Atollon to Dunemere, hoping the young Aetheri's pain would be enough to draw Kade out. Kade found Cass unconscious in the Dune Sea and sheltered him from the storm. Cass regained consciousness and, knowing of Vreth's hatred towards Kade from his own encounters with the former Umbra, tried to warn Orien of Vreth's presence. Kade calmly replied that he knew of it already and that he hadn't gone into hiding unprepared. He told Cass that it was Cass's responsibility to help the Insurgency; not to handle Vreth. That burden fell upon Kade himself.

title: Orien Kade
text: Soon thereafter Vreth arrived, seething with rage upon seeing his old rival after so many years. Kade sent Virel off on a dewback toward Vreth's ship , which Virel would use to fly back to Atollon. Vreth mocked Kade's lackluster living conditions, and wondered out loud whether it would be crueler to simply leave Kade to what Vreth believed was a life of misery and squalor. But rather than responding with mockery in turn, as he might have in his younger years, Kade calmly and succinctly explained to Vreth that because he defined himself by his empty desires to kill, possess, and dominate, the former Umbra Lord had nothing at all.

title: Orien Kade
text: This infuriated Vreth, who ignited one of the blades of his saberstaff and struck the ground in front of Kade's small campfire, showering it with sand and putting it out. Vreth questioned on his old nemesis's reasons for being on Dunemere, noting it wasn't simply to hide. He then began to speculate, quickly coming to the conclusion that Kade was there to protect someone. Stirred to action by the threat of Vreth to Joren, Kade ignited his flux blade and assumed his traditional Soresu ready stance. As Vreth tightened his grip on his own blade and ignited his second blade, Kade shifted his stance to the one used by his old master Sorin during the duel on Ondara in the Serath power generator .

title: Orien Kade
text: Vreth noted Kade's change in stance and after a few tense moments, attacked. He crossed blades with Kade twice before attempting to hit him with the same hilt-strike that had allowed him to kill Sorin. However, Kade had evidently anticipated this, and he struck down at Vreth's hilt as Vreth struck upwards, bisecting Vreth's flux blade and carving a lethal laceration into the former Umbra Lord's chest. Vreth dropped his ruined weapon and collapsed to one knee, but Kade caught him before he could fall to the ground and held him. As Vreth laid dying, he asked Kade whether the person whom he was protecting was the Seeded One; the one prophesied to destroy the Umbra. Kade, who at that point believed that Velgor would never turn from the umbra side, replied that he was. Vreth appeared to take some modicum of comfort from this knowledge, seemingly certain that he and Kade would ultimately be avenged.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade then traveled via dewback to the Havel' Homestead. Upon arriving there, he heard Brue Whitesun Havel calling to Joren and saw the teenager running back home against a binary sunset. Following the former Umbra's death, Kade built a funeral pyre for Vreth, honoring his old rival.

Shortly before the Battle of Halcyon , Kade wrote a set of journals, recounting his service to the Aetheri Order as well as the Republic during the time of the Replica Wars and prior, in order to pass the time whilst a storm occoured on Dunemere. During his final days on the planet, Kade encountered and rescued an injured shock trooper named JM-909 , whom he nicknamed Jim, before bringing him to his hut. Jim eventually escaped, but remembered Kade's actions after being scolded by his superior officer upon returning to the Imperium. Following this, Kade stated that he knew his time on the planet was coming to an end, and that despite having felt alone for so many years, he came to realise that he never had been.

#### Coming out of exile

> " We will need every advantage. " " Your friend... the Aetheri? " " He served me well during the Replica Wars, but has lived in hiding since the Emperor's purge. Yes, I will send for him. " ―Bael Solen and Vela Sess talk about the possibility of recruiting Kade to the Alliance As the Alliance to Restore the Republic foresaw open war with the Imperium becoming more of a possibility, they decided to take every advantage. Shortly before the Battle of Halcyon , in 1 BVE , Kade's old friend Bael Solen, who, by this point, was a high-ranking leader within the Alliance, decided to recruit the exiled Aetheri Master to their cause at Chancellor Vela Sess 's urging. Unable to attend to it in person because he had to travel to Cindervale to warn his people of the coming war, Solen sent his daughter Princess Elira Solen to request Kade's help. Barely escaping from the battle that had just taken place at Halcyon after having recovered the schematics for the Imperium's planet-destroying Void Core , she was captured in a battle over Dunemere. Elira transferred the plans into Bolt-3's memory systems and sent the droid off to find Kade, leading Bolt-3 and Astra-9 on a crusade that led them to be captured by a band of Duskkins and being sold to Owen Havel and Joren Drayden.

title: Orien Kade
text: However, Bolt-3 ran off from the Havel homestead and off into the Jundland Wastes to try and find Kade. Astra-9, who was unaware of the mission given to Bolt-3 by Princess Elira, encouraged Drayden to go after the wayward astromech droid, but, before they could return to the homestead, they were attacked by a group of Dunefolk Raiders. It was at that moment when Kade showed up on the scene and scared the Dunefolk Raiders off by imitating the cry of a krayt dragon. Upon turning to see where the call had come from, the Tuskens saw Kade and remembered Chieftain A'Yark had warned them of a mysterious " shaman " who lived in the area. Remembering their chieftain's warnings, they quickly fled, although the young Dunefolk A'Koba intended to return in greater numbers to finally hunt down the hooded figure. Indeed, Kade knew the Tuskens were likely to return in greater numbers if they stayed in the canyon for too long, meaning he had to awaken Drayden but also lead him to safety.

title: Orien Kade
text: With the Tuskens gone, Kade approached the unconscious Drayden and checked that he was still alive before greeting Bolt-3. However, Kade acted as though he did not know the droid for Joren's benefit. Restoring Drayden to consciousness, the boy told him that Bolt-3 was looking for someone named "Orien Kade," to which Kade replied that was, in fact, his real name. To avoid more Dunefolk Raider attacks, Kade brought the two droids and the farm boy to his home. There, Kade revealed that he had known Drayden's father, and that he'd been an Aetheri Knight during the Replica Wars, choosing to talk about him before his turn to the Umbra side.

title: Orien Kade

Though he wasn't technically lying to Joren - the man who Kael Drayden had been had died when he became Xarn Velgor - he wasn't being directly truthful either, and Joren would not learn the whole truth for another several years. Afterward, Joren decided to show Kade the partial message from Elira Solen. The message finally played in its entirety, stating her father's request for him to aid the Alliance and that Bolt-3 contained information vital to the survival of the Alliance. After the message concluded, Kade requested Drayden's help to see the mission through and learn the ways of Synth Flux, but Drayden refused to get involved as he believed his

At the age of 57, and after more than nineteen years of exile, Kade was done hiding and being cautious, regardless of Joren's answer he needed to leave Dunemere and confront the Imperium by aiding the princess who had begged for his help.

title: Orien Kade
text: On their way to the city, the two came across the skiff that had sold Bolt-3 and Astra-9 to Drayden and his uncle; it had been destroyed and the Duskkins had been killed. Worried that the shock troopers may have gone after his aunt and uncle next, Drayden headed back home despite Kade's claims that it was too dangerous. While Drayden discovered that the Imperials had attacked the homestead and killed both Owen and Brue, Kade arranged a small funeral pyre for all the Duskkins killed by the Imperium's soldiers.

title: Orien Kade
text:
At this time that, Kade was met by Synth Flux Wisp of Vael. Kade's old master helped ease his anxieties about Joren, specifically his fear that Joren would suffer a tragic fate such as Kael's. Sorin marveled at how Orien had remained so steadfast and resilient after suffering through years of war and losing everyone he ever truly loved to a terrible end: Kael, Satinna, Lira, and Vael himself. Sorin reassured Kade that he was making the right decisions with Joren. Sensing that Joren was returning from the remains of the Havel homestead, Sorin bade his former student farewell and told him that they would see each other again, though kept to himself that Orien only had a short time to live. #### Leaving Dunemere

> " If his ship is as fast as his boasting, we ought to do well. " ―Kade regarding Dax Karrick and the Corsair Wing

The four ventured out to Port Kess and to pay a visit to Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina —a place Kade had made rare visits to throughout his exile —in hopes of recruiting a pilot that could take them to Cindervale. During their journey, they were stopped by shock trooper Foot Patrol 7 , as Commander TD-110 had spotted Bolt and Astra-9 and thought they could be the droids they needed. One of his subordinates, trooper TD-7556 , privately disagreed, thinking that the boy and whom he assumed to be his grandfather would never be chosen by the Free Coalition to protect their secrets. Claiming that he and Drayden had owned the droids for several seasons, Kade used a mind trick to ensure the shock troopers did not check for identification and to ensure they could move along. The trick worked, with it even making TD-7556 believe Kade had been an Imperial. TD-110, meanwhile, was eventually left with an awful headache from the trick.

title: Orien Kade
text: Explaining to Drayden that he had used Synth Flux to ensure they made it past Foot Patrol 7, the four made their way to the cantina. Drayden was skeptical about the prospect of finding a pilot in the cantina, but Kade assured him that the best pilots could usually be found there, but warned him that the cantina could "be a little rough." They ran into a small bout of trouble when a pair of wanted criminals, Cornelius Evazan and Ponda Baba , began bullying Drayden, but Kade was able to defuse the situation when he sliced off Baba's arm in defense of the young man. Although the patrons began to whisper of the flux blade, Kade continued with his business of looking for transport.

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade soon met a Vorak named Brevok , who served as the first mate aboard a freighter known as the Corsair Wing , which was captained by a Korrathi smuggler named Dax Karrick . Karrick boasted about his ship's speed to entice Kade. Though Karrick's initial rate was 10,000 credits all paid in advance, Kade was able to compromise: offering to pay 2,000 credits upfront, with an additional 15,000 when they got to Cindervale, for a total of 17,000 credits. Karrick was convinced and agreed to take them to Cindervale. Kade and Drayden then exited the cantina when they saw shock troopers, actually the very same troops Kade had mind tricked, who had entered to investigate the earlier disturbance caused when Baba lost his arm. Having been saved by Aetheri during the Replica Wars, Wuher —the cantina bartender who had previously written Kade off as an old hermit—chose to lie to the soldiers, keeping the Aetheri's presence a secret.

title: Orien Kade
text: As they departed, the two were confronted by another shock trooper , who demanded to see their identification. In response, Kade cut the trooper's volt pistol and killed the soldier by throwing pieces of metal at them with Synth Flux. Realizing shock troopers were all around Port Kess, Kade informed Drayden that they needed to leave quickly. However, they had been spotted by an Imperial spy named Garindan ezz Zavor , who had entered the cantina after hearing Baba and Kade's fight, enabling the Kubaz spy to overhear Kade's discussion with Karrick. Waiting until he could see Kade and Drayden with the droids, Zavor notified Imperial shock troopers of their location at Docking Bay 94 . Fortunately, the Corsair Wing was able to escape Dunemere. As Karrick checked his ship's controls, Kade assured Bolt-3 that he still remembered him and commented that it was good to fly with him again.

title: Orien Kade
text:
As they waited for the Corsair to arrive at Cindervale, Kade arranged an exercise for Drayden so that he would learned how to sense through Synth Flux and deflect volt pistol fire from a training remote , when the Aetheri Master sensed a disturbance in Synth Flux caused by the Disaster . Soon enough, the Corsair exited hyperspace, and they discovered that the planet had been destroyed and replaced by an asteroid field . As a SKREE fighter approached them, Karrick decided to shoot the small ship, but Drayden noticed that the ship was coming from what, at first, seemed like a small moon - the Void Core. As the space station's grapple beam pulled them in, Kade told Karrick not to resist, saying there were alternatives to fighting.

As the Corsair Wing was forced to land on Bay 327, Karrick prompted everyone to hide on the ship's sensor-proof smuggling compartments, with Kade hiding alongside the two droids, to trick the Imperials into thinking they had abandoned the ship. He decided to go alone, despite Drayden's protest, to whom he told that his destiny lay on a different path than his own, and reassured Drayden that Synth Flux would be with him always.

title: Orien Kade
text: As Drayden, Karrick and Brevok learned of Solen's presence on the station and set out to rescue her, Kade managed to disable the grapple beam; however, as he made his way to the Corsair , he encountered Velgor and the two engaged in one final duel. Velgor claimed to be the true master of Synth Flux, but Kade, refusing to use Kael's name and instead simply calling Velgor " Vael ," instead claimed that he was only a "master of evil." During the duel, Velgor noted that his age had made him weak, but Kade told his former apprentice that he wouldn't win because he would become more powerful than Velgor could ever imagine, even if he managed to kill him.

title: Orien Kade
text:
The two made their way to Bay 327 just as the team reunited to board the Corsair , only for Kade to see the young Drayden and give Velgor a mysteriously knowing smile. As he raised his blade in surrender and took a deep breath, Velgor struck him down and his body disappeared, for he had become one with Synth Flux, with only his Aetheri robes and flux blade left behind on the Void Core. At the age of fifty-seven, Kade's life had finally come to an end. Despite being horrified, Drayden was unable to attend to the body of his master due to being attacked by Storm Troopers. Obi Wan's voice (through Synth Flux) called out to him to run, causing Drayden to run and then escape on the Corsair with everyone else. Velgor, meanwhile, stomped upon his former mentor's cloak and collected his flux blade.

Kade's communion with Sorin was successful as Kade did not vanish completely but instead became a Synth Flux spirit. As he did, he felt past, present, future collide, seeing the eventual death of Karrick on Voidfang Base , and his apprentice's self-imposed exile on Tidehollow . Using his new-found abilities, he was able to guide Drayden during the Battle of Cinderfall so that he could successfully destroy the Void Core with proton torpedoes .

About five days later, the spirit of Kade would go to Mirefall, where he would visit Zho regarding Drayden. Kade listened as Zho explained that Elira was by far the best candidate to pick up the mantle of Aetheri, as Joren was impetuous, headstrong, unruly, and inattentive like Kael. Nevertheless, Kade remained steadfast in his resolve that Joren be trained and was successful in gaining Zho's approval to bring the boy to him.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Meanwhile, in the aftermath of the Cinderfall battle, Joren deeply grieved the loss of his mentor, having thought they would train together longer. He began to question whether he had heard the Aetheri's voice in the Battle of Cinderfall, wondering if it was his own imagination. When he was sent to the planet Rodanor on an Alliance mission, Joren often contemplated what Kade would think of his surroundings, and told the Rodanori Taneetch Soonta that he considered the Aetheri Master the personification of honor. While on Rodanor, Joren did his best to learn more about the Aetheri from Soonta, whose uncle was the Aetheri Huulik . With his extremely limited training, Joren struggled to move objects with Synth Flux, and felt dismay when recalling how easily Kade had mind tricked individuals on Dunemere. By repeating the few lessons about Synth Flux he had received from Kade, the Alliance pilot became more determined to retain and build his knowledge base. After acquiring Huulik's flux blade from his mausoleum with Soonta's help, Joren documented its inner workings, hoping to build another that would honor the Aetheri that came before him.

### Legacy

> " You are named after legends. " " That's exactly it, Vorr. Orien Kade… Big famous Aetheri. Everyone thinks I'm supposed to be like him. I never even met him. " ― Vorr and Beno Karrick

Orien Kade was considered a legend by the time of the Concordat Era . In the aftermath of the Galactic Civil War, Dax Karrick and Elira Solen named their only son, Beno Karrick , after the famous Aetheri Master. However, the fame of Kade's name and his deeds as an Aetheri weighed on the young Beno, who harbored feelings of insecurity due to the expectations that had been thrust on him because of his heritage.

Karrick grew resentful toward the late Aetheri, especially as he thought that everyone expected him to be like his namesake despite never knowing Kade. It was part of the reason why Karrick hated his name as it reminded him of a legacy that he believed had been built on lies. Ultimately, he renounced his ties to the Aetheri and adopted a new identity, that of Zarrin Karrick, following in the example of Kade's fallen apprentice —Karrick's grandfather, Xarn Velgor.

title: Orien Kade
text:
In time, however, Karrick returned to the light, destroying the dark persona of Karrick. Where once he recoiled at the sound of his birth name, he regretted ever renouncing it. His redemption came when he sacrificed his life to save Nyla—a selfless act mirroring that of Kael Drayden. Once revived, Nyla looked at Karrick and smiled, calling him by his name "Beno," who shortly afterwards became one with Synth Flux.

Kade's contributions during the Replica Wars were remembered long after the war's end, with citizens of Pau City on Uthara being able to recall Kade's name many decades after the Battle of Uthara. When the Synth Flux-sensitive human Karr Nuq Sin embarked on a journey across the galaxy to learn more about Synth Flux and the Aetheri, he used his powers of psychometry to experience visions of Kade visiting Pau City in search of General Skarn as well as moments of him and Joren Drayden onboard the Corsair Wing .

During much of his time as a youngling, Kade was known to be rebellious and willful, described as breaking the rules laid out by the Aetheri left and right. However, throughout much of his early apprenticeship to Sorin Vael, Kade possessed strong fondness for rigid rules and a largely by-the-book attitude when it came to matters such as the Aetheri Code. He felt as if he never truly understood his master and yet nevertheless wished to please him and earn his respect. He also had trouble understanding his master's hobbies and interests, such as study of arcane Aetheri prophecies. At various points, he considered the fact that Vael could be kicked out of the Order and wondered what would happen to him if such a case were to occur. The two later came to realization that Zho intentionally placed Kade with a maverick master in the hope that he would insurgent in the only way possible: by attempting to become a model Aetheri.

title: Orien Kade
text: Over time, Kade would become loyal and dedicated to Vael, possessing a dry sense of humor and sarcastic wit. Zho said that he sensed Sorin Vael's defiance in him, and Vael himself reflected upon Kade's considerable knowledge and potential; he also considered his Adept a lot wiser than he, if somewhat headstrong. Leading up to his Aetheri Trials, Kade was very nervous and lost sleep worrying about them. Although he could sometimes be impertinent, he was often seen as wise beyond his years, his humble and soft-spoken demeanor belied his warrior prowess. Despite his numerous complaints during flight, and deeply shaken by an experience involving auto-pursuit in his youth, he was also a skilled pilot. In many ways, he represented the strength of the old Aetheri Order: steadfast, selfless, and modest. Kade's combination of knowledge and friendly support made him an ideal choice for Master to some Adepts. |hilt model= A tireless defender of the Republic's ideals of democracy and justice, his later skill at resolving disputes without battle would earn him the sobriquet "The Negotiator."

title: Orien Kade
text: Over time, Kade lost some of his youthful audacity and assumed the role of a more cautious mentor to Kael Drayden, who was in many ways his opposite in personality. The two had a very strange dynamic early on, with Kade feeling protective and responsible for his young Adept and Drayden worrying about Kade's commitment to him, having been abandoned in his life previously. Kade knew of these feelings, evidenced by waking up to see Drayden had moved to sleep on the floor next to his bed. Kade often worried he was not fit to teach Drayden and sometimes would lie awake at night thinking of things to teach his apprentice. As their relationship deepened over time, the two found that they could easily get on each other's nerves, with Kade becoming particularly annoyed by his Adept's habit of grinding his teeth in frustration. For all their bickering, they cared deeply for each other.

title: Orien Kade
text:
Kade carefully measured his actions in any situation, garnering him the aforementioned nom de guerre. Kade was also known to be an accomplished storyteller. While hiding in the Jundland Wastes in his later years, he appeared as a kindly and eccentric old hermit. Owen Havel described him as "a crazy old man" to those not familiar with the ways of the Aetheri. In his final days, Kade retained his traits of patience and foresight as well as gaining some of the boldness reminiscent of his youth.

Kade often thought out plans and strategies rather than leaping into action. He would usually place his hand on his chin or stroke his beard as he thought. This was a common trait of the Aetheri Master, one that his apprentice Kael Drayden did not practice very often. He sometimes mentally repeated the Aetheri Code to calm himself. He had also served as a mentor to Drayden's Adept, Sela Marr. Marr recognized that Kade had more patience than Drayden, but she also fondly remembered how they would bicker. Marr believed Kade would have enjoyed the strategy game crokin .

title: Orien Kade
text: Kade's respect for the lives of others led him to emerge from hiding to save Cass Virel and the C1-series astromech droid Chomper from succumbing to the deserts of Dunemere. Kade then reproved Cass for succumbing to Vreth's manipulation and counselled the young insurgent to return to his place with the insurgency. When faced with the Umbra who slew his master, Kade did not hate Vreth and tried to talk him down, but when he made his violent intent clear and sensed Joren Drayden, Kade was forced to fight and kill him in self defense. After mortally wounding Vreth, Kade comforted the former Umbra and assured him that he was watching over the "Seeded One," Joren Drayden, though Joren was not the Seeded One by prophecy. When he confronted Velgor on the Void Core, Kade found himself unable to believe his foe was once his friend, even being unable to call him by his name; he used the title "Vael" instead, while he also realized his own anger was rising as Velgor spoke.

title: Orien Kade
text: During his exile on Dunemere, Kade was forced to engage in self-reflection that he described as agonizing. Over the years, he was forced to dismantle systemic rituals and ingrained doctrines he had experienced during his time with the Aetheri. He was left broken and unwilling to fight until his rematches with Velgor ten years after Directive 66, which left him with the belief that his friend had been destroyed by Velgor. While he once blamed himself for Drayden's fall, Kade, after hearing Velgor's proclamation, had come to believe that, while he and Vael did have some blame, Drayden had made his own choices and thus was at fault for his own fate. As he noted to Revai Sevander, the adventure had freed both of them from the past. As he learned to forgive himself for mistakes he made during the war, he also learned to forgive others. Nevertheless, despite finding himself unable to call Velgor by his old name during their final duel on the Void Core, he did ponder if Kael Drayden still remained within, but he later claimed to Joren that Kael was truly gone. Joren proved him wrong when he redeemed his father, enabling Kade and Drayden

#### Siri Tachi

A fellow Aetheri, Siri Tachi trained at the Vantor's Temple at the same time as Kade. Back then, Tachi and Kade used to hold hands under the table during lunch. Years later, Kade mused that although the Aetheri may have been exterminated, their dedication to posturing theatrics lived on in Zho and that he needed just look back at moments with Tachi to feel as though he had deserved a punishment from the Aetheri Council.

#### Satinna Velara
