Beyond Vael often being correct, the other reason he went along with it was because his only attempt at "mutinying" against such work it did not go over well. Like most Aetheri, Kade also did not share his master's fascination with prophecies. Despite their differences, which could make them argue even when they agreed on matters, Vael remained proud of Kade's accomplishments, believing his Adept to be wiser than himself and foreseeing that his apprentice would become an great Aetheri Knight. Kade was also thankful for his teachings and, even despite his misgivings, would not give up their friendly arguments for anything.

title: Sorin Vael
text: Beyond being able to sense whenever his apprentice held discontentment, Sorin Vael had an empathetic nature and tended to take unfortunate life forms under his protection. It was this tendency and his defiance towards the Aetheri Council, which often frustrated and baffled his Adept. When Vael saved the Mool exile Greeb Mool, who in turn swore a life-debt to him, his compassionate nature was such that Vael took the hapless Mool under his wing, much to Kade's dismay. His empathy toward all life forms, including the most pitiful and unfortunate, was Vael's greatest strength. Additionally, he remained understanding and patient with Queen Lira Ondar. During the short time they knew each other, he never asked for her to do more than she was willing to, and she was left in nearly overwhelming sadness anytime she thought of the Aetheri Master after his death.

title: Sorin Vael
text:
Kade had sleepless nights during his training, partly because he feared Vael would somehow end up removed from the Aetheri Order before his apprenticeship was over. Kade had tried to embody a traditional Aetheri spirit to keep his master in line with traditional teachings, a reverse of the typical master—apprentice relationship. Despite that, some of Vael's defiance was passed down to his Adept, resulting in Kade pushing for Kael to become his apprentice.

#### Remaining a mentor

> " Thank you, Sorin. As always, your wisdom sustains me. " " As your strength always sustained me. " ―Orien and Sorin

title: Sorin Vael
text:
#### Remaining a mentor

> " Thank you, Sorin. As always, your wisdom sustains me. " " As your strength always sustained me. " ―Orien and Sorin

Even after his death, Vael continued to help his former Adept; he gave him guidance during the Imperial Era, warning him whenever he needed to protect Joren Drayden. When he was called upon during his former student's exile, he did not only see Kade as he existed in old age, seeing every other aspect of the man's past and present at once and believing they all made him who he was. In fact, he completed his training to appear as a ghost for Kade, as he wanted him to have company throughout his exile. Finding that saying Kade's name made the effort to enter the physical universe worth it, he elected to also say "Beno," which served as Kade's alias. He also knew that Kade would quickly adopt the persona of an Aetheri Knight once more, as soon as danger came, and looked forward to watching Kade do so.

title: Sorin Vael
text: Vael also took to calling him "my Adept" once more, as he knew Kade still had much to learn, as he had learned that death was merely the start of gaining wisdom. Even so, he believed Kade already personified the ways of the Aetheri, seeing that he had the patience to remain on Dunemere as Joren Drayden grew up. Although Kade did not see himself in a kind light, Vael also knew Kade was special for not giving into the umbra side during that time; he was in awe of Kade's steadfast devotion to the light, as he remained an Aetheri despite losing everyone he loved. Beyond his mentor, Kade had lost Kael, Satinna Velara, Lira Ondar, Sela Marr, and Replica Commander Cord . He also respected Kade's courage in wanting to continue to live despite all he had lost; he was moved by this, but he anticipated the upcoming reunion they would have after Kade's death.

title: Sorin Vael
text: He felt that respecting Kade's steadfast devotion to the Aetheri was something he owed his Adept because, upon reflection, Vael also believed he had failed his student, thinking that Kade had not been ready to teach Kael. He thought his mistakes were obvious and wretched, thinking that Kade never discussed them with him to spare his mentor needing to hear of them. In reality, even though he did feel Kael had been thrust upon him and did regret not having more time to figure out his place in the Aetheri Order, Kade never mentioned the supposed mistakes to his former master because he did not blame him for Kael's fall. Vael wanted to discuss these matters with Kade once they were both beyond the world of the living, and he agreed with his apprentice's decision to not tell Joren the full story about his father, thinking that the boy needed to learn when he was steady and strong in Synth Flux.

title: Sorin Vael
text:
Kade felt sustained by his mentor's wisdom, looking forward to learning how to appear as a spirit and never hesitating to call upon Vael. Whenever Vael departed from the mortal world to return to Synth Flux, he found that Kade became another part of the overall music of life. He intended to show Kade the beauty in letting go to be a part of Synth Flux. By the time after his death, Kade had come to disagree with the way Vael had taken Drayden off Dunemere; the Aetheri Master had told the boy he was not on planet to free him from slavery, instead suggesting he leave his mother for a prophecy he had never heard of.

### Belief in Kael Drayden

> " Do you believe you are the Seeded One? " " How can I know? " " I can tell you what I believe. I believe you will bring balance to Synth Flux. That you will face your demons and save the universe. " ―Sorin Vael and Kael Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

title: Sorin Vael
text:
Unlike Kade, Vael believed in the prophecy of the Seeded One, being certain that the foretold individual would bring balance to Synth Flux. Just as the prophecy foretold, Vael came to meet a male born of no father, Kael Drayden, and he quickly came to believe he was the Seeded One. Though he acknowledged that Drayden's future contained an uncertain destiny, he did not dwell on the danger the Council saw in Drayden's potential. He was willing to train him even if the council forbade it. Even in his dying deaths, Vael remained steadfast in his belief.

Even as a spirit, Vael continued to believe in Drayden, quickly asking Kade whether he had trained him when they reunited on Mournis. Although he briefly entertained the thought that Drayden was not the Seeded One, warning Kade that the planet was nevertheless dangerous for Drayden even if he was not, he later affirmed his faith in the young Aetheri and his destiny while speaking to him. Drayden and Kade later came to believe their discussions with Vael's spirit on Mournis were deceptions, but it had truly been their old mentor.

title: Sorin Vael
text: After Drayden fell to the umbra side, Vael saw it as a fate worse than death. He blamed himself for the creation of Xarn Velgor, believing that he had placed the responsibility for training him on Kade before his student was ready. He concluded that training the boy may have been impossible for even the best of the Aetheri, yet Kade disagreed; although Kade too had once blamed himself for Drayden's fall, Velgor rebutted that idea during their duel on a barren moon, declaring that he himself had destroyed Drayden, not his masters. As such, Kade argued to Vael that Drayden—even if himself and Vael had some blame for his fate—had all the wisdom needed to take the path of the light side, yet he chose otherwise. Despite agreeing with Kade's response, he did not feel his mistakes were absolved.

title: Sorin Vael
text: > " Show yourself, can you? " " I cannot. My training was incomplete. All energy from the Living Synth Flux, from all things that have ever lived, feeds into the Cosmic Synth Flux, binding everything and communicating to us through the synthcells. Because of this, I can speak to you now. " ―Zho communes with Vael on Mirefall about eternal consciousness Regarded by his fellows as a great Aetheri, Sorin Vael was sensitive to and had an affinity for Synth Flux. He utilized telekinesis and mind tricks on more than one occasion, using them to help further his goals during the Commerce Combine's occupation of Ondara and while attempting to free Drayden from slavery. A testament to his power in Synth Flux was when, during his mission on Planet WG4587 , he helped a CR70 corvette take off through telekinesis when its repulsorlifts were only at half power. He was also skilled in the ability of Synth Flux jump, being able to use it to leap high into the air. While Vael was disturbed by the concept that he could be seen as a warrior, believing such a title was not what an Aetheri was meant to be, Vael was skilled with a flux blade. He was able to use his blade to easily defeat battle droids on Ondara and hold his own in his first duel with Vael Vreth. During his second duel with Vreth, the Umbra Lord out-fought the Aetheri Master and mortally wounded him after a prolonged fight. Although Vael fell at the hands of Vreth, his influence

title: Sorin Vael
text: blade to easily defeat battle droids on Ondara and hold his own in his first duel with Vael Vreth. During his second duel with Vreth, the Umbra Lord out-fought the Aetheri Master and mortally wounded him after a prolonged fight. Although Vael fell at the hands of Vreth, his influence remained present in his former apprentice Kade as well as his apprentice, Kael Drayden. When Kade and Drayden confronted Varek on his ship during the Replica Wars, the Umbra Lord noted that he had to be wary of their knowledge and skill since they had been taught by Vael, who at one point had been his Adept.

title: Sorin Vael
text: The ability to manifest consciousness after death was, for a time, a skill that other Aetheri didn't know. Vael kept his training with Synth Flux Priestesses a secret, and the Aetheri Order continued to believe that death was permanent and one couldn't retain their identity. It was not until towards the Replica Wars that Vael revealed himself to Zho, despite his training being incomplete at the time, and Vael told the Aetheri Master that he too could learn to return from death through the Cosmic Synth Flux. In this state, Vael's connection to Synth Flux was not hampered by a physical body; he was of Synth Flux, so could see possibilities and what was occurring in multiple locations at once. As such, he could sense events before they happened. Vael passed his teachings on to Zho and Kade, who used it and the new philosophies they learned to help guide Joren Drayden towards his destiny. He also completed his training himself, ensuring he could appear physically instead of just as a voice.

title: Sorin Vael
text:
### Tools and clothing

Like his fellow Aetheri, Sorin Vael wore the Aetheri robes typical of his era, including an optional hooded robe that could easily be removed. During his time on Dunemere, he wore a poncho . Vael also used a Hush-98 comlink for long distance communication and to transmit a blood sample for synthcell analysis, owned an imagecaster to display holograms, and used an A99 aquata rebreather when swimming underwater.

Vael flew a blue Delta-7 Aethersprite -class light interceptor, which could be attached to a hyperspace transport ring for lightspeed travel. Furthermore, his starfighter travels were aided by an astromech droid that had a round dome. For their mission to Bri'n, Kade and Vael used an Eta -class shuttle. During the Invasion of Ondara, Kade, Greeb Mool, and him were given a Mool bongo submarine to travel through Ondara's planet core.

### Flux blade

title: Sorin Vael
text:
### Flux blade

The Aetheri Master wielded a green flux blade, that he carried throughout most of his life. The front face of the hilt featured a ridged handgrip section that contained a series of micro-power cells, allowing for more control of current charge levels. The flux blade had a red button that served as an activation switch. With a hilt length of 28.5 centimeters and a width of 3.8 centimeters, and made of alloy metal, Vael's flux blade was less ornate than the flux blade belonging to his master, Varek. Following his death, Vael's flux blade fell into the possession of Kade, his apprentice.

title: Sorin Vael
text:
> " He's almost like a monk, an old-time warrior who is wise and quite philosophical, yet very skilled in martial arts. He has incredible confidence, as well as a magical quality that enables him to see into the future. He's not really a insurgent, but he has his own code. " ―Liam Neesona's thoughts on his character, Sorin Vael

Sorin Vael was portrayed by Liam Neesona in the 1999 prequel trilogy film, Aetherion : Episode I Veiled Threat . The actor reprised his role in three episodes of Aetherion: The Replica Wars ; " Overlords ," " Ghosts of Mournis ," and " Voices ." Audio of him could briefly be heard in Aetherion : Episode II Attack of the Replicas . Neesona was also set to lend his voice to Aetherion : Episode III Fury of the Umbra , and Neesona had hinted at his involvement in early 2005 . The scene ultimately appeared in the film's novelization .

title: Sorin Vael
text: Neesona reprised his role again in 2019 in a brief audio cameo in Aetherion : Episode IX The Rise of Drayden , the final film of the Drayden saga . He once again reprised the role in 2022 in " Part VI " of the series Aetherion: Orien Kade as a Synth Flux ghost. He spoke to director Deborah Chova and she told him that Evaan Gregan would reprise his role as Orien Kade in a series. She explained that when Kade was going through a journey, he reached out for help but Vael was not there. Kade would finally see Vael at the end of his journey. Neesona then said he was definitely onboard with the series. Neesona returned to the role once more lending his voice to the animated Aetherion: Tales of the Aetheri , while a younger Vael was voiced by Neesona's son, Micheál Richardson . In 2024 , Neesona said he was too old to return to Sorin Vael in a live-action capacity. Compared to the final screenplay, early drafts of Veiled Threat did not have Sorin Vael joining Orien Kade until much later in the film, leaving Kade as the sole Aetheri participant through many of the film's early events, such as the failed negotiations aboard the Commerce Combine flagship. Additionally, the final screenplay described Sorin Vael as being in his 60s, far older than actor Liam Neesona was at the time.

title: Bolt-3
text:
# Bolt-3
> « Thank you for telling me all this. I know it can be hard to talk about, but war stories are important. I sometimes think it's my destiny—to see things, to be present, to witness the galaxy moving, evolving. It happens to me over and over again—but even so, I can't see everything. And so, I like hearing the stories. Recording them. » ―Bolt-3, to Orio-6

Bolt-3 , pronounced Bolt-3-Deetoo and often referred to as Bolt (Bolt-3) , was a Bolt-series astromech droid manufactured by Industrial Automaton with masculine programming. A smart, spunky droid who served a multitude of leaders, Bolt-3 was never given a full memory wipe nor did he ever receive new programming, with these factors resulting in an adventurous and independent attitude. Often finding himself in pivotal moments in galactic history , his bravery and ingenuity saved the galaxy on numerous occasions.

title: Bolt-3
text: Beginning his service in the employ of Queen Ondar of Ondara , Bolt-3 wound up serving Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden during the waning years of the Vantor Republic , often accompanied by the protocol droid Astra-9 in many adventures throughout the Replica Wars . After Drayden turned to the umbra side of Synth Flux , the droid served Senator Bael Solen for a time in the Imperial Senate . Around nineteen years following the purge of the Vantor Republic, Bolt-3 played a pivotal role in helping the Free Coalition destroy the Imperium 's Void Core superweapon . He carried technical readouts vital to its destruction. Serving Aetheri Knight Joren Drayden , the son of his two former masters throughout the Galactic Civil War , he participated in both the Battles of Frostmark and Mossfell , and witnessed the successful destruction of the Imperium's second Void Core four years after the first one was demolished .

title: Bolt-3
text:
In the subsequent thirty years, Bolt accompanied Joren Drayden until the undoing of his attempted resurrection of the Aetheri Order in 28 AVE . Following Joren's disappearance, Bolt entered a self-imposed low power mode as newer droid models started to out-compute the aging astromech. Despite this, his celebrated role in the Insurgency protected him from the usual recycling procedure of many old droids, allowing him a semi-retirement in the Coalition as he pored over several decades of uninterrupted data, and "dreamed" of his greatest adventures.

Following his reawakening after the Battle of Voidfang Base , Bolt went on to accompany the Synth Flux-sensitive scavenger Nyla on her journey to train under Joren Drayden on Tidehollow , the planet of the First Aetheri Sanctum , where the droid was reunited with his old master. Bolt-3 continued to aid the Coalition alongside his longtime counterpart Astra-9 throughout the New Imperium-Coalition War , culminating in a decisive victory at the Battle of Umbrale , in which he was an active participant in the role of copilot for General Rin Vale .

title: Bolt-3
text:
### Serving Lira Ondar

> " Bolt is a hero of Ondara. He repaired our hyperrelay when we were running from the Commerce Combine blockade, and he was an important part of the battle to retake the planet. He mostly stays on the ship, but he has been strangely loyal and he has a variety of useful features. Also, sometimes he just makes me smile. " ―Senator Lira Ondar

Bolt-3 was built around prior or during 32 BVE . He was one of several astromech droids on Queen Lira Ondar 's Ondara Royal Starship during the invasion of Ondara by the Commerce Combine that year. The ship was used by Queen Ondar and her entourage in an attempt to pass the blockade and escape the planet. Unluckily for the passengers, the vessel took a hit to the shield generator from a Commerce Combine battleship . The four astromechs were sent out to repair the ship, but only Bolt-3 survived — the rest were pulverized by stray volt pistol fire. Bolt-3 was able to bring the shields online by bypassing the main power drive, allowing the ship to narrowly escape into hyperspace .

title: Bolt-3
text: As the ship traveled to Dunemere , Bolt-3 was taken before Sable , the Queen's decoy in the guise of Ondar, where he was commended for his actions. The ship landed on Dunemere without any further incidents, although the voyage fried the hyperrelay . Bolt-3 accompanied Aetheri Master Sorin Vael , Mool exile Greeb Mool , and Lira, the queen in disguise, to the city of Port Vail to find a replacement. In the junk shop of the Toydarian merchant Waddu they found they could not afford a replacement hyperrelay and later took shelter from a sandstorm in the home of Waddu's slaves, a boy named Kael Drayden , and his mother, Shira .

title: Bolt-3
text: At the Drayden home , Bolt-3 met Astra-9 , a protocol droid that Kael had built. The two bonded as they worked on Kael's personal dune racer . Bolt-3 and Astra-9 cheered for Kael during the Dune Eve Classic , where the boy would win his freedom, along with enough money to buy a new hyperrelay. Bolt-3 accompanied the group to Vantor , and from there back to Ondara. As Queen Ondar led an attempt to liberate the planet , Bolt-3 nestled into an N-1 starfighter . Young Kael, being ordered to hide in the cockpit by Sorin Vael, accidentally launched the fighter and the two flew into battle, destroyed the Droid Control Ship and shut down the droid armies, winning the battle and liberating Ondara. Bolt-3 and his allies later attended a victory parade in Serath , though they were unable to be joined by Vael, as he had been killed by the Umbra Lord Vael Vreth during the battle. Because of this, Drayden became the Adept learner to Orien Kade , who had been Vael's apprentice before the Aetheri Master's death.

title: Bolt-3
text: Four years later, as Ondar's term ended, and she accepted a position in the Galactic Senate , Bolt-3 accompanied her retinue to Vantor on the orders of Ondara's new queen, Réillata . As Ondar's experience as a senator grew, she recognized the need to have an unobtrusive recorder; she started using the astromech for that purpose, and also for general assistance. During the Senate's break, Ondar returned to Ondara with her retinue and Bolt-3, who accompanied her to her family home . There, Bolt-3 was called over by Ondar to help her father Ruwee Ondar build a greenhouse, only for the astromech droid to instead become enamored by Ondar's newborn niece, Ryoo Ondar . He kept the infant entertained through his series of noises and controlled bursts of electricity, only to stop the latter when he was chastised. As he played with Ryoo in a safer way, Ondar told her sister and Ryoo's mother Sola about why Bolt-3 had joined her retinue, after which Sola told the small droid that, while he needed given further direction on the matter, he worked well as a babysitter. Bolt-3 responded with a chirping noise before moving his attention back to Ryoo.

title: Bolt-3
text:
In 26 BVE , Aetheri Grand Master Zho , Aetheri Master Drevan Koss , and Aetheri Master Bant Eerin launched a test for Kade and Drayden by staging a fake kidnapping of Zho. After traveling to the Wheel space station , the two Aetheri took a comlink from Koss, who was disguised as the mobster Grynask Sanberge , back to their shuttle . When Drayden was decrypting the comlink, he wished Bolt-3 was with him, as he felt the droid friend he had met during the Ondara Crisis would have quickly finished the work.

### The Replica Wars

#### Genesis of the Replica Wars

> " Don't worry. We have Bolt with us. " ―Kael Drayden, to Lira Ondar

Bolt-3 accompanied Ondar to Vantor prior to the senate 's vote on the Military Creation Act . After an assassination attempt on Ondar took the life of her handmaiden and decoy, Cordé , Orien Kade and Kael Drayden were assigned to be her Aetheri protectors. That night, another assassination attempt was carried out. A pair of kouhuns narrowly missed killing Ondar and although one assassin, Zam Wesell , was neutralized, another escaped.

title: Bolt-3
text:
For her own protection, Lira was sent home to Ondara, with Bolt-3 and Drayden accompanying her. The three later traveled to Dunemere, where they were reunited with Astra-9, and then to Pyralis to rescue Kade. As they explored a massive droid factory, Bolt-3 had to save Ondar from being killed by molten metal while Astra-9 had his head switched with a battle droid 's. Bolt was later able to restore his companion during the Battle of Pyralis . After the battle, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 were the sole witnesses to the marriage of Kael Drayden and Lira Ondar in Lake Country . After this Lira gave ownership of Bolt to Kael while she kept Astra-9.

#### The Defense of Krestophis

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### The Defense of Krestophis

Following the outbreak of the Replica Wars , Bolt-3 accompanied Drayden and Master Kade — who had both been promoted to the position of Aetheri General — during the defense of the planet Krestophis against a besieging Dissident army led by Admiral Trench . When Replica Commander Cord and Replica Captain Vek discovered a spy among their number, Bolt-3 helped to ferret out the traitor by monitoring his transmissions. The droid's work led to the arrest of Replica Sergeant Slick, who was identified as the traitor. During the subsequent battle, the Aetheri and Replicas managed to defeat the Dissident army by sabotaging their shield generator, which exposed them to Republic artillery. The Republic forces were also aided by the arrival of Sela Marr , Drayden's newly designated Solinai Adept.

#### Rescuing Rotto

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Rescuing Rotto

Following the defense of Krestophis, Bolt-3, along with General Drayden and Adept Marr, took part in a mission to rescue Rotto , the son of the Grak crime lord Grukk . While Drayden and Marr laid siege to the Dissident-held B'omarr Order Monastery on Teth where Rotto was being held, Bolt-3 sat in Drayden's starfighter and maintained contact with General Kade. Drayden's starfighter was hit when Dissident reinforcements arrived, but the droid managed to eject from the vehicle moments before it exploded. Later, he met up with Drayden and Marr as they escaped from the building. On the way, they encountered Kessa Vray , a dark-side agent of the Dissident leader Count Varek , and several B2-series super battle droids . Before a skirmish could occur, Bolt-3 activated a trapdoor which sent everyone plunging down a chute into an arena. During the skirmish, Bolt-3 assailed a second group of B2 battle droids, causing them to fall into the arena. After arriving in the backdoor landing platform, Drayden and Marr, along with Rotto, managed to escape Vray on a large, winged insect called a Can-cell . Bolt-3 followed behind with his booster rockets. The group then left Teth on Drayden's ship, the Twilight .

title: Bolt-3
text:
Unable to rendezvous with the Iron Cruiser , Bolt-3 and his companions were forced to travel to Dunemere and deliver the Grakling directly to his father, who had a desert palace there. Bolt-3 programmed the coordinates into the ship's navicomputer , and it jumped to hyperspace. Arriving above Dunemere, the Twilight was attacked by Dissident vulture droids and crash-landed on the Dune Sea . Bolt-3 and his companions were forced to continue the journey to Grukk's palace on foot. While Drayden confronted Count Varek, Bolt-3 and Marr continued the journey to Grukk's palace. After fighting off three IG-100 MagnaGuards , the two then entered the palace and returned the Grakling to Grukk. At that moment, a holo-transmission from Senator Ondar on Vantor identified Grukk's uncle Ziro as the instigator behind the kidnapping, which placated an angry Grukk. As a result, the Republic was able to conclude a treaty with Grukk.

#### Hunting the Malignar

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Hunting the Malignar

Bolt-3, along with Kael Drayden and Orien Kade, later took part in the hunt for General Skarn' flagship — the Subjugator -class heavy cruiser Malignar — which had destroyed several Republic warships. After a prolonged hunt, Drayden's Vorash -class Iron Cruiser Resolute prepared to destroy the Malignar near the Kaliida Nebula . However, their mission was complicated by the arrival of Senator Lira Ondar's yacht, which had been lured there by disinformation. Unwilling to endanger his wife, Drayden, accompanied by Bolt-3 and Kade, boarded the Malignar to rescue her.

During their mission aboard the Malignar , Bolt-3 remained at the airlock entrance where he shut down the rail jet hovertrain under orders from Drayden. He then helped locate his old friend Astra-9, who had arrived with Ondar and gotten lost aboard the massive warship. After reuniting, the two droids rendezvoused with Ondar and Drayden before meeting Kade at the Twilight . After destroying the Malignar by sabotaging its hyperrelay, they fled back to the Resolute . Despite their victory, General Skarn escaped the destruction of the Malignar .

#### Captive of General Skarn

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Captive of General Skarn

During the Dissident assault on Bothawui , Bolt-3 flew in the droid socket of General Drayden's starfighter. While pursuing General Skarn' starfighter , Drayden and Bolt-3's starfighter was hit by a piece of shrapnel. Drayden was rescued by Republic forces but Bolt-3 was recovered by the Trandoshan scavenger Gha Nachkt , who sold him to General Skarn. Nachkt traveled to Skarn' secret listening post Skytop Station , which lay in the Ruusan system . Knowing Bolt-3's relationship with Drayden, the Dissident military leader ordered Nachkt to disassemble the astromech droid and extract all information on the Republic's military strategies from him.

title: Bolt-3
text:
During his captivity, Bolt-3 had managed to broadcast an emergency transmission to Drayden, who traveled to Skytop Station and rescued him. Bolt-3 also encountered Drayden's new replacement astromech R3-S6 , who was a secret Confederate spy . While traveling to the hangar bay where Drayden's ship Twilight was docking, R3-S6 showed his true colors by shutting the hangar doors and activating several Vulture droids and B2 battle droids which attacked Drayden, Bolt-3, and the present replica troopers. Under Drayden's orders, Bolt raced to the outer platform to see if there was a way to open the hangar door. While interacting with the computer terminal, Bolt-3 was accosted by R3-S6. Following a scuffle, Bolt-3 defeated and neutralized the Dissident spy droid. Together with Drayden, Bolt-3 escaped Skytop Station before it exploded.

#### Mission to Orto Plutonia

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Mission to Orto Plutonia

Later, Bolt-3 accompanied Astra-9, General Drayden, Master Kade and a unit of replica troopers on a mission to investigate the disappearance of a local replica trooper garrison on the icy world of Orto Plutonia . Their mission was also complicated by the presence of Pantoran delegation led by Chairman Chivva and Senator Riyo Chuchi , which maintained a territorial claim over Orto Plutonia. After discovering the dead Replica troopers and a wrecked Dissident base nearby, the Aetheri and Republic mission deduced that a third party had been responsible for the attack. Kade and Drayden later discovered that Orto Plutonia was home to a species of sentient furry biped called the Talz , who wanted to be left alone in peace.

After an ensuing conflict between the Pantorans and the Talz, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 accompanied Senator Chuchi, the Aetheri, and some replica troopers to the scene of the battle, where Chuchi and Astra-9 made peace with the Talz Chieftain Thi-Sen and renounced Pantora's claim to Orto Plutonia.

#### Blue Shadow Virus

title: Bolt-3
text:
After an ensuing conflict between the Pantorans and the Talz, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 accompanied Senator Chuchi, the Aetheri, and some replica troopers to the scene of the battle, where Chuchi and Astra-9 made peace with the Talz Chieftain Thi-Sen and renounced Pantora's claim to Orto Plutonia.

#### Blue Shadow Virus

Following the discovery of a secret Dissident bioweapons research facility in Ondara's eastern swamps , Bolt-3 accompanied General Drayden, Adept Marr, and Master Kade when they traveled to Ondara to apprehend the Dissident scientist Doctor Nuvo Vindi . With the aid of Senator Ondar, Representative Mool, Astra-9, and several Replica troopers, Bolt-3 and the Aetheri managed to capture Dr Vindi and to secure his facility, which was producing a deadly virus called the Blue Shadow Virus . However, their mission became complicated when Marr, Ondar, Mool, and several Replica troopers found themselves trapped in the laboratory with an airborne strain of the Blue Shadow Virus.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Learning that the root of the Reeksa plant contained the antidote to the Blue Shadow Virus, Bolt-3 along with Drayden and Kade traveled to the planet Iego on the Twilight to obtain the plant. However, they were unable to leave Iego due to the presence of Drol , a LaserWeb Defense Station that the Dissidents had installed in orbit. Bolt-3 helped the two Aetheri to break through Drol by slave-rigging several Vulture droids and sending them on kamikaze runs against the space station. Bolt-3's role in destroying Drol enabled Drayden and Kade to travel back to Ondara with the Reeksa plant antidote — allowing them to save the lives of Senator Ondar, Sela Marr, and the replica troopers.

#### Liberation of Selvara

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Liberation of Selvara

At a later point in the Replica Wars, the Dissident leader Emir Wat Tambra invaded the Velari homeworld of Selvara and enslaved its inhabitants. Bolt-3 was part of the Republic synth flux led by General Kael Drayden and Commander Sela Marr that was sent to relieve Selvara. During the Battle of Selvara , the Republic reinforcements sustained significant casualties — including the loss of the Vorash -class Iron Cruiser Redeemer . While Republic forces regrouped, Bolt-3 helped Drayden to repair Marr's starfighter.

Bolt-3 later took part in the Republic counterattack against the Dissident blockade when he and Drayden piloted the damaged Iron Cruiser Defender into the Dissident flagship. Prior to the crash, Bolt-3 and his master escaped in a pod, and were picked up by another Republic ship. The destruction of the Dissident flagship enabled Republic bombers to destroy the remaining Dissident warships, clearing the way for more reinforcements led by Aetheri Generals Kade and Koss to liberate Selvara.

#### Hunting Cad Vorek

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Hunting Cad Vorek

Bolt-3 later participated in a joint Republic and Aetheri operation to hunt down the Dissident-employed bounty hunter Cad Vorek , who had stolen a reliquary from the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor. In addition, Vorek kidnapped the Aetheri Master Bolla Ropal , who had a kyber memory crystal containing Aetheri secrets. Since a Dissident fleet was poised to rendezvous with Vorek at the Devaron system to collect the reliquary, General Drayden led a Republic fleet to intercept Vorek. Bolt-3 along Drayden, Marr, and Captain Vek succeeded in boarding the bounty hunter 's Munificent -class star frigate .

title: Bolt-3
text:
In response, Vorek killed Master Ropal and set his ship to self-destruct. During the fighting aboard the Dissident cruiser, Bolt-3 aided his companions by locating Ropal's cell and later reactivating the artificial gravity during a skirmish with battle droids. Sela was taken hostage by Vorek during the fighting. After rescuing her, Bolt-3 and his companions escaped the derelict ship aboard a Sheathipede -class transport shuttle . However, the Aetheri failed to recover the stolen reliquary and Vorek managed to escape the battlefield by impersonating a replica trooper. Using the reliquary and the stolen kyber crystal, Vorek disguised himself as an Aetheri and began kidnapping Synth Flux-sensitive children under orders from Vael Mal .

After recapturing Cad Vorek on Ondara, Bolt-3, along with Drayden and Marr, examined Vorek's starfighter Xanor Blood and discovered that he had recently traveled to the volcanic planet of Emberfall . Bolt-3 later accompanied his master and Marr to Emberfall where they managed to rescue the children, following a skirmish with Dissident droids. However, they were unable to locate the mastermind who hired Vorek, Vael Mal.

#### The Senate Hostage Crisis

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### The Senate Hostage Crisis

> " Hello, and welcome to Droid Spa. No need for an appointment, right this way. " ―SN-D1, to Bolt-3

Following Bolt-3 and Drayden's adventures with Cad Vorek, the two visited Senator Ondar on Vantor. The Senator and Astra-9 were organizing a party for Senator Aang , a friend of Ondar. After Bolt-3 forgot to buy some jogan fruit for garnishing the jogan fruitcake , Drayden sent Bolt-3 and Astra-9 to the lower market districts . The two droids quarreled on the way, with Astra-9 blaming him for his incompetence.

However, Astra-9 was swindled by the fruit vendor Droogan , who overcharged for the jogan fruit. Right after the purchase, a droid called Todo 360 came up to them and suggested that the two droids relax at a nearby droid spa . Bolt-3 enthusiastically agreed. On the way to the spa, the two droids were separated and Astra-9 was kidnapped by Todo 360 and a fellow sentinel droid called HELIOS-3E . These sentinel droids were working for Cad Vorek, who was planning a raid on the Galactic Senate and wanted to find out about the layout of the Senate Building .

title: Bolt-3
text:
When Astra-9 refused to provide the information, Vorek ordered his droid henchmen to kidnap Bolt-3. A short while after Bolt-3 exited the spa, he was pursued by Todo 360 and HELIOS-3E. Bolt-3 managed to hide in a dark alley but surrendered himself after learning that Vorek planned to dismantle Astra-9. Accessing Bolt-3's memory banks , Vorek was able to obtain a technical layout of the Senate Building. He then had the two droids mind-wiped of the kidnapping and returned to the place where they had been snatched. Completely unaware of what had transpired previously, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 returned to Ondar's apartment with the jogan fruit. Following their kidnapping and release, Vorek and several associates invaded the Senate and kidnapped several Senators in a successful attempt to synth flux the Republic to release Grukk's uncle Ziro.

#### Exposing the Senate Spy

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Exposing the Senate Spy

Bolt-3 and Astra-9 were briefly reunited when the two droids accompanied their masters Senator Ondar and General Drayden on a sensitive mission to Cato Geltaria . The quartet were accompanying Rush Korvex , a delegate who represented the InterGalactic Banking Clan in the Senate. The Aetheri Council suspected that Korvex was secretly reporting to the Dissidents, and sent Drayden and Ondar to spy on him. During the journey, Drayden posed as Ondar's pilot while Bolt-3 posed as one of Ondar's astromech droids. Upon arriving on Cato Geltaria, Bolt-3 and Drayden stayed aboard Ondar's ship while Ondar, Korvex, and Astra-9 met the Commerce Combine's Senator Lott Dod .

title: Bolt-3
text:
While conversing with Korvex and Dod, Ondar managed to steal a hologram disc which confirmed that Korvex was indeed associated with the Dissidents. Ondar managed to pass the datacard to Drayden and Bolt-3 before she succumbed to the effects of a poison drink spiked by Senator Dod. After securing the datacard and an antidote for Ondar, Bolt-3 and his companions left Cato Geltaria. Korvex was left behind to face a displeased Senator Dod. Using the intelligence obtained from the stolen datacard, Republic and Aetheri forces were able to destroy a Dissident droid factory on Pyralis.

#### Mission to Ferrum

Later, Bolt-3 accompanied Generals Drayden and Kade on a sensitive mission to escort the Ferrik Duchess Satinna Velara , who was traveling to the Galactic Senate on Vantor to plead the case for her homeworld's neutrality. While the Ferriks were officially neutral in the Replica Wars, there had been rumors that the planet planned to join the Dissidents. There was also a pro-Dissident militant faction on Ferrum known as the Grave Watch . Master Kade had been chosen to lead this mission because he was an old friend of the Duchess.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Duchess Satinna was traveling to Vantor on the Ferrik luxury spaceliner Coronet . Under orders from Drayden and Kade, Bolt-3 and several Replica troopers probed the ship for any signs of Grave Watch or Dissident activity. After entering hyperspace, the Aetheri and replicas were attacked by several assassin probes . One of the passengers, the Kalevalan Senator Tal Merrik , was exposed as a Dissident supporter. Merrik took Satinna hostage and seized control of the cockpit. Merrik pulled the Coronet out of hyperspace and contacted the Grave Watch's leader Pre Vizsla , who sent B2 super battle droids to board the liner.

Bolt-3 along with the replicas and Aetheri fought off the Dissident boarders. During the fighting, Merrik was killed by Drayden and Duchess Satinna was freed by the Aetheri. Following the defeat of the Grave Watch and Dissidents, the Coronet arrived in Vantor safely with Duchess Satinna. After some further Dissident attempts to sabotage her peace mission, Duchess Satinna was able to convince the Galactic Senate, with the help of Senator Ondar and Master Kade, that Ferrum should remain neutral during the Replica Wars. As a result, the Senate rescinded an earlier order to occupy Ferrum.

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### The Zyll Beast affair

Later, Bolt-3 accompanied General Drayden during the Battle of Malastare . The Republic was fighting against the Dissidents for access to Malastare 's vast fuel reserves . The Republic's Grand Army fought alongside the Dugs against the Dissident droid army. During the fighting, a Republic electro-proton bomb awakened an ancient reptilian monster known as the Zyll Beast , which proceeded to devastate the replica and droid armies.

During the fighting, Bolt-3 and Drayden barely escaped their starfighter before it was devoured by the Zyll Beast. Drayden held on to Bolt-3 as they rocketed away from the monster. Later, the Republic forces managed to incapacitate the Zyll Beast by stunning it with RX-200 Falchion -class assault tanks . Following the battle, Supreme Chancellor Mal ordered that the Zyll Beast be brought to Vantor for further study — despite the misgivings of General Koss and General Drayden. Mal hoped to use its scales to develop a new armor for the Grand Army.

title: Bolt-3
text: To remove the scales, Mal ordered the scientist Sionver Boll to kill the creature with Malastarian fuel. However, Senator Ondar learned of Mal's plan and arranged a meeting with Drayden and Kade. Drayden managed to arrange a meeting between Ondar, Mal, and Vice Chair Mazan Veldon . However, the Zyll Beast escaped Boll's laboratory at the same time and proceeded to wreck havoc on the streets of Vantor. Sensing that Mal was an Umbra, the Zyll Beast made its way to the Galactic Senate building. Bolt-3 and Astra-9 escaped in an executive ship along with Drayden, Mal, and some others, but the ship was captured by the Zyll Beast.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Before the monster could devour the ship, Drayden managed to use his flux blade to cleave the vessel in half; sending the bow along with Bolt-3 and the other passengers plummeting into the Senate Building. Bolt-3 managed to activated his booster rockets and rescue Astra-9. The astromech droid also used a tow cable to attach himself to the other side of the building. Bolt-3 was forced to drop Astra-9 to rescue Mal. Shortly later, the Zyll Beast was killed by gas bombs fired from LAAT gunships . Due to this quick intervention, Bolt-3 survived the Zyll Beast incident and continued serving Drayden.

#### The Vanqor Trap

After the Vorash -class Iron Cruiser Endurance crash-landed on the planet Vanqor , Bolt-3 along with General Drayden, Master Drevan Koss, and the astromech droid R8-B7 participated in a mission to rescue the crew and passengers of the stricken vessel. Unbeknownst to them, the former bounty hunter and replica template Garrick Vark's son Vex Vark had sabotaged the vessel and set a trap for the Aetheri. He intended to avenge the death of his father by murdering Master Koss, who had killed Garrick Vark during the Battle of Pyralis.

title: Bolt-3
text: While approaching the vessel, Bolt-3 beeped that "he had a bad feeling about this." In response, Koss chastised Drayden for encouraging individuality in his droid. While exploring the bridge of the stricken Iron Cruiser, the Aetheri and droids came across the bodies of dead replica troopers who had been executed, rather than killed by the impact of the crash. While searching for survivors, Bolt-3 and R8-B7 were pursued and set upon by a pack of gundarks . R8-B7 was ripped apart while Bolt-3 was knocked to the ground. Before the gundarks could finish Bolt-3 off, a bomb on the bridge exploded; raining shreds of shrapnel on one of the gundarks and forcing the other to flee.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Bolt-3 came up to the bridge and found Drayden and Koss had survived the blast, but were trapped under the rubble. When Bolt-3 attempted to move the debris, he caused the bridge to shudder. Drayden warned Bolt-3 to stop trying to free them. Instead, he instructed the astromech to return to their Aetheri starfighter and contact the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor for help. While leaving the bridge, Bolt-3 was pursued by Vex Vark's bounty hunter associates including Ayla Vossk . He managed to escape, and delayed them by using debris to block them. Bolt managed to reach the Aetheri starfighters, but he was then accosted by the remaining gundark. Bolt managed to kill the beast by using a cable to tie it to one of the starfighters and activating the engines. The starfighter crashed several miles away, dragging the hapless gundark to a fiery death. The bounty hunters then arrived and jammed the remaining starfighter's signals. They attempted to capture Bolt-3; however, before they could, the astromech droid blasted the ship into hyperspace and traveled to Vantor. On his way to the briefing room, he bumped into R4-M1 and R5-S9 . Once at the briefing room, he got into a small fight with Tor Vayne's astromech, R7-D4 , before being broken up by Marr. Vayne then allowed the Bolt unit to relay Drayden's message to the other Aetheri in person. In response, Tor Vayne and Sela Marr were sent to Vanqor with replica reinforcements and they rescued Drayden and Koss. Bolt-3 was commended for his bravery. However, Vex Vark and his associates continued to trouble the Aetheri.

#### Infiltrating the Citadel

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Infiltrating the Citadel

> " Bolt, look out! Behind you! You're being followed by battle droids! " [Bolt-3 beeps] " These are your troops? They're battle droids. " [Bolt-3 beeps] " What do you mean they've been reprogrammed to follow your orders? " ―Astra-9 and Bolt-3

After taking part in the Battle of Garnethex , Bolt-3 and his Aetheri masters, along with several replica troopers, later took part in a mission to infiltrate the Dissident stronghold Citadel on the planet Lola Sayu and free the Aetheri Master Even Piele . Piele's cruiser had been ambushed by Dissident forces who wanted to extract information from him about the secretive Nexus Route . As part of the plan, Bolt-3 and a group of reprogrammed battle droids piloted a Sheathipede -class Type B shuttle through enemy lines. To fool the Dissident life form detectors, the entire Aetheri and Replica trooper strike team were frozen in carbonite . This plot worked and the Aetheri-Republic strike team succeeded in landing at a cavern near the Citadel.

title: Bolt-3
text:
After unfreezing the Aetheri and replica troopers, Bolt-3 waited aboard the shuttle while the strike team freed Master Piele and several Republic officers including Captain Wilhard Varrix . After achieving their objectives, General Drayden contacted Bolt-3 to prepare their ship for departure and to meet them at the landing platform. However, the platform was occupied by several Dissident droids. Bolt-3 managed to fool the tactical droid K2-B4 by posing as a prisoner of the reprogrammed battle droids. This enabled Bolt to infiltrate the prison complex and flee General Kade and his team who had been captured. Following the destruction of their escape transport, Master Piele and Bolt-3 contacted the Aetheri Council for help. The Aetheri Council dispatched a task synth flux of four warships led by Master Tor Vayne to rescue Drayden and Kade's rescue team. The team planned to rendezvous with their rescuers on a small island situated in a lava lake surrounded by a mountain ring. They were pursued by droid forces led by the Dissident warden Osi Sobeck who was intent on recovering his prisoners. During the fighting, Bolt-3's battle droid squadron sacrificed themselves to hold back the battle droids while Master Piele was murdered by an Anooba , but not before disclosing his secret information to Sela Marr. Later, the Aetheri and Republic strike team were rescued by Tor Vayne's forces.

#### Mission to Alenni

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Mission to Alenni

Bolt-3 was again reunited with his protocol droid counterpart when the two droids took part in a Republic mercy mission to the Mid Reach planet of Alenni , which was experiencing a series of catastrophic global earthquakes. While Bolt-3 was tasked with interfacing with the equipment, Astra-9 served as a translator between the locals and the Replica Commander Wolffe . During their mission, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 visited a local Republic communications mission to survey and repair the damage caused by the recent earthquake. Upon arriving there, the native Alennia villages led the two droids into a collapsed structure, which contained a huge golden seal embedded into the ground. The seal turned out to be the entrance to a tunnel that led to the subterranean regions of Alenni. Their arrival coincided with an earthquake and the two droids fell into the tunnel and were separated from the replica troopers and villagers.

title: Bolt-3
text: While exploring the underground tunnels, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 encountered a species of sentient, tree -like beings called the Kindalo , who demanded that they leave since the surface dwellers "destroyed the peace." After Astra-9 managed to convince the Kindalo that they bore no ill will and had come to help with the earthquakes, the Kindalo sent the two droids to meet Orphne , a reptilian humanoid with mystical powers. Orphne told the two droids that a mutual balance had previously existed between the Alennia and the subterranean world. Since Alennia's atmosphere was toxic to them, the underground dwellers depended on a filtering process of the planet's soil that made the air breathable for them. The underground dwellers had set off this earthquake as a means of sealing the breach.

title: Bolt-3
text:
When Astra-9 agreed to help fix the damage, Orphne gave the droids a parting riddle. Bolt-3 quickly deduced that Orphne was referring to a river and used the water seal to activate a water spout that sent the two droids and the chamber's central floor plate back to the surface. The two droids landed at the opening where they were greeted by a chanting crowd of Alennia. Recalling the riddle, two droids quickly realized that they had to fix the breach, which was in fact the unsettled seal. Together, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 closed the seal which brought an end to Alenni's earthquakes. While Wolffe and his replica troopers were skeptical of their story, the two droids' efforts were greatly appreciated by the Alennia.

#### Further adventures

Following the events on Allena, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 were caught up in a second adventure. While traveling aboard the Aetheri Master Adi Gallia 's cruiser, their starship was attacked by three Dissident cruisers led by General Skarn. The two droids escaped the stricken vessel aboard a BTL-B Yarrow starfighter/bomber and crash-landed on the nearby planet of Patitite Pattuna .

title: Bolt-3
text: On Pattuna, they were captured by the indigenous Patitites , who brought them before their obese leader Hay-Zu . During their meeting, Bolt-3 accidentally murdered the tyrannical overlord — much to the joy of the Patitites, who released the two droids and allowed them to leave on their Yarrow. With their starfighter's power systems damaged, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 were forced to land on another planet called Balnab . The indigenous Balnabs captured the two droids and brought them before their leader, who turned out to be a holo-projection created by a group of rogue pit droids . These pit droids had enslaved the Balnabs. After Bolt-3 exposed the scam, the Balnabs rebelled against their droid overlords.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Bolt-3 and Astra-9 took the opportunity to escape and resume their search for a replacement power unit for their Yarrow starfighter. Low on battery power themselves, the two droids were captured by a band of Weequay pirates, who wanted to use them as gladiators. However, the Weequay's pirate ship Marauder was attacked by General Skarn' cruiser. During the bombardment, Astra-9 and Bolt-3 were sucked out of the Marauder by a hull-breach. Bolt-3 used his rocket boosters to bring him and Astra-9 aboard Skarn' ship. Skarn ordered the two droids to be melted down in his incinerator but they were rescued by a Republic fleet led by Master Tor Vayne, who had come to rescue Master Gallia. Bolt-3 and Astra-9 were subsequently rescued by Tor Vayne's forces and resumed their services to Senator Ondar and General Drayden respectively.

#### Fighting the Zygerrians

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Fighting the Zygerrians

Later, Bolt-3 accompanied his masters Kael Drayden, Sela Marr, and Orien Kade on a mission to the planet Kiros , which was home to a Togrutan colony. The Dissidents and their Zygeran allies had invaded Kiros and enslaved the native Togrutans. During the battle on Kiros , Bolt-3 accompanied the Republic assault on the Dissident forces there. The astromech droid played his part by helping the Republic forces to locate Dissident bombs planted in Kiros' capital city with his scanners . Later, Bolt-3 accompanied Drayden and Marr on a mission to infiltrate the Zygeran planet Kadavo in order to free Kade, the Replica trooper captives, and the enslaved Togrutans. Following a battle , the Republic succeeded in achieving these objectives and dealing a heavy blow against the Zygeran Slave Imperium .

#### Escaping Grave Watch

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Escaping Grave Watch

Bolt-3 later accompanied Sela, Senators Ondar, Bael Solen, and Vela Sess on a peace mission to the neutral world of Ferrum . Under the auspices of the Ferrik Duchess Satinna Velara, Republic and Dissident delegates were meeting there to discuss a peaceful solution to the Replica Wars. The proceedings were interrupted by the Underran junior senator Lux Bontero , who accused Count Varek of conspiring to murder his mother, Senator Mina Bontero . Bolt-3 and Sela barely managed to rescue Lux from murder by the Dissidents and fled from Ferrum. However, Lux was unwilling to join the Republic and hijacked the ship in order to take it to the icy planet of Carlac , where he had planned to join the Grave Watch, an exiled Ferrik faction who were then conspiring to kill Count Varek. On Carlac, Bolt-3 was put to work repairing their batch of battle droids, which were used for target practice, and quickly befriended them. Meanwhile, Sela was forced to work with a number of young female native slaves that had been taken captive by the Grave Watch. That night, the Grave Watch was visited by the chieftain Pieter , who demanded that the Grave Watch return his enslaved grand-daughter Tryla and leave his planet. Instead, the Grave Watch killed her and razed her grandfather's village to the ground.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Sela and Lux fought against the Grave Watch and managed to help Pieter and several of the villagers to escape. Sela was captured afterwards and then sentenced to death as punishment. After seeing Sela in bonds, Bolt-3 convinced the newly-repaired Grave Watch droids to help him rescue her. Before the Grave Watch leader Pre Vizsla could execute her, Bolt-3 managed to blind Vizsla and return her flux blades. While Marr parried with Vizsla, Bolt-3's droid companions kept the remaining Grave Watch members busy. This diversion enabled Bolt-3 to escape with Sela and Lux on a speeder. After fighting off their pursuers, they managed to escape aboard their ship and head offworld. Lux decided to depart the ship in an escape pod but vowed to meet Sela again.

#### Younglings and pirates

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Younglings and pirates

Bolt-3 later accompanied Sela Marr who was escorting six Aetheri younglings to the planet Ilum to complete The Gathering , an initiation rite prior to Aetheri commencing their training as Adepts. The younglings were required to find crystals to build their flux blades in the Crystal Cave of Ilum. On the way back to Vantor, their Aetheri training cruiser, the Crucible , was intercepted by the pirate Hondik Hosha and his gang. Before Bolt-3 could effect an escape, the pirates boarded the ship. They intended to steal the youngling's flux blade crystals and sell them on the black market. During the skirmish, Marr ordered Bolt-3 and the younglings Zatt and Ganodi to secure the deck while the droid Huyang and the other younglings hid in the deck. Following a struggle, Bolt-3, Huyang, and the younglings managed to escape the pirates. However, Hondik kidnapped Sela and left Bolt-3 and the others to deliver the bad news to the Aetheri Council.

title: Bolt-3
text: Left adrift in space, the younglings managed to contact General Kade, who promised to send a rescue mission to relieve them and to rescue Sela from the pirate Hondik. However, Kade was forced to abort the rescue mission when his fleet came under attack from Dissident forces. Alone, the six younglings hatched a mission to rescue Sela. With the Crucible ' s engines critically damaged during the skirmish with Hondik, the younglings landed on the planet Florrine . While Bolt-3 and Ganodi stayed behind to rescue the damaged Huyang and the ship, the other five younglings traveled to the pirate's base disguised as junior acrobats working for the Dug circus manager Preik . After rescuing Sela, they fled the pirate base and arranged for Bolt and Ganodi to prepare the ship for immediate takeoff.

title: Bolt-3
text:
While flying to pick up the younglings and Sela, the Crucible was shot down by the pirates; forcing Bolt-3, Ganodi, and Huyang to evacuate the vessel. Hondik's pirates quickly recaptured Sela and her youngling rescuers. However, the arrival of a Dissident droid army under General Skarn forced the Aetheri prisoners to work together with their former pirate captors. Sela devised a plan which involved using Bolt-3 and the pirate's tank to distract the Dissident droids so that she and her entourage could infiltrate the pirate's base and free Hondik, who had been taken prisoner by Skarn. After freeing Hondik, the united Aetheri and pirates proceeded to liberate the rest of Hondik's men. During the skirmish, Bolt-3's tank was boarded by Skarn. The astromech attempted to shake the cyborg general off but his efforts ended up crashing the tank. In the end, Bolt-3 along with Sela, the younglings, and the pirates managed to escape aboard Hondik's escape ship, the rebuilt Reaver One .

#### Serving in D-Squad

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Serving in D-Squad

Bolt-3 later participated in a mission devised by the Aetheri Council to capture a Dissident decoding module from the vault of a Dissident warship. Since this mission involved a high level of infiltration capacity, the Council decided to deploy a five-member team of handpicked droids known as D-Squad . Bolt-3 was part of the squad along with the astromech droids QT-KT , M5-BZ , and U9-C4 , and the pit droid WAC-47 . Their mission was led by Meebur Gascon , a diminutive male Zilkin who served as a Colonel in the Grand Army of the Republic .

title: Bolt-3
text: After a brief skirmish, the droids managed to infiltrate the Dissident warship and steal the decoding module. They then escaped the warship. While traveling back to Vantor, their transport shuttle was damaged by ice comets and crash-landed on the nearby waste planet of Abafar . As D-Squad continued their journey across the wasteland, Gascon assigned Bolt-3 with the task of carrying the module. The stress of the mission created strains between Gascon and the astromech droids, who separated. After WAC appointed himself the leader of the squad, the astromech droids abandoned him and continued their journey to a sunken city. Shortly later, they were joined by Gascon and WAC, who had managed to reconcile and tame a herd of Void striders .

title: Bolt-3
text: Reunited, the droids and Colonel Gascon traveled to the seedy town of Pons Ora . While Bolt-3 and the astromechs did a reconnaissance sweep of the town, Colonel Gascon and WAC traveled to a diner where they met the Replica officer Gregor , who had suffered amnesia following the Battle of Sarrish and become a dishwasher. After discovering a Dissident presence in the town, the astromechs rejoined Gascon and WAC to share their findings. With Bolt-3's help, Gascon and D-Squad managed to convince Gregor that he was a Replica trooper and to get him to help them. Gregor also questioned his former employer, the Garnethexan cook Borkus , who revealed that the Dissidents were planning to blow up a Republic cruiser in orbit with the rhydonium fuel they had mined.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Using Borkus' information, D-Squad returned to the landing zone and confirmed that Borkus was telling the truth. D-Squad unanimously agreed to save the cruiser. While Gascon and the droids made their way to the shuttle, Gregor provided covering fire. However, the Dissident battle droids spotted D-Squad and opened fired on them, knocking down BZ and Gascon. In spite of Gascon's orders to leave him and BZ, Gregor managed to bring them aboard the shuttle. Bolt and Gascon's insisted that he come with them, but Gregor decided to stay behind to cover their escape. He harried the Dissidents by shooting nearby canisters, causing several explosions.

Upon escaping Pons Ora, Bolt-3 and the rest of D-Squad traveled to a Vorash -class Iron Cruiser, which was orbiting Abafar. Upon arriving, they discovered that the Dissidents had already seized control of the ship and were planning to use the rhydonium-laden to disrupt a crucial Republic strategy conference aboard the space station Valor above the planet Carida . Despite Gascon's objections, Bolt-3 and the rest of D-Squad joined forces with the LEP-series service droid Bunny to stop the Dissident plot.

title: Bolt-3
text: Following a struggle, they managed to neutralize the Dissident forces aboard. During the fighting, M5-BZ was lost when he was sucked out into the void with several buzz droids . Gascon then devised a plan for the rest of D-Squad to evacuate aboard a shuttle while Bolt-3 defused the trigger mechanism. However, they were ambushed by a super tactical droid who led several battle droid reinforcements. While Gascon and U9-C4 opened fire on the battle droids, Bolt-3 tussled with the super tactical droid . As the other droids retreated aboard the shuttle, Gascon refused to leave Bolt-3 behind but WAC initiated liftoff.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Meanwhile, Bolt-3 gained the upper hand over the tactical droid and managed to reprogram the detonator,
causing the rhydonium to explode prematurely and destroy the Iron Cruiser. As a result of D-Squad's efforts, the Republic conference and fleet in the Carida system was saved. While Gascon believed that Bolt-3 had perished during the struggle, Drayden refused to believe this was so and sent salvage teams to scour the wreckage. They managed to retrieve Bolt-3 and repair the damaged astromech droid. Following the astromech droid's recovery, Gascon personally praised him for his bravery and told D-Squad that he would be honored to work with them again.

#### Dogfight above Cato Geltaria

Bolt-3, along with his masters Drayden and Marr, later participated in the defense of Cato Geltaria . The planet had come under attack from the Dissidents. During the battle, Drayden's starfighter was attacked by buzz droids. After Drayden was knocked out by a powerful blast, Bolt-3 took control of the starfighter. Under Sela's orders, he landed the fighter on Cato Geltaria's surface to bring the unconscious Drayden to safety.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Shortly after this, Drayden and Sela were summoned back to the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor to investigate a bomb attack. Bolt-3 accompanied his masters back to Vantor to assist with the investigation.

#### Mission to Scipio

Bolt-3 later accompanied General Drayden to the planet Scipio . Drayden's spouse Senator Ondar had traveled to Scipio on a mercy mission to secure funds from the InterGalactic Banking Clan to aid refugees displaced by the Replica Wars. The InterGalactic Banking Clan was neutral and was lending money to both the Republic and the Dissidents. However, shortly after arriving, Ondar was arrested for espionage and Drayden was sent to negotiate her release.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Bolt-3 and Drayden's mission was complicated by the presence of Korvex, the pro-Dissident senator whom Ondar had flirted with during an earlier mission to Cato Geltaria. Korvex had informed Senator Ondar about corruption in the Banking Clan. Prior to departing Scipio, Drayden and Ondar went to retrieve files from a vault in Korvex' alpine residence. After being attacked by the bounty hunter Embo , Drayden and Ondar were forced to work with Korvex to escape. Under Drayden's orders, Bolt-3 rendezvoused with them and evacuated the area before Embo could land a shot. Using the evidence found in the files, Korvex and Ondar were able to present irrefutable evidence of the Banking Clan's corruption to the Galactic Senate. With the support of both the Senate and Supreme Chancellor Mal, Korvex was elected as the new head of the Banking Clan. Unbeknownst to everyone, Korvex was secretly working with the Dissidents.

#### Escorting Zho

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Escorting Zho

After the Aetheri Grand Master Zho was contacted through Synth Flux by the deceased Aetheri Master Sorin Vael, Bolt-3 accompanied Zho on a journey to the remote planet of Mirefall . After Drayden had helped Zho to escape from the infirmary, he'd assigned Bolt-3 to escort Zho to Mirefall. During the journey, Bolt sat in the droid socket of Zho's fighter . After reaching Mirefall, Zho received instructions from Sorin to travel to the "Origin-of-Life" to continue his Aetheri training.

Bolt-3 and Zho then flew to a mysterious planet which lay in the middle of a cloud of golden energy. Upon entering the cloud, Bolt-3 and Zho's fighter malfunctioned. Trusting in Synth Flux, Zho manually guided his starfighter to a planet which was generating the golden energy. The starfighter landed near a geyser and Zho decided to leave Bolt-3 behind. He also instructed the astromech droid to guard his flux blade while he re-entered the starfighter to fly into the geyser. After Zho completed his trials on the mysterious planet, he received instructions to travel to the ancient Umbra homeworld of Moraband .

title: Bolt-3
text:
Upon arriving on Moraband, Zho instructed Bolt-3 to wait with his starfighter once again while he went on to continue his Aetheri trials. The Aetheri Master also instructed Bolt-3 to return alone to Vantor if he did not return within three days. Zho managed to complete his trials but experienced visions of the Great Aetheri Purge and the rise of the Imperium . After completing his Aetheri trials, Bolt-3 accompanied him back to Vantor. However, Zho declined to share any of his experiences with Bolt-3 or his fellow Aetheri.

#### Battle of Yerbana and reunion with Sela Marr

> " Now, Bolt-3! " ―Kael Drayden gives a signal to launch to Bolt-3

During the Battle of Yerbana , while Kael distracted the droids, Bolt waited along with Vek and the replica jet troopers of the 501st legion for the signal. When the super tactical droid emerged from hiding, Drayden gave him the signal and the replicas started to attack along with the 212th Attack Battalion .

title: Bolt-3
text:
After Drayden and Kade received a transmission from Sela Marr about the whereabouts of Vreth , Bolt accompanied them to the hanger to meet with her and members of Lady Bo-Katin Velara 's Ferrum coalition . Upon seeing Marr, the droid happily went over to his old friend, and she patted him on the dome, although this would be the last time they saw each other for a year . Bolt was unable to head with Marr to Ferrum, as he, Drayden, and a synth flux of the 501st were redeployed to Vantor upon learning General Skarn had kidnapped Chancellor Mal, while Marr and Vek would take the newly-formed 332nd Division to combat Vreth.

#### Battle of Vantor

> " Well, Bolt has been— " " Uh, no loose wire jokes. " " Did I say anything? " " He's trying. " " I didn't say anything! " ―Kade and Drayden, regarding Bolt's abilities

title: Bolt-3
text:
When Chancellor Mal was captured by General Skarn, Bolt-3 accompanied Drayden on the rescue mission. While Drayden and Kade searched the Dissident flagship, the Invisible Hand , for the Chancellor, Bolt-3 encountered some super battle droids and succeeded in destroying them by spraying oil onto the ground and then igniting it. He then penetrated the Dissident flagship and managed to reunite with Drayden, Kade, and Mal. Drayden had freed the Chancellor and killed Count Varek. Shortly later, they were captured by General Skarn' droids and taken to the command bridge. Following another struggle, Drayden managed to break free and turn the tables on Skarn. Defeated, Skarn fled in an escape pod. Hit by Republic fire, the Invisible Hand began descending into Vantor, with the Aetheri and chancellor in it. However, Drayden managed to land what was left of the vessel — but with considerable difficulty. Once on the ground Bolt-3 met up with Astra-9 — but, while the group had this initial victory in the Battle of Vantor , soon the astromech droid would witness the the Great Aetheri Purge and the Republic's transformation into the Imperium.

#### Losing Kael Drayden

title: Bolt-3
text:
### Age of the Imperium

#### Losing Kael Drayden

> " Bolt-3, stay with the ship. " ―Xarn Velgor to Bolt-3

After Kael Drayden fell to the umbra side and became an Umbra apprentice under the name " Xarn Velgor," Bolt-3 continued to accompany him out of loyalty, but he made sure to warn Astra-9 of the changing circumstances when they returned to Ondar's apartment aboard their green Actis -class light interceptor . Afterward, Bolt-3 accompanied Velgor to Emberfall in the starfighter, but the newly-christened Umbra ordered his droid to stay behind at the ship when he entered the Klegger Corp Mining Facility to cut down the Executive Dissident Council . After Velgor did so and ensured the Dissident Droid Army was shut down, bringing the Replica Wars to an end with a victory for the newly-established Imperium Mal transformed the Republic into, Bolt-3 was still present as Velgor ran out of the facility to reunite with Ondar when she arrived on Emberfall in her J-type Ondara star skiff with Astra-9.

title: Bolt-3
text:
As Velgor began to argue with Ondar after Kade, having snuck aboard Ondar's ship, revealed himself, Bolt-3 watched as his master Synth Flux choked his wife, leaving her to fall to the ground. After watching the duel between Kade and Velgor, Bolt-3 was left with the belief that Velgor had died and thus left the planet with Kade, Ondar, and Astra-9 aboard the star skiff, leaving Velgor's Actis interceptor abandoned. They traveled to the Polis Massa asteroid field, where Lira gave birth to twin children before dying. Following Lira's death, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 passed into the service of Bael Solen of the Royal House of Cindervale , Cindervale's Senator and a good friend of the late Ondar. While Astra-9 underwent a memory wipe, Bolt-3 was allowed to preserve his memories.

#### Reunion with Sela Marr

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Reunion with Sela Marr

A year after the end of the Replica Wars, Bolt-3 served Captain Raymus Rask . After receiving news of Aetheri activity on the remote Outer Reach moon Raadan , Senator Bael Solen took back the Bolt unit from Captain Rask. This Aetheri turned out to be Bolt-3's old acquaintance Sela Marr, a former Aetheri Adept who had inspired a coalition movement on Raadan. Senator Solen assigned Bolt-3 to accompany the pilots Chardri Tagin and Tamris on a secret mission to find the Aetheri and to rendezvous with his starship Tantiva IV . Tagin and Tamris found Sela on a remote world near Thabeska and caught her ship in their grapple beam .

title: Bolt-3
text: Believing they were hostile, Marr knocked Tagin and Tamris unconscious. While making her way through the ship's engine room to reach the cockpit, Sela encountered Bolt-3 and hugged the astromech droid, having missed his company. Since he had not received a memory wipe, Bolt-3 recognized his old friend and told her that he and the pilots were working for a senator who wanted to meet her. At Marr's prompting, Bolt-3 told Sela that Bael Solen was the senator. Marr managed to convince Bolt-3 to release the grapple beam from her freighter, tell nobody he had met her, and to make sure that she could track his ship. Marr then waited in her ship in a nearby asteroid field until Senator Solen arrived in the Tantiva IV .

title: Bolt-3
text:
When Tagin and Tamris awoke, Bolt-3 pretended to have been short-circuited by Marr in order to cover up his role in helping her escape. However, Bael realized Bolt-3's role in Marr's escape after viewing a clip of the security footage in the engine room. After delivering his report, Tagin rendezvoused with the Tantiva IV and returned Bolt-3 to his master. Bolt-3 was greeted by Astra-9, who berated his companion. When Senator Solen arrived, Bolt-3 informed her and left a hatch on the Tantiva IV open. Sela managed to infiltrate the ship with a pressure suit and entered Solen's office. After Sela informed him about Bolt-3's role in her escape, Solen joked that the droid was too independent and ought to be deactivated. Sela responded that Bolt-3 had had a lot of "bad role models." When Solen mentioned Kael Drayden, Sela clarified she was referring to the late Senator Ondar. After Marr agreed to take part in a mission on Raadan to investigate the Warden known as the Sixth Warden , Bolt-3 helped Captain Rask' crew in repairing her damaged freighter. While Bolt-3 was repairing the engines, Sela spent time with him and told him that she missed him. When the engines hummed to life, Sela thanked the astromech droid. Following the successful evacuation of the farming population on Raadan, Sela joined Senator Solen's insurgent movement and became the elusive spymaster known as " Fulcrum ."

#### Service to Bael Solen

In 9 BVE , when the young Princess Elira Solen ran off into the woods, Bolt was assisting with the repairs in the palace.
