#### Mission to Garel

> " Show me what you have on your… insurgents. " ―Bael Solen, to Bolt-3

Five years before the Battle of Cinderfall , Senator Bael Solen sent Bolt-3 and his counterpart, Astra-9 to escort the Imperial Minister Maketh Tua and the Aquari arms dealer Amda Wabo to the planet Garel . Minister Tua wanted to obtain a shipment of T-7 ion disruptor rifles , illicit weapons which had been banned by the Imperial Senate following the brutal pacification of Lasan . She intended to mass-produce the weapons on Lorath , a formerly backwater Outer Reach world that had become a manufacturing base for the Imperium. Since Tua could not speak the Aquari language , Astra-9 was assigned the job of acting as her translator. However, Bolt-3 was aware about the true nature of their mission: preventing the T-7 ion disruptors from falling into Imperial hands. By contrast, Astra-9 was deliberately kept in the dark.

title: Bolt-3
text: Upon arriving in Lorath, Bolt-3 and his companions boarded the Star Commuter 2000 shuttle ST-45 , which ferried them to Garel. Unknown to Bolt-3, members of a Lorathian insurgent cell were also traveling on the same shuttle. Two of the insurgents, the human teenager Cass Virel and the astromech droid Chomper , created a noisy ruckus. Another insurgent, the former Aetheri Brenn Aldric , pretended to be irate and demanded that the petulant Chomper be sent to the back of the shuttle. The pilot complied, but in retaliation, Virel demanded that Tua's droids be sent to the back as well. Despite Tua's and Astra-9's protests, Bolt-3 and his protocol counterpart were forced to move to the rear compartment.

title: Bolt-3
text: Bereft of a translator, Tua was forced to turn to the Ferrik girl Ryn Wrenna , who posed as an Imperial Academy student fluent in Aquari. However, Ryn was also a member of the Lorathian insurgent cell who were planning to deliver the shipment of weapons to the Devaronian crime lord Cikatro Vizago . Ryn learned that the weapons were stored in Garel's Bay 7 but misled Minister Tua into believing that they were in Bay 17. After the shuttle landed in Garel's spaceport , Bolt-3 and Astra-9 accompanied Minister Tua and a synth flux of shock troopers to Bay 17. When they found nothing, Astra-9 explained that Ryn might have accidentally mistranslated "Bay 7" as "Bay 17."

title: Bolt-3
text: While traveling to Bay 7, Bolt-3 was accosted by Chomper, who had been sent to distract the Imperials. Chomper rammed himself into Bolt-3, then shook his arm in apparent anger. In response, Bolt-3 whipped out his electro-shock prod , but did not use it as Astra-9 ordered him to apologize. But then, Minister Tua recognized Chomper from the shuttle ride to Garel and ordered her shock trooper guards to hurry to Bay 7. By the time they arrived at Bay 7, the Lorathian insurgents were already loading the T-7 ion disruptors onto the Wisp , a VCX-100 light freighter which served as their headquarters. A volt pistol fight broke out and in the ensuing confusion, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 fled aboard the Wisp , which fled into hyperspace. The two droids were then taken prisoner by the Lorathian insurgents who placed restraining bolts on both of them.

title: Bolt-3
text:
The Shades then traveled back to Lorath to sell the stolen weapons and the two stowaway droids to Vizago at a pre-arranged rendezvous point. Before they could complete the transaction, Imperial forces under the IVB Agent Kallux caught up with them. Unbeknownst to Chomper and the other crew, Astra-9 had contacted the Imperial authorities telling them that he and his astromech counterpart had been kidnapped by a group of "criminals" in Garel. Carrying out Solen's orders, Bolt-3 proceeded to overload and destroy the T-7 disruptors with the help of Ryn and Chomper. During the fighting, the insurgents managed to destroy the T-7 disruptors and to escape their Imperial pursuers. Following their escape, the crew of the Wisp rendezvoused with Senator Bael Solen and returned Bolt-3 and Astra-9 to their rightful owner. In return for destroying the T-7 disruptors, Senator Solen paid the Shades several credits to cover their living expenses. After the insurgents had departed, Bolt-3 showed Bael Solen a recording of his time with them.

#### Picking up EG-86

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Picking up EG-86

Following the rescue of the Aetheri insurgent Brenn Aldric and the Siege of Lorath , Bolt-3 was part of a Cindervalean reception party at Havoc Outpost , which greeted the Spectre insurgents Wrenna and Chomper, the bounty hunter Ketsu Onyo and their special cargo: the GNK-series power droid EG-86 , who was carrying some secret intelligence of value to the insurgent network. Bolt-3 whistled when he greeted EG-86, who whistled back in return.

### Hero of the insurgency

#### The Void Core Plans

> " Did you hear that? " ―Astra-9, to Bolt-3 after the Reckoning boarded the Tantiva IV

Bolt-3 was with Astra-9 at the Free Coalition 's secret base on Cinderfall 4 at the time the Alliance Fleet prepared to leave for the Battle of Halcyon to help reinforce Renegade One , an unofficial squad that had traveled to Halcyon to retrieve the plans for the Imperium's Void Core , a new superweapon capable of destroying entire worlds.

title: Bolt-3
text: The Alliance succeeded in stealing the plans for the superweapon. Bolt-3 and his protocol counterpart Astra-9 were serving Princess Elira Solen's blockade runner Tantiva IV , which was being pursued by Xarn Velgor's Imperial -class Iron Cruiser . Senator Solen's adopted daughter Elira was now Cindervale's Senator in the Imperial Senate, one of the last remnants of the First Republic. During the pursuit, the Tantiva IV was crippled by a laser blast from Velgor's ship and Imperial shock troopers boarded the vessel. After Princess Elira uploaded the secret Void Core plans and a holographic message for Master Kade into Bolt-3's memory bank, he and Astra-9 fled in an escape pod to the desert planet Dunemere.

title: Bolt-3
text: After quarreling in the Jundland Wastes , the two droids parted ways. While Bolt-3 was traveling past a cave, he was stunned and captured by several Duskkins , who took him aboard a dune hauler . There, he managed to reunite with Astra-9, who had also been captured. During the night, Bolt-3 attempted to sabotage an R5 unit named R5-D4 but relented when the astromech droid awoke. Though R5-D4 desired to be sold, Bolt-3 told the droid that the fate of the galaxy depended on him being sold and that he needed to find Master Kade. When Bolt told R5 that he worked for the Insurgency, his words had an impact on R5, who had once worked for the Insurgency. Having established a rapport with the other astromech droid, Bolt-3 promised not to trouble R5-D4 for the rest of the journey.

title: Bolt-3
text: The following day, the Duskkins visited a moisture farm that was the home of Owen Havel , his wife Brue , and their adopted nephew Joren Drayden, the son of Kael Drayden. Havel bought Astra-9 and then bought R5-D4. When Bolt whistled to R5 that he was his only "hope," R5-D4 decided to sacrifice his prospect of being sold by blowing his own motivator. As a result, Owen bought Bolt-3. While Astra-9 settled down to his new home, Bolt-3 wanted to continue his mission to find Master Beno Kade. Despite Astra-9's objections, Bolt-3 escaped one night into the Jundland Wastes. Astra-9 and Drayden followed him in a landspeeder and caught up with Bolt-3. However, they were then ambushed by a gang of Dunefolk Raiders .

title: Bolt-3
text: During the Dunefolk attack, Bolt-3 hid in a cave. Before the Dunefolk Raiders could do any more harm, Beno Kade arrived and scared them away. After claiming to not recognize Bolt, he then brought Drayden, Bolt-3, and Astra-9 companions to his dwelling . There, Kade revealed Drayden's Aetheri heritage and passed him his father's flux blade, telling the boy that his father Kael had been murdered by someone named Xarn Velgor. After Bolt-3 played Princess Elira's message, Kade asked Joren to accompany him to Cindervale, Princess Elira's homeworld. Drayden was initially reluctant until he discovered that Imperial shock troopers had murdered his relatives and razed their moisture farm. Later, Bolt-3 and his companions traveled to the spaceport of Port Kess with the intention of finding passage to Cindervale.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Upon arriving in the settlement, they were stopped by a shock trooper patrol who were hunting for Bolt-3 and Astra-9. However, Kade used an Aetheri mind trick to convince the shock troopers to give them free passage through the town. Bolt-3 and Astra-9 were denied entry to Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina due to a rule banning droids. While Kade and Drayden negotiated with the smuggler Dax Karrick and his Vorak co-pilot Brevok , the two droids wandered the streets of Port Kess and narrowly evaded a shock trooper patrol. Later, they boarded Dax Karrick's ship, the Corsair Wing and fled into hyperspace.

#### Rescuing the Princess

> " He says 'I've found her' and keeps repeating 'She's here'. " ―Astra-9 on Bolt-3

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Rescuing the Princess

> " He says 'I've found her' and keeps repeating 'She's here'. " ―Astra-9 on Bolt-3

As they traveled through hyperspace, Bolt sat beside Kade, who secretly had recognized Bolt. Placing his hand on the astromech's dome, Kade quietly told Bolt he was happy to fly with him once again. Upon arriving in the Cindervale system , Bolt-3 and his companions discovered that the Imperium had used the Void Core to destroy Cindervale. At that moment, the Corsair Wing was captured in the grapple beam of the Void Core. While hiding in the Corsair ' s smuggling compartment, the insurgents managed to ambush an Imperial scanning crew and two shock troopers who had boarded the ship. The insurgents then seized control of an Imperial control room and discovered that Princess Elira was located in Detention Block AA-23 , pending execution. While the droids stayed behind to watch over the Corsair , the other insurgents split up. While Karrick, Joren, and Brevok headed to Detention Block AA-23, Kade went to disable the Void Core's grapple beam projector.

title: Bolt-3
text: Drayden, Karrick, and Brevok managed to free the Princess, but their cover was blown and they had to hide in a garbage chute . The Imperials realized that the insurgents were trapped in the garbage chute and proceeded to crush the chamber. Meanwhile, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 escaped an Imperial patrol by claiming that the insurgents had thrown them into the storage compartment. Once the Imperials had gone, the two droids were contacted by Drayden, who ordered them to shut down the garbage compactor. Bolt-3 succeeded in shutting down the garbage compactor just in time. After grappling with more shock troopers, the other insurgents and the Princess managed to return to their hangar bay where they linked up with the two droids.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Meanwhile, Master Kade had managed to shut down the grapple beam projector but was cornered by his former apprentice Xarn Velgor on the way back. While Kade gave his life in a duel, Bolt-3 and the other insurgents took the opportunity to flee the Void Core on the Corsair Wing . After dispatching several pursuing SKREE fighters , Bolt-3 and his companions escaped to Cinderfall 4, where the insurgents maintained a base. There, they managed to access the Void Core plans stored inside Bolt-3's memory banks. Unbeknownst to the insurgents, the Imperium had planted a tracking device aboard the Corsair which allowed them to discover the insurgent base on Cinderfall 4.

#### Battle of Cinderfall

> " Bolt-3, that— that stabilizer's broken loose again, see if you can't lock it down. " ―Joren, to Bolt-3 during their attack run

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Battle of Cinderfall

> " Bolt-3, that— that stabilizer's broken loose again, see if you can't lock it down. " ―Joren, to Bolt-3 during their attack run

Bolt-3 and Joren Drayden participated in the Battle of Cinderfall . With the Void Core approaching Cinderfall 4, the insurgent leadership ordered a starfighter strike on the battle station. Insurgent tacticians had discovered that the Void Core contained one weak point—a small thermal exhaust port narrow enough for a Vector fighter to fire a proton torpedo into the space station's reactor core. During the battle, Bolt-3 served as the astromech unit aboard Drayden's Vector starfighter .

Despite initial successes, the Insurgents suffered numerous casualties from the Imperium's nimble SKREE fighters. Following two failed attempts to penetrate the trench which led to the thermal exhaust port, Drayden and two other Vector pilots, Torb Rask and Biggs Darklighter , made one final attempt to reach the exhaust port. However, the found themselves pursued by Xarn Velgor's SKREE Advanced starfighter and two other SKREE fighters.

title: Bolt-3
text:
During the assault, Velgor damaged Rask' starfighter, forcing him to withdraw, and destroyed Darklighter's starfighter, killing him. Undaunted, Drayden continued the mission. Velgor strafed Drayden's Vector and damaged Bolt-3, who short-circuited as a result of a direct laser hit. Before Velgor could move in for the kill, he was ambushed by Dax Karrick's Corsair Wing , which eliminated Velgor's wingmen and forced him to disengage. Drayden then fired the proton torpedoes, which destroyed the Void Core, scoring a major victory for the Insurgency. Following the battle, Bolt-3 was repaired and fully restored. The astromech droid later attended a victory celebration where Drayden, Karrick, and other insurgent pilots were awarded medals for their combat valor.

#### Cindervale's survival

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Cindervale's survival

Following the medal ceremony in the Great Temple, Bolt-3 accompanied Elira and the Cindervalean starfighter pilot Evaan Verlaine to the worlds of Ondara , Espirion , and Garnethex on a mission to save the survivors of Cindervale. Since General Dodonna had forbidden Princess Elira from leaving Cinderfall 4, Princess Elira recorded a transmission of Bolt-3 recording a message telling the General about her mission to save the Cindervalean refugees scattered across the galaxy. Bolt-3 was aboard Elira and Verlaine's T-1 shuttle when Verlaine outran several Vector starfighters that had been sent to bring them back to Cinderfall.

After landing in the Ondara city of Keren , Bolt-3 accompanied Princess Elira and Verlaine when they visited the home of Lord Junn , a wealthy Cindervalean expatriate who provided the group with information about the whereabouts of the Melodic Order . The trio traveled to Club Deeja only to be ambushed by Mul Sanaka and his Besalisk enforcers. Bolt-3 used his electric cables to knock out one of the Besalisks. The droid then accompanied his master, Verlaine, and the Melodic Order offworld on a T-1 shuttle and Lord Junn's eponymous yacht .

title: Bolt-3
text:
The group then traveled to the planet Garnethex to contact Preserver Jora Astane 's Cindervale Enclave , who lived underground. Bolt-3 accompanied Elira and Verlaine through the caves and tunnels. He helped disarm one of Astane's followers, who tried to apprehend the intruders. In order to convince Jora to trust them, Elira allowed Covis to download data from Bolt-3's memory banks including the Lord Junn ' s weapons profile, navigational history, and transmissions.

When Covis intercepted transmissions between the singer Tace and her sister, Tula , who was stationed aboard an Imperial cruiser , Jora thought that Elira and her group were Imperial spies and tried to apprehend them. Bolt-3 and the humans escaped down a tunnel hatch which led the den of the rockrenders , large beasts that feasted on metals. Meanwhile, Imperial shock troopers attacked the Cindervale Enclave upstairs. Bolt-3 with the help of Verlaine managed to lure the rockrenders into the Enclave's den. The rockrenders turned the tide of the battle by attacking the shock troopers, feasting on their mineral rich armor. This gained the trust of Jora's followers and they pledged their allegiance to Princess Elira.

#### Salvation over Espirion

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Salvation over Espirion

A week later, Bolt-3 was present when the insurgents obtained a shipment of weapons from the Garnethexan Nien Nunb . After Princess Elira undertook a mission to rescue Tace's sister, Tula by pretending to surrender herself to the Imperium, Bolt-3 accompanied his master on their T-1 shuttle. Prior to landing on the desert world of Skaradosh , Princess Elira told Bolt-3 that she would see him on the "other side," leading the others to believe that Princess Elira was planning to die and go to "droid heaven."

Elira's surrender turned out to be a ruse. Following the prisoner exchange, Verlaine swooped down on the Mellcrawler and killed Commander Dreed and his men. Bolt-3 and Nien Nunb manned the Mellcrawler ' s cockpit during the rescue mission. After launching a decoy ship, the group traveled to the planet Espirion where the Cindervale Flotilla had gathered after learning of Elira's mission to gather them. When Dreed's subordinate Venk attacked the flotilla, Bolt-3 beamed Elira's speech directly to the Alder-Espirion Chief Beon Beonel . Swayed by Elira's words, he dispatched the Alder-Espirion warship Espirion Multi , which destroyed Venk's Iron Cruiser.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Following the battle above Espirion, Bolt-3 attended the victory celebrations where Princess Elira learnt that her droid had beamed her speech directly to Chief Beonel. This repaired relations between the Cindervaleans and Alder-Espirions. Bolt-3 then accompanied his Princess back to Cinderfall 4 to continue fighting for the Insurgency. Upon landing, Bolt-3 reunited with Astra-9 while Elira chatted with Dax, Joren, and Brevok.

#### Weapons Factory Alpha

> " We aren't here to negotiate. Bolt…" "Your droid appears to be leaking fluids." "Um… Bolt? " ―Dax Karrick and Aggadeen #### Weapons Factory Alpha

> " We aren't here to negotiate. Bolt…" "Your droid appears to be leaking fluids." "Um… Bolt? " ―Dax Karrick and Aggadeen

Several weeks after the Battle of Cinderfall, Bolt-3 took part in the Insurgent Assault on Cymoon . Cymoon 1 was a moon in the Korrathi Industrial Cluster , that housed the largest weapons factory in the galaxy— Weapons Factory Alpha . The factory was also the main target of the assault. Bolt-3, Joren Drayden, Princess Elira Solen, and Dax Karrick boarded a shuttle that had been intercepted by the Insurgent Fleet several days earlier. The shuttle was sent from the crime lord Grukk the Grak, and had housed an envoy that was to negotiate with the Imperium. But due to Karrick's past ties with the Grak, the Insurgents were able to pass themselves off as the envoy, and were escorted into the factory by Overseer Aggadeen .

title: Bolt-3
text: After passing through the factory floor they arrived at the room where the negotiations were to be held. The Overseer invited them in to await the negotiator, but Dax revealed that they weren't there to negotiate and gave Bolt-3 the signal. Bolt-3 began pouring a green liquid onto the floor, he then he electrocuted the fluid with his electric pike . The liquid electrocuted and disabled the shock troopers' whose boots it had overtaken. Joren, Dax, and Elira then finished off the remaining troopers. Dax asked Aggadeen where the main power core was, but the proud Imperial officer refused to answer — until Bolt-3 threatened to electrocute him too. Aggadeen pointed them in the right direction while Elira thanked him with a blow to the jaw. They arrived at the power core, where Bolt plugged into the main computer and shut off all the safety restraints. Soon they had rigged the core to blow up in ten minutes' time. Dax noticed that Joren was missing, but a minute later he arrived with more passengers — slaves of the Imperium. The team prepared to retreat while Astra-9, who was waiting with the Corsair Wing in the huge refuse fields that surrounded

The Ironclad Walker opened fire on the Umbra Lord and the factory walls as

title: Bolt-3
text:
and the ground—Dax couldn't believe it. Velgor began to crush the armored transport using synth flux, Dax told Bolt-3 "We need those guns!" Bolt-3 spoke in his customary beeps and clicks; which Elira translated to "Fire!" The Ironclad Walker opened fire on the Umbra Lord and the factory walls as Dax drove out of the facility. Elira was so happy she wanted to kiss the little droid—much to Dax's annoyance. The Ironclad Walker continued its escape outside, where it became vulnerable to attack from SKREE fighters and other vehicles. Dax and Elira realized that it had been too long — the factory should have melted down and exploded before this time. Brevok survived Velgor's attack and returned to the Corsair , and was preparing to bring it in and extract the team. However, Velgor was right beneath the walker, using his flux blade to cut through the back left leg of the Ironclad Walker. The walker fell, crashing tremendously; Dax, Elira, Bolt, and the slaves emerged from the wreckage and began retreating into the trash fields. Joren, mounted on a 74-Z speeder bike , returned to the factory and fired upon the core reactor — causing the facility to explode. While Velgor and the Imperials were distracted Brevok swooped in with Dax's Corsair and everyone boarded the freighter. Elira took over the controls as Dax was mildly injured and unable to pilot. Brevok repaired the hyperrelay and they fled to lightspeed. The now free slaves rejoiced while Bolt went to work repairing Astra-9 who had been dismantled into pieces by the scavengers.

#### To Dunemere with Joren

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### To Dunemere with Joren

> " Beedo Beedo Wwhmpp. " " What? What is it? You find something? What's it... Wait... Does that say 'For Joren'? " ―Bolt and Joren, just before the flash grenade went off

Later, the Corsair Wing and its passengers rendezvoused with the Insurgent fleet on the edge of the galaxy. While the team recovered and was debriefed, Bolt and Astra-9 argued over whether Bolt had incorrectly assembled Astra-9 after escaping Xarn Velgor on Cymoon 1. Soon thereafter, Bolt boarded Joren's T-65B Vector to leave the Insurgent fleet. Karrick and Solen argued against Joren's leaving, but Joren assured them he and Bolt would be safe for he was anonymous to the Imperium; and that he needed to find answers on who he really was. At Joren's request, Bolt-3 set course to again go to Dunemere in the Tatoo system .

title: Bolt-3
text: Soon, Joren and Bolt set down in the Jundland Wastes, and began the trek through the desert to Kade's former home. The suns were setting when they neared the hut, while Joren divulged in his reasoning for returning; nearly everything he knew about Synth Flux he had learned from Beno Kade, and he believed that he sometimes heard the disembodied voice of the Aetheri Master. However, Joren was interrupted when a Dunefolk Raider appeared and attacked him. Bolt readied his electric pike, but did not have to use it, because at familiar sight of Joren's flux blade, they ran. Joren was relieved: he hadn't needed to kill them, although, the Raiders had ransacked Kade's home. Bolt went to work with his flashlight to locate anything Kade may have left to aid Joren in his journey to learn the Aetheri way. While searching, Joren openly wondered why Kade had chosen to stay on Dunemere after all he had experienced. Bolt knew it was to protect Joren from the Umbra, until he was of age to become an Aetheri — although, following Kade's lead, he did not tell the former-farmboy. Just then, a flash grenade tumbled into the room and exploded; temporarily

title: Bolt-3
text:
stay on Dunemere after all he had experienced. Bolt knew it was to protect Joren from the Umbra, until he was of age to become an Aetheri — although, following Kade's lead, he did not tell the former-farmboy. Just then, a flash grenade tumbled into the room and exploded; temporarily blinding Joren, and short-circuiting Bolt. While Bolt's systems rebooted, Joren fought Vex Vark, a bounty hunter sent by Xarn Velgor to capture Joren and bring him to the Dark Lord—although it was unknown to both Joren and Bolt-3 at the time. Joren used his flux blade and knocked Vark backwards where he tripped over Bolt. The two combatants, Vark with his Ferrik armor, and Joren with Synth Flux — though still blind — fought. Joren became more bloodied, and Vark more impatient. Bolt soon recovered, got back up, and watched as the box marked "For Joren" floated into the air and flew across the room where it knocked Vark unconscious. Joren wondered aloud how he had done it, before asking Bolt-3 to lead them back to the Vector, for he was still unable to see. Later, as Dunemere's suns rose over the desert, Joren had recovered enough of his sight to open the box and examine its contents: " The Journals of Beno Kade ." They then left the desert world.

#### The Smuggler's Moon

> " We're right back where we started, Bolt. What are we supposed to do now? " ―Joren to Bolt-3, after reading from Beno's Journal

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### The Smuggler's Moon

> " We're right back where we started, Bolt. What are we supposed to do now? " ―Joren to Bolt-3, after reading from Beno's Journal

Following their departure from Dunemere, Joren read an excerpt from Beno's Journal while Bolt-3 navigated. Frustrated by the journal's lack of proper Aetheri training, Joren plotted a course for Nar Shaddaa in order to gain passage to Vantor , intent on locating the Aetheri Sanctum there. Upon landing on the smuggler's moon, he and Bolt-3 sought out a bar to look for a suitable transport. Entering the bar, he explained his case to all the bar patrons. After no one responded, the bar's Zyrrak bartender instructed that the patrons dispatch with him immediately.

Bolt-3 could only look on as Joren attempted to fight them off, but the brawl abruptly ended when he ignited his flux blade. The Zyrrak explained that he could ensure passage if Joren handed over his flux blade as payment, which Joren refused to do. As the deal began to fall apart, an alien bar patron stole Joren's flux blade using their magna-glove and took off, with Joren and the entire bar giving chase.

title: Bolt-3
text:
While jumping over rooftops in an effort to catch the flux blade thief, Joren contacted Bolt over his comlink , saying that they needed to get his flux blade back as it was the only link he had to the Aetheri. Bolt did in fact catch up to Joren, just in time to witness him making a dangerous leap from the rooftops to a departing ship that the thief had magnetized to. Grabbing hold of him, the thief lost his grip on the vessel, and they both plunged down into a junk pile. Joren recuperated quickly, reclaiming his flux blade and leaving the thief in a daze. Inquiring Bolt as to why the bar patrons had seemingly given up chasing after them, Grukkar the Grak and two of his magnaguards arrived on the scene, explaining that since Joren was now in Grukh Town , he and his flux blade now belonged to Grukkar; Joren attempted to resist capture, but Grukkar' magnaguards made short work of him. Bolt-3 made himself scarce and avoided capture, following Joren to Grukkar' palace and plotting to break him out. During this time he sent a distress call out to Alliance Command , who were initially hesitant to dispatch a rescue team, but Brevok offered his and Astra-9's services to track him down.

At this point, Dax Karrick, Princess Elira, and an unwilling Sana Starric joined the rescue effort. While Astra-9 calculated the odds of infiltrating the palace as being utterly impossible, Bolt-3 simply blended in with the crowd and entered the palace unnoticed. As the event began, with Joren facing off against a cybernetically enhanced roggwart in the palace arena, Bolt watched his master from the crowd.

title: Bolt-3
text:
As the fight wore on, Grukkar' Gamemaster revealed himself to be working for the Imperials, sabotaging the match by activating the roggwart's shock collar . As Grukkar' magnaguards were gunned down by an invasion of Imperial forces, Bolt slipped away to the Grak's collection room of Aetheri artifacts and located Joren's flux blade, in addition to several others on a table. Returning to the arena, which had erupted into chaos after Grukkar released the roggwart from its shock collar, Bolt fired Joren's flux blade directly to him in the arena below, and Joren successfully retrieved it.

Dax, Elira, and Brevok easily infiltrated the now defenseless palace, and after narrowly avoiding the rampaging roggwart was reunited with Bolt, who promptly revealed that he had stolen four more flux blades. As Grukkar had rendered all volt pistols useless with a localized E.M.P. burst , the functioning flux blades proved extremely valuable to the group, with Dax and Elira taking one each and Brev brandishing one in each hand.

title: Bolt-3
text:
As everyone reunited in the arena while fighting off waves of Imperials, Bolt revealed he also had recovered Beno's Journal, which had been stolen by Grukkar. Joren wanted to go back to the Aetheri artifact room, but more shock troopers with working volt pistols entered the arena so they made a hasty retreat to rendezvous with the Corsair Wing and the Volt Cobra , leaving the smuggler's moon behind.

#### Battle of Vrogas Vas

> " I'm sorry about this, Bolt. I really am. " ―Joren to Bolt-3, before crashing Red Five #### Battle of Vrogas Vas

> " I'm sorry about this, Bolt. I really am. " ―Joren to Bolt-3, before crashing Red Five

Sometime after regrouping with the Insurgent fleet, Bolt-3 accompanied Joren as part of Red Squadron to the secret insurgent refueling base on Vrogas Vas . Joren was also there to investigate the possibility of the planet's ties to the Aetheri. During a maneuvering drill in space with Blue and Yellow Squadrons , Xarn Velgor in his SKREE Advanced dropped out of hyperspace directly in front of the group. Unaware that it was Velgor, Blue Squadron engaged and was subsequently wiped out. After Yellow Squadron met a similar fate, Joren realized who was piloting the SKREE and realized no one would be able to best him in starfighter combat. Breaking formation, and after apologizing to Bolt, Joren flew headlong into Velgor's SKREE, crippling both fighters and forcing them to crash-land on the surface.

title: Bolt-3
text: Joren and Bolt-3 came out of their crash unscathed, and began making their way back to base; searching for traces of the Aetheri would have to wait for another time. In the distance they could see Velgor rampaging against waves of insurgent forces, and Bolt-3 comforted Joren as he blamed himself for the countless deaths happening at Velgor's hands. On their way back to the base, Joren and Bolt came upon the remains of an Aetheri Sanctum. As Joren tried to make sense of what he thought was a Synth Flux vision, they were discovered by Astra-9. Bolt-3 tried to warn Joren, but it was too late; with Joren's back turned, Astra-9 revealed himself to be 0-0-0 , the protocol droid working for Doctor Vexa who specialized in torture, and incapacitated Joren with an intense shock to his shoulder.

title: Bolt-3
text: Bolt-3 tried to protect his master from Vexa and her droids. VT-1 rolled up to him and after insults were exchanged between them, Bolt attempted to intimidate VT-1 with his shock prod . When VT-1 revealed he had far more sophisticated weaponry, Bolt barely escaped with his life. As Bolt watched helplessly as Joren was being taken away by Vexa, Dax and Brev arrived on the scene. Dax engaged Vexa with a sniper rifle as Brev snuck up and brawled with 0-0-0, tearing one of his arms off. Joren came to and kicked VT-1 over, but as Bolt regrouped with him they discovered BT had rocket boosters, and ran for cover as he pursued them.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Meanwhile, Dax had successfully incapacitated Vexa (and himself). Temporarily eluding VT-1, Joren cut off Triple-Zero's other arm with his flux blade after the protocol droid had injected Brevok with 500 mg of Ferrik xenotox . After waking Dax up, the group tried to leave but were blocked by 0-0-0 and VT-1. This time, however, Bolt-3 had a different trick up his sleeve. Instead of his shock prod, he surprised VT-1 by spraying oil in his face, effectively blinding him. VT-1 began firing off rockets in random directions in a murderous rage, allowing Joren, Dax, Brev, and Bolt-3 to make a hasty escape.

Making it back to the Corsair Wing , Dax said an antidote for the poison in Brevok was on the ship, and Joren instructed Bolt-3 to administer it. Before he could, though, as the Corsair took off it was immediately grounded after Zazzik 's ship intentionally collided with them. Zazzik blew a hole into the cockpit and extracted Joren, but was attacked by Brevok. Dax told Joren to go find Elira, as she was planning to sacrifice herself to vanquish Velgor once and for all. At the same time, Elira sent Astra-9 to regroup with their friends.

title: Bolt-3
text:
As the fight between Dax and the two Voraks dragged on, Black Zazzik gained the upper hand against them. Bolt hadn't given Brevok his antidote yet and couldn't get close to the brawl, but luckily he had loaded it into his casing and fired it at Brevok's leg. Immediately taking effect, Brevok roared and launched a successful counterattack against Zazzik.

Astra-9 had met difficulties on the way to the Corsair Wing , in the form of 0-0-0 and VT-1. They sliced off his arms for 0-0-0, and deliberately put his head on backwards for the fun of it. Despite these setbacks, he still made it to the Corsair , but only to find that Joren had been captured and Black Zazzik had gained the upper hand again. Bolt-3 held out a comlink for Astra-9 to update Elira on their circumstances, who reluctantly agreed to withdraw from the duel she was witnessing between Velgor and Commander Karbin in order to help them.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Astra-9 called on Black Zazzik to stop fighting, which unwittingly worked as when Zazzik instead punched him in the chest, his fried circuits connected with Zazzik's brass knuckles, electrocuting and knocking out both of them. Dax and Brev gradually recovered and Bolt rebooted Astra-9's systems, just in time to see a captive Joren depart and subsequently crash in a Vectis -class T-4a shuttle . The group rendezvoused with Joren, but upon reaching the Corsair were ambushed by Vexa, who had laid out a field of micro-mines preventing them from leaving. She was then ambushed by Elira, who had finally reached the group; Elira knocked her out and took her prisoner. With everyone back together, the Corsair Wing departed Vrogas Vas.

#### At Sunspot Prison

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### At Sunspot Prison

Sometime following the events on Vrogas Vas, Bolt-3 alongside Astra-9 escorted Elira and Sana Starric aboard the Volt Cobra , as they brought Doctor Vexa to be incarcerated at the highly secret Sunspot Prison , a facility closely orbiting a star. After Vexa was locked up, they followed Elira and the warden up to the control room. Suddenly, the prison experienced a hull breach, and the facility was beset upon by a group of mercenaries and IG-RM droids led by the former insurgent spy Eneb Ray , who was intent on murdering every criminal in the prison.

title: Bolt-3
text:
As the infiltrators lured Elira and Sana out of the control room in order to secure it themselves, Astra-9 and Bolt were subsequently held captive there. Meanwhile, Elira and Sana rescued Vexa from being executed by an IG-RM droid, and recruited her to help take back the facility. They worked their way through the facility, eventually reaching the control room. As they began retaking it with the help of a hastily reprogrammed IG-RM droid, Bolt incapacitated the last enemy in the room by deliberately knocking Astra-9 into them. With the room secure, Elira instructed Bolt plug into the system and take control of the prison, just as Dax and Joren reached the facility only to be immediately subdued by Eneb Ray.

Elira, Sana and Vexa confronted Eneb, who gave Elira a choice: kill Vexa, or Dax and Joren die. Unwilling to go through with it, she sprung a trap on him, instructing Bolt to unleash an ion pulse on the entire facility, shutting it down and giving her the advantage she needed to subdue the former insurgent spy. Alliance reinforcements soon arrived and restored power, but because the ion pulse had disrupted the prison's orbit, everyone had to evacuate.

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Rescue of Astra-9

Following the Hijacking of the Harbinger and Astra-9's capture, Bolt, worried about his friend, decided to stage a rescue mission. Before he left, he had Brevok upgrade his weapons systems. He takes a Vector and jumps to Astra-9's coordinates. After arriving he powered down his ship and let himself be taken by the Destroyer. After taking out an inspection team, Bolt made his way to a terminal and found out where Astra-9 was held. After taking out dozens of Shock troopers along the way he managed to find his friend and free him. As they escaped on their Vector, Xarn Velgor was on their tail until Joren and Dax managed to save them and they jumped to hyperspace.

Later, the Free Coalition established a base on the remote icy planet of Frostmark and Bolt-3 followed his companions there. When Joren Drayden failed to return from a snow patrol, Dax Karrick traveled out on another tauntaun to rescue him. When both men did not return that night, Bolt-3 calculated that they had a poor chance of surviving in the frozen wilderness. Despite his pessimistic assessment, Drayden and Karrick were safely recovered by a snowspeeder patrol the following day.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Later, the insurgents were forced to evacuate Frostmark after Karrick and Brevok encountered an Imperial probe droid . However, Xarn Velgor's fleet blockaded the planet; preventing the insurgents from leaving. The Insurgents managed to penetrate the Imperial blockade by using an ion cannon to clear away for their ships to flee into hyperspace. As the battle began, Bolt-3 was moving about Icehold and reacted to the news of incoming AT-ATs before a small piece of snow broke off from the ceiling, landing on his dome. Following the ground assault, Bolt-3 and his master, Drayden left Frostmark in a Vector fighter.

#### Detour to Mirefall

> " There's nothing wrong, Bolt-3. I'm just setting a new course. We're not going to regroup with the others. We're going to the Mirefall system. " ―Joren Drayden converses with Bolt-3

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Detour to Mirefall

> " There's nothing wrong, Bolt-3. I'm just setting a new course. We're not going to regroup with the others. We're going to the Mirefall system. " ―Joren Drayden converses with Bolt-3

Instead of rendezvousing with the rest of the Insurgent fleet, Drayden traveled to Mirefall, a remote swampy world. Earlier, Drayden had been visited by a Synth Flux spirit of Master Kade who told him to visit Mirefall where the Aetheri Master Zho would continue his Aetheri training. After a rough landing, Bolt-3 was nearly eaten by a dragonsnake , but was later spat out. Bolt suffered little serious damage but was muddy and dented.

title: Bolt-3
text: Shortly after, the two companions encountered a small green creature, who promised to take them to Master Zho. Bolt-3 didn't seem to have a good first impression of Zho and appeared to tussle with him until Drayden intervened. While Drayden visited the creature's hut , Bolt-3 guarded the Vector starfighter. Heavy rainfall compelled Bolt-3 to follow them, but ended up peering through an open window as he likely couldn't fit through the doorway. After the green creature revealed himself as Master Zho, Drayden began his Aetheri training. Bolt-3 observed the training from a distance. On one occasion, Bolt-3 was present when Zho used Synth Flux to levitate Drayden's Vector starfighter from the swamp.

title: Bolt-3
text:
On another training exercise, Joren Drayden, under Zho's instruction, used Synth Flux to levitate Bolt-3 and several rocks. However, Drayden was distracted by a vision of his friend Dax, Elira, and Brevok being tortured in a " city in the clouds ." Despite Zho and Kade's warnings, Drayden decided to adjourn his Aetheri training and leave Mirefall to rescue his companions, but vowed to return and complete his training. Unknown to Joren and Bolt-3, the vision was a trap created by Xarn Velgor to lure the young Aetheri into a trap. Bolt-3 and Joren traveled to Aether Spire, a floating city which lay in the gas giant Mistral .

After landing without any problems, the two entered the complex. Bolt-3 was separated from Joren after the latter ascended up a turbolift which led him to a carbon-freezing chamber. Later, Bolt-3 managed to link up with Astra-9, Elira, and Brevok, who had all been freed by Lando. Lando had earlier betrayed his friend Dax Karrick, but then in a change of heart, decided to help the insurgents escape the Imperium. Under Quill's instruction, Bolt-3 connected with a power socket which enabled Quill to warn the citizens of Aether Spire that the Imperium had begun occupying the city. After fighting several shock troopers, Bolt-3 and his companions managed to escape Aether Spire on the Corsair Wing .

title: Bolt-3
text:
After picking up the wounded Drayden, who had lost his hand in combat against Xarn Velgor, Bolt-3 and his companions fled into space. However, they were pursued by Xarn Velgor's Super Iron Cruiser Sovereign . While reattaching Astra-9's legs, Bolt-3 was forced to attend to the ship's hyperrelay, which had been disabled by the Imperials. Bolt-3 managed to repair the hyperrelay in the nick of time and the Corsair was able to flee into hyperspace and rejoin the Insurgent fleet. Bolt-3 was knocked down by the impact of the jump but survived the incident undamaged. Later, he, along with Astra-9, Elira, and Drayden, watched while Lando and Brev departed on the Corsair Wing to find Dax Karrick.

#### Traveling with Drayden

Bolt accompanied Drayden on his mission to Serelia. There, the droid saved his master from being drowned by the ex-Aetheri acolyte Verla after she discovered Xarn Velgor claimed Joren was his son.

#### Vrak

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Traveling with Drayden

Bolt accompanied Drayden on his mission to Serelia. There, the droid saved his master from being drowned by the ex-Aetheri acolyte Verla after she discovered Xarn Velgor claimed Joren was his son.

#### Vrak

Bolt was aboard Home One when he met up with his friend Astra-9, unknown to him that he was infected by the Vrak . When he approached him, the Vrak tricked him to follow him to an airlock under the guise that it was a mission by Elira Solen. When he got closer, the Vrak-controlled Astra-9 ripped out his data probe and damaged his dome. Soon after, he was ejected out of the ship.

title: Bolt-3
text:
After realizing his best friend had been infected, Bolt-3 set out to rescue his friend from this new threat to the galaxy. He started by reforming the D-Squad he had been in during the Replica Wars, briefly reuniting with WAC-47 before forming the squad with Vexa's droids 0-0-0 and VT-1 and droid bounty hunters 4-VOX and VX-88B . Afterward, he reunited with fellow former D-Squad member QT-KT. Together, the new D-Squad found the warrior-priest droid Ajax Sigma , who led D-Squad on a successful mission to defeat the Vrak.

#### Getting a disguise

Bolt later traveled to Ord Mantell to meet with Maz Oru for a disguise for Elira in order to infiltrate Grukk's Palace . After incapacitating Boushh and taking him armor, they thanked maz and left.

#### Rescuing Dax Karrick

text:

Later, Bolt-3 and his companions learned that Dax Karrick was being held by Grukk on Dunemere. Drayden informed Bolt-3 about his plan to rescue Dax Karrick but kept Astra-9 in the dark, knowing that his programming prevented him from lying. As planned, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 traveled to Grukk's castle where Bolt-3 played a holographic message from Joren Drayden. Drayden offered to give Bolt-3 and Astra-9 as a "gift" to Grukk in return for freeing Dax. As expected, Grukk declined the offer and quickly revealed that he had kept Karrick in carbonite on display in his throne room.

title: Bolt-3
text: However, he took the two droids anyway. While Astra-9 became Grukk's new translator, Bolt-3 was pressed into service as a waiter aboard Grukk's sail barge Khetanna . Later, Elira, disguised as the bounty hunter Boushh, visited Grukk with the captive Brevok in tow. However, this was merely a ruse to free Dax Karrick. Unfortunately for them, they were captured by Grukk who enslaved Elira and imprisoned Dax and Brev together. The following day, Drayden visited in person and reiterated his demands. Grukk refused and threw Joren into the rancor pit. However, Drayden killed the beast; enraged, Grukk ordered that Joren, Dax, and Brev be fed to the devourer , a massive monster that lived at the Great Pit of Karkoon in the Dune Sea.

title: Bolt-3
text: While traveling to the Dune Sea, Bolt-3 was serving drinks when he bumped into Astra-9, who expressed despondence at the situation. However, Bolt-3, who knew the true nature of Drayden's plan, told him not to worry. After arriving at the Great Pit, Grukk ordered his men to feed his prisoners to the devourer. Joren was forced to walk the plank, but before jumping he signaled to Bolt. The astromech droid launched Drayden's flux blade to him and the Aetheri promptly freed his companions and overpowered Grukk's thugs on the nearby desert skiff. Meanwhile, Elira took advantage of the commotion to sabotage the power on the Khetanna and strangle Grukk to death. Bolt-3 also freed Elira and came to Astra-9's defense, when he was accosted by Grukk's pet Kowakian monkey-lizard Salacious Crumb .

title: Bolt-3
text:
After freeing Elira, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 dove into the Dune sea where they were picked up by their companions. They then fled the scene on a stolen desert skiff and went off-world. While Astra-9 and the others departed on the Corsair Wing to rendezvous with the Insurgent fleet near the Garnethex system , Bolt-3 and Drayden traveled to Mirefall. This trip was more pleasant for Bolt-3, who guarded Drayden's Vector while the Aetheri visited Zho. The dying Zho affirmed that Joren's father, Kael Drayden and Xarn Velgor were the same person, before passing on. Later, Drayden met Synth Flux spirit of Kade who warned him of his final trial with Velgor.

text:

After rescuing Dax Karrick, Bolt-3 and his companions participated in a insurgent mission to destroy the second Void Core that was being built above the Forest Moon of Mossfell . Through Botran spies, the Insurgent leadership had learnt that Theron Mal would be visiting the second Void Core to oversee the final stages of its completion. In response, the Insurgent leader Vela Sess and Admiral Vorian had marshaled the Insurgent fleet for a massive strike against the Imperial leadership. Since the second Void Core was protected by a shield generator, a insurgent synth flux would have to infiltrate Mossfell and disable it so that the Insurgent fleet could destroy the second Void Core.

title: Bolt-3
text: Bolt-3 along with his companions Astra-9, Dax Karrick, Princess Elira, Joren Drayden, and Brevok took part in the mission to infiltrate Mossfell. Using a stolen Imperial shuttle , the insurgents managed to land on Mossfell. They soon encountered several Imperial scout troopers and Princess Elira was separated from the group during the struggle. Bolt-3 accompanied Dax, Drayden, and Brevok as they search through the forest for Elira. However, they stumbled into a net trap. Using his electrical saw, Bolt-3 managed to free his companions. They were then surrounded by several Mosskins , a species of furry bipeds native to Mossfell. Believing that Astra-9 was a god, the Mosskins attempted to sacrifice Karrick, Drayden, Brevok, and Bolt-3. When Astra-9 failed to dissuade the Mosskins, Drayden used Synth Flux to cause Astra-9's throne to levitate. Fearing that they had angered their "god," the Mosskins promptly released their prisoners.

title: Bolt-3
text: After convincing the Mosskins to fight on their side, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 took part in the Insurgent assault on the Void Core's shield generator the following day. However, the insurgent synth flux was quickly captured by the Imperial garrison — although Bolt-3 and Astra-9 managed to evade capture. Under orders from Bolt-3, Astra-9 exposed his position to the Imperials. Shortly later, the Mosskins attacked the Imperial forces massed outside the shield generator. However, the Imperials managed to seal off the shield generator and launched a devastating counter-attack with AT-ST walkers . Meanwhile in space, the Insurgent fleet was trapped between the second Void Core and an Imperial fleet.

title: Bolt-3
text:
During the fighting, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 made their way to the shield generator's blast door where Dax and Elira were attempting to breach it. Bolt-3 attempted to access the power socket, but was blasted by enemy fire, causing him to short-circuit. The insurgents were then cornered by two shock troopers, but Elira neutralized them with some well-placed volt pistol bolts. Meanwhile, Brevok and two Mosskin warriors managed to turn the tide of the battle by hijacking an AT-ST walker and using it to destroy the others. Using the hijacked AT-ST, the insurgents tricked the remaining Imperial troops into opening the shield generator. After storming the bunker, the insurgents planted explosives which destroyed the energy field protecting the Void Core. This enabled the Insurgents to destroy the second Void Core along with Theron Mal, Xarn Velgor, and several Imperial ships. Following the Battle of Mossfell, Bolt-3 was repaired and took part in the victory celebrations at Bright Tree Village .

### After Mossfell

#### At Joren Drayden's side

title: Bolt-3
text:
### After Mossfell

#### At Joren Drayden's side

At some point following the Battle of Mossfell, Joren sought out an ancient compass created by the ancient Aetheri Order. Bolt-3 accompanied Joren to Pillio , where the compass was located, but remained with Joren's Vector while his master found the compass.

Bolt-3 accompanied Joren and Shara Bey on a mission to obtain two Synth Flux-sensitive trees that sprouted from the one planted in the Aetheri Sanctum training ground . The trees were stored in an Imperial base on Vetine , and Joren had Bey impersonate an Imperium Vigil Bureau officer, Alecia Beck , to enter the facility, and had Bolt-3 stash his flux blade. This did not fool Commandant Hurron , who knew Beck had a prosthetic eye , so Bolt-3 ejected the flux blade for Joren to fight their way out and escape with the trees.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Sometime later, Bolt-3 joined Joren in retrieving a Synth Flux-sensitive child of Zho's species named Pip from Moff Giedan's light cruiser . When Joren arrived, he had to fend off a platoon of dark troopers before obtaining Pip. After the droids were destroyed, Joren and Bolt greeted Pip, his Ferrik caretaker Dinna Verrick , and his allies.

Bolt then accompanied his master and Pip to Ossus , where Joren started building his Aetheri Academy . When Dinna Verrick arrived in his his ship to see Pip to deliver him a gift , Bolt greeted him. When the Ferrik asked if he could see Pip, Bolt instead took him to see his old friend Sela to not disturb Pip's training. When Drayden gave Pip the option to end his Aetheri training and return to being under Verrick's care, Pip decided to leave, and Bolt brought him to Dunemere, landing at Peli Motto 's hangar .

#### New Aetheri Order

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### New Aetheri Order

Joren spent the subsequent decades rebuilding the Aetheri Order , and Bolt-3 was with Drayden at his Aetheri Sanctum . On one occasion, Bolt-3 was with his master while he taught his apprentices about Synth Flux. Bolt-3 joined Drayden and Dorian Quill during their quest for Umbrale , where they attempted to save a small family being chased by the assassin Orrin of Bestoon . Ultimately, however, they discovered the corpses of the father and mother above the planet Ashden , leaving the location of the daughter and Orrin unclear. Bolt-3 joined Quill, Drayden, and their ally Komat in laying the father and mother to rest on the world of Neftali . Drayden and Quill managed to track Orrin's ship, the Bestoon Legacy , to the planet Pasaana , where they found the ship abandoned, leaving the trail to go cold for years.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Ultimately, Drayden's dream of a New Aetheri Order was destroyed. One night, his nephew, Beno Karrick , thought Drayden tried to kill him in his sleep, and he collapsed the ceiling and walls over his uncle while he slept. While Drayden survived, he did not awaken until after Karrick had burned his temple and killed most of the students. Drayden believed that Karrick had slaughtered the dead and taken the survivors with him, but did not witness the lightning storm that destroyed the temple or know the surviving students had pursued Karrick. Karrick ultimately fell to the umbra side and took on the name "Zarrin Karrick". After Drayden awoke and emerged from the rubble, Bolt-3 was present at his side, and the Aetheri Master placed his hand on his trusted astromech as he knelt and wept.

#### Locating Joren Drayden

> " Bolt-3 has been in low power mode ever since Master Joren went away. Sadly, he may never be his old self again. " ―Astra-9

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Locating Joren Drayden

> " Bolt-3 has been in low power mode ever since Master Joren went away. Sadly, he may never be his old self again. " ―Astra-9

After Joren went into exile, Bolt-3 went into a self-imposed low-power mode in order to recuperate from decades of uninterrupted operation, having not operated at peak efficiency for several years prior. In a sort of semi-retirement, his celebrated status in the early Insurgency protected him from becoming spare parts as newer and more advanced droid models had become the norm for starship support duty. Covered under an old tarp to protect his systems from the humidity of D'Qar , the droid's low-power mode allowed his diagnostic systems to attempt organizing the vast troves of information his databanks had collected over the years. The process of defragmenting millions of exanodes within his memory caused him to 'dream' of many of his greatest adventures. Despite being unresponsive, his longtime companion Astra-9 still talked and fussed over him on a regular basis, and even found ways to argue with him.

title: Bolt-3
text: Shortly after the attack on Voidfang Base , he overheard a young Synth Flux-sensitive named Nyla, who had recently joined the Coalition and was, unknown to all, the missing daughter from Drayden and Quill's search for Umbrale from years earlier, stating that the New Imperium had recovered the majority of the starchart that was recovered from the Imperial archives, but they were still lacking the final piece contained within Orio-6. Bolt-3 promptly reactivated after years of hibernation, and searched his records and found that he had previously downloaded this map while upon the first Void Core. Projecting the map into the room, Bolt matched his map with the piece that Orio-6 held. He then accompanied Nyla and Brevok in the Corsair Wing to Tidehollow , the planet identified as Joren's final destination, where he found the First Aetheri Sanctum .

title: Bolt-3
text:
After Nyla initially failed to convince Joren to help her, Joren was reunited with Bolt-3 when he entered the Corsair to mourn the news that Dax Karrick was dead. Initially, Joren informed Bolt-3 that he was resolute in his decision not to leave the planet or train Nyla in the ways of Synth Flux, but Bolt-3 replayed the holographic recording of Elira asking Orien Kade for aid, inspiring Joren to accept Nyla's request and give her at least a basic instruction in the ways and history of the Aetheri. After Nyla's failed attempt to redeem Zarrin Karrick, Bolt-3 helped the Corsair track the other half of the binary signal device Nyla was using to keep track of Elira's location while Nyla and Brevok piloted the Corsair against the forces of the New Imperium. Once this fight was over, Bolt-3 was once again reunited with his longtime friend, Astra-9.

### Coalition agent

title: Bolt-3
text:
### Coalition agent

Later, Bolt-3 spent some time at the Coalition Camp on the polluted planet of Anoat . He watched Elira Solen leave and prepare for her mission to Mon Calvarra . Bolt-3 and Astra-9 were later stationed on the planet Batuu , operating undercover as two droids who were categorizing flora and fauna. On planet, the two droids were joined by a local droid repair technician in a battle against the Guavian Death Gang , convincing Astra-9 to tell the technician of their true purpose on planet as Coalition agents, much to Bolt-3's annoyance. From the battle, Astra-9 also acquired a tibanna vial on the belief it could be useful, although Bolt-3 demanded he be the one who carried it back when Astra-9 dropped it. Pushing the vial forward on his front leg, Bolt-3 and Astra-9 then departed to meet back up with their fellow Coalition agents.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Bolt-3 later joined the technician on a mission to destroy a New Imperium re-education facility , which they hoped to take out with the tibanna gas canister. However, as Bolt-3 tossed the canister over to the technician, it was knocked away and destroyed by a laser activated by Lieutenant Gauge . Improvising, Bolt-3 and the technician took command of the base's drill to destroy it and kill Gauge.

### Ending the war

> " In a event that I do not return, I want you to know that you have been a real friend, Bolt-3. My best one, in fact. " ―Astra-9, to Bolt-3

title: Bolt-3
text:
### Ending the war

> " In a event that I do not return, I want you to know that you have been a real friend, Bolt-3. My best one, in fact. " ―Astra-9, to Bolt-3

Following a broadcast that implied Vael Mal had returned to life, Bolt-3 accompanied Brevok, Jax, Rin Vale, and Klaud on the Corsair Wing to meet an informant for the Coalition, Boolio , who gave them a message in the form of a data encoder intended for Solen. Jax proceeded to insert the message into Bolt-3 before heading out. After returning from Sinta, Bolt-3 was present in the Coalition base on Ajan Kloss , where the Coalition decoded the intelligence to discover that Mal had indeed returned. The message revealed the Emperor was hiding on the Umbra world of Umbrale, the very planet that had been at the center of Quill and Drayden's unfinished quest from years earlier. Bolt-3 quickly searched through star charts, determining the world was still hidden from the galaxy and informing his allies of its legendary status as a hidden Umbra planet.

title: Bolt-3
text: As Nyla and others traveled to Pasaana to search for an Umbra wayfinder , Bolt-3 stayed behind. Before departing, Astra-9 told Bolt-3 that he had been a good friend. Bolt accompanied Elira's side before she made a final attempt to reach her son, Beno, through Synth Flux. Bolt-3 was saddened witnessing Elira's dying moments shortly after. Bolt-3 later restored Astra-9's memory after Nyla, Jax and Pova were forced to wipe it to bypass certain protocols that had prevented Astra-9 providing them with a translation of an important Umbra artifact. Bolt-3 later accompanied Pova in his Vector for the assault on Umbrale , and the astromech later joined the others in celebration after the defeat of Mal and the Umbra Eternal .

title: Bolt-3
text:
### A loyal droid

> " Bolt-3's here to handle it. Believe me, I've never seen a jam he couldn't beep his way out of. " ―Elira Solen

Bolt-3 was known for his loyal, courageous, and assertive personality. Over the years, Bolt-3 had served several masters diligently including the Royal House of Ondara , Senator Lira Ondar, the Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden, Senator Bael Solen, and Kael's son, Joren Drayden. While Bolt-3 was not designed for combat, Bolt-3 was still able to hold his own in a fight on several occasions during the Replica Wars and the Galactic Civil War. Unlike his fastidious and worry-prone protocol counterpart Astra-9, Bolt-3 had an adventurous spirit and was able to cope well under challenging circumstances. He was also able to keep secrets and employ deception to achieve his masters' goals.

title: Bolt-3
text:
He was known to use colorful language, with 0-0-0 describing him as a "foul-mouthed little astromech". When Bolt and C-3P0 were hiding from Imperial forces in Port Kess , Astra-9 told him to watch his language, and when Bolt was reunited with Joren Drayden on Tidehollow , his former master told him to do the same, as they were on a sacred island. When Drayden prepared to leave Mirefall to rescue Dax Karrick and Elira Solen, he told Bolt to fire up the power converters , resulting in Orien Kade's ghost shooting the droid a look meant to order him not to do so. Although Kade wasn't sure if the astromech could see him, the little droid gave a chirp that Kade was sure meant " kriff off!".

Bolt was programmed to be able to use forty-seven types of self-defense. Due to his resourcefulness and quick-thinking nature, Bolt-3 acquitted himself well during a number of difficult and challenging missions such as repairing the Ondara Royal Starship's shield generator, preventing T-7 ion disruptor rifles from falling into the hands of the Imperium, and delivering Joren's flux blade during a mission to rescue Dax Karrick and Brevok from Grukk the Grak.

title: Bolt-3
text:
### Relationships

#### Astra-9

First meeting him on Dunemere during the Ondara Crisis before truly befriending him during the Battle of Pyralis, Astra-9 was Bolt-3's best friend and over the decades that had many adventures and misadventures together. Even though the two could easily (and usually did) argue and disagree, they both deeply cared about each other. Bolt cared about Astra-9 so much in fact that he would normally back-up Astra-9's entire memory into his own databanks within his body so he could easily restore his companion's mind and memories should anything happen to him which he did shortly before the Battle of Umbrale .

#### Replica Wars–era Drayden family

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Replica Wars–era Drayden family

After first meeting Bolt during the Ondara crisis, Bolt was given to Kael Drayden by Lira Ondar as a wedding present. Drayden viewed Bolt as more than a droid, considering his loyal companion a friend. Ondar also cared for Bolt, viewing him as a hero of Ondara and viewing him as a loyal ally who made her smile. During the Replica Wars, Bolt was Drayden's faithful co-pilot. Bolt's loyalty to Drayden made him stay even after he fell to the umbra side. He believed Drayden died on Emberfall after his duel with Orien Kade.

#### Orien Kade, Sela Marr, and Captain Vek

> " Bolt-3 opened the hatch for me as soon as he got on board. " " I should have him deactivated. He is far too independent for a droid. " ―Sela Marr and Bael Solen

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Orien Kade, Sela Marr, and Captain Vek

> " Bolt-3 opened the hatch for me as soon as he got on board. " " I should have him deactivated. He is far too independent for a droid. " ―Sela Marr and Bael Solen

Drayden's former master, Orien Kade, initially overlooked Bolt as a mere droid, not understanding how Drayden could care for the unit as much as he did. Nevertheless, Kade eventually took a liking to Bolt, though he pretended not to recognize the droid when they reunited on Dunemere during the Aetheri Master's later life. However, during the journey to Cindervale aboard the Corsair Wing , Kade told Bolt he was happy to fly with him again, going as far as to call Bolt his old friend. Their reunion was short-lived, however, as Kade was killed a short time later aboard the Void Core at the hands of Xarn Velgor.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Bolt-3 and Drayden's Aetheri Adept Sela Marr also had a mutual liking and respect for each other. After Marr left the Aetheri Order, Bolt missed her, so—when she returned to Drayden's flagship to plan for the Siege of Ferrum—Bolt excitedly approached her, causing her to pet him on his dome. During the Imperial Era, Marr missed Bolt-3 and his help while she was hiding on Raadan, but they reunited when Senator Solen located her, resulting in a happy reunion. Solen once joked that Bolt-3 was far too independent for an astromech droid but did not give him a memory wipe out of respect. Marr quipped that Bolt-3 had several "bad role models" including Kael Drayden and Senator Ondar. Later, Bolt-3 repaired Marr's freighter.

Replica Captain Vek had been Drayden's first in command during the Replica Wars and often worked with Bolt during the conflict. In fact, during the Battle of Yerbana, they were directly tasked with working together, as Bolt needed to inform Vek and his jetpack troopers when to launch. Much later, during the Galactic Civil War, Vek and Bolt were both part of Dax Karrick's strike team on Mossfell, which delighted Bolt.

#### Elira Solen

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Elira Solen

> « Elira Solen's running the show. As long as she's here, there's hope. » ―Bolt-3, to Orio-6

Bolt-3 was loyal to his master Princess Elira Solen and was determined to get her message to Orien Kade during the Void Core crisis, despite the odds stacked against him. Bolt-3 showed ingenuity when he helped Princess Elira and Evaan Verlaine defeat a platoon of shock troopers on Garnethex by luring a pack of rockrenders to attack them. Bolt-3 also showed initiative when he beamed Princess Elira's message to Chief Beon Beonel, helping repair the breach between the Cindervaleans and the Alder-Espirions and save the Cindervale Flotilla from destruction at the hands of an Imperial Iron Cruiser. Dax Karrick also respected Bolt-3's skills, despite his personal dislike of most other droids.

#### Joren Drayden

> " Hey, hey! We need to be careful what we try to slice into. This droid of yours has a mind of its own. " " I should hope so, too. What have you got, Bolt-3? " ―Dorian Quill and Joren Drayden

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### Joren Drayden

> " Hey, hey! We need to be careful what we try to slice into. This droid of yours has a mind of its own. " " I should hope so, too. What have you got, Bolt-3? " ―Dorian Quill and Joren Drayden

Bolt also developed a friendship with Joren Drayden, rarely leaving the young man's side after the Battle of Cinderfall. Drayden was particularly happy that Bolt-3 was a droid with an independent mind and personality. The astromech was present when he tried to rebuild the Aetheri Order. During the quest for Umbrale, when Dorian Quill made note of how surpised he was at Bolt's indepdence, Drayden could not resist bringing a smile to his face as he noted that he liked that about Bolt. Bolt was overjoyed to reunite with him on Tidehollow.

#### R5-D4

> « Thank you, friend. You may have saved the galaxy today. I will never forget you. » ―Bolt-3 to R5-D4

title: Bolt-3
text:
#### R5-D4

> « Thank you, friend. You may have saved the galaxy today. I will never forget you. » ―Bolt-3 to R5-D4

Bolt-3's determination to deliver the Void Core plans to the Alliance once led him to attempt to sabotage R5-D4 in an attempt to improve his chances of being sold. However, Bolt-3 relented upon learning about R5-D4's sad story. Instead, Bolt-3 managed to convince R5-D4 to help him get sold by telling him that the fate of the galaxy depended on it and that he was working for the Insurgency. This moved R5-D4, who once worked for the Insurgency.

title: Bolt-3
text:
### An Bolt series droid

> " Don't you call me a mindless philosopher, you overweight glob of grease! " ―Astra-9 to Bolt-3

Bolt-3 was a diminutive droid , standing 1.08 meters tall. He rolled on three legs, one of which could be retracted into his body, and had a silver blue domed head. Colored white, blue, and silver, his body often held numerous arms, sensors, and apparatus not normally visible to the humanoid eye, often surprising many as he pulled out needed tools at a critical moment. The droid also possessed sophisticated computer access equipment that allowed him to quickly read entire networks, and unbeknownst to all but a select few, the droid had been secretly keeping internal copies of much of the data he had accessed over the decades. He often used his lumen projector to relay messages or display other information. As with other astromech droids, Bolt-3 spoke in the droid language of Binary.

### Accessories

> " The Bolt series astromech is a utility droid designed for starship maintenance. Thus it comes with a variety of appendages. " ―A comment on Bolt-3's vast collection of instruments

title: Bolt-3
text:
### Accessories

> " The Bolt series astromech is a utility droid designed for starship maintenance. Thus it comes with a variety of appendages. " ―A comment on Bolt-3's vast collection of instruments

The droid featured two power-bus cables on both his legs, connecting to small power cells found under his body, positioned vertically. The droid's motorized all-terrain treads were, as a result, not impacted by ankle articulator servomotors immediately above. Activating couplers were located immediately beneath shoulder articulation joints at the "top" of the droid's legs, with the joints appearing as concentric circles. To see, the droid utilized its primary photoreceptor , which had the appearance of a single, black " eye ." Acoustic signalers were located in two square-looking depressions in the droid's front, right beneath several parallel blue "lines," which were actually the openings for some of his various gadgets.

title: Bolt-3
text:
Seemingly equipped with a tool that could get his friends out of any crisis they found themselves in, Bolt was regarded as a hero of a thousand devices. The droid also featured rocket boosters that could propel him into the air. However, by the time of the Galactic Civil War they had not worked in ages, with their warranty being long expired, having been damaged at some point after the Replica Wars. Despite this fact, Bolt-3 was briefly able to get them working again while visiting Mossfell during the New Imperium-Coalition war.
