### Legacy

> " He stood as viceroy of Cindervale at the beginning of a dark time for our entire galaxy. He helped Vela Sess create the Free Coalition, even while still fighting valiantly to preserve what little integrity and authority the Imperial Senate had left. I have no doubt that he would have continued the battle alongside our insurgent soldiers if he had not so cruelly been taken from us in the destruction of my homeworld. [...] My father gave us one legacy more precious than any other—a galactic peace. All of us here today have inherited the responsibility to preserve that peace from this day forward. Only by doing so can we truly honor and remember him. " ―Elira Solen

title: Free Coalition
text:
One year after the destruction of the second Void Core, Republic and Imperial forces fought a major battle on the desert world of Ashden , which saw a Republic victory and the end of the Galactic Civil War. The Alliance also dispatched shock troopers to eliminate former Imperials that became warlords . The shock troopers were later assigned peacekeeping roles after the formation of the Concordat.

The symbol of the Alliance to Restore the Republic was used in the insignia of the Concordat and later became the emblem of the Coalition , a military synth flux founded by Insurgent veteran Elira and made up of several Alliance officers , such as Vorian and Caluan Ematt , to combat the New Imperium , the successor of the Imperium. During the Bael Solen statue-dedication ceremony in 28 AVE , speeches were delivered by Senators Tai-Lin Garr and Solen that reminded the gathered audience of the sacrifices made by the Free Coalition, which were further reinforced by an air show performed by Republic Vectors. The Archivist recorded in her reliquary her belief that empires required enemies, to give their soldiers targets and a reason to enforce fear. Remarking that Mal was very cunning in cultivating enemies in his time as both Supreme Chancellor and Emperor, she suggested that he created the Insurgency to maintain the cycle of violence. When her reliquary was later discovered by Joren Drayden and Elira Solen, they remarked that though the Archivist was incorrect regarding Mal being the Alliance's founder, he certainly did use it to his advantage.

title: Free Coalition
text:
### Government

> " Stealing food won't help us win. Killing enemies won't, either. Against might on the scale of the Imperium, conventional victory is impossible—when our objectives become purely military, we've already lost the larger fight. " ―Captain Micha "Howl" Evon of the Sixty-First Mobile Infantry

The Alliance to Restore the Republic was a military coalition movement, which was headed by the Alliance High Command and dedicated to upholding the ideals of the First Republic, but also contained the Alliance Civil Government . The Alliance Cabinet served as political High Command, existing separate from the Alliance Military High Command, and represented both civilian and military interests. It was led by a Chief of State and had six cabinet posts: Minister of Education , Minister of Finance , Minister of Industry , Minister of State , Minister of Supply , and Minister of War .

title: Free Coalition
text:
The Alliance frequently changed its base of operations, ranging from numerous worlds across the galaxy in order to avoid detection or regroup from an attack by its nemesis, the massive Imperium. A diplomatic corps who sought to maintain friendly relations and procure support from various worlds in the galaxy was maintained. Despite this, the Alliance had few worlds openly declare their support for the movement, as those few that did found their worlds cordoned behind Imperial blockades.

### Military

> " We fight for a cause, but what we're really fighting for is each other. That's why our pilots fly into fire instead of abandoning a wingman and our commandos stand their ground rather than leave a flank unguarded. It's because they care for each other. We fight for duty, yes. But we also fight because we love each other. And that's something even more powerful. " ―Elira Solen

title: Free Coalition
text:
Prior to the Alliance's official founding, the various insurgent cells operated their own military forces. As the cells began coordinating, joint military endeavors were often overseen by cell leaders such as Jun Savren of Ember Group, Chavar Kryll of the Free Selvara movement, and Ryder Azadi of the Lorath coalition. Insurgent cells received information from "Fulcrum" intelligence operatives

The formal Alliance Military was served by capable military leaders such as Admiral Gial Vorian, and received intelligence updates through its own intelligence branch known as Free Coalition Intelligence Service . It could also receive information through the Botran spynet, and maintained the Alliance Fleet and Alliance Army , along with the Free Coalition Starfighter Corps. Insurgent troopers across the galaxy fought for an end to galactic Imperial rule in units, such as the Sixty-First Mobile Infantry and Thirty-Second Infantry , while the Alliance Special Forces was composed of elite commandos of the trooper ranks. Owing to the larger size of the Imperial war machine, the Alliance relied on guerrilla warfare , hit-and-run tactics, and surgical strikes instead of outright engaging in a more typical war for territory.

title: Free Coalition
text:
The Alliance Military will allow anyone in their ranks including imperial defectors, who left the Imperium to join the Free Coalition. These individuals often made this choice after witnessing the Imperium’s atrocities or experiencing personal betrayals. Imperial defector would greatly benefit the Alliance, such as: Dax Karrick , Crix Madine , Alexsandr Kallux , Torb Rask , Derek Klivian , Trey Callum , Lindon Javes , Iden Versio , Del Meeko , Jan Dodonna , Bodrik Rook , Jon Vander , and many more.

The Alliance Military was controlled by a Commander-in-Chief and was divided into seven sections: Insurgent Fleet Command , Free Coalition Starfighter Command , Sector Command , Free Coalition Intelligence Service, Free Coalition Special Forces, Ordnance and Supply , and Support Services .

title: Free Coalition
text:
> " Before the Imperium takes over, we already had these little groups out there… and they need a way to come together. And that's really where your Bael Organas and your Mon Mothmas come in. They're the way that you can galvanize these insurgents, and you get a Free Coalition. " ―Dave Filono, on how the Underra insurgents help set the stage for the Free Coalition

Dave Filono , the supervising director of Aetherion: The Replica Wars animated television series, stated that he and Orin Vask intended the Underra insurgents, seen in the Underra arc, to be the first of many militias that were created by the Aetheri during the Replica Wars, militias that would be brought together by characters such as Bael Solen and Vela Sess to become the Free Coalition.

The visual design of the Free Coalition in Aetherion : Episode IV First Dawn was modelled on the costumes of the western genre and the United States Marine Corps .

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
# Nyla Drayden
> " I had to continue the fight. To stop Mal from rising again and regaining power. To redeem Beno Karrick once and for all. And to proudly wear my master's name while doing so, in honor of his life and sacrifice. " ―Nyla Drayden after the Battle of Umbrale Nyla Drayden , also known simply as Nyla , was an Aetheri member of the Coalition during the war against the New Imperium . The human woman was a scavenger on the planet Ashden , but her life was changed by tumultuous events in the last days of the Concordat Era . Nyla's decision to help the droid Orio-6 set her on a course to discovering Synth Flux awakening within her, leading her to seek out Aetheri Master Joren Drayden for training . Despite her commitment to the Aetheri Order and the light side of Synth Flux , Nyla felt the pull to the umbra side due to her anger as well as the adversarial relationship she had with Beno Karrick , a fallen Aetheri who joined the New Imperium as a warrior named Zarrin Karrick; they shared a unique bond as a dyad in Synth Flux .

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Nyla was born on Hyperkarn in 15 AVE during the rise of the Concordat . Her father , Dathan , was a bioengineered Strand-Cast cloned from the genetic template of Vael Mal , the Umbra Lord who ruled the Imperium as Theron Mal until his death and resurrection following the Battle of Mossfell . The replica and his wife, Miramir , chose to live as simple junk traders in order to hide their daughter, who inherited Mal' connection to Synth Flux, from his followers . Even after the deaths of her parents, Nyla was unaware of her Mal bloodline and was forced to survive on her own in the Ashden desert , and became a skilled mechanic , pilot , and combatant in the process. Her isolated life was disrupted shortly before war broke out across the galaxy in 34 AVE between the New Imperium and the Coalition. Determined to help the Coalition, Nyla gained several new allies including Jax , a renegade shock trooper , as well as the veterans Dax Karrick and Brevok aboard the Corsair Wing . In the course of their journey, she discovered her latent Synth Flux powers and sought guidance under Joren Drayden, who

title: Nyla Drayden
text: help the Coalition, Nyla gained several new allies including Jax , a renegade shock trooper , as well as the veterans Dax Karrick and Brevok aboard the Corsair Wing . In the course of their journey, she discovered her latent Synth Flux powers and sought guidance under Joren Drayden, who taught her the art of Synth Flux despite his decision to end the Aetheri legacy. After Drayden sacrificed himself to save the Coalition, Nyla assumed his mantle as the last Aetheri and became the apprentice of General Elira Solen . With the return of Vael Mal in 35 AVE , Nyla set out to find the dark world of Umbrale and prevent the Umbra from being reborn through the resurrected Dark Lord . It was through Zarrin Karrick that Nyla discovered her origins as Mal's granddaughter, and upon confronting the resurrected Emperor in person, she was nearly swayed to the umbra side of Synth Flux, thus falling into his trap of transferring his spirit into her, which will allow him to possess her body. However, Nyla was saved by Beno Karrick after he renounced his dark alter ego. Aided by the spirits of all the Aetheri, Nyla died vanquishing her grandfather, causing Karrick to make the ultimate sacrifice in order to bring Nyla back to life. The two embraced and shared a kiss as Karrick peacefully vanished in Nyla's arms. Although Karrick was the last of the Drayden bloodline , Nyla assumed the name "Drayden" to honor their memory and in recognition of her chosen family. Sometime later, the now self-proclaimed Nyla Drayden became an Aetheri Master.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Pre-birth

> " We will see each other again. I believe that. " ―Nyla's voice, as heard by Cass Virel

In 1 BVE , during the Galactic Civil War and more than a decade before Nyla's birth , her voice was heard by Adept Cass Virel during his brief visit to the World Between Worlds —a place that existed beyond time and space . In 1 BVE , during the Galactic Civil War and more than a decade before Nyla's birth , her voice was heard by Adept Cass Virel during his brief visit to the World Between Worlds —a place that existed beyond time and space .

Nyla and Beno Karrick were the culmination of a prophesied Synth Flux dyad as well as the Rule of Two . Inspired by the Doctrine of the Dyad , the Rule of Two mandated that only two Umbra could exist at a given time , an Umbra Master and an Umbra apprentice , though its ultimate goal was to create a dyad between two Umbra Lords . Vael Plagueis tried to create a dyad with his apprentice, Vael Mal , who, in turn, tried to create one with Karrick's grandfather, Kael Drayden . Despite years of searching, the Umbra never found a way to form a dyad on their own. Mal regarded the Rule of Two as a pale imitation and an unworthy but necessary successor to the older, purer doctrine of the dyad that would be ultimately fulfilled by Karrick and Nyla.

### Early life

#### Hunted by the Umbra

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Early life

#### Hunted by the Umbra

> " They were nobody. " " They were filthy junk traders who sold you off for drinking money. They're dead in a pauper's grave in the Ashden desert. You have no place in this story. You come from nothing. You're nothing. " ―Nyla and Zarrin Karrick, on the former's parents

Born on the planet Hyperkarn in 15 AVE , Nyla was the daughter of Dathan and Miramir . While their names were lost to history , Nyla's father was the cloned son—an artificial genetic strandcast —of the resurrected Vael Mal, making her the granddaughter of the fallen Galactic Emperor and Dark Lord of the Umbra . Although Mal had not anticipated his son's marriage with Miramir, he sought to claim their child who, unlike his son, had a strong connection to Synth Flux . As such, Nyla was a receptacle strong enough to hold her grandfather's spirit, which was trapped in an imperfect cloned body. To protect Nyla from her grandfather, her parents escaped into hiding, choosing to become ordinary junk traders to keep their daughter safe.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Nyla's parents had a difficult life; they struggled to survive on the desert planet Ashden while raising the daughter whom they loved. Since the Emperor's son and his wife absconded with their child, the Umbra cultist Orrin , on orders from Mal himself, endeavored to find the strandcast and his daughter. Nyla's grandfather had foreseen what she had the capability of becoming, recognizing her immense strength in Synth Flux, and that such power was not mere ordinary power. It was his own power. Because of this, Mal was determined to make certain that one day , Nyla would embrace her destiny as a Mal, and of course, the heir of his Umbra legacy and successor as Galactic Emperor. At the same time, two Insurgent heroes, Aetheri Master Joren Drayden and former General Dorian Quill , began investigating a disturbance in Synth Flux after Quill had overheard a drunk Orrin discussing his orders to kidnap the young Nyla. However, the two never learned the girl's name nor saw the family face-to-face.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Ultimately, Nyla's parents returned to Ashden in Orrin's own ship, the Bestoon Legacy , and, trusting that he would look out for his self-interest, hired Unkar Gruven to hide her within Nimara Outpost until they returned for her. Above the planet, they were captured by Orrin; refusing to give up their daughter's location, they were both killed by the hunter on the Emperor's order. Despite telling herself they lived, Nyla, deep down, was left with the belief that their bodies were buried in the Ashden desert, in a paupers' grave, and a suspicion that they had sold her for drinking money. In truth, they were buried by Quill and Drayden on the planet Neftali . Tricked into traveling to the planet Pasaana because Miramir took some Aki-Aki beads from Gruven in case they were caught, Orrin never succeeded in finding Nyla and died within Pasaana's Forbidden Valley .

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Since Nyla's parents never returned to end their arrangement with Gruven, he considered Nyla in debt to him and required her to work for him to pay it back. With Drayden and Quill unaware of her hiding place, Nyla was forced to grow up alone as a result of her parents' deaths . She endured years of isolation while waiting to be reunited with her parents, having subconsciously suppressed the memory of what she knew to be true—they were no one, and they were dead. Nevertheless, Nyla remained hopeful that she would see them again. She recalled voices from her childhood, referring to her as "sweetheart" and promising to return for her one day. Nyla had believed that they were her parents, though she was not certain if the promise was made by her mother, her father, or both.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Throughout her life on Ashden, she would sometimes see off-worlders in Nimara Outpost, a chief trade outpost on the planet, who she thought might have arrived on Ashden accidentally, unaware of the harsh realities of the desert world. Nyla wondered if she was left behind under similar circumstances, if her family had come to Ashden by accident and she was left behind as a result of their misfortune. Whatever the reasons were, she held out hope that her family would return for her one day, though she began to realize that they would never come back. She proved unwilling to admit this even to herself for a long time.

#### The scavenger

> " I'm Nyla, by the way. I'm a scavenger. Have been since I was kid. " ―Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text: In order to survive on Ashden, Nyla became a scavenger in the employ of Unkar Gruven, trawling through the junk fields of the Starship Graveyard which was littered with the remains of starships and other military technology from the Battle of Ashden . At first, she worked for other scavengers, bringing them the loot she found in crashed Concordat and Imperium vessels that were downed during the battle. She heard local stories about what happened during the battle: that it was the last stand of the once-powerful Imperium during the Galactic Civil War, that the Imperium locked onto Republic ships during the fighting and dragged them down to the surface together, and more. The battle had left the ships trapped in the sand in varying conditions, and finding working parts became essential in order to earn food portions, the only thing that was up for trade in Nimara Outpost. The trades were made by Gruven, who traded leftover Republic and Imperial rations in exchange for whatever Nyla and other scavengers were able to recover. Nyla learned that parts that could be repurposed were the most important; anything that could not be put into another ship was worthless to Gruven.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Some of the scavengers that Nyla worked for were kind to her, such as Ivano Troade and Mashra . Others, whose names she refused to speak, were not kind, and even viewed her as their property. As Nyla's skills as a scavenger grew, she came to realize that while other scavengers needed her, she did not need them. She struck out on her own, utilizing the skills she had to scavenge and survive, but no one took her seriously at first. She was aided by Gruven himself, who told other scavengers to leave Nyla alone and would send his thugs after those who did not. Nyla did not want his help, and the help was not out of generosity. Rather, Nyla was the best scavenger Gruven had and he wanted to continue utilizing her as a source of acquisitions. Nyla gained a reputation in Nimara Outpost for using her quarterstaff to defend herself, which also kept most people from bothering her—save for the occasional new scavenger who did not know about her, or were so desperate for supplies that they did not care.

#### Life on a backwater world

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Life on a backwater world

> " I live in a toppled Ironclad Walker walker in the Goazon. It's a strange place but it's mine. " ―Nyla

At some point in her youth, Nyla made her home in a downed Imperial All Terrain Armored Transport , Hellhound Two , left over from the Battle of Ashden. When she first found it, Nyla did not believe that she could live there, as the Goazon Badlands where the Ironclad Walker was located was a barren wasteland in which nothing seemed to grow. When she inspected the walker, though, she found a small green spinebarrel flower growing out of a few millimeters of sand that had poured into the walker. Nyla realized that if such a tiny flower could survive there, so could she, and that life always found a way to survive on Ashden. Nyla would go on to collect flowers like that, as a reminder that beauty could be found anywhere, even on Ashden.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Once she settled into the walker, Nyla salvaged working parts of the Ironclad Walker for trade. She mostly just used one room in the walker, for a variety of reasons. She would often bring her salvages to the walker before bringing them to Gruven, as Gruven deducted portions one could receive from a salvage if they used his washing and repair stations. The walker also contained scratches she made to mark the passage of time, to remind her how far she had come and to count down the days until her family returned for her. Outside of the walker was where she would go on to keep the speeder she built for herself, which gave her a degree of independence as she made her way back and forth from the Starship Graveyard.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: By the time Nyla was ten years old, she had acquired a Free Coalition flight helmet that once belonged to Captain Dosmit Ræh of the starfighter squadron Tierfon Yellow Aces , which she found while scavenging in the Starship Graveyard. She enjoyed making up stories about Ræh's adventures during the war, which was why Nyla made a doll out of a flight uniform she found in a cargo container. She often enjoyed wearing the helmet and playing with the doll, pretending she was helping Ræh explore the Ironclad Walker and the sands outside. Together, their pretend adventures saw them find lost Insurgents and return them to their ships. When Nyla was older, she no longer played with the doll, but kept it and the helmet, which she sometimes wore anyway, to remind her how far she had come on Ashden.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Inside the walker, Nyla also had a computer display from an old BTL-A4 Yarrow assault starfighter/bomber that she used to learn alien languages, study the schematics of Republic and Imperial starships, and run flight simulations in order to hone her skills as a pilot . Her ability to understand alien languages, including the binary language of droids , helped her when off-worlders came to Nimara Outpost. Two such off-worlders were Voraks , who regaled her with the stories of the famed Vorak smuggler -turned-Insurgent fighter Brevok . She learned of Brevok's exploits, as well as those of his friend and fellow smuggler Dax Karrick . Studying schematics to learn how ships worked was also an important part of her survival on Ashden. She recognized almost all of the Republic and Imperial vessels that could be found in the Graveyard, including what roles they played in combat, the types of weapons they were armed with, their models and classes, and how many crew members each one had. She learned this not just through studying schematics on her computer, but also by climbing through and exploring the ships and tinkering with their systems. This let her know what each part was, what

title: Nyla Drayden
text: they were armed with, their models and classes, and how many crew members each one had. She learned this not just through studying schematics on her computer, but also by climbing through and exploring the ships and tinkering with their systems. This let her know what each part was, what it could do, whether it worked, and, most importantly, whether it would carry any value in Nimara Outpost. Growing up on Ashden meant Nyla not only learned how the ships that littered its wastelands worked, but also about the dangers that lurked on Ashden itself. Nyla saw firsthand the hardship it could inflict. Rumors of an Imperial base on Carbon Ridge once compelled Gruven to mount an expedition there. Knowing her skills as a mechanic, Gruven brought Nyla a flyer to fix. She did so by unclogging one of its turbojets and rebuilding the other out of scrap from the front of an air speeder. Gruven and six of his thugs used it to try to find the rumored base, but he only returned with a collection of shock trooper armor —and two of his men were killed. That led other scavengers to avoid Carbon Ridge. The creatures of Ashden were also dangerous. A fellow scavenger named Teng Malar once accidentally broke open a hatch on a ship beneath a colony of steelpeckers , ferocious avian creatures with razor-sharp beaks and strong talons. Within ten minutes, Teng was ripped to shreds and Nyla watched helplessly as she was unable to do anything to stop the creatures. The Graveyard itself was also a reminder of the realities of war,

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
beneath a colony of steelpeckers , ferocious avian creatures with razor-sharp beaks and strong talons. Within ten minutes, Teng was ripped to shreds and Nyla watched helplessly as she was unable to do anything to stop the creatures. The Graveyard itself was also a reminder of the realities of war, with bodies and skeletons littering the sands. Nyla once discovered a deceased SKREE fighter pilot still in the cockpit of his SKREE fighter ejector seat. Nyla scavenged his helmet, sidearm, and comlink before giving the pilot a proper burial. Aetheri Adept Beno Karrick turned to the umbra side of Synth Flux , in 28 AVE , culminating in his battle with the dark warrior known as " Karrick " on the Minemoon . Karrick's immersion in the umbra side was sensed across the galaxy by his mother, Princess Elira Solen , the umbra side adept Vorr , Mal, and Nyla, who still resided on Ashden. Nyla was in the desert with Gruven when she felt a cold sensation within her body; unaware of her connection with Karrick or Synth Flux, she asked Gruven if he felt it too. As Karrick's training in the umbra side under Vorr began and the man took on the name "Zarrin Karrick," Vorr believed that his apprentice's growing power in the umbra side would be matched by someone from the light, with Vorr later stating that Nyla filled that role.

#### The happabore hazard

> " I can't move this ship with you here. And Unkar knew that, didn't he? " ―Nyla, to a Happabore

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### The happabore hazard

> " I can't move this ship with you here. And Unkar knew that, didn't he? " ―Nyla, to a Happabore

One day between 28 AVE and 34 AVE , Nyla traveled to Nimara Outpost, where she took the job of hauling a pile of scrap heap to Gruven, who offered her ten portions. Gruven reluctantly gave her the coordinates but placed a collateral on Nyla's speeder if she were to fail the errand. Nyla responded by placing a bet of twenty portions since she was risking her speeder.

Nyla traveled on her speeder to the site, which turned out to be a wrecked quadjumper . She found a happabore lying beside the spacetug. Realizing that Gruven had set her up to fail, Nyla tried to get the creature to move. After trying to push it, Nyla realized that the happabore was having trouble breathing because something was blocking its nose. Steeling herself, Nyla dug into the creature's nose and retrieved a piece of machinery that was obstructing its nasal passage.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
After shaking off the happabore's goo, Nyla tried to tow the spacetug back to Nimara Outpost with her speeder but the machine was too heavy. Fortunately for Nyla, the grateful happabore helped her push it back to Nimara Outpost where Unkar Gruven angrily gave Nyla the 20 portions.

#### Repairing the Ghtroc 690

> " It's a Ghtroc 690. Fully restored, working hyperrelay, everything but the laser cannon and the water tanks. Everything else fully operational, Unkar. " ―Nyla, to Unkar Gruven

At some point, Nyla was salvaging a battle cruiser when a sandstorm forced her to retreat to the Hellhound Two , where she decided to wait out the storm by practicing on her flight simulator. The next day, after trading with Gruven for rations at the Concession Stand, she took her speeder out to the Starship Graveyard, where she decided to climb the Spike , the keel of an Imperial ship that had crashed into what would become the Crackle . From her perch, she spotted a ship that, upon closer inspection, she realized to be a reasonably intact Ghtroc 690 light freighter .

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Deciding to look inside the ship for salvage, she discovered food, and more importantly, that the reactor core was still functioning. Realizing that the whole repaired ship was worth more to Gruven than its salvageable parts, she decided to work on it so she could sell it, discovering panels inside that she could use to hide her ship from other scavengers. As it had become dark outside, Nyla opted to spend the night in the ship.

Repairing the ship proved difficult, as it meant using parts she could have traded for food to repair the ship instead, making her go hungry more often than usual. Her decision to not give some parts to Gruven eventually attracted the attention of the scavengers Devi and Strunk , who asked her about it. She refused to tell them anything, and they told her that they might not have been the only ones to notice Nyla's unusual behavior.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Ten days later, the duo trailed Nyla and discovered what she was working on, and offered to help her repair it in exchange for passage off of Ashden with her once it was finished. After Nyla explained that she was going to sell the freighter to Gruven once it was complete, Devi and Strunk brokered a deal with her: they would help her repair the ship, and they would split whatever Gruven gave them. While Nyla was wary of the others at first, she came to think of them as friends as they proved their trustworthiness by keeping watch over the ship at night, and helping to protect it from a group of Teedos . Together the three scavengers restored the ship to working order, and Nyla was able to pilot the craft over the desert with the skills she had learned from her flight simulator program. Once the ship was complete, Nyla flew it to Nimara Outpost with the others. However, as soon as she stepped out of it to barter with Gruven, Devi and Strunk stole the ship and fled the planet, leaving Nyla with nothing to show for her work. Later that night, Nyla punched the lenses out of a battered shock trooper helmet before turning back to testing her skills on her flight simulator.

#### Rescuing a Teedo

> " Give me that…I did just save your life. " ―Nyla, to Teedo

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Sometime later, Nyla had fashioned the lenses from the shock trooper helmet into a pair of goggles. She used them when she entered an Iron Cruiser which was notably in danger of falling apart. After finding a room with some scattered components she was sure would be useful, she noticed a component still attached to the ship. Upon attempting to detach it however, the room and the whole ship began to show signs of stress. She then opted to leave it but was cornered by Teedo who held Nyla at gunpoint. He ordered her to turn over her stash, before noticing the valuable component attached to the ship. Nyla attempted to warn him off but Teedo was not to be dissuaded. After successfully prying the component from the ship, the room began to destabilize, knocking out Teedo in the process. Nyla picked up all of her belongings including the detached component and began to run out. Pulled back by Teedo's sounds of distress however, she quickly ran back, picked him up and proceeded to sprint towards the outside. She made use of a torn piece of the ship to slide her and Teedo away to safety from the collapsing Iron

title: Nyla Drayden
text:

She made use of a torn piece of the ship to slide her and Teedo away to safety from the collapsing Iron Cruiser. Teedo then woke up and gleefully claimed Nyla's stash as his own. But Nyla demanded it back, pointing out that she had just saved his life and thus was initiating a fair trade. Teedo begrudgingly gave it back, and thus Nyla sped away on her speeder. #### Rescuing Unkar Gruven

> " Off-worlders led by some guy called Zool Zendiat. They blasted the outpost and grabbed Unkar. " ―Roodown, to Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Nyla was searching for scrap in an old ship but she only found a couple of comlinks. She then heard a sound and realized she wasn't alone in this ship. Two people surrounded her and demanded that she give them her comlinks. Nyla declined and instead attacked the two persons. Nyla by mistake then set off a chain reaction and the ship started to blow up. Just as everyone managed to escape, the ship exploded together with the mysterious person's speeder bike. Nyla took her speeder away from the ship, leaving the two persons stranded. When she came back to Nimara Outpost she realized that something was wrong. She asked Crusher and he revealed that an off-worlder called Zool Zendiat and his gang had taken Gruven. Nyla asked Constable Zuvio why and he answered that the rumor was that Zendiat was looking for an old J9 droid that Nyla had sold to Gruven, two weeks prior. The Gabdorin Krynodd then appeared, stating that he was the new junkboss in Nimara Outpost and that his boys were the law now, instead of Zuvio. When Bobbajo walked past Krynodd, the Gabdorin hit him and said that he needed to show some respect.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: sold to Gruven, two weeks prior. The Gabdorin Krynodd then appeared, stating that he was the new junkboss in Nimara Outpost and that his boys were the law now, instead of Zuvio. When Bobbajo walked past Krynodd, the Gabdorin hit him and said that he needed to show some respect. Nyla helped the old man capture his creatures who were running away. As thanks she received a few corn-clusters. Realizing that Krynodd would be even worse than Gruven, she decided that she had to rescue him. She returned to her home and took a look at the head of the J9 droid which she had kept so that she could clean it and sell it later for more portions. She then headed out into the night to find Gruven. When out, she heard ripper-raptors in the Kelvin Ravine and decided to go there to see if that was the location of Gruven.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Nyla found Gruven strapped to the ground, surrounded by Zendiat's gang. She then used one of the comlinks she had brought with her to make the sound of a Bloggin . Nyla attacked and managed to beat all except Zendiat. She then attempted to remove the restraints holding Gruven. Instead she got an electric shock. Surrounded by Zendiat's gang, Nyla pulled out the head of the J9 droid, which had been the very droid that had gotten Gruven captured in the first place. Nyla proposed that they let her and Gruven go and she would give them the head. Zendiat then asked why he shouldn't just kill them and take the droid, but Nyla then threw the droid's head up in the sky to show him why. In the meantime, she freed Gruven, but he pushed her away and grabbed the droid's head. Gruven then took Nyla's corn-clusters and threw them on Zendiat's gang so that the ripper-raptors would attack them. As Nyla and Gruven escaped, the scavenger threw the head of the droid back to Zendiat's gang.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Gruven angrily asked why as he had heard that it contained a treasure map but Nyla told him that she had already checked its memory and that it was wiped clean. They drove back to Nimara Outpost on Nyla's speeder and she told Gruven that Krynodd had taken over his business. When arriving, Gruven stormed away without thanking Nyla. The following day when Nyla woke up, she found a crate with at least 30 portions outside of her home, leading Nyla to consider that Gruven was not as rude as she thought.

### Awakening Synth Flux

#### Escape from Ashden

> " We need a pilot! " " We've got one! " ―Jax and Nyla, while escaping from Nimara Outpost

title: Nyla Drayden
text: One of the vessels that Nyla scavenged from was the Inflictor , an Imperial -class Iron Cruiser that crashed after its commanding officer, Captain Ciena Ree , scuttled the ship to prevent it from falling into the hands of the Concordat. Nyla climbed throughout the massive vessel and brought parts back to Nimara Outpost, where she cleaned them up and brought them to Gruven. The materials she brought him on this particular day earned her one quarter portion of food, which she brought back to her home. After eating, she heard the noises of an astromech droid and rushed to find that the source of the noise, Orio-6 , had been captured by a Teedo scavenger, also named Teedo . Nyla rescued the tiny droid and learned that it was on a classified mission —it managed to escape the clutches of the New Imperium during an attack on the spiritual village of Tuanul , an attack that Nyla had heard rumors of. Nyla repaired Orio-6's antenna, and pointed the droids towards Nimara Outpost. After some convincing by Orio-6, Nyla allowed the droid to return home with her for one night, before it went on its way the next morning. On

title: Nyla Drayden
text: village of Tuanul , an attack that Nyla had heard rumors of. Nyla repaired Orio-6's antenna, and pointed the droids towards Nimara Outpost. After some convincing by Orio-6, Nyla allowed the droid to return home with her for one night, before it went on its way the next morning. On their way to Nyla's home that evening, Nyla and Orio-6 were attacked by a nightwatcher worm , which was hungry and wanted to eat Orio-6. Nyla saved Orio-6 from the worm, made it safely to Nyla's, and fed the worm a hunk of scrap. She then took Orio-6 to her home in the Hellhound Two , where she mentioned that Teedo might be looking for Orio-6.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: The next morning, Nyla woke up screaming after having a nightmare of her parents abandoning her. She went with Orio-6 to do some salvaging, where she enjoyed the company of someone she could trust. After that, Nyla and Orio-6 set up for Nimara Outpost. On their way, they were attacked by three bandits who were attempted to steal Orio-6. Nyla was able to synth flux two of the bandits to crash into each other on their speeder bikes , and tricked Teedo into having his bike eaten by a nightwatcher worm . Nyla and Orio-6 continued to Nimara Outpost, where she handed more salvage material over to Gruven. He offered her one half portion for everything, a collection that Nyla reminded him was worth one half portion for each item only a week before. Though Gruven was unmoved, he did offer to give her sixty portions for Orio-6. Nyla almost accepted the offer, but she soon told Gruven that Orio-6 was not for sale. Undeterred, Gruven sent his thugs after Nyla to try to take the droid by synth flux—this proved to be useless, however, as Nyla made short work of her would be attackers. During the fight, Orio-6 caught

title: Nyla Drayden
text: accepted the offer, but she soon told Gruven that Orio-6 was not for sale. Undeterred, Gruven sent his thugs after Nyla to try to take the droid by synth flux—this proved to be useless, however, as Nyla made short work of her would be attackers. During the fight, Orio-6 caught a glimpse of Jax , a shock trooper who defected from the New Imperium, wearing the jacket that belonged to Orio-6's master, Rin Vale . Orio-6 alerted Nyla and a brief chase ensued. Nyla managed to catch the young man and accused him of thievery. Jax explained that the jacket belonged to Rin Vale and that he was the one who helped the Coalition fighter escape from the Finalizer , an escape that he believed had cost Vale his life. He also claimed that he too was a Coalition fighter, sent to help Vale retrieve a map that would lead to the legendary Aetheri Master Joren Drayden. Unaware of his role in protecting her from Orrin during her childhood, Nyla has assumed the Aetheri was only a myth. Nyla accepted Jax's story that he was actually a member of the Coalition, while Orio-6 lamented Jax's news of Vale. The trio was spotted by a small group of shock troopers who were sent to recover the droid from Ashden. Nyla and Jax attempted to flee their attackers after being fired upon by SKREE fighters . Nyla led Jax and Orio-6 towards a shipyard attempting to commandeer a quadjumper moments before it was destroyed.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
With no other option, Nyla led the two towards an old freighter , which she described as "garbage," that had not flown for years. None other than the Corsair Wing , the ship had fallen into Unkar Gruven's ownership after being stolen from a number of other owners. Nyla took the pilot's seat while Jax manned one of the quad laser cannons . Despite a shaky start, Nyla piloted the ship out of the outpost and, on Jax's suggestion, remained at a low altitude in order to confuse the scanners on the SKREE fighters. She led the fighters on a chase into the Starship Graveyard, where she was able to use the downed war vessels to her advantage. One SKREE fighter crashed after Jax scored a direct hit, while the other followed Nyla into the bowels of a Super Iron Cruiser . The Corsair suffered damage and the turret was locked into one position, so, after flying out of the Super Iron Cruiser, Nyla moved the freighter into position where Jax could fire a direct shot. With the last SKREE fighter destroyed, Nyla flew the ship off of Ashden and into open space.

#### Enlisting Dax Karrick's help

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Enlisting Dax Karrick's help

> " The Aetheri were real? " " I used to wonder that myself. Thought it was a bunch of mumbo-jumbo—magical power holding together good, evil, the umbra side and the light. Crazy thing is, it's true. Synth Flux, the Aetheri, all of it. It's all true. " ―Nyla and Dax Karrick With the ship in the clear, Nyla and Jax left their posts and congratulated one another on their hard-fought escape. They finally introduced themselves, having not learned each other's name in the commotion of escaping the desert world, but their joy soon turned to more urgent matters as the propulsion system began to leak when an energy flux in the hyperrelay motivator caused a fuel backup. Nyla started working to fix the problem, which risked flooding the ship with poisonous gas and killing them. While working on the propulsion system, Nyla asked Jax for the location of the Coalition base. Unknown to her was that he and Orio-6, as she worked, argued about revealing the location; Jax did not actually know its location and had to convince Orio-6 to share it with Nyla. Orio-6 ultimately revealed that the base was in the Ileenium system , so Nyla told them she would drop them off before returning to Ashden, much to Jax's annoyance.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Suddenly, the ship began to lose power and the two realized that they were caught in a grapple beam . The Corsair was pulled into the cargo bay of a large freighter called the Eravana , which Jax mistook as a New Imperium ship. The trio hid in a compartment beneath the floor and Nyla planned to release the poisonous gas into the ship to kill what she assumed would be shock troopers, but in reality it was two smugglers, and the original owners of the Corsair : the famed Dax Karrick and his First Mate , Brevok . Karrick found the three fugitives in the compartment and Nyla revealed they were the only ones aboard, and that she was the pilot. Karrick asked where they got the ship, and Nyla told him that it belonged to Unkar Gruven, who stole it from the Irving Boys , who stole it from Gannis Ducain —who, as Karrick revealed, stole it from him. It was then that he revealed himself as Dax Karrick. Nyla and Jax realized that meant the ship was the Corsair Wing , the ship that Nyla believed had made the Cindral Run in fourteen parsecs , to which

title: Nyla Drayden
text: from Gannis Ducain —who, as Karrick revealed, stole it from him. It was then that he revealed himself as Dax Karrick. Nyla and Jax realized that meant the ship was the Corsair Wing , the ship that Nyla believed had made the Cindral Run in fourteen parsecs , to which Karrick corrected her saying it was only twelve. The two correctly deduced that Karrick was indeed the famous smuggler who became a General for the Free Coalition during the Galactic Civil War. Karrick inspected the ship and talked to Nyla about the modifications that Gruven had made on it, including a compressor on the ignition line, which they both knew put too much stress on the hyperrelay . Nyla also told him about their mission to bring Orio-6 to the Coalition, a mission that caught Karrick's attention once he realized that the droid carried a map to his old friend and brother-in-law Joren Drayden.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: The Eravana was soon boarded by the both Guavian Death Gang and Kanjiklub , two criminal organizations that Karrick had swindled into loaning him money so he could smuggle rathtars to King Prana . Nyla and Jax hid in the corridors beneath the floors as Karrick unsuccessfully tried to talk his way out of the situation, and his predicament gave Nyla the idea to shut all of the doors between the Korrathi smuggler and the two gangs. She accessed the wrong door controls, however, and accidentally unleashed the monstrous rathtars, which ran loose across the ship. As Nyla and Jax ran from the beasts, one of them grabbed Jax and carried him away. Nyla found a control panel that allowed her to close a door onto the tentacles of the monster, severing the limbs and allowing Jax to escape. They reunited with Karrick at the Corsair Wing and escaped onto the ship. With Brevok injured in the fight against the gangs, Nyla took the co-pilot's chair as Karrick prepared the ship for launch. Though Nyla questioned him on his ensuing plan, Karrick jumped the ship into hyperspace from inside the Eravana , and they successfully escaped. Bala-Tik of the Guavian

title: Nyla Drayden
text: the ship. With Brevok injured in the fight against the gangs, Nyla took the co-pilot's chair as Karrick prepared the ship for launch. Though Nyla questioned him on his ensuing plan, Karrick jumped the ship into hyperspace from inside the Eravana , and they successfully escaped. Bala-Tik of the Guavian Death Gang, who had seen Orio-6 and realized Nyla and Jax were aboard, then had his men contact the New Imperium to let them know that the fugitives were aboard the Corsair Wing . Nyla and Karrick contended with even more damage to the ship once they were in hyperspace. There was an electrical overload and a coolant leak, so Nyla suggested transferring auxiliary power to the secondary tank, which Karrick had also come to the conclusion to do. Finally, Nyla bypassed the compressor that Gruven had installed, solving the problem, ending their imminent danger, and impressing Karrick. The group gathered in the ship's common area and Orio-6 showed Karrick the holographic map fragment that was in the droid's databanks. Karrick, who pointed out that the map was incomplete, explained why Drayden had disappeared in the first place. An apprentice—Beno Karrick—turned against the Aetheri Master and destroyed Drayden's attempt to rebuild the Aetheri Order . Afterward, Drayden vanished from the galaxy without a trace. Rumors floated around about where he had gone, but those closest to him correctly guessed that he went off in search of the first Aetheri Sanctum . Nyla was surprised to hear that the Aetheri were real, but Karrick, who had once been skeptical of the existence of the Aetheri himself, told her that the stories about the Aetheri and the existence of Synth Flux were all true.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Synth Flux within

> " That flux blade was Joren's. And his father's before him and now, it calls to you! " ―Maz Oru, to Nyla Karrick, the estranged husband of Coalition General Elira Solen , did not plan to bring Orio-6 to the Coalition base himself, so he set course for the planet Takodana , where he intended to enlist the help of Maz Oru , a pirate and collector who had operated a pirate castle on the planet for a thousand years. During the jump to hyperspace, the Corsair Wing suddenly exited hyperspace. Nyla asked Karrick if they scanned for tracking devices , to which she remembered that Gruven had been using a new kind of tracking device. She was ordered by Karrick to do a check of the ship with Brev, while he got the hyperrelay back online. Nyla ran back into the Corsair and informed Jax and Brev of the situation. Brev gave them the idea to look near the active sensor pulse generator . Nyla thought that was a smart idea since the device would go undetected there, so they all looked in the room where the generator was. Brev was able to find the tracker beeping behind a panel. Jax immediately grabbed it, much to Nyla and Brev's dismay as the device was rigged to explode. Nyla told Brev to

title: Nyla Drayden
text: since the device would go undetected there, so they all looked in the room where the generator was. Brev was able to find the tracker beeping behind a panel. Jax immediately grabbed it, much to Nyla and Brev's dismay as the device was rigged to explode. Nyla told Brev to go and throw the explosive out of the airlock . When Nyla told Jax that the bomb would go off in 20 seconds , he ran to inform Dax while Nyla went to see what Brev was doing. Brev threw the bomb out the airlock and Dax jumped into hyperspace shortly thereafter. After they all got back into the cockpit, Karrick thanked Nyla, and she remarked that they made a good team. Dax chuckled at the idea and they continued onto Takodana. As the ship approached Maz's castle, Nyla was taken aback by the lush green world that reminded her of the planets she saw in her dreams as a child, having never known that there was so much green in the entire galaxy. When they landed, the group exited the ship, where Nyla looked out at the stunning vista that stood before her. [ source? ]

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Karrick handed her an NN-14 volt pistol pistol , knowing she would be able to defend herself with it, and asked her what her name was. With the two formally introduced, Karrick said he was considering bringing on a new crew member. Impressed with Nyla's piloting and repair abilities, he said he would consider offering her a job as a second mate aboard the Corsair . Nyla was flattered by the offer and briefly excited by the prospect, but she turned it down because she had to return to Ashden to wait for her family, claiming that she'd already been away for too long already.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Karrick led Nyla, Jax, and Orio-6 to the castle while Brevok stayed behind to watch over the ship. Karrick explained that Oru had the ability and the connections to get Orio-6 to the Coalition. Once inside, their arrival prompted the attention of informants for both the New Imperium and the Coalition, alerting the respective groups that the fugitives were on Takodana. Nyla and the others met with the diminutive pirate and told her about the map to Joren Drayden. Oru said she would not bring the droid to the Coalition because she believed Karrick should, as he had been running from the fight for too long. Nyla asked what fight she was referring to, and Oru told her it was the fight against the umbra side of Synth Flux, one that had given rise to the Umbra, the Imperium, and ultimately the New Imperium. To Nyla's surprise, Jax told Oru that they could not win the fight against the New Imperium. Oru sensed his fear, and Jax finally said that he could not bring the droid to the Coalition. He left to speak to two pirates, Sidon Ithano and Quiggold , about exchanging work for passage to the Outer Reach

title: Nyla Drayden
text: that they could not win the fight against the New Imperium. Oru sensed his fear, and Jax finally said that he could not bring the droid to the Coalition. He left to speak to two pirates, Sidon Ithano and Quiggold , about exchanging work for passage to the Outer Reach Territories and, when Nyla confronted him, he admitted that he was a former shock trooper and not a member of the Coalition. She pleaded with him not to go, but he chose to leave the castle and head to the Outer Reach. As Jax departed, Nyla felt something drawing her towards the lower levels of the castle. She made her way down the steps with Orio-6 and found a collection of ancient artifacts. One box in particular called to her, and she opened it to find a flux blade . Upon touching it, she was immediately confronted with a vision of events both past and present she did not understand. Nyla first found herself in the halls of Aether Spire , where Drayden had once fought Xarn Velgor before learning Velgor was his father. She heard Drayden screaming in disbelief at the revelation, as well as the words of the late Aetheri Master Zho speaking about the energies of Synth Flux. Nyla then saw Drayden himself kneeling before a burning temple alongside his astromech droid, Bolt-3 , before the vision shifted to one of death: Zarrin Karrick and the Knights of Karrick killing many people. The vision then transported her to Ashden, where Nyla saw herself as a young girl screaming for her family to return as they departed in a starship. Finally, she found herself in the middle of a snowy forest, where Karrick ignite his flux blade and stalked towards

title: Nyla Drayden
text: killing many people. The vision then transported her to Ashden, where Nyla saw herself as a young girl screaming for her family to return as they departed in a starship. Finally, she found herself in the middle of a snowy forest, where Karrick ignite his flux blade and stalked towards her. The vision came to an end, she fell to the floor, and she heard the voice of the long-deceased Aetheri Master Orien Kade telling her that these were her first steps. Nyla was left shaken by the vision. Oru found her scrambling away from the collection room, and Nyla asked her what happened. She told the young woman that the flux blade once belonged to Joren and Kael Drayden, and that it was calling out to her. Nyla, overwhelmed, told Oru that she had to return to Ashden, but the old pirate helped Nyla finally admit what she knew all along: whoever left her on Ashden was never coming back, however, there was someone who still could. Upon hearing this, Nyla replied to her: Joren. Oru, who was Synth Flux-sensitive in her own right despite not being a proper Aetheri, tried to guide Nyla towards embracing Synth Flux and letting the light guide her, as well as to take the flux blade. Nyla rejected it, however, and said she wanted no part in this cosmic destiny. She instead fled the castle, in tears, running into the heavy woods that stood just outside of it to be alone. Orio-6 followed her and Nyla told the droid to go back so Karrick could help, but it was too late. Nyla looked up and saw New Imperium transports and SKREE fighters soaring through the

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
in tears, running into the heavy woods that stood just outside of it to be alone. Orio-6 followed her and Nyla told the droid to go back so Karrick could help, but it was too late. Nyla looked up and saw New Imperium transports and SKREE fighters soaring through the sky. #### Capture and escape

> " She's just beginning to test her powers. The longer it takes to find her, the more dangerous she becomes. " ―Zarrin Karrick Nyla and Orio-6 returned to the castle, where they saw it under heavy bombardment from the New Imperium. She noticed shock troopers approaching her position and fired on them, hitting two before running back into the forest. Nyla told Orio-6 to go on without her so she could fight them off, and she told the droid that she hoped to see it again. Nyla continued through the woods until she heard the sound of a flux blade coming to life. She was soon confronted by Zarrin Karrick, who used his flux blade to deflect every shot she fired at him. After allowing her several shots, Karrick used Synth Flux to freeze Nyla and her volt pistol in place, threatening her with his flux blade while demanding to know where the droid was. He probed her mind with Synth Flux, realizing that she had seen the map and that he would not need the droid—he could instead just interrogate her to find out what she had seen. Karrick used Synth Flux to render Nyla unconscious and carried her to his command shuttle , which he used to escape as Coalition Vector fighters —which had arrived to find Orio-6—fended off the SKREE

title: Nyla Drayden
text: not need the droid—he could instead just interrogate her to find out what she had seen. Karrick used Synth Flux to render Nyla unconscious and carried her to his command shuttle , which he used to escape as Coalition Vector fighters —which had arrived to find Orio-6—fended off the SKREE fighters. Nyla was taken to Voidfang Base , a New Imperium stronghold and a superweapon , built into the icy planet of Ilum , that was capable of destroying entire star systems —a power it unleashed when Nyla was on Takodana, using it to destroy the Hosnian system and deliver a crippling blow to the Concordat's government and starfleet . Nyla woke up in a holding cell and found Karrick by her side. She asked him what happened to Karrick and Jax, though Karrick did not know—which he suggested was a sign of relief for her, as he had not heard if they perished. Nyla treated the dark warrior with scorn, calling him a "creature in a mask ," and he removed his mask to reveal that he was a young human man with no disfigurements. He asked about the droid once again and Nyla responded only with its technical specifications.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Because she refused to reply, Karrick used Synth Flux to access her mind and her memories. Through connecting their minds, Karrick unknowingly formed the prophesied dyad in Synth Flux between the two Synth Flux-sensitive beings. He saw that she was lonely but also afraid to leave Ashden, and that she saw an island on an ocean in her dreams. He also saw that she was fond of Karrick and that she felt like he was the father she never had, though Karrick said that he would only leave her disappointed. What Nyla did not know was that Karrick's true name was Beno Karrick, and that he was the son of Karrick and General Solen. After more probing, Nyla began to use Synth Flux to push back and resist, keeping Karrick from seeing any more of her memories. She turned the attack around on him and saw into his mind, finding that he was afraid that he would never be as powerful as his grandfather, Xarn Velgor. Karrick rapidly withdrew, rattled by the experience, and left the holding cell.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Only one shock trooper was left to guard Nyla's cell. Testing out her newfound Synth Flux abilities, Nyla attempted to use a mind trick on the trooper in order to influence him to remove the restraints and leave the cell with the door open. The trooper was confused at first and, after her second attempt, said he would instead tighten the restraints. The third time she tried, however, Nyla was successful. The trooper removed the restraints and began to leave the cell. He also dropped his weapon after Nyla told him to, allowing her to leave the cell while armed with a volt rifle . Nyla made her way through the base, while Karrick discovered that she was missing and ordered the New Imperium troops to be on high alert—the longer Nyla went undiscovered while testing her abilities, the more powerful and more dangerous she would become to the New Imperium.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Her intention, ultimately, was to commandeer a ship and escape from Voidfang Base, so she made her way towards a hangar where she found SKREE fighters that she could steal. She was approached by several shock troopers before she could get to the fighters, so she climbed down a chasm in the hangar to hide. Careful not to fall to her death, Nyla opened a service hatch, climbed inside, and closed it behind her so she could make her way back through the base. While climbing along the walls of the base, her path came to cross with the members of the Coalition's J-Squadron who were also climbing upon the same walls. She quickly nodded to one of the members but ignored further calls from them as she quickly climbed down away from the group.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Deeper into the base, Nyla found Karrick, Brevok, and Jax (who did not flee to the Outer Reach after all). They had arrived on Voidfang Base in order to rescue her and disable the base's shields so Coalition starfighters could destroy it. Nyla embraced Jax when Brevok said the rescue was his idea, and she thanked him for coming back for her. With the shields already disabled as a result of Jax and Karrick's actions, the group left the base to return to the Corsair Wing , but they saw that the Coalition fighters were being cut to shreds and had been unable to destroy the thermal oscillator , which stored the energy that the weapon drained from stars . The group decided to stay behind to help destroy the oscillator.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: They split up, Nyla and Jax were going to access a terminal to let Karrick and Brev enter the oscillator, while Dax and Brev would fight of troops to get there and plant bombs to destroy the oscillator. Nyla and Jax stole a New Imperium snowspeeder to get to the terminal, but they were pursued by another snowspeeder with a snowtrooper firing upon them. Nyla initially fired upon them, but then Jax suggested they switch places, so then Nyla drove and Jax was able to get a direct shot, eliminating the snowtrooper and allowing the snowspeeder to spin out of control. Nyla and Jax switched places, with Nyla asking if he was sure he didn't want her to fly. Jax reassured her that as long as no one was following them, they be fine. Suddenly three more snowspeeders drove up behind them, Nyla fired on them once again, but was unable to get a clear shot in. Seeing a forest, Nyla directed Jax to drive towards the trees. Jax drove through the forest dodging volt pistol fire, but they were still unable to shake their pursuers. Nyla asked him to switch places with her, to which he obliged. With Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text: unable to get a clear shot in. Seeing a forest, Nyla directed Jax to drive towards the trees. Jax drove through the forest dodging volt pistol fire, but they were still unable to shake their pursuers. Nyla asked him to switch places with her, to which he obliged. With Nyla as pilot, she was able to dodge incoming obstacles and outmaneuver the trailing snowspeeders while Jax was able fire at the snowtroopers, taking them out. All but one last snowspeeder was eliminated, and Nyla and Jax were approaching a ravine. Nyla told Jax to hold on and she sped up, creating a cloud of snow that blinded the snowtroopers behind them. They made it over the ravine, with the snowtroopers falling out of their snowspeeder before it fell into the ravine. Upon landing, Nyla and Jax agreed that she would fly and he would shoot from then on and they continued on to the terminal.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Entering the building, Nyla opened the terminal and yanked out a component that opened a door within Voidfang Base. This gave Karrick and Brevok the opportunity to enter the oscillator and plant charges. Nyla and Jax made their way towards their companions and found themselves overlooking a bridge, where Karrick—who, along with Brevok, had already planted charges—found and confronted his son. Though Karrick pleaded with Karrick to turn back to the light, the dark warrior stabbed his father through the torso. Nyla let out a horrified scream upon witnessing this, but could only watch as the famed smuggler fell to his death in the chasm below. Brevok, enraged over the loss of his friend, opened fire on Karrick, managing to hit him in the leg, and set off the charges, damaging the oscillator and giving the Coalition the opening it needed to destroy the base.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Nyla and Jax ran through the snowy forest towards the Corsair Wing , but they were confronted by Karrick who told them that they had unfinished business that Karrick couldn't save them from. Nyla denounced the dark warrior as a monster for his act of patricide and attempted to fire at him with her volt pistol, but Karrick used Synth Flux to toss her against a tree, temporarily knocking her out. Jax, who was given Drayden's flux blade by Maz Oru on Takodana, engaged Karrick in a flux blade duel , but was bested and left critically injured. Seeking the flux blade for himself, Karrick attempted to call the blade through Synth Flux, but it whipped past him, choosing Nyla instead. Igniting the blade, Nyla engaged Karrick in combat and spent part of the duel in retreat, defending herself against Karrick's advances. The two locked blades and Karrick told her he could train her in the ways of Synth Flux. Shock trooper captain Phasma spotted Karrick and Nyla's duel but, being occupied with the hunt for Rivas , did not join in to help Karrick.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Nyla, remembering what Oru told her, drew upon the powers of Synth Flux. Unaware, Nyla instead gave in to her raw power, anger rage, and fury. She moved onto the offensive, viciously delivering several blows against Karrick until she finally disarmed him. Karrick realized that Nyla had more anger than he, or maybe an emotion that he didn't even recognize anymore. In doing so, she slashed her blade across his face, ultimately defeating him. While an unidentifiable voice in her mind tempted her to the umbra side by arguing it would be easy to kill Karrick there and then, she rejected the temptation before a deep chasm formed between them, born out of the imminent destruction of the planet after the Coalition destroyed the oscillator, so Nyla left Karrick behind and returned to the injured Jax. Brevok soon arrived aboard the Corsair and carried Jax aboard, as Nyla followed behind. The ship took off as the ground crumbled beneath it, and the Corsair and the Coalition fighters retreated from Voidfang Base as the planet imploded and became a star from all of the thermal energy the weapon had collected.

### Finding the Last Aetheri

#### Time on D'Qar

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Finding the Last Aetheri

#### Time on D'Qar

> " I'd like you to tell me what happened. With Dax. With Beno. " ―Elira Solen, to Nyla

The Corsair Wing then returned to the Coalition base on the planet D'Qar , where Jax was treated for his wounds. She was greeted at the base by General Solen, and the two embraced in a long hug. The Coalition forces celebrated their victory over the New Imperium, though Nyla was left with a feeling of sadness. The events that had unfolded awakened Bolt-3, who had been in low power mode ever since Drayden disappeared and the droid combined the information contained within his databanks with the map that Orio-6 carried to show a completed map to where Drayden had gone. She also said goodbye to the unconscious Jax, kissing her friend on the forehead and stating that "they would see each other again someday."

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Later, Nyla sat down and had a conversation with Solen about the latter's husband and son. She told Solen about Karrick's confrontation with Karrick, and how it ended in an act of patricide. Remembering how Karrick neither cried out nor fought back, but only reached out to touch his son's face, Nyla wished that Karrick had run away instead. Solen, however, was aware that her late husband knew there was a time to run and a time to make a stand. Nyla asked Solen how she led the Coalition when everything seemed hopeless, to which the general replied that even the instinct to run can be used as motivation to keep fighting. Nyla felt as though they were isolated in their fight against Karrick and the New Imperium, though Solen assured her that neither of them were alone, and that they were part of a cause much larger than themselves. Solen told her that she was proud of what Nyla was about to do. Nyla felt the general's fear, however, knowing that Solen blamed herself for sending her son away to be with her brother only for Beno Karrick to turn to the umbra side. Nevertheless, Solen had confidence in Nyla, believing she would not share in her son's fate. Before parting ways, Solen provided Nyla with a beacon in order to find her way back to the Coalition. The two embraced in a long hug, and Nyla left to find Drayden. As gathered Coalition members watched the Corsair depart with Nyla aboard, Solen assured Vale that they had another hope in addition to her brother.

#### Adventure on Necropolis

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Adventure on Necropolis

While in hyperspace, the Corsair shuddered and alarms went off. Nyla sassed back at Bolt would pointed out the danger of going through uncharted hyperspace. The compressor malfunctioned with Nyla noting the temporary nature of her initial solution of bypassing. In the commotion, Brevok was set on fire. They pulled out of hyperspace, but they needed to find somewhere nearby to get the Corsair fixed, or else they risked the Corsair getting ripped apart in hyperspace. Luckily, Bolt found a place close, it was known as the Necropolis , and it was a junkyard planet. As they prepared to land on Necropolis, a ship hailed them and told them that they needed a scavenging license. When they landed, they met a large insectoid alien known as Ara-Nea , who was the overseer of Necropolis. Ara-Nea asked if they had come to pick junk, which she morbidly called "the bones of the fallen." Ara-Nea then informed Nyla that she had to pay 500 credits if she wished to scavenge, and Brev and Bolt had to stay on the Corsair which had to be clamped. Nyla, though reluctant, accepted these terms and went to scavenge alone.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
In the junkyard Nyla discovered an array of ships, going as far back as the Republic era . However the ships were too valuable to be left in the condition they were for so long. She then heard a rumble, and activated a flux blade as a massive creature came out of the junk and attacked her. Nyla knew she couldn't fend it off alone, so she ran, getting into a Firespray gunship . She used the ship to escape the creature and land back to confront Ara-Nea. She realized that the whole Necropolis was a trap crafted by Ara-Nea to swindle people out of their money, then kill them. Right as a furious Ara-Nea was going to kill her, Nyla used her iconic mind trick on Ara-Nea and made the alien surrender to his enslaved workers and be willing to be imprisoned. After completing repairs to the Corsair , she continued on her journey to Tidehollow .

#### Discovery of Drayden

> " Nyla. May Synth Flux be with you. " ―Elira Solen

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Discovery of Drayden

> " Nyla. May Synth Flux be with you. " ―Elira Solen

After landing on one of the planet's small islands, Nyla ventured throughout the island's ancient ruins and found the old Aetheri Master in seclusion. Drayden said nothing as Nyla arrived with his long-lost flux blade in her hand and hope in her eyes. Upon offering Drayden the blade, Nyla was shocked to see him discard the weapon after briefly examining it, as he hoped to lose it once again. Drayden immediately left the plateau, with Nyla desperately tried to recruit Drayden to help the remaining members of the Coalition the entire way down, which he blatantly refused to do. After recovering the flux blade from some porgs , Nyla discovered Drayden's Vector starfighter within a shallow bay and learned that he had purposefully stranded himself on the planet. She continued to follow him across the island, despite being ordered to leave. Eventually, she stumbled upon an old tree containing some of the last recorded Aetheri texts from the very beginning of the Aetheri Order, claiming the location was familiar to her.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Intrigued, Drayden asked Nyla to elaborate, but she continued to press him to come out of hiding and help fight the New Imperium. Drayden once more refused, explaining that he did not come to the planet to hide but to die where the Aetheri Order first started. Later, when Drayden arrived at the Corsair Wing , Nyla and Brevok informed him that Dax Karrick had been murdered, shocking Drayden. Afterward, the old Aetheri Master pressed Nyla for her true motives for coming to Tidehollow. Nyla explained that she had a power inside of her that she did not understand and was frightened of; she also sought a mentor to help her discover her place in the galaxy. That night, Nyla woke to see Drayden staring at her; he agreed to give Nyla no more than three lessons of the Aetheri Order and that they would start at dawn.

#### Training and revelations

> " What do you know about Synth Flux? " " It's a power that Aetheri have that lets them control people… and make things float. " " Impressive. Every word in that sentence was wrong. " ―Joren Drayden and Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text: On the first day of her training with Drayden, Nyla awoke to find Zarrin Karrick sitting across from her. She instinctively aimed her volt pistol at him and fired, only to blow a hole through her stone hut . She could not harm him, yet neither could Karrick use his powers to reach into her mind due to the actual distance between them. Nyla was both terrified and infuriated to see the dark warlord, but decided to keep this new development between them from Drayden, fearing that she would lose the Aetheri Master's trust if he mistook her and Karrick's newfound connection as a betrayal. She followed him to the first Aetheri Sanctum where he described Synth Flux as an energy that bound everything together, including the light and the darkness. He asked her to sit on a rock overlooking the sea. After some miscommunication, Nyla reached out into Synth Flux with her senses and felt drawn to a cavern immersed in umbra side energy. The ground around her cracked and she was thrown to the ground.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Having been effortlessly drawn to the darkness despite Drayden's warnings, Drayden backed away in fear as Nyla's raw strength in Synth Flux reminded him of another gifted prodigy—his nephew and fallen apprentice, Beno Karrick. At the same time, Nyla sensed nothing from the Aetheri exile and came to realize that Drayden had blocked himself off from Synth Flux. Later, Nyla and Brev re-entered the Corsair Wing , but porgs entered along with them. A porg stole Nyla's spanner without Nyla noticing. She called for Brev, thinking he had stolen it. Eventually, the two notice the porg passengers and allow them to make a home on the Corsair . Sometime later, when it started raining on Temple Island, Nyla checked up on Brev, concerned that they still couldn't reach the Coalition. She made sure to remind Brev to ask about about Jax. Leaving the Corsair, Nyla felt Karrick's presence once again, asking why they were being connected. Nyla barked back calling him a murderous snake. He asked if she knew what happened between him and Drayden, to which she replied that she knew enough. Karrick looked into her mind and commented that she had the same look in her eye that

title: Nyla Drayden
text: asking why they were being connected. Nyla barked back calling him a murderous snake. He asked if she knew what happened between him and Drayden, to which she replied that she knew enough. Karrick looked into her mind and commented that she had the same look in her eye that she had during their fight in the forest, when she called him a monster. She reaffirmed her statement, and Karrick agreed. Blinking she found herself alone once more facing the crashing ocean spray. She continued training on her own, lifting rocks on top of other rocks, but struggling with a larger one. She was then started by a noise, a porg had activated Joren's flux blade and ran off with it. She chased after the porgs, cornering them on a cliff's edge. The porgs started to jump into the water, and Nyla pulled out her hands to try and stop the one with the flux blade from jumping. She was able to use synth flux to levitate the porg to her and get the flux blade back. She put the porg back down, amazed at her new ability. However, all the porgs that had jumped into the water reemerged; they too wanted to be lifted by Nyla. She laughed and told them they'd all get a turn. Later, Nyla trained her combat abilities using her quarterstaff and a rock. She then took out Joren's flux blade and trained with it instead. With Drayden watching, she danced the blade around the rock before cutting clean through it. She noticed Drayden watching and followed him to the first Aetheri Sanctum. For her next lesson, Nyla was made to listen to Drayden's interpretation of the history

For her next lesson, Nyla was made to listen to Drayden's interpretation of the history of the Aetheri Order, which he saw as an example of hubris and failure. He further credited his former mentor, Orien Kade, as the Aetheri Master responsible for the training of Xarn Velgor and also blamed the Aetheri for failing to stop Vael Mal ' rise to power. In spite of his arguments, Nyla was adamant that the Return of the Aetheri Order was the galaxy's last hope against the rising power of the New Imperium. She also countered Drayden's views by exclaiming how it was Drayden himself who saw the light in Velgor and fought to redeem him. Yet despite her assertions to the contrary, Drayden felt responsible for his nephew's fall to the umbra side, lamenting how he had once hoped to pass on his lessons to Karrick and a new generation of Aetheri. It was then that Nyla learned about the night of Karrick's betrayal as explained

Sometime later, Nyla used Synth Flux to hold rocks in place around her; she expressed annoyance at the task. Drayden responded by saying it was for something bigger. Nyla then acted aggressively, using her Synth Flux powers to levitate two of the Caretakers. Drayden told her that was enough, and she gently put them down, apologizing. Drayden told her the training can't be rushed, and Nyla stormed off, telling the Aetheri Master that she thought he would be different. She then used Synth Flux to lift a large rock; in doing so, she accidentally disturbed the nest of a pallaskean . It started to attack Drayden and then Brev, so Nyla used synth flux and her flux blade to protect them. She inadvertently caused a landslide that made Brev jump to protect some porgs. While they were in his hands, Nyla noticed a pallaskean baby in one of the porg's mouths. She returned the baby to its nest and knew she had to re-cover it. She distracted it while Drayden and Brevok pushed the rock back into place over the eggs. Nyla then replied that she would learn the lesson about rushing off, and that Joren Drayden still dashed into

title: Nyla Drayden
text: mouths. She returned the baby to its nest and knew she had to re-cover it. She distracted it while Drayden and Brevok pushed the rock back into place over the eggs. Nyla then replied that she would learn the lesson about rushing off, and that Joren Drayden still dashed into danger to save his friends. As her training with Drayden continued, her connection with Karrick became stronger and resulted in more frequent interactions between them. At first, Nyla was inconvenienced by the fact that she was bonded with a man whom she regarded as a murderer and a monster. To her surprise, however, Karrick no longer tried to hide his feelings of pain and misery from Nyla. At one point she inquired—while distracted by the sight of Karrick stripped to the waist—as to how he could kill his own father, to which Karrick replied by comparing Nyla's experience with abandonment to his own. His knowledge of Nyla's parents confounded her, as well as reminded her that the first contact between their minds had allowed them to access each other's memories. Karrick then took the opportunity to share his recollection of the night he destroyed his uncle's temple, revealing to Nyla that Drayden had made an attempt on his life while he slept. She wanted to believe that Karrick was lying, but her feelings told her that he was telling the truth.

title: Nyla Drayden
