text: Determined to see her parents once again after so many years, Nyla followed the pull to the umbra side which led her to a cave filled with numerous mirror versions of herself. Staring into a clouded mirror of polished stone, she beseeched Synth Flux to reveal her parents but was only met by her own reflection. Having failed to find the answers she sought, either with her parents or Drayden, Nyla began to despair as years of isolation began to weigh upon her. As a result, she turned to the one person whom she felt could relate to her sense of solitude and loss: Zarrin Karrick. The dark warrior listened intently as Nyla recalled her experience in the cave , and he insisted she was not alone despite her sense of loneliness. Nyla returned his gesture, in kind, and came to hope that it was not too late for him to return to the light.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: By then, their bond had reached an unprecedented level in strength and raw power to the extent that Nyla compared it to touching a live wire. She tentatively raised her hand to touch him, although she expected their hands to simply pass through each other. When their fingers actually touched, Nyla gasped and grasped Karrick's hand. At that moment, however, Drayden—now reconnected with Synth Flux and planning to return with her—witnessed their bond with his own eyes and interrupted the connection, thinking that they were in league. Joren had gestured at the walls and the ceiling of the hut, and all the stone blocks were shot outward from the hut's center, scattering them around the bench. Having decided that Nyla could not be trusted anymore, Drayden ordered her to leave the planet.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Confronting the Aetheri Master, Nyla demanded to know if he tried to murder Karrick. The two fought until Drayden admitted that he had contemplated killing his nephew after sensing the darkness within him. Unlike Drayden, Nyla did not believe that Karrick was fully committed to the umbra side as there was still much conflict within him. She therefore set out to confront him, in spite of Drayden's warnings, under the belief that Beno Karrick's redemption was the key to saving the galaxy. Unknown to Drayden, Nyla took the sacred Aetheri texts with her aboard the Corsair before leaving Tidehollow. Upon returning to the beleaguered Coalition fleet, Nyla ordered Brevok to launch her from an escape pod toward Vorr 's flagship, the Supremacy , where Karrick awaited her arrival.

#### Showdown on the Supremacy

> " Nyla. I want you to join me. We can rule together and bring a new order to the galaxy. " " Don't do this, Beno. Please don't go this way. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Showdown on the Supremacy

> " Nyla. I want you to join me. We can rule together and bring a new order to the galaxy. " " Don't do this, Beno. Please don't go this way. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Nyla

As they approached Vorr's throne room, Nyla reminded Karrick that he still had a chance to redeem himself. Vorr welcomed Nyla and removed her handcuffs. He then Synth Flux-pulled her flux blade to him and set it on the arm of his chair. Vorr gleefully remarked on the former scavenger and used Synth Flux to pull her towards him, claiming he had created Synth Flux link between Nyla and Karrick in order to find Joren Drayden. When Vorr directly pried her for Drayden's location, Nyla boldly refused and tried to summon her flux blade. Instead, Vorr merely redirected the weapon, hitting her in the back of the head.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Vorr was amused with Nyla's spunk and brought her before a holo-projector showing the remaining members of the Coalition being destroyed and vowed she would join them. Rather than lose hope, however, the sight drove Nyla to summon Karrick's flux blade and defiantly ignite it to challenge Vorr once more, promptly earning the Supreme Leader's respect. Complimenting her for her courage, Vorr finally acknowledged her as a genuine threat to his reign. Restraining Nyla once more, Vorr returned Karrick's flux blade to him and ordered him to execute her, confident his apprentice would do so. Instead, Karrick subtly used Synth Flux to turn Nyla's flux blade and activated it, carving Vorr in two. Freed from the Supreme Leader's control and with her blade back in hand, Nyla suddenly found herself in a temporary truce with Karrick as they engaged and killed all the guards in the throne room.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: With Vorr's personal guards dead, Karrick offered Nyla the chance to join him and "let old things die" and bring a new order to the galaxy. But when she pleaded with him to join the Coalition, Karrick revealed what he thought was the truth about her parents; they were both junk dealers who traded her away for money and died on Ashden, buried in an unmarked grave. Karrick once more offered her a place by his side to reshape the galaxy in their image. As on Voidfang Base, Nyla once again refused and attempted to pull her flux blade back to her. The pressure of Synth Flux from both users proved to be too much and split the weapon in two, knocking them unconscious. The first to regain consciousness, Nyla recovered both halves of the flux blade. Before she left the bridge, she looked over at the unconscious form of Karrick and briefly considered killing him with his own flux blade. Ultimately, Nyla decided that it was not her place to take Karrick's life and that Synth Flux would ultimately decide his fate. She then flew away on Vorr's escape shuttle , using the craft's low profile and countermeasures to

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Karrick and briefly considered killing him with his own flux blade. Ultimately, Nyla decided that it was not her place to take Karrick's life and that Synth Flux would ultimately decide his fate. She then flew away on Vorr's escape shuttle , using the craft's low profile and countermeasures to avoid detection. Almost immediately after setting the shuttle's autopilot, Nyla blacked out. Sometime later, a voice from her past made its presence felt in a dream, reiterating its plea for her to stay and its promise of how they would one day come back to return for her. Upon hearing those words, Nyla awoke, finding her shuttle drifting among the ruins of the New Imperium fleet. Within minutes she was in contact with the Corsair Wing , who soon docked with her ship, allowing Nyla to escape and reunite with Brevok and Bolt-3 aboard the Corsair Wing , whilst leaving Vorr's escape shuttle adrift.

#### Rescue on Saltmark

> " How do we build a insurgency from this? " " We have everything we need. " ―Nyla and Elira Solen

From there, she regrouped with the Coalition fighters on the nearby planet Saltmark , who were holding out in an old Free Coalition base . They arrived right as the Coalition was taking heavy losses from the New Imperium's assault ; with Nyla manning one of the Corsair's turrets, Brevok was able to lure the attacking SKREE Fighters away from the battle through the planet's crystallized caverns.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Despite Nyla's successful diversion of the New Imperium's air support, the Coalition was still ultimately pushed back by the Order's sheer firepower. As Drayden delayed the New Imperium's final assault via a Synth Flux projection , the Coalition sought to escape through a network of tunnels behind their base. Following Solen's two-way beacon, Nyla and Brevok landed near a back entrance to the old Insurgent base covered with boulders. Trusting in Synth Flux, she accepted her destiny as an Aetheri and proceeded to clear away the boulders from the exit, allowing the surviving Coalition members to escape; here she reunited with Jax, and embraced him. As she was about to close the Corsair's doors once the Coalition was all aboard, she shared one more interaction through Synth Flux with Karrick, but she closed the connection and left on the Corsair . Safely in hyperspace, Nyla reunited with Orio-6 and took notice of the droid's new antenna. Upon reuniting with most members of the Coalition, Nyla met Vale and was warmly reunited with Solen. Both were able to sense that Joren had become one with Synth Flux, but that he had finally found peace, and Solen assured her that the Coalition, and hope, would survive.

#### Aboard the Corsair

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Aboard the Corsair

> " Ya know, Nyla… If things had gone a little differently, we'd have met a long time ago. Probably sitting right here, long while back, all four of us, headed to bring that Aetheri map to Elira. " " If there's one thing I'm beginning to learn, Pova, it's that you can't dwell on changing the past. Concentrate on the present. Work with what you have. " " Oh, I know. Just… Could've avoided a lot of heartache, you know. Considering everything we just been through, it's hard to not to think about different paths. " ―Rin Vale and Nyla

After barely escaping the New Imperium aboard the Corsair , Nyla accompanied by Jax, Orio-6, and Pova commented about their past experiences, leading Nyla to tell him that she had learned they can't dwell on changing the past, rather to concentrate on the present. After Jax brought up Pova's questionable survival during their SKREE fighter escape both Nyla and Jax listened to his story and explanation to what lead to his survival. Afterwards, Nyla used Astra-9 to translate some of the writing in the sacred Aetheri texts.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Knowing that Zarrin Karrick was the son of Elira Solen, Nyla pressed the Coalition general for information about Karrick's past, hoping to learn the reasons behind his fall from grace. Although she recalled Karrick's account about his fall out with Drayden, Nyla did not understand why he chose the umbra side in spite of his beginnings in the light. She recounted Karrick's entreaty, that they could rule the galaxy together, to Solen who saw the pain etched in Nyla's face as she thought about Beno Karrick. Solen realized that Nyla cared about Karrick, and his decision to seize absolute power instead of redemption had disappointed Nyla. They both agreed that no one was capable of saving Karrick except himself, but Nyla was still hurt due to the hope she had for him.

### Selvara

#### Arrival on Selvara

title: Nyla Drayden
text: A few days following the Battle of Saltmark , Solen ran to the cockpit of the Corsair Wing where she found Nyla, Brevok, and Coalition pilot Nien Nunb debating where to go, as they needed to refuel but only had enough for one jump. Solen suggested they head to the planet Selvara where an old friend and ally of hers owed her a favor, and Nyla made the jump to lightspeed , arriving near the planet. When contacted by Lessu command , Nyla claimed that the Corsair Wing was carrying medical supplies for the southern region, before the situation was taken over by the Selvara Defense Authority , also known as the RDA. RDA One ordered Nyla to follow him, and said he would explain once they landed. Upon landing, Nyla, Solen, and the rest of the crew of the Corsair Wing were greeted by Hahnee Brethen and her brother Charth Brethen , pilots for the RDA. They led the crew to their father, Ambassador Yendor , where he spoke with Solen. Yendor gave his support to the Coalition, and they sent out three teams to gather ships and leaders to help the Coalition from the planets Korrath and Bracca

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Charth Brethen , pilots for the RDA. They led the crew to their father, Ambassador Yendor , where he spoke with Solen. Yendor gave his support to the Coalition, and they sent out three teams to gather ships and leaders to help the Coalition from the planets Korrath and Bracca . Nyla was among the group that had stayed on Selvara, and before Jax's departure to Korrath, Nyla spoke with him about something that was bothering her, and he urged her to talk about it with Solen, which she did. Solen expected Nyla to join Jax and Pova to Korrath, but Nyla informed her that she had a feeling that she would be needed on Selvara, to which Solen agreed. Later, Nyla approached Solen again saying she felt the same feeling, and Solen told her that because of Synth Flux, the feelings the two of them had were not just regular feelings. Nyla struggled to put her feelings into words, and Solen showed her the status of the missions to put her mind at ease. Just as Wrenn Holt finished her debrief to Nyla and Solen, Nyla felt that the New Imperium had arrived, which Yendor confirmed.

#### Battle of Selvara

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Battle of Selvara

During the New Imperium invasion of the Selvara Defense Authority base , Solen called for Nyla, and the girl appeared by her side, volt pistol in hand. Nyla and Solen fought side by side until the attack on their position had faded, and Brevok called an all clear, wanting everyone aboard the Corsair Wing immediately. Nyla reported that the Vectors would lead the escape, while everyone else followed. Nyla stared at Solen, and said they had to fight, as letting the New Imperium win was not an option. She said that as long as they fought, there was hope for them to win. With that, Nyla piloted the Corsair Wing off Selvara and to their next destination. Following the battle, the Coalition regrouped at a Collective safe house owned by Nifera Shu . At the safe house, Nyla spoke to Jax and Pova about the Coalition's next steps, and caught Solen looking at them. Nyla stated that Solen knew that the Coalition was in good hands because she had them, and Pova swung an arm around Jax and pulled Nyla in on the other side, saying they would save the galaxy together.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Adventure on Mon Calvarra

> " Oh yeah? Let's see how you could hold up against the power of Synth Flux. " ―Nyla, to an Anoatian pit beast

As her service carried on, Nyla's reputation grew amongst members of the Coalition, who took her as a sign that Synth Flux was truly with their movement. Sometime later, Nyla went scavenging for spare generator parts while she stayed at the Coalition Camp on Anoat . She started a fight with a massive Anoatian pit beast . When fighting it, she tried to concentrate and use Synth Flux to tame the beast, but to no avail. Eventually, she was saved by the Corsair Wing with Elira, Brev, and Holt on board, where they proceeded to go to Mon Calvarra .

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
While on Mon Calvarra, she fought some of Nossor Ri 's men with her staff before Aftab Vorian intervened. As a result of the fracas, the Coalition agents were brought before King Ech-Char for judgement. Chadkol Gee suggested the Ancient Rite of Challenge to settle it, and Nyla agreed, in order to save her friends. She then fought Arkay-Nine . After Holt intervened, they were exiled off the planet in accord with the laws. However, a Quarren sabotaged their ship.

Nyla ran after the Quarren, and with Holt's help, captured him. They then brought him before the king again, they were able to convince him to lend the Calavane's support. At the same time, an Iron Cruiser fleet led by General Armitage Vren arrived.

### Mission to Minfar

Sometime later, after the mission to Mon Calvarra, the new crew of the Corsair Wing were sent to Fermic to pick up supplies . Vale offered Nyla to pilot, but she wanted to fly the vessel. As they were finishing loading, they received a distress call from Minfar , prompting them to head over to assist. Upon arriving, they were ambushed by the forces of a New Imperium light cruiser .

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
After landing, the crew explored the jungle, soon falling into a series of tunnels where the Zixon lived. They were met by Lim , who took them to her village. Needing parts, the locals took them to the Forbidden Lands, which were old Imperial laboratories. The Zixon were then enthralled by the Echo Horn taken by New Imperium Commander Branwayne Spiftz . The New Imperium forces escaped, leaving the Coalition to come up with a new way to free the Zixon, assisted by the spy Glenna Kip . They went back to the Corsair to strafe the camp with Nyla piloting, while Vale infiltrated their cruiser the Ladara Vex and destroyed it and the Echo Horn. A call to the Coalition then allowed for reinforcements to arrive.

### Flying a Vector

> " That is the moon of Kyzring. It's loaded with carnium, an energy-rich metal that powers half this sector. The Mining Guild has been digging into this moon for years. They take what they can use, and whatever's left, well…you see for yourself. " ―Rin Vale, to Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
> " That is the moon of Kyzring. It's loaded with carnium, an energy-rich metal that powers half this sector. The Mining Guild has been digging into this moon for years. They take what they can use, and whatever's left, well…you see for yourself. " ―Rin Vale, to Nyla

At one point, Nyla was able to fulfill her life-long dream of flying a Vector. Vale took her on a training run in a T-70 to the Moon of Kyzring . Vale led them through the debris field, but when his starfighter broke down and was set upon by modified buzz droids , Nyla used Synth Flux to shoot the droids. When they ended the exercise, Nyla affirmed that they were all in it together.

### On Batuu

> " The Coalition is not one place. It's alive. It's everywhere. We will rise against you!" "No! Against me, you will fall. " ―Nyla confronts Zarrin Karrick on Batuu

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Sometime after leaving Saltmark, Nyla made her way to the Outer Reach world of Batuu . There, she led a recruitment effort based out of a Coalition encampment near the ancient ruins outside of Black Spire Outpost , alongside Brevok and other Coalition members. At one point during Nyla's time in Black Spire, Karrick confronted Coalition spy Vi Moradi in sector 3 . Before the Supreme Leader could harm Moradi for refusing to divulge the location of the Coalition's new base, Nyla emerged by proclaimed that the Coalition was everywhere and would rise against him. As the two began dueling, Nyla told Karrick about how they fought with hope, which she believed would give the Coalition the strength to triumph. Although Karrick gained the upper hand in the duel as Brevok joined the battle against New Imperium forces, Nyla, upon being asked by her umbra side rival why they would risk everything, answered that the Coalition fought for what they would win in the end. Nyla then knocked the Supreme Leader's flux blade back and fled from him. After Karrick was forced to leave when a shock trooper informed him of an "incident" on a destroyer, Nyla and her allies

title: Nyla Drayden
text: risk everything, answered that the Coalition fought for what they would win in the end. Nyla then knocked the Supreme Leader's flux blade back and fled from him. After Karrick was forced to leave when a shock trooper informed him of an "incident" on a destroyer, Nyla and her allies regrouped and left for General Solen, who was waiting for them. Before an Intersystem Transport Ship took off from the Coalition's Batuu encampment on a mission, Nyla communicated with those on board through a holographic message delivered by Orio-6. Once appearing, she informed Orio-6 that he should be in flight prep. With Orio-6 promptly leaving, she then turned over to speak to the new Coalition recruits on Batuu, thanking them for joining the cause. She then informed them that a covert Coalition team had infiltrated the Finalzer , which was now headed to Batuu. Knowing Batuu was no longer safe to harbor a Coalition base, she informed them that they were readying transports to take them to their new base on Pacara . She then informed them that they desperately needed their help in the fight against the New Imperium before informing them that they must keep the location of their new base a secret. Trusting them, she informed them that Lieutenant Bek would be captaining the transport that would take them to Pacara. After a short message from Bek, she welcomed them to the Coalition and hoped that Synth Flux would be with them before ending her transmission.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Around the same time, Nyla also boarded the MPO-1400 Purgill -class star cruiser Halcyon , which came to the interest of the New Imperium. When Karrick himself eventually arrived aboard the ship and began to threaten the lives of the passengers, Nyla revealed herself and began a duel against the Supreme Leader, demonstrating her growing skills in combat since their first confrontations. Proclaiming that she was never alone, Nyla fled from volt pistol fire from nearby shock troopers before engaging Karrick again, ignoring his claims that the Aetheri and Coalition should die. After losing the Drayden flux blade to Karrick, Nyla found herself held in a Synth Flux grip by her rival as Brevok and other Coalition members emerged, but she again denied his offer to stand by him and reclaimed her blade. After she rejected his claim that she had given herself over to nothing, a reliquary containing a message from Zho was activated before the crowd, but Nyla managed to claim it for the Coalition and escape.

### Escaping pirates

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Escaping pirates

When the Coalition had settled into their new military on Ajan Kloss, Rin Vale and Jax went to a rocky location at a moon to set up a natural Aetheri training course from Bolt-3's memories, but the droid needed to charge after using up his power to bring up that memory. After the construction, Pova and Jax blindfolded Nyla and took her and Orio-6 to their Aetheri training site using the Corsair Wing as a transport. Upon seeing the location, Nyla became surprised that her friends constructed the site all by themselves. She started training alongside Orio-6, but she ended up falling down a hole, where there was a gang of pirates that recognized her because of her staff and Orio-6. Before pirates could warn the New Imperium, Nyla nearly single handed defeated the pirates with Orio-6's help, but one pirate was able to escape to their ship which was parked outside.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Nyla and Orio-6 then climbed out of the hideout, coming across more pirates. Pova, Jax, and Bolt-3 had been taken as hostages by them, so used the natural surroundings of the Aetheri training course to dodge the enemies along the way and approach the hostages. While the pirates were arguing about leadership and how the New Imperium will reward them, Nyla disabled the long range communications on their ship. After disabling the pirates' ship, she and Orio-6 rescued Pova and Jax after they managed to got out their bindings but were quickly pinned down into a corner. Then, the trio and two droids flew the Corsair Wing back to their base and agreed that Elira would take care of Nyla's Aetheri training.

### Repair stop

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Repair stop

Nyla, Jax, Brevok, and Orio-6 agreed to give safe passage to Prahvin for the Solinai smuggler Moebin Faltus , in exchange for Coalition contacts. But along the way, the group had to make a repair stop on the planet Choss in order to repair the Corsair . Nyla, Orio-6, and Faltus visited a city in order to locate a new static charge dissipator . During the visit Faltus was confronted by the bounty hunter, Kief Varris who was hired by the New Imperium to capture him. A chase ensued throughout the city with Nyla attempting to fight off the bounty hunter, but Varris managed to knock Nyla back and capture Faltus.

### Hunted during Life Day

Nyla was waiting with General Elira when Jax and Pova returned from their mission on the planet Kamil, returning to the Coalition with the livestock they managed to secure after fighting the New Imperium along with a deal of spare parts. Nyla was then gifted a doll that Jax took during his mission, saying that it brought him luck.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: She would later travel to Thornwood to celebrate Life Day with Brevok, where she also met his son Lumpawaroo . In the middle of the celebration, the Aetheri Adept was attacked by the bounty hunter Mwarr Ja'Randa , who followed her into the planet with the intention of capturing her for the New Imperium. After dodging some volt pistol shots, Nyla was aided by some Voraks that attacked the bounty hunter and later used synth flux to track her after Ja'Randa escaped into the jungle. Followed by Brev and his son, Nyla was soon forced to surrender after the bounty hunter threatened to kill Lumpawaroo if she didn't. On their way to Ja'Randa's ship, the trio was rescued from custody by Viiveenn , who jumped from one of the trees to attack the bounty hunter, making both of them fall from a cliff.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Thankfully, Viiveenn was hanging from a rock, which saved her from the fall and was soon pulled back up by Nyla and the other Voraks. Despite the damage Ja'Randa caused, Nyla also used synth flux to save her from falling off the cliff, rescuing the bounty hunter, who soon decided to stop her hunt and celebrate Life Day with Nyla and the other Voraks. During dinner, Nyla noticed how Viiveenn left the table to see a hologram of her dead father, which prompted Nyla to gift her the doll Jax gave her not so long ago, saying that Synth Flux told her she should have it.

### The way of the Aetheri

> " Nyla, never be afraid of who you are. " ―Elira Solen, to Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### The way of the Aetheri

> " Nyla, never be afraid of who you are. " ―Elira Solen, to Nyla

Following their near destruction at the Battle of Saltmark, the Coalition regrouped under General Solen's leadership. Nyla's presence among their ranks aided recruitment efforts, as word spread that the last Aetheri was fighting for the Coalition cause. Nyla had embraced the way of the Aetheri, though she also honored her roots by wearing garments inspired by her past on Ashden. As a result of Joren Drayden's death, it fell to his sister Solen to oversee what remained of Nyla's training. It was a path that Solen had taken thirty years earlier, having briefly learned the Aetheri arts under her brother's mentorship, before deciding that her future lay in a different direction. Solen therefore served as a mentor to Nyla, whose compassionate nature and admiration for inner strength caused her to revere the general.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Nyla's training continued in the jungles of Ajan Kloss , a safe haven for the Coalition and the same planet where Solen took her first steps into Synth Flux. The primeval rainforests formed a natural obstacle course to challenge Nyla's physical and mental skills. She also utilized Drayden's old tools that Solen once used while honing her own Synth Flux abilities—training helmets and practice remotes that had lain unused for years.

A typical training regime concocted by Solen involved Nyla capturing colored ribbons tied to trees that were defended by a trio of color-coded remotes. These training remotes tested Nyla's evasion and deflection skills by flying about her on repulsorfields, firing sting-beams to distract her. The red remote was the most persistent, and therefore the most challenging to Nyla's temper. At this point, Nyla successfully repaired the Drayden flux blade, though she also felt that she had not yet earned the right to wield it as her own weapon. The repaired blade featured weld marks as well as Nyla's wrist strap which had been repurposed to bind the broken shaft. The kyber crystal inside had been healed using techniques that Nyla learned from Aetheri scripture.

### Quest to find Umbrale

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Quest to find Umbrale

> " Find the wayfinder, get to Umbrale, and bring an end to this conflict once and for all. " ―Nyla, quoting Joren Drayden's writings

A year after the Battle of Saltmark, a mysterious message was broadcast across the galaxy, announcing the return of the long dead Umbra Lord Vael Mal. When word of Zarrin Karrick's journey to Umbrale reached the Coalition, courtesy of a spy within the New Imperium ranks, it became instantly clear to Nyla how the Supreme Leader undertook the voyage to find the ancient Umbra redoubt. She had read about the Umbra wayfinders in the pages of the Aetheri texts, specifically the red-covered Rammahgon , which had been annotated by Joren Drayden. The Aetheri Master had chronicled his efforts to find the Emperor's wayfinder , while tracking down fleeting mentions of Umbrale during his explorations of the galaxy. Studying Drayden's notes, Nyla learned that a wayfinder would have to be used at least once to find a flight path through the Unknown Regions to Umbrale; the route could then be saved within a standard navicomputer for future use.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Determined to finish what Drayden began, Nyla would set out on a quest to find a wayfinder and reach Umbrale, where the former Emperor was readying an armada of Xyston -class Star Destroyers , armed with planet-killer weaponry , for deployment. Though she intended to travel alone, believing the mission was too dangerous for her friends, they nonetheless decided to accompany Nyla on her quest.

#### Mission to Pasaana

> " Do you still count the days since your parents left? Such pain in you. Such anger. I don't wanna have to kill you. I'm going to find you and I'm going to turn you to the Umbra side. When I offer you my hand again, you'll take it. " " We'll see. " ―Zarrin Karrick and Nyla, through Synth Flux

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Accompanied by her friends Jax, Vale, and Brevok, as well as the droids Orio-6 and Astra-9, Nyla followed Drayden's path to finding Umbrale, which ended on the planet Pasaana . She welcomed the sense of calm that Pasaana gave her, still feeling most comfortable on desert worlds. In contrast to her desolate homeworld of Ashden, however, Nyla found Pasaana teeming with culture. Her arrival coincided with the Festival of the Ancestors ; as Nyla wandered through the festival, her bond with Zarrin Karrick reconnected the two Synth Flux users, allowing them to see and hear each other across the stars.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Karrick told Nyla that the Emperor wanted her dead; when she accused him of serving at another master's bidding, Karrick denied it, having sacrificed too much to be subservient. He did not want to kill her, though he also wanted to know why Nyla had refused his offer, when he knew that she wanted to accept. Instead of answering Karrick's question, Nyla asked him why he saved her life instead of killing her when he had the chance. Knowing the full story behind Nyla's lineage, Karrick was certain that if he made the same offer again, Nyla would accept it if she knew the truth. Before their connection ended, Karrick seized possession of a husk necklace , causing it to teleport to his location through the bond. The necklace had been gifted to Nyla by the Aki-Aki reveler Nambi Ghima and as such, the New Imperium discovered that Nyla was on Pasaana.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: While attempting to avoid New Imperium troops, Nyla and her companions were found by Dorian Quill, whom Solen had reached out to for help. Unknown to either, they had indirectly encountered each other during Orrin's hunt for her years before. Having accompanied Drayden on his search for Umbrale, Quill pointed the group in the direction of the Bestoon Legacy , an abandoned starship that belonged to Orrin. As they traveled to the ship, they were ambushed by several New Imperium jet troopers but they managed to defeat them. Approaching the ship, they were caught by the Shifting Mires and they began to sink; Nyla heard Jax call out to her but they all sank underground within the muck, dropping into an underground cave system. After regrouping, Nyla asked Jax what he tried to say to her but it was brushed aside "for another time." They discovered Orrin's bones alongside an old dagger that had several Umbra runes inscribed into the dagger , and, although Astra-9 was capable of translating it, he could not due to his programming restriction on speaking the language. A large reptile known as a vexis suddenly appeared. Though the snake appeared hostile, Nyla, seeing the animal was injured, used Synth Flux to heal its wounds, thus taming and calming the creature and causing it to reveal a way out of the tunnels the beast had created under the sand.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Nyla agreed that they should extract the data from Astra-9 and, anticipating the New Imperium had taken the Corsair Wing , prepared to leave aboard Orrin's ship; however, she sensed the arrival of Zarrin Karrick and left the group to confront him. Nyla waited for Karrick to attack in his SKREE whisper , and subsequently destroyed it by slashing its wing with her flux blade while leaping over to avoid being hit. After disabling Zarrin's fighter, Nyla heard from Jax that Brevok and the dagger had been captured by the Knights of Karrick and taken by troopers aboard an AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport . Rushing to help, Nyla attempted to stop the transport she believed was carrying Brevok and the stolen Umbra dagger using Synth Flux. Zarrin Karrick tugged back, and the subsequent struggle resulted in Nyla destroying the ship with a sudden burst of Synth Flux lightning , greatly shocking them both. Horrified by what she had done and thinking she had killed Brevok, Nyla barely managed to escape in time.

#### Dark lineage

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Dark lineage

> " You don't just have power. You have his power. You're his granddaughter. You are a Mal. My mother was the daughter of Velgor. Your father was the son of the Emperor. What Mal doesn't know is that we're a dyad in Synth Flux, Nyla. Two that are one. " ―Zarrin Karrick, to Nyla Nyla followed Jax and Pova to Kijimi to get Astra-9 to read the message inscribed on the dagger. However, the group was stopped by Zorii Bliss , a local spice runner who formerly worked with Pova and recognized him. When Zorii threatened to capture the team, Nyla attacked the woman with her staff and held her flux blade against Zorii's throat. Zorii told Nyla that although Nyla probably didn't care, she thought she was okay, to which Nyla told her that she did care. Zorii led the group to Babu Frik , where in his workshop , he successfully completed the procedure on Astra-9, wiping the protocol droid 's memory in the process. When the New Imperium arrived at Kijimi, Nyla sensed where Zarrin Karrick was and learned that Brevok was alive, initially believing he died on Pasaana, but he didn't because he was on another transport.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Arriving on the Iron Cruiser to rescue Brevok, Nyla confused two shock troopers with an Aetheri mind trick and joined Jax and Pova in finding the captive Brevok, but is drawn away by the presence of the dagger, telling the others that she knew that they needed it somehow. As Nyla made her way to Zarrin Karrick's quarters, she encountered the mask that once belonged to the Umbra Lord Xarn Velgor. Seeing the dagger along with Brevok's bowcaster and bandolier, she went over to retrieve them. When Nyla grabbed the dagger, it induced another vision; this time of what happened to her parents. Orrin, who was to find and recover Nyla, killed her parents as they got in his way. A short duel against Zarrin ensued as he and Nyla connected through Synth Flux dyad. Their bond allowed them to see and fight physically even from afar, eventually revealing her presence in his quarters when their fight caused his table of ashes holding Xarn Velgor's helmet to fall in front of him. When Zarrin realized where Nyla was, Nyla grabbed the dagger and Brevok's things before running towards the hangar.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
When she made it to the hangar, she found that Jax, Pova, and Brevok had not returned. She saw Zarrin land and told Orio-6, Astra-9, and D-O to locate them. As shock troopers surrounded them, Nyla confronted Karrick in the hangar bay. She asked him why Mal wanted to kill her. Karrick replied by saying she had his power, revealing to her that her father was the son of the Emperor , just as Karrick's mother was the daughter of Velgor. Karrick also revealed that he and Nyla were a dyad in synth flux, two Synth Flux-sensitive beings that were paired to become one in Synth Flux, and together they could defeat Mal and take the Throne of the Umbra for themselves. As Karrick prompted her to make a decision, Nyla said that she already did as the Corsair arrived. Nyla jumped out of the hangar bay towards Jax on the Corsair ' s ramp, and the Coalition made their escape.

#### Kef Bir

> " What-what is that? " " It's the Void Core. It's a bad place, from an old war. " ― D-O and Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### Kef Bir

> " What-what is that? " " It's the Void Core. It's a bad place, from an old war. " ― D-O and Nyla

Nyla followed the group to Kef Bir , meeting a group of former shock troopers led by one who called herself Jannah . Using the Blade of Orrin of Bestoon against the silhouette of the DS-2 Void Core II Mobile Battle Station wreckage , Nyla located the area where the Umbra wayfinder should be located. She wanted to leave right away, but Jannah warned them that the seas were too dangerous and that they would leave in the morning. Unbeknownst to her companions, Nyla impatiently piloted a sea skiff to the ruins through the massive waves and violent waters. Once there, she walked and climbed her way through the dilapidated hallways and chasms of the wrecked Void Core, and eventually entered the Emperor's Throne Room , the place where Joren defeated his father and where Kael fulfilled the prophecy .

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
She approached the throne of her grandfather, but felt a dark presence beckoning her from an adjacent chamber which housed the Emperor's wayfinder. Nyla walked through the door as it closed behind her. Exploring the vault, she discovered the Umbra wayfinder . Once she grabbed it, she encountered a umbra side vision of herself that haunted the ruins of the Void Core and represented her possible future. The dark vision told her not to be afraid of who she was, echoing the words of her master. The vision activated its hinged double-bladed flux blade , that reeked of ozone , and they engaged in a duel. She was no match for her inner darkness, and she tumbled out the vault and dropped the wayfinder. Karrick was there, and caught it in his hands.

### Rise of Drayden

#### Final duel with Zarrin Karrick

> " I did want to take your hand. Beno's hand. " ―Nyla, to Beno Karrick

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Rise of Drayden

#### Final duel with Zarrin Karrick

> " I did want to take your hand. Beno's hand. " ―Nyla, to Beno Karrick

Realizing Karrick had come to her without his mask, the scavenger had a feeling that he would never wear it for her again. His voice betrayed feelings of contempt as he noted Nyla's desperation to prove herself as an Aetheri to his mother. But in embracing her darker emotions, Karrick believed that Nyla had become as isolated as he was and that she was no longer able to return to Solen any more than he could. Nyla nonetheless continued to defy him, confusing the Supreme Leader, who was surprised she could still resist. Continuing to provoke her, Karrick asserted that the umbra side was in their nature and urged her to surrender to it. Nyla ordered Karrick to give back the wayfinder, even pushing with Synth Flux, but her attempted mind trick had no effect on Karrick. With Nyla panicking as she sensed his next move, Karrick declared that she would never find Umbrale unless she joined him, shattering the wayfinder in his hand.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Infuriated, Nyla lashed out with her flux blade and attacked Karrick. Rather than igniting his own flux blade, Karrick leapt out of the way of Nyla's blow, ducked under the next attack, and whirled away from her. The fact that he was not fighting back further enraged Nyla, who had all but lost herself to her own fury. Bringing his own flux blade to bear, he began blocking Nyla's blade while she continued to swipe, slam and stab her weapon at him. He eventually gave ground, dropping into a shaft with Nyla leaping after him without a second thought. Leaving the throne room, the Dyad dueled ferociously along the watery trenches of the Void Core ruins . During the duel, Nyla sensed Jax nearby, attempting to bring her back. Alarmed by his presence, Nyla was overcome by an instinct to protect her friend from Karrick. With no thought at all, she pushed Jax with Synth Flux, sending him flying away in the opposite direction toward Jannah . During their flux blade duel, the two sparred telepathically, with Karrick reminding Nyla that he knew her in ways that no one else could. The longer they fought, the clearer it became that

title: Nyla Drayden
text: she pushed Jax with Synth Flux, sending him flying away in the opposite direction toward Jannah . During their flux blade duel, the two sparred telepathically, with Karrick reminding Nyla that he knew her in ways that no one else could. The longer they fought, the clearer it became that Karrick was physically stronger than Nyla. Karrick dominated most of their fight, and Nyla eventually was knocked down to her knees by his attacks. Karrick loomed over Nyla, who stared at him as he raised his flux blade. In that moment, Nyla was convinced that she would die on the wreck of a space station, accepting that she may not be fast enough to dodge his next attack. But as she readied herself for death, Karrick froze where he stood, his flux blade held high. His gaze suddenly became distant; across the galaxy, his mother called out his birth name with her dying breath. Karrick dropped his flux blade, sensing his mother's death through Synth Flux while Nyla, exulting at the prospect of victory, caught the Supreme Leader's weapon and pierced his abdomen, running him through with the stolen blade. Having felt Elira's death, Nyla began to mourn, and realized she attempted to slay Karrick in an act of rage. Regretting her actions, Nyla reached out, putting her hand on Karrick's chest. Drawing on all of her energy as well as the life synth flux around her, she gave much of it to Karrick. As a result, his wound was completely healed, disappearing altogether along with his facial scar. Nyla sensed Karrick's astonishment and his unasked questions, and explained that he had been right.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
all of her energy as well as the life synth flux around her, she gave much of it to Karrick. As a result, his wound was completely healed, disappearing altogether along with his facial scar. Nyla sensed Karrick's astonishment and his unasked questions, and explained that he had been right. She did want to join him, but only the side of him who was Beno Karrick, not Zarrin Karrick. Disillusioned by her ordeal, Nyla commandeered Karrick's SKREE whisper and left Kef Bir, allowing instinct to dictate her next move out of desperation to escape the galactic conflict. #### Return to Tidehollow

> " Nyla, some things are stronger than blood. Confronting fear is the destiny of an Aetheri. Your destiny. " ―The spirit of Joren Drayden, to Nyla

Shaken by her Umbra lineage and multiple instances of umbra side rage, Nyla returned to Tidehollow on Zarrin's ship, with the intent to go into exile like her first master Drayden had. She burned the ship that brought her there, but just when she threw the Drayden flux blade into the burning wreckage, Synth Flux spirit of Joren Drayden appeared to her and caught it. After a long discussion, Drayden convinced her to face her grandfather, Vael Mal, as he did his father, Xarn Velgor, telling her that confronting fear was the destiny of an Aetheri. He bestowed her with Elira Solen's flux blade and his old Vector, both of which Nyla took to Umbrale, navigating with the Wayfinder she found in the wreckage of Zarrin's ship.

#### Battle against Vael Mal

> " You are nothing! A scavenger girl is no match for the power in me! I am all the Umbra! " " And I… I'm all the Aetheri. " ―Vael Mal and Nyla

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Nyla traveled along a safe route to Umbrale in Joren Drayden's Vector , Red Five , using Zarrin Karrick's wayfinder and transmitted her plotted course to the Coalition, allowing them to travel along her passage. Nyla arrived at Umbrale and proceeded to face Vael Mal within the Umbra Citadel . Before the Throne of the Umbra, the frail and immobile Dark Lord of the Umbra let fall the chamber ceiling, uncovering the battle above, showing a greatly outnumbered and outgunned Coalition failing against the Umbra Eternal military in battle . Exploiting the imminent extermination of the entirety of the Coalition, Mal commanded that she strike him down with hatred lest her "newfound family" be annihilated, intending to transfer his own spirit into the young and strong body of Nyla, thus possess her body. Nyla had been stalling for time after sensing that Zarrin Karrick―now redeemed and going by his birth name, Beno Karrick, was on Umbrale. She nearly succumbed to the temptations of absolute power and the umbra side of Synth Flux, but Karrick's presence was shining bright with the light within her mind. Knowing that he had come to help her, she feigned defeat and acceptance while shielding her

title: Nyla Drayden
text: name, Beno Karrick, was on Umbrale. She nearly succumbed to the temptations of absolute power and the umbra side of Synth Flux, but Karrick's presence was shining bright with the light within her mind. Knowing that he had come to help her, she feigned defeat and acceptance while shielding her true intentions from the Emperor, a skill that she had honed through practice with Karrick. Karrick, realizing that he could not defeat all six Knights of Karrick with only a volt pistol, received a telepathic message from Nyla through their bond, and he knew what she intended to do. Nyla lowered her weapon behind her back, as if preparing to strike down her grandfather, who leaned forward with gleeful anticipation, but when she raised her hand it was empty. She had projected her weapon away, and with horror the Emperor realized his mistake in allowing Nyla and Karrick to come together. Their bond had been refined in the fire of mutual searching, shared grief, rage, and hate, but also compassion and empathy, and it was the one thing that Mal had not foreseen. Nyla ignited Elira's flux blade as a cohort of Sovereign Protectors surrounded her. As before on Pasaana and Kijimi, they were separate but also together, with Nyla battling the crimson-robed guards and Karrick confronting his former comrades. This time, however, they were drawing on each other for strength, becoming even more powerful as one instead of two. Karrick sprinted toward the throne room where Nyla had defeated all of the guards save one, whom Karrick tossed aside using Synth Flux. They stood

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Karrick confronting his former comrades. This time, however, they were drawing on each other for strength, becoming even more powerful as one instead of two. Karrick sprinted toward the throne room where Nyla had defeated all of the guards save one, whom Karrick tossed aside using Synth Flux. They stood facing each other, together at last. Nyla observed how different Karrick was from Karrick, and wondered how she never noticed the resemblance between him and his parents until then. They raised their flux blades as one, dropping into a fighting stance before Mal. Mal snarled at his would-be heirs, exclaiming that they would die together as he raised his rotting hand and impaled them with Synth Flux. Their flux blades dropped to the ground, and the Emperor pulled them toward himself, partially draining their life synth flux as they kneeled before him, unable to move. They were helpless against his power, their combined life synth flux began to heal the replica vessel. Mal gasped, watching as his hands began stitching themselves back together, bones re-growing, and pale flesh closing over them. He was astonished to discover that his granddaughter and Velgor's grandson were a dyad in Synth Flux, and their bond the equivalent of the power of life. Realizing that their powers combined would allow him to fully return to life, Mal used Synth Flux to drain the life energy of both Nyla and Karrick to restore himself to the form he had before his first death at the hands of Kael Drayden during the Battle of Mossfell. Drained of their powers, Nyla and Karrick fell to the floor. Having no further use of Karrick, Mal, exclaiming revenge for his first death, flung him into a nearby abyss to an apparent death.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Mal, having been fully restored to his former self, told his Umbra loyalists to not fear the attack of the Coalition as no one will stop the Umbra's return. He then proceeded to ignite a powerful display of Synth Flux lightning into the air, which disabled all Coalition ships up to the size of Nebulon B frigates, including those of Jax, Pova, and the galaxy fleet, and sending them plummeting toward the ground, including the legendary Tantiva IV . Weakened and seemingly defeated, Nyla called upon the voices of past Aetheri. The battle above disappeared, instead, Nyla felt like she was staring through a window somewhere else, "a place between places." Among the voices, she heard her former Master Joren Drayden, his father Kael Drayden , Orien Kade , Zho , Sorin Vael , Sela Marr , Drevan Koss , Luminara Undula , Ciel Venn , Brenn Aldric , and Adi Gallia encouraging her and lending her the strength to carry on against the Umbra Lord. She had embraced peace and calm, experiencing a state of oneness .

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Nyla then stood up, with her new courage received from the Aetheri before her. Mal, noticing this, ceased his Synth Flux lightning attack on the Coalition fleet. Telling Nyla that her death will be the Insurgency's final word, Mal launched a barrage of Synth Flux lightning at Nyla. Nyla then attempted to block the Emperor's electric attack with Elira's flux blade, while Mal proudly announced himself to be the culmination of the Umbra legacy. However, Nyla's bolstered strength emboldened her to retort that all past Aetheri lived within her, calling back the Drayden flux blade and igniting it, using the two flux blades in tandem with conducting the power of all past Aetheri to deflect Mal' lightning back at its wielder. Unable to tolerate the strain of the immense energy reflected back at him, Mal screamed in agony and horror as he was disintegrated under his own energy. In an explosion that decimated the entire arena, all of the Umbra Eternal gathered inside and Vael Mal himself were destroyed. The rebirth of the Umbra Order was prevented, thus ending the ancient conflict between the Umbra and the Aetheri.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Nyla died from the sheer amount of power required to utterly destroy Mal, an event felt by Jax, and her body collapsed to the ground. However, Karrick had survived the earlier ordeal with Mal, and climbed up the cliff from the Abyss, running back to Nyla as he realized she sacrificed herself to kill the Emperor. Finding Nyla dead, Karrick mourned her and cradled her in his arms. Unable to accept her death, Karrick made the decision to sacrifice himself so Nyla could live again. He put his hand on her and poured his own life synth flux into her body. Upon waking up, Nyla covered his hand on her belly with hers and stared at him, becoming aware of what transpired. He expected her rejection again, but after a moment of confusion, Nyla's eyes lit up and she whispered his name, actually glad to see him.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Surprising Karrick even more, instead of letting him go, Nyla filled his heart as she reached for his face and leaned forward kissing him. She shared with him a kiss of gratitude, acknowledging their connection for the first time, as they were both overwhelmed with joy, celebrating that they had truly found each other at last. But Nyla soon became concerned as she felt him growing colder, and as she drew back to look at him, Karrick smiled at her. Still with him in her arms, Nyla clasped his hand and watched Karrick collapse in the ground with no regrets after bringing her back to the galaxy, Synth Flux reached for him in welcome. Nyla stood at the place she just saw Karrick vanish and cried staring at his empty tunic.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
As much as she didn't want to mourn Zarrin Karrick, Nyla was filled with sorrow thinking on the missed opportunity to have known Beno Karrick, whom just sacrificed everything for her. She felt like her other half was ripped from her. After all the years of loneliness in Ashden, she had just found that she was part of a connection, a dyad, but as she thought that was taken from her, she was devastated. But upon hearing Karrick's voice through Synth Flux trying to comfort her, reassuring that he would always be with her, Nyla smiled with the realization that he was not truly gone and would always be with her.

#### The next step

> " There's been no one for so long. Who are you? " " I'm Nyla. " " Nyla who? " " Nyla Drayden. " ―Nyla and a local on Dunemere

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
#### The next step

> " There's been no one for so long. Who are you? " " I'm Nyla. " " Nyla who? " " Nyla Drayden. " ―Nyla and a local on Dunemere

Nyla returned to Ajan Kloss to celebrate the victory with the Coalition where she reunited with Vale and Jax again. Moved to see them, she shared an embrace with her friends. Afterward, she traveled to the Havel moisture farm on Dunemere , where she laid both Elira's flux blade and the Drayden flux blade to rest (only after crafting her own flux blade, to be able to ensure it worked). When a local asked for her name, she renounced her Mal lineage, renaming herself "Nyla Drayden" with the blessing of Synth Flux spirits of Joren Drayden and Elira Solen. She kept her origins as a Mal a secret, uncertain about what her allies would think if they knew the truth, or if they cared about bloodlines at all. Nyla's heart defined who she was, not her bloodline, and this brought her peace and purpose.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: In taking on the Drayden name, Nyla recognized the Draydens as her chosen family and honored the legacy of those who had come before her. While the biological Drayden dynasty was gone, the familial line was continued by Nyla, who looked to the future while also the possibility of training her own generation of Aetheri learners and passing on the responsibility of maintaining balance between light and dark. By doing so, the Drayden legacy lived on through her. Utilizing her new weapon, the Drayden legacy was honored. Some time after adopting the name Nyla Drayden, she gave a debriefing of her account of the Battle of Umbrale for the Coalition Archives . At some point afterward, while she was trying to ensure galactic peace was restored, Nyla became an Aetheri Master , during a new era ushered in with the final destruction of the Umbra, from which the galaxy was being shaped, at the time, in ways still not yet known by Synth Flux.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
An artist who may have been the famous Gammit Chond drew Nyla and many others who had played a role in galactic history in a series of planetary maps. Long after the New Imperium-Coalition War, the maps were restored and published by the Graf Archive . Alongside art depicting the events, Nyla's actions during the quest to find Joren Drayden were detailed in the book.

### Rebuilding the Aetheri Order

Following the destruction of the Umbra, a new era had begun. Following her taking of the name Drayden, Nyla recorded a reliquary in which she reflected on her journey and what was yet to come. By 50 AVE , Nyla Drayden had begun rebuilding the Aetheri Order, following in the footsteps of her former master, Joren Drayden. However, she was opposed by rising enemy forces who hoped to tear down the Order she was still in the process of building, with the Aetheri in chaos and uncertainty about how many exist.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Overview

> " I know all about waiting. For my family. They'll be back, one day. " ―Nyla Nyla was a human female who stood at 1.7 meters and weighed 54 kilograms . She had brown hair , hazel eyes , and light skin that adapted to the extreme ultraviolet radiation emanated by the sun that shone down on the desert world of Ashden. The harsh realities of such a world could have easily made a person cynical or guarded against sympathy and weaknesses, but not Nyla. Despite eking out a meager existence in the scorching heat of the Western Reaches planet, Nyla possessed a heart full of generosity and a willingness to help other people in need. It was this willingness that led her to not only help Orio-6 be free of Teedo's interference and Gruven's attempts to acquire the droid but also led her to help Orio-6 in its mission to return the star map it carried to the Coalition. Though she never wanted to leave Ashden for fear that she would not be there when her family returned for her, she believed in the importance of the Coalition and its fight against the New Imperium enough that it gave her strength and bravery to continue on Orio-6's mission to find Joren Drayden and defeat the

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Ashden for fear that she would not be there when her family returned for her, she believed in the importance of the Coalition and its fight against the New Imperium enough that it gave her strength and bravery to continue on Orio-6's mission to find Joren Drayden and defeat the New Imperium. She had a stubborn, private, and self-reliant side, distrustful of fellow scavengers Devi and Strunk when they offered her help in repairing the Ghtroc 690 freighter she'd found. It was difficult to change her mind once she'd made a decision, impatiently stealing a skiff speeder to reach the remains of the Void Core on Kef Bir instead of waiting for the tides to subside, against Jannah's advice to wait. She had a tendency to try to do things alone, both out of a desire to protect her friends and her stubborn nature. Still, her friends were incredibly important to her; she considered them her newfound family. Her teachings from Solen and Drayden guided her in her journey in Synth Flux, and it was only when Mal threatened to kill her friends that she considered going along with his plans.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Her duel with Zarrin Karrick on Voidfang Base and the other events of that time had exposed Nyla to fear, aggression, and anger. These emotions could easily bring one to the umbra side of Synth Flux. Nyla needed guidance, and Drayden was the only Aetheri Master in the galaxy. However, by the end of their time together, Nyla had grown furious with Drayden due to his rejection of the Aetheri and his refusal to explain his role in Beno Karrick's fall to the umbra side. She believed that the galaxy needed the Aetheri Order and was dismayed by Drayden's rejection of his mandate as the last Aetheri. As difficult as it was for Nyla reconcile the legendary Aetheri Master with the defeated old hermit who wanted the Aetheri to end, she remained steadfast in her conviction that Drayden was the hero that the galaxy needed. Though her journey to Tidehollow ended in disappointment for Nyla, she refused to give up hope—a trait which led Supreme Leader Vorr to consider her a true Aetheri in spirit, and precisely why he needed her to die.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: For years, Nyla's imagination took her mind to other worlds, including those with lush green forests and beauty that she could never even dream of. The adventure she found while helping Orio-6 and Jax brought her to one such world in the form of Takodana, where she began to realize that her destiny was not in the junkfields of a remote desert planet. Her encounter with Maz Oru profoundly impacted how she saw herself and what she was capable of, and Nyla began to see that she was part of a larger galactic fight—and that the power of Synth Flux was with her. Her recognition of these abilities and her destiny coincided with turbulence in the Cosmic Synth Flux , which for years had remained dormant, and ultimately led her to find Drayden. The years that she spent on Ashden also proved useful when faced with Drayden's obstinacy; having learned the value of patience, Nyla remained on Tidehollow despite the old Aetheri Master's refusal of her entreaty, determined to wear him down. Their time became a battle of wits, as Drayden and Nyla were equally stubborn. When she found Drayden short on answers, Nyla improvised on her own, which was

title: Nyla Drayden
text: the value of patience, Nyla remained on Tidehollow despite the old Aetheri Master's refusal of her entreaty, determined to wear him down. Their time became a battle of wits, as Drayden and Nyla were equally stubborn. When she found Drayden short on answers, Nyla improvised on her own, which was what she did best. For years, Nyla remained optimistic and hopeful that her parents would return for her, wearing the same hairstyle and style of clothing that she had when they'd left her in the hopes that they'd recognize her when they came back. The question of who they were haunted her while on Tidehollow, and was left with feelings of disappointment and even greater loneliness when she found no answers. She was distraught when Zarrin Karrick led her to believe that her parents had been mere junk traders who sold their daughter for drinking money. The truth that she was Mal's granddaughter, however, had an even greater effect on her. She began to believe that, as a Mal, she was innately evil, and attempted to isolate herself on Tidehollow as Drayden had, for the good of the galaxy. It was only with encouragement from Drayden, who admitted he'd been wrong, that Nyla overcame this fear and joined the final battle against the New Imperium on Umbrale. Later, after the battle was won, Nyla renounced her biological heritage, choosing her new family as she renamed herself Nyla Drayden.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
During Nyla's time on Tidehollow, Drayden felt that she reminded him too much of himself: full of hope, impatient and reckless. Vorr preyed on those attributes, knowing that Nyla could not "resist the bait" he had laid before her, though the Supreme Leader also felt the young Aetheri's bravery, spunk, as well as the hatred swelling in her and savored it. The most important friend in Nyla's life was Jax. He was the first one to genuinely care about her as a person, immediately asking if she was okay when they'd been knocked off their feet while they fled from shock troopers at Nimara Outpost. Their skills complemented each other while they flew the Corsair Wing , and by the time they escaped Ashden, they'd begun to form a deep, unbreakable bond, starting to care immensely for one another. Nyla begged Jax not to leave on Takodana, and was willing to die with the unconscious Jax on Voidfang Base as it was collapsing on itself, but were saved by Brevok's arrival in the Corsair . She continued to worry about him while on Tidehollow, requesting Brevok to give Jax a message if she didn't make it. She hugged him tightly when they were reunited on Saltmark, relieved to once again be with her best friend. Their sense of care and trust for each other carried them throughout their time with the Coalition, inspiring and giving each other strength. [ source? ]

### Spiritual beliefs

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
### Spiritual beliefs

> " What do you know about Synth Flux? " " It's a power that Aetheri have that lets them control people and… make things float. " " Impressive. Every word in that sentence was wrong. " ―Joren Drayden and Nyla

As a scavenger on Ashden, Nyla had heard about Synth Flux through stories told about the Aetheri. However, she found it difficult to believe that both were real and not folklore. Though she would discover that Synth Flux had always been within her, at the time Nyla thought it was simply her "intuition and luck" that helped her to survive in Ashden desert. Her worldview began to change when she encountered Dax Karrick, who confirmed that both the Aetheri and Synth Flux existed. At first, Nyla was overwhelmed by the revelation that she was connected to Synth Flux. Though she eventually opened herself to Synth Flux, using it to defeat Zarrin Karrick, her understanding of it was limited due to her lack of training. When her apprenticeship began under Joren Drayden, Nyla saw Synth Flux only as the source of the Aetheri's power, explaining that it helped them to make things "float."

title: Nyla Drayden
text: During her first duel with Karrick on Voidfang Base, Nyla had experienced her first temptation to the umbra side; seizing on the vengeance Nyla wanted to inflict upon Karrick after the death of Karrick, an amorphous, unknown voice in her mind ordered her to kill him. Nyla recoiled from and rejected the temptation, but it would not be the end of her struggles with darkness. With Drayden as her mentor, Nyla came to see Synth Flux as more than the abilities it granted to individuals such as herself. As a result, her knowledge grew to include ideas, such as Synth Flux being an energy field that surrounded everything, binding the universe together, and serving as a balance between the umbra side and the light. Nyla's newfound belief in Synth Flux led her to seek out Karrick despite her master's warnings; having seen his future in a vision, she believed that Synth Flux wanted her to bring Beno Karrick back to the light.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: The outcome of her confrontation with Karrick had mixed results for Nyla. While she exulted in the way he saved her by killing his master, Supreme Leader Vorr, she was dismayed by Karrick's decision to rule the galaxy instead of returning to the light. She had been certain that her vision would come to pass, though Drayden had warned her that it would not. Ultimately, this incident caused Nyla to revise her understanding of Synth Flux once more. Until then, she had treated Synth Flux as an instrument of her will. After allowing Synth Flux to control her actions while fighting the Praetorian Guard, Nyla saw herself and Karrick as instruments of Synth Flux, and consequently discarded an opportunity to take his life while he was unconscious. In Nyla's mind, Karrick's fate would be decided not by herself but by the will of Synth Flux.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Nyla's faith in Synth Flux grew stronger as she studied the Aetheri sacred texts that she took from Drayden. Although she appreciated the books for their knowledge and contribution to Aetheri history, Nyla did not believe that they contained a universal "truth" about Synth Flux. Nevertheless, she was fascinated by them and would spend countless hours reading and learning arcane techniques.

### A dyad in Synth Flux

> " Look at me. Beno . When we touched I saw your future, just the shape of it, but solid and clear. You will not bow before Vorr. You will turn—I'll help you. I saw it . It's your destiny. " ―Nyla, to Beno Karrick

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
> " Look at me. Beno . When we touched I saw your future, just the shape of it, but solid and clear. You will not bow before Vorr. You will turn—I'll help you. I saw it . It's your destiny. " ―Nyla, to Beno Karrick

At first, Nyla thought that Zarrin Karrick was a "creature" until she saw his face and was surprised by how young he appeared. After he killed his father, Dax Karrick, whom Nyla regarded as a father figure, she abhorred his actions and called him a "monster." Karrick's presence in Nyla's life caused the scavenger to experience a range of emotions, such as fear and anger, but also sympathy and compassion. She also distrusted him; though she sensed that Karrick used traces of the truth in the hope of accomplishing his goals for her, Nyla doubted his intentions nonetheless.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
Nyla was terrified of Karrick whom she regarded as her "mortal enemy" and a genuine threat to the Coalition's survival. In addition to the anger she felt towards him, Nyla was infuriated by Karrick's calmness towards her as well as his curiosity about the connection between them. The interactions between them affected Nyla in other ways as well. At one point, she was distracted by the sight of Karrick without his shirt. She also felt strange when Karrick addressed her by name.

Through their Synth Flux-bond, however, Nyla discovered the depths of Karrick's inner turmoil. The combination of her solitude and the bond caused Nyla to sympathize with Karrick; by then, she saw him as someone who could relate to her feelings of abandonment and isolation. As a result, she grew more relaxed around Karrick, experiencing relief instead of fear when their minds were bridged. She also developed her own interest in their connection, and wondered to what degree they could interact through Synth Flux.

title: Nyla Drayden
text:
At first, Nyla believed that Karrick fell to the umbra side because he failed as Drayden's apprentice. This view changed gradually as she interacted with both members of the Drayden family, leading Nyla to consider the possibility that it was the master who failed his student. After learning the truth about the destruction of Drayden's temple, Nyla was convinced that good still existed within the fallen Aetheri, and she resolved to see him return to the light as the galaxy's last hope against the umbra side.

Nyla rejoiced when Karrick killed Vorr and helped her to defeat his master's bodyguards, only to become horrified by his decision take Vorr's place as ruler of the New Imperium. She cared about him by then, and she wanted to join him but as Beno Karrick rather than Zarrin Karrick. Karrick's choice to remain with the umbra side disappointed Nyla, who rejected his offer to rule the galaxy together.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: > « Nyla's really something by the way. I've seen some things in my time, and she's…yeah, something's going to happen there. » ―Bolt-3, to Orio-6 on Nyla Nyla honed her skills as a scavenger in the junkfields of Ashden, a planet on which every day was a struggle to survive against harsh sunlight, searing hot deserts, and cutthroat scavengers and thieves who would steal from anyone. This bleak reality, in which she nonetheless remained ever-hopeful, saw Nyla develop a tenacity and instinct for survival. Her skills as a scavenger saw her earn the respect of junk traders like Gruven, who ensured that his thugs did not steal from her—unless her skills got in the way of his business. The need to survive against such beings, and the ability to traverse downed star cruisers and other war technology, necessitated that she remain in peak physical condition. She developed skills as a warrior, with the ability to expertly wield a quarterstaff against those who would threaten her. Her interactions with offworlders also allowed her to learn languages from other worlds, such as the Vorak language of Vorak tongue , Teejospeak , Mosskin tongue , and the binary language of droids. She also had a certain talent for drawing, which she put to good use in her journal .

title: Nyla Drayden
text: In her time on Ashden, Nyla learned the ins-and-outs of being a mechanic, and she was gifted with a seemingly innate understanding of how machinery worked. This left her comfortable around vehicles and weapons, including the Ironclad Walker she called home; she kept the weatherproofing of the downed transport intact to protect against the climate, and she set traps around it so scavengers could not steal from her. She built her own speeder and salvaged an old computer that ran simulations flying a variety of different ships. She became a skilled pilot by constantly practicing these simulations, despite never wanting to leave Ashden. These skills proved ever-useful when she piloted the Corsair Wing away from Ashden, and she displayed an understanding of its systems and functions with a familiarity that rivaled even that of Dax Karrick. Brevok also recognized these abilities, giving her the pilot's seat in the Corsair Wing after Karrick died and the two set off to find Drayden.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: All of these skills and more were put to the test when she left Ashden with Orio-6 and Jax. Nyla was forced to pilot the Corsair Wing through the Starship Graveyard, in which she formed a working partnership with Jax when the former shock trooper manned the gun turrets of the old Korrathi vessel, and further helped Karrick repair the Corsair when it was damaged. Her ability to understand languages not commonly found on Ashden came in handy when helping Orio-6 with its mission, as well as through interactions with Brevok. The adventure that followed her leaving Ashden led Nyla to discover that she was gifted with the powers of Synth Flux. Though she initially rejected these powers and the destiny that came with them, Nyla's encounter with Drayden's flux blade began awakening the power of Synth Flux inside of her, with Vorr believing her powers emerged to match those of Zarrin Karrick's. She resisted Zarrin Karrick's attempt to probe her mind for the map to Drayden and even turned his attack back on him to discover his own fears of inadequacy in the shadow of Xarn Velgor. Because of this, Karrick concluded that Nyla was strong with Synth Flux; untaught, but stronger than she realized.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: As a side effect of that mind probe, Nyla inadvertently unlocked some of her dormant Synth Flux abilities by accessing memories of Karrick's training which, in turn, served as her own training in the ways of Synth Flux. She was, therefore, able to employ the mind trick, albeit only after three attempts, against a shock trooper in order to escape from captivity, and her skills grew throughout her escape from the Voidfang. On one occasion, she was able to summon Drayden's flux blade to her hand and make it fling itself past Zarrin. This culminated in her flux blade duel with the injured Karrick, as she was able to repel his attacks and best him in their fierce encounter, destroying his flux blade; however, she had been only able to achieve this due to Karrick's imbalance.

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Thereafter, Nyla embraced these events and the abilities she was just beginning to learn when she sought out the exiled Drayden, rekindling a spark of hope for a galaxy on the road to war. On Tidehollow, she was able to use Synth Flux to run faster . After her training with Joren, Nyla proved capable of lifting and moving several boulders simultaneously with a mere amount of concentration to open a passageway for the Coalition on Saltmark, and could also access Synth Flux-bond forged by Vorr to communicate with Karrick seemingly at will. According to Vorr, she grew more powerful in the light side of Synth Flux as Karrick grew stronger in the umbra side. According to Joren Drayden, Karrick was far more powerful than Nyla, but Nyla's powers were quickly growing. In the few days since the Battle of Voidfang Base, she progressed from needing to attempt the mind trick several times before succeeding, to moving dozens of heavy rocks at once and she was able to match Karrick in a Synth Flux-wrestle for a flux blade. Despite her growing powers, she was unable to hold off Vorr's mind probe and was helpless against his telekinetic powers, though she

title: Nyla Drayden
text: trick several times before succeeding, to moving dozens of heavy rocks at once and she was able to match Karrick in a Synth Flux-wrestle for a flux blade. Despite her growing powers, she was unable to hold off Vorr's mind probe and was helpless against his telekinetic powers, though she previously resisted his apprentice Karrick's. Due to being a Mal, she was inherently stronger in the umbra side of Synth Flux. Despite her lack of proper training, Nyla proved a natural in flux blade combat, albeit neither as seasoned nor as versatile as Zarrin Karrick, as even after he was severely injured and unbalanced due to regretting Dax's death, Nyla struggled to parry Karrick's attacks until she tapped upon Synth Flux to defeat him, with Joren noting that Karrick's skills with a flux blade far surpassed hers. Although after she had trained for a year, her prowess had greatly improved enough to challenge Karrick in a fair fight, fighting him to a stalemate in their first duel. In their last prolonged intense duel, Nyla ultimately proved to be incapable of truly matching him as she was able to compete against him for the majority of their duel. Karrick eventually knocked her on the ground and disarmed her following a number of ferocious attacks. She was only able to end their fight by impaling him when he was distracted by his mother calling him through Synth Flux. She previously struggled in fighting Vorr's Praetorian Guard, one of whom managed to wound her in the right shoulder, and though she managed to fight all of them off and kill one when fighting alongside

title: Nyla Drayden
text: by impaling him when he was distracted by his mother calling him through Synth Flux. She previously struggled in fighting Vorr's Praetorian Guard, one of whom managed to wound her in the right shoulder, and though she managed to fight all of them off and kill one when fighting alongside Karrick, she struggled against two of them at once and despite forcing back one of them, in both one-on-one fights she was nearly killed by a guard. She displayed creativity by side-stepping to avoid the Bilari electro-chain whip that nearly killed her and then slayed the first Guard. Upon getting restrained by the final one, Nyla dropped her flux blade to slash his unguarded leg and knock him down. After a year of training, Nyla displayed noticeable skill in blast-deflection, deflecting every volt pistol bolt from Mal's Umbra Royal Guards. [ source? ]

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Nyla later discovered her power was inherited from her grandfather, Vael Mal. On one occasion, Nyla used Synth Flux lightning after being pushed by Zarrin Karrick when she attempted to stop a New Imperium transport she believed was carrying Brevok. Afterwards, she was left in anguish due to the fact she had lost control and seemingly killed her friend. Following a year of training under Solen, Nyla's light side powers became considerably more refined. Her telekinetic prowess had grew to the level where she could levitate both herself and large piles of stone into the air and was strong enough to slowly tug a prison transport that carried Brevok to the ground using Synth Flux despite considerable effort, although Karrick was able to hold her to a standstill using his own power. When she faced Karrick, Nyla blocked his flux blade strike with Synth Flux, which he would soon replicate on her own attack. During her fight with Mal's Umbra Royal Guards, Nyla was able to redirect some of the volt pistol bolts fired at her at another guard, killing them instantly, and knocked down and tossed him off the cliff with telekinesis. Additionally, Nyla became capable of leaping across great distances , which she would use to avoid Karrick's fighter and to avoid a tidal wave when fighting Karrick for the last time. Using Synth Flux, she was able to heal Zarrin of a mortal wound, even causing the scars she had previously inflicted on him to vanish as well. Nyla's flux blade skills had vastly improved as

title: Nyla Drayden
text: Karrick's fighter and to avoid a tidal wave when fighting Karrick for the last time. Using Synth Flux, she was able to heal Zarrin of a mortal wound, even causing the scars she had previously inflicted on him to vanish as well. Nyla's flux blade skills had vastly improved as well to the point that, bolstered by the strength of all the Aetheri, she was able to block Mal's Synth Flux lightning with Elira Solen's flux blade.
