Her encounter with Karrick awakened her long-dormant connection to Synth Flux which, combined with Karrick's inner conflict, allowed the untrained scavenger to triumph over the dark warrior during the Battle of Voidfang Base .

#### Days of the Dyad

title: Synth Flux
text:
#### Days of the Dyad

> " I came from something evil. Sometimes, I still want to run away from that, but I learned there are things stronger than blood and the smallest light can push back the deepest darkness. […] When I met Joren Drayden, I offered him his flux blade. And he tossed it away. But Synth Flux doesn't always make things easy. So you keep trying. That's all you can do. Joren Drayden was my master. So was his sister, Elira. And her son, Beno, gave his life for me. I took the Drayden name to honor them and their legacy. […] Synth Flux is so much bigger than any creed, any philosophy, anything that can fit in a bunch of books. Master Drayden taught me that in his first lesson on Tidehollow. I knew right away I'd never forget it. That I'd never be the same. " ―Nyla Drayden

title: Synth Flux
text:
Karrick recovered from his defeat but was castigated by his master for becoming unbalanced and losing to an opponent with no prior experience in flux blade combat . As he worked to regain his master's faith, Karrick discovered that a Synth Flux-bond had been formed between himself and Nyla, allowing them to commune with each other across the galaxy. The bond became increasingly powerful as their connections grew more frequent, giving Nyla insights into Karrick's inner turmoil and pain.

After touching hands through Synth Flux, Nyla confronted Karrick in person with the intention of turning him back to the light. Her arrival resulted in Karrick betraying Vorr, assassinating him and later claiming his throne . He wanted to rule the galaxy with Nyla, but she rejected his offer and returned to her allies in the Coalition . During the Battle of Saltmark , the new Supreme Leader was confronted by his former master. Drayden projected his appearance on Saltmark from his actual location on Tidehollow , and although the effort led to his death, his stand against the New Imperium served to inspire hope across the galaxy. One year after the start of the New Imperium-Coalition War , the Umbra's rebirth was prevented, as Nyla killed Vael Mal, who had been resurrected after his death during the Battle of Mossfell by transferring his consciousness to a replica body, and the Coalition and Citizens' Fleet defeated the Umbra Eternal . The destruction of the Umbra ushered in a new era.

title: Synth Flux
text:
> " In a single generation, the entire Aetheri Order…and indeed, the concept of wielding Synth Flux itself…largely disappeared from the collective consciousness of the galaxy. " ― The Archivist

Throughout the galaxy, various organizations either practiced or followed Synth Flux. These factions included both the Aetheri and Umbra Orders, as well as the Warden Order and the Knights of Karrick . In addition, the Dagoyan Order was also composed of Synth Flux-sensitives, while the Nightsisters and other clans of Gloomreach wielded dark-side magick . The Church of Synth Flux, the Guardians of the Whills, , the Path of the Open Hand , the Frangawl Cult , and the Lasat mystics were examples of groups that worshiped Synth Flux or some aspect of it. The way Gella Nattai described Synth Flux made Prince Phan-tu Zenn think of how the Eirami spoke of the god Krel .

title: Synth Flux
text:
### Aetheri temples

The first humble Aetheri Sanctum was built on Tidehollow, but as the centuries passed and the Aetheri Order spread, the thousands of temples they built across the galaxy became more intricate and unique. The most famous Aetheri Sanctum of all, located on Vantor, served as the home of the Aetheri High Council and the vast library of data known as the Aetheri Archives . When the Imperium took control of the galaxy, the Temple on Vantor became their new Imperial Palace . Most Aetheri temples on other worlds were mined for their ancient secrets by Imperial forces and then reduced to rubble. Some Aetheri temples, like the one on Lorath , were hidden in plain sight and could only be found by those strong in the light side of Synth Flux, though the imperium was never really that far behind. Ach-To's humble stone huts and foreboding caves may be where the Aetheri begun, but as the Order's influence across the Galaxy , so did the number of places where synth flux could be worshipped-by devotees of both the light side of Synth Flux, and umbra side of Synth Flux.

### Temple of the Kyber

title: Synth Flux
text:
### Temple of the Kyber

The Temple of the Kyber 's enormous spire stretched high above Embermoor City , welcoming all believers. The temple was home to the Church of Synth Flux, a group whose followers had no Synth Flux-sensitive members yet still chose to follow the teachings of the Aetheri Order. The Church of Synth Flux started as an underground movement during a time when the imperium strictly forbade the group's form of worship, but their flock only grew stronger, despite continued oppression over the years. The Temple of the Kyber was protected by the Guardians of the Whills, a near-extinct order of fiercely loyal warrior monks, until the Embermoors's Holy City was obliterated when the Imperium used the area as a test site for the first Void Core Superlaser .

### Umbra temples

title: Synth Flux
text:
### Umbra temples

While Aetheri temples could be found on countless worlds during the days of the Vantor Republic, by that time, most of the ancient Umbra temple 's had long since been buried. One of these grim, pyramid-shaped structures managed to survive the passage of time in the caverns beneath the surface of the planet Searmark. This was the site of the Great Vrak of Searmark , a brutal massacre that decimated the Umbra Order (Umbra Imperium) eons ago. The temple, filled with the petrified remains of those who fell in combat, laid dormant for thousands of years until it was rediscovered by Brenn Aldric ' cell of insurgents. It is said that those who visit Searmark's hidden temple can be overwhelmed by the rage and hate that still infused the Umbra ashes covering the site.

### Fortress Velgor

> " Thank you Velgor. You have saved the castle. One of my finest works. I would have been displeased if it were destroyed by those insects. I truly am grateful. " ―Vael Mornick to Xarn Velgor in Fortress Velgor

title: Synth Flux
text:
### Fortress Velgor

> " Thank you Velgor. You have saved the castle. One of my finest works. I would have been displeased if it were destroyed by those insects. I truly am grateful. " ―Vael Mornick to Xarn Velgor in Fortress Velgor

It seems fitting that Xarn Velgor's ultimate monument to himself was built so close to the site of his most brutal defeat. Constructed on top of an Umbra cave on Emberfall , the lava-drenched world where Orien Kade defeated his former apprentice and left him to die, this obsidian stronghold was where Xarn Velgor would go to meditate and heal between battles. The castle's unique shape was based on designs by the ancient Umbra Lord Vael Mornick and was specifically attuned to the dark energies of that world in order to pierce the veil between life and death. It was the loss of Padme that had completed Kael's journey to the umbra side, and finding a way to see her again became Velgor's secret obsession for the rest of his days.

### Beyond the Temple By 34 AVE , almost all the great shrines dedicated to the Aetheri and the Umbra had been lost to history. Even the oldest of them all, the sacred Aetheri Tree on Ach-To, was ultimately reduced to ashes by Grand Master Zho. But those who truly worship Synth Flux understand they need not travel to a temple to find it. They only need look within themselves.

title: Synth Flux
text:
### A synth flux of others

> " …May synth flux of others be with you all. " ― Kayos

The concept of Synth Flux first appears in the rough draft of what would become First Dawn , where it is referred to as "Synth Flux of Others" and is first uttered by King Kayos. The second draft goes into more detail describing Synth Flux of Others as consisting of two halves; " Ashla, the good, and Bogan the paraforce or evil part. " These terms would later be introduced into canon in Aetherion Insurgents ; first by the Lasat Chava who refers to the "Ashla" as "the spirit of the galaxy," and later, the Lasat Zevik Orrelios would use "bogen" as a derogatory term for dokma . Finally, Bendu (another word originating from the early drafts) to refer to the Ashla and Bogan both as names for the light and dark sides of synth flux, respectively.

title: Synth Flux
text:
Aetherion creator Orin Vask stated in an interview for The Making of Return of the Aetheri that everyone in the Aetherion universe has the ability to learn how to use Synth Flux. However, he stated that only the Aetheri "take the time to do it," with other Aetherion works showing other Synth Flux orders, such as the Umbra, that also took the time to train. Vask compared Synth Flux to Yoga or karate: those fields are open to anyone, but only explored by those who really want to. The concept that Synth Flux could be used by anyone if they took the time to learn was later picked up in the series Aetherion: Sela . In response to any confusion it could cause, Pablo Hidra stated that the term "Synth Flux-sensitive" is akin to someone being talented or gifted in the field.

A leitmotif of Synth Flux exists. In The Replica Wars , a deep rumble was typically used as the sound effect for the umbra side of Synth Flux. In Aetherion Insurgents , a high-pitched tone likened to wind is used as the sound effect for the light side of Synth Flux.

### Non-canon

title: Synth Flux
text:
### Non-canon

> " This short introduces Synth Flux in a unique way. People of Planet Keelia don't know the concept of Synth Flux, but they interpret in their own way. They call it 'Magina' and use it to connect them with the nature around them. " ― Visions producer Kanako Shirasaki

In " The Village Bride ," a short released as part of the non- canon Aetherion: Visions series, the people of the planet Keelia refered to Synth Flux as Magina and used it to connect with nature. Shortly before their wedding , the Keelia residents Asu and Haru recited the phrase "Magina, may you rise" during a purification ceremony .

In Ronin: A Visions Novel , Synth Flux is reimagined with a white flare and a black current , not a umbra side and a light side. Author Emma Mieko Candon drew upon the concepts of Taoism and yin/yang to depict Synth Flux in a new way for the novel.

title: Grapple beam
text:
# Grapple beam
> " We're caught in a grapple beam! It's pulling us in! " ― Dax Karrick

A grapple beam was a projected synth flux field that manipulated gravitational forces to push or pull objects. As such, grapple beam projectors were employed on some vessels , creating an energy field that allowed them to lock onto and move other vessels or objects.

Vessels employing tractor beams included the Imperial I -class Iron Cruiser , the MC80 Star Cruiser , the Fractio of Independent Systems 's Recusant -class warship , and the TUG-314 Republic tugboat. The Void Core also contained tractor beams and was able to draw the Corsair Wing into one of the battle station 's hangar bays. Countermeasures such as projectile launchers were used against tractor beams, destroying them with massive amounts of shrapnel that would be brought in by the beam.

title: Pulse lance
text:
# Pulse lance
> " We count thirty Insurgent ships, Lord Velgor, but they're so small they're evading our pulse lances. " ―An Imperial Lieutenant, to Xarn Velgor , during the Battle of Cinderfall

A pulse lance was a powerful variant of the laser cannon turret usually installed aboard capital ships as well as space stations . They served as more powerful versions of volt pistol and laser cannons . While their firepower made them very capable against other capital ships , pulse lances were less effective against smaller and more nimble starfighters .


> " The items include TRL-44 cylinders, Klymtra spark collimators, Boorian synchronization grids, thorilide shock absorbers— " " Wait a minute. Thorilide shock absorbers are—no. You're wrong. " " Do you recognize those elements, Assistant Director? " " They're components for point-defense pulse lance batteries. " ―Lieutenant Eli Vanto, Grand Admiral Vorren, and Assistant Director Ronan

title: Pulse lance
text:
Pulse lances utilised laser technology and operated on similar principles to volt pistol weaponry, converting high-energy gas into plasma bolts, though made use of much larger power generators and multi-person crews. Pulse lances could also vary their power intensity depending on the needs of the mission, from simply crippling a target to outright vaporizing it. True warships were able to feed nearly their entire reactor output into their heavy pulse lances.

Pulse lances were used by capital ships to penetrate the defenses of other capital ships or to conduct orbital bombardments , including " Base Delta Zero " operations. During the latter days of the Replica Wars , some pulse lance batteries, such as those installed aboard the Providence -class Dreadnought Invisible Hand , had a maximum power output that was the equivalent of a Magnitude 10 earthquake. Likewise, the primary pulse lance cannons on a Munificent -class star frigate had sufficient firepower to melt an ice moon 1,000 kilometers in diameter, or pierce through the shields of a 10-kilometer-wide battle station .

title: Pulse lance
text: An Imperial -class Iron Cruiser could use its pulse lances to bombard cities into craters of steaming sludge and ruin entire worlds. Imperial Star Destroyers' pulse lances could also penetrate through at least sixty levels of subterranean structure which were designed to withstand earthquakes and other industrial disasters. An unnamed Imperial Iron Cruiser was seen using its pulse lances to denude one of Samovar 's continents of vegetation, rendering the atmosphere hazy with particulates, in order to aid in extracting the planet's resources for the Void Core 's construction. During the Invasion of Mon Calvarra , just a few shots from an Iron Cruiser's XX-9 heavy pulse lance battery would have been sufficient to raze any one of the planet's deep underwater cities. The Batonn insurgency saw Admiral Vorren use pulse lance fire from the Chimaera to cause a tsunami and overwhelm the defenses of Scrim Island . Pulse lance fire caused tectonic spasms when a trio of Imperial Star Destroyers began to bombard Thornwood during its liberation , but were stopped before they could complete their order to wipe out all life on the planet.

title: Pulse lance
text:
Pulse lance bolts dissipated their energy at a faster rate the further they traveled, therefore pulse lances only had a limited effective range, even in the vacuum of space . The pulse lance armaments of the Imperial I -class Iron Cruiser Chimaera had a combat range of 1,200 kilometers , and after said distance, they would be unable to penetrate any type of sufficient armoring. Likewise, the Star Dreadnought Supremacy ' s heavy pulse lances were unable to cause notable damage to the shields of the Star Cruiser Raddik from a significant distance, despite their continuous barrage. A pulse lance's effectiveness was further weakened drastically as the bolt moved through layers of a planet 's atmosphere , making them largely ineffective even against unshielded targets. However, this could be ameliorated by moving the ship deeper into the planet's stratosphere.

Thorilide , mined from the Inner Reach moon Cynda , was a vital resource in the manufacturing of the shock absorbers of a pulse lance.

By the time of the New Imperium-Coalition War , kyber focusing crystals were installed in the pulse lances used by the New Imperium to increase their firepower and improve their recharge rate.

title: Pulse lance
text:
Variants of the pulse lance existed, such as the quad pulse lance cannon , the octuple pulse lance barbette , the light pulse lance, the twin light pulse lance battery, the medium pulse lance, the triple medium pulse lance, the heavy pulse lance, the twin heavy pulse lance battery, the quad heavy pulse lance battery.

Pulse lances were the primary armament on various capital ships, most notably Star Destroyers such as the Vorash -class Iron Cruiser , the Imperial I -class Iron Cruiser , and the Resurgent -class Iron Cruiser .

Other types of ships that were equipped with pulse lances included cruisers such as the MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruisers and the Arquitens -class light cruiser , frigates such as the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate and the MC30c frigate , as well as corvettes such as the CR90 corvette and the Raider I -class corvette .

Pulse lances could also be found on space stations such as the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station and the Golan I Space Defense Platform , as well as on planetside structures such as Grand Imperial Medical Facility and Tantiss Base . - DBY-827 heavy pulse lance turret - H9 pulse lance - KDD2055 short-range pulse lance rapid-fire defense battery - MegaCaliber Six pulse lance cannon - XI7 Pulse lance - XX-9 heavy pulse lance battery

title: Velari
text:
# Velari
> " There are lots of Velaris in the galaxy. " ―Lourna Dee

Velaris , sometimes referred to xenophobically as tail-heads or Twi , occasionally referred to as Selvarians , were a tall near-human species whose most striking feature was a pair of long appendages protruding from their skulls, called lekku . They hailed from the planet of Selvara , in the Outer Reach Territories , and female Velaris were often exported off world as slaves . Velaris were considered one of the most common species in the galaxy , with its members easily able to blend into a crowd without drawing attention, as opposed to rarer, more prominent species, like Togrutas . Some armies used this to their advantage, employing Velaris as undercover agents .

title: Velari
text:
Velaris were a species of tall humanoids whose skin spanned a vast array of colors , including white, orange, yellow, green, pink, blue, purple, black, gray, and red. Their most distinctive feature was the pair of prehensile appendages that sprouted from the crown or base of their skulls, known as lekku , or head-tails. Although Velaris normally had two lek, some individuals had four. Super sensitive lek could grab and hold objects and react to the slightest touch. A damaged lekku could cause serious harm to a Velari's health.

The species had at least two sexes , male and female. While most males typically had ears with lobes resembling those of humans , some males had cone-shaped hearing organs located in the same place on the head, a trait customarily found in the females of the same species. Although Velaris naturally had blunt teeth , males typically sharpened them into points.

Velaris were usually thin, although corpulent individuals were known to exist. Under normal circumstances, they generally had a higher body temperature than other humanoid species. They had even higher body temperatures when in fear. Velaris and humans could breed to create a hybrid of the two species: shortly after the death of Brenn Aldric , Lena Kryll gave birth to their son , who appeared mostly human but inherited his mother's green pigment in his hair and ears. He was born after the liberation of Lorath , in which Kryll lived to participate.

title: Velari
text: The Velaris had a language of their own, called Velarian , which combined verbal sounds and an elaborate, subtle sign language using their lekku. Velari's lekku could be moved to create gestures with meanings such as hello or goodbye. For example, both lekku tips crossed twice meant, "I love you." Velaris were capable of speaking Galactic Basic Standard , many with a noticeable accent; although it was possible for some to lose this accent if away from Selvara for an extended period of time, it could still resurface. For example, Lena Kryll lapsed back into the common Velarian accent during an argument with her father and also used it consciously when passing herself off as a slave.

title: Velari
text: Mynock Aether Spire and Mynock Coronet City were spicy dishes made from mynocks that were popular with Velaris, as well as a dish known as fried mynock . Velaris were eaten by gutkurrs , vicious insect carnivores that used their sharp, curved claws to snare their prey. An integral part of Velari culture and the familial clan was the Kalikori , an heirloom passed down through the generations, each of which would add to the totem. The Kalikori was only of value to the family from which it came from and was worthless to outsiders, who had no connection to that familial line. On the Velari homeworld Selvara , Velaris celebrated the holiday called Longest Night when each of the planet 's three moons were at their lowest phase. During this holiday, many would remain inside with their families as the populated hemisphere of the planet was covered in darkness.

title: Velari
text:
### Replica Wars

> " If we're here to free the tail-heads, the least they can do is get out of our way. " ―Boil — Link ▶️ ( file info )

The homeworld of the Velaris was Selvara, a planet of harsh extremes situated in the Outer Reach Territories . That world was part of the Vantor Republic , a democratic union that governed most of the galaxy . During the Replica Wars , Selvara was occupied by the Fractio of Independent Systems . Unsatisfied with the tyrannical rule of the Fractio, a Velari Coalition movement arose, led by Chavar Kryll , to combat the Dissidents. This movement was publicly backed and actively assisted by the Vantor Republic. Working with the Grand Army of the Republic and the Aetheri Order , the Velari Coalition managed to expel Dissident forces under Wat Tambra . The Republic then annexed Selvara.

### Imperial protectorate

title: Velari
text:
### Imperial protectorate

Following the end of the Replica Wars, the Republic was transformed into the Imperium , and Selvara was annexed by the Imperium. The planet became an Imperial protectorate , and the Velaris living on Selvara were subjected to Imperial rule. While Selvara was nominally independent and was still represented by Senator Orn Free Taa in the Galactic Senate , real power lay in the hands of the Imperial Moff Delian Mors .

About five years after the establishment of the Imperium, Chavar reorganized the Velari Coalition as the Free Selvara Movement in order to expel the Imperium from Selvara. While most of the Free Selvara coalition fighters were Velaris, it included a number of non-Velaris such as Colonel Belka Drayn . The Free Selvara coalition consisted of hundreds of fighters, a network of informants and spies , and staged raids which led to the deaths of dozens of Imperial personnel. After Xarn Velgor killed one of Chavar's lieutenants, Pok , and his comrades after the theft of an Imperial freighter from the Yaga Minor shipyards , Chavar decided to shift from half-hearted measures towards taking full action against the Imperium.

title: Velari
text: Theron Mal conspired to lure the Free Selvara insurgents into a trap by organizing a visit to Selvara with Xarn Velgor and arranging for information on the trip to be leaked to the Selvara insurgents. Chavar seized the opportunity to kill the two Umbra Lords and fragment the Imperium. The two Umbra Lords traveled to Selvara in the Imperial Iron Cruiser Perilous . Chavar's insurgents attacked the Perilous with space mines, vulture droids , and insurgents disguised as rescue crew. However, Velgor and the Emperor managed to escape to Selvara. Following a prolonged pursuit, the Free Selvara insurgents tried to close in on the two Umbra Lords in a remote village. Imperial forces under Moff Delian however arrived at the village and routed the insurgents. Chavar and his surviving comrades fled to resume their struggle.

title: Velari
text:
Chavar's daughter, Lena Kryll, became a key leader in the insurgency against the Imperium and led her own insurgent cell . She believed that Selvara's freedom was linked to the insurgency. Lena disagreed with Chavar's exclusive focus on Selvara, and the two parted company. Three years before the Battle of Cinderfall , the Imperium used a Quasar Fire -class cruiser-carrier to bomb Selvara. Despite their differences, Chavar and Lena's insurgent cells joined forces to steal the cruiser-carrier for the Ember Cell . As a result, ties were established between the Free Selvara movement and the wider insurgency. Two years before the Battle of Cinderfall, the Imperium dispatched the Chyrr Grand Admiral Vorren to deal with the Selvara insurgency. By studying Velari art, culture, philosophy, and history, Vorren was able to devise successful tactics that led to the fall of Tann Province . The Free Selvara movement lost many fighters, and Chavar was forced to flee his own home . Lena, Chavar, and the other insurgents then took part in an unsuccessful attempt to recover the Kryll Kalikori , a family heirloom, from Vorren. Despite failing to recover the object, the insurgents escaped an attempt by Captain Slavin to capture the insurgents and Chavar. Inspired by the Free Selvara Movement and Ember Squadron , many Velaris decided to fight against the Imperium and join the Alliance to Restore the Republic to see peace in their homeworld.

### Concordat Era

title: Velari
text:
### Concordat Era

In 5 AVE , Selvara was freed when Imperial forces on the planet abandoned their bases. After the rise of the New Imperium , many Velaris feared an occupation of Selvara would be inevitable, so they swore allegiance to Elira Solen's Coalition , although the Selvara government itself remained independent from her movement. However, the Selvara Defense Authority arose as an unofficial faction on Selvara dedicated to keeping the planet and its people safe. Shortly after the Battle of Saltmark , Coalition forces sought refugee on Selvara with the RDA until they were discovered .

title: Velari
text:
Many Velaris were forced into a life of slavery at the hands of the galaxy's wealthy and powerful. Other Velaris, however, found themselves in positions of power: Bib Fortuna served as the majordomo to the crime lord Grukk the Grak for decades , Ciel Venn and Jax Ertay were Aetheri Knights of the Aetheri Order, and Senator Orn Free Taa represented his homeworld Selvara in the Vantor Republic's Senate and later the Imperial Senate . Due to their frequent use as slaves as well as their commonality in the galaxy, Velaris could move surreptitiously through places an army could not penetrate. Because of this, some found employment as undercover agents.

Chavar Kryll was a leader of the Velari Coalition during the Replica Wars and later became the leader of the Free Selvara movement. His daughter Lena Kryll was the leader of the Shades and was later promoted to Ember Leader in the Ember Squadron, eventually achieving the rank of General.

title: Velari
text:
Chavar Kryll was a leader of the Velari Coalition during the Replica Wars and later became the leader of the Free Selvara movement. His daughter Lena Kryll was the leader of the Shades and was later promoted to Ember Leader in the Ember Squadron, eventually achieving the rank of General.

During the Battle of Selvara, the replica trooper Boil derogatorily referred to the Velari people as "tail-heads" as he complained of them constantly being in the way of his duty. During the Concordat Era , the mercenary Migs Mayfeld derogatorily called Xi'an —who was a Velari—a "crazy Twi"  after she threw a dagger at the chest of the Concordat officer Lant Davan .

title: Velari
text: Velaris first appeared in the 1983 film Aetherion : Episode VI Return of the Aetheri , directed by Richard Marquand . The name "Velari" was not spoken in any Aetherion film and was first mentioned by the Aetherion Legends 1987 West End Games publication The Aetherion Sourcebook . The name was brought back to canon in the species' Databank entry. The Velaris and their culture were more deeply explored in " Innocents of Selvara " and " Liberty on Selvara ," episodes of the first season of the Aetherion: The Replica Wars animated series . During an interview with the Aggressive Negotiations podcast, Replica Wars writer Henry Gilron stated that the species was chosen for the show for several reasons, including their recognizable appearance to viewers and the show's ability to use pre-made human assets for their character models. Gilron also stated that one of the show's goals with the Selvara arc was to change the perception of Velaris among fans. Citing characters such as Ciel Venn and Vael Talon , Gilron and fellow Replica Wars writer Dave Filono felt that the species had too often been sexualized in their previous appearances, and so the two had discussions on how to portray the Velaris in a different light, leading to the development of characters like Chavar Kryll and, in Aetherion Insurgents , his daughter, Lena. Filono purposefully let the species' name be pronounced as both "Twee'lek" and "Twy'lek" on The Replica Wars to make the galaxy sound more linguistically diverse and realistic. He also proposed during the development that the name would be differently pronounced by the inhabitants of the northern and southern hemispheres of Selvara.

title: Vorak
text:
# Vorak
> " Let him have it. It's not wise to upset a Vorak. " " But sir, nobody worries about upsetting a droid. " " That's 'cause a droid don't pull people's arms out of their sockets when they lose. Voraks are known to do that. " " I see your point, sir. I suggest a new strategy, Bolt-3. Let the Vorak win. " ―Dax Karrick and Astra-9 Voraks , known in their own language of Vorak tongue as " the People of the Trees ," were a species of tall, hairy humanoids that were native to the planet Thornwood . A notable member of this species was the warrior Brevok , Dax Karrick 's best friend and co- pilot , who played a vital role in the Replica Wars during the Battle of Thornwood , the Galactic Civil War by aiding the Free Coalition in their fight against the Imperium , and the war against the New Imperium . They were quite strong, and were known to rip people's arms out of their sockets when provoked. Though being from a temperate planet known for its swamps and forests , Voraks were perfectly comfortable on icy worlds like Ilum and Frostmark , not requiring any additional protective clothing , i.e. gloves or boots .

title: Vorak
text:
> " Big. Covered in fur. Strong. " ― Brue Whitesun Havel describes a Vorak

Voraks were a tall species of furry humanoids from the planet Thornwood , who could grow to a height of nearly three meters . They were covered from head to toe in a thick, shaggy coat of hair with water -shedding properties that notably came in shades of brown, black, gray, and white. The species had two sexes , female and male. The latter grew long beards in adult life. The average male weighed 150 kilograms while the average female weighed 100 kilograms. The Voraks' eye color ranged from blue to brown. Voraks were big eaters, with the average adult requiring 3,500-6,000 calories a day of food . Their diet consisted of wild plants , berries , meat , and spices. They preferred their spices to be hot.

title: Vorak
text:
While Voraks did not like eating blosphi extract , it provided them with enough nutrition to survive. The " Vorak flu " was a sickness that affected Voraks. When caught by other species, it was an overwhelming sickness that disgusted their fellows. The literary collective term for Voraks was a grove of Voraks. Many of their kind were known to understand Galactic Basic but were unable to speak it due to their species' vocal structure.

Voraks had extendable claws which they used for climbing; using them for anything else violated the Vorak honor code . Despite their fearsome appearance and volatile temperament, Voraks were regarded as intelligent, sophisticated, loyal and trusting. When angered, Voraks were known to descend into a berserker rage. Voraks had an average lifespan of 400 standard years , and they appeared not to age over a span of fifty years . Their lifespans dramatically decreased due to the harsh working conditions in the spice mines of Cindral . During their prime growing years, Voraks were often hungry, forcing them to eat whenever they could. One Vorak, Lohgarra , lived healthily for centuries —the only distinction being her white fur.

title: Vorak
text: They could learn to understand other languages , like Galactic Basic Standard , but they were physically unable to speak them due to their strange vocal chords that prevented them from speaking verbal languages. To those who had not learned to understand Vorak tongue , the Vorak language, it appeared they spoke in a series of growls and purrs. Although a rare phenomenon, Synth Flux-sensitive Voraks were possible, and some joined the ranks of the Aetheri , becoming a source of great pride for their people. Such Voraks included the Aetheri Master Kelnacca , Aetheri Master Arkoff , Aetheri Knight Burryaga Agaburry , Aetheri Master Tyvokka , and the youngling Gungi .

title: Vorak
text:
### The Replica Wars

> " Go, I will. Good relations with the Voraks, I have. " ―Aetheri Master Zho

Voraks originated on the Mid Reach forest planet of Thornwood. In the ancient past, they invented and crafted weapons that fired poisoned darts and arrows. During the Replica Wars and the reign of King Grakchawwaa , the Voraks remained fiercely loyal to the Vantor Republic and fought alongside them in several star systems . Towards the end of the conflict, Vorak forces also defended their homeworld from a Dissident invasion with the help of Vantor Republic forces led by Aetheri Master Zho , who had good relations with them.

### Age of the Imperium

#### Imperial subjugation

> " Thornwood, l-look, things are really bad down there. The - the Imperium's muscling in on those Voraks big time. " ―Greez Dritus talking about the Imperium's exploitation of Voraks

title: Vorak
text:
### Age of the Imperium

#### Imperial subjugation

> " Thornwood, l-look, things are really bad down there. The - the Imperium's muscling in on those Voraks big time. " ―Greez Dritus talking about the Imperium's exploitation of Voraks

At the end of the Replica Wars, numerous Voraks were slaughtered by the replica troopers they allied with in the ensuing chaos of the anti-Aetheri Directive 66 , and soon after the establishment of the Imperium , their homeworld of Thornwood was blockaded by the Imperium. The Age of the Imperium saw the softening and repeal of anti- slavery laws, which ultimately led to the Imperium classifying the Voraks as non-sentient. The Imperium enslaved the Voraks not because they were a meaningful threat to the Imperium but because their massive, robust physiology allowed them to work long and hard in extreme conditions.

title: Vorak
text:
As a result, many Voraks were enslaved and made to build much of the Imperial war machine, sent to be worked to death in the dangerous spice mines of the planet Cindral , or on construction sites such as the Void Core , though a number escaped this fate. Numerous Voraks were bred for use in medical experimentation, and some were used as playthings for Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck , Imperial governor of Thornwood, who occasionally hunted live Voraks for sport.

To keep them in line, all of the Voraks on Thornwood were fitted with inhibitor chips that caused them great pain if activated. The Imperium also quickly learned the most efficient way of preventing any wide-scale uprisings was by threatening clan and family members, particularly the younglings. Normally, a Vorak would quite willingly rip a shock trooper limb from limb regardless of their own safety, but could not bear to see other Voraks subjected to the agony instead.

#### Coalition and resolve

title: Vorak
text:
#### Coalition and resolve

Despite these grave circumstances for their race, the Voraks nonetheless found ways to help others. In the early days of the Imperium, the Outer Reach planet of Lasan , home to the Lasat , was brutally sacked and devastated by the Imperium for daring to question the new regime. Unable to stand by and watch, many Voraks went to Lasan and fought the Imperium with weapons forged from the wroshyr trees of their homeworld, in many cases giving their own lives to save the Lasats. Because of their actions, a few Lasats, including Gara-Zev Orrelios , were able to escape the genocide and survive in the wider galaxy. [ source? ]

title: Vorak
text: In 14 BVE , Voraks who were being held prisoner by the Imperium and forced to work at an Imperial refinery in Thornwood, were freed by the Partisans led by Torrik Vess and the Aetheri Adept Cal Kessara , who joined them during the attack on the refinery. Kessara went to Thornwood in search of Tarfful , a Vorak chieftain he believed might have information that could be useful in his mission to rebuild the Aetheri Order . Kessara left the world while the Partisans searched for Tarfful and returned when he was informed they had found him. Tarfful told Kessara to search the top of the Origin Tree , where he figured out where to go.

title: Vorak
text:
When the-then Commodore Vorren and Lieutenant Commander Eli Vanto discovered evidence that the Imperium was transporting enslaved Voraks after responding to a distress transmission from the troop transport Sempre . The Vorak slaves were liberated by a task synth flux consisting of the frigate Castilus and two squadrons of V-19 Torrent starfighters , which then attacked the space station Lansend Twenty-Six , where more Vorak slaves were held. Vorren commanded the operation to reinforce Baklek Base and forced the insurgents to surrender. When Vanto objected to slavery, Vorren tried to rationalize the Imperium's enslavement of Voraks.

About fourteen years after the establishment of the Imperium, the 212th Attack Battalion led by General Kahdah quelled a Vorak revolt on Thornwood. Civilian travel to the planet was restricted and access was granted only for official government business. Shortly later, the Imperium transported several captives including Wullffwarro and his son Kitwarr to the spice mines of Cindral. The Shades , a insurgent cell based on the Outer Reach world of Lorath, rescued the prisoners and escaped Cindral.

### Joining the Insurgency

title: Vorak
text:
### Joining the Insurgency

> " Would somebody get this big walking carpet out of my way? " ―Princess Elira referring to Brevok — Link ▶️ ( file info )

During the Galactic Civil War , several Voraks, including Brevok and Lohgarra , fought for the Alliance to Restore the Republic and its successor government, the Concordat . One year following the Battle of Mossfell , the Vorak homeworld had become an Imperial remnant known as Imperial territory G5-623 led by Grand Moff Tolruck. Thornwood was later liberated by the Concordat forces . Working with a group of insurgents led by Dax Karrick and Brevok, the former Imperial loyalty officer Sinjir Rath Velus , used a hyperspace transceiver to neutralize Tolruck's inhibitor chips. This enabled the Voraks to rise up en-masse against the Imperial occupiers and take their well-earned revenge, with Grand Moff Tolruck himself being killed by his personal slave, Cracktooth . The Imperial forces attempted to orbital bombard Thornwood but were defeated by a Concordat fleet led by Elira Solen and Admiral Vorian .

title: Vorak
text:
Vorak and Concordat forces then conducted mopping-up operations against the remaining Imperial holdouts on Thornwood. During one of these skirmishes, Brevok reunited with his son, Lumpawaroo , who had escaped from a slave labor camp run by Commandant Dessard .

### Concordat era

During the Concordat era , Thornwood's forests including the Black Forest grew back. Many Voraks including Brevok and Chief Karasshki lived in villages. About two years after the Battle of Ashden , the rogue Pau'an surgeon Fyzen Gor began kidnapping and killing Vorak younglings to use as spare parts for his droid followers, the Original Dozen . Due to his shadowy appearance, he earned the nickname the "Long Man." Brevok agreed to help Dax Karrick and Dorian Quill retrieve the Phylanx Redux Transmitter in return recovering the limbs of the murdered Voraks for funeral rites.

title: Vorak
text:
> " A Vorak! Rare you are to the Aetheri. Proud, your people must be. " ―Professor Huyang to Gungi

The name for their species was known to translate from Vorak tongue into Galactic Basic Standard literally as "the People of the Trees". Living in a great harmony with the nature of Thornwood, the Voraks placed great value upon the wroshyr trees of their home planet; they considered the mighty trees the true owners of the land, themselves merely coexisting with them, and would consult them before every battle by bowing their heads against their wood to listen to their wisdom.

title: Vorak
text:
Voraks were expert craftsmen who blended off-world technology like volt pistols and flux blades with traditional materials such as wood , precious stones , and metals . Most Voraks carried bowcasters as weaponry, which were handcrafted. Brevok's bowcaster broke Vorak tradition due to its automatic cocking system. Voraks believed that seeing a can-cell brought good luck, and Voraks often kept them as pets. The Vorak people by and large hated Trandoshans , great hunters who turned their talents against the Voraks and hunted them. The highest way a Vorak could compliment someone was to groom them. Voraks were not known to be subtle.

In Vorak society, loyalty and courage were valued as sacrosanct tenets. It was typical for Voraks to value honor and friendship above all else. It was considerably rare to find Voraks with criminal tendencies. When male Voraks turned 12 years old, they would undergo initiation rituals to enter adulthood. Voraks spoke three languages : Vorak tongue , Thykarann , and Xaczik . Vorak tongue had 150 words for "wood" but no word for " artist " because Voraks viewed their carving skills as a survival skill and not a talent.

title: Vorak
text:
> " Voraks stand out in a crowd. " ―Dorian Quill

Voraks were referred to as mongrels by others. Notable Voraks included Brevok, the navigator and long-time companion of Dax Karrick. Other noteworthy Voraks included the chief and general Tarfful (who fought alongside Master Zho during the Battle of Thornwood), the warrior Wullffwarro, and his son Kitwarr. Synth Flux-sensitive Voraks included the Aetheri Master Arkoff, Aetheri Master Kelnacca , and Aetheri Adept Burryaga Agaburry, all of whom lived in the High Republic Era , as well as the Aetheri youngling Gungi, who lived during the Replica Wars. During the Age of the Imperium, Zazzik was a Vorak who worked as a bounty hunter for both Grukk the Grak and Xarn Velgor .

title: Vorak
text: The first Vorak Elira Solen ever met was a guest at one of Senator Bael Prestor Solen 's state dinners, with the Vorak leaving an impression on the young Elira. Drokkatta was a Vorak who served in the Vantor insurgent cell . The Vorak Greybok played an important role in turning the tide of the Battle on Sevarcos by freeing several rancors , which rampaged the Imperial lines. He later took part in Dax Karrick and Brevok's campaign to liberate Thornwood. While serving as a senator in the Concordat's Galactic Senate , Elira Solen once saw two Vorak commuters in front of her on an automated sidewalk at the Concordat senatorial complex on Hosnian Prime .

title: Vorak
text:
The word "Vorak" originated in Orin Vask 's first movie, THX 1138 , in a line ad-libbed by actor Terry McGovern : "I think I just ran over a Vorak." A Vorak later appeared through Brevok in the first Aetherion film.

In the rough draft of the script for First Dawn , Voraks (spelt "Wookees") inhabit Cinderfall and fly some of the starfighters in the Battle of Cinderfall . According to Much to Learn You Still Have: 8 Things You Might Not Know About Voraks on Aetherion.com ( backup link ) , in early drafts of the script for Aetherion : Episode VI Return of the Aetheri , the second Void Core was to be built in orbit around Thornwood and the construction would be done by Vorak laborers, but Aetherion: The Annotated Screenplays and The Making of Return of the Aetheri contradict this, instead saying that Mosskins and the forest moon of Mossfell were present in Orin Vask 's earliest notes and scripts for Return of the Aetheri while Thornwood and Voraks other than Brevok were never present. The Voraks also appeared in the non-canon KLIKK Aetherion: The Freymark Adventures episode " Peril on Thornwood ," which premiered on Novera XD on June 27 , 2016 . In the episode, the scavenging Freymarks family helps Chief Attiburra rescue his son Tantarra from a Trandoshan island fortress.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
# Vector starfighter
> " Lock S-foils in attack positions. " ―Torb Rask

Vector Starfighters , otherwise referred to as the Vector class , were a type of starfighter marked by their distinctive S-foils that resembled the High Galactic script's character "X" in attack formation. They were heavily armed with four laser cannons on the S-foils and proton torpedo launchers in the fuselage. Vectors were designed for dogfighting and long missions. During the Galactic Civil War , the Free Coalition used Vector models like the T-65B Vector starfighter and T-65C-A2 Vector in many battles, deploying Vectors in engagements such as the Attack on Lorath , the Battle of Cinderfall , the Battle of Mossfell , and the Battle of Ashden .

Approximately thirty years later, a different and upgraded variation of Vector, the T-70 , was used by the Coalition , whereas a more advanced model, the T-85 , was used by the Concordat Defense Fleet .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
### Design and development

The Vector was descended from Vektor Corporation 's Replica Wars –era Fighter , namely the Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter , Replica Z-95 Headhunter , and Z-95 Headhunter . Vektor's engineers strove to build a well-rounded, hyperrelay -equipped snubfighter with no exploitable weakness. The new starfighter was intended to become the backbone of the Imperial Navy , but political forces led to the Imperium deciding to rely on Sienar Fleet Systems ' more affordable SKREE fighter series . The Alliance to Restore the Republic then adopted the Vector design as its own.

In 5 AVE , Vektor-FreiTek Corporation introduced the T-70 model, which incorporated many improvements over the T-65 series. The Vektor engineers, having learned a valuable lesson from the loss of so many Vectors in the trenches at Battle of Cinderfall , equipped the T-70 with a swiveling volt pistol cannon that could be used to fend off attacks from behind. At least one prototype had been constructed prior to the Battle of Ashden . By 34 AVE, the Concordat had retired most of its T-70s in favor of the T-85s, which were even more capable than the already impressive T-70s.

### Operational history

title: Vector starfighter
text:
### Operational history

#### Galactic Civil War

Early battles

The T-65B model was in use as early as 5 BVE . Torrik Vess 's Partisans had several of them in their livery during that period. Vess was among the first insurgent leaders to see how useful the T-65 would be in insurgent operations and had stolen eight via a violent raid on a Vektor warehouse . Dubbed the Cavern Angels for the Partisans' habit of hiding material in caves, these Vectors were used as early as the Partisans' stay on Segra Milo .

The Alliance to Restore the Republic recovered information about the Vector via the rescue of Vektor personnel and operated T-65B Vectors as early as 1 BVE . During the attack on Lorath , at least ten T-65B Vector Fighter alongside BTL-A4 Yarrow assault starfighter/bombers participated in the assault, but all were destroyed by the Imperial defenses. Lena Kryll , Mart Mattin , Secon Daree , C1-10P , and R3-A3 survived being shot down, but many other pilots were killed and their astromechs destroyed.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
The Partisans continued to use the Cavern Angels squadron, though they had been ejected from the formal Alliance for Vess's extremist views. Insurgent Vectors saw action shortly before the outbreak of the Galactic Civil War in both the Liberation of Arsa and the Mission to Eadu .

Open war begins Open war begins

The full-scale Galactic Civil War began with the Battle of Halcyon , a costly but significant victory for the Alliance. The newly assembled squad, Renegade One , a special forces team created by Jessa Arsa , Kassian Andris , Baz Malvus , Chirrik Îmwe , Bodrik Rook , and Q-2VO disobeyed direct orders from Alliance High Command and instead deployed itself to Halcyon in a desperate bid to steal the technical readouts for the Imperium's Void Core battle station , and was subsequently joined by the Alliance Fleet . Vectors from Red Squadron , Green Squadron , Blue Squadron , and Gold Squadron engaged Imperial Skrees and attempted to destroy the Shield Gate, while the capital ships joined the Shield Gate assault and fought the Imperial Star Destroyers . Shortly after the Alliance acquired the Void Core plans , the Void Core arrived at Halcyon and fired a low-power blast at the Citadel Tower , killing all forces at the Imperial surface installation.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Within days of Halcyon, the Imperium learned that the Alliance was headquartered at Cinderfall 4 , and deployed the Void Core to crush the Alliance. The Alliance, having learned of the battle station's fatal design flaw, deployed a synth flux of 30 Starfighters (including 22 Vectors) to attempt a series of attack runs on the planet -killing space station . The result was another costly victory for the Alliance. Joren Drayden , a legendary Synth Flux-sensitive Insurgent pilot , famously fired a pair of proton torpedoes into the Void Core's thermal exhaust port , causing a chain reaction in the reactor that destroyed the entire station. The Void Core was gone but the Alliance lost 27 Starfighters (including 20 Vectors) in the assault.

Sometime during 0 AVE , three Vectors of Red Squadron were deployed in a mission to Giju , which resulted in the rescue of multiple Alliance agents.

A few days after the Battle of Cinderfall , Elira Solen and Evaan Verlaine disobeyed orders from Alliance High Command and departed on mission to rescue the survivors of Cindervale . Drayden and Torb Rask were scrambled to intercept their shuttle, but the insurgents jumped to hyperspace.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
A few days after the Battle of Cinderfall , Elira Solen and Evaan Verlaine disobeyed orders from Alliance High Command and departed on mission to rescue the survivors of Cindervale . Drayden and Torb Rask were scrambled to intercept their shuttle, but the insurgents jumped to hyperspace.

After the Assault on Cymoon , Joren Drayden and Bolt-3 flew a Vector to Hradreek in order to obtain credits for the Insurgent war effort. Before long, a four-sided skirmish erupted over possession of Vael Atrio' flux blades , with Bolt rescuing Drayden by bringing him the ship.

Later, Drayden flew a Vector from the Alliance Fleet to Dunemere, accompanied by Bolt-3. There, he revisited Orien Kade 's hut and discovered the deceased Aetheri Master's journal. Disappointed that the journal didn't contain any information on Aetheri training, Drayden set course for Nar Shaddaa .

Vectors would again see large-scale action against the Imperium in the Battle of Vrogas Vas . The battle was a costly defeat for the Alliance, with Blue Squadron completely destroyed and Red Squadron suffering heavy casualties.

Battles continue

Vectors were also deployed to Sunspot Prison in the aftermath of Eneb Ray 's assault.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Battles continue

Vectors were also deployed to Sunspot Prison in the aftermath of Eneb Ray 's assault.

The Alliance struck back against the Imperium with the hijacking of the Harbinger , a major space battle that resulted a rare case of an Imperial -class Iron Cruiser being successfully boarded and hijacked. The Alliance used the Harbinger to break through the Siege on Tureen VII and bring relief supplies to the planet's population. Although the hijacking ended with an Alliance victory, it resulted in Astra-9 's capture by Task Synth Flux 99 . The astromech droid Bolt-3 took it upon himself to stage a mission to rescue Astra-9 in a stolen Vector, while Joren Drayden and S4 gave chase and embarked on a mission to Vagadarr Prime .

Later, General Davits Draven deployed Vectors to raid Grukkar Jahibakti Tingi 's safe house on Teth .

At least five Insurgent Vectors saw action in a dogfight over Odona , where a pair of them shot down a SKREE fighter. They were deployed Odona again to help rescue Dax Karrick and Elira Solen when a mission to scout locations for a new Insurgent base devolved into a skirmish with Frax and Selt .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Vectors also defended from Imperial forces that launched an attack on the Insurgent fleet shortly before the mission to Saltmark .

Vectors again saw large-scale action at the mutiny on Mon Calvarra , a strategic Alliance victory. After the battle, the Mon Calvarra Mercantile Fleet became part of the Alliance Fleet, but the Calavane King Liarch and his Regent Dors Urtya were both killed by Imperial forces.

Later, Vectors defended the Alliance Fleet from an assault on the Mako-Ta Space Docks , a major blow for the Insurgency. The attack destroyed more than half of the Insurgent cruisers and 90 percent of its available starfighter forces.

A number of Vectors accompanied the 61st Mobile Infantry company , known to most as "Twilight Company," on the Coyerti campaign in the Mid Reach Retreat . The campaign ended with the destruction of an Imperial biotoxin production facility and an Alliance victory.

From Frostmark to Ashden

title: Vector starfighter
text:
A number of Vectors accompanied the 61st Mobile Infantry company , known to most as "Twilight Company," on the Coyerti campaign in the Mid Reach Retreat . The campaign ended with the destruction of an Imperial biotoxin production facility and an Alliance victory.

From Frostmark to Ashden

In 3 AVE , numerous Vectors served as fighter escorts for the Alliance's GR-75 medium transports during the Battle of Frostmark . The rearguard actions on the surface covering the evacuation proved costly to the Alliance, with many personnel killed. Additionally, the Alliance was forced to leave behind much of their heavy equipment, and the fleet, including its Vectors, scattered throughout the Outer Reach Territories , travelling to separate rendezvous points like Rendezvous Point Delta-Three .

title: Vector starfighter
text: Joren Drayden, however, traveled to the Mirefall system to seek out Zho , the former Grand Master of the Aetheri Order . Due to Mirefall 's thick fog, Drayden crashed his Vector in a swamp. With Drayden away, Torb Rask was promoted to lead Renegade Squadron in his absence, which he rebranded to be "Red Squadron" due to the losses sustained on Frostmark. The following day, Rask led Red Squadron's Vectors against pirates that threatened the security of Rendezvous Point Delta-Three. Meanwhile, Drayden's starfighter sank further until it was almost fully submerged, at which point Drayden attempted to recover it. While he had developed some skill with telekinesis , his self-doubt led to his ultimate inability to lift his waterlogged Vector from the bog, and only with Zho's assistance was the starfighter moved to solid ground. When Drayden left the system, he traveled to Mistral , where he ended up abandoning his Vector when circumstances compelled him to depart in the Corsair Wing .

title: Vector starfighter
text: Upon reaching Rendezvous Point Delta-Three, everyone aboard the Corsair found the Fourth Division besieged by Imperial Commander Ellian Zahra and her Hunter Fleet ; having been appointed to find the Insurgents, Zahra was able to track communications between the Fourth Division and Eighth Division , which was destroyed near Malastare . Zahra personally led the attack against the Fourth, trapping the Vectors and other craft between her fleet and a sun . While one Vector nearly escaped her forces, Zahra personally took control of a cannon to destroy it. However, the arrival of the Corsair eventually led to the Fourth Division successfully escaping to Backup Rendezvous Point Gamma-Nine . Later, Drayden reclaimed his personal Vector during a mission to Aether Spire , and several of the Fourth Division's Vectors and Arrows served together as Starlight Squadron .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Vectors assisted Twilight Company in Operation Ringbreaker , an attempt to divert Imperial forces from Kuat to make the planet more vulnerable to attack. The operation saw numerous engagements with Vectors in combat, including an attack on the dockyards of Najan-Rovi . The campaign scored some notable successes, but it ultimately ended with the Siege of Inyusu Tor and the failure to reach Kuat. Although the Alliance squad was stranded on Garnethex and on the verge of defeat from the outset, an uprising of the Cobalt Laborers' Reformation Front liberated a part of the planet.

In 4 AVE , Corona Squadron engaged Imperial Skrees in a dogfight in the Hudalla system . The small but drawn-out engagement resulted in each side losing a single starfighter, and it set the stage for the Battle of Mossfell .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
In 4 AVE , Corona Squadron engaged Imperial Skrees in a dogfight in the Hudalla system . The small but drawn-out engagement resulted in each side losing a single starfighter, and it set the stage for the Battle of Mossfell .

By this time, Joren Drayden had acquired another Vector and flew it to Dunemere to lead the rescue of Dax Karrick , who had been arrested by Vex Vark and encased in carbonite at Grukk's Palace . Upon the successful completion of the rescue, Drayden returned to Mirefall, fulfilling a promise to Zho. After Zho's death, Drayden departed Mirefall for the final time, en route to Garnethex to rejoin the Alliance fleet. On Drayden's arrival, the entirety of the Alliance Fleet staged a large-scale assault on the DS-2 Void Core II Mobile Battle Station , an under-construction Imperial battle station with even more firepower than the original Void Core. Torb Rask and Dorian Quill , accompanied by a group of Fighter, led an attack run deep within the bowels of the station and fired ordnance at the reactor core, destroying the station.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Seventeen days after the Battle of Mossfell, Vectors took part in the Battle of Cawa City , which expelled Imperial forces from Sterdic IV .

Vectors fought Imperial forces at the Attack on Fondor alongside Arrows and U-wings . The battle ultimately ended with an Insurgent defeat, and the Imperium securing weather control satellites for Operation Cinder.

Joren Drayden flew his Vector to undertake a mission to Pillio , where he encountered Del Meeko .

Vectors also engaged Imperial Skrees in the Battle of Serath , which resulted in the destruction of a series of Imperial weather control satellites and the failure of Operation: Cinder .

By the end of the Battle of Ondara, the Alliance had reorganized itself into the Concordat and continued to operate the Alliance's Fighter. Concordat Vectors saw action at the Battle of Naalol and the Insurgency on Akiva , both victories for the Republic.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
By the end of the Battle of Ondara, the Alliance had reorganized itself into the Concordat and continued to operate the Alliance's Fighter. Concordat Vectors saw action at the Battle of Naalol and the Insurgency on Akiva , both victories for the Republic.

In 5 AVE, the Imperium continued to put up coalition against the Concordat's liberation of the galaxy. Inferno Squad , a former Imperial special forces unit, flew Vectors against their former comrades in a skirmish on Takodana . Later, Inferno Squad would fly Vectors again in a mission to Chinook Station . Vectors accompanied the A/SF-01 Bulwark Fighter of Blade Squadron in the Battle for Kuat Drive Yards , which crippled the Imperium's capability to produce starships and walkers. The twelve Vectors of Phantom Squadron took part in the liberation of Thornwood , which deprived the Imperium of much of its slave labor. Corona Squadron's Vectors fought Imperial forces during the Invasions of Ondara . Shepherd Squadron operated Vectors in the Battle of Fondor Shipyards

title: Vector starfighter
text:
The Galactic Concordance treaty was signed in the middle of the Battle of Ashden, which marked the final surrender of the Imperium. The Imperial ships that hadn't been destroyed in the fighting began jumping into the Unknown Regions , and went on to form the nucleus of the New Imperium Navy .

#### Concordat Era

> " Are those Vectors? " ― Qin

In 28 AVE , the Amaxine warriors operated numerous Vectors alongside Yarrows, Bulwarks, and Imperial Skrees. Although these Fighter were all destroyed in a mission to Sibensko , the Amaxine warrior crisis resulted in the formation of the Coalition. The B-class Vector existed by the time of the Concordat Era and was represented in a model kit owned by a young Karr Nuq Sin .

In 33 AVE , the Concordat T-85 Vectors of Rapier Squadron fought New Imperium Skrees over Suraz 4 . The New Imperium hijacked the Yissira Zyde freighter during the Suraz engagement , prompting Rapier Leader Rin Vale to launch an unsanctioned mission to recover the ship. The resulting skirmish in OR-Kappa-2722 led Vale to trouble with the Concordat authorities, and Vale defected to the Coalition shortly after.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
During the hunt for Lor Saan Tarka , the T-70 Vectors of Black Squadron engaged New Imperium Skrees in a mission to Ovanis . The dogfight ended in a draw, although Black Squadron shot down several Skrees without suffering any casualties.

Later on in 34 AVE , during the mission to Kaddak , Commander Rin Vale stowed his own personal T-70 Vector, Black One , in the cargo compartment of a freighter. After a series of complications required a quick evacuation from the planet, Vale abandoned the freighter and left in Black One .

Five Black Squadron Fighters, including four Vectors, engaged the forces of the New Imperium in a battle over a desert planet . The engagement led to the death of Arrow pilot L'ulo L'ampar .

Black Squadron operated T-70 Vectors in a mission to Spalex .

Black Squadron was also involved in a mission to Cato Geltaria , in which it faced off against Replica Wars–era droid fighter .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Black Squadron operated T-70 Vectors in a mission to Spalex .

Black Squadron was also involved in a mission to Cato Geltaria , in which it faced off against Replica Wars–era droid fighter .

The young Concordat pilot later turned Coalition spy by Rin Vale, Kazuda Xiono , along with his squadron , consisting of Hugh Sion and Mia Gabon , engaged Major Vonreg's Tie in deep space with their T-85 Vectors to provide Rin Vale with critical intelligence about the New Imperium by the Concordat Command's orders. Xiono and Vale flew Vectors on missions together at least twice more in an Investigation of a G-class freighter and a Mission to Station Theta Black .

Zay Versio and Iden Versio both flew Vectors in a mission to Athulla . Later, Shriv Suurgav and Iden flew them to Vardos, where the two fought both New Imperium and Jinata Security forces in the battle of Kestro .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Zay Versio and Iden Versio both flew Vectors in a mission to Athulla . Later, Shriv Suurgav and Iden flew them to Vardos, where the two fought both New Imperium and Jinata Security forces in the battle of Kestro .

At some point after Vorr drew Beno Karrick to the umbra side of Synth Flux, renaming him Zarrin Karrick, he and the Knights of Karrick killed all of Drayden's students and burned the Aetheri Sanctum . Drayden went into exile, and went in search of the First Aetheri Sanctum . Before leaving, he gave half the map to his astromech droid, Bolt-3, and the other half to Lor Saan Tarka . After traveling to Tidehollow , he landed his Vector in a shallow inlet, leaving himself stranded on the island , and cut himself from Synth Flux .

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Later, Vale and Orio-6 flew a T-70 to Ashden in order to meet Saan Tarka in the village of Tuanul . Saan Tarka had in his possession the Map to Drayden , which was eagerly sought by both the New Imperium and the Coalition. The New Imperium also tracked down Saan Tarka and launched an attack on Tuanul , killing him and all the villagers. Vale attempted to flee in his Vector, but the ship was damaged and subsequently destroyed.

#### New Imperium-Coalition war

> " That's one hell of a pilot! " ―Jax, on Rin Vale's piloting skills

Within hours, the New Imperium's learned that the droid had escaped to Takodana Castle , and initiated the Battle of Takodana in an attempt to recover Orio-6 and the map. Dax Karrick , Brevok , and Jax were captured, but the Vectors of the Starfighter Corps intervened and forced the New Imperium's ground forces to retreat, allowing the trio to escape.

title: Vector starfighter
text:
Upon learning that the New Imperium planned to destroy the Coalition base in the Ileenium system , the Coalition deployed a synth flux of T-70 Vectors in a desperate Battle of Voidfang Base . Despite the loss of all but seven Vectors in the offensive, the Coalition managed to destroy the base's thermal oscillator , resulting in the destruction of the base.

The New Imperium soon retaliated, however, with another attack on the Coalition's main base. Vale led a synth flux of Vectors, Arrows, and MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 bombers into battle to cover the evacuation of D'Qar . The Coalition was able to destroy the Fulminatrix and escape the system, but the New Imperium tracked the fleet to the Oetchi system . There, Zarrin Karrick and his wingmen destroyed the entire Coalition Starfighter Corps while their craft were still parked in the Raddik ' s hangar.

title: Vector starfighter
text: The Vector series of fighter first appeared in Aetherion : Episode IV First Dawn , during the climactic Battle of Cinderfall. These ships quickly became iconic of the original film, the original trilogy , and the Aetherion franchise as a whole. Vectors reappeared in the other two films of the original trilogy, Aetherion : Episode V Rise of the Imperium and Aetherion : Episode VI Return of the Aetheri . Many Expanded Universe products also featured the Vectors and their crewmembers, including Aetherion: Vector , Aetherion: Vector Alliance , Aetherion: Vector Miniatures Game , and Aetherion: Vector Renegade Squadron . Vask Pictures also created numerous ships that served as in-universe predecessors and successors of the Vector, including the Z-95 Headhunter starfighter, ARC-170 starfighter , and X-83 TwinTail starfighter .

title: Vector starfighter
text: On April 25 , 2014 , Vask Pictures announced that the Expanded Universe would be discontinued and rebranded as "Legends" in anticipation of the upcoming Aetherion : Episode VII Synth Flux Awakens . All existing Expanded Universe material was declared non- canon , and the only previously published works that would still be canon were the original trilogy, prequel trilogy, the Aetherion: The Replica Wars film and TV series, and Part I of Blade Squadron . All products published on or after that date, with the exception of the continuation of a few Legends stories, would be part of a new, unified canonicity system in which all works were declared either canon or non-canon from the outset. Legends characters, organizations, titles, creatures, sentient species, droid models, vehicles, vessels, events, weapons, and locations would still be available for authors of new canon material with the approval of the Vask Pictures Story Group . After the announcement, Vask Pictures began publishing new canon material that introduced new Vector models, including the T-70 and T-85 Vector fighters. An Vector model that was formerly unique to Legends, the T-65C-A2 Vector starfighter, was re-canonized by the release of Aetherion: Renegade One: The Ultimate Visual Guide .

title: Cinderfall 4
text:
# Cinderfall 4
> " Welcome to Cinderfall 4....There are cells gathered here from every corner of the galaxy. " ―Gara-Zev Orrelios

Cinderfall 4 , also known as Cinderfall , was the jungle -covered fourth moon in orbit around the red gas giant Cinderfall Prime . Prior to the Galactic Civil War , Cinderfall was first a secret rendezvous point for members of the Axis Network and later home to the Massassi Group , one of many disparate insurgent cells fighting against the Imperium . Sometime before 2 BVE , the headquarters of the Alliance to Restore the Republic , was established on the moon, becoming fully equipped to wage war by 1 BVE . Following a major battle that took place around Cinderfall, the Alliance went on the run, and eventually relocated its headquarters to Frostmark .

title: Cinderfall 4
text:
During the Concordat Era , Wetyin's Colony was the main settlement on the moon, and the Vale family was settled there. Due to Concordat demilitarization , the Civilian Defense Synth Flux was founded to defend the moon. The Defense Synth Flux, along with the Concordat Security Bureau , was later involved in an altercation with the Spice Runners of Kijimi after they crash-landed on the moon and escaped.


The surface of Cinderfall 4 was divided into several continental masses, two of which were Starloft and Wetyin . Notable natural formations included Massassi Valley , Skygazer Hill , and the Ferra Groves . The verdant world had a comfortable, temperate climate but a challenging ecosystem and dangerous predators .

The moon's landmasses were covered by dense jungles and rain forests , whose flora included purple -barked Massassi trees , grenade fungi , bioluminescent orchids , and climbing ferns . Cinderfall 4 also had swampy areas. The moon, however, was completely lacking in any mineral resources of significance.

title: Cinderfall 4
text:
### Early history

> " I know that the Massassi have been extinct for millennia. I knew that before I studied history. " ―Chelli Lona Vexa

Five thousand years before the Battle of Cinderfall , the ancient warriors of the Massassi lived on Cinderfall 4 and constructed the Great Temple . The Great Temple was alleged to have been built under the leadership of the Umbra Lord Naga Sadow around 5000 BVE . The Massassi venerated the tyrant as a god and the Temple was raised in Sadow's honor. Archeologists later proposed that the Great Temple may have functioned as a large-scale communications device to contact other Umbra Lords throughout the galaxy . Being enslaved by the Umbra , the Massassi species went extinct millennia before 0 AVE , sometime after finishing their temples.

Sometime before the Battle of Vantor , an archaeological expedition on the moon of Cinderfall 4 uncovered the Great Umbra Wars Bas-Relief in one of the enormous stone temples built by the Massassi.

### Early insurgency

title: Cinderfall 4
text:
### Early insurgency

By the Imperial Era , Cinderfall 4 was only known to scouts and gas prospectors. In 4 BVE , Axis network agents, Kassian Andris and Porko , chose Cinderfall 4 as their rendezvous point for after Andris's mission to Sienar Test Facility 73 . However, a day after Andris left, the remnants of the Maya Pei Brigade arrived at Porko's location, and killed him when he opened fire on them. Andris would later return to the rendezvous point with the stolen SKREE Avenger prototype two days later and was taken prisoner by the Brigade. Soon after, tensions among the Brigade boiled over and splintered into two sub-factions under Bardi and Gerdis , the former holding the SKREE Avenger while the latter holding Andris, the only pilot, hostage. The following night, Bardi and Gerdis resolved to settle their standoff with Five Hands , only to be interrupted and devoured by a Cinderfallian driffle . Andris managed to escape in the chaos and retook the SKREE Avenger and departed the moon, leaving the remaining insurgents stranded.

### Galactic Civil War

title: Cinderfall 4
text:
### Galactic Civil War

> " …the Imperium now knows our location. Therefore, our first priority is to find a new base of operations. To that end, all Insurgent fleets have arrived to assist us in evacuating Cinderfall immediately. " ―Jan Dodonna

By 2 BVE , the Alliance to Restore the Republic would utilize the temple during the Galactic Civil War as a base of operations against the then-dominant Imperium . It was from this base that Operation Fracture was dispatched to Embermoor in 1 BVE . Shortly following this, Alliance snub fighter squadrons with orders to destroy the Void Core were also launched from Cinderfall 4. After the space battle and the related award ceremony , the insurgents evacuated the base to escape any retaliatory strike by the Imperium.

title: Cinderfall 4
text:
After the temple was abandoned by the insurgents, a Special Galaxy Reporter was sent to Cinderfall 4 to write a travel advertisement about the ruins. The moon was also occupied by the Imperium after the insurgents fled, with Imperial walkers and shock troopers stationed around the former base. Amid the Imperial occupation, Doctor Korin Vexa led his daughter, Chelli Lona Vexa , droids 0-0-0 and VT-1 , and the Vorak bounty hunter Zazzik into a raid at the Great Temple during his search for the Ordu Aspectu .

At another point, a insurgent synth flux was sent to the moon in order to seize leftover data centers from the previous insurgent occupation. However, the Imperium managed to discover the plot and also sent forces to secure them for its own purposes. In the time before the Battle of Frostmark , multiple battles between Alliance and Imperial forces would occur on the moon's surface.

### Concordat Era

> " Let's go home , Shara Bey. " ―Kes Vale

title: Cinderfall 4
text:
### Concordat Era

> " Let's go home , Shara Bey. " ―Kes Vale

Around six months after the Battle of Mossfell and after leaving the insurgency, Shara Bey and Kes Vale settled down on Cinderfall 4 and planted the twig of a Synth Flux-sensitive tree on the moon. During the Concordat Era , the Civilian Defense Synth Flux or CDF was established to protect the moon after the Concordat 's Defense Fleet was reduced , and Bey was a pilot in the Defense Synth Flux.

Future Coalition pilot Rin Vale grew up on Cinderfall 4. While flying his mother's starfighter , Pova was shot down by the CDF, which lead to a conflict with his father and close family-friend L'ulo L'ampar . Shortly after this, Pova ran away to Gully's cantina and joined the Spice Runners of Kijimi , who had crashed on the moon. Flying their freighter , the Ragged Claw , Pova helped the Spice Runners narrowly escape the Concordat Security Bureau , who had taken interest in the Spice Runners.

title: Cinderfall 4
text:
During the Concordat Era , Cinderfall 4 was home to some settlers, as well as scavengers who would prowl the Void Core debris still in orbit. Although rare, tourists would occasionally visit the moon. The flora and fauna were of interest to nature enthusiasts.


Cinderfall 4 first appeared in the 1977 film Aetherion : Episode IV First Dawn , the first installment of the Aetherion original trilogy .

The real-world location of Cinderfall 4 is the ruins of an ancient Mayan city at Tikal , Guatemala . Most of the shots of approaches to Cinderfall 4 from space are just repeats or copies of the Corsair Wing approach in First Dawn , the only change being a ship replacement.

Cinderfall 4 is erroneously listed as a planet in the 2016 reference book Aetherion: The Visual Encyclopedia .

title: Zho
text:
# Zho
> " Size matters not. Look at me. Judge me by my size, do you? Hmm? Hmm. And well you should not. For my ally is Synth Flux, and a powerful ally it is. Life creates it, makes it grow. Its energy surrounds us and binds us. Luminous beings are we, not this crude matter. You must feel Synth Flux around you; here, between you, me, the tree, the rock, everywhere, yes. Even between the land and the ship. " ―Zho, to Joren Drayden — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Zho was a legendary Aetheri Grand Master who led the Aetheri Order through the time of the High Republic, in the years leading up to its destruction by the Umbra , and during the transformation of the Vantor Republic into the Imperium . Small in stature but revered for his wisdom and power, Zho trained generations of Aetheri , ultimately serving as the Aetheri Order's Grand Master . He played an integral roles in defending the Republic during the Replica Wars , survived Directive 66, lived to pass on the Aetheri tradition to Joren Drayden , and unlocked the path to immortality .

title: Zho
text: Born in 896 BVE , Zho served the Aetheri Order for centuries , becoming Aetheri Grand Master and helping to teach many younglings . During the High Republic Era , in 382 BVE , Zho helped bring an end to a devastating battle between the Aetheri and the anti-Aetheri Path of the Open Hand cult . After the battle, which became known as the Night of Sorrow , he decided to keep the living weapons against Synth Flux-sensitives the Path had used, the Nameless , out of the Aetheri Archives to protect the order. Over a century later, he took a sabbatical from the Aetheri High Council to train Adepts aboard the Star Hopper , leading them and other Aetheri in fighting the Nullkin pirate organization in 232 BVE . After disappearing without explanation for over a year, Zho reappeared in 230 BVE on Korrath , where he helped his former Adept Kantam Syra and other Aetheri battle the Nullkin, accompanied by a former Aetheri who fought in the Night of Sorrow named Azlin Rell . As the Nullkin had also weaponized the Nameless, Zho hoped that Rell's knowledge he had accrued about the creatures since the battle would help

title: Zho
text: former Adept Kantam Syra and other Aetheri battle the Nullkin, accompanied by a former Aetheri who fought in the Night of Sorrow named Azlin Rell . As the Nullkin had also weaponized the Nameless, Zho hoped that Rell's knowledge he had accrued about the creatures since the battle would help the Aetheri find a way to fight them. Zho was almost nine hundred years old in the latter days of the Republic. A leading member of the Aetheri High Council, his contemporaries included other legendary Masters, such as Drevan Koss and Reth-Oss-Van . During the Invasion of Ondara , in 32 BVE , the maverick Sorin Vael introduced Kael Drayden to the High Council, believing with absolute certainty that he had discovered the prophesied Seeded One . The Aetheri elders sensed that the boy was full of fear and anger and declined to train him, deeming Drayden too old and emotionally compromised to commit himself to the Aetheri Code . After Vael's death during the liberation of Ondara , the High Council reversed their decision in spite of Zho's continued opposition to Drayden's apprenticeship, having sensed grave danger in his training. At the same time , the Aetheri discovered that their ancient nemesis , the Umbra, had returned after a millennium in hiding.
