Aware of the Rule of Two , Zho was convinced that at least one more Umbra Lord remained active following Orien Kade 's victory over the Umbra apprentice Vael Vreth .

title: Zho
text: Over the next decade, the galaxy was on the verge of civil war with entire star systems —led by Count Varek , Zho's one-time Adept—threatening to secede from the Republic by 22 BVE . Unable to defend the entire Republic against this betrayal on their own, the Aetheri took command of the newly-formed Grand Army of the Republic , with Zho himself leading an army of replica troopers against the Dissident Droid Army of the Fractio of Independent Systems in the first battle of the Replica Wars, rescuing the Aetheri and Senator from execution. For three years Zho led the Republic military's war effort as an Aetheri General , determined to bring a swift and decisive end to the conflict. During this time he was approached by the spirit of Sorin Vael, who helped Zho learn how to retain his identity as a spirit after death. Zho's efforts against the Dissidents were undermined by Vael Mal , the Dark Lord of the Umbra who conspired to destroy the Aetheri and restore the Umbra to power. After the Great Aetheri Purge commenced in 19 BVE , killing thousands of Aetheri both on Vantor and across the galaxy, Zho confronted the self-declared

title: Zho
text: Dissidents were undermined by Vael Mal , the Dark Lord of the Umbra who conspired to destroy the Aetheri and restore the Umbra to power. After the Great Aetheri Purge commenced in 19 BVE , killing thousands of Aetheri both on Vantor and across the galaxy, Zho confronted the self-declared Galactic Emperor but failed to cut short Mal' reign and consequently retreated into exile , leaving the Umbra Master to consolidate his power with a new apprentice, the former Kael Drayden-turned- Xarn Velgor, at his side. Zho's remaining years were spent living in isolation on the remote world of Mirefall . After the death of Orien Kade, he was able to commune with his spirit, who wished for Zho to train Kael's son Joren Drayden . Zho initially reluctantly agreed, but later believed that the galaxy as better off without him and refused Kade's request. After being convinced by Kade to enter the Cave of Evil , in which he confronted many figures from his past and made peace with his failures, he agreed to teach Joren Drayden, who soon after sought out the legendary Grand Master in the hope of becoming an Aetheri Knight . He trained Drayden for a time, until despite Zho's warnings Drayden hurriedly abandoned his training to save his friends after a having a vision that they were in danger. A year later, in 4 AVE , with his health rapidly declining, Zho died of old age when Drayden returned to see him. He became one with Synth Flux , shortly before Joren redeemed his father Kael, who fulfilled his destiny as the Seeded One by killing Mal.

title: Zho
text: Years later, Joren Drayden's attempt to reform the Aetheri Order would be foiled when his nephew Beno Karrick turned to the umbra side and destroyed his Aetheri Sanctum . Believing the galaxy was better without him and the Aetheri, Drayden went into exile, just as Zho had. After his student he reluctantly trained, the scavenger Nyla , also abandoned her training, Zho appeared as a ghost to Drayden. Zho taught Drayden to learn from his failures and helped him forgive himself.

title: Zho
text:
### Early life

> " For 800 years have I trained Aetheri. " ―Zho, to Joren Drayden

Born nine-hundred years before the Battle of Mossfell , Zho belonged to an ancient and mysterious species and little was known of Zho's early life; he never revealed his homeworld . As he was keenly attuned to Synth Flux , he joined the Aetheri Order as a youngling . As an Aetheri Initiate , Zho made use of a training flux blade . After undergoing the ritual known as the Gathering , he received his own personal kyber crystal , and Professor Huyang helped him construct his first flux blade aboard the Crucible . The circumstances surrounding Zho and the construction of his first flux blade were exciting, according to Huyang. At some point during his time as a youngling, Zho skipped across the lily pads in the Aetheri Sanctum's meditation pond .

title: Zho
text:
Although Zho spoke little of his early days, it was rumored that one of his early instructors was the Hysalrian N'Kata Del Gormo . Zho was paired up with a personal mentor at a younger age than usual. During their time together, Zho's Aetheri Master told him the tale of K'ungfu and Chuang , two great Aetheri of the past. As an Adept , Zho visited multiple planets and during his first years he could have named them all, but in the following centuries, he couldn't remember how many he'd seen and later estimated the number to be in the tens of thousands. Around the age of one hundred, in 796 BVE , Zho was ready to pass on what he had learned. Having attained the rank of Master, he spent the next eight centuries training and tutoring generations of Aetheri. It was estimated that over his lifetime, he trained around twenty thousand Aetheri.

### High Republic Era

#### Early High Republic Era

title: Zho
text:
### High Republic Era

#### Early High Republic Era

> " You must choose Synth Flux. One does not fall into being an Aetheri Knight by mistake, hm? Or because it is convenient! You must choose Synth Flux, with your whole heart. To do this, you must learn, again, to listen. To hear the world, the world outside of your own emotions. Even when they are very, very loud, heh, [like] a hurricane. " ―Zho By the High Republic Era , Zho was considered a great Aetheri Master. He had also gained a seat on the Aetheri High Council and the rank of Grand Master . Two other Aetheri— Xo Lahru and Pra-Tre Veter —shared the Grand Master title with Zho. Eventually the human Aetheri Ry Ki-Sakka also attained the position. As the Aetheri who taught younglings, Zho one day met the human youngling Gella Nattai , who was scared of the training remotes and ran from the room. Finding Nattai in the Temple garden and sitting with her, Zho and Nattai watched a frog in the garden repeatedly try to jump into a waterfall behind a stone wall. Zho used the frog as a lesson, teaching her to face her fear and always get back up to try again.

#### An uncertain Path

> " No one, no galaxy, no Republic, no Aetheri Order, no family, is perfect. " " You are right. […] Perhaps we are doing too much, too fast. " " You must continue. The great good is a good vision. Fight for this good as well, the Aetheri do. " ―Zho and Chancellor Kyong Greylark

title: Zho
text: In 382 BVE , after learning of the Battle of Embermoor and the failure of a peace treaty between the warring planets Eiram and E'ronoh there, Zho went to the Republic Executive Building on the galactic capital Vantor to meet with with Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark while they waited for more information from Embermoor . They spoke to Aetheri Master Creighton Sun and Aetheri Knight Aida Forte , who were on the ground on Embermoor and confirmed that the E'roni ambassador was dead and the Eirami had deployed a droid army. They requested to perform an investigation on the Outer Reach Territories planet Dalna of the Path of the Open Hand cult, considering their involvement in the failure of the peace talks, the fact that Aetheri Master Silandra Sho felt a disturbance that made the Aetheri ill at the Path's almshouse , and that Aetheri Knight Gella Nattai believed the Chancellor's criminal son Axel Greylark was working with the Path. Zho admitted that he had sensed a disturbance beyond Embermoor, and emphasized that they need to be careful, reminding them that there was always those who thrived in chaos. After much deliberation, Zho and Chancellor Greylark eventually agreed to a

title: Zho
text: Chancellor's criminal son Axel Greylark was working with the Path. Zho admitted that he had sensed a disturbance beyond Embermoor, and emphasized that they need to be careful, reminding them that there was always those who thrived in chaos. After much deliberation, Zho and Chancellor Greylark eventually agreed to a fact-finding mission accompanied by two of her guards and to send Aetheri Master Char-Ryl-Roy and Adept Enya Keen to Eiram and E'ronoh to try and keep the peace and discover what was causing communications buoys to be down, Zho explaining to them that Werth Plouth , the Path's Herald , was responsible for the riots on Embermoor.

title: Zho
text: After the communication ended, Zho expressed his concern as they received another message from Aetheri Master Yaddle , who was accompanied by an Aetheri Initiate named Cippa Tarko , though the connection of the message was poor. Tarko asked about Zho, and Yaddle explained that he was an Aetheri Master and not her brother. Zho told Yaddle that they were sending help to Embermoor and two Aetheri to Dalna and that she was to return to Vantor, but the message was so choppy they were not sure if she understood. Zho had an unsettling feeling in Synth Flux that reminded him of the feeling he got whenever a battle was coming. Master Yaddle did misunderstand Zho's message to mean she was needed on Dalna and joined Sun and Forte there, who sent a message to Zho confirming they were there shortly before Yaddle arrived.

title: Zho
text:
Later, Chancellor Greylark had her guards summon Zho to her to reveal that her son Axel had escaped from prison with the help of the Path and someone named Binnot Ullo . She told Zho that she did not know who Ullo was and did not think Axel had many friends. He assured her that no one, no galaxy, and no republic was perfect, and that she should continue to fight for the greater good like the Aetheri did. She explained that she felt like they have all been moving through a fog that has corrupted everything lately and Zho insisted that Axel still had good in him and that the 'fog' was just corrupting him too. However, the Chancellor resolved to make Axel truly feel the consequences of his actions.

#### Chancellor no more

> " We will go together. Chancellor you may not be anymore. Friend, you still are. " ―Zho to Greylark, on going to Dalna

title: Zho
text:
#### Chancellor no more

> " We will go together. Chancellor you may not be anymore. Friend, you still are. " ―Zho to Greylark, on going to Dalna

Eventually, Greylark received a message from her son on Dalna and immediately called Zho to have him listen to it with her via hologram. After hearing Axel ask for her to go to Dalna to speak with the Path and with him, Zho asked her what she would do, the Chancellor deciding to go to Dalna. She then recorded a message for Axel that included Zho in it, wearing a blank expression, so that he could bear witness to her stepping down as Chancellor. After she sent the message, Zho stayed with her wordlessly for a while, and she appreciated his kindness.

title: Zho
text:
Before Greylark could leave for Dalna, Zho approached her and said that since he had not heard back from Masters Sun or Ela Sutan , who had also been sent to Dalna, that he would go with her because she was still his friend even though she was no longer Chancellor. Zho had an Aetheri Longbeam cruiser follow them with a contingent of Aetheri. While in hyperspace, they received a distress call from Princess Xiri A'lbaran of E'ronoh and Prince Phan-tu Zenn of Eiram. They then received a message from Chancellor Orlen Mollo , who said that the leaders of Eiram and E'ronoh were still not cooperating. Zho volunteered to rescue the heirs due to their proximity to them and left, taking other Aetheri with him.

#### The Night of Sorrow

> " Speak to the Aetheri Council soon, you should. We must explain the happenings on Dalna. All that went wrong. " […] "But we must also speak to all the things that went right. We could not have defeated the Path without the Aetheri. " " And the Aetheri could not have defeated the Path without the help of our Republic allies. " ―Zho and Greylark

title: Zho
text: Eventually, Zho arrived at the battle that was now raging on Dalna between the Path and the Aetheri, which came to be known as the Night of Sorrow . The Path, much of it reorganized into the Path of the Closed Fist , was led by Marda Ro of the Ro family . He was joined by Princess A'lbaran and Prince Zenn, the three announcing that the combined forces of Eiram and E'ronoh were there to fight together with the Aetheri. When Zho arrived on the ground at the Path compound , Aetheri Gella Nattai told him to direct people to go to the cave system as there was potentially many more Path members there. On Dalna, he met Path Little Tromak . Zho eventually came to forget Tromak but always remembered the importance of his visit to Dalna.

title: Zho
text: As the battle started to come to a close with it turning in the Aetheri's favor, Zho and Yaddle stood together, the latter watching Cippa Tarko sleep. However, A'lbaran and Zenn contacted them and informed them that explosions have been set off underground. As Yaddle suggested getting help, the ground shook and Zho spotted sections of the caves collapse into sinkholes. Zho and Yaddle then sensed an Aetheri in distress and went to help. Finding a door in the ground, Zho and Yaddle connected to synth flux and sensed Gella Nattai and Axel Greylark. Yaddle lifted up the ground, rocks, and soil while Zho lifted the water to try and rescue them. Enya Keen then ran toward them, seeing Nattai, and pulled her and Axel from the mud-like water, having been brought to the surface by the two Aetheri Masters. Zho and Yaddle then set the water and mud down far away. In the sinkhole, E'roni and Eirami soldiers began recovering survivors. Yaddle noticed that the sounds of battle have faded and the sun was rising. She asks Zho if the battle was done, and he says it was.

title: Zho
text:
Zho met with Kyong Greylark and Chancellor Mollo on a medical frigate above Vantor, the three discussing now only having one Chancellor instead of two and what it means. Zho suggested they speak to the Aetheri Council and tell them everything that went wrong, but Greylark also wanted to focus all the things that went right, including the help of the Republic and the Aetheri. Mollo revealed that the people of Dalna were calling the event the Night of Sorrow. While he imagined the future, Greylark assured Zho that she would meet him on Vantor soon, Zho adding that there was much to celebrate and remember.

#### Return to the Temple

> " What do you know about these nameless creatures? " "I, too, know of them. Powerful beings, they are. Dangerous, they are. But in pain, they could be. Only a few understand them. You, and I. And still, much to learn is there. " ―Zho and Creighton Sun

title: Zho
text:
> " What do you know about these nameless creatures? " "I, too, know of them. Powerful beings, they are. Dangerous, they are. But in pain, they could be. Only a few understand them. You, and I. And still, much to learn is there. " ―Zho and Creighton Sun

Zho then traveled to the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor, confirming first that the royal families of Eiram and E'ronoh had already gathered, who he met with when he arrived. He met with several Aetheri, including Yaddle, who was standing with Tarko. Zho raised his arm to silence the room and Master Sun rose from his chair, walking to the center of the room using a walking stick before beginning a funeral for Aetheri Aida Forte, Orin Darhga , and Char-Ryl-Roy. Zho allowed Roy's former Adept, Keen, to keep his flux blade and use it alongside hers.

title: Zho
text:
Later, in the Aetheri Archives , Creighton spoke with Zho about Nameless creatures that the Path deployed on Dalna and the horror they wrought upon the Aetheri, causing them to be weakened, hallucinate, and eventually be turned to dust. Zho confirmed that there is a larger danger connected to them, which caused Creighton to wonder what Zho knew. Realizing how catastrophic to the Order it could be if people found out about the creatures, and since they had heard no other reports of their usage, they decided to keep quiet about them and not include them in the Aetheri Archive. They agreed not to speak of it again and each of them left.

#### Master of Kantam Syra

> " The lesson of Younglings we take on is one of the hardest ones for most Aetheri to learn. Indeed, some never do." "Detachment." "To let go. Elusive it is, but also, always available to us, always there. And then, when we grasp, gone again. Takes practice, it does. Repetition. To have to do it again does not mean we have failed, only that we must do it again. And again. " ―Zho and Kantam Syra

title: Zho
text: At some point, Zho took on a human named Kantam Syra as his Adept. The two were stationed at the Aetheri Sanctum on the planet Endovar . Syra was a very talented Adept and was far ahead of their peers and even some of their elders, with Zho even admitting that they were the most disciplined Adept he had ever taught and one of the most connected to Synth Flux. Despite this, Zho held off knighting Syra, for a reason that the Adept did not understand until they began a romantic relationship with an acrobat named Aytar and realized that both Zho and them had been waiting for something like that to happen. Eventually, Syra decided to leave the Aetheri Order, a decision partially incited by their newfound relationship with Aytar.

title: Zho
text: Zho and Syra loved to spar with each other, and it was how the two often found understanding and how Syra often found inner harmony while troubled or when they had a problem. Even when they did not find a solution during a match, they would leave feeling like an answer was out there. When Syra traveled to the meditation room in the Endovar Aetheri Sanctum in order to tell Zho about their decision, Zho challenged them to a sparring match, remembering that they had dueled many times in that room and saying that this duel could be one final lesson. Syra agreed to the duel, as it was custom to not refuse a duel with Master Zho, but also realized that this meant Zho knew about their decision. Zho dodged Syra's question by engaging in combat, before saying that the time had come to make a choice, but not the one that Syra thought. Zho explained that Synth Flux chose Syra just as it had chosen all other Aetheri, and asked when Syra would choose Synth Flux. Syra insisted that they chose Synth Flux every day when they took part in their Aetheri training, but after knocking Syra to

title: Zho
text: the one that Syra thought. Zho explained that Synth Flux chose Syra just as it had chosen all other Aetheri, and asked when Syra would choose Synth Flux. Syra insisted that they chose Synth Flux every day when they took part in their Aetheri training, but after knocking Syra to the ground, Zho asked if we really make a choice when we do not believe there are any other options. Zho told Syra that there was a reason he had not knighted them yet, before ending the duel, helping Syra up, and sitting down with Syra to meditate. Eventually Syra asked Zho if they should leave the Aetheri Order, but Zho insisted that there was no 'should' and that the right thing to do is an idea we invent to make ourselves feel better. Zho also suggested that Syra had stopped listening, in the literal sense, and in a larger general sense. Zho explained that feelings are like wind, we can feel it, we can experience it, but it passes, though sometimes it can feel like a hurricane which can make it easy to give in to anger and fear. Zho told Syra that in order for them to continue to be an Aetheri they must actively choose the Aetheri Order and Synth Flux and learn to listen to the world outside of their emotions even when they were as loud as a hurricane. Eventually, after a moment, Syra set down their flux blade in front of Zho. Zho nodded at them, and then his Adept left him, and the Aetheri Order, behind. Zho was saddened but supported Syra through their departure. Syra would reflect on the conversation they had that day throughout the rest of their life.

title: Zho
text: Over a year later, Syra returned to the Aetheri, and met with Zho on the Endovar. Zho was in the process of helping a pet Happabore named Monsalmo at the time, after being awoken from a nap by the creature's squealing. Zho was used to dealing with her complicated behaviors, including finding her inside the temple underneath the younglings' bunks. This time, Monsalmo was pregnant and had climbed onto the roof of her pen to avoid giving birth in a fuel spill. However, the roof could not hold the creature's weight and it collapsed. Zho caught Monsalmo with Synth Flux, but at that same time she started to give birth to her pups, so Zho had to carry them with Synth Flux too. Just then, Syra and a Synth Flux-sensitive girl they had rescued on the planet Ondara named Lula Talisola arrived and both used Synth Flux to help Zho carry Monsalmo and her pups. Zho welcomed Syra back, telling them that they had left an Adept and returned a Knight. A few hours later, Zho knighted Syra in a modest ceremony so that they could take on Talisola as their Adept learner.

title: Zho
text: After the ceremony, Syra and Zho sat around a fire near the happabore enclosure and discussed the events that had occurred. Syra expressed that they did not understand how one second they felt so sure in their path separate from the Order but was then pulled back to it when they saved Talisola. Zho explained that the young are the greatest teachers and the greatest lesson that can be learned from them is necessity of detachment and letting go, that being an Aetheri was to let go. Syra realized that they had been the one that taught Zho that lesson. Zho revealed that he had struggled with Syra's departure and had been unsure of the future. The two then shared Sweetpuff jamwiches with Talisola.

title: Zho
text:
Sometime later, Zho and Syra met with Talisola in the Endovar Aetheri Sanctum. Syra told Talisola that the lesson she taught the two masters was the hardest one of all. Talisola hoped that it was front flips with a flux blade, which made Syra retract their statement and say that it was the second hardest lesson to learn. Zho concurred, saying that the front flip was nothing simple. But the lesson that Syra wanted to teach Talisola was the same one that Syra had learned from her and Zho had learned from Syra: Detachment.

Sometime before 232 BVE , Zho traveled to the Aetheri Sanctum on Takodana to pick up a Synth Flux-sensitive Aloxian child named Qort from Maz Oru and Aetheri Sav Malagán and bring him into the Aetheri Order. Adept Reath Silas briefly met Zho during some events both attended together.

#### Time on the Star Hopper

> " Chaos on the surface, there will be. Remember that Synth Flux moves through you, through all living things, even in chaos. Move with Synth Flux, we must. Never against it. " ―Zho during the Trymant IV disaster

title: Zho
text:
#### Time on the Star Hopper

> " Chaos on the surface, there will be. Remember that Synth Flux moves through you, through all living things, even in chaos. Move with Synth Flux, we must. Never against it. " ―Zho during the Trymant IV disaster

By 233 BVE , Zho was stationed alongside Master Zia Zaldor Zanna at the Aetheri Grand Temple on Vantor assigning youngling Aetheri Initiates to different temple outposts across the galaxy to continue learning and training under their teachers. Here he met initiates Kai Brightstar , Lys Solay , and Nubs ; Zho gifted Brightstar his own training blade after Brightstar sacrificed his to save Nubs while on a mission. In 232 BVE, Zho took a sabbatical from the Aetheri Council, having felt Synth Flux needed him on a different path. Thus, Zho joined the crew of the Aetheri Adept Academic Cruiser Star Hopper , allowing him to help train Adepts and younglings. Zho was also therefore able to help train Talisola, who was stationed aboard the Star Hopper .

title: Zho
text: Zho appointed the Calavane Aetheri Master Ephru Shinn to hold his seat on the council while he was away. During the Great Hyperspace Disaster in the Hetzal system , Aetheri Master Avar Kriss established a Synth Flux network , which was eventually aided by Aetheri who were outside the system. Zho—located somewhere with the crew of younglings he was currently teaching—helped the effort, adding his focus to the network to ensure a Tibanna gas container did not collide with an R-class sun . The Great Hyperspace Disaster also caused the Emergences , which were when giant pieces of debris exited hyperspace in various places throughout the galaxy and threatened to hit planets at near lightspeed. Eventually, the Trymant system was threatened by an Emergence . The staff of Republic Security Zone Monitoring Satellite 777B-Alpha reported the incident to the Starlight Beacon space station , who then asked the only Republic or Aetheri ship immediately within range, the Star Hopper , to assist. Onboard was Zho along with fellow Aetheri Master Torban Buck and a class of Adepts. As they traveled through hyperspace to the Trymant system, Zho told the Adepts to prepare for anything because they had no idea what was coming, but that Synth Flux would reveal all. When they received the information that they were the only Republic or Aetheri ship nearby to respond, one of the Adepts suggested that they stay back and wait for backup. But Zho insisted that they were Trymant's only hope and needed to press forward. Shortly before they exited hyperspace Zho had the Adepts report what information they had discovered about the calamity. Zho and Buck decided to stay on the Star Hopper to use

title: Zho
text: stay back and wait for backup. But Zho insisted that they were Trymant's only hope and needed to press forward. Shortly before they exited hyperspace Zho had the Adepts report what information they had discovered about the calamity. Zho and Buck decided to stay on the Star Hopper to use Synth Flux to divert the biggest pieces of debris but sent the Adepts in Rescue speeders to help on the surface of the planet. However, amid the chaos of the Emergence, a Spider Cruiser called the Squall Spider commanded by the Eye of the Nullkin , Marchion Ro arrived in Bralanak City to pick up Elder Tromak, whom Ro wanted the services of to find some information. When the Adepts attempted to get Nullkin marauders to allow them to use the Spider Cruiser to evacuate civilians, a fight broke out, leading Zho and Buck to the surface to help the young Aetheri and fight against the Nullkin. During the fight, a Synth Flux-sensitive civilian named Zeen Mrala who had helped the Aetheri against the Emergence and against the Nullkin, told Masters Zho and Buck that her friend Krix Kamerat had been captured by the Nullkin and needed to be rescued. Lula Talisola offered to go, but Zho insisted that he would go rescue the boy. Master Buck protested, believing that he was not a fighting Aetheri and therefore should not be left to lead the Aetheri, but Zho ignored him. Concurrent to the destruction of Starlight Beacon , Syra, Vitus, Jomaram, Silas, and Mrala joined Korrathi bodyguards and civilians in fighting Nullkin who were attempting to steal a fleet of MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruisers and Republic Longbeam cruisers from the shipyards in Coronet City on Korrath in order to add to the chaos and destruction of the space station. As Syra, Vitus, and Mrala charged through a horde of Nullkin, a group of the pirates stole a massive ship from one of Korrath's shipyards and attempted to take it to attack Starlight. However, the three Synth Flux-sensitives used Synth Flux to stall the trawler and prevent it from escaping, but they had a weak hold on it and as they did Nullkin reinforcements arrived. But then Master Syra suddenly noticed the trawler become light and seemingly weightless. And then the remaining Nullkin war cloud was swept away suddenly, confusing the pirates, but also revealing Master Zho in hooded robes holding the trawler with Synth Flux with his flux blade ignited at his side.

title: Zho
text: Zho told Syra that it seemed like they needed a hand, and Syra collapsed and started cry at the sight of their old Master. Zho then used Synth Flux to send the massive ship crashing onto the horde of Nullkin reinforcements with a fiery explosion. When more Nullkin came, Zho threw himself into their leader feet first and then used Synth Flux to knock the others down with a single hand motion. This inspired Syra, who shouted "For light and life" before joining up with Vitus and Mrala again and fighting by Zho's side. Zho and Syra worked together to take down a Nullkin with a buzz saw , Syra knocking him off balance before Zho stabbed him in the back with his flux blade. The Aetheri then regrouped with the Korrathi fighters and Zho shouted the rallying cry "For light and life" which spread throughout the crowd. Eventually they managed to drive the Nullkin away, winning the battle.

text: Afterward, Jomaram, who had been instrumental to the Aetheri's success elsewhere in the battle, reunited with Syra, who introduced him to Zho. Alys "Crash" Ongwa , one of the leaders of the Korrathi fighters offered up a location to the Aetheri. The group ate, bathed, and then tried to sleep.

Decades after his apprentice graduated to Knighthood, in 42 BVE , Zho was informed by Varek that he was departing from the Aetheri Order, much to his disappointment, and when his former student offered to turn over his flux blade, the Grandmaster allowed him to retain ownership of his weapon.

### Invasion of Ondara

title: Zho
text:
### Invasion of Ondara

> " There's no doubt the mysterious warrior was an Umbra. " " Always two, there are. No more, no less. A master and an apprentice. " " But which one was destroyed, the master or the apprentice? " ―Drevan Koss and Zho, about Vael Vreth — Link ▶️ ( file info ) By the invasion of the planet Ondara by the Commerce Combine , Zho still served on the Aetheri High Council, yet he was the sole Grand Master of the Aetheri Order. By the invasion, he had been training Aetheri students for about 800 years. In the time before the invasion, Zho took part in a council meeting. Several hours after that meeting, he took to mediating in a small garden in the temple, only to be interrupted by fellow council member Drevan Koss, who, after Zho waited for him to explain why he wanted a private discussion, expressed his belief that Zho had sensed something he was keeping private. Zho repeatedly responded that he sensed nothing: the issue was not that there was a problem to be sensed, but that something was being hidden. Not understanding but trusting the Grand Master's judgement, Koss excused himself while Zho, incorrectly believing the umbra side was far away, tried to find what it was that he could not sense. Zho was unable to uncover the fact that the sensation was caused by the secret plots of the Umbra Lord Vael Mal .

title: Zho
text:
Concurrent to the Federation's occupation on Ondara, Zho was present when Aetheri Master Sorin Vael presented Kael Drayden , a young boy from the planet Dunemere , to the Council in the hopes of training him. Although Vael believed Drayden to be the Seeded One , prophesied to bring balance to Synth Flux, Zho and the other Council members did not share his opinion, sensing that the boy was harboring a high amount of fear and his future was uncertain. They therefore refused to allow for his training.

After Vael and his Adept Orien Kade returned to Ondara, they forged an alliance between the human inhabitants of the world and the native Mool species in order to combat the Federation occupation forces. The Federation's droid army was eventually deactivated after Kael Drayden accidentally destroyed its command ship. During the battle, however, Vael and Kade dueled an Umbra apprentice — Vael Vreth , the Gloomreachian Zyrrak apprentice of Mal—which cost Vael his life.

title: Zho
text:
With the Ondara having waited until the Council's arrival to begin the funeral, Zho, along with other members of the Council, was present at the Ondara victory parade and Vael's earlier funeral, where he shared his thoughts on the apparent reemergence of the Umbra with fellow Master of the Order Drevan Koss, pointing out that the Rule of Two , the Umbra succession system in effect at the time, meant that another Umbra was still present. Unbeknownst to the two Aetheri, the remaining Umbra was Theron Mal, the Supreme Chancellor of the Vantor Republic, who had been sworn in after a Vote of No Confidence forced his predecessor Valorum to resign.

Zho and the other Council members remained at the funeral until Vael's body turned to ash. Then, the Council left the ceremony, leaving Drayden, Kade, and Ondar's court there. With Vael dead, following the events on Ondara, the Council named Vael's former Adept Orien Kade an Aetheri Knight, who informed Zho of his master's final will—that Drayden be trained. Reluctantly, Zho permitted him to take the boy as his Adept. Zho also attended the parade held by the Ondara and Mools to celebrate their victory.

### Dissident Crisis

title: Zho
text:
### Dissident Crisis

> " I think it is time we inform the Senate that our ability to use Synth Flux has diminished. " " Only the Dark Lord of the Umbra knows of our weakness. If informed the Senate is, multiply, our adversaries will. " ―Drevan Koss and Zho

Ten years after the Ondara crisis, several thousand systems that were disillusioned with the Vantor Republic seceded from the government and formed the Fractio of Independent Systems under the leadership of Count Varek, the former student of Zho who left the Order due to widespread corruption in the Republic. As the Galactic Senate , the chief governing body of the Republic, debated the creation of a standing army, an unsuccessful attempt was made on the life of Senator Ondar of Ondara. After Aetheri Knight Orien Kade and his Adept Kael Drayden cornered the assassin, the killer was in turn killed by a mysterious person who escaped using his jetpack . The events prompted the Council, which included Zho, to appoint Kade to track him down.

title: Zho
text: Kade's investigation led him to attempt to find the planet Gelvaris , whose location had been missing from the Aetheri Archives. This discovery alarmed Zho, who surmised that only an Aetheri could have erased the files. Interrupting a training session with the Bear Clan , Zho helped Kade pinpoint the world's exact location through meditation, allowing the latter to travel there. Following Kade's departure, Zho experienced a vision while meditating, in which he heard the voice of the spirit of Sorin Vael, and sensed that Kael Drayden was in terrible pain. He discussed the vision with fellow Master Drevan Koss afterwards.

title: Zho
text:
Having arrived on Gelvaris, Kade reported that the Gelvarian replicators had created a replica army, the order for which had been placed by Aetheri Master Sifas Dyen , who had perished around the time of the Invasion of Ondara. Kade believed that the template used to create the army, bounty hunter Garrick Vark , was the person involved in the attack on Ondar. After a brief encounter with Vark, Kade followed him to the planet Pyralis, where he found that Varek's Dissidents ordered the assassination attempt on Ondar and had constructed a droid army. After relaying the information to the Aetheri Council, Kade was captured and scheduled for execution, later joined by Ondar and Kael Drayden.

### The Replica Wars

#### Battle of Pyralis

> " The shroud of the umbra side has fallen. Begun, the Replica War has. " ―Master Zho

title: Zho
text:
### The Replica Wars

#### Battle of Pyralis

> " The shroud of the umbra side has fallen. Begun, the Replica War has. " ―Master Zho

News that Drayden and Kade had been captured prompted the Council to dispatch an Aetheri strike team to Pyralis, while Zho headed to Gelvaris to take command of the replica forces. As a replica strike team interrupted the execution of Kade and his associates, the replicas suffered casualties at the hands of the numerically superior Confederate battle droid forces. Zho led the replicas into battle, thus beginning a galaxywide conflict that would become known as the Replica Wars .

title: Zho
text:
As the replicas engaged the Fractio's forces in a massive battle, Zho headed to rescue Kade and Drayden from Varek, who had incapacitated the duo in a duel. The diminutive Aetheri Master showed his mastery and power over Synth Flux surpassed that of Varek by casually repelling the latter's telekinetic assault and Synth Flux lightning . He then engaged Varek in a brief but intense duel, having the upper hand. Varek, realizing he was outmatched by Zho, used Synth Flux to bring a large metal pillar down on the unconscious Drayden and Kade, forcing Zho to break off the duel and use his own powers to stop it from crushing them. Varek used the distraction to flee aboard his personal craft. Although the battle on Pyralis ended in the Republic's favor, Zho was concerned about the growing influence of the umbra side of Synth Flux and the outcome of the Replica Wars.

#### Mentoring Kael Drayden

title: Zho
text:
#### Mentoring Kael Drayden

As the Replica Wars progressed, Zho decided to alleviate Aetheri Knight Kael Drayden's fear and inability to lose loved ones by assigning him an Adept learner, Sela Marr. He believed that by becoming a teacher, Drayden would develop emotionally and that when the time came for Marr to go off on her own, he would understand that his excessive bonding to those he cared about was unnecessary. Marr traveled to the planet of Krestophis, where she presented herself to Drayden in the midst of a battle against Confederate forces.

After the battle had concluded, Zho, himself, arrived on the planet and assigned the duo to the task of finding Rotto , the son of influential Grak crime lord Grukk , who had been kidnapped as part of a plan arranged by his uncle Ziro to alienate the Graks and the Aetheri and drag the former into war. After the two Aetheri successfully completed the mission, Zho, along with a group of replicas, extracted them from the planet Dunemere.

#### Ambush on Rugosa

title: Zho
text:
#### Ambush on Rugosa

> Vray : " If Zho is indeed the Aetheri warrior you believe he is, let him prove it. Allow me to send my best troops to capture him. If he escapes, join the Republic. But should my droids defeat Zho, consider an alliance with the Dissidents. " Katuunko : " I did not request Zho's presence here to test him in battle. " Zho : " Accept the challenge I do, Your Highness. Arrive by nightfall, I will . " ―Kessa Vray challenges Zho for a competition; Zho accepts — Link ▶️ ( file info )

Some time later, Zho and a small squad of replica troopers —composed of Replica Lieutenant Thire and two troopers, Jekko and Rys —were sent to the neutral coral moon Rugosa to negotiate the construction of a Republic base on Toydarian territory with the incumbent monarch, King Katuunko . Simultaneously, the Fractio dispatched Kessa Vray , an assassin trained by Confederate leader Varek, to the moon with droid escort to pressure Katuunko into siding with the Dissidents.

title: Zho
text: Zho's starship was ambushed by two Confederate vessels upon arriving into the system, forcing him to use an escape pod to land on the surface of the moon, accompanied by three replica troopers. The Aetheri then successfully made contact with the Toydarian delegation, prompting Vray, who was at the king's location, to challenge Zho: if he could defeat her droid units, Toydaria would join the Republic, but a defeat would result in the planet pledging its allegiance to the Fractio. The Aetheri accepted, and Katuunko requested that he be given a fair fight—an agreement which Vray did not intend to honor.

title: Zho
text: Encountering the droids, Zho destroyed a squad of them by himself without using his flux blade, and returned to assist his replica companions, until the arrival of droidekas forced them to flee. The Aetheri covered their escape by deflecting the droids' volt pistol fire at a nearby rock formation that collapsed and crushed them, after which he and the replicas retreated to a nearby cave to rest. In the cave, Zho relaxed into his natural role as a teacher. Calling each replica by name, he raised their morale by lecturing them on their individuality in Synth Flux. Upon hearing the sound of more approaching Confederate units, Zho and his escort left the cave. The Grand Master engaged and destroyed three tanks and their associated infantry alone, much to the amusement of the king and the anger of Vray, who were watching the droids' progress via hologram. Breaking the terms of the competition, the assassin sent in droidekas to take out Zho, which the replicas prevented by launching their final rocket that caused the enemy to be buried under a rock slide.

title: Zho
text:
Katuunko, impressed by Zho, decided to join the Republic. As Zho arrived to meet with the king, he used Synth Flux to stop Vray from killing, then returned her blades to humiliate her. When Vray triggered an avalanche with planted explosives, Zho saved Katuunko, Thire, Jekko, and Rys from being crushed by rocks, maneuvering the debris to the side with Synth Flux. Republic gunships soon arrived to retrieve the group.

Back on the cruiser, Zho entered a meditation in his cabin. He reached out with Synth Flux to sense the replicas he had served with, feeling their differences but sensing the same desires in each of them: to follow orders, win battles, and to be a good soldier. Zho pondered on the humanity of the replicas, deciding that the Republic must understand them as humans, nurturing them instead of treating them like machines. When he returned to his meditation, he had a vision, seeing Thire, Jekko, and Rys in the future. Remembering how dangerous the visions of the future were, Zho ended his meditation, but could not let go of the discomfort of the vision.

#### The Malignar crisis

title: Zho
text:
#### The Malignar crisis

As the war progressed, the Fractio developed the Malignar , a heavy cruiser designed to incapacitate and destroy Republic vessels with its mega-ion cannons , which proceeded to destroy dozens of ships without leaving survivors. The Aetheri Council dispatched Aetheri Master Tor Vayne to track down the superweapon, but upon locating it, his fleet was ambushed and destroyed by the starship. Although Vayne and some replicas survived in an escape pod, Zho, alongside fellow Aetheri Drevan Koss and Orien Kade, forbade Kael Drayden and Sela Marr to search the system for survivors, citing the threat posed by the Malignar . Drayden and Marr, however, disregarded his warnings and successfully rescued Vayne. The Malignar was later destroyed by a concerted Republic assault.

#### Gunray's capture

Some time after the destruction of the Malignar , Commerce Combine Viceroy Nutis Gunray was captured by the Republic on the planet of Rodanor , but as he was being transported to Vantor aboard the cruiser Tranquility by Aetheri Master Luminara Undula and Sela Marr, a Dissident boarding party led by Kessa Vray freed the prisoner. Undula and Marr subsequently reported the loss of Gunray to Kael Drayden and Zho.

title: Zho
text:
#### The Zyll Beast

In the aftermath of the Battle of Malastare , Chancellor Mal ordered the Zyll Beast to be taken back to Vantor for study. However, the Zyll Beast escaped captivity and began to rampage through Vantor. Zho and Aetheri General Ciel Venn moved to aid Drayden, Kade, and Koss to recapture the beast. As gunships fired gas bombs in an attempt to pacify the beast, Zho, Venn, and Drayden used Synth Flux to prevent themselves and their companions from inhaling the gas. The Zyll Beast was eventually killed by the gas bombs.

### Facing the rising darkness

#### Attack on the Aetheri Sanctum

During the peak of the war, Barris Ovva with the help of Letta Turmond bombed the Aetheri Sanctum on Vantor. Zho then ordered Kael Drayden and his Adept Sela Marr to return from Cato Geltaria to help investigate, refusing to trust anyone who was in the temple during the bombing. Zho's judgement was clouded, but he still guided the Aetheri as the leader of the Council.

title: Zho
text: Turmond was captured by Drayden and Marr. In prison, she requested Marr speak with her, saying Marr was the only one she could trust. When Turmond was strangled to death by way of Synth Flux, Wilhard Varrix , who was serving as an admiral in the Republic Army, had Marr arrested, accusing her of being the mastermind responsible for the attack. Desperate to prove her innocence, Marr escaped the prison, resulting in a manhunt led by Kael Drayden and Captain Vek . During the chase, Marr lost her Shoto flux blade . After Marr fled to the Underworld, Zho ordered Drayden and Tor Vayne to track her down and bring her to the Temple, with some coalition from Drevan Koss, who felt that Drayden's emotional connection to Marr would only make things worse. Marr was quickly captured by Kessa Vray, who agreed to help the young Adept in exchange for a pardon for Vray' crimes as an Umbra. Marr contacted Barris Ovva at the Aetheri Sanctum. Ovva led Marr into a trap by telling her she could find evidence to prove her innocence by going to a warehouse on Level 1315. There, Ovva jumped Vray, stealing her flux blades and mask. She attacked Marr, knocking her out in front of crates of Nanodroids and effectively framing her for the bombing.

title: Zho
text:
Marr was then brought back to the Temple, where Zho and the rest of the Aetheri Council reluctantly agreed to expel her from the Aetheri Order and have her face a military tribunal before the Senate. Zho, Orien Kade, Tor Vayne and several other Council members were present in the court room, where Marr was prosecuted by Varrix and defended by Lira Ondar. However, before the jury could render its decision, Drayden burst in with Barris Ovva, who confessed to being responsible for the bombings and the framing of Marr. In light of this revelation, Zho, Drayden and the Council personally invited Marr to rejoin the Order, but to their shock, she refused and left. Zho would regret the Council's decision and began to question the doctrine of the war.

#### Biochip conspiracy

title: Zho
text:
#### Biochip conspiracy

Several years prior to the start of the war, Mal and his apprentice, Count Varek secretly created the Replica Army with the assistance of an unsuspecting Sifas Dyen, who had seen visions of a conflict beforehand. When this was done, they had organic inhibitor chips implanted in their brains, which would cause the replicas to do anything Mal told them to, in this case execute the Aetheri. With one simple command, the replicas would enter a trance-like state and perform whatever orders they were given.

During the Battle of Ringo Vindra , replica trooper Tupp murdered Aetheri Master Tiplar when his inhibitor chip was activated prematurely. Mal ordered Varek to apprehend Tupp to prevent the Aetheri from discovering the truth. Tupp was eventually sent to Gelvaris after Kael Drayden, Captain Vek and ARC trooper Fivva were able to recover Tupp from a Dissident Transport.

title: Zho
text:
After escorting Tupp to Gelvaris, Fivva and Vek were greeted by Aetheri Master Shaak Ti , alongside the main developer of the replicas, Gelvarian scientist Nalle Seris . Vek returned to Ringo Vindra while Fivva remained on Gelvaris to undergo examination in case of Fivva having a similar situation. Disputes over the tests led to a debate. While Shaak Ti advised a brain scan, Nalle Seris suggested terminating the replica and preforming an autopsy to isolate the case. Shaak Ti contacted the Aetheri Sanctum where Zho, alongside Orien Kade, decided Tupp should be brought to the temple to be examined through Synth Flux.

What the Aetheri were unaware of was that the Gelvarians knew of the inhibitor chips and were working with Count Varek, who used his Umbra name, Varek, to prevent the Aetheri from making the connection. Varek ordered that Tupp be terminated and that the chip be sent to him to be looked at.

title: Zho
text: Angry at Nalle Seris and Master Ti for their treatment of Tupp, Fivva escaped the medical center and embarked on his own plan. Fivva faked leaving the planet, but stayed to try and save Tupp and discover the truth. He and the medical droid AZI-3 were able to preform a brain scan on Tupp, where they learned of the inhibitor chips. Fivva had the droid take the chip out of his and Tupp's brains. Unfortunately, the already-weakened Tupp died soon after the operation, whispering his last words to Fivva. Fivva blamed Nalle Seris for what happened to Tupp. Suspecting the Gelvarians of treachery, and with the support of Master Ti, Fivva insisted on presenting his evidence and the removed chips directly to Mal. Fivva was eventually brought to Vantor, at the request of Shaak Ti, where he was brought before the Chancellor. As the ship landed, Nalle Seris drugged Fivva, causing him to act strange.

title: Zho
text:
When Fivva attempted to assassinate Mal, Zho was a part of the Aetheri Council that ordered Kael Drayden to investigate. Fivva was killed in the end, and Zho was ultimately told that the doctors had found another cause, and that a vaccination had been prepared in case of a future incident.

#### The mystery of Sifas Dyen

> " Know now we do that guide the creation of the replicas from the beginning, Varek did. Hm, our enemy created an army for us." "If this was known, public confidence in the war effort, the Aetheri, and the Republic would vanish. There would be mass chaos." "Cover up this discovery we must. No one, not even the Chancellor, may know. Valiant men the replicas have proven to be. Saved my life and yours they have many times. Believe in them we must. Win the war swiftly we must, before our enemy's designs reach completion, whatever they may be. " ―Zho and Drevan Koss

title: Zho
text:
Sometime later, the Aetheri received a distress signal from a moon near Oba Diah . Sending Tor Vayne and Commander Wolfe to investigate, they found the remains of a shuttle and the flux blade of Aetheri Master Sifas Dyen, who was killed sometime around the Battle of Ondara while dealing with a conflict on Feldora . Upon reviewing the temple archives, Jocasta Nura and the Aetheri found that the information had been sealed by order of the Supreme Chancellor. While sending Kael Drayden and his master, Orien Kade to Feldora, Zho went to speak with Mal, not knowing he was the Umbra Lord that orchestrated the murder and the creation of the replica army. Mal told Zho to visit Chancellor Valorum , as these events had happened before the vote of no confidence that led to Mal becoming chancellor. Mal then contacted Count Varek, telling him to destroy the last piece of the puzzle before the Aetheri would be able to unravel the mystery.

Kael and Orien attempted to communicate with the native tribe on the Feldora, but were unable to understand them. They did learn, however, that a second Aetheri had shown up with Sifas Dyen.

title: Zho
text:
Kael and Orien attempted to communicate with the native tribe on the Feldora, but were unable to understand them. They did learn, however, that a second Aetheri had shown up with Sifas Dyen.

Valorum told Zho that he had sent Sifas Dyen to negotiate with the Gruv Syndicate to stop a booming drug trade underneath Vantor. Valorum also revealed that he kept this secret, fearing his opponents in the bureaucracy. The talks were postponed after the Council sent Sifas Dyen to intervene on Feldora. Valorum was unable to identify the second Aetheri, but did say that his assistant, Silman , was with Sifas Dyen when he was shot down.

Eventually, Zho dispatched Kael and Orien to Oba Diah, where they learned the Pykes were paid to shoot down the ship carrying Sifas Dyen, but had kept Silman captive as leverage and that Varek was in fact the individual known as Varek, leading them to realize Varek impersonated Sifas Dyen to help push forward the Replica Wars. Zho, not knowing how to stop the plot, suggested the Aetheri keep the discovery a secret, and that they should keep playing the Umbra Lord's game.

#### Discovering immortality

title: Zho
text:
#### Discovering immortality

> " It is I, Sorin Vael. " " That cannot be. Dead, you are. " " No. I am part of the Living Synth Flux, Zho. " ― Sorin Vael communes to Zho

While meditating during the end of the war, Zho heard the voice of Sorin Vael, who demonstrated his presence by levitating Zho. The encounter left Zho distracted during the subsequent Council gathering, leaving them worried about whether the stresses of the war were finally taking its toll on him. While strolling through the Temple gardens, Zho was greeted by Kael. Zho asked him about his encounter with Sorin's spirit on Mournis , which Kael had dismissed as a trick, noting the Aetheri belief that one could not retain their identity after becoming one with Synth Flux. Zho responded that he now questioned this dogma.

title: Zho
text:
Zho confessed what happened to the Council, much to their disbelief. They agreed though to meditate with him, to verify his experience. Despite meditating together for an entire day, they were unable to hear anything. Reth-Oss-Van expressed worry that Zho had become susceptible to Umbra manipulation, so Zho underwent medical tests that revealed that he was still in good health. Aetheri Doctor Rig Nema suggested Zho undergo a deprivation ritual that would allow him to meditate more strongly and find the source of the voice.

Agreeing, Zho was suspended in a liquid tank with an oxygen mask to bring him as close as possible to death without actually becoming one with Synth Flux. While unconscious, Sorin's voice requested Zho go to Mirefall , and to tell no one about it. After, Orien broke open the tank due to his concern over Zho's failing life signs.

title: Zho
text:
Put on bedrest and under guard, Zho convinced Kael to help him escape by posing as simply accompanying each other for a walk. Guided to the Aetheri Sanctum Hangar, Kael lent Zho his astromech droid , Bolt-3 to accompany him to his personal interceptor . Zho and Bolt-3 flew to Mirefall, where Zho asked the droid to stay with their ship while he found a clearing to meditate.

Sorin's voice greeted him. Zho asked why he could not see him. Sorin explained he had not been fully trained enough to do so. The Living Synth Flux appeared to Zho in the form of fireflies , guiding Zho to a cave strong with the umbra side, it showed the Aetheri Master a vision of the future, where a hooded Umbra Lord slaughtered the Aetheri. Sorin explained to a distraught Zho that he would help him bring hope for the future, and directed him to the planet that spawned the synthcells .

title: Zho
text: Arriving there, Zho gave his flux blade to Bolt-3 for safekeeping, and descended into the world to meet Synth Flux Priestesses , who agreed to teach him how to achieve life after death. First, Zho confronted a manifestation of his own umbra side, conquering his hubris. Next, he witnessed a vision of the Aetheri massacred in the Temple, where an apparition of a dying Sela Marr asked him if she would still become one with Synth Flux after being expelled from the Aetheri Order; this vision was a manifestation of Zho's guilt over having placed Marr on the path that led to her departure. An apparition of Katooni then invited Zho to enter a peaceful courtyard to escape these painful events. Seeing Sorin Vael, Kade, Marr, and Varek together, alive and full Aetheri, Zho eventually recognized the vision's falsehood, overcoming its temptation and his attachment to those that have fallen.

title: Zho
text: Instructed to complete his tests on the Umbra homeworld of Moraband , Zho and Bolt-3 flew to the valley where the ancient Umbra Lords were buried. Recognizing the danger, Zho instructed Bolt-3 to return to the Aetheri Sanctum and inform the Council of what happened, if he did not come back after three nights. Specters of a serpent, undead Umbra warriors, and even Vael Vorek himself confronted him, but Zho brushed them off. As he entered a temple execution chamber , Synth Flux Priestesses warned Zho that whatever he encountered there would be beyond their control. Unknown to Zho, Vael Mal and Varek sensed his presence on Moraband, and met in an abandoned tower in the industrial sector of Vantor. Using Varek and Zho's Synth Flux-bond , Mal planned to reach out to Zho and crush his spirit. Appearing in a vision to Zho in the form of Sifas Dyen, Mal temped Zho, until the Grandmaster rejected him. The Dark Lord then had Zho wake up in a Republic attack gunship with Kael and members of the 501st Legion , en route to terminate the Umbra on Vantor. As they arrived, the replicas, led by Captain Vek, rushed at Varek only to be killed with Umbra lightning. Drayden immediately attacked Varek while Mal fled. Walking sadly past the fallen replicas, a dismayed Zho witnessed Drayden defeat Varek and brutally decapitate him. However, he left Drayden and pursued Mal.

title: Zho
text: Emerging out on a catwalk, Zho and Mal dueled. Drayden tried to help, but Mal knocked him out. Sensing an opportunity, Mal damaged the catwalk, forcing Zho to divide his attention between Synth Flux-lifting Drayden to save him from falling to his death and blocking Mal' Umbra lightning. After Mal taunted him by suggesting he sacrifice Drayden to concentrate on defeating him, Zho put down his flux blade to ensure Drayden's safety and saying he would not be tempted by Mal. As the catwalk collapsed, Zho maneuvered Drayden to safety, then Synth Flux-threw his blade to ensure the Umbra would fall and grabbed Mal, dragging him down too. Zho tore Mal's hood off, seeking his identify, but in the vision world only seeing a shadow, then an empty robe, before both fell to their "doom." The incident proved Zho's selflessness and demonstrated his resolve to Mal, who concluded the illusion as he realized it would take more to defeat or taint the Aetheri Master.

title: Zho
text:
Zho awoke and was greeted by a Priestess who explained he would continue his training with Sorin's spirit. As she disappeared in a glow of light, Zho had a vision of the future, including his own death. Zho returned to the Aetheri Sanctum, where Koss and Kade greeted him in the garden. Zho claimed his journey had been uneventful, but wondered how long the Aetheri could resist the umbra side during the war.

#### Uthara crystal crisis and Thornwood defense

Following the death of Master Tu-Anh on the sinkhole world of Uthara , Zho and his fellow Aetheri Council members sent Master Kade and Kael on a mission to investigate her death. They discovered that she had been investigating Dissident efforts to excavate and obtain a giant kyber crystal on Uthara. After destroying the crystal and thus denying the Dissidents access to the weapon, Zho was present at a Council meeting when the two Aetheri gave a report of the events on Uthara. During the meeting, Zho recounted how the ancient Umbra had constructed superweapons using massive kyber crystals to power them up. He feared that Varek's mysterious master Vael Mal had similar intentions.

title: Zho
text:
Zho traveled to the defense of Thornwood and helped fight off Dissident raiders who threatened the Voraks. In addition to having been granted the title due to his negotiations with the Trandoshans, Zho was granted the Defender of the Home Tree title for his help in protecting the planet.

#### The plan to assassinate Count Varek

> " One, there is, who has tried and failed. Yet closer has she come than any other to killing Count Varek. " " You can't possibly mean Vray! " ―Zho and Orien Kade #### The plan to assassinate Count Varek

> " One, there is, who has tried and failed. Yet closer has she come than any other to killing Count Varek. " " You can't possibly mean Vray! " ―Zho and Orien Kade

Zho and his fellow Aetheri Council members witnessed Count Varek's devastating attack on Mahranee , the home world of the Mahran species, via hologram. The Council was reluctant to condone an assassination, but ultimately concluded that killing Varek was necessary to end the war and prevent more deaths. The Council decided to use Master Daren Kelv, who had considerable experience with undercover work, to assassinate the Dissident leader. When Vossa suggested that a partner accompany him, Zho recommended Kessa Vray, Varek's former Umbra apprentice and a Nightsister for that mission, knowing her hatred for Varek. Vray agreed to assist Vossa with his mission but insisted that he had to learn the ways of the umbra side.

title: Zho
text: Despite their preparation, Vossa and Vray were bested by Varek and Skarn, who took Vossa captive. Varek then managed to bring Vossa over to the umbra side by revealing that Vray had murdered his late Master, Tholme . After Vossa spurned Vray' offer to rescue him, he became Varek's newest Umbra apprentice and assumed the persona of " Admiral Enigma." Vray informed Master Kade who conveyed the news to his fellow Council members including Zho. For the next several months, Admiral Enigma scored several victories for the Dissident cause. When Vossa' old friend Akar-Deshu , a Mahran Aetheri, brought Vray into a Council meeting to discuss rescuing Vossa, Zho and Kade spoke up for Vray when Koss wanted to arrest her. During the proceedings, Zho and his fellow Aetheri learned that Vray had instructed Vossa in the umbra side in order to defeat Varek. While Koss was suspicious of Vray, Zho and Kade were convinced that she genuinely cared for Vossa and that she had rejected the Umbra ways for good. After sending Vray along with Desh and Kael outside, Zho and his fellow Aetheri debated whether to include Vray in their rescue mission. When Master Kade suggested leading the operation to rescue Vossa, Zho accepted Kade's offer and also argued that Vray was key to the rescue mission. He also recommended that Kade take both Vray and his former Adept Drayden along for the mission.

title: Zho
text:
After receiving intelligence from Admiral Wulric Yular that Count Varek and "Admiral Enigma" were planning to attack Tarisa , the Aetheri Council decided that they had to move quickly to rescue Quilav. In the end, the Council decided to offer Vray a pardon for all her crimes in return for rescuing Vossa. The rescue mission was a success and the Aetheri succeeded in recovering Vossa alive. To reward her services, Vray was formally pardoned. Unknown to Zho and his colleagues, Vossa had become a Dissident double agent in order to gain Varek's trust so that he could learn the identity of Vael Mal and destroy the Umbra once and for all.

Using his position in the Aetheri Order, Vossa leaked intelligence about Aetheri and Republic military operations to Count Varek; allowing the Dissidents to undermine these operations. After several Council members voiced their suspicions about Vossa' true loyalties, Zho had a personal meeting with Vossa and was able to deduce that Quilav had fallen to the umbra side. To test Vossa' loyalties, the Aetheri Council sent him to assassinate Varek, but secretly sent Kade and Drayden to tail him.

title: Zho
text:
Vossa managed to defeat Varek in flux blade combat , but did not kill him. When Vossa demanded that Varek lead him to Vael Mal, Kade and Drayden promptly revealed themselves and arrested the two men. After learning of Vossa and Varek's arrest, Master Zho ordered Kade to bring them back to the Aetheri Sanctum where they would be interrogated and executed for their crimes. However, Vossa and Varek escaped with the unwitting help of Vray, leading to the events of the second battle of Krestophis . In the end, Vray helped Vossa return to the light side , but was seemingly killed by Varek. Kade and Drayden then recaptured Vossa and brought him back to Vantor.

After Vossa confessed all his crimes and explained his motivations to destroy the Umbra, Zho and his fellow Council members accepted Vossa' repentance as genuine and pardoned him. Kade, who believed that the order to assassinate Varek was morally wrong and responsible for Vossa' fall to the umbra side, took on the responsibility of monitoring Vossa during his rehabilitation. Kade accompanied Vossa to Gloomreach for Vray' funeral.

#### Last days of the Replica Wars

title: Zho
text:
#### Last days of the Replica Wars

> " I sense a plot to destroy the Aetheri. The Umbra side of Synth Flux surrounds the Chancellor. [...] The Aetheri Council would have to take control of the Senate in order to secure a peaceful transition. " " To a dark place this line of thought will carry us. Great care we must take. " ―Koss and Zho

Three years after the initial battle on Pyralis, the Republic was crumbling under the attacks of the Fractio. Throughout the course of the war, Mal had been granted ever increasing personal authority by the Senate to command both the war and the Republic at large. The Aetheri Council, though reluctant to oppose the extremely popular Chancellor, nonetheless grew ever more concerned about the continual centralization of political power in Mal. A Dissident attack on the Republic capital world of Vantor was launched by General Skarn as well, with Zho taking part in the defense of Vantor. Zho used Synth Flux to make enemy craft collide with each other.

title: Zho
text: Shortly after the battle, Drayden came before Zho, seeking counsel. He had been experiencing terrifying visions of the death of a loved one, though he did not reveal that the one in question was his secret wife, Lira Ondar. Zho warned Drayden to be wary of his visions and of his own feelings, as fear was a path to the umbra side, and advised him to "train himself to let go of everything he feared to lose." Drayden, however, was dissatisfied with this answer, as he could not bear the thought of losing someone he loved. Shortly afterwards, Mal, hoping to increase his influence over the Aetheri Council and further ingratiate himself with Kael Drayden, appointed the young Aetheri to be his personal representative on the Council. The Council, having little choice, begrudgingly accepted Mal's interference, but refused to grant Drayden the rank of Aetheri Master, infuriating him. Additionally, the Council gave Drayden the unofficial assignment of spying on Mal, an assignment which Drayden was less than enthusiastic about, as he regarded Mal as a friend and a mentor.

title: Zho
text: Following Drayden's appointment, the Council chose to take action to avert an imminent Dissident invasion of Thornwood. Zho chose to personally oversee the defense, as he was held in high esteem by the Voraks. Before leaving for the planet, Zho discussed with Orien and Koss about Kael's assignment. Kade expressed his former Adept's disagreement, and asked if he was not going to fulfill the prophecy when Koss doubted his abilities. Zho suggested that it could've been misread, but Orien believed they would not be let down, which Zho hoped would be true. On Thornwood, Zho participated in a holographic session of the Council, where he learned from Drayden that Republic intelligence located the fugitive General Skarn in the Uthara system . When Kael volunteered to lead the campaign, with the stated approval of Mal, Zho and Drevan both disagreed, and Zho nominated Kade to be sent instead. Agreeing with the Grand Master, fellow council member Reth-Oss-Van seconded the nomination and the decision was made. Zho left the call and was approached by Commander Grev, who told him that the droids had started their power generators. Zho ordered his troops to prepare, and soon after the battle began. He observed the battle from above when a shot almost hit him.

title: Zho
text: Later, on a meeting in the Temple's war room with Koss, Kael, Mundi, and Ciel Venn, they were interrupted by Commander Cord, who informed that General Kade had engaged Skarn and that the battle had begun on Uthara. Drayden was then sent to deliver the message to Mal, since his reaction to this news could give the Council clues about his intentions. After Kael left, Drevan informed the other Aetheri that he felt a plot to destroy the Order, and that the Chancellor was surrounded by the umbra side. Mundi and Koss suggested to take control over the Senate in case Mal did not abide of his emergency powers, though Zho expressed that this would lead them to a "dark path", and that they would need to be careful.

title: Zho
text: Right afterwards, Sela Marr and Commander Vek joined the call. She revealed that they successfully captured Vreth on Ferrum and that he would be delivered to Vantor by them, which Zho considered a great service. Sela stated she did her duty as a citizen, but when Zho asked if it was not as an Aetheri, she simply said that "not yet". Marr wanted to speak with Drayden, but since he had left, Koss and Zho explained Orien's situation to her. When she realized the war could end soon, Koss retorted that it would depend on Mal, but refused to explain more to her, which did not sit well with Zho. As the members of the call left, Zho stayed and asked Sela if she had anything else to say, and after a brief silence, she confirmed she would tell the information to Kael himself. Zho then said "May Synth Flux be with you, Adept." and ended his transmission.

title: Zho
text:
As the battle on Thornwood continued, Supreme Chancellor Mal revealed his true identity as the Umbra Lord Vael Mal, killed a group of Aetheri Council members who had come to arrest him, and with his offers of dark knowledge, turned Kael Drayden to the umbra side of Synth Flux. When Mal bestowed the name of Xarn Velgor to Drayden, Zho felt the moment through Synth Flux.

#### Directive 66

> " How many other Aetheri have managed to survive? " " Heard from no one have we. " ―Orien Kade and Zho, after Directive 66

Christening his newfound apprentice Xarn Velgor, Mal sent him and part of the 501st Legion to attack the Aetheri Sanctum and slaughter all who resided there. Meanwhile, Mal began to broadcast Directive 66 to the replica troopers, a contingency order that required them to eliminate their Aetheri Generals, which the replica complied to due to the activation of their biochips.

title: Zho
text:
As the replica army betrayed and turned on their leaders galaxy-wide, Zho sensed the deaths of his fellow Aetheri and fell to his knees. Commander Grev and Captain Jekko received Directive 66 a few moments afterwards and prepared to shoot Zho. However, Zho sensed their intentions and decapitated the duo with his flux blade. He then proceeded to escape with the help of the Voraks Brevok and Tarfful in a Vorak escape pod , rendezvousing with Senator Bael Solen of Cindervale and Orien Kade, who had escaped death on Uthara. The two Aetheri discussed their situation, during which Bael and Zho informed Kade that the Temple was broadcasting a coded retreat message, ordering all surviving Aetheri to return to Vantor. Zho and Kade decided to return to the Temple and reconfigure the beacon to warn any survivors to go into hiding, and to that end Bael took them to Vantor. The two Aetheri fought their way in and witnessed the effects of the rampage by Velgor and his replica unit, including the visible flux blade cuts on several dead Aetheri. In the meantime, Mal, as Mal, reforms the Republic into the first Imperium with himself as its Emperor. That was the beginning of the Age of the Imperium.

### The Age of the Imperium

#### Duel in the Senate

> " I have waited a long time for this moment, my little green friend… at last, the Aetheri are no more. " " Not if anything to say about it, I have! […] At an end your rule is, and not short enough it was. " ―Vael Mal and Zho

title: Zho
text: Having recalibrated the signal, Kade wished to learn the identity of the one responsible for the massacre. Zho, aware that watching recordings of their fellow Aetheri being slaughtered would cause Kade pain, cautioned him before the younger Aetheri activated the security recordings. The duo thus learned of Kael Drayden's fall to the umbra side, his Umbra title of Xarn Velgor, Mal's Umbra identity and the formation of the Imperium from the Republic. Agreeing that the two Umbra had to be destroyed, Zho headed to the Galactic Senate to confront the Emperor, while a deeply reluctant Kade departed to the volcanic planet of Emberfall to face his former apprentice.

title: Zho
text: Upon arriving into the Chancellery Secretariat , Zho confronted the Emperor, who surprised the Aetheri and rendered him briefly unconscious with a burst of Synth Flux lightning. As Mal boasted how he came to eradicate the Aetheri Order, Zho managed to wake up and slammed his opponent into a wall. Mal attempted to depart, but was barred by Zho. The duo then drew their flux blades and engaged in a fierce duel that soon continued into the central auditorium of the Senate Building, driving the Umbra back to his speaking pod. Briefly separated from Zho, Mal launched the numerous Senate hoverpods at his opponent, but the Aetheri nevertheless managed to catch up with him, engaging him at close quarters again with his flux blade drawn. Mal then blasted Zho with a burst of Synth Flux lightning which tore Zho's flux blade from his hand, but which the Aetheri proceeded to successfully deflect with his bare palms . Zho slowly redirected Mal's synth flux lighting at him, appearing to give the Aetheri Master the upper hand. However, the buildup of energy subsequently triggered an explosion that blew both combatants apart and caused Zho to fall to the bottom of the chamber,

title: Zho
text: successfully deflect with his bare palms . Zho slowly redirected Mal's synth flux lighting at him, appearing to give the Aetheri Master the upper hand. However, the buildup of energy subsequently triggered an explosion that blew both combatants apart and caused Zho to fall to the bottom of the chamber, while Mal was thrown out of the pod but managed to barely hold on to one of its guardrails, gaining the high ground. Despite neither conquering the other, Zho realized he had been defeated, which prompted the Aetheri Master to flee through the maintenance tunnels of the building. He then contacted Solen to rescue him via his airspeeder, considering the duel his personal failure and voicing his intent to go into self-imposed exile .

title: Zho
text:
#### Exile

> " Into exile I must go. Failed, I have. " ―Zho, to Bael Solen

After being rescued by Solen, the two proceeded to the asteroid Polis Massa , where Zho conferred with Sorin Vael's spirit, who offered him to train him in techniques that could help him retain his identity after his death. Orien Kade, having defeated but not killed Velgor on Emberfall, arrived soon thereafter, bringing with him the dying Senator Ondar. She gave birth to her twins from Kael Drayden and named them Joren and Elira before her death.

Sensing the children's power in Synth Flux, Zho, Kade and Solen decided to keep them hidden in unsuspecting locations to avoid detection by the Imperium; Joren Drayden was delivered to the Havel family on Dunemere, while Solen personally adopted his sister, Elira. As the trio prepared to go their separate ways, Zho asked Kade for a moment of his time. He revealed that he had training for him during his solitude on Dunemere, and that Sorin Vael had reached the path to immortality , having returned from the Netherworld of Synth Flux . Zho decided he would teach Kade to communicate with Vael.

title: Zho
text: Using an E3-standard starship lifeboat , Zho returned to Mirefall to begin his own exile where he waited for the twins to grow up and continued his studies of Synth Flux. The lifeboat served as Zho's initial shelter but it started to degrade within a year due to Mirefall's swampy environment. As the first shelter was slowly consumed by the swamp, Zho built a new home for himself. He positioned it near to the umbra side cave but out of range of its influence and would visit every few years. Furthermore, Zho's light side presence on Mirefall kept the Cave in check, holding the Cave's dark influence back and, in doing so, keeping the Mirefall ecosystem in balance. However, the Mirefall wet season created a need for the Aetheri Master to regularly relocate to the planet's highlands for the duration. Following the destruction of the Aetheri Order, Zho was listed as one of the Warden Order ' priority targets amongst presumed survivors of the Great Aetheri Purge .

title: Zho
text:
Around a year after Directive 66, Marr was hiding on the world of Thabeska , where she had met a Synth Flux-sensitive child named Hedala Fardi . Despite her young age, the child proved to be wise, and Marr was upset that Fardi would likely never be able to prove her wisdom to Zho. Later, while sleeping aboard the CR90 corvette Tantiva IV after Solen offered her a chance to join his insurgency , Marr remembered Zho's advice to her when she was getting her first kyber crystal. Awaking and knowing she should make a new set of flux blades , she thanked Zho, even though she knew he could not possibly hear or help her.

#### Helping the Shades

title: Zho
text:
#### Helping the Shades

> " Master Zho, you're powerful. You must know a way to destroy Velgor and his Inqusitors. " " Adept, thousands of Aetheri once there were. Then came war. In our arrogance, join the conflict swiftly we did. Fear, anger, hate. Consumed by the umbra side, the Aetheri were. " " Was it wrong for the Aetheri to fight? Is it wrong for me to protect my friends? " " Wrong? Hmm. A long time, fought I did. Consumed by fear, I was, though see it I did not. " " You were afraid? " " Yes, afraid. Hmm, surprised are you? A challenge lifelong it is, not to bend fear into anger. " ― Cass Virel consults Zho through Synth Flux

title: Zho
text: During his exile on Mirefall, Zho kept an eye on other Aetheri throughout the galaxy, including those who ventured into the various Aetheri Temples found amongst the stars. Approximately four years before the Battle of Cinderfall , Zho spoke to Brenn Aldric, who had been the Adept of Depa Billaba and a survivor of Directive 66. Aldric had traveled to the Aetheri Sanctum on the planet Lorath with his own Adept, Cass Virel , to whom Zho also spoke. Virel was in the temple in order to overcome his greatest fears; Zho acted as an anonymous guide in helping Virel do so and to understand why he wanted to become an Aetheri and how to withdraw from the anger and the wish of revenge within him. This guidance led Virel to receive a kyber crystal, which he used to build his own flux blade . Meanwhile, Zho counseled Aldric about Aldric' insecurities as a teacher.

title: Zho
text:
The year after, Aldric and Virel returned to the Lorath Temple with Sela Marr in search of a way to defeat the Warden Order. Zho cast an illusion of the Aetheri Sanctum Guard for Aldric, including the Grand Warden as he was before the Aetheri Purge. The Warden forced Aldric to recognize his fears and knighted him a true Aetheri. Meanwhile, Virel pleaded with Zho for help: though still filled with fear and shame and thus disinterested in fighting the Imperium before training a new Drayden, the Aetheri Master ultimately rendered aid and directed him to go to Searmark . When the other Wardens arrived, Zho used the Temple Guard to distract them as the Aetheri escaped. As she fled, Marr turned back and saw Zho, who smiled and waved at her: she smiled back being the last time they saw each other.

#### The last Aetheri

title: Zho
text:
#### The last Aetheri
